prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent 2dust/v2rayNG release stream from version 2.0.1 through 2.2.3, covering Hysteria2 refactoring, xray core updates, TLS configuration changes, new features like strategy groups and WebDAV backup, and eventual deprecation of allowInsecure.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the 2dust/v2rayNG release 2.0.1, the Hysteria2 implementation was refactored to use xray core, and the plugin version was removed. Additionally, issues reported in discussion #5157 were fixed.

In the 2dust/v2rayNG release 2.0.7, issues reported in discussion #5157 were fixed. TLS certificate fingerprint support was added. Strategy group types now include random and round-robin.

In the 2dust/v2rayNG release 2.0.8, issues reported in discussion #5157 were fixed. The xray configuration was updated to follow xray-core v26.2.6. A special note warns that xray core TLS will remove the allowInsecure configuration option; users should use pinnedPeerCertSha256 instead, which supports sharing, and the logs will provide clear prompts.

In the 2dust/v2rayNG release 2.0.9, issues reported in discussion #5157 were fixed. The xray configuration was updated to follow xray-core v26.2.6. A special note warns that xray core TLS will remove the allowInsecure configuration option; users should use pinnedPeerCertSha256 instead, which supports sharing, and the logs will provide clear prompts.

In the 2dust/v2rayNG release 2.0.11, issues reported in discussion #5157 were fixed. The xray configuration was updated to follow xray-core v26.2.6. A default group was added, and a setting to enable all groups was introduced (disabled by default). A special note warns that xray core TLS will remove the allowInsecure configuration option; users should use pinnedPeerCertSha256 instead, which supports sharing, and the logs will provide clear prompts.

In the 2dust/v2rayNG release 2.0.12, issues reported in discussion #5157 were fixed. The notification message after subscription update was optimized. A special note warns that xray core TLS will remove the allowInsecure configuration option; users should use pinnedPeerCertSha256 instead, which supports sharing.

In the 2dust/v2rayNG release 2.0.13, the minimum Android version was raised to 7.0 and the target Android version updated to Android 16. New features include Material Design 3 adaptation, strategy group functionality with smart server selection (minimum latency, minimum load, random, round-robin), WebDAV remote backup, a new tabbed main interface for grouping by subscription, an independent backup management interface, Xray native TUN support (v26.2.6), and removal of badvpn-tun2socks. Improvements include accelerated batch speed tests, real-time progress display during speed tests, automatic cleanup of invalid configurations after speed tests, automatic sorting by latency after speed tests, ECH support, optimized dark mode, display of last subscription update time, refactored Hysteria2 using xray core with plugin version removed, TLS certificate fingerprint addition, and optimized subscription update notification. Important notes: this is a major version update, backup is recommended before updating; xray core TLS will remove allowInsecure, use pinnedPeerCertSha256 instead, which supports sharing.

In the 2dust/v2rayNG release 2.0.14, issues reported in discussion #5157 were fixed. When routing rules contain geoip:cn and geoip:private, geoip-only-cn-private.dat is loaded to reduce memory usage. The default group retention logic was improved so that the default group can be deleted when other subscription groups exist.
In the 2dust/v2rayNG release 2.0.15, issues reported in discussion #5157 were fixed. Pull-down subscription update and a locate selected server function were added.
In the 2dust/v2rayNG release 2.0.16, issues reported in discussion #5157 were fixed. The search function was changed to regex mode. The xray-core version was updated to v26.3.23.
In the 2dust/v2rayNG release 2.0.17, issues reported in discussion #5157 were fixed. The xray-core version was updated to v26.3.27.

In the 2dust/v2rayNG release 2.0.18, issues reported in discussion #5157 were fixed. The xray-core version was updated to v26.3.27. The locate action was moved from the FAB to the menu. Finalmask support was added. New Hysteria2 fragment structure support was added.

In the 2dust/v2rayNG release 2.1.0, local SOCKS username/password support was added. A dynamic local SOCKS port option was added. Process-based (package name) routing support was added, available only when using Xray TUN with routeOnly enabled on Android 10+. Outbound alias support in routing was added, enabling traffic splitting to different servers when using Xray TUN. A launcher shortcut to start/stop the service was added. An enable IPv6 option was added, distinct from IPv6 priority. The xray-core version was updated to v26.4.15.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent yt-dlp/yt-dlp release stream from early 2025 through early 2026, covering core changes, extractor updates, and important deprecations and security fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.02.19
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.02.19, core changes include improvements to jsinterp with the addition of js_number_to_string and better zeroise handling. Extractor changes add support for acast shows.acast.com URLs, fix cwtv extraction, add movie extractor for cwtv, add digiview extractor, fix dropbox extraction, fix francetv site and livestream extraction, fix francetvinfo.fr extractor, fix gem.cbc.ca extractors, and extract live_status for DASH manifest URLs in the generic extractor.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.03.21
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.03.21, core changes fix external downloader availability when using --ffmpeg-location, implement on-demand plugin loading, and support emitting ConEmu progress codes. Extractor changes fix azmedien, bilibiliplaylist, add bunnycdn extractor, add canalsurmas extractor, fix cda login support, extend cultureunplugged _VALID_URL, improve dailymotion embed detection, fix gem.cbc.ca login support, and other fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.03.25
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.03.25, core changes fix an attribute error on failed VT init and make the js_to_json utility function less fatal. Extractor changes fix sorting of HLS audio formats by GROUP-ID, add 17live vod extractor, fix 9now.com.au extractor, fix chzzk video extraction, remove deezer extractors, fix generic MPD base URL parsing, add streaks extractor, fix tver extractor, and remove viki extractors.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.03.26
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.03.26, extractor changes for youtube fix signature and nsig extraction for player 4fcd6e4a and only cache nsig code on successful decoding.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.03.27
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.03.27, core changes in jsinterp fix nested attributes and object extraction. Extractor changes for youtube make signature and nsig extraction more robust.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.03.31
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.03.31, core changes add --compat-options 2024. Extractor changes add francaisfacile extractor, validate response before checking m3u8 live status in generic, extract more formats from microsoftlearnepisode, fix mlbtv radio-only extraction, support mainEvent URLs in on24, fix sbs subtitles extraction, rename stvr extractor from RTVS to STVR, extract portrait formats from twitch clips, add player_js_variant extractor-arg for youtube, and fix youtube tab playlist continuation extraction.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.04.30
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.04.30, important changes add the new --preset-alias/-t option with presets like mp4, mp3, mkv, aac, and sleep. Core changes add the --preset-alias option, make _yield_json_ld less fatal, and support WebSocket URLs in url_or_none. Extractor changes fix abematv thumbnail extraction, rework atresplayer extractor, fix bpb formats extraction, fix cda formats extraction, extend cdafolder _VALID_URL, make crowdbunker format extraction non-fatal, support tokenized URLs in dacast, and other fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.05.22
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.05.22, core changes fix Linux desktop environment detection in cookies and fix increment/decrement evaluation in jsinterp. Extractor changes fix 1tv, amcnetworks, bitchute, remove cartoonnetwork extractor, fix iprima login support, add jiosaavn artist, playlist, and show extractors, fix lrtradio extractor, support --mark-watched in nebula, and other fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.06.09
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.06.09, extractor changes improve JSON LD thumbnails extraction, fix 10play extractor, add Fubo MSO to adobepass, always add newer user-agent when required, fix Philo MSO authentication, rework adobepass to require software statement, validate login URL before sending credentials, fix aenetworks playlist extractors and provider-locked content extraction, fix bilibilibangumi extractor, adapt brightcove new to new AdobePass requirement, and other fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.06.25
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.06.25, extractor changes add _search_nuxt_json helper, improve brightcove new metadata extraction, fix huya live extractor, improve hypergryph metadata extraction, fix lsm extractors, add mave extractor, fix sportdeutschland extractor, fix sproutvideo extractor, support slugless URLs in tv8.it, check any ios m3u8 formats prior to download in youtube, and improve youtube player context payloads.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.06.30
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.06.30, core changes fix extract_object in jsinterp. Extractor changes extract hidden-mode collections as playlists in bilibilispacevideo, fix hotstar extractor and metadata extraction, raise for login required, fix hotstar series extractor, remove jiocinema extractors, support subscriber-only content in kick, fix niconico live extractor and downloader, add sauceplus extractor, and other fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.07.21
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.07.21, important changes switch default behaviour from --mtime to --no-mtime, fix CVE-2025-54072 for --exec placeholder expansion on Windows, and properly escape filepath from {} on Windows. Core changes allow extractors to designate formats/subtitles for impersonation, don't let format testing alter return code, fix --exec placeholder expansion on Windows, no longer enable --mtime by default, warn when skipping formats, cache undefined variable names in jsinterp, fix variable scoping in jsinterp, and always parse flac from audio/flac in mimetype2ext.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.08.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.08.11, important changes raise the minimum recommended Python version to 3.10, discontinue darwin_legacy_exe builds, and discontinue linux_armv7l_exe builds. Core changes deprecate darwin_legacy_exe and linux_armv7l_exe support, raise minimum recommended Python version to 3.10, warn when yt-dlp is severely outdated, load cookies with float expires timestamps, add WINDOWS_VT_MODE to globals, support width-only pattern in parse_resolution, and bump versions in random_user_agent. Extractor changes fix archive.org metadata extraction and other fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.08.20
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.08.20, core changes warn against using -f mp4 and add improved jwt_encode function. Extractor changes extract avif storyboard formats from MPD manifests, do not assume age_limit is 0 in _rta_search, fix adobetv extractor, handle Bangumi redirection in bilibili, add faulio extractor, fix francetv site extractor, rework medialaan extractors, overhaul mtv extractors, support age-restricted streams in niconico live, and other fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.08.22
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.08.22, core changes fix --cookies-from-browser with Firefox 142+. Extractor changes fix mediaklikk extractor, fix steam extractors, improve tv client context in youtube, optimize playback wait times in youtube, replace ios with tv_simply in default clients for youtube, and update tv client config for youtube. Misc changes include post-release workflow cleanup.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.08.27
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.08.27, extractor changes simplify invalid URL error message in generic, use https as fallback protocol in generic, support wav files in skeb, add tcc player JS variant in youtube, deprioritize web_safari m3u8 formats in youtube, perform player client maintenance in youtube, and use alternative tv user-agent when authenticated in youtube.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.09.05
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.09.05, core changes fix --id deprecation warning. Extractor changes fix charlierose extractor, fix googledrive subtitles extraction, fix itvbtcc extractor, support ongoing livestream VODs in kick vod, fix lrt extractors, extract more metadata in tver, and restore vevo extractors. Misc changes overhaul Linux builds and refactor release workflow.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.09.23
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.09.23, important changes deprecate several options to simplify the codebase. Core changes add compat_datetime_from_timestamp, recognize vnd.dlna.mpeg-tts in mimetype2ext, and bump versions in random_user_agent. Extractor changes fix 10play extractor, fix applepodcast extractor, fix loco extractor, remove mitele extractor, warn when only preview is available in newspicks, add onsen extractor, and other fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.09.26
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.09.26, extractor changes fix twitch vod live_status detection, fix youtube player JS overrides, improve PO token logging in youtube, perform player client maintenance in youtube, and replace tv_simply with web_safari in default clients for youtube.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.10.14
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.10.14, core changes fix prefer-vp9-sort compat option. Extractor changes handle geo-restriction errors in 10play, rework 10play extractor, support listen URLs in abc.net.au, add cbc.ca listen extractor, update dropout extractor for new domain, add idagio extractors, fix musescore extractor, rework prankcastpost extractor, fix slideslive extractor, support new API URLs in soundcloud, and other fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.10.22
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.10.22, important changes provide a stopgap release with a temporary partial fix for YouTube support, note that some formats may still be unavailable, and raise the minimum required Python version to 3.10. Core changes remove Python 3.9 support. Extractor changes rework appleconnect extractor, support URLs with country codes in idagio, rework tvnoe extractor, and use temporary player client workaround for youtube. Misc changes include cleanup and docs update.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.11.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.11.12, important changes require an external JavaScript runtime (e.g. Deno) for full YouTube support. Core changes allow --cookies-from-browser for Safari on iOS, support Firefox cookies database v17, add hook category to sponsorblock, and fix PyInstaller onedir variant detection in update. Extractor changes add 1tv live extractor, add ardaudiothek extractors, fix bunnycdn extractor and support player subdomain URLs, fix discoverynetworksde extraction, and other fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2025.12.08
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2025.12.08, core changes respect PATHEXT when locating JS runtime on Windows and fix --cookies-from-browser for new installs of Firefox 147+. Extractor changes add agalega extractor, add alibaba extractor, add bitmovin extractor, rework digiteka extractor, raise appropriate error when stream is offline in fc2 live, add subtitle support in floatplane, fix jtbc extractor, fix loom extractor, and other fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2026.01.29
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2026.01.29, core changes accept float values for --sleep-subtitles, add --compat-options 2025, add --format-sort-reset option, bypass interactive format selection if no formats are found, fix --parse-metadata when TO is a single field name, fix concurrent formats downloading to stdout, fix interactive format/video selection when downloading to stdout, support Deno installed via Python package, fix missing key handling in decode_packed_codes, fix calling reviver on cached values in devalue, and other fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2026.01.31
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2026.01.31, extractor changes support subscription-only VODs in soop, update unsupported URLs, extract more metadata in whyp, add web_embedded fallback for android_vr client in youtube, remove broken ios_downgraded player client in youtube, and remove broken tv_embedded player client in youtube. Misc changes include cleanup.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2026.02.04
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2026.02.04, extractor changes update unsupported URLs and default to tv player JS variant in youtube.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2026.02.21
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2026.02.21, important changes fix CVE-2026-26331 for arbitrary command injection with the --netrc-cmd option by limiting the argument to safe characters. Core changes ignore cookies with control characters, fix bitwise operations in jsinterp, stringify bracket notation keys in object access in jsinterp, and support string concatenation with + and += in jsinterp. Extractor changes add browser impersonation support to more extractors, limit netrc_machine parameter to shell-safe characters, extract chapters in 1tv, fix aenetworks extractor, fix applepodcasts extractor, and other fixes.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2026.03.03
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2026.03.03, extractor changes fix aenetworks extraction, fix patreon extractors, rework thechosen extractor, force player 9f4cc5e4 in youtube, skip webpage player response by default in youtube, and improve zapiks extraction.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2026.03.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2026.03.13, extractor changes fix tiktok challenge solving, fix android_vr player client in youtube, fix use_ad_playback_context extractor-arg in youtube, fix web_embedded player client in youtube, request web_safari & web_creator client configs in youtube, update ejs to 0.7.0 in youtube, fix album extraction in youtube tab, and improve description extraction in youtube tab.

chunks.title: yt-dlp 2026.03.17
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release 2026.03.17, extractor changes for youtube always respect webpage_client extractor-arg, fix --live-from-start support, and update ejs to 0.8.0. Misc changes use PyInstaller v6.19.0 for Windows, bump actions pins, fix player_client extractor-arg documentation, and mark all CurlCFFIRH tests as flaky for any OS.

2025.03.26 adds a new extractor for YouTube, while 2025.03.27 removes an extractor.
Both releases only update the YouTube player client without extraction changes.
2025.03.26 deprecates the YouTube extractor, while 2025.03.27 restores it.

questions.query_text: In the yt-dlp/yt-dlp release window, order the following release-content states from earliest to latest: (1) a release that adds the --preset-alias option, (2) a release that raises the minimum recommended Python version to 3.10, (3) a release that requires an external JavaScript runtime for full YouTube support.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent Aider-AI/aider release stream from v0.57.0 through v0.86.0, covering new model support, editing features, and developer experience improvements.

chunks.title: Aider v0.57.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.57.0, support for OpenAI o1 models is introduced, with o1-preview working well with the diff edit format and matching SOTA leaderboard results. New shortcuts 'aider --model o1-mini' and 'aider --model o1-preview' are available. On Windows, /run correctly uses PowerShell or cmd.exe. Support for new 08-2024 Cohere models is added. Recursive directory addition with /read-only is now possible. User input prompts fall back to simple input() if --no-pretty or a Windows console is not available. Git repo sanity check on startup is improved, along with prompt cache chunking strategy. The message 'No changes made to git tracked files' is removed. Numerous bug fixes for corner case crashes are included, all dependency versions are updated, and Aider wrote 70% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.58.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.58.0, a pair of Architect/Editor models is introduced for improved coding, using a strong reasoning model like o1-preview as Architect and a cheaper, faster model like gpt-4o as Editor. New --o1-preview and --o1-mini shortcuts are added. Support for new Gemini 002 models and better support for Qwen 2.5 models are included. Many confirmation questions can be skipped for the rest of the session with a '(D)on't ask again' response. Autocomplete for /read-only supports the entire filesystem. New settings for completion menu colors are available. A new /copy command copies the last LLM response to the clipboard, and /clipboard is renamed to /paste. HTTP redirects are followed when scraping URLs. A new --voice-format switch sends voice audio as wav/mp3/webm. ModelSettings takes extra_params dict for litellm.completion(). Cursor shapes are supported in vim mode. Numerous bug fixes are included, and Aider wrote 53% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: v0.59.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.59.0, improvements to /read-only include shell-style auto-complete of the full file system, auto-completion of full paths of repo files like /add, and support for globs like 'src/**/*.py'. The --yes flag is renamed to --yes-always, with corresponding AIDER_YES_ALWAYS env var and yaml key; existing YAML and .env files need updating, but --yes can still be abbreviated on the command line. The config file now uses standard YAML list syntax with '- list entries'. /settings includes the same announcement lines that would print at launch. Sanity checks for --editor-model on launch are added, same as main and weak models. A --skip-sanity-check-repo switch speeds up launch in large repos. A bugfix ensures architect mode handles Control-C properly. Repo-map is now deterministic with improved caching logic. The commit message prompt is improved, and Aider wrote 77% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: v0.60.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.60.0, full support for Sonnet 10/22 is provided, the new SOTA model on aider's code editing benchmark, and it is used by default. Improved formatting of added and read-only files above the chat prompt is implemented. Support for o1 models is improved by more flexibly parsing their nonconforming code edit replies. The diff edit format prompt is corrected to note that only the first match is replaced. A stronger whole edit format prompt asks for clean file names. Aider now offers to add .env to the .gitignore file. A small model metadata json file is shipped to handle models not yet updated in litellm. Model settings for o1 models on Azure are included. A bugfix properly includes URLs in /help RAG results, and Aider wrote 49% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.61.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.61.0, slash-commands can be loaded and saved to files: /save <fname> creates a file of /add and /read-only commands that recreate the current file context, and /load <fname> replays the commands in the file; /load can run any arbitrary set of slash-commands, and --load <fname> runs a list of commands on launch before the interactive chat begins. Anonymous, opt-in analytics with no personal data sharing are introduced. Aider follows litellm's supports_vision attribute to enable image support for models. A bugfix handles diff mode flexibly when the model uses the wrong filename. Filenames are displayed in sorted order for /add and /read-only. A new --no-fancy-input switch disables prompt toolkit input, still available with --no-pretty. Browser config can be overridden with --no-browser or --no-gui. Aider offers to open documentation URLs when errors occur. All o1 models are properly supported regardless of provider. The layout of filenames above the input prompt is improved. Corrupted repomap tags cache is better handled. API error handling is improved, especially for the weak model, and Aider wrote 68% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.62.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.62.0, full support for Claude 3.5 Haiku is added, scoring 75% on aider's code editing leaderboard and almost as good as Sonnet at much lower cost; launch with --haiku to use it. File edits from ChatGPT, Claude, or other web apps can be easily applied: chat with the web app, give it source files and ask for changes, use the web app's 'copy response' button to copy the entire reply, then run 'aider --apply-clipboard-edits file-to-edit.js' to apply the changes. A bugfix for creating new files is included, and Aider wrote 84% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.63.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.63.0, support for Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B is added. The /web command now just adds the page to the chat without triggering an LLM response. Prompting for the user's preferred chat language is improved. Handling of LiteLLM exceptions is improved. A bugfix addresses double-counting tokens when reporting cache stats. A bugfix for the LLM creating new files is included, along with other small bug fixes, and Aider wrote 55% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.64.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.64.0, an /editor command is added to open the system editor for writing prompts. Full support for gpt-4o-2024-11-20 is provided. o1 models are streamed by default. /run and suggested shell commands now confirm that they 'Added XX lines of output to the chat.' 1% of users are asked if they want to opt-in to analytics. Optional multiline input tags with matching closing tags are supported. Model settings configuration is improved with support for global extra_params for litellm.completion(). Architect mode now asks to add files suggested by the LLM. A bug in fuzzy model name matching is fixed. A Timeout exception handles API provider timeouts. --show-release-notes controls release notes display on first run of a new version. An empty dict is saved to cache file on model metadata download failure to delay retry. Error handling and code formatting are improved. A bug in fuzzy model name matching when litellm provider info is missing is fixed. Model metadata file loading allows override of resource file. Recursive loading of dirs using --read is allowed. Dependency versions are updated to pick up a litellm fix for ollama models. Exponential backoff retry is added when writing files to handle editor file locks. Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B model configuration is updated. A bug in git ignored file handling is fixed. Error handling for git operations is improved, and Aider wrote 74% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.65.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.65.0, --alias config is added to define custom model aliases. A --[no-]detect-urls flag disables detecting and offering to scrape URLs found in the chat. Ollama models now default to an 8k context window. RepoMap support for Dart language is added. 2.5% of users are asked if they want to opt-in to analytics. Files that share names with files already in chat are skipped in suggestions. /editor returns and prefills the file content into the prompt, so /editor can be used to compose messages that start with /commands, etc. Error handling for analytics is enhanced. Handling of UnknownEditFormat exceptions is improved with helpful documentation links. Dependencies are bumped to pick up grep-ast 0.4.0 for Dart language support, and Aider wrote 81% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.66.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.66.0, PDF support for Sonnet and Gemini models is added. A --voice-input-device option selects the audio input device for voice recording. A --timeout option configures API call timeouts. The cwd is set to the repo root when running shell commands. Ctrl-Up/Down keyboard shortcuts for per-message history navigation are added. Error handling is improved for failed .gitignore file operations, input history file permissions, and analytics file access. A spurious warning about disabling pretty in VSCode is removed. Broken support for Dart is removed. A bugfix addresses scraping URLs found in chat messages. Handling of __version__ import errors is improved. The /drop command supports substring matching for non-glob patterns. A bugfix to --alias is included, and Aider wrote 82% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.67.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.67.0, aider can be used in an IDE or editor by running 'aider --watch-files', which watches for instructions added to source files. One-liner '# ...' or '// ...' comments that start or end with 'AI' are instructions to aider; when aider sees 'AI!' it reads and follows all instructions in AI comments. Support for new Amazon Bedrock Nova models is added. When /run or /test have non-zero exit codes, 'Fix that' is pre-filled into the next message prompt. /diff now invokes 'git diff' to use the preferred diff tool. Ctrl-Z support for process suspension is added. The spinner falls back to ASCII art if fancy symbols throw unicode errors. --read now expands '~' home dirs. Exception capture in analytics is enabled, and Aider wrote 61% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.68.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.68.0, aider works with LLM web chat UIs via a new --copy-paste mode and a new /copy-context command. API keys and other environment variables for all providers can be set from the command line or yaml conf file with new --api-key provider=key and --set-env VAR=value settings. Bash and zsh support is added to --watch-files. Better error messages are provided when missing dependencies for Gemini and Bedrock models. Control-D now properly exits the program. Token costs are not counted when the API provider returns a hard error. A bugfix ensures watch files works with files that don't have tree-sitter support. A bugfix allows o1 models to be used as weak model. The shell command prompt is updated. Docstrings are added for all Coders. Command line arguments are reorganized with improved help messages and grouping. The exact sys.python is used for self-upgrades. Experimental Gemini models are added, and Aider wrote 71% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.69.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.69.0, watch files improvements include using '# ... AI?' comments to trigger aider and ask questions about code, watching all files instead of just certain source files, and using '# AI comments', '// AI comments', or '-- AI comments' to give aider instructions in any text file. Full support for Gemini Flash 2.0 Exp is added with shortcuts 'aider --model flash' or 'aider --model gemini/gemini-2.0-flash-exp'. A new --multiline flag and /multiline-mode command make ENTER a soft newline and META-ENTER send the message. /copy-context <instructions> now takes optional instructions when copying code context to the clipboard. Clipboard error handling is improved with helpful requirements install info. 5% of users are asked to opt-in to analytics. /voice now lets you edit the transcribed text before sending. Auto-complete is disabled in Y/N prompts, and Aider wrote 68% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.70.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.70.0, full support for o1 models is provided. Watch files now honors --subtree-only and only watches that subtree. Prompting for watch files is improved to work more reliably with more models. New install methods via uv, including one-liners, are available. Support for the openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-chat model is added. Better error handling occurs when interactive commands are attempted via /load or --load. Read-only files are displayed with absolute path if shorter than relative path. 10% of users are asked to opt-in to analytics. A bugfix for auto-suggest is included. Unicode errors in git path names are gracefully handled. A fix for gemini model names in model metadata is applied. Hints about AI! and AI? are shown when user makes AI comments. Support for running without git installed is added. Environment variable setup messages on Windows are improved, and Aider wrote 74% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.71.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.71.0, prompts help DeepSeek work better when alternating between /ask and /code. Streaming pretty LLM responses is smoother and faster for long replies, and streaming automatically turns off for models that don't support it. Switching to/from /model o1 and a streaming model is now possible. Pretty output remains enabled even when editing files with triple-backtick fences. Bare /ask, /code, and /architect commands now switch the chat mode. The default size of the repomap is increased. The max chat history tokens limit is increased from 4k to 8k. Fancy input and watch files are turned off if the terminal is dumb. Support for custom voice format and input device settings is added. The Streamlit email prompt is disabled. Lint command handling of nested spaced strings is fixed. Token count feedback is added when adding command output to chat. Error handling is improved for large audio files with automatic format conversion, git repo index errors, unicode handling in console output with ASCII fallback, and git errors with AssertionError and AttributeError. File export path in voice format conversion is fixed. Markdown rendering performance is improved with adaptive delay based on render time. A typo in model metadata variable name is fixed, and Aider wrote 60% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.72.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.72.0, support for DeepSeek R1 is added with shortcut '--model r1' and also via OpenRouter '--model openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-r1'. Kotlin syntax support is added to repo map. A --line-endings option for file writing is added. examples_as_sys_msg=True is set for GPT-4o models, improving benchmark scores. All dependencies are bumped to pick up litellm support for o1 system messages. A bugfix addresses turn taking when reflecting lint/test errors. A permissions issue in Docker images is fixed. Read-only file announcements are added. A bugfix provides ASCII fallback for unicode errors. A bugfix corrects integer indices for list slicing in repomap calculations, and Aider wrote 52% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.73.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.73.0, full support for o3-mini is added with 'aider --model o3-mini'. A new --reasoning-effort argument accepts low, medium, or high. Handling of context window size limits is improved with better messaging and Ollama-specific guidance. Support for removing model-specific reasoning tags from responses with 'remove_reasoning: tagname' model setting is added. Parent directories are auto-created when creating new files. Support for R1 free on OpenRouter is added with '--model openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-r1:free'. User/assistant turn order is enforced to avoid R1 errors. Model name matching is case-insensitive while preserving original case. Hardening against user/assistant turn order problems is applied. Model metadata for 'openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-r1' is fixed, and Aider wrote 69% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.74.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.74.0, the Ollama context window is dynamically changed to hold the current chat. Better support is provided for o3-mini, DeepSeek V3 & R1, o1-mini, and o1 via secondary API providers. <think> tags are removed from R1 responses for commit messages and other weak model uses. Model settings can now specify 'use_temperature: <float>' instead of just true/false. The full docker container now includes boto3 for Bedrock. Docker containers set HOME=/app to persist ~/.aider. A bugfix prevents creating incorrect filenames like 'python', 'php', etc. A bugfix for --timeout is applied. /model now correctly reports that the weak model is not changed. Multi-line mode persists through ^C at confirmation prompts. Watch files now fully ignores top-level directories named in ignore files to reduce the chance of hitting OS watch limits. Startup is faster with more providers and when model metadata is provided in local files. .gitignore handling is improved: honors ignores already in effect, checks for .env only when the file exists. Yes/No prompts now accept All/Skip as alias for Y/N even when not processing a group of confirmations, and Aider wrote 77% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.75.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.75.0, basic support for Claude 3.7 Sonnet is added with '--model sonnet' to use the new 3.7; thinking support is coming soon. A bugfix to the /editor command is applied. The streamlit dependency is downgraded to avoid a threading bug. Support for tree-sitter language pack is added. openrouter/o3-mini-high model configuration is added. build.gradle.kts is added to special files for Kotlin project support. More than one cache warming thread is prevented from becoming active. The continuation prompt '. ' for multiline input is fixed. HCL (Terraform) syntax support is added. o1 & o3-mini are made to generate markdown by sending the magic 'Formatting re-enabled.' string. A bugfix ensures multi-line inputs do not include the '. ' continuation prompt, and Aider wrote 46% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.76.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.76.0, support for thinking/reasoning models is improved with a --thinking-tokens CLI option to control token budget and display of thinking/reasoning content from LLMs. Handling of reasoning tags is enhanced to better clean up model responses. A deprecation warning is added for the remove_reasoning setting, now replaced by reasoning_tag. Notifications when LLM responses are ready are added with --notifications flag and --notifications-command. Support is added or improved for many models/providers: QWQ 32B, DeepSeek V3 free on OpenRouter, Claude 3.7 Sonnet models on OpenRouter, Bedrock and Vertex AI, GPT-4.5-preview, Claude 3.7 Sonnet:beta on OpenRouter, and openrouter/anthropic/claude-3.7-sonnet. The default model is updated to Claude 3.7 Sonnet on OpenRouter. Weak_model_name patterns are fixed to match main model name patterns for some models. Tree-sitter-language-pack is switched to for tree sitter support. Error handling is improved for EOF (Ctrl+D) in user input prompts. A helper function ensures hex color values have a # prefix. Handling of Git errors when reading staged files is fixed. SSL verification control for model information requests is improved. Empty LLM response handling is improved with clearer warning messages. Git identity retrieval is fixed to respect global configuration. Aider offers to install dependencies for Bedrock and Vertex AI models. Model shortcut args (like --4o, --opus) are deprecated in favor of the --model flag, and Aider wrote 85% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.77.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.77.0, a big upgrade in programming languages supported is achieved by adopting tree-sitter-language-pack, adding 130 new languages with linter support and 20 new languages with repo-map support. A /think-tokens command sets thinking token budget with support for human-readable formats (8k, 10.5k, 0.5M). A /reasoning-effort command controls model reasoning level. Both commands display current settings when called without arguments. Display of thinking token budget and reasoning effort in model information is added. The --thinking-tokens argument is changed to accept string values with human-readable formats. An --auto-accept-architect flag (default: true) automatically accepts changes from architect coder format without confirmation. Support for cohere_chat/command-a-03-2025 and gemini/gemma-3-27b-it is added. The bare /drop command now preserves original read-only files provided via args.read. A bug where default model would be set by deprecated --shortcut switches even when already specified in the command line is fixed. The AutoCompleter now requires 3 characters for autocompletion to reduce noise. Handling of JSONDecodeError when loading model cache file and GitCommandError when retrieving git user configuration is fixed. An ignore_permission_denied option is added to file watcher to prevent errors when accessing restricted files, and Aider wrote 72% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.78.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.78.0, support for thinking tokens for OpenRouter Sonnet 3.7 is added. Commands to switch between model types are added: /editor-model for Editor Model and /weak-model for Weak Model. Model setting validation ignores --reasoning-effort and --thinking-tokens if the model doesn't support them, with a --check-model-accepts-settings flag (default: true) to force unsupported model settings. Models are annotated with which support reasoning_effort and thinking_tokens settings. Code block rendering in markdown output is improved with better padding using NoInsetMarkdown. A --git-commit-verify flag (default: False) controls whether git commit hooks are bypassed. Autocompletion for /ask, /code, and /architect commands is fixed. Vi-like behavior is added when pressing enter in multiline-mode while in vi normal/navigation-mode. AWS_PROFILE support for Bedrock models allows use of AWS profiles instead of explicit credentials. The --aiderignore argument is enhanced to resolve both absolute and relative paths. Platform information handling is improved to gracefully handle retrieval errors. Dependencies are bumped to pickup litellm fix for Ollama. Support for openrouter/google/gemma-3-27b-it model is added. Exclude patterns for help documentation are updated, and Aider wrote 92% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.79.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.79.0, support for SOTA Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek V3 0324 is added. A new /context command automatically identifies which files need to be edited for a given request. /edit is added as an alias for the /editor command. An 'overeager' mode for Claude 3.7 Sonnet models tries to keep it working within the requested scope, and Aider wrote 65% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.80.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.80.0, OpenRouter OAuth integration is added: it offers to OAuth against OpenRouter if no model and keys are provided, selects OpenRouter default model based on free/paid tier status if OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set and no model is specified, and prioritizes gemini/gemini-2.5-pro-exp-03-25 if GEMINI_API_KEY is set, and vertex_ai/gemini-2.5-pro-exp-03-25 if VERTEXAI_PROJECT is set, when no model is specified. User-configured color settings are validated on startup and invalid ones are warned/disabled. A warning is shown at startup if --stream and --cache-prompts are used together, as cost estimates may be inaccurate. Repomap ranking is boosted for files whose path components match identifiers mentioned in the chat. Web scraping timeout is changed from an error to a warning, allowing scraping to continue with potentially incomplete content. Markdown headings are left-aligned in terminal output. The edit format is updated to the new model's default when switching models with /model, if the user was using the old model's default format. The openrouter/deepseek-chat-v3-0324:free model is added. Ctrl-X Ctrl-E keybinding edits the current input buffer in an external editor. Linting errors for filepaths containing shell metacharacters are fixed. Repomap support for Scala language is added. A bug in /run preventing auto-testing is fixed. A bug preventing UnboundLocalError during git tree traversal is fixed. GitCommandNotFound error is handled if git is not installed or not in PATH. FileNotFoundError is handled if the current working directory is deleted while aider is running. Completion menu current item color styling is fixed, and Aider wrote 87% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.81.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.81.0, support for the openrouter/openrouter/quasar-alpha model is added, currently free on OpenRouter and scoring 55% on the polyglot coding benchmark; run with 'aider --model quasar'. OpenRouter OAuth authentication is offered if an OpenRouter model is specified but the API key is missing. Retrying API calls is prevented when the provider reports insufficient credits. URL detection is improved to exclude trailing double quotes. Dependencies are bumped to pickup a litellm change to properly display the root cause of OpenRouter 'choices' errors. The error message for OpenRouter API connection issues is improved to mention potential rate limiting or upstream provider issues. Weak models (gemini/gemini-2.0-flash and openrouter/google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free) are configured for Gemini 2.5 Pro models. Model metadata for openrouter/google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free is added. Dependencies are updated for yanked fsspec and aiohttp packages. A redundant dependency check during OpenRouter OAuth flow is removed, and Aider wrote 86% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.82.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.82.0, support for GPT 4.1, mini and nano is added. Support for using architect mode with Gemini 2.5 Pro is improved. Support is added for xai/grok-3-beta, xai/grok-3-mini-beta, openrouter/x-ai/grok-3-beta, openrouter/x-ai/grok-3-mini-beta, openrouter/openrouter/optimus-alpha, grok-3-fast-beta, and grok-3-mini-fast-beta models. A new 'patch' edit format for OpenAI's GPT-4.1 model is added, along with new 'editor-diff', 'editor-whole', and 'editor-diff-fenced' edit formats. A bugfix automatically selects the best edit format to use in architect mode. Aliases 'grok3' for xai/grok-3-beta and 'optimus' for openrouter/openrouter/optimus-alpha are added. URL extraction from error messages is fixed. Files can be added by full path even if a file with the same basename is already in the chat. Quoting of values containing '#' in the sample aider.conf.yml is fixed. Support for Fireworks AI model 'deepseek-v3-0324' is added, and Aider wrote 92% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.83.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.83.0, support for gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06 models and qwen3-235b models is added. Repo-map support for OCaml and OCaml interface files is added. A spinner animation is shown while waiting for the LLM to start streaming its response, updated to a Knight Rider style. An --attribute-co-authored-by option adds co-author trailer to commit messages. Gemini model aliases (e.g., gemini, gemini-2.5-pro) are updated to point to the 05-06 preview versions. Gemini 2.5 Pro preview models are marked as overeager by default. The commit message prompt specifies the user's language. The default weak model for Gemini 2.5 Pro models is updated to gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-preview-04-17. gemini-2.5-pro-exp-03-25 model settings are corrected to reflect its lack of support for thinking_budget. Model-specific system prompt prefixes are ensured to be placed on a new line before the main system prompt. Tracking of total tokens sent and received is added, now included in benchmark statistics. Model parameters (context window, pricing) for OpenRouter models are automatically fetched from their website. Support for thinking_tokens and reasoning_effort parameters for OpenRouter models is enabled. Cost calculation is improved using litellm.completion_cost where available. Model settings for openrouter/google/gemini-2.5-pro-preview-03-25 are added. A --disable-playwright flag prevents Playwright installation prompts and usage. The 'aider scrape' command-line tool uses Playwright for web scraping if available. Linter command execution on Windows is fixed by adopting oslex for argument quoting. Cross-platform display of shell commands is improved using oslex for robust argument quoting. /ask mode instructs the LLM to elide unchanging code in its responses. Web scraping in the GUI respects Playwright availability and the --disable-playwright flag. Display of filenames in the prompt header is improved using rich Text formatting. reasoning_effort is enabled for Gemini 2.5 Flash models. A --shell-completions argument generates shell completion scripts (e.g., for bash, zsh). Explicit --attribute-author or --attribute-committer flags override the default behavior when --attribute-co-authored-by is used. An issue where read-only status of files might not be preserved correctly by some commands is fixed. The aider-args utility defaults to printing a sample YAML configuration if no arguments are provided. Token count progress and the name of the file or identifier being processed are displayed during repo map updates. The waiting spinner is extended to also show for non-streaming responses and further enhanced with console width clipping, cursor hiding, and a more continuous appearance. Support for Python 3.9 is dropped, and Aider wrote 55% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.84.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.84.0, support for new Claude models including the Sonnet 4 and Opus 4 series (e.g., claude-sonnet-4-20250514, claude-opus-4-20250514) across various providers is added, with default sonnet and opus aliases updated to these newer versions. Support for the vertex_ai/gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20 model is added. Default OpenRouter models during onboarding are updated to deepseek/deepseek-r1:free for the free tier and anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 for paid tiers. GitHub Copilot tokens are automatically refreshed when used as OpenAI API keys. An issue where files explicitly added via the command line were not correctly ignored if listed in .gitignore is fixed. Automatic commit messages are improved by providing more context during their generation. OpenRouter token cost calculation is fixed for improved accuracy. OpenRouter model metadata handling is improved by introducing a local cache, increasing reliability and performance. Shell tab completion is added for file path arguments and for --edit-format/--editor-edit-format options. The /settings command now displays detailed metadata for active main, editor, and weak models. User language detection is improved by correctly normalizing hyphenated language codes and enhancing validation of locale results. Aider is prevented from instructing the LLM to reply in 'C' or 'POSIX' when these are detected as the system locale. A spinner with the model name is displayed when generating commit messages. configargparse is bumped to 1.7.1 as 1.7 was pulled.

chunks.title: Aider v0.85.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.85.0, support for new Gemini models including gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, and gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05 with thinking tokens support is added. Model aliases are updated: flash now points to gemini-2.5-flash and gemini now points to gemini-2.5-pro. Support for Responses API models like o1-pro, o3-pro is added, along with support for OpenAI o3-pro model across multiple providers. Thinking tokens support is enhanced: can now be disabled by setting to 0, and improved help text with examples. Max tokens for Deepseek models is increased to 65536 for better performance. Pricing for o3 is updated. An --add-gitignore-files flag enables adding files listed in .gitignore to Aider's editing scope. Co-authored-by attribution is enabled by default for commit messages. Commit message generation is enhanced to use system prompt prefixes. A --commit-language option specifies the language for commit messages. Expensive file tracking operations are skipped when --skip-sanity-check-repo is enabled for better performance. Chat history summarization performance is optimized. Custom PostHog analytics configuration options are added with --analytics-posthog-host and --analytics-posthog-project-api-key flags. MATLAB and Clojure language support for repository maps is added. Kebab-case identifier recognition in repository maps is improved. GitHub Copilot token handling is improved with better validation and error messages. Inline code rendering in Rich markdown output is improved. Vertex AI model name prefixes in settings are fixed. The /read-only command resolves literal paths correctly. Encoding issues in git diff output and LLM history logging are fixed. Search block regex accepts optional closing tags when working with HTML content. Parent directories for chat history files are auto-created to prevent startup errors. Pip availability is ensured before package installation, and Aider wrote 21% of the code in this release.

chunks.title: Aider v0.86.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Aider-AI/aider release v0.86.0, support for all GPT-5 models is added. Support for Grok-4 via xai/grok-4 and openrouter/x-ai/grok-4 model names is added. Support for gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17 model is added. /clear now prints 'All chat history cleared.' so you know it worked. /undo output now shows only the first line of each commit message, making it easier to read. Support for openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2 model is added. Model announcements are displayed with no-arg /model command. An issue where new settings for an existing model didn't replace the old ones is fixed. Analytics is fixed to support the latest PostHog SDK event-capture API. Dependencies are bumped to pick up latest litellm==1.75.0, and Aider wrote 88% of the code in this release.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent Alamofire/Alamofire release stream from version 5.0.5 through 5.12.0, covering new features like Combine support, Swift concurrency, WebSocket requests, and numerous bug fixes and platform updates.

chunks.title: Finishing Moves
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.0.5 (Finishing Moves), the release fixes a Request casting issue on retry that could lead to incomplete retry of UploadRequests, and a rare scenario where finish() could be called multiple times, leading to duplicate response handler calls.

chunks.title: Streaming and Modification
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.1.0 (Streaming and Modification), the release adds a RequestModifier closure to request APIs for mutating created URLRequests, and DataStreamRequest for streaming HTTP responses. It also updates various framework internals for easier Linux porting, requires Swift 5.1, and fixes a typo in ServerTrustEvaluating documentation.

chunks.title: Combine and AuthenticationInterceptor
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.2.0 (Combine and AuthenticationInterceptor), the release adds Combine support with DataResponsePublisher, DownloadResponsePublisher, and DataStreamPublisher, and adds AuthenticationInterceptor for easier adaptation and retry of requests with credentials. It updates response handlers to take all serializer parameters, renames DisabledEvaluator to DisabledTrustEvaluator, allows Interceptor to be initialized with multiple RequestInterceptors, and fixes minor documentation issues, encoding of Decimal values in URLEncodedFormEncoder, a thread-safety issue in Session, and a memory leak in NetworkReachabilityManager.

chunks.title: Pluggin' Leaks
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.2.1 (Pluggin' Leaks), the release updates usage of .background DispatchQoS to .utility to avoid low-power issues, and fixes various memory leaks.

chunks.title: Reliable Streaming
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.2.2 (Reliable Streaming), the release adds a macOS(Catalyst) User-Agent string, updates debugDescription of DataRequest and DownloadRequest for better handling of non-text and long content, updates code to use switch instead of if else, and fixes linking on some Apple OS versions when using Swift Package Manager and reliability issues with DataStreamRequest.

chunks.title: Lifetime Events
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.3.0 (Lifetime Events), the release adds closure callback APIs for the production of URLRequests and URLSessionTasks, and URLSessionTaskMetrics gathering on watchOS 7+. It updates project settings, GitHub Actions, tests, and formatting for newer Xcodes, updates use of URLRequest.headers in URLEncoding, updates the iOS example app and various documentation, and fixes a double lock crash in AuthenticationInterceptor caused by synchronous refresh implementations, a crash when requesting file:// URLs by producing a validation error, missing rethrow of error when writing temporary multipart files fails, and Objective-C module conflicts in Xcode 12 by removing Obj-C module support.

chunks.title: URLs and File Downloads
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.4.0 (URLs and File Downloads), the release adds URLResponseSerializer and attendant convenience methods so downloads can produce a non-optional URL, and updates handling of file:// URLs, removing the error added in 5.3.0 and adding support for DownloadRequest.

chunks.title: Installing Obj-C Headers
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.4.1 (Installing Obj-C Headers), the release updates the project and CocoaPods installation of the Obj-C header.

chunks.title: Multipart Safety
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.4.2 (Multipart Safety), the release updates resume data handling for DownloadRequests to access resume data from errors as well as cancellation, updates project files and templates for Xcode 12.4 and GitHub templates, and fixes MultipartUpload thread-safety and multipart body stream length handling to better handle partial streams.

chunks.title: Multipart Order
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.4.3 (Multipart Order), the release fixes a change in multipart upload creation order and a typo in the Alamofire 5 migration guide.

chunks.title: Xcode 13 Fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.4.4 (Xcode 13 Fixes), the release adds support for Xcode 13 including a workaround for Combine compilation on older architectures, testing on watchOS, and support for building on Windows and Linux. It updates usage of .count >= 0 to !.isEmpty, and fixes async navigation title updating in the example app and various documentation bugs.

chunks.title: Swift Concurrency
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.5.0 (Swift Concurrency), the release adds experimental support for Swift Concurrency including async-await for requests and StreamOf for streaming values, generic static accessors for various protocol types for Swift 5.5, .indexInBrackets options for array encoding in query parameters, and RequestAdapterState with new protocol requirements for RequestAdapter. It updates Session to more safely target provided custom DispatchQueues, updates AFError message regarding unacceptable Content-Types to sort the types, updates the base Swift language version requirement to 5.3, updates the sample app to show proper loading state for requests, deprecates responseJSON and associated methods in preference to responseDecodable, and fixes use of Protected wrapper when accessing properties of wrapped values to ensure proper thread-safety and various documentation typos.

chunks.title: Concurrency Redux
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.6.0 (Concurrency Redux), the release adds support for HTTPMethod.query, a compile-time Swift version check to enforce minimum supported Swift version, and GitHub Sponsors support. It updates the Swift version required to build experimental Swift Concurrency support to 5.6.0, updates DownloadRequest to avoid producing resume data when not explicitly requested on cancellation, updates testing infrastructure to use XCTestPlans on Apple platforms, updates GitHub Actions support for greater OS coverage, more SPM platforms, and Swift 5.6, and fixes various Security framework deprecation warnings and documentation issues.

chunks.title: Missing Cancellation Parameter
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.6.1 (Missing Cancellation Parameter), the release fixes a missing automaticallyCancelling parameter in serializingDownloadedFileURL.

chunks.title: Safer Encoding
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.6.2 (Safer Encoding), the release adds an error when an object provided to JSONEncoding contains values that can't be passed through JSONSerialization, updates CI support for all supported Xcode, macOS, and Linux versions, updates support for various Xcode versions, updates Cache-Control header tests to not require hard-coded delays, and fixes a Swift version check for SecTrustCopyCertificateChain and various documentation issues.

In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.6.3, the release updates the Swift package to 5.7 and CI to Xcode 14.1, and fixes calls to deprecated cancellation handler function, unnecessary protocol conformance on Combine publishers, and prevents retry when Request has already been cancelled.
In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.6.4, the release fixes deprecated OS version support in the Swift 5.7 SPM Package.

In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.7.0, the release adds request body compression support (disabled by default), ArrayEncoding.custom to URLEncodedFormEncoder and URLEncoding, KeyPathEncoding to URLEncodedFormEncoder, and NilEncoding to URLEncodedFormEncoder. It updates Alamofire to require Swift 5.5+ and (macOS 10.13, iOS 11, tvOS 11, watchOS 4)+, updates flatMap to map in HTTPHeaders, updates various CI integrations, and fixes reachability API usage safety, unused bufferingPolicy in StreamOf, and various documentation typos.
In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.7.1, the release reverts deployment targets to (macOS 10.12, iOS 10, tvOS 10, watchOS 3)+.

In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.8.0, the release adds visionOS support, hooks for initial HTTPURLResponse values, and Android build support. It updates async integration to obey automatic cancellation by default, updates platform #if checks, Windows CI, URL conversion tests for 2023 URL changes, and updates a for-loop to contains. It fixes MultipartFormData stream to properly obey bodyContentLength, an unnecessary call to empty init, and documentation typos.

In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.8.1, the release updates the internal Protected to no longer be a @propertyWrapper, and fixes URLEncodedFormEncoder encoding of Encodable values with optional properties using encodeIfPresent and a missing "Skip Install" setting for the visionOS target.

In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.9.0, the release adds experimental WebSocketRequest as a wrapper for URLSessionWebSocketTask, a PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy file and integration with SPM, CocoaPods, and Carthage, an AlamofireDynamic target to force dynamic linking in Xcode when using SPM, and AFInfo enum with a public version value to get Alamofire's current version. It updates Alamofire to require Swift 5.7.1, restructures the project to break apart large Request.swift file, updates Empty type to be Sendable, updates .swiftformat to remove duplicate rules, and fixes platform deprecation warnings in Package.swift, Alamofire.podspec after project restructuring, and various documentation typos.

In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.9.1, the release updates HTTPHeaders and HTTPHeader to be Sendable, updates HTTPMethod to be Sendable, and fixes CocoaPods visionOS support by explicitly declaring it in the podspec.

In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.10.0, the release adds full Swift concurrency support with Sendable requirements, requires existential any internally, updates Session.init(eventMonitors:) to allow no EventMonitors at all and fixes CompositeEventMonitor thread-safety, updates DownloadRequest.validate to read the fileSize rather than the whole file from disk, updates links to swiftlang repositories, and fixes various documentation typos, passing queue parameter to DataStream serializers, and a test for date encoding when running with a non-Gregorian calendar.

In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.10.1, the release fixes @Sendable in AdaptHandler and RetryHandler types, a downstream JSONResponseSerializer wrapper by reverting output type to just Any, and missing @Sendable on Authenticator.refresh.
In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.10.2, the release fixes a runtime crash when calling validate from a Swift 6-compiled target and a Swift 6.0 Package.swift deprecation warning.

In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.11.0, the release adds lazy Request setup by default, inline per-Request RequestAdapter, RequestRetrier, RequestInterceptor, and EventMonitor APIs, per-Request automatic resume() control with shouldAutomaticallyResume parameter, and OfflineRetrier to retry requests based on NWPathMonitor status as a replacement for NetworkReachabilityManager. It updates Alamofire to require Xcode 16.0 and the Swift 6 compiler, updates deployment targets for test targets, updates Empty to be Hashable, updates Request internals to use more atomic locking, deprecates NetworkReachabilityManager on iOS 17.4 and later, updates Linux and Android CI builds, and fixes missing @Sendable in RetryPolicy, an example in Usage.md, and deletes .swiftpm folder from repo to prevent Xcode from creating Alamofire schemes when used as a package.

In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.11.1, the release fixes a rare logical race that allowed the same response serializer to execute multiple times simultaneously, which would call the completion handler multiple times, leading to crashes when wrapping continuations.

In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.11.2, the release updates use of #file to #fileID to prevent build system info leakage, updates CI and dependencies, and fixes a rare race between the creation of StreamOf values and the start of their iteration which could miss values, and handling of duplicate URLSessionTaskMetrics callbacks likely caused by using the new loading system.

In the Alamofire/Alamofire release 5.12.0, the release adds FreeBSD compilation support, updates various CI configurations, and fixes multiple issues including rare races in Request.suspend(), Request.cancel(), and Request.resume(), thread-safety issues in Session.deinit, multiple unlikely force unwrap or unowned self crashes, write to DataStreamRequest's outputStream after it was closed, MIME type parsing, cancelled DownloadRequests triggering retry, DataRequest.DataTask and DownloadRequest.DownloadTask missing early cancellation events, and multiple issues in AuthenticationInterceptor.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release evolution of AlistGo/alist, covering a series of releases from v3.38.0 to v3.61.0. It includes new driver additions, feature enhancements, bug fixes, and performance improvements across multiple versions.

chunks.title: v3.38.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.38.0, the offline_download feature adds transmission support. Bug fixes include updates for Terabox and the 115 driver using the latest appVer for upload.

chunks.title: v3.39.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.39.1, a new febbox driver is added. General users can now view and cancel their own tasks. The local driver receives a thumbnail token bucket smooth migration. Bug fixes address 115 20GB file size limit enforcement, cloudreve path issues, ilanzou infinite loop and small file upload failures, and local cross-device file move. Performance improvement changes the 123pan login domain.

chunks.title: v3.39.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.39.2, the 115 driver enhances cache, and baidu_netdisk and baidu_photo add and fix hashinfo. Bug fixes include pikpak domain block and change to NET, storage deletion failure after panic during initialization, and terabox big file upload issue and slice out of range panic.

chunks.title: v3.39.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.39.4, a bug fix addresses a missing installation of zig in the release process.

chunks.title: v3.40.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.40.0, security features include generating random strings with crypto rand and generating/verifying OAuth state with go-cache for SSO. Bug fixes update baidu_netdisk fileToObj to use ServerCtime and ServerMtime, preserve file owner when copying in local, fix close of closed channel in net, resolve captcha_sign error in pikpak and pikpak_share, and add OIDC compatibility mode for SSO.

chunks.title: v3.41.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.41.0, FTP server and SFTP server support are added. The 139 driver supports multipart upload. SSO adds custom extra scope support. Bug fixes include 115 login bug, 139 API updates, baidu_photo cookie login download error, cloudreve upload to remote and OneDrive storage, ftp-server large transfer client timeout, onedrive timeout error, and pikpak removal of oauth2 method. Performance improvement merges requests of operating selected tasks.

chunks.title: v3.42.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.42.0, a Reference interface is added to the driver. The alias driver adds DownloadConcurrency and DownloadPartSize options. Archive manage is introduced. CI adds build info for beta release. Docker release improves aria2 image and adds aio image. The fs module adds an overwrite option and displays existing filename in error messages. ftp-server treats moving across file systems as copying and supports resumable downloading. New drivers include github api driver and github_releases driver. The index module adds a disable index option for storages. local supports both time and percent for video thumbnail. A misskey driver is added. offline-download allows using offline download tools in any storage. The patch module is upgraded. recursive-move adds an overwrite option. s3 supports custom host presign.

chunks.title: v3.43.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.43.0, the 115 open driver is introduced. The archive module supports deprioritize previewing. baidu_netdisk supports dynamical slice size for low bandwidth upload. bootstrap adds .url to proxy types. CI uses go-cross/cgo-actions for dev build. github driver supports github proxy and GPG verification. github_releases supports dir size for show all version. recursive-move adds advanced conflict policy. traffic supports limit task worker count and file stream rate. webdav supports oc:checksums. Bug fixes include missing args when using alias driver, potential XSS vulnerabilities, missing handling of RangeReadCloser, 139 account handling restoration, 189pc transfer rename, archive filename decoding when decompressing zips, and other fixes.

chunks.title: v3.44.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.44.0, the alias driver supports writing to non-ambiguous paths. alist_v3 supports forward archive requests. archive supports multipart archives. A Doubao driver is added. ipfs gets better support. Bug fixes include 115_open SDK upgrades, rename delay, multipart upload support, baidu_netdisk duplicate retry, cloudreve SetContentLength for local policy, db postgres trust/peer mode, sftp-server postgre control characters, and traffic duplicate semaphore release.

chunks.title: v3.45.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.45.0, h2c is added for the http server. UseLargeThumbnail is added for 139. 115_open implements rate limiting for API requests. 139 adds option ReportRealSize. azure_blob implements GetRootId interface. cloudreve gets S3 policy support. A Cloudreve V4 driver is added. doubao supports upload and adds get_download_info API and download_api option. doubao_share supports doubao_share link. An Azure Blob Storage driver is added. url-tree implements the Put interface. Bug fixes include reverting a net refactor, shebang of entrypoint.sh, removing auth middleware for authn login, preventing guest user from updating profile, 115_open MakeDir delay, 139 incorrect host, and other fixes.

chunks.title: v3.45.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.45.1, a ghcr docker image is added. Bug fixes update documentation links to the new domain and fix 189pc getToken failure, and fix a dead link.

chunks.title: v3.46.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.46.0, permission control and label management are enhanced. github_releases concurrently requests the GitHub API. Bug fixes update DriveId assignment to use DeviceID from Addition struct and restore user-agent header in HTTP requests.

chunks.title: v3.46.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.46.1, a bug fix improves role conversion logic for legacy formats.

chunks.title: v3.46.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.46.2, user, role, and storage operations are enhanced with additional validations.

chunks.title: v3.47.0

chunks.title: v3.47.1

chunks.title: v3.48.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.48.0, a new driver support for 123 Open is added. alist_v3 adds IntSlice type for JSON unmarshalling. log enhances log formatter to respect NO_COLOR env variable. A bug fix addresses 123 download and modifies request headers on the frontend.

chunks.title: v3.49.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.49.0, user path management and role handling are enhanced.

chunks.title: v3.50.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.50.0, tag backup is added and bugs are fixed. A bug fix addresses Webdav error location.

chunks.title: v3.51.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.51.0, a user registration endpoint and role-based default settings are added. Bug fixes resolve webdav decode issue, ensure DefaultRole stores role ID while exposing role name in APIs, and correct comment parsing logic in lanzou driver.

chunks.title: v3.52.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.52.0, session management is implemented. auth optimizes device session handling logic. search optimizes search result filtering and paging logic. session adds user session limit and device eviction logic. user enhances role assignment logic. chunks.title: v3.53.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.53.0, 123pan safebox is supported. Usage is checked before deleting storage. A Gofile storage driver and a MediaFire driver are added. chunks.title: v3.54.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.54.0, pCloud driver support is added. driver adds URL signing support. driver/s3 adds OSS Archive Support. A ProtonDrive driver is added. gofile adds configurable link expiration handling.

chunks.title: v3.55.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.55.0, a new driver bitqiu support is added. cloud189 adds sanitization for file and folder names. A Gitee driver is added.
