chunks.title: v3.56.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.56.0, the Baidu Netdisk upload logic is enhanced with dynamic URL retrieval. proxy adds configurable signature for down proxy URLs. settings adds a SetToken endpoint for updating token settings.

chunks.title: v3.57.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.57.0, a new doubao driver is added. iso9660 refactors path handling for secure file extraction. Bug fixes prevent Zip Slip in archive extraction, block path traversal in fs handlers, and harden TLS defaults with a warning on insecure mode.

chunks.title: v3.58.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.58.0, FTPS driver and streamtape driver are added. auth adds consistent error messaging for invalid login credentials. driver upgrades dependencies and enhances 115 cloud functionality. drivers add FTPS driver with TLS support. fs adds pagination support and enhances response structure. local adds options to use ffmpeg to generate thumbnail. quark supports 302 with transcoding and stable video preview. strm adds STRM driver with independent sync flow and driver-level sign expiry and rotate action. thumbnail adds configurable thumbnail size setting. wukong adds WuKongNetdisk driver with read-write support. Bug fixes include unescaping URL path to handle '#' in filenames, reducing WebDAV logging for NotFoundError, handling nil buffer case in resizeImageToBufferWithFFmpegGo, preventing and healing dirty admin permissions in auth, adding host parsing for TLS configuration in ftps login, and blocking rename for password-protected paths.

chunks.title: v3.59.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.59.0, public share support, burn-after-read support for shares, and extended share lifecycle controls are added. A 360AI YunPan driver is added. chunker adds a storage driver and supports multi-target chunk storage. driver adds baidu youth driver and Darkibox driver. driver/streamtape adds response types, remote upload ID helpers, PutURL for remote uploads, Other method implementations, and Sha256 upload support. s3 adds placeholder toggle and fixes empty-folder delete behavior. Bug fixes handle aliyundrive open rate limits, enable GFM extension for markdown rendering in proxy mode, recover personal host for 139 personal_new requests, add warning type prefix to streamtape Alert message, and fix misskey FolderId format validation and root directory handling.

chunks.title: v3.60.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.60.0, frp adds runtime log API and stop endpoint, and wires bootstrap settings and runtime dependencies. A full GuangYaPan driver integration is added.

chunks.title: v3.61.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AlistGo/alist release v3.61.0, GuangYaPan offline download is added. 139-share supports mounting and HLS playback. api adds virtual_path field on fs/list and fs/get responses. lark adds export tools API. settings adds frontend sort memory switch and preview_settings for per-extension preview management. Bug fixes address V-002 security vulnerability, support all pagination mode, fix CVE-2026-34986 security vulnerability, fix 139-share modification time parsing, allow user input folder path in guangyapan driver root path, expose sorting options, resolve offline root folder lookup, handle acw_sc__v2 anti-crawler challenge in lanzou, initialize task manager in mcp, expire missing meta cache, synchronize Buf.Close with Write/Read in net, and clear list cache after storage updates.

questions.query_text: In the AlistGo/alist releases, which release adds FTP server and SFTP server support?

answer_support.answer_text: FTP server and SFTP server support are added.

questions.query_text: Across the AlistGo/alist releases, how does the offline download feature change from v3.38.0 to v3.42.0?

options.text: v3.38.0 adds transmission support to offline_download, while v3.42.0 allows using offline download tools in any storage.
v3.38.0 removes offline download, and v3.42.0 reintroduces it with FTP support.
Both releases only fix bugs in offline download without adding features.
v3.38.0 adds offline download for the first time, and v3.42.0 removes it.

questions.expected_answer: v3.38.0 adds transmission support to offline_download, while v3.42.0 allows using offline download tools in any storage.

answer_support.answer_text: the offline_download feature adds transmission support
offline-download allows using offline download tools in any storage

answer_support.answer_text: a new febbox driver is added
A Doubao driver is added
pCloud driver support is added

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release evolution of AvaloniaUI/Avalonia, covering stable and preview releases from 11.2.8 through 12.0.4, including feature introductions, fixes, and platform-specific enhancements.

chunks.title: 11.3.0-beta2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.0-beta2, fixes include resolving a binding null conditional operator issue with AvaloniaProperty, fixing a DateTimePickerPanel scrolling exception, correcting the Grid ColumnSpacing property name, handling Window.Show when MinWidth exceeds MaxWidth, disabling Metal by default on macOS for 11.3, and fixing Grid size calculation for ranges. Ported fixes from 11.2.7 address OverhangLeading, DatePicker format refresh, and Windows Alt codes.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.2.8, fixes include keeping SelectingItemsControl selection values until ItemsSource is set, fixing Windows IME, resolving a crash when creating documents in an opened folder on Android, and fixing MenuItem enabled state in the presence of sub-items.

chunks.title: 11.3.0-rc1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.0-rc1, enhancements include picking the nearest parent if a container query doesn't specify a container name, adding XML doc comments to RegisterDirect warning about unsetValue, and adding a small banner about Accelerate. Fixes include resolving height queries not matching when container name is set, removing unused query grammar, allowing nesting selector in container styles, and porting fixes from 11.2.8 for SelectingItemsControl selection, Windows IME, Android document creation crash, and MenuItem enabled state.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.0, features include adding Popup.ShouldUseOverlayLayer property, ItemsControl.PreparingContainer event, ContactRect support on X11 and Windows, GeneratedComInterface-based Windows automation, configurable DevTools HotKey, clipboard content persistence after app close, Binding.Delay feature, Container Queries, Unicode data update to v16.0, Classes syntax on Style and ControlTheme, DataContext type inference from $parent and #named binding paths, font family mapping, new AvaloniaDictionary constructor, proper nc hittest for caption buttons, automation peer for UserControl, TextSearch on all SelectingItemsControl items, TextBox LineCount property, Matrix.CreateRotation with center point, BoolConverters.Not ConvertBack support, Android TalkBack support, single file/folder access from IStorageFolder by name, WrapPanel item alignment, TextBox hidesuggestions property, missing Blend Modes and BlendMode on Image Control, trailing whitespace length from glyph run metrics, DockPanel Spacing properties, UniformGrid spacing, Grid RowSpacing and ColumnSpacing, WrapPanel Spacing properties, pressure and tilt support on macOS, and FontFamily.FamilyTypefaces support.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.1, enhancements include updating SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp to support LA64 and RV64, improving inline documentation of class event handler methods, reducing allocations in TextShaperImpl by reusing HarfBuzz Buffer, updating azure-pipelines.yml, not expecting WasmRuntimeAssetsLocation to always be set, and bumping Angle version. Fixes address TextBox multiline selection with up/down keys, multiple TextLine.GetTextRunBounds issues, ScrollContentPresenter measure invalidation on CanScroll changes, incorrect CandidateWindow position with Pinyin IMEs on Windows, pen secondary button handling on list box, crash with Samsung keyboard on password textboxes, caret handles not updating, input controls initialized with InputMethod.IsInputMethodEnable=false still using IME, children of UniformGrid having negative dimensions, insets on Android 15, rare soft-freezes with OnRender InvalidateVisual pattern, focus not lost when parent hidden, removing Keyboard Theme Override, removing win32 dialog dpi hack, transitions with delay but no duration completing instantly, gradient stop reordering, RectangleGeometry not cloning radius properties, BindingEvaluator.ClearDataContext, infinite animation memory leak, StringBuilderCache release in TextBox.DeleteSelection, LostFocus not raised on macOS, DirectX signatures, and more IDL uint fixes.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.2, enhancements include correcting PointerPointProperties inline documentation and exposing it on PointerEventArgs, and removing the need for MenuItem Icon to be a ILogical. Fixes include extending dirty rect when UseLayoutRounding is false, properly handling in-cluster ShapedBuffer split, reversing TickBar when Slider direction is reversed, better API level detection for display edge-to-edge on Android, ignoring system bar color changes on API level 35, fixing display edge-to-edge detection for Android 16, reverting changes preventing status bar theme updates, resetting Android input method focus and connection state when text input focus is removed, setting SuggestedStartLocation when FileTypeChoices is not null on macOS, respecting info.plist values for setActivationPolicy on macOS, and adding shouldResize value to SetWindowState to avoid resizing on Window move on macOS.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.3, features include adding OpenGlControlBase XML docs, InputPaneActivationRequested in TextInputMethodClient, a buffer cache to containers in VirtualizingStackPanel, pointer/trackpad scrolling on iOS, and save file picker support on iOS. Fixes include properly checking if DispatcherOperation is pending, fixing memory leak by clearing shared array pool references in LightweightObservableBase, fixing random NRE inside Compositor.CommitCore callback, setting IsKeyboardFocusWithin to false when control is detached from visual tree, fixing ComboBox focus styles, making textbox context menu transient on mobile, removing textbox holding handler in text selection handle, using captured element as source for tap gestures, fixing Grid inner size calculation when Row/ColumnDefinition is not set but spacing is set, fixing selecting multiple lines in RTL mode, fixing TextLineImpl.GetTextBounds for clustered trailing zero width characters, fixing multiline selection crash, explicitly disposing GRBackendRenderTarget and SKSurfaceProperties, replacing manual input tracking with NSEvent on macOS, fixing thick titlebar pointer events streaming on macOS, fixing X11Screen info update on screen change, stopgap fix for Clipboard.ClearAsync not returning on X11, restricting source of input events to Avalonia view on Android, and enabling tray icon creation when running as admin on Win32.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.4, features include adding Window.CanMinimize/CanMaximize, Window.IsDialog, Calendar.AllowTapRangeSelection, and retrieving platform input config value on Android. Fixes include fixing WeakEvent subscription management thread race condition, enabling Copy and Cut in ContextMenu for AutoCompleteBox, removing nullability overrides from TimePickerPresenter and DatePickerPresenter, tracking TabIndex value in NumericUpDown, fixing SplitView incorrectly closing when DisplayMode changes to Inline when IsPaneOpen is already true, fixing a typo in X11Window ClientMessageEvent.ptr5, fixing duplicated pointer events on Android, removing non-implemented message AvnView.resetPressedMouseButtons on macOS, and fixing thick titlebar mouse event duplication on macOS.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.5, features include updating Brush.Parse() to handle all color formats and making typeface matching and synthetic typeface creation customizable. Fixes include fixing validation error not being cleared on valid input, scheduling a full render pass on CompositionBatchCompletion to prevent tearing, fixing TransformGroup.Children collection changes not changing TransformGroup.Value, fixing duplicate class property registration, fixing overhang calculation, fixing zero width space handling, fixing FontCollection.MatchCharacter, not treating combining marks as whitespace, font loading adjustments, reworking TextLineImpl.GetTextBounds, fixing usage of GridSplitter inside ItemsControl as ItemsPanel, fixing RelativePanel calculation error with extensible and aligned child, fixing selected files filename in managed file chooser, fixing BringDescendantIntoView with respect to margins, passing app delegate to the default UseiOS call on iOS, and fixing Win32 GDI leak on TrayIcon close on Windows.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.6, enhancements include adjusting macOS Tray/Menu icons scaling. Fixes include fixing OS timer interval calculation in Windows dispatcher, fixing maximized window being able to resize on Windows, fixing SkiaSharp 3 Metal interop signature on macOS, backporting GRContext bugfix on iOS, ignoring empty preeditText when no composition was active before on X11, fixing headless FontManager leak, fixing TextLine.GetTextBounds zero width run, and fixing TextLineImpl.GetTextBounds with trailing zero width.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.7, features include a clipboard rework, adding IsEditable to ComboBox, adding SplitViewPanePlacement settings for Top and Bottom, adding HeadingLevel to AutomationProperties, adding INCR support on X11, implementing IOSurface/MTLSharedEvent interop APIs on macOS, and responding to WM_CAPTURECHANGED on Windows. Enhancements include adding BoxShadow(s) documentation comments, adding Add/Remove event handler methods to DragDrop, adding a resource for TextControlPlaceholderOpacity, and updating Avalonia.BuildServices package version. Fixes include fixing BoxShadow equality, fixing typeface exception when created with empty font family name, not recapturing already captured element, fixing tooltip hit test following dirty rect invalidation not respecting IsHitTestVisible, limiting InlineUIContainer to available width, making sure inlines properly inherit text run properties from their parent, fixing focus issues with ComboBox, fixing TypeConverterAttribute for Avalonia properties, adding FindAssembliesGrantingInternalAccess to AvaloniaXamlIlRuntimeCompiler, fixing memory leaks when closing a window on Linux on X11, moving Drag and Drop logic to TopLevelImpl on macOS, fixing StorageItem methods not working and handling conversion issue on Browser, and removing Microsoft.SourceLink.GitHub PackageReference.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.8, enhancements include clarifying CenterX and CenterY properties documentation in RotateTransform, adding internal PointerCaptureChanging event, distributing LineGap evenly to top and bottom, adjusting GetBackspaceCaretCharacterHit, and enabling network location browsing in GTK file chooser dialogs on X11. Fixes include fixing PlatformDataTransferItem.TryGetRaw for unknown formats, ignoring PointerOver change when pointer event is CancelCapture, adding guards in TryGetGlyphTypeface so the $Default placeholder stops, fixing LayoutTransformControl memory leak due to Transform.Changed event subscription, making ScreenBase impl more reliable, fixing ArgumentException when showing multiple notifications with the same content, fixing Checkbox and RadioButton height in compact density of Fluent theme, fixing ExpressionParseException being reported as an internal compiler error, fixing DBus tray icon NullReferenceException when changing visibility on X11, fixing margins and nc hit test for caption buttons in extend to client windows on Windows, fixing Win32Exception when a file picker has an invalid file type on Windows, adding finalizer to Win32Icon which frees its GDI handle on Windows, preventing duplicated files during drag-and-drop on Windows, properly handling non-standard italic/oblique fonts on Windows, fixing scaling of inset when app is launched on Android, and adding parent/automationPeer null guards on AvnWindow on macOS.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.9, enhancements include adding SaveFilePickerWithResultAsync API, primary mouse device, an optional ConvertBack method to FuncValueConverter, support for reading from and copying images to clipboard, SuggestedFileType for Save/OpenFilePicker, headless AvaloniaTestIsolationLevel, and updating Avalonia.BuildServices package version. Fixes include properly handling DrawableRun.Baseline, fixing Selector.ValidateNestingSelector not calling overrides, handling long file paths in UriFromFilePath, fixing ServerCompositionSimplePen memory leak, caching platform font manager TryMatchCharacter result, fixing EmbeddedFontCollection.TryGetNearestMatch caching, making ContentPresenter.RecognizesAccessKey stylable, not letting the PreviewerWindow be any size, fixing changes to AccessibilityNodeInfoCompat.Checked data type from bool to int on Android, fixing external app not reading text in clipboard on Android, fixing fullscreen transitions with ExtendClientAreaToDecorationsHint windows on macOS, fixing XButtons event handler on macOS, correcting key mapping for scan code 0x18 on macOS, fixing TryCreateGlyphTypeface return on macOS with SkiaSharp 2.88, handling mouse movement in non-client areas of window on Windows, fixing ComVariant native size on Windows, not activating embedded windows when shown on Windows, and properly snapshotting GlSkiaImportedImage on Windows.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.10, enhancements include allowing stopping composition animation, introducing PathSegmentEllipsis TextTrimming, enabling antialiasing based on EdgeMode in DrawBitmap, reducing allocations in text rendering, improving effect render performance by providing Skia with information about subscene bounds, adding StrokeMiterLimit property to Shape, adding FillRule property for Polyline/Polygon, removing Avalonia.ReactiveUI, changing empty TrayIcon to use lazy initialization on Windows, exporting bitmap in more clipboard formats on Windows, implementing accessibility value setter on macOS, and adding basic Pen support on X11. Fixes include fixing newline requiring two backspaces to be deleted, correcting some Container Query error outputs, fixing ImmediateRenderer, fixing exception when deleting a non-empty directory, fixing SystemFontCollection, rounding measured cell sizes when UseLayoutRounding is enabled in UniformGrid, preserving run formatting when applying SelectionForegroundBrush in SelectableTextBlock, fixing ReversibleStackPanel not invalidating arrange on ReverseOrder change, skipping disabled controls in XYFocus, applying NumberFormat changes to NumericUpDown, fixing thread-safety issue causing infinite loops in TypeHelper cache, fixing no border sysmenu on Windows, fixing intermediate mouse points order on Windows, fixing popups not closing when using WinForms Host on Windows, fixing winforms mnemonic handler being called when textbox is focused on Windows, using relative placement for detecting drag and drop locations on macOS, avoiding clearing clipboard if we still have the ownership on X11, and cleaning up IME inconsistencies on X11.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.11, enhancements include adding support for parsing BoxShadows with color functions and setting XkbSetDetectableAutoRepeat to true on X11. Fixes include fixing thread-race condition in Dispatcher on shutdown, fixing NullReferenceException in TextShaperImpl.ShapeText on netstandard2.0, adding null reference check for animation keyframes, fixing accessibility with screen reader on TextBlock with inlines, fixing BindingExpression.LeafNode throwing when nodes list is empty, updating HelpLink for XAML namespace resolution, fixing TextInputResponder on iOS, calling default back callbacks when not handled on Android, removing obsolete clipboard format CF_TEXT on Windows, and fixing InvalidOperationException Dispatcher job loop detected in headless.

In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 11.3.12, enhancements include adding AXAML Source Information to debug builds, improving the error message for invalid surface size, improving capture source change notification, adding LandmarkType automation property, adding LiveSetting automation property, adding automation peer for Expander control, adding property changed event for IToggleProvider, adding FindAncestorOfType and FindDescendantOfType with predicates, adding ItemStatus and ItemType automation properties, adding thread name in DxgiConnection on Windows, and reducing the number of WrapDirect3D11Texture calls on Windows. Fixes include resetting cached transform on PopEffect, using epsilon-aware greater than in TextLine and TextFormatter, fixing DatePicker to respect custom Width property, disabling scroll chaining for ScrollViewers in popup, fixing TimePicker to respect custom Width property, fixing ScrollBar collapsing during active thumb drag, not inheriting TextDecorations in popup, fixing broken accessibility properties in ScrollBar control, fixing title bar appearing in content element accessibility tree, raising IAvaloniaActivity.Activated on new intent on Android, fixing clipboard not returning bitmaps in some cases on Windows, fixing DxgiRenderTimerLoop throwing an exception when accessing a Screen instance on Windows, fixing clipboard bitmap pixel shift on Windows, fixing clipboard manager store completion on X11, releasing implicit mouse capture on focus lost on macOS, and ensuring render target is at least 1x1 on macOS.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the AvaloniaUI/Avalonia release 12.0.0-rc1, changes include streamlining drawn decorations management to avoid call ordering problems, disposing GRBackendRenderTarget and @autoreleasepool for metal objects, firing Page lifecycle events after transitions complete not before, fixing pixel rounding and visual transforms in NativeControlHost, finding perfect match before nearest in font collection, adding automation landmarks to HamburgerMenu, fixing TabControl DataContext issues when switching tabs, adding PipsPager Control, updating summaries for gesture events in InputElement, disabling animations processing when Visual's not visible redux, adding translation property for CompositionVisual, adding FocusChangedEventArgs for GotFocus/LostFocus, making GetMaxSizeFromConstraint a protected method, adding /update-api and /api-diff commands, removing uncompilable code guarded by platform defines, using Numerge package, not ticking with render loop when app is idle, hiding TextRange, making SelectionHandleType internal, using the correct flag to determine if extra dirty rect needs to be combined with existing one, opening FocusManager API, allowing TextSearch.TextBinding on non-controls, deferring default icon loading until Window is shown, validating layoutable Thickness properties to block NaN or infinite values, updating .NET SDK to 10.0.201, adding new HeadlessWindow.SetRenderScaling API, fixing X11IconLoader exception for icons < 128px, fixing clipboard bitmap transferred with INCR on X11, fixing values of known atoms, adding WinForms message filter for Avalonia windows, not resolving markup extensions when resolving selector types, and adding gestures and WrapSelection (loops) support to C...

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent BurntSushi/ripgrep release stream from 0.3.0 to 15.1.0, covering major feature introductions like PCRE2 support, multi-line search, JSON output, hyperlink support, and a regex engine rewrite, along with numerous bug fixes and performance improvements.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.3.0, the project introduces breaking changes including a requirement for Rust 1.11 and a limitation on the -e/--regexp flag with patterns starting with '-'. Performance improvements bring ripgrep's speed on small corpora close to GNU grep and fix slowdowns from large argument lists. New features include a -f/--file flag for reading patterns from a file, a --colors flag for customizing output colors, a --files-without-match flag, and completion files for Bash, Fish, and PowerShell. Bug fixes address ANSI escape sequences for screen.linux, automatic stdin detection on Windows, color support in mintty and Emacs, reduced help content with -h, non-UTF-8 file names on Unix, line buffering, and error message suppression with --no-messages.
In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.3.1, a single bug fix corrects the handling of --colors foo:none, which previously did not work as expected.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.3.2, file type filtering is added or improved for Less, Sass, stylus, and Zsh. Bug fixes include making smart case less conservative, clarifying --heading/--no-heading, fixing a matching bug caused by literal optimizations, correcting behavior differences when searching symlinks, and resolving a regression from 0.3.0 that prevented patterns starting with '-' from being used with the -e/--regexp flag.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.4.0, the regex dependency is upgraded from 0.1 to 0.2, introducing minor syntax changes such as double bracketing for POSIX character classes and required escaping of certain characters. Breaking changes include the --column flag now implying --line-number and the removal of ^C handling. New features include improved file type filtering for Crystal, Kotlin, Perl, PowerShell, Ruby, and Swig, type definitions that can include other types, a --sort-files flag, and a --path-separator flag. Bug fixes cover portable ANSI color sequences, a CPU-spinning parallel iterator, documentation for shell completion files, explicit lack of backreference support, removal of a clap dependency, a cosmetic issue in globset docs, termination with -q/--quiet, clearer -g/--glob docs, not searching stdout when redirected, ZSH completions, removal of a superfluous memmap dependency, improved -r/--replace docs, an updated bytecount dependency, and invalid UTF-8 output on Windows consoles.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.5.0, a breaking change hides line numbers by default when printing to a tty and searching only stdin. New features include support for additional text encodings with automatic UTF-16 detection via BOM sniffing and an -E/--encoding flag for encodings like latin-1, GBK, EUC-JP, and Shift_JIS; a -M/--max-columns flag to omit long lines; and a --max-filesize flag to limit searches by file size. File type filtering is added or improved for Ceylon, CSS, Elixir, HTML, log, SASS, SVG, and Twig. Bug fixes adjust binary file detection, prevent parsing positional arguments as regexes with --files, allow --heading to override --no-heading, clarify -u/--unrestricted aliases, correct global git ignore config path, clarify -g/--glob docs, add license files to sub-crates, update clap, fix translation of set globs to regexes, add PowerShell completion to Windows release, and fix exclusion of absolute paths with -g/--glob.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.5.1, file type filtering is added or improved for vim. New features include a -o/--only-matching flag, customizable column number colors, and a -0 short flag for --null. Bug fixes ensure license text is included in all subcrates and correct several issues with -h/--help output.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.5.2, file type filtering is added or improved for Nix. New features include --regex-size-limit and --dfa-size-limit flags, and improved error messages for invalid globs. Bug fixes address line wrapping in --help output and duplicate output when using the -o/--only-matching flag.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.6.0, the minimum supported Rust version increases to 1.17. New features include an --iglob flag for case-insensitive glob matching, a -x/--line-regexp flag requiring matches to span entire lines, and a new matched_path_or_any_parents method in the ignore crate. File type filtering is added or improved for BitBake, C++, Cabal, cshtml, Julia, Make, msbuild, QMake, and Yocto. Bug fixes change the default Windows color scheme for PowerShell visibility, strip Unix release binaries, make --files quiet with --quiet, enable --with-filename automatically with --vimgrep, fix another -o/--only-matching bug, allow certain flags to override others, re-fetch Windows console on all calls, show compile-time features in --version, improve zsh completion, enable SIMD for encoding_rs when appropriate, fix -w/--word-regexp with capturing groups, and document potential unexpected termination when using memory maps.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.7.0, file type filtering is added or improved for config & license files, Elm, Purescript, Standard ML, sh, systemd, and Terraform. A feature enhancement makes using both -o/--only-matching and -r/--replace work correctly together. Bug fixes include stopping when the pipe is closed, fixing context printing with -m/--max-count, fixing interaction between -r/--replace and terminal colors, ignoring a non-UTF-8 file path test on macOS, fixing color escapes on empty matches, avoiding an expensive file handle check on Windows with --files, clarifying Ubuntu installation instructions, and faster symlink loop checking on Windows.
In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.7.1, a single bug fix addresses a regression from 0.7.0 that made it very easy to exceed standard file descriptor limits.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.8.0, the minimum supported Rust version increases to 1.20. Breaking changes include a new flag override rule where the most recent flag wins, a tweak to -M/--max-columns where a value of 0 acts as if the flag is absent, glob character class negation equivalence, and a changed directory hierarchy in archive releases. New features include support for a configuration file, extended/true color support, searching gzip, bzip2, lzma, or xz files with -z/--search-zip, a --line-number-width flag for line number alignment, linuxbrew support in the Brew tap, .rgignore files, ARM binaries, a suggestion for -F/--fixed-strings on regex syntax errors, a --passthru flag, overhauled documentation with a user guide and FAQ, and hidden flags for convenient overrides. File type filtering is added or improved for Apache Avro, C++, GN, Google Closure Templates, Jupyter notebooks, man pages, Protocol Buffers, Smarty, and Web IDL. Bug fixes include permitting repeated flags, and other fixes.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.8.1, file type filtering is added or improved for csv and VHDL. A new feature adds underline support to termcolor and ripgrep via the --colors flag. Bug fixes improve documentation for --ignore-file, suppress (rev ) when revision is unavailable, add man page to ARM release, improve documentation for intense setting in termcolor, fix a bug in the ignore crate for custom ignore files, correct behavior differences between rg --hidden . and rg --hidden ./, clarify a common failure mode in the user guide, fix a Windows bug where symlinks were followed even if not requested, and fix a performance regression in directory traversal on Windows.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.9.0, the minimum supported Rust version increases to 1.23.0. Breaking changes include altered behavior when --count and --only-matching are used together (now equivalent to --count-matches), removal of octal syntax support, and removal of the --line-number-width flag. New features include a --stats flag for aggregate statistics, a --no-ignore-messages flag, support for \u{..} Unicode escape sequences, a -b/--byte-offset flag, a --count-matches flag, a --no-column flag, lz4 support with -z/--search-zip, termcolor moved to its own repository, a --no-ignore-global flag, renaming --maxdepth to --max-depth, a --pre option to filter inputs with an arbitrary program, and improved zsh completion. File type filtering is added or improved for Android, Bazel, Fuschia, Haskell, Java, and Puppet. Bug fixes include portable binaries with runtime CPU feature detection, descriptive error messages for look-around/backreferences, comprehensible error messages for certain regexes, backslash escapes in globs, and other fixes.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 0.10.0, the minimum supported Rust version now tracks the latest stable Rust. Breaking changes include altered match semantics for -w/--word-regexp. Major new features include libripgrep, PCRE2 support via -P/--pcre2, multi-line search with -U/--multiline, and a JSON output format with --json. Other new features include a --one-file-system flag, --sort and --sortr flags (deprecating --sort-files), a --crlf flag, a --trim flag, a --null-data flag, --passthru working with --replace, --line-buffered and --block-buffered flags, and a --pre-glob flag. Bug fixes address searching with non-zero context using memory maps, correct stopping when output pipe is closed, more intuitive -w/--word-regexp, improved stdin detection on Windows, and matching empty lines.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 11.0.0, the versioning scheme changes from 0.x to major version 11. The minimum supported Rust version increases to 1.34.0. Breaking changes include tweaked exit status codes to match GNU grep, -uuu now equivalent to --no-ignore --hidden --binary, and removal of the avx-accel feature. Performance improvements make rg -F -f dictionary-of-literals much faster. New features include a --binary flag, a --max-columns-preview flag, Brotli and Zstd support with -z/--search-zip, a --no-ignore-dot flag, an --auto-hybrid-regex flag, exit status logic matching GNU grep, --ignore-file-case-insensitive, and other enhancements. File type filtering is added or improved for many types including Apache Thrift, ASP, Bazel, Brotli, BuildStream, bzip2, C, C++, Cython, gzip, Java, Make, Postscript, QML, Tex, XML, xz, zig, and zstd.
In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 11.0.1, a single bug fix addresses a search regression from 11.0.0 that could cause ripgrep to enter an infinite loop when searching invalid UTF-8.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 11.0.2, a new feature adds a --glob-case-insensitive flag. Bug fixes include adding translations to the README, fixing a bug where the last byte of a -f file was stripped if not a newline, documenting no error for \n with -P/--pcre2, mentioning .ignore and .rgignore more prominently in the README, fixing incorrect --with-filename enabling, fixing a major performance regression in the x86_64-linux binary release, showing better error messages for non-existent preprocessor commands, and fixing a match regression with -F when patterns contain meta characters.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 12.0.0, there are no known breaking changes. Deprecations include --no-pcre2-unicode in favor of --no-unicode, and --auto-hybrid-regex in favor of --engine auto. Performance improvements enhance literal detection, word-regexp performance, and directory traversal. New features include an --include-zero flag, a --no-context-separator flag, a --no-require-git flag, a --no-ignore-exclude flag, a --no-ignore-files flag, an --engine flag, and a --no-unicode flag. File type filtering is added or improved for erb, diff, Gradle, HAML, Org, Postscript, Skim, Slim, Slime, RPM Spec files, Typoscript, and xml. Bug fixes address working in non-existent directories, errant literal detection, a serious performance regression with very long lines, documentation for --type all, and a panic when searching a symlink.
In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 12.0.1, a single bug fix prevents spurious error messages in git repositories with submodules, a regression from 12.0.0.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 12.1.0, notices for downstream packagers include the future removal of Fish shell completions and a switch from a2x to asciidoctor for man page generation. A new feature supports decompressing .Z files via uncompress. Bug fixes add a section on --pre to the GUIDE, improve error messages for invalid UTF-8 patterns, note how to escape $ with --replace, fix a match bug from inner literal optimization, switch to asciidoctor for man page generation, reduce peak memory usage when searching wide directories, add a note about configuration files in --type-{add,clear} docs, and fix incorrect --count-matches output with look-around.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 12.1.1, bug fixes correct egregious markup output in --help, mention the special $0 capture group in -r/--replace docs, and fix a failing test from out-of-sync dependencies.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 13.0.0, breaking changes include a slight change to binary detection output format, vimgrep output in multi-line mode now only printing the first line for each match, and --count in multi-line mode becoming equivalent to --count-matches. A security fix addresses CVE-2021-3013 on Windows. Performance improvements include checking if a file should be ignored before stat calls and a new vectorized memmem implementation. New features include a -. short flag for --hidden, static executables on Windows with MSVC, --field-{context,match}-separator flags, and a warning when nothing is searched. File type filtering is added or improved for ASP, Bazel, dvc, FlatBuffers, Futhark, minified files, Mint, pofiles, Racket, Red, Ruby, VCL, and Yang.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 14.0.0, breaking changes include a modification to how -A and -B flags override -C. Build process changes involve generating shell completions and man page via a new --generate flag, dropping the asciidoc/asciidoctor dependency. Performance improvements make inner literal cases faster, speed up \b look-arounds, and improve parallel directory traversal. New features include a --hyperlink-format flag for hyperlink support, improved documentation for tty behavior, Apple silicon binaries, a --stop-on-nonmatch flag, and categorized flags in -h/--help. File type filtering is added or improved for Ada, DITA, Elixir, Fuchsia, Gentoo, Gradle, GraphQL, Markdown, Prolog, Raku, TypeScript, USD, and V. The release also contains a rewrite of its regex engine.
In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 14.0.1, a single bug fix includes pkg/windows/Manifest.xml in the crate package to fix cargo install ripgrep on Windows.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 14.0.2, bug fixes address the deb release sha256 sum file, a partial regression in --null-data --line-regexp behavior, Fish shell completions, and a typo in documentation for -i/--ignore-case.
In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 14.0.3, a single bug fix corrects --sortr=path, which was left with a todo!() in the source.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 14.1.0, bug fixes include a fix for unbounded memory growth in the ignore crate. New features add or improve file type filtering for Lean and Meson, improve completions for the fish shell, and add release binaries for additional ARM targets.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 14.1.1, a bug fix addresses a matching bug that could cause false negatives due to an inner literal optimization collision. Miscellaneous changes include the removal of the simd-accel feature because it was frequently broken.

In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 15.0.0, highlights include fixes for gitignore matching bugs, a memory usage regression fix for large gitignore files, rg -vf file with an empty file now matching everything, -r/--replace working with --json, Jujutsu repository support, and nested curly braces in globs. Platform support adds aarch64 Windows artifacts, drops powerpc64 artifacts, and enables full LTO for binaries. Performance improvements avoid resolving helper binaries on Windows when -z isn't used, avoid path canonicalization for hyperlinks, and improve performance with large -A/--after-context values. Bug fixes address gitignore parent directory issues, empty -vf file behavior, UTF-8 BOM in .gitignore, memory regression with large gitignore files, incorrect bytes searched in --stats, globs ending with '.', -m/--max-count with -U/--multiline, line terminator preservation with -r/--replace, inverted exit code with -q --files-without-match, and documentation inconsistency between -c/--count and --files.
In the BurntSushi/ripgrep release 15.1.0, a bug fix addresses a regression with --line-buffered introduced in 15.0.0. A new feature adds a hyperlink alias for Cursor.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent Dokploy/dokploy release stream from v0.25.9 through v0.29.7, covering new features like custom build servers, multi-admin management, rollback rework, AI log analysis, MCP server, shared git providers, and numerous fixes and enhancements.

chunks.title: v0.25.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Dokploy/dokploy release v0.25.9, the update fixes Docker command execution to use a clean environment and enhances environment variable handling for shell commands.

chunks.title: v0.25.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Dokploy/dokploy release v0.25.10, the update adds display of environment in notifications and improves Docker command execution by including environment variables.

chunks.title: v0.25.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Dokploy/dokploy release v0.25.11, the update includes fixes for input handling, date format standardization, error handling in deployments, cleanup operations, pg data path for latest Docker, rclone S3 options, GitLab API URL, user management, notification components, server time, and volume naming; it also adds Railpack installation command and allows organization members to access requests.

chunks.title: v0.26.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Dokploy/dokploy release v0.26.0, the update introduces custom build servers, multi-administrator management, a reworked rollback mechanism using registry-based rollbacks, documentation improvements, and Dokploy Enterprise Support; it also includes various fixes and enhancements such as GitLab authorization, stop grace period, e2e tests, command arguments, notification validation, domain validation, WebSocket timeout, CDN IP ranges, and a top-loading progress bar.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Dokploy/dokploy release v0.28.2, the update handles optional chaining for organization and user IDs in GitHub, simplifies domain handling in Docker compose utilities, and improves loading queries.

chunks.title: v0.28.3

chunks.title: v0.28.4

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent FortAwesome/Font-Awesome release stream from version 5.12.0 through 7.2.0, covering new icons, brand updates, bug fixes, and major version transitions.

chunks.title: Release 5.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FortAwesome/Font-Awesome release 5.12.0, new science fiction and household icons were added, metadata in Yaml format became available in JS packages, and several brand icons were updated including twitch, safari, pied-piper, and android. The haykal icon was renamed to bahai, and 'sideEffects: false' was added to JS icon packages to aid with tree-shaking. Fixes included improved eye position on the dog icon, updated solid style of the shape icon, missing versions for balance-scale-left and balance-scale-right, corrected cut-outs for envelope-open-dollar and envelope-open-text, icon mismatch for contract and expand in the version 4 shim, TypeScript definition for optional params in layer() API, symbol insertion support in Windows Character Map, Word, and PowerPoint, and corrected LICENSE.txt for @fortawesome/fontawesome-svg-core and @fortawesome/fontawesome-common-types.

chunks.title: Release 5.12.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FortAwesome/Font-Awesome release 5.12.1, new icons added include user-unlock, mixer brand, coffin-cross, instagram-square, shopify, and dailymotion. Changes include no longer separating web font files for Free Kits, setting explicit weight of 400 for .fab CSS class, balancing the plus symbol in file-plus and folder-plus, removing the cross from coffin (with coffin-cross still available), updating the edge brand icon, and updating clock hands. Fixes guard against run-away pseudo element searching with String.codePointAt ponyfill and silence errors when using the conflict detector.

chunks.title: Release 5.13.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FortAwesome/Font-Awesome release 5.13.0, new icons related to COVID-19 were added, along with the ability to specify mask ID and title ID for SVG with JS for predictable snapshot testing. Changes include explicitly setting font-display to block to suppress warnings in tools like Lighthouse. Fixes correct the version 4 font face shim src attribute declaration warning of incorrect font file format, and set the font family name to 'Font Awesome 5 Free' for free kits when using pseudo-elements.

chunks.title: Release 5.13.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FortAwesome/Font-Awesome release 5.13.1, new brand icons added include deezer, edge-legacy, google-pay, rust, tiktok, and unsplash. Icons sink, users-slash, bacteria, and bacterium were added to Font Awesome Free. Brand icons bandcamp, google-plus, tripadvisor, and yahoo were updated. A fix addressed the missing version 5.13.0 for the hand-holding-water icon.

chunks.title: Release 5.14.0

chunks.title: Release 5.15.0

chunks.title: Release 5.15.3

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent FuelLabs/fuel-core release stream from v0.40.0 through v0.48.2, covering GraphQL improvements, metrics additions, shared sequencer support, gas price service enhancements, preconfirmations, block aggregation, and PoA high-availability fixes.

chunks.title: v0.40.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.40.0, the project added a GraphQL complexity histogram to metrics, a new CLI flag `graphql-number-of-threads` to limit GraphQL service threads (default 2, 0 for old behavior), and CLI arguments for configuring GraphQL query costs. Fixed PoA block creation timer priority over txpool events. Changed the GraphQL service to prepare for async methods, added new metrics for gas prices, gas used, fees, transactions per block, and P2P swarm/protocol, avoided long heavy tasks in GraphQL by splitting work into batches, updated pagination queries to use async streams, and limited GraphQL service threads. Breaking changes: the `metrics` CLI parameter was replaced with `disable-metrics` (metrics now enabled by default), and the maximum processed coins from `coins_to_spend` query is limited to `max_inputs`.

chunks.title: v0.40.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.40.1, the project added support for posting blocks to the shared sequencer.

chunks.title: v0.40.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.40.2, the project fixed an issue by hardcoding the timestamp of the genesis block.

chunks.title: v0.41.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.41.0, the project added a replacement of the old GraphQL gas price provider adapter with ArcGasPriceEstimate, a GQL endpoint for querying asset details, an uninitialized task for V1 gas price service, `Unknown` variants to `ConsensusParameters` and `Block` GraphQL queries, a `TransactionType` type in `fuel-client`, new TxPool metrics (size, time in pool, number of transactions, pending verification, executable transactions, selection time, insertion time), new histogram buckets for TxPool metrics, an activity concept to protect against infinitely increasing DA gas price, a new request_response protocol version `/fuel/req_res/0.0.2` with error codes, a flag to define maximum file descriptors for RocksDB, a way to fetch transactions in P2P without specifying a peer, caches in the sync service, more service tests and pool documentation, definition of `GasPriceServiceV1` task, a new expiration policy in the transaction pool with pruning, support for posting blocks to the shared sequencer, and removal of `Option<BlockHe...` (truncated).

chunks.title: v0.40.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.40.3, the project added txpool stats to the node_info GraphQL endpoint.

chunks.title: v0.41.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.41.1, the project enhanced the DA compressed block header to include block id, added an `indexation` field to the `nodeInfo` GraphQL endpoint, changed the latest recorded height to be set on initialization, fixed the use of latest gas price to estimate next block gas price during dry runs and in the tx pool, fixed response checking before deserialization, fixed URL construction in `BlockCommitterHttpApi` client, and fixed utxo id decompression.

chunks.title: v0.41.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.41.2, the project fixed an issue by pinning the netlink-proto version.

chunks.title: v0.41.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.41.3, the project fixed a rocksdb import issue when rocksdb is enabled within the `local_node_with_reader` function.

chunks.title: v0.41.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.41.4, the project did not list specific changes in the release notes beyond a warning about LDC and CCP opcode bugs and a reference to the patch in v0.41.6.

chunks.title: v0.40.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.40.4, the project changed the fetching of `latest_height` to use the height at the time of view creation, optimized the `cumulative_percent_change` function used in gas price estimation by converting async functions to sync, removed the `txPoolStats` requirement from the fuel core client, and fixed transaction ordering when tip is zero so that transactions with different gas amounts are correctly prioritized.

chunks.title: v0.41.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.41.5, the project updated the description of the `tx-max-depth` flag, removed some noisy `tracing::info!` logs, fixed transaction ordering when tip is zero, added an integration skeleton of parallel-executor, scaffolded a global merkle root storage crate, added an initial test suite for global merkle root storage updates, added metrics to the gas price service, improved performance of certain async trait impls in the gas price service, and fixed balances query endpoint cost without indexation and behavior of coins to spend with one parameter at zero.

chunks.title: v0.41.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.41.6, the project exposed gas price service test helpers, added global merkle root storage updates for processing upgrade transactions, populated the `ProcessedTransactions` table in global merkle root storage, populated the `Blobs` table in global merkle root storage, added raw contract bytecode to global merkle root storage when processing Create transactions, and fixed the read behavior on InMemoryTransaction to use offset and allow unequal buffer sizes, addressing the LDC and CCP opcode bug.

chunks.title: v0.41.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.41.7, the project fixed compressed transaction backward compatibility by updating Fuel-VM.

chunks.title: v0.41.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.41.8, the project reworked the migration logic for historical tables in the modifications_history.

chunks.title: v0.41.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.41.9, the project fixed the relayer to ensure local state is updated after logs are downloaded, and enabled block production only after all other services have been started.

chunks.title: v0.42.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.42.0, the project introduced breaking changes including a feature-flagged `fault_proving_header` in block headers with a commitment to all transaction ids, removal of public accessors for `BlockHeader` fields, moving `tx_id_commitment` to the application header of `BlockHeaderV2`, CLI argument changes (renaming, time format changes, default value changes), deprecation of `vm-backtrace`, and renaming of `extra_tx_checks` to `forbid_fake_coins`. Added upgrades to libp2p 0.54.1 with ConnectionLimiter, storage read replays for historical blocks behind `--historical-execution`, possibility to submit list of changes to rocksdb, GraphQL query consistency CLI arguments, GraphQL APIs for contract storage and balances for current and past blocks, merklized DA compression temporal registry tables, service definition for state root service, explicit error type for merkleized storage, a new gossip-sub message for transaction preconfirmations, `TemporalRegistry` trait implementations for v2 tables, a pending pool transaction mechanism, API crate for merkle root service, and a new service for managing pre-confirmations.

chunks.title: v0.43.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.43.0, the project introduced breaking changes: the type of `resolved_outputs` for pre-confirmations now includes `Utxoid`, removal of `Deref` impl on `ImportResult`, compressed block headers include a merkle root of the temporal registry after compression, and the `compress` function takes a reference to `Config`. Added linking of all preconfirmation components with E2E tests, listening to tx status updates from `TxStatusManager` in `TxPool` with cleanup and promotion logic, notifying P2P from `TxStatusManager` on bad preconfirmation messages, a new `dryRunRecordStorageReads` query, an `allow_partial` parameter for `coinsToSpend`, and tests for proof generation and validation of sparse and merklized tables. Changed off-chain worker compression to a dedicated compression service, broke out test logic to trait methods, and made preconfirmation optional on API endpoints. Fixed background work cancellation on primary RocksDB drop and immediate rejection of transactions using spent coins via a SpentInputs LRU cache. Removed DA compression from off-chain worker.

chunks.title: v0.41.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.41.10, the project fixed an issue to ensure that VM heap memory is zeroed out on reallocation after `reset`, bumping `fuel-vm` to 0.59.3.

chunks.title: v0.43.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.43.1, the project ensured that VM heap memory is zeroed out on reallocation after `reset`, added support for `GM::GetGasPrice`, and bumped `fuel-vm` to 0.60.2.

chunks.title: v0.43.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.43.2, the project fixed the compression service to prevent syncing from genesis if the compression database is empty.

chunks.title: v0.44.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.44.0, the project introduced breaking changes: bumped Rust version to 1.85.0, made newly generated WASM state transition functions incompatible with old fuel-core versions, changed registry root calculation for compression tables to no longer account for the evictor cache, upgraded to 2024 Rust edition, changed the return type of the `balance` endpoint from `u64` to `u128`, and updated `fuel-vm` to 0.61.1 with receipts using `SubId` scalar type. Added making the `registry` mod public in `fuel-core-compression`, an `excluded_contract` filter for transaction extraction from TxPool, a simple makefile, and additional error logs for Ethereum provider failures. Changed by updating fuel-vm to 0.62.0. Fixed VM heap memory zeroing on reallocation with `GM::GetGasPrice` support and fuel-vm 0.60.2, client coins endpoint to correctly return all asset types when `asset_id` is `None`, conditional txpool pre-conf broadcast, prevention of syncing compression database from genesis with `--da-compression-starting-height`, assemble tx not counting message data inputs as spendable for fees, and pinned graphiql playground to v3 with caching. Removed unnecessary lifetime constraints on fuel-core-client.

chunks.title: v0.45.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.45.1, the project introduced breaking changes: support for rolling back Relayer DB, bumped Rust version to 1.86.0, and upgraded `wasmtime` and `thiserror` dependencies. Added a `Registrations` table to the compression database (merkleized), support for state rewind for compression DB, and a new configuration option `--p2p-cache-size`. Changed by disabling dependency on blob transactions in the transaction pool, using ubuntu:24.04 for x86_64 binary builds, using v44 STF for forward-compatibility tests, and increasing default transmission size to 260MB to support 2.5MB blocks during synchronization. Fixed the `MaxCoinsReached` error to be thrown when the target reaches the max input limit.

chunks.title: v0.46.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.46.0, the project introduced a breaking change to fix the `AssetDetails` endpoint to match GraphQL standards. Added tests showing that mints are correctly added and validated, and an alpha version of new subscriptions for pre confirmations and new blocks (disabled by default, enabled via `--expensive-subscriptions`). Fixed block compression to use outputs instead of events.

chunks.title: v0.47.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.47.1, the project introduced breaking changes: extended `CoinConfig` to support private keys, used new `fuel-vm 0.64.0` with default gas cost changes and receipts behind `Arc`, changed `deploy_contract_with_id` to work with `[u8]`, disabled gossip subscription for transactions by default (enable with `--subscribe-to-transactions`), fixed a bug charging for additional 40 entries on GraphQL queries, used hash-based `balance_root` and `state_root` fields in tx inputs and outputs, bumped Rust version to 1.90.0 and fuel-vm to 0.65.0, and changed the algorithm for genesis state root and balance root to not use SMTs. Added a method to wait for `gas_price` to finish syncing, support for awaiting DA block height on pre-defined block production, a new benchmarking group for `niop` operations, debug logging in predicates and scripts using ECAL with fuel-vm 0.63.0, scaffolding for a new block aggregator service, an adapter for the block aggregator DB, a subscription manager for core service, and a block source adapter using fuel storage and block importer. Changed by actualizing benchmarks with network performance, adding optimizations (memory reuse, receipt extraction, faster gas discovery, avoiding contract bytecode cloning), and other improvements.

chunks.title: v0.47.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.47.2, the project added fork resilience for Leader Lock and added a lease port for PoA adapter to allow multiple producers to be live but only one leader.

chunks.title: v0.47.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.47.3, the project included PoA quorum and HA failover fixes.

chunks.title: v0.48.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.48.0, the project introduced breaking changes: only the first RPC URL is used for relayer server provider, fixed the index of transactions inside pre-confirmations during native block production, and bumped dependencies and Rust version to 1.93.0. Added a protobuf API for querying the block aggregator, integrated new block aggregation RPC into Fuel Core, added an adapter for storing blocks on AWS S3 bucket, added a quorum provider, completed coverage of proto block types, introduced `FailoverTransport` for retrying GraphQL queries across multiple endpoints, integrated a backup tool as an `archive` subcommand, added integration tests for preconfirmation transaction indices, and added integration tests for FuelClient failover functionality. Changed by migrating relayer service and tests from ethers-rs to alloy-rs, including `tx_id` into `SqueezedOut` reason, making `stage` and `data` fields public in `DataSource`, migrating CI from BuildJet to WarpBuild runners, updating fuel-vm to 0.66 with new instruction benchmarks, adding lease port for PoA adapter, and applying PoA quorum and HA failover fixes. Fixed serialization to use Protobuf types, using Debian Bookworm as Docker runtime base image, better signal handling, typo errors in CI, ignored rustsec advisories, fixed `FuelClient::with_urls` to normalize URLs, and validated TxPool transactions against next block height.

chunks.title: v0.47.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.47.4, the project changed by migrating CI from BuildJet to WarpBuild runners, adding lease port for PoA adapter, and applying PoA quorum and HA failover fixes. Fixed by using Debian Bookworm as Docker runtime base image, rolling back stale preconfirmations in the mempool, grouping reconciliation votes by block_id, preventing PoA leader deadlock after reconciliation import, and improving redis publish performance.

chunks.title: v0.48.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.48.1, the project changed by migrating to GCR Distroless Docker images, adding client and server support for protobuf HTTP-based remote RPC block accessor, and bumping wasmtime to 0.43.1. Fixed backward-compatibility of GraphQL queries for pre-0.48.0 versions, PoA leader deadlock after reconciliation import, rollback of stale preconfirmations in the mempool, PoA reconciliation deadlock when the same block exists on all Redis nodes with different epochs, improved performance of redis block publish, fixed mainnet block-production hang when a single ElastiCache leader-lock node enters a half-alive state, and added forward-compatibility for old clients and new fuel-core.

chunks.title: v0.48.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the FuelLabs/fuel-core release v0.48.2, the project fixed shutdown services to run in parallel to stop PoA promptly, used semantic JSON comparison in QuorumTransport, and disabled coredumps in the fuel-core binary to prevent RocksDB atexit SIGABRT from blocking pod restarts (opt back in with `FUEL_CORE_ENABLE_COREDUMP=1`).

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent Genymobile/scrcpy release stream from v1.18 through v4.0, covering major features like Android version support, HID/OTG modes, audio forwarding, virtual displays, and SDL3 migration.

chunks.title: scrcpy v1.18
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v1.18, the project adds support for Android 12, introduces V4L2 device screen capture as a webcam, adds options to lock initial video orientation and power off the device on close, binds 4th and 5th mouse buttons to APP_SWITCH and notification panel, changes default push target to /sdcard/Download, centers window on resize-to-fit, and removes the --render-expired-frames option.

chunks.title: scrcpy v1.19
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v1.19, the project implements optional buffering for display and V4L2 to reduce jitter, makes --turn-screen-off work with --no-display, works around a Windows non-ASCII path issue, prints correct error messages on Windows socket errors, and upgrades platform-tools to 31.0.3 and SDL to 2.0.16 in Windows releases.

chunks.title: scrcpy v1.20
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v1.20, the project adds an official high-resolution icon, introduces HID keyboard support on Linux, adapts --help output to terminal size, reworks server initialization, removes deprecated short options -T and -c, fixes V4L2 muxer and Meizu device workarounds, and fixes expand notification feature on some devices.

chunks.title: scrcpy v1.21
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v1.21, the project adds --tcpip to automate wireless connections, --raw-key-events to always inject key events, --no-clipboard-autosync to disable automatic clipboard sync, --tunnel-host and --tunnel-port for remote ADB tunneling, ensures clipboard sync before Ctrl+v via HID keyboard, adapts settings read/write for Android 12, fixes hanging with multiple instances on Windows, and prints help to stdout.

chunks.title: scrcpy v1.22
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v1.22, the project adds HID mouse support, introduces OTG mode for HID-only operation without mirroring or adb, enables DPI awareness by default on Windows, automatically retries with lower definition on MediaCodec error, adds a shortcut to open a terminal on Windows, adds an icon to scrcpy.exe, adds server options to send raw H.264 video, fixes process execution on Windows 7, fixes adb server hang, fixes input injection on custom ROMs, fixes possible overflow on copy-paste, and upgrades SDL to 2.0.20 and FFmpeg to 5.0 in Windows releases.

chunks.title: scrcpy v1.23
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v1.23, the project adds HID/OTG support for Windows (OTG only) and macOS, improves device selection by listing devices and supporting -d/-e, downscales and retries on MediaCodec error in more cases, adds ZSH and Bash completion scripts, adds --no-cleanup and --printf-fps options, prints both compiled and linked library versions, fixes the FPS counter, and makes various technical refactors.

chunks.title: scrcpy v1.24
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v1.24, the project adapts input injection for Android 13, adds --no-power-on option, reads $ANDROID_SERIAL if no selector is specified, considers emulators as TCP/IP devices, applies requested window size in OTG mode, adds specific exit code for device disconnection, enables libusb support for Windows 32-bit, upgrades libusb to 1.0.26, platform-tools to 33.0.1, SDL to 2.0.22, and FFmpeg to 5.0.1 in Windows releases, and improves error messages.

chunks.title: scrcpy v1.25
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v1.25, the project adapts copy-paste internals for Android 13, adds support for high-precision scrolling, adds desktop entry files for Linux, adds bash and zsh autocompletion for -s/--serial, uses current adb port for --tcpip, adds fallback to get display information on some devices, fixes click behavior with --forward-all-clicks, fixes non-ASCII characters in window title, fixes getDisplayIds() crash on Android 13 beta, and upgrades platform-tools to 33.0.3, FFmpeg to 5.1.2, and SDL to 2.26.1 in Windows releases.

chunks.title: scrcpy v2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v2.0, the project adds audio forwarding, H265 and AV1 video codec support, --list-displays and --list-encoders options, fixes clicks on Chrome with --forward-on-clicks, retries on spurious encoder error, makes --turn-screen-off work on all displays, restores resizing workaround for Windows, and upgrades platform-tools to 34.0.1, FFmpeg to 6.0, and SDL to 2.26.4 in Windows releases.

chunks.title: scrcpy v2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v2.1, the project adds --no-video for audio-only mirroring, option to select device microphone as audio source, renames --no-display to --no-playback and adds --no-video-playback and --no-audio-playback, adds --time-limit to auto-stop after a delay, adds option to change audio output buffer size, adds option to kill adb on close, supports dynamic device folding, uses OpenGL 3.0+ on macOS, adds partial Android 14 support, improves delay buffer estimation, fixes --tcpip, audio for Vivo/Honor phones, copy-paste on Honor Magic 5 Pro, audio capture on Android 11+, V4L2 regression, Nvidia Shield support, .desktop files, device rotation while minimized on Windows, extra audio glitches, and PTS for buggy encoders, and upgrades SDL to 2.28 in Windows releases.

chunks.title: scrcpy v2.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v2.1.1, the project ignores fold change events for other display ids, fixes a Meizu deadlock, fixes a possible division by zero, and increases attempts to start AudioRecord.

chunks.title: scrcpy v2.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v2.2, the project adds option to mirror camera, adds --pause-on-exit, renames --display to --display-id, fixes device disconnection detection with --no-video, accepts --turn-screen-off without video playback, and upgrades SDL to 2.28.4 and platform-tools to 34.0.5 in Windows releases.

chunks.title: scrcpy v2.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v2.3, the project adds flipped display orientation, recording rotation, FLAC audio codec, raw audio (WAV) recording, fixes turn screen off for Android 14, fixes camera issues on many devices, fixes clipboard synchronization when no video, fixes screen refresh on device rotation, fixes .desktop files on Linux, and upgrades SDL to 2.28.5 in Windows releases.

chunks.title: scrcpy v2.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v2.3.1, the project adds a workaround for issues on Samsung devices, fixes an error in a headless environment without display, fixes AV1 demuxing, and fixes a build issue on macOS.

chunks.title: scrcpy v2.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v2.4, the project adds UHID keyboard and mouse support, simulates tilt multitouch by pressing Shift, adds rotation support for non-default display, improves audio player, adapts to display API changes in Android 15, adapts audio workarounds to Android 14, fixes clipboard for IQOO devices on Android 14, fixes integer overflow for audio packet duration, reworks cleanup, and upgrades FFmpeg to 6.1.1 and libusb to 1.0.27 in Windows releases.

chunks.title: scrcpy v2.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v2.5, the project adds a scrcpy window without video playback, adds a shortcut to pause/unpause display, forwards mouse hover events, adds option to configure mouse bindings, forwards all clicks by default for UHID/AOA, simplifies shortcut modifiers, fixes rotation shortcut for Android 14, fixes YUV conversion for full color range, fixes camera sizes listing on some devices, fixes thread leak on Windows, and upgrades FFmpeg to 7.0.1, SDL to 2.30.4, and platform-tools to 35.0.0 in Windows releases.

chunks.title: scrcpy v2.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v2.6, the project adds audio playback capture method, audio duplication feature, mouse secondary bindings with Shift+click, reworks mouse events, fixes "turn screen off" for Honor devices, adds clipboard workaround for Honor devices, always applies device workarounds, fixes missing initialization, does not report error on device disconnected, and upgrades SDL to 2.30.5 in Windows releases.

chunks.title: scrcpy v2.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v2.6.1, the project injects finger input whenever possible to fix mouse event issues in some applications introduced in v2.6.

chunks.title: scrcpy v2.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v2.7, the project adds gamepad support, fixes workarounds for ONYX devices, accepts float values for --max-fps, and upgrades SDL to 2.30.7 in Windows releases.

chunks.title: scrcpy v3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v3.0, the project adds virtual display feature, ability to launch Android app on start, OpenGL filters, --capture-orientation to replace broken --lock-video-orientation, fixes --crop on Android 14, handles virtual display rotation, adds --angle for custom rotation, adds --screen-off-timeout, adapts "turn screen off" for Android 15, adds shortcut Ctrl+Shift+click-and-move for horizontal tilt, adds shortcut MOD+Shift+r to reset video capture/encoding, forwards Alt and Super with SDK Keyboard, adds more details to --list-encoders output, adds option to disable virtual display system decorations, fixes --time-limit overflow on Windows, fixes "does not match caller's uid 2000" error, accepts filenames containing ':' when recording, disables mouse by default if no video playback, renames --display-buffer to --video-buffer, listens to display changed events, adapts server debugging for Android >= 11, upgrades FFmpeg to 7.1, SDL to 2.30.9, platform-tools to 35.0.2, builds releases via GitHub Actions, and releases static builds for Linux and macOS.

chunks.title: scrcpy v3.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v3.0.1, the project sets main display power for virtual display, rolls back to old --turn-screen-off method for Android 15, does not reset TCP/IP connections, fixes socket interruption on macOS, fixes NullPointerException on certain devices, fixes camera capture failure without retry, accepts control events without display, builds macOS x86_64 release, fixes .tar.gz compression for release tarballs, and calls static binary without wrapper script.

chunks.title: scrcpy v3.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v3.0.2, the project fixes a version issue.

chunks.title: scrcpy v3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v3.1, the project adds --no-vd-destroy-content to keep virtual display content on close, improves gamepad support in games, injects events to main display, fixes "turn screen off" on some devices, improves cleanup reliability, adds dav1d in release builds, and upgrades SDL to 2.30.10.

chunks.title: scrcpy v3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v3.2, the project adds many audio sources (mic-unprocessed, mic-camcorder, mic-voice-recognition, mic-voice-communication, voice-call, voice-call-uplink, voice-call-downlink, voice-performance), improves/fixes camera listing, adds --display-ime-policy, allows controls with --no-window, adds workaround for Pico 4 Ultra, fixes rotation after recent Android 15 upgrade, fixes audio capture on Android 16, makes static Linux binaries compatible with older versions, makes static macOS binaries compatible with older versions, and upgrades FFmpeg to 7.1.1, libusb to 1.0.28, and SDL to 2.32.2.

chunks.title: scrcpy v3.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v3.3, the project associates UHID devices to virtual displays, fixes audio capture (again) on Android 16, fixes segfault with --no-window without --no-control, fixes default locked capture orientation, adds app name SDL hint, reports specific error for INJECT_EVENT permission, and upgrades platform-tools to 36.0.0, SDL to 2.32.8, and libusb to 1.0.29.

chunks.title: scrcpy v3.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v3.3.1, the project fixes --power-off-on-close, fixes clipboard with --no-clipboard-autosync, fixes --list-apps and --list-cameras, fixes HID mouse support with SDL precise scrolling, and adds horizontal scrolling support for HID mouse.

chunks.title: scrcpy v3.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v3.3.2, the project fixes virtual display after Android 16 upgrade, works around clipboard issue on Samsung devices, catches CTRL_BREAK_EVENT signal on Windows, and makes various technical fixes.

chunks.title: scrcpy v3.3.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Genymobile/scrcpy release v3.3.3, the project fixes immediate error after new Android 16 upgrade, fixes frame memory leak on Windows in specific cases, and makes virtual display presentable.

chunks.title: scrcpy v3.3.4
