prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent Homebrew/brew release stream from 5.0.2 through 5.1.14, covering incremental improvements, new commands, internal API changes, and the introduction of a Rust frontend.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Homebrew/brew release 5.0.2, the project adds a `--online` flag to `dev-cmd/lgtm`, allows the `WSL_DISTRO_NAME` environment variable, replaces `sdk_path_if_needed` with `sdk_path`, skips libexec metafiles if the prefix already has some, adds dependencies to the internal API in `dev-cmd/generate-formula-api`, removes old fuse pkg-config files on macOS, makes `bump-formula-pr --write-only` skip PR checks, updates Portable Ruby to 3.4.7, recommends MacPorts for older macOS versions, runs bump once per synced group in `dev-cmd/bump`, audits `synced_versions_formulae.json` in `tap_auditor`, runs `setup_gem_environment!` in `utils/gems`, makes `HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_FROM_API` disable `HOMEBREW_USE_INTERNAL_API`, adds `brew --taps` command, removes arm-linux from Gemfile.lock, fixes permissions for Linux GitHub Actions in `dev-cmd/vendor-gems`, uses GitHub Actions helper method more consistently, notes Homebrew/discussions in CONTRIBUTING, adds profiling to `brew tests`, updates ruby_URLs when using `HOMEBREW_ARTIFACT_DOMAIN`, bumps dependencies, checks requirement on simulated system in `github_runner_matrix`, tweaks linkage handling in `upgrade`, changes quarters to be the most common unit of time in `dev-cmd/contributions`, fixes spacing in `--quarter` docs, prevents users from uninstalling casks with dependents, fixes rubocop in vscode and simplifies `brew install-bundler-gems` calls, leaves default `ignore_errors=false` for internal API load in `formulary`, removes `pypi_formula_mappings.json` code, and tweaks workflows/tests behaviour.

In the Homebrew/brew release 5.0.3, the project disables the internal API in `env_config`, updates the example for listing taps with a note about fresh installs, uses a simpler check for performance in `cmd/which-formula`, adds the test_prof plugin to rubocop.yml, corrects links for brew mirrors, adds a Nice option to service, adds comprehensive validation for formula and cask renames in `tap_auditor`, fixes a flaky test in `bundle/commands/install_spec`, adds `arm64?` to hardware, enables arm64 linux dep tests when not self-hosted in `github_runner_matrix`, retains patches in `update_python_resources` in `utils/pypi`, adds a ThrottleInterval option to service on macOS, respects arch for universal apps in `audit_min_os`, removes portable ruby bin from PATH, moves rustc_wrapper from super to shared in shims, and fails on checksum mismatch in `download_queue`.

In the Homebrew/brew release 5.0.4, the project allows checking non-brew libraries in `utils/linkage`, audits `conflicts_with` stanza in `cask/audit`, restores setting up gem environment in `dev-cmd/vendor-gems`, installs ast bundler gems before requiring `utils/pypi` in dev-cmd, clarifies `desktop` and `launcher` suffix in tokens in cask-cookbook, uses canonical_path on `<sysroot>/usr/lib` in shims/super/cc, makes `system_config` `typed: strict`, checks for Metal Toolchain in `extend/os/mac/system_config`, removes `session-manager-plugin` in `test_bot`, does not remove `lib` formulae/casks in `item`, bumps dependencies, writes files to tmpdir in `test/commands_spec`, makes `brew uninstall` respect `HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_FROM_API`, updates type signature for `==`, adds flatpak support to brewfile, makes `outdated` respect `HOMEBREW_UPGRADE_GREEDY_CASKS`, adds `--no-secrets` switch to `cmd/bundle`, ignores scripts optionally by default in `std_npm_args`, only uses MachOShim/ELFShim when required, fixes linkage detection in `linkage_checker`, makes `formula_versions` `typed: strict`, updates `array_alphabetization` to check `conflicts_with` methods, documents Flatpak support in docs/Brew-Bundle-and-Brewfile, and fixes a type error in `linux/cask/artifact/relocated`.

In the Homebrew/brew release 5.0.5, the project prefers lsof to ps to read the command for a process in `shellenv`, updates quarter dates in `dev-cmd/contributions`, overhauls Homebrew governance, audits `revision` and `compatibility_version` in `formula_auditor`, adds Lead Maintainers to README and manpages, fixes broken links in README, makes `utils/git` `typed: strict`, makes `compilers` `typed: strict`, updates pull request documentation for casks, suppresses warning from lsof, adds comment on older GCC usage in compilers, makes `unversioned_cask_checker` `typed: strict`, removes `T.must` in attestation, makes `extend/os/linux/hardware/cpu` `typed: strict`, removes unused `--concurrent-downloads` in `dev-cmd/test-bot`, makes `install`, `installed_dependents`, and `uninstall` `typed: strict`, avoids here-string for sandbox compatibility in `brew.sh`, deprecates `Formula#needs` and removes `needs :openmp` support, makes `requirements/codesign_requirement` `typed: strict` and deprecates it, replaces some `install_test_formula` with `setup_test_formula` in test, checks for SSSE3 instructions, makes `test` `typed: strict`, deprecates `option :cxx11` and `option :universal`, bumps `urllib3` in formula-analytics/requirements.txt, bumps `github_packages` to Sorbet `typed: strict`, removes unused inherited_options, removes unneeded formulae in linuxbrew-core-migration, casts `pkg_version` and `rebuild` to `Version` and `Integer` in `github_packages`, and converts formula version to a string in schema in `github_packages`.

In the Homebrew/brew release 5.0.6, the project removes migration of linuxbrew-core formulae, removes obsolete PKGID in `os/mac/xcode`, removes linuxbrew automatic git repo migration, bumps dependencies, fixes pouring dependencies extracted by download queue, makes cask uninstall opt-in quit/signal on upgrade/reinstall, avoids slow `brew link` in `test/bundle/formula_installer_spec`, moves to ubuntu-slim, uses `FormulaStruct` when loading formulae from the API, skips non-core compatibility bumps check in `formula_auditor`, does not abort an install if a dangling tracking link exists, speeds up cask tests, adds all `deprecate!` and `disable!` arguments to the formula API, sets `deprecate!`/`disable!` args correctly in `FormulaStruct`, bumps dependencies, makes `cleanup` `typed: strict`, uses bottle pour for faster test run in `test/cmd`, adds workaround for language URLs in `cask/installer`, includes Formulae API in Homebrew caching proxy instructions in docs/Tips-and-Tricks, makes `extend/os/mac/hardware/cpu` `typed: strict`, adds `--ruby` option to `brew sh`, makes several cask files `typed: strict`, shows "Verified" status after successful checksum verification in `downloadable`, migrates installed formulae in `cmd/update-report`, adds Homebrew's ruby to PATH for VSCode Ruby LSP setup, skips symlinks in `bundle/go_dumper`, makes `extend/ENV/{shared,std}` `typed: strict`, avoids running xcrun unless needed in `os/mac/sdk`, allows running `--changed` in sub-directory in `dev-cmd/style`, fixes absolute path of changed files in `dev-cmd/audit`, and clarifies when `--include-test` is recursive in `cmd/deps`.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent JetBrains/kotlin release stream across multiple versions, including 2.2.10, 2.2.20, 2.2.21, 2.3.0, 2.3.10, 2.3.20, 2.3.21, and 2.4.0, with their respective release candidates and betas.

chunks.title: Kotlin 2.2.10-RC2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the JetBrains/kotlin release Kotlin 2.2.10-RC2, the changelog includes compiler fixes for dexing failures with null local variables, broken code generation for JVM default suspend methods in interfaces, and a missing symbol error on iOS 15.5 simulator in Xcode 16.3. JavaScript fixes address an unexpected IR class body and a missing 'mocha' module in jsNode tests. Native fixes resolve a stuck symbolication process and a missing LLVM symbol. Kapt fixes an unresolved reference issue with @kotlin.Metadata in Java.

chunks.title: Kotlin 2.2.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the JetBrains/kotlin release Kotlin 2.2.10, the changelog includes compiler fixes for dexing failures, broken JVM default suspend methods, iOS simulator symbol errors, missing diagnostics for delegated interface methods, IR lowering failures, Kotlin/Native compiler performance reporting, missing inline diagnostics, an IllegalArgumentException, missing ABSTRACT_SUPER_CALL, and a false-positive identity sensitive operation warning. Compose compiler fixes ensure default transform affects functions, fix visibility for default wrappers, and emit parameter names in Compose source information. JavaScript fixes address the IR class body and mocha module issues. Native fixes include the symbolication and LLVM symbol issues, plus a crash on Apple Watch. CLI fixes resolve unresolved references and a NoClassDefFoundError. Compiler plugins fix an AssertionError for protected open composable calls and make jvm-abi-gen output classloader-friendly. Gradle fixes support creating KotlinJvmAndroidCompilation, and JS fixes address broken NPM build cache entries.

chunks.title: Kotlin 2.2.20-RC

Compose compiler fixes include target description lookup, preventing lambda memoization in local classes, and fixing AbstractMethodError for overridden functions with default parameters. JavaScript fixes address an Uncaught TypeError with long-as-bigint, incorrect Long.rotateLeft results, BigInt enabled for ES 2015, and the mocha module issue. Native fixes resolve the stuck symbolication. Serialization plugin fixes exclude field-less properties. Gradle JS fixes address webpack reconfiguration and Wasm subtask triggering. Swift Export fixes a status diagnostic issue. Kapt fixes reduce verbose output and fix unresolved nested class references.

chunks.title: Kotlin 2.2.20-RC2

FIR fixes address SOE from recursive value classes, companion object references via typealias, partial body resolution, context parameters on dangling modifier lists, delegation generic signature checker, context() call errors, NPE in Java type parameter bounds, KaType.asPsiType returning null, implicit receiver smart-cast snapshots, resolveToFirSymbol finding scripts, lazy resolution before accessing modifiers, sealed inheritors checker exceptions, dangling annotation on anonymous functions, local variable scope in do-while, and lazy transformer rework. Multiplatform fixes address broken KMP Parcelize implementation and removal of scoped resolvable configurations. prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent Kong/insomnia release stream from 11.5.0-beta.0 through 12.6.0, covering beta iterations, stable releases, and feature introductions such as external vault support, MCP client, LLM integrations, and Konnect sync.

chunks.title: 11.5.0-beta.0 📦
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Kong/insomnia release core@11.5.0-beta.0, the team delivers a beta that includes session exposure fixes, replacement of lodash with es-toolkit, bulk project import support, improved undo changes confirmation with file count details, OAuth authorize using system browser, external vault separation and bundle plugin support, a React Router SPA mode architecture change, data folder constraints for file access, Electron bumps to 36 and 37, and various UI and performance improvements.

chunks.title: 11.5.0-beta.1 📦
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Kong/insomnia release core@11.5.0-beta.1, the team addresses onboarding route handling with splat, improves error handling and success notifications for Git push operations, maintains localStorage data after migrating from the file:// protocol, cleans up Resolve Conflicts and Changes UX, resolves merge conflicts when no script changes exist, and fixes socket.io creation in folders.

chunks.title: 11.5.0-beta.2 📦
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Kong/insomnia release core@11.5.0-beta.2, the team fixes macOS auto-update, adjusts Hashicorp vault config form with help tooltip, supports listing folder environment keys in the editor auto-complete list, includes linting dependencies in the final package, bumps the external vault plugin, fixes modal error message wrapping, and resolves a crash when viewing repo settings without a connected repo.

chunks.title: 11.5.0-beta.3 📦
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Kong/insomnia release core@11.5.0-beta.3, the team fixes an issue with project name when creating a new git project and points the 'See What's New' app update notification link to the official changelog page.

chunks.title: 11.5.0-beta.4 📦
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Kong/insomnia release core@11.5.0-beta.4, the team finesses the experience of loading remote branches when creating a project, excludes the dist directory from TypeScript compilation, fixes repository form validation, and addresses file filtering inside the project.
In the Kong/insomnia release core@11.5.0, the team promotes the 11.5.0-beta.4 changes to stable and includes a wording change.

chunks.title: 11.6.0-beta.0 📦
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Kong/insomnia release core@11.6.0-beta.0, the team fixes workspace deletion errors, race conditions when switching projects, improves Postman script translation, removes nunjucks context API, refactors database get descendants, bumps Vite to v7, refines error messages for file imports, prunes database methods, removes fromSync hack, improves TypeScript, puts collection filter into localStorage, provides more user-friendly Swagger file error messages, redirects to organization page if project not found, cleans unused notification calls, creates submit hook with factory, adds auth for socket.io, fixes Playwright warnings, updates Electron to 37, updates tab after moving request, improves commit modal and uncommitted modal, adds initModel to findOne, fixes issue where pulling/discarding changes on a Git Project would remove metadata or private environments, includes token as backup credential when initially fetching repo contents, bumps electron-builder, improves wording for Security Whitelist Error Message, and resolves git merge conflicts change by change.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent LizardByte/Sunshine release stream from v0.11.1 through v2026.531.163415, covering early fixes, platform expansion, security hardening, and major feature additions like AV1 encoding, HDR, and new capture backends.

chunks.title: v0.11.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.11.1, the project fixes a configuration issue where the Linux version searched the wrong path for config and assets, and uploads new .deb packages. Changes include fixing a segfault when connecting multiple controllers, improving NVENC on Linux to offload RGB-to-NV12 conversion, adding support for wlroots-based compositors on Wayland, fixing a stuttering bug on Linux, and adding an icon for the Windows executable.

chunks.title: v0.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.12.0, the project adds a --version command line argument and custom PNG poster support. Changes include correcting software bitrate calculation, increasing vbv-bufsize to 1/10 of requested bitrate, and improvements to the Web UI.

chunks.title: v0.13.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.13.0, the project adds initial support for macOS.

chunks.title: v0.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.14.0, the project adds Sphinx documentation, initial localization support, an RPM package for Linux, a Portfile for macOS, a DwmFlush() call to improve capture on Windows, and a Windows installer. Fixes include resolving an AMD hwdevice destruction order issue, adding missing dependencies to the AppImage, fixing rumble events causing game freezes on Linux, improving Pulse/Pipewire compatibility, moving to a single deb package, fixing a missing TPCircularBuffer submodule on macOS, properly catching exceptions in stream broadcast handlers, and an AVPacket fix.

chunks.title: v0.14.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.14.1, the project adds a Flatpak package for Linux, automated AUR package updates, and automated Winget package updates for Windows. Changes include moving the repository to the LizardByte GitHub organization, fixing button spacing on the Web UI home page, and adding a Discord WidgetBot Crate. Fixes ensure default config and app files are copied to the user home directory on Linux/macOS and to the working directory on Windows.

chunks.title: v0.15.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.15.0, the project adds firewall rules scripts for Windows, automatic firewall rule management at install/uninstall, automatic service install/uninstall on Windows, an official Docker image, and an aarch64 Flatpak package for Linux. Changes include moving default config and apps files to an assets directory, bumping Boost to 1.80 for MacPorts builds, and removing backup/restore of config files on Linux. Fixes address creating the Sunshine config directory if missing, removing portable home/config directories for AppImage, including service install/uninstall scripts again, automatically deleting start menu entries and program directories on uninstall with user prompt, handling no default audio sink on Linux, fixing default image paths, and fixing CUDA RGBA to NV12 conversion on Linux.

chunks.title: v0.16.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.16.0, the project adds a cover finder, an arm64 Docker image, Flatpak installation helper scripts, and Unicode input message support on Windows. Fixes include reintroducing Ubuntu 20.04 and 22.04 specific deb packages and fixing udev and systemd file locations on Linux. Dependencies are updated, including using npm for web dependencies and pre-built ffmpeg from LizardByte/build-deps, which are breaking changes for third-party package maintainers.

chunks.title: v0.17.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.17.0, the project addresses a security flaw on Windows where the binary was in a user-writable location and games ran as SYSTEM; now games run under the user account without elevated privileges. Breaking changes include removing automatic desktop entry, improving the Windows upgrade experience, moving config files to a specific directory, and fixing the npm path. Additions include initial arm64 macOS support via MacPorts, foreign keyboard input support, logs in the Web UI and to file, an Apply button on the configuration page when running as a service, and enabling Mouse Keys while streaming. Numerous fixes improve capture performance, audio bitrate/quality, PATH handling, service stability, NV12 color conversion, game launching under correct user account, encoder presets, certificate serial numbers, graceful termination, app launching as admin, removal of std::abort() calls, log consistency, automatic app list updates in Moonlight, Wayland capture on Nvidia, 7.1 surround channel mapping, NVENC profile values, origin_web_ui_allowed binding, service self-termination on hang, masked cursor blending, color conversion, and BT.2020 support. Dependencies are updated, including ffmpeg from 4.4 to 5.1.

chunks.title: v0.18.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.18.0, the project contains critical security fixes and encourages users to change their Sunshine password. Additions include Intel QuickSync support on Windows, aarch64 deb and rpm packages for Linux, hybrid graphics system support on Windows, streaming from Steam Deck Gaming Mode on Linux, and HDR support on Windows. Fixes include refactoring UPnP port forwarding, enforcing a 10 FPS minimum encoding frame rate, making deb and rpm packages distro-specific, adding an Nvidia/NVENC preset migration guide, network performance optimizations, fixing streaming to multiple clients from hardware encoders, fixing child process spawning on Linux, fixing a security vulnerability in SimpleWebServer, renaming "Steam BigPicture" to "Steam Big Picture", scrubbing basic authorization headers from logs, restarting the systemd service on crash, fixing KMS RGB import errors, fixing stream freezing on resolution change, fixing silent installation and other installer improvements, and significantly improving CPU usage.

chunks.title: v0.18.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.18.1, the project fixes missing dependencies for deb and rpm packages on Linux and switches to using dynamic Boost.

chunks.title: v0.18.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.18.2, the project fixes Wayland capture on Nvidia for KMS, implements vaSyncBuffer for libva <2.9.0, fixes a MIME type issue with reverse proxies, adds missing audio sink config options on macOS, specifies correct Boost dependency versions, and adds missing AMF encoder tunables.

chunks.title: v0.18.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.18.3, the project adds a PKGBUILD and precompiled package for Arch Linux-based distros, and an Arch Linux Docker image (x86_64 only).

chunks.title: v0.18.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.18.4, the project drops support for the AUR package on Linux and makes general enhancements to Docker images.

chunks.title: v0.19.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.19.0, the project moves Flatpak to org.freedesktop.Platform 22.08 and CUDA 12.0.0, dropping support for Nvidia GPUs with compute capability 3.5. Additions include options to suppress input from gamepads/keyboards/mice, Unicode support for remote pasting on Linux, XTest input fallback, version notifications in the Web UI, a system tray icon, ability to safely elevate commands on Windows, global prep commands with per-app exclusion, and automatic ViGEmBus installation in the Windows installer. Changes include logging client verified messages as debug, saving only non-default config values, using xdg-desktop-autostart for the systemd service, a config option to force capture method on Linux, executing prep commands in the current user context on Windows, and allowing disconnected X11 outputs. Fixes address international key translation and stuck modifier keys on Windows, startup when /dev/dri doesn't exist, changing software encoding settings to a select menu, and not terminating on failure to allow Web UI access.

chunks.title: v0.19.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.19.1, the project fixes a no audio issue introduced in v0.19.0.

chunks.title: v0.20.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.20.0, the project makes several breaking changes: the Windows installer version is always launched by the Sunshine Service, the Start Menu shortcut is redesigned to launch Sunshine in the background and open the Web UI, the Moonlight Internet Hosting Tool must be removed or upgraded to v5.6+ to avoid UPnP conflicts, Steam Streaming Speakers driver is automatically installed on first stream (can be disabled), the Back Button Timeout is renamed to Guide Button Emulation Timeout and disabled by default, the service name changes from SunshineSvc to SunshineService, install-service.bat no longer sets auto-start by default, and Fedora 36 builds are removed. Additions include an option to launch apps/commands as administrator, an installer option to choose whether Sunshine launches on boot, an option to send VK codes instead of scancodes, Apply/Restart in the Web UI for all platforms, a Restart option in the system tray, host latency data in video frames, matching audio sink and virtual sink on device names, friendly error messages for clients, warning logs for DRM-protected content and GeForce Experience port conflicts, and Fedora 38 builds. Changes include encoder selection at each stream start, and the host dis...

chunks.title: v0.21.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.21.0, the project adds automatic emulated controller type selection, Applications key support on Windows, touchpad/motion/battery/LED for emulated DualShock 4, advertising new input features, a Debian Bookworm package, connection environment variables for prep commands, pen and touch support on Windows, a standalone NVENC encoder, AV1 encoding, IPv6 support, an option to disable realtime HAGS, an option to decrease GPU scheduling priority for HAGS video hang workaround, FFmpeg powerpc64le architecture for self-compiling, capturing rotated displays, streaming event notifications in the system tray, a port configuration table, automatic detached command treatment for launcher-type apps, and allowing the Misc button to work as Guide on emulated Xbox 360 controllers. Changes include input batching to reduce latency, moving input packet debug prints off the control stream thread, refactoring gamepad emulation to use DS4 extended report format, modifying and restoring NVIDIA control panel settings, a new NVENC config page, refactoring DX shaders, and using own keycode mapping to avoid installing US English keyboard layout. Fixes address update notifications, replacing libboost chrono/thread with standard, increasing gamepad limit to 16, allowing multiple ENet channels, considering link-local addresses on LAN, stuck buttons on Windows, "ControllerNumber not allocated" warning, gamepad feedback with multiple clients, clamping mouse position, crash on older AMD GPUs, crash with non-ASCII characters, resource exhaustion with many prep commands, race condition when inserting processes, logging IDR frame errors, improving audio capture logic, AMF logging, logging FFmpeg to file, rejecting unsupported codecs, adding fallbacks for unsupported codec settings, avoiding probing HEVC/AV1 in some cases, removing DwmFlush(), capture sleep improvements, adjusting capture rate, fixing Arch Linux package version, highlighting fatal log messages, allowing stream if prep command fails, fixing KMS grab VRAM capture with libva 2.20, fixing macOS video capture backend, not starting session monitor window in command mode, using linuxdeploy GTK plugin for AppImage, and fixing reWASD recognition of emulated DualShock 4.

chunks.title: v0.22.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.22.0, the project makes breaking changes: clients must be paired before using Wake-on-LAN, and Fedora 37 support is dropped. Additions include native pen/touch support on Linux, HDR streaming on Linux via KMS, KMS capture for Nvidia GPUs on Wayland, full E2E stream encryption configurable for LAN/WAN, process group tracking for launchers, GPU power saving/encoding latency tradeoff setting for NVENC, additional NVENC encoding settings, experimental support for launching URLs and non-exe files on Windows, slower HEVC encoding setting for older Intel GPUs, automatic gamepad type selection heuristics, DS4 back/select button touchpad click setting, disabling high resolution scrolling and native pen/touch, support for certificates other than RSA-2048, Fedora 39 docker image and rpm package, monitor indexes in logs for wlroots and KMS, a link to logs in fatal error container, and hash handler/ids for configuration categories. Changes include moving configuration options, adjusting client-selected bitrate for FEC overhead, improving VAAPI encoding performance on Intel GPUs, reducing connection establishment delay by eliminating encoder probing, attempting graceful termination of processes, enabling multi-threaded color conversion for software encoding, adjusting default CPU thread count for software encoding from 1 to 2, modernizing the default Steam app shortcut, updating desktop files, adding 2560x1440 to default resolutions, using configured ping timeout for initial launch event timeout, migrating UI to Vite and Vue3, adjusting log message wording/severity, using a single ffmpeg submodule, skipping ViGEmBus installation if a supported version is already installed, optionally using system wayland-protocols, making VAAPI optional, and replacing boost::json with nlohmann/json. Fixes address auto-discovery by iOS/tvOS clients, immediate connection termination over some Internet connections, missing mouse cursor on KMS capture with hardware cursor, Nvidia driver bug with RTX HDR, AMD driver bug on pre-RDNA GPUs, NVENC on older Nvidia drivers, encoding on old Intel GPUs, GL errors on GPUs with aux planes or DRM modifiers, non-functional d...

chunks.title: v0.22.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.22.1, the project drops support for standalone PKGBUILD files on Arch Linux and the experimental dmg package on macOS, while adding Homebrew support for macOS. Changes include searching the working directory first for relative paths on Windows, compiling kmsgrab by default on Arch Linux, preferring X11 capture over kmsgrab for cards lacking atomic modesetting, and choosing NVENC by default in kmsgrab only if the display is connected to the Nvidia GPU. Fixes address unsupported resolution errors with some Moonlight clients, crashes with unusually sized monochrome cursors, KMS cursor capture crash on Arch-based distros, crash if CUDA GPU PCI ID has hex digits >9, starting apps with quoted working directories, process tree tracking with cmd.exe trampoline, slow ViGEmBus installation, build issues on macOS 13/14, missing install script and optional dependencies in Arch binary package, ensuring correct Arch pkg is published, mismatched case in CUDA device lookup, missing resolution in default config UI, udev rules not working until reboot, wrong path in desktop files, tray icon caching and destruction issues, config migration with SUNSHINE_MIGRATE_CONFIG=1, and re-enabling CUDA support on Fedora with bump to 12.4.0.

chunks.title: v0.22.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.22.2, the project fixes a broken system tray icon on some Windows systems, a crash when XDG_CONFIG_HOME or CONFIGURATION_DIRECTORY are set on Linux, and config migration across filesystems and with non-existent parent directories.

chunks.title: v0.23.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.23.0, the project contains critical security fixes and drops support for Ubuntu 20.04 and arm64 rpm packages. Fixes include ensuring unpairing takes effect without restart, fixing a logical comparison of texture size, and quoting the path to sunshinesvc.exe. Additions include Web UI localization support, populating host latency for KMS/X11 grab, AMF rate control improvements, and Ubuntu 24.04 support (x86_64 only).

chunks.title: v0.23.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v0.23.1, the project fixes video quality regressions on AMD GPUs by disabling HRD and CBR encoding options by default, incorrect strings for QuickSync presets, update prompt appearing on latest version on Linux, crash when absolute input events are received before viewport is set, missing clamping of rumble intensity on Linux, compilation errors when disabling tests or using Musl libc, broken debug messages for codec capability flags, and log messages for KMS permission errors. Additions include improving frame time consistency for all capture backends on Linux and setting focus to the PIN textbox when navigating to the PIN tab. The libavdevice dependency is removed.

chunks.title: v2025.118.151840
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v2025.118.151840, the project contains critical security updates and many new features and bug fixes, including automatic resolution and HDR mode changing on Windows, YUV 4:4:4 encoding support for Intel and NVIDIA GPUs on Windows, automatic discovery support for macOS hosts, capturing displays other than the main display on macOS, emulating DS5, Nintendo Switch Pro, and Xbox One controllers on Linux, removing the limit on concurrent streaming sessions, eliminating the need for driver patching to use NvFBC capture on Linux, significantly reducing CPU usage for encoding on AMD GPUs (RDNA or later) on Windows, fixing video traffic timeout error when streaming from a Hyper-V VM using GPU Paravirtualization, fixing inability to stream with Microsoft Basic Display Adapter driver, optimizing internal frame handling with SSSE3/AVX2/AVX512, implementing flow control to reduce dropped packets, reworking VA-API video encoding rate control logic on Linux, a new experimental capture method using Windows.Graphics.Capture API (not compatible with service), naming and unpairing clients individually, dark mode in the Web UI, checkboxes for boolean settings, and RestAPI improvements.

chunks.title: v2025.122.141614
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v2025.122.141614, the project removes the legacy input option on Linux, fixes broken desktop file, icons, and service for Flatpak, fixes new version notification conditions in the Web UI, and updates translations.

chunks.title: v2025.628.4510
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v2025.628.4510, the project contains critical security updates and many new features and bug fixes, including encoder probing fixes, disabling display automation by default, RestAPI improvements, async encode for NVENC, native DualSense support on Linux, headless monitor support on Wayland Linux, basing minimum FPS on client framerate, new languages and updated translations, and many behind-the-scenes build, CI, and dependency updates.

chunks.title: v2025.923.33222
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v2025.923.33222, the project contains critical security updates and fixes including not waking up every 500ms to poll while not streaming, attempting to use level 5.1/5.2 for HEVC in AMF, restoring Checkbox import for display device options, bundling ViGEmBus instead of downloading it, not requiring content type for apps delete endpoint, restoring the ability to set a minimum FPS target, depending on libgbm, compiling with gcc13+ and bumping CUDA, updating to FFmpeg 8.0 branch, allowing DS5 gamepads to have a fixed device MAC based on controller index, cleaning up and showing additional gamepad options correctly on Linux, adding missing default value for ds5_inputtino_randomize_mac, optionally running tray in main event loop for macOS support, adding a runtime config option to enable/disable system tray, making CUDA and unit tests optional on Arch, not failing if CUDA was freshly installed, fixing udev rules style issues, removing CUDA as a required dependency on AUR, and ensuring uhid is loaded automatically.

chunks.title: v2025.924.154138
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v2025.924.154138, the project corrects the binPath syntax in install-service.bat on Windows and removes the XCode dependency for macOS builds.

chunks.title: v2026.516.143833
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine release v2026.516.143833, the project contains critical security updates and breaking changes: ViGEmBus is no longer installed automatically and CSRF protection is added to the Web UI. Highlighted changes include XDG, Pipewire, and KWin direct screencast capture on Linux, Vulkan encoding on Linux, official OpenSUSE packages, FreeBSD packages, binding to a specific network interface, MSI/WiX installer for Windows, Windows ARM64 support, signed dmg package for macOS, signed Windows executables and installers for AMD64, new REST API endpoints for covers, updated icons and themes with a modernized Web UI, capturing audio on macOS using Tap API, client enable/disable access control from Web UI, support for fractional NTSC framerates, split frame encoding on GPUs with 2+ NVENC blocks, and updating FFmpeg to 8.1 branch.

chunks.title: v2026.528.35537
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine prerelease v2026.528.35537, the project includes dependency updates, fixes for macOS remote scroll input scaling, release automation fixes, disconnecting only the disabled client instead of all sessions, moving ViGEmBus to ThirdParty group in the Windows installer, adding an option to limit RTSP packet size, adding filtering and searching to the Apps page in the Web UI, and various translation and build updates.

chunks.title: v2026.531.163415
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the LizardByte/Sunshine prerelease v2026.531.163415, the project includes dependency updates, fixes for macOS remote scroll input scaling, release automation fixes, disconnecting only the disabled client instead of all sessions, moving ViGEmBus to ThirdParty group in the Windows installer, adding an option to limit RTSP packet size, adding filtering and searching to the Apps page in the Web UI, and various translation and build updates.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent OpenHands/OpenHands release stream from version 0.51.0 through 1.7.0, including CLI-specific releases. It covers new features, model support additions, UI improvements, bug fixes, and architectural changes across the evolution of the platform.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 0.51.0, the project adds MCP support for CLI, improves resolver summary generation to focus on new changes, optimizes git change detection with multi-repository support, fixes agent rate limit errors, fixes configuration precedence in CLI mode, resolves tab display issues when agent is stopped, and fixes MCP configuration merging between config.toml and frontend settings.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 0.52.0, the project adds support for models qwen-3-coder-480b, gpt-5-2025-08-07, and claude-opus-4-1-20250805; adds search API key settings to CLI, support for launching OpenHands UI using CLI, overlay mounts in Docker runtime, a switch for additional solvability analysis in resolver, branch information to repository context, and auto-pagination for conversation list. It improves conversation card context menu, /resume command validation, conversation history limit from 20 to 100, repository loading reliability, and CLI markdown rendering. It fixes echoed user input commands, model reliability, git clone hanging, ports error on Windows, CodeActAgent prompts on Windows, Global Microagents in Cloud, and CLI errno21 warning.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 0.53.0, the project adds support for binding named Docker volumes into the runtime, allows partial modification of CLI settings, adds ability to specify the user OpenHands should commit as, and adds explicit instructions for the resolver to encourage pushing code changes.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 0.54.0, the project adds a task tracking tool and planning mode for long-horizon tasks, a new feedback reason 'The agent didn't finish the job', and enables MCP in OpenHands Cloud. It improves the MCP config UI with add, edit, and delete functionality. It fixes UI flashing and browser tab title reversion.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 0.55.0, the project adds an LLM risk analyzer and a setting for condenser max history size. It improves performance when working with repositories that have many branches. It fixes usage of some reasoning models, CLI markdown rendering spacing, GitHub Cloud Resolver context around comments, GitLab cloud resolver context around comments, tokens expiring mid-conversation, and API requests with malformed conversation IDs returning 500 instead of 400.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 0.56.0, the project adds support for AGENTS.md files in microagents, a new microagent management feature, and support for routing between different LLMs in an agent trajectory. It fixes wrong working directory in local runtime.
In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 0.57.0, the project introduces a new UI for landing and conversation pages and a new bring your own key (BYOK) feature in OpenHands Cloud.
In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 0.57.2, the project pins litellm version to fix dependency issues and sets Claude Sonnet output token limit.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 0.58.0, the project adds configurable timeout settings for SHTTP MCP servers, adds claude-sonnet-4-5 model support, converts settings to vertical sidebar layout, significantly improves security of the enterprise Docker image by fixing multiple CVEs, fixes users getting stuck in initializing agent step on resume, and fixes multiple UI bugs.

chunks.title: 1.0.0-CLI - 2025-10-10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.0.0-CLI, the project delivers V1 CLI with multi-platform standalone executable binaries, faster startup time using uv or pip, a new and refreshed UI, and simplified JSON MCP configuration plus MCP OAuth support.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 0.59.0, the project adds support for Lemonade Provider, improves searching of repositories, fixes file ownership on mounted volumes, fixes prompt box resizing behavior, and fixes multiple UI bugs.

chunks.title: 1.0.1-cli - 2025-10-13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.0.1-cli, the project fixes CLI binary GLIBC compatibility for older Linux systems, fixes unexpected crashes when disabling confirmation mode mid-conversation, and fixes existing API key disappearing from CLI settings when updating settings.

chunks.title: 1.0.2-cli - 2025-10-21
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.0.2-cli, the project simplifies the option to reject agent action in confirmation mode and fixes broken CLI entrypoint when using package managers like uvx.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 0.60.0, the project removes V0 CLI as officially unsupported, adds support for Clarifai provider, adds automatic sandbox lifecycle management to prevent resource exhaustion, simplifies security analyzer confirmation interface, implements graceful shutdown for headless mode, improves VSCode integration in sandbox environments, fixes git operations failing on resume, fixes config.toml not respected by swe-bench entrypoint, fixes terminal not rendering input commands, and fixes multiple UI issues.

chunks.title: 1.0.3-cli - 2025-10-30
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.0.3-cli, the project fixes LLM args to remove deprecation warnings and fixes MCP tool validation error from OpenHands SDK dependency.

chunks.title: 1.0.4-cli - 2025-10-31
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.0.4-cli, the project fixes the CLI command to launch OpenHands GUI (openhands serve command).

chunks.title: 1.0.5-cli - 2025-10-31
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.0.5-cli, the project allows users to configure settings before conversation has started and fixes conversation ending abruptly with error when invoking condenser.
In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 0.61.0, the project makes the terminal tab read-only and removes the Jupyter tab.

chunks.title: 1.0.6-cli - 2025-11-7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.0.6-cli, the project fixes broken entrypoint when using UV, fixes MCP settings persisting after removal, removes preset MCPs from upstream package agent-sdk, lazy loads conversation when calling /new command, and removes noisy logs when loading conversations.
In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 0.62.0, the project allows pinning and unpinning of conversation tabs and adds a Documentation link to the profile menu.

chunks.title: 1.0.7-cli - 25-11-11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.0.7-cli, the project cleans up CLI outputs when conversation is first started and prevents tool calls with security_risk parameter from crashing conversations.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.0.0, the project introduces the new software-agent-sdk with many optimizations, queues chat messages during runtime connection, implements a new task tracker interface, adds Azure DevOps integration support, enables native tool calling for gemini-3-pro-preview, fixes many UI issues, and notes that OpenHands CLI has been moved to its own repo.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.1.0, the project adds OAuth 2.0 Device Flow for CLI authentication, a refresh button to the Changes tab, an Export Conversation button, Forgejo integration, changes the init process from micromamba to tini for proper child process reaping, fixes local runs to use host-writable paths and keep Playwright downloads out of /workspace, and fixes multiple UI and performance issues.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.2.0, the project adds a status indicator above the chat until conversation is ready, displays conversation title in delete confirmation modal, bumps condenser defaults max_size from 120 to 240, fixes a bug where Search API Key was reset when saving other settings, and includes many bug fixes and improvements.
In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.2.1, the project fixes error messages in the chat interface to include a dismiss button and automatically truncate long messages with a 'View More' toggle.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.3.0, the project adds CORS support to Docker sandbox service for remote browser access, adds support for host networking mode via OH_SANDBOX_USE_HOST_NETWORK, fixes UI not displaying agent thought content from ThinkAction, fixes cursor jumping in dropdown search fields, and fixes Display Cost for conversations.
In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.4.0, the project adds MiniMax-M2.5 model support and fixes an issue where resumed conversations incorrectly displayed an error status during startup.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.5.0, the project adds ability to attach or change Git repository for existing conversations, a Task List tab with real-time status updates, a planning agent, a slash command menu, Bitbucket datacenter support, and support for models Claude Opus 4.6, GLM-4.7, Claude-Sonnet-4-6, GLM-5, Kimi-K2.5, Qwen3-Coder-Next, Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview. It hides the microagent management UI, fixes tab pinning/unpinning, fixes many CVEs, and fixes multiple UI issues.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.6.0, the project adds support for hooks, Catalan language, /clear command for V1 conversations, copy button to code blocks, support to enable/disable default global skills, and the /new slash command to the slash command menu. It fixes conversations not being persisted, Export Conversation event duplication, and multiple CVEs.

In the OpenHands/OpenHands release 1.7.0, the project adds LLM model on conversation cards and header, SANDBOX_KVM_ENABLED environment variable for KVM acceleration, exposes SDK settings schema, moves Tavily search key to MCP settings, resolves multiple CVEs, and fixes multiple UI issues.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release stream from v2.1.0 through v3.6.0, covering major OCR model upgrades, document parsing pipelines, and deployment enhancements.

chunks.title: PaddleOCRv2.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.1.0, the project introduces the end-to-end text recognition algorithm PGNet, published in AAAI 2021, along with a multi-language recognition model supporting more than 80 languages, and performance optimizations for the English recognition model.

chunks.title: PaddleOCRv2.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.1.1, the project adds model pruning and quantization tools based on PaddleSlim, mobile deployment tools based on Paddle-Lite, an Android demo of the ppocr system, and service deployment based on Paddle Serving.

chunks.title: PaddleOCRv2.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.5.0, the project releases PP-OCRv3 with improved Chinese and English scene effects and multilingual model accuracy, PPOCRLabelv2 with annotation for table recognition, key information extraction, and irregular text images, and the interactive e-book 'Dive into OCR'.

chunks.title: PaddleOCRv2.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.6.0, the project releases PP-Structurev2 with upgraded functions and performance, including layout recovery and one-line PDF-to-Word conversion, optimized layout analysis with reduced model storage and increased speed, improved table recognition accuracy, and enhanced key information extraction with a visual-independent model structure.

chunks.title: PaddleOCRv2.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.7.0, the project releases PP-OCRv4 with mobile and server versions, achieving improved Chinese and English scene effects and multilingual model accuracy, and introduces PP-ChatOCR, a new scheme for extracting key information using PP-OCR and ERNIE LLM.

chunks.title: PaddleOCRv2.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.7.1, the project adds the Parseq recognition model, text recognition returning single character coordinates, a savefile option for OCR output, more data preprocessing options, compatibility updates, and various bug fixes including memory leaks and training seed issues.

chunks.title: PaddleOCRv2.7.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.7.2, the project includes minor updates such as adding Finnish language files, fixing unbound variable issues, updating PP-OCRv4 framework, and various documentation and CI improvements.

chunks.title: PaddleOCRv2.7.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.7.3, the project fixes issue #11808.

chunks.title: PaddleOCRv2.7.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.7.4, the project includes missed commits from v2.7.0 to v2.7.1 and fixes issue #11824.

chunks.title: PaddleOCRv2.7.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.7.5, the project fixes a broken v2.7.4 release.

chunks.title: v2.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.8.0, the project includes various cherry-picked fixes and enhancements such as adding the ParseQ recognition method, SVTR large model, CPPD model, and updates to PP-OCRv4 framework, along with compatibility improvements and bug fixes.

chunks.title: v2.8.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.8.1, the project adds project URL, fixes slice op parameter passing, and fixes a dictionary bug in table recognition inference.

chunks.title: v2.9.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.9.0, the project includes fixes for table recognition content escaping, layout predictor handling, data type unification, and various documentation and CI updates, along with adding PaddleX info and new features like latex OCR.

chunks.title: v2.9.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.9.1, the project updates paddle2onnx documentation, fixes isnan support, and fixes CI docs multi-version error.

chunks.title: v2.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v2.10.0, the project includes documentation updates, GPU memory growth fix, NaN fix in PP-OCRv4, dependency updates, and various CI and documentation improvements.

chunks.title: v3.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.0.0, the project releases PP-OCRv5 with support for five text types and complex handwriting, PP-StructureV3 for high-precision PDF parsing, PP-ChatOCRv4 with native ERNIE 4.5 Turbo support, unified inference interfaces, adaptation to PaddlePaddle 3.0, and standardized model naming.

chunks.title: v3.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.0.1, the project optimizes default model configurations for PP-OCRv5, adds a new text line orientation classifier, improves CLI usage, adds parameters for PP-ChatOCRv3 and PP-StructureV3, enables CPU MKL-DNN inference, supports C++ inference for PP-OCRv5, and fixes various issues including formula/table model MKL-DNN errors and GPU inference errors.

chunks.title: v3.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.0.2, the project changes the default model download source to HuggingFace, adds service call examples in six languages, optimizes layout sorting for complex vertical layouts, improves model selection logic, sets MKL-DNN cache upper bound, updates high-performance inference defaults, adjusts device acquisition logic, adds Android example for PP-OCRv5, and fixes various bugs including CLI parameter issues and image channel order errors.

chunks.title: v3.0.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.0.3, the project fixes the enable_mkldnn parameter not taking effect and includes other fixes from PaddleX 3.0.3.

chunks.title: v3.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.1.0, the project adds PP-OCRv5 multilingual text recognition model supporting 37 languages with over 30% average accuracy improvement, upgrades PP-Chart2Table model in PP-StructureV3 with 9.36 percentage point RMS-F1 increase, launches PP-DocTranslation pipeline based on PP-StructureV3 and ERNIE 4.5 Turbo, and introduces a new MCP server supporting OCR and PP-StructureV3 pipelines with multiple working modes.

chunks.title: v3.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.1.1, the project adds missing methods to PP-ChatOCRv4 and missing parameters to PPDocTranslation, improves MCP documentation, updates performance metrics documentation, and changes MCP server dependency to puremagic.

chunks.title: v3.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.2.0, the project introduces PP-OCRv5 recognition models for English, Thai, and Greek, upgrades deployment capabilities with full PaddlePaddle 3.1.0/3.1.1 support, upgraded C++ deployment, CUDA 12 support, open-sourced high-stability service deployment, adds fine-grained benchmarking, separates core and optional dependencies, supports NVIDIA RTX 50 series, and adds single-character coordinate return and new model download sources.

chunks.title: v3.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.3.0, the project releases PaddleOCR-VL, a compact vision-language model for document parsing supporting 109 languages with SOTA performance, and releases PP-OCRv5 multilingual recognition model with improved accuracy and coverage for 109 languages.

chunks.title: v3.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.3.1, the project fixes the document image preprocessing switch not taking effect in PP-StructureV3 and PaddleOCR-VL, and adds instructions for using PaddleOCR-VL in a fully offline environment.

chunks.title: v3.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.3.2, the project includes changes as detailed in the full changelog between v3.3.1 and v3.3.2.

chunks.title: v3.3.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.3.3, the project adds support for custom model names and API keys in PaddleOCR-VL, integration with third-party inference services, PP-StructureV3 MCP Server support for Qianfan platform, documentation improvements, and Muxi GPU inference support.

chunks.title: v3.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.4.0, the project releases PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 with 94.5% accuracy on OmniDocBench v1.5, irregular-shaped bounding box localization, seal recognition and spotting tasks, adds MLX-VLM inference service support, cross-page table merging and multi-level heading reconstruction, and new parameters for PP-StructureV3.

chunks.title: v3.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.4.1, the project adds llama-cpp-server backend support for PaddleOCR-VL, AMD GPU and Intel Arc GPU hardware support, fixes dependency issues in NPU/XPU images, and removes the default page limit for Docker Compose service.

chunks.title: v3.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.5.0, the project deeply integrates with Hugging Face ecosystem with 20 models supporting Transformers inference backend, supports conversion of Word, Excel, PowerPoint to Markdown, adds DOCX export for PaddleOCR-VL, PP-StructureV3, and PP-DocTranslation, and releases the official browser inference SDK PaddleOCR.js.

chunks.title: v3.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR release v3.6.0, the project releases PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 with 96.33% accuracy on OmniDocBench v1.6, improved table recognition, ancient document parsing, and rare character recognition, releases official API SDKs for Python, Go, and TypeScript, and adds support for parsing multi-page TIFF files.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the evolution of PhilJay/MPAndroidChart from early v1.7.x fixes through the v2.0.x major rewrite, v2.1.x feature expansions, v2.2.x enhancements, and the v3.x breaking changes including the elimination of the x-index concept and bumping minSdkVersion to 14.

chunks.title: Minor fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v1.7.1, the release note describes minor fixes of the previous release.

chunks.title: Minor improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v1.7.2, the release note adds new LegendPositions NONE and RIGHT_OF_CHART_INSIDE, a callback for fling gestures on the chart, and a feature to enable or disable logging.

chunks.title: Fixed known issues
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v1.7.3, the release note fixes known issues, provides a FillFormatter interface for custom line-filling in LineChart, and fixes a crash in XLabels.

chunks.title: Minor improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v1.7.4, the release note includes a minor bugfix in RadarChart, changes to the library architecture, and fixes known issues.

chunks.title: Version 2.0.0 beta
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.0.0 beta, the release note introduces dual YAxis, a CombinedChart for displaying bar, line, scatter, and candle data together, removes the nineoldandroids library, and notes that HorizontalBarChart and grouped BarChart highlighting are not yet working.

chunks.title: The all new MPAndroidChart
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.0.1, the release note adds dual YAxis, HorizontalBarChart, CombinedChart, performance improvements, and removes the nineoldandroids library and v4 support library.

chunks.title: Bugfixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.0.2, the release note includes bugfixes concerning BarChart and code cleanup.

chunks.title: MPAndroidChart v2.0.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.0.7, the release note presents the all new MPAndroidChart, includes JavaDoc for gradle dependencies, fixes an issue in cubic-lines, and provides general bugfixes.

chunks.title: Performance Increase, Bugfixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.0.8, the release note delivers major performance improvements, a Combined-Chart improvement, and general bugfixes.

chunks.title: Bugfixes, Enhancements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.0.9, the release note adds LimitLine for both XAxis and YAxis, makes inverted YAxis work for all chart types, introduces animation easing, more styling options, more viewport modification methods, and bugfixes.

chunks.title: BubbleChart, XAxis improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.1.0, the release note introduces a new BubbleChart chart type, fixes an issue concerning elevation, fixes an issue concerning jumping XAxis, and provides general bugfixes.

chunks.title: Bugfixes, Enhancements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.1.1, the release note includes general bugfixes, support for negative stacked bars, and more customization possibilities.

chunks.title: Bugfixes, Enhancements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.1.2, the release note provides fixes for stacked BarChart (vertical and horizontal bars, positive and negative values), fixes concerning highlighting (indicator and MarkerView), a feature to force a fixed number of YAxis labels, general bugfixes, and a smaller .jar file.

chunks.title: Bugfixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.1.3, the release note includes fixes concerning grouped-bars and general bugfixes.

chunks.title: Formatters update, bugfixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.1.4, the release note adds MarkerView support for PieChart and HorizontalBarChart, dashed highlight-lines, FillFormatter for individual LineDataSets, XAxisValueFormatter and YAxisValueFormatter for custom axis label formatting, changes the formatter package name from utils to formatter, improves the documentation wiki, and includes general improvements and bugfixes.

chunks.title: PieChart, LimitLine & interaction improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.1.5, the release note improves LimitLine customizability, gesture callbacks, fixes PieChart offsets, adds SpannableString and normal String support for PieChart center text, and includes general bugfixing and code cleanup.

chunks.title: General bugfixes & improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.1.6, the release note allows disabling tap-highlighting separately from drag or programmatic highlighting, fixes RadarChart webline, improves MarkerView dynamic position, enables XAxis label rotation, and provides general bugfixes.

chunks.title: Realm.io support, Bugfixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.2.0, the release note introduces plotting data directly from Realm.io mobile database, a Realm.io tutorial, DataSet interfaces for creating custom DataSets, bugfixing in HorizontalBarChart and stacked-bars, fixes for rotated XAxis labels, and general bugfixes.

chunks.title: Bugfixing, New features
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.2.2, the release note adds support for setting different colors for value-text, Realm.io support related bugfixes, a zero-line configurable separately from YAxis grid lines, and minor other bugfixes.

chunks.title: New animations, Bugfixing
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.2.3, the release note enables moving the viewport with animations, and includes improvements for PieChart, CandleStickChart, BubbleChart, RadarChart, and general bugfixing.

chunks.title: Bugfixing, New features
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.2.4, the release note simplifies setting axis min and max value, changes zero-line drawing default to false, fixes issues related to cubic-lines, adds support for stepped LineChart, and includes other bugfixes.

chunks.title: Bugfixes, new features
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v2.2.5, the release note adds horizontal cubic bezier lines for LineChart, transparent color in circle hole color, circleHoleRadius property, PieChart values outside of chart connected with lines, highlightFullBar for highlighting all values on an x-index, setting xVals on existing Data objects, non-normalized bubble sizes, a material color template, a flag to control drawing limit line labels, exploded Legend-Position enum, borders for bars in BarChart, improved highlighting for multiple values on x-index, fixes for extra offsets in Pie/Radar chart view, MarkerView fixes, improvements to Demo dataset styling, and general bugfixes.

chunks.title: New MPAndroidChart v3.0b
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v3.0.0-beta, the release note eliminates the x-index concept so each Entry now has float x and y coordinates, changes the Entry constructor, makes XAxis and YAxis concepts similar, separates Realm.io support to a separate repository, and includes bugfixes and stability improvements.

chunks.title: Performance and GC related fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v3.0.0-beta1, the release note references issue #1947 and provides performance and GC related fixes.

chunks.title: New major release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v3.0.0, the release note is a major release that eliminates the integer x-index, introduces float x-values, unifies XAxis and YAxis features, refactors highlighting, marker, and legend entry mechanisms, allows each dataset to set its own legend form, adds more demos, and includes many minor bug fixes and improvements.

chunks.title: Stability Improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v3.0.1, the release note improves stability and fixes bugs.

chunks.title: Bugfixing & Stability Improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PhilJay/MPAndroidChart release v3.0.2, the release note includes bugfixes and minor changes that came up over the past weeks.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent PostgREST/postgrest release stream from v12.2.5 through v14.12, covering bug fixes, new features, and breaking changes across multiple minor and major versions.

chunks.title: v12.2.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v12.2.5, the project fixes startup for the arm64 Docker image.

chunks.title: v12.2.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v12.2.6, the project fixes the JWT cache so that it removes expired entries.

chunks.title: v12.2.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v12.2.7, the project fixes a schema reloading notice on Windows.

chunks.title: v12.2.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v12.2.8, the project fixes logging of 503 client errors to stderr.

chunks.title: v12.2.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v12.2.9, the project fixes incorrect parsing of the 'for' parameter of the 'application/vnd.pgrst.plan' media type and fixes the JWT cache to prevent old tokens from being accepted after the jwt-secret is changed in a config reload.

chunks.title: v12.2.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v12.2.10, the project fixes a performance issue where JWT cache purging on every request decreased performance.

chunks.title: v12.2.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v12.2.11, the project fixes a regression with the parameter 'charset=utf-8' in mediatype.

chunks.title: v12.2.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v12.2.12, the project fixes exposing the admin server '/config' endpoint by default; the endpoint is now disabled unless the 'admin-server-config-enabled' config is set to 'true'.

chunks.title: v13.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v13.0.0, the project introduces features including spread to-many relationships, automatic tsvector conversion on filters, improved performance for RPCs via GET, the 'not_null' operator value, JWT role extraction from arrays, a Proxy-Status header for error responses, Content-Length header for traces, SQL query logs, improved JWT errors, new error codes PGRST125 and PGRST126, and an admin-server-host config. Fixes include preventing spread embedding from allowing aggregates when disabled, handling queries on non-existing tables gracefully, fixing order in mutation requests, and failing to start when server-port and admin-server-port are the same. Breaking changes drop support for PostgreSQL EOL versions 9.6, 10, and 11.

chunks.title: v13.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v13.0.1, the project fixes a JWT error returning HTTP status 400 for invalid role and fixes 'db-extra-search-path' so it can be disabled by setting it to an empty string, with schema cache load errors now logged including config values.

chunks.title: v13.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v13.0.2, the project fixes a regression that makes ORDER BY with nulls-order not work alongside limits.

chunks.title: v13.0.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v13.0.3, the project fixes the 'max-affected' preference not failing with RPC when handling=strict and fixes a property definition's type in OpenAPI not showing the correct base type of a recursive domain.

chunks.title: v13.0.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v13.0.4, the project fixes a regression that makes full-text search not work on domain types based on tsvector and fixes the 'jwt-aud' config not failing when set to an invalid URI.

chunks.title: v13.0.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v13.0.5, the project fixes a broken OpenAPI docs link, incorrect exposure of GET methods for volatile functions in OpenAPI, empty spread embeddings returning unexpected SQL errors, and the '/metrics' endpoint not responding with a Content-Type header.

chunks.title: v13.0.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v13.0.6, the project fixes logging the Haskell type instead of the listener error message directly, the format of IPv6 address logged at startup, and an empty enum in the preferParams OpenAPI parameter.

chunks.title: v13.0.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v13.0.7, the project improves the PGRST106 error when the requested schema is invalid by showing the invalid schema in the message field and listing exposed schemas in the hint, and improves error details of the PGRST301 error.

chunks.title: v13.0.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v13.0.8, the project fixes loading utf-8 config files with ASCII locale set.

chunks.title: v14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v14.0, the project introduces a bounded JWT cache using the SIEVE algorithm, increasing throughput for GET requests by 20% and including JWT cache metrics, and a ready flag for healthcheck. Fixes include speeding up schema cache loading for large schemas from 7 minutes to 2 seconds, logging OpenAPI queries and explain queries when log-query is enabled, and fixing reloading the schema cache unnecessarily on PGRST002 errors. Breaking changes drop support for PostgreSQL EOL version 12, adopt MAJOR.PATCH two-part versioning, replace jwt-cache-max-lifetime with jwt-cache-max-entries, and change log-query config to a boolean.

chunks.title: v14.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v14.1, the project fixes the 'db-pre-config' function failing when function names are pg reserved words and fixes 'server-host=!6' incorrectly binding to an IPv4 address.

chunks.title: v14.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v14.2, the project fixes 'hasSingleUnnamedParam' incorrectly matching functions with named parameters, misleading logs on unsupported PostgreSQL versions, a regression where the PGRST103 error response was truncated, not returning Content-Length on empty HTTP 201 responses, inaccurate Server-Timing header durations, and inaccurate 'Schema cache queried' logs.

chunks.title: v14.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v14.3, the project fixes performance and high memory usage of relation hint calculation.

chunks.title: v14.4

chunks.title: v14.5

chunks.title: v14.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v14.6, the project fixes leaking table and function names when calculating error hint.

chunks.title: v14.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the PostgREST/postgrest release v14.7, the project fixes not logging SIGTERM and SIGINT.

chunks.title: v14.8

chunks.title: v14.9

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent Raphire/Win11Debloat release stream, covering a series of updates from mid-2025 through mid-2026. chunks.title: Release 2025.06.11

chunks.title: Release 2026.02.15
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Raphire/Win11Debloat release 2026.02.15, a titlebar menu is added. Proper MessageBox styling is introduced. A GUI prompt after failure to create a restore point is added. Tweak category icons are added. Tooltips are added to all tweaks. The Strip-Progress function is removed to prevent localization issues. Code structure is refactored for improved readability and maintainability.

chunks.title: Release 2026.02.18
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Raphire/Win11Debloat release 2026.02.18, the app page is improved with table-like styling. App/tweak descriptions are updated. chunks.title: Release 2026.02.19
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Raphire/Win11Debloat release 2026.02.19, the force remove Edge prompt is fixed, and the winget check is updated.

Support for removing additional apps from Microsoft, Lenovo & Dell is added. Warnings about changes requiring a reboot and about removing Edge's impact on Sandbox are added. chunks.title: Release 2026.03.09

The support button is replaced with a 'Report a bug' button when an error occurs during applying changes.

chunks.title: Release 2026.03.15
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Raphire/Win11Debloat release 2026.03.15, a hint bubble highlights selected changes in Default Mode. Logic for loading/populating GUI elements is improved. UI stuttering when creating a system restore point is fixed.

chunks.title: Release 2026.04.04-R2

chunks.title: Release 2026.04.05
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Raphire/Win11Debloat release 2026.04.05, options to export/import settings configuration and drive letter position and visibility are added. chunks.title: Release 2026.04.26
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Raphire/Win11Debloat release 2026.04.26, system32 is manually added to System PATH when missing. A prompt asking the user to run as administrator is added. chunks.title: Release 2026.05.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Raphire/Win11Debloat release 2026.05.10, user validation is improved. System Registry backup & restore and Start Menu pinned apps layout backup & restore are added. chunks.title: Release 2026.05.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Raphire/Win11Debloat release 2026.05.11, this minor release fixes an issue with registry backup creation introduced in release 2026.05.10. Capture and restore of signed dword/qword registry values is fixed. Restart instructions are added to the registry restore success message.

chunks.title: Release 2026.05.20
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Raphire/Win11Debloat release 2026.05.20, the System Restore point creation timeout is increased to 90 seconds. Backup restore files are limited to .json only.
