prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release stream from v2.1.3 through v2.11.0, covering SSO fixes, new features like ebook conversion, redaction, mobile scan, 2FA, file sharing, and desktop improvements.

chunks.title: 2.1.3 SSO login page bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.1.3, the project delivers a quick hotfix for SSO login pages not displaying correctly. Additional fixes address cache clearing issues, the app version not showing correctly for desktop installs, Mac not opening certain files correctly, and airgapped issues for the PDF viewer (previously downloading pdfium on load). Minor enhancements include improved cache busting and static upgrade flow. Docker updates include a lite version of CI and synchronization of app version across Tauri and simulation configs. Other changes improve styling of the quick access bar, fix Mac app file opening with spaces, fix tooltips on tabs, and make pdfium offline.

chunks.title: 2.1.4 line art conversion and bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.1.4, bug fixes address SAML not working for certain installations, PDF Viewer not working due to wasm loading issues, and PDF Text editor cache not found exception. New features include line art conversion inside the compress tool to convert images into black and white lineart for further compression, an account change UI, and onboarding shortening. Minor enhancements validate certificate inputs for cert signing, remove UserApi mapping from proprietary signature controller, and fix cache issues. Other changes include account change details, fixing language codes in the picker, fixing German text for sign tool text entry, simplifying V2 PR auto-deploy triggers, and handling SSO account restrictions in account settings.

chunks.title: 2.1.5 annotations and minor fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.1.5, the release features annotations, SAML bug fixes, and reintroduces static file overrides for custom files. Minor enhancements allow static overrides and SAML fixes. Other changes add Sign Up functionality to the desktop app, fix viewer annotations, allow dual page view only when more than one page, update translations, and bump the version.

chunks.title: 2.2.0 Ebook, Redaction, Mobile Scan, desktop SSO and more
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.2.0, the project fully integrates all remaining V1 codebase and introduces full Ebook conversions (EPUB, MOBI, CBR and others), full manual redaction, various new PDF compliancy conversions such as PDF/A-3B, auto background removal for signatures, auto crop mode, mobile phone scan with edge detection and deskewing (QR code scan to upload photos from phone, must be enabled in connection settings), and desktop app SSO login support for selfhosted users. API-only additions include full PDF file attachment management and improved PDF compliancy and standards checking. Enhancements add keyboard shortcuts for rotating with arrow keys and a command to remove unused translation keys. Minor enhancements include API mode UI, image optimization, OCR option to invalidate digital signatures, PDF standards verification using veraPDF, a flag to hide settings, PDF/A-3b conversion with attachment listing/renaming/deletion, eBook to PDF conversion options, photo scan V2, resource management improvements, redaction feature, opacity for PDF numbers and stamps, certSign PKCS12 upload support, PDF/A conversion quality improvements, and incremental save after PDF signing.

chunks.title: 2.2.1 Mobile QR code plus possible Desktop connection fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.2.1, the release includes a possible fix for selfhost connection issues from the desktop app, custom OCR languages fix, hiding login options based on selection, and mobile QR scanner custom options found under connections in the settings menu. Minor enhancements add desktop self-hosted connection logging, format everything with pre-commit, OCR fix and mobile QR changes, hide login if login type disabled, and fix verify-pdf to properly detect non-PDF/A documents with XMP metadata. Other changes note a new VPS.

chunks.title: 2.3.0 Conversion threads and bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.3.0, several important bug fixes address file conversion threading, non-roman alphabet files processing incorrectly, desktop app bugs, and others. New features include a Telegram bot (in Connections menu or settings.yml), PDF to EPUB and AZW3 conversion, and MSG support. Enhancements improve JaCoCo reporting, prevent self-modification in People management, refactor EML parser to use Simple Java Mail library and add MSG support, and add PDF to EPUB/AZW3 conversion support. Minor enhancements pin base container images, switch npm install to npm ci, harden EML error handling, format with pre-commit, update translations, return JSON responses for admin settings, update backend 3rd party licenses, bump dependencies, add Telegram bot integration, sync translations, remove unnecessary authentication from SignatureController, make controls sticky, fix broken enterprise docs link, and introduce Libre threads. Docker updates bump various actions and scope Docker layer cache per artifact.

chunks.title: 2.3.1 Bug fixes, Ui optimisations and SVG
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.3.1, several bug fixes address scroll bar not showing correctly in settings menu, automate menus showing options correctly, and other changes such as SVG to PDF conversion and performance changes throughout the app. Enhancements add SVG to PDF conversion, improve file processing with resource management and temp file handling, and add tessdata language management for OCR and download support. Minor enhancements sync translations, format with pre-commit, enhance parameter handling in automation, fix scrollbar issues, fix hook ordering for endpoint name resolution, add zIndex and withinPortal props to dropdown components, remove legacy Thymeleaf web UI controllers and templates, fix pipeline multipart boundary, update Dutch translations, and update Italian translations. Docker updates enable Gradle dependency caching and bump actions/checkout. Development tools bump stylelint-config-standard. Other changes bump actions/download-artifact and reportlab.

chunks.title: 2.4.0 2FA support, Database management, PDF/X and more
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.4.0, new features include database backup management (only for internal H2 database users), full 2FA support with one-time-password auth code app support, get info supporting better compliance verification, PDF/X conversions, and automation tool export into folder scan JSONs for folder automation. Bug fixes address sign tool, SSO user creation, and addStamp not handling timestamps. Enhancements add H2 database backup & restore management, enhance icon detection and update config navigation icon, add TOTP-based multi-factor authentication, and implement compliance verification for get info on PDF. Minor enhancements format with pre-commit, fix error 300 on sign frontend, whitelist health endpoints, API cleanups, update backend 3rd party licenses, refactor SSO handling, fix CWE-681 & CWE-197, bump nginx and node dependencies, fix V2 SSO user creation, remove old java desktop, fix date and time placeholders in addTextStamp, add PDF/X export option, show enterprise demo messages, export folder scanning, and update translations. Docker updates add sync-versions job and bump debian. Other changes include various dependency bumps.

chunks.title: 2.4.1 Desktop fixes, Iframe fix and others
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.4.1, bug fixes address HTTPS connection for desktop mode, Xframe option now in settings.yml and options menu for iframe support, various other bug fixes and dependencies updates, and Mac desktop not starting correctly. Enhancements update Tauri, Rust crates, and frontend dependencies. Minor enhancements fix pipeline naming issues, xframe fix, tool tags, bump embedPDF to v2.3.0, possible login fixes, and sync translations. Docker updates remove automated version sync job. Other changes bump pypdf.

chunks.title: 2.4.2 Audit fix, stamp variables and tool option fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.4.2, the quick update includes fixes for Audit display failing under certain scenarios, fix for tools not being correctly disabled via disable-endpoints settings, text editor font rendering fixes, and new variables for Stamp PDF feature. Enhancements add dynamic variables and templates for stamp text customization. Minor enhancements fix tool disabling, fix Audit & Usage Analytics Sections, and format with pre-commit. Other changes fix PDF Text Editor file open.

chunks.title: 2.4.3 ⁨Desktop fixes and other improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.4.3, the big desktop release includes correctly showing desktop and server versioning separately, support for watched folders to be recursive and multiple directories to be defined, desktop login expiry fix, desktop self-host connection improvements (self-sign fixes and others), page editor performance and UI improvements, frontend error screen appearing during SSO fix, and desktop CORS fixes. Enhancements display frontend/backend versions and warn on client-server mismatch, and support multiple pipeline watch directories and configurable pipeline base path. Minor enhancements stop type checking TypeScript files, fix missing AuthnRequest bug, update links to Docs, prevent hydration errors in admin security form, align token refresh handling, always allow tauri cors, add page editor virtualisation, and stop attempting to refresh Spring tokens in desktop. Other changes update Python dependencies and pin GitHub Actions.

chunks.title: 2.4.4 hotfix - page editor bug
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.4.4, the quick fix addresses a page editor bug causing multi-page selection issues. The release also contains Italian translations, Bates stamping functionality to add page numbers, extract bookmarks API fix, and a diagnostics command in CLI for easy error reporting (grabs logs into a zip on request). Enhancements add missing compare placeholder and stamp label translations. Minor enhancements add optional zero padding to page numbers (Bates Stamping), fix ClassCastException in extractBookmarks endpoint, additional page editor fixes, update Italian translation, and format with pre-commit. Other changes add a diagnostic script.

chunks.title: 2.4.5 Various Desktop changes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.4.5, desktop changes include Windows desktop MSI to support headless installation with custom parameters to set up server URL and login mode, SSO UI changes, support for login method restrictions in desktop, and remembers last entered selfhost URL for easy reconnection. General changes include SSO functionality cleanups, new strict mode for PDF/A conversion for issues where conversion isn't perfect, and redaction improvements. Bug fixes address SSO auto login mode now working correctly. Enhancements implement strict PDF/A mode with verification, show and reuse last used server URL in Setup Wizard, and update to embedPDF v2.4.0 with unified redaction mode support. Minor enhancements fix SAML, sync translations, improve synonym search, update backend 3rd party licenses, headless windows installer, format with pre-commit, and SSO styling changes. Docker updates bump alpine and update GitHub Actions. Translation changes improve language TOML check output and refine pre-commit workflows. Development tools replace deprecated Copilot extension. Other changes bump various dependencies and fix build repositories.

chunks.title: 2.4.6 bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.4.6, several bug fixes address license not always correctly loading due to cache issues, public endpoints not always accessible when without JWT, language not always correctly taking the server's default, desktop issues for SAML SSO, and maxFileSize server setting not being handled correctly. Additionally, SSO cleanups, extra SSO logging for future issues, and markdown conversion now supports images. Breaking changes fix markdown conversion image handling and zip support. Enhancements enhance SSO SAML in desktop app. Minor enhancements fix maxFileSize environment variable support, bug fixing and debugs, address potential backend resource leaks and improve frontend accessibility, sync translations, and bump spotless dependency.

chunks.title: 2.5.0 Big update
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.5.0, new functionality includes huge manual redaction changes with colour selection and improved UI, add attachment support with sidebar button for viewing attachments, FormFill tool with context and UI components for PDF form filling, desktop now edits files that have been opened instead of creating new copies, extra JWT settings to customise expiry times for desktop and browser, and add/remove link support. Extra improvements include text selection improvements within the viewer with custom actions, improved link handling and link location, EmbedPDF 2.6.0 upgrade for several bug fixes, multiple fixes with the viewer, its functionality, and its export, PDF Text editor cache / JSON size issues, enhanced JWT handling and refreshing for better session management without forced re-logins, improved annotation UI, files correctly open in the viewer automatically if only 1 file is opened, and improved tool disable menu to be able to disable all remaining tools and docs. Enhancements improve manual redaction with color selection and updated UI elements, implement text selection enhancement for double and triple-click actions, improve link handling with pdf-lib integration and add link toolbar and delete link functionality, add attachment support with sidebar and API integration, add FormFill tool with context and UI components, and upgrade embedPDF to v2.6.0 and migrate to pdf-lib fork. Minor enhancements update translation, various viewer pill fixes, fix viewer export, fix tool disabling for docs and others, preserve local paths for desktop saves, refactor API regex, fix homepage file upload path, PDF Text editor changes, fix env files for tauri, JWT enhancements for desktop, and improve annotation UI.

chunks.title: 2.5.1 Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.5.1, several bug fixes address login issues showing "something went wrong" when language list = 1, forms not showing correctly, forms not working on desktop, desktop SSO redirect race condition issues, and 431 error for large endpoint for endpoints available. Minor enhancements fix SAML login when language list = 1, update form field UI and behavior for better interactivity and alignment, fixes for desktop SSO, large query reduction, and fix hardcoded response in form-fill.

chunks.title: 2.5.2 Ruler/Measure support,  Bug fixes and security
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.5.2, the release includes security improvements and ruler/measure support in the viewer. Bug fixes address writing to forms not working on OSS (package now moved fully to OSS), possible fix for mac desktop issues, desktop not being detected as desktop all the time, license checks not having a retry, and desktop having wrong publisher ID. Enhancements add plist file for Mac permissions. Minor enhancements add ruler support, fix publishing for tauri author, dos fixes, license retry, authclient, zipFix, update German translation, translate various terms in Italian localization, move Forms location, AI translations placeholder, and format with pre-commit. Other changes enforce Java 17+ requirement in Windows jlink build script.

chunks.title: 2.5.3 XLSX support and lots of other changes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.5.3, new features include XLSX conversion, splitting a page into printable chunks (a3 into 2 a4 etc for posters), keyboard shortcut support for the viewer, bug fixes for some viewer issues, and bug fix for cookie consent showing on desktop builds. Enhancements add CSV and XLSX extraction for form fields, improve file ID handling, add PDF to Excel (XLSX) conversion, split pdf into small chunks by pdfbox, and handle keyboard shortcuts for print, save, undo, etc. Minor enhancements include cucumber for days, migrate to EmbedPDF v2.6.2 annotation state for link rendering, fix cookie consent reappearing on desktop builds, fix export, load latest file in viewer if in viewer, and update backend 3rd party licenses.

chunks.title: 2.6.0 Java 25, Huge dependency and speed updates and more
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.6.0, the update drastically improves memory usage and startup performance (around 30% reduction in both idle usage and startup speed) and dramatically reduces the docker filesize by 30-40%. Breaking updates: no longer supporting JDK 17, moved to JDK 21-25 and recommending all jar installs to upgrade to JDK 25 for best performance. Other updates: desktop now supports running non installed tools by optionally connecting to Stirling cloud server IF a user chooses to and is already running via login to cloud, several dependencies updated, security patches. Bug fixes: health check failing under certain auth scenarios, crop not working for desktop. Enhancements update base images to Java 25, Spring 4, Jackson 3, Gradle 9 and optimize JVM options (Project Lilliput), add moveAnnotation API for efficient repositioning of annotations and bump embed to 2.7.0, switch PDF input engine to pdftohtml for improved performance and reduced dependencies, and add aot-diagnostics.sh for AOT cache diagnostics and validation. Minor enhancements update frontend minor package versions, sync up Tauri versions, fix zip and response issues, change to use dpdm for circular import scanning, cachefixing test, desktop connection SaaS config/billing/team support, switch to use ESLint 10, cleanups, DocumentBuilderFactory limiting, lint, harden shared signature endpoints, open-saml bumps, fix split caused by defaultParameters breaking dynamic endpoint tools, hardening, fix health status checks falling under metric flag, frontend and desktop audit fixes, refactor merge/split/json to adopt streaming approach, fallback for /api/v1/config/endpoints-availability, add check for ghostscript before plowing on with removeDataOutsideCrop, and fix split tooltips.

chunks.title: 2.7.0 Various improvements!
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.7.0, app changes include option to hide google drive and mobile upload when disabled in 'my files' view, new search bar to search settings menu easily, and auditing has improved with new filehash/author options supported with better reporting overall (enterprise users recommended to backup Stirling database before updating). Desktop changes: desktop app correctly returns to its previous window state and location as its previous launch, and desktop app supports OS notifications if it finishes working on tasks whilst minimised. Bugs fixed: pipeline erroring in merge tool and others based on parameters, certification signature stamps not showing correctly in the viewer, and English was being enabled even when it was disabled in settings. Enhancements rework settings menu. Minor enhancements format with pre-commit, persist Tauri window state between launches, tauri notifications, audit fixes and improvements, fix merge pdf pipeline validation, fix signatures not showing, add the production billing portal link for static plan page, option to hide google drive and add settings, stop enabling english, and add searchable settings selector to AppConfigModal and improve nav behavior. Docker updates bump actions/setup-node. Other changes don't build mac if you don't have the secrets, bump digicert/ssm-code-signing, bump pypdf, and translations and version bump.

chunks.title: 2.7.1 Several Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.7.1, bug fixes address desktop conversions mistakenly doing a 'save' to 'save as', desktop 'open with PDF' having invalid description on windows, Posthog still creating a cookie even when its not used (still a fully unused cookie), desktop not falling back to local connection if on selfhosted and server down, and rotate on large docs not always working correctly. Minor enhancements include transforms as root, limit PostHog cookie to Stirling PDF's subdomain only, Posthog-fixes, get rid of bad description for file association on Windows, desktop fallback to local backend if self-hosted server is offline, add SaaS frontend code, manage state of price-lookup calls, add system for managing env vars, fix rotate failing on large documents, cleanup-conversion-translations, and update Italian translations. Development tools move AI advice to AGENTS.md and add symlink from CLAUDE.md.

chunks.title: 2.7.2 Hotfix for desktop bug
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.7.2, the hotfix addresses a bug where self-hosted connections via desktop would stop working, thinking they were connecting to a non selfhost instance. Minor enhancements check if saas before blocking credit insufficiencies.

chunks.title: 2.7.3 Read aloud, Annotations improvement, printing and bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.7.3, new features include a PDF read aloud feature in viewer mode to "speak" the PDF to you, improved annotation handling in annotation UI, Mac printing finally working on desktop app, and several general bug fixes such as fix non-ASCII characters in headers being rejected and fix bug for HTTP2 support. The release also temporarily removes the remove-image tool and makes some changes to folder watching; users of these are recommended to hold off until 2.8.0. Enhancements add jetty-alpn-java-server dependency for HTTP/2 support. Minor enhancements improve annotations, update backend 3rd party licenses, fix printing on Mac desktop, delete code from invalid license, fix jumping cursor bug, fix `any` type usage in the `saas/` folder, unify creditCosts.ts files, hotfix-cant-run-tools-when-no-credits, fix non-ASCII characters in headers being rejected, and add speaking feature. Docker updates bump various actions. Other changes bump actions/download-artifact, add SaaS AI engine, bump srvaroa/labeler, and bump github/codeql-action.

chunks.title: 2.8.0 Desktop no longer requires login and lots of new features!
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.8.0, desktop no longer requires a login to use; this feature is now fully optional and only required for tools which can't run locally (and can be run on stirling.com OR your own selfhosted indicated with a cloud icon). New features include improved PDF Rendering performance, comment support for both viewing and adding (uses your username automatically), reintroduced the remove image endpoint, new RFC 3161 PDF timestamp tool, security patches, fixed bug for docx conversion on desktop, fixed bug for email invites, possible fix for users reporting text selection issues, and multi-page PDF layout enhancement with a dramatic increase in customisation. Enhancements replace PdfLib with Pdfium for form handling and general rendering tasks, remove images, and add RFC 3161 PDF timestamp tool. Minor enhancements update Spanish translation, add explicit Save As button for desktop viewer, XSS for eml and others, add frontend developer guide, remove cmd-r override for rotation, fix save converted files, bump/embed pdfv2.8.0, invite-link-issues, desktop/remove hard requirement auth wall on desktop, fix/v2/text selection 2, FileReadiness, enhance multi-page PDF layout with advanced customization options, and fix pause-rounded icon typos and comments. Docker updates fix gradle jar version and bump various actions. Other changes bump softprops/action-gh-release.

chunks.title: 2.9.0 File sharing, Group signing and many fixes!
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.9.0, server-side file sharing and group signing (both visual and certificate) are added as alpha features, off by default. Other features include dark mode colour filters for PDF in the viewer, accounts blocked due to incorrect password attempts can now be unblocked sooner by admins, and non PDF files should now be supported in the viewer (CSV, JSON, MD, PNG etc). Fixes address QR code splitting not working for certain PDFs, CPU usage issues, redact API issues, redact UI issues, and many security fixes and removal of old dependencies. Minor enhancements include dark mode PDF filter init, shared sign cert validation, update Italian translations, fix Playwright E2E tests, only allow Tauri imports in the desktop app, unlock account, nonpdf-viewer, pdf layer toggle, update and improve zh-TW Traditional Chinese locale, fix `any` type usage in `proprietary/`, added back ctrl+r as rotate if on desktop, qr split fixes, idle cpu fix test, fix new line in redact, bug/connection mode fixes, alpha flag for file storage settings, bump deps, restore English search aliases in zh-TW tags, pipeline changes and version bump, fix/redact bug, removeffmpeg, fix image stamp cropping and align preview with PDF output for add-stamp, and translate more messages to fr-FR. Docker updates base docker image.

chunks.title: 2.9.1 Bug fixes and UI improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.9.1, quick fixes address file permission issues in docker and add nice file UI selection improvements for file handling across tools. Minor enhancements add specific view scope for selected files: running a tool in the viewer only runs the tool on the viewed file, running a tool in active files runs the tool on all selected files (as before), UX improvements to the compare tool, merge tool and more, possible fix permission issues and fix thread timing issues, and line separator fix for redaction drift. Other changes include dependency updates.

chunks.title: 2.9.2 hotfix for folder scanning
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.9.2, the hotfix addresses folder scanning issues. Minor enhancements include pipeline fixes.

chunks.title: 2.10.0 AppImage, RPM, bug fixes and more
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.10.0, users can now set a default startup view and reader zoom preferences for desktop, new pixel compare mode in PDF Compare tool to compare formatting and other changes, improved memory efficiency of API calls, improved thumbnail speed and rendering and fixed thumbnail bugs, support AppImage files for desktop release, support RPM Builds for desktop release, support Homebrew, AUR, Scoop and winget for desktop release, landing page UI change, improved comment interaction (side bar opens on clicking comment annotations), and improve swagger docs. Bug fixes address file sharing bugs for SSO users, thumbnail rendering issues, encrypted PDF modal not working, and fix for QR code usage on desktop. Enhancements add default startup view and reader zoom preferences. Minor enhancements fix/desktop open with tool access, add prototypes folder, use clean 3 card design for landing page, fix critical issue in axios, remove duplicate isPanning state, fix encrypted pdf handling, fix encrypted PDF unlock modal missing on IndexedDB restore and large files, desktop mobile QR fixes, fix Java formatting, add Taskfile for unified dev workflow, cleanup work + stream endpoints to reduce memory usage, thumbnail preview fixes windows, fix terms and privacy URLs links, feat/math validation agent, chore/remove usage of mantine color scheme, enable AppImage and rpm distributions, and fix compare tool file.

chunks.title: 2.10.1 Unified mac installer, bug fixes and improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.10.1, changes include a unified mac installer so a single install for both x86 and arm, lots of dependency updates, loading speed improvements, fixes for certain desktop tools not working at all such as "get info", fixes for desktop file save/edit status not showing, and automate tool to now import and export configurations easier. Bug fixes skip translation key extraction for files without i18n usage, set CI to run the same in the merge queue as it does in CI, fix leaking peer share tokens from participant session API, fix missing desktop save indicator on files, and fix frontend download links pointing to split Mac binaries. Enhancements sync translations, update backend 3rd party licenses, change frontend `.env` files to be committed and have `.env.*.local` overrides, fix translation, playwright, bug fixes for some desktop tools, have Task choose free ports for dev servers, lazy load open cv, update backend 3rd party licenses, bump the npm_and_yarn group, update backend 3rd party licenses, fix stubs playwright, fix French translations, switch key areas to lazily import to improve Vite chunk size, bump the mui group, bump globals, bump windows, bump sha2, bump the tauri group, bump the embedpdf group, and fix move button on multitool.

chunks.title: 2.11.0 New easy file management UI release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF release v2.11.0, the release is a preview of a new UI to make file management and selection feel less clunky, with a new layout putting files on the left and tools on the right. Bug fixes address Task commands in Powershell, replace deprecated payload too large status, and fix desktop app overscrolling inappropriately. Enhancements add Playwright/bootRun/test.sh tasks, unoserver docker, update backend 3rd party licenses plus version bump, fix main frontend validation, UI redesign staging, split and delete forms, and add translations. Docker updates bump step-security/harden-runner and actions/cache. Other changes bump various dependencies and remove frontend validation PR comment after successful check.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent TabbyML/tabby release stream from v0.14.0 through v0.32.0, including patch releases and extension updates. It covers new features like code search, Answer Engine enhancements, access control, LDAP integration, and custom branding.

chunks.title: v0.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.14.0, code search functionality is introduced in the Code Browser tab with regex patterns and filters by language, repository, and branch. Initial experimental support for natural language to codebase conversation is added in Answer Engine. Incremental issues/PRs indexing by updated_at is implemented, git_url canonicalization is fixed for relevant code search, and llama.cpp is bumped to b3370 to fix Qwen2 model series inference.

chunks.title: v0.15.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.15.0, the Code Browser search bar is reworked and integrated with file navigation, and GraphQL syntax highlighting is supported. For linked GitHub repositories, issues and PRs are only returned when the repository is selected. GitLab issues/MRs indexing is fixed to handle null description fields, proxy settings are skipped for localhost model servers, and code completion input/output settings are allowed in config.toml.

chunks.title: v0.16.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.16.1, websockets are now used for streaming features like Answer Engine and Chat Side Panel, requiring reverse proxy configuration. Discussion threads in Answer Engine are persisted for sharing. A bug where the llama-server subprocess was not reused for Chat/Completion with the same model is fixed, and llama.cpp is updated to b3571 to support jina series embedding models.

chunks.title: v0.17.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.17.0, the Web context provider is reworked into the Developer Docs context provider, requiring manual migration of previously added content. The Answer Engine search box is extensively reworked: Developer Docs/Web search is triggered by '@', and Repository Context is selected using '#'. OCaml language support is added.

chunks.title: v0.18.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.18.0, the Chat Side Panel is redesigned, requiring extension version bumps (VSCode >= 1.12.0, IntelliJ >= 1.8.0). User Groups Access Control is introduced, allowing server administrators to assign user groups to specific context providers for precise access control.

chunks.title: v0.19.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.19.0, the Answer Engine includes entire file content directly when the file is short (less than 200 lines). Additional languages can be added via config.toml, and the system_prompt for Answer Engine can be customized. The homepage is redesigned to make team activities discoverable, and downloading models with multiple partitions (e.g., Qwen-2.5 series) is supported.

chunks.title: v0.20.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.20.0, search results can be edited directly, backend chat models can be switched in Answer Engine, and a connection test button is added in the System tab. CR-LF inference in code completion is optimized, and llama.cpp is bumped to b3995.

chunks.title: v0.21.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.21.0, due to indexing format changes, the ~/.tabby/index directory is automatically removed before re-indexing. Support for connecting to llamafile model backend is added. Open/Closed state is displayed for issues/PRs in Answer Engine context cards, entire threads can be deleted, and rate limiter options are added for HTTP-powered model backends. A panic when specifying a local model is fixed, pagination is added to Answer Engine threads, Vulkan binary distributions are fixed, and retry logic for chunk embedding computation is improved.

chunks.title: v0.21.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby patch release v0.21.1, the Gitlab Context Provider is fixed.

chunks.title: intellij@1.9.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby IntelliJ extension release 1.9.1, the chat panel is updated to be compatible with Tabby server versions 0.21.2, 0.22.0, and later.

chunks.title: v0.21.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby patch release v0.21.2, extension side changes are adapted for new versions: VSCode 1.16.0 and IntelliJ Platform 1.9.1.

chunks.title: v0.22.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.22.0, a notification inbox is introduced on the homepage with license expiration check. Author information is displayed for issues/PRs in Answer Engine context cards. Pull request indexing is refactored for faster incremental indexing, rate limiter on HTTP-powered model backend is optimized, rate limiting at 60 requests per minute is introduced in the webserver, model capability is validated before download, a broken tree view on Windows in CodeBrowser is fixed, and all Linux base images are upgraded to manylinux_2_28.

chunks.title: v0.23.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.23.0, commit hash is added to code attachments for redirection to the specific commit in the code browser. The connection status of the gitUrl repository is displayed in the chat side panel. Database backups are performed only when there are pending schema migrations, and repository selection is added with removal of '#' mentions in the Answer Engine.

chunks.title: v0.23.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby patch release v0.23.1, an issue preventing remote model downloads due to HuggingFace API changes is fixed.

chunks.title: v0.24.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.24.0, LDAP Authentication Integration is implemented. Notifications for unsuccessful background jobs are added. A bug preventing client code context in historical messages from being added to the prompt is fixed. Job run and user event history is retained only for the past three months. Integration errors with recent Jan AI versions are resolved, repository synchronization issues from config.toml are fixed, the active text tab is set as default context in Code Browser chat, model download failures due to HuggingFace API changes are resolved, and indexing of GitHub Pull Request diffs exceeding 300 files is omitted.

chunks.title: v0.25.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.25.0, default parallelism is increased from 1 to 4, potentially increasing VRAM usage. A new embedding kind 'llama.cpp/before_b4356_embedding' is introduced for legacy embedding APIs. The Answer Engine's thinking process is exposed in thread messages, it can access the repository's directory file list, '@' mentions of symbols are enabled in Chat Sidebar, and default repository-aware question recommendations are provided. Configuration to truncate text before embedding is added, llama.cpp is bumped to b4651, embedding retries on failure are automatic, Answer Engine UI is enhanced, and a deserialization issue with finish_reason from LiteLLM Proxy Server is resolved.

chunks.title: v0.25.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby patch release v0.25.1, UI details in Answer Engine are refined.

chunks.title: v0.26.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.26.0, the minimum katana version is bumped to 1.1.2. The Answer Engine can access the repository's commit history, and user chat history is displayed on the Homepage and Chat Side Panel. Crawling of developer documentation from llms-full.txt is facilitated when available.

chunks.title: v0.27.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.27.0, preparation for the 1.0 release begins, with extension version upgrades maintaining backward compatibility. Shell command execution is supported within the Chat Panel, '@changes' can include uncommitted changes as contexts, and a security option hides password login on the frontend. Background job logs are stored on disk, chat usage frequency is tracked and displayed on the Reports page, and chat functionality issues with OpenAI reasoning models like o3-mini and o1-mini are resolved.

chunks.title: v0.27.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby patch release v0.27.1, an issue with escaped characters causing plugin crashes on Windows is resolved, a hang when waiting for registry file download in offline environments is fixed, and handling of file mentions from different sources in the Chat Panel is improved.

chunks.title: v0.28.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.28.0, the 'Convert to Page' feature is introduced, transforming Answer Engine messages into persistent, shareable Pages. Doc Query support is added in the Chat Panel to include Dev Docs as context. Background task logging is enhanced for performance, and the display of thinking processes in Answer Engine and Chat Panel is improved.

chunks.title: v0.29.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.29.0, RESTful APIs are added for ingesting custom documents and facilitating their removal. Error details in the Notification Inbox are enhanced, automatic Jobs status polling is supported, and llama.cpp is bumped to b2500.

chunks.title: v0.30.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.30.0, the Docker image now requires an NVIDIA GPU; CPU-only environments should use the Linux binary. GitLab Merge Request indexing as context is supported. CUDA 12 image is used as base image by default, Answer Engine logic enriches context when generating pages, model configuration details on the System page are improved, button flickering in code snippets during answer generation is resolved, the member filter bar on the Reports page is fixed at the top, and loading multi-part models from local is fixed.

chunks.title: v0.30.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby patch release v0.30.1, the CUDA base image is downgraded to version 12.4.1 to enhance compatibility.

chunks.title: v0.30.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby patch release v0.30.2, sqlx is updated to 0.7.3 to avoid database pool timeout, llama.cpp is bumped to b6047, and the Flash Attention LLAMA flag is exposed as an environment variable.

chunks.title: v0.31.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.31.0, custom branding with name and logo is supported, available exclusively with an Enterprise License.

chunks.title: v0.31.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby patch release v0.31.1, SQLite connection parameters are optimized to improve stability.

chunks.title: v0.31.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby patch release v0.31.2, an environment variable TABBY_INDEX_REPO_IN_SHARD is added to enable hourly sharded indexing when the repository count exceeds 20.

chunks.title: v0.32.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release v0.32.0, support for mistral/embedding api kind is added, generic OAuth support is introduced, and indexing of multiple branches is supported. Email is included in invitation links and email editing is disabled when opening the link.

chunks.title: next-alpha
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TabbyML/tabby release next-alpha, this is an alpha version intended only for internal use by Tabby developers.

questions.query_text: In the TabbyML/tabby releases, which release introduces the 'Convert to Page' feature that transforms Answer Engine messages into persistent, shareable Pages?

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release evolution of TeamNewPipe/NewPipe, covering a series of releases from v0.22.0 to v0.28.7. The releases include new features, improvements, fixes, and development changes, with a focus on YouTube extraction fixes, UI enhancements, and platform support updates.

chunks.title: v0.22.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.22.0, new features include a new fast forward/rewind behavior, searchable preferences/settings, highlighting of pinned comments, and the addition of the FSFE-Tube PeerTube instance. Improvements cover unified error reporting with error notifications, an alert dialog when no appropriate file manager is found, removal of repeated 'Video preview thumbnail' announcements in reader mode, and better handling of playlist stuck target duration and BehindLiveWindowExceptions. Fixes address local search result order, cutout respect in MultiWindow, non-English character hashtags, a readme link, sub-channel icon view, search key input after closing player overlay, loading full stream info before use to fix empty play queue fields, crash when sharing a loading playlist, a workaround for player switching recovery, app icon in fastlane metadata, always showing background/popup toast, first item always played in play queue on reload, loading uploader URL from play queue, and crash on long-pressing stream while player starts. Development changes include bumping ktlint, Checkstyle, and Java version (now requiring Java 11 to build), updating F-Droid badge, libraries, NewPipeExtractor, and various code quality and CI improvements.

chunks.title: v0.22.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.22.1, fixes include loading enough initial items and fixing a crash in lists, having the fast seek overlay arc go under the system UI, and reverting the 'Respect cutouts when playing in MultiWindow' change. Development updates include updating the ACRA library, improving the image-minimizer, changing compileSdk from 30 to 31, and a small refactor in the player class.

chunks.title: v0.22.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.22.2, the main fix addresses YouTube not playing any streams. It also includes all fixes and improvements from NewPipe Extractor version 0.22.0.

chunks.title: v0.23.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.23.0, new features include notifications for new streams, seamless transition between background and video players when putting the app in background, pitch change by semitones, appending queue to playlist in the main player, and loading YouTube mixes in related items (though this was already broken by YouTube in the EU). Improvements cover remembering adjustment step size for playback controls (speed and pitch), mitigating long buffering on initial video playback, replacing 'yes' with 'ok' in strings, improving player UI and navigability for Android TV, adding a confirmation button when deleting all files in downloader, removing icon duplicates and fixing theming issues, and updating ExoPlayer to 2.17.1 with a MediaSource management rework. Fixes address player controls not hiding if resumed from media button, migrating the app update checker to AndroidX Work, fixing error notification on KitKat, playback resetting to beginning when player type changed, download dialog selector layout, crash when rotating device with playlist dialog open, adapting opacity of popup close button for touches in other apps on Android >=12. Development changes include replacing CircleImageView with ShapeableImageView, solving Java warnings, fixing Room warnings, fixing build on Apple Silicon Macs, refactoring InfoItemDialog generation, better equals check, updating Android Gradle Plugin and Gradle, removing duplicate large-land player layout, updating ConstraintLayout and Room libraries, updating Kotlin to 1.6.10, updating AndroidX libraries, deduplicating code for fetching stream info, extracting view click listeners from player, deleting unused code, cleaning up the about package, creating a stub for OnSeekBarChangeListener, lint cleaning, updating Checkstyle to 10.0, updating license, updating CONTRIBUTING.md, updating GitHub action dependencies, updating AGP, Gradle, and Kotlin, using simpler DrawerLayout method, and replacing checklist drawable.

chunks.title: v0.23.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.23.1, new features include support for delivery methods other than progressive HTTP (thanks to @AudricV), which enables using DASH for YouTube playback (improving loading times and seeking), full playback of recently ended livestreams on YouTube, improved availability of some resolutions and formats on YouTube, fixing seeking on PeerTube videos with only HLS streams, fixing crash on PeerTube videos with an audio-only stream, fixing playback of HLS-only tracks on SoundCloud, adding a button to add a remote playlist to a local one, and image preview in the Android share sheet (Android 10+ only). Improvements include enhancing the playback parameters dialog's UI and moving subscription import/export options to the overflow menu. Fixes address keyboard not opening with disabled animations, crash when opening NewPipe from the notification bar, hiding player controls when playing from media button, history view count, RouterActivity theming, removing only fully watched videos from playlist, crash when rotating device on unsupported channels, making volume progress bar match system volume when sliding, and fixing 'Add to playlist' not working and cleaning up RouterActivity choice handling. Localization adds a Hindi translation of the README. Development updates include updating ACRA library, user agent used by downloader, removing unused strings.xml resources, updating Groupie and ACRA libraries, updating Android Gradle Plugin and Kotlin, using JvmOverloads, removing unnecessary compat method calls, using AppCompatResources, and making changes to the ReadMe.

chunks.title: v0.23.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.23.2, fixes address YouTube issues: the 'Could not get any stream' error when trying to play any video (thanks to @Theta-Dev) and the replacement of video and audio streams by a video saying 'The following content is not available on this app'.

chunks.title: v0.23.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.23.3, fixes address YouTube infinite loading when trying to play any video and throttling on some videos. Development includes upgrading the jsoup library to 1.15.3, which includes a security fix.

chunks.title: v0.24.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.24.0, new features include bumping minSdk to 21 (Android 5 Lollipop) and dropping support for Android 4.4 KitKat, adding a Download entry to the long-press menu, adding an option to hide future videos in the feed, and adding a Share menu item to local playlists. Improvements include cropping the notification thumbnail in 1:1 mode instead of stretching it, making thumbnails' scaleType fitCenter, improving image placeholders, removing the '(beta)' tag from services, refactoring the player and extracting UI components, and sorting tags case-insensitively. Fixes address wrong image used as a placeholder for channel avatars and various issues with the player notification. Localization includes making changes to the README and fixing the language code for Chinese Simplified. Development changes include running CI on all release branches, cleaning up proguard file, updating ExoPlayer to 2.18.1, specifying used ExoPlayer libraries, using minimum required permissions for GitHub workflows, Checkstyle assign on same line, using ViewCompat.setBackgroundTintList(), updating some misc libraries, using stream sorting, using Java 9 collection factories (List.of(), Set.of(), Map.of()), using MathUtils.clamp(), using Kotlin IO extensions, removing unnecessary methods, removing deprecated method calls in FocusAwareCoordinator, deduplicating SQL queries to get feed streams, updating OkHttp to 4.10.0, updating Lifecycle to 2.5.1, updating AndroidX Fragment to 1.4.1, updating Google Material to 1.6.1, using Throwable.stackTraceToString(), updating AppCompat to 1.4.2, using WindowMetrics API, updating AndroidX Room to 2.4.3, removing uses of setBottomSheetCallback(), refactoring LicenseFragmentHelper, making OnClickGesture an interface, reducing View.kt size, using toArray() with zero-length arrays, using Comparator factory methods, using Collectors.joining(), updating FilePicker to a custom fork and disabling Jetifier, adding FAQ entry to template checklists, using ListAdapter for search predictions, updating Gradle to 7.5.1, removing extra whitespace from issue and PR templates, clarifying that span shouldn't be in translated READMEs, keeping strong references to Picasso notification icon loading targets, and creating media session UI and fixing player notification.

chunks.title: v0.24.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.24.1, new features include adding a monochrome icon, a link to FAQ in the app, an 'Open in browser' button on the error panel, an option to display channel groups as list instead of grid, long-click on stream segment to share timestamped URLs (for YouTube only), and YouTube support for handles. Improvements include adding a play queue button to the video details fragment, showing 'Hold to enqueue' tip in local playlists, YouTube support for attributed text description, and YouTube support for all channel usernames. Fixes address potential cast exception in comments text, DownloadDialog crash on screen rotation, crash when clicking download and quitting the history fragment, job for removing watched streams from playlist not executing only once, duplicate videos in feed group 'All', YouTube extraction of videos in channels and feeds when not using dedicated mode (RSS feeds) with a note about shorts and livestreams separation, YouTube 403 HTTP errors workaround with downsides, YouTube extraction of author and video count of playlists with new metadata format (no author thumbnail), SoundCloud tracks in incorrect order on playlists, and SoundCloud getting more comments. Localization adds new localizations (Icelandic, Latvian, Malayalam) to language selector, updates translations, and removes empty localizations. Development changes include using LinkifyCompat, utilizing useSimpleSummaryProvider attribute, improving FeedGroupDialogViewModel factory, updating Android Gradle Plugin to 7.3.0, using range-limiting methods in more places, using Okio's ByteString for download checksums, calculating search score using streams, using TextViewCompat.setCompoundDrawableTintList(), updating AppCompat to 1.5.1 and compileSdk to 32, updating PrettyTime from 5.0.3 to 5.0.6, and other updates.

chunks.title: v0.25.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.25.0, new features include showing a toast when no updates are available, showing subscriber count on the video details page, downloading items from the long press menu of queue items, allowing permanently setting a playlist thumbnail, adding long press action on hashtags and web links in descriptions, and a new card view mode with full width thumbnails. Improvements include removing the redundant 'Copied to clipboard' toast for Android 13+, making the mini-player close button area larger, using smoother bitmap downscaling for thumbnails, renaming 'Help' to 'Fast mode', adding a hint to improve discoverability of subscription import, disabling night theme selection if auto theme is not used, setting compileSdk and targetSdk to 33 (Android 13), seeking no longer pausing the played stream, adding an icon for 'Play All', adding language suffix to downloaded subtitle filenames, checking availability of Samsung DeX only on Samsung devices, adding 'What's New' to the default main page tabs, changing the 'What's New' icon, making channel images in grid lists bigger, changing the 'Chapters' icon, and YouTube support for live links. Fixes address persistent hover overlay when in desktop/DeX mode or using a mouse/non-touch input, only showing 'Enqueue next' when in the middle of the queue, removing dead Privacy Tools PeerTube instance, crash when clicking 'Add to playlist' while the current list is still loading, allowing using background player when there are no separate audio streams, improving screen rotation handling in Open action menu, asking for permission when enqueuing in a popup, fixing removing watched videos from playlist includes currently playing, fixing displaying multiple empty playlists, fixing background player stops working when enqueueing playlist at different index, and fixing link clicking and ellipsizing of comments. Localization updates translations and adds Odia language to the language selector. Development changes include making PendingIntents immutable on Android 6.0+, using Locale.forLanguageTag(), forbidding wrong @Nullable and @NotNull annotation imports, setting image-minimizer to specify image width, updating Sonarqube to 3.5, using Math.floorDiv(), using SparseArrayCompat, updating LeakCanary to 2.9.1, updating Desugaring to 1.1.8, ACRA to 5.9.7 and Android Gradle Plugin to 7.3.1, refactoring VideoDetailFragment, refactoring VideoPlayerUi, updating RxJava to 3.1.5 and RxAndroid to 3.0.2, using ListAdapter in NotificationModeConfigAdapter, using new NPE UTF8 Utils methods, cleaning up Optional-related code, removing Runnable variables for Handlers, using WindowCompat (with a note about possible system UI issues), updating desugar_jdk_libs to 2.0.2 and Android Gradle Plugin to 7.4.0 (requiring Android Studio Electric Eel), and fixing reproducible builds.

chunks.title: v0.25.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.25.1, known issues include player notification actions not being used on Android 13+, crash when playing content in fullscreen on some devices, and YouTube trends not shown sometimes. New features include handling duplicate streams in the 'Add to playlist' dialog, larger channel cards in search results, an option to ignore hardware media button events, an option to remove partially watched videos from the 'Whats new' feed, and a button to remove duplicates from a playlist. Improvements include reducing the size of thumbnails on big screens to fit more grid columns and making UI behavior for playback information display more consistent. Fixes address orientation locked if there is no sensor for it, crash when clicking on an empty comment, correctly opening URLs in browser and fixing opening downloads and external players on Android 11+, fixing playlist streams progress bar size in card mode, fixing erroneous updates of playlist thumbnails, and reverting the use of WindowCompat. Localization updates translations. Development updates include updating to ExoPlayer 2.18.5.

chunks.title: v0.25.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.25.2, important fixes address YouTube videos aborting playing due to HTTP 403 errors with a new workaround that can break at any time, and player crashes or black screen on some devices by disabling media tunneling by default on more known unsupported devices. Known issues include YouTube no streams in some playlists with only shorts and player notification actions not used on Android 13+. New features include allowing setting volume and brightness gestures on any side of the screen, adding an ExoPlayer settings page, adding support for multiple audio tracks, and adding support for displaying main-tabs at the bottom of the screen. Improvements include adding a whitelist to only retrieve supported YouTube itags/streams, improving YouTube download speed, handling PeerTube links to 'peertube.stream', fixing a memory leak in the player, and disabling media tunneling by default on more known unsupported devices. Fixes address PeerTube uploader and subchannel avatars being swapped and disabling loading thumbnail message failure, crash after feed update, and no video in player when switching to main player from playlist view. Localization updates translations, adds N'Ko language to the language chooser, translates README into new languages, and adds Uchinaguchi translation. Development changes include removing jsoup files from APK, updating Kotlin to 1.8.20, and other updates.

chunks.title: v0.26.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.26.0, this version includes changes from NewPipe Extractor v0.23.0 and v0.23.1, fixing the recurring 'Could not get like count' error on YouTube streams. New features include accessing more content provided by channels grouped in different tabs (YouTube: videos, shorts, live, playlists, about; PeerTube: videos, playlists, channels, about; SoundCloud: tracks, playlists, albums, about; Bandcamp: albums, tracks, about; media.ccc.de: videos, about) and allowing selecting image quality among multiple images with three presets (low, medium, high). Improvements include adjusting empty state message for ListInfoFragments depending on Info stream type, showing loading indicator before opening the download dialog from the share menu, improved accessibility of player interfaces, including a high-resolution option in the default resolution settings, showing play queue button in main player when there is one stream, adding option to add playlist name and video name to playlist sharing content, and improving audio stream selection for video-only streams in the downloader. Localization and documentation changes include making capitalization of 'Night theme' setting consistent, updating Weblate and fixing string formats, fixing selection of wrong languages in language picker, making 'latest release' link more obvious to bug reporters, removing Bitcoin and Bountysource donation options from Readme, and adding Matrix room link to Readme. Fixes address player audio focus not respecting mute, downloads of streams with missing MediaFormat, YouTube extraction of age-restricted music videos, restoring software license dialog, inconsistency between user interaction and database commit order when re-adding videos to a playlist, playing SoundCloud songs under some conditions (OPUS HLS streams considered unplayable), app not responding, background app crashes and issues with starting the player, some null pointer exceptions, custom filename replacement character being interpreted as regex and crashing the app, notifying about old 'new' streams, and channel avatar not loading correctly sometimes. Development changes include simplifying MainActivity.tabSelected, image minimizer replacement, updating miscellaneous libraries, improving download helpers using Java 7 NIO API, fixing memory leaks and adding documentation, replacing MathUtils.clamp with Kotlin coerceIn, bumping AGP to 8.1.1, improving code quality, updating extractor and removing DeobfuscateException, and other changes.

chunks.title: v0.26.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.26.1, the fix addresses a MediaCCC crash when opening a channel/conference.

chunks.title: v0.27.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.27.0, important fixes include fixing YouTube extraction of comments (with approximate like counts for comments with more than 999 likes and third-party social links showing accessibility text), restoring access to some YouTube streams (audio streams with average bitrate around 32 and 48 kbps and 720p MPEG-4 muxed video stream on musical contents, with a note that these may become completely unavailable), and fixing a vulnerability when importing backups (new format for settings stored in backups, old format still supported but will be removed, warning shown for old format). Known issues include YouTube avatars, banners, and subscriber count unavailable on channels sometimes. New features include adding support for comment replies, adding playlist description to playlist fragment, adding option to reset settings, showing overall duration of items in a playlist, and allowing ordering bookmarked playlists. Improvements include restoring support of custom notification actions on Android 13+ (first three actions cannot be customized), allowing playing/pausing from the notification when the player is buffering, adding 'free memory' check before downloading, changing the landscape layout of list card item, asking for consent before checking for updates, and moving player notification setting to notification section. Fixes address not writing defaultFormat setting, calculating cache key based on info type instead of item type, not considering nullability when comparing getAudioTrackType, trimming search string and removing duplicate records from the database, various download fixes, error if there is no avatar when reloading feed. Localization and documentation updates include updating translations, using GitHub markdown to emphasize, and other changes. Development changes include various updates and improvements.

chunks.title: v0.27.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.27.1, fixes address YouTube HTTP error 403 when starting videos and a crash in MediaSessionPlayerUi while destroying the player. Note that 403 errors in the middle of YouTube videos are not fixed and will be addressed in another hotfix release.

chunks.title: v0.27.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.27.2, this hotfix release fixes HTTP 403 errors in the middle of YouTube videos. New features include SoundCloud support for on.soundcloud.com URLs. Improvements include Bandcamp showing additional info in radio kiosk. Fixes address YouTube occasional HTTP 403 errors at the beginning or in the middle of videos, YouTube extraction of avatar and banner from more channel header types, and Bandcamp various bugs and always using HTTPS.

chunks.title: v0.27.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.27.3, known issues include YouTube 'Sign in to confirm...'/'Watch on the latest version...' error messages, PeerTube no audio in videos with separated audio file, and YouTube age-restricted content not available anymore. Updates on development mention progress on the rewrite and NewPipe e.V. hiring people. New features include adding support for secondary audio track type. Improvements include making playlist description clickable to show more/less content, handling PeerTube subscribeto.me instance links automatically, only starting playing single item in history screen, and throttling YouTube feed loading to avoid rate limits. Fixes address RSS button visibility, seekbar preview crashes, crash after adding item to a playlist caused by null thumbnail URL, seekbar crashing on drag with faulty frameset, UI crash when user navigates away before the download dialog appears, related items list enqueue popup crash, playlist order in add to playlist dialog, and adjusting the playlist bookmark item layout for RTL languages. Localization and documentation updates include updating backup and restore explanation in README, removing Kotlin code restriction from contribution guidelines, updating README.pt_BR.md, fixing 404 page not found when clicking on 'contribution notes' in multiple translated READMEs, adding hash of signing key to README, fixing a typo in README, using Android's elapsed time formatting, updating French README.fr.md, translating README to Arabic, and updating backup and restore explanation and improving Hindi, Punjabi and Assamese READMEs. Development changes include fixing GitHub workflow for Android tests, migrating to non-transitive R classes, updating PrettyTime to 5.0.8, converting CommentTextOnTouchListener to a lambda, adding NewPipe icon to Android Studio's new UI, removing outdated returnActivity test code, replacing IcePick with Bridge and Android-State, updating Java version used in CI from 17 to 21, updating Gradle Wrapper from 8.2 to 8.9, updating AGP from 8.2.0 to 8.7.1, replacing symlink list_stream_card_item.xml by a copy, removing deprecated android.defaults.buildfeatures.buildconfig Gradle property, fixing and updating NewPipeExtractor dependency, making it possible to control the version code and name, adding null-safe SharedPreferences.getStringSafe, and updating user agent to Firefox ESR 128.

chunks.title: v0.27.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.27.4, this is a minor release to allow the new APK to be reproducible for F-Droid. Improvements include always allowing changing player notification preferences on Android 13+. Fixes address exporting database/subscriptions would not truncate an already existing file, possibly leading to a corrupted export, and player resuming from start when clicking on a timestamp. Development adds a workflow to build unsigned release APKs reliably.

chunks.title: v0.27.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.27.5, this hotfix release fixes YouTube videos not loading due to extractor error 'IOS player response is not valid'. It only addresses the most pressing error that prevents YouTube video details from loading, with other problems to be solved in a separate release.

chunks.title: v0.27.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.27.6, this hotfix release fixes various YouTube issues: 'IOS player response is not valid' which prevented any video from loading, HTTP 403 errors while playing videos (usually at minute 1:09), missing video streams at 720p 24-30FPS, and a few age restricted videos are now playable again (but only a few). It notes that YouTube requests now require running and passing Google's web browsers integrity checks through the system WebView, and if not available, fallback methods may incur HTTP 403 errors. New features include YouTube support for poTokens. Improvements include converting error report timestamps to ISO format. Fixes address caption sizes not being changed, loading StreamInfo twice on first VideoDetailFragment opening, SoundCloud removing unplayable DRM-protected streams and reducing network requests, and DownloaderImpl auto-closing resources and simplifying headers setting. Translation/localization corrects a typo in contribution guidelines and adds a link to donation page on app drawer. Development fixes image-minimizer on lines containing multiple images.

chunks.title: v0.27.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.27.7, this hotfix release fixes YouTube only providing a 360p stream. The solution is likely temporary, and the SABR video protocol needs to be implemented in the long run.

chunks.title: v0.28.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.28.0, new features include adding support for Android Auto, adding feed groups as main screen tabs, YouTube support for new kiosks and migration to change trending kiosk tab, YouTube share as temporary playlist, SoundCloud support for likes in channel and feed, and SoundCloud support for AAC 160k unprotected stream. Improvements include Android 13+ support for per-app language preferences (replacing in-app setting), showing service name in search bar hint, showing download date in Downloads, supporting RTL usernames in comment header, and disambiguating audio track labels. Fixes address broken text colors in dark mode, YouTube playlists not loading more than 100 items, YouTube missing recommended videos, other miscellaneous YouTube fixes, crashes in History list view, stream notification grouping when channel URLs differ, duplicate menu options in ChannelFragment, timestamps not working in comment replies, adding migration to remove the now-defunct SoundCloud Top 50 kiosk, and UI crash instead of proper error report if search next page can't be extracted. Translation/localization updates translations and adds 15 new locales to the in-app language chooser, does not capitalize 'page' for main page content options, adds dev and refactor nightly build badges to README, adds matrix chat link and dev/refactor nightly badges to all translated READMEs, fixes 'Get it on F-Droid' appearing giant in README, and fixes new badge links on README being rendered incorrectly. Development changes include disabling logs about view animations by default, adding new Proguard rules for Mozilla Rhino, improving extractor Jitpack workaround comment and fixing its hash, fixing accessing poToken challenge data at wrong index in some cases, and updating user agent to Firefox 140 ESR.

chunks.title: v0.28.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.28.1, this version is shipped with NewPipe Extractor 0.25.0. New features include supporting on.soundcloud link opening and adding metadata fields for OPUS audio downloads. Improvements include fixing clearing queue and keeping current player when clicking on timestamps, trying to recover pending download missions when possible, adding option to delete a download without also deleting file, adding enqueue option to router dialog, adding more specific error messages and deduplicating their handling, overlay permission displaying explanatory dialog for Android > R, notifications no longer requested again after rotating the phone, and allowing dragging bookmarked playlist in both directions. Fixes in the player include using original audio language by default, remembering and restoring orientation on fullscreen exit, fixing ghost notifications and random player crashes, fixing audio language button pushing player controls off-screen in portrait and popup, and fixing scaleX being NaN on minimize to background app switch. Downloader fixes include fixing insufficient permissions on opening downloaded streams, fixing download resume corruption when server returns HTTP 200, fixing missing subtitle text in manually downloaded *.SRT files, and fixing initial numbering of frames in TTML to SRT converter. Other fixes include fixing short count formatting for Android versions below 7.0, fixing and simplifying opening URLs in browser, fixing long-pressing Play All-button does nothing, enforcing using SAF on FireOS TVs with Android 10+, committing all the playlist changes to db immediately to prevent incorrect UI states, fixing incorrect UI states of PlayQueue items, and fixing crash on screen rotation while entering SoundCloud import URL. Translation/localization updates translations and updates PR template to specify target branch for features. Development changes include targeting SDK 35, correctly ignoring new version check for Picasso, updating Android Gradle Plugin to 8.13.0, removing isUsingDSP, switching to version catalogs and migrating Gradle files from Groovy DSL to Kotlin DSL, migrating from KAPT to KSP, dependency updates, reverting Google Material Components to 1.11.0, deprecation fixes, using context.getString() shorthand, converting KioskTranslator.java to kotlin, adding AI policy to contribution guidelines and PR template, code quality improvements, updating actions versions in workflows, and Kotlin migration.

chunks.title: v0.28.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.28.2, this hotfix release fixes the 'Content not available' error that prevents YouTube videos from being played, and fixes a few regressions from 0.28.1. Improvements include restoring ability to rewind YouTube livestreams up to 4 hours, disabling video and text tracks when playing livestreams in background player, and allowing reporting ContentNotAvailableException errors if they may be caused by extractor bugs. Fixes address YouTube page reload required error and related breaking API changes, playlist items dragging to only neighbor positions, video title and comments flickering back and forth between current and previous video, 'Start main player in fullscreen' option not working anymore (reverts a previous change), header crash while scrolling in a playlist or just after deleting a video in it, a bug that prevented the display of multiple empty playlists, and 'remove watched' button in playlist removes some unwatched streams too. Development changes include deleting long orphaned file, using 'factory' method for creating db migrations, updating dependencies, Kotlin refactor, deleting unused code, enabling multiple ktlint checks, and adding a workflow to backport PRs to another branch.

chunks.title: v0.28.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.28.3, improvements include YouTube support for more channel URL formats and more video metainfo formats. Fixes address resuming streams at the last playback position. Translation/localization updates translations. This version comes with NewPipe Extractor v0.25.2.

chunks.title: v0.28.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.28.4, new features include adding a warning popup about ongoing Google certification for Android apps. Improvements include shuffling the order outdated subscriptions are updated in the feed, not stacking comment pages, forcefully catching click events uncaught by children in VideoDetailFragment, and adding a link to FAQ entry to 'Sign in to confirm not a bot' exception message. Fixes address comment replies header layout without avatar image, subtitle post-processing error losing original exception, hiding related items in tablet mode after fullscreen exit if showing related items is disabled, hiding controls when resuming playback via double tap, and fixing inconsistency in getQuantity and adding docs. Development changes include upgrading Android Gradle Plugin to 9.0.0, Kotlin conversion, code cleanup, enabling lint checks and resource shrinking (APK size reduced significantly), accommodating extractor changes (EnumSet for service media capabilities), migrating from Picasso to Coil, updating dependencies and Gradle to latest stable releases, and upgrading GitHub Actions to latest versions for Node 24 compatibility.

chunks.title: v0.28.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.28.5, this release includes updates about the Android developer verification program and a call to action. Improvements include adding UI options to import/export subscriptions in backup & restore settings. Fixes address NullPointerException in enqueue actions by using Application Context and YouTube parsing duration of related items. Translation/localization updates translations and removes untranslated locales. Development changes include small improvements to image handling, removing freedroidwarn license, porting path related changes from refactor, and updating dependencies and Gradle to latest stable release. This release is shipped with NewPipe Extractor v0.26.1.

chunks.title: v0.28.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.28.6, this release only adds a popup to inform users that the next version, v0.28.7, will drop support for Android 5.

chunks.title: v0.28.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release v0.28.7, this is a small hotfix update to make YouTube usable again due to changes by YouTube. NewPipe is able to extract items in channel tabs again. Further changes from NewPipe Extractor v0.26.2 include fixing duration and live stream display in related videos on YouTube and fixing comments crash on SoundCloud by handling null page URLs. NewPipe will drop Android 5 support in the next release.

questions.query_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe releases, which release introduces a new card view mode with full width thumbnails and adds long press action on hashtags and web links in descriptions?

answer_support.answer_text: new card view mode with full width thumbnails and long press action on hashtags and web links in descriptions

questions.query_text: Across the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe releases, how does the YouTube-related fix in v0.27.5 differ from the YouTube-related fix in v0.27.6?

options.text: v0.27.5 fixes the 'IOS player response is not valid' error preventing video details from loading, while v0.27.6 additionally fixes HTTP 403 errors during playback and missing 720p streams.
v0.27.5 adds support for poTokens, while v0.27.6 removes poToken support.
Both releases only update the user agent without fixing any YouTube issues.
v0.27.5 fixes age-restricted videos, while v0.27.6 fixes comment extraction.

questions.expected_answer: v0.27.5 fixes the 'IOS player response is not valid' error preventing video details from loading, while v0.27.6 additionally fixes HTTP 403 errors during playback and missing 720p streams.

questions.query_text: In the TeamNewPipe/NewPipe release window, order the following release-content states from earliest to latest: (1) a release that adds support for comment replies and an option to reset settings, (2) a release that adds a monochrome icon and long-click on stream segment to share timestamped URLs, (3) a release that adds support for Android Auto and feed groups as main screen tabs.
