prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent Textualize/textual release stream from v6.6.0 through v8.2.7, covering widget enhancements, performance optimizations, new themes, and breaking changes like the BLANK to NULL rename.

chunks.title: The mark of the Best release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v6.6.0, the project delivers minor updates and fixes, including a style change for the checkbox widget that may affect snapshot tests. Fixes address TextArea cursor display on wrapped lines, remove_children layout refresh, hover pseudo-class flicker, and scrollbar update after textarea paste. Additions include a grid_size property for GridLayout, exposure of NoSelection and BLANK via textual.widgets.select, Widget.FOCUS_ON_CLICK classvar and focus_on_click method, support for the kitty keyboard protocol on Windows, and Widget.mount_compose. The highlight style of Select is changed to only highlight the border, not the label.

chunks.title: The 6.7 - if you know, you know release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v6.7.0, new features include GridLayout.max_column_width, Content.fold, and strip_control_codes in Content constructors. Screen.get_loading_widget is added, deferring to App.get_loading_widget. A fix addresses anchor with ScrollView widgets.

chunks.title: The Fixed faster than superman on laundry day Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v6.7.1, a hotfix resolves an issue with Content.fold introduced in the previous release.

chunks.title: The grown up Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v6.8.0, Content.blank is added. Fixes include Input cursor color display in ANSI mode, alt modifier handling on systems without extended Key Protocol, lowercasing of alpha keys with modifiers, exception when setting loading attribute before mount, and dim filter background issue that may cause snapshot failures.

chunks.title: The arbitrary release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v6.9.0, new themes are added: Solarized Dark and Rosé Pine. A fix corrects the fuzzy matcher displaying wrong matched characters with simple substring match.

chunks.title: The last before Toad release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v6.10.0, broken themes are fixed and toggle button style is updated for consistency, which may impact snapshot tests.

chunks.title: The Batrachian release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v6.11.0, a TextSelected event is added as a small update required for the Toad project.

chunks.title: The Smol Paws release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v6.12.0, a performance issue is fixed where unnecessary style updates when popping screens caused noticeable pauses, especially with many widgets. The private _update_styes is promoted to update_node_styles.

chunks.title: The Atomic Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v7.0.0, a breaking change modifies Node.update_node_styles to include an animate parameter. Two new themes, atom-one-dark and atom-one-light, are added.

chunks.title: The Transition Speed Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v7.0.1, a refresh_styles boolean is added to the ScreenResult message to reduce style updates when popping screens, speeding up transitions.

chunks.title: The One Line Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v7.0.2, superfluous style updates when setting the display attribute are removed.

chunks.title: The Good Night's Sleep Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v7.0.3, a performance issue with large scrollable containers is fixed.

chunks.title: The BLANK Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v7.1.0, a missing refresh issue is fixed, and Widget.BLANK is added to optimize rendering of large widgets, typically scrolling containers.

chunks.title: The Helping Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v7.2.0, the help panel is changed to look at ancestor widgets for a HELP attribute if the focused widget lacks one, and more titles are added to the keys area.

chunks.title: The Super release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v7.3.0, fixes include a triple-click exception on the command palette. Additions include DOM.query_one_optional and a default parameter for get_component_rich_style. Changes include super+c alternative bindings for copy on supported terminals and allowing Sparkline to be any height.

chunks.title: The Pointed Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v7.4.0, a pointer rule is added to TCSS, allowing customization of the mouse pointer appearance over widgets.

chunks.title: The extended cursor release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v7.5.0, the DataTable row cursor extends to full width when excess space exists, and the DataTable emits a selected event on click only if the cell/row/column is currently highlighted.

chunks.title: The BLANK to NULL release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v8.0.0, a breaking change renames Select.BLANK to Select.NULL to avoid a name clash. Additions include a mode argument to push_screen and push_screen_wait, App.mode_change_signal and App.screen_change_signal, Tabs.get_tab, and Catppuccin Frappe and Macchiato themes. Changes include allowing dismiss of non-active screens, a 50ms delay when switching screens, and the BLANK to NULL rename.

chunks.title: The Juicy Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v8.0.1, DirectoryTree runs more operations in a thread to avoid micro-freezes, and garbage collection tweaks reduce GC time.

chunks.title: The Direct Tree Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v8.0.2, themes are ordered alphabetically in the command palette, and issues with Directory Tree are fixed.

chunks.title: The Paused Released
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v8.1.0, circular references in the DOM are replaced with weak references to improve GC times, the original on_complete is called when animating an attribute a second time, and an experimental App.PAUSE_GC_ON_SCROLL_ boolean is added (disabled by default).

chunks.title: The Hotly Completed Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v8.1.1, a hotfix addresses an animation on_complete issue.

chunks.title: The Select Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v8.2.0, text selection is enhanced with auto-scrolling and the ability to select across container widgets. App.ENABLE_SELECT_AUTO_SCROLL, App.SELECT_AUTO_SCROLL_LINES, and App.SELECT_AUTO_SCROLL_SPEED are added to tweak auto-scrolling behavior. This work was sponsored by Mistral AI.

chunks.title: The Hot Select Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v8.2.1, a crash when a selected widget is removed during selection is fixed.

chunks.title: The Faster Resize Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v8.2.2, pointless style updates when resizing are fixed, making Textual apps adapt to terminal size changes more quickly.

chunks.title: The snappier resize Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v8.2.3, resize lag is reduced by moving resize handling from idle to a timer.

chunks.title: The small potatoes Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v8.2.4, DOM.update_classes is added, and a fix addresses anchor release when scrolling down with the trackpad.

chunks.title: The Antsy Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v8.2.5, dedicated ansi themes are added: ansi-dark and ansi-light. An ansi value is added to themes, and App.ansi_color may now be None to use the theme's ansi value. Theming system tweaks may break snapshots without visual changes.

chunks.title: The more selective release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v8.2.6, text selection logic is improved, allowing selection outside of text for less precision. Fixes address selection to the right of code fence blocks and Markdown code fences losing content when switching themes.

chunks.title: The more Kitty Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the Textualize/textual release v8.2.7, additional Kitty key protocol support is added, enabling alt+backspace on Warp and detection of separate modifier keys. A TEXTUAL_DISABLE_KITTY_KEY env var is added. TextArea shortcuts are updated: undo/redo/copy/cut/paste work with cmd+, ctrl+u deletes newline at start, alt+delete deletes word right. Text opacity on ansi themes sets dim if opacity < 50%. Sponsored by Mistral AI.

v6.12.0 reduces GC time, while v7.0.1 fixes a performance issue with large scrollable containers.
v6.12.0 speeds up transitions by adding a 50ms delay, while v7.0.1 replaces circular references with weak references.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent TryGhost/Ghost release stream from v6.19.4 through v6.43.1, covering bug fixes, new features like retention offers, gift subscriptions, pinned and threaded comments, and various admin and theme improvements.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the TryGhost/Ghost release 6.19.4, the release note includes fixes for file upload content type passthrough to storage adapter, missing permission checks in paginated query hooks, last_seen being modifiable via User API, and an invisible comments filter dropdown in Safari. It also adds new Turkish translations for Comments, Ghost, and Portal, and optimizes the comment count subquery to avoid a full table scan.
In the TryGhost/Ghost release 6.20.0, the release note adds Feedbin to the list of supported Inbox Links providers and fixes a sign-out redirecting to the wrong URL on subdirectory sites.
In the TryGhost/Ghost release 6.20.1, the release note states that this release contains fixes for minor bugs and issues reported by Ghost users.

In the TryGhost/Ghost release 6.21.0, the release note expands available cards in the welcome email editor, fixes double-prefixed asset URLs when using CDN, fixes the contributor user menu Posts link navigating to the wrong route, fixes the contributor posts list not being scrollable, fixes missing server-side label search in recipient and segment selects, and fixes #-prefixed member label select ordering when scrolling.

In the TryGhost/Ghost release 6.21.2, the release note updates Source to v1.5.1 and Casper to v5.10.0, fixes missing feature images for published posts in the Contributor posts list, refreshes the cancel button state after the retention offer flow, and fixes a broken settings view when logged in as Editor.

In the TryGhost/Ghost release 6.22.0, the release note adds retention offers, adds separate Server and Admin build versions to the About dialog, fixes N+1 queries and broken reply limit in the comments API, fixes bookmark filtering in the Welcome Emails editor, and fixes a race condition in the reply-to-reply comment form.

In the TryGhost/Ghost release 6.22.1, the release note adds file type validation and content-type control for file uploads, updates Source to v1.5.2 and Casper to v5.10.1, updates private page access and signup flow, changes email verification error messages to be configurable via hostSettings, fixes font rendering when converting SVGs with text elements to PNG format, fixes a 'labels is not defined' error when creating comped members via API, fixes translations for Inbox Links button, fixes domain warming when warming has completed, adds missed string wrapping for Portal's offer page, and adds new Chinese language strings.

In the TryGhost/Ghost release 6.23.0, the release note releases the Transistor.fm integration, mitigates comments being blocked by fingerprint content blockers, fixes @site.admin_url missing /ghost/ when admin URL is configured, and fixes attribution on links in email-only posts.
In the TryGhost/Ghost release 6.24.0, the release note states that this release contains fixes for minor bugs and issues reported by Ghost users.

In the Unitech/pm2 release 4.5.6, the release notes include bumping all submodules versions and suppressing all "security" warnings.

In the Unitech/pm2 release 5.0.3, the release notes include fixes for system monitoring.

In the Unitech/pm2 release 5.1.2, the release notes include cron-restart improvements.

In the Unitech/pm2 release 5.2.0, the release notes include replacing node-cron by croner, upgrading mocha deps, fixing pm2 report when daemon not running, removing semver check for legacy Node.js versions, updating node version in setup.deb.sh, replacing legacy util._extend by Object.assign, adding missing start options types, recursive detection of package.json, making tarball module uninstall cross-platform, fixing unnecessary ENOENT console.error when serving a spa, using env variable instead of hardcoded datetime format, copyright update, removing constants import from VersionCheck, and reducing async import.

In the Unitech/pm2 release 5.3.0, the release notes include fixing a non-working condition that blocks flush from clearing the logs (#5533) and fixing ESM script loader (#5524).

In the Unitech/pm2 release v5.3.1, the release notes include fixing terminal width when condensed, auto running tsx/ts files with bun binary instead of ts-node, switching from Travis CI to Github Actions, fixing reserved keyword for ES6 Strict Mode when bundling, updating badges, auto switching light and dark mode logos, fixing deploy ecosystem filename extension / esm module default ecosystem config name, fixing matching logic for logs from namespace when lines = 0, and fixing vulnerabilities in axios module.
In the Unitech/pm2 release v5.4.0, the release notes include dropping old uuid sub dependency, adding autostart true||false feature (#5782), and updating modules.

chunks.title: Pattern Visualizers, better data processor
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.27.0, the project introduces pattern visualizers for graphically visualizing patterns and binary data, including line_plot, scatter_plot, image, bitmap, disassembler, 3d, and sound visualizers. It adds support for custom nodes in the data processor, multiple Yara rules execution, OTF font selection, a Division by Invariant Multiplication calculator tool, and new builds for Fedora Rawhide, RHEL, and AlmaLinux. The pattern language gains local variables inside structs, const variables, and the ability to query provider information.

chunks.title: Text Editor improvements, bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.27.1, the focus is on text editor improvements and bug fixes. It improves word selecting in the text editor and adds CTRL+Backspace/Delete shortcuts to delete full words. Bug fixes address build issues on some Linux platforms, a safety backup restore popup getting hidden, and pattern language issues such as attributes not being applied correctly to bitfield fields and crashes when returning invalid values from format/transform functions.

chunks.title: `match` statements, `bitfield` improvements, custom themes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.28.0, the project adds match statements and bitfield improvements to the pattern language, along with support for custom themes that can be downloaded from the Content Store or created manually. The diffing view is completely rewritten, and new plugins for Malcore and Hashes are introduced. Other additions include a binary hex cell visualizer, a byte swapper tool, new CRC hash types, and a Fedora 38 build. The release also fixes a bug where ImHex would jump back up in the hex view when making a selection.

chunks.title: Custom layouts, Spanish translation, try-catch statements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.29.0, the project adds support for saving and loading custom layouts, a Spanish translation, and a network control interface that allows external tools to send commands over a TCP socket. The pattern language introduces try-catch statements and std::math::exp(). Other additions include a Documentation helper AI window, non-ranged and aligned value search, and bit/byte reversal nodes in the data processor. Improvements include better file handle management and faster pattern highlighting.

chunks.title: Pattern language debugger, [[export]]ing local patterns, pattern data view improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.30.0, the project adds a pattern language debugger for setting breakpoints and inspecting variables, and an option to export generated pattern data as JSON, YAML, or HTML. It introduces a replace feature in the find view, a filter option and favorite marking in the pattern data view, and a provider tab right-click menu. The pattern language gains #pragma magic for automatic pattern loading, a hex_viewer visualizer, and the [[export]] attribute to display local variables. The offset column in the pattern data view is split into Start and End columns.

chunks.title: Font loading and favorite pattern fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.30.1, the release provides font loading and favorite pattern fixes. It fixes an issue that caused the unifont font to not load correctly, affecting mainly Asian languages, a rendering issue with the entropy and byte type graph, and performance problems with hex editor hovering tooltips on large arrays and favorites loading in large patterns. The Accept Pattern popup can now be closed using Escape.

chunks.title: Command Line Interface, .NET scripts, Achievements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.31.0, the project adds a command line interface, initial support for .NET scripts for cross-platform automation, and an achievements system to help users learn ImHex. It introduces a new splash screen, support for hashing arbitrary strings, a built-in logging console, and the ability to switch hex editor data visualizers to big-endian mode. The release upgrades to Capstone V5, adds a 'Update All' button to the content store, and uses the GTK filepicker on Linux when possible.

chunks.title: Web and M1 version, Workspaces, Tutorials, Auto backups and more
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.32.0, the project announces web and native Apple M1 builds, an auto updater, a shortcut manager, Markdown reports, and a greatly improved undo/redo system. It adds workspaces for multiple layouts, a minimal layout, automatic backups, an interactive tutorial, and merges the ExtraHashes plugin for about 20 new hashes. The process memory provider now works on Linux, and a full Base64 provider replaces the previous import option. Other additions include custom highlighting rules, a TCP Client/Server tester tool, a function graphing calculator tool, and a euclidean algorithms tool.

chunks.title: [Packaging fixes] Web and M1 version, Workspaces, Tutorials, Auto backups and more
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.32.1, the release provides packaging fixes for the web and M1 version, workspaces, tutorials, and auto backups. It fixes the Ubuntu package referring to an invalid libarchive package, includes missing libarchive and libcapstone DLLs in Windows packages, properly initializes library plugins on macOS, and resolves a crash when opening the diffing view.

chunks.title: Working M1 build, working custom plugins
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.32.2, the project delivers a working M1 build and a completely overhauled external plugin system with an SDK and template. It adds a very simple HTTP tool as a stripped-down Postman/curl frontend, and allows num keys to be used as arrow, home, end, page up, and down keys when numlock is off. Improvements include a prettier progress bar animation, removal of the window name from the title bar on macOS, and enabling antialiasing by default on custom fonts.

chunks.title: Better data analysis, Myers diffing algorithm and UI improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.33.0, the project adds Myers' diffing algorithm to the diff view, customizable toolbar icons, and a much improved out-of-the-box experience. It introduces many new hash algorithms, greatly improves the data information view with switchable sections and built-in Yara rules, and enhances the pattern editor with find and replace. A mini map is added to the hex editor, along with a font picker, parent pattern region highlighting, and support for virtual file systems. ImHex now uses atomic file I/O instead of memory mapping.

chunks.title: Drastically lower CPU usage, better error recovery, fixed import statements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.33.1, the project drastically lowers CPU usage by improving the frame rendering algorithm, especially on Linux. It improves error recovery from exceptions in the main thread and fixes bugs such as project files being opened as regular files, Yara rules not being read correctly, and crashes when calculating CRCs. The pattern language fixes template types imported using import statements and a crash due to infinite recursion in the validator.

chunks.title: Low power mode fix, better unicode font handling, fixes for Arch Linux
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.33.2, the project fixes low power mode on Linux, improves unicode font handling by loading Unifont characters at native size, and addresses issues for Arch Linux such as linking to libyara. It fixes the auto updater on Windows, view providers not being saved to project files, and various pattern language issues with the virtual file system and data decompression functions.

chunks.title: Hex Editor Insert Mode, File update tracker and new logo
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.34.0, the project adds a simple insert mode to the hex editor, loads small files into memory with external change detection, and introduces a new logo on the welcome screen. It adds Hungarian and updated Simplified Chinese translations, a table pattern visualizer, and short forms for CLI commands. Improvements include DWM immersive dark mode on Windows, less window flickering during resizes, and faster right-click menus. Bug fixes address custom font loading from unicode paths, workspace deletion, and visual glitches with highlights.

chunks.title: Rendering speed optimizations, bitfield improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.35.0, the project drastically improves rendering times, making ImHex extremely smooth. It adds basic process memory provider support to macOS (with SIP disabled), options to load files into memory or read from disk, and export of find results as CSV, TSV, and JSON. A digital signal pattern visualizer is added, and the pattern data view uses nicer colors. The pattern language introduces continue/break, std::core::execute_function(), array initialization syntax, and support for constants inside custom types. Bitfields can now be properly edited in the pattern data view.

chunks.title: Hotfix for "Rendering speed optimizations, bitfield improvements"
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.35.1, this is a hotfix for the rendering speed optimizations and bitfield improvements release, addressing an issue where default folders weren't created correctly.

chunks.title: Hotfix hotfix for "Rendering speed optimizations, bitfield improvements"
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.35.2, this is a second hotfix for the rendering speed optimizations and bitfield improvements release, fixing that default folders still weren't created correctly on Linux and macOS, and that standard magic files weren't bundled properly.

chunks.title: Hotfix hotfix hotfix for "Rendering speed optimizations, bitfield improvements"
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.35.3, this is a third hotfix for the rendering speed optimizations and bitfield improvements release, addressing that default folders even still weren't created correctly on Linux and macOS, standard magic files weren't bundled properly, and a crash on exit.

chunks.title: Eradicate window flickering, improve pattern highlighting performance, crash fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.35.4, the project eradicates window flickering during resizes on Windows and the Web, drastically improves pattern hover highlighting performance, and makes the web version usable on mobile with touch inputs. It fixes a crash when an auto backup was created on macOS, liblzma configuration, and a rare crash when re-evaluating patterns with sorting. The pattern language adds built-in crc8, crc16, and crc64 hash functions, and makes std::mem::find_sequence hundreds of times faster.

chunks.title: We're back!
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.36.0, the project returns with massive improvements to the pattern editor, a loop node in the data processor, and support for enumerating system fonts on Linux. It adds a quarter precision option to the IEEE 754 tool, customizable segment separators in the hex editor, annotations for entropy dips/spikes, and an export option for the disassembler. The pattern language introduces new built-in types like hex::type::Json and hex::type::Instruction, the ability to import existing patterns, lz4 decompression, reinterpret-expressions, and user-defined literals.

chunks.title: Shortcut fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.36.1, the release provides shortcut fixes, resolving various issues with shortcuts not working and forcing a one-time reset of customized shortcuts. It fixes an issue where the CTRL key could get stuck on keyboard layouts mapping ALT GR to CTRL+ALT, and addresses problems with interactive tutorial highlighting, saving files from the web version, and a crash when disassembling bytes.

chunks.title: Startup fix
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.36.2, this release is identical to v1.36.1 except that it fixes a crash on startup when ImHex is launched for the first time.

chunks.title: Massive UX improvements, Custom Disassemblers, MSVC support
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.37.0, the project delivers massive UX improvements including proper HiDPI scaling on all platforms, native menu bar on macOS, and separate font settings for UI, hex editor, and pattern editor. It adds initial support for custom disassemblers via JSON, messaging support for macOS and Linux to control the current instance, a Russian translation, and OpenGL post-processing shaders. The release can now be fully compiled with MSVC and ClangCL, and introduces new CLI subcommands, UTF-16/32 string types, and a title bar backdrop gradient.

chunks.title: Bug fixes for Massive UX improvements, Custom Disassemblers, MSVC support
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.37.1, the release provides bug fixes for the massive UX improvements and custom disassemblers release, addressing large memory allocations when printing error messages, a pattern editor shift when clicking evaluate, a crash when a custom disassembler returns no bytes, and incorrect native scaling on Wayland. It also fixes moving the window between different DPI screens on Windows and a crash when loading a project with a saved process memory provider.

chunks.title: Bug fixes for Massive UX improvements, Custom Disassemblers, MSVC support Latest
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.37.2, the release provides further bug fixes, including the imhex CLI no longer hanging before returning output, improved frame limit handling, correct Windows title bar icon size, a potential fix for a core dump when talking to dbus on Linux, and fixes for crashes when switching fonts, a startup crash on Windows 7, and a broken Plugin API link.

chunks.title: Bug fixes for Massive UX improvements, Custom Disassemblers, MSVC support Latest
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.37.3, the release fixes a crash when closing ImHex, mainly noticeable on macOS, and an ID collision when multiple fonts with the same name are installed on the system.

chunks.title: Bug fixes for Massive UX improvements, Custom Disassemblers, MSVC support
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.37.4, the release fixes a regression with the frame rate limiting logic that caused high CPU usage on idle, a rendering issue on macOS when the native menu bar is used, and a few issues with OpenGL texture deallocations.

chunks.title: Nightly Builds
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex nightly build, the changelog includes a build fix for no-gpu failures, pattern language updates, and a fix for issue 2745.

chunks.title: Better Pattern Editor, new Data Sources, Save Editor Mode
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.38.0, the project adds multiple new data sources including a UDP provider and an SSH provider for remote file access and live RAM inspection. It introduces a save editor mode and simplified pattern editor using [[hex::editor_export]], semantic syntax highlighting in the pattern editor, and new translations (French, Polish, Ukrainian). Other additions include new data inspector rows (Custom Encoding String, fp24, bfloat, fixed-point), a Markdown renderer, a file information CLI option, and a 'Decode as Encoding' right-click option.

chunks.title: Windows installer, data inspector edit and updater fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the WerWolv/ImHex release v1.38.1, the release provides a signed Windows installer, less blurry icons on low-resolution screens, and better error messages when opening a data source fails. It fixes the Windows installer not correctly replacing all files, dependencies of deb packages, the Extended ASCII display being active by default, and various issues with the updater, pattern editor, data inspector editing, and crashes when opening remote SSH files or drag-dropping files repeatedly.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aaif-goose/goose release v1.16.1, a patch release addresses a critical issue affecting Linux users where the goosed server would crash due to libssl errors. The fix updates dependencies and improves tunnel handling to ensure stable operation on Linux systems.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent agno-agi/agno release stream from v2.4.8 through v2.6.10, covering new features like Team execution modes, HITL, approvals, scheduler, context providers, and multiple model integrations, along with numerous improvements and bug fixes.

chunks.title: v2.4.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the agno-agi/agno release v2.4.8, new features include CEL support for workflow steps, a Neosantara model provider, and a Studio visual editor. Improvements cover Workflow Router Step enhancements, WebsiteReader chunking changes, and Skills shebang parsing. Bug fixes address LanceDB backward compatibility, Parallel step positional argument, AzureOpenAI authentication, Agentic State Tool session_state extraction, and LearningMachine user message addition.

Improvements include an Agent/Team refactor. Bug fixes cover LanceDB Cloud search, and primary key constraints. Breaking changes: store_history_messages defaults to False, and Knowledge uniqueness is required.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent airbnb/lottie-android release stream from early Compose support through the 6.x series, highlighting new features like blend modes, 3D animation support, and numerous bug fixes.

chunks.title: Compose 1.0.0-rc02-1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the airbnb/lottie-android release Compose 1.0.0-rc02-1, the project upgrades to Compose rc02 and adds support for ContentScale and Alignment similar to the Image composable, automatic font loading with dynamic property support, LottieCancellationBehavior support in animateLottieCompositionAsState, custom cache keys and cache skipping, and ensures LottieClipSpec is always respected.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 4.0.0, the first stable release of Lottie Compose is announced, and versions between the Android and Compose libraries are synchronized.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 4.1.0, support for gaussian blur effects and drop shadow effects is added. This release notes that drop shadows and blurs were previously ignored and will now be rendered, with implementation details available in the documentation.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 4.2.0, some rounding errors with trim paths are fixed.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 4.2.1, the project upgrades to Compose 1.0.3, adds an overload to TextDelegate that provides layerName, removes extra Integer allocations with dynamic colors, and fixes two rare potential NPEs.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 5.0.1, the setScale(float) APIs are removed from LottieAnimationView and LottieDrawable, support for the Rounded Corners effect on Shape and Rect layers is added, and the rendering mode handling is overhauled to reduce memory consumption and allow LottieDrawable consumers to set a RenderMode. Additionally, animation control logic is moved into LottieDrawable via setVisible, resolving a long-standing RecyclerView bug.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 5.0.2, a crash when using software rendering before a composition has been set is prevented.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 5.0.3, the software rendering bitmap is invalidated when invalidate is called.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 5.1.1, support for gradient opacity stops at different points than color stops is added, LottieDrawable can be notified when system animations are disabled, rounding errors when setting min/max frames are removed, onVisibleAction is cleared once consumed, a Xiaomi Android 10 specific crash is fixed, LottieAnimationView.start() is made to mimic playAnimation, and the @RestrictTo annotation is removed from LottieNetworkFetcher.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 5.2.0, a Compose breaking change is introduced where LottieAnimation now takes progress as a () -> Float instead of a Float to avoid recomposition on every progress update. Gradient stops are de-duplicated to fix artifacts on pre-Oreo devices when using hardware acceleration.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.0.0, a major overhaul of text layout is performed for better consistency. New features include allowing animations in zip files to contain embedded base64 encoded images, allowing zip files to contain embedded fonts, adding fontStyle and fontName parameters in FontAssetDelegate, allowing decimal values for precomp size, interpolating between gradients with different numbers of opacity stops, supporting box position in document data, allowing repeater contents as targets of dynamic properties, providing a global LottieTask listener for Espresso idle resources, allowing a default font extension, an option to disable Lottie's network cache, a font map for custom fonts, ImageAssetDelegate usage without a drawable callback, making Layer name and refId public, and rendering at the composition frame rate. Bugs fixed include NPEs for invalid bitmaps, transform opacity, and transform anchor position, storing only application context in ImageAssetManager, preventing rounded corner effects on shapes with control points, passing LottieComposition directly to avoid race conditions, restoring progress from saved state, accounting for top and left Drawable bounds, and using the correct cache key for network animations. Compose additions include reverseOnRepeat, font map support, and image rendering.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.0.1, loading URLs with a length greater than 255 characters is allowed.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.1.0, a new multithreaded asyncUpdates feature moves the entire update phase off the main thread. LottieCompositionFactory can be configured to not close input streams, and Lottie can be initialized multiple times. Bugs fixed include closing input streams for cache hits, always using ApplicationContext in ImageAssetManager, holding weak references to listeners, adding default values for line join and cap types, and applying layer parent opacity to text. Compose changes include keying dynamic properties on composition and adding @JvmOverloads to LottieAnimation.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.2.0, screen, overlay, darken, lighten, and add blend modes are implemented, auto-orient is implemented, asyncUpdates can be globally configured, an optional close param is added to LottieCompositionFactory.fromJsonReader, dynamic properties for solid layer colors are allowed, baseline profiles are updated, and a ZipInputStream overload is added to LottieAnimationView.setAnimation. Bugs fixed include upgrading okio, improving cache hits for synchronous methods, fixing gradient interpolation for opacity stops beyond the last color stop, a potential NPE in NetworkCache.clearCache, an IllegalArgumentException when creating a bitmap, rounded corners for non-closed paths, varying opacity stops across keyframes in the same gradient, and a NullPointerException in ColorKeyframeAnimation.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.3.0, Compose additions include LottiePainter and rememberLottiePainter for using Lottie anywhere a Painter can be used, and constraining unconstrained bounds when the other dimension is constrained. Support for dynamic path properties on shape contents, gzipped and tgs files, and an option to clip text if it extends beyond its bounding box are added. Bugs fixed include making all LottieAnimationView setters idempotent, a rendering artifact for polygons with large strokes, re-scaling bitmaps if the system scale changes, handling null color callbacks in solid layer, null shape data end values, and gradient colors when progress is <0 or >1.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.4.0, support for reduced motion marker names is added, GZIP and TGS network downloads are supported, easings are allowed to go <0 and >1, a memory leak in LottieTask is fixed, play is prevented from working after a non-Lottie drawable was set and then returned back, autoPlay is respected in LottieAnimationView when setting a new composition, LottieTask is called synchronously when already on the main thread, and bitmaps are properly rescaled when the system scale changes. Compose additions include safe mode and clarified clipToCompositionBounds docs.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.5.0, blend modes are applied to layers and Multiply is added, initial support for text range selectors is added, a new feature flag API allows opting into newer platform features, and an API to get the unscaled width/height of a composition is added. Bugs fixed include improving the accuracy of drop shadow position and softness, and treating appcompat as an API dependency.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.5.1, bugs fixed include a value callback not called for PathKeyframeAnimation, shadow softness accuracy, a global configuration to control reduced motion settings for a11y, an NPE on ImageAssetManager#getContext, improved strokes with skew, an NPE when animation contains a Font Family and Context is null, factory methods that take an okio Source, and closing FileOutputStream in fromZipStreamSyncInternal.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.5.2, bugs fixed include an NPE when running Lottie in instrumentation tests, and support for new reduced motion options in Compose is added.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.6.0, drop shadow support is overhauled for better correctness, a new API applyShadowsToLayers applies shadows to a whole layer, RenderNodes are used on supported APIs, and an overload to LottieCompositionFactory.clearCache clears the network cache. Bugs fixed include rounded corners when the underlying shape doesn't animate, animation update listener order, unifying parsing for all file types including dotLottie as ZIP files, keypath resolving for matte layers, and applying translate before scale in LottieDrawable.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.6.1, an NPE on a Bitmap reference in Utils.resizeBitmapIfNeeded is fixed, and floating point errors calculating keyframe end progress are fixed.

In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.6.2, width/height are parsed as double, line height is re-measured when justifying dynamic text, parent layer alpha is only applied to mattes, binary compatibility with 6.5 and lower on LottieAnimation is maintained, and clip specs are better handled when minProgress equals maxProgress.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.6.3, a system property to set a testing executor is supported, a radial gradient crash is fixed, and a bitmap crash is fixed.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.6.4, an image NPE is fixed.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.6.6, a guard against Bitmap allocations of size 0 is added.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.6.7, a crash when drawing shadow on image using RenderNode is fixed.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.6.9, transparent background rendering with MULTIPLY Blend mode on Android 34+ is fixed.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.6.10, lottieComposition is made public, and RTL support is added.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.7.0, initial support for 3D animations is added.
In the airbnb/lottie-android release 6.7.1, a safeguard against very large Bitmap creation is added.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release evolution of ajeetdsouza/zoxide, a smarter cd command, from v0.4.0 through v0.9.9, highlighting new shell supports, feature additions, and bug fixes.

chunks.title: v0.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.4.0, the project added interactive mode for removing entries (zoxide remove -i), aliases for interactive query and remove (zqi and zri), and PWD hooks for POSIX shells. Changes include zoxide remove now throwing an error if no match, interactive mode no longer erroring on graceful fzf exit, canonicalizing to regular paths on Windows, zoxide init using PWD hooks by default, $_ZO_ECHO only working when set to 1, --z-cmd flag renamed to --cmd, and --no-define-aliases renamed to --no-aliases. A fix prevents fish from cd-ing to home when no match is found.

chunks.title: v0.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.4.1, support for PowerShell was added. Backward compatibility with v0.2.x databases was removed, and support for paths with invalid UTF-8 was removed.

chunks.title: v0.4.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.4.2, $_ZO_FZF_OPTS was added to specify custom fzf options, zoxide query --list to list all matches, and zoxide query --score to show score with result. The default $_ZO_MAXAGE was increased to 10000, and symlinks are treated as separate directories by default (changeable with _ZO_RESOLVE_SYMLINKS=1). Help menus for z and zri were removed, and zoxide remove -i was replaced with zri.

chunks.title: v0.4.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.4.3, a bug in the Fish init script was fixed.

chunks.title: v0.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.5.0, inaccessible directories are no longer removed, allowing zoxide to remember paths on removable devices. $_ZO_EXCLUDE_DIRS now supports globs. zoxide init defines __zoxide_z* functions for aliasing. Support for the xonsh shell was added. zoxide import can now import from Autojump. zoxide init --no-aliases no longer generates z or zi. Conflicting alias definitions in bash/fish/zsh/POSIX shells are clobbered. Deprecated PWD hooks for POSIX shells were removed.

chunks.title: v0.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.6.0, support for Nushell and Elvish was added. The z command now excludes the current directory from search results. Fixes include removing backtraces on Rust nightly, avoiding aliased builtins in generated shell code, handling broken pipe errors gracefully, fixing NUL file appearing on Windows, accidental redefinition of hooks when initialized twice, and zoxide unable to find itself on Xonsh. Aliases za, zq, zqi, zr, zri were removed.

chunks.title: v0.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.7.0, manpages for all subcommands and a default prompt for Nushell were added. zoxide remove -i now accepts multiple selections, zoxide add no longer accepts zero parameters, $_ZO_EXCLUDE_DIRS defaults to "$HOME", and binary releases use .zip on Windows and .tar.gz otherwise. Fixes include cd - on fish, __zoxide_hook no longer changing $? within $PROMPT_COMMAND on bash. The GitHub install script and release binaries built with glibc were removed.

chunks.title: v0.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.7.1, auto-generated shell completions, zoxide query --all for listing deleted directories, lazy deletion for removed directories not accessed in > 90 days, and Nushell support for 0.32.0+ were added. Fixes include Nushell avoiding __zoxide_hook on non-filesystem subshells, Fish alias cd=z working after zoxide init, PowerShell avoiding __zoxide_hook on non-filesystem providers, and Fish avoiding __zoxide_hook in private mode.

chunks.title: v0.7.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.7.2, a fix was made for zoxide -V not printing the version.

chunks.title: v0.7.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.7.3, zoxide add and zoxide remove now accept multiple arguments. Fixes include Nushell errors on 0.33.0, PowerShell errors in StrictMode, Bash/POSIX removing conflicting alias definitions, Bash removing extra semicolon in $PROMPT_COMMAND, and Xonsh using shell environment instead of os.environ.

chunks.title: v0.7.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.7.4, a compile error with clap v3.0.0-beta.4 was fixed.

chunks.title: v0.7.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.7.5, completions for the z command were added for Bash and Elvish. Nushell minimum supported version was upgraded to v0.36.0 with easier installation instructions. Fixes include Elvish unable to z into directories by path, Elvish not showing traceback on z or zi failure, and Elvish nested shells not initializing correctly.

chunks.title: v0.7.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.7.6, Nushell minimum supported version was upgraded to v0.37.0. Fixes include Xonsh error messages in zi and Xonsh configuration environment variables not being handled correctly.

chunks.title: v0.7.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.7.7, a fix was made for PowerShell hook not initializing correctly.

chunks.title: v0.7.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.7.8, auto-generated completions for Fig were added. A compile error with clap v3.0.0-beta.5 was fixed.

chunks.title: v0.7.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.7.9, improved completions for the z command were made for Bash and Fish. Fixes include Fish error erasing completions on older versions and PowerShell enabling --cmd cd to replace the cd command.

chunks.title: v0.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.8.0, Zsh completions for the z command were added. Changes include better default fzf options, Fish interactive completions only triggered when last argument is empty, and updated PowerShell installation instructions. Fixes include PowerShell using global scope for aliases, Zsh errors with set -eu, fzf handling early selection, PowerShell handling escape characters in paths, parse error on Cygwin/MSYS due to CRLF, fzf handling spaces in preview window, Bash avoiding initializing completions on older versions, and fzf avoiding launching binary from current directory on Windows.

chunks.title: v0.8.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.8.1, manpages were moved to man/man1/*.1, --no-aliases was replaced with --no-cmd, Elvish minimum supported version was upgraded to v0.18.0, and Nushell minimum supported version was upgraded to v0.61.0. Fixes include renaming _z completion function in Bash/Zsh to avoid conflicts, adding --keep-right option by default for fzf with minimum version v0.21.0, enabling Bash completions only on 4.4+, bypassing ls alias in fzf preview window, retaining ownership of database file, and preventing zoxide query --interactive from conflicting with --score.

chunks.title: v0.8.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.8.2, fzf preview window was changed to show below results. Fixes include paths on Cygwin for Bash/Fish/POSIX/Zsh, Fish completions not working on certain systems, and Bash completions not escaping spaces correctly.

chunks.title: v0.8.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.8.3, Nushell support for z - and PWD hooks was added. Fish fuzzy completion prefix was changed to z!, Zsh allowed z to navigate dirstack via +n and -n, and fzf preview window was improved. A fix was made for Bash double forward slash in completions.

In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.9.0, an edit subcommand was added to adjust entry scores. Fixes include Zsh completions clashing with zsh-autocomplete, fzf 'invalid option' on macOS, PowerShell handling UTF-8 encoding, Zsh not hiding output from chpwd hooks, Nushell minimum supported version upgraded to v0.73.0, Zsh extra space in interactive completions when no match, various fzf improvements, and Nushell accidental redefinition of hooks when initialized twice. The remove -i subcommand was removed in favor of edit.

In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.9.1, Fish/Zsh aliases on __zoxide_z now use completions, Nushell support for v0.78.0 was added, Fish plugin works on older versions, PowerShell warns when version is too old for z - and z +, and PowerShell supports PWD hooks on all versions. Fixes include Fish not providing cd completions with space in path, Bash/Fish/Zsh providing z completions when last argument starts with z!, and Bash/Fish/Zsh attempting to cd when last argument is z!.
In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.9.2, a short option -a was added for zoxide query --all. A fix was made for PowerShell using global scope for variables/functions.
In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.9.3, Nushell support for v0.89.0 was added.
In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.9.4, Zsh Space-Tab completions were improved.

In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.9.5, additions include improved cd completions for Zsh, lazy deletion of excluded directories from the database, Fish infinite loop detection when using alias cd=z, installer flags --bin-dir, --man-dir, --arch, --sudo, Nushell support for v0.94.0+, bash/fish/zsh support for z -- dir style queries, Fish improved Space-Tab completions, and Korn shell (ksh) support. Changes include fzf removing --select-1 from default options and enforcing $_ZO_DATA_DIR as an absolute path. Fixes include Zsh Space-Tab completion repeating output, fish/Nushell/PowerShell handling queries that look like args, elvish z - working, fish generated code avoiding aliased builtins, fish cd command copied from $__fish_data_dir/functions/cd.fish, symlinks not added when $_ZO_RESOLVE_SYMLINKS=0, and symlinked database files not being replaced.
In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.9.6, fixes include Fish builtin abbr not working on older versions and Zsh making __zoxide_z_complete available with --no-cmd.

In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.9.7, Nushell support for 0.102.0 was added, and a doctor command was added for Bash/Zsh to diagnose common issues. A fix was made for ksh aliasing to regular POSIX implementation for better compatibility.

In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.9.8, support for Tcsh was added, --score flag was added to zoxide add, POSIX doctor was added, and Nushell CLI completions were added. Changes include Bash automatically cd-ing when selecting Space-Tab completions. Fixes include Bash doctor handling PROMPT_COMMAND array and VS Code shell integration, Bash completions working with ble.sh, Nushell not ignoring symlinks when cd-ing, fzf minimum version updated to v0.51.0, PowerShell avoiding setting $error when defining __zoxide_hooked, PowerShell handling special characters in file paths, and database corruption when filesystem is 100% full.

In the ajeetdsouza/zoxide release v0.9.9, support for Android ARMv7 and Fish v4.1.0+ was added. Fixes include Nushell using sigil operator for external commands, Zsh supporting multiple digits in z +N and z -N dirstack commands, Bash avoiding downcasting $PROMPT_COMMAND array and overwriting $PIPESTATUS, POSIX removing non-POSIX calls to builtin, and Fish clearing existing completions when defining z command.

chunks.title: Alacritty Version 0.12.0 Release Candidate 3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the alacritty/alacritty release v0.12.0-rc3, the release notes fix a memory leak on macOS and an issue where pasting from Alacritty would freeze the target application.

chunks.title: Alacritty Version 0.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the alacritty/alacritty release v0.12.0, the release notes add uppercase -T short form for --title, support for horizontal scrolling in mouse mode and alternative scrolling modes, support for fractional scaling on Wayland with wp-fractional-scale protocol, support for running on GLES context, touchscreen input for click/scroll/select/zoom, and a window.resize_increments config option disabled by default. Changes include always using sRGB color space on macOS, erasing in line after the last column no longer clearing the last column, opening new windows by default with macOS Cmd+N binding, properly issuing the hint about window transparency on Wayland and macOS, window.decorations_theme_variant now controlling theme on macOS and Windows, IME purpose set to Terminal, window.decorations_theme_variant using Dark, Light, and None values, and resize increments set on macOS and X11 to resize by cell sizes. Fixes address --help output for --class not matching man pages, cursor and underlines always being black on very old hardware, crash when using very low negative font.offset, startup failure on macOS with default config when system /bin/sh is dash, artifacts in corners for maximized window with CSD on Wayland, dotted underline not shown on macOS, underline on macOS always being at the bottom of the cell, crash with OT-SVG fonts on Linux/BSD, crash during text compose on old GNOME under Wayland, mouse cursor staying hidden after window regains focus on macOS Ventura, blurry fonts when changing padding size at runtime, crash while typing on Wayland, multi-line semantic bracket selection, reduced GPU memory usage, low frame rate when multiple windows render at the same time, redraw hanging until a keypress on X11 in rare cases, window clipping when maximizing a window without decorations on Windows, quadrants not aligned with half blocks with built-in font, EOT (\x03) escaping bracketed paste mode, drag & drop not working for the search bar, and simple-fullscreened window not resized when moving between monitors on macOS. Removals include window.gtk_theme_variant config field (use window.decorations_theme_variant instead) and alt_send_esc now always set to true.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent alibaba/arthas release stream from version 3.6.1 through 4.2.0, covering new commands, dependency upgrades, bug fixes, and architectural changes such as the introduction of MCP support and profiler enhancements.
