prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent anomalyco/opencode release stream from v1.14.34 through v1.15.13, covering core improvements, bugfixes, TUI enhancements, desktop updates, and community contributions.

chunks.title: v1.14.34
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.34, the core improvements include adding PTY connection tickets for more reliable authenticated terminal websockets, adding v2 session failure events for client detection of failed runs, and improving shell command handling for Bash, PowerShell, and cmd sessions. Core bugfixes address returning structured error bodies from the effect HTTP server, reloading server auth environment variables correctly for each new HTTP listener, preventing worktree creation from hanging during bootstrap commands, fixing Azure Anthropic model resolution when using the Anthropic SDK, fixing the web UI proxy so public manifest assets load and proxied responses do not break on transfer-encoding, allowing Codex Spark models when signing in with Codex OAuth, fixing embedded UI serving from the standalone server build, fixing PTY websocket connections from Desktop when using the HttpApi server, respecting custom basic auth usernames in opencode clients, prompting browsers for basic auth on protected server logins, showing real server error messages in the CLI and SDK instead of bare {}, preventing large diffs from using unbounded memory, fixing v2 session API responses to encode optional fields correctly, and fixing pagination Link headers to use the real request host. TUI improvements add debug info to print environment and diagnostic details. TUI bugfixes add a --username option for basic-auth server connections, pass server auth through internal ACP connections, and show provider login errors from stderr instead of swallowing them. Desktop bugfixes prevent terminal reconnect loops after recovery failures and preserve auth-token credentials when reopening the app. The release thanks 4 community contributors.

chunks.title: v1.14.35
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.35, the core bugfix preserves diff patch boundaries so session diffs keep rendering correctly when file contents include diff --git text.

chunks.title: v1.14.37
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.37, core bugfixes ensure canceling a task also cancels child subtask sessions. Core improvements include improved v2 session rendering with cleaner tool states, better compaction summaries, and more accurate timing, and the ability to warp a session into another workspace or back to the local project. Desktop bugfixes run the desktop migration on startup so existing installs transition correctly after the desktop packaging move, and stabilize the Windows titlebar when changing zoom levels.

chunks.title: v1.14.38
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.38, core bugfixes make embedded UI requests work with arbitrary connect-src origins under the default CSP. Desktop bugfixes make the desktop trust system CA certificates for HTTPS connections.

chunks.title: v1.14.39
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.39, desktop bugfixes respect HTTP_PROXY and related proxy environment variables in the desktop app, and return null instead of failing when the desktop app cannot read a stored value.

chunks.title: v1.14.40
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.40, core improvements support .well-known/opencode configs that point to a separate remote config file. Core bugfixes preserve assistant text when replaying signed reasoning blocks, return consistent not-found errors for missing sessions, apply CORS headers before auth so browser clients can reach legacy server endpoints, fix serve, web, and ACP network options triggering runtime re-entry errors, only show connected workspaces in warp flows and carry the new directory into the session after warping, restore web terminal CSP allowances, sanitize invalid surrogate characters before provider transforms, fix Cloudflare AI Gateway provider options for OpenAI-compatible models, use the current workspace with /new including local-project warps, keep editor selection context stable until it is sent, retry server_is_overloaded API errors automatically, restore Mistral Medium 3.5 variants so model selection works correctly, and show compaction summaries before retained tail messages. TUI bugfixes keep the selected model when model data refreshes and fix /agent create to use the /agents path. Desktop improvements allow trusted app windows to write to the clipboard without permission failures. Desktop bugfixes ignore broken pipe (EPIPE) errors in desktop console logging, stop auto-installing updates when quitting the app, silence noisy browser API Sentry reports in production, and prevent sync bootstrap queries from failing during app startup. The release thanks 6 community contributors.

chunks.title: v1.14.41
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.41, core bugfixes restore formatter output handling so formatting still works when formatters write to stdout or stderr. Core improvements allow warping a session to another workspace to carry over uncommitted file changes. TUI bugfixes restore custom provider setup in /connect. Desktop bugfixes add a macOS Settings menu entry. Desktop improvements move the desktop app's local server into a separate utility process for more reliable startup and shutdown. Extensions improvements make ACP clients restore the last model, mode, and effort when loading sessions, and can close sessions cleanly. The release thanks 4 community contributors.

chunks.title: v1.14.42
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.42, core improvements add HTTP API response compression for large non-streaming responses, add the Scout agent for repo research, docs lookup, and dependency-source inspection, add workspace sync so adapter-backed workspaces can be discovered and registered automatically, add an interactive split-footer mode for opencode run, simplify TUI keybinding config into a flat keybind format, and make duplicate worktree names fall back to the parent directory for clearer labels. Core bugfixes fix HTTP API auth responses to match the previous wire format for empty authorize results and share errors, return structured validation errors from the HTTP API, reject invalid permission and question IDs in the HTTP API, include auth challenges on typed HTTP API 401 responses, fix the HTTP API OpenAPI document route, fix detached sessions so they are claimed by the source project again, forward SIGINT, SIGTERM, and SIGHUP correctly when running through the npm shim, allow skills without descriptions to load correctly, require auth on effect HTTP API root routes, keep tool ordering stable so tool lists stop reshuffling between runs, make retry dialogs more specific to the provider and failure reason, fix Gemini reasoning controls so supported effort levels and small-mode defaults match the model, fix Anthropic Opus 4.5 reasoning effort options, limit OpenAI deep research models to the reasoning level they actually support, and fix GPT-5 reasoning variants so the exposed effort options match each model family. TUI improvements show retrying sessions as active in the project sidebar. TUI bugfixes fix the sidebar message shown for language server state, sort the session picker by full last-updated time instead of day buckets, and keep longer cleared prompts in draft history so they can be restored. Desktop improvements switch desktop updates to silent per-user install flow. The release thanks 5 community contributors.

chunks.title: v1.14.43
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.43, core bugfixes keep provider and config API responses working when auth loaders add non-JSON options to providers, and include tool image attachments in ACP updates and session replays. The release thanks 1 community contributor.

chunks.title: v1.14.44
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.44, core bugfixes fix upgrades failing for existing workspaces when adding the time_used field.

chunks.title: v1.14.45
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.45, core bugfixes make provider configs and API responses accept models marked as active, make read tool permission rules match worktree-relative paths so read allowlists and denylists apply correctly, and make workspace-routed HTTP API endpoints no longer reject valid directory and workspace query params. TUI bugfixes make startup errors report every failed bootstrap request instead of only the first one, and prevent opening a session from crashing when the messages request fails. Desktop bugfixes make older migrated sessions with missing diff file details load again, and older migrated sessions with missing diff patches load again. SDK bugfixes make throwOnError: true throw a real Error with the server message and preserve the response body in cause. Extensions improvements make TUI plugins using the deprecated api.command API keep working while you migrate to api.keymap. Extensions bugfixes prevent provider plugins from mutating shared provider model state for the rest of the app. The release thanks 1 community contributor.

chunks.title: v1.14.46
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.46, core improvements add a built-in customize-opencode skill so opencode config edits are less likely to break startup. Core bugfixes fix numeric HTTP API query parameters in the generated OpenAPI spec and SDK for session and file endpoints, fix boolean HTTP API query handling so SDK types and runtime validation stay aligned, tolerate legacy stored numeric values in sessions, diffs, and retry events instead of failing to load old data, fix old sessions with negative token counts causing message loads and Desktop startup to fail, fix MCP tool discovery when a server publishes broken outputSchema references, fix workspace HTTP API query drift so workspace-routed endpoints expose the right query parameters in OpenAPI and the SDK, and fix a Plan Mode security bypass where subagents could ignore parent-agent deny rules.

chunks.title: v1.14.47
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.47, core bugfixes restore prompt editing keybindings in the TUI textarea including aliases like esc and enter, make model changes persist reliably across session activity, and make HTTP API schema validation errors return a readable 400 response body. Core improvements make Scout able to materialize configured reference repositories up front so they are ready to search, and make large image attachments auto-resized before sending with configurable size limits. TUI changes make file and directory paths render relative to the session directory when possible.

chunks.title: v1.14.48
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.48, core improvements preserve original image attachments instead of resizing them before sending them to the model.

chunks.title: v1.14.49
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.49, core improvements add the v2 model and provider listing API, add DigitalOcean OAuth and Inference Router support, create a global opencode.jsonc automatically when no config exists, enable customize-opencode by default with a linked full schema, autocomplete configured @mentions in prompts, and parse fenced Markdown code blocks in patch diffs by default. Core bugfixes fix keymap fallback priority and make TUI config errors clearer, restore model suggestions for unloaded providers and missing models, preserve layered permission rule order in config merges, preserve attachments returned by custom tools, keep recent turns after compaction instead of folding them into the summary, fix prompt cursor movement and mentions for wide characters, prevent duplicate submits from creating empty phantom sessions, keep compacted tail history when forking a session, and return proper busy-session errors from the HTTP API. TUI improvements add pinned recent sessions, quick slots, and recent-session cycling. TUI bugfixes restore non-interactive run exit behavior, make the websearch provider label update reactively, reduce flicker when switching workspaces, fix run --json output draining, and fix prompt history and line up/down commands. Desktop improvements add Ctrl/Cmd+number shortcuts to switch projects, remember whether the todo dock is collapsed, and restore AppStream metadata in Linux desktop builds. Desktop bugfixes show clearer wrapped server errors in the app, use the login shell when loading desktop environment variables, remember the selected model variant when switching sessions or projects, open the next available project when closing the current one, and prevent streamed Markdown from being cut off. The release thanks 5 community contributors.

chunks.title: v1.14.50
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.50, core bugfixes keep HTTP event streams open after the initial connect event so subscribers continue receiving instance updates, return proper busy errors when a session is already running prompt or shell work, let invalid small_model config values fall back cleanly instead of breaking small-model selection, and improve missing-model errors with suggestions across CLI and typed callers. TUI improvements restore markdown rendering for session output by default. SDK improvements add instance.directory and instance.workspace query support to the v2 model and provider calls.

chunks.title: v1.14.51
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.14.51, core improvements add experimental background subagents so tasks can keep running while you continue working, and add the required billing origin header for NVIDIA endpoints. Core bugfixes fix worktree creation requests that omitted the POST body, fix sessions getting stuck with interrupted assistant messages after cancellation, fix repeated auto-compaction in sessions after compaction reordered messages, update LiteLLM compatibility to require v1.85.0-rc.2+ for current GPT-5 and tool-call behavior, fix truncated shell output streams closing cleanly, stop exposing internal named defect details from the HTTP API, fix Azure gpt-5.5 requests through the completions API, and restore automatic image resizing for oversized image attachments. TUI bugfixes preserve text selection when clicking question prompt options. Desktop improvements add MCP connection status for client registration and authentication, with direct re-auth flows in the app. Desktop bugfixes fix Windows app detection by reading where output correctly. Extensions bugfixes fix DigitalOcean OAuth to request only the GenAI scopes it needs. The release thanks 7 community contributors.

chunks.title: v1.15.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.15.0, core improvements add an Effect-based core event system for more complete event delivery across sessions and integrations. Core bugfixes ignore invalid exports in custom tool modules instead of failing tool loading, ignore project instruction lookup errors so sessions keep loading when project instruction discovery fails, and fix versioned event projector lookups so event replay uses the right handlers. Desktop improvements auto-hide the menu bar on Linux and Windows. Desktop bugfixes fix archived sessions being reprocessed when their archive state did not change. SDK bugfixes restore missing event types in the JavaScript SDK, including session and message events. The release thanks 1 community contributor.

chunks.title: v1.15.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.15.1, core improvements clarify how to recover when the npm package is installed without its native binary. Core bugfixes avoid duplicate consecutive entries in prompt history, show full config validation errors during TUI startup instead of a generic failure, fix npm installs so the CLI can recover and fetch the right native binary on more setups, fix multiline @ mentions in prompts, preserve custom tool metadata from Zod schemas, preserve custom tool argument descriptions in generated schemas, and fix file watching in repos where .git is a symlink. TUI improvements add a collapsed thinking view that can be expanded inline, and add pinned sessions with quick-switch slots in the session picker. TUI bugfixes fix thinking mode defaults so reasoning starts collapsed consistently, limit session quick-switching to pinned sessions, and fix Markdown table rendering in chat output. The release thanks 1 community contributor.

chunks.title: v1.15.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.15.2, core improvements reduce unnecessary prompting around shell, task, and todo flows. Core bugfixes fix sync events not reaching project-scoped subscribers in injected instances. TUI improvements make newly pinned sessions stay at the end of the pinned list instead of jumping to the top. TUI bugfixes fix opencode run --agent resolving project-local agents. The release thanks 1 community contributor.

chunks.title: v1.15.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.15.3, core bugfixes reduce wasted work when reading very large files after output truncation. TUI bugfixes fix async commands losing the active instance context, which could break agent generation and GitHub-driven runs.

chunks.title: v1.15.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.15.4, core bugfixes fix project-scoped bus events so file watcher and update notifications reach the right instance, fix custom LSP servers not sending refresh events after they initialize, and hide background subagent task instructions unless experimental background mode is enabled. TUI improvements make Markdown H1 headings easier to distinguish. The release thanks 1 community contributor.

chunks.title: v1.15.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.15.5, core improvements preview the native OpenAI runtime path behind an experimental flag, and add --replay and --replay-limit to show recent history when resuming interactive runs. Core bugfixes fix plugin tools using ask so tool calls complete correctly, reduce missed /event updates caused by a subscription race, and sort the v2 session list by most recently updated. TUI improvements refresh the prompt layout after pasting content. TUI bugfixes keep file references scoped to the current workspace, preserve pasted prompt content when copying, collapse very long tool output lines to keep the layout readable, and use a higher-contrast paste summary badge color in some themes. Desktop improvements allow desktop notifications from the renderer, show free-limit and usage-exceeded dialogs in Desktop, and speed up large session timelines. Desktop bugfixes fix question dock overflow and message layout clipping, hide the prompt placeholder when the input only contains whitespace, sync the PWA status bar color with the active theme, and install the newest available desktop update instead of reusing a stale download. The release thanks 4 community contributors.

chunks.title: v1.15.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.15.6, core improvements add a diff viewer in the TUI for reviewing changes, collapse single-child directories in the diff viewer file tree, add shell mode to the run prompt, replace subagent tabs with an on-demand picker in run, make plugin file load errors no longer break the rest of plugin loading, make Anthropic API-key models use the native runtime, and make the v2 HTTP API expose structured public error schemas. Core bugfixes make Zed editor context only activate inside Zed terminals, make the v2 HTTP API expose catalog errors, make the v2 HTTP API expose request errors, make the v2 OpenAPI spec preserve endpoint error responses, make opencode login default to https://console.opencode.ai, make agent and command names resolve correctly from relative config paths, make invalid OPENCODE_PERMISSION JSON no longer crash startup, make plugin tools with missing args no longer break tool loading, restore legacy PgUp and PgDn TUI keybind aliases, and make the native runtime prefer the console provider token for OpenCode models. TUI improvements make the diff viewer focus the first file automatically. TUI bugfixes make imported sessions refresh their directory and relative path fields correctly. Desktop improvements add initial desktop tabs support, add a native app menu on Windows, and add Ukrainian locale support. Desktop bugfixes make custom providers appear immediately after config updates. SDK updates opentui dependencies to 0.2.15. The release thanks 4 community contributors.

chunks.title: v1.15.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.15.7, core improvements add Grok OAuth sign-in, including device-code login. Core bugfixes make v2 session APIs return safe UnknownError responses with log reference IDs when stored messages are corrupt, make generic API 500s no longer expose config details from server errors, make unknown API errors include reference IDs so you can match responses to server logs, make v2 session APIs return 503 ServiceUnavailableError for mutations that are not available yet, make v2 session APIs return SessionNotFoundError for missing sessions, dedupe concurrent Codex OAuth refreshes to avoid repeated refresh failures, restore native OpenAI OAuth requests, make tool schema failures surface as friendly tool errors, add PDF attachment support for Grok, and restore OpenAI reasoning streams. TUI bugfixes make collapsed thinking labels use clearer punctuation, make new sessions default to the local project, and make single-select question checkmarks no longer run into option labels. Desktop improvements add a pinch zoom setting for the desktop app, add a new desktop home view, session entry flow, and titlebar, refine the new desktop UI and move app update actions into the titlebar, and add desktop log export. SDK bugfixes make v2 global event streams include account add, remove, and switch events. The release thanks 3 community contributors.

chunks.title: v1.15.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.15.9, core improvements redesign the diff viewer with a file tree and refreshed layout. Core bugfixes return to the previous screen when closing the diff viewer, show clearer errors when a default model is invalid or unavailable, surface missing PTY session errors instead of failing generically, improve diff viewer empty states and context handling, show clearer errors when a skill invocation fails as expected, show clearer errors when an installation upgrade fails, show clearer project not found errors from the HTTP API, return PTY error bodies from the HTTP API, enable the diff viewer by default, return MCP server not found errors from the HTTP API, let MCP OAuth configs set a callback port and include configured scopes in client metadata, use working Vertex Anthropic endpoints for us and eu multi-region setups, return session busy error bodies from the HTTP API, and preserve native reasoning continuation metadata across turns. TUI improvements copy the current worktree path from the command palette. TUI bugfixes refine diff viewer keyboard shortcuts, restore question prompt key handling, and keep the spinner color aligned with the active agent. Desktop improvements move tab navigation into the title bar and tighten session tab shortcuts, and show session status in the title bar. Desktop bugfixes extract user codes correctly from callback URLs that contain multiple colons, and debounce VCS refreshes to reduce session page churn. The release thanks 4 community contributors.

chunks.title: v1.15.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.15.10, desktop bugfixes restore the legacy production desktop flows for opening projects and starting sessions.

chunks.title: v1.15.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.15.11, core improvements add headerTimeout config for provider requests with a 10s default for default OpenAI setups, make experimental background agents push updates without polling, allow setting only modalities.input or modalities.output in config, and make remote-backed projects resolve a stable project identity. Core bugfixes make dynamically added MCP servers disconnect cleanly when removed, make DigitalOcean inference use your OAuth token directly instead of creating a MAK, make config loading fall back cleanly when user info is unavailable, fix Google tool calling after the upstream tool ID regression, allow experimental flags to override the umbrella experimental flag, make resumed sessions no longer continue orphaned interrupted tools, make OpenAI reasoning summaries render as separate blocks, update Google Vertex support for reasoning signatures, and make the shell tool advertise your configured timeout to the model. TUI improvements make the prompt resize with terminal width and add prompt size config. TUI bugfixes accelerate diff viewer scrolling, and make external editors open from the worktree directory when available. Desktop improvements refine the Desktop v2 home screen, prompt, status popover, and session controls. Desktop bugfixes fix V2 titlebar errors when a session sync cache was deleted, make web deployments no longer run desktop health checks, merge duplicate server connections in the server list, stabilize virtualized session timeline interactions, and fix the white flash when restoring the desktop window. Extensions improvements add a dispose hook for plugins. Extensions bugfixes fix Codex plugin requests to send the expected session ID header. The release thanks 7 community contributors.

chunks.title: v1.15.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.15.12, core improvements allow ACP integrations to send prompts, slash commands, and usage updates through acp-next, and add WebSocket transport for OpenAI responses on supported channels (set OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_WEBSOCKETS=true). Core bugfixes enable adaptive reasoning controls for Anthropic Opus 4.7+ models, allow colons in passwords, speed up warm acp-next model and config switches, improve first-session acp-next startup time, keep OpenAI WebSocket response timeouts active, retry failed OpenAI WebSocket streams before falling back, handle acp-next permission prompts correctly, use the persisted session directory for existing-session requests, forward remote workspace request bodies correctly, and support custom base URLs for OpenAI WebSocket responses. TUI improvements add a workspace management dialog. TUI bugfixes keep session navigation working while prompt modes are open, restore the thinking spinner, surface subagent retry status, and fix opening editors from non-Git project paths. Desktop improvements add a setting to switch tab layouts. Desktop bugfixes improve the home empty state and fix V2 font usage, and fix tab close buttons not showing reliably. The release thanks 5 community contributors.

chunks.title: v1.15.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anomalyco/opencode release v1.15.13, core bugfixes make Gateway Anthropic Opus 4.7+ adaptive reasoning keep summarized thinking instead of returning empty thinking blocks. Core improvements allow sessions to store custom metadata through the API and SDK, and make config load from the opened location upward so directory-specific settings and provider policies apply more predictably. TUI bugfixes make wrapped inline tool rows stay aligned, and allow failed inline tools to expand their error details in place. The release thanks 1 community contributor.

questions.query_text: In the anomalyco/opencode releases, which release introduces the Scout agent for repo research, docs lookup, and dependency-source inspection?

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent ant-design/ant-design release stream from version 5.27.6 through 6.4.3, covering bug fixes, new features, deprecations, and the major 6.0.0 release with semantic structure and dynamic component generation.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ant-design/ant-design release 5.27.6, the Table component fixes pagination.align not working and adds missing useMemo capability to spinProps. The Modal component refactors ConfirmDialog useMemo to resolve invalidation when Object.values generates a new array. TypeScript improvements add Window and ShadowRoot type definitions to ConfigProvider getTargetContainer and getPopupContainer, and improve Modal type definition.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 5.28.0, Drawer supports closable.placement to specify close button position. Image supports fallback global configuration. QRCode supports boostLevel. Splitter supports onCollapse. Statistic displays animation effect by default when loading. TreeSelect supports global configuration for switcher icon. Segmented theme variable itemSelectedBg supports background gradient, and fixes abnormal animation after React DevTools upgrade. Tree and Transfer fix disabled inheritance issue. Tree.DirectoryTree fixes defaultExpandAll not working when fieldNames is defined. Upload adds info.defaultRequest in customRequest parameters and supports pictureCardSize token. Notification supports configuring background color token. Pagination supports modifying active item text color through tokens. Fixes for Select, DatePicker, TreeSelect, Cascader not showing default suffix icon when suffixIcon is undefined, Mentions not inheriting disabled from external Form, and Watermark crashing when wrapping Modal with modalRender. Input deprecates addonAfter and addonBefore, recommending Space.Compact. Row gutter prop supports string type definition.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 5.28.1, Carousel fixes style issue in vertical mode and dots animation missing on first render. Descriptions fixes content style wrongly using labelStyle. Select component height adjusted to 32px when variant="underlined". Input component border color changes on mouse hover when underlined property is enabled. Flex gap prop supports number type. Missing TimePicker translations added for multiple locales.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 5.29.0, InputNumber deprecates addonAfter and addonBefore props, recommending Space.Compact. Drawer accessibility improved by adding aria-labelledby when a title is present. Korean localization fixes spacing in "복사됨" message.
In the ant-design/ant-design release 5.29.1, Carousel fixes dot not clickable when in vertical mode.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.0.0, the major version introduces semantic structure support across components with ConfigProvider configuration, and dynamic component generation via function based on props. It also includes a new React-based UI, enhanced security, DAG versioning, improved backfills, event-driven scheduling, and remote execution support.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.0.1, Flex fixes cannot pass 0 for flex and gap properties. Input fixes colorText token not working with filled variant without affix, and Input.OTP empty slots can be skipped when typing. Anchor fixes scroll problem when clicking same link rapidly. Button fixes hover text color in solid variant. Cascader fixes page scroll to top on first open with defaultValue. DatePicker fixes borderRadiusSM and borderRadiusLG token not working. InputNumber fixes text clipping bug with ColorPicker. Select fixes text color for search input in dark mode. Splitter fixes failing to fill its container when sum of panel proportions is not 1. Wave fixes memory leak risk since RAF not cleaned up. Modal/Image/Drawer fix colorBgMask token not taking effect. ConfigProvider fixes default not config theme.hashed is true causing style conflict with multiple versions. Layout.Sider fixes styles lost when zeroRuntime enabled. MISC fixes build with pnpm hoist: false. TypeScript fixes ConfigProvider type missing for Table className and styles config, and DatePicker props type definition.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.1.0, ConfigProvider supports configuring trigger property for Tooltip, Popover, and Popconfirm. Alert adds semantic close button element. Drawer adds semantic close button element and boolean type setting for resizable. Select adds multi-field search functionality to optionFilterProp, fixes input cursor displayed in non-search mode, and fixes option not enabled when containing interactive content. Table fixes cellFontSizeSM and cellFontSizeLG tokens not working. Button fixes tokens not working with specific variants. Menu fixes item styles not taking effect. MISC removes classnames from @ant-design/react-slick and migrates rc-overflow and rc-virtual-list to @rc-component packages. TypeScript exports ErrorBoundaryProps type from Alert, supports passing a function as Table rowKey in ConfigProvider, and makes notification title optional.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 5.29.2, notification background colors fix when cssVar is disabled. Breadcrumb link style priority raised to avoid being overridden by global styles. Input.Search fixes warning about deprecated addonAfter. Splitter fixes failing to fill its container when sum of panel proportions is not 1.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.1.1, DatePicker fixes cannot support webpack 4. ColorPicker fixes inconsistent input heights. Notification fixes default background color not white when cssVar is disabled. Input fixes border missing when focused on Space.Compact with allowClear prop. Splitter fixes incorrect collapse behavior in RTL mode for vertical layouts. Result fixes not passing through data-* and aria-* attributes. MISC fixes theme.cssVar.prefix and theme.cssVar.key now respect empty string value. Breadcrumb link style priority lifted. ConfigProvider fixes closable.placement not working. Form fixes onValuesChange params missing Form.List nested content. Select fixes selectorBg token not working. Upload fixes incorrect progress position style.
In the ant-design/ant-design release 5.29.3, Breadcrumb fixes link color being overridden when using custom itemRender.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.1.2, Button fixes missing wave effect and issue where component could not show Dropdown on hover immediately after clicking. Form.List with useWatch fixes double rendering on item removal. Breadcrumb fixes style issue when using custom itemRender. Transfer removes className for selected state when disabled and prioritizes using disabled property. Select fixes missing semantic DOM names, wrong hover cursor style in search mode, and cursor style when disabled with showSearch enabled. Card fixes unexpected border radius when using Card.Grid without a header. Tag deepens default background to improve borderless contrast. Segmented fixes duplicate role and unnecessary aria- attributes on items.
In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.1.3, Drawer.PurePanel fixes failing to respond to mouse interactions. Select fixes options props leaking to DOM elements causing React unknown-prop warnings.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.1.4, Select fixes multiple aria- attributes in DOM. Table fixes hidden measure headers mounting interactive filter dropdowns and triggering unexpected close events when scroll.y is enabled.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.2.0, Button, Masonry, Mentions, Select, Space, Splitter, Steps and other components batch use genCssVar method to generate more stable CSS variable names. QRCode adds marginSize property. Tour adds keyboard property. Tooltip adds maxWidth design token and Tooltip/Popover/Popconfirm can be closed with ESC by default. Steps removes useless styles. Form supports tel type validation. Badge fixes ref not working when using text property. Calendar and DatePicker locale configuration supports partial content filling. ConfigProvider fixes theme.cssVar configuration not working for icons. Collapse fixes items semantic properties not working. Modal supports focusable.trap to configure focus locking and removes useless DOM structure optimizing focus capture. ConfigProvider supports pagination configuration for totalBoundary and showSizeChanger, and supports configuring Alert global icons. Drawer adds focusable to configure focus behavior and fixes size definition not supporting string type. Image nested in Modal fixes cannot be closed sequentially with Esc. Pagination supports size prop.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.2.1, Button fixes child element's className being cleared if it contains two Chinese characters. DatePicker fixes DOM not updated after updating suffixIcon as null. Table fixes content area border radius when setting border radius for container. Card fixes unexpected border radius for Body area. MISC fixes unexpected undefined and null in injected styles and improves background transition to background-color for all components. Grid improves using genCssVar method. @ant-design/icons usage improved to avoid depending on full package.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.2.2, Button with href wrapped by Typography fixes incorrect color and flickering outline on hover. Button component token fixes not taking effect for type="text". Popover components fix being affected by state association with Form.Item. Select fixes placeholders displayed incorrectly when selecting multiple items. Pagination fixes misaligned elements when global fontSize is increased. Drawer fixes incorrect dragger position in RTL mode.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.2.3, Button fixes defaultBg, defaultColor, defaultHoverColor, defaultActiveColor tokens not taking effect, default tokens not taking effect, and variant="solid" borders displaying incorrectly inside Space.Compact. Input.TextArea ref fixes missing nativeElement property. Flex fixes default align not taking effect when using orientation. Typography link selector specificity fixes being too low. ColorPicker HEX input fixes allowing invalid characters.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.3.0, ConfigProvider supports global configuration of maskClosable for Modal and Drawer, suffixIcon for DatePicker and TimePicker, expandIcon and loadingIcon for Cascader, scroll for Table, className and style for App, arrow for ColorPicker, loadingIcon for Button, rangePicker.separator, and tooltipIcon and tooltipProps for Form. Upload adds classNames.trigger and styles.trigger props, supports Upload.Dragger onDoubleClick event, and fixes missing default height for picture-card/picture-circle parent nodes. Grid adds xxxl breakpoint. Switch supports indicator customization for semantic structure. Button fixes reversed hover and active colors for color in dark theme and border size not following Design Token lineWidth. Select removes redundant -content-value div DOM in single mode and fixes notFoundContent not taking effect. Radio.Group fixes extra right margin for radio items when vertically aligned and removes -inner DOM node of icon sub-element. Modal and Drawer disable mask blur effect by default. Tooltip and Popover fix popup animation starting position shifted to the left.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.3.1, Select fixes incorrect dropdown height when value is empty string, value echo issue when value is empty string, and selected value text still visible when searching. TreeSelect fixes Checkbox being compressed when multi-line text is present. Typography fixes hovering copy button triggering ellipsis tooltip when both copyable and ellipsis are enabled, and ellipsis tooltip not appearing after moving back from copy button. Progress fixes animation overflow when status="active". Upload fixes picture-wall mode list overflow and overlap when file count exceeds one row. Image fixes flickering in some browsers when opening preview. Button, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Segmented add prefers-reduced-motion media query support. Input fixes height inconsistency with Select when using variant="borderless". Modal confirm method fixes layout whitespace when icon is empty. Select adds aria-disabled attribute for disabled options.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.3.2, Form.Item fixes validation failure caused by timing issue when using dynamic rules and dependencies together. InputNumber fixes height in borderless variant when using with Input or Select. Radio.Group fixes radio button width when options text has different length or breaks. Skeleton.Avatar, Skeleton.Button, Skeleton.Input, Rate and Spin fix cannot take effect when componentSize is set globally. Splitter fixes may calculate wrong size if some panel in controlled mode. Tree and TreeSelect fix line alignment problem when customizing titleHeight property. Checkbox.Group fixes checkbox width when options text has different length or breaks. ConfigProvider fixes csp not taking effect on all dynamic style. Select fixes text jumping problem in Firefox and cannot set visibility: hidden via style property. Upload fixes invalid blank area in picture-card mode with empty data and improves to always show item action area on non-hover or coarse-pointer devices. es_US locale preset added. Size enumeration unified, replacing default with medium for several components. Size className unified for all components DOM. TypeScript adds Upload.Dragger generic type definition support and fixes Modal KeyboardEvent type definition for onCancel event handler.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.3.3, Image improves preview mask blur transition for backdrop-filter to reduce flicker perception and fixes showing move cursor when movable={false}. App link :focus-visible outline improved to enhance keyboard accessibility. Form fixes required mark using hardcoded SimSun font. Grid fixes media size mapping issue for xxxl breakpoint. Tree fixes scrolling to top when clicking node.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.3.4, the official @ant-design/cli command-line tool is added for querying component knowledge, analyzing project usage, and guiding migrations offline. Form.List fixes losing sibling field values when using onValuesChange. useToken fixes missing screenXXXLMin causing incorrect antd.css generation. ConfigProvider component config typings expose semantic classNames and styles for supported components. Image fixes fetchPriority prop not being passed through to img element. Menu fixes SubMenu parent item not applying custom hover color via ConfigProvider and collapsed icons appearing misaligned when customizing collapsedIconSize. Table fixes controlled popover in column title being rendered twice when scroll is enabled. Transfer fixes render prop returning JSX elements causing search to fail. Tree fixes custom switcherIcon missing switcher-line-icon className when showLine is enabled. Watermark fixes TypeScript errors when onRemove is omitted.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.3.5, Image preview action buttons fix not resetting native button styles. TimePicker fixes column cannot scroll directly on touch devices. MISC fixes Icon not being centered in certain scenarios.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.3.6, InputNumber fixes disabled handlers showing hover styles. Space.Addon fixes wrapping CJK content in compact layouts. Cascader fixes menu item ellipsis styles for long option labels. Image preview fixes focus not being locked when opened via keyboard and restores focus to trigger element after preview closes. Input fixes disabled border color to use colorBorderDisabled token. MISC fixes some expand animation crash issues. Notification fixes close button overlapping description when title is empty. Radio fixes hover color display issue in disabled state. Table improves filter performance by caching flattened filter keys and reusing normalized search input, and fixes rowSelection to use selectionColumnWidth from Design Token as default columnWidth. Design Token shadow tokens fix not adapting to dark theme. Transfer fixes remove button still changing color on hover when list item is disabled. Tree fixes checkbox, switcher and content alignment when parent nodes have multiple lines of content.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.3.7, Input.OTP fixes masked value being visible when selected on Windows. Input accessibility improved for clear button. Card fixes rendering an empty body wrapper when no content was provided. InputNumber fixes selection highlight radius. Tooltip semantic configs fix leaking into Popover and Popconfirm from ConfigProvider. Typography.Link fixes cannot trigger action buttons when disabled. ConfigProvider language packs fix export from ESM/CJS dist files. Alert fixes focus styles for close button.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.4.0, BorderBeam component added for animated border beam effect. ConfigProvider adds Select allowClear, showSearch, clearIcon, loadingIcon, menuItemSelectedIcon, removeIcon, suffixIcon config support; DatePicker and TimePicker allowClear and clearIcon config support; RangePicker allowClear, clearIcon, suffixIcon config support; Modal infoIcon, successIcon, warningIcon, errorIcon config support; Upload progress and accept config support; Modal and Drawer focusable config; Mentions allowClear config support; and fixes css var prefix not following prefixCls. Input adds allowClear.disabled prop, Input.TextArea allowClear.disabled prop, Input clear semantic segment, Input.Search searchIcon prop, and improves Input.Password accessibility with ConfigProvider support. Splitter adds destroyOnHidden prop, smooth transition animation for collapsible panels, deprecates collapsibleIcon adding collapsible.icon replacement, and fixes unexpected 1px horizontal padding from Splitter.Panel. Select fixes option active style priority higher than selected and showSearch not working.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.4.1, the exports field added in a previous PR is reverted to fix antd TypeScript type resolution failure under moduleResolution: "bundler". BorderBeam fixes beam animation breaking at rounded corners.
In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.4.2, message and notification fix build error in strict ESM toolchains caused by deep rc notification runtime import.

In the ant-design/ant-design release 6.4.3, DatePicker RangePicker fixes empty placeholder when locale only defines singular *Placeholder fields. Result fixes rendering an empty title element when title prop is not provided. Select fixes search input font size and line-height rendering issue in Safari. Strict ESM build errors caused by deep @rc-component/util runtime imports fixed in Form, Input, Button and other components. Transfer fixes filteredItems not updating when filterOption or direction changes. Table and Mentions performance improved by reducing redundant array iterations. Table filter types rename FilterRestProps to FilterResetProps with deprecated alias, and row selection performance improved using Set-based lookup.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release evolution of anthropics/claude-code, covering a dense sequence of updates from late April to early June 2026. The releases introduce new features such as agent view, dynamic workflows, Opus 4.8 support, and numerous fixes across authentication, MCP, background sessions, and terminal rendering.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anthropics/claude-code release v2.1.149, the project added: /usage shows per-category breakdown; /diff detail view scrollable with keyboard; markdown output renders GFM task list checkboxes; enterprise allowAllClaudeAiMcps managed setting; fixed PowerShell permission bypass via built-in cd functions; fixed sandbox write allowlist in git worktrees; fixed PowerShell prefix/wildcard allow rules not pre-approving; fixed permission-analysis gap with stale variable-tracking; fixed find in Bash tool exhausting macOS file table; fixed managed-settings approval dialog leaving terminal frozen; fixed /ultraplan and remote session creation failing; fixed otelHeadersHelper failing silently; fixed thinking spinner staying amber; fixed collapsed Bash output reporting wrong hidden-line count; fixed slash-command argument-hint clipping; fixed argument-hint not appearing after Tab-completing skill; fixed status bar showing baseline /effort instead of applied effort; fixed Ctrl+O transcript view freezing; fixed editing recalled prompt-history entry losing edit; fixed /config exit summary reporting phantom changes; fixed /insights crashing with missing fields; fixed malformed PowerShell and History tool calls misclassified; fixed renaming Remote Control session not updating local name; fixed race where prompt appears twice in history; fixed tapping Jump to bottom pill not dismissing; improved /feedback reports to include pre-compaction conversation.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anthropics/claude-code release v2.1.152, the project added: /code-review --fix applies review findings; skills and slash commands can set disallowed-tools; /reload-skills command; SessionStart hooks can return reloadSkills and set session title; MessageDisplay hook event; pluginSuggestionMarketplaces managed setting; claude plugin marketplace remove accepts --scope; Claude Code switches to --fallback-model when primary not found; auto mode no longer requires opt-in consent; vim mode / opens reverse history search; /usage breakdown includes large session files; thinking summaries stay readable for 3 seconds; fullscreen mode thinking indicator counts up live; simplified Workflow tool inline progress; post-response timer shows waiting for background agents; added session entrypoint as OTEL metric attribute; fixed terminal styling degrading; fixed sandbox-enabled warning not appearing; fixed loading spinner showing thinking while tool running; fixed focus mode showing spurious hidden messages count; fixed clicking link inside expanded tool result collapsing section; fixed markdown table cell borders inheriting color; fixed plugin MCP servers with same command but different env vars deduplicated; fixed /doctor reporting marketplace not found for stale entries; fixed plugins tracking git branch not receiving updates; fixed remote MCP servers failing to connect with egress proxy; fixed effort-change confirmation dialog appearing incorrectly; fixed the...

chunks.title: v2.1.153
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anthropics/claude-code release v2.1.153, the project added: skipLfs option for plugin marketplace sources; one-time notice when npm global install can't auto-update; status line commands receive COLUMNS and LINES; claude agents autocomplete suggests native slash commands; claude agents PR column shows PR count; claude doctor shows last update attempt; combined MCP authentication notifications; macOS background agents appear as Claude Code in Privacy & Security; fixed stateful MCP servers reconnect-looping; fixed custom API gateway receiving OAuth credential; fixed subagent frontmatter MCP servers ignoring policies; --strict-mcp-config no longer strips inline mcpServers; fixed Windows PowerShell installer reporting success on failure; fixed claude update installing wrong channel version; fixed excessive memory usage when resuming by transcript path; fixed claude agents running on stale daemon; fixed hang when stdin closed without EOF; fixed malformed file:// links not clickable; fixed claude --help rendering unwrapped; fixed MCP tool progress notifications not rendering; fixed Agent tool with subagent_type claude running in temporary worktree; /bg while Claude responding continues response in background; fixed /btw keyboard shortcuts unresponsive; fixed background sessions writing temp files triggering permission prompt; fixed recovering background agent with deleted directory; fixed EnterWorktree not available immediately; fixed cmd+k not repainting attached sessions; fixed IME candidate window appearing at bottom; fixed background-color bleed when attaching; fixed /copy and copy-on-select failing in tmux; fixed opening claude agents with Remote Control leaving zombie sessions.

chunks.title: v2.1.154
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anthropics/claude-code release v2.1.154, the project introduced Opus 4.8 with high effort default; dynamic workflows for orchestrating background agents; fast mode on Opus 4.8 at reduced cost; lean system prompt default for most models; Claude reserves multiple-choice questions for genuine decisions; /simplify runs cleanup-only review; renamed /effort slider labels to Faster/Smarter; claude agents: ! command runs shell as background session; claude agents: /logout signs out; ←← to open agents view works on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry; Claude in Chrome: pick connected browser; plugins can declare defaultEnabled: false; /plugin Discover tab pins suggested plugins; streaming tool execution always enabled; stdio MCP servers receive CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID and CLAUDECODE=1; claude mcp list/get show pending approval servers; /remote-control autocomplete shows disconnect option; added Opus 4.8 support to /claude-api skill; deprecated CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE; improved auto-mode classifier detection of data exfiltration; fixed rm -rf $HOME not blocked with trailing slash; fixed $TMPDIR resolving differently in sandboxed vs unsandboxed; fixed unreadable highlighted-row text in claude agents; fixed background-agent completion notifications triggering premature out of context; fixed background-session classifier losing user goal; fixed pinned background sessions respawning every minute; fixed background sessions stuck not retiring; fixed subagents in background sessions bypassing worktree isolation; fixed orphaned claude --bg-pty-host processes spinning.

chunks.title: v2.1.156
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anthropics/claude-code release v2.1.156, the project fixed an issue when using Opus 4.8 where thinking blocks were modified, leading to API errors.

chunks.title: v2.1.157
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anthropics/claude-code release v2.1.157, the project added: plugins in .claude/skills automatically loaded; claude plugin init command; autocomplete for /plugin arguments; claude agents honors agent field in settings.json; EnterWorktree can switch between Claude-managed worktrees; tool_decision telemetry includes tool_parameters; worktrees left unlocked after agent finishes; fixed unprocessable images crashing request; fixed sandbox network permission prompts appearing incorrectly; fixed claude agents completed sessions not retiring; fixed claude agents pressing Esc not cancelling; fixed background agent worktrees orphaned after retention sweep; fixed background sessions re-attached after sleep/wake not telling correct date; fixed copy-on-select in claude agents not reaching clipboard in tmux; fixed --resume not reporting background subagents; fixed --resume session picker leaving contents; fixed --worktree returning to canonical repo root; fixed /model picker showing incorrect newer version hint; fixed literal markdown markers in in-progress message; fixed terminal freezing after approving managed-settings dialog; fixed rare duplicate line in scrollback; fixed right-click paste duplicating clipboard in VS Code; WSL: fixed image paste and added drag support; improved performance of long conversations; /terminal-setup disables GPU acceleration in VS Code; Feature of the Week credit-claim status shown as notification; claude agents slash-command autocomplete matches substrings; removed sandbox startup banner; removed /ide startup hint toast; fixed IDE clicking Stop not stopping background subagent; fixed VSCode fast mode indicator not appearing on Opus 4.8; pressing backspace after workflow trigger keyword dismisses request; added Workflow keyword trigger setting in /config.

chunks.title: v2.1.158
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anthropics/claude-code release v2.1.158, the project made auto mode available on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry for Opus 4.7 and Opus 4.8, opt-in via CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE=1.

chunks.title: v2.1.159
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anthropics/claude-code release v2.1.159, the project included internal infrastructure improvements with no user-facing changes.

chunks.title: v2.1.160
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the anthropics/claude-code release v2.1.160, the project added: prompt before writing to shell startup files and ~/.config/git/; acceptEdits mode prompts before writing build-tool config files that grant code execution; Edit no longer requires separate Read after viewing file with grep; fixed copy-on-select not writing to Windows clipboard on WSL; fixed restoring completed session from claude agents dropping chat history; fixed background sessions re-attached after overnight retire losing conversation; fixed claude --bg failing with socket missing; fixed on Windows directory could not be deleted after claude rm; fixed background agents that resumed work shown under Completed; fixed claude agents freezing due to auto-updater; fixed Esc, arrow keys, typing unresponsive on Windows under heavy CPU load; fixed background agents emitting terminal sync-output markers causing render artifacts; fixed mouse wheel scrolling prompt history instead of transcript; fixed CJK IME composition appearing at bottom-left; fixed valid file:///C:/ links rewritten to broken path; fixed voice mode failing with non-ASCII characters; fixed auto mode unavailability message on third-party providers; fixed /effort ultracode incorrectly blaming dynamic workflows setting; fixed model-not-found errors suggesting --model in SDK; fixed Claude's past replies disappearing from scrollback; fixed vim mode p pasting on line below; improved performance of opening recently-inactive background agent sessions; improved auto mode classifier latency; improved background-session teardown to send SIGTERM before SIGKILL; removed CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE; removed JetBrains plugin install suggestion; renamed dynamic-workflow trigger keyword from workflow to ultracode.

questions.query_text: Across the anthropics/claude-code releases, how does the /simplify command change between v2.1.146 and v2.1.154?

options.text: In v2.1.146, /simplify is renamed to /code-review with optional effort level; in v2.1.154, /simplify runs a cleanup-only review instead of the full /code-review --fix.
In v2.1.146, /simplify is removed; in v2.1.154, it is reintroduced as a dynamic workflow trigger.
In v2.1.146, /simplify gains the ability to post inline GitHub PR comments; in v2.1.154, it loses that ability.
In v2.1.146, /simplify is unchanged; in v2.1.154, it is deprecated in favor of /ultracode.

questions.expected_answer: In v2.1.146, /simplify is renamed to /code-review with optional effort level; in v2.1.154, /simplify runs a cleanup-only review instead of the full /code-review --fix.

answer_support.answer_text: Renamed /simplify to /code-review with an optional effort level (e.g. /code-review high)
/simplify now runs a cleanup-only review (reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude) and applies the fixes, instead of running the full /code-review --fix bug-hunting review

questions.query_text: In the anthropics/claude-code release window, order the following release-content states from earliest to latest: (1) a release that adds the /goal command to set a completion condition, (2) a release that introduces Opus 4.8 and dynamic workflows, (3) a release that makes auto mode available on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry for Opus 4.7 and 4.8, (4) a release that renames the dynamic-workflow trigger keyword from workflow to ultracode.

answer_support.answer_text: Added /goal command: set a completion condition and Claude keeps working across turns until it's met.
Opus 4.8 is here! ... Introducing dynamic workflows: ask Claude to create a workflow and it orchestrates work across tens to hundreds of agents in the background
Auto mode is now available on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry for Opus 4.7 and Opus 4.8.
Renamed the dynamic-workflow trigger keyword from workflow to ultracode.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent apache/dubbo release stream across the 3.2.x and 3.3.x lines, including beta releases and stable releases, highlighting new features, bug fixes, and dependency upgrades.

chunks.title: dubbo-3.2.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the apache/dubbo release dubbo-3.2.4, the release note includes features such as support for setting actual content length to inv/res attributes, support for getting alibaba GenericService from spring context, and enabling spring bean autowired to get scope model in advance. Bug fixes address issues like getting method name from invocation, duplicated methods in registry, disabling all filters for internal service, fixing registry notification using same event time, fixing config center properties log level, renaming getModelEnvironment to modelEnvironment, fixing local invoke consumer url override, supplementary directory metrics data push, caching interfaceClass in advance to prevent IndexOutOfBoundsException, checking if jackson2 security dependency existed, fixing unable to getAppName in InjvmInvoker, skipping check ignored extensions, adding transient to some overrided field, disabling register if registry disable register, fixing registry repeat export same service, triple set resolve fallback enable as default, fixing alibaba Rpc compact, enhancing register type of ServiceConfig, using serviceKey when to metadata ServiceSubscribeEvent, changing retry times to forever, skipping catch SkipFailbackWrapperException in NacosRegistry, reading heartbeat from util when recreate url in ExchangeClient, temporarily removing fill zero in metrics due to performance issue, and clearing future in RpcContext when calling sync. Code enhancements and dependency upgrades are also included.

chunks.title: dubbo-3.1.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the apache/dubbo release dubbo-3.1.11, the release note includes enhancements to logs and the use of random id.

chunks.title: dubbo-3.2.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the apache/dubbo release dubbo-3.2.5, the release note includes features such as ByteAccessor support for customizing RpcResult, Resteasy filter and intercept support, rest protocol support for generic reflect type for collection, map and array json, and support for multi registries metrics key. Bug fixes address issues like consumer remoteApplication being null, server shutdown await timeout, service context early restore, updating minimal reconnect period, fixing shutdown timeout override, fixing invoker select in AdaptiveLoadBalance, using metric obj for key of LongContainer to fix split bug, fixing throw RejectedExecutionException in triple protocol, fixing reference bean not being init if deployer is early started, performance optimization, fixing digest thread safe bug, waiting executor terminated and removing some usage of default model, fixing deadlock when starting, the Response Filter and Response Interceptor handling exceptions, checking if initialized for ReferenceBean, writing the MediaType of Response in the result, fixing anyMethodParameter using consumer first, skipping warn if provider app and consumer app are the same, tag key remove error, fixing netty close when init count is 0, fixing compact with spring 3.2.x, removing -1 delay usage, removing applicationName in jvm metric, avoiding metric bug, putting all configs to application environment instead of override for spring properties, fixing when curatorWatch unwatch childListener is null, fixing dubbo provider lose when zookeeper restored to normal after network fluctuations, fixing multiple registry when namespace diff, fixing log level is null in Slf4j and not valid in Log4j2, fixing register failed if re-register service discovery, supporting real RpcException be thrown, and fixing rest re export path double. Code enhancements and dependency upgrades are also included.

chunks.title: dubbo-3.2.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the apache/dubbo release dubbo-3.2.6, the release note includes features such as generic call by gson support null args, support check if qos server is started, adds metrics initialization metrics for the service interface, and support ignore refresh config. Bug fixes address issues like memory leak, adding rest method annotation support judge, removing rest first match break, resteasy response context result support, fixing rest thread memory leak, fixing callback mode rpc context loss, fixing Spring Listener order, supporting keep running on spring closed with properties, fixing DubboMergingDigest concurrent issue, fixing triple npe, fixing http method pathmatcher, fixing chunkoutputstream chunksize exception, fixing injvm params error, fixing shouldReconnect check, fixing static directory metrics label, fixing serialize.allowlist not including SingletonMap, ignoring start if scope model is LifeCycleManagedExternally, cleaning up resource if qos start failed, and fixing Rest serializationException. Code enhancements and dependency upgrades are also included.

chunks.title: dubbo-3.2.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the apache/dubbo release dubbo-3.2.7, the release note includes features such as official support for JDK 21, support disable metrics init and sync, support service level metrics, and add metrics version compare to improve performance. Bug fixes address issues like fixing rest protocol NPE when using apache-http-client, fixing triple generic invoke, fixing AbortPolicyWithReport concurrency when collecting stack, updating jvalidator to support parameter name retrieval, fixing Jakarta exception being casted in ExceptionFilter, fixing qps time window unit, fixing ClassPool issue when multi-classloader, fixing Hessian Serializer Factory concurrent issue, and fixing invoker ignored to destroy when unlock failed. Code enhancements and dependency upgrades are also included.

chunks.title: dubbo-3.3.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the apache/dubbo release dubbo-3.3.0-beta.1, the release note announces the first beta release of the 3.3.x branch with exciting features. New features include a new Triple protocol fully compatible with gRPC while supporting direct access from cURL and browser, rest-style programming (Spring MVC and JAX-RS) and communication (application/json) support, a bunch of starters for easy dependency management when developing with Spring Boot (Zookeeper, Nacos, Sentinel, etc.), GraalVM Native Image support with Dubbo AOT, fully JDK 21 support and project loom thread model, and metrics and tracing improvement. The release also includes numerous changes related to GraalVM Native Image (Dubbo AOT), protocol (rest & triple), and other enhancements.

chunks.title: dubbo-3.2.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the apache/dubbo release dubbo-3.2.8, the release note includes features such as support heartbeat for triple protocol, Jboss @Form support, and multiple registry support service discovery. Bug fixes address issues like releasing ByteBuf when handle onData failed to prevent memory leak, fixing triple client stream executor, fixing RejectException, setting default value for accept in rest protocol, fixing wrong returnTypes for StubMethodDescriptor, fixing unable to receive go away frame, fixing triple method override, removing sync lock for lazy spring target to prevent dead lock, fixing MigrationRule changing when load consumer default value, fixing lowerCase header in rest protocol, fixing jackson deserialization not fail on unknown properties, fixing service key params when remove service instance listener, and fixing MappingListener override in ServiceDiscoveryRegistry. Code enhancements and dependency upgrades are also included.

chunks.title: dubbo-3.2.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the apache/dubbo release dubbo-3.2.9, the release note includes bug fixes such as fixing RegistryNotifier notify error when shutdown, fixing dubbo.enabled=false not work in actuator configurators, fixing async generic method metrics, fixing go away handler, and fixing generic type result copy in InjvmInvoker. Code enhancements and dependency upgrades are also included.

chunks.title: dubbo-3.2.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the apache/dubbo release dubbo-3.2.10, the release note includes a feature to move Kubernetes and xDS implementations to apache/dubbo-spi-extensions repo. Bug fixes address issues like fixing tri stub unary method overload, fixing listener hash code error, fixing issue of metadata only registered to one nacos namespace, fixing generic invoke failed for triple, fixing rest proxy double service method, fixing metrics service level config bug, fixing TriRpcStatus not implements Serializable, supporting exclude fastjson2 or hessian2 serialization dependencies, fixing streamobserver actual type, fixing SslServerTlsHandler#decode early return, and fixing potential NPE in Hessian2FactoryManager. Code enhancements and dependency upgrades are also included.

chunks.title: dubbo-3.2.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the apache/dubbo release dubbo-3.2.11, the release note includes enhancements such as DubboService annotation support custom serialization, support resteasy response status code, and support customize parameters for interface-level registration. Bug fixes address issues like fixing Chinese character decoding in rest protocol, fixing MultipleRegistry cache file error name, fixing AbortPolicyWithReport Semaphore lock not released, fixing MergeableClusterInvoker log issue, fixing protobuf class deep copy issue, fixing MethodKeyRt override and error enhance, fixing delay publish deadlock, fixing dubbo.tag override by consumer.tag in NacosRegistry, fixing StubMethodDescriptor generate issue, fixing proto package and java_package issue, fixing complete already exception, fixing dubbo-go link and rust language, fixing native demo logback dependency, and fixing memory leak in rest service and release the ByteBuf of the NettyHttpRequest field. Code enhancements, CI and tests enhancements, and dependency upgrades are also included.

chunks.title: dubbo-3.3.0-beta.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the apache/dubbo release dubbo-3.3.0-beta.2, the release note includes features such as removing jprotoc, adding support for running dubbo as a native image with nacos as the registry centre, RedisMetadataReport implementation, adding the system properties tool unified system configuration items, adding a new completion state to the deployer, removing grpc and grpc/reactive package from dubbo-compiler, supporting more content types for Triple protocol, and checking if protocol already found before going through ConsumerConfig. Bug fixes address issues like fixing wrong return types for StubMethodDescriptor, fixing DubboAutoConfiguration cannot be processed AOT in spring native image scenario, fixing reference bean create proxy with javassist in native, Triple Stub path compatibility, fixing potential npe of CodecUtils, dubbo triple&rest protocol convergence, fixing AotUtils StackOverflowError, fixing LengthFieldStreamingDecoder#bytesToInt parse error, and fixing obtaining remote application name on the server side. Code enhancements are also included.

chunks.title: dubbo-3.2.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the apache/dubbo release dubbo-3.2.12, the release note includes bug fixes such as refreshing valid invokers after connectivity check, fixing port unification issue in triple and dubbo protocol, fixing NPE in DefaultTypeBuilder, fixing ConsistentHashLoadBalance not base on arguments, fixing ModuleEnvironment#getDynamicGlobalConfiguration, fixing lazy property of serviceBeanDefinition to false, fixing URL issue, fixing RpcContext local address info get null on custom filter, fixing memory leak in ScopeBeanFactory, fixing add condition to match serviceKey in cd command, and fixing incorrect rest response header and demo double path error. Code enhancements and dependency upgrades are also included.

chunks.title: dubbo-3.2.13
