chunks.title: v3.2.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.2.7, the release includes bug fixes such as fixing OIDC config via secrets, addressing excessive ls-remote requests on monorepos with Auto Sync enabled apps, and allowing tar.gzip suffixes in compressed layer extraction. Dependency updates include updating golang to v1.25.6. Other work includes excluding testdata from sonar.exclusions.

chunks.title: v3.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.3.2, the release fixes the client-side apply migration issue that existed in v3.3.0 and v3.3.1 by using csapgrade to patch managedFields. It also instructs users to enable ClientSideApplyMigration. The upgrade notes emphasize enabling ServerSideApply=true for self-managed Argo CD installations and removing the temporary ClientSideApplyMigration=false remediation.

chunks.title: v3.3.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.3.3, the release aligns Argo CD's interpretation of K8s cluster version with Helm 3.19.0 behavior, requiring Application Sets with Cluster Generators to use the vMajor.Minor.Patch format. Bug fixes include correcting CNPG suspend/resume annotations, handling comma-separated hook annotations for PreDelete/PostDelete hooks, using note.drySha when available, fixing standard resource icons display, ensuring consistency of kubeversion with Helm version 3, and fixing multi-level cross-namespace hierarchy traversal for cluster-scoped resources.

chunks.title: v3.4.0-rc1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.4.0-rc1, the release aligns Argo CD's K8s cluster version interpretation with Helm 3.19.0. New features include adding a Health field to ApplicationSet status, optimizing appset controller performance for cluster secrets, an annotation to pause reconciliation for a specific cluster, configurable authorName/Email for hydration commits, appProject access in notification templates, UI enhancements like AppSet Slide Out Summary, annotation filtering, appset tree-view details page, appset list page and filters, hydrator support in app create panel and summary tab, application filter for operation status, custom User-Agent headers for Helm repository requests, ApplicationSet watch API, exposing K8S API client environment variables, and nmstate health checks.

chunks.title: v3.3.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.3.4, the release includes bug fixes for missing git-lfs installer checksum for ppc64le and skipping token refresh threshold parsing in unrelated components. Documentation clarifies cluster version change impact for ClusterGenerator, CMP Plugins and migration. Other work bumps otel-sdk.

chunks.title: v3.4.0-rc2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.4.0-rc2, the release adds support for wildcard glob patterns in Helm valueFiles. Bug fixes include showing RollingSync step clearly when labels match no step, adding .gitkeep to images dir, including _-prefixed dirs in embedded assets, and fixing stack overflow when processing circular ownerrefs in resource graph.

chunks.title: v3.4.0-rc3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.4.0-rc3, the release fixes find container logic for terminal, improves message on self-healing disabling panel, and addresses Hook resources not created at PostSync when configured with PreDelete PostDelete hooks. Dependency updates bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.79.2 to 1.79.3.

chunks.title: v3.3.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.3.5, the release includes bug fixes for showing RollingSync step clearly, adding .gitkeep to images dir, fixing find container logic for terminal, improving self-healing disabling panel message, including _-prefixed dirs in embedded assets, fixing Hook resources not created at PostSync with PreDelete PostDelete hooks, and fixing stack overflow with circular ownerrefs. Dependency updates bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.77.0 to 1.79.3. Other work tests against k8s 1.35.0.

chunks.title: v3.1.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.1.13, the release includes bug fixes for showing RollingSync step clearly and mitigation of grpc-go CVE-2026-33186. Dependency updates bump lodash from 4.17.21 to 4.17.23. Other work uses base ref for cherry-pick PRs.

chunks.title: v3.2.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.2.8, the release includes bug fixes for showing RollingSync step clearly, controller incorrectly detecting diff during app normalization, and mitigation of grpc-go CVE-2026-33186. Other work uses base ref for cherry-pick PRs.

chunks.title: v3.4.0-rc4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.4.0-rc4, the release fixes controller incorrectly detecting diff during app normalization and wrong installation id returned from cache.

chunks.title: v3.3.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.3.6, the release fixes controller incorrectly detecting diff during app normalization and wrong installation id returned from cache.

chunks.title: v3.2.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.2.9, the release notes a potential bug with application reconciliation where the application controller may fail to refresh applications. Bug fixes include running yarn install with --frozen-lockfile, fixing OCI revision metadata rendering, and preventing automatic refreshes from informer resync and status updates. Dependency updates bump fast-xml-parser and notifications-engine dependency.

chunks.title: v3.1.14
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.1.14, the release notes a potential bug with application reconciliation. Bug fixes include running yarn install with --frozen-lockfile and preventing automatic refreshes from informer resync and status updates. Dependency updates bump fast-xml-parser.

chunks.title: v3.3.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.3.7, the release notes a potential bug with application reconciliation. Bug fixes include improving performance by switching parentUIDToChildren to map of sets, running yarn install with --frozen-lockfile, reducing secret deepcopies, fixing manifest path in Source Hydrator docs, ensuring OIDC config is refreshed at server restart, fixing OCI revision metadata rendering, handling 401 error in stream, adding X-Frame-Options and CSP headers to Swagger UI endpoints, forcing attempt http2 with custom tls config, passing repo.insecure flag to helm dependency build, preventing automatic refreshes, triggering app sync on app-set spec change, using force flag in copyutil symlink, and using unique names for initial commits.

chunks.title: v3.4.0-rc5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.4.0-rc5, the release notes a potential bug with application reconciliation. Bug fixes include improving performance by switching parentUIDToChildren to map of sets, running yarn install with --frozen-lockfile, reducing secret deepcopies, fixing manifest path in Source Hydrator docs, fixing hook code issues causing stuck applications on Deleting state, preserving all source type fields in GetDrySource(), ensuring OIDC config is refreshed at server restart, fixing OCI revision metadata rendering, handling 401 error in stream, adding X-Frame-Options and CSP headers to Swagger UI endpoints, forcing attempt http2 with custom tls config, passing repo.insecure flag to helm dependency build, and preventing automatic refreshes.

chunks.title: v3.1.15
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.1.15, the release reverts the fix for preventing automatic refreshes from informer resync and status updates, and fixes application controller in core mode failing to sync when server.secretkey is missing.

chunks.title: v3.2.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.2.10, the release reverts the fix for preventing automatic refreshes, fixes application controller in core mode failing to sync when server.secretkey is missing, uses DrySource revision for app diff/manifests with sourceHydrator, avoids stale informer cache in RevisionMetadata handler, and reverts autosync event message format change.

chunks.title: v3.4.0-rc6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.4.0-rc6, the release reverts the fix for preventing automatic refreshes, uses DrySource revision for app diff/manifests with sourceHydrator, avoids stale informer cache in RevisionMetadata handler, removes resourceVersion from ssd, and reverts autosync event message format change.

chunks.title: v3.3.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.3.8, the release reverts the fix for preventing automatic refreshes, fixes application controller in core mode failing to sync when server.secretkey is missing, changes appset resource status count to 5000 by default, uses DrySource revision for app diff/manifests with sourceHydrator, avoids stale informer cache in RevisionMetadata handler, and reverts autosync event message format change.

chunks.title: v3.2.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.2.11, the release contains a security fix to a critical vulnerability (GHSA-3v3m-wc6v-x4x3). Bug fixes include avoiding error when attempting a second delete operation, handling 401 error in stream, and preventing pod logs viewer crash on stale container index. Dependency updates bump SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action. Other work includes a merge commit from fork.

chunks.title: v3.3.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.3.9, the release contains a security fix to a critical vulnerability (GHSA-3v3m-wc6v-x4x3). Bug fixes include avoiding error when attempting a second delete operation, preventing pod logs viewer crash on stale container index, fixing ApplicationSet DuckType Generator panic on non-string values, and putting/getting ocimetadata to/from redis cache. Documentation fixes progressive sync since version. Dependency updates bump SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action and go version. Other work includes a merge commit from fork.

chunks.title: v3.4.0-rc7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.4.0-rc7, the release fixes application controller in core mode failing to sync when server.secretkey is missing, avoids error when attempting a second delete operation, prevents pod logs viewer crash on stale container index, fixes ApplicationSet DuckType Generator panic on non-string values, fixes missing import, and puts/gets ocimetadata to/from redis cache. Documentation fixes progressive sync since version. Dependency updates bump SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action. Other work includes a merge commit from fork.

chunks.title: v3.1.16
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.1.16, this is the final release of the 3.1 series, reaching end of life on May 06th 2026. Bug fixes include avoiding error when attempting a second delete operation. Dependency updates bump SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action.

chunks.title: v3.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.4.1, this is the first release in the 3.4 series. It aligns Argo CD's K8s cluster version interpretation with Helm 3.19.0. Features include adding Health field to ApplicationSet status, optimizing appset controller performance, annotation to pause reconciliation for a specific cluster, wildcard glob patterns for Helm valueFiles, configurable authorName/Email for hydration commits, appProject access in notification templates, UI enhancements (AppSet Slide Out Summary, annotation filtering, appset tree-view details page, appset list page and filters, hydrator support in app create panel and summary tab), application filter for operation status, custom User-Agent headers for Helm repository requests, ApplicationSet watch API, exposing K8S API client environment variables, and nmstate health checks.

chunks.title: v3.4.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.4.2, the release reverts a fix for avoiding calling UpdateRevisionForPaths unnecessarily, prevents panic on nil APIResource in permission validator, bumps github.com/moby/spdystream, includes merge commits from fork, bumps otel/sdk to 1.43.0, pins images of setup-qemu-action, setup-buildx-action and goreleaser CLI version, and applies HideSecretData to server-side diff results for Secrets.

chunks.title: v3.3.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.3.10, the release prevents panic on nil APIResource in permission validator, fixes wrap lines toggle causing log lines to overflow container, includes merge commits from fork, aligns Go versions across Dockerfiles, bumps otel/sdk to 1.43.0, updates Go to 1.25.9, and applies HideSecretData to server-side diff results for Secrets.

chunks.title: v3.2.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.2.12, the release fixes unnecessary nesting lint, exports url validation function, fixes wrap lines toggle causing log lines to overflow container, bumps github.com/moby/spdystream, and includes merge commits from fork.

chunks.title: v3.4.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.4.3, the release fixes 'app wait' to return immediately when app is already in desired state, fixes unnecessary nesting lint, prevents prefetch errors in UI, returns full source for non-hydrator apps in Parameters tab, honors repo depth setting in gitSourceHasChanges and fetch functions, adds nil-check, prevents InvalidSpecError race in application controller startup, truncates labels for deletion hook resources, bumps redoc/dompurify to v3.4.0, and fixes nil pointer dereference error in removeWebookMutation().

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the argoproj/argo-cd release v3.3.11, the release fixes unnecessary nesting lint, prevents prefetch errors in UI, adds nil-check, prevents InvalidSpecError race in application controller startup, removes resourceVersion from ssd, truncates labels for deletion hook resources, bumps redoc/dompurify to v3.4.0, and fixes nil pointer dereference error in removeWebookMutation().

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent aristocratos/btop release stream from v1.1.0 through v1.4.7, covering OS support additions, GPU monitoring, new themes, and numerous bug fixes.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.1.0) OSX Support
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.1.0, the project adds support for OSX, contributed by @joske and @aristocratos.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.1.1) OSX build fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.1.1, the project adds partial static build (libgcc, libstdc++) for macOS, switches continuous build macOS to OSX 11.6 (Big Sur) and partial static build, and switches release binaries for macOS to OSX 12 (Monterey) and partial static build.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.1.2) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.1.2, the project fixes a SIGSEGV on macOS Mojave, small optimizations and fixes to Mem::collect() and Input::get(), wrong unit for net_upload and net_download in config menu, UTF-8 detection on macOS, coretemp iteration due to missing tempX_input, and coretemp ordering.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.1.3) New themes + bugfixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.1.3, the project adds new themes ayu, gruvbox_dark_v2, and OneDark, fixes macOS CPU coretemp for Intel, fixes network graph scale int rollover, and fixes a suspected possibility of very rare stall in Input::clear().

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.1.4) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.1.4, the project fixes creation of dependency files in build directory when compiling, fixes CPU temp fallback on macOS, changes from rng::sort() to rng::stable_sort() for more stability, and fixes in_avail() can always be zero.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.0) FreeBSD Support
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.0, the project adds support for FreeBSD, fixes (again) accounting for system rolling over net speeds in Net::collect(), adds theme gruvbox_material_dark, and adds option for base 10 bytes/bits.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.1) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.1, the project adds arrow only after use of "f" when filtering processes, fixes Fx::uncolor not removing all escapes, fixes text alignment for popup boxes, fixes terminal resize warning getting stuck, removes unnecessary counter for atomic_lock, adds percentage progress to Makefile, fixes alignment of columns in proc box when wide UTF8 characters are used, and fixes battery meter draw.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.2) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.2, the project reverts uncolor() back to using regex to fix delay in opening menu when compiled with musl, adds toggle for showing free disk space for privileged or normal users, and adds clarification on signal screen that number can be manually entered.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.3) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.3, the project changes floating_humanizer() to show fractions when shortened and value is < 10, fixes process tree not redrawing properly, and fixes string to wstring conversion crash when string is too big.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.4) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.4, the project optimizes Proc::draw(), fixes ignoring duplicate disks with same mountpoint, changes restriction of command line for processes to 1000 characters to fix utf8 conversion errors, and adds "g" and "G" to vim keys.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.5) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.5, the project fixes fallback to less accurate UTF8 char count if conversion to wstring fails, fixes small UI fixes for mem and disks, adds new theme HotPurpleTrafficLight, fixes title_left symbol between auto and zero in the net box not displayed, and fixes mouse mappings for net box.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.6) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.6, the project fixes wrong memory unit when shorten and size is less than 10, fixes use of CPU cores average temp if missing CPU package temp for FreeBSD, and changes enter symbol to a more common variant.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.7) Bug fixes & new features
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.7, the project fixes disk IO stats for individual partitions instead of whole disk (Linux), adds case insensitive process filtering, adds inclusion of ZFS ARC in cached/available memory on Linux, adds desktop entry and icons, fixes net sync scale bug, and adds tokyo-night & tokyo-storm themes.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.8) New features & themes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.8, the project adds support for ZFS pool IO stats monitoring, adds filtering of kernel processes, adds new theme everforest-dark-hard, adds new theme tomorrow-night, and changes to disable battery monitoring if it fails instead of exiting.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.9) Bug fixes + new features and themes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.9, the project fixes memory values not clearing properly when not in graph mode in mem box, changes kyli0x theme color update, adds Elementarish theme, adds key "?" to see help, adds solarized_light theme, changes to make ZFS stats collection compatible with zfs_pools_only option, rewrites process sorting and tree generation including fixes for tree sorting and mouse support, adds option to hide the small CPU graphs for processes, changes small graphs to show colors for each character, and fixes getting selfpath on macOS (fix for finding theme folder).

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.10) Bug fixes, cleanup + a new theme
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.10, the project fixes process tree filtering not case insensitive, adds Paper theme, fixes extra checks to avoid crash on trying to replace empty strings in tree mode, fixes crashing when cores are offline, fixes Cpu::collect() core count counter, changes to using sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_CONF) for number of cores instead of sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN), and performs code cleanup.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.11) Quick fix for number of cores detection
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.11, the project fixes number of cores wrongly detected for Ryzen in rare cases.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.12) Bug fix
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.12, the project adds dynamic updating of max number of CPU cores.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.2.13) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.2.13, the project adds VERBOSE=true flag for Makefile to display all compiler commands and fixes display of already set CXXFLAGS and LDFLAGS, adds autodetection for gcc12 to make compiling on macOS Ventura easier, reverts back to sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN) for CPU core count and lets the new dynamic update fix if cores are turned on later, fixes ignoring disks that fail in statvfs64() to avoid slowdowns and possible crashes, moves up get_cpuHz() in the execution order to get better CPU clock reading, adds proc tree view: if there's more than 40 width left, try to print full cmd, fixes showing the first IP of the interface in NET box instead of the last, replaces getnameinfo with inet_ntop on Linux, fixes not picking up last username from /etc/passwd, fixes process nice value underflowing, replaces getnameinfo with inet_ntop on FreeBSD, replaces getnameinfo with inet_ntop on macOS, and changes release packages folder structure so all files are now contained in btop folder.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.3.0) GPU Support Linux and platform support OpenBSD
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.3.0, the project adds GPU support for Linux, adds platform support for OpenBSD, enables macOS clang, fixes Apple Silicon CPUs misprinted, adds CMake support for macOS, updates Elementarish theme color according to Elementary palette, adds alternative key codes for Delete, Insert, Home, End, fixes scrollbar not clearing sometimes, adds keybind for toggling memory display mode in PROC box, makes minor string initialization improvement, makes disks statvfs logic asynchronous, fixes signal list on non-linux/weird linux platforms, adds option to accumulate a child's resources in parent in tree-view, adds CMake support for Linux, adds Horizon theme, fixes short conversion of 1000-1023 *iB, fixes integer overflows in btop_collect.cpp, supports compiling with LLVM, fixes getting zfs pool name with '.' char in freebsd, supports gcc13 on macOS/FreeBSD, adds FreeBSD swap info, creates adwaita.theme, tries to get terminal size of "/dev/tty" if stdout fails, adds refresh rate program argument, improves error handling when determining the config directory, uses native POSIX polling syscalls to read input, and conditionally compiles on Big Sur and up.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.3.1) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.3.1, the project adds support for dynamic loading of ROCm v6 libraries for GPU, increases max network interface name to 15, fixes OpenBSD UTF-8 locale detection, adds hot-reloading of config file with CTRL+R or SIGUSR2 signal, adds battery power draw for Linux and FreeBSD, fixes crash caused by string exception when CPU clock is exactly between 999.5 and 999.9 MHz, writes newline at end of config file, adds theme based on Everforest Dark Medium palette, fixes not mangling memory for zombie processes, shares common code from collect, and fixes incorrect used and available memory for OSX.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.3.2) Hotfix GPU support AMD ROCm v6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.3.2, the project fixes inability to detect librocm 6.0.x.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.4.0) Intel GPU support & NetBSD support
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.4.0, the project adds NetBSD support, adds Intel GPU support, adds warnings when toggling boxes and terminal size is too small, fixes missing core percentages, fixes various drawing of GPU related information, fixes divide by zero error when calculating disk usage percentage, fixes io_graph_speeds parsing, adds V1 of Phoenix Night theme, fixes missing CPU core temps when too small to show core temp graphs, fixes missing IO graphs in IO mode, fixes zero temp, fixes comments parsing in theme files, adds regex filtering, fixes typo in file existence check for voltage_now, shows time in days when remaining battery exceeds an estimation of 24h, fixes AMD GPU pwr_usage not being defined correctly during rsmi collection, fixes macOS crash if there exists a uid not associated with any user, fixes rsmi device name buffer size, adds gruvbox_light theme, creates man page for btop in Markdown, includes metadata in binary version output, and fixes reading of battery power draw on Linux.

chunks.title: btop++ v1.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.4.1, the project includes various code fixes, fixes a typo, moves the config parser into its own module, adds a menu option to show bitrates in base 10 separate from the setting to show bytes/bits in base 10, allows MidnightBSD to build btop using the existing FreeBSD support, uses XDG_STATE_HOME to save logs, bumps CMake version to 3.25 required for LINUX variable, replaces brackets with arrows in net and proc box, bumps bundled fmt to 11.1.4, links to CMAKE_DL_LIBS in cmake, fixes phoenix-night.theme marked as executable, adds Kanagawa-lotus and Kanagawa-wave themes, bumps NetBSD version to 10.1 and FreeBSD version to 14.2, adds dark version of adwaita theme: adwaita-dark, resets last selection on page navigation in optionsMenu to avoid unordered_map error, shares the CPU name trimming code between platforms, updates Ryzen name trimming, drops macOS 12 build and adds v14 and v15, fixes cmake-macos workflow, bumps version of deprecated upload-artifact step, updates obsolete egrep call, fixes menu crash when GPU_SUPPORT=false, adds 'Everforest Light Medium' theme, supports Intel GPUs before Gen-6 (patch from upstream), fixes SEGFAULT in intel_name_lookup_shim.c, fixes rsmi_measure_pcie_speeds not saving, and shows GPU Watt fractions when below 100W.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.4.2) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.4.2, the project fixes process arguments appearing outside proc box by replacing ASCII control codes with blankspace, fixes problems shown by clang-tidy's performance checks, fixes wrong error message and documentation of renamed option --utf-force, flattens cmake module path, removes option to use mold in CMake, updates Terminus font link and fixes typo/spelling/grammar, pleases clang with sanitizers, fixes macOS tree-mode + aggregate memory/thread scaling issue, and fixes typo Mhz -> MHz.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.4.3) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.4.3, the project reverts a commit which broke str_to_upper() and str_to_lower(), enables additional checks in libc++ with the new hardening mode, removes redundant optimization flag, and ignores incomplete filter regex.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.4.4) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.4.4, the project fixes auto-detection of CPU temp on Ampere boards, fixes floating_humanizer() to work correctly when numeric delimiter isn't a dot, adds command line option to set an initial filter, makes 100ms the minimal refresh rate and exits gracefully if integer conversion in CLI parser fails, locks/unlocks config to avoid infinite recursion, fixes incorrect positioning and start symbol of second title, and fixes dangling reference warnings for GCC 13 and later.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.4.5) Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.4.5, the project bumps bundled fmt to 12.0.0, enables vim movement in help menu, removes redundant symbols in tree view, uses /sys/dev/block/MAJOR:MINOR instead of /sys/block/NAME for disk I/O, displays CPU power draw and fixes GPU+load avg overwriting core info, fixes locale issues, adds encode and decode meters on Nvidia GPUs, adds battery time-to-full on Linux, converts ascii escape codes in mountpoint names before reading statvfs, fixes presets erroring with gpu* usage, and fixes --tty/--no-tty flag having no effect.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.4.6) New features & Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.4.6, the project skips 'H' and 'HX' suffix in AMD CPU name trimming, adds process renice functionality, reverts a disk I/O change, introduces CPU frequency display modes, fixes CPU frequency detection for LoongArch CPUs, fixes arrow keys that send 'O' instead of '[', adds OpenBSD battery support for watthour and watts sensors, adds Gotham theme, fixes macOS deadlocks and race conditions in collector threads, fixes btop crash on ARM CPU, adds ability to set which GPU vendors to enable, adds tree toggle of expand/collapse for children of process, uses right key codes to match F1 and F2 keys, handles missing SMC gracefully on macOS, fixes redraw in proc list when changing sort order, fixes load average and GPU watts leaking past box border, respects effective CPUs from cgroup, displays container engine, raises C++ standard to C++23, adds configuration toggle for terminal synchronization, implements process list pausing, flips name/command/user sorting, fixes tty theme for pause banner, adds test harness with ctest, fixes skipping first argument of argv, adds --themes-dir flag, fixes over-/underflow when parsing --update argument, fixes segfault on musl systems, passes only static duration strings to Config::set in Config::apply_preset, fixes CPU per-thread totals not reaching 100%, aligns boxes when CPU bottom and GPU on, includes minor fixes and improvements for NetBSD, fixes GPU rendering, always collects GPU data when cpu_graph_lower = "Auto", fixes humanized units shortening, adds mouse dragging of scrollbar, adds CLI option to dump default config, and adds "save_config_on_exit" option to configuration.

chunks.title: btop++ (v1.4.7) New features & Bug fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aristocratos/btop release v1.4.7, the project adds process following and following mode improvements, adds Apple Silicon GPU support via IOReport API, adds Kanagawa Dragon theme, adds twilight theme, adds swap upload/download speed graph option and fixes network graphs overlap, adds Flexoki dark and light themes, adds menu option to disable presets, creates orange.theme, adds E hotkey to collapse/expand all processes in tree mode, fixes restoring Apple Silicon temp reporting on M2 Pro, fixes regression from a switch to kIOMainPortDefault, fixes hide and info buttons, fixes mouse mapping for process kill buttons with vim keys enabled, fixes kill buttons, fixes following mode, fixes and improves pause and follow modes, removes unused asprintf implementation function, removes busy waiting when checking runner thread state, updates clock with preset change or show/hide box, tweaks RX/TX collection and drawing and fixes -Wparentheses warning, fixes mem bottom border when net is not shown, fixes force_tty menu option sets TTY mode on start, fixes accumulating pwr_usage into pwr_total instead of mem_total in Gpu::collect(), fixes reading GPU/VRAM clocks when ROCm SMI reports version 1.x, fixes rendering non-ascii chars in proc list, fixes CPU mib queries for OpenBSD and only displays online CPUs in output, fixes correctly mapping AMD Zen CPU core temps, fixes restoring Intel Mac CPU temperature fallback, fixes using SVG features compatible with Qt SVG Tiny 1.1, updates widechar detection and fixes replace_ascii_control() removing wide characters, fixes CPU watt overflow in CPU box and division by zero fix for cpu.temp_max, and fixes missing CPU package temperature color (numeric value).

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent aseprite/aseprite release stream from v1.3.3 through v1.3.18-beta3, covering bug fixes, new features like the Text tool and dockable UI, Lua API enhancements, and platform-specific improvements.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.3, the update includes fixes for recovering old crashed sessions with sprites containing slices, unified menu indication text, several sync issues locking the sprite correctly in scripts, a division by zero prevention for grid bounds, a crash fix for Alt+T to Alt+V, prevention of setting slider ranges with min > max, adding the user directory as the first path to search for the tags palette, fixing the built-in file selector's file list layout to avoid horizontal scrolling, removing the 'Pixel-perfect' checkbox from the Spray Tool, fixing how separators are added into dialog tabs, fixing wrong edges on Brush Preview in Tilemap Mode, adding an option to play subtags and repetitions when exporting animations, avoiding exposing doc::frames types to the global namespace, fixing tabs ID handling in the scripting engine, allowing selection of how opacity/alpha values are displayed, fixing HSV/HSL values on ColorSliders, and fixing exporting one tag without 'play subtags/repeats' and changing its animation direction.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.4, the update adds the possibility to use Edit > Paste on the Home tab to create a new image from clipboard content, fixes identifying running Aseprite processes correctly to recover crashed sessions, and fixes a critical Lua bug running commands and other functions inside transactions.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.5, the update drops selection when hiding a layer to fix issues moving hidden layers, fixes the slice tool when used in tilemap layers and Manual mode, fixes a crash exporting one frame animation of a ping-pong tag, adds a new -noinapp option for the Steam version to avoid showing 'in game' status, removes verbosity in the Aseprite description on Windows, writes smaller palettes in .aseprite files if possible, fixes crashes using some broken themes, and fixes several crashes when there is no more enough memory.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.6, the update adds new Afrikaans, Arabic, Dutch, Japanese, and Turkish translations, fixes some random crashes when resizing sprites, fixes a bug updating the correct copy+move cursor in the timeline, makes minor UI improvements in File > Export > Export As dialog, disables Windows Ink feedback when clicking on Windows, fixes the Aseprite icon of the main window when Windows is configured with 175% or 125% DPI, fixes title bar flickering selecting menus and dialogs on Windows, fixes picking colors from desktop outside the main window on Linux/X11, fixes a bug where sometimes key modifiers (Ctrl, Alt, Shift) kept stuck on Linux/X11, and includes PRs fixing copy+move cursor icon bug and crashes with SpriteJob(s) that weren't locking the doc correctly.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.7, the update allows backslash in filenames on Linux and macOS, fixes nested ping-pong tags, fixes wrong alignment between mouse and sensor threshold position, fixes painting with right-click with custom brush paints with background color, and adds Lua API enhancements: new app.os object, added recent parameter to SaveFile/ExportSpriteSheet commands to avoid adding the file to the list of recent files, disables progress bar in commands that can receive ui=false, fixes bugs handling errors inside app.transaction(), fixes return values of os.execute(), and asks permissions for io.popen()/lines()/input()/output() functions.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.8, the update fixes crashes using flood fill algorithm in a large canvas, fixes a couple of bugs restoring backup sessions, disables mouse stabilizer while previewing a straight line, fixes a crash when previewing a sprite sheet export when selecting an empty layer group located at the bottom of the layer stack, fixes CounCountour Tool pixel perfect not working after a straight line, uses ui::Style* instead of strings in ButtonSet::addItem(), fixes crashing segfault when calling app.command.CloseFile() or app.command.GotoPreviousTab() in --batch mode, adds a new CLI param to save animations taking into account subtabs and repeats, updates zlib to 1.3.1, adds -list-layer-hierarchy CLI option, shows format within filename when exporting file, fixes mipmaps options when downsampling, fixes crashes with ill-formed fmt format strings, refactors app::DocFormat to doc::SerialFormat, doesn't clone strings repository by default, fixes slice order in File > Export > Export As > Area, adds help button '?' in some windows, fixes size calculation on resize_image, ignores any third-party theme that uses 'default' as ID, adds needed libwebP as a dependency on Arch Linux, adds new frame menu to status bar button, adds opacity field when exporting a cell, fixes indentation in MacOS (Apple Silicon) install instructions, improves phrasing for Tileset image data length, resets mask when clicking outside of bounds with the magic wand tool, and avoids div by zero by preventing returning a grid bounds with zero width or height (take 2).

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.8.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.8.1, the update avoids loading current dithering matrix on each mouse move, fixes the New Frame button in the status bar for existing third-party themes, fixes saving files to network paths on Windows, and fixes File > Export > Export As when exporting files to other drive on Windows.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.9, the update adds new Hungarian, Norwegian Nynorsk, Thai, and Ukrainian translations, improves performance in the 'Recover Files' tab, adds 'Don't show this alert again' when saving WebP files, adds a new 'Reset' page in Edit > Preferences, adds a new 'Reset Symmetry to View Center' option, adds new criterias to match similar RGB colors with color palette entries, fixes 'Merge Down' command when the merged cels have a special z-index, fixes a bug where we weren't able to uninstall third party extensions, fixes transparent color bugs converting between RGB <-> Indexed conversion, fixes moving multiple tilemap layers at the same time, fixes right click action with shading ink is selected, fixes a bug where the first mouse click after a Ctrl+Z was ignored if we had Ctrl key configured to drag the 'Brush Size', fixes duplicate items in keyboard shortcuts list, fixes CLI exporting Sprite Sheet with group names, and adds Lua API enhancements: new app.fgTile/bgTile properties, added Site.tilemapMode property, added x and y params to app.command.Paste(), fixed app.command.Cut/Paste in -batch mode, fixed app.command.Cancel() command when used from scripts, and fixed default color/bgColor params in app.useTool().

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.9.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.9.1, the update fixes a regression breaking linked cels on 'Merge Down' and fixes transparency issues with new color criterias.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.10, the update publishes HD icons, adds support for JPEG image orientation adjustment from EXIF metadata, disables Brush Preview in Preview window by default, snaps cels to grid on moving cel action, fixes slice tool when we are in tiles mode, fixes bug copying/moving cels with z-index, fixes issues with windows visibility when changing between 'Home' tab and sprites, fixes Duplicate Sprite/Layer didn't duplicate z-indexes, fixes mouse issues making hard to resize floating windows, fixes UI issue scaling brush type icons, fixes crash clicking 'Hide Other Layers' when there is no preview window, and adds Lua API enhancements: updates API version to 30, adds app.editor.zoom/scroll properties, and adds new option (Dialog:show{ hand=true }) to enable Hand tool in the active editor with a modal dialog.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.11-beta1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.11-beta1, the update introduces a new Text tool with T key, new diagonal symmetry, new drop files on timeline to import files as layers/frames/cels (works on Windows and macOS), adds 'Transform' checkbox to move slices with its content, adds experimental compose layer groups separately from all other layers, groups buttons in the toolbar when the window is too small, duplicates tilemaps correctly when Sprite > Duplicate, replaces jpeglib with libjpeg-turbo to load/save JPEG files, provides better text rendering using Skia (DirectWrite on Windows, Core Text on macOS), and adds Lua API enhancements: added GraphicsContext for images (Image.context property), and added ui/flatten/filename parameters to app.command.DuplicateSprite command.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.10.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.10.1, the update fixes window flickering using 'Disable Snap to Grid' button and fixes a broken Lua Dialog:show{ bounds=Rectangle } API.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.11-beta2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.11-beta2, the update fixes a crash dropping files on timeline in certain cases, fixes a crash clicking the canvas when multiple layers/frames were selected in the timeline and the Edit > Preferences > Timeline > Keep Selection option was enabled, fixes some theme related problems with the font popup, and minimizes crashes related to buggy WinTab drivers on Windows.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.11, the update adds columns and rows fields to Import Sprite Sheet, shows grid cell index in status bar, fixes empty Edit > Keyboard Shortcuts > Action Modifiers list, fixes recent files/folders repeating items, fixes reverting layer changes after locking it, fixes some UI issues with the timeline and toolbar, fixes clicking window close button when the title overlaps it, fixes Magic Wand in Tiled Mode, fixes showing the main window back when the app is hidden on macOS, and adds Lua API enhancements: updates API version to 31, fixes cel.image = nil statement, and adds ui param to app.command.MaskByColor.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.12-beta1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.12-beta1, the update adds a new 'Apply' button in effects, adds new options to Edit > Preferences > Reset: reset window positions & brushes, fixes a crash dropping a file as layers and then undoing, avoids app hang when dropping some files on the timeline, fixes a crash displaying the Preview window in multiple windows, fixes artifacts when moving the cursor, fixes a crash when dropping files and a modal dialog is open, and adds Lua API enhancements: new beforesitechange event, and new plugin.version and plugin.displayName properties.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.12, the update converts View > Preview > Brush Preview as a global option, fixes skew with pivot on right side of selection, and fixes saving tileset correctly from loaded .aseprite file changes after color remap.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.13-beta1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.13-beta1, the update adds a new field to write output file names in File > Export options with relative or absolute paths, fixes a crash applying filters when the final result is empty, fixes a bug with floating cursor/eraser brush edges after closing a sprite in some cases, resets FXs window position when we reset the preferences, includes changes in v1.3.12, and adds Lua API enhancements: new app.clipboard API.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.13, the update fixes 'Saturation' blend mode for layers, fixes drawing semi-transparent slices on the canvas, fixes straight line via Shift + click on Tiled mode and tilemaps on manual mode, fixes onionskin bug switching layer visibility, fixes crash rendering sprites with custom pixel ratios, fixes timeline thumbnails to use the full available space, and adds Lua API enhancements: updates API version to 32, doesn't allow to set invalid pixel ratios for sprites, and fixes Image:drawImage() when BlendMode.SRC is used.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.14-beta1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.14-beta1, the update adds possibility to customize theme fonts from Edit > Preferences > Fonts, adds possibility to create (and save in .aseprite files) a UUID for each layer, adds Edit > Preferences > Aseprite Format options to save .aseprite files without compression if needed, fixes multiple crashes with filter dialogs (Replace Color, Color Adjustments, etc.), includes changes in v1.3.13, and adds Lua API enhancements: added fitCriteria parameter to app.command.ChangePixelFormat command.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.14
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.14 (tag v1.3.14.2), the update includes multiple sub-releases: v1.3.14.4 fixes timeline thumbnails with semi-transparent colors, GIF animations with semi-transparent colors, crash rendering empty text in certain UI elements, edge-case detecting old sessions to be recovered, and separation between text and suffix in UI text fields; v1.3.14.3 brings back Windows Vista/7 compatibility, exports user & extension defined properties, improves SVG output merging similar pixels, fixes pivot movement when dragging a selection with Alt key to snap to grid, fixes bug/font baseline alignment news items/file list items when multiple fonts/emojis are needed, fixes crashes when a big font size is specified for the Aseprite font, and updates Lua API version to 34 with events to listen to blendMode, name, opacity and visibility Sprite layer changes; v1.3.14.2 fixes double-clicking/dropping an .aseprite-extension file to install it, fixes the default font size for CJK and other translations, fixes bug with third-party themes using odd size values for the Aseprite font, fixes some crashes using the font search capability with the Text tool, and adds possibility to disable hinting for theme ttf/otf fonts; v1.3.14.1 fixes dithering options using Sprite > Color Mode > Indexed and fixes crash switching between Grayscale/Indexed options, and fixes crash when default font is not available or invalid; v1.3.14 adds pin icon to the Palette presets with performance improvements, adds a way to change default Timeline options, adds option to switch font hinting, adds support to scale sprite sheet fonts, better support to use system fonts from themes, adds missing Esperanto accents, includes startup optimizations, prevents polling keyboard state for each message, improves performance loading list of fonts, and improves performance resizing dialogs.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.15
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.15 (tag v1.3.15.4), the update includes multiple sub-releases: v1.3.15.5 adds Ignore empty frames toggle to File > Export > Export As, improves rotated rectangles and square brushes, fixes small graphical bug when dragging cels, fixes creating a copy rotating selection (CW/CCW) when we associate these commands with a shortcut including Ctrl modifier, fixes export file window not starting out centered, fixes some Brush Preview visual traces when canvas is zoomed out, fixes Move tool with Auto Select Layer when the composition of groups is enabled, makes Steam -batch arg have the same effect as -noinapp, fixes thumbnails for macOS Sequoia, fixes regression pasting DIB bitmaps from old Windows programs, adds compatibility to paste 1bpp and 4bpp bitmaps from clipboard, and updates Lua API version to 37 with fixes for setting window bounds when the app is closing, centering a dialog with autoscrollbars behavior, WebSocket error param to onreceive handler, and fixed app.clipboard.content.selection property; v1.3.15.4 fixes random crashes applying filters (Replace Color, Outline, etc.), fixes crash with certain scripts pasting images with an empty selection, fixes crash dropping certain images, and fixes mouse gestures not working after switching tabs; v1.3.15.3 fixes UI theme colors to match theme color space, context matching and prioritization using keyboard shortcuts, fixes Color Management issues, and updates Lua API version to 36 with enclose key names for plugin preferences; v1.3.15.2 fixes arrow keys to move selection, fixes close button in popup window, and fixes pivot position when Tiled Mode is enabled; v1.3.15.1 reverts Esc key behavior to drop pixels + deselect, adds options to reconfigure keys to apply/cancel the transformation, and adds slices copy & paste.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.16-beta
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.16-beta (tag v1.3.16-beta2), the update includes multiple sub-releases: v1.3.16-beta3 adds IME support on text fields on Windows, adds a new external process to show Open/Save File dialog on Windows to avoid crashes, and includes changes from Aseprite v1.3.15.5; v1.3.16-beta2 includes changes from Aseprite v1.3.15.4; v1.3.16-beta1 adds 'Run Command' window (press Ctrl+Space) featuring Aseprite's command search, input of math expressions, inline Lua script evaluation, adds UI customization by making all elements on screen dockable/movable/resizable, and adds Lua API enhancements: added 'ui' parameter to all commands for enabling/disabling user interaction through their dialogs.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.16
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.16, the update adds possibility to search commands by its keyboard shortcut, adds key bindable 'Solo Layer' command, adds new option on Windows to associate any kind of file with the running instance of Aseprite and customize how to see thumbnails on File Explorer, fixes selection in text fields with special fonts, fixes HSL+ and HSV+ filters with mask color, fixes UI bug in Keyboard Shortcuts with the 'Add' button in other languages, fixes bug starting to drag the color palette after picking a new ink, fixes bug selecting a recent/pinned folder to export with relative paths, fixes crash due big font sizes, fixes dragged tabs lingering when executing commands, fixes several issues with multiple screens, fixes crash using Select Used/Unused Colors when there is a pixel out of bounds, fixes crash with Lasso tool + pixel perfect + new selection, and adds Lua API enhancements: updates API version to 38, new behavior that property changes outside a transaction don't generate undo steps, new behavior that layer flag changes inside a transaction generate undo steps, avoids clicking an invalid button after a new window is displayed, doesn't reset dialog bounds after Dialog:show{autoscrollbars} when dialog.bounds were set before, allows mouse wheel scrolling in dialogs with autoscrollbars option, fixes widgets interactivity using bounds and autoscrollbars in Dialog:show{}, fixes dialog with scrollbar wrong size in a particular case, fixes crash using a label field in Dialog:endtags{}, fixes disabled checkbox style change after Dialog:combobox() change, fixes crash setting properties with its same value, adds Sprite.isValid, fixes console re-centering, fixes calling filters inside the same app.transaction() with ui=true, and doesn't show progress bar for filters when running with ui=false.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.17-beta
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.17-beta (tag v1.3.17-beta2), the update includes multiple sub-releases: v1.3.17-beta1 adds new option to paint/select rounded rectangles, makes moving the selection in Tiled Mode work correctly, allows mouse buttons (even X1 / X2) to be associated to commands / tools / drag values, avoids confusing UX creating new keyframes for slices, avoids confusion with Slice selection search field, doesn't modify the sprite when we just click/select slices, and adds Lua API enhancements: added Dialog onresize event, and fixed Image:drawSprite() call when the user is drawing; v1.3.17-beta2 fixes not responding menus after using Keyboard Shortcuts dialog, fixes Ctrl+drag to start a new copy of the selection, fixes Shift+special mouse button to drag values when the Pencil tool is selected, and fixes some customization to select quick tools using regular keys.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.17
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.17, the update adds new options to extend the 'Keep closed sprite on memory' time, fixes square brush rotation direction, fixes auto focusing layer name when pressing F2 to rename the layer, fixes regression painting selected text in text input fields, fixes a crash when doing 'Export As' for animation and the target file is read only, fixes crash copying floating image when Tiled Mode is enabled, includes changes from v1.3.17-beta2, and adds Lua API enhancements: updates API version to 39, and fixes security issue where a script could gain already given access from other script.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.18-beta1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.18-beta1, the update adds a Search field to Edit > Preferences, adds new option to configure tooltip delay from Edit > Preferences > Experimental > Tooltip Delay, makes internal changes to support faster undo/redo, and adds a new 'Widget Zoo' command (Ctrl+Space > Widget Zoo) to test widgets and themes.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.17.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.17.1, the update fixes Edit > Insert Text which doesn't paste text on viewport's center, allows installing extensions by dropping them into the preferences dialog, fixes tips for thin filled ellipses, fixes underscore and strike-through not shifted with layer's name, fixes color picker selecting below alpha bar, fixes selection tool performance in tilemap layers in 'Tiles' mode, fixes crash when painting in an empty tilemap in manual mode, fixes bug showing invalid zoom level in status bar, releases mouse capture after switching to other app with Alt+Tab, fixes the Palette unlock icon, adds some missing translation strings for the Advanced Mode dialog, fixes inactive window doesn't pass events to window below on macOS, doesn't change process name to 'main' on Linux, fixes crash decoding invalid external file types in .aseprite decoder/encoder, fixes stack overflow decoding multiple level of properties, and adds Lua API enhancements: updates API version to 40, fixes moving active cel to 0,0 when drawing for some specific scripts, and adds Sprite.hasAssociatedFile property.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.18-beta2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.18-beta2, the update adds better presentation of Layer Groups in Timeline, fixes hidden layers affect z-index, adds new -power-of-two-size CLI parameter to create sprite sheets with a power of two size, fixes bug opening .aseprite-extension from Windows File Explorer, fixes right-click on multi-line text editor (e.g. user data field), avoids confusing Eyedropper behavior when there is no Reference Layer available, includes changes in v1.3.17.1, and adds Lua API enhancements: new plugin API to add custom file formats when loading/saving sprites, improved Dialog labels and buddy enabled handling, and added support for eyedropper tool in app.useTool().

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.17.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.17.2, the update fixes cannot select one tile in a tilemap layer in tiles mode and fixes zoom level 20% distorts layers.

chunks.title: Aseprite v1.3.18-beta3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the aseprite/aseprite release v1.3.18-beta3, the update fixes cannot select one tile in a tilemap layer in tiles mode, fixes zoom level 20% distorts layers, and uses format auto-detection only on built-in formats.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent astral-sh/ruff release stream from 0.14.0 through 0.15.15, covering new rules, bug fixes, formatter improvements, and configuration changes across multiple minor versions.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.0, the project updates default and latest Python versions for 3.14, extends FA102 with listed PEP 585-compatible APIs, adds fixes for FURB101 and FURB103, includes certain guaranteed-mutable expressions in B006, and fixes various issues in flake8-annotations, flynt, isort, and ruff rules.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.1, the formatter removes parentheses around multiple exception types on Python 3.14+, B006 omits annotation in preview fix, G004 avoids dropping implicitly concatenated pieces, DOC102 is implemented, UP019 extends to typing_extensions.Text, UP046 fixes false negative for TypeVar with default, and several bug fixes and rule changes are included.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.2, INT001/INT002/INT003 resolve qualified names and built-in bindings, various bug fixes address nested interpolations, FAST002, SIM911, UP032, UP032 decimal ints, FAST003, and rule changes skip B905/B912 for fewer than two iterables, use DiagnosticTag for more rules, and CLI improves JSON output from ruff rule.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.3, --output-format is respected with --watch, DOC501/DOC502 fix false positive on explicit exception re-raising, F401 reverts to stable behavior for alternate branch imports, PLR1708 implements stop-iteration-return, RUF065 adds support for additional eager conversion patterns, and various bug fixes and rule changes are included.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.4, the formatter allows newlines after function headers without docstrings and avoids extra parentheses for long match patterns with as captures, FURB164 expands fix safety, FURB103 preserves argument ordering in autofix, and bug fixes address server diagnostics for notebooks, B009/B010 non-NFKC attribute names, FURB157 false negative, and RUF057 false positives.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.5, SIM113 applies when index variable is of type int, DOC502 fixes false positive when Sphinx directives follow a Raises section, DOC102 supports NumPy-style comma-separated parameters, FURB101 auto-fixes annotated assignments, RUF065 ignores str() when not used for simple conversion, and bug fixes address alternative match patterns, SIM222, UP029, UP035, and rule changes detect empty f-strings in FURB105.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.6, S508/S509 support new PySNMP API paths, bug fixes adjust own-line comment placement, avoid syntax errors in attribute expressions, fix panic in unary expressions, respect fmt: skip for compound statements, fix FURB103 autofix, fix RUF065 false positive for complex conversion specifiers, and rule changes avoid false positive on ClassVar reassignment in RUF012.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.7, S310 handles string literal bindings, PLR1708 fixes false positives on nested functions, PLE1141 fixes suppression for empty dict without tuple key annotation, RUF066 detects unnecessary class properties, RUF052 catches more dummy variable uses, and bug fixes address server severity, ISC003 invalid fix, and parser panic on IPython escape command expressions.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.8, B901 catches yield expressions within other statements, PTH104/PTH105/PTH109/PTH115 mark fixes unsafe for return type changes, bug fixes address syntax error false positives for await outside functions and truthiness assumption in SIM222/SIM223, and documentation suggests using --output-file option in GitLab integration.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.9, RUF100 adds diagnostics for unused range suppressions, PLW0133 detects subclasses of builtin exceptions, bug fixes address comment placement in lambda parameters, trivia tokens after re-lexing, S506 false positive with CSafeLoader, B008 accepting immutable slice default arguments, and rule changes suppress D417 for parameters with Unpack annotations.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.10, the formatter adds fluent formatting of method chains and keeps lambda parameters on one line, ISC004 prevents implicit string concatenation in collections, PTH104/PTH105/PTH109/PTH115 make fixes unsafe when types change in compound statements, FURB101/FURB103 extend support for Path.open, and bug fixes address UP032 parsing named Unicode escape sequences.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.11, diagnostics are consolidated for matched disable/enable suppression comments, invalid/unmatched range suppression comments are reported, AIR303 flags passing positional argument into HookLineageCollector.create_asset, FURB192 fix is marked always unsafe, RUF067 adds non-empty-init-module, and bug fixes address GitHub format for multi-line diagnostics and ARG001 marking **kwargs in TypeVar as used.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.13 (follow-up to 0.14.12), BLE001 allows more logging methods, RUF066 respects lint.pydocstyle.property-decorators, bug fixes address configuration path in --show-settings and respect fmt: skip for multiple statements, rule changes update D401 Rust crate imperative, I002 inserts imports in alphabetical order, and documentation adds llms.txt support.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.14.14, lambda bodies preserve required parentheses, range suppression code diagnostics are combined, AIR303 flags second positional argument to Asset/Dataset as not a dictionary, RUF068 detects duplicate entries in __all__, and bug fixes address UP029 shadowing, UP045 string arguments, PIE794 duplicated class fields, and many fixes are marked unsafe if they would remove comments.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.0, the project introduces breaking changes including 2026 style guide formatting, block suppression comments, updated Docker base images, removal of ppc64 binaries, and configuration resolution changes; stabilizes several rules and behaviors; and adds new preview features and bug fixes.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.1, preview features include AIR321 for deprecated Airflow 3.1 imports, AIR303 for third positional parameter, INT001/INT002/INT003 fix false negatives for ngettext, F401 fix infinite loop, PGH005 detect non-existent mock methods, PLC2701 allow dunder submodules, UP024 improve diagnostic range, FURB118 check subscripts, RUF008 detect mutable defaults in field calls, RUF069 ignore std cmath.inf and add float-equality-comparison, and Markdown formatting support is added.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.2, the preview default rule set is significantly expanded to 412 rules, PYI041 also checks string annotations, and bug fixes address flake8-async in_async_context logic, RUF102 fix, RUF027 suppression, B023 false positive, parser false syntax errors, and indentation tracking.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.3, explicit support for .qmd file extension is dropped, configured extensions are included in file discovery, S401-S415 allow suspicious imports in TYPE_CHECKING blocks, B901 allowed in pytest hook wrappers, ICN001/ICN002 add missing conventions, D420 enforces docstring section ordering, PLR1712 implements swap-with-temporary-variable, RUF070 adds unnecessary-assign-before-yield, RUF102 supports file-level noqa, RUF027 suppresses diagnostic for invalid f-strings before Python 3.12, and S506 doesn't flag BaseLoader/CBaseLoader as unsafe.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.4 (follow-up to 0.15.3), a panic when PLR1712 was enabled with definition-analyzing rules is fixed, F821 suppresses false positive for names used before del in stub files, and documentation clarifies first-party import detection and fixes incorrect import-heading example.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.5, Markdown files are discovered by default in preview mode, PERF102 extends to comprehensions and generators, FURB101/FURB103 fix false positives when I/O variable is used later, RUF036 adds fix for none-not-at-end-of-union, RUF055 fixes false positive for re.split with empty string pattern, and bug fixes address FAST003, D420, F811, and UP045.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.6, support for lazy import parsing and star-unpacking of comprehensions (PEP 798) is added, several rules are dropped from preview defaults, AIR003 flags Variable.get() calls outside task execution, AIR304 flags runtime-varying values in DAG/task constructor arguments, B043 implements delattr-with-constant, TID254 enforces lazy imports, UP006 adds from __future__ import annotations automatically, FURB101 supports newline parameter, RUF071 adds os-path-commonprefix, and various bug fixes and rule changes are included.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.7, output severity is displayed in preview, noqa hover is not shown for non-Python documents, E501 recognizes pyrefly: as a pragma comment, server doesn't return code actions for non-Python documents, and documentation adds company AI policy and editor features for Markdown code formatting.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.8, new rules RUF050 (unnecessary-if), RUF072 (useless-finally), and RUF073 (f-string-percent-format) are added, pyflakes recognizes frozendict as a builtin for Python 3.15+, and bug fixes address ASYNC115, S607, F821, E501/W505/formatter, IPython parsing, and analyze graph.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.9, F811 flags annotated variable redeclarations in preview, RUF067 allows dunder-named assignments in non-strict mode, and bug fixes address EM101, SIM113, W391, UP008, UP012, RUF072, RUF024, RUF050, and disallow starred expressions as values of starred expressions.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.10, LOG004 allows closures in except handlers, SLF diagnostics are robust to non-self-named variables, SIM102 fix is made safe in preview, and bug fixes avoid emitting multi-line f-string elements before Python 3.12, avoid syntax error from E502 fixes, strip form feeds from indent, fix UP012 panic, and reject multi-line f-string elements before Python 3.12.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.11, RUF029 is ignored when function is decorated with asynccontextmanager, AIR201 implements airflow-xcom-pull-in-template-string, S103 fixes false positives and negatives in mask analysis, and bug fixes omit overridden methods for ASYNC109.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.12, #ruff:file-ignore file-level suppressions and #ruff:ignore logical-line suppressions are implemented, preview changes to displayed diagnostic severity in LSP are reverted, AIR004 implements task-branch-as-short-circuit, B909 fixes break/continue handling in loop-iterator-mutation, PLC2701 fixes for type parameter scopes, and rule changes suggest .array in PD011.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.13, a rule to flag lazy imports that are eagerly evaluated is added, PLR0914/PLR0917 standardize diagnostic message, and bug fixes address F811 false positive for class methods, setting selection for multi-folder workspace, ERA001 false positive, and PYI016 false positive.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.14, AIR202 implements airflow-task-implicit-multiple-outputs, PTH101 fix is marked unsafe when first argument is a class attribute annotated as int, W0717 implements too-many-try-statements, RUF074 adds incorrect-decorator-order, RUF075 adds fallible-context-manager, and bug fixes address lambda formatting, generic frozenset annotations, TC001/TC002/TC003 strict behavior, and PLR1733 false positives.

In the astral-sh/ruff release 0.15.15, Markdown closing fence handling is fixed, F811 reports duplicate imports in typing.TYPE_CHECKING block, F821 treats function-scope bare annotations as locals per PEP 526, and performance improvements reduce memory usage and use ThinVec in AST.
