prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent astral-sh/uv release stream from 0.10.2 through 0.11.18, covering enhancements, bug fixes, Python version additions, and security updates.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the astral-sh/uv release 0.10.2, the project deprecates unexpected ZIP compression methods and fixes a cargo-install failure due to a missing uv-test dependency.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.10.3, the project adds CPython 3.15.0a6, avoids opening file locks for writing, makes Windows trampoline error messages consistent, logs which preview features are enabled, adds support for ruff version constraints and exclude-newer in uv format, fixes script path handling when target-workspace-discovery is enabled, uses version constraints to select the default ruff version for uv format, avoids matching managed Python versions by prefixes, fixes handling of --allow-existing with minor version links on Windows, fixes a panic when encountering unmanaged workspace members, improves accuracy of request timing, rejects u64::MAX in version segments to prevent overflow, and updates documentation to reference Debian Trixie instead of Bookworm.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.10.4, the project removes duplicate references to affected paths when showing uv python errors, skips discovery of workspace members that contain only git-ignored files, prevents a panic when initialising a package at the filesystem root, fixes permissions on wheel and sdist files produced by the uv_build build backend, and reverts a locked file change to fix locked files on NFS mounts.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.10.5, the project adds a hint when a named index is found in a parent config file, adds a warning for uv lock --frozen, attempts to use reflinks by default on Linux, falls back to hardlinks after reflink failure before copying, filters pylock.toml wheels by tags and requires-python, validates wheel filenames are normalized during uv publish, fixes a message when exclude-newer invalidates the lock file, changes the missing files log level to debug, improves performance of repeated conflicts with an extra, fixes --no-emit-workspace with --all-packages on single-member workspaces, fixes UV_NO_DEFAULT_GROUPS rejecting truthy values like 1, fixes iOS detection, propagates project-level conflicts to package extras, uses a global build concurrency semaphore, and updates documentation for environment variable files, uv export formats, and Windows support in configuration docs.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.10.6, the project applies lockfile marker normalization for fork markers, fixes Python version selection for scripts with a requires-python conflicting with .python-version, preserves file permissions when using reflinks on Linux, and removes verbose documentation from optional dependencies help text.
In the astral-sh/uv release 0.10.7, the project fixes handling of junctions in Windows Containers on Windows, activates logging for middleware retries, and uploads uv releases to a mirror.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.10.8, the project adds CPython 3.10.20, 3.11.15, and 3.12.13; adds Docker images based on Docker Hardened Images; adds a resolver hint when --exclude-newer filters out all versions of a package; configures a real retry minimum delay of 1s; expands uv_build direct build compatibility; fetches CPython from an Astral mirror by default; downloads uv releases from an Astral mirror in installers by default; adds SBOM attestations to Docker images; improves hint for installing meson-python when missing as build backend; adds UV_INIT_BARE environment variable for uv init; prevents uv tool upgrade from installing excluded dependencies; promotes authentication policy when saving tool receipts; respects exclusions in scripts; retains default-branch Git SHAs in pylock.toml files; skips installed Python check for URL dependencies; respects constraints during --upgrade; fixes uv tree orphaned roots and premature deduplication; and updates documentation mentioning cooldown and tweaking inline script metadata in dependency bots documentation and moving cache prune in GitLab to after_script.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.10.9, the project adds fbgemm-gpu, fbgemm-gpu-genai, torchrec, torchtune, and torchcodec to the PyTorch list; logs the duration before erroring; warns when using uv_build settings without uv_build; adds fallback to /usr/lib/os-release on Linux system lookup failure; uses cargo auditable to include SBOM in uv builds; adds an environment variable for UV_VENV_RELOCATABLE; avoids toml Document overhead; uses a single global workspace cache; continues on trampoline job assignment failures; handles the hard link limit gracefully instead of failing; respects build constraints for workspace members; revalidates editables and other dependencies in scripts; supports Python 3.13+ on Android; supports cp3-none-any; skips tool environments with broken links to Python on Windows; and adds documentation for common marker values and improves documentation on virtual dependencies.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.10.10, the project adds CPython 3.15.0a7; adds --outdated flag to uv tool list; adds riscv64 musl target to build-release-binaries workflow; fetches Ruff from an Astral mirror; improves error handling for platform detection in Python downloads; warns if --project directory does not exist; warns when workspace member scripts are skipped due to missing build system; updates build backend versions used in uv init; logs explicit config file path in verbose output; makes uv cache clear an alias of uv cache clean; rejects invalid classifiers and warns on license classifiers in uv_build; adds links to uv audit output; adds output/report formatting for uv audit; switches to batched OSV queries for uv audit; avoids sharing version metadata across indexes; bumps zlib-rs to 0.6.2 to fix panic on decompression of large wheels on Windows; filters out unsupported environment wheels; preserves absolute/relative paths in lockfiles; recreates Python environments under uv tool install --force; respects timestamp and other cache keys in cached environments; simplifies selected extra markers in uv export; sends pyx mint-token requests with a proper Content-Type; fixes Windows operating system and version reporting; and updates the platform support policy with a tier 3 section including freebsd and 32-bit windows.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.10.11, the project fetches Ruff release metadata from an Astral mirror; uses PEP 639 license metadata for uv itself; improves distribution id performance; allows --project to refer to a pyproject.toml directly and reduces to a warning on other files; disables SYSTEM_VERSION_COMPAT when querying interpreters on macOS; enforces available distributions for supported environments; fixes uv sync --active recreating active environments when UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR is relative; and updates documentation adding missing -o requirements.txt in uv pip compile example, linking to organization security policy, and linking to the AI policy in the contributing guide.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.10.12, the project adds pypy 3.11.15; adds support for using Python 3.6 interpreters; includes uv's target triple in version report; allows comma separated values in --no-emit-package; shows uv audit in the CLI help; improves reporting of managed interpreter symlinks in uv python list; preserves end-of-line comments on previous entries when removing dependencies; treats abi3 wheel Python version as a lower bound; detects hard-float support on aarch64 kernels running armv7 userspace; and updates documentation adding Python 3.15 to supported versions, adjusting the PyPy note, moving Pyodide to Tier 2 in the Python support policy, moving Rust and Python version support out of the Platform support policy, updating Docker guide with changes from uv-docker-example, and updating the Python version policy.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.0, the project includes breaking changes to the networking stack: rustls-platform-verifier is used instead of rustls-native-certs and webpki for certificate verification; aws-lc is used instead of ring for a cryptography backend; --native-tls is deprecated in favor of --system-certs; building uv on x86-64 and i686 Windows requires NASM; empty SSL_CERT_FILE values are ignored. Additionally, it enables frame pointers for improved profiling on Linux x86-64 and aarch64; treats 'Dynamic' values as case-insensitive; uses a dedicated error for invalid cache control headers; enables checksum verification in the generated installer script; and adds --service-format and --service-url to uv audit.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.1, the project adds missing hash verification for riscv64gc-unknown-linux-musl; falls back to direct download when direct URL streaming is unsupported; reverts treating 'Dynamic' values as case-insensitive; removes torchdata from list of packages to source from the PyTorch index; special-cases == Python version request ranges; and updates documentation covering --python <dir> in 'Using arbitrary Python environments' and fixing version annotations for PS_MODULE_PATH and UV_WORKING_DIR.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.2, the project adds a dedicated Windows PE editing error; makes uv self update fetch the manifest from the mirror first; uses uv reqwest client for self update; shows uv self update success and failure messages with --quiet; evaluates extras and groups when determining auditable packages; and skips redundant project configuration parsing for uv run.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.3, the project adds a progress bar for hashing phase in uv publish; adds support for ROCm 7.2; emits abi3t tags for every abi3 version; expands uv workspace metadata with dependency information from the lock; implements support for PEP 803; pretty-prints platform in built wheel errors; publishes installers to /installers/uv/latest on the mirror; shows free-threaded Python in built-wheel errors; adds --ignore and --ignore-until-fixed to uv audit; bumps simple API cache; doesn't drop blake2b hashes; handles broken range request implementations; removes powerpc64-unknown-linux-gnu from release build targets; respects dependency metadata overrides in uv pip check; supports debug CPython ABI tags in environment compatibility; and documents false opt-out for exclude-newer-package.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.4, the project adds support for --upgrade-group; merges repeated archive URL hashes by version ID; requires all direct URL hash algorithms to match; avoids panics in environment finding via cycle detection; enforces direct URL hashes for pyproject.toml dependencies; errors on --locked and --frozen when script lockfile is missing; fixes uv export extra resolution for workspace member and conflicting extras; includes conflicts defined in virtual workspace root; recomputes relative exclude-newer values during uv tree --outdated; respects --exclude-newer in uv tool list --outdated; sorts by comparator to break specifier ties; stores relative timestamps in tool receipts; tracks newly-activated extras when determining conflicts; patches Cargo.lock in uv-build source distributions; and clarifies that --exclude-newer compares artifact upload times.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.5, the project adds CPython 3.13.13, 3.14.4, and 3.15.0a8; fixes build_system.requires error message; removes trailing path separators in path normalization; improves error messages for unsupported or invalid TLS certificates; adds exclude-newer to [[tool.uv.index]]; adds context/warnings for ignored vulnerabilities in uv audit; normalizes persisted fork markers before lock equality checks; clears junction properly when uninstalling Python versions on Windows; reports error cleanly instead of panicking on TLS certificate error; removes the legacy PIP_COMPATIBILITY.md redirect file; and fixes uv init example-bare --bare examples.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.6, the project resolves a low severity security advisory (GHSA-pjjw-68hj-v9mw) where wheels with malformed RECORD entries could delete arbitrary files on uninstall. It does not remove files outside the venv on uninstall; validates and heals wheel RECORD during installation; and avoids uv cache clean errors due to Win32 path normalization.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.7, the project upgrades CPython build to 20260414 including an OpenSSL security upgrade; elevates configuration errors to required-version mismatches; further improves TLS certificate validation messages; improves --exclude-newer hints; fixes --script handling in uv audit; fixes traversal of extras in uv audit; de-quotes workspace metadata in linehaul data; avoids installing tool workspace member dependencies as editable; emits JSON report for uv sync --check failures; filters and warns on invalid TLS certificates; fixes equality comparisons for version specifiers with ~= operators; fixes stale Python upgrade preview feature check in project environment construction; and improves Windows path normalization.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.8, the project adds --python-downloads-json-url to python pin; fetches uv from Astral mirror during self-update; supports pip uninstall -y; allows exclude-newer to be missing from the lockfile when exclude-newer-span is present; only shows the version number in uv self version --short; silences warnings on empty SSL_CERT_DIR directory; uses a sentinel timestamp for relative exclude-newer and exclude-newer-package values in lockfiles; adds UV_PYTHON_NO_REGISTRY; adds an environment variable for UV_NO_PROJECT; exposes UV_PYTHON_SEARCH_PATH for Python discovery PATH overrides; adds rust-toolchain.toml to uv-build sdist; ensures uv invocations of git do not inherit repository location environment variables; redacts pre-signed upload URLs in verbose output; handles transitive URL dependencies in PEP 517 build requirements; supports uv lock on a pyproject.toml that only contains dependency-groups; disables transparent Python upgrades in projects when a patch version is requested via .python-version; fixes Python variant tagging in the Windows registry; bans external symlinks in .tar.zst wheels; removes deprecated license classifiers from uv-build and adds Python 3.14 classifier; and updates documentation bumping astral-sh/setup-uv version and updating PyTorch documentation for PyTorch 2.11.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.9, the project includes a special release candidate for Python 3.14.5 to address memory pressure issues from the new garbage collection implementation; upgrades PyPy to v7.3.22; adds CPython 3.14.5rc1; on macOS, CPython statically links libpython to match Linux; omits compatible release desugaring for pre-release hints; fixes file locks on Android; adds reporting for adverse project statuses in uv audit; discovers versioned Python executables when requires-python pins a version; fixes URL prefix matching to require path boundaries; fixes transitive Git path dependencies in lockfiles; handles incorrect unlock error in LockedFile::drop on Wine; prevents uninstalling site-packages for empty top_level.txt in .egg-info; uses symlinks instead of junctions on Wine; fixes floating-point environment handling on ARMv7; redacts credentials from remote requirements URL in offline errors; Windows trampolines no longer set PYTHONHOME and only set __PYVENV_LAUNCHER__ for virtual environments; and updates documentation marking --native-tls and UV_NATIVE_TLS as deprecated, re-adding pytorch-triton-rocm to PyTorch ROCm docs, tweaking changelog entries for 0.11.8, adding 'Exporting lockfiles' to the Concepts->Projects index, and clarifying that uv init creates git files/folders in the projects guide.
In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.10, the project allows pre-release Python requests with non-zero patch versions.
In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.11, the project accepts legacy ID format from pre-0.11.9 cache entries.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.12, the project adds CPython 3.15.0b1; adds --no-editable support to uv pip install; requires git refs in URLs to be percent-encoded; respects --no-dev over UV_DEV=1; doesn't suggest non-existent --no-frozen flag; and fixes a bug from inconsistent workflow name in GHA-PyPI guide example.
In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.13, the project includes data files in editable builds; respects --require-hashes when installing from pylock.toml files; and adds CPython 3.14.5.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.14, the project adds Astral mirror URL override; ignores top_level.txt entries in uninstall that are not valid Python identifiers; avoids applying .env files in parent process; filters ANSI codes in logging output; fixes uv tree showing extra-conditional deps for packages required without extras; and respects build options (e.g., --no-build) during lock validation.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.15, the project fixes a TAR parser differential (GHSA-3cv2-h65g-fgmm) and enforces that entry points cannot escape in the scripts directory (GHSA-4gg8-gxpx-9rph); adds TOML v1.1 -> v1.0 backwards compatibility for source distributions; adds support for Azure request signing; applies stricter validation to all wheel filename segments; rejects empty strings as an invalid package name; uses structured errors for signing authentication failures; adds JSON output to uv audit; respects required-environments in uv pip compile; avoids parsing JSON manifest when local Python is available; avoids walking nested directories in linker conflict registration; optimizes async wheel ZIP writing; fixes dead 'already trimmed' fast-path in Version::only_release_trimmed; applies workspace-member [tool.uv.sources] credentials under uv sync --frozen; skips empty directories in uv build outputs; fixes Git submodule handling when using relative paths; fixes line number reporting in netrc parsing; and moves Bazel auth helper setup into integration guide.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.16, the project adds support for direct archive dependencies in Git; adjusts hint rendering; specializes malformed OSV error in uv audit; rejects locked malware installations; allows disabling reading the system config with UV_NO_SYSTEM_CONFIG; allows environment variables that take a list to be empty; ensures that incompatible wheel hints do not leak secrets; rejects unsafe entry points in uv-build; restricts delimiters in entry point parsing; fixes multi-word no-space comment lines causing parse errors in uv-netrc; and documents and tests relative exclude-newer support for uv pip.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.17, the project adds a diagnostic for uv add with standard library modules; exposes uv workspace and its list subcommand in help output; improves the '403 forbidden' hint to suggest ignore-error-codes when applicable; skips direct URL lock freshness checks while offline; adds import-names and import-namespaces support to uv-build (PEP 794); adds a --no-editable-package flag to various commands; infers Python version requests from source trees in uv tool invocations; adds module owners to uv workspace metadata; does not allow uv venv --clear to remove non-virtual environments; improves the performance of large entries in tool.uv.conflicts; avoids modifying the parent process' env with --env-file in uv run; fixes script environment creation for scripts with long filenames; fixes transitive Git archive dependencies in lockfiles; preserves Git repository URLs in direct URL metadata; supports redirects in --check-url; accepts case-insensitive HTML tags in --find-links parsing; rejects duplicate script metadata blocks; bans names like 'python3' as script entry points; validates Git LFS artifacts for Git archives; uses a relative path when creating symlinks in cache to improve relocatability; and fixes malformed positional anchors in the CLI reference.

In the astral-sh/uv release 0.11.18, the project fixes a performance regression in unzip of local wheels; adds uv check to run ty from uv; updates activation scripts with upstream fixes; and bumps MSRV to 1.94.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent browser-use/browser-use release stream from version 0.9.5 through 0.12.9, covering sandbox support, LLM judge integration, Gemini 3 availability, community contributions, skills, CLI improvements, and security fixes.

chunks.title: 0.9.5 - Sandboxes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.9.5, the project introduces sandbox support, implements a template system with a template-library repository, adds remote code upload and execution, and includes various fixes for Gemini, scrolling, popups, and file path handling.

chunks.title: 0.9.6 - Automatic llm as a judge for your agent runs to monitor success
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.9.6, the project adds automatic LLM-as-a-judge for monitoring agent run success, improves judge logging and console output, adds judge output fields for task impossibility and captcha, and includes various fixes and documentation updates.

chunks.title: 0.9.7 - Gemini 3 available
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.9.7, the project makes Gemini 3 available, configures screenshot size for browser-use models, fixes a max steps bug, and updates Laminar documentation.

chunks.title: Browser Use with Community!
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.10.0, the project merges many community PRs to improve stability, records click coordinates, adds captcha and impossible flags in AgentEvent, introduces agent history rerun with step interval calculation and variable detection, and adds Vercel AI Gateway integration.
In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.10.1, the project re-releases version 0.10.0 with a bumped pyproject version to 0.10.1 and updates the dependency accordingly.

chunks.title: 0.11.0 - Skills
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.0, the project introduces skills integration, allowing agents to use specific skills or all skills, adds fallback LLM support, includes a Mistral chat provider, and adds AI step to replace extract_content on rerun.

chunks.title: More Stable
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.1, the project focuses on stability improvements, updates system prompts, filters sensitive data in history, makes coordinates optionally available, and fixes structured output for sandboxes.

chunks.title: BROWSER USE OSS MODEL!!!
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.2, the project releases an open-source model specialized in Browser Use (bu-30b-a3b-preview), adds support for it, and includes performance improvements and fixes for XAI vision and tab creation.

In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.3, the project adds cascading element matching for history rerun stability, support for external skill service, shadow DOM form elements in selector_map, multi-tab video recording, and various fixes and enhancements.

chunks.title: 0.11.4 - CLI
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.4, the project introduces a Browser Use CLI and skill, enabling Claude Code/Codex agents to access local and remote browsers with commands like open, state, click, type, screenshot, and close, and supports multiple browser modes and sessions.

In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.5, the project announces the bu-2-0 premium model with 83.3% accuracy, adds support for it, sets default thinking to 0 for gemini-3 models, and includes various fixes and enhancements.

In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.6, the project increases LLM timeout to 75s for gemini and browser-use models, increases default step_timeout to 180s, adds step budget awareness to prompts, and includes various fixes and improvements.

chunks.title: 0.11.7 - Agent performance boost
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.7, the project adds a grep tool to the agent, improves filename sanitization, and restores install, init, and --mcp commands in skill_cli.

chunks.title: 0.11.8 - Profiles in Browser Use CLI
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.8, the project adds profiles in Browser Use CLI, schema enforcement in extract tool, improves multiact for agent, and improves the Markdown Chunker.

In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.9, the project adds basic planning to agents, aligns agent success with simple judge, introduces action loop detection, adds read_long_content action, and increases default max step to 500.

chunks.title: 0.11.10a1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.10a1, the project fixes agent stop if browser closed, handles missing choices in openai proxy response, redirects logging to stderr for MCP stdio, and increases default consecutive failure to 5.

chunks.title: 0.11.10a2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.10a2, the project fixes download monitoring issues with fetch requests and blob downloads, and adds an agent max clickable parameter.

In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.11, the project includes fixes from 0.11.10a1 and 0.11.10a2, adds cookie overlay fix, custom headers support, file attachments to structured output, and a new direct CLI mode.
In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.12, the project fixes CDP connectivity issues, improves auth/real browser docs, adds Browser.from_system_chrome(), and removes simple judge.

In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.11.13, the project adds automatic captcha solver handling via CAPTCHA watchdog, WebSocket reconnection for remote browser CDP connections, save_as_pdf agent action, and various fixes.
In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.12.0, the project improves CSV file generation and pins all dependency versions in pyproject.toml.

In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.12.1, the project fixes proxy auth attach handler overwriting tab tracking, restores storage_state (cookies + localStorage), patches gemini version, and includes various documentation and compatibility fixes.

In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.12.2, the project adds check for hard constraints, detects empty DOM after navigation and retries, prevents duplicate items in multi-page extraction, adds strict data grounding rules, and removes read_long_content action.

chunks.title: 0.12.3 - Browser Use CLI 2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.12.3, the project introduces Browser Use CLI 2.0 built on direct CDP for faster automation, supports multiple browser modes including real Chrome and cloud, and provides form filling and file upload capabilities.
In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.12.4, the project pins the litellm library version and fixes detection of uv installed via curl script.
In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.12.5, the project removes litellm from core dependencies in response to a supply chain attack, preserving ChatLiteLLM wrapper for separate installation.

In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.12.6, the project sets default temperature to 1.0 for gemini-3 models, fixes bedrock structured output, adds option to disable SignalHandler, and includes various performance and compatibility fixes.

In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.12.7, the project delivers a big CLI update, addresses security vulnerabilities in aiohttp and requests, adds per-session auth token to daemon socket, and includes numerous fixes and improvements.

In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.12.8, the project restricts unix socket file to owner-only access, defaults ChatBrowserUse to bu-2-0, recommends gemini-3-flash-preview, and moves per-step metadata out of agent_state.
In the browser-use/browser-use release 0.12.9, the project passes session id to judge LLM calls and skips screenshots on new tab pages.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent bumptech/glide release stream from v4.4.0 through v5.0.7, including major feature additions like animated AVIF support, Compose integration, and KSP processor support, as well as numerous bug fixes and build improvements.

chunks.title: Glide 4.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.4.0, the November release of Glide introduces features such as updated generated API to allow RequestOptions return values, support for cache sizes larger than Integer.MAX_VALUE, a clearOnDetach() API on ViewTarget, a waitForLayout() API on ViewTarget, a MockGlideExecutor for testing, and a custom executor for decoding GIF frames. Bug fixes include improved trimming behavior, fixed URL escaping, added direct dependency on support-fragment, fixed resource return to memory cache, fixed IllegalStateException with memoized RequestManagers, fixed NPE with GifDrawables as thumbnails, fixed SecurityException on connectivity receiver and status, fixed GifDrawable animation after clear/onStop, improved GIF frame decode times by up to 40%, eliminated unnecessary object allocations, fixed ExternalPreferredCacheDiskCacheFactory external storage issue, ensured onlyRetrieveFromCache requests don't block, and fixed re-use/recycle of Bitmap/Drawable in load methods.

chunks.title: Glide 4.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.5.0, the December release of Glide adds features including an API to pause all requests for a given Activity or Fragment, full support for Bitmap re-use for RGBA_F16 Bitmaps, support for decoding videos from resources as AssetFileDescriptors, support for MediaMetadataRetriever.getScaledFrameAtTime to reduce memory usage when decoding video frames, and support for transcoding BitmapDrawables to byte arrays. Bug fixes include cleaning up @TargetApi annotations, adding @Nullable/@NonNull annotations, fixing skipMemoryCache(true) completing from memory cache, fixing decoding interlaced and downsampled GIFs as static images, adding more devices requiring lock for Bitmap operations, fixing race condition NPE on simultaneous first loads, making annotation processor tests pass on Windows, fixing NPE and RuntimeExceptions in DefaultConnectivityMonitor, trimming memory cache to half of maximum size on background, fixing StateVerifier exception in ResourceEncoder, fixing NPE error message in ResourceDrawableDecoder, fixing IllegalStateException when error request is cleared while running, cleaning up accessor classes, updating OkHttp and removing workaround for ClassCastException on O, adding missing annotations to generated classes, and avoiding exceptions in LruBitmapPool.

chunks.title: Glide 4.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.6.0, the January release of Glide features using buffered streams when writing Bitmap data and allowing re-use of ARGB_8888 and RGBA_F16 Bitmaps via re-configuration. Bug fixes include returning correct size of RGBA_F16 Bitmaps in Util.getBitmapByteSize, avoiding conversion of RGBA_F16 to ARGB_8888 during transformations adding transparent pixels, avoiding exception when loading remote images not in cache as Files with DiskCacheStrategy.AUTOMATIC, and avoiding inefficiently trying identical load path parts multiple times. Behavior changes note that wide gamut PNGs decoded as RGBA_F16 may be affected by improved handling. Breaking changes add correct Nullable annotations to generated classes, RequestManager, and load package. Build changes cut build times by parallelizing tasks and removing redundant release variants.

chunks.title: Glide 4.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.6.1, a bugfix release for Glide 4.6.0, the only fix addresses an issue where pom files in the 4.6.0 release did not list the appropriate dependencies for Glide's various components.

chunks.title: Glide 4.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.7.0, Glide adds support for data Uris when provided as Uris, improves scrolling performance by optimizing internal calls, adds support for downsampling in VideoBitmapDecoder, and provides better default names for annotation generated classes. Bug fixes include improved cancellation handling in VolleyStreamFetcher, improved handling of TRIM_MEMORY_RUNNING_CRITICAL, avoiding delay of first requests in Fragments/Activities by defaulting RequestManagers to started, fixing annotation processor failures for classes with '_' in package name, obeying themes when retrieving drawables with appcompat, fixing loading another application's launcher icon with mismatched support library version, and fixing a pixel swap in GifDecoder output. Behavior changes include VideoBitmapDecoder obeying DownsampleStrategy and preloading ahead the first page in RecyclerView/ListView preloader. Breaking changes make GlideBuilder.build package private, deprecate non-support fragments, remove deprecated constructors in transformation implementations, and remove ComponentsCallbacks from RequestManager. Build changes update to Gradle 4.6 and improve NonNull checks for Kotlin.

chunks.title: Glide 4.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.8.0, Glide features allowing multiple RequestListeners on a single request and adding a safer version of base target methods that force callers to implement onLoadCleared, deprecating unsafe versions. Bug fixes include supporting HEIF orientation on O MR1+ via ExifInterface, improving error message for network failures, making placeholder/error/fallback drawable and id variants replace previous calls to the same method with the other variant, and improving synchronization in ModelLoaderRegistry. Deprecations include SimpleTarget and ViewTarget in favor of CustomViewTarget. Behavior changes include immediately pausing requests started with a paused RequestManager. Breaking changes remove deprecated PREFER_ARGB_8888_DISALLOW_HARDWARE DecodeFormat, remove pause() and isPaused() from internal Request interface, and note that Glide now uses resource ids and can no longer be released as a straight jar. Build changes add support for androidx annotations and update to Android Gradle 3.1.3.

chunks.title: Glide 4.9.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.9.0, Glide allows applying RequestOptions directly in a RequestBuilder without the generated API, adds Global/Activity/Fragment scoped RequestListeners, adds a CustomTarget class to reduce boilerplate, supports loading resources from dynamic modules, adds a varargs .transform() method, makes proguard rules consumable, stops forcing all requests to be posted to the main thread, and adds Animatable2Compat callbacks to GifDrawable. Bug fixes include fixing different resource types sharing a cache key, working around an ArrayList compiler bug, adding Nullable/NonNull annotations to LazyHeaders.Builder, adding a transformation to rotate images, fixing a race in MultiModelLoader after cancellation, fixing a bug in SizeConfigStrategy returning incorrect config, avoiding classifying non-0 exif orientation images as having transparency, adding a debug API to attach stack traces to requests, and fixing handling of resource Uris pointing to other applications. Deprecations include .transforms() replaced by .transform(). Behavior changes note that RequestListeners for background thread requests can be called on background threads. Breaking changes may affect subclasses of RequestBuilder/RequestOptions. Build changes add support for incremental annotation processing.

chunks.title: Glide 4.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.10.0, Glide adds a Mocks library to mock GlideExecutor in tests, an integration library for Guava's ListenableFuture, granular options for rounded corners, day/night mode in resource id cache keys, an API to manually clear memory, simple support for wide gamut color spaces, releasing more memory in background on M+, support for Fragments not hosted by Activities, and handling contexts with null application contexts. Bug fixes include fixing incorrect downsampling for rotated images with Target.SIZE_ORIGINAL, fixing negative byte values converting ByteBuffers to InputStreams, canceling all preload requests in cancelAll(), fixing concurrency bugs from background thread requests, ensuring specified numbers of threads are used in animation executor, avoiding blinking when pausing requests with thumbnail, making it less likely to mix support and non-support fragments, avoiding incorrect downsampling in FitCenter and CenterInside, always using orientation corrected sizes in Downsampler, fixing transparency in GifDecoder with RGB_565, handling security exceptions with MediaStore Uris, and fixing an unused AnimationExecutor. Deprecations include custom tags in CustomViewTarget. Behavior changes ignore custom tags in CustomViewTarget. Build changes update target SDK to 28, disable BuildConfig generation, and update Truth.

chunks.title: Glide 4.11.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.11.0, Glide adds a thread timeout for Glide's threads to reduce memory, getters to Bitmap Pool for cache statistics, methods to concurrent integration libraries to release resources back to Glide's pool, and support for decoding videos from ByteBuffers. Bug fixes include improving ModelLoader error text, fixing errors with thumbnail loaders causing flashing, fixing an exception using Arrays.addAll on some devices, working around a framework bug breaking heic/heif decoding on Android Q, improving hardware bitmap use on P+, avoiding removing caller added listeners in GlideFutures, avoiding propagating unexpected callbacks from cancelled or failed model loaders, switching to the support exif library to avoid spurious logs, and fixing a deadlock when recursively clearing resources. Behavior changes allow decoding files via FileDescriptors when all other types fail. No deprecations or breaking changes.

chunks.title: Glide 4.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.12.0, Glide adds a Cronet integration library, support for width/height in SvgDecoder sample, a thumbnail method taking a list of RequestBuilders, and an .error() method taking a model for fallback requests. Bug fixes include hardcoding disallowed device models for hardware Bitmaps, fixing flickr sample by allowing non-https urls, fixing a verification error in ParcelFileDescriptorRewinder on API < 21, fixing never returning larger size keys in Flickr sample, fixing bugs caused by items changing sizes in LruCache, fixing annotation processor with more than 5 library modules, fixing ConcurrentModificationException in trimMemory, noting RequestListener.onLoadFailed's model is Nullable, fixing an IllegalArgumentException in GifFrameLoader if GIF started before visible, avoiding adding both support and non-support RequestManagers, avoiding a memory leak when starting RequestManagers, working around a JDK bug in Registry, progress on workarounds for obscure Hardware Bitmap issues on Android < P, avoiding claiming annotations in Glide's processor, fixing issues with clone/autoclone in RequestBuilder, fixing a bug decoding partial images for large PNG files, rethrowing in exception handling streams to workaround infinite loop in ExifInterface, and reducing stat() syscalls in startup. Behavior changes include better http status codes in HttpUrlFetcher failures. Build changes add a Gradle Wrapper Validation Github Action and remove Monkeyrunner.

chunks.title: Glide 4.13.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.13.0, Glide adds an integration library to support decoding AVIF. Bug fixes include improving performance of canceling pending requests, improving memory overhead when decoding byte[] and ByteBuffer, avoiding returning duplicate transcode classes in the registry, avoiding cancelling higher tier preload requests when a lower tier completes, decreasing the maximum FD size limit for certain devices to avoid native crashes, fixing a memory leak caused by unusual activity/fragment lifecycle interactions, and fixing decoding videos from assets. Deprecations include .thumbnail(float) to simplify thumbnail logic. Behavior changes set the default color space to null instead of SRGB, fallback to decoding data from source if writing to disk cache fails, avoid using deprecated APIs for detecting connectivity state on API 24+, and add support for detecting animated webp's to ImageHeaderParser. Build changes bump Gradle version and replace Jcenter with Maven Central.

chunks.title: Glide v4.13.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.13.1, a bugfix release, the only fix addresses a missing dependency in the AVIF integration library.

chunks.title: Glide v4.13.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.13.2, a bugfix release, the only fix updates the AVIF dependency to fix proguard stripping code erroneously.

chunks.title: Glide v4.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.14.0, Glide adds support for KSP, an alpha version of a Compose integration, an alpha version of general Kotlin support including converting a Glide request into a Flow, enabling animated WebP decoding on P+ using framework APIs, and allowing Drawables to be loaded with specific themes. Bug fixes include registering connectivity listeners on API < 24 on background threads, disabling ParcelFileDescriptor rewinding in Robolectric, rewinding ByteBuffers between image header parsers, avoiding duplicate notifications of Targets when an error request builder is set, and using the correct run reason in DecodeJob. Deprecations include Glide's Extensions, GlideApp, GlideRequest, GlideRequests, and Android framework Fragment support. Behavior changes include initializing Glide's registry on a background thread and updating the state of a Request before calling Targets or RequestListeners. Build changes remove Spotless, clean up gradle.properties versioning, update to Gradle 7+, fix deprecation warnings, use jarjar from maven, and remove the exif orientation.

chunks.title: Glide v4.14.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.14.1, a bugfix release, the only fix addresses an incorrect dependency in the ksp modules POM file.

chunks.title: Glide v4.14.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.14.2, bug fixes include allowing LibraryGlideModules to be processed in separate code modules when using KSP and fixing recomposition when properties of RequestBuilder change. Behavior changes include a proper implementation of equals/hashcode for BaseRequestOptions and TransitionOptions subclasses, which may break code relying on the old behavior.

chunks.title: Glide v4.15.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.15.0, Glide improves support for dark mode, RTL and other theme attributes on loaded resources, adds Robolectric shadow and legacy cleanup, adds support for okhttp4, adds support for animated AVIF, and adds support for RGB_565 in Avif. Compose-specific features include adding loading and failure composable parameters, making automatic transformations based on ContentScale optional, avoiding exceptions when Composables have unexpected sizes, simplifying the preloading API, and showing placeholder resources in Compose previews. Bug fixes include working around VP8 decoding issues on ARC devices, improving error messages when Glide is recursively initialized or application code throws during initialization, and fixing a race that can result in RequestManagers leaking. Behavior changes use Android's Lifecycle for androidx Fragments/Activities instead of adding a hidden Fragment.

chunks.title: Glide v4.15.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.15.1, a bugfix release, the only fix addresses a bug in the KSP processor preventing it from recognizing or including any of Glide's library modules, or any other library module compiled with Glide's java annotation processor.

chunks.title: Glide 4.16.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v4.16.0, Glide focuses on build improvements and Compose, adding support for Compose specific transitions like cross fade and supporting recomposition based on request state using GlideSubcomposition. Features include allowing passing an executor into ChromiumRequestSerializer and allowing the host app to provide a way to clear all resources onStop(). Compose additions include a Transition API and CrossFade Transition, influencing layout using intrinsics in GlideNode, logging instead of throwing parsing manifests to fix compose previews, launching no more than one request per onRemembered, removing GlidePainter in favor of Modifier nodes/Flows, and replacing flows in GlideSubcomposition with a listener on GlideNode. Bug fixes include reading library glide module names from Java indexes, fixing a typo, including URL in error log, adding isInitialized visible for testing method, using onIdle to avoid a race in FlowTests, adding an isEquivalentTo method, and adding @RequiresPermission to NotificationTarget. Deprecations include placeholderOf(@Composable) in GlideImage. Behavior changes include hard coding disabling hardware bitmaps on O/OMR1 and not setting requireOriginal on Android photo picker uris. Breaking changes add @Nullable and @NonNull annotations to RequestListener. Build changes include integration tests for ksp library modules, updating README.md to use https, using dokka to build scripts/update_javadocs.sh, updating libavif dependency, disabling java 7 source obsolete warning, updating mockito version, and switching Glide's dependency.

chunks.title: Glide Compose alpha6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release compose-alpha6, a dot release of the compose integration library without changes to the rest of Glide, bug fixes include fixing Drawables not animated in GlideImage and fixing issues with duplicate padding and draw order due to duplicate Modifier nodes.

chunks.title: Glide 5.0.0-rc01, Compose 1.0.0-beta01
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v5.0.0-rc01, Glide 5.0 contains no major changes from Glide 4.16 except compiling against Java 8 and Kotlin 1.8. Compose additions include a Painter variant of the placeholder APIs, avoiding modifying constraints when a scale factor can't be computed, avoiding duplicating Modifiers in GlideModifer, and finishing animation ignoring cancellation. Build changes update Glide to java 8, AGP to 8.1.0, Gradle to 8.3, update to AGP 8.1.1, and remove custom MediaMetadataRetriever shadow in GlideTest. Breaking changes include building against Java 8 and Kotlin 1.8, and the addition of @Nullable and @NonNull annotations to RequestListener from 4.16.

chunks.title: Glide v5.0.0-rc05
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v5.0.0-rc05, Compose reverts recent updates and bumps version to 1.0.0-beta03, KTX bumps version to 1.0.0-beta03. Build changes update Glide to java 8, AGP to 8.1.0, Gradle to 8.3, update to AGP 8.1.1, fix outdated JavaDoc for BitmapPoolAdapter, and update AVIF dependency to align with 16KB page size. Bug fixes include using the correct bucket for AVIF GlideModule, updating TransformationUtils#rotateImageExif to preserve gainmap, adding workaround for AOSP bug with decoding single channel hardware gainmaps, cleaning up preserveGainmapAndColorSpaceForTransformations flag, cleaning up setEnableHardwareGainmapFixOnU flag, and avoiding referencing resource names within Resource Loader.

chunks.title: Glide v5.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v5.0.1, Compose bumps version to 1.0.0-beta04, KTX bumps version to 1.0.0-beta04. Bugs note that it doesn't fix missing gifdecoder and disklrucache modules, which will be addressed in 5.0.2.

chunks.title: Glide v.5.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v.5.0.0, Glide 5.0 contains no major changes from Glide 4.16 except compiling against Java 8 and Kotlin 1.8. Note that this version was accidentally published and has issue #5580 preventing its usage. Compose additions include a Painter variant of the placeholder APIs, avoiding modifying constraints when a scale factor can't be computed, avoiding duplicating Modifiers in GlideModifer, and finishing animation ignoring cancellation. Build changes update Glide to java 8, AGP to 8.1.0, Gradle to 8.3, update to AGP 8.1.1, and remove custom MediaMetadataRetriever shadow in GlideTest. Breaking changes include building against Java 8 and Kotlin 1.8, and the addition of @Nullable and @NonNull annotations to RequestListener from 4.16.

chunks.title: Glide v5.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v5.0.2, Compose bumps version to 1.0.0-beta05, KTX bumps version to 1.0.0-beta05. Bugs fix missing gifdecoder and disklrucache modules.

chunks.title: Glide v5.0.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v5.0.3, Compose bumps version to 1.0.0-beta06, KTX bumps version to 1.0.0-beta06. Bugs fix missing gif_decoder modules.

chunks.title: Glide v5.0.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v5.0.4, Compose bumps version to 1.0.0-beta07, KTX bumps version to 1.0.0-beta07. Bugs fix compiler module missing in published artifacts.

chunks.title: Glide v5.0.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v5.0.5, Compose bumps version to 1.0.0-beta08, KTX bumps version to 1.0.0-beta08. Bugs restore the GlideUrl fix for urls with IPV6 addresses that was accidentally reverted in 5.0.4.

chunks.title: Glide v5.0.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v5.0.6, Compose bumps version to 1.0.0-beta09, KTX bumps version to 1.0.0-beta09. Changes include setting the background memory category only when trim level is higher than TRIM_MEMORY_UI_HIDDEN, stopping appending requireOriginal to URIs loaded by Glide on Android R+, converting Groovy Gradle files to Kotlin DSL, and migrating from Robolectric's Util.readBytes to Guava ByteStreams.

chunks.title: Glide v5.0.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the bumptech/glide release v5.0.7, a build change adds a missing version bump. No other changes.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent caddyserver/caddy release stream from v2.7.0 through v2.11.3, including major feature releases, patch fixes, and beta versions. It highlights key milestones such as the introduction of Encrypted ClientHello (ECH) and post-quantum key exchange in v2.10.0, and the automated release process in v2.11.0.

chunks.title: v2.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.7.0, the release note advises users not to use this release and instead use v2.7.3 which contains hot fixes.

chunks.title: v2.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.7.1, the release note advises users not to use this release and instead use v2.7.3, which contains a hotfix for a WebSocket issue.

chunks.title: v2.7.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.7.2, the release note advises users not to use this release and instead use v2.7.3 which contains several hot fixes.

chunks.title: v2.7.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.7.3, the release note presents Caddy 2.7 with significant strides in scaling, performance, and niche features. Highlights include: in-memory TLS certificate cache no longer purged during config reloads; significant HTTP/3 performance improvements including 0-RTT; new default template for file server browse listings; reverse proxy now supports PROXY protocol; Caddyfile supports Heredoc syntax; enhanced client IP information; certificate private keys no longer reused when renewing; Caddyfile import arg placeholders support slice syntax; customizable fallback policy for reverse proxy; Etags generated more sensibly for NixOS; experimental short CLI flags; experimental reverse proxy keep hijacked connections open through config reloads; experimental named routes; experimental permissions for unix sockets. Deprecations include: the ask endpoint is now required to enable On-Demand TLS for catch-all or wildcard hosts; on-demand config throttle options deprecated.

chunks.title: v2.7.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.7.4, the release note rounds out some bug fixes from the 2.7 release. It resolves issues with on-demand TLS, fixes race conditions in dynamic reverse proxy upstreams, and addresses a last-minute breaking change in Go 1.21 that broke quic-go (HTTP/3). The changelog includes updates to CertMagic and quic-go, and fixes for file server error handling, reverse proxy upstreams, and templates httpInclude.

chunks.title: v2.7.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.7.5, the release note fixes many small bugs and annoyances, including HTTP/2 Rapid Reset. Highlights include: updated quic-go to v0.39.0 with performance improvements (GSO and ECN enabled by default); file server's BrowseTemplate exported; environment variables loaded with --envfile no longer override existing variables; encode handler compresses application/wasm* by default; reverse_proxy can emit verbose logs for debugging streaming and buffering; caddy -v now works. The changelog includes fixes for Caddyfile heredoc parsing, admin responses, encode defaults, file server browse template, and various other improvements.

chunks.title: v2.7.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.7.6, the release note includes several fixes and enhancements. Notable changes: the templates middleware is now officially extensible (experimentally); TLS storage cleaning is synchronized across the cluster and remembered across restarts; placeholders are now evaluated in config for certificate loaders. The changelog includes upgrades to acmeserver, quic-go, and fixes for Caddyfile variadic placeholders, TLS automation policy merging, and other bug fixes.

chunks.title: v2.8.0 beta 1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.8.0-beta.1, the release note states that this release is obsolete and to see the next release for notes.

chunks.title: v2.8.0-beta.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.8.0-beta.2, the release note states that this release is obsolete and to see the next release for notes.

chunks.title: v2.8.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.8.0-rc.1, the release note states that this release is obsolete and to see the next release for notes.

chunks.title: v2.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.8.0, the release note announces Caddy 2.8 with hundreds of improvements, including ACME Renewal Information (ARI) support, HTTP/3 to proxy backends, and more. Breaking changes: ZeroSSL now requires an email address for free ACME endpoint; the zerossl issuer module is no longer ACME-capable and is exclusively for ZeroSSL API. Other highlights include: Encrypted ClientHello (ECH) support, post-quantum key exchange, ACME profiles, Via header in reverse proxy, global DNS provider option, wildcards used by default, libdns 1.0 APIs, and global dns config. The release also notes that only the latest minor Go version is now supported.

chunks.title: v2.8.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.8.1, the release note provides quick fixes for a few users related to directory permissions and matcher parsing. The changelog includes fixes for merging consecutive client_ip or remote_ip matchers and creating appDataDir with 0o700 permissions.

chunks.title: v2.8.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.8.2, the release note provides a few more fixes of reported bugs related to ARI, try_files with the root path, and Caddyfile adapter detection on the CLI. The changelog includes fixes for sanitizing requests for root path, implementing certmagic.RenewalInfoGetter, and fixing auto-detection of .caddyfile extension.

chunks.title: v2.8.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.8.4, the release note is a hotfix for the Caddyfile detection regression in v2.8.2. The v2.8.3 tag was mistakenly made on the wrong commit and is skipped. The changelog includes a fix for regression in auto-detect of Caddyfile.

chunks.title: v2.9.0-beta.2

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.9.0, the release note announces Caddy 2.9, focused on refinements and bug fixes in config loading, events, logging, placeholders, reverse proxy and HTTP server performance, matchers, HTTP/3, metrics (per-host metrics), security, TLS automation & ACME ARI. It notes that Encrypted ClientHello (ECH) and post-quantum ciphers are slated for Go 1.24 and a future Caddy 2.10 release. The changelog includes numerous fixes and enhancements such as adding {?query} placeholder, allowing matching Transfer-Encoding, setting default ReadHeaderTimeout, adding MatchWithError, closing http3 server gracefully, allowing disabling storage cleaning, dropping deprecated rate_limit and burst, allowing add-package to select version, and many more.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.9.1, the release note is a patch release fixing issues related to FastCGI, HTTP/3 and unix sockets, log file permissions, repeated TERM signals, and an ARI edge case. It also adds Caddyfile support for response matching in the header directive. The changelog includes fixes for initiating exit only once, disabling h3 for unix domain socket, upgrading CertMagic to fix ARI handshake maintenance, adding match subdirective for response matching, and chmod for log files.

It also notes that only the latest minor Go version is supported. The release includes detailed ECH documentation and thanks contributors.

chunks.title: v2.10.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.10.1, the release note is a large patch release with bug fixes and dependency upgrades. It requires Go v1.25.0 or newer. Changes include updating quic-go to v0.51.0, fixing forwardproxy LoadModule, adding .avif support in file server, using DialTLSContext for TLS with placeholder servername, ensuring admin routers are provisioned, fixing default logger exclude/include, moving local admin server replacement logic, fixing acme_server policy parsing, implementing Unwrap for interceptedResponseHandler, mapping invalid path errors to fs.ErrInvalid, fixing route sort, and many refactors and dependency bumps.

chunks.title: v2.10.2

chunks.title: v2.11.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.11.0-beta.1, the release note announces the first beta of 2.11, made by a new automated release process carried out by the maintainer team without intervention from the original author. Notable changes: SIGUSR1 can reload configuration if loaded from a file and not changed by API; replaced lumberjack with timberjack for time-rolling logs; Caddy can bind listeners with named socket activation. The changelog includes fixes for encode response corruption, basicauth argon2id, various dependency bumps, Caddyfile block and import fixes, trusted_proxies_unix, keepalive options, placeholder normalization, and many other enhancements.

chunks.title: v2.11.0-beta.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.11.0-beta.2, the release note is the second beta of 2.11, closer to final release. It includes minor new features and enhancements, and a fix for the ZeroSSL API issuer. Changes include: ECH key rotation, logging on wildcard sites fix, {http.request.body_base64} placeholder, support for multiple intermediates in signing chain, preferred chains options fix, --json flag for list-modules, log_append Early option, tracing span attributes, and various dependency updates.

chunks.title: v2.11.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.11.1, the release note announces Caddy 2.11 with new features, bug fixes, and security patches. Notable changes: ECH keys rotated automatically, time-rolling options for logs, SIGUSR1 reload, reverse proxy rewrites Host header to upstream when HTTPS, log_append can log request/response bodies, AI assistance disclosures required. Security patches include CVEs for FastCGI, admin, caddyhttp Host and Path matchers, caddytls client authentication, and file matcher glob sanitization. The release also thanks sponsors and contributors.

chunks.title: v2.11.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.11.2, the release note contains numerous bug fixes and enhancements. Highlights: reverse proxy fixes for PROXY protocol, health check port, and body closing on retries; dynamic upstreams tracked for passive health checking; performance improvements for metrics; new tls_resolvers global option; log rolling supports zstd compression; refined logging and error messages; fixed rewrite handler URI bug. Security fixes include CVEs for forward_auth identity injection and vars_regexp double-expansion. Built on Go 1.26.1.

chunks.title: v2.11.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the caddyserver/caddy release v2.11.3, the release note improves several aspects with minor features, bug fixes, and security patches. chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.0.0-beta.9, the project improves data forwarding performance and adds built-in dashboards for the v8 version.

chunks.title: v8.0.0-beta.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.0.0-beta.10, the project introduces a new dashboard datasource selector, disables anonymous access for dashboards containing 'Machine Identifier' variables, deprecates 'Business Group Identifier' variable for dashboards, adds a 'Save' button to datasource form page supporting save without testing, changes default execution frequency of alert rules to 60 seconds, unifies submit buttons on rule form pages to 'Save', improves notification rules with view rule functionality, message template cloning, and adjustable documentation panel width, and fixes issues: datasource type not refreshed after creation, cloned alert rules not saving when original modified, incorrect field path saving for Elasticsearch source in alert rules, Lucene mode filter condition field values with 'and'/'or' auto-converted to uppercase, older dashboard import overflow due to missing legend.placement, and line chart tooltips not filtering empty value legends.

chunks.title: v8.0.0-beta.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.0.0-beta.11, the project adds support for ClickHouse data source alerts, redesigns the menu layout, revamps the active alerts page with side panel details for active and historical alerts, introduces an alert event processing Pipeline supporting Relabel, Callback, Event Update, and Event Drop processors, supports cross-business-group cloning of alert rules, adds timezone selection to dashboard time picker, adds a 'View' function to dashboard chart panels for full-screen viewing, adds variance and standard deviation statistics to dashboard time series legend, adds Offset setting to Elasticsearch alert rule query conditions, refactors Prometheus alert rule data preview to Table mode, and fixes issues: Elasticsearch single query condition preview querying all conditions, dashboard panel title bar tooltip max-width not applying, and shared temporary chart rendering failure.

chunks.title: v8.0.0-beta.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.0.0-beta.12, the backend has no changes; the frontend fixes a bug on the historical alert details page, requiring only binary replacement or image update for upgrade.

chunks.title: v8.0.0-beta.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.0.0-beta.13, the project adds support for MySQL data source alerts, refactors dashboard chart popup to include a time picker, fixes issues: notification media contact method saving failure, Elasticsearch KQL syntax error not displayed, and adds documentation for event pipeline processors with a note about Basic Auth configuration constraints.

chunks.title: v8.0.0-beta.14
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.0.0-beta.14, the project adds support for PostgreSQL data source alerts, an AI Summary processor for event pipelines, sharing links for alert events, testing functionality for mute rules and subscription rules, refactors by removing the event pipeline menu (now managed via notification rules side panel), adds sorting and copy functionality for alert rule event relabel settings, adds a refresh button to alert healing history task list page, displays 'Expired' label for mute rules outside effective time range, removes tag character length limit for additional tags input, adds password complexity validation, hides deprecated menus based on system installation time, optimizes datasource form save to prevent duplicate submissions, and fixes issues: alert rule batch update execution frequency input changed to cron expression format, and missing offset parameter in Elasticsearch alert rule query condition preview.

chunks.title: v8.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.0.0, the project adds support for Doris and Opensearch data source alerts, user management with permission-based access control, machine list with multiple search criteria, built-in metric descriptions supporting multi-language configuration, refactors alert duration calculation logic to use current detection time minus previous detection time, redesigns template center to prevent user modification of built-in templates, optimizes shield rule configuration page, supports displaying associated notification rules on alert rule list page, adds prominent alerts when data source-associated alert engines are disconnected, optimizes notification rule testing functionality prompts, adds 'Is recovery event?' option to applicable properties, supports hiding specific query conditions in dashboard query conditions, and fixes issues: dashboard table chart overrides configuration field matching, SSO login failure, and Elasticsearch alert data deviation when alert interval is 1 day.

chunks.title: v8.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.1.0, the project adds support for Elasticsearch log search to record user personal query statements, full-screen log viewing, quick query operations on content field values, refactors subscription rules to support Host type data sources, optimizes message template text, and fixes issues: subscription rule list table business group column rendering, page address mismatch with actual tab address, Elasticsearch log search left field list top N query pagination error, dashboard anonymous share link not using identifier, and notification rule script notification timeout.

chunks.title: v8.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.2.0, the project adds support for viewing Nightingale release records within the product, email notification records, refactors template center alert rules to convert to new notification rules when importing to business groups, optimizes message templates to fix display issues with blocked links and query curve links in IM, imports Prometheus alert rules adapted to new notification rules, and fixes issues: HTTP notification media 'Skip certificate verification' parameter error, shared anonymous access alert event pages removing data source list requests, PostgreSQL cross-database query issues, alert rule duplicate name detection logic, and Loki data source alert event details page jump to instant view carrying incorrect parameters.

chunks.title: v8.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.2.1, the project fixes MySQL data source alert client connection issues, Elasticsearch alert rule 'document minimum value' field name not taking effect, SSO logout functionality to redirect to SSO logout URL if available, refactors Prometheus alert rule import logic, and adds/adjusts some text descriptions.

chunks.title: v8.2.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.2.2, the project fixes a problem of data interaction when batch-updating alerting rules.

chunks.title: v8.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.3.0, the project adds a 'Table NG' panel type to dashboards, refactors machine heartbeat update logic, time-series data forwarding logic, data source selector UX for Instant Query/Log Search/Dashboard pages, alert rule picker UX on Subscription Rules page, Prometheus Instant Query to save history on Enter and input blur, Elasticsearch Log Search Query DSL, SSO login redirect to originally requested page, and fixes auto-remediation task status update and search not working in Business Group list view.

chunks.title: v8.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.3.1, the project fixes the dashboard data source selector not being able to select data source variables, and a send notification error retry invalid problem.

chunks.title: v8.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.4.0, the project adds Top N for field statistics in Elasticsearch log search, CSV export for Prometheus instant query Table view, encrypted storage for phone numbers, refactors periodic host caching logic, dashboard TableNG panel code and style, changes 'add filter by clicking a tag' to 'double-clicking a tag' in Active Alerts and Alert History, optimizes Business Group sidebar node action buttons, adds step-related settings to Quick View time-series chart, and fixes Business Group sidebar missing Edit button in list mode, SQL injection vulnerabilities in machine list and user list APIs, and OpenSearch authentication issue.

chunks.title: v8.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.4.1, the project fixes Elasticsearch v9 range query compatibility and HTTP callback retry interval in milliseconds.

chunks.title: v8.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.5.0, the project adds support for VictoriaLogs data source for alert rules, Dingtalk SSO, displaying associated business groups in team management, a hash field in alert event details, machine business group type option in applicable attribute selector, 'Metric classification ignore prefix' setting in quick view, notes field in dashboard configuration and tables, refactors dashboard variables with data preview and error messages, migrates 'Max data points' and 'Time' settings to panel level, limits PromQL input max height, optimizes ClickHouse data source configuration page, renames 'Collector' to 'Category' for built-in metrics, and fixes typos in dashboard configuration and message template save conflict.

chunks.title: v8.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v8.5.1, the project optimizes database initialization logic, fixes a typo in panel config within dashboard groups, resets zoom when time range changes in dashboard time series chart, and shows constant type variables when hide option is disabled in dashboard.

chunks.title: v9.0.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v9.0.0-beta.1, the project introduces Nightingale AI with built-in AI assistant, Skills marketplace, LLM config management, and page-specific prompt recommendations, redesigns navigation menu, global layout, and table UI, refactors notification channel management, adds a new event pipeline execution tracking page with detailed execution view, supports batch deletion of expired mute rules, filtering by disabled status for mute/subscription/recording rule lists, adds Feishu SSO, OAuth2 userinfo nested paths, LDAP login optional role override, a new host dashboard page with CPU, memory, and version stat cards, cross-page panel copy/paste via clipboard, TableNG CSV export, MySQL variables with multi/all selection, and strengthens SQL injection protection, adds Webhook queue size limit, and unifies MySQL collation. Upgrade note: Redis 5.0+ required (7.0+ recommended for Cluster).

chunks.title: v9.0.0-beta.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ccfos/nightingale release v9.0.0-beta.2, the project adds a document-based Q&A skill for AI chat and a one-click AI analysis button on the Alert Event Details page, and reiterates the V9 new features: Nightingale AI, redesigned navigation and UI, refactored notification channel management, and new event pipeline execution tracking page. Upgrade note: Redis 5.0+ required.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent ccxt/ccxt release stream from v4.5.27 through v4.5.56, covering exchange additions, API updates, bug fixes, and performance improvements.

chunks.title: v4.5.27

It also includes error mapping improvements for binance and bitget, unification of order types for binance, market type inference for coincatch fetchTickers, a fix for hyperliquid hip3 dex loading, removal of check_conflicting_proxies camelCase in Exchange.py, and various other fixes and dependency bumps.

It also includes refactoring of hasTakeProfit/hasStopLoss for coincatch, bingx, blofin, and bitget, a fix to not omit 'tpslMode' from params in bybit, and a dependency bump for next.

It also includes numerous refactors of hasStopLoss/hasTakeProfit across multiple exchanges, transpiler chore updates, documentation link replacements, encoding fixes, and various other fixes and rate limit adjustments.

It also includes error mapping for bybit and gate, a fix for hyperliquid hip3 markets loading, a fix for bingx status mapping, and various test skips and chore updates.

It also includes fixes for dydx import, handlePong timestamp, gate microsecond order timestamp, hyperliquid spot currency mapping, and binary message handling in browser, along with removal of oceanex exchange.
