prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent charmbracelet/bubbletea release stream from v1.2.2 through v2.0.7, covering rendering fixes, interrupt handling, Windows support, and the major v2.0.0 release with a new renderer, declarative view API, and keyboard enhancements.

chunks.title: v1.2.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.2.2, the project fixes bugs in the fast new renderer introduced in v1.2.0, specifically incorrect line skipping in renderer flush and erasing the rest of the line when it is shorter than the width.

chunks.title: v1.2.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.2.3, a longstanding bug in the renderer is fixed where mis-paints could occur when toggling in and out of the altscreen if the height of the TUI changed while in the altscreen, by adjusting cursor position after exiting alt screen.

chunks.title: v1.2.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.2.4, a couple of rendering bugs are fixed: cursor position adjustment after exiting alt screen and keeping a separate count of lines rendered in the alt screen.

chunks.title: v1.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.3.0, refined interrupt handling is introduced, allowing graceful handling of ctrl+c or interrupt signals via a new tea.Interrupt command. It also fixes the last rendered line count to include alt screen lines and cancels Windows console input threads using CancelIoEx.

chunks.title: v1.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.3.1, important bug fixes are introduced for cursor movements while rendering, using newline instead of cud1 to move cursor down, and properly handling Windows AltGr key on non-English keyboards.

chunks.title: v1.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.3.2, a fix is provided for canceling terminal input reads on Windows by handling cancel io error.

chunks.title: v1.3.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.3.3, the program options that were deprecated in previous releases are restored.

chunks.title: v1.3.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.3.4, an issue on Windows is fixed where the mouse is always enabled even if not requested; now mouse options and commands turn the mouse on/off as expected.

chunks.title: v2.0.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.0-beta.1, the first beta of Bubble Tea v2 is announced, restoring the old Init behavior, adding cursor support via a new tea.CursorView interface, and renaming keyboard enhancement request function to tea.RequestKeyboardEnhancement.

chunks.title: v1.3.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.3.5, an important bug on Windows is fixed where function keys (F1..F20) were not recognized, and multiple concurrency bugs related to external context and p.Wait()/p.Kill() are resolved.

chunks.title: v2.0.0-beta.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.0-beta.2, key events now always return the textual value via key.String() and a keystroke representation via key.Keystroke(), the trailing newline on program exit is reverted, and concurrency fixes with deadlock prevention are added.

chunks.title: v2.0.0-beta.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.0-beta.3, key disambiguation is enabled by default when supported, and basic keyboard enhancements are always enabled to disambiguate keys.

chunks.title: v1.3.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.3.6, issues regarding tea.Exec output after resuming from the executed program and Windows losing input character on successive program execution are fixed.

chunks.title: v2.0.0-beta.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.0-beta.4, keyboard enhancements are split into three separate functions: WithKeyReleases, WithUniformKeyLayout, and RequestKeyDisambiguation. A panic trace file can be created by setting TEA_DEBUG=true.

chunks.title: v1.3.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.3.7, the renderer properly resets cursor position to start of line, compact sequences like batches are fixed, and nested SequenceMsg is handled in the event loop.

chunks.title: v1.3.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.3.8, batch commands are sent to the cmds channel instead of being executed in the event loop.

chunks.title: v1.3.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.3.9, nested sequenceMsg and batchMsg are properly called, and recovery from nested panics in Sequence and Batch commands is added.

chunks.title: v1.3.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v1.3.10, setWindowTitleMsg and windowSizeMsg are handled in the event loop.

chunks.title: v2.0.0-beta.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.0-beta.5, the View API is refined to be more declarative, with a View struct encapsulating all view-related properties, and many view-based startup options and commands are removed in favor of this approach.

chunks.title: v2.0.0-beta.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.0-beta.6, renderer fixes are included: avoiding keyboard enhancement requests on close, resetting cursor style and color on close, moving cursor to bottom only in main screen, and syncing buffer resize with frame rate.

chunks.title: v2.0.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.0-rc.1, the module name changes to charm.land/bubbletea/v2, and several message types (CursorPositionMsg, KeyboardEnhancementsMsg, PasteMsg, CapabilityMsg, TerminalVersionMsg) change from type aliases to structs for extensibility.

chunks.title: v2.0.0-rc.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.0-rc.2, synchronized output updates (mode 2026) are introduced and enabled by default, along with various renderer bug fixes and edge case handling.

chunks.title: v2.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.0, the second major release is announced, featuring the new Cursed Renderer, improved key handling with progressive keyboard enhancements, built-in color downsampling, a declarative view API, and a charm.land import path.

chunks.title: v2.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.1, a small patch fixes opening the proper default stdin file for input by checking if os.Stdin is a terminal before opening the TTY.

chunks.title: v2.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.2, a rendering fix is applied for Wish users on Unix platforms by using mapNl optimization when not on Windows and no PTY input.

chunks.title: v2.0.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.3, support for extended keyboard enhancements is added, and the Cursed Renderer is made smarter by resetting terminal tab stops for the program process context.

chunks.title: v2.0.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.4, a small fix related to width calculation in x/ansi is included.

chunks.title: v2.0.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.5, an accidental unwanted debug log file is removed.

chunks.title: v2.0.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.6, an issue with handling wide characters is fixed, preventing skipping or infinite loops that could cause CPU spikes.

chunks.title: v2.0.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the charmbracelet/bubbletea release v2.0.7, stability patches are provided: a race condition around mice in the Cursed Renderer is fixed, a panic when input is not available is fixed, and a correctness issue with mouse releases when Kitty Keyboard is active is resolved.

Type improvements allow font to be partial scriptable and individually scriptable, add 'middle' to borderSkipped, export types for cartesian and radial tick options, add startAngle to radial scale options typings, add missing fields to ScriptableContext, and allow array for line opts in dataset. Documentation adds links to docs in all samples, fixes a typo in data-structures.md, corrects chart initialization flow, updates link to filler plugin, fixes broken link in Animations docs, removes hardcoded licenseYear, updates link to license and bumps license year, and documents scale update plugin hooks. Development bumps to 3.8.0, resolves circular import filler plugin, replaces deprecated String.prototype.substr(), and refactors filler plugin for easier maintenance.

Type improvements allow clip to be configurable in options object typescript, add index to legendItem interface, add padding to pointLabels type and type to scriptable context, and allow for each dataset to be individually typed without a main type. Documentation documents defaults for plugins, updates a link to be usable within github, adds a stale version warning and a link to the latest version of docs, updates integration.md, enforces maximum width on chart editor blocks in the docs, updates aspectRatio documentation, updates responsive.md, clarifies helpers need to be imported when using bundlers, fixes a typo in link to documentation from sample, fixes default value of 'includeInvisible' option in the documentation, and clarifies api docs. chunks.title: v1.0.0 Release Candidate 3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.0.0-rc3-hotfix7 (Release Candidate 3), the project restructured the SpacetimeDB directory, requiring a data wipe. Highlights include performance improvements, removal of println! and eprintln! macros in favor of log::info! and log::error!, fixing multiple table definitions on the same struct in Rust modules, CLI fixes such as spacetime energy balance and renaming spacetime dns to spacetime rename, preserving comments and formatting in cli.toml updates, new C# index syntax, reduced noisy C# compilation errors, and a fix for C# modules not building with .NET 9 installed.

chunks.title: v1.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.0.0, the project announces the first production-ready release, leaving beta. It introduces Maincloud, a managed cloud service, streamlined stable client SDKs in TypeScript, C#, and Rust, stable module APIs in C# and Rust, performance improvements, mutable subscription APIs, a new version manager CLI, a new website interface and account management, and OpenID Connect integration. Testnet is deprecated and replaced by Maincloud.

chunks.title: Release 1.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.0.1, a collection of small bugfixes on top of 1.0.0 is provided. It fixes an issue with primary keys not working properly in generated TypeScript code, addresses --build-options not working, Identity and ConnectionId not implementing IComparable, SQL update and delete exceptions, row deduplication in incremental update, a bug on generated TypeScript from C# module, OIDC JWT handling accepting string aud, and Alpine Linux install issues.

chunks.title: Release 1.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.1.0, the first version bump since 1.0, public access for row-level security is introduced. It improves usability for timestamps and durations with new methods and trait impls for arithmetic operations. Other notable improvements include features to save disk space and reduce memory usage, support for enums as index keys, and restoring CLI functionality for printing the number of rows affected by an operation.

chunks.title: v1.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.1.1, a small collection of performance improvements and bugfixes is provided. Most notably, two outstanding TypeScript code generation bugs are fixed.

chunks.title: Release 1.1.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.1.2, the primary fix addresses an issue related to building Rust modules where a dependency update caused compilation issues for some users. Other changes include TypeScript generation wrapping union types in parens for arrays, implementing OnUnhandledReducerError in C#, preventing double compression of subscribe messages, pruning queries from subscription evaluation, and removing redundant rows from subscription updates.

chunks.title: Release 1.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.2.0, a ton of performance improvements are included in both server code and generated client code, along with several important bug fixes and quality of life improvements. Specific changes include proper use of import type in generated TypeScript code, fixing Equals and GetHashCode for types containing lists and arrays in C# code, fixing an SDK bug with overlapping subscriptions, fixing a bug where spacetime rename would leave the old name in place, fixing a bug where RLS would stop working after opening the web dashboard, and adding an unstable HTTP route for getting the current timestamp.

chunks.title: Release v1.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.3.0, users can now add new values at the end of an enum without clearing database data. The release includes lots of performance improvements to CPU usage, memory usage, and network behavior. Several bugs are addressed, especially fixing a bug where clients making similar queries could prevent each other from getting query updates, fixing issues #2894 and #2891, and fixing spacetime version list not showing the current version.

chunks.title: Release v1.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.3.1, a few bugfixes related to database reloading are provided. The functionality to add enum variants is temporarily disabled due to causing other issues. Note that the version number will display as 1.3.0 instead of 1.3.1 due to a forgotten patch number bump; verify commit hash starts with cc4a1 to ensure using 1.3.1.

chunks.title: Release v1.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.3.2, a small bugfix release re-enables and fixes functionality for adding new enum variants.

chunks.title: Release v1.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.4.0, Unreal Engine support is announced with a full SDK, and React Hooks (Beta) are introduced for easier React integration. Confirmed reads feature allows specifying during connection setup to only hear back about transactions that have been persisted. The release also includes a new Blackholio tutorial with Unreal Engine parity, and upgrade instructions for the new CLI and SDK versions.

chunks.title: Release v1.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.5.0, the initial version of the Postgres Wire Protocol (Beta) is implemented, allowing normal Postgres clients to connect to SpacetimeDB on port 5432. SpacetimeAuth (Beta) is also released, a new authentication and user management service operated by Clockwork Labs. The release also removes @clockworklabs/typescript-sdk in favor of spacetimedb.

chunks.title: Release v1.6.0 - TypeScript Modules (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.6.0, TypeScript Modules (Beta) are introduced, adding a new server module language with a new runtime shipping with v8. Additional schema migration support is added, including adding columns to tables. Other improvements include a Default attribute for fields in C# modules, database snapshot improvements, Unreal Engine fixes, TypeScript SDK fixes, and miscellaneous bugfixes.

chunks.title: Release v1.7.0 - `spacetime dev`
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.7.0, a new CLI command spacetime dev is introduced, automating the development loop by generating types, building, publishing, subscribing to logs, and watching for file changes. A canonical default project structure is introduced, and the command supports initializing new projects or connecting to existing ones.

chunks.title: Release v1.8.0 - Module Defined Views
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.8.0, Module Defined Views are introduced, allowing custom read permissioning via virtual tables defined by view functions in Rust, C#, and TypeScript. The RLS API is deprecated in favor of the view API. Views support index probing and will later support typed queries for full table scans.

chunks.title: Release v1.9.0 - Project Collaborators
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.9.0, project collaborators feature is introduced, allowing team members to be invited to projects on Maincloud. The TypeScript API receives a major update with breaking changes, including camelCase accessor names, unified SDK and server module types, and changes to reducer callbacks and count return type.

chunks.title: Release v1.10.0 - Procedures and HTTP Requests
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.10.0, procedures and HTTP requests are introduced, allowing databases to perform HTTP requests to external services from within modules. Procedures are a new type of database function with weaker guarantees than reducers, enabling side effects. Only Rust and TypeScript modules can define procedures in this release. TypeScript fixes are also included.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.0 - Typed Query Builder
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.11.0, typed query builders for Rust and TypeScript modules are released, enabling views with performance guarantees for realtime subscription updates. Query operators include .where(), .leftSemijoin(), and .rightSemijoin(). Examples are provided for both languages.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.1 - Bug Fixes + Performance Improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.11.1, bug fixes and performance improvements are provided, especially for TypeScript: sourcemap processing for stacktraces, native UTF-8 processing for TextEncoder/TextDecoder, useTable working with camelCase columns, and compatibility with noImplicitOverride. Other changes include WebSocket message fragmentation and various fixes.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.2 - Bug fixes + Performance improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.11.2, performance improvements for small transactions and time between transactions, a critical deadlock fix, and many small fixes are included. C# procedures are introduced (beta until 1.12). TypeScript gets a performance improvement for faster index lookups. Unreal receives several bug fixes. A new /templates directory is introduced for sharing templates.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.3 - Bug fixes + Performance improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.11.3, spacetime dev gets an additional --template argument. Bug fixes and improvements include many small improvements for C# and Unreal, and various other fixes.

chunks.title: Release v1.12.0 - Client-side Typed Query Builder
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v1.12.0, the last minor version before 2.0, client-side typed query builders are added for TypeScript, Rust, and C#. New front-end framework SDKs for Vue and Svelte are introduced. Organizations support is added. Operational tooling improvements include spacetime login --no-browser and a method to query replica IDs. New authentication tutorials for Auth0 and Clerk are added. Performance and reliability improvements are included.

chunks.title: SpacetimeDB 2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v2.0.1 (SpacetimeDB 2.0), TypeScript/JavaScript support leaves beta, web framework integrations are built for Angular, React, Nuxt, Vue, Next.js, Node, Deno, TanStack, Remix, Svelte, and Bun. Unreal Engine/C++ support is official. Performance delivers over 100k transactions per second for TypeScript and up to 170k for Rust. A new Maincloud FREE tier and pricing are announced, along with the Spacerace Referral Program. Procedures and HTTP calls are now available, and a migration guide is provided.

chunks.title: Release v2.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v2.0.2, a bug fix and quality-of-life release following 2.0, CLI improvements, durability tuning, and documentation fixes are provided. Bug fixes include TypeScript table schema wire name lookup crash, spacetime dev file watcher ignoring --module-path, better error for missing module directory, fix for "Press any key to exit" in templates, and not saving source_config to spacetime.json. Performance improvements include reducing local durability fsync interval to 10ms and C# SDK using ArrayPool for row iteration buffers.

chunks.title: Release v2.0.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v2.0.3, new features include spacetime logs --level filtering. Bug fixes improve latency for durable commits, fix React useTable isReady stuck on false, fix TanStack Start useSpacetimeDBQuery returning untyped rows, fix TypeScript toCamelCase conversion, fix index truncate edge cases, preserve leading .. in --out-dir paths, fix publishing in directories with spaces, and skip upgrade prompt when -y is passed. C# SDK improves error messages for Views.

chunks.title: Release v2.0.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v2.0.4, the spacetime CLI now checks daily for updates and notifies users. spacetime dev project initialization includes fuzzy search for template selection. Bug fixes include fixing spacetime login --token falling through to web login and several correctness fixes preventing database loading.

chunks.title: Release v2.0.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v2.0.5, a small bug fix release fixes a bug introduced in v2.0.4 and another fix for users trying to use LLMs in procedures. Fixes include bumping HTTP procedure timeouts and attempting to repair databases with wrong host type.

chunks.title: Release v2.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v2.1.0, Rust client Wasm support is added, enabling browser-based apps. C++ Modules and Unreal SDK are updated for 2.0 compatibility. Bug fixes include fixing useTable isReady reverting to false and fixing v2 client disconnects dropping subscriptions for other v2 clients.

chunks.title: Release v2.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v2.2.0, a new v3 WebSocket transport batches messages for faster realtime transport. Safer production database operations include spacetime lock/unlock, confirmation for spacetime delete, and improved listing. Better TypeScript app ergonomics include an Astro + TypeScript template and a typed useProcedure hook. Smoother schema evolution allows dropping empty tables during auto-migration and fixing primary key changes. More powerful table and index APIs include clear table support and bytes-key B-tree support. Bug fixes address V8 crashes, schema migration bugs, autoinc reset, Windows code signing, and more.

chunks.title: Release v2.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the clockworklabs/SpacetimeDB release v2.3.0, first-party Godot SDK and Blackholio Tutorial are introduced. WebSocket transport is improved with batched responses and pipelining. HTTP/2 backend support is added. Vue useProcedure hook is introduced. Unity 6 WebGL compatibility is added. Commitlog performance and operations are enhanced. Rust DbContext generics are supported. API changes deprecate ReducerContext::identity. Bug fixes address V8 segfault, connection lifecycle callbacks, unsubscribe panics, view auto-migration, msync calls, Windows fsync, auth error details, and prepared statement rollback.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent conductor-oss/conductor release stream, covering stable releases v3.22.2 through v3.30.1 and a series of pre-release candidates for v3.3.0, v3.30.0, and v3.31.0. Key themes include UI overhauls, new persistence and scheduler modules, AI integration improvements, and workflow engine reliability enhancements.

chunks.title: v3.22.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor release v3.22.2, the project relaxed task definition requirements for SIMPLE tasks.

chunks.title: v3.22.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor release v3.22.3, the project added support for reasonForIncompletion in fail_task event handlers, overhauled the documentation site with a modern design, fixed ui-next enum export, ported improved decider postpone logic to the new sweeper, fixed JetStream stream name generation for dot-separated subjects, bumped several dependencies, introduced OSS Conductor UI V2, added synchronous join support to FORK_JOIN, and fixed a PostgresPollDataDAO flush executor shutdown issue.

chunks.title: v3.23.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor release v3.23.0, the project added support for ES8 Persistence, introduced JDBC workers, added a conductor-scheduler-postgres-persistence module, fixed Swagger UI fallback to Petstore, made Assistant UX height adjustments, allowed sidebar items override, added pre-commit hooks, fixed sidebar buttons to open in new tabs, supported multiple WF status listeners via composite pattern, split Integrations sidebar into Connections & Resources and Connected Apps views, added multi cron support in scheduler, added boundary timer config for tasks in workflow definitions, added a drill-down modal to Tags Dashboard, added Gemini API key support, fixed DO_WHILE with empty items list, added TaskDef-level control for task status event publishing, and reverted the drill-down modal and multi cron features.

chunks.title: v3.3.0.rc2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.3.0.rc2, the project added an e2e test suite and fixed ES8 ILM rollover template aliases.

chunks.title: v3.3.0.rc3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.3.0.rc3, the project added an e2e test suite, fixed ES8 ILM rollover template aliases, and refactored Redis and upgraded Jedis.

chunks.title: v3.3.0.rc4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.3.0.rc4, the project resolved a Claude assistant message prefill error in the AI module.

chunks.title: v3.3.0.rc5

chunks.title: v3.3.0.rc6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.3.0.rc6, the project pushed a 60-second code example for the Java SDK while downgrading Protobuf, upgrading Polyglot, and downgrading testcontainers; removed a Python-specific example from the bug report template; fixed the JS SDK package in a quickstart worker example; and fixed a mutable map issue for tool call args in LLMHelper.

chunks.title: v3.3.0.rc8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.3.0.rc8, the project introduced the Workflow Message Queue (WMQ) feature to push messages into running workflows.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc1, the project improved onboarding quickstart accuracy, fixed a busy-wait loop in a quickstart Python worker, fixed a failing test harness, restored Redis Sentinel auth and supported multiple sentinel addresses in redis-lock, added wildcard search and sub-workflow filtering, added useSSL and trustCert fields to GrpcServiceDefDto, fixed conductor_server.sh to download JAR to ~/.conductor-cli/ with progress, replaced a broken jq pipeline with plain async start for WORKFLOW_ID capture, loaded Redis connection beans when Redis is used for queues, fixed standalone and sentinel Redis command retries, used mcp-core instead of mcp and removed dead MCP client code, reorganized the UI, added missing integration icons, and removed an Adoptium link from README prerequisites.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc2, the project removed a GitHub account from CLAUDE.md, fixed slow GET /metadata/workflow with Redis cache and UI switch to names-and-versions, removed the tags dashboard (enterprise-only feature), added a CONNECTED_APPS_ENABLED flag and integration icon type map, and cleaned up during CI.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc3, the project prevented DO_WHILE horizontal overlap inside FORK_JOIN and improved the task retry policy.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc4, the project fixed flaky tests on test-harness, fixed a DO_WHILE + SWITCH premature iteration advancement when an async task completes before the successor is scheduled, removed Spring AI provider SDKs and added native tools, reverted boundary timer fields from task input parameters, and added documentation for monitoring and callback patterns for Human tasks.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc5, the project implemented an initial file storage feature, fixed an ElementTree truthiness bug in the e2e summary script, updated JDBC workers, fixed a jq pipeline in quickstart, and performed package updates.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc6, the project added MCP integration types and wired doc links in the workflow editor, updated Tomcat version to 10.1.54, and removed an unnecessary switch style causing misalignment issues.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc7, the project applied a fix for the assistant.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc8, the project refactored metrics to make Monitors self-contained and turned MetricsCollector into a registry wiring bean.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc9, the project added a per-workflow /versions API with lazy UI version loading and added a scheduler to conductor OSS from Orkes.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc10, the project fixed OpenSearch OOM kills, pinned postgres:latest, fixed startup.sh flag ordering, added documentation for the file storage feature, updated the project title in README, and hot-fixed a reaflow version downgrade from 5.4.1 to 5.1.2 because the diagram broke.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc12, the project resolved ${...} expressions in subWorkflowParam.workflowDefinition.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc13, the release was created for UI testing to facilitate a new conductor-ui release.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc14
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc14, the project added reasoning / chain-of-thought summary support across all AI providers.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc15
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc15, the project fixed ci.yml to run on all changes due to branch protection, added AWS_S3 and HUBSPOT integration types, and hot-fixed showing task doc URL for non-MCP task types.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc16
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc16, the project added a JSON response option and saving of temperature, topP, stopwords to AI Prompts, made assistant improvements, fixed AMQP to skip ack when using exchange, improved SUB_WORKFLOW reliability, recovery, and scalability, made PostgresLockDAO reentrant, fixed a UI crash on New Workflow Definition, and made SubWorkflow id derivation task-intrinsic for idempotency.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc17
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc17, the project cut Inline task latency via Context pool, shared Engine, Source cache, and native deep-copy; converted original UI tests to Playwright; and unified OkHttp3 transport with shared bean, retry, and Gemini REST migration for AI.

chunks.title: v3.30.0.rc18
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor pre-release v3.30.0.rc18, the project renamed TaskType.MCP to INTEGRATION and cleaned -mcp suffix from integration types, gated loop assistant-prefill injection on provider capability, released postponed tasks when concurrencyLimit slot frees in Redis, and refactored metrics to make Monitors self-contained with MetricsCollector as a registry wiring bean.

chunks.title: v3.30.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor release v3.30.0, the project aggregated changes from multiple pre-releases including an e2e test suite, ES8 ILM rollover template alias fix, Redis refactor and Jedis upgrade, Claude assistant message prefill fix, README link fix, extraction of conductor-redis-api, removal of accidentally committed TaskType.class file, persistence search query single-quote stripping, various dependency bumps, a 60-second Java SDK code example with Protobuf downgrade, removal of Python-specific bug report template example, JS SDK package fix in quickstart, mutable map fix for LLMHelper tool call args, /api/version endpoint, Workflow Message Queue (WMQ) feature, onboarding quickstart accuracy improvements, busy-wait loop fix in quickstart Python worker, test harness fix, Redis Sentinel auth restore and multiple sentinel address support, wildcard search and sub-workflow filtering, useSSL and trustCert fields in GrpcServiceDefDto, conductor_server.sh download fix, broken jq pipeline replacement, Redis connection bean loading for queues, standalone and sentinel Redis command retry fix, mcp-core usage and dead MCP client code removal, UI reorganization, missing integration icons addition, and Adoptium link removal from README prerequisites.

chunks.title: v3.30.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the conductor-oss/conductor release v3.30.1, the project rewrote thinkingTokenLimit to adaptive thinking on Claude Opus 4.7 and raised the nested rerun await to 30s for sub-workflow propagation in e2e tests.

chunks.title: v3.31.0-rc.1

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent continuedev/continue release stream across CLI, VS Code, JetBrains, and config-yaml releases. It covers a period of rapid iteration with multiple daily prereleases and stable releases introducing new providers, agent features, and bug fixes.

chunks.title: @continuedev/config-yaml@1.41.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the continuedev/continue release @continuedev/config-yaml@1.41.0, several bug fixes were introduced: detection of WSL remote for shell PATH resolution, a fix for OpenAI Responses API parallel tool calls losing call_ids, prevention of file descriptor count leak in resource monitoring, and simplification of file descriptor count calculation. Additionally, a feature was added to support tool prompt override in .continuerc.json.

chunks.title: @continuedev/config-yaml@1.42.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the continuedev/continue release @continuedev/config-yaml@1.42.0, bug fixes included adding reasoning content field support in chat body, adding an SSL verification option for client transports, retrieving reasoning toggle from local storage, and showing an error for blank inputs when using hub blocks in local config. New features added were Nous Research Hermes models as a provider and OpenRouter Provider Support with Dynamic Model Loading.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent coollabsio/coolify release stream from v4.0.0-beta.448 through v4.1.1, covering security fixes, new service templates, UI improvements, and the final v4.0.0 stable release.

chunks.title: v4.0.0-beta.448
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the coollabsio/coolify release v4.0.0-beta.448, the release note indicates that the release includes migrations, with a single pull request by @andrasbacsai.

chunks.title: v4.0.0-beta.449
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the coollabsio/coolify release v4.0.0-beta.449, fixes include preserving Docker build cache by excluding dynamic variables, showing shared env scopes dropdown even when no variables exist, and adding authorization checks for environment and project views. New features include a developer view for shared environment variables and custom docker entrypoint support. Improvements include improved variable scope handling in docker entrypoint parsing.

chunks.title: v4.0.0-beta.450
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the coollabsio/coolify release v4.0.0-beta.450, security and fixes include fixing database restore modal not closing properly, fixing installation failures caused by CDN redirect handling in curl commands, and fixing proxy startup failures due to bash syntax errors. Improvements include adding Docker build cache preservation toggles, a new option to skip automatic Dockerfile ARG injection, and a new option to exclude SOURCE_COMMIT from build context, applicable to both Dockerfile and Docker Compose buildpacks.

chunks.title: v4.0.0-beta.451
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the coollabsio/coolify release v4.0.0-beta.451, security and fixes include enhanced security by validating and escaping database names, file paths, and proxy configuration filenames to prevent command injection, fixing Docker command failures on non-root servers and proxy network race conditions, fixing path duplication in SERVICE_FQDN and SERVICE_URL, and fixing configuration change detection for build settings. Improvements include enhanced environment variable handling with better password field support and shared variable management, improved build time variable checkbox behavior, reduced excessive logging in cleanup commands, improved version release automation workflow, and better error handling during Git operations.

chunks.title: v4.0.0-beta.452
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the coollabsio/coolify release v4.0.0-beta.452, security and fixes include fixing Traefik proxy startup issues with null versions and network filtering, fixing service name parsing issues when using hyphens, fixing version downgrade prevention with improved cache validation, fixing webhook notification settings migration conflict, fixing Docker database start commands compatibility across versions, fixing duplicate environment variables in buildtime.env and Nixpacks plan overrides, fixing incorrect Caddy proxy config file path display, fixing Livewire snapshot error during database restore, fixing Beszel realtime monitoring feature, and fixing Appwrite too many redirects error. Improvements include improved manual update process with better user feedback, improved new resource page UI layout and styling, added color-coded log highlighting based on log level, and added Postgresus to predefined Docker networks by default.

chunks.title: v4.0.0-beta.453
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the coollabsio/coolify release v4.0.0-beta.453, security and fixes include terminal stays connected when browser tab loses focus, preview deployments now properly cleaned up on GitLab, Bitbucket, and Gitea, fixed SSH conflicts during concurrent scheduled tasks, fixed Nixpacks failing with null environment variables, deployment status now shows 'In Progress' immediately when queued, fixed cleanup errors incorrectly marking successful deployments as failed, fixed service status stuck at 'Starting' after stop, fixed backup timeout not being applied during remote execution, fixed Traefik warning not clearing after proxy restart, fixed container 'Restarting' status not displaying correctly, fixed degraded sub-resource and mixed status states, fixed Traefik email notifications with clickable server links, fixed PostgREST showing in wrong category and empty Domains section, fixed base directory path validation issues, fixed port validation blocking advanced checkbox saves, fixed Docker build args not working with service names, fixed preview URL port template variable, fixed logs not loading for single container services, and fixed Garage service TOML config and healthcheck. New services and templates include added Garage (S3-compatible distributed storage), added RustFS (S3-compatible storage), and added Fizzy (feedback widget). Improvements include added Arch Linux server support, added Docker image retention for application rollback support, added colorized log levels with toggle, added log search, download, and collapsible sections, added collapsible option to logs component, added runtime/buildtime properties to environment variables, proxy restart now runs as background job with real-time logs, dashboard performance improved with request-level caching, renamed 'unsend' to 'usesend' in email configuration, renamed DOCKER_TOKEN/USERNAME to DOCKERHUB_TOKEN/USERNAME, improved Advanced Settings helper text clarity, improved PostgreSQL type docs link styling, improved Sentinel update check scheduling, and decoupled storage check from Sentinel sync.

chunks.title: v4.0.0-beta.454
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the coollabsio/coolify release v4.0.0-beta.454, security and fixes include fixing concurrent builds being ignored and adding deployment queue limit protection, fixing deployments incorrectly marked as failed after healthy container rolling update, fixing Docker container race condition during upgrades, fixing deployment logs stopping unexpectedly mid-deployment, fixing deployment logs overlap with deployments indicator, fixing empty logs display and fullscreen coverage in logs viewer, fixing restart counter persistence and race condition, preventing Coolify infrastructure images from being pruned during cleanup, fixing API response to return fqdn instead of non-existent domains attribute, fixing user token session not being set correctly for team, and adding proxy config filename validation to prevent path traversal. Improvements include adding Hetzner server provisioning API endpoints, adding autogenerate_domain API parameter for applications, adding Retry-After header to 429 rate limit responses, always showing 'Allow Public PR Deployments' option for better discoverability, improving OpenAPI spec and adding rate limit handling for Hetzner, removing dead server filtering code from scheduler for better performance, and removing duplicate getArchDockerInstallCommand() method. Developer experience includes adding deterministic UUIDs to development seeders for easier API testing.

chunks.title: v4.0.0-beta.466

chunks.title: v4.0.0-beta.468
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the coollabsio/coolify release v4.0.0-beta.468, security and fixes include fixing SSH connection retry failures during deployments, fixing deployment type selection when using GitHub/GitLab Apps, fixing deployment authorization endpoint returning incorrect 404 errors, fixing shared variables not resolving in Docker Compose environments, fixing SSH keys not being used for git submodule and LFS operations, and adding support for scoped npm packages in file path validation. chunks.title: v4.0.0-beta.469
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the coollabsio/coolify release v4.0.0-beta.469, security and fixes include fixing sporadic SSH 'permission denied' errors during key rotation, fixing deployment failures when build server is enabled during restart operations, fixing breadcrumb queries causing out-of-memory crashes, fixing GitHub App webhook endpoint defaulting to IPv4 instead of instance domain, fixing Hoppscotch service failing to start due to database health check, fixing Docker Compose not respecting preserveRepository for project directory, fixing backup error when S3 storage is missing or deleted, fixing Stripe subscription error handling and resilience, fixing Heyform template configuration, fixing API resource UUID extraction from route parameters, fixing Docker cleanup stale container warning on cloud instances, and fixing Compose file-not-found error now includes git branch info. chunks.title: v4.0.0-beta.474
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the coollabsio/coolify release v4.0.0-beta.474, security and fixes include preventing data loss when persistent containers are accidentally pruned during service deletion, fixing S3 storage backup endpoints returning 500 in API context, encrypting manual webhook secrets and strengthening HMAC signature verification, fixing Rocky Linux installer to use correct RHEL Docker repository, hardening authentication by upgrading email verification hash and fixing invitation link login, validating and rate-limiting feedback endpoint, tightening volume name and path validation with shell argument escaping, validating backup upload file type and size limits, tightening S3 endpoint URL validation, hardening dev helper version validation and build argument escaping, strengthening team scoping across resource creation flows, fixing SSH repository URLs with custom ports being mangled, fixing healthcheck path validation rejecting commas and semicolons, fixing database credential validation and shell escaping across Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, improving shell command tokenization for install, build, and start commands, and returning stable generic error messages for API 5xx responses. Improvements include adding optional expiration for API tokens with advance notification warning before expiry, adding DELETE API endpoint to remove preview deployments by pull request ID, marking Docker Swarm support as deprecated ahead of v5 removal, categorizing application advanced settings into logical sections, improving service settings layout with dedicated advanced page and clearer headings, displaying memory limit fields in a single row, adding info callout to clone resource section listing excluded items, adding architecture warning for service templates with platform limitations, and improving domain port+path format documentation in the UI.

chunks.title: v4.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the coollabsio/coolify release v4.0.0, the release note announces the final release of v4.0 after a long beta period, with thousands of companies using it in production. Security and fixes include fixing Rallly service environment variable defaults, fixing Logto upgrade failure caused by missing database migration step, fixing Jitsi Meet not working by rebuilding template with stable image and proper UDP/secrets, fixing Twenty deployment failure from unhealthy worker dependency, fixing mobile info popup not opening on tap and bubbling clicks to parent, and fixing SPA navigation race conditions causing stale state, broken buttons, and unsaved changes. New services and templates include added Cap captcha service template, re-enabled Plane service with updated docker-compose, updated Beszel and Beszel Agent to 0.18.7, and disabled Cal.com template because the project went closed source. Improvements include added healthcheck to Langfuse worker.

chunks.title: v4.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the coollabsio/coolify release v4.1.0, features include adding Railpack as a beta build pack option with build-time environment support, config merging, examples, and deployment smoke coverage, adding configurable application stop grace periods for manual stops, previews, and deployments, adding structured audit logging for API mutations, webhook events, authentication, and authorization outcomes, adding per-server configurable SSH connection timeouts and exposing the setting through the API and UI, adding deployment skipping for webhook commits and PR/MR titles containing [skip ci] or [skip cd], adding instance-level MCP support with read-only tools for Coolify resources and API/UI enablement controls, adding application deployment configuration diff tracking so pending changes and build-impacting changes are surfaced before redeploy, adding a collapsible sidebar with persisted state, tooltips, and a compact team menu, and adding a Gitea runner service template. Fixes include fixing OAuth user matching by normalizing email addresses before lookup, fixing SMTP notification validation by setting a default encryption value, fixing database backup max storage validation to allow decimal values, fixing Dockerfile build pack builds by using BuildKit-supported host networking, fixing generated HEX magic environment secrets so encoded values have the expected length, fixing server reachability notifications by dispatching them through an event path without blocking retry loops, fixing large file-volume editing in the UI by blocking editable payloads over 5 MiB, fixing deployment commit resolution to use the application git_commit_sha when no commit is explicitly provided, fixing database imports to allow .dmp files, fixing invalid or undecryptable Sentinel tokens by regenerating them automatically, fixing scheduled task server resolution when relationships are missing, fixing preview image tags so different commits on the same PR do not reuse shared tags, fixing custom nginx configuration updates from the API by correctly decoding payloads and supporting clearing the value, fixing API token expiration warnings so sent-warning state persists and failed notifications can retry, fixing terminal reliability with heartbeat handling, idle timeouts, reconnect replay, and preserved scrollback, fixing deployment and log views so auto-scroll pauses when users scroll up and resumes at the bottom, fixing realtime server dependencies by replacing Axios with the native HTTP client, fixing nginx Docker images to use patched official packages and HTTPS package repositories, and fixing Docmost templates to require a mail driver before startup. Improvements include improved Railpack behavior with Docker buildx validation, safer shell argument handling, scoped build-time variables, better port handling, and updated helper versions, improved MCP resource listing performance and changed enable/disable routes to POST for state-changing actions, improved standalone database lookup coverage for KeyDB, Dragonfly, and ClickHouse, suppressed noisy Horizon failed-job entries for expected deployment and timeout failures on cloud instances, synced service templates from next and disabled the stale LiteQueen template, bumped follow-redirects in the realtime Docker package to 1.16.0, bumped phpseclib/phpseclib to 3.0.52, and improved Vite dev-server host, port...

chunks.title: v4.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the coollabsio/coolify release v4.1.1, security and fixes include restricting source and private key selection to the current team, restricting environment deletion to the current team, restricting server and network selection to the current team, fixing source selection during repository setup, hardening API token permission handling, fixing service pages opening in the correct project and environment, matching manual webhooks to the exact repository only, and improving GitHub App setup, installation, and reinstall flow. New services and templates include added Cloudflare DDNS template, added EMQX service template, added OpenObserve template, and added Hermes Agent and WebUI one-click service. Improvements include pinning Ryot, Jellyfin, Audiobookshelf, Grocy, and Mealie to stable image versions, updating Gitea Runner to v1.0.6, and improving the configuration changes modal readability and spacing.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent dani-garcia/vaultwarden release stream from version 1.30.2 through 1.36.0, covering security fixes, web-vault updates, native mobile app support, SSO integration, and various feature enhancements.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.30.2, the WebSockets service for live sync is integrated into the main HTTP server, simplifying proxy setups by removing the need for a separate rule to redirect WS traffic to port 3012. The release updates the web-vault to v2023.12.0, adds a build target optimized for size, allows customizing featureStates, enforces 2FA policy on removal of second factor and login, improves emergency access when not enabled, fixes bulk collection deletion, and includes various dependency updates and small fixes.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.30.3, a minor release fixes push notification device registration and resolves a Docker healthcheck issue when using a .env file. The WebSockets service remains integrated into the main HTTP server, with the old port 3012 deprecated.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.30.4, the project updates crates to fix new builds, adds Kubernetes environment detection, updates GHA workflows, changes codegen-units for low resources, fixes the env template for systemd compatibility, and updates Rust, crates, and web-vault.
In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.30.5, a fix is applied for a web API call related to jquery 3.7.1.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.31.0, initial support is added for beta releases of new native mobile apps, support for WebSocket traffic on port 3012 is removed, and the included web vault is updated to 2024.5.1. The release also notes that Bitwarden changed push API endpoints affecting EU region users, requiring an update from push.bitwarden.eu to api.bitwarden.eu. Other changes include JWT RSA key initialization improvements, removal of custom WebSocket code, timestamp data type changes, manager permission fixes within groups, automatic email address as 2FA provider, async Yubikey verification, custom DNS resolver implementation, and various dependency updates.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.32.0, several CVEs are fixed (CVE-2024-39924, CVE-2024-39925, CVE-2024-39926). The web-vault is updated to v2024.6.2, and issues with password reset enrollment are fixed by rolling back a web-vault commit. Other changes include using a custom enterprise plan to fix limits, removing port 3012 from Dockerfile, improving HTTP client, updating admin interface, fixing RSA key read-only issues, fixing Email 2FA login on native app, adding support for MFA with Duo's Universal Prompt, allowing note size increase to 100,000, securing send file uploads, and fixing data disclosure on organization endpoints.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.32.1, syncing and login with native mobile clients are fixed, a CLI option to backup SQLite database is added, and email templates for invites, 2FA incomplete logins, and new logins are changed. Other changes include fixing Duo redirect path, fixing manager in web-vault v2024.6.2 for collections, removing unnecessary email normalization, fixing Vaultwarden Admin page error messages, allowing custom umask setting, allowing Org Master-Pw policy enforcement, allowing enforcing Single Org with pw reset policy, and various dependency updates.
In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.32.2, collection management for managers is fixed, compiling for Windows targets is fixed, and the --version flag no longer fails without config.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.32.3, the email template for org invites is updated to fix HTML-encoded URLs, SMTP issues with some providers sending erroneous QUIT responses are fixed, and a long-standing collection management issue where collections could not be managed via the Password Manager overview is resolved. Other changes include fixing iOS sync by converting field types to int, fixing field type to actually be hidden, updating Rust to 1.82.0, adding an extension-refresh feature flag, and hiding user name on invite status.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.32.4, security fixes are applied for CVE reports from a third-party auditor. Compatibility fixes for native mobile apps include formatting datetimes without too many decimals, and the email template for sending emergency access invites is changed.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.32.5, further CVE fixes are applied. SSH-Key storage support is added, usable with Bitwarden Desktop v2024.12.0 and newer, enabled via EXPERIMENTAL_CLIENT_FEATURE_FLAGS. Other changes include dynamic CSS support, fixes for hibp username encoding and password hint check, authrequest changes, and a fix for Org Import duplicate collections.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.32.6, push notifications are fixed, editing members with access-all rights is fixed, Alpine is updated to version 3.21, another sync issue with native clients is fixed, and some backend admin fixes and updates are applied.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.32.7, a security fix for CVE GHSA-g65h-982x-4m5m is applied, affecting installations with ORG_GROUPS_ENABLED. Other changes include masking _smtp_img_src in support string, refactoring and optimizations, allowing adding connect-src entries, and using updated fern.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.33.0, security fixes are applied for GHSA-f7r5-w49x-gxm3, GHSA-h6cc-rc6q-23j4, and GHSA-j4h8-vch3-f797. The web-vault is updated to v2025.1.1, partial manage role support for collections is added, and OCI containers and binaries are signed via GitHub Attestations. Other changes include adding inline-menu-positioning-improvements feature flag, fixing issues when uri match is a string, adding TOTP delete endpoint, refactoring uri match fix and fixing ssh-key sync, and various dependency updates.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.33.1, minor issues are fixed including icons not working on Desktop clients, invites not always working, DUO settings not able to configure, manager rights, and mobile client sync issues. Other changes include hiding already approved auth_requests, letting invited members access OrgMemberHeaders, fixing passwordRevisionDate format, adding new event types, fixing Duo field names for web client, and allowing all managers to create collections again.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.33.2, workflows are updated and security enhanced, crates are updated and CVE-2025-24898 is fixed, a bulk-access endpoint for collections is added, icon redirect not working on desktop is fixed, and assigned collections are shown on member edit.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.34.0, the web-vault is updated to v2025.5.0, a new registration flow with email verification is implemented, and support is added for feature flags including mutual TLS, attachment export, and AnonAddy/SimpleLogin self host. Other changes include fixing CVE-2025-25188, allowing CLI to upload send files with truncated filenames, updating Rust to 1.85.0, and various dependency updates and fixes.
In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.34.1, an admin diagnostics crash is fixed.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.34.2, the web vault is updated to 2025.7.0, and experimental support for S3 file backend using OpenDAL is included, requiring compilation from source with the s3 feature flag. Other changes include fixing CSS for login with passkey and locked screen, abstracting persistent files through Apache OpenDAL, admin updates, password policy improvements, updating Alpine to 3.22, and various fixes for yubico key validation, favicon, and client compatibility.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.34.3, an issue with MySQL/MariaDB database connections when using Alpine images is fixed by reverting to MariaDB Connector/C v3.4.5. The signup link hiding is also fixed.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.35.0, SSO support with OpenID Connect is implemented, the web vault is updated to 2025.12.0, support for future mobile apps with versions 2026.1.0+ is added, and this is the first release using immutable releases and release attestation. Other changes include fixing multi delete slowdown, performing same checks when setting KDF, updating webauthn-rs to 0.5.x, fixing Email 2FA for mobile apps, updating Rust to 1.89.0, and various dependency updates and fixes.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.35.1, an issue with applications being logged out after upgrading due to refresh token parsing changes is fixed, the web vault is updated to 2025.12.1, and the alpine tag is correctly published.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.35.2, an issue with the web-vault preventing organization creation is fixed. Other changes include returning no content with status code 204, allowing MasterPasswordHash for Android, improving SSO callback path, and fixing web-vault version check.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.35.3, a security fix for GHSA-h265-g7rm-h337 is applied, addressing unauthorized access to items from collections. Other changes include fixing User API Key login, using email instead of empty name for webauthn, hiding password hints via CSS, fixing email as 2FA with auth requests, and various dependency updates.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.35.4, security fixes are applied for GHSA-w9f8-m526-h7fh, GHSA-h4hq-rgvh-wh27, and GHSA-r32r-j5jq-3w4m, addressing cipher access, manager-level collection modification, and unauthorized collection modification. Other changes include updating Rust and crates, hiding remember 2FA token, fixing invite links, and miscellaneous organization fixes.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.35.5, security fixes are applied for GHSA-937x-3j8m-7w7p, GHSA-569v-845w-g82p, and GHSA-6j4w-g4jh-xjfx, addressing unconfirmed owner purging organization vault, cross-org group binding, and refresh token invalidation. Two Factor Remember Tokens are now valid for max 30 days. Other changes include applying policies only to confirmed members, adding feature flags, fixing apikey login, updating crates and GHA, and various organization fixes.
In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.35.6, an issue where Two Factor Remember Tokens and Recovery Tokens were not accepted is fixed.
In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.35.7, 2FA for Android is fixed.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.35.8, a dummy org master password policy auth fix is applied, recovery-code not working is fixed, invalid refresh token response is fixed, and Rust, crates, GHA, and a DNS issue are updated.

In the dani-garcia/vaultwarden release 1.36.0, security fixes are applied for SSO Login CSRF, User/Organization Enumeration, SSO existing-user binding, and SSRF via Icon Endpoint. Archiving of items is available, and the web vault is updated to v2026.4.1. Other changes include SSO fallback to UserInfo preferred_username, adding DuckDuckGo browser device type, fixing hardcoded SSO identifier, adding support for archiving items, and various dependency updates.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.424, the project updates several npm and Yarn dependencies in the /web directory: @sveltejs/kit from 2.49.5 to 2.53.1, svelte from 4.2.20 to 5.51.5, ajv from 6.12.6 to 6.14.0, devalue from 5.6.2 to 5.6.3, and minimatch from 3.1.2 to 3.1.4.

chunks.title: v1.4.425
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.425, the Web UI receives dependabot upgrades and bug fixes: Svelte is updated to 5.53.5, @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte to 4.0.0, Rollup to 4.59.0, and lucide-svelte to 0.575.0. A standardized postinstall script replaces custom install scripts. Self-closing tags in Svelte components are fixed, and transcript joining uses newlines. The cleanPatternOutput method is made public in ChatService, and svelte-markdown is removed. Additionally, a new create_slides pattern is added for generating Reveal.js HTML slideshows, registered across CONVERSION, VISUALIZE, and WRITING categories, and integrated into pattern descriptions and extracts.

chunks.title: v1.4.426
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.426, the WebUI is refactored for YouTube URL processing: YouTube URLs are replaced with fetched transcript blocks inline in the chat flow, supporting multiple links per message. The user message is always rendered before processing the response, with a YouTube-specific loading indicator. YouTube URL state is reset after submission. Dependency upgrades include SvelteKit, Svelte, Tailwind, TypeScript toolchain, pdfjs-dist, and @napi-rs/canvas. Lockfiles are regenerated.

chunks.title: v1.4.427
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.427, a Git CLI fallback is added to FetchFilesFromRepo for improved compatibility. When the go-git in-memory clone fails, a shallow clone (--depth 1) into a temp directory is performed via git CLI, with deferred cleanup. SingleDirectory and PathPrefix options are respected, and a combined error is surfaced if both methods fail. The go-git logic is extracted into a helper, and a copyFile helper is added.

chunks.title: v1.4.428
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.428, a Polish (pl) locale is added with a complete translation file containing all 683 keys, matching the structure of existing locale files in internal/i18n/locales/.

chunks.title: v1.4.429
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.429, a GetRaw method is added to PatternsEntity for unprocessed pattern retrieval. Test coverage for GetRaw is added.

chunks.title: v1.4.430
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.430, AWS Bedrock authentication is enhanced with a 3-tier system: bearer token (ABSK), static AWS credentials, and default credential chain. A guided setup flow covers auth method, region, and model configuration. The hasAWSCredentials() gate is removed so Bedrock always appears in setup. A temperature-only fix is applied for Claude models on Bedrock, API keys are masked during re-setup, a fallback model list is added, and i18n support for 11 locales is included. Additionally, the YT summary task is explicitly made aware of possible transcription errors.

chunks.title: v1.4.431
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.431, security hardening is performed: API keys are redacted in config responses (maskAPIKey shows only last 4 characters), shell injection surfaces are eliminated by replacing exec/shell commands in the Obsidian route with native fs APIs, and path-confinement validation ensures resolved file paths stay within target directories, preventing path traversal attacks.

chunks.title: v1.4.432
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.432, web dependencies are updated to fix an npm override issue.

chunks.title: v1.4.433
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.433, Ollama thinking levels are mapped to the Ollama API, and single system-role messages are converted. Additionally, manual edits are made to changelog.db and fixes for ChangeLog.

chunks.title: v1.4.434
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.434, dynamic Bedrock region fetching is added from botocore's endpoints.json, expanding support to 40+ regions with a static fallback. An AWS_PROFILE environment variable conflict is fixed for users with AWS_PROFILE set for other tools. Empty auth choice handling is improved to skip gracefully.

chunks.title: v1.4.435
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.435, the indirect dependency devalue is bumped from 5.6.3 to 5.6.4 in the /web directory as part of the npm_and_yarn dependency group.

chunks.title: v1.4.436
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.436, the MiniMax-M2.5-highspeed model variant is added to the static MiniMax model list, delivering the same performance as MiniMax-M2.5 but with faster inference speed.

chunks.title: v1.4.437
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.437, a new Codex AI vendor plugin is added with OpenAI OAuth PKCE flow, browser-based login, automatic token refresh on 401, and explicit model selection. Shared OpenAI helpers are exposed, system/developer messages are moved into the Codex instructions field, and comprehensive unit tests are added. New internationalization keys are added for all 11 languages.

chunks.title: v1.4.438
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.438, a streaming deadlock in Chatter.Send is fixed by introducing recordFirstStreamError() with a non-blocking select/default. Strategy handling is unified across CLI and REST API by passing StrategyName through to GetChatter() and ChatRequest. Inline os.ReadFile strategy loading is removed from the server handler. A joinPromptSections() helper replaces raw string concatenation for system message assembly. Regression and unit tests are added.

chunks.title: v1.4.439
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.439, the MiniMax default model is upgraded to M2.7, the latest flagship model with enhanced reasoning and coding capabilities. MiniMax-M2.7 and MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed are added to the static model list and placed at the top as new defaults. All previous models are retained as alternatives.

chunks.title: v1.4.440
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.440, a Chinese translation of the README (README.zh.md) is added, with refined translations for improved idiomaticity. A duplicate key in the Chinese locale file is removed.

chunks.title: v1.4.441
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.441, several Go dependencies are updated: google.golang.org/grpc from 1.79.0 to 1.79.3, anthropic-sdk-go from 1.23.0 to 1.27.1, gin-gonic/gin to 1.12.0, go-git to 5.17.0, and ollama/ollama from 0.16.2 to 0.18.2. Deprecated Claude model aliases are removed.

chunks.title: v1.4.442
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.442, the Codex client module is refactored by extracting all OAuth and authentication logic into a dedicated module. OAuth flow, PKCE handling, token refresh logic, auth transport retry, JWT parsing, and unused OAuth types are removed from codex.go. A test for SendStream HTTP error mapping and channel close behavior is added.

chunks.title: v1.4.443
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.443, visual text extraction from YouTube videos is implemented using FFmpeg and Tesseract-based OCR. Configurable CLI flags are added for visual extraction parameters. Support for multi-line yt-dlp outputs is fixed, and syntax compatibility with modern FFmpeg is updated. OCR processing is refactored with bounded concurrency, context timeouts, and hardened CLI argument handling. Reliability issues with Tesseract CLI arguments, racy error handling, and timestamp overflow are resolved. Additionally, README badges are made clickable.

chunks.title: v1.4.444
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.444, multiple Go module upgrades are performed: anthropic-sdk-go from 1.27.1 to 1.34.0, ollama from 0.18.2 to 0.20.4, google.golang.org/grpc from 1.79.3 to 1.80.0, google.golang.org/genai from 1.51.0 to 1.53.0, google.golang.org/api from 0.272.0 to 0.275.0, go-sqlite3 from 1.14.37 to 1.14.42, go-git/v5 from 5.17.0 to 5.17.2, and various golang.org/x and OpenTelemetry packages are refreshed.

chunks.title: v1.4.445
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.445, the Dockerfile is updated for best practices and critical CVE fixes: Alpine 3.21 and Go 1.25.9 are pinned, the Go toolchain is installed directly in the builder stage, setuptools is upgraded to remediate CVE-2025-47273, the yt-dlp installation path is refreshed, and the final image runs as a non-root user.

chunks.title: v1.4.446
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.446, a new --readpattern <name> CLI flag is added that prints the raw contents of a named pattern's system.md file to stdout, respecting custom pattern directories. Docker documentation is updated to align config mount paths and examples with the non-root container home directory.

chunks.title: v1.4.447
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.447, Claude Opus 4.7 model support is added, and the Anthropic SDK is bumped to v1.37.0. The claude-opus-4-7 model is added to the supported models list, and the 1M context window beta feature is enabled for it.

chunks.title: v1.4.448
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.448, a fix is implemented to fall back to streamed delta text when a completed Codex response is empty. The extracted completed text is preferred only when content stays non-empty; otherwise, accumulated streamed delta text is used. A regression test is added for empty completed output text.

chunks.title: v1.4.449
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.449, Vite is upgraded from 5.4.21 to 8.0.8 in the web layer, and @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte from 4.0.4 to 7.0.0. AWS SDK Go v2 modules are updated, Ollama client from 0.20.4 to 0.21.1, and go-git from 5.17.2 to 5.18.0. Scoop installation instructions are added to the README, and the cSpell dictionary is expanded.

chunks.title: v1.4.450
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.450, GrokAI search grounding is added via xAI's Responses API. Two new fields are introduced in openai_compatible.ProviderConfig: WebSearchToolName and EnableXSearch. GrokAI is pre-configured with WebSearchToolName set to "web_search" and EnableXSearch set to true, enabling grounded search results with source URLs. Tests are added for the new override paths.

chunks.title: v1.4.451
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.451, three commerce intelligence patterns are added: extract_affiliate_products, extract_video_commerce_entities, and analyze_monetization_opportunities. They are registered in pattern descriptions and extracts, integrated into suggest_pattern, and documented. Additionally, a fix adds fallback logic to parse the vendor prefix from a model name when no vendor is explicitly specified, resolving models like ollama/llama3 correctly.

chunks.title: v1.4.452
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.452, Anthropic sampling parameters (temperature and top_p) are omitted for Claude Opus 4.7 to ensure compatibility. A sampling parameter guard is added specifically for Opus 4.7, preserving existing behavior for compatible models. Unit test coverage is added.

chunks.title: v1.4.453
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the danielmiessler/Fabric release v1.4.453, Claude Opus 4.8 is added to the list of supported models. The Go toolchain is upgraded to 1.26.0, anthropic-sdk-go to v1.46.0, AWS SDK and Bedrock service modules are updated, and the Ollama client is bumped to v0.24.0.
