chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.168.0, the API, CLI, dashboard, and SDKs expose sandbox last activity timestamp, the API and dashboard surface per-sandbox resource limits in region usage overview, docs add robots.txt, the runner adds build resource limits, and fixes include CLI actionable hint on 403 Forbidden, proxy raw encoded preview path preservation, and Python SDK unreachable error check in wait_for_resize/snapshot_complete(), while the dashboard refactors to remove suspend-react and bring back client-side pagination for sandboxes.

chunks.title: v0.169.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.169.0, the API adds runtime sandbox network updates and caps declarative build sandboxes per runner, docs add Java SDK references and code snippets, the Python SDK adds optional WebSocket handshake concurrency limit, and fixes cover API sandbox service jobs locks, docs guides list container hover, and locale handling routes.

chunks.title: v0.170.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.170.0, the daemon adds an opt-in git CLI clone path for large repos, docs add search functionality and OSS deployment behind a domain, and numerous fixes include API using 400 for quota/resource limit/precondition errors, TypeORM param passing in cron query, snapshot reactivation grace period, computer-use keyboard input normalization and lowercase region screenshot query parameter binding, daemon computer-use control characters and delay in keyboard.type(), dashboard WS sandbox details invalidation, docs proxy request fallback, API key authorization, sandbox snapshot description, and markdown headings spacing, along with a breaking change where per-sandbox resource limits and quota exhaustion now return HTTP 400 instead of 403/428.

chunks.title: v0.171.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.171.0, the API prefers org-configured Docker Hub registry for prefixless images and adds skipstart option to sandbox recovery endpoint, the API and dashboard filter runners by region, the dashboard gets a consistency pass and tables updates and a sandbox file explorer, docs add sandbox filesystem, dynamic OpenGraph image generation, agentic improvements, and runtime sandbox network updates, SDKs expose file download stream across all SDKs, and fixes cover per-runner sandbox state sync, split snapshot REMOVING sync, split backup checks by state, archive usage periods every 5s, runner v0 HTTP timeout to 15 minutes, null snapshot size, buildSnapshot error handling, computer-use mouse contract mismatches, dashboard unknown API key permission filter, API keys full access label check, default region prompt on any page, SDK auth error messages improvement, and Ruby SDK/daemon code interpreter race conditions.

chunks.title: v0.172.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.172.0, the API, dashboard, and SDKs move organization OTel config to GA, the dashboard revamps the sandbox sheet and adds a snapshot details sheet, docs add Netbird VPN connection setup, CLI reference installation and update, declarative builder image configuration examples, volumes data sharing examples, and ask AI, guides add a Flue guide, and a fix removes stale wording around a dashboard bug from OSS domain deployment docs.

chunks.title: v0.173.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.173.0, the API ends usage period on destroying state, the API and runner add Docker filesystem snapshots, docs add customer managed compute (runners) installation, and a fix enables v2 recover path and patches v0 race.

chunks.title: v0.174.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.174.0, the API and runner add NVIDIA GPU-enabled runner, the dashboard adds a sandboxes terminal action, docs add LLMs txt files structure generation and sandboxes with NVIDIA GPU devices, and fixes cover CLI snapshot create hanging after fast builds, daemon/SDKs classifying git operation errors by HTTP status code, dashboard sandboxes table pagination reset, runner mounting fuse volumes in parallel, scaling storage recovery increment to 5% of original quota per attempt, and disabling storage limits when limits are off.

chunks.title: v0.175.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.175.0, the API defaults snapshot quota to 30, adds initial runner score addon, extends backup job timeout, and with the runner forwards backup registry on recover and pulls image if missing, SDKs add upload streaming with progress and cancellation across SDKs, and fixes include Python SDK consolidating async traffic onto a single aiohttp session, TypeScript SDK handling late busboy errors and forwarding abort to progress stream, and dual build for CJS and ESM.

chunks.title: v0.176.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.176.0, the daemon, computer-use, docs, and SDKs add AT-SPI accessibility API, the dashboard adds snapshot size, docs add GPU snapshots, mount external storage, define stateless and stateful code execution, and resize sandboxes general availability, the runner, API, and docs support private Amazon ECR registries via cross-account IAM roles, the webhook skips svix message create when org has no endpoints, and fixes cover daemon upload_files.go pre-regression behavior with progress tracking, dashboard tooltips on sandbox table actions, using SDK dist for dev, TypeScript SDK resolving Buffer in browser without require(), and suppressing busboy late teardown errors in downloadFileStream.

chunks.title: v0.177.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.177.0, the API changes declarative sandbox count to CPU sum, adds tags property to runner entity, adds partial index for recoverable sandboxes, and with the runner marks archiving sandboxes as recoverable when backup fails, the dashboard adds OTel config Zod validation, and fixes cover daemon reaping session and pty child processes, returning JSON error body for empty exec commands, and dashboard chart y-axis cut off.

chunks.title: v0.178.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.178.0, the API adds draining mode and force flags for self-hosted drains, the dashboard updates layout and billing v2, guides add a Claude Managed Agents on Daytona guide, the sandbox-image adds OpenAI dependencies to the default image for Codex functionality, and fixes cover API stopped sandbox usage period guards, applying soft-delete rename on ephemeral stop and state sync, daemon not reaping idle commands, toolbox listFiles route accepting /files and /files/, daemon direct-write upload to fix FUSE volume regression, Java SDK preserving exception cause chain and classifying transport failures, and TypeScript SDK using import type for type-only imports.

chunks.title: v0.179.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.179.0, the API and dashboard add a CTA to enable webhooks for organization and GPU region quota, per-sandbox limits, and dashboard surfacing, docs add CLI installation commands and Archil to external storage providers, and fixes cover daemon memory optimized git CLI option for clone, push & pull, and runner escaping quotes in env values for import/export commit fallback.

chunks.title: v0.180.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.180.0, sandbox list moves to cursor pagination as a breaking change, and fixes include API adding node-forge as explicit dependency, jest support for uuid v14 ESM-only package, Python SDK anchoring sync http_client finalizer on the client itself, and TypeScript SDK routing stream module through dynamicImport in ESM downloadFile path.

chunks.title: v0.181.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.181.0, the API and runner assign one physical GPU per sandbox on multi-GPU runner.

chunks.title: v0.182.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.182.0, the API sets sandbox creation timeout to 30, docs add sandbox get, labels, and last activity, and fixes exclude DESTROYED and ARCHIVED from GPU capacity count, enforce GPU filter in snapshot-runner fallback assignment, infer restoring case on create sandbox v2, and enforce GPU filter in snapshot propagation.

chunks.title: v0.183.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release v0.183.0, sandbox classes and linked sandboxes are introduced, the API adds API level recovery, the dashboard shows IDs for volumes and snapshots and a CTA on personal members page, docs add verify CPU and memory limits after resize and Tigris to external storage providers, guides add a Vercel AI SDK guide, and fixes cover locking runners GPU capacity query, making entity constructor params optional per TypeORM contract, handling invalid labels filter in deprecated sandbox list, preserving hidden provider defaults on registry tab switch, allowing write-only users to perform bulk sandbox actions, banner padding fix, removing tier 2 access requirement, updating preview port range and auth details, proxy serveWarningPage https value, escaping redirect URL on proxy preview warning page, and runner non-force removal of snapshots.

questions.query_text: In the daytonaio/daytona releases, which release introduces a Java SDK implementation?

answer_support.answer_text: a Java SDK is implemented

questions.query_text: Across the daytonaio/daytona releases, how does the GPU-related change in v0.174.0 differ from the GPU-related change in v0.181.0?

options.text: v0.174.0 introduces an NVIDIA GPU-enabled runner, while v0.181.0 assigns one physical GPU per sandbox on multi-GPU runners.
v0.174.0 adds GPU snapshots, while v0.181.0 removes GPU support.
Both releases only update GPU documentation without functional changes.
v0.174.0 adds GPU region quota, while v0.181.0 adds GPU capacity count exclusion.

questions.expected_answer: v0.174.0 introduces an NVIDIA GPU-enabled runner, while v0.181.0 assigns one physical GPU per sandbox on multi-GPU runners.

the API and runner assign one physical GPU per sandbox on multi-GPU runner

questions.query_text: In the daytonaio/daytona release window, order the following release-content states from earliest to latest: (1) a release that adds a Java SDK implementation, (2) a release that introduces sandbox classes and linked sandboxes, (3) a release that adds an NVIDIA GPU-enabled runner, (4) a release that moves sandbox list to cursor pagination.

answer_support.answer_text: a Java SDK is implemented
the API and runner add NVIDIA GPU-enabled runner
sandbox list moves to cursor pagination
sandbox classes and linked sandboxes are introduced

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent dbeaver/dbeaver release stream from version 25.0.1 through 26.1.0, covering SQL editor enhancements, database driver updates, and UI improvements across multiple minor and major releases.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.0.1, the SQL Editor fixes a bug in single-tab mode where script execution displayed results from the previous execution, improves buttons layout in result set view on execution error, and stops auto-refresh when the result is not visible or the window is collapsed. SQL autocompletion adds the ability to use the 'Short object names' option for columns. The AI assistant fixes an issue where a query without a semicolon before @ai was skipped. The Metadata Editor adds the ability to view and edit comments in a popup window and fixes folder content display. The Data Editor removes options for copying column names and row numbers from the context menu. The Diagram updates scrollbar color. Connectivity resolves font rendering in the connection creation window. Security adds TLS/SSL debug logging. Breadcrumbs update immediately on object rename, and popups for version update, Tip of the Day, and Sample Database are delayed if other modals are open. The Open File dialog issue on Linux is fixed. Database-specific changes include Azure SQL Server replacing CREATE VIEW with CREATE OR ALTER VIEW for v16+, ClickHouse fixing geometry data reading, CUBRID fixing new column creation and adding synonym support, Databend fixing catalog name changes with special characters, GBase 8s adding table and column comment editing, Oceanbase fixing diagram display, Oracle supporting global variables like SYSDATE and UID in query validation, PostgreSQL fixing 'Exclude auto-generated columns' to exclude all auto-generated columns, fixing 'Show partitions' hiding permissions, adding query cancellation in Session manager, fixing backslash display in comment blocks, SQLite improving BLOB display, SQL Server fixing table hints parsing, and Yellowbrick adding geospatial data support.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.0.2, the Navigator improves filter behavior and fixes filters for secondary windows. The SQL Editor fixes query cancellation after retry, correctly recognizes blank lines as script delimiters when 'Blank Line is Statement Delimiter' is set to Smart, and fixes missing space after leading keywords. Miscellaneous changes add an option to display breadcrumbs in the status bar or at the top of editors, reduce breadcrumb horizontal space, add the DBeaver icon to aarch64-linux package, and add support for Teiid database. Database-specific changes include CUBRID adding statistics and trace information to the result tab and fixing trigger script generation, Denodo modifying the connection name, GBase 8s fixing table creation with a primary key, MariaDB allowing immediate connection testing after changing an expired password, MariaDB/MySQL fixing creation of auto_increment columns with primary key, Oracle fixing view creation via Metadata editor, Sap Hana fixing name editing when creating a table in Metadata Editor, Snowflake fixing metadata queries for driver versions 3.13.20+, and Teradata fixing an exception during code completion.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.0.3, the Data Editor adds the ability to sort data by primary key and fixes data type coloring for foreign and primary keys. The SQL Editor fixes single quotes handling, fixes SELECT .. FOR UPDATE queries execution, and the AI assistant allows macOS users to send messages with Enter and to AI Chat with Cmd+Enter. The Navigator fixes ascending table sorting. Connectivity fixes an issue where credentials in the Test connection overwrite credentials of the previously created connection. Miscellaneous changes migrate to Eclipse 2025-03, update the Light theme, and reorder windows at app start. Database-specific changes include Apache Cloudberry fixing server version fetching, Dameng adding support for unique and check constraints, Cassandra fixing string filtering, Clickhouse fixing connection to new driver version 0.8.2, MariaDB fixing backup to use mariadb-dump, and PostgreSQL fixing changing auto-increment sequence parameters, updating arrays via Value panel, fixing connection when executing a query, and fixing a typo in the 'Replace legacy timezone' setting description.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.0.4, the SQL Editor adds support for Common Table Expressions (CTE) by semantic analysis and autocompletion. The Data Editor automatically scrolls to the cell being edited when an inline editor is active and the user starts typing. Connectivity adds an option to update a driver to a recommended version and fixes replacing localhost with the IP address when connecting via SSH. Database-specific changes include Clickhouse updating the driver to version 0.8.5 and fixing data type display, CUBRID adding the ability to update user, GBase 8s enhancing support for editing unique and CHECK constraints, Firebird fixing native binary presentation, PostgreSQL adding the ability to backup all database schemas using the Completed backup option, fixing Foreign data wrappers configurator opening, removing Collation retrieval for older PostgreSQL versions, Snowflake updating the driver to version 3.23.0, SQLite adding information about a table's Strict mode to the Table Metadata section, and TDengine updating the driver to the latest version.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.0.5, the SQL Editor significantly improves CTE completion and navigation support, fixes SQL columns completion for overlapping names, adds support for STRAIGHT_JOIN and LATERAL JOIN, and fixes several navigation shortcuts to avoid conflicts with European keyboard layouts. Metadata adds the ability to resize multiline fields. The Navigator adds the number of elements in folders (configurable) and fixes an issue that prevented schemas and databases from opening. Miscellaneous changes add an extra CLI runner dbeaverc that respects dbeaver.ini settings, prevent automatic driver updates when a user selects the driver version manually, and fix application use when certain accessibility tools are enabled. Database-specific changes include Clickhouse fixing connection to version 0.8.5, MySQL fixing the 'remove definer' option of backup/restore in a special case, Oracle setting 'Use UNION for table metadata reading' preference to true by default, PostgreSQL fixing foreign servers display when no access to pg_user_mapping table, fixing execution hang on a query with huge JSON in dollar-quoted strings with tag, fixing hangs when working with large JSON files, allowing unquoted identifiers starting with underscore, and adding support for Kingbase database.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.1.0, the SQL Editor always prepends the referenced table alias before the column name for semantic completion, adds a new setting for semantic completion to control fully-qualified column names, and fixes bind variables dialog layout for large fonts. Data Transfer removes the 'All but nulls' option and adds 'All including nulls' for CSV export. Miscellaneous changes fix misaligned editor window in the Bind Parameters dialog for macOS, fix an issue where the 'Tip of the Day' window could block the application interface, fix inconsistent application of connection colors for test and production connection types, fix application launch in CLI mode, and move the 'All file types' option to the top of the file open dialog. Database-specific changes include Clickhouse returning the driver to version 0.8.5 and fixing quoting of nested array values, CUBRID fixing Info panel visibility, DuckDB adding an option to hide system objects, fixing geometry display issues in version 1.2.2+, and fixing the simple structure compare wizard, MySQL fixing primary key column creation, PostgreSQL adding support for wildcards in ILIKE filters within the data grid, SQL Server fixing the 'Only connections' option in Session Manager to display only active connection sessions, and Teradata disabling native date/time formatting by default.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.1.1, the SQL Editor adds support for column expansion for CTEs, adds support for TSQL 'TOP' expression, adds support for CTE names in sub-queries, disables SQL autocomplete inside DBeaver SQL commands, fixes code completion failure in long queries when using column aliases, and fixes an issue where most of the output was lost after performing a search. The AI assistant improves the GitHub Copilot authorization dialog. The Metadata Editor adds progress visualization for loading items and a message when the list is empty, fixes sorting of objects such as indexes, and fixes layout issues when resizing stacked multi-line fields. The Data Editor fixes cursor positioning after filter auto-completion. The Navigator fixes 'Hide' and 'Show Only' filter options, adds support for filtering by name with arguments, and fixes an exception when deleting an open project. Connectivity fixes SSL settings removal after adding an SSH profile, redesigns DBeaver connection profiles, and allows immediate connection testing after changing an expired database password. General changes add drop-down menus to transaction commit/rollback buttons showing queries within the transaction, fix compact DDL generation for tables, set English as the default language in the Microsoft Store distribution, improve database logos in dark theme, and fix an exception in the Output viewer. Database-specific changes include CUBRID adding the ability to delete comments on Serial and Views, fixing errors when deleting properties and comments on the server, fixing editing null values in the metadata editor, and fixing view DDL truncating UNION ALL statements, Clickhouse fixing display of nested arrays and SQL generation, fixing folder display in Navigator with driver version 8.0.x+, fixing data type loading and array editing, and removing Foreign Keys and References tabs from Metadata Editor, DuckDB improving display of structured data type keys, Exasol updating the driver to version 25.2.3, Firebird removing 'AS' before table alias for legacy Firebird, Neo4j being deleted from Community version, Oracle adding column-level privileges to the Privileges view, PostgreSQL fixing syntax highlighting for INTERVAL keyword, fixing connection error when database names contain slashes, and Salesforce Data Cloud using the shaded driver version by default.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.1.2, the SQL Editor adds variables for virtual column manipulation (row and table), allows case-insensitive alias usage, and fixes an issue where the selected schema wasn't recognized after reconnecting. The AI Assistant improves GitHub Copilot authorization by displaying and allowing copying of the auth token, displays the up-to-date list of available models, fixes the AI button not working when the AI extension is installed, and hides the script ruler when executing queries from AI chat. The Data Editor fixes incorrect code generation and saving for Virtual key updates, and adds an option to show column ordinal position next to the column name. Data Transfer improves NVARCHAR mapping accuracy during data import. Security fixes CVE-2023-48795. Connectivity improves UI controls on connection settings, fixes the '--newInstance' option when starting via CLI, makes the 'Change Connection(s) Driver' option work again, and fixes deletion of newly created connection types. General changes set English as the default language, fix UI elements disappearing when using a display scale other than 100%, update most icons to SVG format, and base on Eclipse 2025-06. Development updates the JSQL Parser library to version 5.3 and fixes installation of CE bundles in Eclipse. Database-specific changes include BigQuery being added to the SQL category in the connection dialog and fixing column aliases visibility validation, Clickhouse fixing identifiers quotation and adding support for complex types nested in arrays, CUBRID fixing VARCHAR length not displaying in Navigator, DB2 LUW adding support for changing expired passwords, MySQL fixing dump creation and an exception when opening the partition Virtual tab, Oracle fixing CREATE PROCEDURE statement boundaries detection, and PostgreSQL fixing misplaced comment in DDL generation, fixing connection when port is specified in URL for PgPass authentication, fixing time zone display when date formatting is enabled, and adding support for MAINTAIN privilege.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.1.3, AI integration is now included in the Community packaging, so extension install is not needed anymore. The SQL Editor fixes an issue when files modified externally could not be closed without overwriting, and improves schemas/catalogs support in the Generic driver. Metadata fixes an issue where virtual keys created via the popup dialog were not saved. The Data Editor fixes the Copy as CSV option in Advanced Copy. General changes make editor tabs use connection color for visualization. Connectivity improves SSHJ encryption keys support and resolves an issue with network profiles name wrapping. Database-specific changes include CUBRID fixing metadata objects search, enhancing partition support, adding support for PLCSQL, and adding support for DONT_REUSE_OID keyword, Clickhouse fixing the presentation of tuples and map data types in the data editor, fixing support for temporary tables so all queries run within the same session, DD2 driver being downgraded to version 11.5.9 due to Kerberos authentication issues, MySQL and Clickhouse fixing aliases generation and quotation in SQL Editor, and SAP HANA adding support for HALF_VECTOR type.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.1.4, the SQL Editor fixes autocomplete for tables whose names conflict with keywords, fixes WHERE keyword autocompletion, fixes collapse/expand of result tabs, and stops highlighting CEIL and CEILING as keywords. The Data Editor fixes the icon for the 'Move to Top' action and displays query text near the filter panel when results are filtered. Data Transfer fixes an excessively wide window during data export and fixes button order in the export dialog. The Navigator adds an indicator to show when entities are filtered using the search bar. General changes add a notification if the application is run on an unsupported operating system. Database-specific changes include CUBRID adding a tab to view the full text of the execution plan, Clickhouse fixing incorrect representation of nested array values in the Value panel and fixing the ability to edit boolean arrays, Databricks adding a UserAgentEntry parameter with product version information, LibSQL fixing a connection configuration issue, and Oracle fixing autocomplete for synonyms in the SQL editor and fixing the ability to add comments via the Action tab in Metadata editor.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.1.5, the SQL Editor displays tables with foreign keys at the top of the autocompletion list, fixes foreign key conditions and join suggestions for subqueries, and redesigns SQL processing settings. The AI assistant adds confirmation for executing dangerous AI-generated queries (configurable). The Data Editor adds the ability to filter values with plus and other special characters in the column data filter. The Navigator updates filter icons and moves them to the same line as the search bar. Data Transfer adds a setting to save SQL logs in Query Manager during data transfer and fixes editing the database name in the data transfer wizard. General changes make the file editor close automatically if a folder or file was deleted, resolve unexpected dialog resizing, and redesign driver version configuration in Connectivity. Miscellaneous changes redesign save/save as icons, change connection type colors to less bright, and fix the 'Show resource in explorer' option in the project context menu. Database-specific changes include Azure Databricks fixing default database switching and no default database selection, Clickhouse fixing primitive array editing for all engines, CUBRID adding support for sharded database connections, fixing incorrect query generation for comments on view columns, and fixing duplicate tables in the Navigator, MariaDB/MySQL improving reference navigation performance, MySQL adding 'Show all databases' setting to the connection page and fixing the ability to copy a user, and Oracle adding support for Oracle sequences by autocomplete and semantic analysis in SQL Editor and adding a setting to read sequences metadata in Oracle properties (disabled by default).

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.2.0, the AI Assistant adds query preview to the @ai command and AI chat query confirmation, adds support for a custom OpenAI API base URL, and improves query analysis performance. The SQL Editor resolves issues with slow auto-completion of schemas/tables, fixes context information (F2) to work without text selection, fixes query re-parsing at the very end of the script, fixes aliases completion when the dialect doesn't support them, and fixes scrolling after script formatting. The Data Editor fixes advanced paste for tables without a key and fixes value display when switching to a record via foreign key. The ER Diagram fixes incorrect key highlighting for tables with self-referencing columns. Data transfer improves icons for export and import providers. Connectivity fixes scroll display in Connection settings. General changes update coloring for test and production connection types and in Query Manager, fix inconsistent font changes when running as an Eclipse plugin, improve toolbar colorization in dark theme, fix background rendering issues in Dark Theme, make the timezone name in the status bar reflect daylight saving time, and add support for TimechoDB/IoTDB. Database-specific changes include ClickHouse displaying maps as strings in the Data Editor and fixing connection issues for read-only users, CUBRID correcting label name for Views in Metadata Editor and adding support for AUTO_INCREMENT on SMALLINT and NUMERIC(x,0) column types, MySQL improving performance of foreign key and references reading, Oracle improving column copy, fixing public synonyms loading, and adding a new optimizer preference to connection settings, Snowflake adding support for SHOW, GRANT, and TRUNCATE keywords, and SQL Server fixing data mapping issue during export.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.2.1, the SQL Editor fixes result grid minimizing, fixes alias name duplication in join table completion, fixes selected schema reset on reconnect, stops showing autocomplete proposals for values inside quotes, fixes recognition of pseudo columns in semantic analysis, improves parsing and execution of multiple queries, and restricts generation of aliases that match SQL keywords. The AI Assistant shows no-query AI command responses in the Output tab and fixes the ability to disable AI integration in the Community version. The Data Editor fixes dictionary lookup for composite foreign keys to show only distinct values in the Value pane. The Metadata Editor redesigns the panel with reduced empty space and improved field layout. Data transfer adds the option 'Ignore characters outside quotes' when importing from CSV, and adds BIGINT support and numeric type widening during data import. Dashboards correct the date format displayed in tooltips. Connectivity adds support for connecting via JDBC URLs with custom protocol parts. General changes make CLI commands return valuable process exit codes, fix connection color incorrectly applied to result sets in text format, improve disabled checkbox appearance in dark theme, color-code all tabs for the same Production or Test connection, and add support for Greengage Database. Database-specific changes include Athena fixing identifier naming rules, CUBRID fixing DDL generation for tables with multi-column keys and fixing newly created table disappearance after refresh, Databricks renaming the driver to Databricks, adding host and URL selectors, and adding Databricks OSS driver version, Ingres fixing driver download, Kingbase fixing unsupported vector type, MariaDB fixing node costs on Execution plan, Oracle fixing user metadata information display unless 'Always use DBA_ views' is selected, PostgreSQL fixing filtering issues for composite types with identical column names and adding support for hash indexes in Metadata Editor, Redshift fixing incorrect DDL generation for materialized views, and German translation being improved.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.2.2, the SQL Editor fixes an issue where the wrong ID was selected after a join operation and improves behavior of the progress control. The AI assistant fixes model name case issues. Metadata fixes an issue with object editor resize. The Data Editor redesigns the panel context menu, improves filter visuals and layout with unified background color, fixed separator line, and merged toolbars. Data Transfer fixes column casing issues when importing from XML. General changes add the ability to configure 'Show all databases' property via CLI, fix truncated labels in Preferences on Linux, fix broken colors in Dark theme after Eclipse update, unify toolbar separator appearance, improve color-coding for Test connections, set NO_AT_BRIDGE=1 for Linux applications, and clarify error message when a driver is unavailable. Database-specific changes include ClickHouse fixing several bugs related to incorrect type handling including array, tuple presentation, and nested column presentation, CUBRID fixing some issues on full text query plan, MySQL adding 'Compress' flag in the dump wizard, PostgreSQL showing an error when creating a database with 'Show all databases' disabled, Redshift fixing an issue that prevented updating the driver and hiding jobs and system databases in the Navigator, Snowflake updating the driver to version 3.24.0, SQLite fixing 'Cannot determine target node for File' error, and Spanish localization being improved.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.2.3, the AI assistant adds the ability to test AI configuration in Preferences and fixes a bug in the AI command that caused an error when a query contained a trailing delimiter. The Data Editor removes the default shortcut for Select Row Count due to a conflict and fixes an issue when the boolean inline editor was read-only in tables without a primary key. The Metadata Editor updates the UI for object comments editing and removes duplicate object name comments in view DDL. The Navigator adds an option for case-insensitive alphabetical sorting, fixes tree inconsistency after disconnect, and fixes table list reading in certain drivers. Connectivity fixes an issue that prevented deleting an SSH jump server and makes network profile settings easier to find in Preferences. General changes fix an issue when it was impossible to set the result set fetch size to 0, improve panel and result set maximize behavior, fix a startup issue in the Snap version related to NO_AT_BRIDGE variable, and redesign the driver download window. Database-specific changes include Athena driver updated to version 2.2.2.1000, Google Cloud Spanner driver updated to version 2.33.1, and Greengage adding a database icon.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.2.4, the Data Editor changes the default shortcut for Advanced Copy with previous settings on macOS to CTRL+SHIFT+4 and adds the option to disable numeric identifier columns formatting. The SQL Editor adds support for temporary tables in semantic analysis. The AI assistant adds confirmation for query types that DBeaver cannot recognize as valid SQL. Data Transfer adds connection and database info to backup/restore wizards. Connectivity fixes an issue that prevented deleting network profiles. Miscellaneous changes fix a crash on Windows when the username contained non-ASCII characters, fix notifications stealing focus, add the ability to import connections from DataGrip. Database-specific changes include ClickHouse improving array data types display in the Data Editor, DuckDB fixing catalog selection loss upon disconnect, Oracle making the Privileges tab open for non-admin users, SQLite fixing foreign keys created with shorthand syntax not recognized as references, and Snowflake displaying procedures with multiple versions correctly.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.2.5, the Data Editor updates icons for data edit commands and shows more details in data loading progress messages. The SQL Editor resolves performance lag during long scripts scrolling, improves @include command processing, fixes error processing in nested scripts, and fixes the CTRL+Enter shortcut in Find/Replace panel. AI adds OpenAI legacy API support. Miscellaneous changes fix opening of sql files via command line or file explorer, resolve a potential security breach in GIS map viewer, and disable the splash screen on macOS. Data transfer fixes the 'Write to the single file' option and allows file name copy/edit in the input file selector UI. Database-specific changes include Apache Derby driver updated to 10.17.1.0, Athena driver updated to 3.6.0, BigQuery driver updated to 42_1.6.3, Clickhouse adding query canceling support, Databricks fixing OSS driver configuration, PostgreSQL fixing GIS data types support, Redshift driver updated to 2.2.0 and resolving network disconnect issues for all driver versions, Snowflake driver updated to 3.27.0, SQL Server driver updated to 13.2.1, and Sybase/SAP ASE resolving stored procedures body reading issue.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.3.0, the SQL Editor fixes the ability to select multiple rows on macOS and fixes an issue with the unavailable script execution button. The Data Editor fixes incorrect behavior when applying filters with extra conditions. The Metadata editor fixes an issue with duplicate unique index create statement when generating DDL and fixes table size presentation. The Navigator fixes an issue when filters didn't work in a new DBeaver window. Query Manager always displays execution time in milliseconds. Data transfer fixes an application freeze during export of a large number of tables. Task Management adds a loading progress indicator for the task view. Security fixes a security issue in the Spatial Viewer to prevent third-party script execution. Miscellaneous adds the application installer for Windows ARM (beta version). Database-specific changes include CUBRID fixing column list duplicates with reused foreign key names, H2GIS driver downgraded to 2.2.1 due to a driver error, Oracle fixing REFCURSOR fetching, Redshift driver configuration fixed, and Yellowbrick changing to the native Yellowbrick driver and adding OAuth2 authentication support.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.3.1, the SQL Editor improves the new script numbering algorithm, resolves a bug in Find/Replace panel and Ctrl+Enter shortcut, shows dangerous query confirmation for any DROP statements, and fixes the query confirmation message. The Data Editor redesigns ordering of rows by primary key to work only in tables, resolves issues with virtual keys and 'use all columns as key' option, resolves tooltip issues for JSON columns, fixes value change cancellation, fixes data export in DbUnit format with escaping, makes the data import wizard show file selector automatically, and resolves incorrect detection of read-only columns. Miscellaneous changes fix the driver download dialog focus and details panel, improve new connection name generator, add connection configuration import from pgAdmin, add an internal connection information page to the connection edit dialog, fix check-buttons and radio-buttons rendering on Linux, remove warnings related to custom driver icons, fix saving of 'Open separate connection for metadata reads' option, fix pt_BR localization, and deprecate product distribution without Java included. Database-specific changes include Azure SQL Server fixing active database detection, CUBRID fixing duplicated primary key columns, fixing SQL query execution plan layout, and adding shards support, Denodo updating driver to version 9.0, TDengine improving non-latin encodings support, Microsoft Fabric fixing stored procedures body reading and extended properties reading, MySQL adding table column DDL generator, Oracle fixing active user name detection and GRANT statements in object's DDL, PostgreSQL adding login event triggers support, fixing SSPI authentication, resolving redundant change of 'search_path' variable, resolving wrong native binary for database restore, and Redshift fixing materialized views read.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.3.2, the Data Editor fixes value change cancellation. Search fixes text input for Chinese, Japanese, and similar languages on macOS. Data transfer removes a warning from the logs during CSV import. Miscellaneous changes fix the Linux Debian package, switch Snap packaging to classic mode, resolve issues with web browser activation, resolve Office integration issues, and fix the problem with DuckDB embedded driver connection. Database-specific changes include MySQL fixing database dump when SSH is enabled, and ClickHouse updating the driver to version 0.9.5, fixing JSON data type reading, resolving CTE expression issues, fixing active database selector, resolving LIMIT clause and read-only connections issues, fixing big numbers rendering, fixing tuple data types rendering, and fixing a number of issues with array data types fetch/render.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.3.3, the SQL Editor improves performance when executing multiple SQL queries simultaneously. The AI Assistant disables the temperature setting for models that do not support it. The Data Editor enables 'Calculate row count automatically' by default and applies it only to SELECT queries. Data Transfer resolves an issue with an oversized data transfer window. Miscellaneous changes redesign auto-commit settings, redesign visual page structure in Preferences and some dialogs, resolve incorrect transaction mode display, and restore the splash screen on macOS. Database-specific changes include ClickHouse fixing broken spatial data presentation, Sybase fixing table opening via double-click in the Navigator, DuckDB adding support for dollar-quoted string syntax, Redshift displaying materialized views as system tables with a special icon and fixing multiple issues related to permissions, incorrect empty table display, and the data import wizard, and Netezza adding the ability to search metadata objects by definitions.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.3.4, the SQL Editor makes Ctrl+C and Ctrl+X copy or cut the entire line when no text is selected, fixes status bar visibility in the result set for single and multiple query execution, adds result set display for pause commands in scripts, and includes filters and actions in non-result presentations after executing a script. The AI assistant fixes SQL generation for the OpenAI engine. The Grouping Panel adds Percent of Total function, allows columns and functions to be reordered, makes the Add button open a submenu with available items and columns, and makes choosing Custom add an empty, editable column or function. Data Transfer adds the ability to export fetched rows without querying the database and fixes data migration from database to database when 'Selected rows only' is enabled. Connectivity fixes an SSH connection error on Windows related to temporary file permissions, renames 'Database Native' authentication type to 'Username/password', and fixes 'Transaction settings' opening in the connection editor. Miscellaneous adds the ability to open DuckDB and MS Access files via File - Open. Database-specific changes include Athena fixing connection issues after an application upgrade, Azure Synapse Dedicated SQL Pool fixing stored procedure definitions display, ClickHouse fixing display of arrays of UUID, IPv4/IPv6, and Map types as strings and fixing timestamp insert/update with date formatting, CUBRID fixing an error when executing a script generated after changing the view schema owner, PostgreSQL fixing Complete backup behavior and table selection visibility during dump, Redshift fixing schema change failure when no schema matched the user's name, Salesforce Data Cloud fixing default schema detection for autocomplete, and TimescaleDB fixing incorrect table size display.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 25.3.5, the AI assistant adds descriptions for custom prompts. The Data Editor improves the presentation of multiple foreign keys, fixes dark mode display for single-tab results, and fixes several minor issues related to background rendering, exceptions, and cursor behavior. The Metadata Editor fixes tab styling. Task Management moves the 'Save Task' button to the same row as other action buttons and adds a tooltip to the Auto-commit option in SQL Script task settings. Miscellaneous changes add an option to exclude the application from Windows Defender during installation, fix Linux installation using Debian, fix the ability to manage software installation, and fix file opening from the main menu. Database-specific changes include IoTDB fixing an SQL execution error, PostgreSQL adding DDL display support for PostgreSQL policies, Salesforce Data Cloud being renamed to Salesforce Data 360, and SQLite fixing an issue where creating a foreign key with a new column failed on the first attempt.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 26.0.0, the AI assistant adds the ability to filter database objects in AI scope settings. The Data Editor fixes an issue where adding a new row in record mode inserted an existing row, fixes incorrect DDL generation for tables without keys, and fixes a bug where a new column could be replaced with the percent column after being enabled and disabled. The ER Diagram fixes table name truncation after saving in PNG format. Task Management fixes the ability to run tasks with linked scripts. Connectivity fixes jump host edits to take effect as soon as the hostname is updated and fixes the 'Test tunnel configuration' functionality for custom network profiles. Miscellaneous fixes the arm64 build in the dbeaver-ce snap package. Database-specific changes include Athena updated to version 3.27.0, Hive 4 fixing the ability to edit binary files in the Value panel, Microsoft Fabric/Azure SQL Server fixing table name autocompletion with schema-qualified names, MySQL/MariaDB fixing ER diagram creation for tables with foreign keys, PostgreSQL fixing a bug where the 'Role' field in the table policy view displayed only a single role when multiple roles were assigned, Salesforce adding support for the currency data type, and SingleStore using the correct encoding for new tables and rows.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 26.0.1, the SQL Editor stops marking user-cancelled queries as invalid and fixes a layout issue where the first few rows of text were not visible. The Grouping panel makes the Percent function show 2 significant digits and adds the ability to reorder grouping columns. The Metadata Editor fixes hash code display when the table name is empty. Data Transfer enables the Proceed button earlier on every properly filled page. Query Manager becomes accessible even if the database password is lost. Connectivity adds connection name and background color to the Ctrl+E editor switcher dropdown and fixes an issue when changes in connection parameters were not applied correctly. Miscellaneous changes add an option to disable automatic connection attachment to scripts, make the simple/advanced mode switcher more visible, and migrate to Eclipse 2026-03. Database-specific changes include ClickHouse fixing IP address display by removing the leading slash, CUBRID making default generated key names lowercase and fixing trigger display in Navigator and DDL generation, GaussDB Driver fixing connection issues and errors when viewing constraints and foreign keys in M-Compatibility databases, InterSystems IRIS driver updated to version 3.10.5, MySQL fixing views appearing in the list when 'Show views' is disabled, Oracle improving viewing of packaged procedures, PostgreSQL fixing connection error via URL when the database name contains a hyphen, and Vertica fixing column order in Metadata Editor to match the actual table structure.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 26.0.2, the Navigator fixes Copy/Paste for active connections and returns the ability to show/hide system objects in Simple view mode. The Data Editor fixes 'Access blocked' error in Spatial Viewer when loading OpenStreetMap. Miscellaneous changes fix an issue where Git and Proxy settings could break the workspace path and fix -con attribute handling when starting from the command line. Database-specific changes include Athena updating the default driver to AWS Athena JDBC driver with the previous driver available as Athena (Legacy), ClickHouse fixing database failure due to unknown driver parameters, DuckDB fixing geometry type display for database versions > 1.5, MariaDB fixing zero dates displayed as NULL, MySQL adding MANUAL to the keyword list and fixing user management, Oracle fixing default schema not selected automatically and restoring navigation from procedure to the corresponding package body code line, and SQL Server updating the driver to version 13.4.0 and adding warning about expired password.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 26.0.3, the Data Editor adds keywords autocompletion for partially typed, adds source table name to column header tooltips for query results with JOIN, fixes the row count calculation icon not resetting after counting, fixes display of spatial data when multiple columns are selected, and fixes the ability to calculate row count for non-standard SELECT statements. The Navigator adds a key binding to focus the Database Navigator filter. The ER Diagram adds a preference option to load lazy comments in diagrams. Data Export fixes export in SQL format for values containing single quotes and fixes a corrupted UI area during the Extraction step. Connectivity adds the ability to set Navigator filters in connection settings and fixes filtering for embedded databases. Miscellaneous fixes an inverted splash screen on macOS Tahoe. Database-specific changes include ClickHouse fixing display of Array(JSON) types in the data grid, CUBRID fixing CSV export error caused by missing child object, fixing binding failure in PreparedStatement for table names containing single quotes, and fixing incorrect partitioning DDL generation for values containing commas, Databricks adding a logo and fixing the link on the connection page, H2GIS driver updated to the latest version, MySQL fixing Dump database tool not working with URL-based connections, MySQL/MariaDB fixing incorrect query generation when changing an auto-increment value on the first attempt, Oracle fixing cursor movement to a comment containing the procedure name instead of the procedure itself in Metadata Editor, Redshift setting client_protocol_version driver property to default to fix external schema availability, and SQL Server fixing user-defined data types based on NVARCHAR shown with double length, removing redundant spaces between CREATE and PROCEDURE, and fixing view creation in Metadata Editor.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 26.0.4, the SQL Editor adds options to trim leading or trailing spaces in selected text or the whole script, resolves incorrect transaction mode display, fixes the transaction monitor showing 'N/A' after toolbar drag-and-drop, fixes the 'Open a separate connection for each editor' preference not being saved, and fixes the DROP confirmation dialog layout for long SQL queries. The AI assistant fixes the default temperature value for different AI engines. The Data Editor fixes reference tables becoming empty when fetching the next page in the References panel, adds an option to show column data type names in column headers (disabled by default), and fixes an exception when expanding a custom data type value in Record mode. Data Export fixes object list resizing in the Export/Dump window. Connectivity fixes cleared driver proxy credentials still being saved and fixes testing an SSH connection with a passphrase failing if the passphrase was not saved. Security fixes the high vulnerability CVE-2026-3505 in the bcpg-jdk18on library by updating to version 1.84.0. Miscellaneous adds the ability to save SQL to a file from the Generate SQL dialog, adds the ability to import JetBrains database connections by pasting datasource configuration text directly into the import wizard, and fixes the splash screen being flipped on macOS 14.x. Database-specific changes include Athena adding type casting for date values in data filters, BigQuery adding a new driver BigQuery (Experimental), ClickHouse fixing SQL Editor recognition for existing tables with uppercase letters in their names, Denodo adding support for custom data types and fixing column names for nested arrays, DuckDB fixing map rendering for GEOMETRY types with CRS parameters, Firebird expanding database-specific SQL dialect coverage, Greenplum/Cloudberry fixing external table recognition in the Database Navigator, MySQL fixing query boundaries recognition in the SQL Editor for scripts with the DELIMITER keyword, PostgreSQL fixing debug configuration dialog layout and datasource saving, fixing DDL generation for VIRTUAL generated columns, SAP HANA adding the ability to reset the license during connection when the database is in license-only mode, SQL Server fixing DDL generation for external tables and fixing row limiting for table-valued function queries, StarRocks fixing ADD COLUMN DDL generation, and Chinese localization being improved.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 26.0.5, the AI assistant adds support for new Codex models in GitHub Copilot. The SQL Editor fixes syntax highlighting for inline ORDER BY clauses inside aggregate functions. The Data Editor disables Save and Cancel buttons for read-only databases, adds a group row striping option to color rows by column values in the result grid, and adds the ability to show multiple selected rows in Text record mode. Data Transfer redesigns wizard pages and keeps the export window open after errors to allow restarting. The Navigator adds indicators for connection view type (Simple, Advanced, or Custom) and updates simple view mode switching, and adds the ability to change the current project from the bottom-left corner. Connectivity fixes an issue where the option to save credentials was disabled after testing the connection and fixes multi-line pasting in driver properties. Charts and Dashboards fix an issue where deleting one dashboard removed other dashboards from the panel. Miscellaneous adds a Format SQL option to the Generate SQL dialog, fixes white background for some toolbar items in dark theme, and fixes grouping panel queries when generated aliases matched SQL keywords. Database-specific changes include BigQuery fixing array display for the new BigQuery driver, Exasol fixing view loading in the Database Navigator, PostgreSQL updating driver to version 42.7.11, adding support for the MAINTAIN keyword, fixing handling of '24:00' values in time columns, and fixing missing INOUT parameters in CHECK generation for procedures and functions, Redshift fixing default schema switching when the 'public' schema is missing, Snowflake updating driver to version 4.1.0 and fixing an occasional error while typing SQL, SQL Server fixing the ability to connect after Java update, Starrocks adding external catalogs support, and fixing hardcoded localization for several command labels in the SQL Editor main menu.

In the dbeaver/dbeaver release 26.1.0, the SQL Editor adds support for double-curly SQL parameters. The AI assistant adds support for new OpenAI codex models with GitHub Copilot. The Metadata Editor fixes an issue where the item count disappeared after refreshing the editor. The Data Editor adds new shortcuts: 'Shift+Alt+Insert' inserts a row before the current, 'Ctrl+Shift+Alt+Insert' duplicates a row and inserts before the current row, adds the ability to hide filters, adds the 'Insert new rows' option to Advanced Copy, and fixes spatial data displayed as grayed in the Spatial viewer. The Navigator fixes an issue when the newly created object was deleted after refresh. Connectivity makes jump servers settings update on the fly. Data Transfer fixes incorrect export to HTML format when only one of 'Table header' or 'Column headers' options was enabled. Task Management fixes multiple issues where content could disappear on some tool pages inside the Task wizard. Security fixes XXE Injection in DBeaver XML Viewer. New drivers add support for GizmoSQL driver. Miscellaneous changes make the Copy button in the Generate DDL dialog remain disabled until DDL generation is complete, fix white background of vertical tabs and some toolbar items in Dark theme, improve import from DataGrip for Snowflake, BigQuery and other non-standard connections, add the 'supports-ddl-transactions' parameter for custom generic drivers, and fix build failures caused by non-English default JVM locales. Database-specific changes include BigQuery fixing incorrect presentation of multiple query results, DuckDB fixing LIST array presentation in the Data Editor, Databricks fixing the ability to open schemas with a hyphen in the name, Microsoft Fabric fixing Execution plan opening, Oracle naming result tabs depending on the executed query, Redshift driver updated to version 2.2.6, and French localization being improved.

questions.query_text: In the dbeaver/dbeaver releases, which release adds support for Common Table Expressions (CTE) by semantic analysis and autocompletion in the SQL Editor?

answer_support.answer_text: SQL Editor: Added support for Common Table Expressions (CTE) by semantic analysis and autocompletion

questions.query_text: Across the dbeaver/dbeaver releases, how does the AI assistant change described in release 25.1.3 differ from the AI assistant change described in release 25.2.0?

options.text: 25.1.3 includes AI integration in the Community packaging without needing an extension, while 25.2.0 adds query preview to the @ai command and AI chat query confirmation.
25.1.3 removes AI integration entirely, while 25.2.0 reintroduces it with custom OpenAI API base URL support.
Both releases only update the GitHub Copilot authorization dialog.
25.1.3 adds support for custom OpenAI API base URL, while 25.2.0 includes AI integration in the Community packaging.

questions.expected_answer: 25.1.3 includes AI integration in the Community packaging without needing an extension, while 25.2.0 adds query preview to the @ai command and AI chat query confirmation.

answer_support.answer_text: AI integration is now included in the Community packaging, extension install is not needed anymore
AI Assistant: Added query preview to the @ai command and AI chat query confirmation

questions.query_text: In the dbeaver/dbeaver release window, order the following release-content states from earliest to latest: (1) a release that adds support for Common Table Expressions (CTE) by semantic analysis and autocompletion, (2) a release that significantly improves CTE completion and navigation support, (3) a release that adds support for column expansion for CTEs.

answer_support.answer_text: SQL Editor: Added support for Common Table Expressions (CTE) by semantic analysis and autocompletion
CTE completion and navigation support was significantly improved
Added support for column expansion for CTEs

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent denoland/deno release stream from v2.5.6 through v2.8.1, covering feature additions, Node.js compatibility improvements, and bug fixes across minor and patch versions.

chunks.title: v2.5.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.5.6, the release reverts a urlpattern chore update, implements StatementSync#columns() for Node compatibility, re-allows spawning of bat and cmd files on Windows, and fixes Windows path normalization to strip periods and trailing slashes.

chunks.title: v2.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.6.0, the release introduces a breaking change requiring `--` for script args in `deno install -g`, adds an approve-scripts subcommand, filters internal frames in stack traces, prints working directory in grey, allows storing npm constraints for lifecycle scripts, adds dark-mode toggle for coverage HTML output, implements FileHandle.appendFile, adds ImageData Float16Array support, stabilizes BroadcastChannel, makes {Readable,Writable,Transform}Stream transferable, adds `--lockfile-only` flag, supports subpath imports starting with '#/', allows Deno.env.toObject() for partial env permission, adds socket.dev integration for `deno audit`, upgrades to V8 14.2, adds `--ignore-read`, `deno init --empty`, `--require` run arg, Float16Array support, `--ignore-env`, `deno x` alias, native source maps support, includes @types/node type declarations out of the box, supports `publish: false` in deno.json, uses Node.js timers by default, and adds wasm source phase imports, along with numerous fixes for bundle, check, compile, config, ext/node, ext/net, and other subsystems.

chunks.title: v2.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.6.1, the release makes deploy config app optional, fixes graph building to include type-only imports, adds streams as transferable types, fixes Intel Mac compile issues, improves DatabaseSync compatibility, corrects the `deno x` alias location on Windows, fixes executing native binaries on Windows, restricts --preload and --require flags to runtime subcommands, adjusts deno_cache version, and fixes source map file names pointing to non-existent paths.

chunks.title: v2.6.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.6.2, the release adds an unstable sandbox subcommand, fixes deserde for transitive npm audit actions, handles workspace members with different jsx import sources, fixes a tsgo regression with node globals, fixes deno tunnel when token storage is unavailable, ensures temp dir exists during x64 codesign, improves sqlite:backup compatibility, adds error handling for UV bindings, avoids env permission for TERM in console and readline, fixes a hot loop in setImmediate, stubs Module.register and Module.registerHooks, supports named pipe listen/connect/open, fixes otel baggage propagation, fixes SOCKS5 proxy URL validation, implements a better sandbox subcommand, adds worker debugging support via CDP, improves `deno x` caching and resolution, fixes shim script with custom alias names, fixes a panic on dropped inspector session, and updates glob implementation to match latest Node.

chunks.title: v2.6.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.6.3, the release improves node types handling in check and reverts the stubbing of Module.register and Module.registerHooks.

chunks.title: v2.6.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.6.4, the release makes compile work with --unstable-npm-lazy-caching, enables keepAlive connection reuse for HTTP Agent, handles errors in sqlite session filter callback, supports TypedArray and DataView targets in Buffer.copy(), supports inspector.url(), supports numbered positional parameters in node:sqlite, prevents sending multiple close frames in WebSocket, waits for package installations before applying patches, integrates async_hooks for domain error handling in node/crypto, fixes net permissions in config file for serve, prioritizes member package.json when deno.json is only in root, updates wgpu to 28.0.0, fixes deno cross compile for Intel Mac target, and updates urlpattern to 0.4.2.

chunks.title: v2.6.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.6.5, the release adds gif and webp support for createImageBitmap in ext/canvas, adds performance.clearResourceTimings() and setResourceTimingBufferSize() in ext/web, implements FileHandle.readableWebStream() in node/fs, respects --level flag for audit exit code, renames trusted-signing-action to artifact-signing-action in CI, closes Node HTTP connections before sanitizer check in test, reads file urls via vfs in ext/fetch, supports ipv6 destination host with http and socks proxy, fixes DatabaseSync garbage collection invalidating associated resources, adds tls.setDefaultCACertificates support, emits deprecation warning for SlowBuffer, fixes use-after-free in StatementSync JS iterator, uses correct block sizes for HMAC algorithms, handles empty TextDecoder input when stream is true, ignores BrokenPipe error in op_print, fixes ChildProcess constructor without args, improves arg type validation for execFile and fork, rejects null bytes in arguments, uses correct syscall name in spawn error, performs deduplication pass for initially partially resolved npm graphs, handles options parameter in Deno.errors constructors, preserves signal-based exit codes for child processes in task, fixes nil deref for exported symbols in tsgo, correctly exposes GPUCompilationInfo and GPUCompilationMessage in webgpu, adds more details when panicking getting dir path from deno.json, allows multiple --allow-all args, queues dynamic imports for modules with pending TLA, and updates config schema for read permission to include ignore property.

chunks.title: v2.6.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.6.6, the release shows a progress bar for TSGO downloads in cli/tsc, accepts bare host and bare port for --inspect flag, adds /ws/events endpoint in inspector server with watcher restart event notification, adds globstar, failglob, nullglob, and pipefail support in task, instruments cron with OTEL, improves @types/ package resolution for the global resolver in check, fixes non-determinism in deno doc --lint, always spawns subprocess for dx, adds SHA3 support in ext/crypto, improves assert compatibility, fixes deadline resolution for queued timers, implements PerformanceObserver, implements getValidStdio for child_process, improves child_process CLI argument parsing, implements inspector.open() and inspector.close(), prevents dereferencing symlinks on fs.rm, properly implements process.features, validates fd in tty.isatty and enables pseudo-tty tests, fixes double free of Session after database closed in ext/sqlite, exports PerformanceObserver and PerformanceObserverEntryList from ext/web, excludes tsconfig imports from publish graph, includes npm:@types/ package resolution in published packages, and prevents setting 1005 outbound close code.

chunks.title: v2.5.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.5.7, the release fixes deno cross compile for Intel Mac target, fixes fetch fd leak, avoids name clash in bundle hack, does not error on failing to clean up esbuild dir in bundle, fixes import.meta.main transform with jsr entrypoint in bundle, treats bun specifiers as external by default in bundle, fixes nil deref with --unstable-tsgo in check, ensures temp dir exists during x64 codesign in compile, fixes Intel Mac compile issues, fixes sentinal conflict with strtab on Intel Mac in compile, fixes autopadding behavior on crypto.Cipheriv, prevents cipher operations after finalize, truncates first non-hex value on Buffer.from, ensures process.argv is an array of strings, stubs missing process.sourceMapsEnabled, respects authTagLength in createCipheriv for GCM ciphers, and makes process.stdin.isTTY writable.

chunks.title: v2.6.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.6.7, the release implements mock API for node:test module, implements FileHandle.readv() method, uses JSR for @jsr scope in npm, adds External Socket-Based Cron Implementation, upgrades to V8 14.5, adds --inspect-publish-uid flag for VSCode debugging, uses serve address override only once in ext/http, removes socket file when dropping unix listener in ext/net, improves sqlite StatementSync compatibility, aligns assert throws/rejects signatures, fixes usage of new V8 string APIs, implements sqlite missing options, passes test-child-process-bad-stdio node compat test, reads NODE_OPTIONS for --require and --inspect-publish-uid, retries stale keepAlive connections in http client, supports setImmediate promisify.custom, uses primordials in _fs_ftruncate.ts and tls.ts, supports object in DOMException second argument for Node.js compat, throws ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE for invalid fs.readFile path, fixes lint ast comments from first file showing in others, uses local npm package even if npm specifier is used in x, allows reading /dev/tty without requiring --allow-all, enables edns for Deno.resolveDns, implements graceful server shutdown with open un-upgraded connections, and uses locked-tripwire to prevent unlocked cargo installs.

chunks.title: v2.6.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.6.8, the release supports jsr: scheme in package.json for npm, adds Windows on ARM builds, enables defensive option on DatabaseSync, improves error formatting compatibility, implements sqlite SQLTagStore, uses primordials in _fs_fchown.ts, corrects zsh completions for script arg in flags, cleans up associated config and lock files during uninstall in install, corrects types for Worker events, reloads CronHandlerImpl when control socket receives new envs, and upgrades deno_core to 0.383.0.

chunks.title: v2.6.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.6.9, the release supports markdown files in doc, adds ability to verify zip archive against checksum in upgrade, adds context to upgrade error messages, sends reject-ack message through cron socket, makes Path property more readable in audit, pulls in tunnel fix for Windows, uses a temporary directory with node_modules folder when compiling npm specifiers, fixes .only tests compatibility, improves fs.writeFile and FileHandle.writeFile compatibility, adds threadName to worker_threads, adds worker.cpuUsage API, adds hasColors() to process.stdout and process.stderr, adds stub for ServerResponse.writeEarlyHints, adds zstd compression support to node:zlib, emits close on both paired MessagePorts, emits error event for worker with missing main module, emits error event for worker_threads terminal errors, fixes test-worker-process-argv and test-worker-process-env tests, fixes multiple node:zlib compatibility issues, handles raw fd instead of rid in isatty, implements Node worker BroadcastChannel ref/unref, implements Symbol.asyncDispose for node Worker, implements DatabaseSync.setAuthorizer(), makes child_process stdio streams Socket instances, propagates worker exit code from process.exit(), reads from stdin when spawning node with no args, serializes workerData before resolving worker filename, sets exitCode/signalCode correctly for killed child processes, unrefs child_process stdio streams by default, unrefs stdin on pause to allow process exit, validates execArgv and NODE_OPTIONS in worker_threads, uses correct severity for console.trace in ext/otel, fixes GPUQueue writeBuffer size in ext/webgpu, fixes extra trailing space in zsh directory completions, makes randomBytes return buffer with dedicated ArrayBuffer, handles EOF gracefully in JSON REPL mode, fixes user input clearing test runner output, fixes deno info npm subpath import, adds raw.esm.sh to default --allow-import list, fixes flaky cron socket tests, runs on pre-Windows 10 version 1709, supports DENO_SERVE_ADDRESS not being applied to the first server, supports loading npm: and jsr: specifiers in required ES modules, and fixes unstable_cron_socket_serve_reject flakiness.

chunks.title: v2.6.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.6.10, the release adds SSLKEYLOGFILE support for TLS key logging in ext/tls, supports more license file types in publish, adds deno install --compile, removes data.is_empty() check in compile, bypasses minimumDependencyAge in deploy, does not mark accessor properties as read-only in napi_define_class, improves assert.ok compatibility, improves fs.rmdir compatibility, adds parentPath to Dirent from fs.opendir and supports Buffer paths in lstat, adds worker_threads stdin support, exports File class from node:buffer module, fixes test-worker-process-argv test, fixes worker exit code propagation in worker_threads, fixes worker.terminate() return value and exit code, forwards stdout from worker_threads to parent, makes worker_threads ref/unref idempotent, normalizes trailing dot in TLS servername, makes process.exit() in worker immediately halt execution, supports O_RDONLY | O_CREAT in fs.openSync, uses primordials in _fs_lchown.ts, validates execArgv flags in worker_threads instead of rejecting all, prevents GC of AbortSignal.any(), rechecks state after signaling abort on writable stream, cleans up node_modules folder on install, replaces lsp-types with tower-lsp-community/ls-types, unconditionally calls Module.prototype._compile with file content in loadMaybeCjs, makes zlib write callback async to match node behavior, preserves request body on stale keepalive retry in node/http, and throws when Deno.test() is called during test execution.

chunks.title: v2.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.7.0, the release adds --ignore flag to filter advisories by CVE ID in audit, adds --check-js flag in check, adds --save-exact/--exact flag to deno add and install, adds deno create command, adds --self-extracting flag in compile, supports include and exclude in deploy config, adds --keep-names flag in ext/bundle, adds brotli support to CompressionStream and DecompressionStream in ext/web, adds --fail-fast flag to deno fmt --check, adds tryLock to FsFile, supports --node-modules-dir for -g and uses manual node_modules dir for installing npm: specifiers in install, turns off failglob by default in task, adds Deno.spawn() and Deno.spawnAndWait{Sync}() as unstable, caches downloaded binaries in upgrade, adds deno create jsr:<package> and deno init --jsr <package>, adds navigator.platform, adds npm overrides, stabilizes Temporal API, and includes numerous fixes for audit, bundle, CI, ext/node, install, lsp, node, permissions, and other areas.

chunks.title: v2.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the denoland/deno release v2.7.1, this maintenance release fixes wrong output of deno --version in v2.7.0.

chunks.title: v2.7.2
