prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent derailed/k9s release stream from v0.40.0 through v0.50.18, covering feature introductions like custom columns and namespace-specific views, numerous maintenance hotfixes, and the 0.50.x series with performance improvements and Super Column Blow.

chunks.title: v0.40.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.40.0, the project introduces full custom columns support. Users can now customize views for a given resource by adding definitions in views.yaml, including the ability to add columns for labels, annotations, or other resource fields. New directives allow specifying sort order and column layout, and remaining columns are automatically filled from standard columns.

chunks.title: v0.40.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.40.1, a maintenance release addresses several issues from v0.40.0. Resolved issues include the inability to retain temporary view sort, failure to describe or print YAML for HPAs in all namespaces view, context filtering problems, a small colour/filtering bug, drain node with -disable-eviction, restart count in container view associated with the wrong container, and a request to add a ServiceAccount column in v1/POD view. Contributed PRs add features such as logging in as root to the node, skipping cache invalidation on failed connection, making menu foreground style configurable through skins, improving logo aesthetics, allowing scaling of custom resources, adding history navigation with [ and ], stopping table header cells from being selectable, and a feature to disable autoscroll.

chunks.title: v0.40.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.40.2, a maintenance hotfix addresses the issue where custom CRDs could not be listed since v0.40.1.

chunks.title: v0.40.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.40.3, a maintenance hotfix continues to address the issue where custom CRDs could not be listed since v0.40.1, noted with feelings.

chunks.title: v0.40.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.40.4, a maintenance release resolves issues including events no longer sorted by LAST SEEN, custom view column mismatch with shuffled values in pods view, custom views failing to load with % in column names, and selecting an alias showing wrong resources. A contributed PR updates regex to allow '%' and '/' in column names.

chunks.title: v0.40.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.40.5, a maintenance release resolves issues where singular versions of native Kubernetes resource names no longer work and custom views fail to load with % in column names (with feelings). A contributed PR updates regex to allow '%' and '/' in column names.

chunks.title: v0.40.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.40.6, a maintenance release introduces a breaking change by moving portForwardAddress out of cluster/context config into the main K9s config file as a global preference. It adds namespace-specific column definitions for custom views, allowing different column configurations per namespace (e.g., v1/pods@fred). A new column attribute 'Show' (S) overrides the default wide attribute. Resolved issues include resource name display with full api/group, cronjobs with same name in different namespaces appearing together, triggering all marked cronjobs, context directory created under wrong cluster after context switch, and others.

chunks.title: v0.40.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.40.7, a maintenance release fixes hosed custom view loading from v0.40.6. A contributed PR allows absolute paths for the 'dir' command.

chunks.title: v0.40.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.40.8, a maintenance release resolves issues including a feature request to view aliases with custom columns, allowing readonly indicator to respect the noIcons configuration, and adding support for bunyan logging. Contributed PRs include allowing absolute paths for the 'dir' command and adding plugin support for parsing logs with bunyan CLI.

chunks.title: v0.40.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.40.9, a maintenance release refactors plugins implementation and updates plugins docs. It updates the 'write' icon from unlock to a writing hand. Resolved issue: v0.40.8 breaks plugins loading.

chunks.title: v0.40.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.40.10, a maintenance release acknowledges that plugins were hosed after all, with feelings. It refactors plugins implementation, updates plugins docs, and updates the 'write' icon. Resolved issue: v0.40.8 breaks plugins loading.

chunks.title: v0.50.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.0, the project undergoes a major code revamp and refactor with performance improvements to address slowdowns since v0.40.x. It introduces 'Super Column Blow', allowing JQ queries in custom views to extract and transform data (e.g., pulling image version from container image). Resolved issues include filter view mess, respecting kubectl.kubernetes.io/default-container annotation, option to display resource names without API version prefix, and a buggy description line. Contributed PRs fix listing CRDs with k8s.io in names, correct skin config reference, and add a splashless option.

chunks.title: v0.50.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.1, a hotfix addresses several issues from v0.50.0: crash when no shellPod is defined, aliases with namespace and/or labels producing an error, mac silicon runtime error, pods reported on wrong nodes, pods view broken, and custom view not working randomly.

chunks.title: v0.50.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.2, a hotfix resolves more issues from the v0.50.0 cleanup: no output when no resources found, command alias :dp fails with 'no resource meta defined for deployments', cannot execute get/describe in StorageClass view, and yaml view of pod crashes the app.

chunks.title: v0.50.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.3, a maintenance release includes code spring cleaning and addresses bugs: RBAC view bombing out on cluster roles, and custom views parsing jq filters bombing out. Contributed PRs fix plugin scopes containers issue and pass context and token flags to kubectl exec commands.

chunks.title: v0.50.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.4, a maintenance release resolves issues: resource search doesn't filter by name in custom view, K9s doesn't understand matchExpressions selector in Deployment to Pod navigation, Rollout Restart method conflicts with GitOps, Deployment status showing wrong ready state, and k9s doesn't honor the --namespace parameter. Contributed PRs include respecting insecure flag when switching context, adding hostPathVolume for docker, setting default request timeout to 120 seconds, and a feature for default_view.

chunks.title: v0.50.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.5, a maintenance release resolves issues: pod overview shows wrong number of running containers with sidecar init-container, k9s crashes when loading logs, port forward deleted without UI notification when forwarding to wrong port, k9s crashes when filtering based on labels, and k9s doesn't honor the --namespace parameter. Contributed PRs fix concurrent read writes, use full path of date to avoid conflict, show replicasets from deployment view, truncate label selector input to max length, and update time format in logging to 24-hour format.

chunks.title: v0.50.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.6, a maintenance release resolves an issue where the watcher failed for events.k8s.io/v1/events expecting a meta table but got *unstructured.Unstructure. Contributed PRs include pre-check for get permissions only on port-forward, fix concurrent read writes, and use full path of date to avoid conflict.

chunks.title: v0.50.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.7, a maintenance release resolves issues: noExitOnCtrlC, pulses navigation selection invisible, add GPUs to nodes view, changing ns should keep current kind, 'Toggle Decode' for secret has no effect, history navigation truncation, improve UX of FieldManager field on restart, and triggering a CronJob fails as Unauthorized since v0.50. Contributed PRs add kube-metrics plugin, add context to condition in keda-toggle plugin, fix GVR Title option in readme, and revert a previous change.

chunks.title: v0.50.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.8, a maintenance release resolves issues: feature request to add GPU column to pod/container view, weirdness when filtering namespaces, and allow KnownGPUVendors customization. Contributed PRs add GPU usage to pod view, fix can't switch namespaces in helm view, and allow skin to be selected via K9S_SKIN env var.

chunks.title: v0.50.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.9, a maintenance release resolves issues: update the tablewriter dependency + implementation, and unable to switch namespaces with 0.50.8. A contributed PR updates to tablewriter v1 apis.

chunks.title: v0.50.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.10, a maintenance release resolves issues: ServiceAccount RBAC Rules not displayed if RoleBinding subject doesn't specify namespace, current release process causing code changes reverted, k9s suspends when launching foreground plugin, regression in filtering with aliases, high disk and CPU usage when imageScans enabled, aliases for pods with unequal label filters not working, shared GPU shown as n/a, and memory command not found. Contributed PRs include consolidating duplicate resource commands, adding dup plugin, making flux trace more generic, adding flux-operator resources, adding pvc debug container plugin, feature/refresh rate, fixing flickering in context suggestions, and suppressing init no resources warning.

chunks.title: v0.50.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.11, a maintenance release resolves issues: extra slash '/' added when filtering from the command prompt, and unable to switch context or use k9s after upgrade to 0.50.10.

chunks.title: v0.50.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.12, a maintenance release resolves issues: 0.50.11 could not display any resources, can't delete namespace, and error message from admission controller.

chunks.title: v0.50.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.13, a maintenance release resolves issues: UI doesn't show any updates when restarting a Deployment, abbreviation sec for secret not working, show managed fields doesn't show them, cannot open shell to pods without node read access as of 0.50.12, log view is broken as of v0.50.10, and aliases for pods with label filters not working.

chunks.title: v0.50.14
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.14, a maintenance release resolves issues: k9s crashes when :namespaces used, Xray not working anymore, show pod yaml crashes with 'cannot deep copy int', accept suggestion with enter (without having to tab), and custom alias/view not working anymore since v0.50.10.

chunks.title: v0.50.15
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.15, a maintenance release reverts the change for accepting suggestion with enter (without having to tab) from issue #3591.

chunks.title: v0.50.16
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.16, a maintenance release introduces 'namespace warp' via shortcut 'w', allowing users to view all resources of the selected type in the current namespace. Resolved issues include a vulnerability in k9s project, switching to ':Deploy' sending to deployments from namespace 'deploy', trying to show pod yaml using custom views.yaml crashes k9s, k9s crashes when :namespaces used, can't delete namespace, toggle namespace filter in pods view with 'n' key, and custom alias/view not working anymore since v0.50.10. Contributed PRs fix debug-container plugin when KUBECONFIG has multiple files, fix panic in BenchmarkPodRender, add plugin to list all resources by namespace, do not prevent redraw when connection unavailable, set linux when OS detection fails, and do not error out of shellIn if OS detection fails.

chunks.title: v0.50.17
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.17, a maintenance release resolves issues including quay.io related problems and others. It includes a New Year's greeting and sponsorship acknowledgments.

chunks.title: v0.50.18
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the derailed/k9s release v0.50.18, a maintenance release notes that a PR was missed in v0.50.17 excitement and drops v0.50.18 with feelings. It includes sponsorship acknowledgments and a New Year's greeting.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release stream of dgtlmoon/changedetection.io, covering a series of updates from version 0.52.3 through 0.55.7. The releases include browser step fixes, localization improvements, datastore refactoring, security patches, and the introduction of AI/LLM-based change detection.

chunks.title: 0.52.3 Important fix for Browsers Steps (from UI), minor UI fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.52.3, the project fixes a Browser Steps UI async_loop bug, refactors the startup of BrowserSteps, increases test coverage, and improves Playwright memory cleanup.

chunks.title: 0.52.4 Languages fix for pypi,  Fixing Traditional Chinese locale mapping
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.52.4, the project fixes Traditional Chinese locale mapping.

chunks.title: 0.52.5 i18n improvements, revert potential CPu hungry brotli sub-process
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.52.5, the project includes i18n improvements, reverts a potential CPU-hungry brotli sub-process, bumps pyppeteer-ng to 2.0.0rc11, fixes zh_TW to zh_Hant_TW, updates jsonschema requirement, updates zh_Hant_TW translations, and adds a new contributor.

chunks.title: 0.52.6 Selenium fetcher fix and small UI update
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.52.6, the project provides a Selenium fetcher fix and a small UI update.

chunks.title: 0.52.7 Improvements and small features extras
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.52.7, the project delivers improvements and small feature extras, including a Selenium fetcher fix for RGB error on transparent screenshots, bumping apprise to 1.9.6, updating zh translations, bumping elementpath, a hack fix for selenium 3, manual polish for zh locale, empty watches tweaks, not adding imported items to the check queue, language updates, running clear history in background thread, change deterministic fix, non-blocking improvements, API and UI recheck all improvements, global mute and pause buttons on main menu, moving Backups to Settings, lots of translation updates, and fixing zh PO duplicates.

chunks.title: 0.52.8 Memory handling fixes, API validation improvements, small fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.52.8, the project addresses memory handling fixes, API validation improvements, and small fixes including a search query parameter fix, browser auto-detection fix for Traditional Chinese, API validation improvements, and a favicon reader memory leak fix along with JSON database improvements for large watch lists.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.52.9, the project updates German, French translations, opens GitHub link on new tab, speeds up browser page fetching by making element locking off by default, makes language selection sticky, uses credentials to fetch web manifest, and improves memory management.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.53.1, the project performs a very large refactor of the datastore backend to split watch data into uuid/watch.json and uuid/tag.json, includes lots of API fixes, refactors the queuing system, bumps apprise, updates German translations, adds CLI options, adds support for remote reverse proxies, improves error catching in Browser Steps, adds ability to limit total number of watches with PAGE_WATCH_LIMIT, removes Janus queue worker, improves Puppeteer and Playwright browser shutdown, bumps elementpath, improves processor plugins, improves memory by using builtin markupsafe, limits trim history size, improves watch global settings handling, adds more tests, rebuilds translations, fixes a plugin firing issue, bumps pyppeteer-ng and psutil, refactors code and tags storage, fixes tags update, includes missing tags in API watch information, adds API import query parameters, uses background task for API import, and refactors upgrade path.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.53.2, the project adds a small security test and fixes an overzealous filename cleaner, and validates restock price number before output in the UI watch overview.
In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.53.3, the project skips API validation errors about server path to allow use on sub-paths/reverse proxy.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.53.4, the project adds pluggy plugin hooks for before and after a watch is processed, fixes realtime UI updates for status updates, fixes a time schedule off-by-one bug, handles large SPA pages causing HTML to Text failure, fixes stripping tags for long content, adds extra Puppeteer browser cleanup, and re-runs tag update and re-saves to cleanup changedetection.json.
In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.53.5, the project implements backup restore and fixes bad replacement of metadata causing possible content removal.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.53.6, the project removes flask patch and pins library versions for pip installs, and fixes exclude compression which had a memory leak with flask-socketio.
In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.53.7, the project upgrades flask-socketio, bumps referencing, and unpins the referencing library.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.54.1, the project addresses CVE-2026-27696 (SSRF via Watch URLs) by requiring an environment variable to access IANA reserved URLs, and CVE-2026-27645 (Reflected XSS in RSS Single Watch request).

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.54.2, the project fixes the change_datetime notification token, adds arguments to the diff notification token, implements a processor extensible API for updating, updates jsonpath-ng requirement, bumps dependencies, and allows unresolvable hostnames to be added with security checks at fetch time.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.54.3, the project updates French translation, adds Ukrainian translations, and applies a small fix for CVE-2026-27696 where restricted hostnames can still be added but are only checked at fetch-time.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.54.4, the project accepts translated confirmation text when clearing snapshot history, adds Python 3.14 CI test and support, updates API docs with better processor plugin info, and addresses CVE-2026-29038 (Reflected XSS in RSS Tag Error Response), CVE-2026-29039 (XPath Arbitrary File Read via unparsed-text()), and CVE-2026-29065 (fixes for backups including zip slip, zip bomb, upload size limit, UUID validation, secret.txt leakage, and download edge cases).

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.54.5, the project removes unnecessary text extraction for restock, improves content fetching with better encoding detection and UTF-8 handling, fixes UI price amount type, bumps dependencies, makes various memory and CPU improvements, adds complete Spanish translation, fixes API tag creation not saving restock config, fixes UI Preview GO button, and inverts changes_only flag for include_equal parameter in API.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.54.6, the project bumps apprise, adds commit calls for pause and mute operations, improves pluggable extra fetchers/browsers, and attempts to strip out JSONP and treat as plaintext.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.54.7, the project addresses security issues including XPath json-doc() Arbitrary File Read Bypass and CVE-2026-33981 (Environment Variable Disclosure via jq env Builtin in Include Filters), tidies UI text, suppresses socket.io errors in logs, adds previous_price to restock values, fixes critical errors in Spanish translation, clears last_error when page content is the same, and updates Czech translation strings.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.54.8, the project addresses CVE-2026-35490 (Authentication Bypass via Decorator Ordering), implements an extendable theme pluggy implementation, ensures all unit tests are run in CI, and updates openapi-core requirement.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.54.9, the project adds Japanese translation, updates Selenium RemoteConnection to use ClientConfig for timeout, fixes SCREENSHOT_MAX_HEIGHT enforcement, adds notification tokens diff_changed_from and diff_changed_to, adds wildcard group application, adds Portuguese (Brasil) translation, fixes word-level diff ignore_change_type_prefix, allows custom colour for tag/group/label background, fixes step failure notification crash, adds test for word-level diff, fixes XLSX import error messages, updates Czech translation, adds Turkish translation, handles inline favicons, adds new text filter 'Extract lines containing text', improves text extract tidyup, updates Japanese translations, fixes locale rendering, and makes ignore text override trigger text.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.54.10, the project wraps untranslated UI strings and updates Japanese translations, bumps apprise, fixes diff_changed_to causing missed notifications, fixes untranslated labels on mobile watchlist view, and fixes unresponsive help and tips button on tag edit screen.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.55.1, the project introduces AI/LLM rulesets for change detection and text summary using LiteLLM, uses pgettext for diff page labels, fixes broken opacity feedback for restock/price fields, wraps untranslated UI strings, adds msgfmt linting, updates python-engineio requirement, adds CI translation sync check, fixes deprecation warning, implements LLM integration, consolidates gettext calls, adds translation linting and TRANSLATORS.md, fixes ambiguous Usage tab label, and updates Korean language.
In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.55.3, the project provides a release with no detailed notes in the provided data.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.55.4, the project includes i18n linting, UI fixes for AI/LLM Summary button, improves LiteLLM deps, adds dennis .pot/.po lint, fixes API watch.link type, adds restock config to API output, enforces dennis lint warnings, clears pre-existing dennis warnings, fixes broken HTML tags, adds extra check for system default notifications, escapes diff variables before Jinja2 rendering, fixes GHSA-vwgh-2hvh-4xm5 substring match, bumps tests, adds self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint support for LLM, tweaks LiteLLM config UI, makes LLM status sticky, fixes LLM summary cache miss-hit, processes subtractive_selectors first in text filters, improves API support for watch private vars, runs ignore text before extract text, fixes Czech l12n catalog sync, changes Docker INSTALLED_MARKER handling, fixes LLM Ollama tweaks, adds SSRF guard for LLM api_base setting, and changes API watch GET history snapshot to return text/plain mimetype.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.55.5, the project fixes Spanish translations for 'Changed' and 'Last Changed', fixes a notification error when diff callable tokens are used with HTML output, and adds a master on/off switch for LLM.

In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.55.6, the project addresses a security issue (SSRF via urlparse/urllib3 Parser Differential), fixes UI preview for extract_text/ignore_text, adds LLM_FEATURES_DISABLED flag to disable all LLM, adds missing raw_diff notification token, disables LLM blueprint when flag is enabled, refactors LLM settings with pydantic, and bumps dennis with strict mode.
In the dgtlmoon/changedetection.io release 0.55.7, the project fixes LLM settings for wtforms vs pydantic.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent directus/directus release stream from v11.8.0 through v12.0.0-rc.1, covering new features, bug fixes, and breaking changes across the headless CMS platform.

chunks.title: v11.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.8.0, the project introduces new features and improvements including applying configured display format to the kanban layout, enhancing flow trigger buttons with custom colors, adding color indications and a failed-only filter to flow logs, fixing permissions handling in the Files module, and adding a toggle for variable input on _in and _nin filters. The API adds new action events for extensions. Bug fixes address field validation in relational drawers, filters and relation creation for file interfaces, clarity for Readonly and Required options, a togglable v-list-group in storybook, invalid color values in select color field, a primaryKey data attribute on form fields, permissions handling in the Files module, and loss of ID for newly added M2M/M2A items after editing a junction field. API fixes include bumping samlify to v2.10.0, deleting the dist folder during build, redirecting to login on OpenID SSO error, coercing values only in REST, including aliases in wildcard selection, fixing cache skipping for getSchema, adding ip/userAgent/origin for ws activity, and returning dates in valid ISO format. The utils package fixes value coercion, types adds ws activity fields, and env ensures ADMIN_PASSWORD, ADMIN_TOKEN, KEY, and SECRET are always interpreted as strings.

chunks.title: v11.9.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.9.0, potential breaking changes include added support for LDAP login and enhanced parameter consistency for refresh/logout commands, requiring the login method to accept a payload object instead of separate parameters, and updating refresh and logout to accept an options object. The API fixes manual flows to only trigger with appropriate permissions, the SDK adds LDAP support and parameter consistency, and the extensions-sdk updates to Rollup v4. New features include keyboard accessibility in the app, improved field permissions UX with a checkbox tree, new OpenID environment variables (AUTH_.+_ISSUER_DISCOVERY_MUST_SUCCEED and AUTH_.+_CLIENT_HTTP), and a backlink query parameter to exclude back-relations when expanding *.*. Bug fixes add a BSL license banner for the first admin user, fix system filters showing null, ensure changes are reverted on error after drag & drop in kanban and calendar layouts, prevent null table column widths, ensure redirection after editing an item respects bookmark queries, and allow selecting custom collections for item permissions.

chunks.title: v11.9.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.9.1, a bug fix addresses an issue that prevented the file interface menu from appearing in the drawer. Published versions include @directus/app@13.11.1 and @directus/api@28.0.1.

chunks.title: v11.9.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.9.2, bug fixes resolve an error when making unchanged edits to an O2M field in the app, and fix the requireSelection check for manual trigger flows in the API. Published versions include @directus/app@13.11.2 and @directus/api@28.0.2.

chunks.title: v11.9.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.9.3, a bug fix resolves an issue where flows with manual triggers failed for integer primary keys on the item detail page. Published versions include @directus/app@13.11.3 and @directus/api@28.0.3.

chunks.title: v11.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.10.0, potential breaking changes include excluding database-only tables from snapshots, which may cause tables to be created or dropped depending on source and target versions. The API fixes replacing process.env.NODE_ENV on backend extensions and implements the snapshot exclusion. The extensions-sdk upgrades all dependencies to latest major versions of Rollup and Vite, raising the minimum Node.js version to 20.19.0, and fixes process.env.NODE_ENV replacement. New features add RTL rendering support in the studio, Stylelint and logical properties refactoring, a code tool in the WYSIWYG editor, custom validation rule execution in overlays, improved custom validation message handling, and accessibility improvements for anchors, iframes, labels, and roles. The API adds a websocket.authenticate filter hook. Bug fixes address notification rendering location, add copy ID to file details panel, update material symbols font, ensure relational interfaces can reset saved edits in versioning, and other optimizations.

chunks.title: v11.10.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.10.1, potential breaking changes include added TypeScript support for services within the extension context, making service methods strictly typed and potentially causing type errors for broader types. The extensions-sdk implements this typing. New features add a new error operation to Flows, support for private_key_jwt auth method in OpenID driver, and the ability to override the email from property. Bug fixes ensure user language is set on hydrate, add RTL support for transform properties, fix empty state centering in RTL, enable text selection in the studio, fix theme overrides interface RTL rendering, prevent English code from rendering as RTL, fix code editor interface when language prop is null, fix v-resizeable dragging for RTL vs LTR, upgrade dependencies, fix table header column resizing in RTL, ensure labels for data fields always display in batch mode, update form-data dependency, and standardize batch mode for raw group fields.

chunks.title: v11.10.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.10.2, bug fixes address a focus trap issue in TinyMCE dialogs within the WYSIWYG editor, and fix a failed Directus startup caused by additional arguments to the start command. Published versions include @directus/app@13.13.1 and @directus/api@29.1.1.

chunks.title: v11.11.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.11.0, potential breaking changes fix Content Versioning to correctly merge relational data and support all query parameter functionality, requiring explicit field expansion for relational versioned data, erroring on invalid data, and applying filter conditions to versioned data instead of the main record. The API implements this fix. New features include fixing WYSIWYG link styling and adding a new field to conditions for clearing hidden fields on save. Bug fixes address timestamp fields incorrectly marked as changed due to timezone mismatch, code button state not updating in WYSIWYG, adding currentItem ID check to prevent stale data, RTL support for popper context menu, focus trap in TinyMCE dialogs, upgrading esbuild and Vite, updating nodemailer to use AWS SESv2, fixing permissionsCacheable erroring on null operator value, and fixing auth being cleared before login/refresh request succeeds in the SDK.

chunks.title: v11.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.12.0, potential breaking changes fix USER_CREATED, USER_UPDATED, DATE_CREATED, and DATE_UPDATED values in content versioning to reflect actual user and timestamp rather than promotion metadata, and requesting a non-existent version now returns a Forbidden error. New features add MCP support, fix OAuth flow to allow 2FA setup, and add description and primary key copy option to the policy page sidebar. Bug fixes ensure custom validation messages display in the drawer, add cache-busting to image asset URLs, fix incorrect relationships in custom interfaces, ensure M2M fields in directus_files use the correct interface, upgrade joi dependency to 18.0.0, add activity tracking for user suspension due to failed login attempts, fix constraint errors not being propagated in MSSQL, upgrade tmp dependency, and replace tsup with tsdown.

chunks.title: v11.13.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.13.0, potential breaking changes include removing non-relational types from the RELATIONAL_TYPES constant, fixing the <scope>.delete filter hook to run after permission check and use returned keys, restricting system collection fields to only allow indexing, and using node exportConditions when building API extensions. New features introduce the Content Comparison Modal for side-by-side review of version and revision changes, an interface config option to control indicator appearance, a schema snapshot download button, a setup flow and license agreement banner, comparison indicators for group interfaces, improved error reporting for data imports, support for custom metric name prefix via METRICS_NAME_PREFIX, retention indexes, rate limiting options for sending emails, support for indexes on system fields in snapshots, and tracking of mcp_enabled, mcp_allow_deletes, mcp_system_prompt_enabled, and visual_editor_urls in telemetry reports.

chunks.title: v11.13.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.13.1, bug fixes address layout display dependent on item count request, add a loading indicator when saving setup forms, fix the system owner interface behaving unexpectedly, amend file imports to disallow importing multiple records into singleton collections, remove a defunct accepted_terms settings field, and fix accounts with minimum access permissions unable to add 2FA. Published versions include multiple package updates.

chunks.title: v11.13.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.13.2, a bug fix resolves an issue with tabular view loading items after a delay. Published versions include @directus/app@14.1.2, @directus/api@32.0.2, @directus/composables@11.2.6, create-directus-extension@11.0.22, and @directus/extensions-sdk@17.0.2.

chunks.title: v11.13.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.13.3, new features add a new interface to select multiple items from a collection in JSON format, support for CSV files export in UTF-8 encoding (Excel format), a non-editable mode allowing fields to display as read-only, and multi-domain OAuth/OpenID support. Bug fixes ensure the direction prop is passed down to interfaces, fix merge behavior during validation for nested drawer forms, add trigger manual flow functionality to buttons interface, update dependencies, fix notification emails failing due to transaction race condition, optimize MCP tool descriptions for ChatGPT, fix aliases on GQL M2A filters, add admin check to registry proxy calls, fix file replacement with tus enabled, and improve extension install error messages.

chunks.title: v11.13.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.13.4, a new feature ensures that flows open in a new tab when pressing Ctrl/Cmd+click or the middle mouse button. Bug fixes address error messages mismatch when creating content items, revert multi-domain OAuth/OpenID support, fix _by_id querying with M2A filters in GraphQL, and fix telemetry reporting when visual editor urls are set. Published versions include @directus/app@14.3.0 and @directus/api@32.1.1.

chunks.title: v11.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.14.0, potential breaking changes remove sidebar states from the app store. New features add support for downloading multiple files and entire folder trees, an AI chat sidebar, support for float intervals and min/max warnings for number inputs, resizable sidebars, and a header interface. The API and other packages integrate these features. Bug fixes address input focus ring disappearing on hover, display template not appearing for relations inside translations on new items, ensuring the created revision uses the correct label, adding a reactive primaryKey prop to useFlows composable, adding redirect validation, moving fetchRolesTree and related functions to the public utility package, updating synchronization of remotely stored extensions, and fixing missing accountability for files.upload when TUS is enabled.

chunks.title: v11.14.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.14.1, potential breaking changes include adding multi-domain support for OAuth/OpenID with port matching for SSO callback URL generation and redirect validation, fixing getAsset to respect directus_files permissions, removing the deprecated /webhooks functionality across the stack, removing the Comment tab from the activities page, and adding a new AI_ENABLED environment variable to opt out of the AI chat feature. Bug fixes and other changes are included across multiple packages.

chunks.title: v11.15.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.15.0, potential breaking changes include attaching prompts, content items, and visual editor elements to AI Assistant Context (requiring @directus/visual-editing v1.2.0+), and making disabled interfaces non-interactive. New features add a deployment module for triggering deployments with Vercel as the first supported provider, collaborative editing, multi-provider AI support with Google and OpenAI-compatible providers and a new @directus/ai package, a toggle to compare revision to previous revision, relational field support on the x-axis of bar charts, visual editing support in live preview split pane, and changing permission-blocked fields from disabled to non-editable appearance. The SDK fixes a race condition and allows accessing the connected state.

chunks.title: v11.15.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.15.1, bug fixes address field selection of 20+ fields in the app returning no selection, and improve prompts for using Visual Editor elements inside AI Assistant. Published versions include @directus/app@15.1.1, @directus/api@33.1.1, @directus/composables@11.2.11, create-directus-extension@11.0.27, @directus/env@5.5.1, and @directus/extensions-sdk@17.0.7.

chunks.title: v11.15.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.15.2, new features add Netlify as a deployment provider. Bug fixes address only focusing on fields that have a schema, nested group fields losing values when a condition toggles readonly, useStores/useApi/useSdk not working inside Pinia stores in extensions, manual flow triggers not working in drawer, replacing flatpickr with reka ui primitives, block editor readOnly toggle race condition, updating editorjs to fix inline link tool bug, metric list labels being cut off, asset transformation error when using withoutEnlargement with focal point, preserving SQL parameterization in relational count subquery, fixing linking scoped extensions creating nested folders, and removing node:assert usage from shared utils.

chunks.title: v11.15.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.15.3, new features add activity logging for explicit user logout. Bug fixes address date picker month select offset, opening multiple drawers when editing tree view item, vertical alignment of button fields set to half-width, and GraphQL groupBy collision when a field is named group. Published versions include multiple package updates.

chunks.title: v11.15.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.15.4, a new feature adds collaboration state (is viewing, is editing) and minor design updates. Bug fixes address translation interface being disabled when delete permission not allowed, item comparison failing with special characters in manual primary keys, non-editable state for relational fields with custom permissions, and adding restriction of allowed MIME types to the system file upload interface. Published versions include @directus/app@15.4.0 and @directus/api@33.3.1.

chunks.title: v11.16.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.16.0, potential breaking changes include adding support for a global draft version automatically available for all items when versioning is enabled (standardizing existing draft key names to "Draft"), adding field permission and version access checks to Visual Editor (requiring @directus/visual-editing v2.0.0), and fixing password reset to throw a Forbidden error for external auth provider users. New features implement RBAC for the deployment module, persist table column widths to localStorage, add image and PDF upload support to Directus AI Assistant with a provider adapter pattern for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini, add version support for visual editing in live preview, support provider webhooks for deployment real-time updates, add lower_case_table_names support for MySQL, and add JSON field selection support.

chunks.title: v11.16.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.16.1, new features update latest models for Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI providers. Bug fixes address creation of related item with empty or default state, add field level MIME type restriction to file-image interface, fix AI tool approval flow hanging, fix custom Vue operation options not persisting edited values, fix an invalid filter for M2M interfaces when item ID is null, fix folder navigation state being lost when reopening file selection drawer, enforce MIME type allow list on remaining v-uploads, fix client side validation breaking in drawer with dynamic variable, fix Visual Editor stripping trailing slashes from URLs, enable conditional styling for string fields in pie and donut charts, update AI SDK dependencies, fix save-as-copy failing on collections with many duplication fields, improve redirect handling, fix unable to click on m2o fields arrow icon, fix countAll generating incorrect query, update TUS validation, fix AI assistant Fields tool call inconsistency, add support for disabling OpenAPI output via OPENAPI_ENABLED, bump various dependencies, and fix deleteMany returning unexpected error for non-admin with empty array.

chunks.title: v11.17.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.17.0, potential breaking changes include adding support for importing data in the background with configurable timeout and concurrency, improving build times using tsdown's oxc-transform (moving collab exports to @directus/types), and shrinking the app UI to 90% and converting all px to rem (16px browser default), which may affect extensions relying on hardcoded px values. New features add a utility endpoint and UI to generate translations collections and fields, a deployment provider link on the run detail page, a tool search tool for Anthropic AI provider, support for setting the secure attribute on OpenID/OAuth2 cookies, an optional storage parameter for FilesService.uploadOne, AI SDK Devtools middleware support, AI telemetry provider config for Braintrust and Langfuse, and support for Redis namespace control.

chunks.title: v11.17.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.17.1, new features add keyboard navigation to the cards layout, a native Tabs group interface, bulk folder deletion from the files grid, shorter tooltip delay for disabled elements, and a parseNow utility to resolve the $NOW dynamic variable. Bug fixes address calendar picker crash when using dynamic variables, update relationship_not_setup wording, restore useItem support for custom query options, fix file replacement returning Forbidden, update dependencies to address CVEs, fix extension auto reload not triggering, fix MySQL foreignKeys query to prevent cartesian product, and fix filter operator typing for date and time fields.

chunks.title: v11.17.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.17.2, new features move useShortcut and translateShortcut to @directus/composables, add timezone support to datetime display, and add a comparison modal checkbox to view only modified fields. Bug fixes address alias fields being included when selecting all fields in export, fix invite acceptance error display and translation, fix relational field removals inside groups not persisting on draft items, fix search input not closing on keyboard navigation, update dependencies, fix coercion of stringified JSON in AI assistant tool arguments, and add cleanup handlers for disconnected file streams.

chunks.title: v11.17.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.17.3, new features replace the "All Users" tab with Active, Suspended, and Invited status tabs, add a "Save as New File" option to the image editor, add a new /ai/object endpoint to generate structured objects, and eliminate redundant count requests in the useItems composable. Bug fixes address export failing on collections with virtual fields, add customizing of cache keys for flow endpoints, fix named routes usage, fix VBadge intercepting pointer events, fix comparison modal footer responsive breakpoint, update dependencies, fix schema introspection for MSSQL text fields, trim leading and trailing spaces from search queries, fix promotion of deleted relation returning invalid date time value error, fix API building with a node_modules folder, fix MARKETPLACE_REGISTRY env not being passed, and replace INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR with SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE for marketplace registry errors.

chunks.title: v11.17.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v11.17.4, new features update the token field on the user detail page to require confirmation before regenerating or removing a token and save changes immediately, add opt-in must-revalidate and ETag headers for assets via ASSETS_CACHE_REVALIDATE, and add a force option to schema apply to bypass hash check. Bug fixes address UI freeze when navigating items with WYSIWYG translations for non-admin users, selection not being cleared after running a manual flow, "Save as copy" in the file library throwing a 403 error, user token not being displayed after generation when collaboration is enabled, filter popup being closed when reordering filters, icon flash in navigation sidebar for bookmarks without an icon, migrating @directus/visual-editing into the monorepo, removing duplicate @directus/schema-builder dependency, bumping dependencies, fixing flows not awaiting reload, fixing VERSION_SAVE activity/revisions not respecting collection tracking settings, denying collections with / in name, fixing SDK types linking to directus_access junction collection, and fixing useShortcut attempting to access document before available.

chunks.title: Directus v12.0.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the directus/directus release v12.0.0-rc.1, potential breaking changes include introducing VERSION_KEY_* constants and renaming main to published (with backward compatibility for ?version=main), replacing the status field with an archived boolean in collection settings, deprecating the VResizeable component, updating the type system, borders, and theme variables (removing headerShadow, sidebarShadow, boxShadow, and navigation.project theme properties), updating module navigation bar spacing and styling, locking published items in versioned collections from editing and adding a header action button to edit in the draft version, removing rounded buttons and adopting a shared header action button, changing the license to MSCL-1.0-GPL, and updating header and navigation bar base design with merged theme properties into a new shell scope.

questions.query_text: In the directus/directus releases, which release introduces a Content Comparison Modal for side-by-side review of version and revision changes?

answer_support.answer_text: Introduced the Content Comparison Modal for side-by-side review of version and revision changes.

questions.query_text: Across the directus/directus releases, how does the AI-related change in v11.14.0 differ from the AI-related change in v11.15.0?

options.text: v11.14.0 adds an AI chat sidebar, while v11.15.0 adds multi-provider AI support with Google and OpenAI-compatible providers and a new @directus/ai package.
v11.14.0 adds multi-provider AI support, while v11.15.0 adds an AI chat sidebar.
Both releases only update AI SDK dependencies without new features.
v11.14.0 removes AI features, while v11.15.0 reintroduces them.

questions.expected_answer: v11.14.0 adds an AI chat sidebar, while v11.15.0 adds multi-provider AI support with Google and OpenAI-compatible providers and a new @directus/ai package.

answer_support.answer_text: Added AI chat sidebar
Added multi-provider AI support with Google and OpenAI-compatible providers. Extracted shared AI types into new @directus/ai package.

questions.query_text: In the directus/directus release window, order the following release-content states from earliest to latest: (1) a release that adds support for LDAP login and updates refresh/logout command parameters, (2) a release that introduces a global draft version automatically available for all items when versioning is enabled, (3) a release that adds a deployment module for triggering deployments with Vercel as the first supported provider, (4) a release that adds an AI chat sidebar.

answer_support.answer_text: Added support for LDAP login and enhanced parameter consistency for refresh/logout commands.
Added AI chat sidebar
Added deployment module for triggering deployments from Directus with Vercel as first supported provider
Added support for a global draft version that is automatically available for all items when versioning is enabled

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent dokku/dokku release stream from v0.36.9 through v0.38.16, covering bug fixes, new features, refactors, and dependency updates across multiple minor and patch versions.

chunks.title: v0.36.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.36.9, the project adds the ability to disable letsencrypt for a given application or globally. Bug fixes include setting correct labels for tests/apps/dockerfile-release pip updates. Dependency updates bump several packages including github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager, mkdocs-material, django, whitenoise, djangorestframework, psycopg2-binary, dj-database-url, golang, actions/setup-node, github.com/gofrs/flock, and github.com/kedacore/keda/v2.

chunks.title: v0.36.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.36.10, bug fixes include using -t instead of deprecated --time in stop commands, ensuring the pre-receive hook and URLS files are correct when cloning or renaming apps, expanding variables for release tasks, and using updated http2 directive for setting http2 support. Documentation fixes a typo in Caddy SSL configuration. Dependency updates bump actions/upload-artifact, actions/download-artifact, and node in several test apps.

chunks.title: v0.37.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.37.0, backwards compatibility breaks include renaming scheduler-k3s:cluster-* commands to use a colon instead of a dash delimiter and removing references to pack being experimental. Bug fixes address resetting manually set port mappings on upgrade, executing run commands when exec is part of an entrypoint, skipping install trigger when installing a plugin, dropping deprecated aufs check, and adding process-type label for run with procfile cmd. New features add aliases for select builder and scheduler plugins, buildpack trace mode when dokku trace is on, ability to create k3s node profiles, support for git remotes with port specified inline, cron and one-off run task TTLs, inline comments for app.json, specifying kubelet-args when adding a new node, config:import command, buildpacks:detect subcommand, ability to pause/restart cron jobs, support to prevent overlapping execution of cron tasks, support for specifying CNB buildpacks via buildpacks command, a Railpack builder, and commands to proxy implementations for managing labels. Refactors filter build docker-options correctly for each builder. Documentation corrects the release version for railpacks support. Dependency updates bump several packages including golang.org/x/crypto, google.golang.org/grpc, js-yaml, click, traefik, timberio/vector, pymdown-extensions, mkdocs-material, and sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/api.

chunks.title: v0.36.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.36.11, bug fixes include using the correct case for AS in Dockerfile, using correct variable for tasks, and erroring out if the appname or app.json is missing when retrieving cron entries. Refactors standardize naming in cron code. Dependency updates bump timberio/vector, github.com/containerd/containerd, golang, markdown, django, mkdocs-material, traefik, github.com/kedacore/keda/v2, and github.com/traefik/traefik/v2.

chunks.title: v0.37.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.37.1, bug fixes include updating url to download golang, sanitizing vector sink values in report output, not starting nginx if there are no apps with nginx as a proxy, and ensuring keda usage does not cause jank in scaling deployments. New features enable live-restore by default when installing Dokku and allow exposing non-web processes as kubernetes services. Refactors remove nginx checks for functionality that always exists. Documentation fixes version in migration docs, updates logging in doc generation, fixes reference to letsencrypt-server property, clarifies system requirements for k3s usage, and clarifies plugin installation documentation. Dependency updates bump several packages including golang, python, django, express, beautifulsoup4, werkzeug, body-parser, github.com/go-resty/resty/v2, pymdown-extensions, github.com/traefik/traefik/v2, github.com/fluxcd/pkg/kustomize, helm.sh/helm/v3, and k8s.io/kubernetes.

chunks.title: v0.37.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.37.2, a bug fix ensures the system continues with logic if the error returned from fetching all apps is NoAppsExist. Dependency updates bump byjg/easy-haproxy and github.com/traefik/traefik/v2.

chunks.title: v0.37.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.37.3, bug fixes include passing global build args as array when building nixpacks apps and ensuring the /etc/docker exists when interacting with it via postinst. Documentation fixes command syntax for removing docker options and adds community plugins. Tests add tests to prove that Procfile tasks all work for every builder. Dependency updates bump numerous packages including k8s.io/kubectl, github.com/go-resty/resty/v2, k8s.io/kubernetes, github.com/onsi/gomega, github.com/traefik/traefik/v2, github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager, pyparsing, google.golang.org/grpc, github.com/kedacore/keda/v2, helm.sh/helm/v3, importlib-metadata, k8s.io/client-go, github.com/expr-lang/expr, golang.org/x/crypto, golang.org/x/sync, google.golang.org/protobuf, actions/download-artifact, actions/upload-artifact, soupsieve, ruby, mkdocs-material, traefik, timberio/vector, python, pymdown-extensions, github.com/onsi/gomega, github.com/kedacore/keda/v2, and github.com/go-...

chunks.title: v0.37.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.37.4, a bug fix installs logrotate in the container. Tests add a test to prove cron:run commands work as expected and update test ruby app. Dependency updates bump pymdown-extensions, qs, traefik, github.com/traefik/traefik/v2, and ruby. Other changes add proxy-keepalive to Nginx properties.

chunks.title: v0.37.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.37.5, bug fixes include deleting the tls app chart when the app is deleted, ensuring the destination directory exists when extracting files from a repository, and setting correct version for builder-railpack plugin. New features add the ability to log into a registry on a per-app basis, support for dns-01 challenge mode when using traefik, use certificates imported by certs plugin when deploying via scheduler-k3s, a method to force build when re-using an image with git:from-image, and the ability to skip setting the deploy-branch when running git:sync. Refactors rewrite the storage plugin in golang. Dependency updates bump github.com/onsi/gomega, werkzeug, django, luizm/action-sh-checker, and dj-database-url.

chunks.title: v0.37.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.37.6, a bug fix ensures storage:report can be called properly. Documentation adds an architecture document and a readme for the docs folder. Dependency updates bump timberio/vector, gunicorn, pymdown-extensions, helm.sh/helm/v3, ruby, golang, soupsieve, github.com/traefik/traefik/v2, pyparsing, lodash, packaging, and traefik.

chunks.title: v0.37.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.37.7, a bug fix calls correct function for limiting letsencrypt to certain domains. New features add Debian 13 versions of docker plugin packages, configure Traefik readiness healthchecks based on app.json config, and support custom entrypoint for api and dashboard. Dependency updates bump mvdan.cc/sh/v3, github.com/traefik/traefik/v2, github.com/melbahja/goph, golang.org/x/crypto, golang.org/x/sync, traefik, github.com/onsi/gomega, lucaslorentz/caddy-docker-proxy, k8s.io/kubectl, docker/login-action, docker/setup-qemu-action, mkdocs-material, django, docker/setup-buildx-action, google.golang.org/grpc, golang, python, gunicorn, qs, flask, rack, org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-dependency-plugin, and others.

chunks.title: v0.37.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.37.8, a bug fix corrects client prepending --app for non-app commands. New features add application/graphql-response+json to nginx gzip_types. Dependency updates bump packaging, k8s.io/kubernetes, k8s.io/apimachinery, github.com/fluxcd/pkg/kustomize, github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager, zipp, mvdan.cc/sh/v3, github.com/joho/godotenv, golang.org/x/crypto, click, helm.sh/helm/v3, traefik, golang, rack-session, django, rack, github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4, werkzeug, pymdown-extensions, pygments, google.golang.org/grpc, github.com/fatih/color, gunicorn, brace-expansion, path-to-regexp, and others.

chunks.title: v0.37.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.37.9, dependency updates bump k8s.io/api, github.com/go-openapi/jsonpointer, github.com/go-acme/lego/v4, and github.com/moby/spdystream.

chunks.title: v0.38.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.38.0, bug fixes include splitting env config and image pull secret into separate helm releases, splitting multi-flag input in docker-options, skipping retiring images still in use by app containers, adding launcher entrypoint for CNB images on dokku run and cron:run, only emitting keda fallback when a non-cpu/memory trigger exists, fixing vector mount directory config, preserving all domains when renaming an app, and retiring orphaned containers when scaling down. New features add scheduler-aware named storage entries, accept --global on :report subcommands, pre-validate custom nginx.conf.sigil during core-post-extract, support resource limits on the build container, send SIGTERM to old containers immediately on deploy, scope docker-options to specific procfile processes, ship default catch-all site on fresh apt install, add --format json to git:report and nginx:report, add git:auth-status to check netrc match, generate 502 config for apps without web listeners, upgrade vector chart, ingress-nginx chart, and keda, add post-create support for env key in app.json, add support for specifying buildpacks via app.json, enable live-restore by default when installing Dokku, and migrate builds plugin to go and track per-build records. Refactors migrate docker-options subcommands to go, move app and global ENV files to consolidated config path, and migrate environment variables to plugin properties. Dependency updates bump traefik, github.com/traefik/traefik/v2, github.com/onsi/gomega, dokku/netrc, packaging, k8s.io/apimachinery, dokku/openresty-docker-proxy, k8s.io/kubernetes, and bump go version to 1.26.2.

chunks.title: v0.38.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.38.1, bug fixes include sourcing property-functions where fn-plugin-property-* helpers are used, installing cnb pack from github releases instead of ppa, chowning migrated legacy storage entries to dokku, and deflaking haproxy bats tests. Refactors consolidate nginx.conf.sigil server blocks. Documentation uses explicit type property in proxy:set examples, documents plugin properties migrated from env vars, and fixes reference to when the build plugin was introduced. Tests bump google.golang.org/grpc, gunicorn, and django. Dependency updates bump traefik, github.com/traefik/traefik/v2, pack, github.com/mattn/go-isatty, github.com/Masterminds/semver/v3, docker-container-healthchecker, dokku-event-listener, lambda-builder, procfile-util, and peter-evans/create-pull-request.

chunks.title: v0.38.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.38.2, security fixes restrict app names to prevent command injection, harden archive extraction against symlink traversal, enforce 0600 permissions on .netrc credentials file, and sanitize openresty include filenames to prevent eval injection. Bug fixes gate ssl_reject_handshake behind nginx 1.19.4 and reference SOURCECODE_WORK_DIR in builder core-post-extract. Documentation adds security section to release changelog, corrects buildkit builder code block syntax, and sets issue type in bug report template. Dependency updates use type prefix for dokku-bot dependency label. Tests count assert_output_contains matches as fixed strings and bump golang and node in several test apps.

chunks.title: v0.38.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.38.3, bug fixes reject per-app sets for global-only proxy properties, rename app-json:report flags to match property, and ensure report info-flag does not error when app undeployed. New features add docker healthcheck to dokku container.

chunks.title: v0.38.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.38.4, bug fixes reject per-app sets for openresty global-only properties, expose raw deploy-branch and keep-git-dir in git:report, and route CNB images through launcher on scheduler-k3s. New features split scheduler-docker-local report into raw, computed, and global. Documentation adds dokku-http-oauth to community plugins. Tests isolate scheduler-k3s registry tags per bats file, migrate from junit_files to files in EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action, upgrade actions in shared build-image compose action, skip packer lint job on dependabot PRs, and bump python. Dependency updates bump golang.org/x/crypto, github.com/traefik/traefik/v2, dokku/openresty-docker-proxy, and python.

chunks.title: v0.38.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.38.5, a bug fix preserves explicit https:443 port mappings on cert update. New features attach vector container to additional docker networks, expose certs-set and certs-remove plugin triggers, and split caddy report tls-internal into raw, computed, and global. Tests bump heroku/heroku-buildpack-php and ruby. Dependency updates bump k8s.io/kubernetes.

chunks.title: v0.38.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.38.6, bug fixes correctly redirect http traffic to https when using scheduler-k3s, clarify byte-preserving behavior of config:set --encoded, depend on cron | cron-daemon to allow alternatives, and support --global on cron:set. Refactors split report global keys into raw and computed, hash scheduler-k3s cron-id label to fit Kubernetes' 63-byte cap, and convert filesystem migration markers to plugin properties. Documentation removes outdated warning about dokku-update not being able to upgrade to specific versions. Tests rename logs:report vector key test and guard old keys, and bump qs, sass, heroku/heroku-buildpack-php, slim/slim, ruby, and google.golang.org/grpc. Dependency updates bump github.com/onsi/gomega, herokuish, pack, golang.org/x/crypto, click, github.com/containerd/containerd, zipp, traefik, and pymdown-extensions.

chunks.title: v0.38.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.38.7, a security fix prevents host shell injection from app.json cron commands. Bug fixes recover deployed image from registry on local miss, align ps/cron :report --global keys with plugin convention, split openresty report keys into global and computed pairs, and use SYSTEM for shfmt Darwin detection. Refactors split more report global keys into raw and computed. New features warn on deprecated listen http2 in custom nginx templates. Tests bump heroku/heroku-buildpack-php and qualify scheduler-k3s ingressroute kubectl lookups. Dependency updates bump k8s.io/apimachinery and soupsieve.

chunks.title: v0.38.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.38.8, bug fixes unset bind-all-interfaces on empty value and expose remaining settable properties via :report. New features enable compression middleware for traefik when using scheduler-k3s, align Go-plugin :report JSON keys with bash-strip convention, and promote registry image-repo-template to app + global. Dependency updates bump helm.sh/helm/v3.

chunks.title: v0.38.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the dokku/dokku release v0.38.9, new features split openresty report into raw/computed/global. Refactors treat empty ps restart-policy as an unset.

chunks.title: v0.38.10

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent duckdb/duckdb release stream from v0.7.1 through v1.5.3, covering major feature releases, bugfix releases, and the transition from preview to stable 1.0.0.

chunks.title: 0.7.1 Bugfix Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the duckdb/duckdb release 0.7.1 Bugfix Release (tag v0.7.1), the release provides bug fixes for issues discovered after 0.7.0, with no new features. It maintains compatibility with database files created with v0.7.0.

chunks.title: 0.8.0 Preview Release "Fulvigula"
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the duckdb/duckdb release 0.8.0 Preview Release "Fulvigula" (tag v0.8.0), the release introduces two SQL-level breaking changes: the default sort order switches from NULLS FIRST to NULLS LAST, and the division operator '/' now always yields a floating point result with integer parameters, while '//' retains the old semantics. It also introduces a backwards-incompatible on-disk storage format change.

chunks.title: 0.8.1 Bugfix Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the duckdb/duckdb release 0.8.1 Bugfix Release (tag v0.8.1), the release provides bug fixes for issues discovered after 0.8.0, with no new features. Database files created by v0.8.0 can be read by v0.8.1, but v0.8.0 cannot read v0.8.1 files.

chunks.title: 0.9.0 Preview Release "Undulata"
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the duckdb/duckdb release 0.9.0 Preview Release "Undulata" (tag v0.9.0), the release introduces a backwards-incompatible on-disk storage format change and includes new features such as list_intersect, list_has_any, list_has_all, and support for nested laterals.

chunks.title: 0.9.1 Bugfix Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the duckdb/duckdb release 0.9.1 Bugfix Release (tag v0.9.1), the release provides bug fixes for issues discovered after 0.9.0, with no new features. Database files created by v0.9.0 can be read by v0.9.1 and vice versa.

chunks.title: 0.9.2 Bugfix Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the duckdb/duckdb release 0.9.2 Bugfix Release (tag v0.9.2), the release provides bug fixes for issues discovered after 0.9.1, with no new features. Database files created by v0.9.0 or v0.9.1 can be read by v0.9.2 and vice versa.

chunks.title: DuckDB 0.10.0 "Fusca"
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the duckdb/duckdb release DuckDB 0.10.0 "Fusca" (tag v0.10.0), the release drops the 'Preview' designation and introduces features such as fixed-size list type (ARRAY), parquet key-value metadata support, and the ability to provide a list of files to read_csv. The on-disk storage format is backwards-compatible with the 0.9 releases.

chunks.title: v0.10.1 Bugfix Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the duckdb/duckdb release v0.10.1 Bugfix Release (tag v0.10.1), the release provides bug fixes for issues discovered after 0.10.0, with no new features. Database files created by v0.10.0 or v0.9.* can be read by v0.10.1.

chunks.title: v0.10.2 Bugfix Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the duckdb/duckdb release v0.10.2 Bugfix Release (tag v0.10.2), the release provides bug fixes for issues discovered after 0.10.1, with no new features. It includes SQL modifications for nested boolean comparisons and struct comparisons. Database files created by v0.10.* or v0.9.* can be read by v0.10.2.

chunks.title: v0.10.3 Bugfix Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the duckdb/duckdb release v0.10.3 Bugfix Release (tag v0.10.3), the release provides bug fixes and highlights including UPDATE EXTENSIONS syntax, improved checkpointing, native HuggingFace data loading via hf:// prefix, and NULL casting behavior changes for MAP type. Database files created by v0.10.* or v0.9.* can be read by v0.10.3.

chunks.title: DuckDB 1.0.0 "Nivis"
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the duckdb/duckdb release DuckDB 1.0.0 "Nivis" (tag v1.0.0), the release marks the first stable version, named for stability. It includes various bug fixes and improvements, such as adding enable_view_dependencies and fixing replacement scan issues.

chunks.title: electron v42.0.0-beta.7

chunks.title: electron v40.9.3
