prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent ethereum/go-ethereum release stream from v1.14.10 through v1.17.3, covering hotfixes, feature releases, and major upgrades including the Prague and Fusaka forks, archive node improvements, and security patches.

chunks.title: Kopis (v1.14.10)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.14.10 (Kopis), the project ships a hotfix for a blob pool regression introduced in v1.14.9, adds stateless witness production and verification into the engine API, and treats a 0 global gas cap as unlimited in simulated calls.

chunks.title: Makhaira (v1.14.11)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.14.11 (Makhaira), the primary goal is publishing new stable and latest Docker images after a CI pipeline issue; the release also removes the totalDifficulty field from RPC, fixes a flaw in the simulated backend, introduces a new method for building multi-platform Docker images, and adds the ability to disable FINDNODE liveness checks in tests.

chunks.title: Gei Hinnom (v1.14.12)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.14.12 (Gei Hinnom), the release removes the personal RPC namespace and the --unlock command-line parameter, adds RISC-V Docker images and PPA builds for Ubuntu 24.10, includes tracing improvements such as OnCodeChange hook on selfdestruct and new options for prestateTracer, improves EIP-712 array type support, fixes multiple bugs, optimizes the database by running Pebble in non-sync mode and using increasing level sizes, and works on Verkle, EIP-7002, EIP-7251, EIP-7685, EIP-6110, EOF container validation, and EVM speed optimizations.

chunks.title: Schwarzschild (v1.14.13)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.14.13 (Schwarzschild), this is a security release fixing vulnerability CVE-2025-24883, and users are advised to update their nodes as soon as possible.

chunks.title: Operative Package (v1.15.0)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.15.0 (Operative Package), the release contains breaking database changes requiring re-syncing for downgrades, implements the Prague fork specifications up to devnet-6 including EIP-2537, EIP-7623, EIP-7685, EIP-7702, and EIP-7840, updates the evm command, allows enabling metrics and NAT traversal via TOML config, renames --trace to --go-execution-trace, removes the bootnode utility, and updates the live tracing Go API with new hooks and optional EVM revert tracking.

chunks.title: Engineering Kit (v1.15.1)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.15.1 (Engineering Kit), the release enables the Prague fork for Holesky and Sepolia testnets, enables EIP-7702 transactions in the transaction pool, fixes a v1.15.0 regression in genesis handling for custom networks related to blobSchedule, fixes a regression in the evm command related to state dumps, fixes a regression with the ancient store in read-only mode, fixes a crash in debug_getRaw* RPC methods, and upgrades the supranational/blst dependency to v0.3.14 for Go 1.24 compatibility.

chunks.title: Survivor Loadout (v1.15.2)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.15.2 (Survivor Loadout), the release restores block building on mainnet which was broken in v1.15.1, restores discv5 and DNS peer discovery accidentally disabled since v1.14.9, and fixes an edge-case for geth dumpconfig related to the P2P.NAT setting in TOML.

chunks.title: Expert Package (v1.15.3)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.15.3 (Expert Package), the release corrects the predefined fork configuration of Holesky and Sepolia testnets by adding the missing deposit contract address, improves eth_simulateV1 to match regular block processing semantics, fixes a peer-finding issue with discovery v5, makes an invalid --discovery.dns flag value cause an error at startup, enables Geth --dev mode to handle custom genesis configs with older forks, removes the EVM assembler/disassembler, fixes encoding of nested byte arrays in EIP-712 signature processing, updates the cloudflare-go dependency, and is built with Go 1.24.0.

chunks.title: Commando Package (v1.15.4)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.15.4 (Commando Package), the release fixes a v1.15.0 regression in eth_feeHistory causing incorrect blobGasRatio return values, fixes a regression in RPC transaction submission where transactions failing txpool verification were still added to the local pool, reworks txpool logic to avoid error log flood about EIP-7702 authorities, prevents certain invalid blob transactions from causing disconnect issues in the p2p layer, adds a BlobBaseFee method to ethclient, and fixes the PPA package build broken by the Go 1.24 upgrade.

chunks.title: Stronghold Package (v1.15.5)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.15.5 (Stronghold Package), the release is a hotfix for an issue on the Sepolia testnet where a custom deposit contract implementing ERC-20 caused unexpected log events after the Pectra fork activation, omits empty memory and storage fields in debug_traceTransaction output, and is built with Go 1.24.1.

chunks.title: Mental Focuser (v1.15.6)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.15.6 (Mental Focuser), the release introduces a new filtermaps index for log filtering with huge performance improvements, releases abigen v2 focusing on ABI encoding/decoding with smaller generated bindings, fixes a regression in eth_sendRawTransaction where too-low nonce transactions were accepted, makes eth_call/estimateGas always return error code 3 for reverts, fixes eth_simulateV1 logs bloom and adds block overrides, fixes debug_traceCall movePrecompileTo override, hex-encodes EVM return values in debug_traceCall (breaking change), adds EstimateGasAtBlock to ethclient, adds support for the Hoodi testnet, updates the beacon chain light client for Electra, improves transaction signature validation performance, and includes preliminary changes for History Expiry (EIP-4444).

chunks.title: Juggernaut Shield (v1.15.7)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.15.7 (Juggernaut Shield), the release fixes a critical issue where the log indexer would accidentally delete trie nodes for --state.scheme=hash, fixes an issue with tx submission where the local pool didn't track pending nonces correctly, makes the log indexer disable itself when hitting missing receipts, fixes a txpool reorg issue in ethclient/simulated.Backend, reduces memory allocation for trie operations, adds state overrides support to eth_createAccessList, excludes 7702 authorities from eth_createAccessList results, and makes abigen correctly forward access lists to eth_estimateGas.

chunks.title: Combatives Upgrade (v1.15.8)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.15.8 (Combatives Upgrade), the release makes geth import apply database and cache flags correctly, exports metrics from the new log indexer, adds checkpoint file export to the beacon chain light client, makes database writes fully synchronous again, takes pending blob transactions into account for EIP-7702 authorization limits, resolves a logic race in EIP-7702 transaction validation, reduces disk reads in blob transaction pool announcements, adds a fast-path for PUSH2 in the EVM, adds 32-bit chain ID support to Trezor, allows stopping history syncing at the PoS merge point, returns error code 4444 for pruned history in RPC, improves UPnP support, changes discv5 talk request API (breaking), fixes discv5 challenge resend logic, properly handles large skip values in GetBlockHeaders, and is built with Go 1.24.2.

chunks.title: Multicapacitor (v1.15.9)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.15.9 (Multicapacitor), the release enables the Prague execution-layer fork on mainnet scheduled at timestamp 1746612311, lists the included EIPs (2537, 2935, 6110, 7002, 7251, 7549, 7623, 7685, 7691, 7702, 7840), makes transaction-sending RPCs add txs to locals tracker only when includable, considers blocks with failing EVM system calls invalid, resolves a corner-case crash in eth_feeHistory, fixes several correctness bugs in the new log indexer, improves history pruning, prints periodic logs for non-activated forks, occasionally drops random peers after full sync, optimizes CPU usage of tx propagation, and improves peer disconnect metrics.

chunks.title: Omni-Capacitors (v1.15.10)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.15.10 (Omni-Capacitors), the release corrects a deadlock condition in the log indexer affecting archive mode with LevelDB, configures the beacon chain light client for the Electra fork on mainnet, increases the default block gas limit to 36M, allows passing an EIP-7702 authorizationList to calls in ethclient, and adds a debug_setMemoryLimit RPC endpoint for tweaking Go garbage collector behavior.

chunks.title: Armored Compartments (v1.15.11)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.15.11 (Armored Compartments), the release resolves a stall condition in eth_getTransactionByHash, fixes two bugs in the new log indexer requiring index rebuild, improves log indexing performance, makes eth_simulateV1 correctly return the transaction sender, resolves a corner-case in eth_estimateGas related to floorDataGas, enables ethclient's BlockByNumber to retrieve the pending block, makes geth init exit in error when re-initializing with incompatible config, makes transaction pool reorgs slightly faster, and resolves a transaction pool data race in geth --dev mode.

chunks.title: Terran Rivets (v1.16.0)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.16.0 (Terran Rivets), the release introduces an experimental path-based archive node implementation with configurable historical state storage on a dedicated disk, a state database size of ~1.9TB for full mainnet history, and automatic pruning of older states; it also includes the usual bug fixes and small improvements.

chunks.title: Repair Actuals (v1.16.1)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.16.1 (Repair Actuals), the release fixes regressions from v1.16.0: abigen v2 now creates TryPack methods returning errors for invalid parameters, fixes geth --vmtrace not working, hex-encodes blockTimestamp in eth_getLogs, limits queried addresses in eth_getLogs to 1000, speeds up eth_getTransactionReceipt, resolves a buggy interaction of the new archive node and snap sync, fixes a rare crash in geth --dev mode related to debug_setHead, and provides statically-linked binaries in release archives.

chunks.title: Sprouted Seed Vial (v1.16.2)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.16.2 (Sprouted Seed Vial), the release implements Fusaka EIPs including EIP-7825, EIP-7934, EIP-7939, EIP-7918, EIP-7951, EIP-7892, and EIP-7883; adds block-level accessList structure; limits max blobs in blob transactions; reduces memory allocation in trie hash function; improves freezer background sync; introduces file-based state journal; fixes dropping oversized transaction announcements; fixes condition disabling direct ancient sync mode; adds interface for jump destination analysis cache; fixes incorrect address length in historical state reader; fixes deadlock in state history indexer; exposes SigHash of SetCodeAuthorization; rejects eth_getLogs requests with both block hash and range; fixes block overrides in debug_traceCall; introduces debug_sync for trusted full chain sync; adds automatic package aliasing in rlp code generator; adds metrics for snap sync duration; updates checkpoints for blsync and filtermaps; and adds test suite for ENRRequest.

chunks.title: Impact Restrictors (v1.16.3)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.16.3 (Impact Restrictors), the release prepares for the Fusaka release with a state history rewrite, fixes for Osaka devnets, performance improvements, and bug fixes; includes Fusaka fixes for blob parameters and legacy sidecar conversion; core changes like stabilized tx relay peer selection, reduced allocations, reworked tracer, avoided loading same blob tx multiple times, fixed modexp input check, handled pending blocks in GetBlockReceipts, tree node prefetching, and parallelized db inspect; RPC changes like applying precompile overrides in DoEstimateGas, fixing uncle reward accounting, checking ErrGasLimitTooHigh, implementing EIP-7910 eth_config, adding SetWebsocketReadLimit, adding GraphQL query depth limit, adding codeHash to prestateTracer, and removing deprecated debug_seedHash; and other changes like introducing TransitionState object, fixing ledger version check, not returning error for nil peer in GetHeader, adding Go 1.25 support, adding trie depth-tracking metrics, implementing EIP-7864 binary trees, and improving ETA calculation.

chunks.title: Bioelectric Infusers (v1.16.4)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.16.4 (Bioelectric Infusers), the release enables the Osaka (Fusaka) fork on testnets Holesky, Sepolia, and Hoodi with specific timestamps, enables two blob-parameter-only forks increasing blob capacity, sets default block gas limit to 60M gas, fixes geth snapshot commands not finding trie journal, resolves regression in geth snapshot dump and export-preimages, adds experimental zkVM guest program keeper, fixes eth_call to not apply EIP-7825 gas limit under Osaka rules, makes log query address limit configurable via --rpc.logquerylimit, adds --state.size-tracking option and debug_stateSize endpoint, adds debug_executionWitness and debug_executionWitnessByHash methods, adds CodeChangeV2 hook, fixes OnBalanceChange invocation, exposes Address method on BoundContract, optimizes MODEXP precompile, migrates blobpool to v1 blob proof format, updates engine_getBlobs for spec compliance, fixes path-based state database corruption, supports BPO-style forks in engine API and eth_config, works on historical state proofs, correctly reports Pebble stall counters, updates node discovery iterator, resolves hang in eth protocol test suite, updates KZG proof libraries to fix vulnerability, and is built with Go 1.25.5.

chunks.title: Coolant Cells (v1.16.5)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.16.5 (Coolant Cells), the release adds a conversion path for blob proofs submitted via eth_sendRawTransaction after the Fusaka fork, adds transactionReceipts subscription to eth_subscribe, fixes eth_simulateV1 to return block timestamp in logs, makes BoundContract.Transfer verify payable fallback, adds keccak256preimage tracer, drops peers sending duplicated transactions, fixes regression causing high CPU usage in discovery, resolves rare shutdown hang related to peer discovery, adds post-merge test chain to eth protocol test suite, implements partial reads in freezer, implements trie history storage layer, corrects txpool/valid.meter metric, and fixes engine API fork compatibility checks.

chunks.title: Leather Wrapping (v1.16.6)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.16.6 (Leather Wrapping), the release enables the Fusaka hardfork on Ethereum mainnet scheduled at 2025-12-03 21:49:11 UTC, enables BPO1 and BPO2 forks for mainnet, sets mainnet timestamps for Osaka, enables Fusaka for geth --dev mode, adds eth_sendRawTransactionSync RPC method, adds eth_simulateV1 support in ethclient, fixes crash in debug_traceCall, fixes issue where local transactions were not persisted to journal, adds geth --genesis flag, fixes receipt insertion during ERA file import, works on trie node history for historical eth_getProof, continues work on cmd/keeper, includes various optimizations, adds metrics for tracking slow peers, and fixes issue where disconnected peers were not removed in txFetcher.

chunks.title: Ballistic Drift Stabilizer (v1.16.7)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.16.7 (Ballistic Drift Stabilizer), this is a re-roll of v1.16.6 including an important fix in the KZG cryptography library; it enables the Fusaka hardfork on Ethereum mainnet at 2025-12-03 21:49:11 UTC, enables BPO1 and BPO2 blob-parameter-only upgrades, sets mainnet timestamps for Osaka, enables Fusaka for geth --dev mode, adds eth_sendRawTransactionSync, adds eth_simulateV1 support in ethclient, fixes crash in debug_traceCall, fixes local transaction persistence, fixes cryptographic vulnerability in c-kzg-4844, adds geth --genesis flag, fixes receipt insertion during ERA file import, works on trie node history for historical eth_getProof, continues work on cmd/keeper, includes various optimizations, adds metrics for tracking slow peers, and fixes disconnected peer removal in txFetcher.

chunks.title: Moisture Filters (v1.16.8)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.16.8 (Moisture Filters), this is a security fix release resolving two p2p vulnerabilities reported through the Ethereum Foundation bug bounty program, and is recommended for all users.

chunks.title: Shield Focusing Module (v1.16.9)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.16.9 (Shield Focusing Module), this is a security hot-fix release fixing CVE-2026-26314 and CVE-2026-26315, and recommends recreating the p2p node key after installation.

chunks.title: Eezo-Inlaid Circuitry (v1.17.0)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.17.0 (Eezo-Inlaid Circuitry), this feature release includes multiple critical security fixes (CVE-2026-26313, CVE-2026-26314, CVE-2026-26315), introduces path-based archive node with proofs configurable via --history.trienode, adds EraE history support, adds OpenTelemetry tracing for RPC and engine API, removes geth version-check subcommand, adds --miner.maxblobs flag, supports continuous profiling with Grafana Pyroscope, fixes rare block production halt in --dev mode, adds --rpc.rangelimit flag, makes --exitwhensynced set finalized and safe block, reports newPayload processing time to ethstats, fixes many CLI flag issues, implements EIP-8024, implements engine_getBlobsV3, rejects engine API calls with wrong payload version, updates blsync for Fusaka, works on binary tree state migration, fixes access list semantics, and includes many other changes.

chunks.title: Eezo Shunt (v1.17.1)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.17.1 (Eezo Shunt), this bug fix release resolves a regression in snap sync and several security issues; disables plain-text HTTP2 in engine API, adds --metrics.influxdb.interval flag, adds inspect-trie subcommand, includes Amsterdam fork-related changes like EIP-7834 and EIP-8024, fixes payload building, drops p2p protocol version eth/68, fixes rare crash in p2p request tracking, reduces unnecessary txpool traffic, fixes snap-sync regression with --history.chain=postmerge, fixes snap-sync peer connection issue, reports unexpected state during snap-sync, fixes p2p listener metrics, makes eth_estimateGas honor user-supplied access list, adds eth_getStorageValues and testing_buildBlockV1 RPC methods, and is built with Go 1.25.7.

chunks.title: EMF Suppressor (v1.17.2)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.17.2 (EMF Suppressor), this maintenance release fixes a critical issue in debug_executionWitness that could corrupt node data, adds support for syncing with chains where pre-Prague history has been pruned, allows explicit pruning via geth prune-history --history.chain postprague, sets default cache size to 4GB, adds fetchpayload command, optimizes Era history import, adds womir target for keeper, adds support for iterating a single storage trie, includes Amsterdam fork updates (EIP-8024, EIP-7778, EIP-7954, EIP-7708), reworks gas measurement order, improves payload building, makes various binary trie improvements, upgrades go-eth-kzg to v1.5.0, refactors state database, enables trie node history retention, optimizes historical state indexer, fixes potential deadlock in txlookup, adds new RLP APIs, fixes dir.Sync() failure on Windows, avoids duplicate connections, fixes session key mismatch, adds DNS hostname resolution for bootstrap nodes, fixes state corruption in debug_executionWitness, adds MaxUsedGas to eth_simulateV1, fixes gas cap handling, fixes nonce revert edge case, fixes eth_createAccessList to return empty list, makes eth_getFilterLogs return error for pruned segments, fixes slot number encoding, enforces RPC call limits, enforces storage slot limits for proofs, adds various OpenTelemetry fixes, and fixes build issues on FreeBSD.

chunks.title: Enzymatic Injector (v1.17.3)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum release v1.17.3 (Enzymatic Injector), this maintenance release continues Amsterdam fork implementation, introduces ETH/70, makes breaking changes to tracing APIs (structLog memory and storage fields 0x-prefixed, error omitted when empty, reexec removed), adds retry mechanism for checkpoint init in blsync, adds subcommand for offline binary tree conversion, adds code exporter for db export, includes Amsterdam fork updates (EIP-7928 prerequisites, EIP-8037 prerequisites, EIP-7976, EIP-7981, EIP-7610), updates state tests, implements stack arena, implements EIP-7975 eth/70 partial block receipt lists, works on snap/2 protocol prerequisites, implements history index pruner for path-mode archive nodes, adds Prague chain segment pruning point for Hoodi, allows reorging head to parent within 32 blocks under ePBS, stops serving chain segment requests when data unavailable, drops peers sending invalid bodies or receipts, adds kzg4844 cell-related functions, refactors state database, makes binary trie improvements, merges EIP-4762 access events, rejects duplicate layers in path database, omits empty slotNumber, includes operand in EIP-8024 error messages, fixes vmodule downgrades, fixes incorrect fsync ordering, fixes file descriptor leak, fixes size calculation in path database, fixes gapped queue size cap in blobpool, improves txpool pending concurrency, replaces deprecated TypeMux with Feed, continues blob retrieval on individual cell proof extraction failure, uses uint256 in core Message, fixes early exit of timeout loop, prevents data races in discover, fixes discover waitForNodes deadlock, validates hash length in nocgo signature verification, fixes structLog JSON output format, applies block overrides in eth_estimateGas and eth_call, adds MaxUsedGas to eth_simulate call results, integrates trienode history indexing progress into eth_syncing, returns -32602 from log RPCs when block range limit exceeded, fixes prestate tracer for EIP-7702, emits logs for EIP-7708 ETH burns, and forwards V2 state hooks.

questions.query_text: In the ethereum/go-ethereum releases, which release introduces a new filtermaps index for log filtering and releases abigen v2?

answer_support.answer_text: introduces a new filtermaps index for log filtering with huge performance improvements, releases abigen v2

questions.query_text: Across the ethereum/go-ethereum releases, how does the archive node implementation in v1.16.0 differ from the archive node capabilities in v1.17.0?

options.text: v1.16.0 introduces an experimental path-based archive node without proof support, while v1.17.0 adds the ability to serve proofs for historical states via eth_getProof.
v1.16.0 removes archive node support entirely, and v1.17.0 restores it with hash-based storage.
Both releases only support hash-based archive nodes with identical proof capabilities.
v1.16.0 requires a dedicated SSD for archive state, while v1.17.0 removes the need for any persistent storage.

questions.expected_answer: v1.16.0 introduces an experimental path-based archive node without proof support, while v1.17.0 adds the ability to serve proofs for historical states via eth_getProof.

answer_support.answer_text: introduces an experimental path-based archive node implementation
introduces path-based archive node with proofs configurable via --history.trienode

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent evanw/esbuild release stream from v0.21.4 through v0.28.0, covering import attribute updates, platform support changes, CSS and JSX fixes, security improvements, and new language feature support.

chunks.title: v0.21.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.21.4, esbuild updates support for import assertions and import attributes in node: the 'assert' keyword is stripped and a warning is generated when targeting node22 or above, while import attributes (the 'with' keyword) are no longer stripped for node18.20+. A bug is fixed where the 'for await' transform failed to move a loop label into the generated try statement. Additional constant folding is performed after cross-module enum inlining. Import attributes are now passed to on-resolve plugins via the 'with' property.

chunks.title: v0.21.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.21.5, a bug is fixed where Symbol.metadata was not added to classes without a class decorator, aligning with the decorator metadata proposal. Unknown import attributes are now allowed with the 'copy' loader. Import attributes are supported for glob-style imports. The new TypeScript 5.5 feature ${configDir} is supported in tsconfig.json baseUrl and paths.

chunks.title: v0.22.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.22.0, a breaking change makes --packages=external the default for --platform=node, omitting packages from bundles by default. Support is dropped for Windows 7, 8, Server 2008, and Server 2012, and the minimum node version for the JavaScript API is increased from 12 to 16.

chunks.title: v0.23.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.23.0, the recent change making --packages=external the default for node is reverted, restoring --packages=bundle as the default. A bug is fixed where collapsed JSX whitespace was incorrectly ignored with --jsx=preserve.

chunks.title: v0.23.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.23.1, the 'node:' import prefix is now allowed with es* targets. A CLI panic with invalid build flags and --analyze is fixed. A regression causing incorrect error locations for variable declarations is fixed. Comments before case clauses in switch statements are now printed. A memory leak with pluginData is fixed.

chunks.title: v0.24.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.24.0, support is dropped for macOS 10.15 Catalina. A bug is fixed where class field decorators in TypeScript with useDefineForClassFields=false incorrectly omitted field initializers. Incorrect cycle warnings with tsconfig.json multiple inheritance are avoided. A Yarn Plug'n'Play stack overflow with tsconfig.json is handled. Issues with Deno 1.31+ are worked around.

chunks.title: v0.24.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.24.1, es2024 is allowed as a target in tsconfig.json. Automatic semicolon insertion after get/set is fixed. Quoted property names are now allowed in --define and --pure. Empty try/catch/finally blocks are minified. The 'copy' loader now includes entryPoint metadata. Source mappings may now contain null entries.

chunks.title: v0.24.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.24.2, a regression with --define and import.meta introduced in v0.24.1 is fixed, restoring the ability to use --define:import.meta=....

chunks.title: v0.25.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.25.0, a security vulnerability is addressed by disabling CORS on the development server and denying requests if the host does not match --serve. The serve() API now returns an array of hosts. Output files are deleted when a build fails in watch mode. Correctness issues with the CSS nesting transform are fixed. Access to esbuild's development server is restricted.

chunks.title: v0.25.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.25.1, a regression from v0.25.0 causing incorrect paths in inline source maps is fixed. A regression from v0.24.1 causing invalid generated source maps is fixed. A regression with non-file source map paths is fixed. A crash with switch optimization is fixed. Go is updated from 1.23.5 to 1.23.7.

chunks.title: v0.25.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.25.2, JavaScript regular expression flags are now translated into Go regular expression flags for the plugin API. Node-specific annotations for string literal export names are fixed. Basic support for index source maps is added.

chunks.title: v0.25.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.25.3, lowered async arrow functions before super() are fixed to not forward 'this' when unused. A memory leak with --watch=true is fixed. Repeated legal comments are grouped in output. A custom host is allowed with the development server.

chunks.title: v0.25.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.25.4, simple CORS support is added to the development server via a new 'cors' option. Invalid URLs in source maps are passed through unmodified. Exports named __proto__ in ES modules are handled correctly.

chunks.title: v0.25.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.25.5, a regression with 'browser' overrides in package.json is fixed. Certain keywords are now supported as TypeScript tuple labels. CSS prefixes for the 'stretch' sizing value are added.

chunks.title: v0.25.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the evanw/esbuild release v0.25.6, a memory leak when cancel() is used on a build context is fixed. Empty :is() and :where() syntax in CSS is supported. Tree-shaking of try statements in dead code is improved. Negated bigints are considered to have no side effects. A configurable delay in watch mode before rebuilding is supported. Mixed arrays for entryPoints API option are allowed. Go is updated from 1.23.8 to 1.23.10. Experimental support for esbuild on OpenHarmony is added.

chunks.title: v0.25.7

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release evolution of exelban/stats, a macOS system monitor, from v2.11.54 through v2.12.15. The releases include new features such as CPU average load, chart style improvements, widget updates, localization additions, and bug fixes across multiple versions.

chunks.title: v2.11.54
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.54, new features include adding CPU average load to the Remote protocol and moving from a list of Double to a struct, adding round style to some charts for a more Apple-like appearance, removing the header line from the popup view, moving App settings from the menu to the bottom part of the sidebar, and adjusting the settings window to the new macOS design.

chunks.title: v2.11.55
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.55, a hot fix disables widgets update for macOS 26 due to a problem with 'chronod'.

chunks.title: v2.11.56
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.56, bug fixes address an app crash when the battery is damaged and fix initializing the update interval from the store. New features add a new way to obtain the WiFi network SSID and add display information to the Dashboard.

chunks.title: v2.11.57
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.57, bug fixes include fixing a check if a key exists in the Store after adding a cache layer and adjusting table height in the Clock settings for macOS 26. New features include including previous and new IP addresses in notifications and adding a bug report template to the report bug button.

chunks.title: v2.11.58
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.58, bug fixes correct NVMe SMART data units read/written calculation and add an additional redraw when something changes in the Battery widget to eliminate artifacts when switching from AC plug-in to charging icon. A new feature adds gradient style to the line chart.

chunks.title: v2.11.59
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.59, a bug fix addresses an issue on macOS 26 where setting autosaveName to the menu bar item prevents it from loading. A new feature adjusts value width in the process view to fit bigger values. Localization updates include updated Vietnamese translations and added translations for internet status notifications.

chunks.title: v2.11.60
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.60, new features unlock widgets updates since 'chronod' was fixed in macOS 26.1 and move remote authorization from api. to oauth. domain name. Localization updates include updated German and Taiwan Traditional Chinese localizations.

chunks.title: v2.11.61
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.61, a hot fix reverts enabling macOS widget updates since there is still a problem with 'chronod'.

chunks.title: v2.11.62
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.62, a bug fix addresses a long-term battery widget glitch where a black vertical line is visible in the widget preview. New features add a fallback to the CPU core index when id not found when calculating cores load, add an option to disable system-widget updates for users experiencing ongoing chronod issues, add a check if the macOS widget is active before updating the read value in user defaults to prevent unnecessary writes, move from telemetry id to remote id for the Remote module, and remove the Telemetry module. Localization updates include updated Vietnamese and Turkish translations.

chunks.title: v2.11.63
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.63, bug fixes implement local caching for settings list to prevent storage thrashing and move WKWebView initialization to when it should be displayed to prevent initialization on app start and silence system logs. New features include a small redesign in the Network popup view with interface details, DNS servers, and interface speed, and add an IP change counter to the IP change notification. Localization updates include updated Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese localizations.

chunks.title: v2.11.64
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.64, a bug fix corrects case values for SP4B and SP69 in smc.swift. Localization updates add Korean translation for Fixed scale and Toggle the module, update Japanese localization for Clock settings, and update Simplified Chinese localization for network messages.

chunks.title: v2.11.65
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.65, a bug fix addresses race condition crashes in Chart and Stack widgets. New features add clearing the process after it was killed, add -9 code to kill command when killing a process from the popup view, add an option to manually refresh disk space information, and add jitter to the network module calculated from ICMP signals. Localization updates include updated Japanese and Korean translations.

chunks.title: v2.11.66
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.66, a bug fix corrects the build version.

chunks.title: v2.11.67
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.11.67, which is the last release with macOS 10.15 support, a bug fix renames telemetry_id to remote_id when exporting/importing settings. New features change the default value of macOS widgets to disabled to prevent heavy load on some systems and add information text to the widgets, and add CPU frequency support for M5 type. Localization updates refine German localization strings.

chunks.title: v2.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.0, new features change the minimum macOS version to macOS 11.15 (Big Sur), add better fan control for M3/M4 Apple Silicon, and add a week numbers toggle to the Clock calendar. Localization adds translation for 'Show week numbers'.

chunks.title: v2.12.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.1, bug fixes cherry-pick changes to fix the automatic fan mode after sleep and remove menu item position control when showing widget in the menu bar. A new feature adds flag emoji instead of country code in the popup view, and countryCode and flag options to the Text widget. Localization updates Taiwan Traditional Chinese localization.

chunks.title: v2.12.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.2, new features add an option to resize the settings window with autosaved position and size, add a new way to obtain Bluetooth device battery levels using pmset, and add an option to use an HTTP method for connectivity check. Localization generates missing translations for all languages using a translategemma:4b model.

chunks.title: v2.12.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.3, a hot fix addresses a missing background on older macOS.

chunks.title: v2.12.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.4, bug fixes correct Apple Silicon power readings scaling with update interval and fix incorrect CPU tick calculation after UInt32 overflow. New features add base M5 CPU and GPU core sensors, limit WiFi details read every 15 seconds to reduce CPU usage, add new MacBooks ids and new MacBook Neo to known devices, add an option to sync reader fire time to the second bound, add sleep mode to the reader for sensor module, and add an option to sync clock with NTP server and move reader to separate file.

chunks.title: v2.12.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.5, bug fixes correct Mac Studio M3 Ultra name and release years in deviceDict, fix fan control helper on M5, and adjust clock list table height to be fully visible in the min window size. New features add 'Enable in Settings' text to all macOS widgets, improve support for new M5 gen, add an option to switch between emoji flag and country code in the Network module, and update M5 cpu sensors.

chunks.title: v2.12.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.6, a hot fix addresses a LineChart draw offset when a label is present and tries to omit duplicates of Bluetooth devices using vendor and product ID.

chunks.title: v2.12.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.7, a bug fix addresses cases when CPU total frequency will be NaN. A new feature handles the case when DMG mounting fails. Localization updates include updated Turkish and Polish translations.

chunks.title: v2.12.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.8, a bug fix addresses a data race in the Disk processes reader. New features add a Dot widget to the RAM module to visualize ram pressure level, make small improvements in the Remote module, move the State widget to Dot widget to show any color provided by module, initialize a CPU preview component (not active), and add a label to the Stack widget to show Bluetooth device name instead of id. Localization updates missing translations.

chunks.title: v2.12.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.9, bug fixes address a data race in the Sensors popup, fix the Fan helper installation process by using System over domain for launchd, and fix a Line Chart draw offset. New features add a RAM preview (disabled), add ANE utilization to the GPU module. Localization improves Korean language support, updates Japanese translations, and adds missing translations.

chunks.title: v2.12.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.10, a bug fix addresses a crash when reading I/O from an unavailable network interface. New features add a GPU preview (disabled), add display FPS to the GPU module, and add FAQ for hidden menu bar icons on macOS 26. Localization updates include updated French, Estonian, and auto translation fixes.

chunks.title: v2.12.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.11, a bug fix corrects the release version for v2.12.10.

chunks.title: v2.12.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.12, a bug fix refreshes popup readers when the popup reopens. New features adjust stepper field width constraints, make improvements in the Remote module, move ANE utilization from read to calculation from power usage, add a Disk preview (disabled), improve the updater mechanism for better handling of the mount point and add a new app version signature, and remove powermetric from the SMC helper. Localization updates Japanese translations for clarity and accuracy.

chunks.title: v2.12.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.13, a bug fix addresses an inverted separator color. A new feature adds an authorization step when trying to update Stats as non-admin. Localization fixes some Dutch translations.

chunks.title: v2.12.14
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the exelban/stats release v2.12.14, bug fixes address possible memory leaks and fix display fps visibility in the GPU popup. New features add custom colors for widgets, redesign the Network usage timer, fix stale CPU popup data when reopening the popup, improve LineChart rendering by showing gaps when data is unavailable, add timestamp tooltips to the connectivity chart, add a Network preview (disabled), move Settings, Update, Setup, and Support windows to lazy-loaded initialization to reduce startup memory usage, add a How to contribute section to the README.md, and add System Stats account information to hide contribution alert for non-free users. In the expressjs/express release 4.17.0, the project adds express.raw to parse bodies into Buffer, express.text to parse bodies into string, improves error messages for non-strings to res.sendFile and for null/undefined to res.status, supports multiple hosts in X-Forwarded-Host, and updates dependencies: accepts to ~1.3.7, body-parser to 1.19.0 (adding encoding MIK, petabyte support, fixing parsing array brackets after index, and updating bytes, http-errors, iconv-lite, qs, raw-body, type-is), content-disposition to 0.5.3, cookie to 0.4.0 (adding SameSite=None support), finalhandler to ~1.1.2 (setting stricter Content-Security-Policy header, updating parseurl and statuses), parseurl to ~1.3.3, proxy-addr to ~2.0.5 (with ipaddr.js 1.9.0), qs to 6.7.0 (fixing parsing array brackets after index), range-parser to ~1.2.1, send to 0.17.1 (setting stricter CSP header in redirect and error responses, updating http-errors, mime, ms, range-parser, statuses, and removing redundant path.normalize call), serve-static to 1.14.1 (setting stricter CSP header in redirect response, updating parseurl and send), setprototypeof to 1.1.1, statuses to ~1.5.0 (adding 103 Early Hints), and type-is to ~1.6.18 (with mime-types ~2.1.24 and preventing internal throw on invalid type).

chunks.title: 5.0.0-alpha.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the expressjs/express release 5.0.0-alpha.8, the sixth Express 5.0 alpha release based on 4.17.1, it includes changes from 5.0.0-alpha.7.

In the expressjs/express release 4.17.3, the project updates dependencies: accepts to ~1.3.8 (with mime-types ~2.1.34 and negotiator 0.6.3), body-parser to 1.19.2 (with bytes 3.1.2, qs 6.9.7, raw-body 2.4.3), cookie to 0.4.2, qs to 6.9.7, fixes handling of __proto__ keys, and removes an unnecessary regexp for trust proxy.

In the expressjs/express release 4.18.1, the project fixes hanging on large stack of sync routes.

chunks.title: v5.0.0-beta.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the expressjs/express release v5.0.0-beta.3, the project provides a full changelog comparing to 5.0.0-beta.2.

In the expressjs/express release 4.20.0, the project makes important changes: the default depth level for parsing URL-encoded data is now 32 (previously Infinity), and removes link renderization in html while using res.redirect. Other changes include staging 4.19.2, removing duplicate location test for data uri, documenting beta releases expectations, cutting down on duplicated CI runs, adding a Threat Model, assigning captain of encodeurl, nominating jonchurch as repo captain for several packages, updating Security.md, updating triage nomination policy, adding CodeQL (SAST), adding UlisesGascon as triage initiative captain, updating encodeurl to ~2.0.0, skipping QUERY method test, ignoring ETAG query test on 21 and 22, adding support Node.js@22 in CI, adding table of contents and tc/triager lists to readme, listing and sorting all projects with captains, adding UlisesGascon as captain for cookie-parser, bringing back query tests for node 21, deprecating res.clearCookie accepting options.maxAge and options.expires, skipping QUERY tests for Node 21 only, updating people and adding ctcpip to TC, removing minor version pinning from CI, fixing link variable use in attribution section of CODE OF CONDUCT, replacing Appveyor windows testing with GHA, adding OSSF Scorecard badge, updating scorecard link, nominating @IamLizu to the triage team, updating path-to-regexp to 0.1.8, specifying new instructions for question and discuss, upgrading merge-descriptors dependency, and updating path-to-regexp to 0.1.10.

In the expressjs/express release v5.0.0, the project announces the official release of Express v5. Major changes include dropping support for Node.js versions before v18, routing changes with path-to-regexp@8.x removing sub-expression regex patterns for ReDoS mitigation, middleware can now return rejected promises caught by the router, body-parser changes including customizable urlencoded body depth and defaulting extended to false, and removal of deprecated API method signatures from v3/v4. Security updates include ReDoS prevention and mitigation for CVE-2024-45590. The release also includes many other changes such as staging 4.19.2, removing duplicate location test, documenting beta releases expectations, cutting down on duplicated CI runs, adding a Threat Model, assigning captain of encodeurl, nominating jonchurch as repo captain, updating Security.md, updating triage nomination policy, adding CodeQL, adding UlisesGascon as triage initiative captain, using object with null prototype for various app properties, updating encodeurl to ~2.0.0, skipping QUERY method test, ignoring ETAG query test on 21 and 22, adding support Node.js@22 in CI, adding table of contents and tc/triager lists to readme, listing and sorting all projects with captains, and many more.

In the expressjs/express release 4.21.0, the project deprecates the 'back' magic string in redirects, updates finalhandler to 1.3.1, updates serve-static to 1.16.2, and upgrades qs to 6.13.0 to match qs in body-parser.
In the expressjs/express release 4.21.1, the project backports a fix for CVE-2024-47764 to the 4.x branch.

In the expressjs/express release v5.0.1, the project removes --bail from test script, nominates @bjohansebas to the triage team, links and updates captains, and updates cookie semver lock to address CVE-2024-47764.
In the expressjs/express release 4.21.2, the project adds a funding field, updates path-to-regexp to 0.1.11 and then to 0.1.12.

chunks.title: v5.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the expressjs/express release v5.1.0, the project updates captains, builds with Node.js 23.0, adds a funding field, adds a discarded middleware test, updates homepage link to https, improves readme, adds bjohansebas as repo captain for expressjs.com, removes Object.setPrototypeOf polyfill, uses node:buffer instead of safe-buffer, adds DCO documentation, removes promise support check from tests, uses loop for acceptParams, improves documentation step in release process, removes unnecessary require for global Buffer, removes AsyncLocalStorage check, updates history.md for acceptParams change, adds @rxmarbles to the triage team, refactors for readability, clarifies security process in triage role, replaces methods dependency with standard library, removes utils-merge dependency using spread syntax, fixes vulnerabilities, prefixes built-in node module imports, removes download size badges, removes unused depd dependency, fixes usage of invalid action input for actions/setup-node@v4, adds support for OSSF scorecard reporting, adds @Phillip9587 to the triage team, fixes a missing semicolon in css styles in examples/auth, includes team email in security policy, simplifies normalizeTypes function, updates github actions ci workflow, fixes npm install --include typo, updates scorecard actions, uses carat notation for dependency versions, and many more.

In the expressjs/express release 4.22.0, the project includes a security fix for CVE-2024-51999, refactors for readability, adds support for Node.js@23.0 in CI, makes method functions with no path error, updates github actions ci workflow, reorders npm i steps to fix CI for older node versions, backports adding node.js 24 to test matrix, widens range for query test skip, uses tilde notation for certain dependencies, updates qs to 6.14.0, and uses tilde notation for qs.

chunks.title: 0.84.0-rc.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/react-native release 0.84.0-rc.0, the project introduces several breaking changes including bumping the minimum Node.js version to v22.11, making the TurboModuleBinding constructor private, removing TurboCxxModule, removing the microtask API from JSTimerManager, and removing CxxModule support across Java/Kotlin, C++, and CatalystInstance. Android-specific breaking changes include removing unstable_shouldEnableLegacyModuleInterop(), deleting the deprecated NativeKind class, and removing several legacy architecture classes. iOS-specific breaking changes include removing the legacy architecture by default and making RCTPackagerConnection an instance of RCTDevSettings. Additions include a new test for the AnimationBackend, support for maxWidth, maxHeight, minWidth, and minHeight props in the AnimationBackend, and support for flex properties.

chunks.title: 0.84.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/react-native release 0.84.0-rc.1, a breaking change on iOS makes Hermes V1 the default engine. Fixed issues include a missing dependency that broke 'react-native config' in pnpm setups, and an Android-specific fix for handling the 'unstable_path' query param in asset URLs.

chunks.title: 0.84.0-rc.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/react-native release 0.84.0-rc.2, fixed issues include an empty screen problem for RNDT Network and Performance panels, and an iOS-specific fix for a glog namespace issue to allow using interop mode of objcxx.

chunks.title: 0.84.0-rc.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/react-native release 0.84.0-rc.3, additions to the Animated module include transformOrigin prop support, backfaceVisibility prop support, missing flex style in AnimatedPropsBuilder, and support for borderCurves, borderStyles, pointerEvents, isolation, cursor, boxShadow, mixBlendMode, overflow, position, zIndex, and direction props in the AnimationBackend. An iOS-specific codegen fix addresses codegen failing when the project is inside a hidden folder.

In the facebook/react-native release 0.80.3, which is the final release for the 0.80 line and is now out of support, fixed issues include a codegen fix for missing dependencies. Android-specific fixes include stabilizing custom accessibility action IDs for TalkBack, fixing a race condition with codegen libraries missing sources, making accessors inside HeadlessJsTaskService open again, fixing a legacy architecture Android freeze on metro refresh, fixing request permission not always resolving in Android 16, and updating font scale on Android when recreating RootView. iOS-specific fixes include a prebuild cp command fix for gnu coreutils, RefreshControl recycling and initial mount fixes, an RCTDeviceInfo crash fix when application.delegate.window is nil, and a TextInput fix for setting maxLength to 0 still allowing typing.

chunks.title: 0.84.0-rc.4

chunks.title: 0.85.0-rc.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/react-native release 0.85.0-rc.0, breaking changes include removing deprecated type aliases, moving the Jest preset to a new react-native/jest-preset package, removing the deprecated StyleSheet.absoluteFill API, and dropping support for EOL Node.js lines and old minors. Android-specific breaking changes include re-adding receiveTouches to RCTEventEmitter with a default no-op, deprecating UIManagerHelper.getEventDispatcherForReactTag and related methods, stubbing the UIImplementation class, and making ReactTextUpdate internal. Additions include missing tests for Standalone fusebox shell, adding onPressMove prop to Pressable TypeScript types, AnimationBackend cleanup and examples, a synchronization mechanism for layout information between React and main branches of the ShadowTree, upstreaming useAnimatedColor and useAnimatedValueXY, creating a viewTransitionEnabled feature flag, AnimationBackend docs, and tests for Pressability onHoverOut property.

In the facebook/react-native release 0.83.3, an Android-specific addition adds support for custom header in devsupport. Changes include skipping set-rn-artifacts-version for PRs targeting stable branches in CI. Fixed issues include a build fix for rncore tarball extraction for EdenFS compatibility, and an Android-specific Gradle fix for included-build gradle.properties resolution for monorepos so hermesV1Enabled can be inherited correctly.
In the facebook/react-native release 0.83.4, an iOS-specific fix adds RCTDevSupportHeaders in the React Umbrella for precompiled binaries.

It adds new violations requiring component names to start with an uppercase letter, support for ESLint v9, considers dispatch from useActionState stable, accepts as expressions in callbacks and deps arrays, treats React.use() the same as use(), moves use() lint to non-experimental, supports Flow as expressions, allows useEffect(fn, undefined), disallows hooks in async functions, renames experimental useEvent to useEffectEvent, and adds linting for useEvent functions in dependency lists.
