prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent facebook/rocksdb release stream from v8.11.4 through v11.1.1, covering major feature introductions, API changes, behavior adjustments, and bug fixes across multiple minor and patch versions.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.0.0, new features include FSBuffer support for point lookups, SstFileWriter creating SST files without persisting user-defined timestamps when the flag is false, user-defined timestamp support in DeleteFilesInRanges and GetPropertiesOfTablesInRange, and marking wal_compression as production-ready with ZSTD. Public API changes allow setting Stderr logger via C API, declare one Get and one MultiGet variant as pure virtual, expose mode option to Rate Limiter via C API, and remove several deprecated options. Behavior changes set format_version=6 as default, allow parallel compactions within a single column family, and enable intra-L0 compaction when total L0 size is small. Bug fixes address a data race in RenameTempFileToOptionsFile, perf context statistics errors in write steps, a rare MultiGet duplicate key issue, and a bug where older ingested key data could be returned under universal compaction.

chunks.title: RocksDB 8.11.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v8.11.4, bug fixes include fixing the CMake Javadoc build and fixing Java SstFileMetaData to prevent throwing java.lang.NoSuchMethodError.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.0.1, bug fixes include fixing CMake Javadoc and source jar builds, and fixing Java SstFileMetaData to prevent throwing java.lang.NoSuchMethodError.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.1.0, new features include an option to end GetMergeOperands early, sanity checks for ingesting external files, support for ingesting external files with user-defined timestamps in memtable only, retry SST block reads on checksum mismatch, enhancements to temperature handling, WriteBatchWithIndex wide-column point lookups, and experimental iterator write-time property and TimedPut API. Public API changes allow best-effort recovery with atomic flush, remove deprecated bottommost_temperature, add new PerfContext counters, deprecate old remote compaction APIs, update GetForUpdate UDT validation, define kEnableWait PerfLevel, change RateLimiter API, and add write_memtable_time. Behavior changes modify RateLimiter refill period, merge write operand count handling. Bug fixes address kBlockCacheTier reads returning Status::Incomplete for merge operations.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.1.1, bug fixes include fixing Java SstFileMetaData to prevent throwing java.lang.NoSuchMethodError and fixing a regression where CPU overhead for merge decisions could increase when max_successive_merges > 0 unless strict_max_successive_merges was set.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.2.1, public API changes add a kAdmPolicyAllowAll option to TieredAdmissionPolicy. New features in v9.2.0 include deadline and max_size_bytes for CacheDumper, GetEntityFromBatchAndDB for wide-column lookups, experimental CoalescingIterator and AttributeGroupIterator, MultiGetEntityFromBatchAndDB, SstFileReader::NewTableIterator, and wait_for_purge in WaitForCompactOptions. Public API changes make DeleteRange return NotSupported with row_cache, deprecate CompactionOptions::compression, and warn about OptionChangeMigration to FIFO. Behavior changes make block_align incompatible with more compression options, change default compression to kDisableCompressionOption, set optimize_filters_for_memory true by default, dump all keys for cache dumper, abort CompactRange with change_level and target_level 0, and retry file reads on checksum mismatch. Bug fixes address VerifyFileChecksum issues.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.3.1, bug fixes include an internal build script improvement. In v9.3.0, new features add GetEntity, MultiGetEntity, and PutEntity support for optimistic and WriteCommitted transactions, and a new Iterator property for value pinning. Public API changes expose block based metadata cache options and compaction pri via C API, and add kAdmPolicyAllowAll to TieredAdmissionPolicy. Behavior changes make CompactRange with change_level on FIFO return NotSupported, and external file ingestion with FIFO always ingest to L0. Bug fixes address 2PC DB with one CF corruption, CreateColumnFamilyWithImport epoch reset, race conditions with inplace_update_support, CompactFiles range conflict, false corruption on reopen with recycle_log_file_num and wal_compression, blocking operations during LockWAL, and stale memory access with TieredSecondaryCache.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.4.0, new features include CompactForTieringCollectorFactory, GetEntityForUpdate for optimistic and WriteCommitted transactions, a count command in ldb, C API functions for writebatch timestamps and iter refresh, and C API for creating writebatch with all options. Public API changes deprecate LogFile/VectorLogPtr in favor of WalFile/VectorWalPtr, and introduce max_read_amp for universal compaction. Behavior changes immediately close inactive WALs after sync, with an opt-out option. Bug fixes address a rare unsynced hard-linked WAL in Checkpoint, ldb dump_wal output for PutEntity, incorrect PutEntity handling during recovery, various read operations ignoring ReadOptions, and performance improvements for concurrent memtable writes.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.5.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.5.2, bug fixes address a race condition in pessimistic transactions allowing duplicate transaction names. Public API changes add ticker stats for file read retries due to checksum mismatch. In v9.5.1, bug fixes make DestroyDB support slow deletion when configured in SstFileManager. In v9.5.0, public API changes introduce rocksdb_writebatch_iterate_cf and support ingesting SST files generated by a DB. Behavior changes exclude archived log size from log_size_for_flush in CreateCheckpoint. Bug fixes address iterator missing data with prefix filtering and SeekForPrev, OnErrorRecoveryBegin not called, event listener race, MANIFEST write error deletion, race between error recovery and external SST ingestion, and performance improvements for compactions and backups.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.6.1, bug fixes correct MultiGet across column families with user timestamp. In v9.6.0, new features include best efforts recovery to incomplete Version, decouple_partitioned_filters option, and paranoid_memory_checks CF option. Public API changes add ticker stats for file read retries and optional installation callback for remote compaction. Behavior changes reduce intra-L0 compaction using compensated file size. Bug fixes include DestroyDB slow deletion, unprep_seqs_ set on WriteImpl failure, duplicate WAL entries after error recovery, data race in unordered_write, file snapshot functions copying non-existing manifest, per kv checksum corruption ignored in MultiGet, and race condition in pessimistic transactions.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.7.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.7.3, behavior changes preserve OPTIONS file for remote worker. In v9.7.2, bug fixes address surfacing write unix time for non-L0 files. In v9.7.1, bug fixes correct lost DB option settings, under counting of allocated memory in compressed secondary cache, and skip insertion of compressed blocks in secondary cache when lowest_used_cache_tier is kVolatileTier. In v9.7.0, new features make Cache customizable, add prefix_seek_opt_in_only, and add a table property for largest seqno. Behavior changes modify blob_garbage_collection_force_threshold semantics, set write_dbid_to_manifest true by default, change FIFO temperature compaction to one file at a time, support ingesting db generated files via hard link, add link_files ingestion option, and untrack files in SstFileManager on DB::Close. Bug fixes address CompactRange result files not compacted, dynamic prefix_extractor handling, and manual_wal_flush with auto error recovery.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.6.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.6.2, bug fixes address a leak of obsolete blob files left open until DB::Close, introduced in v9.4.0. The release also includes the same fixes as v9.6.1 for MultiGet across column families with user timestamp, and the features and fixes from v9.6.0 such as best efforts recovery, decouple_partitioned_filters, paranoid_memory_checks, ticker stats, remote compaction callback, reduced intra-L0 compaction, DestroyDB slow deletion, unprep_seqs_ fix, duplicate WAL entries, data race in unordered_write, file snapshot manifest copy, per kv checksum corruption in MultiGet, and pessimistic transaction race condition.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.7.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.7.4, bug fixes address a leak of obsolete blob files left open until DB::Close, introduced in v9.4.0. The release also includes behavior changes from v9.7.3 preserving OPTIONS file for remote worker, bug fixes from v9.7.2 for surfacing write unix time, and fixes from v9.7.1 for lost DB option settings, under counting of allocated memory, and skip insertion of compressed blocks. It also includes new features from v9.7.0 such as customizable Cache, prefix_seek_opt_in_only, and largest seqno table property, along with behavior changes and bug fixes from that version.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.8.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.8.4, behavior changes prevent purging OPTIONS file immediately after SetOptions when Remote Compaction is enabled. In v9.8.3, bug fixes address missing cases of corruption retry during DB open and read API processing. In v9.8.2, public API changes add Transaction::GetAttributeGroupIterator, behavior changes make BaseDeltaIterator honor allow_unprepared_value, and bug fixes address BaseDeltaIterator PrepareValue and WAL replay for WriteCommitted transaction DB with toggled UDT. In v9.8.1, bug fixes address a leak of obsolete blob files introduced in v9.4.0. In v9.8.0, new features include mutable BlockBasedTableOptions, on-demand large value loading in BlobDB, fill_cache ingestion option, allow_unprepared_value for multi-CF iterators, and standalone range deletion file compaction. Behavior changes include batched level assignment during ingestion, OPTIONS file preservation, trimmed readahead_size, and universal compaction level assignment. Bug fixes address SetOptions race condition.

chunks.title: RocksDB release 9.9.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.9.3, performance improvements align writes on power of 2 in buffered IO mode. In v9.9.2, bug fixes honor ConfigOptions.ignore_unknown_options in ParseStruct. In v9.9.1, behavior changes update RocksDbThreadYieldAndCheckAbort to support MySQL abort. In v9.9.0, new features mark Multi-Column-Family-Iterator as non-experimental, add a table property for newest key time, and use it for FIFO TTL and temperature change compaction. Public API changes add Transaction::GetAttributeGroupIterator and GetCoalescingIterator. Behavior changes make BaseDeltaIterator honor allow_unprepared_value. Bug fixes address BaseDeltaIterator PrepareValue, obsolete blob file leak, missing corruption retry, transaction db 2pc WAL retention, open SST file leaks, WAL replay for WriteCommitted with toggled UDT, and performance regression fix for compaction_readahead_size.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.10.0 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.10.0, new features introduce TransactionOptions::commit_bypass_memtable. Public API changes remove deprecated Remote Compaction APIs. Behavior changes make DB::KeyMayExist follow its function comment. Bug fixes address compaction incorrectly dropping a key with snapshot sequence zero, and honor ConfigOptions.ignore_unknown_options in ParseStruct. Performance improvements enable reuse of file system allocated buffer for synchronous prefetching and align writes on power of 2 in buffered IO mode.

chunks.title: RocksDB 9.11.2 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v9.11.2, a patch version bump fixes a mistake in the previous 9.11 release tag. In v9.11.1, new features add the ability to plug-in a custom table reader implementation. In v9.11.0, new features introduce CancelAwaitingJobs in CompactionService, experimental secondary indices, and track_and_verify_wals option. Public API changes add io_buffer_size to BackupEngineOptions, clean up random_access_max_buffer_size references, add file_ingestion_nanos perf context, offer new DB::Open with unique_ptr, and deprecate DB::DeleteFile. Behavior changes make manual compaction stricter about max_compaction_bytes, and make tiering options mutable. Bug fixes address a major SetOptions bug.

chunks.title: RocksDB 10.0.1 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v10.0.1, public API changes add ReadOptions::property_bag, introduce CompactionServiceJobStatus::kAborted, and add disallow_memtable_writes CF option. In v10.0.0, new features include auto_refresh_iterator_with_snapshot, custom table reader, FAISS inverted file indices, num_running_compaction_sorted_runs property, simple secondary indices, and txn_commit_bypass_memtable_threshold. Public API changes update secondary index query API, add primary key to secondary index entries, require ZSTD 1.4.0, and remove kZSTDNotFinalCompression. Behavior changes make VerifyBackup evaluate checksums in parallel, reverse order of updates in WriteBatchWithIndex, and add Merge support for commit_bypass_memtable. Bug fixes address GetMergeOperands in ReadOnlyDB and SecondaryDB, and a bug in GetMergeOperands with continue_cb.

chunks.title: v10.1.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v10.1.3, bug fixes address resurrected full_history_ts_low from a previous session with UDT enabled used by a session with UDT disabled. In v10.1.2, bug fixes address tail size of remote compaction output not persisted in primary db's manifest. In v10.1.0, new features add calculate_sst_write_lifetime_hint_set, num_l0_files in CompactionJobInfo, per-key-placement in Remote Compaction, and DB::GetPropertiesOfTablesByLevel. Public API changes make GetAllKeyVersions interpret empty slices literally, change DeleteFilesInRanges to take RangeOpt, add ReadOptions::property_bag, introduce CompactionServiceJobStatus::kAborted, and deprecate format_version < 2. Behavior changes make ldb error on unsupported compression_type, MultiGet with snapshot and kPersistedTier read consistent view, and disallow CreateColumnFamily on read-only DB. Bug fixes address stats for Tiered Storage with preclude_last_level.

chunks.title: v10.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v10.2.1, bug fixes address improper initialization of ExternalTableOptions. In v10.2.0, new features include COMPACTION_PREFETCH_BYTES histogram, DB::GetNewestUserDefinedTimestamp, IngestWriteBatchWithIndex, and memtable_op_scan_flush_trigger. Public API changes delete max_write_buffer_number_to_maintain, deprecate MaxMemCompactionLevel, ignore_range_deletions, and PromoteL0, add arbitrary string map for remote compactions, and remove fail_if_options_file_error. Behavior changes make PREFETCH_BYTES_USEFUL, PREFETCH_HITS, PREFETCH_BYTES only account for user initiated scan. Bug fixes address Posix file system ReopenWritableFile file size tracking and tail size of remote compaction output not persisted.

chunks.title: v10.4.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v10.4.2, bug fixes address a race condition between concurrent DB::Open sharing the same SstFileManager instance. In v10.4.1, behavior changes trigger eligible compactions every 12 hours with periodic compaction, and bug fixes address a BackupEngine crash due to null FSWritableFile. In v10.4.0, new features include memtable_avg_op_scan_flush_trigger, concurrent writers for vector memtable, large_txn_commit_optimize_byte_threshold, reduce_file_locking for universal compaction, and format_version=7 for custom compression. Public API changes make NewExternalTableFactory return unique_ptr, add min file size for deletion triggered compaction. Behavior changes set large_txn_commit_optimize_threshold default to 0 and make txn_commit_bypass_memtable_threshold have no effect. Bug fixes address CreateColumnFamilyWithImport missing SST file, iterator NotImplemented with disallow_memtable_writes and paranoid_memory_checks, and file checksum handling in IngestExternalFile.

chunks.title: v10.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v10.5.1, bug fixes address a remote compaction bug that may mistakenly delete live SST files during cleanup when no keys survive compaction. In v10.5.0, public API changes deprecate skip_checking_sst_file_sizes_on_db_open, add GetTtl API to TTL DB. Behavior changes make PessimisticTransaction::GetWaitingTxns return info even after timeout, add GetFileSize to FSRandomAccessFile, and trigger compactions every 12 hours. Bug fixes address BackupEngine crash, DB::NewMultiScan iterator respecting scan upper bound, and performance improvements for MultiScan I/O coalescing and prefetching.

chunks.title: v10.6.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v10.6.2, bug fixes address a race condition in FIFO size-based compaction. In v10.6.1, new features add fail_if_no_udi_on_open and MultiScanArgs::max_prefetch_size. In v10.6.0, new features introduce cf_allow_ingest_behind, MultiScanArgs::io_coalesce_threshold. Public API changes allow any DB generated SST file ingestion, make decouple_partitioned_filters default true, add GetTtl to TTL DB, require LZ4 1.7.0, change Compressor APIs, and add Filesystem::SyncFile. Behavior changes preserve tombstones when allow_ingest_behind is enabled. Bug fixes address dropped CF files in GetFileChecksumsFromCurrentManifest, MultiScan fallback with dictionary compression, iterator Prepare crash, MultiScan incorrect results across files, remote compaction live SST deletion, user defined index configuration, and UDI key format consistency. Performance improvements enhance compression CPU efficiency, especially LZ4HC.

chunks.title: v10.7.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v10.7.5, bug fixes address a bug in Page unpinning in MultiScan. In v10.7.4, public API changes update MultiScan API contract. In v10.7.3, bug fixes address a few bugs in MultiScan. In v10.7.2, bug fixes address incorrect MultiScan seek error status and performance regression in LZ4 compression. In v10.7.0, new features include fail_if_no_udi_on_open, memtable_verify_per_key_checksum_on_seek, MultiScanArgs::use_async_io, max_prefetch_size, and improved sst_dump. Public API changes make HyperClockCache production-ready, require C++20, and change MultiScanArgs constructor. Behavior changes make HyperClockCache default, allow UDIs with non-BytewiseComparator. Bug fixes address compaction/flush CPU usage reporting, FIFO size-based compaction race, MultiScan with UDI empty range, and performance improvements with smallest seqno table property and PerKeyPointLockManager.

chunks.title: v10.8.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v10.8.3, new features add GetColumnFamilyMetaData API variant for key range. In v10.8.2, new features add auto-tuning for manifest file size and allow_trivial_move in CompactionOptions. In v10.8.1, behavior changes make PosixWritableFile reposition seek pointer after Truncate. In v10.8.0, new features add kFSPrefetch and resumable compaction. Public API changes allow specifying output temperature in CompactionOptions, add DB::FlushWAL with FlushWALOptions, and update MultiScan API contract. Behavior changes make kChangeTemperature FIFO compaction honor compaction_target_temp and allow UDIs with non-BytewiseComparator. Bug fixes address MultiScan seek error, Page unpinning, and LZ4 performance regression.

chunks.title: v10.9.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v10.9.1, bug fixes address resumable compaction incorrectly allowing resumption from truncated range deletion. In v10.9.0, new features add auto-tuning for manifest file size, option migration for multiple CFs, target_file_size_is_upper_bound, and allow_trivial_move. Public API changes remove ROCKSDB_USING_THREAD_STATUS from public headers. Behavior changes make PosixWritableFile reposition seek pointer after Truncate and update standalone range deletion L0 file compaction. Bug fixes address compaction with range deletion persisting kTypeMaxValid, GetSortedWalFiles hang, MultiScan max_sequential_skip_in_iterations issue, and WAL_ttl_seconds incorrect deletion. Performance improvements add asynchronous prefetching for multiscan iterator.

chunks.title: v8.11.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v8.11.5, behavior changes backport new value types kTypeValuePreferredSeqno and kTypeColumnFamilyValuePreferredSeqno introduced in RocksDB 9.1 to fix forward compatibility for reading MANIFEST with kTypeMaxValid entries written by RocksDB 9.1+.

chunks.title: v10.10.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v10.10.1, bug fixes address a use-after-free crash in best-efforts recovery, resumable compaction with truncated range deletion, PosixRandomFileAccess IO uring submission queue ownership, and Windows VS 2022 build errors.

chunks.title: v11.0.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v11.0.4, public API changes re-remove deprecated DB::Open raw pointer variants. In v11.0.3, public API changes relax option sanitization for kv ratio compaction. In v11.0.2, public API changes revert removing deprecated DB::Open raw pointer variants. In v11.0.0, new features include wide-column entity column values in blob files, CompactionOptionsFIFO::max_data_files_size and use_kv_ratio_compaction, and interpolation search index_block_search_type. Public API changes add AbortAllCompactions/ResumeAllCompactions, drop support for format_version < 2, remove deprecated DB::Open raw pointer variants, MaxMemCompactionLevel, CompressedSecondaryCacheOptions::compress_format_version, skip_checking_sst_file_sizes_on_db_open, SliceTransform::InRange, and various deprecated APIs. Behavior changes set reduce_file_locking default to true. Bug fixes address range deletion issues, WritePrepared/WriteUnprepared sequence number corruption, and performance improvements with separate_key_value_in_data_block.

chunks.title: RocksDB 11.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release v11.1.1, public API changes modify ExternalTableReader::Get/MultiGet to use PinnableSlice, add SstFileReader::Get/MultiGet overloads with PinnableSlice, and add block_decompress_count to PerfContext. Bug fixes address a memory accounting leak in IODispatcher. In v11.1.0, new features include open_files_async, kAuto index block search type, enforce_write_buffer_manager_during_recovery, memtable_batch_lookup_optimization, PrepopulateBlockCache::kFlushAndCompaction, and verify_manifest_content_on_close. Behavior changes factor re-seeks and next/prev into num_reads_sampled, and skip WAL recovery for remote compaction workers. Bug fixes address round-robin compaction missing input files.

questions.query_text: In the facebook/rocksdb releases, which release introduces the `CompactForTieringCollectorFactory` to auto trigger compaction for tiering use case?

answer_support.answer_text: Added a CompactForTieringCollectorFactory to auto trigger compaction for tiering use case.

questions.query_text: Across the facebook/rocksdb releases, how does the handling of obsolete blob files differ between v9.6.2 and v9.7.4?

options.text: v9.6.2 fixes a leak of obsolete blob files left open until DB::Close, while v9.7.4 also fixes the same leak but additionally preserves OPTIONS file for remote worker.
v9.6.2 introduces blob file garbage collection, while v9.7.4 removes blob file support entirely.
v9.6.2 only addresses blob file leaks in best-efforts recovery, while v9.7.4 addresses them in all scenarios.
v9.6.2 does not mention blob files, while v9.7.4 adds blob file compression.

questions.expected_answer: v9.6.2 fixes a leak of obsolete blob files left open until DB::Close, while v9.7.4 also fixes the same leak but additionally preserves OPTIONS file for remote worker.

answer_support.answer_text: Fix a leak of obsolete blob files left open until DB::Close(). This bug was introduced in version 9.4.0.

Fix a leak of obsolete blob files left open until DB::Close(). This bug was introduced in version 9.4.0. ... OPTIONS file to be loaded by remote worker is now preserved so that it does not get purged by the primary host.

questions.query_text: In the facebook/rocksdb release window, order the following release-content states from earliest to latest: (1) a release that introduces `TransactionOptions::commit_bypass_memtable`, (2) a release that adds `TransactionDBOptions::txn_commit_bypass_memtable_threshold`, (3) a release that sets `TransactionOptions::large_txn_commit_optimize_threshold` default to 0 and makes `txn_commit_bypass_memtable_threshold` have no effect, (4) a release that adds `TransactionOptions::large_txn_commit_optimize_byte_threshold`.

answer_support.answer_text: Introduce TransactionOptions::commit_bypass_memtable to enable transaction commit to bypass memtable insertions.

Added new TransactionDBOptions::txn_commit_bypass_memtable_threshold, which enables optimized transaction commit (see TransactionOptions::commit_bypass_memtable) when the transaction size exceeds a configured threshold.
TransactionOptions::large_txn_commit_optimize_threshold now has default value 0 for disabled. TransactionDBOptions::txn_commit_bypass_memtable_threshold now has no effect on transactions.
Add new experimental TransactionOptions::large_txn_commit_optimize_byte_threshold to enable optimizations for large transaction commit by transaction batch data size.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release evolution of farion1231/cc-switch, covering major feature introductions, architectural upgrades, and stability improvements from v3.6.0 through v3.16.1.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.6.0, the project introduces a major architecture refactoring with enhanced config sync and data protection. New features include Edit Mode & Provider Management with provider duplication, manual sorting, and edit mode toggle; Custom Endpoint Management with multi-endpoint configuration; Usage Query Enhancements with auto-refresh interval, test script API, and enhanced templates; Custom Configuration Directory (Cloud Sync) with customizable storage location and cloud sync support; Configuration Directory Switching (WSL Support) with auto-sync on directory change; Configuration Editor Improvements with JSON format button and real-time TOML validation; Load Live Config When Editing to protect manual modifications; Claude Configuration Data Structure Enhancements with granular model configuration, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY support, template variable system, endpoint candidates, and visual theme configuration; updated provider models including Kimi k2; and new provider presets for DMXAPI, Azure Codex, and others.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.6.1, the focus is on stability improvements and user experience optimization based on v3.6.0. New features include Usage Query System Enhancements with credential decoupling, UI component upgrade, form unification, and password visibility toggle; Form Validation Infrastructure with common schema library and MCP conditional field validation; and Partner Integration with PackyCode. Improvements cover drag sort sync, enhanced error notifications, removed misleading placeholders, auto-fill base URL, CJK quote normalization, and preserve custom fields. Bug fixes address usage script panel white screen crash, CJK input quote parsing failure, drag sort tray desync, MCP custom field loss, and error isolation.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.6.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.6.2, the release introduces new providers: Kimi for Coding and Bailing. It also includes the stability improvements and user experience optimizations from v3.6.1, such as usage query system enhancements, form validation infrastructure, partner integration with PackyCode, drag sort sync, enhanced error notifications, removed misleading placeholders, auto-fill base URL, CJK quote normalization, preserve custom fields, and critical bug fixes for usage script panel crash, CJK input quote parsing, drag sort tray desync, MCP custom field loss, and error isolation.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.7.0, the project evolves from a provider switcher to an all-in-one AI CLI management platform. Major new features include Gemini CLI Integration with dual-file configuration, auto-detection, full MCP support, deep link integration, and system tray; MCP v3.7.0 Unified Architecture with unified panel, SSE transport, smart parser, format correction, and extended fields; Claude Skills Management System with GitHub integration, lifecycle management, and technical architecture; Prompts Management System with multi-preset management, cross-app support, Markdown editor, and smart synchronization; and other enhancements.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.7.1, the release provides stability enhancements and user experience improvements. Bug fixes include fixing third-party skills installation failure, Gemini configuration persistence issue, and preventing dialogs from closing on overlay click. New features include Gemini configuration directory support and ArchLinux installation support. Improvements cover skills error message i18n enhancement and code formatting. The release also includes the complete v3.7.0 release notes.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.8.0, the project undergoes a persistence architecture upgrade, migrating from single JSON file storage to SQLite + JSON dual-layer architecture for hierarchical data management. Major updates include a brand new user interface with redesigned layout, unified component styles, smoother animations, and optimized visual hierarchy; Japanese language support; skills recursive scanning; and other improvements. The release lays the foundation for future cloud sync and local proxy features.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.8.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.8.1, the release includes bug fixes for Linux scroll wheel issue, Codex config updates, MiniMax URL corrections, and UI style fixes. Refactoring includes MCP modularization, URL handling improvement, and dead code removal. The release also includes the complete v3.8.0 release notes.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.8.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.8.2, the changes include fixing provider card hover scale animation being clipped and updating DeepSeek default model from experimental to stable version. The release also includes the complete v3.8.1 and v3.8.0 release notes.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.9.0-1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.9.0-1, this is a test version that warns users to back up the database before running. It introduces proxy functionality with a usage guide, but notes that official providers cannot be proxied yet.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.9.0-2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.9.0-2, this test version adds new provider icons for OpenRouter, LongCat, ModelScope, AiHubMix. Bug fixes include Claude config sync, proxy orphan state, SQL import, SQL import restriction, Windows window, and about page UI. Refactoring includes OpenRouter passthrough mode and removal of proxy global auto-start. Style optimization unifies header styles. Users are warned to back up the database before running.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.8.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.8.3, the release adds macOS tray template icon, AiGoCode partner, skip first-run confirmation, DMXAPI partner, and provider icons. Fixes include UI header layout, dark mode visibility, Azure link, skill installation, SQL import refresh, and MCP sync safety. Changes include model versions, provider switch notification, SQL import restriction, and GLM partner images. The release also includes the complete v3.8.2, v3.8.1, and v3.8.0 release notes.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.9.0-3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.9.0-3, this test version adds Universal Provider configuration support, auto failover main switch, provider search filter, keyboard shortcut for settings, Xiaomi MiMo icon and provider config, usage statistics model info extraction, skip Claude Code first-run confirmation option, and panel switch fade animation. Bug fixes include Windows MCP export compatibility, version check terminal popup, macOS auto-start path, dialog/modal first click, dark mode form label contrast, header layout shift, usage statistics timezone, MCP sync invalid Codex config, and proxy_config migration compatibility. Improvements include macOS tray template icon, titlebar dye removal, and i18n completion. Users are warned to back up the database before running.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.9.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.9.0, the stable release of the v3.9 beta series introduces a local API proxy with per-app takeover, automatic failover with circuit breaker, universal providers, skills improvements, common config snippets, MCP import, usage improvements, and Linux packaging. Major features include Local API Proxy, Auto Failover, Skills Management, Universal Provider, Common Config Snippets, and MCP Management.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.9.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.9.1, bug fixes address panic/crash fixes including proxy port conflict, UTF-8 boundary panics, unwrap/expect replacements, and SOCKS proxy support. Other fixes include Windows window title, presets rename, and new features like crash logging and AiGoCode icon. CI/Build temporarily removes Flatpak build. The release also includes the complete v3.9.0 release notes.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.10.0, the project introduces OpenCode support as the fourth managed CLI application, along with global proxy settings, Claude Rectifier (thinking signature fixer), enhanced health checks, per-provider configuration, app visibility control, takeover compact mode, terminal improvements, WSL tool detection, and skills preset enhancements. Main features include OpenCode Support, Global Proxy, Claude Rectifier, Enhanced Health Checks, Per-Provider Config, App Visibility Control, Takeover Compact Mode, Terminal Improvements, WSL Tool Detection, and Skills Preset Enhancements.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.10.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.10.1, this patch release adds provider icons, changes proxy rectifier default to disabled, reorders window settings, increases app icon collapse threshold, and simplifies RectifierConfig. Fixes include Windows platform terminal window closing, OpenCode config path, ProviderIcon color validation, layout padding, and panel content alignment. The release also includes the complete v3.10.0 release notes.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.10.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.10.2, this patch release adds skill sync method setting with symlink/copy options and RightCode as official partner. Fixes include prompts clear, OpenCode extra model fields, and provider form backfill. The release also includes the complete v3.10.1 and v3.10.0 release notes.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.10.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.10.3, this feature release adds API Format Selector, API Format Presets, Pricing Config Enhancement, Skills ZIP Install, Preferred Terminal, Silent Startup, OpenCode API Key Link, OpenCode Environment Check, OpenCode Directory Sync, AICodeMirror Partner Preset, NVIDIA NIM Preset, n1n.ai Preset, and Linux ARM64 support. Changes include API Format Migration, DeepSeek max_tokens removal, terminal functions consolidation, home dir utility, Kimi/Moonshot upgrade, and update badge icon. Fixes address Codex 404 & Timeout, Proxy URL Building, OpenRouter Compat Mode, Gemini Visibility, Footer Layout, Claude Code Detection, Tray Menu, Duplicate Skills, Windows Tests, i18n, and Error Display. The release also includes the complete v3.10.2, v3.10.1, and v3.10.0 release notes.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.11.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.11.0, this major update adds full management support for OpenClaw as the fifth application, introduces a new Session Manager and Backup Management feature, Oh My OpenCode (OMO) integration, partial key-field merging architecture upgrade for provider switching, settings page refactoring, 6 new provider presets, thinking budget rectifier, theme switch animation, and WebDAV auto sync. Main features include OpenClaw Support, Session Manager, Backup Management, Oh My OpenCode Integration, Partial Key-Field Merging, Settings Page Refactoring, New Provider Presets, Thinking Budget Rectifier, Theme Switch Animation, and WebDAV Auto Sync.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.11.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.11.1, this hotfix release reverts the Partial Key-Field Merging architecture introduced in v3.11.0, restoring the full config overwrite + Common Config Snippet mechanism. Highlights include restoring full config overwrite, proxy panel improvements, theme & compact mode fixes, and Windows compatibility. Changes include proxy panel layout, manual import for OpenCode/OpenClaw. Fixes address 'Follow System' theme, compact mode exit, proxy takeover toast, and Windows protocol handler side effects. The release also includes the complete v3.11.0 release notes.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.12.0, this feature release focuses on provider compatibility, OpenClaw editing, Common Config usability, and sync/data reliability. It restores the Model Health Check (Stream Check) UI, adds OpenAI Responses API format conversion, expands provider presets for Ucloud, Micu, X-Code API, Novita, and Bailian For Coding, and upgrades WebDAV sync with dual-layer versioning. Main features include Model Health Check, OpenAI Responses API, Bedrock Request Optimizer, OpenClaw Config Enhancements, Provider Presets, and Common Config usability improvements.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.12.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.12.1, this patch release focuses on stability improvements and bug fixes. It resolves a Common Config modal infinite reopen loop, a WebDAV sync foreign key constraint failure, and several i18n interpolation issues. It also adds StepFun provider presets, OpenClaw input type selection and authHeader support, upgrades the default Gemini model to 3.1-pro, and welcomes four new sponsor partners. New features include StepFun Provider Presets, OpenClaw Enhancements, and Sponsor Partners. Changes include UCloud to Compshare rename, Compshare Links, and Gemini Model Upgrade. Bug fixes cover Common Config & UI, Sync & Data, Provider & Preset, and i18n & Localization.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.12.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.12.2, this reliability-focused patch release addresses Common Config loss during proxy takeover and improves Codex TOML editing accuracy. Highlights include empty state guidance, proxy takeover restore flow rework, snippet lifecycle stability, section-aware Codex TOML editing, and Codex MCP config protection. New features include Empty State Guidance. Changes include Proxy Takeover Restore Flow, Codex TOML Editing Engine, and Common Config Initialization Lifecycle. Bug fixes cover Common Config Loss and other issues.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.12.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.12.3, this major feature release adds GitHub Copilot reverse proxy support with a dedicated Auth Center, introduces macOS code signing and Apple notarization, maps reasoning effort levels across providers, migrates OpenCode to a SQLite backend, enables Tool Search via native environment variable toggle, and delivers a full skill backup/restore lifecycle. Additional improvements include proxy gzip compression, o-series model compatibility, Skills import rework, Ghostty terminal fix, Skills cache strategy optimization, Claude 4.6 context window update, and multiple bug fixes. New features include GitHub Copilot Reverse Proxy, Copilot Auth Center, macOS Code Signing & Notarization, Reasoning Effort Mapping, OpenCode SQLite Backend, Codex 1M Context Window Toggle, Disable Auto-Upgrade Toggle, Tool Search Env Var Toggle, Skill Backup/Restore Lifecycle, Proxy Gzip Compression, o-series Model Compatibility, Skills Import Rework, and Ghostty Terminal Support.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.13.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.13.0, this major feature release is centered on observability, provider workflow ergonomics, and proxy compatibility. It adds inline quota and balance displays, introduces a Lightweight Mode, delivers automatic model discovery via OpenAI-compatible /v1/models, ships a Codex OAuth reverse proxy, reorganizes the tray menu into per-app submenus, rebuilds the proxy forwarding stack on a Hyper-based client, and overhauls the Skills workflow. Additional improvements include full URL endpoint mode, enhanced token usage tracking, the Copilot interaction optimizer, a UTF-8 streaming chunk boundary fix, a Linux startup UI responsiveness fix, and a friendlier new-user onboarding experience. Highlights include Lightweight Mode, Quota & Balance Visibility, Provider Model Auto-Fetch, Codex OAuth Reverse Proxy, Tray Per-App Submenus, Skills Discovery & Batch Updates, Session Workflow Upgrades, OpenCode / OpenClaw Stream Check Coverage, Full URL Endpoint Mode, and Hyper-based Proxy Forwarding Stack.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.14.0, this major release centers on onboarding Hermes Agent as the 6th first-class managed app and rolling out Claude Opus 4.7 across the full aggregator and Bedrock preset matrix. Hermes support covers database migration, Rust command surface, YAML config read/write, MCP sync, Skills sync, session management, and dedicated frontend panels. Beyond Hermes, this release adds a Gemini Native API proxy, renames Local Proxy Takeover to Local Routing, introduces application-level window controls, and bundles late additions for launching hermes dashboard, a LemonData preset, a DDSHub Codex endpoint, plus several Hermes health-check and Usage modal fixes. On the session side, the message list is virtualized, the Usage dashboard adds a date range picker and page-jump input, Stream Check error classification is improved, and switching to official providers is blocked while Local Routing is active. The pricing database is reseeded with new model entries. Highlights include Hermes Agent Support, Claude Opus 4.7 Rollout, Claude max Effort Tier, Gemini Native API Proxy, GitHub Copilot Enterprise Server, and other improvements.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.14.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.14.1, this patch release focuses on Codex OAuth reverse-proxy stability, tray usage visibility, Skills import/install reliability, Gemini session restore paths, and simplifying Hermes configuration health handling. For the first time, the system tray surfaces cached usage for the current Claude/Codex/Gemini provider directly in its submenus. Several Codex OAuth reverse-proxy stability issues are addressed. Additionally, the in-app Hermes config health scanner and its warning banner are removed. Highlights include Tray Usage Visibility, Tray Coding-Plan Usage, Codex OAuth FAST Mode, Codex OAuth Stability, Hermes Config Health Scanner Removed, and Skills Import/Install Reliability.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.15.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.15.0, this major release promotes Claude Desktop to a first-class managed surface. It ships third-party provider switching through the in-app proxy gateway, role-based model mapping with a long-context flag, Copilot/Codex OAuth provider reuse, a redesigned Claude Code import flow, app-switcher differentiation, and 44 provider presets translated from the Claude Code catalog. Around proxy reliability, this release performs a systematic hardening pass with P0–P3 patches, pooled HTTPS connection reuse, cache hit-rate improvements, correct tool_choice mapping, Vertex AI full URLs, Gemini request model extraction, takeover detection tightening, and IPv6 listen addresses. Other highlights include Claude Desktop Guide, proxy reliability hardening, and other improvements.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.16.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.16.0, this major release makes third-party Codex providers first-class citizens through Chat Completions routing. It converts Codex Responses requests to Chat Completions and rebuilds responses, preserving reasoning, tool calls, and state. It unifies and hardens Codex third-party provider identity and history, adds in-app managed CLI tool lifecycle, refreshes provider ecosystem and model matrix with new presets and model upgrades to Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5, and includes usage observability, Traditional Chinese localization, documentation, and proxy/format conversion robustness improvements. Highlights include Codex Chat Completions Routing, Codex Third-Party Provider Identity and History Unification, Managed CLI Tool Management, and other improvements.

chunks.title: CC Switch v3.16.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the farion1231/cc-switch release v3.16.1, this Codex stability patch adds a toggle for Codex enhancement mode (default off) to allow using third-party APIs while retaining Codex remote operations and official plugins. It includes stability fixes for Codex OAuth and third-party provider switching, Codex model catalog clearing, Codex Chat tool/plugin routing recovery, local routing takeover and hot-switch stability, and diagnostics/platform compatibility fixes. New features include Codex Official Auth Preservation Setting and Codex DeepSeek Routing Guide. Changes include Codex Auth Preservation default opt-in, Codex restart prompt after provider switch, and serialization of provider switch and takeover toggle.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent fastapi/fastapi release stream from 0.127.0 through 0.136.3, covering breaking changes like dropping pydantic.v1 and Python 3.9 support, new features such as JSON serialization with Pydantic and Server Sent Events, and internal refactors.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.127.0, the project adds deprecation warnings when using pydantic.v1, adds LLM prompt files for Korean and Japanese translations, and upgrades the OpenAI model for translations to gpt-5.2.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.127.1, the project adds a custom FastAPIDeprecationWarning, adds a documentary to the website, updates German translations, updates pre-commit to use local Ruff, adds missing tests for code examples, removes the lint job from the test CI workflow, updates secrets check, runs CodSpeed tests in parallel, and updates scripts and pre-commit to autofix files.
In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.128.0, the project drops support for pydantic.v1 and runs performance tests only on Pydantic v2.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.128.1, the project adds a viewport meta tag to improve Swagger UI on mobile devices, improves error messages for invalid query parameter type annotations, updates the ValidationError schema to include input and ctx, fixes TYPE_CHECKING annotations for Python 3.14, strips whitespaces from Authorization header credentials, fixes OpenAPI duplication of anyOf refs, tweaks types for mypy, re-exports IncEx from Pydantic, updates comments for Pydantic internals, and makes numerous documentation updates including fixing a copy button, adding contribution instructions, and updating embedded code examples to Python 3.10 syntax.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.128.2, the project adds support for PEP695 TypeAliasType, allows Response type hint as dependency annotation, fixes using Json[list[str]] type, updates docs for translations, fixes a duplicate word in advanced-dependencies.md, enables Traditional Chinese and French docs translations, updates translations for multiple languages, and adds max pages to translate to configs.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.128.3, the project re-implements on_event in FastAPI for compatibility with the next Starlette while keeping backwards compatibility, upgrades Starlette supported version range to starlette>=0.40.0,<1.0.0, updates Russian translations, runs tests with Starlette from git, and runs tests with lower bound uv sync while upgrading minimum dependencies for ujson and orjson.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.128.4, the project refactors internals to simplify Pydantic v2/v1 utils, create_model_field, and lenient_issubclass, removes Pydantic v1 only logic, cleans up unneeded Pydantic v1 specific logic, updates French and Turkish translations, and upgrades development dependencies.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.128.5, the project refactors and simplifies Pydantic v2 and v1 compatibility internal utils, and adds inline snapshot tests for OpenAPI before changes from Pydantic v2.
In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.128.6, the project fixes on_startup and on_shutdown parameters of APIRouter, updates Chinese translations, and fixes parameterized tests with snapshots.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.128.7, the project shows a clear error on attempt to include router into itself, replaces dict by Mapping on HTTPException.headers, simplifies reading files in memory sequentially, uses dfn tag for definitions instead of abbr in docs, tweaks a comment in test, updates LLM-prompt for abbr and dfn tags, tests order for submitted byte Files, and configures test workflow to run tests with inline-snapshot=review.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.128.8, the project fixes grammar in first-steps.md, tweaks PDM hook script, and updates build setup for fastapi-slim, deprecating it and making it only depend on fastapi.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.129.0, the project drops support for Python 3.9, updates internal types for Python 3.10, updates highlights in webhooks docs, updates source examples and docs from Python 3.9 to 3.10, and updates docs.py scripts to migrate Python 3.9 to Python 3.10.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.129.1, the project fixes JSON Schema for bytes to use contentMediaType application/octet-stream instead of format binary, adds Kapa.ai widget, removes Python 3.9 specific files, updates docs for JWT to prevent timing attacks, fixes typos in Russian translations, updates translations for multiple languages, always runs tests on push to master and by scheduler, upgrades typing syntax for Python 3.10, and bumps cryptography and pillow dependencies.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.129.2, the project upgrades pytest, fixes CI to not attempt to publish fastapi-slim, drops support for fastapi-slim, and updates pyproject.toml removing unneeded lines.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.130.0, the project adds serialization of JSON response with Pydantic in Rust when there is a Pydantic return type or response model, resulting in 2x or more performance increase for JSON responses, and adds new docs on Custom Response - JSON Performance.
In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.131.0, the project deprecates ORJSONResponse and UJSONResponse.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.132.0, the project adds strict_content_type checking for JSON requests, rejecting requests without a valid Content-Type header by default, with an option to disable it, bumps flask dependency, updates all dependencies to use griffelib instead of griffe, fixes FastAPI People workflow, and stops running codspeed with coverage and excludes benchmark tests from coverage.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.132.1, the project refactors logic to handle OpenAPI and Swagger UI escaping data, updates FastAPI People - Experts, and allows skipping benchmark job in test workflow.
In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.133.0, the project adds support for Starlette 1.0.0+.
In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.133.1, the project adds FastAPI Agent Skill and fixes all tests skipped on Windows.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.134.0, the project adds support for streaming JSON Lines and binary data with yield, upgrades Starlette to >=0.46.0, adds new docs for Stream JSON Lines and Stream Data, updates Library Agent Skill with streaming responses, updates docs for responses and new stream with yield, adds await in StreamingResponse code example, renames docs_src/websockets to avoid import errors, and runs tests with pytest-xdist and pytest-cov.
In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.135.0, the project adds support for Server Sent Events and new docs for Server-Sent Events (SSE).

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.135.1, the project fixes yield from a TaskGroup to only be used as an async context manager closed in the request async exit stack, fixes a typo in docs, updates Skill to optimize context, and updates FastAPI People and GitHub topic repositories.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.135.2, the project increases lower bound to pydantic >=2.9.0 and fixes the test suite, adds missing last release notes dates, updates docs for contributors and team members regarding translation PRs, fixes code blocks in reference docs overflowing table width, fixes duplicated words in docstrings, adds docs for pyproject.toml with entrypoint, updates links in docs to no longer use external-link and internal-link classes, adds JS and CSS handling for automatic target=_blank for links, updates styles for internal and external links in new tab, adds documentation for the FastAPI VS Code extension, fixes docstrings for max_digits and decimal_places, adds dates to release notes, and updates translations for multiple languages.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.135.3, the project adds support for @app.vibe(), adds new docs for Vibe Coding, fixes a typo for client_secret in OAuth2 form docstrings, updates FastAPI People - Experts, bumps orjson, ruff, fastmcp, and requests dependencies, updates FastAPI GitHub topic repositories, and adds ty check to lint.sh.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.135.4, the project removes the April Fool's @app.vibe(), bumps cryptography and strawberry-graphql dependencies, and adds a pre-commit hook to ensure latest release header has date.
In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.136.0, the project adds support for free-threaded Python 3.14t.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.136.1, the project updates Pydantic v2 code to address deprecations, tweaks translation script, and bumps numerous dependencies including mkdocs-material, inline-snapshot, pytest-codspeed, pytest-cov, cloudflare/wrangler-action, mypy, python-dotenv, starlette, pygithub, pyjwt, zizmor, strawberry-graphql, python-multipart, authlib, aiohttp, pygments, pymdown-extensions, pillow, pytest, actions/upload-artifact, and actions/cache, and updates sponsors by removing Zuplo.

In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.136.2, the project validates Server Sent Event fields to avoid broken data, documents --entrypoint CLI option, updates and simplifies docs about help and management, adds docs references to central contributing docs, updates security policy, updates sponsors image, simplifies usage of admonitions, fixes image URLs in index.md, fixes a spelling typo, improves layout and styling, refactors opinions section with interactive tabs and new logos, adds FastAPI Conf '26 announcement, improves translation consistency in Portuguese docs, and updates translations for multiple languages.
In the fastapi/fastapi release 0.136.3, the project stops accepting underscore headers when using convert_underscores=True (the default).

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent fastlane/fastlane release stream from version 2.215.1 through 2.235.0, covering workarounds for Google Play API instability, match GitLab storage fixes, numerous improvements across tools like spaceship, deliver, gym, scan, and match, Apple authentication updates, and support for new Apple platforms and Xcode versions.

chunks.title: 2.215.1 Workaround for Google Play API instability
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fastlane/fastlane release 2.215.1, a new SUPPLY_UPLOAD_MAX_RETRIES environment variable is added to supply to help work around failed Google Play API calls.

chunks.title: 2.216.0 Fix for match GitLab storage

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent fatedier/frp release stream from v0.51.3 through v0.69.1, covering configuration format changes, new proxy types, plugin additions, dashboard improvements, and protocol evolution.

chunks.title: v0.51.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.51.3, the project adds support for Go 1.21.

chunks.title: v0.52.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.52.0, configuration now supports TOML, YAML, and JSON formats, while INI is deprecated and will be removed in future releases. New features will only be available in TOML, YAML, or JSON. The way to start the visitor through the command line changes from `frpc stcp --role=visitor xxx` to `frpc stcp visitor xxx`. The semantics of `server_addr` in the command line are modified to no longer include the port, and a `server_port` parameter is added. Range ports mapping is no longer supported in TOML/YAML/JSON.

chunks.title: v0.52.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.52.1, fixes include: `transport.tls.disableCustomTLSFirstByte` not having any effect, the Server API not returning data correctly, the Dashboard being unable to display data, and `natHoleStunServer` missing a default value.

chunks.title: v0.52.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.52.2, a fix addresses encryption and compression not being displayed correctly in the dashboard.

chunks.title: v0.52.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.52.3, a fix ensures `admin_user` is effective in the INI configuration.

chunks.title: v0.53.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.53.0, a new command line parameter `--strict_config` enables strict configuration validation mode, throwing an error for unknown fields. SSH reverse tunneling is supported, allowing local service exposure without running frpc, using only SSH, with limitations compared to frpc. The frpc tcpmux command line parameters support configuring `http_user` and `http_pwd`. The frpc stcp/sudp/xtcp command line parameters support configuring `allow_users`. Fixes include frpc returning code 1 when the first login attempt fails and exits, and an unresponsiveness issue when OIDC auth with HeartBeats scope fails to obtain an AccessToken.

chunks.title: v0.53.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.53.2, a fix addresses a panic in frpc during login due to closing a closed channel.

chunks.title: v0.54.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.54.0, using an underscore in a flag name is deprecated and replaced by a hyphen, e.g., `--remote_port` becomes `--remote-port`. The frps Dashboard adds `Refresh` and `ClearOfflineProxies` buttons. Host/domain matching in routing rules becomes case-insensitive.

chunks.title: v0.55.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.55.0, the minimum supported Go version is updated to 1.22, changing the default minimum TLS version to 1.2. The default value of `--strict-config` changes from false to true, causing errors for unknown or misspelled configuration items. Proxies support configuring annotations, which are displayed in the frps dashboard. Dependencies on forked kcp-go and beego log are removed, using upstream kcp-go and golib/log instead.

chunks.title: v0.55.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.55.1, there are no feature changes; it only fixes the issue of missing released assets in version 0.55.0.

chunks.title: v0.56.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.56.0, range ports mapping is supported in TOML/YAML/JSON configuration files using go template syntax. Health check supports custom request headers. Compatibility mode for Android is enabled to fix incorrect log time due to time zone problems and default DNS resolution failures. Fixes include incorrect interval time for rotating the log by day and disabling quic-go's ECN support by default due to issues on certain operating systems.

chunks.title: v0.57.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.57.0, the `https2http` and `https2https` plugins now support the `X-Forwarded-For` header. The `X-Forwarded-For` header is now correctly set in requests to the backend server for proxy type http.

chunks.title: v0.58.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.58.0, the heartbeat mechanism is optimized when tcpmux is enabled, with the default `heartbeatInterval` adjusted to -1 to avoid additional heartbeats. Compatibility issues may arise with frps versions older than v0.39.0; setting `heartbeatInterval` to 30 can help. Tcpmux proxies are now shown on the frps dashboard. HTTP proxy can modify response headers, e.g., `responseHeaders.set.foo = "bar"`. HTTP proxy requests that time out now return 504 instead of 404.

chunks.title: v0.58.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.58.1, fixes include HTTP/2 not being enabled for https2http and https2https plugins, and inconsistent default values of INI configuration parameters compared to other formats. The default value of `transport.tcpMuxKeepaliveInterval` is changed from 60 to 30. On Android, the Google DNS server is used only when the default DNS server cannot be obtained.

chunks.title: v0.59.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.59.0, a new plugin "http2http" is added, forwarding HTTP requests to another HTTP server with options like local address binding, host header rewrite, and custom request headers. An `enableHTTP2` option controls HTTP/2 in plugins https2http and https2https, defaulting to true. Plugins https2http and https2https return 421 Misdirected Request if the host does not match SNI.

chunks.title: v0.60.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.60.0, a new plugin `tls2raw` enables TLS termination and forwarding of decrypted raw traffic to local service. A default timeout of 30 seconds is added for frpc subcommands to prevent commands from being stuck due to network issues. A fix addresses the frpc stop command not working correctly when `loginFailExit = false` and the server is not successfully connected after startup.

chunks.title: v0.61.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.61.0, the frpc visitor command-line parameter adds the `--server-user` option to specify the username of the server-side proxy to connect to. Multiple frpc instances with different subjects are supported when using OIDC authentication.

chunks.title: v0.61.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.61.1, `tzdata` is installed by default in the container image, and the time zone can be set using the `TZ` environment variable. The `quic-bind-port` command line parameter is supported in frps, specifying the port for accepting frpc connections using the QUIC protocol. The vhost HTTP proxy of frps supports the h2c protocol.

chunks.title: v0.61.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.61.2, support is added for metadatas and annotations in frpc proxy commands. A fix properly releases resources in service.Close() to prevent resource leaks when used as a library.

chunks.title: v0.62.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.62.0, Feature Gates are introduced as an experimental mechanism to enable or disable specific experimental features. The first feature gate is `VirtualNet`, enabling experimental Virtual Network functionality (Alpha). VirtualNet allows creating a TUN device managed by frp, enabling Layer 3 connectivity between different clients within the frp network, requiring root/admin privileges and supported on Linux and macOS. Configuration is via the `virtualNet` section and the `virtual_net` plugin.

chunks.title: v0.62.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.62.1, various issues related to connection handling, TUN device management, and stability in the virtual network feature are resolved.

chunks.title: v0.63.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.63.0, YAML merge functionality (anchors and references with dot-prefixed fields) is supported in strict configuration mode without requiring `--strict-config=false`. Proxy protocol is supported in UDP proxies to preserve real client IP addresses.

chunks.title: v0.64.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.64.0, `tokenSource` is supported for loading authentication tokens from files. A fix addresses the SSH tunnel gateway incorrectly binding to proxyBindAddr instead of bindAddr, causing external connections to fail when proxyBindAddr was set to 127.0.0.1.

chunks.title: v0.65.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.65.0, NAT traversal configuration options are added for XTCP proxies and visitors, supporting disabling assisted addresses to avoid slow VPN connections during NAT hole punching. OIDC client configuration is enhanced with support for custom TLS certificate verification and proxy settings, adding `trustedCaFile`, `insecureSkipVerify`, and `proxyURL` options. Detailed Prometheus metrics are added with `proxy_counts_detailed` metric including proxy type and proxy name labels.

chunks.title: v0.66.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.66.0, HTTPS proxies support load balancing groups, allowing multiple HTTPS proxies with the same `loadBalancer.group` and `loadBalancer.groupKey` to share a custom domain and distribute traffic. Individual frpc proxies and visitors accept an `enabled` flag to disable specific entries without relying on the global `start` list. OIDC authentication supports a `tokenSource` field to dynamically obtain tokens from external sources, with `type = "file"` or `type = "exec"` (requiring `--allow-unsafe=TokenSourceExec`). VirtualNet implements intelligent reconnection with exponential backoff. A deadlock issue when TCP connection is closed is fixed.

chunks.title: v0.67.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.67.0, frpc supports a `clientID` option to uniquely identify client instances, with the server dashboard displaying all connected clients with online/offline status, connection history, and metadata. The frp web dashboard is redesigned with a modern UI, dark mode support, and improved navigation. A fix addresses UDP proxy protocol sending header on every packet instead of only the first packet of each session.

chunks.title: v0.68.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.68.0, a built-in `store` capability is added for frpc, including persisted store source, Store CRUD admin APIs with runtime reload, and Store management pages in the frpc web dashboard. Proxy/visitor names are kept as raw config names during completion. A `noweb` build tag allows compiling without frontend assets. Config parsing errors are improved for TOML files. OIDC auth caches the access token and refreshes it before expiry.

chunks.title: v0.68.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.68.1, a fix addresses a configuration-dependent authentication bypass in `type = "http"` proxies when `routeByHTTPUser` is used together with `httpUser` / `httpPassword`. Proxy-style authentication failures now return 407 Proxy Authentication Required.

chunks.title: v0.69.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.69.0, a compatibility policy is introduced: each minor release is supported until there are nine newer minor releases. Wire protocol v2 is introduced as a transition path for future protocol changes, with the default remaining v1. When v2 is enabled, the control channel uses negotiated AEAD encryption after the login handshake. Supported algorithms are xchacha20-poly1305 and aes-256-gcm. Client protocol visibility is added in the frps dashboard and API.

chunks.title: v0.69.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the fatedier/frp release v0.69.1, `transport.wireProtocol = "v2"` now applies to UDP-based proxy payloads, including ordinary UDP and SUDP. SUDP compatibility is improved during mixed wire protocol deployments. XTCP work connection `NatHoleSid` messages follow the selected wire protocol. When enabling v2 for SUDP, both proxy and visitor frpc instances should be upgraded first.
