prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release evolution of files-community/Files, covering major and minor releases from v3.1.1 through v4.1.1. It includes feature additions, bug fixes, and infrastructure updates across the project's development timeline.

chunks.title: v3.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.1.1, the update addresses several crash fixes: a crash when opening the properties window from the home page, a crash when opening the properties window twice, and a crash when pinning an executable file to the start menu. It also includes new Crowdin localization updates.

chunks.title: v3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.2, new features include support for pinning executable shortcuts to start, using File Explorer naming preferences when creating shortcuts, starting tag search from the Details Pane, hiding more options from the context menu, an option to disable auto scroll when navigating up, updating to WinAppSDK 1.4.4, including unindexed items in search results, switching away from GetThumbnailAsync API, setting jfif files as wallpaper, updating cloud status icon for Columns Layout, editing album covers, adding newly created items to Recent Files, and a new List View layout. Numerous fixes address smart extraction, stream API usage, library opening, pinned application execution directory, COM exceptions, file picking for shortcuts, environment variable expansion, thumbnail reloading, new tab opening, folder size calculation, PowerShell command handling, and address bar selection crash.

chunks.title: v3.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.2.1, new features include a notification when the app goes to the background for the first time and a prompt when failing to rename items requiring additional permissions. Fixes address issues with renaming while switching directories, high contrast support in menu flyouts, COMException in HandleLocationItemDroppedAsync, NullReferenceException in InvertSelectionAction, ArgumentException in ContextMenu, untranslated path bar on the home page, small exe icons, InvalidOperationException when removing page from BackStack, NullReferenceException in Item_Opening, NullReferenceException in DirectoryInfoUpdated, and cached icon overlays. Code quality improvements update Windows App SDK to 1.4.5, improve Widget code, update dependencies, refactor IncreaseLayoutSize, improve Git operation performance, differentiate icon size and height, and transition Sidebar and Tabs away from LoadIconFromPathAsync.

chunks.title: v3.2.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.2.2, fixes address a crash when clicking an item in the Tags widget, a crash when navigating folders continuously in a short period, a COMException loop due to notification generation failure, an ArgumentException when a wrong color is specified, and an InvalidOperationException in ColumnsLayoutPage. It also includes new Crowdin localization updates.

chunks.title: v3.2.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.2.3, the update services the update pipeline for the sideload version.

chunks.title: v3.2.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.2.4, this version is only for the sideload version of Files. It updates the deployment pipeline, requiring users to uninstall and reinstall the sideload version.

chunks.title: v3.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.3, new features include a slider to control item size, icon sizes in the layout flyout, updated layout size selection state, tooltips on the Layout Picker, updated layout icons in the toolbar, simplified 'Layout' string, a new 'Layout' settings page, a header on the home page, renaming 'Favorites' to 'Pinned', shimmer animation when loading icons, restoring tabs when the process is closed incorrectly, a Discord link on the About page, support for opening and extracting mrpack files, and removal of the web shortcut icon placeholder. Fixes address DPI settings for icons, SocketException in GitHelpers, NullReferenceException in Item_Opening, CloseTab, ShareItemsAsync, and DuplicateSelectedTabAction, item selection in List View, pin/unpin string display, copy/paste from archives, hash calculation, file property loading, tab restoration from background, Open with and Send to submenus in Widgets, network share credential prompts, tab list saving, localization in Layout Picker, and more.

chunks.title: v3.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.4, new features include support for personalizing Files with a custom background image, remapping keyboard shortcuts, filtering items by file name, an integration with Listary, localizations for Albanian, Khmer, Kurdish, and Lithuanian, support for multiple SharePoint drives in the sidebar, an integration for the Lucid Link cloud provider, audio bitrate and video properties in the Details Pane, and the Recent Files widget respecting file extension display settings. Improvements include better display of keyboard shortcuts in the Command Palette. Fixes address issues with pinned items not displaying in the sidebar, sort direction not changing on header click, adaptive layout option not disabled when syncing layout settings, sort preference changes not working with synced layout settings, existing tabs duplicating when opening a folder from outside Files, Properties Window navigation after returning from advanced settings, app crash when entering characters into the Address Bar, alignment of the add tab button, Git submenu shown for non-GitHub repos, crash when closing the GitHub login modal, Recycle Bin not pinned to the Sidebar by default, View More and Open All options disabled in the Tags widget, incorrect scroll position, 'Scroll to previous folder' not working in some folders, HWiNFO64.exe not opening, extra animation when changing focus in columns view, app window not refocused if minimized on launch, conflicts dialog not appending numbers when pasting files, renaming in conflict dialog leaving copy status in process, misaligned setting control margin, exporting tags, certain drive icons not loading on the Drive Widget, ftp addresses not displayed in the Address Bar, copying or moving a folder causing empty destination folder contents, insufficient space to right click folders in columns view, wrong item shown as active in the sidebar, Preview Pane freezing when holding arrow key, editing properties of multiple items simultaneously, conflict with svg thumbnails generated by PowerToys, and overlapping brushes leaving a gap in the columns view.

chunks.title: v3.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.4.1, new features include support for displaying all network folders on the sidebar, support for SeerPro's 'Track selected file' setting, a toolbar button to play mkv files, and support for setting tif files as the Background Image. The wording of the 'Files is running as admin' prompt is updated. Fixes address the app not running as admin, a crash when connecting some removable drives, and the 'Actions' string not being localized in the Settings menu.

chunks.title: v3.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.5, the design is updated with rounded corners. New features include an action to switch focus between panes, an 'Edit in notepad' option in the right-click context menu, a setting to configure the 'Open in ide' button on the status bar, support for 'Thin acrylic' system backdrop, support for running AHK files as admin, support for hiding the toolbar, support for displaying total duration when selecting multiple video files, support for closing the left pane in Dual Pane mode, and a network locations widget on the home page. Hovering over items in OneDrive locations displays a tooltip with sync status, and hovering over images displays dimensions in a tooltip. Selecting a batch file shows an 'Edit in Notepad' option on the toolbar. Opening the log location closes the Settings Dialog when Files is the default file manager. Fixes address crashes when two paths are entered from the command line or when ungrouping from zoomed out view, a resize cursor incorrectly shown at titlebar edges when maximized, inability to compress empty folders into an archive, inability to switch between panes using a touch screen, unresponsive text on the Actions page on smaller screens, focus change when quickly switching between tabs, launching programs from the Address Bar, search results stopping after switching tabs, Toolbar display in High Contrast, chevron in Column View not supporting High Contrast, Files logo displayed incorrectly in High Contrast, app crash when changing the theme, certain commands in the Address Bar changing format, Nutstore cloud drive detection, certain keys not mappable to Actions, setting desktop wallpaper on multiple monitors, changing icons when admin access is required, deleting items from zip files, potential crash when locating the Libraries folder, potential crash when clicking items in the Quick Access widget, and potential crash when deleting items.

chunks.title: v3.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.6, new features include support for changing the pane orientation in Dual Pane mode, an 'Actions' menu on the title bar, customizing folder locations with unique background images, localization for Malay, optimized sorting performance for large folders, moving the sidebar toggle button to the address toolbar, a keyboard shortcut to toggle toolbar visibility (Ctrl+Shift+B), a keyboard shortcut to move focus between panes in Dual Pane mode (Ctrl+Shift+Right), support for clicking links when previewing markdown files, and an action to toggle the dot files setting. Fixes address issues with empty tab title when opening a folder in a new tab, wrong sort mode when dragging or opening multiple items, Run with PowerShell not displaying a window, Home Page opening when launched with custom args, layout size change not working with adaptive layout enabled, quick search filtering not cleared when navigating to another folder, non-cached windows having the wrong theme, settings not exported in correct format, double tap to rename being too sensitive, hover to open being too sensitive, cursor not inline when resizing columns in Details View, online files downloaded when loading tooltips, navigation button wrong foreground in disabled state, arguments not passed when running shortcuts as admin, compressing and extracting archives on ARM64 devices, a warning about WSL displaying on startup, position of the 'New item' flyout, crash when updating Files, crash when entering invalid parameters via command line, crash when adding items to the jumplist, and various exceptions including ArgumentNullException, ArgumentException, TypeInitializationException, DirectoryNotFoundException, FileNotFoundException, NullReferenceException, InvalidOperationException, and COMException.

chunks.title: v3.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.7, new features include a setting to hide the System Tray icon, focusing existing tab when opening locations from external process, viewing navigation history when right-clicking back/forward buttons, thumbnails in breadcrumb flyouts, an optional toolbar button to navigate home, customizing CPU threads when creating archives, an action to navigate home, experimental support for flattening folders, removing the loading animation from the home page, holding shift while pressing the properties button to open File Explorer properties window, support for opening the breadcrumb dropdown via keyboard navigation, support for Infomaniak kDrive, and an option to close the active pane from the right-click context menu. Inverted scrolling behavior for icon size adjustment is corrected. Fixes address issues with creating shortcuts for commands, resuming from background not bringing Files to the foreground, context menus not following custom font setting, creating a shortcut to a folder, Google Drive not displayed when mounted as a folder, layout settings not persisting across updates, folders with file extensions treated as files, ejecting drives failing, double-clicking a file navigating up, and opening certain file formats.

chunks.title: v3.7.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.7.6, the user experience for toolbar settings is enhanced, the restriction on opening more than 10 files simultaneously is removed, and translations are updated. Fixes address a NullReferenceException caused by EnableRaisingEvents, an OverflowException in UpdateSelectionSize, a NullReferenceException related to ShellFileOperations2, a crash when opening folders with invalid Git configurations, a crash when closing the main window, and a crash when the Windows Event Log service isn't running.

chunks.title: v3.7.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.7.7, translations are updated, QuickLook support is fixed, and exceptions including InvalidOperationException in GetSystemFilePropertiesAsync and InvalidOperationException in FileTagsContextMenu are fixed.

chunks.title: v3.7.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.7.11, new features include adding the Files icon to the process in Windows, enabling support for typing a custom icon path in the properties window, updated translations, support for renaming multiple items at the same time, improved UX for the 'Create new item' dialog, an option to copy the User ID from the about page, and reduced minimum window dimensions. Fixes address window placement, sorting preferences not saved when changed in Columns Layout, NullReferenceException in BaseTransferItemAction.ExecuteTransferAsync, issues when dragging & dropping items in the sidebar, the Start Menu tile not specifying the branch, and navigating photos on Windows 10.

chunks.title: v3.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the files-community/Files release v3.8, new features include managing tags from the sidebar, freeing up space with the Storage Sense action, creating alternate data streams, copying the path of the current tab, closing all tabs with Ctrl+Shift+W, pasting items from the clipboard as shortcuts, and storing archive creation settings across sessions. The privacy policy URL is updated, and the responsiveness of cards in the drives widget is improved. Fixes address a WSL prompt sometimes displaying on startup, canceling drag & drop clearing selected items, bulk rename not following sort order, and context menu placement on the home page.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent firecrawl/firecrawl release stream from v1.2.1 through v2.10, covering the introduction of /extract, self-host overhauls, deep research, search API, v2.0.0 migration, and subsequent SDK and platform improvements.

chunks.title: v1.2.1 - /extract Beta Improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.2.1, the /extract endpoint is updated to be asynchronous, returning an ID for status checks. SDK users need to update to the latest versions, and direct API users have 10 days to migrate to the new asynchronous model. The release also includes indexes, caching for /extract, a new random user agent, and a queue system for extract.

chunks.title: v1.3 - /extract improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.3.0, a new re-ranker and multi-entity extraction are added to /extract. The release also introduces a new snips test framework and an __experimental_streamSteps feature.

chunks.title: Introducing /extract - v.1.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.4.0, the /extract endpoint is officially released, enabling structured web data extraction with a prompt. Users can define custom schemas, use URL wildcards, and deploy via Python, Node, cURL, or Zapier. Limitations include difficulty with large sites and complex searches.

chunks.title: Extract Improvements - v1.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.4.1, data extraction is enhanced with a new re-ranker system returning more data, improved infrastructure reliability, migration from Cheerio to a Rust-based parser for faster and more memory-efficient parsing, and enhanced crawl cancellation functionality.

chunks.title: Extract and API Improvements - v1.4.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.4.2, new features include web search capabilities for the extract endpoint via enableWebSearch, source tracking with __experimental_showSources, configurable webhook events for crawl and batch operations, a timeout parameter for map, and optional ad blocking with blockAds. Infrastructure improvements include enhanced proxy selection and a redesigned LLMs.txt generator interface.

chunks.title: Examples Week - v1.4.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.4.3, examples and features are added including Open Deep Research, R1 Web Extractor, O3-Mini Web Crawler, updated model parameters, URL deduplication, improved URL blocking, valid JSON via rawHtml in scrape, product reviews summarizer, scrape options for extract, O3-Mini job resource extractor, and cached scrapes for extract evals.

chunks.title: v1.4.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.4.4, features include scrape API action and wait time validation, extraction improvements like detection of PDF/image sub-links and text extraction via Gemini, multi-entity prompt enhancements, and showing sources out of __experimental. Examples include Gemini 2.0 Crawler and Gemini TrendFinder. Fixes address HTML transformer, Gemini crawler, crawl queue worker, relative URL conversion, and batch scraping rate limits.

chunks.title: Self-Host Overhaul - v1.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.5.0, self-host improvements include a reworked guide, Kubernetes deployment updates, proxy support, Playwright integration, and SearXNG support for /search. Core fixes address crawl status race conditions, timeout enforcement, query parameter retention in map, screenshot action order, PDF scraping, and abort control. New features include proxy and stealth options, deep research alpha, and an LLM text generator endpoint. A production-ready Docker image is introduced.

chunks.title: LLMs.txt API + Deep Research API - v1.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.6.0, the LLMs.txt API endpoint /llmstxt is introduced to transform websites into LLM-ready text files. The Deep Research API (alpha) endpoint /deep-research enables AI-powered research. An official Firecrawl MCP Server is released. Fixes include charset detection, extract token limits, and includes/excludes handling. New features include AI-SDK migration, auto-recharge emails, Fire-Index, self-hosting enhancements, batch billing, and Supabase read replica routing. Crawler improvements add Claude 3.7 and GPT-4.5 web crawlers.

chunks.title: v1.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.7.0, new features include Deep Research Open Alpha with structured outputs, llmstxt.new for generating llms.txt, concurrent browsers for improved rate limits, Compare Beta for detecting website changes, optional URLs in /extract, concurrency-limited warnings in /scrape, new examples featuring various models, and maxDiscoveryDepth option in crawl. Fixes address circular JSON error in search, tally system rework, sitemap poisoning, crawler status retries, credit check snapping, path filtering in map, and unsupported schema in llmExtract.

chunks.title: Launch Week III - v.1.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.8.0, Launch Week III introduces integration updates including Discord Bot, Make, n8n, Langflow, LlamaIndex, and Dify. Firecrawl MCP is upgraded with FIRE-1 agent support and SSE. Developer day brings async Python SDK 2.0, Rust SDK upgrades, and a dark theme. LLMstxt.new is announced for instant llms.txt generation. Additional features include agent endpoint, search endpoint, and various fixes.

chunks.title: v1.9.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.9.0, self-host improvements include Supabase client fixes, LLM provider support, faster crawl, and cacheable lookup system. MCP improvements (v1.11.0) add prompts and examples. SDK enhancements add change tracking to SDK 2.0, crawl delay support, Qwen3 crawler example, and cancel batch scrape endpoint. Performance increases map limit to 30,000 links and search schema limit to 100. Fixes address SSL errors, optional chaining, WaitAction validation, and concurrency queue rework. Dashboard adds activity logs.

chunks.title: Introducing Search - v1.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.10.0, a new Search API endpoint is launched, combining web search with scraping capabilities. Features include output format selection, search parameter customization, and full SDK support. Additional features include auto mode proxy, timeout handling for PDF scraping, Redis improvements, search improvements like ignoreBlockedURLs, a /cclog endpoint, metadata extraction with itemprop, and a deployable Playwright image for self-hosted. Fixes address subdomain handling, URL validation, zombie worker cleanup, concurrency queue logic, and various minor issues.

chunks.title: v1.11.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.11.0, major features include the Firecrawl Index, 5x faster scrapes if opted in, improved activity logs, webhook event viewing, active crawl management, a Fire Enrich example, and a community Java SDK. Features include improved Playwright tests, GET /crawl/ongoing endpoint, tag support in change tracking, integration field propagation, parallel testing for runpod v2, ported queryIndexAtSplitLevel to RPC, enhanced SDK with index parameters, removed redundant GCS check, added credits_billed field, domain-level index splitting, and index usage in search and extract. Fixes address crawl pre-finishing, webhook refactoring, index testing, JS SDK tests, and various other issues.

chunks.title: v1.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.12.0, a new concurrency system allows specifying max concurrency per request. A crawl entire domain parameter follows internal links to sibling or parent URLs. Google Docs scraping is officially supported. Activity logs are improved for FIRE-1 requests. The /search playground is enhanced with location params. A Firestarter example is introduced. Performance improvements and bug fixes are included.

chunks.title: v1.13.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.13.0, stealth mode adds AU, FR, DE locations. Crawl subdomains with allowSubdomains. Google Slides scraping is added. PDF generation of the current page is supported. Higher resolution screenshots with quality param. Weekly usage view on dashboard. Fireplexity example introduced. Features include cookie support in scrapeURL, PDF actions in SDKs, screenshot quality config, parsePDF support, international URLs, subdomain crawling in SDKs, and worker liveness check. Improvements remove old cache systems, enhance error messages, and fix various bugs.

chunks.title: v1.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.14.0, authenticated scraping is introduced (waitlist). Zero data retention for enterprise is added. Improved p75 speeds. New MCP version with maxAge and better tool calling. Open Researcher example. Fixes and improvements address JSON format on search, proxy usage, PDF prefetch logging, ledger events, auto-charge logic, IDN support, timeout error messages, job lock duration, crawl status creditsUsed, extract JSON parsing, map timeout, zero data retention, protocol changes, queue worker liveness, integration parameter support, and various other issues.

chunks.title: v1.15.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the firecrawl/firecrawl release v1.15.0, SSO for enterprise is added. Scraping reliability is improved. Search params are added to activity logs. FireGEO example introduced. Over 50 PRs merged. Improvements include OMCE support, improved logging, created_at field in /crawl/active, case-insensitive URL protocol checks, and filterLinks ported to Rust. Fixes address HTML transformer stability, scrapeURL index bug, PDF billing, crawl returning only 1 result, crawler no-sections bug, logger method naming, timeout handling, and crawl-status resilience. SDK and infra fixes include header param fix, async error handling, configurable Express port, and temporary crawl expiry exemption.

chunks.title: v2.0.0

questions.query_text: Across the getsentry/sentry releases, how does the approach to alerting in release 26.2.0 differ from the approach in release 26.4.0?

options.text: 26.2.0 focuses on adding issue type conditions and publishing workflow engine API docs, while 26.4.0 focuses on adding onboarding banners and inline environment creation.

chunks.title: b9453

chunks.title: b9457

chunks.title: b9458
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ggml-org/llama.cpp release b9458, the Vulkan backend is changed to avoid holding the device mutex while compiling pipelines, using a separate lock for pipeline traversal.

chunks.title: b9460

chunks.title: b9464

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent ggml-org/whisper.cpp release stream from v1.2.0 through v1.8.6, covering major features like memory reduction, quantization, GPU support, beam search, grammar sampling, Flash Attention, VAD, and numerous performance improvements.

chunks.title: v1.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ggml-org/whisper.cpp release v1.2.0, the project significantly reduces memory usage during inference by introducing scratch buffers in ggml, lowering memory requirements across all model sizes (e.g., tiny from ~390 MB to ~125 MB). It also adds PPC64 big-endian support, conditions sampled timestamp tokens to be monotonically increasing, and includes various binding and example improvements.

chunks.title: v1.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ggml-org/whisper.cpp release v1.2.1, a critical bug fix addresses random crashes when using the language auto-detect function. The release also adds a split_on_word flag for max_len, a whisper_full_lang_id() API, fixed beam search strategy, suppression of non-speech tokens, Ruby bindings, and refactored examples.

chunks.title: v1.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ggml-org/whisper.cpp release v1.3.0, Core ML support is added, decoding fallbacks are restored with a default size of 2, audio is padded with zeros instead of the spectrogram, a talk-llama example is introduced, and whisper_state enables parallel transcriptions with a single model in memory. The C-style API is extended with breaking changes only in callback signatures.

chunks.title: v1.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ggml-org/whisper.cpp release v1.4.0, integer quantization is introduced, allowing models to be converted to 4, 5, or 8-bit integer weights, reducing disk size and memory usage. Partial GPU (NVIDIA) support via cuBLAS is added, improving Encoder inference speed. Supported quantization modes include Q4_0, Q4_1, Q4_2, Q5_0, Q5_1, and Q8_0.

chunks.title: v1.4.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ggml-org/whisper.cpp release v1.4.3, a minor pre-release accumulates small changes from the master branch. It is considered beta and precedes the planned major v1.5.0 release, which will include full CUDA offloading, efficient beam-search, and grammar support.

chunks.title: v1.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ggml-org/whisper.cpp release v1.5.0, full GPU processing of Encoder and Decoder with CUDA and Metal is supported, efficient beam-search via batched decoding and unified KV cache is implemented, all ggml quantization types are supported, grammar constrained sampling is added, and support for Distil Whisper and Whisper Large-v3 models is introduced.

chunks.title: v1.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ggml-org/whisper.cpp release v1.5.1, a minor update adds auto-fallback to CPU for Metal if the device does not support Apple7 family, and introduces a server example. Various fixes and syncs with ggml are included.

chunks.title: v1.5.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ggml-org/whisper.cpp release v1.5.2, a minor maintenance release re-enables CPU BLAS processing after fixing a regression, and adds a new wchess example. Other changes include server improvements, CI updates, and ggml syncs.

chunks.title: v1.5.3

chunks.title: v1.5.4

chunks.title: v1.5.5

The Speckit preset fiction book is updated to v1.7 with support for RAG (Chroma DB) offline semantic search. Extensions use explicit UTF-8 encoding when reading manifest YAML. The m365 community extension is added. Documentation replaces deprecated --ai flag with --integration. GitHub-hosted catalog and download requests are authenticated with GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN. The extensify extension is updated to v1.1.0. The --no-git flag is deprecated, gated at v0.10.0. The Spec Orchestrator extension is added.

chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the github/spec-kit release v0.8.3, the version is bumped to 0.8.3. The Work IQ extension is added to the community catalog. Devin for Terminal skills-based integration is added. The upgrade hint includes --from git+... to avoid PyPI squat package. OpenCode commands are dispatched via run. Catalog discovery CLI commands are added. The security review extension is updated to v1.3.0, v-model extension to v0.6.0. The threatmodel and isaqb-architecture-governance extensions are added to the community catalog.

chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the github/spec-kit release v0.8.4, the version is bumped to 0.8.4. A fix corrects a self-referencing step number in the validation flow. Community extensions added include security-governance, cross-platform-governance, architecture-governance, a11y-governance, Spec2Cloud for Azure deployment workflow, and Squad Bridge. Extension commands are migrated on integration switch.

chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the github/spec-kit release v0.8.5, the version is bumped to 0.8.5. The Spec2Cloud preset for Azure deployment workflow is added. The security-review and memory-md extensions are updated to latest versions. A fix honors template overrides for tasks-template. The token-analyzer extension is added to the community catalog. An April 2026 newsletter is added. An init-time notice is emitted for git extension default change. Controlled multi-install for safe AI agent integrations is supported.

chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the github/spec-kit release v0.8.6, the version is bumped to 0.8.6. Constitution context is loaded in `/speckit.implement` to enforce governance during implementation. Catalog submission templates and CODEOWNERS are improved. URL scheme validation is fixed in build_github_request. Community extensions added include Architecture Guard, multi-model-review, and agent-parity-governance. Ralph Loop is updated to v1.0.2. GitHub Actions are pinned by SHA. A fix requires project for catalog list in workflows.

chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the github/spec-kit release v0.8.7, the version is bumped to 0.8.7. The agent-orchestrator extension is added to the community catalog. Documentation adds uv installation guide and inline callouts. The fx-to-dotnet extension is added. Non-interactive init defaults to copilot integration. chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the github/spec-kit release v0.8.8, the version is bumped to 0.8.8. The Spec Kit Schedule (schedule) community extension is added. chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the github/spec-kit release v0.8.9, the version is bumped to 0.8.9. The landing page is revamped with a four-pillar card layout. Governance ecosystem extensions are updated to latest versions. A changelog extension is added. The install directory is added to docfx.json file references. chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.10

chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.11

chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.12

chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.13

chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.14

chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.15

chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.16

chunks.title: Spec Kit - 0.8.17

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release evolution of gkd-kit/gkd, covering beta and stable releases from v1.10.0-beta.3 through v1.12.1. The releases introduce new features such as rule group batch operations, selector enhancements, UI restructuring, automation modes, and numerous optimizations and fixes.

chunks.title: Release v1.10.0-beta.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.10.0-beta.3, the main update is a fix for the HTTP server startup failure. The release also notes that new selector content can be viewed in the documentation.

chunks.title: Release v1.10.0-beta.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.10.0-beta.4, new features include long-press on rule groups to trigger batch operations, and new subscription fields: excludeAllMatches, disableIfAppGroupMatch, and ignoreGlobalGroupMatch. Optimizations include improved rule group list item card display, local subscription rule group list display, and interface operation logic. The long-press time was changed from 400 to 500 milliseconds. Fixes address crashes caused by abnormal app icons, incorrect snapshot link generation, and probabilistic matching when matching is paused.

chunks.title: Release v1.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.10.0, the interface layout structure is adjusted and optimized. New features include long-press on rule groups for batch operations, long-press on notification panel icon to jump to the corresponding interface, a prompt when multiple subscriptions are enabled, recognition of app lists in other workspaces, selector relationship selectors, selector logical expressions/negation expressions, and subscription fields excludeAllMatches, disableIfAppGroupMatch, ignoreGlobalGroupMatch. Optimizations include transition animations, rule group list item card display, local subscription rule group list display, interface operation logic, partial app list retrieval without app list permission, and accessibility switch control logic. The long-press time is changed from 400 to 500 milliseconds. Fixes address abnormal rule states preventing rule triggering, inability to end subscription refresh loading state, crashes from abnormal app icons, snapshot upload failure, incorrect snapshot link generation, probabilistic matching when paused, and crashes on some devices when notification permission is denied.

chunks.title: Release v1.10.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.10.1, the release note is identical to v1.10.0 with the addition of a fix for a crash when calling Shizuku on Samsung OneUi. All other features, optimizations, and fixes from v1.10.0 are included.

chunks.title: Release v1.10.2-beta.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.10.2-beta.2, new features include a consent dialog for usage declaration and accessibility explanation, and accelerated opening of documentation links within the app. Optimizations include improved Shizuku calling method, adaptation for 'special purpose foreground service' notification permission, and improved text prompts. A fix addresses incorrect display of rule counts for some apps.

chunks.title: Release v1.10.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.10.3, new features include a consent dialog for usage declaration and accessibility explanation, and accelerated opening of documentation links within the app. Optimizations include manual reload of the app list, batch selection and copying of rule groups, improved Shizuku calling method, adaptation for 'special purpose foreground service' notification permission, and improved text prompts. A fix addresses incorrect display of rule counts for some apps.

chunks.title: Release v1.10.4-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.10.4-beta.1, fixes address selector query failures when using certain fields, inability to jump via long-press on the control center icon when an app is open, and rules sometimes not participating in matching. Optimizations include a new resetMatch field scenario and adaptation for Android 16.

chunks.title: Release v1.10.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.10.4, the release note is identical to v1.10.4-beta.1, containing fixes for selector query failures with certain fields, inability to jump via long-press on the control center icon when an app is open, and rules sometimes not participating in matching. Optimizations include a new resetMatch field scenario and adaptation for Android 16.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.11.0-beta.1, multiple page displays and user experiences are optimized. The rule editing dialog is changed to a page with code highlighting. The app list is restructured: some sorting and filtering are removed, sorting by recent use is added, frozen apps are shown, interface-less apps are hidden, and pull-to-refresh is supported. New features include multiple notification bar switches, usage agreement and privacy policy, notification text supporting main title and subtitle, floating window saving last position, accessibility event floating window and log page, screenshot snapshot app ID and feature event selector, pause matching within app whitelist, partial closure (closing accessibility within the accessibility whitelist), interface service floating window showing Activity, and subscription fields versionCode and versionName, and subscription field value action:'none'. Shizuku authorization is refactored to a single 'Enable Optimization' switch with automatic internal judgment. Optimizations include automatic GKD authorization after connecting to Shizuku, notification management with close buttons on service persistent notifications, feedback prompts on the about page, text prompts on blank screenshots, and clicking titles on list pages to return to the top. Fixes address errors when starting persistent notifications on device reboot, abnormal matching when resetMatch=app and activityIds have values, and abnormal recognition of com.android.systemui.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.0-beta.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.11.0-beta.2, optimizations include improved advanced authorization flow, local image display, and prompts for missing app list permission. Fixes address errors in app rule overview and probabilistic rule non-execution when reopening the screen.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.0-beta.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.11.0-beta.3, a fix addresses app list loading failure on some devices.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.0-beta.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.11.0-beta.6, optimizations include improved user experience for visually impaired users, clickable icons to close floating windows, and display of disabled apps in the app list. Fixes address the selector isMatchRoot not taking effect, errors when opening the app from the notification bar, and missing information in the HTTP service snapshot list.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.0-beta.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.11.0-beta.7, a fix addresses app list loading failure on some devices.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.11.0, the release consolidates features from the beta series. It includes optimizations for visually impaired users, multiple page displays and user experiences, rule editing as a page with code highlighting, restructured app list with recent use sorting, frozen apps display, hidden interface-less apps, and pull-to-refresh. New features include multiple notification bar switches, usage agreement and privacy policy, notification text with main title and subtitle, floating window saving last position, clickable icons to close floating windows, accessibility event floating window and log page, screenshot snapshot app ID and feature event selector, pause matching within app whitelist, partial closure, interface service floating window showing Activity, subscription fields versionCode and versionName, and subscription field value action:'none'. Shizuku authorization is refactored to a single 'Enable Optimization' switch. Fixes address persistent notification errors on device reboot, abnormal matching with resetMatch=app and activityIds, selector isMatchRoot not taking effect, abnormal recognition of com.android.systemui, and probabilistic rule non-execution when reopening the screen.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.11.1, a fix addresses abnormal rule states causing repeated execution.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.11.2, fixes address app list retrieval failure on some devices, display of long text in recent records on the home page, and failure to execute built-in scripts. A change makes the app list whitelist displayed by default.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.11.3, a fix addresses interface call failure on some devices.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.11.4, fixes address interface call failure on some devices and add an abnormal permission prompt for reading the app list.

chunks.title: Release v1.11.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.11.6, new features include a permission restriction prompt, app list grouping filter, and long-press hints for icon buttons. Optimizations include improved trigger record date display. A fix addresses abnormal interface background color in some cases.

chunks.title: Release v1.12.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.12.0-beta.1, new features include an automated work mode, swipe operations, display of trigger positions, backup and restore functionality, toast display templates, a crash restart error report page, subscription category rule list page, subscription category description field, subscription click position xy field, rule trigger position using screen width and height, hiding disabled rules in the app rule list, a background hiding prompt, and long-press to close the snapshot button. Optimizations include swapping app icon light/dark theme colors, changing partial closure to not detect other accessibility services, changing screenshot snapshot to always screenshot, removing useless configurations when updating subscriptions, improving the image preview page, improving some text and layout, and hiding the status bar in full-screen snapshots without cropping. Fixes address privilege escalation not taking effect and some Android 17 issues.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gkd-kit/gkd release v1.12.0-beta.3, optimizations include improved prompts in no-network environments and automatic key setting when adding or editing rules.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent glanceapp/glance release stream from v0.5.0-beta.1 through v0.8.5, covering new widgets, configuration enhancements, and bug fixes across multiple minor and patch versions.

chunks.title: v0.5.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.5.0-beta.1, the project adds reporting of server errors, web app support, 24-hour time format support for the weather widget, and custom sorting for the twitch channels widget.

chunks.title: v0.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.5.0, new widgets are introduced: a search widget with custom bangs and search engine support, a clock widget with optional timezones, a lobsters widget, a changedetection.io widget, and an extension widget for custom widgets via HTTP server.

chunks.title: v0.6.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.6.0-beta.1, the search widget gains a new-tab property and an autofocus property; a css-class property is added for every widget; the lobsters widget gets instance-url and custom-url properties; a title-url property is added for every widget; default title URLs are added for hacker-news, lobsters, reddit, twitch-channels and twitch-top-games widgets; and several fixes are made for the releases, search, and RSS widgets.

chunks.title: v0.6.0-beta.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.6.0-beta.2, a group widget is added that allows grouping multiple widgets into one via tabs; the monitor widget gains a check-url property; a width property is added for each page with slim and wide options; a base-url property is added to the server configuration; a hide-desktop-navigation property is added for each page; the videos widget now filters YouTube shorts by default; and fixes are made for custom-css-file crashes and twitch channels without categories.

chunks.title: v0.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.5.1, fixes are backported from the v0.6.0 beta: the releases widget now correctly fetches latest releases for repositories with many pre-releases, the RSS widget fixes missing thumbnails, and the search widget fixes input color when using a light theme.

chunks.title: v0.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.6.0, preconfigured pages are introduced; the group widget is officially released; a DNS stats widget supporting AdGuard Home and Pi-hole is added; branding customization allows changing logo, favicon, and footer; the releases widget now supports Docker Hub and GitLab sources; page customization properties include width, hide-desktop-navigation, and center-vertically; a base-url property under server enables hosting behind a reverse proxy; and many other enhancements and fixes are included.

chunks.title: v0.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.6.1, the releases widget gains the ability to fetch releases from Codeberg via a codeberg: prefix; the DNS stats widget fixes AdGuard graph display when statistics retention is not 24 hours; and mobile navigation link wrapping is fixed.

chunks.title: v0.6.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.6.2, a /api/healthz endpoint is added that returns status 200; fixes include a videos widget collapsing bug in group widgets on Chromium browsers, a DNS stats widget bug for Pi-hole with hidden domain names, and a bookmarks widget icon shrinking issue.

chunks.title: v0.6.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.6.3, the simple icons provider is changed from cdnjs.cloudflare.com to cdn.jsdelivr.net and always uses the latest version; graphical bugs in the weather widget rain indicator and DNS stats widget graph are fixed; a weather widget graph bug for constant temperature is fixed; and a heads-up is given about a future backwards-incompatible Docker image change in v0.7.0.

chunks.title: v0.6.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.6.4, dependencies are updated to address a security vulnerability in golang.org/x/net, and broken thumbnails for NSFW Reddit posts and those containing videos are fixed.

chunks.title: v0.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.0, Docker container breaking changes move the config file to /app/config/glance.yml; CLI breaking changes rename --check-config to config:validate; new widgets include docker-containers, custom-api, server-stats, split-column, and a reworked calendar; new features include auto-reload on config change, environment variables anywhere in the config, config file includes, custom HTML in document head, and support for selfh.st and Dashboard icons; new styles include compact for monitor and vertical-list for videos; and many widget enhancements and fixes are included.

chunks.title: v0.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.1, an error when using the new playlists property in the videos widget is fixed.

chunks.title: v0.7.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.2, a hide-mountpoints-by-default property is added to the server-stats widget; a potential crash on OpenBSD when using server-stats is fixed; the Dashboard Icons URL is updated; and a small visual glitch with popover functionality is fixed.

chunks.title: v0.7.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.3, config auto-reload not working when editing with Vim is fixed; a markets widget rate limit error is fixed; the docker containers widget timeout is increased; and console errors for sensors data on OpenBSD are suppressed.

chunks.title: v0.7.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.4, accessibility improvements are made; a currency symbol issue for some markets is fixed; and new contributors are welcomed.

chunks.title: v0.7.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.5, support for Pi-hole version 6 is added via a new pihole-v6 service option in the DNS stats widget.

chunks.title: v0.7.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.6, an issue with the DNS stats widget when using service: pihole-v6 from the previous release is fixed.

chunks.title: v0.7.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.7, accessibility of the docker containers widget is improved; calendar date contrast is reduced; DNS stats widget error messages for pihole-v6 are enhanced; the custom API widget integer type is changed to int; and fixes include videos widget vertical-list links not opening in new tab and a Safari display issue in DNS stats.

chunks.title: v0.7.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.8, the custom-api widget receives many improvements: allow-insecure property, parameters property, request method and body support, subrequests, and new functions trimPrefix, trimSuffix, trimSpace, replaceAll, findMatch, findSubmatch, parseTime, and more.

chunks.title: v0.7.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.9, custom-api widget improvements continue: math operations no longer require float conversion; skip-json-validation and .JSONLines are added; new functions concat, now, offsetNow are introduced; the extension widget can return a Widget-Title-URL header; and the markets widget properly displays prices less than 0.01.

chunks.title: v0.7.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.10, mobile scaling is slightly increased; a sensors:print CLI command is added to list temperature sensors; and dependencies are bumped.

chunks.title: v0.7.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.11, the RSS widget filters duplicate post links; the custom API widget adds replaceMatches and unique functions; mountpoint:info CLI command is added; sensors:print output is enhanced; and fixes include twitch channels sorting for zero viewers, potential missing mountpoint stats, and a Yahoo finance test request in diagnose.

chunks.title: v0.7.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.12, a server crash in some configurations when a widget is provided with a single resource to fetch instead of multiple is fixed.

chunks.title: v0.7.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.7.13, the custom API widget adds a parseLocalTime function; the search widget adds a target property for opening results in a new tab; and fixes include server stats temperature sensor retrieval and Reddit widget URL escaping.

chunks.title: v0.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.8.0, major features include authentication, a theme picker, a to-do widget, nested config includes with new include syntax, Docker secrets support, hiding widget titles, head widgets, separate navigation and page widths, PWA configuration, and many widget enhancements such as Docker containers customization, custom API synchronous calls and options, Reddit application auth, RSS conditional requests, monitor basic-auth and timeout, and DNS stats Technitium support.

chunks.title: v0.8.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.8.1, an error that prevented page loading when hide-desktop-navigation is set to true is fixed.

chunks.title: v0.8.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.8.2, fixes include hide-desktop-navigation not working, custom favicons not working in Chromium browsers, server crash with head-widgets and releases widget, URLs getting escaped in videos widget vertical-list style, and startOfDay and endOfDay functions are added to the custom API widget.

chunks.title: v0.8.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.8.3, the theme picker can be disabled; mod, safeHTML, and .Options.JSON functions are added to the custom API widget; a theme key is added to the document root for theme-based styling; and fixes include HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY environment variables not being used and truncated link hover text whitespace.

chunks.title: v0.8.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.8.4, Material Design icons support is added via mdi prefix; the auto-invert icon prefix works for icon libraries; multiple to-do widgets on a single page are fixed; the search widget shortcut works with non-English keyboard layouts; and the Docker image health check is removed.

chunks.title: v0.8.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the glanceapp/glance release v0.8.5, a workaround is added to bypass Reddit API restrictions so the widget works without config changes; Go and Alpine versions are bumped.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent gofiber/fiber release stream across v2 and v3 releases, including new features, middleware enhancements, security fixes, and breaking changes.

chunks.title: v2.48.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.48.0, the project adds the ability to print a custom message on startup via the OnListen hook, introduces a Logger interface and fiberlog package, updates dependencies including fasthttp to v1.48.0, and fixes default logger color behavior.

chunks.title: v2.49.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.49.0, a breaking change adds a config option EnableSplittingOnParsers to split query/body/header parameters by comma. New features include a custom data property for the favicon middleware config. Updates include latency formatting matching gin, refactoring filesystem middleware, and dependency bumps. Fixes address default latency output and decompression of request bodies with multiple Content-Encoding headers.

chunks.title: v2.49.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.49.1, the project bumps fasthttp from v1.48.0 to v1.49.0, rolls back changes to go.mod, and adds Polish and updates Korean README translations.

chunks.title: v2.49.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.49.2, the logger middleware enables color changes padding for some fields, bumps actions/checkout and golang.org/x/sys, fixes a vulnerability in Ctx.IsFromLocal, and replaces double quotes with backticks in route parameter documentation.

chunks.title: v2.50.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.50.0, breaking changes modify GetReqHeaders and GetRespHeaders to return map[string][]string. Security improvements to CSRF middleware include single-use tokens, session integration, origin checks, and double submit cookie approach. New features add a cookie parser, CORS preflight caching disable, session Reset and Store Delete methods. Updates improve filesystem SendFile status and other middleware enhancements.

chunks.title: v2.51.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.51.0, new features add support for parameters in content negotiation and application/problem+json. Updates reduce allocations in Ctx.Range and improve pprof middleware performance. Maintenance bumps dependencies. Fixes address intermittent limiter failures, route naming after mount, and method validation on route naming.

chunks.title: v2.52.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.52.0, a new healthcheck middleware adds liveness and readiness checks. Updates allow middleware context-keys to be non-strings, colorize logger error messages, change default log output, log client IP by default, and update encryptcookie defaults. Maintenance bumps dependencies. Fixes address redirect with query params, adaptor+otelfiber issue, CORS AllowedOriginsFunc, session race, CSRF tests, parallel test race, and inconsistent IsIPv4 results.

chunks.title: v2.52.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.52.1, a security advisory addresses insecure CORS configuration allowing wildcard origin with credentials. A fix resolves healthcheck middleware not working with route groups. Documentation fixes include default value for QueryBool and code snippet indentation.

chunks.title: v2.52.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.52.2, a fix addresses validation of multiple Origins in the CORS middleware.

chunks.title: v2.52.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.52.3, fixes address CORS handling and wildcard subdomain matching, categorize requests correctly, and fix CSRF benchmark tests.

chunks.title: v2.52.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.52.4, fixes address CORS handling and Vary header handling for non-CORS OPTIONS requests.

chunks.title: v3.0.0-beta.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v3.0.0-beta.2, new features include initial binding support, retry mechanism, client refactor, CSRF trusted origins with subdomain style, CORS Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network, proxy DialDualStack, conversion of fiber.Ctx to interface, merged Listen methods, new Route method, router interface changes, redirection methods, mounting system, msgp tests, app.Test timeout, QueryParser, Locals with generics, custom constraints, GetReqHeaders/GetRespHeaders, and generic Params/Get/Convert. Updates and fixes span many areas including adaptor benchmarks, CSRF/limiter naming, earlydata, filesystem refactor, healthchecker migration, idempotency, logger refactor, client rename, router status 501, utils changes, testify usage, startup message, Ctx.Format, interface{} to any, linting, content negotiation, log package tests, performance optimizations, CORS handling, logger benchmarks, stderr logging, benchmark fixes, TLS config rename, context key collisions, testifylint errors, body immutability, flaky tests, and query/body parsing. Maintenance bumps Go minimum to 1.21, adds go1.22, updates utils, speeds up tests, re-enables linters, uses gotestsum, enables shuffling, runs on Apple M1, merges v2, updates golangci-lint, and bumps dependencies.

chunks.title: v2.52.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.52.5, a security advisory addresses session middleware token injection vulnerability. Updates remove extra release/acquire calls in session tests. Bug fixes address monitor CPU usage reporting and session mutex for thread safety. Documentation improves ctx.Locals description and updates README_id.

chunks.title: v3.0.0-beta.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v3.0.0-beta.3, new features add static middleware, cache invalidation option, keyauth custom KeyLookup, zstd compression, configuration support for SendFile, longtests CI support, and CHIPS cookie support. Updates include CORS config as list types, session test cleanup, cache middleware optimization, CTX interface generator, and IsProxyTrusted benchmarks. Bug fixes address struct name comments, flash message with redirect, session mutex, and session data-race. Maintenance bumps fasthttp and other dependencies. Documentation adds new client docs, core changes consolidation, and various fixes.

chunks.title: v3.0.0-beta.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v3.0.0-beta.4, new features add startup probe to healthcheck, RebuildTree support, Max func to limiter, TrustProxy, context support to RequestID, TestConfig, Fiber client from existing FastHTTP client, buffered streaming, CBOR encoding, AllLogger, graceful shutdown timeout, AutoTLS/ACME, iterator methods for client, TLS Min Version config, Drop method for silent connection termination, and session middleware rewrite. Updates include fiberlog benchmarks, logger benchmarks, encryptcookie key length enforcement, ctx.Next simplification, adaptor performance, benchmark workflow refactor, struct alignment, helper performance, utils Trim usage, c.Body performance, rewrite benchmarks, request body handling consolidation, go1.23 and golangci-lint update, msgp for flash messages, IsFromLocal optimization, gorilla/schema replacement, CORS scheme restriction removal, naming convention improvements, go1.23 minimum, and FormData method rename.

chunks.title: v2.52.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.52.6, bug fixes use Content-Length for bytesReceived/bytesSent in logger, handle unmatched open brackets in query params, remove scheme restriction in CORS, respect immutable config for Body, and support square bracket notation in multipart form data. Documentation adds detailed templates guide. Maintenance updates benchmark-action, adds CODEOWNERS, updates dependencies, and adds parallel benchmark for Next.

chunks.title: v2.52.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.52.8, a security fix addresses BodyParser vulnerability. Updates backport ctx.String from v3. Bug fixes resolve routing with mount and static. Documentation updates ctx.Redirect usage and adds AGENTS.md.

chunks.title: v2.52.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.52.9, bug fixes add upper index limit for parsers, fix embedded struct parsing, fix Content-Type comparison in Is(), and fix MIME type equality checks.

chunks.title: v3.0.0-beta.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v3.0.0-beta.5, new features add context.Context support to keyauth, Skip function to logger, predefined log formats, ForceColors in logger, Keys() in session, Timeout middleware config, End() method to Ctx, ShutdownWithContext optimization, multipart file binding, Req and Res API, application state management, CheckConstraint enhancement, All method to Bind, service dependencies, route removal, fiber.Context implementing context.Context, NewErrorf, NewWithCustomCtx, UNIX socket support, Msgpack support, and context methods to fiber.Storage. Updates enhance BasicAuth RFC compliance and security, cache RFC compliance, CORS response headers and tests, CSRF tests and refactor, earlydata tests, encryptcookie config validation, envvar refactor, helmet tests, idempotency tests, and more.

chunks.title: v3.0.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v3.0.0-rc.1, new features add Fiber Context to BasicAuth Authorizer, HeaderLimit option, hashed passwords support, CSRF extractor enhancement, limiter response headers disable, proxy KeepConnectionHeader, session extractor pattern, SendEarlyHints, generic configurable logger, conditional copy helpers, embedded Koa-style Req/Res structs, and default UTF-8 charset. Updates remove SHA-1/MD5 and PasswordFromContext from BasicAuth, fix CORS docs, CSRF error message and subdomain wildcard, keyauth extractor-based config and generic errors, pprof docs, add tests, replace math/rand with crypto/rand, enable govet shadow, fix Cookie SameSite constants, streaming test timing, reduce AutoFormat allocation, add sync pool for Bind, CBOR support to AutoFormat, missing Ctx tests, stabilize stream writer test, fix AcceptsLanguages RFC compliance, respect immutable config, optimize Fresh header parsing, use ephemeral ports, and more.

chunks.title: v3.0.0-rc.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v3.0.0-rc.2, new features add request inspection helpers, extractors package, and support for redacting values. Updates improve cache middleware defaults, fix cache cleanup and redact tokens, improve compress RFC compliance, update CSRF to use shared extractors, improve keyauth RFC compliance and update to shared extractors, migrate session to new extractors, handle Transfer-Encoding bodies, improve storage driver error handling, improve constant part analysis performance, ensure middleware prefix matching, use sync.Pool for client hooks, avoid locking in gc, improve request Params allocations, cleanup Bind error logic, update RouteChain, and expand binder tests. Bug fixes improve BasicAuth RFC compliance, handle Unix sockets in adaptor, and fix context.Context support. Maintenance bumps dependencies.

chunks.title: v2.52.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.52.10, bug fixes handle invalid path in filesystem, fix recover middleware panic output formatting, and fix enforcement of Immutable config for edge cases. Documentation adds RoutePatternMatch.

chunks.title: v3.0.0-rc.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v3.0.0-rc.3, new features add cookie name authentication for encryptcookie, BodyStream logic to adaptor, HostClient and LBClient support, native net/http and fasthttp handler support, Express.js style req/res handlers, DisableAutoRegister of HEAD routes, handling unsupported HTTP methods as 501, ReloadViews, and startup message customization hooks. Updates include adaptor panic prevention and tests, flushing unit tests, encryptcookie error return, client slice preallocation, request allocation reduction, boundary const, gc locking skip, cacheableStatusCodes memory reduction, duplicate constant merge, context.Context propagation, inline request state wrappers, utils alias removal, cache miss benchmark, FullPath helper, nil map target handling, generic releasePooledBinder, sentinel errors, HEAD request compliance test, OPTIONS wildcard regression test, byte-range handling improvement, and int64 for HTTP ranges. Bug fixes address limiter MaxFunc default, recover panic formatting, session fresh flag logic, spelling issues, and fatal error calls.

chunks.title: v2.52.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.52.11, updates improve mount functionality. Bug fixes backport defensive copying fixes and improve limiter middleware.

chunks.title: v3.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v3.0.0, the project announces the general availability of Fiber v3 with a migration tool. New features span App (TLS config rename, any error message type, custom constraints, trusted origins, DialDualStack, subdomain trusted origins, SendFile config, CHIPS cookie, TestConfig, buffered streaming, AutoTLS/ACME, TLS Min Version, square bracket notation, application state management, NewErrorf, UNIX sockets, Msgpack, UTF-8 charset, SendEarlyHints, conditional copy helpers, request inspection helpers, redacting values, unsupported HTTP methods as 501, ReloadViews, startup message hooks, UUIDv4 to SecureToken, ExpirationFunc, auto-enforce Secure for Partitioned cookies), Binding (initial support, multipart file binding, All method), Client (refactor, from existing FastHTTP client, iterator methods, HostClient/LBClient, streaming response bodies), Context (Ctx to interface, Drop method, End method, ShutdownWithContext optimization, context.Context in keyauth, fiber.Context implements context.Context, NewWithCustomCtx, context methods to Storage, BasicAuth Authorizer context, OverrideParam, common request helpers, GetReqHeaders/GetRespHeaders, Req/Res API), Extractors (session ID extractor, enhanced extractor, extractors package), Generic (QueryParser, Locals with generics, Params/Get/Convert), Middleware (BasicAuth context, HeaderLimit, hashed passwords, CSRF extractor enhancement, limiter response headers disable, proxy KeepConnectionHeader, session extractor, SendEarlyHints, generic configurable logger, conditional copy helpers, embedded Koa-style Req/Res, default UTF-8 charset, encryptcookie cookie name auth, BodyStream adaptor, HostClient/LBClient, native handlers, Express.js style handlers, DisableAutoRegister HEAD, unsupported methods 501, ReloadViews, startup message hooks, SecureToken, ExpirationFunc, Partitioned cookies), and more.

chunks.title: v3.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v3.1.0, new features expand middleware context helpers with PassLocalsToContext config. Updates include utils update, go 1.26 test workflow, helper performance optimization, and numeric constraint parsing hardening. Fixes address nil handler panics in DefaultRes.Format, nil request in adaptor, Unix-socket in IsProxyTrusted, proxy nil client handling, nil-safety in response decode, attachment/download filename sanitization, flash cookie detection, bind struct validation, Range header limit, msgp serialization limits, sanitizePath validation, Test method timeout response, nil pointer dereference after release, retry addon sleep, TLS listener config safety, nil services validation, non-string state keys, Port handling, and non-string log keys. Maintenance bumps dependencies.

chunks.title: v2.52.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.52.12, a fix addresses a CVE (GHSA-mrq8-rjmw-wpq3).

chunks.title: v3.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v3.2.0, new features add URL() method to Route, comprehensive binding tests for pointer scalars, response format support to healthcheck, Route Domain() for host-based routing, pagination middleware, BindError type with source/field metadata, and PanicHandler in recover middleware. Updates optimize speed and remove duplicate benchmark handling. Fixes address race condition in TestTimeout, ARMv7 build overflow in etag, HTML escaping in AutoFormat, structured default cache keys, BodyLimit enforcement on decompression and multipart, releaseData function, referer path stripping for trusted origins, ProxyHeader/TrustProxy clarity, prefork children exit in Docker, math.MaxUint32 overflow in etag, nil checks in End, and custom binders bypassing StructValidator. Maintenance bumps many dependencies.

chunks.title: v2.52.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v2.52.13, a bug fix escapes HTML output in Ctx.Format.

chunks.title: v3.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gofiber/fiber release v3.3.0, new features add configurable regex engine on router, host authorization middleware, delegate prefork to fasthttp/prefork with PreforkRecoverThreshold and PreforkLogger, contextual logs with context template, storage-backed SharedState for prefork, and lightweight SSE middleware. Updates add prefixes to unexported boolean fields, improve error messages in SaveFileToStorage, and streamline request handler selection. Fixes preserve mounted sub-app regex handler, trim trailing dot in host normalization, reject oversized unknown-length adaptor bodies, fix compress shouldSkip memory growth, reject malformed host authorities, synchronize view reloads, avoid panic for non-struct listeners, clear plaintext cookie on encryption failure, fix regex route constraint parsing, reject empty normalized host, preserve idempotency replay protection, enforce CookieJar domain acceptance, avoid panic on released context values, enforce static root for fs-backed serving, prevent negative paginate start overflow, prevent SharedState namespace key collisions, and more.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent gogs/gogs release stream from v0.12.4-rc.1 through v0.14.2, including patch releases, release candidates, and minor version upgrades. It highlights security fixes, new features, configuration changes, and deprecations across the 0.12, 0.13, and 0.14 series.

chunks.title: 0.12.4-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.4-rc.1, this is a release candidate for the 0.12.4 patch release.

In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.4, the release notes include a security fix for potential SSRF attack by CRLF injection via repository migration, a regression fix for smart links for issues stops rendering, and the addition of X-Frame-Options header to prevent Clickjacking.

chunks.title: 0.12.5-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.5-rc.1, this is a release candidate for the 0.12.5 patch release.
In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.5, the release notes include security fixes for potential SSRF in repository migration and improper PAM authorization handling.

chunks.title: 0.12.6-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.6-rc.1, this is a release candidate for the 0.12.6 patch release.

In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.6, the release notes include a security fix for remote command execution in file uploading, a regression fix for inability to migrate repository from other local Git hosting with a new configuration option [security] LOCAL_NETWORK_ALLOWLIST, and a fix for slow start of Docker containers using NAS devices.

chunks.title: 0.12.7-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.7-rc.1, this is a release candidate for the 0.12.7 patch release.

In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.7, the release notes include a security fix for stored XSS in issues, a fix for invalid character in Access-Control-Allow-Credentials response header, and a fix for mysterious ssh: overflow reading version string errors from builtin SSH server.

chunks.title: 0.12.8-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.8-rc.1, this is a release candidate for the 0.12.8 patch release.

In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.8, the release notes include a change that all users need to use the configuration option [security] LOCAL_NETWORK_ALLOWLIST to allow repository migration and webhooks to access local network addresses, and security fixes for SSRF in webhook, XSS in cookies, OS Command Injection in file uploading, and Remote Command Execution in file editing.

chunks.title: 0.12.9-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.9-rc.1, this is a release candidate for the 0.12.9 patch release.

In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.9, the release notes include security fixes for OS Command Injection in file editor, sanitize DisplayName in repository issue list, Path Traversal in file editor on Windows, Path Traversal in Git HTTP endpoints, and fixes for unable to init repository during creation on Windows and mysterious panic on Value not found for type *repo.HTTPContext.

chunks.title: 0.12.10-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.10-rc.1, this is a release candidate for the 0.12.10 patch release.

In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.10, the release notes include a change to support using [security] LOCAL_NETWORK_ALLOWLIST = * to allow all hostnames, and a fix for unable to send webhooks to local network addresses after configured [security] LOCAL_NETWORK_ALLOWLIST.

chunks.title: 0.12.11-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.11-rc.1, this is a release candidate for the 0.12.11 patch release.

In the gogs/gogs release v0.12.11, the release notes include security fixes for stored XSS for issue assignees and OS Command Injection in repo editor on case-insensitive file systems, and a fix for unable to render repository pages with implicit submodules.

chunks.title: 0.13.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gogs/gogs release v0.13.0-rc.1, this is a release candidate for the 0.13.0 minor release.

In the gogs/gogs release v0.13.0, the release notes include added support for personal access token in the password field, an unlisted option for repositories, new API endpoint PUT /repos/:owner/:repo/contents/:path, new configuration options for git diff timeout, SSH server MACs, default branch, SSH server algorithms, custom PostgreSQL schema, Mermaid diagrams in Markdown, Docker backup extra arguments, and new languages Mongolian and Romanian. Changes include default branch to main, MSSQL deprecation, Task build tool, Go 1.18 requirement, and access tokens stored as SHA256 hashes. Fixes include LDAP authentication on ARM, avatar lookup, custom directory in Docker, and outdated migration version. Removals include pre-0.12 migrations, deprecated configuration sections and options.

chunks.title: 0.13.1-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gogs/gogs release v0.13.1-rc.1, this is a release candidate for the 0.13.1 patch release.
In the gogs/gogs release v0.13.1, the release notes indicate that this release was pulled back due to issues with pre-compiled release archives, and users should use 0.13.2 instead.

chunks.title: 0.13.2-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gogs/gogs release v0.13.2-rc.1, this is a release candidate for the 0.13.2 patch release.

In the gogs/gogs release v0.13.2, the release notes include security fixes for Path Traversal in file editing UI, Path Traversal in file update API, Argument Injection in the built-in SSH server, Deletion of internal files, Argument Injection during changes preview, Argument Injection when tagging new releases, and fixes for using non-deprecated email section names and purple template label color. It also notes that the pam tag will not be included in release archives going forward.

In the gogs/gogs release v0.13.3, the release notes include security fixes for Stored XSS in PDF renderer and Path Traversal in file editing UI, and fixes for randomly timeout on repository file uploads and unable to override email templates in custom directory. It also notes that the pam tag will not be included in release archives going forward.

In the gogs/gogs release v0.13.4, the release notes include security fixes for DoS in repository mirror sync, RCE in repository put contents API, Arbitrary file deletion via path traversal in wiki page update, 2FA bypass via recovery code, Authorization bypass in repository deletion API, Update repository content via API with read-only permission, Arbitrary file read/write via path traversal in Git hook editing, Stored XSS via Mermaid diagrams, and fixes for route GET /api/v1/user/repos responses 500 when accessible repositories contain forks and newer Git versions with default branch main causing wiki initialization to fail. It also notes that the pam tag will not be included in release archives going forward.
