prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent gohugoio/hugo release stream from v0.152.1 through v0.162.1, covering new features such as multidimensional content models, WebP improvements, partial decorators, css.Build, AVIF support, and numerous bug fixes and deprecations.

chunks.title: v0.152.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.152.1, the release note describes fixes related to a YAML library upgrade from v0.152.0. It expands numeric conversions in template funcs/methods, fixes where with uint64, ensures YAML integer types can be used where Go int types are expected, fixes compare/sort of uint64s, and fixes an 'assignment to entry in nil map' error on empty YAML config files.

chunks.title: v0.152.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.152.2, the release note addresses a regression in file mount source validation introduced in v0.152.0. It adds special handling for node_modules mounts, allowing themes/modules to mount node_modules relative to the project root if the local source does not exist. It also updates the minify dependency and fixes a typo in a stale PR message.

chunks.title: v0.153.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.153.0, the release note introduces a multidimensional content model with languages, versions, and roles, including sites matrix and complements. It overhauls WebP image support by building a WASM version of libwebp v1.6.0 running in Wazero, enabling animated WebP and removing the need for the extended edition for WebP. It adds signed and notarised pkg installers for macOS, improves Asciidoctor integration, adds urls.PathUnescape and urls.PathEscape template funcs, and supports external refs in openapi3.Unmarshal. It also deprecates libsass in favor of dartsass, changes build and sort order for dimensions, and deprecates lang option on mounts and segments in favor of sites.matrix, and file mount includeFiles/excludeFiles in favor of a new files filter.

chunks.title: v0.153.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.153.1, the release note is a bug fix release that handles PNG files named *.webp, reverts deprecation logging for contentDir per language, fixes a panic when 404 is backed by a content file, and increases the WebP memory limit to 256 MiB.

chunks.title: v0.153.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.153.2, the release note fixes an 'image: unknown format' error, removes the extended edition check from modules, and updates edition comparison and guidance in README.md.

chunks.title: v0.153.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.153.3, the release note bumps a dependency and fixes an error with _content.gotmpl file when index.md siblings exist.

chunks.title: v0.153.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.153.4, the release note sets the cascade target to the content matrix if not set in the cascade itself.

chunks.title: v0.153.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.153.5, the release note adds a compression option to image config, fixes a cascade per language regression in hugo.toml, and fixes WebP quality and hint parameters being ignored.

chunks.title: v0.154.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.154.0, the release note introduces partial decorators, a new construct allowing partials to act as decorators with an inner keyword. It adds reflect.IsPage, IsSite, IsResource, and IsImageResource utility functions. It fixes apply to work with built-in funcs like len, reverts a previous slugorcontentbasename fix, limits verbose watch output, increases WebP memory limit to 384 MiB, and updates dependencies.

chunks.title: v0.154.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.154.1, the release note adds WASM licensing information to README and fixes partial decorator detection in partials with blocks containing outer range break or continue.

chunks.title: v0.154.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.154.2, the release note fixes an alpha/fuzzy border issue with the new WebP decoder for images with transparent backgrounds.

chunks.title: v0.154.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.154.3, the release note bumps the goldmark dependency from v1.7.13 to v1.7.16.

chunks.title: v0.154.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.154.4, the release note fixes language resolution for markdown shortcodes, fixes alias handling and multihost publish path for multiple dimensions setups, bumps a dependency, and adds the Page.OutputFormats.Canonical method.

chunks.title: v0.154.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.154.5, the release note fixes some default site redirect woes, fixes newly created shortcodes not found during server rebuild, and removes trailing slash from void elements.

chunks.title: v0.155.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.155.0, the release note improves version handling with range queries and caching of Go module version queries. It adds XMP and IPTC image metadata support, makes page aliases work in multidimensional sites, and includes performance improvements for WebP and image processing. It introduces a breaking change where alias paths beginning with '/' are now site-relative instead of server-relative. It also adds == and != operators to range predicates, range matchers for site matrix vector store filtering, and various bug fixes and dependency updates.

chunks.title: v0.155.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.155.1, the release note fixes an image DecodeConfig regression for WebP images from file cache, fixes WebP useSharpYuv being ignored, and removes failing Twitter tests.

chunks.title: v0.155.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.155.2, the release note fixes template change detection for multi-version sites and adds image decode/encode debug logging.

chunks.title: v0.155.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.155.3, the release note prevents rendering default site redirect for non-primary isHTML output formats, fixes stuck server global error logging, bumps esbuild dependency, and fixes a panic when the server browser error handler tried to use a config in a state of flux.

chunks.title: v0.156.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.156.0, the release note brings significant speedups to collections.Where and collections.Sort. It deprecates Site.AllPages, Site.BuildDrafts, Site.Languages, Site.Data, Page.Sites, and Site.Sites, and removes many previously deprecated template functions, page methods, paginator methods, site methods, site config options, and file caches. It also moves site.Data to hugo.Data, deprecates cascade._target in favor of cascade.target, and throws errors for gist and twitter shortcodes. It includes various bug fixes and improvements such as allowing lineNos to be true, false, 'inline', or 'table', and upgrades to Go 1.26.

chunks.title: v0.157.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.157.0, the release note adds GitInfo support for Hugo Modules, allowing content from Git modules to have GitInfo. It fixes menu pageRef resolution in multidimensional setups, fixes automatic section pages not replaced by sites.complements, handles GitInfo for modules where Origin is not set, adds AVIF, HEIF and HEIC partial metadata support, adjusts WebP processing defaults, adds a per-request timeout option to resources.GetRemote, and includes other improvements and dependency updates.

chunks.title: v0.158.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.158.0, the release note adds css.Build for native CSS bundling/transformation/minifying and strings.ReplacePairs for fast string replacements. It upgrades to Go 1.26.1 to fix a security issue. It deprecates language configuration options (languageCode, languageName, languageDirection) and their corresponding methods in favor of locale, label, and direction. It includes bug fixes for external source maps, server no watch, context canceled on GetRemote, and others, and improvements such as re-publishing on transformation cache hit and allowing regular pages to cascade to self.

chunks.title: v0.159.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.159.0, the release note improves and simplifies management of Node.js/npm dependencies in a multi-module setup. It replaces deprecated site.Data with hugo.Data in tests, replaces deprecated excludeFiles and includeFiles with files in tests, and replaces deprecated :filename with :contentbasename in permalinks test. It fixes a Vimeo shortcode test, returns error instead of panic when page not found, preserves non-content files in convert output, uses workspaces to simplify 'hugo mod npm pack', and includes other improvements and dependency updates.

chunks.title: v0.159.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.159.1, the release note fixes a regression where the minifier stripped namespaced attributes in SVGs, breaking dynamic constructs like AlpineJS' x-bind. It adds a keepNamespaces option to the SVG minifier, defaulting to keep '' and 'x-bind' namespaces.

chunks.title: v0.159.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.159.2, the release note fixes a potential content XSS by escaping dangerous URLs in Markdown links and images, and fixes a shared reader issue in Source.ValueAsOpenReadSeekCloser. It also adds release archives for non-extended-withdeploy builds.

chunks.title: v0.160.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.160.0, the release note adds support for injecting CSS vars into stylesheets via css.Build and adds .Position method to all render hooks. It fixes recently introduced Position issues, double-escaping of ampersands in link URLs, and stray quotes from partial decorator in script context. It also supports @import 'hugo:vars' for CSS custom properties and improves .Position handling in Goldmark render hooks.

chunks.title: v0.160.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.160.1, the release note fixes a panic when passthrough elements are used in headings, a panic on edit of legacy mapped template names, RenderShortcodes leaking context markers when indented, strips nested page context markers from standalone RenderShortcodes, renames deprecated cascade._target to cascade.target in tests, fixes auto-creation of root sections in multilingual sites, and fixes links in readme.

chunks.title: v0.161.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.161.0, the release note contains security hardening: Node tools run with --permission flag, requiring Node >= 22, and TailwindCSS CLI must be installed as a Node.js package; security.http.urls defaults are more restrictive. It adds nested vars support in css.Build and css.Sass, slice-based permalinks config, and a more flexible scheme for identifiers in filenames using prefixes like language_, role_, version_, etc. It also includes various bug fixes and improvements.

chunks.title: v0.161.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.161.1, the release note makes resources.GetRemote honor the Retry-After header, moves warpc to parson.c, adds AllowChildProcess to security.node.permissions, and restricts default http.urls '@' deny to userinfo.

chunks.title: v0.162.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.162.0, the release note adds support for AVIF images (encoder and decoder). It includes security fixes from Go 1.26.3 (XSS in html/template) and Hugo-specific hardening: disallows text/html content files by default with a new security.allowContent policy, re-checks security.http.urls on every redirect hop in resources.GetRemote, and rejects symlinked entries in resources.Get. It also includes various bug fixes and improvements such as fixing Page.GitInfo for modules with go.mod in a subdirectory, allowing empty params front matter, and merging existing hugo_stats.json when renderSegments is set.

chunks.title: v0.162.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gohugoio/hugo release v0.162.1, the release note fixes a false stale warning after npm pack, reverts a change that made dict return nil when no values are provided, and fixes locale-specific month abbreviations.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent google/guava release stream from v29.0 through v33.6.0, covering API additions, deprecations, security fixes, nullness annotation improvements, modularization, and Android compatibility changes.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the google/guava release 29.0, the project announces that Guava types can no longer be sent over GWT-RPC, with a temporary system property to reenable support. API documentation is now easier to reach via guava.dev. In the collect package, FluentIterable.from(FluentIterable) is annotated with @DoNotCall, and ImmutableSortedSet gains ceiling, floor, headSet, and tailSet methods in GWT. The graph package adds support for setting a stable incident edge order via a new Builder method and adds incidentEdgeOrder() to graph interfaces. In util.concurrent, Duration-based default methods are added to ListeningScheduledExecutorService, immediateVoidFuture is introduced, @Beta is removed from Service and related classes, the 1-arg ServiceManager.addListener is deprecated, the return type of ServiceManager.servicesByState() is changed to ImmutableSetMultimap, and AbstractFuture is made safe to load from a ForkJoinPool thread under a security manager.

In the google/guava release 30.0, the temporary way to reenable GWT-RPC support is removed. A memory leak in LocalCache under j2objc is fixed. The collect package adds two-element min and max methods to Comparators, removes @Beta from Multimaps.toMultimap, makes ImmutableMap.keySet() serializable, fixes a bug in powerSet equality, and eliminates a j2objc retain-cycle in SingletonImmutableBiMap. The eventbus package prevents @Subscribe on methods taking primitives. The graph package makes Traverser.breadthFirst() lazier and adds @DoNotMock to Traverser. The io package deprecates Files.createTempDir() due to CVE-2020-8908. The math package adds roundToDouble to BigDecimalMath, BigIntegerMath, and LongMath. The net package adds MediaType constants for font types and HttpHeaders constants for Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy. The testing package makes EqualsTester test non-String objects against their String representations. In util.concurrent, ClosingFuture is added, the deprecated 1-arg ServiceManager.addListener is removed, AbstractFuture.toString() no longer includes the result, and awaitTerminationUninterruptibly is added.

In the google/guava release 30.1, users of guava-android in Android projects need to enable desugaring of Java 8 language features. A warning log message is introduced when running guava-android under a Java 7 VM. The base package deprecates StandardSystemProperty.JAVA_EXT_DIRS. The net package adds HttpHeaders constants for Origin-Isolation and X-Request-ID. The reflect package adds ClassInfo.isTopLevel(). The util.concurrent package adds ClosingFuture.submitAsync(AsyncClosingCallable).

In the google/guava release 30.1.1, the aggressiveness of the warning log message for running guava-android under Java 7 is increased. The cache package fixes compatibility between asMap().compute(...) and a load, and adds @CheckReturnValue to some APIs. The collect package adds @DoNotCall to mutator methods on immutable types. The hash package removes @Beta from HashCode. The io package removes @Beta from CountingOutputStream.

In the google/guava release 31.0, guava-android is changed to generate Java 8 bytecode, dropping support for Java 7 JREs. Guava is annotated more thoroughly for nullness. The base package changes Functions.forSupplier and Predicates.instanceOf to accept an additional type argument. The collect package adds ImmutableMap.ofEntries, overloads of ImmutableMap.of for up to 10 entries, renames ImmutableMap.Builder.build() to buildOrThrow(), removes @Beta from Interner and Interners, and adds @InlineMe to Streams.stream(Optional). The graph package makes EndpointPair.adjacentNode require an N. The hash package removes @Beta from HashFunction.
In the google/guava release 31.0.1, a GWT compilation failure introduced in release 31.0 is fixed.

In the google/guava release 31.1, the base package deprecates Throwables methods lazyStackTrace and lazyStackTraceIsLazy. The collect package adds ImmutableMap.Builder.buildKeepingLast() and notes a side-effect change for ImmutableList.copyOf with Maps.transformValues. The hash package adds Hashing.fingerprint2011(). The io package changes ByteStreams.nullOutputStream() to follow the OutputStream.write contract. The net package adds @CheckReturnValue and an HttpHeaders constant for Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network. The util.concurrent package adds accumulate/update methods for AtomicDouble and AtomicDoubleArray. Many APIs are promoted from @Beta across base, collect, escape, io, net, reflect, testlib, and util.concurrent.

In the google/guava release 32.0.0, Files.createTempDir and FileBackedOutputStream are reimplemented to further address CVE-2020-8908 and CVE-2023-2976, but the new implementations throw an exception under Windows. guava-gwt now requires GWT 2.10.0. A binary-incompatible change is made to a @Beta API in guava-testlib. Two methods are added to the Android flavor of Guava that do not work under an Android VM.
In the google/guava release 32.0.1, the io package fixes Files.createTempDir and FileBackedOutputStream under Windows, which broke in release 32.0.0.
In the google/guava release 32.1.0, Gradle Module Metadata is introduced, but the version numbers are broken. The release notes document how to resolve errors for Gradle 6 users.
In the google/guava release 32.1.1, the broken Gradle metadata from 32.1.0 is fixed.

In the google/guava release 32.1.2, the section of Gradle metadata that caused conflicts with listenablefuture is removed. The Maven project is changed to avoid affecting Mockito version resolution. Under J2CL, ImmutableList and ImmutableSet methods copyOf and of are exposed for JavaScript usage. InternetDomainName construction is optimized.

In the google/guava release 32.1.3, Gradle Metadata is changed to include dependency versions directly. The collect package changes Multisets.unmodifiableMultiset(set).removeIf(predicate) to always throw an exception. The graph package fixes the behavior of Graph/ValueGraph views when a node is removed. The io package fixes Files.createTempDir and FileBackedOutputStream under Windows services for Java 9+. The net package makes MediaType.parse allow whitespace around separators. The util.concurrent package tweaks Futures.getChecked constructor-selection behavior.

In the google/guava release 33.0.0, guava-android contains package-private methods with Java 8 Collector API for testing. Various classes are changed to catch Exception instead of RuntimeException. An Automatic-Module-Name is added to failureaccess. In guava-android, Invokable.getAnnotatedReturnType() and Parameter.getAnnotatedType() are removed. util.concurrent implementations are changed to avoid eagerly initializing loggers during class loading.

In the google/guava release 33.1.0, the Error Prone dependency is updated to 2.26.1. The base package adds a Duration overload for Suppliers.memoizeWithExpiration and deprecates remaining overloads of Throwables.propagateIfPossible. The cache package fixes a false "recursive load" report during refresh. The graph package changes return types of transitiveClosure() and reachableNodes() to Immutable types and changes view behavior when an element is removed. The hash package optimizes Checksum-based hash functions for Java 9+. The testing package exposes FakeTicker Duration methods to Android users. The util.concurrent package deprecates constructors of UncheckedExecutionException and ExecutionError without a cause and improves correctness for J2ObjC users.

In the google/guava release 33.2.0, testing for Android versions before Lollipop is dropped. A GWT compilation breakage under Gradle is fixed. The collect package makes Collector APIs available in guava-android and fixes a potential NullPointerException in ImmutableMap.Builder. The net package adds HttpHeaders constants Ad-Auction-Allowed, Permissions-Policy-Report-Only, and Sec-GPC.
In the google/guava release 33.2.1, the net package changes InetAddress-String conversion methods to preserve the IPv6 scope ID if present, which may cause failures if the scope ID fails validation.

In the google/guava release 33.3.0, the base package removes @Beta from the Duration overload of Suppliers.memoizeWithExpiration. The cache package adds CacheBuilder Duration overloads to guava-android. The collect package removes @Beta from guava-android Collector APIs and adds ImmutableMultimap.builderWithExpectedKeys and expectedValuesPerKey. The graph package improves Graphs.hasCycle to avoid StackOverflowError. The net package adds text/markdown to MediaType and deprecates an HttpHeaders constant. The testing package changes some test libraries to throw AssertionError.
In the google/guava release 33.3.1, j2objc-annotations is added to the Gradle runtime classpath to stop an Android Gradle Plugin error.

In the google/guava release 33.4.0, additional Java 8 APIs are exposed to Android users. The base package deprecates Charsets constants in favor of StandardCharsets and adds ToStringHelper.omitEmptyValues(). The collect package adds an optimized copyOf method to TreeRangeMap. The collect.testing package fixes @Require annotations. The io package changes ByteSink and CharSink to no longer call flush() in some cases before close(). The net package adds HttpHeaders.ALT_SVC and MediaType.CBOR.

In the google/guava release 33.4.1, the release notes describe nullness and module-system changes across the 33.4.x series, recommending most users upgrade to 33.4.8. The release itself is part of a series improving nullness annotations.
In the google/guava release 33.4.2, @ParametricNullness is changed into a no-op for Kotlin and IntelliJ, allowing Kotlin to detect more nullness errors.
In the google/guava release 33.4.3, the project migrates from @CheckForNull to the Checker Framework @Nullable, removing the dependency on JSR-305.
In the google/guava release 33.4.4, the project migrates from Checker Framework annotations to JSpecify annotations and makes nullness annotations available in the GWT artifact.

In the google/guava release 33.4.5, the Guava jar is changed to be a modular jar, but the build is misconfigured, causing extra class copies and missing dependency declarations. Various classes stop using sun.misc.Unsafe under Java 9+. The Public Suffix List data is updated.
In the google/guava release 33.4.6, the extra copy of each class from the Guava jar is removed, and annotation-related warnings in modular builds are fixed.

In the google/guava release 33.4.7, the guava module's dependency on failureaccess is made transitive, and guava-testlib module dependencies are adjusted. util.concurrent fast paths are modified to work with optimizers, and the guava-android copy of AbstractFuture tries VarHandle before Unsafe.
In the google/guava release 33.4.8, the VarHandle code is removed from guava-android to fix a problem with the Android Gradle Plugin when minSdkVersion is below 26.

In the google/guava release 33.5.0, the Automatic-Module-Name is restored to guava-android. The Android minSdkVersion is increased to 23. JSpecify annotations are listed as an optional OSGi dependency. The cache package improves exception handling in Cache.asMap(). The collect package improves Iterators.mergeSorted() stability. The graph package removes @Beta from all APIs, adds support for self-loop strategies in Graphs.transitiveClosure(), and adds an asNetwork() view. The hash package adds BloomFilter.serializedSize(). prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent google/zx release stream from version 8.1.9 through 8.8.5, highlighting pipe API enhancements, new features like delayed piping and stream picking, and infrastructure improvements including distribution channels and legacy maintenance.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the google/zx release 8.1.9, the project delivers a minor update that replaces ProcessOutput fields with lazy getters to reduce memory consumption, reduces ReDoS risks for codeblock patterns, keeps argv reference on update, strengthens the Shell interface to properly handle sync mode, and corrects stdall fill for $.sync calls.

In the google/zx release 8.2.0, the project introduces delayed piping that allows filling dependent streams at any time during the origin process lifecycle without losing data, and promisified streams enabling direct piping to writable streams with promise-like behavior.
In the google/zx release 8.2.1, the project fixes endless streams piping and enables custom extensions support.
In the google/zx release 8.2.2, the project adds a test for stdio inherit and fixes handling of nullable stdout/stderr.

chunks.title: 8.2.3 – Golden Wrench
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the google/zx release 8.2.3 (Golden Wrench), the project continues pipe API enhancements by autorunning halted processes on the entire pipe run, allowing $ to be piped directly from streams, mixing ProcessOutput data into promisified pipe values, and tweaking dist contents for better bundler compatibility.

chunks.title: 8.2.4 – Leaky Faucet
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the google/zx release 8.2.4 (Leaky Faucet), the project fixes bun async_hooks compatibility.

chunks.title: 8.3.0 – Pipes of Steel
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the google/zx release 8.3.0 (Pipes of Steel), the project implements Symbol.asyncIterator for ProcessPromise, makes zx version available via JS API, enables stream picking for pipe(), adds signal handling on piping, provides direct piping to file shortcut, allows $.defaults setting via ZX_-prefixed environment variables, introduces --env option to load dotenvs, lands installation registry customization, adds --prefer-local option, fixes temp assets clutter on process.exit(), handles tslib-generated string templates, disables spinner on CI and in quiet mode, adds missing ZX_SHELL env handling, updates contribution guide, builds documentation from main branch, and syncs docs with current API.

chunks.title: 8.3.1 – Perfect Seal
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the google/zx release 8.3.1 (Perfect Seal), the project introduces full-featured .env support via a tiny dotenv-inspired parser and serializer, provides stdall piping, exposes ProcessPromise fullCmd and unique id, simplifies internal regexps, removes zx globals from unit tests scope, adds check if tempfile exists, adds ts support in markdown, enables CodeQL and OSV scanners, configures pre-push git hooks, explicitly declares permissions for test.yml, mentions halt and run API in docs, fixes timeout option handling for corner cases, allows killSignal setting via env vars, adds diagnostic_channel to built-ins list, enhances logger with id field and end event, makes nothrown() toggleable, handles ZX_REPL_HISTORY envvar, fixes file:// protocol check, accepts mode option for tmpdir and tmpfile, enhances deno support, optimizes markdown parser, applies zizmor suggestions, makes minor code improvements, optimizes output buffers joining, fixes predefined _timeoutSignal override, exposes ProcessPromise stage, and aligns script processing flows (CLI).

chunks.title: 8.3.2 – Clogged Drain
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the google/zx release 8.3.2 (Clogged Drain), the project restricts unsafe values usage on dotenv.stringify.

chunks.title: 8.4.0 – Drip Detective
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the google/zx release 8.4.0 (Drip Detective), the project allows --prefer-local to link both external binaries and packages, slightly changes quote for array corner case, provides support for custom script extensions via CLI, enhances nothrow option to suppress any errors, replaces @types/node and @types/fs-extra deps with triple-slash typing refs, makes ProcessOutput iterable, handles inappropriate ProcessPromise instantiation, passes origin error as ProcessOutput cause, separates build and release steps, introduces API bus, optimizes ProcessOutput inners, pins deps, and switches to explicit .ts extensions for relative imports.

chunks.title: 8.4.1 – Rusty Elbow
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the google/zx release 8.4.1 (Rusty Elbow), the project enhances logger by allowing custom formatters for each log entry kind, improves cmd highlighter to properly detect bins and arguments, switches to TS 5.8, applies zizmor to check GHA workflows, and enables prettier as a pre-commit hook.

chunks.title: 8.5.0 — Flow Splitter
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the google/zx release 8.5.0 (Flow Splitter), the project introduces zx@lite, a ~7x smaller version with only core functions, expands distribution channels to npmjs, GH npm, GH repo, GH docker, JSR, and Homebrew, provides a Docker image based on node:22-alpine, adds fetch pipe helper to bypass string size limits, adds glob.sync shortcut, restores CLI flags and envars symmetry, enhances errors stacktrace formatting, improves 3rd party licenses digest, enables zizmor checks, and makes docs improvements.

chunks.title: 8.5.2 — Threaded Perfection
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the google/zx release 8.5.2 (Threaded Perfection), the project applies various JSR fixes and makes docs improvements.

chunks.title: 8.5.3 — Trap Master
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the google/zx release 8.5.3 (Trap Master), the project delivers another portion of JSR related improvements, refactors goods by fixing expBackoff implementation, setting $.log.output as default spinner() output, making question() I/O configurable, adds Graaljs compatibility test, and updates docs and usage examples.

chunks.title: 8.5.4 — Pipe Dreamer

chunks.title: 8.6.0 — Valve Vanguard

chunks.title: 8.6.2 — Flow Unstoppable

chunks.title: 8.7.0 — Solder Savior

chunks.title: 8.7.1 — Pipe Whisperer

chunks.title: 8.8.0 — Pressure Tested
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the google/zx release 8.8.0 (Pressure Tested), the project introduces unpipe() to selectively stop piping, enables many-to-one piping from multiple sources to a single destination, allows piping from rejected processes, and provides a versions static map to access component versions including zx itself.

chunks.title: 8.8.3 — Sealing Gasket

chunks.title: 8.8.4 — Flange Coupling

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent gorhill/uBlock release stream from version 1.52.2 through 1.71.1b1, covering new features, scriptlet additions, filter option enhancements, and bug fixes. The evolution shows a steady progression of content-blocking capabilities, differential update support, and compatibility improvements across browsers.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the gorhill/uBlock release 1.52.2, the release note describes fixes including a fix for XHR hook partial response handling, a regression fix in the :is() operator, a fix for the popup panel viewport assumption in desktop portrait mode, and a fix for removal of the :scope prefix in the :has() operator.

In the gorhill/uBlock release 1.53.0, the release note introduces a new static network filter option urltransform, brings the header= filter option out of experimental status, adds the trusted-click-element scriptlet, adds filtering expressions for logger output, adds a warning against adding custom filters from untrusted sources, considers My filters an untrusted source by default, adds the trusted-prune-inbound-object scriptlet, adds dontOverwrite vararg to (trusted-)set-cookie scriptlets, adds on and off values to set-cookie, supports AdGuard's [trusted-]set-cookie-reload scriptlets, supports quoting scriptlet parameters with backticks, adds ability to update lists through links with specifically crafted URLs, and includes various other scriptlet improvements and fixes.

In the gorhill/uBlock release 1.53.2, the release note states that there is no change from 1.53.0 and that this release exists only as an attempt to unstick publishing of 1.53.0 in the Microsoft Edge Addons store.

In the gorhill/uBlock release 1.53.4, the release note indicates that this release is essentially 1.53.0 plus a fix to address an issue where uBlock Origin blocks local files opening in a new window under certain conditions, which so far has affected only Microsoft Edge. The fix properly resets needle length in unserialized buffer. Other browsers will get that fix in stable release 1.54.0.

In the gorhill/uBlock release 1.54.0, the release note announces differential update of filter lists to reduce bandwidth usage, enables the path for native has() selector in Firefox, allows scriptlets to be injected in about:blank, fixes the faulty as vararg in set-constant scriptlet, adds support to redirect to noop.json, adds the trusted-set-session-storage-item scriptlet, allows the use of quotes in set-cookie and set-(local|session)-storage-item, adds ability to trigger cookie removal on specific events, ensures CSSTree does not hold a reference onto last parsed string, lowers minimum Expires value to 4h, properly resets needle length in unserialized buffer, adds additional flags to regional lists, hardens scriptlets which need to serialize function code into string, resets g regexes before use in rmnt/rpnt scriptlets, applies response filtering according to mime type, and adds t/f to set-cookie.

In the gorhill/uBlock release 1.55.0, the release note includes fixes and changes such as minding drop events in filter expression field of logger, improving xml-prune scriptlet, fixing message entries overflowing in logger, adding support for application/x-javascript in replace= option, extending support for differential updates to imported lists, adding detection of mismatched !#if-!#endif in linter, supporting links to update lists which are differential update-friendly, removing the Purge all caches button from Filter lists pane, adding support for all list token in updater-link feature, fixing logging of broad exception filter #@#+js(), improving no-xhr-if scriptlet, ensuring cache storage backend is selected before access, fixing popup panel rendering when embedded in logger, adding visual hint in support information re. differential update, removing obsolete web accessible resources, renaming urltransform to uritransform, vertically expanding/collapsing in steps in dom inspector, resetting the DOM inspector when URL in top context changes, supporting shadow-piercing combinator >>> in trusted-click-element, isolating DOM inspector layers from page context, refactoring to replace DOM events with broadcast channels, supporting non-default sticky lists, adding enableLazyLoad function, changing frequency of save-to-storage blocking stats, improving prevent-fetch scriptlet, and catching cases of ! Expires: field with no value.

In the gorhill/uBlock release 1.56.0, the release note describes fixes and changes including minding that multiple uritransform may apply to a single request, fixing incorrect built-in filtering expression in logger, fixing improper invalidation of valid uritransform exception filters, improving prevent-addEventListener scriptlet, fixing Chartbeat flicker control div's, fixing potential exfiltration of browsing history by a rogue list author through permissions= and csp=, outputting scriptlet logging information to the logger, fixing decompiling of scriptlet parameters, adding support for extraMatch in trusted-click-element scriptlet, removing minimum height constraint from My filters pane, unregistering all scriptlets when disabling uBO on a specific site, allowing uritransform to process the hash part of a URL, remembering presentation state of My rules pane, fixing improperly assembled !#include sublists, marking procedural filters with pseudo-elements selector as invalid, preventing access to picker when My filters is not enabled, providing visual feedback when applying changes in Filter lists pane, ensuring empty query parameters must still use =, adding support to toggle no-scripting switch with keyboard shortcut, not exceeding rate-limited calls to handlerBehaviorChanged(), shielding some code paths against potentially tampered global properties, and not preventing applying changes when lists are updating.

In the gorhill/uBlock release 1.57.0, the release note includes changes such as not blocking large media resources when loaded as top-level document, properly managing cache storage regarding managed user filters, improving [trusted-]set-cookie scriptlets, fixing Belgian and Nepali flags for Windows Chromium users, minding that tabs.sendMessage can throw, improving set-cookie scriptlet, appending wildcard character only when filter starts & ends with /, fixing failure to create popup logger window sometimes, improving json-prune-related scriptlets, supporting maximizing editor to viewport size, adding advanced setting to force popup panel orientation, adding checkboxes to My filters pane, assuming UTF-8 when no encoding can be looked up, fixing issue with My filters pane on mobile, supporting aborting Pick mode in element picker, removing sections with no lists in Filter lists pane, adding Social widgets and Cookie notices sections in Filter lists pane, no longer disabling generic cosmetic filters by default on mobile, improving spoof-css scriptlet, making asset updater compatible with non-persistent background page, moving dragbar to the top of element picker dialog, moving Quit button to top bar in element picker, adding advanced setting requestStatsDisabled, first looking up matching stock lists when importing URLs, resetting filter lists in worker when creating filters via Block element, removing trusted-source requirement when using badfilter, and redesigning cache storage.

In the gorhill/uBlock release 1.57.2, the release note states that this is an emergency release to fix an issue causing differential updates to fail, primarily affecting Firefox because of uBO's use of indexedDB prior to 1.57.0. The issue did not affect full update of filter lists. The release also contains translation work. The fix addresses stray lists in redesigned cache storage.

In the gorhill/uBlock release 1.58.0, the release note includes changes such as falling back to requestAnimationFrame when requestIdleCallback is not available, improving trusted-click-element scriptlet, replacing EasyDutch with AdGuard Dutch, adding checksum validation when loading trie buffers in selfie, catching exceptions in API calls for old Chromium versions, adding accept/reject to set-local-storage-item, using raw string for regex patterns in python scripts, improving noeval-if scriptlet, improving trusted-set-local-storage-item scriptlet, fixing potential corruption when reading serialized data, improving remove-[attr|class] scriptlets, improving dashboard layout at high zoom factor, adding a console pane to the logger, improving spoof-css scriptlet, fixing bad date computation in auto-comment feature, fixing regression breaking import of file:// lists, adding trusted-replace-outbound-text scriptlet, and improving [trusted-]set-cookie scriptlets.

In the gorhill/uBlock release 1.59.0, the release note describes improvements to href-sanitizer, trusted-replace-node-text, set-constant, prevent-fetch scriptlets; fixes CSP/PP header injection in non-document resources; adds trusted-suppress-native-method scriptlet; adds support for $currentISODate$ in trusted-set-cookie scriptlet; adds essential and nonessential to set-cookie; fixes distance calculation in picker; fixes bad serialization of Date objects; fixes race condition when loading redirect/scriptlet resources; improves logging in prevent-addEventListener scriptlet; adds :matches-prop() pseudo CSS operator; improves set-cookie, trusted-replace-node-text, trusted-replace-(fetch|xhr)-response, prevent-addEventListener scriptlets; adds isodate as available placeholder for auto-comment; improves trusted-replace-outbound-text scriptlet; classifies generic cosmetic filters with comma as highly generic; raises max buffer size for response body filtering; trims end of class tokens in generic cosmetic filtering's surveyor; and improves trusted-set-cookie scriptlet.

In the gorhill/uBlock release 1.60.0, the release note adds advanced setting dnsResolveEnabled, fixes contextual menu quirks, fixes exception thrown in spoof-css in Firefox, throttles down repeated scriptlet logging information, improves scriptlet helper proxy-apply, adds an entry in Report page for badware/phishing category, introduces new static network filter option urlskip=, rewrites cname uncloaking code to account for new ipaddress= option, avoids using dns.resolve() for proxied DNS resolution, adds support for lan/loopback values to ipaddress= option, adds new static network filter option ipaddress=, adds ability to quote static network option values, improves prevent-fetch scriptlet, applies CSP/PP injections to object resources, improves xml-prune scriptlet, adds support for application/dash+xml in replace= option, adds ability to directly evaluate static network filtering engine, fixes prevent-window-open for when logger is open, improves prevent-window-open scriptlet, improves validate-constant scriptlet helper, improves trusted-replace-outbound-text scriptlet, improves prevent-xhr scriptlet, adds noop resources for redirect purpose, uses helper function to lookup safe cookie values, adds checked/unchecked to set-cookie, and adds allowed/denied to set-local-storage-item.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent grpc/grpc release stream from v1.71.0 through v1.81.0, including prereleases and patch releases. It captures core improvements, language-specific updates, and bug fixes across multiple versions.

chunks.title: Release v1.71.0-pre3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the grpc/grpc repository, release v1.71.0-pre3 is a prerelease of gRPC Core 1.71.0 (gears). It contains refinements, improvements, and bug fixes.

chunks.title: Release v1.71.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the grpc/grpc repository, release v1.71.0 is the stable release of gRPC Core 1.71.0 (gears). It includes core changes such as fixing call attempt tracer lifetimes for retries, fixing a pick_first bug that stopped triggering connection attempts, adding support for service deprecated option in C++ codegen, and adding a SetDefaultEventEngine API. C++ changes include restricting grpc++_public_hdrs target visibility and adding a C++17 cmake option. Python drops support for Python 3.8 and adds musl-linux binary wheels on arm64. Ruby builds and tests Ruby 3.4 and builds native gems with Ruby 3.4 support.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the grpc/grpc repository, release v1.71.1 is a patch release of gRPC Core 1.71.1 (gears). It fixes a use-after-free in RLS from accessing config after LB policy shutdown and fixes a busy loop in the EventEngine thread pool when shutting down.

chunks.title: Release v1.72.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the grpc/grpc repository, release v1.72.1 is a patch release of gRPC Core 1.72.1 (gusto). It includes backports: protecting grpc generated sources from unwanted system macros in C++, pinning Cython to 3.1.1 in Python to address inconsistent Cython versions and a memory leak in AsyncIO APIs, and fixing Python 3.12 MacOS universal release artifacts.

chunks.title: Release v1.73.0

C++ marks OpenCensus and dependent APIs as deprecated. Python pins Cython to 3.1.1 and makes grpc_tools handle dot in proto paths. Ruby adds remove_unused_artifacts to opt build.

chunks.title: Release v1.74.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the grpc/grpc repository, release v1.74.0 is the stable release of gRPC Core 1.74.0 (gee). Core changes include plumbing TCP write timestamps and metrics to OTel tracers, implementing fork support in Posix Event Engine, and fixing GRPC_ARG_HTTP2_STREAM_LOOKAHEAD_BYTES when BDP is disabled. Objective-C upgrades Protobuf to 31.1. PHP fully qualifies stdClass with global namespace, fixes PHPDoc for UnaryCall return type, and fixes typing of nullable parameters. Python fixes the gRPC Python Client not reconnecting in certain situations and fixes the docs website layout. Ruby adds rubygems support for linux-gnu and linux-musl platforms, enables EE fork support, returns nil for c functions expected to return a VALUE, removes connectivity state watch thread and fixes cancellations from spurious signals, and drops Ruby 3.0 support.

chunks.title: Release v1.74.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the grpc/grpc repository, release v1.74.1 is a patch release of gRPC Core 1.74.1 (gee) for grpc-ruby. It backports a fix to mark credential object in channel to fix an issue.

chunks.title: Release v1.75.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the grpc/grpc repository, release v1.75.0 is the stable release of gRPC Core 1.75.0 (gemini). Core changes include cherry-picking Spiffe Verification, adding Typeguard to AIO stack in tests for Python, updating c-ares to 1.34.5, and fixing a pick_first bug that stopped attempting to connect. C++ implements retry metrics for OTel. Objective-C fixes a data race by adding custom getter for state property with synchronized locking. Python now depends on typing-extensions~=4.13, updates musllinux wheels to musllinux_1_2, fixes grpc.aio typehints, metadata type validation, serializer parameters, and an error in public API where ClientCallDetails.method was declared as str but called with bytes, and fixes installation on non-Mac Apple devices. Ruby marks credential object in channel and adds rubygems support for linux-gnu and linux-musl platforms.

chunks.title: Release v1.75.1

Python changes include releasing grpcio wheels with Python 3.14 support, fixing a grpc shutdown race condition during Python interpreter finalizations, and preserving current behavior when using grpc.aio async methods outside of a running event loop for Python 3.14.

chunks.title: Release v1.76.0-pre1

Python fixes a race condition causing asyncio.run() to hang forever during shutdown, migrates to pyproject.toml build system from setup.py builds, logs error details when ExecuteBatchError occurs at DEBUG level, and updates setuptools min version to 77.0.1. chunks.title: Release v1.80.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the grpc/grpc repository, release v1.80.0 is the stable release of gRPC Core 1.80.0 (glimmering). Core changes include implementing TLS private key signer in Python, private key offload implementation for TLS credentials, fixing max sockaddr struct size on OpenBSD, enabling EventEngine for Python by default and EventEngine fork support in Python and Ruby, creating InMemoryCertificateProvider to update certificates independently, building and testing ruby 4.0 and building native gems with Ruby 4.0 support, removing an incorrect std::move in DNSServiceResolver constructor, enabling change to connect from a random index for RR and WRR, and implementing gRFC A101 for xds. C++ adds SNI override option to channel credentials options API. C# tools add option to append Async to server side method names. Objective-C fixes plugins falling back to edition 2023 for older protobuf. PHP disables infinite recursion check for callback from Core to PHP and fixes a runtime error with PHP 8.5 alpha. Python fixes GRPC_TRACE not working when absl log initialized in cython, reverts alignment of GRPC_ENABLE_FORK_SUPPORT env defaults, fixes AsyncIO Server maximum_concurrent_rpcs enforcement, corrects grpc.Compression references in docs, adds Typeguard to AIO stack in tests, fixes multi-thread exception for Asyncio gRPC clients, resolves absl::InitializeLog warning, removes IF usage in Cython, adds language features to exported proto files, fixes crash when iterating on AIO Metadata, and modernizes and revamps Public API Docs. Ruby adds support to push native-debug packages off rubygems to public gcs bucket.

chunks.title: Release v1.81.0-pre1

Objective-C adds receiveNextMessage to GRPCUnaryProtoCall. Python adds typing_extensions dep to aio Bazel target, starts Pyright for aio/_base_server.py, drops Python 3.9, relaxes protobuf dependency upper bound in grpc-status to allow 7.x, adds Typeguard SYNC Stack in tests, removes GIL from ReceiveMessageOperation.un_c method, and supports observability in AsyncIO stack. Ruby drops support for EOL Ruby 3.1 and cleans up, and composed CallCredentials keep a reference to their source.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent hakimel/reveal.js release stream from version 3.5.0 through 6.0.1, covering major feature additions like auto-animate, scroll view, lightbox, and the React wrapper, along with numerous bug fixes and plugin improvements.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hakimel/reveal.js release 3.5.0, the project introduces a display config option for controlling slide section display mode, a toggleHelp() method, speaker notes support for slide fragments, pacing advice in the speaker view, a textarea data-template wrapper for Markdown, autoplay for background videos in iOS, interactive background iframes when no content or data-background-interactive is present, shifting dependencies to devDependencies, and loading MathJax from cdnjs. Bug fixes address multiple autoplay issues with video and audio, and overview rendering in Firefox.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 3.6.0, the project moves to a new domain revealjs.com, introduces redesigned presentation control arrows that bounce to attract attention and auto-contrast with the background, a controlsLayout option for edge-aligned controls, a mobile-friendly layout for shared speaker notes, improved search plugin with CTRL+SHIFT+F shortcut, lazy-loaded video unloading, an autoSlide option to prevent all auto-sliding, new API methods isSpeakerNotes(), loadSlide(), and unloadSlide(), always-visible video/audio controls on mobile, and default quotation marks for <q> in themes. Bug fixes include preventing configure() from being called before or after initialize(), not applying text-transform uppercase inside code tags, fixing Mobile Safari chrome covering content in landscape, and a feature test exception for speaker notes in Safari.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 3.7.0, the project adds a Key Binding API, pdfSeparateFragments option for exporting fragments on separate PDF pages, fragmentInURL option, hashOneBasedIndex option, data-background-opacity attribute, a Resume presentation button on the pause overlay, two new fragment styles (semi-fade-out and fade-in-then-semi-out), new API methods syncSlide and syncFragments, removal of arbitrary restrictions on slide IDs, the slide number as an anchor pointing to the current hash, and whitespace allowed in background image names. Bug fixes include hiding left/right arrows when no horizontal slides, preserving present class on same-slide navigation, loop option working with only vertical slides, graceful error handling for duplicate slide IDs, and interactive iframe backgrounds in vertical slides.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 3.8.0, the project introduces automatic cursor hiding after inactivity, pinch-to-zoom on touch devices, a navigationMode config option (default/linear/grid), a hash config option for reflecting the current slide in the address bar without pushing history, a preloadIframes config option, a resize event dispatched on scale changes, hiding the Resume button when controls are false, a new keyboard shortcut CMD/CTRL + left/right for first/last slide, getRevealElement() API method, removal of Head JS and classList polyfill, separation of reset styles into reset.css, zoom transition now zooms between all slides, and upgrade to Socket.IO 2.2.0. Plugin changes include a new plugin registration API, code highlighting with line numbers and line highlights, speaker view working from filesystem, asynchronous external Markdown loading, marked 0.6.0 upgrade, and configurable MathJax options. Bug fixes address npm security warnings, internal link double-click, data-transition on vertical slides, double slide method invocation, speaker notes layout, getProgress() exceeding 1, speaker view multiple openings, vertical overflow in mobile browsers, and more.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 3.9.0, the project adds step-by-step code highlights, postMessage callbacks, pacing timer accepting total presentation time, background iframes no longer preloading by default, honoring slideNumber format in PDF exports, data-fragment attribute on slide sections, getHorizontalSlides() and getVerticalSlides() API methods, hasHorizontalSlides() and hasVerticalSlides() API methods, mobileViewDistance config option, allow="autoplay" on iframes for Chrome autoplay policy, switching to CSS transforms for HDPI scaling, changing first/last slide shortcuts to Shift+left/right, and updating highlight.js to 9.18.0. Bug fixes include navigation down-arrow blocked by progress bar, swipe navigation in linear mode, vertical overflow in iPadOS Safari, inconsistent fragment slide animations, failing npm install, and exception on empty code blocks.
In the hakimel/reveal.js release 3.9.1, the release contains no changes and was only published to bump the npm version after 3.9.0 was published with local edits.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 3.9.2, the project fixes a security vulnerability in the postMessage API by blacklisting the methods registerPlugin, registerKeyboardShortcut, addKeyBinding, and addEventListener.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 4.0.0, the project introduces breaking changes and highlights including a new website, docs, and logo, Auto-Animate for complex animations, support for multiple presentations on the same page, an embedded config option, keyboardCondition 'focused' option, rewriting core and plugins as ES modules with UMD and ES module bundles, auto-scrolling code highlights, initialize() returning a promise, switching build system to gulp with rollup, moving compiled CSS to dist/, moving print CSS into reveal.js, adding slidetransitionend event, r-stack layout helper, data-visibility="uncounted", getComputedSlideSize API, renaming add/removeEventListener to on/off, removing default border from images, and removing bower.json. Plugin changes include new registration syntax, built-in plugins as ES modules, notes plugin no longer needing external notes.html, highlight.js 10.0.1, moving highlight themes, installing highlight.js and marked from npm, Markdown support for line numbers and highlights, boolean data- attributes, and moving multiplex and notes server to separate repos. Bug fixes include links not working in exported PDF.
In the hakimel/reveal.js release 4.0.1, the project fixes issues with printing speaker notes to PDF and incorrect auto-animations when multiple auto-animated presentations are on the same page.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 4.0.2, the project enables caching for JavaScript builds, makes data-autoslide take precedence over video duration detection in auto-sliding, removes overzealous reset styles when printing to PDF, makes configure and isReady available pre-initialization, switches to serving demo assets from a CDN, fixes polyfills and adds IE 11 support, and fixes the progress bar direction in right-to-left mode.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 4.1.0, the project adds data-visibility="hidden" to hide slides, r-fit-text class for auto-sizing text, exposes slide width/height as CSS variables, shuffles vertical slides with shuffle config, inverts text color based on background in all themes, includes /css and /js in npm package, and fixes not appending #/ to URL on first slide, not filling progress bar with one slide, and correct slide count with data-visibility="uncounted".

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 4.1.1, the project adds support for Node.js 16, multiple images in data-background-image, Markdown animateLists config option, reduces tab size in code blocks to 2, improves progress bar click accuracy, optimizes DOM interactions for PDF export, and fixes video/audio stopping when fragment hidden, Markdown splitting by default separator, r-fit-text sizing in PDF exports, slide-specific transitions overridden by global, and has-dark-background with named colors.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 4.1.2, the project adds support for data-auto-animate-restart and data-auto-animate-id for finer auto-animate control, exposes theme properties as CSS variables, and fixes Markdown-enabled speaker notes being visible on-slide.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 4.2.0, the project adds support for three math typesetting libraries (KaTeX, MathJax 2, MathJax 3), a beforeslidechange event, keyboard shortcut for skipping fragments (alt + arrows), API option for skipping fragments in directional navigation, beforeHighlight callback in highlight plugin, code line numbers starting from an offset, better error messaging for missing containers, and fixes last slide shortcut in looped presentations, Markdown code blocks as fragments, unit tests on Windows, base64 background images, looping with linear navigationMode, and internal links starting media playback on mobile.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 4.2.1, the project fixes slides disappearing after transitions in Chrome, double-navigations impacting performance, --host not working in npm start, incorrect auto-sized text sizing in PDF exports, and background video playback by inferring MIME type from file extension.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 4.3.0, the project adds the ability to destroy/uninitialize a presentation, support for an absolute URL in speaker view, includes source maps in dist, and fixes speaker view going out of sync after live-reloading, XSS vulnerability in speaker view, and scaling issues with embedded presentations in Safari fullscreen.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 4.3.1, the project fixes speaker view not working from file:// protocol, console errors from non-reveal.js postMessage events, providing custom config for MathJax3 plugin, ZIP package gulp task, and replaces deprecated String.prototype.substr().

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 4.4.0, the project adds gradient slide backgrounds, shows multiple separate notes for the same slide in speaker view, updates browser targets, stops using zoom for presentation scaling, and fixes speaker view syncing, incorrect slide numbers in PDF exports of vertical slides, inconsistent fragment visibility in looped presentations, r-fit-text truncation in PDF exports, and auto-animate interfering with inherited line-height.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 4.5.0, the project adds jump-to-slide functionality, dracula theme, black-contrast and white-contrast high contrast themes, default lang attribute, easier custom fragment styles via .custom class, live reload for files in subfolders, and fixes npm audit warnings, special characters in background image URLs, leading whitespace stripped from Markdown, spacing in overview mode with disableLayout, print styles applying outside reveal.js, and selection color contrast for black theme.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 4.6.0, the project adds line number offsets in Markdown code blocks, speeds up livereload, supports links to nested element IDs, ability to override Markdown plugin default options, allows theme subfolders, refactors Markdown plugin, and fixes auto-slide duration fallback, fragment data-autoslide timing, code block auto-animate unmatched lines, livereload with root CLI param, scss watch tasks, typos, code block font when printing PDF, dracula theme list-style and li markers.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 5.0.0, the project introduces scroll view as a groundbreaking new feature, automatically enabled for viewports below 435px wide, with config options for fine-tuning. Breaking change: scroll view auto-enabled on mobile. Also adds PDF print view via config or ?view=print query, and fixes notes from data-notes not working on slide-level and replaces deprecated mousewheel/DOMMouseScroll with wheel event listener.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 5.0.2, the project upgrades dependencies, makes Markdown plugin callable without a reveal deck instance, fixes an exception in speaker view, and fixes a future vertical slide background flashing prematurely.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 5.0.3, the project adds search plugin support for diacritics and full phrases, jump-to-slide adapting to slide number format, slide background XSS prevention, and fixes speaker notes not appearing in PDF exports, exception when stepping backwards through code highlights, exception when navigating decks in mobile browsers, pause/help overlay position in scroll view, and mobile scroll view navigation when fragments begin at index higher than 1.
In the hakimel/reveal.js release 5.0.4, the project fixes missing slide backgrounds in mobile scroll view.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 5.0.5, the project adds keyboard navigation support in scroll view, F1 shortcut for help overlay, and fixes postMessage XSS exploit, stack backgrounds not working in scroll view, and fragmentshown/fragmenthidden events not firing in scroll view.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 5.1.0, the project adds enter-fullscreen class for fullscreen triggers, seamless video backgrounds across slides, and fixes MathJax3 plugin with non-singleton instances, swipe gestures on videos, exception when destroying uninitialized instance, videos restarting on fragment show, broken backwards navigation in RTL mode, error on non-string message in notes plugin, question mark shortcut on non-English keyboards, and r-stack overflow in Chromium.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 5.2.0, the project introduces the Lightbox feature for image/video overlays, upgrades to gulp 5.0, adds controls: "speaker-only" config option, extends search API with closeSearch and toggleSearch, automatic source code spellcheck via GitHub action, math plugin ignoring code tags by default, muted background videos autoplay in speaker view, prevents initialize from being called twice, auto-animate no longer skips matching fragments on adjacent slides, and fixes reveal.js not covering full viewport height in iOS, background video restarting when switching fragments from notes view, gulp package not working in gulp 5, and last slide not triggering slidechange event in scroll view.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 5.2.1, the project provides lightbox bug fixes and improvements: preventing reveal.js keyboard shortcuts while lightbox is open, opening iframe lightboxes via data-preview-link on all element types, persisting/restoring lightbox state with getState/setState, syncing lightbox between speaker view and main window, fixing pause overlay/lightbox layering conflict, and adding a lightbox example to demo.html.

In the hakimel/reveal.js release 6.0.0, the project introduces a new official React wrapper package @revealjs/react, breaking changes including plugin path moves, ES module path renames, CSS path changes, and TypeScript types included. Other changes: switch from gulp to Vite, dark mode and llms.txt support for revealjs.com, controls: 'speaker' config option, videos blocked from autoplaying play muted with unmute button, MathJax 4 support, accessibility improvements, sync() updates slide classes, sync event dispatched, removeHiddenSlides() API, data-id support for slide links, data-preview-link value precedence, preventIframeAutoFocus config option, Enter on active slide in overview exits overview, display config supports !important, distinct active/hover state in overview. Fixes include videos not autoplaying on Android, initial video autoplay on Android, multiple videos failing to render in Mobile Safari, overview missing thumbnails in adjacent stacks, missing font in dracula theme, and more.
In the hakimel/reveal.js release 6.0.1, the project upgrades to Vite 8 and TS 6, blacklists previewIframe in postMessage API, and fixes an exception in media control removal during PDF exports.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent halo-dev/halo release stream from v2.21.10 through v2.24.2, including alpha, beta, rc, and stable releases. It covers new features like editor enhancements, Spring Boot upgrades, and numerous bug fixes and optimizations.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the halo-dev/halo release v2.21.10, the release note describes optimizations for password reset case sensitivity and adding an insert image option to the editor command palette. It also fixes a potential memory leak, an issue where the Console could not request interfaces in offline environments, and an abnormal page jump when switching code block languages.

chunks.title: 2.22.0-alpha.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.0-alpha.1, the release note introduces new features including a gallery (image collection) function for the editor, support for setting protected usernames during registration, adding description text to images, videos, and audio in the editor, refactored editor drag functionality with an operation menu, support for Chinese symbols and suggestion menus in the editor, setting cover images on the article editing page, setting display priority for attachment storage policies on the upload interface, and hiding some storage policies on the attachment upload interface. Optimizations include cleaning up residual data from notification sending, skipping database queries when the homepage does not use article list variables, allowing '.' and '?' in user passwords, adding timeouts to blocking operations, optimizing editor styles and interactions, improving Console and UC loading speeds, enhancing Console code input box rendering speed, merging third-party login and two-step authentication into one tab in personal center identity settings, asynchronous loading of language packs for Console and UC, lazy loading of some routes, displaying usernames when selecting authors in article settings, fixing offline Console interface requests, solving potential memory overflow during thumbnail generation, configuring thumbnail generation enable/disable and concurrency, adding insert image option to editor command palette, refactoring image thumbnail functionality to generate on demand instead of storing records, and adding Shiki code highlighting and hyperlink card preset plugins. Fixes include resolving inability to insert videos in the editor, potential theme configuration initialization failure, potential memory leak, password reset case sensitivity, abnormal page jump when switching code block languages, and potential failure to obtain attachment links. Dependency updates include upgrading Spring Boot to 3.5.7 and Tiptap to 3.x. Developer-related changes include fixing Dropdown component type issues, renaming @halo-dev/console-shared to @halo-dev/ui-shared, providing a uuid generation method, and providing stores object with currentUser and globalInfo.

chunks.title: 2.22.0-alpha.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.0-alpha.2, the release note describes optimizations such as reducing the height of the cover in the article editor and supporting image expansion, optimizing image size settings in the editor by not setting a default height, and supporting manual editing of icon information in FormKit Iconify. It fixes an issue where the editor search and replace box position was incorrect. Developer-related changes include FormKit Iconify supporting display of iconify data, fixing an issue where multiple Array input types in a form caused display anomalies, and supporting configuration of the expansion position for FormKit Iconify input boxes.

chunks.title: 2.22.0-alpha.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.0-alpha.3, the release note includes optimizations for Console and UC loading speed, system performance, article detail page loading, and editor search interface styles. Developer-related changes include FormKit Color supporting hsl format and manual color value editing, injecting current form data into article and page metadata forms to determine whether to display form items, and modifying the data structure of FormKit Iconify form type to store as an object by default.

chunks.title: 2.22.0-alpha.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.0-alpha.4, the release note describes optimizations including refactoring the attachment selection modal to integrate with the upload interface and refactoring the attachment form type to support preview and direct upload. It fixes issues with asynchronous loading of Console language packs and potential inability to preview Iconify form items in Array form types.

chunks.title: 2.22.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.0-rc.1, the release note includes a dependency update to upgrade Spring Boot to 3.5.9. Developer-related changes include the Array form type list supporting display of color values.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.0, the release note introduces new features such as an image gallery function for the editor, support for setting protected usernames during registration, adding description text to images, videos, and audio in the editor, refactored editor drag functionality with an operation menu, support for Chinese symbols and suggestion menus in the editor, setting cover images on the article editing page, setting display priority for attachment storage policies on the upload interface, and hiding some storage policies on the attachment upload interface. Optimizations include cleaning up residual data from notification sending, allowing '.' and '?' in user passwords, adding timeouts to blocking operations, optimizing editor styles and interactions, improving Console and UC loading speeds, enhancing Console code input box rendering speed, merging third-party login and two-step authentication into one tab in personal center identity settings, asynchronous loading of language packs for Console and UC, lazy loading of some routes, displaying usernames when selecting authors in article settings, fixing offline Console interface requests, solving potential memory overflow during thumbnail generation, configuring thumbnail generation enable/disable and concurrency, adding insert image option to editor command palette, refactoring image thumbnail functionality to generate on demand instead of storing records, adding Shiki code highlighting and hyperlink card preset plugins, optimizing system performance, optimizing article detail page loading, optimizing editor search interface styles, refactoring the attachment selection modal to integrate with the upload interface, refactoring the attachment form type to support preview and direct upload, and refactoring default storage policy configuration to be unified in settings -> attachment settings. Developer-related changes include fixing @halo-dev/components Dropdown component type issues, renaming @halo-dev/console-shared to @halo-dev/ui-shared, providing a uuid generation method, providing stores object with currentUser and globalInfo, and other changes.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.1, the release note describes an optimization to the Iconify form type icon style to not fix the width for better compatibility. It fixes an issue where the attachment group dropdown options were not fully displayed. Developer-related changes include adding a Switch form type for FormKit.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.2, the release note includes an optimization to increase the length limit of titles and aliases for articles, pages, and categories for better compatibility. It fixes issues where the system could not start normally with some databases and where some article routing rule configurations were ineffective.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.3, the release note describes optimizations including support for logging in with a verified email and support for metadata forms in personal center article settings.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.4, the release note fixes issues including the last page of data potentially containing some data from the previous page, incorrect description text for avatar attachment configuration by removing non-existent group option descriptions, inability to access thumbnails on Windows and Linux, and inability to correctly upload a single image when pasting rich text in the editor.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.5, the release note describes optimizations to plugin enable/disable logic and system and plugin startup speed. It fixes issues including inability to display images due to plugins not adapting to thumbnails, backup-related data remaining after backup restoration, inability to access thumbnails when image links contain Chinese characters, duplicate registration with the same email in different cases, and potential inability to access the comment management list.
In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.6, the release note fixes issues including inaccurate comment counts and potential inability to start and update plugins.
In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.7, the release note fixes an issue where plugins could fail if the startup time was too long.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.8, the release note describes optimizations including support for logging out on the two-step verification interface, improving system stability and concurrent access, optimizing homepage loading speed under specific conditions, reducing login device update frequency to lower SQL queries, implementing intelligent threshold scrolling for the editor, and removing the default color set when creating article tags. It fixes issues including potential system inaccessibility after stopping a plugin, inaccurate multi-value index query results, attachment form type removal logic inconsistency with the old version, and ineffectiveness of alignment tools in the default editor top toolbar for images, videos, and audio. Developer-related changes include adding a toggle component for FormKit.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.9, the release note fixes issues including the Formkit Toggle component switching being ineffective, incorrect success prompt when transferring a single image in the editor, a 500 error when accessing an attachment after deletion, and the tag and category selector dropdown being obscured when embedded in a modal.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.10, the release note describes optimizations including automatically kicking out all login sessions after modifying a user role, optimizing system performance, allowing modification of some default storage policy configurations, and removing the default memory limit. It fixes issues including layout disorder when opening historical articles and query results not meeting expectations under specific conditions. Developer-related changes include simplifying the /actuator/globalinfo endpoint by removing unnecessary fields and refactoring the Secret form item interaction logic to support setting multiple required keys.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.11, the release note describes optimizations including solving the issue of private articles not being displayed in the homepage article list and optimizing the theme installation and update experience. It fixes issues including potential failure when assigning roles to users and icon preview style issues in Array form items. Developer-related changes include adding attachment group information to the attachment plugin upload context.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.12, the release note describes an optimization to adapt the Array component to most components in Halo and support Select remote data sources. It fixes an issue where the Secret component UI was too long and the border was obscured when on the last line.
In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.13, the release note fixes an issue where the Array component rendered abnormally with null values.
In the halo-dev/halo release v2.22.14, the release note fixes an issue where the first image would be overwritten when copying or pasting images in the editor.

chunks.title: 2.23.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the halo-dev/halo release v2.23.0-beta.1, the release note introduces new features including adding a scroll-to-top button on theme and plugin settings pages, adding an 'apply width to full text' function for images in the editor, supporting setting the number of articles displayed on the author page in article settings, and supporting article version comparison. Optimizations include allowing removal of the selected parent menu when creating a new menu item, applying reserved usernames to display names in system settings, adding a like count widget to the Console dashboard, and optimizing the default sorting of comment management in the Console to prioritize recently replied comments. Fixes include resolving a hidden blank page issue in FormKit Iconify form type, resolving FormKit Array form type inability to support image multi-select rendering, resolving the issue of the first image being overwritten when copying or pasting images in the editor, fixing inability to upload files in the article editor after first installing Halo, resolving Array component null value rendering exception, resolving FormKit Secret form type UI border obscuring when on the last line, and fixing abnormal rendering when the homepage article list pagination parameter is not a number. In the halo-dev/halo release v2.23.1, the release note describes an optimization to add a description field to article tags. It includes a dependency update to upgrade the MariaDB driver for improved compatibility.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.23.2, the release note fixes issues including abnormal scrolling when other editors are nested in the rich text editor, potential errors when FormKit Array renders images, and the FormKit Iconify form potentially closing automatically when customizing images. It includes a dependency update to upgrade Spring Boot to 4.0.4. Developer-related changes include fixing the missing _templateId variable on the tag archive page.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.23.3, the release note fixes issues including incorrect display of alignment icons for image, video, and audio types in the editor, inability to set the author when creating an article, potential failure of some plugins containing Finder API to start after upgrade, and a large number of warning logs when attachment plugins do not implement thumbnail generation.

In the halo-dev/halo release v2.24.0, the release note introduces new features including improving the management functionality of the plugin details page, supporting plugin reloading in the Console plugin management, supporting direct selection of current roles when creating personal tokens, and supporting menu cloning. Fixes include fixing the issue where newly added configuration defaults may not take effect after theme updates, fixing a black line appearing when the Console input box is focused, fixing incorrect absolute path generation for attachments when the external access address ends with '/', fixing inability to set the author when creating an article, fixing incorrect display of alignment icons for image, video, and audio types in the editor, fixing missing theme upgrade permission when generating personal tokens with theme management permissions, fixing a large number of warning logs when attachment plugins do not implement thumbnail generation, and fixing potential failure of some plugins containing Finder API to start after upgrade. In the halo-dev/halo release v2.24.1, the release note includes a security fix to strengthen the target address verification when uploading attachments via URL in the personal center to reduce the risk of server-side request abuse.
