prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent hasura/graphql-engine release stream across patch and minor releases, including security fixes, server improvements, console updates, and data connector enhancements.

chunks.title: v2.45.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine release v2.45.0, the server fixes a websocket connection timeout issue, corrects the isRepeatable field in directive introspection, and updates the http-log-query-only-on-error flag behavior. It also adds a new flag to include query field in http-log only on error, hides internal action errors unless dev mode or admin internal errors are enabled, and introduces a hasura_postgres_connection_error_total metric (Cloud/Enterprise). The console fixes a permission builder crash with composite foreign keys and adds session variable support for _in and _nin operators in performance mode.

chunks.title: v2.45.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.45.1, the CLI allows migration directories with 14-digit numeric prefixes to be picked up when running 'hasura scripts update-project-v3'.

chunks.title: v2.44.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.44.1, the console adds support for session variables for the _in and _nin operators while creating permissions in data tab performance mode. The build updates the ubi9 image for security vulnerabilities for the GraphQL engine.

chunks.title: v2.45.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.45.2, the server fixes a ConnectionClosed error during metadata apply and silences some websocket messages incorrectly logged as errors. The console fixes the Model Summary for MongoDB databases and an email alerts modal crash in Schema Registry (Cloud only). The build updates RH, Quarkus, Kotlin, Snowflake, Ubuntu Jammy base image, and ubi9 image for security updates.

chunks.title: v2.46.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine beta release v2.46.0-beta.1, the server fixes an issue where Postgres reset JSON parameters to empty strings after a transaction, causing event trigger failures. It attempts to set Haskell runtime threads based on cgroup CPU limits for better sizing in Docker/Kubernetes, adds an optional no_transaction flag to run_sql API for executing SQL outside transaction blocks, fixes source metadata erasure on inconsistent source update, marks remote schemas as inconsistent on type conflicts, and hides internal action errors unless dev mode or admin internal errors are enabled. It also fixes the hasura_active_subscriptions metric inconsistency, increases execution time metrics upper bound to 100s, adds hasura_events_fetch_query_time and hasura_events_fetched_total metrics, and fixes metrics label for DB with non-standard URI (Cloud/Enterprise).

chunks.title: v2.46.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine release v2.46.0, the server includes the same fixes and features as v2.46.0-beta.1: fixing Postgres JSON parameter reset, setting Haskell runtime threads based on cgroup CPU limits, adding no_transaction flag to run_sql API, fixing hasura_active_subscriptions metric inconsistency, fixing source metadata erasure, marking remote schemas inconsistent on type conflicts, hiding internal action errors, increasing execution time metrics upper bound to 100s, adding event fetch metrics, and fixing metrics label for non-standard URI (Cloud/Enterprise).

chunks.title: v2.36.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.36.10, the build updates the Ubuntu Jammy base image and RH image to get the latest security updates.

chunks.title: v2.47.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine beta release v2.47.0-beta.1, the server avoids attempting to CREATE EXTENSION pgcrypto if it already exists, aiding Azure users with unprivileged Postgres users. It adds a HASURA_GRAPHQL_REDIS_NO_FAIL_ON_STARTUP option to allow startup with rate limiting and caching disabled on Redis errors (Enterprise). The console fixes connection template and Dynamic Routing settings reset when editing database in Connection Details page (Cloud/Enterprise). The CLI adds a --no-transaction flag to migrate apply command. The build updates libpq version in UBI9 base image.

chunks.title: v2.47.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine release v2.47.0, the server includes the same features as v2.47.0-beta.1: avoiding duplicate pgcrypto extension creation, adding HASURA_GRAPHQL_REDIS_NO_FAIL_ON_STARTUP option (Enterprise), console fix for connection template and Dynamic Routing settings reset (Cloud/Enterprise), CLI --no-transaction flag for migrate apply, and libpq update. Additionally, it includes a security fix for nested inherited roles permission propagation, ensuring permissions are properly applied through multiple levels of role inheritance for both queries and mutations.

chunks.title: v2.48.3

chunks.title: v2.48.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.48.4, the server fixes non-compliant OpenAPI specs generated when routes use path parameters or GET with parameters, fixes a bug in experimental 'remove_empty_subscription_responses' causing database query error for non-array-returning live queries, ignores unknown key types when parsing JWK-set JSON, and sets JAVA_OPTS for Snowflake RSA key authentication in bundled super-connector (Enterprise).

chunks.title: v2.48.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.48.5, the server removes all value_from_env and known-sensitive header values from event trigger logs to protect secrets, and allows JWKs that omit the 'use' field.

chunks.title: v2.48.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.48.6, the server supports Postgres version 17, fixes a bug where types from two remote joins with different type prefixes and namespaces might be inter-mixed, and partially fixes a bug in streaming subscriptions on non-unique columns where rows may be skipped when the column contains duplicates (fixed for Postgres and Citus, remains for Cockroach and others).

chunks.title: v2.48.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.48.9, the server fixes a bug where the connection_lifetime pool setting was not correctly set, supports PostgreSQL 18 in Docker images, ignores tracing related headers while caching auth-hook responses, and fixes an erroneous 'overloaded functions are not supported' error due to oid overlap. The console fixes a bug where saving permissions for non-admin roles in remote schemas failed.

chunks.title: v2.48.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.48.10, the server improves BigQuery schema introspection performance when there are many tables, and adds configurable Redis pool size options for caching and rate limiting with default increased to 500 (Enterprise). The console fixes a bug where deselecting or clearing a column type in the table schema editor causes existing columns to be duplicated.

chunks.title: v2.48.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.48.11, the server fixes a SuperConnector error caused by permissions in relationships in mutations where the SQL temp table name was improperly threaded, updates the ubuntu container base image to jammy-20260109, and upgrades pgdump in containers to fully support postgres 18.

chunks.title: v2.48.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.48.12, the server fixes a performance issue where large gzipped responses caused long cumulative GC sync phase pauses, and fixes duplicate event triggers firing when an event trigger was moved from one table to another. Data connectors fix a bug in the super-connector (MySQL) where queries on self-referencing tables fail with 'Relation not found' when SELECT permission filter navigates through the same self-referencing relationship, and fix update mutations on nullable columns via data connectors (Enterprise/cloud).

chunks.title: v2.48.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.48.13, the server sets error status and message in OpenTelemetry spans consistent with logs (Enterprise/cloud), and fixes active subscriptions EKG gauge going negative due to unconditional decrement in removeLiveQuery and removeStreamingQuery.

chunks.title: v2.48.14
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.48.14, data connectors fix a performance issue in Oracle introspection of the super-connector.

chunks.title: v2.48.15
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.48.15, data connectors fix MariaDB update and delete mutations failing with 'temp table doesn't exist' error by adding a dedicated MariaDBMutationTranslator with proper temporary table lifecycle management.

chunks.title: v2.48.16
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.48.16, the server fixes the hasura_http_response_bytes_total metric so it does not count the size of internal error fields when those fields are not returned to the client.

chunks.title: v2.45.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine patch release v2.45.4, the server marks remote schemas as inconsistent when type conflicts occur, fixes the hasura_http_response_bytes_total metric, sets error status and message in OpenTelemetry spans (Enterprise/cloud), fixes active subscriptions EKG gauge going negative, fixes a performance issue with large gzipped responses causing GC pauses, fixes duplicate event triggers when moving triggers, adds configurable Redis pool size options (Enterprise/cloud), improves BigQuery schema introspection performance, fixes connection_lifetime pool setting, ignores tracing headers while caching auth-hook responses (Enterprise/cloud), fixes erroneous 'overloaded functions' error due to oid overlap, fixes type inter-mixing from remote joins, partially fixes streaming subscriptions on non-unique columns, and allows JWKs that omit the 'use' field.

chunks.title: v2.49.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hasura/graphql-engine release v2.49.0, the server promotes the Relay API to stable /v1/relay and deprecates /v/1beta1/relay, adds an --enable-relay flag to enable/disable Relay API with different defaults per edition, improves schema memory usage, and adds HASURA_GRAPHQL_DISABLE_EVENTING env var to disable the entire eventing subsystem on OSS/single-tenant builds. Data connectors fix MariaDB update/delete mutations still failing with 'Table temp_table_xxx doesn't exist' by pinning the full CREATE/mutation/DROP lifecycle to one JDBC connection (Enterprise/cloud).

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent hexojs/hexo release stream from version 4.0.0 through v8.1.2, covering breaking changes, new features, performance improvements, and fixes across major and minor releases.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release 4.0.0, the project introduces breaking changes including dropping Node 6 support, fixing post_link and asset_link when titles contain unescaped HTML characters, encoding permalink by default, and adding an escape option for paginator. New features include using existing excerpt if possible, switching from minimatch to micromatch, an option to disable the meta generator tag, limiting parallel generation, using date instead of file mtime for updated date, adding Schema keywords and Microdata tag for list_tags, a pretty_urls option to remove index.html from URLs, a full_url_for helper, and external_link after_render with field and exclude options. Performance improvements drop cheerio in meta_generator, open_graph, and external_link, and enforce caching across modes. Fixes set English as default, use filename when title is not specified, ignore categories/tags with zero posts, remove index.html from open_graph URL, remove duplicate twitter card tags, encode URL by default in helpers and tag plugins, percent-encode open_graph URL, allow backtick code block in blockquote tag plugin, correct processing of backtick code block on blockquote, and prevent inserting extra new line character into the end of backtick code blocks.

In the hexojs/hexo release 4.1.0, breaking changes require Node 8.10 or above and change og:locale Open Graph tag insertion to require language-TERRITORY format. New features support adding hour and minute to post permalink, insert article:published_time and article:author Open Graph tags, enable lazyload in iframe-related tag plugins, provide a meta_generator helper to insert metadata element tag, support custom attributes in js() and css() helpers, and support a wrap option to enable/disable wrapping backtick codeblock in table element. Fixes retain blank lines in a codeblock attached in blockquote, replace deprecated og_updated_time with article:modified_time, replace deprecated keywords Open Graph tag with article:tag, ensure meta_generator tag is inserted into multi-line head, no longer clear database db.json when running hexo new or hexo --help, and completely ignore files/folders specified in ignore.

In the hexojs/hexo release 4.1.1, a new feature adds trailing_html to pretty_urls option to remove .html from URL. Fixes set default locales in language_TERRITORY format for og:locale Open Graph tag, ensure meta_generator() helper outputs the correct Hexo version, parse permalink_defaults option instead of replacing it, and always ignore node_modules/ and .git/ folders in themes. A refactor further reduces lodash usage.

In the hexojs/hexo release 4.2.0, features include disabling caching by default in hexo-server and adding a min_depth option to toc() helper. Fixes merge similar theme configs in main config and theme's config, resolve some caching issue, and apply all pretty_urls options to og:url tag in Open Graph. Refactors no longer use lodash and completely drop cheerio from production dependencies.
In the hexojs/hexo release 4.2.1, a fix ensures compatibility with Node 14.

In the hexojs/hexo release 5.0.0, breaking changes include migrating external_link config during load_config, removing Bluebird.asCallback from Box, bringing up config.updated_option, dropping keywords option from open_graph front-matter, overriding permalink using front-matter, removing lodash from global variable, dropping Node.js 8 and adding Node.js 14 support, and removing site config from theme config. New features show source of error and beautify in tag, provide better error message when a post could not be located in post_link, skip assets of unpublished posts and delete them if exist, bring up new extend Injector, add prism highlight support, and add tagcloud features. Other changes include various refactors and dependency updates.

In the hexojs/hexo release 5.0.1, changes include fixing helpers to call url_for from hexo-util, updating regexp for external_link filter to pre-match external links, and shorthand optimization for injector.
In the hexojs/hexo release 5.0.2, a change reverts a performance improvement that avoided running plugins in 'clean' command, fixing an error in hexo clean.

In the hexojs/hexo release 5.1.0, features include parsing caption option to prismHighlight, refactoring post escape to fix prismjs processing tag removal, and removing the deprecated plugins option from config. Performance improvement avoids duplicated escaping in backtick_code.
In the hexojs/hexo release 5.1.1, a fix avoids escaping curly brackets when both highlight.js and prismjs are disabled, preventing mistaken escaping in the backtick_code_block filter.

In the hexojs/hexo release 5.2.0, changes include faster regexp for external_link, support for disableNunjucks in front-matter, avoiding unnecessary escaping of front-matter, validating config.url to start with http:// or https://, converting string to buffer in route stream to fix crash in hexo generate --bail, making disableNunjucks work reliably with synchronous renderer, and ignoring package names ending with theme name in load_plugin. Housekeeping moves benchmark and profiling to Actions.

chunks.title: v5.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v5.3.0, new features expose escape_html helper method for string manipulation to templates and add span element and custom class for label in list_tags. Fixes ignore plugin whose name starts with hexo-theme in load_plugins and allow closing code fence to be followed only by spaces in codeblock. Refactor replaces process.mainModule with require.main. Docs replace david-dm badge with shields.io.

chunks.title: v5.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v5.4.0, new features handle config.root not existing. Breaking change uses span instead of anchor element for excerpt for better SEO. Fixes set property awaitWriteFinish for chokidar filewatcher in box, match whitespace but not newlines in codeblock, and resolve page.lang undefined when using language key in front-matter. Misc updates include GitHub Actions updates and dependency bumps.

chunks.title: v6.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v6.0.0, breaking changes drop Node 10. Security escapes HTML by default in list_tag. New features load hexo plugin in the theme's package.json and provide different URLs for og:image and twitter:image in open_graph. Performance improvements include memoizing tag/helper, optimizing regex for external_link, using nanocolors/picocolors, avoiding delete operator, overall improvements, using state machine to escape swig tag in post, and refactoring pagination. Fixes escape swig full tag with args, remove race condition failsafe in processor, fix curly brackets and empty tag name correction, and generate draft assets in draft mode. Refactor uses native Array.flat(). Docs add homebrew install and jsdoc. Dependencies are updated.
In the hexojs/hexo release 5.4.1, a fix addresses js-yaml tags for v4.0.0+.

In the hexojs/hexo release 6.1.0, new features support unnumbered headings in toc, exclude some languages in code highlighting, and add line threshold option for codeblocks. Fixes restrict renderable files to default file extension when post_asset_folder is set, fix benchmark on node 16+, resolve plugin loading conflict with @vercel/nft, and fix js-yaml tags for v4.0.0+. Tests use chai#should. Dependencies are updated.
In the hexojs/hexo release 5.4.2, a fix downgrades js-yaml from v4.x to v3.14.x.

In the hexojs/hexo release 6.2.0, fixes suppress YAMLException when loading js-yaml and bump warehouse to 4.0.1 as workarounds. Refactors replace deprecated String.prototype.substr(). Dependencies are updated. Misc deletes stale bot and removes Your theme _config.yml section from issue template.

In the hexojs/hexo release 6.3.0, new features include throwing on post_link error, robust URL computation for view raw in include_code, allowing custom class name in paginator, more flexible class name in toc helper, show_count option in tagcloud helper, adding language_attr option in code tag, and adding is_home_first_page() helper. Improvements let post_link use original post title as title attribute. Fixes correct db.json file path in debug logging on Windows, show source file in unformatted error message in tag, and don't use data-uri for og:image. Refactors use whatwg url api in open_graph helper and native URLSearchParams in mail_to. Test replaces nyc with c8 and makes tag test async. CI/CD updates permissions, deletes release-drafter, and improves benchmark result. Dependencies are updated.

chunks.title: v7.0.0 (RC1)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v7.0.0 (RC1), migration guide notes that built-in tags gist, youtube, jsfiddle, and vimeo are dropped and can be replaced by hexo-tag-embed. Breaking changes require Node 14+, drop those tags, drop external_link boolean type, and drop use_date_for_updated option for updated_option. Notable changes migrate to TypeScript. New features include searching for both slug and title in post_link, dropping google_plus in open_graph, supporting quotes in img title and alt, supporting default title from path in console-new, and adding an option to disable titlecase in post. Fixes address hexo server error when changing config, exclude_languages not working in code blocks, preserving disableNunjucks property when promisifying, skipping before_post_render and after_post_render on non-posts, failing to create post with special character title, and checking for invalid file in box. Performance reduces traversals through posts. Refactor adds extend API for highlight and uses WHATWG URL API instead of url.resolve. Dependencies are updated.

chunks.title: v7.0.0 (RC2)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v7.0.0 (RC2), new features since RC1 include adding exclude_languages feature to prismjs, using slug when title is empty in post_link, adding url_for and full_url_for tag plugins, and allowing top-level await in plugins or scripts. Fixes handle empty code block in backtick_code and fix moize helper function not working with relative_url. Refactor types. Tests improve coverage. Dependencies are changed. The release also includes all changes from v6.3.0 to v7.0.0 (RC1) as listed in the RC1 notes.

chunks.title: v7.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v7.0.0, migration guide warns that built-in tags gist, youtube, jsfiddle, and vimeo are dropped and can be replaced by hexo-tag-embed, and syntax highlighting is refactored with a new syntax_highlighter setting. Breaking changes require Node 14+, drop those tags, drop external_link boolean type, drop use_date_for_updated option, remove front-matter property link, revert access data files from source folder, and refactor highlight with extend API. Notable changes migrate to TypeScript and refactor types. New features include searching for both slug and title in post_link, dropping google_plus in open_graph, supporting quotes in img title and alt, supporting default title from path in console-new, adding an option to disable titlecase in post, adding exclude_languages feature to prismjs, using slug when title is empty in post_link, adding url_for and full_url_for tag plugins, allowing top-level await in plugins or scripts, and defining global variable hexo. Fixes address hexo server error when changing config, exclude_languages not working in code blocks, preserving disableNunjucks property when promisifying, skipping before_post_render and after_post_render on non-posts, failing to create post with special character title, checking for invalid file in box, and other issues. Performance reduces traversals through posts. Refactor adds extend API for highlight and uses WHATWG URL API. Dependencies are updated.

chunks.title: v7.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v7.1.0, notable changes add event emitter descriptor and refactor types. New features add URL hash support for post_link tag. Fixes cast from number to string explicitly in types, overwrite permalink when post_asset_folder is true, and check tag completeness in escapeAllSwigTags. CI/CD updates commenter and benchmark workflows. Dependencies are updated.

chunks.title: v7.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v7.1.1, a fix escapes tag which includes line break in escapeTags. Misc uses prepublishOnly instead of prepublish and runs npm install in prepublishOnly script.

chunks.title: v7.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v7.2.0, new features add an option to switch stripIndent in highlight. Improved type definitions refactor types, make callback on exit optional, and migrate typescript. Fixes correct typos, fix post_link behaviour when using subdir, use url_for in tag, prevent path traversal in include_code tag, and revert behavior of locals.tags and locals.categories. Refactor handles backslashes on Windows. Test adds test case for issue #4334. CI/CD suppresses comment err and reduces benchmark running. Docs update Sponsors images. Dependencies are updated.

chunks.title: v7.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v7.3.0, new features include deepMerge frontMatter of post and scaffold in renderScaffold, add option to use slug as title of post, and specify maximum number of items to output in toc helper. Fixes revert backslashes on Windows refactor. Performances improve processing speed when config.post_asset_folder is enabled. Test reverts test case for issue #4334. CI fixes wrong condition in comment. Misc upgrades ecmascript version.

chunks.title: v8.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v8.0.0, breaking changes drop Node.js 16 and Node.js 18. New features bind hexo context to helper function callback, add url config validation, add permalink variable timestamp, support additional options for Backtick Code Block, and enforce stricter extension checks in load_config. Fixes change judgement of whether it has been injected, backtrack when tag is incomplete in escapeAllSwigTags, show all posts in hexo.locals.get('posts'), fix parsing error for code blocks in list items, sort tags in open_graph, and escape HTML in title of code and include_code tags. Performances optimize external link filter, add binary relation index for PostCategory/PostTag, add cache for posts in listArchives, reduce GC overhead in escapeAllSwigTags, skip tag render when there is no swigTags, faster text-table, and warehouse6 with caching for data keys. Refactor deletes unused function ignoreTmpAndHiddenFile, deletes scripts pretest, and removes unused timezone setting in moment. Test extends mocha timeout and improves coverage. Dependencies are updated.

chunks.title: v8.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v8.1.0, performances fix potential cache miss issues with moize, reduce ObjectAssign overhead, faster archy, reduce match calls in metaGenerator, and faster escapeAllSwigTags. Fixes correct incorrect TOC anchor generation, fix missing tags and categories when running hexo s with cache existed, fix ts error in test, remove overly strict invalid tag format check in Swig parser, fix updated post assets not being copied in hot processing when post_asset_folder is enabled, and fix nunjucks/code blocks in HTML comments incorrectly converted. Refactor supports skipping heading level in toc. Dependencies are updated.

chunks.title: v8.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v8.1.1, a fix handles comment nesting in code fence and nunjucks. Misc uses object format for repository field in package.json.

chunks.title: v8.1.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hexojs/hexo release v8.1.2, fixes correct noopenner to noopener in external_link and fix incorrectly ignoring single-line code blocks when escaping Swig and HTML comments. Performances faster externalLink regexp. Refactor removes node internal api usage in loadPlugin. CI/CD adds dependency-review action and enables trusted publishing. Test adds missing await to unlink in save_database test. Dependencies are updated.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent hoppscotch/hoppscotch release stream from 2025.5.0 through 2026.5.0, covering major feature introductions like environment variable enhancements, experimental scripting sandbox, collection variables, mock servers, API documentation, and Cloud for Organizations support, along with numerous patch and hotfix releases.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.5.0, the project adds support for initial and current values in environment variables, JWT authorization type, user groups exclusive to the Enterprise offering, and an experimental scripting sandbox comprising an in-app console alongside enhancements and bug fixes across the board.
In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.5.1, a hotfix addresses issues with environment values not persisting alongside a few other bug fixes.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.5.2, a patch release provides bug fixes and enhancements across the board, including support for version bounded parsing and migration, in-app console UI enhancements, and fixes for OpenAPI import worker and team environment user access.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.5.3, a patch release resolves issues related to environment data migrations in shared workspaces, alongside other bug fixes and improvements such as auth tokens not propagating to child requests and team env not migrating in edge cases.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.5.4, a patch release exclusive to the Enterprise offering resolves issues with the URL input widget appearing empty and non-editable due to underlying CodeMirror editor dependency mismatches.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.6.0, the project introduces quality of life improvements to the desktop experience with native tab keyboard shortcuts and enhanced navigation handling, alongside the ability to copy between initial and current environment values, security patches, German i18n additions, and various bug fixes across the platform.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.6.1, a patch release features various improvements and bug fixes across the board, including tab shortcuts discoverability, retry import openapi from url with proxy interceptor on network error, and enhanced URL parsing to use environment variables on openapi import.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.7.0, the project introduces a new onboarding flow for SH instances, scripting editors powered by Monaco as part of the experimental scripting sandbox, and advanced configuration options for OAuth 2.0 requests alongside various enhancements and bug fixes across the platform.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.7.1, a patch release includes various bug fixes across the platform, such as onboarding flow smtp bug, SmartEnvInput environment context bug, and correctly resolving request variables during collection runs.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.8.0, the project introduces collection variables, OpenTelemetry integration for connecting Hoppscotch to your own telemetry pipeline, enhancements to OpenAPI import and OAuth 2.0 flows, alongside various improvements and bug fixes.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.8.1, a hotfix addresses an issue where request deletions incorrectly affected order index computations across collections specific to Self Hosted instances, alongside other improvements.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.9.0, the project introduces alphabetical sorting for collections, enhanced UI interactions, and expanded scripting capabilities through the new hopp namespace within the experimental scripting sandbox, along with numerous bug fixes and improvements across the platform.
In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.9.1, a patch release fixes an issue where request runs were not properly resolving inherited authorization properties and headers from parent collections.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.9.2, a patch release comprises various bug fixes across the board, including resolving errors with pw.env namespace in legacy sandbox, preventing syncing secret variable initial values, and focusing existing request tab instead of duplicating.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.10.0, the project introduces mock servers for simulating API responses, enhancements to the scripting suite including Chai-powered assertions with experimental Postman script import support, the ability to disable HTTP redirects for native interceptors, alongside bug fixes and improvements.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.10.1, a patch release addresses a critical issue affecting the Self-Hosted Desktop App where users encountered Session expired errors while creating environments or saving requests, despite being logged in, and also addresses concerns around environment variable corruption and team collection loading issues.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.11.0, the project introduces API Documentation for sharing specifications, the ability to send requests from the scripting context, mock server improvements, and a portable instance manager for the Desktop App, along with a comprehensive security patch and bug fixes.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.11.1, a patch release addresses issues affecting the mock server and API documentation workflows on the cloud offering, alongside other fixes such as preventing clear response action in response examples and test runner, and adding auto-create collection option to mock server creation.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.11.2, a patch release includes bug fixes for environment variable detection and UI improvements, as well as enhanced database connection configuration for self-hosted deployments.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.12.0, the project introduces an organization switcher sidebar for seamless navigation across organizations as part of the Cloud for Orgs tier, the ability to create and manage example responses in collections, and enhanced keyboard shortcuts for the Desktop App, alongside bug fixes and improvements.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2025.12.1, a patch release stabilises the Desktop App by fixing the macOS white-screen crash caused by repeated store path lookups, and hardens backend rate limiting behind proxies, along with a small desktop UI cleanup.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2026.1.0, the project introduces jq-based JSON response filtering, Web Crypto API support and memory leak fixes in the experimental scripting sandbox, alongside desktop cloud organization infrastructure, CLI fixes, and backend performance improvements.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2026.1.1, a patch release fixes broken scroll on Chrome v144+, auth cookie handling on macOS, and database connection leaks, alongside mock server and OpenAPI import improvements.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2026.2.0, the project introduces API documentation versioning, a unified dropdown-based switcher for Cloud orgs tier, and scripting sandbox reliability improvements, alongside security patches, bug fixes, and enhancements.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2026.2.1, a patch release addresses a security issue related to Personal Access Token deletion, a regression with stored request payloads that could override collection identifiers, and list truncation beyond 10 items in team workspaces, alongside minor bug fixes.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2026.3.0, the project brings Cloud for Organizations to the desktop app, adds admin workspace visibility, keyboard shortcut support for non-English layouts, and optional SMTP authentication, alongside security patches and bug fixes.
In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2026.3.1, a patch release exclusive to the Enterprise offering resolves an issue that prevented changes to settings from being saved in the admin dashboard.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2026.4.0, the project introduces collection-level pre-request and test scripts, desktop settings with manual update controls, refinements to the API documentation experience, and self-hosted improvements including SMTP OAuth2 authentication, alongside security patches and bug fixes.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2026.4.1, a patch release fixes a regression affecting top-level imports in pre-request and test scripts on the experimental scripting sandbox, resolves a desktop blank screen on older macOS versions, and adds a desktop setting for keyboard shortcuts on non-QWERTY layouts.

In the hoppscotch/hoppscotch release 2026.5.0, the project adds OpenAPI 3.1 collection export, zoom level controls in the Desktop App, configurable proxy URLs from environment variables and the admin dashboard, and Mongolian language support, alongside security patches and bug fixes.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the evolution of the httpie/cli command-line HTTP client from early releases through version 3.2.4, highlighting major feature additions, security fixes, and compatibility updates.

chunks.title: v0.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release v0.2.1, the project added compatibility with requests-0.12.1 and dropped custom JSON and HTTP lexers in favor of the ones newly included in pygments-1.5.

chunks.title: v0.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release v0.2.0, the project added Python 3 support, the ability to print the HTTP request as well as the response via --print and --verbose, support for Digest authentication, file upload support, improved syntax highlighting for JSON, support for field name escaping, and many bug fixes.

chunks.title: v0.1.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release v0.1.6, the project fixed an IOError in setup.py.

chunks.title: HTTPie 0.9.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 0.9.1, the project added support for Requests transport adapter plugins to enable plugin-provided features such as unix socket communication and HTTP/2.

chunks.title: HTTPie 0.9.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 0.9.2, the project fixed compatibility with Requests 2.5.1 and changed the default JSON Content-Type to application/json as UTF-8 is the default JSON encoding.

chunks.title: HTTPie 0.9.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 0.9.3, the project changed the default color --style from solarized to monokai, added basic Bash autocomplete support, added request details to connection error messages, fixed 'requests.packages.urllib3' has no attribute 'disable_warnings' errors, fixed colors and formatting on Windows, and fixed --auth prompt on Windows.

chunks.title: HTTPie 0.9.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 0.9.4, the project added Content-Type of files uploaded in multipart/form-data requests, --ssl=<PROTOCOL> to specify the desired SSL/TLS protocol version, JSON detection with --json, -j, --all to show intermediate responses, --history-print, -P WHAT, --max-redirects=N, -A as short name for --auth-type, -F as short name for --follow, removed the implicit_content_type config option, changed the default --style back to solarized, improved --debug output, fixed --session when used with --download, fixed --download to trim too long filenames, fixed handling of Content-Type with multiple +subtype parts, and removed the XML formatter.

chunks.title: HTTPie 0.9.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 0.9.6, the project added Python 3 as a dependency for Homebrew installations, the ability to unset a request header with Header: and send an empty value with Header;, --default-scheme <URL_SCHEME>, -I as a shortcut for --ignore-stdin, fish shell completion, updated requests to 2.10.0 for SOCKS support, changed the default JSON Accept header to application/json, */*, and changed pre-processing of request HTTP headers to remove leading and trailing whitespace.

chunks.title: HTTPie 0.9.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 0.9.8, the project extended the auth plugin API, added exit status code 7 for plugin errors, added support for curses-less Python installations, fixed REQUEST_ITEM arg incorrectly being reported as required, improved CTRL-C interrupt handling, and added the standard exit status code 130 for keyboard interrupts.

chunks.title: HTTPie 0.9.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 0.9.9, the project made only README changes.

chunks.title: HTTPie 1.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 1.0.0, the project added --style=auto which follows the terminal ANSI color styles, support for selecting TLS 1.3 via --ssl=tls1.3, true/false as valid values for --verify, changed the default --style from solarized to auto (on Windows it stays fruity), fixed default headers being incorrectly case-sensitive, and removed Python 2.6 support.

chunks.title: HTTPie 1.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 1.0.1, the project removed external URL calls from tests.

chunks.title: HTTPie 1.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 1.0.2, the project fixed tests for installation with pyOpenSSL.

chunks.title: HTTPie 1.0.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 1.0.3, the project fixed CVE-2019-10751 by changing the way the output filename is generated for --download requests without --output resulting in a redirect to only consider the initial URL as the base for the generated filename, and not the final one.

chunks.title: HTTPie 2.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 2.0.0, the project removed Python 2.7 support (Python 3.6+ is now required), added --offline to allow building an HTTP request and printing it but not actually sending it over the network, replaced the old collect-all-then-process handling of HTTP communication with one-by-one processing, removed automatic config file creation, removed the default 30-second connection --timeout limit, removed Python's default limit of 100 response headers, added --max-headers, added --compress, added --ignore-netrc, added https alias command, added $ALL_PROXY documentation, added type annotations, added tests/ to the PyPi package, fixed an error when stdin was a closed fd, and improved --debug output formatting.

chunks.title: HTTPie 2.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 2.1.0, the project added --path-as-is to bypass dot segment URL squashing, changed the default Accept header value for JSON requests to application/json, */*;q=0.5, and fixed --form file upload mixed with redirected stdin error handling.

chunks.title: HTTPie 2.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 2.2.0, the project added support for custom content types for uploaded files, support for $XDG_CONFIG_HOME, support for Set-Cookie-triggered cookie expiration, --format-options, --sorted and --unsorted shortcuts, --ciphers, netrc support for auth plugins, and fixed built-in plugins-related circular imports.

chunks.title: HTTPie 2.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 2.3.0, the project added support for streamed uploads, multipart upload streaming, body-from-file upload streaming, --chunked, --multipart, preserving field order in multipart requests, --boundary, combining cookies specified on the CLI and in a session file, out of the box SOCKS support, --quiet, -q flag, fixed handling of invalid expires dates in Set-Cookie headers, and removed Tox testing entirely.

chunks.title: HTTPie 2.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 2.4.0, the project added support for --session cookie expiration based on Set-Cookie: max-age=<n>, showed a --check-status warning with --quiet as well, fixed upload with --session, and fixed a missing blank line between request and response.

chunks.title: HTTPie 2.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 2.5.0, the project added --raw to allow specifying the raw request body without extra processing, support for XML formatting, internal support for file-like object responses, fixed --continue --download with a single byte left, fixed --verbose HTTP 307 redirects with streamed request body, and fixed handling of session files with Cookie: followed by other headers.

chunks.title: HTTPie 2.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 2.6.0, the project added support for formatting & coloring of JSON bodies preceded by non-JSON data, charset auto-detection, --response-charset, --response-mime, the ability to silence warnings through using -q or --quiet twice, added installed plugin list to --debug output, and fixed duplicate keys preservation in JSON data.

chunks.title: HTTPie 3.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 3.0.0, the project dropped support for Python 3.6, improved startup time by 40%, added support for nested JSON syntax, added httpie plugins interface for plugin management, added support for Bearer authentication via --auth-type=bearer, added support for quick conversions of pasted URLs into HTTPie calls, added support for sending multiple HTTP header lines with the same name, added support for receiving multiple HTTP headers lines with the same name, added support for basic JSON types on --form/--multipart, added support for automatically enabling --stream when Content-Type is text/event-stream, added support for displaying the total elapsed time through --meta/-vv or --print=m, added new pie-dark/pie-light styles, added support for better error handling on DNS failures, added support for storing prompted passwords in local sessions, added warnings about --ignore-stdin when there is no incoming data from stdin, fixed crashing due to broken plugins, fixed auto addition of XML declaration to every formatted XML response, fixed highlighting when Content-Type specifies charset, fixed an unexpected crash when --raw is used with --chunked, and changed the default Windows theme from fruity to auto.

chunks.title: HTTPie 3.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 3.0.1, the project changed the value shown as time elapsed from time-to-read-headers to total exchange time.

chunks.title: HTTPie 3.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 3.0.2, the project fixed usage of httpie plugins when there is a presence of a config with default_options.

chunks.title: HTTPie 3.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 3.1.0, the project fixed a security vulnerability that caused exposure of cookies on redirects to third party hosts, fixed escaping of integer indexes with multiple backslashes in the nested JSON builder, fixed displaying of status code without a status message on non-auto themes, fixed redundant issuance of stdin detection warnings, fixed double --quiet to suppress all python level warnings, added support for specifying certificate private key passphrases through --cert-key-pass and prompts, added httpie cli export-args command, improved regulation of top-level arrays, and improved UI layout for standalone invocations.

chunks.title: HTTPie 3.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the httpie/cli release HTTPie 3.2.0, the project added a warning for notifying the user about new updates, support for single binary executables, support for man pages and auto generation of them, http --manual for man pages & regular manual with pager, support for session persistence of repeated headers with the same name, support for sending Secure cookies to localhost and .local suffixed domains, improved UI for progress bars, fixed redundant creation of Content-Length header on OPTIONS requests, fixed blocking of warning thread on some use cases, changed httpie plugins to the new httpie cli namespace as httpie cli plugins, and soft deprecated --history-print.

In the httpie/cli release 3.2.1, the project improved support for determining auto-streaming when the Content-Type header includes encoding information and fixed the display of the crash happening in the secondary process for update checks.
In the httpie/cli release 3.2.2, the project fixed compatibility with urllib3 2.0.0.
In the httpie/cli release 3.2.3, the project fixed SSL connections by pinning the requests version to 2.31.0 and made it possible to unset the User-Agent and Accept-Encoding request headers.
In the httpie/cli release 3.2.4, the project fixed default certs loading and unpinned requests.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent huggingface/transformers release stream from v4.56.1-Vault-Gemma-preview through v5.9.0, including major version 5.0.0, its release candidates, and weekly minor releases with new model additions and fixes.

chunks.title: Vault-Gemma (based on v4.56.1)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release Vault-Gemma (based on v4.56.1), a new model Vault-Gemma is added. VaultGemma is a text-only decoder model derived from Gemma 2, dropping norms after Attention and MLP blocks and using full attention for all layers. It is a pretrained 1B parameter model with 1024 token sequence length, trained from scratch with sequence-level differential privacy (DP) using DP-SGD, providing a (ε ≤ 2.0, δ ≤ 1.1e-10)-sequence-level DP guarantee. This tag is a preview and will be included in the next minor release v4.57.0.

chunks.title: Patch release v4.56.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v4.56.2, fixes include processor load with multi-processing, Jetmoe RoPE fix, getter regression fix, and config dtype parsing for Emu3 edge case.

chunks.title: v4.57.0: Qwen3-Next, Vault Gemma, Qwen3 VL, LongCat Flash, Flex OLMO, LFM2 VL, BLT, Qwen3 OMNI MoE, Parakeet, EdgeTAM, OLMO3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release v4.57.0, new models added include Qwen3-Next, Vault Gemma, Qwen3 VL, LongCat Flash, Flex OLMO, LFM2 VL, BLT, Qwen3 OMNI MoE, Parakeet, EdgeTAM, and OLMO3. Qwen3-Next introduces hybrid attention with Gated DeltaNet and Gated Attention, high-sparsity MoE with 1:50 activation ratio, multi-token prediction, and other optimizations. Vault Gemma is a text-only decoder derived from Gemma 2 with differential privacy training. Qwen3 VL is a multimodal vision-language model series with enhanced MRope and DeepStack integration.

chunks.title: Patch release v4.57.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v4.57.1, fixes include an optional dependency issue with optax causing parsing errors with poetry, removal of offload_state_dict from kwargs, bnb fsdp loading for pre-quantized checkpoint, fsdp tests, and trainer fix for Python 3.9.

chunks.title: Patch Release v4.57.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v4.57.2, fixes include AutoTokenizer mapping for mistral3 and ministral, auto conversion of tekken.json, tekken pattern matching, check model inputs hidden states, and removal of invalid @staticmethod from module-level get_device_and_memory_breakdown.

chunks.title: Patch release v4.57.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v4.57.3, a hidden bug when loading models with local_files_only=True and a typo related to the recent patch are fixed. The previous release is yanked due to impact on many users.

chunks.title: Transformers v5.0.0rc0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release candidate v5.0.0rc0, the first major release in five years is announced with 800 commits. Highlights include dynamic weight loading API centered around WeightConverter class, significant tokenization refactors, and many bug fixes. This is a pre-release, opt-in via pip install transformers --pre.

chunks.title: Release candidate 5.0.0rc1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release candidate v5.0.0rc1, focus is on quantization support with the new dynamic weight loader. Breaking changes include default dtype auto for from_pretrained, default shard size 50GB when saving, and every model forward() requiring **kwargs. New models added: FastVLM, Lasr, PaddleOCR-VL. Quantization fixes for fbgemm, quanto, FP8. PEFT integration fixes and tokenization refactoring.

chunks.title: Release candidate 5.0.0rc2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release candidate v5.0.0rc2, focus is on fixing AutoTokenizer, expanding dynamic weight loading support, and improving MoE performance with batched and grouped experts. Tokenization refactor enforces TokenizersBackend usage. Core improvements boost weight loading performance on device. New models: Sam Perception Encoder Audiovisual, jais2, Pixio, Ernie VL, GLM-ASR. Quantization fixes for FP8 and deepspeed.

chunks.title: Patch release v4.57.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v4.57.4, the last patch for v4 includes fixes for remote generation methods (group beam search), vLLM, and offline tokenizer loading when already cached.

chunks.title: Patch release v4.57.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v4.57.5, additional fixes include QwenVL skipped keys in setattr and lr_scheduler_parsing fix.

chunks.title: Patch release v4.57.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v4.57.6, a fix for incorrect model_type for qwen2vl and qwen2.5vl when config is saved and loaded again.

chunks.title: Release candidate v5.0.0rc3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release candidate v5.0.0rc3, new models include GLM-Lite, GLM-Image, LWDetr, LightOnOCR. Focus on removing deprecated stuff, fixing minor issues, doc updates, and style rework with ruff rules.

chunks.title: Transformers v5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release v5.0.0, the full major release with 1200 commits. Highlights include dynamic weight loading API, tokenization refactors, and removal of long-due deprecations. Starting with v5, minor releases will be weekly. Migration guide available.

chunks.title: v5.1.0: EXAONE-MoE, PP-DocLayoutV3, Youtu-LLM, GLM-OCR
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release v5.1.0, new models include EXAONE-MoE (236B total, 23B active MoE), PP-DocLayoutV3 (layout analysis with instance segmentation and reading order), Youtu-LLM (1.96B params, 128k context, agentic talents), and GLM-OCR (multimodal OCR with MTP loss and reinforcement learning). Breaking changes: T5Gemma2 model structure, generation cache preparation, and deletion of duplicate code in backbone utils.

chunks.title: v5.2.0: GLM-5, Qwen3.5, Voxtral Realtime, VibeVoice Acoustic Tokenizer
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release v5.2.0, new models include VoxtralRealtime (streaming speech-to-text), GLM-5 (744B params, 40B active, DeepSeek Sparse Attention), Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.5 MoE (397B total, 17B active, hybrid architecture with Gated Delta Networks), and VibeVoice Acoustic Tokenizer.

chunks.title: v5.3.0: EuroBERT, VibeVoice ASR, TimesFM2.5, PP-DocLayoutV2, OlmoHybrid, ModernVBert, Higgs Audio V2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release v5.3.0, new models include EuroBERT (multilingual encoder, 8192 tokens), VibeVoice ASR (speech-to-text with acoustic/semantic tokenizers), TimesFM2.5 (time-series forecasting), PP-DocLayoutV2 (layout analysis with RT-DETR and pointer network), OlmoHybrid (hybrid transformer with Gated Deltanet), ModernVBert, and Higgs Audio V2.

chunks.title: Release v5.4.0: PaddlePaddle models 🙌, Mistral 4, PI0, VidEoMT, UVDoc, SLANeXt, Jina Embeddings v3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release v5.4.0, new models include VidEoMT (video segmentation), UVDoc (document rectification), Jina Embeddings v3 (multilingual embeddings with LoRA adapters), Mistral 4 (MoE with 128 experts, 119B params, 6.5B active, multimodal), PI0 (vision-language-action for robotics), and PaddlePaddle models.

chunks.title: Release v5.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release v5.5.0, new models include Gemma4 (multimodal, 1B/13B/27B, fixed-budget vision tokens, 2D RoPE), NomicBERT (reproducible long context embeddings, 8192 context), and MusicFlamingo (audio-language model).

chunks.title: Patch release v5.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v5.5.1, fixes focus on vLLM and Gemma4 export and integration tests.

chunks.title: Patch release: v5.5.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v5.5.2, optimizations for Gemma4 include MoE TP plan, dissociating kv states sharing from cache, removing shared weights, and fixing conversion mappings for VLMs.

chunks.title: Patch release: v5.5.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v5.5.3, a fix for device_map support for Gemma4.

chunks.title: Patch release v5.5.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v5.5.4, fixes include Kimi-K2.5 tokenizer regression, training fixes for GAS and DeepSpeed ZeRO-3, and Qwen2.5-VL temporal RoPE scaling for still images.

chunks.title: Release v5.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release v5.6.0, new models include OpenAI Privacy Filter (PII detection), QianfanOCR (4B document intelligence), SAM3-LiteText (lightweight vision-language segmentation), and SLANet (table structure recognition). Breaking change: internal rotary_fn no longer registered as hidden kernel function. Serve command enhancements with /v1/completions endpoint and multimodal support.

chunks.title: Patch release v5.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v5.6.1, a fix for broken flash attention path (AttributeError on s_aux=None).

chunks.title: Patch release v5.6.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v5.6.2, a fix for Qwen 3.5 and 3.6 MoE (text-only) broken with FP8, and configuration reading and error handling for kernels.

chunks.title: Release v5.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release v5.7.0, new models include Laguna (MoE with per-layer head counts and sigmoid router), DEIMv2 (real-time object detection). Attention fixes for T5Gemma2, Qwen3.5 GDN, GraniteMoeHybrid. Tokenizer bug fix for AutoTokenizer. Generation fixes for continuous batching. Kernel improvements for FP8 and custom expert kernels.

chunks.title: Release 5.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release v5.8.0, new models include DeepSeek-V4 (MoE with hybrid local+long-range attention, mHC, static hash table), Gemma 4 Assistant (speculative decoding with MTP), GraniteSpeechPlus (speech-to-text with intermediate hidden states), Granite4Vision (document data extraction), and EXAONE-4.5.

chunks.title: Patch release v5.8.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers patch release v5.8.1, fixes mainly for DeepSeek V4 integration, including fatal_error in ContinuousBatchingManager, WeightConverter regex fix, and CSA mask collapse.

chunks.title: Release v5.9.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the huggingface/transformers release v5.9.0, new models include Cohere2Moe (MoE with hybrid sliding window and full attention), Parakeet tdt, HRM-Text (hierarchical reasoning model). Breaking change: SAM3/EdgeTAM/SAM3-Lite-Text now expect full text embeddings. Audio support expanded with AudioFlamingoNext. Generation fixes for Gemma4, RAG, and VLM tests.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent hyprwm/Hyprland release stream from v0.45.0 through v0.55.2, covering major feature additions, breaking changes, and patch-level fixes across multiple minor and patch releases.

chunks.title: v0.45.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.45.0, the project delivers a big update with tons of fixes, improvements, and new features. Breaking changes include the removal of `no_gaps_when_only` (replaced by workspace rules for smart gaps) and the relocation of `decoration:shadow_` variables. New features encompass a custom treewide formatter, group-related options like `group_on_movetoworkspace` and `merge_groups_on_groupbar`, hyprctl additions for caps/num lock state and monitor mirroring, floating window snapping, drag_into_group layout control, merge_floated_into_tiled_on_groupbar, default auto for no_hw_cursors, hyprland-ctm-control-v1 protocol support, expand_undersized_textures renderer option, sharp shadows, and snap border_overlap improvements. Numerous fixes address CMake systemd issues, IME popup positioning, config generation loops, group member disappearance on monitor moves, drm-lease crashes, drm-syncobj timeline handling, group swallowing, hyprerror height calculation, hyprpm crashes, VRR for constrained cursors, internal CMonitor usage, keybind xkb_states, auto-group on non-focused workspaces, window snapping cleanup, bad wiki links, VRR breaking monitor disconnect, notification overlay padding, floating window damage, screencopy frame cleanup, shader jagged edges, shadow double premultiplication, and xwayland stability. Other changes include building with hyprland-session.service, adding optional smart gaps to default config, nofocus rule for X windows, nuking no_gaps_when_only, moving internal structures to monitor pointers, improving default animations and smart gaps, updating default shadow config, allowing leading whitespace in dispatcher window parameter, updating desktop file, adding xdg autostart support, and various foreign-toplevel, gammactrl, and groupbar adjustments.

chunks.title: v0.45.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.45.1, a minor update to v0.45.0, several fixes are backported from main. These include a makefile stub to discourage direct make, fixing smart gaps rules in the default config, a hyprpm format crash fix, a workspace name fix via focusworkspaceoncurrentmonitor, a constraints pointer warp fix on release, a core guard for pmonitor in focuswindow, marking primarySelection as not privileged, not rendering unmapped popups, handling scaled surfaces with zero area, replacing fgrep with grep -F in shell scripts, minor cleanup of min/max size calculations for xdg windows, not checking 'on-created-empty' when using a workspace windowrule, and storing xcursor themes in a std::set to order them.

chunks.title: v0.45.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.45.2, another minor release with two patches backported on top of v0.45.1. The fixes include an internal correction for changeWindowZOrder reordering incorrectly and an xdg-shell fix to not report invalid min/max sizes on unset.

chunks.title: v0.46.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.46.0, the Hyprland overlord brings a festive update. Breaking changes require full match for window/layer rule regexes and replace `cursor:dumb_copy` with `cursor:use_cpu_buffer` for experimental Nvidia hardware cursors. New dependencies include hyprgraphics and re2. New features include allowing fullscreening a pinned window, a force option for cursor warp on workspace change, support for hyprqtutils' update screen, festive splashes, moving colorspace handling to oklab, an option to prioritize focus change within groups with movefocus, pre connected/disconnected monitor events, an inhibitingIdle field in hyprctl windows, directScanout in hyprctl monitors, json output for hyprctl plugins list, warp_back_after_non_mouse_input, context to config error logs, a makefile stub, drm dumb buffers for cursors, lockdead_screen_delay, blurring IME popups, link versions for other utils, windowrules for mouse and touchpad scroll factors, and cross DnD from Wayland for xwayland. Fixes address example config name, animationmgr stack-use-after-return, monitor arrangement with mixed auto directions, data-device damage region expansion, clang-tidy additions, workspace selector parsing, wrong box expansion, smart gaps rules, incomplete hyprpm dependency message, changeWindowZOrder reordering, misused configStringToInt conversions, missed updateColorsOk calls, layerrules ignorezero, default focus when switching to a fs workspace, invalid ogl uniform reads, oklab parsing, incorrect early return in renderer, blur optimization conditions, double scrolling in some applications, shm fd size check, prop rules with boolean values, and missing workspace name via focusworkspaceoncurrentmonitor. Other changes include temporarily disabling cross build in CI/Nix, locking uwsm desktop file behind feature flag, creating TAG info from version in Nix, disabling uwsm desktop file installation, optimizing bezier curve setup, new long press option for binds, removing leftover var, changing default blur ignore_opacity to true, not overwriting errors in gradients, throwing explicit errors for color parsing in gradients, updating configStringToInt implementation, not warping pointer position on release, using pointer focus for DnD operations, not sending enter too aggressively, moving regex from stdlib to re2, optimizing window/layer rule application, dropping deques for vectors, moving to os/Process from hyprutils, moving version include to hyprctl, and various workspace-related function changes.

chunks.title: v0.46.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.46.1, a minor release with a patch backported from main, the fix addresses duplicate rule enum tags in windowrules.

chunks.title: v0.46.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.46.2, another round of minor fixes and patches for v0.46.0, mostly edge-case crashes. Backported fixes include duplicate rule enum tags in windowrules, hyprctl batch json command, avoiding activating toplevel-less surfaces, fixes to no_xwayland builds, xwm selection request targets, unbreaking build on FreeBSD, hyprpm returning 0 despite errors, possible crash on null workspace, and applying groups after window creation.

chunks.title: v0.47.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.47.0, a large new year update with internal rewrites for memory safety, renderer, and animation system. Breaking changes replace `master:always_center_master` with `master:slave_count_for_center_master`. New dependency: glaze. Binary releases are dropped. New features include an option controlling hyprpm building, exec(-onec) with rules and execr(-once), GPU hotplug support, a periodic donation request, configurable early buffer release, HDR and color management protocols, --verify-config, internal fade animation for ctm transitions, debug:pass for render pass debugging, hyprpm force reload all plugins, glaze dependency FetchContent fallback, new window destruction dispatchers, visible arg for cyclenext, option to show slaves on left in center orientation for master layout, register dispatcher v2 in pluginAPI, hyprland_lock_notify_v1 and hyprland_surface_v1 protocol implementations, hyprland_surface_v1.set_visible_region, supercircular window corners, tag: selector for matching window tags by regex, focusedmonv2 socket2 event, and negative: prefix for negating a regex in windowrules. Fixes cover animation tick, XWayland cursor glitch, borderangle, CI resource access, incorrect cast, animations requiring all args, float animation speeds < 0, missing include for clang, crash on very early plugin loads, too early buffer release, custom resolutions, possible crash on null active workspace, edge case crash on null xwm in data-device, ISDEBUG checking, debug overlay not rendering, include path fixes, possible crash on null ws in dwindle, waiting for hyprland pages in functionHooks, hyprctl batch JSON command, hyprctl --batch with exec rules, hyprpm returning 0 despite errors, movefocus fallback for special workspaces, nullptr deref in forcekillactive, previous_per_monitor logic, Gpu info logging, debug mode rendering of input boxes, alpha-modifier noncompliance, compilation error, CRendererHintsPassElement reset duplication, fullscreen hdr check, oversized blur precalcs, and rare case when a til...

chunks.title: v0.47.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.47.1, a patch release with fixes backported from main, addressing crashes, odd behavior, and flickers. Fixes include sending synthetic configure events for xwayland, adding libinotify-kqueue on BSDs, respecting window size set by configure requests in xwayland, freeing xkbSymState in ikeyboard, properly freeing glob memory in configmgr, logging a fixme for presentation feedback leak, calculating UV using both pixel and monitor dimensions in renderer, fixing bounding/opaque regions in pass/rect, keyword not updating autoreload in config/hyprctl, rounding refresh rates in monitor sorting, stopping refocusing at unmap for popups, and fixing invalid parent typo in subsurface.

chunks.title: v0.47.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.47.2, a minor update on top of v0.47.1 with additional fixes and patches. Backported fixes include handling window coords correctly in xwayland, trying first 3 modes before erroring in monitor preferred mode, preventing invalid window configurations for X11 apps, fixing segfault when destroying a partially created ls, watching both symlinks and canonical paths in configWatcher, correcting pointer coordinate mismatch in X11 windows, not immediately disconnecting active vars during animation tick, moving popup and subsurface ctors to factories, taking xdg geometry into account in popup input calcs, and moving popups to UPs and fixing missing subsurface resource.

chunks.title: v0.48.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.48.0, celebrating Hyprland's 3rd birthday, breaking changes remove `opengl:force_introspection` and `render:allow_early_buffer_release`, and deprecate windowrule v1 syntax in favor of windowrulev2. New features include the gnomed animation style for windows, an ANR dialog, ability to target pinned windows in workspace rules, cyclenext hist option, groupbar gap size adjustment, IPC support for Hyprsunset, --hl-url for custom forks in hyprpm, flip_x and flip_y for touchpad, follow_mouse_threshold, toggleswallow dispatcher, option to keep master window position, version 2 of ext-idle-notify-v1 protocol, simple color management, activespecialv2 socket2 event, ensuring syncobj waiters on successful checks, option to allow size persistence between app launches, and INCR support for xwayland clipboard transfers. Fixes include requiring C++26, adding enable_anr_dialog description, keyword not updating autoreload, possible crash in monitor config parser, clang/clang-tidy/typo fixes, non-relative Texture import, dropping cursor buffer data early, null activeWorkspace check in moveWorkspaceToMonitor, DS and VRR automation, default initializers for ccompositor ptrs, mallopt to modify trim threshold, wrong param in datadevice, libinotify-kqueue on BSDs, segfault when destroying partially created layer surface, moving popups to UPs, groupbar missing when indicator_height <= 0, config descriptions, clicking through groupbar tabs, touch calibration matrix overriding, mouse check for flipping x/y, compiler warnings, include paths, errors not returning failure, bounding/opaque regions, feedback leak, IWaylandProtocol onDisplayDestroy double-free, blocked color management get_information, cursor shape protocol valid shape check, wrong iface for xdg_dialog, option to disable cm and auto-skip cm, cm_fs_passthrough, fade out on silent moves to special, missing null checks to prevent crashes, window offset for dragged windows, various fixes towards improving gpu calls robustness, invalid parent typo in subsurface, transformed origin for shm buffers in toplevelexport, missing surface null checks, and possible clipboard race condition in xwayland. Other changes include CI/Nix removal of deprecated magic-nix-cache-action, installing frag files, Meson including frags in globber, and various Nix and Meson adjustments.

chunks.title: v0.48.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.48.1, a bugfix release with patches cherry-picked from main on top of v0.48.0. Fixes include simplifying and fixing hdr metadata setting in renderer, avoiding sending null surfaces in leave/enter events in seat, not closing the fd too early in xwl, applying scaling factor to text in groupbar, removing unused timeline in texpass, rounding boxes in groupbar, including clipBox in opaque calculations, not attempting to compile cm on gles3.0 in opengl, tracking and applying updated state in surfacestate, fixing minor ubsan errors, minor fixes to workspaces persistence, resetting buffer bit before applying to current in surfacestate, not damaging the entire surface every frame, and cleaning up server startup and fds in xwayland.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.49.0, breaking changes include `cursor:warp_on_change_workspace` no longer controlling warps for special workspaces (use `warp_on_toggle_special`), `master:center_master_slaves_on_right` changed to `master:center_master_fallback`, and requiring sudo password for sensitive hyprpm operations (resetting repositories and enabled plugins). Other changes include storing cursor pixel data retriev...

chunks.title: v0.50.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.50.0, new features include a test suite, monitor v2 HDR rules, a new monitor v2 config syntax, group: selector, maxwidth monitor resolution mode, auto-center arrangements, Multi-GPU Support for drm-lease, better automatic window drag and drop direction detection in dwindle, ability to specify an aspect ratio for a singular window in dwindle, config options to color inactive and locked groupbar titles, sticky option for drag_lock, error log when getEdgeDefinedPoint is impossible, option to respect gaps out for floating to movewindow, permission management for keyboards, ext-workspace implementation, automatic hdr in renderer/cm, pointer position uniform to screen shader, mouse zoom animations, wrapping options to renderTexture and renderTextureWithBlur, option to respect gaps in snap, unbind all, and noscreenshare windowrule. Fixes include race to finish on null buffer, crash on misnamed variable, inconsistent hint of default value, missing description for enforce_permissions, screencopy cursor pos and duplicate shape with sw cursors, tick measurement in debugOverlay, event source callbacks in eventLoop, manual mem management and leak in hookSystem, crash with enable without an arg in hyprpm, execute permission bit on installed dirs, typo in help message, TryExec in hyprland-uwsm.desktop, missing include for libc++, checking version and updating automatically on add, ignoring pins when adding a package with a git rev, refusing adding a new repo without update, incorrect localcoords with a surface above an XWayland window, mouseDown triggering hl ops on locked, HyprError not displaying at startup, missing skipcm if case in opengl, missing vao for screenshader, preferred image description in protocols/cm, invalid luminance check, place_above and _below in protocols/subcompositor, incorrect CM proto debug check and preferred image description, incorrect cursor position when screencopy region with monitor scaling, missing fadeout cases with special, minor damage fixes, applying noscreenshare to invisible special workspaces, improper box calculations for transforms in screencopy, incorrect noscreenshare positions with monitor scaling, border_overlap option for monitor snapping, crash when copying from wayland to xwayland, minor errors in previous refactor, and xwayland -> wayland clipboard. Other changes include disabling tests by default in CMake, filtering src using fileset in Nix, updating image cdn and previews in README, implementing new render scheduling, moving alphamodifier to unique ptrs, making ANR dialog disappear if the app dies, and various asset updates.

chunks.title: v0.50.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.50.1, a patch release backporting fixes from main onto v0.50.0. Fixes include invalid ws passed to openwindow in socket2, defaulting drag_lock to 0, not if checking deleted weakpointer in framescheduler, properly setting infinite region on null input in compositor, checking monitor validity in doLater in framescheduler, using window extents instead of border size in snap, detecting android fence support and disabling explicit if missing in opengl, avoiding duplicate timers in eventloop, improving timer handling to avoid crashes, and fixing timer logic on unsafe state in sessionlock.

chunks.title: v0.51.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.51.0, new features include better zoomFactor default, dim_modal, allowing window address in swapwindow, unset for gestures, getprop in hyprctl, fully configurable trackpad gestures, per-device scroll-factor, ignoremaster to swapwithmaster in master layout, previous mode for focusmaster command, bezier to topCommandsPrefixes in nix/lib, cursor:invisible to hide the cursor, rounding power setting to groupbar and gradient roundness, dpms animations, RENDER_POST_WALLPAPER render stage, popup fade-in-out, force 8 bit to fix 10b screensharing in screencopy, options to skip releasing pressed keys on close and to skip sharing key states in virtualkeyboard, and novrr dynamic window rule. Other changes include checking for qt version in CI/Nix update script, checking for finite value in CTM, updating year in LICENSE, adding link to CI from badge in README, bumping hu dep to 0.8.2, marking createNewWorkspace as nodiscard, properly setting infinite region on null input, hardening config logic against Time-Of-Check race conditions, defaulting drag_lock to 0, formatting animation config as table, updating environment if cfg changes live, disabling esync for non-linux kernels, entering unsafe state on boot if there are no mons, moving workspace ptrs to weak, disabling buffer readability checks on intel, dropping on tablet pen tip up in dnd, and checking syn...

chunks.title: v0.51.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.51.1, a patch release backporting fixes from main. Fixes include compilation for 32-bit systems in render, movecursor not updating client pos in dispatchers, handling tablet active area scaling when axes swap due to rotation, no decorate not disabling borders in windows, typo in float and fs in gestures, clamping blur passes 1-8 in renderer, vrr check for reporting no refresh time in presentation, check for config error in solitary, slide/slidefade accepting forced direction in animation, making temp root if not present in hyprpm, relative workspaces with monitor descs in workspace, inconsistent border thickness for roundingPower < 2 in renderer, auto applying suggested scale and notifying the user in monitors, and updating cached mods before IME and adding share_states = 2 config option in vkeyboard.

chunks.title: v0.52.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.52.0, breaking changes rename `misc:disable_hyprland_qtutils_check` to `misc:disable_hyprland_guiutils_check`. New features include automatic closing to submaps, forceidle dispatcher, set/unset/toggle to fullscreen dispatcher, option to rotate device input, more monitor cm options, noscreenshare layer rule, cursor:zoom_disable_aa for controlling AA on zoom, more uniforms to the screen shader, render:non_shader_cm and fixes, updating cached mods before IME and share_states = 2 config option in vkeyboard, and modal prop in windowrules. Other changes include building hyprgraphics after hyprutils in CI/Arch, allowing running CI in forks, removing generateVersion call in CI/release, running cmake configure, allowing building hyprtester without running tests, printing pch messages based on var, minor egl changes, not sharing keys/mods states from grabbed keyboards with ime keys/mods, wl-copy -> wl-clipboard in Nix/tests, building hyprtester along with hyprland in Nix, dropping ninja for CMake build, reverting "nix: use meson", replacing generateVersion.sh, removing duplicate cp and redundant mkdir commands in ci, following preferred srgb eotf for screencopy in cm, and various other adjustments.

chunks.title: v0.52.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.52.1, a patch release backporting fixes from main to v0.52.0. Fixes include populating git info in CI/release, not raising protocol error if layer surface is not anchored in protocols/layershell, fixing wlr-randr by deferring success event until monitor reloads in protocols/outputMgmt, and fixing version.h install location in meson.

chunks.title: v0.52.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.52.2, another patch release with fixes backported on top of v0.52.1.
