chunks.title: v0.53.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.53.1, a standard patch release backporting fixes from main. Fixes include slide direction in desktopAnimationMgr, going back to the previously focused window in a group in desktop/window, guarding null view() when processing mouse down in input, avoiding creating an invalid LS if no monitor could be found in desktop/LS, avoiding sending events to inactive TIs in input/ti, using workArea for idealBB in desktop/window, reading static rules before guessing initial size if possible, min/max clamp potentially crashing in core/xwaylandmgr, and an epic c+p fail in desktop/layerRuleApplicator.

chunks.title: v0.53.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the hyprwm/Hyprland release v0.53.2, a standard patch release backporting fixes from main on top of v0.53.1. chunks.title: v1.6.0

chunks.title: v1.6.1

chunks.title: v1.6.2

chunks.title: v1.8.0

Other changes include fixing hidden Mermaid arrows, adding a `.br` line break function, and introducing subdocuments and links.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent iina/iina release stream from early betas through the 1.4.x series, highlighting major feature additions, UI redesigns, plugin system introduction, and critical bug fixes across macOS versions.

chunks.title: 1.0.0 Beta2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the iina/iina release 1.0.0 Beta2 (tag v1.0.0-beta2), the project updates mpv to 0.28.2 with FFmpeg HEAD, improves the playlist and welcome window, adds a logging system for easier debugging, and includes many refactors, bug fixes, and enhancements.

chunks.title: 1.0.0 Beta3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the iina/iina release 1.0.0 Beta3 (tag v1.0.0-beta3), macOS 10.10 Yosemite support is dropped. FFmpeg is updated to 4.0.1 and youtube-dl is bundled. A new preferences window design is introduced, an Edit menu is added, and shortcuts for quick settings panels are changed to use the Shift key. Slider adjustment by mousewheel is supported, and volume control in music mode is updated. Bug fixes include correcting sort key in history window, fixing resume playback position issues, using monospaced font for time labels, and respecting 'Show remaining time' in music mode.

chunks.title: 1.0.0 Beta4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the iina/iina release 1.0.0 Beta4 (tag v1.0.0-beta4), full support for macOS 10.14 Mojave is added with dark and light themes. More windows and panels are redesigned, CLI and URL scheme options are expanded, remote file support is fine-tuned, and music mode is enhanced with scrolling titles and window layout memory. The audio equalizer is reimplemented, bugs in the new preferences window are fixed, and all known crashes except those from dependencies are resolved.

In the iina/iina release 1.0.1 (tag v1.0.1), a crash on quit is fixed, a potential crash when generating thumbnails is addressed, and the method to obtain actual display FPS for options like video-sync is improved. The 'Use config directory' option is no longer clickable when advanced settings are disabled, automatic quit when the playback history window is open is fixed, exiting full screen when entering PiP is prevented, and localizations are updated in Swedish, Japanese, and Ukrainian.

In the iina/iina release 1.0.2 (tag v1.0.2), fixes include a crash when resizing window, preventing thumbnails from the last video, fixing filter removal, preventing open URL window from entering full screen, fixing key recording view background color on theme change, and fixing menu bar and dock hiding in legacy full screen. Improvements include resuming playback on chapter click, proper double-click on title bar, and preventing system media control grab when main window is not loaded. New features: options to hide main window when entering PiP, playlist edit functions, 'Open URL in browser' and 'Copy URL' in playlist context menu, a PiP toggle button in Touch Bar, and Romanian, Brazilian Portuguese, and Czech localizations. Sparkle and youtube-dl are updated.

In the iina/iina release 1.0.3 (tag v1.0.3), fixes include correcting label/tooltip for Safari toolbar button, fixing argument parsing with '=', hiding sidebar when on audio or subtitles tab, fixing long time label cut-off in music mode, preventing crash when adding custom filter with no name, fixing URL with trailing newline in Open URL window, and fixing media keys not working on app start. Improvements: adding .cue extension to document types and a new --no-stdin option to iina-cli. New: a search bar to filter and search key bindings. Russian and Japanese localizations are updated.

In the iina/iina release 1.0.4 (tag v1.0.4), fixes include playlist not updating after reordering, stretched screen when entering/exiting full screen, player unable to quit when main window hidden due to PiP, dead links in the app, key binding conf file saved incorrectly when filtering and editing, current chapter not correctly highlighted, 'Open in new window' from browser extension not working, and OSDs displaying even when disabled. Slovak translation and youtube-dl are updated, fixing YouTube links not opening.

In the iina/iina release 1.0.5 (tag v1.0.5), fixes and updates include fixing mini player playtime slider and labels not updating on network resources, fixing scratched video during full screen animations after PiP, fixing a crash when initial window size is too small, fixing a cell reuse issue in playlist view, fixing text overlapping issues, fixing mirror filter, fixing unresponsiveness, fixing crashes when streaming and quitting, fixing a crash when quitting in legacy full screen, improving KeyRecordView, using monospace font for chapter info in menu, pausing media when seeking in mini player by dragging progress bar, hiding info panel when app is not top-most, compiling with Swift 5, updating German, Ukrainian, Czech, and zh-Hant localizations, updating mpv to 0.31.0 with FFmpeg 4.2.1, updating youtube-dl, and adding Polish and Turkish localizations. The release is notarized for Catalina, requiring custom mpv builds to be copied into the app bundle. A new Crowdin-based translation platform is introduced.

In the iina/iina release 1.0.6 (tag v1.0.6), several critical issues from 1.0.5 are fixed: crashes on macOS 10.12 and 10.11, disappearance of the Safari plugin, and a bug where thumbnail previews were forced to be generated every time.

chunks.title: IINA 1.0.7 beta 1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the iina/iina release IINA 1.0.7 beta 1 (tag v1.0.7-beta1), new features include an option to accept first mouse click, Catalan language support, a remove button in the playlist, and mouse scroll controls in music mode. Fixes address format PopupButton clickability, OSC disappearance, infinite loop when matching subtitles, Touch Bar seeking resuming playback, crash when scrolling large playlist, enabling saved audio filters, window jumping to focused screen on file change, window size issues in music mode, and mini player behavior. Improvements include performance when deleting histories, continuous update of input fields, double-click to jump to chapter, double-click to download online subtitles, remembering inspector panel position, vertical scroller in welcome window history table, and not showing last video's frame when opening new video. mpv is updated to 0.32.0, and translations from Crowdin are incorporated.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the iina/iina release IINA 1.0.7 beta 2 (tag v1.0.7-beta2), fixes include window always showing on primary screen, not showing OSD on chapter changes, previous video remaining in window if new file has no video tracks, animation when entering/exiting fullscreen, and some typos. Additionally, a crash when setting audio/sub preferred languages is fixed.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the iina/iina release IINA 1.2.0 (tag v1.2.0), a universal binary is shipped that runs natively on both Intel and M1-based Macs. Apart from the universal binary, there are no changes from v1.1.2, so Intel Mac users can skip this update.

chunks.title: v8.7.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ionic-team/ionic-framework release v8.7.3, bug fixes add aria attributes to ignore the checkbox icon and prevent focus-related scroll jumps on refresh in the refresher component.

chunks.title: v8.7.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ionic-team/ionic-framework release v8.7.4, bug fixes improve error text accessibility for input, remove an invalid aria-hidden attribute from overlays and picker, and fix segment-view scrolling and selection in RTL context.

chunks.title: v8.7.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ionic-team/ionic-framework release v8.7.5, bug fixes allow sheet modals to skip the focus trap and make Vue emit component-specific overlay events.

chunks.title: v8.7.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ionic-team/ionic-framework release v8.7.6, a bug fix makes tabs respect the Stencil lifecycle order for tab selection.

chunks.title: v8.7.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ionic-team/ionic-framework release v8.7.8, a bug fix makes checkbox and toggle fire ionFocus and ionBlur events.

chunks.title: v8.7.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ionic-team/ionic-framework release v8.7.9, a bug fix makes accordion-group skip its initial animation.

chunks.title: v8.7.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ionic-team/ionic-framework release v8.7.10, a bug fix improves screen reader announcement timing for validation errors in checkbox, toggle, and radio-group.

chunks.title: v8.7.11

chunks.title: v8.7.13

chunks.title: v8.7.14

chunks.title: v8.7.16

chunks.title: v8.7.17

chunks.title: v8.7.18
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ionic-team/ionic-framework release v8.7.18, bug fixes stretch ion-buttons to fill space for iOS in datetime, clear timeouts in many components, respect safe area insets on popovers and modals, reset direction state when navigation is canceled in nav-controller, prevent DOMException and NotFoundError when filtering radios in radio-group, and keep the icon on the same line as a long message in stacked toast layout.

chunks.title: v8.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ionic-team/ionic-framework release v8.8.0, new features include custom injector support for modal and popover controllers in Angular, a content-fullscreen class when fullscreen is true, header parts for datetime, a wheel part for ion-picker-column, inner and container parts for item-divider, item-option, item, and list-header, drag events for sheet and card modals, classes and parts for individual styling of dual knobs on range, classes when the range value is at min or max, ionPullStart and ionPullEnd events for refresher, a swipeGesture property to disable swiping on segment-view, and wrapper and bottom shadow parts for select.

chunks.title: v8.8.1

chunks.title: v8.8.2

chunks.title: v8.8.3

chunks.title: v8.8.4

chunks.title: v8.8.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ionic-team/ionic-framework release v8.8.5, bug fixes remove a safe-area gap and flash in fullscreen modals and make select focus the selected option on Enter in popover and modal interfaces.

chunks.title: v8.8.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ionic-team/ionic-framework release v8.8.6, bug fixes restore the action-sheet-selected class on non-radio buttons, prevent the hidden-state observer from tearing down the ready class on initial entry in datetime, and prevent segment drag from setting a disabled segment button as checked.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release stream from v3.6.2 through v3.9.2, covering major milestones such as AI integration, Spring Boot 3 migration, and low-code platform enhancements.

chunks.title: v3.6.2 版本发布—2024年度首版本
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.6.2, the project upgrades ant-design-vue to 4.0.8, provides a new dashboard with backend integration, adds flyway automatic database upgrade mechanism for MySQL 5.7 and 8, offers a Spring Boot 3 version branch, applies permission annotations to all interfaces by default for improved security, upgrades hutool to address vulnerabilities, refactors WeChat Work synchronization logic, and upgrades the rich text component to tinymce 6.6.2.

chunks.title: v3.6.2last
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.6.2last is a final version that fixes some issues found in v3.6.2.

chunks.title: v3.6.3  AI版本
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.6.3, the low-code platform integrates with ChatGPT, introducing an AI assistant chat feature, adding 5 new dashboard templates, optimizing login and first-screen performance, supporting homepage customization, extending the export Excel interface timeout, adding a nacos namespace for Spring Boot 3 configuration, upgrading spring-boot-starter to 2.7.18, and providing a new AI dependency starter jeecg-boot-starter-chatgpt.

chunks.title: v3.6.2 springboot3
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.6.2_springboot3 is a backup tag for the Spring Boot 3 and JDK 17 version, including updates such as upgrading fastjson to 2.0.43, replacing tomcat with undertow, and various fixes for Spring Boot 3 compatibility.

chunks.title: v3.6.3last
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.6.3last fixes known bugs discovered in version v3.6.3.

chunks.title: v3.6.3_springboot3
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.6.3_springboot3 is a backup tag for the Spring Boot 3 version of v3.6.3.

chunks.title: v3.6.3_springboot3sas
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.6.3_springboot3sas is a backup tag for the Spring Boot 3 SAS version of v3.6.3.

chunks.title: v3.7.0 里程碑版本
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.0, a milestone version, the project achieves domestic compatibility with Dameng and Kingbase databases, undergoes a major UI theme and performance overhaul, upgrades the Online module, code generator, and templates, upgrades JimuReport to the latest version without concurrency limits, revamps the dashboard with improved layout and capabilities, enhances system monitoring with exception and slow API tracking, and provides a RocketMQ solution for microservices.

chunks.title: v3.7.0_springboot3
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.0_springboot3 is a Spring Boot 3 version of v3.7.0, including merges from master and upgrades such as druid 1.2.22 compatibility.

chunks.title: v3.7.0_springboot3sas
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.0_springboot3sas is a Spring Boot 3 SAS version of v3.7.0, featuring Spring Authorization Server integration, removal of Shiro, and various fixes.

chunks.title: v3.7.0 合并版(前端+后端)
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.0_all is a combined package of the frontend and backend for v3.7.0.

chunks.title: v3.7.0_springboot3sas_20240821
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.0_springboot3sas_20240821 is a backup of code with the login interface still using Spring Security, before compatibility modifications for the default frontend login mode.

chunks.title: v3.7.0_all_last
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.0_all_last adds one-click frontend and backend startup for both standalone and microservice deployments, upgrades xxl-job to 2.4.1 to address CVE-2024-24113, and includes other fixes.

chunks.title: v3.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.1, the code generator is significantly optimized to support sub-package multi-level directories and more detailed generation, JimuReport is upgraded to the latest version with form filling capabilities, the dashboard is upgraded, microservice gateway configuration is simplified, several underlying components are upgraded, and Online functionality is enhanced.

chunks.title: v3.7.0last_springboot3
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.0last_springboot3 is a Spring Boot 3 version with changes compared to v3.7.1.

chunks.title: v3.7.0last_springboot3sas
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.0last_springboot3sas shortens token length to adapt to the main branch frontend login.

chunks.title: v3.7.2 大屏版
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.2, the project integrates JimuBI to provide a free large-screen designer, upgrades JimuReport, supports email push configuration, custom Alibaba Cloud SMS template codes, new DingTalk login logic, and replaces Redis keys command with scan.

chunks.title: v3.7.3 DeepSeek版
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.3, the platform adapts three AI large models: DeepSeek, ChatGPT, and local DeepSeek-R1 via Ollama, upgrades frontend dependencies to vite6 and antd4.2.6, upgrades JimuReport and JimuBI to 1.9.3, and optimizes tenant package management.

chunks.title: v3.7.1 SpringBoot3
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.1springboot3 is a Spring Boot 3 version of v3.7.1, including fixes for distributed transactions and docker image base change to JDK17.

chunks.title: v3.7.1 SpringBoot3sas
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.1SpringBoot3sas is a Spring Boot 3 SAS version of v3.7.1, with Spring Authorization Server, removal of Shiro, and various fixes including Redis serialization and dashboard access issues.

chunks.title: v3.7.4 架构大升级
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.4, the backend architecture undergoes a major upgrade, default JDK is switched to 17, Knife4j is upgraded to OpenAPI3 SpringDoc, tomcat is replaced with undertow, JUnit5 is adopted, and various dependencies are upgraded including fastjson, spring-cloud, and jimureport.

chunks.title: v3.8.0 AI应用平台+知识库
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.8.0, the platform introduces a full suite of AI large model features including AI model management, AI applications, knowledge base, AI process orchestration, and AI chat assistant, marking its transformation into an AI low-code platform.

chunks.title: v3.7.3  springboot3
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.3springboot3 is a Spring Boot 3 version of v3.7.3, including fixes for Redis keys scan, CVE-2023-6378, and Shiro upgrade to 2.0.4.

chunks.title: v3.7.3 springboot3 sas
chunks.memory_unit_text: The jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.7.3springboot3sas is a Spring Boot 3 SAS version of v3.7.3, with Spring Authorization Server, removal of Shiro, and various fixes.

chunks.title: v3.8.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.8.1, the AI application module is stabilized, Electron desktop application support is added, OpenAPI with AK/SK authentication is introduced, user import supports departments and roles, and the code generator supports association record controls and JS enhancement.

chunks.title: v3.8.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.8.2, the Online module is enhanced with AI intelligent table creation, AI test data, and AI report generation, the code generator is strengthened, and new features like APP version management and a revamped notification system are added.

chunks.title: v3.8.3 全面迈向SpringBoot3版
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jeecgboot/JeecgBoot release v3.8.3, the organization structure is deeply revamped to support subsidiaries, position hierarchies, and ranks, the homepage configuration is personalized, tenant management is improved, and the architecture is upgraded to Spring Boot 3.5.5, Spring Cloud 2025.0.0, with a switch back to Tomcat.

chunks.title: v3.9.0

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent jekyll/jekyll release stream from v3.8.0 through v4.4.1, covering major version jumps, security fixes, performance improvements, and feature additions across multiple minor and patch releases.

chunks.title: v3.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jekyll/jekyll release v3.8.0, the project delivers two massive performance improvements for large sites, caches the list of documents to be written, allows Jekyll Doctor to detect stray posts directories, ensures excerpt relative-path matches its path, reminds users to resolve conflicts in 'jekyll new' with --force, memoizes helper methods in site-cleaner, computes document relative_path faster, creates a single instance of PostReader per site, allows date filters to output ordinal days, changes regex to sanitize and normalize filenames passed to LiquidRenderer, allows passing :strict_variables and :strict_filters options to Liquid's renderer, debugs writing files during the build process, improves regex usage in Tags::IncludeTag, improves the comment in the starter index.md, stores and retrieves converter instances for Jekyll::Filters via a hash, implements a cache within the where filter, stores regexp in a constant, and optimizes computing filename in LiquidRenderer. Development fixes include moving duplicate code to a single private method, testing against Ruby 2.5 on AppVeyor, replacing simple regex with native Ruby methods, excluding livereload.js from Codeclimate, adding a cucumber feature to test link tag, fixing theme gem feature, rewriting script/rubyprof as a Ruby script, adding debug output to theme rendering, fixing minitest deprecation warning, memoizing Site#site_data, memoizing document output extension, accessing document permalink attribute efficiently, minimizing array allocations in the where filter, bumping JRuby, asserting existence of <collection>.files, bumping Rubocop to 0.54.x, regenerating unconditionally unless incremental build, centralizing require statements, bumping to Rubocop 0.55, and refactoring HighlightBlock#parse_options. Documentation adds several plugins and fixes various typos and instructions. Site enhancements remove links to Gists and enforce HTTPS for Google Fonts and analytics.js. Bug fixes append appropriate closing tag to Liquid block in an excerpt, bypass rendering via Liquid unless required, and ensure delegated methods after private keyword are meant to be private.

Bug fixes include a security fix for include bypass of EntryFilter#filter symlink check, ensuring theme gem directories aren't symlinks, adding call to unused method validate_options, checking if scope applies to type before given path, documenting two methods, checking key in collections only if not 'posts', interpolating Jekyll::Page subclass on inspection, measuring template render counts, reducing array traversal in Jekyll::Reader, re-implementing handling Liquid blocks in excerpts, enabling documents to render their date, fixing interpreter warning from Jekyll::Renderer, allowing loggers to accept numbers and symbols, replacing regex arg to gsub with a string arg, not writing static files from unrendered collection, handling excerpts of custom and intermediate tags, changing future post loglevel to warn, handling files with trailing dots in basename, fixing unnecessary allocations via StaticFileReader, not checking site URL if nil, avoiding unnecessary duplication of pages array, memoizing Site#post_attr_hash, memoizing Document#excerpt_separator, optimizing DATE_FILENAME_MATCHER, escaping valid special chars in site path name, replacing name in Page#inspect with relative_path, logging warning when slug is empty, and pushing Markdown link refs to excerpt only as required. Minor enhancements include enhancing --blank scaffolding, fixing custom 404 page for GitHub pages, loading config from current theme-gem, using jekyll-compose if installed, suggesting --trace on fail, supporting binary operators in where_exp filter, automatically loading _config.toml, adding vendor folder to .gitignore, outputting Jekyll version while debugging, memoizing excerpt relative_path, skipping unreadable posts, memoizing Site#documents, caching globbed paths in front matter defaults, caching computed item property, cleaning up Markdown converter, disabling Liquid via front matter, not processing Liquid in post excerpt when disabled, liquefied link tag, updating item_property to return numbers as numbers instead of strings, using .markdown extension for page templates, adding support for *.xhtml files, allowing i18n v0.9.5 and higher, ignoring permission error of /proc/version, stripping extra slashes via Jekyll.sanitized_path, removing default config for markdown in site template, adding custom inspect string for StaticFile objects, reminding user to include gem in Gemfile on error, searching front matter defaults for Page objects with relative_path, locking tzinfo to v1.x, utilizing absolute paths of user-provided file paths, detecting nil and empty values in objects with where filter, initializing mutations for Drops only if necessary, reducing array allocations via Jekyll::Cleaner, encoding and unencoding urls only as required, reducing string allocations, reducing allocations from Document instances, adding type attribute to Document instances, reducing allocations from where-filter, memoizing SiteDrop#documents, adding PathManager class, removing warnings for deprecated config, and delegating --profile tabulation to terminal-table.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent jesseduffield/lazydocker release stream from early versions through the latest updates, highlighting key feature additions, bug fixes, and configuration changes.

chunks.title: v0.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.7.1, the release notes include a typo fix, updates to the README, removal of the tap command for Homebrew, respect for the DOCKER_HOST environment variable, and documentation updates.

chunks.title: v0.7.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.7.2, the release notes describe improvements to container top, implementation of a PreviousViews stack for better navigation, ensuring the current task is stopped before exit to avoid orphan child processes, CI improvements including a proper build matrix using workflows, and changes to Homebrew installation instructions in the README.

chunks.title: v0.7.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.7.3, the release notes mention checking out the latest master branch before updating documentation.

chunks.title: v0.7.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.7.4, the release notes revert the previous change of checking out the latest master before updating docs and instead use a relative path when creating documentation.

chunks.title: v0.7.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.7.5, the release notes include adding missing imports, building a Windows amd64 target on CI, commenting out snapcraft configuration, killing all related processes using Windows internals, removing unconditional logging profile, returning error with stderr value, returning only stdout from command, updating the README with badges and FAQ about Docker logs, CI improvements with global GOFLAGS and vendor usage, goreleaser configuration for armv6, removing duplicate 'c' binding in the images panel, and documentation updates.

chunks.title: v0.7.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.7.6, the release notes add a Windows release to the README, update documentation to mention availability in the Scoop main bucket, build on Windows i386 in CI, pass arguments inline in commands, and update documentation.

chunks.title: v0.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.8, the release notes defer stopping a ticker, reduce CPU usage caused by tickers, update dependencies, use only curl in the install_update_linux.sh script, and update the README.

chunks.title: v0.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.9, the release notes fix CPU usage, remove Rollbar, allow specifying a directory in the Linux install script, and mention the DIR environment variable in the README.

chunks.title: v0.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.10, the release notes add a health check to the container list, add information about the Chocolatey package, correct Dutch typos, log PrepareForChildren, improve alignment for the health check, fix empty logs, and include various small fixes and CI error corrections.

chunks.title: v0.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.11, the release notes merge pull requests that add a new config folder location, update a patch, add browser support, and add exec shell functionality.

chunks.title: v0.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.12, the release notes replace 'github' with 'tap' in the brews section of the goreleaser configuration.

chunks.title: v0.16
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.16, the release notes mention new tokens and swapping tokens.

chunks.title: v0.17
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.17, the release notes include a fix for a version bump.

chunks.title: v0.17.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.17.1, the release notes highlight that CPU usage is now under control, idling at 1-2% instead of 100% before. A new tab in the main view shows a container's environment variables. Containers are now sorted by status, with an option to restore legacy sorting via 'gui.legacySortContainers: true'. The anonymous reporting popup is removed since telemetry was stopped. Contributor changes include moving to Go 1.18 and using GitHub Actions instead of CircleCI. The maintainer notes that the CPU fix was achieved by using Docker's event stream to avoid polling.

chunks.title: v0.18
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.18, the release notes state that CPU usage is well under control. When Docker is not running, the application now waits for it to start instead of crashing. A bug where container CPU was reported lower than expected is fixed. There is less reliance on the Docker binary, resulting in faster loading of container logs. The updated rendering library (gocui) includes bug fixes, supports more terminals like Alacritty, and introduces scrollbars. Images are now sorted by name, and force removal of images is possible. Services can be started with 'shift+S'. A bug where toggling the hiding of stopped containers did not immediately apply is fixed. Version info is now built in upon 'go install'. The Dockerfile is fixed to support Go 1.18. Performance improvements are included. Defaults are changed: content in the main panel is now wrapped by default, timestamps in container logs are no longer shown by default, and the 'commandTemplates.containerLogs' is no longer recognized; instead, logging can be configured with 'logs.timestamps' and 'logs.since'.

chunks.title: v0.18.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.18.1, the release notes mention a minor fix from v0.18 where TTY containers were not showing their logs.

chunks.title: v0.19.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.19.0, the release notes include features such as displaying ports in the containers and services panels, support for the 'docker pause' command via the 'p' key, ability to start a shell from the services panel via the 'E' key, expanding the current window to half or full screen using '+' and '_' keys, string replacements for image names to shorten long image name columns, using a blue background color on the selected line for better visibility, support for tab and backtab navigation, viewing container logs via SDK rather than the Docker binary, improving sorting of volumes to show named volumes at the top, and including the image name in the config tab. Bug fixes address focus-related issues and a bug where text was white in light themes. Maintenance updates include FAQ steps for Docker Compose V2, marking keybinding cheatsheets as auto-generated, improving the install script, extracting process kill logic for use in lazygit, and fixing linting errors.

chunks.title: v0.20.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.20.0, the release notes add list panel filtering with the '/' key, French keybindings, allowing upping a service with the 'u' key, fixing port flickering, and ensuring the cheatsheet is up to date when running CI against a PR.

chunks.title: v0.21.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.21.0, the release notes add a networks view, allow configuring the number of logs to tail, wrap custom commands on shell, use service name as service ID, allow setting default screenMode, add selectedLineBgColor theme customization, allow showing compact container statuses, render container stats and configs as YAML, display hotkeys to detach from the container, add Chinese translation, add a dev-container, fix a linter issue, explain Go templates in custom commands in documentation, and bump several dependencies.

chunks.title: v0.21.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.21.1, the release notes fix a broken custom command template application.

chunks.title: v0.23.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.23.0, the release notes honor the host specified in the current Docker context, forward environment variables to commands, add Portuguese and Spanish translations, fix mistakes in French and Polish translations, mention JSON schema, use Go 1.20, fix a maintenance typo, add a timeout to the Go linter, appease the linter, bump Docker and x/net, and bump the version tag in installation docs for asdf.

chunks.title: v0.23.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.23.1, the release notes gracefully check for Docker config and update the README.

chunks.title: v0.23.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.23.3, the release notes fix a bug where logs did not appear in the main view as expected, especially on startup, fix a bug where logs did not render correctly after returning from a subprocess, fix a Portuguese typo, update docs to use the correct Go version, add config for border style, and update the appearance of scrollbars to be less ugly.

chunks.title: v0.24.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.24.0, the release notes add a hint to .DockerCompose in documentation, fix the Alpine version in the Dockerfile, properly support remote Docker daemon over SSH, fix breaking when having default Docker explicitly mentioned in Docker config, use 'docker compose' by default, update many Go module dependencies, update to Go 1.21, and remove the Homebrew bump action.

chunks.title: v0.24.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.24.1, the release notes properly support remote Docker daemon over SSH, fix breaking when having default context in config, bump many dependencies which fixed a bug where lazydocker didn't realize it was in a folder with a docker compose file, add a hint to what .DockerCompose is in documentation, use 'docker compose' by default, and update go.mod dependencies.

chunks.title: v0.24.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.24.2, the release notes add navigation via numbers, show jump panel keybindings in panel titles, update the Docker client to support API version 1.52, add manual install part to the README, update the README with various changes, fix CI, and run 'go mod vendor'.

chunks.title: v0.24.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.24.3, the release notes fix a panic by validating Names slice length and using containerID as container name if Names slice is empty in container summary, upgrade the Go version from 1.21 to 1.23 in the Dockerfile, and use a newer Go version and setup-go version.

chunks.title: v0.24.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.24.4, the release notes fix a version lock issue.

chunks.title: v0.25.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.25.0, the release notes add a Claude settings file and improve projects support.

chunks.title: v0.25.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazydocker release v0.25.2, the release notes add some Claude stuff, fix forced project view, hide project/services panels when not in a docker-compose project, support the -p flag and DRY up code, and use IsProjectScoped at remaining call sites plus add a test.
