prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent jesseduffield/lazygit release stream from v0.43.1 through v0.62.1, covering enhancements like per-repo config, stacked branches, auto-forwarding, hunk staging, keybinding revamp, and GitHub PR integration, along with numerous fixes and maintenance updates.

chunks.title: v0.43.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.43.1, the only change is a fix for language auto detection.

chunks.title: v0.44.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.44.0, enhancements include per-repo config files with automatic reloading, viewing diff across a range of commits, support for hyperlinks from pagers, switching to the Files panel after popping/applying a stash, asking to auto-stage unstaged files when continuing a rebase after resolving conflicts, offering an autostash option when creating a new branch, allowing shell aliases in interactive custom commands, switching tabs with panel jump keys, renaming 'Custom Command' to 'Shell Command', and improving template placeholders for custom commands.

chunks.title: v0.44.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.44.1, enhancements include creating fixup commits at the end of the branch they belong to when using stacked branches, and adding options to disable switching to the Files panel after popping or applying a stash. Fixes include a crash when viewing divergence of a branch up to date with its upstream. Performance improvements address large numbers of untracked or modified files. Language files are updated from Crowdin.

chunks.title: v0.45.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.45.0, enhancements include better branch delete confirmation, a menu item to delete both local and remote branch at once, auto-rendering hyperlinks, allowing pasting commits multiple times, a config option to disable switching tabs with panel jump keys (disabled by default), a new filter to show only tracked files in the Files panel, allowing DiffContextSize to be decreased to zero, allowing user to select remote and branch when creating a PR, deleting a range selection of branches, showing the number of lines changed per file in the working file tree view, dropping merge commits, wrapping lines in the staging view, allowing to switch branches in Commit View, allowing on-prem Azure DevOps Server pull requests, adding a screen-mode command line argument, defaulting to half-screen mode when opening with certain CLI args, showing the alt-enter keybinding at the bottom of the commit description view, and adding the number of commits to the cherry-pick confirmation prompt. Fixes address copying commit author to clipboard, merge conflict resolution when file doesn't end with LF, file icons, non-sticky range select after clicking in staging view, scroll position when entering staging view by clicking in the main view, mouse wheel scrolling of custom patch view, improving editing a commit, using custom context size in range diff, and adding missing default sort order in the commits panel.

chunks.title: v0.45.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.45.2, enhancements include the ability to configure branch color patterns using regex, collapsing/uncollapsing all files in the tree, and improving the undo action to restore files upon undoing a commit. Fixes include bumping gocui (and tcell). Maintenance includes cutting a new release automatically each month and bumping tcell to fix broken deployment.

chunks.title: v0.46.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.46.0, enhancements include preserving the pending commit message when closing/re-opening, swapping the position of checkout-commit and checkout-branch menu items, allowing the user to filter the files view to only show untracked files, exposing {{.SelectedCommitRange}} to custom commands, showing background fetch status in the bottom line, supporting copying tags to clipboard, adding an option to delete local and remote tags, showing a confirmation menu when trying to amend changes while there are conflicts, improving error reporting on config migration, showing files filter status, and improving contrast of highlighted search results. Fixes address not trying to kill processes if the command already finished, adding '--' to 'git rev-list' to disambiguate branch name from path, fixing adding a blank line at the end of the commit message, fixing checking out a different branch while pushing a branch for the first time, fixing tag being truncated when copying to clipboard, disabling staging and unstaging lines or hunks when the diff context size is 0, fixing incorrect stash diff after rename, fixing a possible crash when deleting a branch while filtering is active, fixing pasting multi-line text into the commit message panel, properly detecting icons for BAZEL and WORKSPACE files, and fixing the json schema for the context of CustomCommand. Maintenance includes bumping go-deadlock version to fix a crash with go 1.23 in debug mode and fixing the auto-release workflow. Translations are updated, including a new Portuguese translation.

chunks.title: v0.47.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.47.1, the only change is a maintenance fix for a race condition with reselecting the focused branch and rendering.

chunks.title: v0.47.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.47.2, enhancements include skipping the post-checkout hook when discarding changes. Fixes include disabling global keybinds when confirmation is active, not rewriting the config file unnecessarily when it contains commitPrefixes, and changing side panel width calculation to work for larger numbers. Maintenance includes fixing the auto-release schedule, using indentation of 2 when rewriting auto-migrated config files, using refs in jsonschema, improving the release workflow, filtering out dev comments from schema, and fixing the release script. Docs improve the error message when users have gpg signing turned on.

chunks.title: v0.48.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.48.0, the only enhancement is custom commands submenus. Maintenance refactors migrations to only marshall yaml twice.

chunks.title: v0.49.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.49.0, breaking changes include that executing shell commands no longer uses an interactive shell. Enhancements include supporting fish when running shell commands, adding an acme editor preset, supporting home and end as alternatives to '<' and '>', dropping the git config cache when getting focus, adding a 'Content of selected file' entry to the copy menu for commit files, adding a root node in the file tree, adding recursive bulk initialize and update for submodules, making the commit without pre-commit hooks action independent on prefix, letting users define custom icons and color for files on the config file, adding an 'Absolute path' item to the file view's copy menu, allowing range drop stashes, more navigation keybindings for the confirmation panel, resolving non-inline merge conflicts, adding a runCommand function to Go template syntax plus support for templates in git branchPrefix setting, showing '(hooks disabled)' in the title bar of the commit message editor, and adding a command to select all commits of the current branch. Fixes include using a waiting status for rewording a non-head commit, fixing the layout of the options view for non-English languages, fixing changing language while lazygit is running, URL encoding gitlab brackets to make consistent with branch names, fixing commitPrefix setting with empty pattern, committing only tracked files in the tracked filter view, reverting the skip post-checkout hook when discarding changes, enhancing support for GPG signed tags, fixing checking out a file from a range selection of commits, fixing discarding submodule changes in nested folders, and better support for shell aliases.

chunks.title: v0.50.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.50.0, breaking changes include that after fetching, main branches now get auto-forwarded to their upstream if they fall behind, configurable via git.autoForwardBranches. Enhancements include continuing/aborting a conflicted cherry-pick or revert, showing todo items for pending cherry-picks and reverts, using 'git cherry-pick' for implementing copy/paste of commits, allowing reverting a range of commits, section headers for rebase todos and actual commits, focusing the main view, auto-forwarding main branches after fetching, adding a new command 'Move commits to new branch', stripping the '+' and '-' characters when copying parts of a diff to the clipboard, and reducing memory consumption of the graph. Fixes include fixing truncation of branches when scrolling the branches panel to the left, fixing nvim-remote commands for fish shell, disallowing creating custom patches when the diff context size is 0, and removing double space between rebase todo and author columns. Maintenance allows closing issues via github actions. Docs add Debian installation instructions alongside Ubuntu and fix wording of a random tip.

chunks.title: v0.51.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.51.0, breaking changes include that the 'subprocess', 'stream', and 'showOutput' fields of custom commands have been replaced by a single 'output' field. Enhancements include cleaning up the configuration of where a custom command's output goes, adding a custom patch command 'Move patch into new commit before the original commit', making '>' first jump to the beginning of the branch and then to the first commit, adding an alternate keybinding (default <c-s>) for ConfirmInEditor, and printing migration changes to the console when migrating the config file. Fixes include migrating deprecated AllBranchesLogCmd to AllBranchesLogCmds, clearing preserved commit message when entering CommitEditorPanel, splitting behavior of rendering allBranchesLogCmd and switching to next cmd, fixing a possible crash with auto-forwarding branches, fixing the main view occasionally scrolling to the top on its own when focused, fixing home and end keys in prompts, and fixing a crash when clicking in the status view. Maintenance cleans up the utils package. Docs reword documentation for git.autoForwardBranches.

chunks.title: v0.51.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.51.1, the only change is a fix for lazygit's UI becoming unresponsive when a background fetch asks for a passphrase.

chunks.title: v0.52.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.52.0, enhancements include adding user config for hiding the root item in the file tree, using branchPrefix when moving commits to a new branch, and showing the default option when prompting to create a new git repo. Fixes include fixing selecting large hunks and problems editing very long commit descriptions, killing background fetch when it requests a passphrase, fixing branch selection jumping back on background fetch, fixing resetting to a branch when a tag shares the same name or vice versa, fixing wrong inactive highlight when switching between repos, and fixing assigning a custom key to the pullFiles command in the Commits panel. Maintenance replaces a literal with a ConfigFilename constant and improves the PR template regarding release notes.

chunks.title: v0.53.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.53.0, this is the first release after passing maintainership to @stefanhaller. Enhancements include adding an option to disable warning when amending the last commit, adding bold style for border, adding credential prompts for PKCS11-based SSH keys, showing annotation information for the selected tag, showing stash name for the selected stash, auto-stashing modified files when cherry-picking or reverting commits, moving to the next stageable line when adding a line to a custom patch, improving hunk selection mode in the staging view, and adding a user config to use hunk mode by default when entering the staging view. Fixes include fixing stash operations when a branch named 'stash' exists, fixing moving a custom patch from the very first commit of the history to a later commit, fixing DEFAULT_REMOTE_ICON character code, showing GPG error before entering commit editor when rewording non-latest commits, fixing branch head icon appearing at head commit when a remote or tag exists with the same name as the current branch, fixing applying custom patches to a dirty working tree, and collapsing selection after deleting a range of branches or stashes. Maintenance includes instantiating mutexes by value, bumping a dependency, updating the linter, and some code cleanups.

chunks.title: v0.54.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.54.0, breaking changes include changing the default sort order for local and remote branches to 'date' (committerdate) and changing the default selection mode in staging and custom patch building views to hunk mode. Enhancements include adding confirmation for hard reset, providing user config defaults for UI-changeable settings, improving mouse handling of the suggestions panel, adding a new command 'Checkout previous branch', adding confirmation for nuking the working tree, supporting Alt+Backspace for word deletion in text areas, not using hunk mode for added or deleted files even when useHunkModeInStagingView config is on, showing [0] keybinding in the main view title, drawing divergence from base branch right-aligned in the branches view, and enabling hunk staging mode by default. Fixes include fixing scrolling hunk into view when selecting next hunk, fixing stale main view content when entering/exiting filtering view, detecting double-clicks properly, fixing commit searching during rebase or in divergence from upstream view, fixing amending commits whose commit message is empty, several small fixes to filtering mode, showing diff for renamed file when filtering by path, allowing rewording or dropping commits in filtering mode, fixing an index out of bounds panic when repository has massive tags, and when pressing 'a' to stage all files, not including untracked files when showing only tracked files.

chunks.title: v0.54.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.54.1, this hotfix release fixes a regression in 0.54.0 that made lazygit fail on startup when multiple users use it on a single machine. The fix addresses a temp dir permission problem on multi-user machines. Maintenance stops updating Jesse's homebrew tap. Docs update the Fedora section of the README.

chunks.title: v0.54.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.54.2, this point release fixes a performance regression in 0.54.0 that made flicking through diffs less snappy. Fixes include fixing the scrollbar in certain popup panels and fixing delay with flicking through files or commits when git diff is very slow. Maintenance stops bumping the homebrew formula and updates badges in README. Docs fix the useHunkModeInStagingView hint in the breaking changes message and update CONTRIBUTING.md to clarify translation contribution process.

chunks.title: v0.55.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.55.0, breaking changes include rebinding the 'redo' command from ctrl-z to shift-Z because ctrl-z is now used for suspending the application, and removing the git.paging.useConfig option. Enhancements include allowing filtering the keybindings menu by keybinding, adding support for suspending LazyGit with Ctrl+Z on Unix systems, adding a 'CopyToClipboard' command to ConfirmationController, adding a user config for using git's external diff command for paging, and logging the hash of dropped stashes. Fixes include fixing right-alignment of divergence from base branch for a branch checked out in a worktree, supporting Azure DevOps vs-ssh.visualstudio.com SSH remotes as hosting provider, improving display of 'esc' keybinding in the keybindings status bar, using external diff command in stashes panel, removing the git.paging.useConfig option, not auto-forwarding branches that are checked out in another worktree, fixing dropping range selection of filtered stashes, fixing a rare crash in interactive rebase (merge command without comment), and making it possible to rebind the Confirm keybinding. Maintenance includes passing only Git-tracked Go files to gofumpt, updating donation wording, enhancing PR/Issue templates readability, and running label check workflow only on label events and open PR events. Docs add installation with gah, fix a typo in VISION, and add dev container feature as installation method. Translations are updated from Crowdin.

chunks.title: v0.55.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.55.1, this hotfix release fixes two bugs from v0.55.0: one regression that broke displaying the enter key in the keybindings menu, and a problem with a newly added feature that didn't work correctly. Fixes include not hiding keybindings that match the confirmMenu key in the keybindings menu and fixing staging when using the new useExternalDiffGitConfig config.

chunks.title: v0.56.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.56.0, enhancements include not breaking line after footnote symbol in commit messages, giving better visual feedback when checking out the previous branch, adding a merge menu with conflict resolver, when entering a commit in path filtering mode selecting the filtered path, documenting a workaround for using custom pagers on Windows, showing 'Log (x of y)' in the title bar when there is more than one branch log command, supporting multiple pagers, adding config option gui.skipSwitchWorktreeOnCheckoutWarning, and adding a no-ff merge option. Fixes include not logging the git rev-list command used for IsBranchMerged, hiding the cursor when the password prompt is showing, updating Merge conflicts menu keybinding to use p instead of k, updating diff of conflicted file in the main view after conflicts have been resolved, not depending on en_US locale to be installed, fixing dropping submodule changes from a commit, fixing support for Git copy status when status.renames=copies, when pasting multi-line text into a prompt not treating line feeds as 'confirm', offering to force-delete a worktree if it contains submodules, fixing window arrangement when a popup or the search prompt is open, fixing lazygit getting unresponsive when pasting commits that become empty, showing a better error message if the temp directory is not writeable, avoiding auto-stashing when only submodules are out of date, using a PTY when using external diff command from git config, and fixing fixup's false filename detection in hunks containing dashed lines. Maintenance includes making running with --debug and running integration tests work when built with go 1.25, updating go to 1.25, adding a comprehensive Nix flake, fixing normalisedSelectedNodes function, and adding a 'synchronize' event to the hooks of 'Checkout previous branch'.

chunks.title: v0.57.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.57.0, enhancements include opening pull requests in browser with extra leading slashes removed, allowing using SelectedSubmodule in CustomCommands, not allowing empty input in most prompts, suppressing output from background fetch (unless there were errors), adding a fork remote command, and triggering immediate background fetch when switching repos. Fixes include keeping cursor at top/bottom when navigating by page, switching to branches view when checking out a commit, fixing deleting a remote tag when a remote branch with the same name exists or vice versa, showing fixup base commits in correct order in ctrl-f error message, a band-aid fix for rare crashes when refreshing files, and fixing to support creating MRs for repositories cloned with SSH alias. Maintenance includes keeping config and schema unchanged during a release, modernizing all codes, bumping a dependency, not using 'HEADLESS' environment variable for running tests, refactoring to use strings.Builder and strings.Repeat, and fixing a function name in a comment. Docs add a 'Commit history' section to CONTRIBUTING.md, update table of contents in README.md, and update docs and schema for release. Translations are updated from Crowdin. Performance improvements fix and speed up the file list for the 'Enter path to filter by' feature.

chunks.title: v0.58.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.58.0, enhancements include adding keys for command log menu items, adding Codeberg as a supported git hosting service, changing the keybinding of the 'keep' item in the Merge Conflict menu back to 'k', supporting custom keybindings in custom command menu prompts, and showing an error when checking out a file would overwrite local modifications. Fixes include removing confirmation for opening the merge tool, allowing using 'j', 'k', 'H', or 'L' as keybindings in custom command menus, preventing many hyperlinks from launching while mouse moving, fixing the main view display after reverting a commit, avoiding scrolling the selection into view on refresh, and fixing rendering of certain emojis. Docs fix small issues with the Breaking Changes texts, add a note about delta's --navigate option not working in lazygit, and update docs and schema for release. Translations are updated from Crowdin. Performance improvements fix annoying UI stalls after refresh when the reflog is very long.

chunks.title: v0.58.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.58.1, this hotfix release fixes known issues with 0.58, including regressions from updating the TUI library tcell. Enhancements include updating search position when changing the selection in a list view. Fixes include when doing ctrl-f and the resulting commit is not visible, scrolling it into view; fixing pasting multi-line text into the commit description; fixing keypad keys and pasting emojis in Windows Terminal; not logging the 'git ls-remote' call when opening a PR; and fixing rendering artefacts after double-width characters on some terminals. Maintenance requests info about the terminal in the issue template.

chunks.title: v0.59.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.59.0, enhancements include having 'Find base commit for fixup' ignore fixup commits for the found base commit, excluding commit trailers from line wrapping, limiting popup panel widths to a maximum width, supporting using the selected commit's message in a fixup, and fixing gitignore path collisions. Fixes include not logging the 'git rev-list' call when marking bisect commits, fixing opening a menu when a previous menu was scrolled down, when moving commits up/down and the selection leaves the view scrolling to make it visible again, fixing rendering of CRLF sequence, fixing rendering of the Reflog panel when using up/down to scroll it, and adding Nushell support for nvim-remote preset. Maintenance includes updating devcontainer VARIANT, updating outdated GitHub Actions versions, disabling the automatic scheduled release, and auto-updating cheatsheets after updating translation. Docs update README to add GitArbor TUI as an alternative and update docs and schema for release. Translations are updated from Crowdin.

chunks.title: v0.60.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.60.0, enhancements include renaming 'Copy commit hash to clipboard' to mention it's an abbreviated hash, hiding the 'Fetching...' status of the auto-fetch when the bottom line is hidden, allowing removing lines from patch directly, filtering file views rather than searching, showing branch name and detached HEAD in worktrees tab, adding backward cycling support for log view, and showing worktree name next to branch in branches list. Fixes include fixing matching of lazygit-edit URLs without line numbers, creating .git/info directory before writing exclude file, fixing off-by-one error when calculating popup panel dimensions, properly disabling clicks in inactive views behind popups, enabling '{' and '}' to change diff context size in branches and tags panels in diffing mode, and fixing diff display of custom pagers after screen mode change. Maintenance bumps a dependency. Docs fix a typo. Translations are updated from Crowdin. Other changes add Terra as an alternative Fedora install method.

chunks.title: v0.61.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.61.0, the big feature is support for GitHub pull requests, shown as GitHub icons next to branches with PRs, and openable in the browser with shift-G, requiring the gh CLI tool. Enhancements include adding support for clicking on arrows in the file list to expand/collapse directories, removing empty directories after discarding untracked files, making file sort order and case sensitivity configurable and defaulting to mix files and folders, allowing customizing the window width/height thresholds for portrait mode, logging hashes of local branches when deleting them, and adding a condition field to custom command prompts. Fixes include fixing staging only some lines of a block of consecutive changes, fixing the expanded layout of the branches panel, fixing searching commits or main view after switching repos, scrolling to top when showing subcommits, fixing patch commands when git config has color=always, and not staging out-of-date submodules when asking user to auto-stage after resolving conflicts. Maintenance includes removing go-git dependency, making Debian/Ubuntu install command architecture-independent, and bumping several dependencies.

chunks.title: v0.61.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.61.1, this release has a few fixes for the recently added GitHub pull requests feature. Enhancements include hiding closed pull requests on main branches. Fixes include normalizing repository owner casing to fix GitHub PR integration and not defaulting the base repo for pull requests to 'origin'. Maintenance includes a security fix to avoid using variable interpolation in run steps and adding a justfile.

chunks.title: v0.62.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.62.0, the big change is a keybinding revamp allowing richer keybindings and a new syntax. Breaking changes include the default keybinding for submitting a commit from the commit description editor changing from alt-enter to command-enter on Mac or ctrl-enter on Linux/Windows. Enhancements include retrying on ref lock errors during fetch/pull, preserving whitespace when remembering commit message, defining PR colors as hex colors to match GitHub's, revamping the keybinding mechanism, platform-specific edit bindings for move-by-word and backspace-word, changing canonical keybinding syntax, using more widely-supported Unicode symbols for the commit graph, showing push URLs for remotes that have any, supporting GitHub Enterprise for the Pull Requests feature, allowing keybindings to configure more than one key, adding <alt+up>/<alt+down> as alternate keybindings for moving commits up/down, and adding support for git flow using the git-flow-next tool. Fixes include fixing copying a file's absolute path when running in a linked worktree, preserving commit message when quitting while the commit message panel is open, stopping showing cached PRs when we no longer have a base remote, if multiple remotes exist but only one is a Github remote picking it without prompting, and fixing cherry-picking a range selection of commits.

chunks.title: v0.62.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release v0.62.1, this release fixes a regression (crash) introduced in 0.62.0. The fix addresses a crash when keybindings are disabled that normally show in the status bar. Docs add how to add the default, non-pager diff to the list of pagers.

questions.query_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit releases, which release introduces per-repo config files with automatic reloading and the ability to view diff across a range of commits?

answer_support.answer_text: enhancements include per-repo config files with automatic reloading, viewing diff across a range of commits

questions.query_text: Across the jesseduffield/lazygit releases, how does the change to the default selection mode in staging described in v0.54.0 differ from the hunk selection improvement described in v0.53.0?

options.text: v0.53.0 improves hunk selection mode in staging view and adds a user config to use it by default, while v0.54.0 changes the default to hunk mode and also changes branch sort order defaults.
v0.53.0 removes hunk mode entirely, while v0.54.0 reintroduces it as the only option.
Both releases only fix crashes in the staging view without changing selection behavior.
v0.53.0 makes hunk mode mandatory, while v0.54.0 makes line mode mandatory.

questions.expected_answer: v0.53.0 improves hunk selection mode in staging view and adds a user config to use it by default, while v0.54.0 changes the default to hunk mode and also changes branch sort order defaults.

answer_support.answer_text: improving hunk selection mode in the staging view, and adding a user config to use hunk mode by default when entering the staging view
changing the default selection mode in staging and custom patch building views to hunk mode

questions.query_text: In the jesseduffield/lazygit release window, order the following release-content states from earliest to latest: (1) a release that adds custom commands submenus, (2) a release that introduces per-repo config files with automatic reloading, (3) a release that adds support for GitHub pull requests shown as icons next to branches, (4) a release that revamps the keybinding mechanism to support richer keybindings.

answer_support.answer_text: per-repo config files with automatic reloading
custom commands submenus
support for GitHub pull requests, shown as GitHub icons next to branches
keybinding revamp allowing richer keybindings

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent jestjs/jest release stream from v29.4.2 through v30.4.2, covering feature additions, breaking changes, and fixes across minor and major versions including the Jest 30 alpha, beta, and stable releases.

chunks.title: v29.4.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v29.4.2, the project instruments significant lifecycle events with performance.mark() in @jest/core, provides the type of actual as a generic argument to Matchers for better-typed extensions, adds an explicit mention in jest-circus when a test fails because done() is not called, handles CJS re-exports of node core modules from ESM in jest-runtime, downgrades write-file-atomic to v4 in jest-transform, and makes jest-worker ignore IPC messages not intended for Jest.

chunks.title: v29.4.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v29.4.3, the project updates toThrow() to use error causes in expect, allows workerIdleMemoryLimit with only 1 worker or runInBand in jest-core, adds support for error causes in jest-message-util, reverts import assertions for JSON modules in jest-runtime, fixes subsetEquality to consider inherited string keys in @jest/expect-utils, clears mock state when jest.restoreAllMocks() is called in jest-mock, prevents mockImplementationOnce and mockReturnValueOnce from bleeding into withImplementation, and ensures jest.resetAllMocks() does not restore mocks.

chunks.title: v29.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v29.5.0, the project adds support for Sapling in jest-changed-files, introduces a feature to randomize test order via CLI flag or config, adds a workerThreads configuration option for parallelization using worker threads, exports yargsOptions from jest-cli, adds an openHandlesTimeout option to configure open handles warning, allows passing a length argument to createCacheKey() with a default of 16 on Windows, adds support for AggregateError and Error causes in jest-message-util, adds a summaryThreshold option to the summary reporter, exposes @sinonjs/fake-timers async APIs in jest-runtime, allows V8 coverage provider to collect coverage from files not loaded explicitly, adds support for cts and mts TypeScript files to inline snapshots, adds a start method to worker farms, supports passing a URL as path to worker, fixes unwanted hoisting of nested jest usages in babel-plugin-jest-hoist, sends test case results for todo tests, updates the test timeout message, avoids creating the word testfalse when takesDoneCallback is false, stops setting document to null on teardown in jest-environment-jsdom, updates toStrictEqual() to check jest.fn().mock.calls, and allows TestResultsProcessor type to return a Promise.

chunks.title: v29.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v29.6.0, the project adds support for snapshot matchers in concurrent tests, includes type definitions in generated config files, supports arrays as property matchers in jest-snapshot, adds support for reporting about start individual test cases using jest-circus, prevents false test failures caused by promise rejections handled asynchronously, handles frozen config objects, allows coverageDirectory and collectCoverageFrom in project config, always uses workers in watch mode to avoid crashes, fixes assignment of customExportConditions via testEnvironmentOptions, fixes copying value of inherited getters in jest-matcher-utils, tweaks typings to allow jest.replaceProperty() to replace methods, improves user input validation and error messages of spyOn and replaceProperty methods, binds jest.isolateModulesAsync to this, forwards wrapperLength to the Script constructor as columnOffset for accurate debugging, guards _isMockFunction access with in, fixes a potential bug when not using prettier and improves performance in jest-snapshot, does not instrument .json modules in @jest/transform, and restarts a shut down worker before sending it a task.

chunks.title: v29.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v29.6.1, the project reverts a change in jest-circus that prevented false test failures caused by promise rejections handled asynchronously, as it was a breaking change.

chunks.title: v29.6.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v29.6.2, the project fixes snapshot matchers in concurrent tests when the number of tests exceeds maxConcurrency, avoids trying to change the message property of a thrown error object when it is unwritable during global setup and teardown, moves @types/prettier from dependencies to devDependencies in jest-snapshot, throws an explicit error if Prettier v3 is used in jest-snapshot, adds skipped and todo symbols to the Github Actions Reporter, and uses pluralize from jest-util rather than an internal implementation in @jest/core.

chunks.title: v29.6.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v29.6.3, the project adds support for symbol as key in ObjectContaining, removes @types/node from dependencies in expect, uses workers in watch mode by default to avoid crashes, updates istanbul-lib-instrument dependency to v6 in jest-reporters, reverts several breaking changes in jest-mock, marks Reporter's hooks as optional in @jest/reporters, fixes a dynamic ESM import module bug when loaded through jest.isolateModulesAsync, and uses invariant and notEmpty from jest-util rather than internal implementations in several packages.

chunks.title: v29.6.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v29.6.4, the project fixes a typo in the scheduleAndRun performance marker in jest-core, makes sure atob and btoa are writeable in Node 20 in jest-environment-node, and adds an additional error wrapper for parentPort.postMessage to fix unhandled DataCloneError in jest-worker.

chunks.title: v29.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v29.7.0, the project adds an npm init / yarn create initialiser for Jest projects via create-jest, allows deprecation warnings for unknown options in jest-validate, replaces unmatched capture groups in moduleNameMapper with empty string instead of undefined in jest-resolver, allows strings as well as template literals in inline snapshots in jest-snapshot, calculates test runtime if perStats.duration is missing in @jest/test-sequencer, caches access of NODE_ENV and BABEL_ENV in @jest/create-cache-key-function, and moves internal config initialisation logic to the create-jest package.

chunks.title: v30.0.0-alpha.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.0.0-alpha.1, the project introduces breaking changes including adding mts and cts to default moduleFileExtensions, updating testMatch and testRegex defaults for mjs, cjs, mts, and cts, grouping open handles with the same stack trace, exposing globalConfig and contexts to TestSequencer, upgrading JSDOM to v22, upgrading @sinonjs/fake-timers to v11, adding support for Error causes in snapshots, and changing pretty-format to not render empty string children in React plugin. It also adds new features such as exposing advanceTimersToFrame() in @jest/fake-timers and jest-runtime, upgrading @sinclair/typebox to v0.31, accepting a readonly table in test.each(), and supporting Prettier 3. Fixes include using denylist instead of blacklist for Babel 8 support, checking error instance type for toThrow/toThrowError, preventing false test failures from promise rejections handled asynchronously, passing test.failing tests when containing failing snapshot matchers, respecting runInBand option, fixing comparison of DataView, making leak-detector more aggressive, properly handling re-exported native modules in ESM via CJS, ensuring isInteractive works in a browser, printing ArrayBuffer and DataView correctly, and matching only relative paths of test files when specifying paths on the command line.

chunks.title: v30.0.0-alpha.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.0.0-alpha.2, the project adds a waitNextEventLoopTurnForUnhandledRejectionEvents flag to minimise performance impact of correct detection of unhandled promise rejections, adds perfStats to surface test setup overhead in @jest/core, supports testTimeout in project config, introduces breaking changes by excluding non-enumerable properties in object matching, fixes comparison of URL and checks Symbol properties in equality in @jest/expect-utils, removes several matcher aliases in expect, upgrades ci-info, removes MockFunctionMetadataType, MockFunctionMetadata and SpyInstance types in jest-mock, upgrades write-file-atomic in jest-transform, and upgrades picomatch to v3 in jest-util.

chunks.title: v30.0.0-alpha.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.0.0-alpha.3, the project adds a waitBeforeRetry option to jest.retryTimes, allows setupFilesAfterEnv to export an async function, loads config file from provided path in package.json, allows loading jest.config.cts files, groups open handles with the same stack trace, changes --filter to accept an object with shape { filtered: Array<string> }, introduces a new @jest/environment-jsdom-abstract package, updates jest-environment-node with dispose symbols, adds support for the Explicit Resource Management proposal to use the using keyword with jest.spyOn, supports import.meta.filename and import.meta.dirname, replaces recursive makeTestResults implementation with iterative one, omits expect.hasAssertions() errors if a test already has errors, validates CLI flags that require arguments, supports testTimeout and coverageReporters in project config, allows reporters in project config, prints ArrayBuffer and DataView correctly in pretty-format, spawns only one process to check for watchman installation, upgrades to glob@10, uses TypeError over Error where appropriate, and upgrades @sinclair/typebox.

chunks.title: v30.0.0-alpha.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.0.0-alpha.4, the project adds a retryImmediately option to jest.retryTimes, supports --outputFile option for --listTests, removes deprecated jest.genMockFromModule() and unnecessary defensive code in @jest/environment, adds SERIALIZABLE_PROPERTIES to allow custom serialization of objects in jest-matcher-utils, adds support for DEC mode 2026 in jest-reporters, supports import.meta.resolve in jest-runtime, makes it mandatory to pass globalConfig to the Runtime constructor, improves argument type inference passed to test and describe callback functions from each tables, improves diff for failing expect.objectContaining, prints underlying errors when VCS commands fail, aborts sl root call if output resembles a steam locomotive, allows $keypath templates with null or undefined values, catches circular references within arrays when matching objects, fixes not addressing Sets and Maps as objects without keys, adds missing dependency on jest-regex-util in jest-util, upgrades istanbul-lib-source-maps, and upgrades picomatch to v4.

chunks.title: v30.0.0-alpha.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.0.0-alpha.5, the project extracts utils used by tooling from jest-snapshot into its own package @jest/util-snapshot, introduces %$ option to add number of the test to its title in jest-each, allows Node16/NodeNext/Bundler moduleResolution in project's tsconfig, specifies testPathPatterns when programmatically calling watch as new, increases version of micromatch to ^4.0.7, and revises documentation for .toHaveBeenCalled() to accurately depict its functionality.

chunks.title: v30.0.0-alpha.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.0.0-alpha.6, the project adds an option excludeJestPreset to allow opting out of babel-preset-jest in babel-jest, adds startedAt timestamp in TestCaseResultObject within onTestCaseResult, shows rootDir in error message when a preset fails to load, supports loading TS config files using esbuild-register via docblock loader, allows passing TS config loader options via docblock comment, adds type inference for function parameters in CalledWith assertions, properly compares all types of TypedArrays, supports file:// URLs as paths in jest-resolver, adds unstable_unmockModule in jest-runtime, uses Array.isArray to check if an array is an Array in expect, corrects the return type of createCacheKey, fixes a bug where anonymous custom elements were not being printed as expected in pretty-format, properly handles circular reference errors and BigInt when worker tries to send an assertion fails, better cleans up source-map-support after test to resolve minor memory leak, drops support for Node.js versions 14, 19 and 21, updates babel-plugin-istanbul to v6, and moves unnecessary dependencies to devDependencies in babel-plugin-jest-hoist.

chunks.title: v30.0.0-alpha.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.0.0-alpha.7, the project exports buildArgv from jest-cli, does not require a TS loader if Node is running with type stripping enabled, stringifies Errors properly with --json flag in @jest/core, upgrades @sinonjs/fake-timers to v13, adds onGenerateMock transformer callback for auto generated callbacks in jest-runtime, upgrades @sinclair/typebox to v0.34, replaces exit with exit-x, does not rely on buggy Babel behaviour in babel-plugin-jest-hoist, makes concurrent tests emit jest circus events at the correct point and in the expected order, fixes type of testFailureExitCode config option, and always loads mjs files with import in jest-util.

chunks.title: v30.0.0-beta.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.0.0-beta.3, the project announces Jest 30 is shipping soon, drops support for Node.js version 16, updates jsdom to v26.0.0, mitigates memory leaks in jest-environment-node, passes resolve conditions when loading stub module, refactors _importCoreModule so required core module is consistent, fixes error cause bug, ignores Window object in deepCyclicCopyReplaceable, fixes clobbering/errors when multiple configs use different haste implementations, prints AggregateError to display, prevents EPERM windows transform issue from failing tests, fixes a bug where ObjectContaining matched with non-object values, fixes calledWith(objectContaining) when there are multiple calls, adds ArrayOf asymmetric matcher in expect, fixes jest-circus sharing events among imports, and fixes worker state.

chunks.title: v30.0.0-beta.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.0.0-beta.4, the project changes the runtime to use compileFunction over new Script.

chunks.title: Jest 30
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.0.0, the project announces the release of Jest 30, featuring renamed globalsCleanupMode to globalsCleanup and --waitNextEventLoopTurnForUnhandledRejectionEvents to --waitForUnhandledRejections, adds ArrayOf asymmetric matcher, adds excludeJestPreset option to babel-jest, reverts a change to fix expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining(...)) when there are multiple calls, adds waitNextEventLoopTurnForUnhandledRejectionEvents flag, adds waitBeforeRetry and retryImmediately options to jest.retryTimes, allows setupFilesAfterEnv to export an async function, adds startedAt timestamp in TestCaseResultObject, exports buildArgv from jest-cli, adds mts and cts to default moduleFileExtensions, updates testMatch and testRegex defaults for mjs, cjs, mts, and cts, loads config file from provided path in package.json, allows loading jest.config.cts files, shows rootDir in error message when a preset fails to load, supports loading TS config files using esbuild-register via docblock loader, allows passing TS config loader options via docblock comment, does not require a TS loader if Node is running with type stripping enabled, groups open handles with the same stack trace, adds perfStats to surface test setup overhead, changes --filter to accept an object with shape { filtered: Array<string> }, supports --outputFile option for --listTests, introduces @jest/environment-jsdom-abstract package, updates jest-environment-node with dispose symbols, adds support for the using keyword with jest.spyOn, supports import.meta.filename and import.meta.dirname, adds onGenerateMock transformer callback, supports import.meta.resolve, makes it mandatory to pass globalConfig to the Runtime constructor, adds SERIALIZABLE_PROPERTIES to allow custom serialization of objects, adds support for DEC mode 2026 in jest-reporters, upgrades @sinonjs/fake-timers to v13, upgrades @sinclair/typebox to v0.34, drops support for Node.js versions 14, 19 and 21, and includes numerous fixes and chore updates.

chunks.title: Jest 30.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.0.1, the project implements the defaultAsyncResolver in jest-resolver, resolves builtin modules correctly, avoids setting globals cleanup protection symbol when feature is off, removes and deprecates jest-repl package, and replaces custom isBuiltinModule with node's isBuiltin.

In the jestjs/jest release v30.0.2, the project makes deepCyclicCopyObject safer by setting descriptors to a null-prototype object in jest-matcher-utils and makes garbage collection protection property writable in jest-util.

In the jestjs/jest release v30.1.0, the project adds configurable GC aggressiveness regarding V8 heap snapshot generation in jest-leak-detector, reduces redundant ReferenceError messages in jest-runtime, includes test modules that failed to load when --onlyFailures is active in jest-core, fixes deprecated goo.gl snapshot guide link not getting replaced with fully canonical URL in jest-snapshot-utils, fixes it.concurrent not working with describe.skip in jest-circus, fixes mangled inline snapshot updates when used with Prettier 3 and CRLF line endings in jest-snapshot, fixes importing from @jest/globals in more than one file no longer breaking relative paths in jest-runtime, and updates docblock for toContain() to display info on substring check in expect.
In the jestjs/jest release v30.1.1, the project fixes the deprecated goo.gl snapshot warning not handling Windows end-of-line sequences in jest-snapshot-utils.
In the jestjs/jest release v30.1.2, the project corrects the snapshot header regexp to work with newline across OSes in jest-snapshot-utils.
In the jestjs/jest release v30.1.3, the project fixes unstable_mockModule with node: prefixed core modules.

In the jestjs/jest release v30.2.0, the project updates the example repo for testing React Native projects, updates jest-watch-typeahead to v3, adds support for JSDOM v27 in jest-environment-jsdom-abstract, exports the TransformerConfig interface in babel-jest, and fixes jest.config.ts with TS loader specified in docblock pragma in jest-config.

chunks.title: v30.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.3.0, the project adds defineConfig and mergeConfig helpers for type-safe Jest config in jest-config, adds setTimerTickMode to configure how timers advance in jest-fake-timers, reduces token usage when run through LLMs, keeps CLI coverage output when using --json with --outputFile in jest-config, uses Symbol from test environment in jest-mock, fixes issue where console output not displayed for GHA reporter even with silent: false option in jest-reporters, fixes issue where user cannot utilize dynamic import despite specifying --experimental-vm-modules Node option in jest-runtime, fixes issue where failed tests due to compilation errors not getting re-executed even with --onlyFailures CLI option in jest-test-sequencer, makes sure process.features.require_module is false in jest-util, replaces remaining micromatch uses with picomatch, updates to sinon/fake-timers v15, updates V30 migration guide to notify users on jest.mock() work with case-sensitive path, and updates Twitter icon to match the latest brand guidelines.

chunks.title: v30.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.4.0, the project announces a rewrite of the custom runtime in preparation for stabilisation of native ESM support, supports require(esm) module on Node 24.9+, supports fake timers for the Temporal API in Node v26, supports React 19 in pretty-format, supports collecting coverage from .mts, .cts files in babel-jest, adds --collect-tests flag to discover and list tests without executing them, adds workerGracefulExitTimeout config option, adds support for jest.config.mts as a valid configuration file, allows verbose and silent to be set per-project, accepts Temporal.Duration in jest.advanceTimersByTime() and jest.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(), accepts Temporal.Instant and Temporal.ZonedDateTime in jest.setSystemTime() and useFakeTimers({now}), supports faking Temporal.Now.*, adds clearMocksOnScope(scope) on ModuleMocker, adds canResolveSync() on Resolver, uses synchronous evaluate() for ES modules without top-level await on Node v24.9+, supports require() of ES modules on Node v24.9+, validates TC39 import attributes on ESM imports, adds canTransformSync(filename) on ScriptTransformer, adds isError helper in jest-util, supports React 19 in pretty-format, fixes toStrictEqual failing on structuredClone results, prevents toMatchObject/subset matching from throwing when encountering exotic iterables, converts Date to milliseconds before passing to @sinonjs/fake-timers, exports GlobalConfig and ProjectConfig TypeScript types, and includes other fixes and chore updates.

chunks.title: v30.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.4.1, the project allows custom runner configuration options via tuple format ['runner-path', {options}] and aligns CJS-from-ESM default export with Node by making module.exports always the ESM default and no longer applying __esModule unwrapping.

chunks.title: v30.4.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the jestjs/jest release v30.4.2, the project fixes named imports from CJS modules whose module.exports is a function with own-property exports in jest-runtime.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the evolution of juliangarnier/anime from v2.0.2 through v4.4.1, covering major rewrites, new features like text splitting and layout animations, and numerous bug fixes.

chunks.title: v2.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v2.0.2, the release notes include fixes for Timeline bugs and improvements (issues #113, #131, #121), a fix for an Internet Explorer bug related to Promise (#123), and an update to use absolute image paths in documentation (#114).

chunks.title: v2.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v2.1.0, improvements include children animations inheriting properties from parent timelines (targets, duration, delay, easing, round) (#152), support for vmin/vmax/ch units, support for the transform perspective property (#207), support for circle, rect, polyline, polygon and line shapes in anime.setDashOffset() (#145, #155), duration 0 instantly finishing animations (#228, #208), and automatic setting of animation initial values even when autoplay is false. Bug fixes address timeline callbacks at initialization (#215), timeline Promise being called instantly (#159), wrong values re-composition for complex CSS properties like filter, box-shadow, calc() (#119, #174, #175, #167, #223), numerical values not being converted to strings (#116), relative values keeping their unit (#214), seeking to 0 correctly setting initial properties (#177, #208), and the run callback being properly called after animation delay.

chunks.title: v2.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v2.2.0, improvements include a performance boost of up to 1.5x faster and support for RGBA and HSLA color animations. Bug fixes address timeline children begin() callback, incorrect timeline duration calculations, anime.path() initial values not being properly set (#245), percentage unit starting values miscalculation (#238), and begin() and complete() callbacks being called instantly when duration is 0.

chunks.title: v3.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v3.0.0, new features include spring and steps easings, an endDelay parameter, a new keyframes system, a new staggering helper, new callbacks (loopBegin, loopComplete, changeBegin, change, changeComplete), automatic CSS units conversion, responsive motion path animation, a new set() helper to apply values instantly to multiple targets, ES6 Modules and a new build process, new documentation, and a website. Bug fixes include no need to re-define transform properties when animating multiple transforms on the same target in a timeline, improved simultaneous animations on the same target (#257), allowing remove() to remove targets from timeline (#318, #286), reversed animations being delayable using endDelay (#254), better inline style unit handling (#251), SVG scale property no longer overridden by CSS transform scale (#316), fix for Uncaught TypeError when no TL parameters object specified (#341), fix for specific HTML id selectors being selected (HEX colors) (#281), and fix for wrong initial SVG transform value (#340). API changes include run() callback replaced by change(), animations pausing when tab/window is not active, getValue() replaced by get(), Cubic Bézier curves defined using a string 'cubicBezier(x1,y1,x2,y2)' instead of an array, timeline offset property replaced by timelineOffset (#229), and timeline offset settable as a second argument inside .add().

chunks.title: v3.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v3.0.1, bug fixes include a ReferenceError on document when running anime.js on the server (#472, #481, #345), a bug preventing the complete callback from being called again when re-playing the animation (#483, #373, #378, #392, #408), and a bug triggering a timeline Promise instantly (#159).

chunks.title: v3.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v3.1.0, improvements include support for values with exponent (-1.12742e-12) (#552), easing functions refactoring, and addition of Bounce easing. Bug fixes address wrong unit detection when a value contains spaces (#502), parent of responsive SVG path not properly set (#556), animation flickering on reverse (#512), loopBegin callback being called just before animation complete, updating anime.running reference when clearing array on visibility change (#560, #466), and updating ES6 module install path (#588, #527, #590).

In the juliangarnier/anime release 3.2.0, improvements include adding matrix and matrix3d parameters to allow the use of matrix values in CSS Transforms (#636) and changing steps easing behavior to match the jump-start CSS timing function (#625). Bug fixes address the animation flickering on reverse again (#623, #586, #503, #577).

chunks.title: v3.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v3.2.1, improvements include adding a remove method on instance (#635) and re-adding the easeOutIn easing function (#684). Bug fixes address a bug with the visibilitychange event and paused instances (#701, #560, #721, #711), a condition for getAttribute when the returned value is 0 (#540), and a scaling issue on path animations when animating an element inside an SVG (#568). Documentation fixes include a ranged staggering example (#704), better Elastic easings explanations (#694), and cleanup of examples.

chunks.title: v3.2.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v3.2.2, the bug fix addresses a wrong expo easing calculation (#591).

chunks.title: v4.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.0.0, a complete rewrite of Anime.js introduces a modular, ESM-first API with improved performance and many new features. New components include Timer (createTimer) for scheduling timed callbacks, Animation (animate) with new parameters like from, playbackEase, composition (replace, blend, none), modifier, frameRate, and a more flexible keyframes system with four syntaxes. Improvements include support for CSS variables and hex colors with alpha channel. New callbacks: onBeforeUpdate, onRender, onLoop, onPause. New methods: refresh(), revert(), complete(), stretch(), then(). Timeline (createTimeline) adds a dedicated defaults parameter, better children loop and direction handling, and new methods: set(), call(), sync(), label(), remove(), refresh(). New position syntax includes label references, previous animation references (<, <<), and relative positions (+=, -=, *=). New Animatable (createAnimatable) for efficient property animation. New Draggable (createDraggable) for drag capabilities.

chunks.title: v4.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.0.1, the fix addresses the createScope root param type for ReactRef (#971).

chunks.title: v4.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.0.2, fixes include Timer floating point inaccuracies with .stretch() (#1005), SVG stroke-linecap defined in a stylesheet overriding attributes defined by createDrawable() (#1002), createDrawable() line effect issues when vector-effect is set to non-scaling-stroke (#793), WAAPI Promise issue when complete() is called before animation plays (#1001), conflicts between user-defined CSS Custom Properties and WAAPI animate() properties (#1000), a caching issue preventing different parameters for the same easing function (#999), Draggable .revert() not properly reverting internal Animatable (#997), onSettle() triggering on onComplete of x property before y property update (#997), and added Draggable params to exported types (#969, #1004).

chunks.title: v4.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.1.0, breaking changes include renaming StaggerParameters to StaggerParams. New features include text.split() method for splitting text by characters, words, and lines with support for nested tags, custom wrapping, and accessibility. New Scope methods: scope.addOnce() and scope.keepTime(). New utils methods: utils.keepTime(). New stagger() settings: use and total parameters for custom staggering order, and random from parameter. Improvements and bug fixes include ensuring .refresh() only updates fromNumbers when value is function-based, improving startup performance and tree shaking. Documentation updates include various bug fixes, copy and design tweaks.

chunks.title: v4.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.1.1, bug fixes include a TextSplitter issue where the cleanup function returned by split.addEffect() was called after the split html reset when using .refresh(). Documentation fixes include tweaking morphTo description (#1049) and adding missing utils import in Stagger grid axis (#1048).

chunks.title: v4.1.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.1.2, bug fixes include Timeline onComplete callback not called on reversed timelines (#378), Scroll onScroll() not properly handling SVG targets by using getBoundingClientRect() (#1021), Animation relative values (+=, -=, *=) not properly refreshed when calling animation.refresh() (#1025), Draggable disable() now properly disabling drag without interrupting animations, Draggable internal ResizeObserver not properly disconnected on revert (#1041), Draggable onUpdate only called when position changes (#1032), and documentation clarification on composition blend limitations with .reverse() (#1012).

chunks.title: v4.1.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.1.3, improvements include increasing spring stiffness and velocity limits (#1039, #1040). Bug fixes include Scroll threshold with transforms on parent (#1059), non-browser usage for Targets and Text (#1056), Draggable onUpdate and onSettle callbacks not triggered when only updating x axis (#1045), preventing error when removing draggable container from DOM (#1064), Animatable callbacks triggered multiple times fixed by setting callbacks to a dedicated Animation, Animation tweens composition inconsistencies on tweens with composition replace not controlled by a Timeline, and Animation time calculation inconsistencies when using seconds engine.timeUnit = 's'. Types fixes include adding missing WAAPIAnimation type to Revertible, stagger() return type inferred from input value type, fixing linear easing type error (#972), and exporting missing types (#1051, #1010).

chunks.title: v4.2.0-beta.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.2.0-beta.0, new features include all utils, svg, text, and eases objects and methods exported by the main module, and all modules importable individually. Utils add createSeededRandom() and damp(). Breaking changes include removing the clock parameter from lerp() (use damp() instead), removing interpolate() (use simplified lerp()), replacing lib/ with dist/bundles/ and dist/modules/, and removing lib/anime.iife.min.js (use dist/bundles/anime.umd.min.js). Bug fixes include Draggable touch dragging with Shadow DOM support (#1067) and adding @types/node dependency for type checking (#1069). Changes include moving stagger() to /utils, simplifying build scripts, and deprecating text.split() in favor of splitText().

chunks.title: v4.1.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.1.4, the bug fix addresses a Scroll issue where onEnter could be called even if the target is outside the viewport if another onScroll instance is already running.

chunks.title: v4.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.2.0, breaking changes include removing interpolate() (use lerp()), removing the clock parameter from lerp() (use damp()), setting a CSS variable using utils.set() now computes the variable value instead of setting the var name, and removing linear(), irregular(), steps(), and cubicBezier() from core (must be imported separately). New features include all modules importable individually with subpaths, Spring adding bounce, duration, onComplete, and support for over-damped springs, WAAPI animate() built-in eases on par with JS animate() plus native WAAPI easing parameters and persist parameter, JS Animation support for CSS variable values, Utils adding createSeededRandom(), and Docs adding an easing functions editor. Bug fixes include Draggable touch dragging within Shadow DOM (#1067) and getting stuck near origin, Animation revert() not properly reverting multi-target styles and inline styles with hyphens, WAAPI cancel() not committing styles, revert() not reverting multi-target styles, scroll-controlled WAAPI animations disconnecting after completing once, staggered animations with reversed true not updating on play, and Timeline call() not being fired in some cases (#1088). Changes include moving stagger() to /utils, WAAPI convertEase() values rounded to 4 decimals, Spring mass minimum clamped to 1, stiffness and damping minimum 0, Ease Back default overshoot 1.7, adding @types/node dependency, and simplifying build scripts. Deprecations include text.split() (use splitText() or text.splitText()) and createSpring() (use spring()).

chunks.title: v4.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.2.1, new features include SVG createMotionPath() adding an offset parameter (#1037) and Draggable createDraggable() adding a dragThreshold parameter (#1091). Changes include Timer, Animation, Timeline .reset(softReset) parameter type now Boolean instead of int, and Draggable drag threshold now 3px with mouse and 7px with touch instead of 3px everywhere. Fixes include onScroll wrong target offsets calculation when container is scaled (#1098) and fixing await animate() throwing TypeScript error (#1043). Documentation updates include every demo editable on CodePen and added .reset() chapters.

chunks.title: v4.2.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.2.2, the fix addresses an SVG createMotionPath() bug introduced in v4.2.1 that wrapped the target back to 0 when reaching 1 (#1104).

chunks.title: v4.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.3.0, new features include AutoLayout with createLayout() method for animating between two layout states, Easings ease parameter now accepting function-based values, and Timeline adding composition parameter to disable animation composition when using .add() for performance. Bug fixes include JS Animation complex values containing a color (e.g., box-shadow) incorrectly handled as color values, WAAPI animations not properly removed from document.timeline, Draggable spring parameters not properly setting duration, Timeline spring easing ignored in defaults parameter, .call() and .sync() incorrectly inheriting delay from defaults, splitText first word of second line incorrectly added to first line and unnecessary empty spaces not removed from lines. Changes include Engine max fps increased to 240, and Animation/Timer/Timeline adding muteCallbacks parameter to .complete().

chunks.title: v4.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.3.1, the bug fix addresses a Layout issue where inline tags like <span> or <strong> weren't detected when surrounded by comments.

chunks.title: v4.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.3.2, the bug fix addresses a Layout issue where inline tags like <span> or <strong> weren't detected when surrounded by comments (again).

chunks.title: v4.3.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.3.3, improvements include function-based from values now refreshing correctly when calling .refresh(), unit conversion (e.g., svh to rem) recalculated on refresh, and onScroll adding onResize callback that triggers when the scroll container refreshes due to a resize event. Documentation updates include adding missing tl.backward / anim.backward / time.backward property doc and adding an opacity animation preview to the easing functions editor.

chunks.title: v4.3.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.3.4, improvements include WAAPI/Timeline synced WAAPI animations automatically having their persist property set to true (#1121). Bug fixes include onScroll comment syntax potentially causing an error (#1124).

chunks.title: v4.3.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.3.5, bug fixes include an Auto Layout regression introduced in v4.3.2 that prevented inline elements from being animated in some cases, and an Animation regression introduced in v4.3.0 that prevented CSS computed style of background from being correctly interpreted as a color value (#1136).

chunks.title: v4.3.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.3.6, the bug fix addresses Auto Layout not properly synced with onScroll, allowing controlling layout animations with autoplay: onScroll({ sync: true }).

chunks.title: v4.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the juliangarnier/anime release v4.4.0, breaking changes include transforms now following a fixed render order (perspective > translate > rotate > scale > skew) regardless of definition order, matrix and matrix3d no longer animatable directly, function-based value callbacks third argument changed from total (Number) to targets (Array) and a fourth argument prevTween added, and stagger callback signature changed to match function-based values. Bug fixes and improvements include JS Animation revert() now restoring object properties and DOM attributes, fix getOriginalAnimatableValue not storing original inline value for object props and DOM attributes, morphTo chaining in keyframe arrays and timelines producing incorrect intermediate shapes, chainable utils accessing non-existent methods throwing error instead of returning undefined, splitText addEffect() returning undefined instead of this when effect argument is not a function, and Layout scroll-controlled layout animations not properly calling onComplete and onP...
