prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release evolution of junegunn/fzf, covering versions from 0.56.0 through 0.73.1. It highlights major feature additions such as gap display, border customization, raw mode, frozen columns, word wrapping, popup support, and performance improvements.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the junegunn/fzf release 0.56.0, the project introduces the --gap[=N] option to display empty lines between items, useful for visually separating adjacent multi-line items. It also adds the noinfo option to --preview-window to hide the scroll indicator in the preview window, along with various bug fixes.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.56.1, the release includes bug fixes and improvements: a race condition causing stale results after reload is fixed, page-up and page-down actions now work correctly with multi-line items, {n} is allowed in SCROLL expression in --preview-window, and zsh-specific fixes address history loading regression and command extraction.
In the junegunn/fzf release 0.56.2, the release provides bug fixes: abnormal scrolling behavior when --wrap is set is corrected, and a zsh warning message when ksh_arrays is set is fixed.
In the junegunn/fzf release 0.56.3, the release contains bug fixes in zsh scripts: handling of backtick trigger edge case is fixed, and the 'fc -RI' call in the history widget is reverted.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.57.0, the release allows resizing the preview window by dragging the border. Built-in walker improvements include --walker-root accepting multiple directory arguments and --walker-skip handling multi-component patterns. It also removes long processing delay when displaying images in the preview window, exports FZF_PREVIEW_* environment variables to all child processes, and fixes bugs in fish scripts.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.58.0, the release introduces three new border types: --list-border, --input-border, and --header-border, along with style presets (default, full, minimal) via --style. It adds border and label options for list, input, and header sections, a new preview border style 'line', dashed lines in --gap, and actions like toggle-multi-line, toggle-hscroll, and change-nth. It also supports rendering --nth parts in different text styles and treats a single-character delimiter as a literal character.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.59.0, the release prioritizes file name matches with a new tiebreak option pathname, and --scheme=path now sets --tiebreak=pathname,length. It adds --header-lines-border to display header from --header-lines with a separate border, click-header event setting $FZF_CLICK_HEADER_WORD and $FZF_CLICK_HEADER_NTH, --no-input option to hide the input section, extended {q} placeholder to support ranges, search(...) and transform-search(...) actions, binding actions to multiple keys/events, --min-height with + to show at least that many items, and various other enhancements.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.60.0, the release adds --accept-nth for choosing output fields, with support for templates including multiple field index expressions in curly braces. It introduces exclude and exclude-multi actions for dynamically excluding items, and the preview window now prints a wrap indicator when wrapping is enabled, along with bug fixes and improvements.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.60.1, the release includes bug fixes and minor improvements: the built-in walker now prints directory entries with a trailing slash, and a bug causing unexpected behavior with fzf-tab is fixed.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.60.2, the release updates the template for --with-nth and --accept-nth to support {n} which evaluates to the zero-based ordinal index of the item. It fixes a regression that caused the last field in the nth expression to be trimmed when a regular expression delimiter is used, and corrects the 'jump' action when the pointer is an empty string.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.60.3, the release provides bug fixes and improvements: fish enables multiple history commands insertion, walker appends '/' to directory entries on MSYS2, trailing whitespaces are trimmed after processing ANSI sequences, temp files are removed before become when using --tmux, condition for using item numlines cache is fixed, --accept-nth is made compatible with --select-1, query length limit is increased from 300 to 1000, and on Windows fzf is prevented from consuming user input while paused.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.61.0, the release adds --ghost=TEXT to display a ghost text when the input is empty, along with change-ghost and transform-ghost actions. It also adds change-pointer and transform-pointer actions for dynamically changing the pointer sign, and introduces the r flag for placeholder expression (raw mode) for unquoted output, plus bug fixes and improvements.
In the junegunn/fzf release 0.61.1, the release disables bracketed-paste mode on exit, fixing an issue where pasting breaks after running fzf on old bash versions that don't support the mode.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.61.2, the release fixes a panic when using header border without pointer/marker, fixes --tmux option when already inside a tmux popup, includes bug fixes and improvements in CTRL-T binding of fish, and adds --no-tty-default option to make fzf search for the current TTY device instead of defaulting to /dev/tty.
In the junegunn/fzf release 0.61.3, the release reverts a previous change that caused tmux run-shell 'fzf --tmux' to fail, and provides more environment variables for child processes.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.62.0, the release relaxes the --color option syntax to allow whitespace-separated entries, adds alt-bg color to create striped lines for visual separation, improves fish CTRL-R binding (trigger in middle of command, delete history items with SHIFT-DEL), fixes unnecessary 100ms delay after reload, and fixes selected-bg not applied to colored items.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.63.0, the release adds a footer with options, colors, and actions, allows line border style for all border types except --list-border, adds {*} placeholder flag that evaluates to all matched items, introduces asynchronous transform actions with bg- prefix and bg-cancel action, supports full-line background color in the list section, enhances SSH completion, and includes bug fixes and improvements.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.64.0, the release adds a multi event triggered when multi-selection changes, normalizes halfwidth and fullwidth alphanumeric and punctuation characters to ASCII equivalents for matching, renames clear-selection action to clear-multi (with backward compatibility), and fixes bugs causing abort due to incorrect update ordering and loss of multi-selections when using exclude or change-nth.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.65.0, the release adds click-footer event with environment variables for clicked column, line, and word, introduces trigger(...) action to trigger events bound to another key or event, supports {*n} and {*nf} placeholders, and includes bug fixes for neovim margin background, rendering error when hiding preview window without border, mawk existence check, and --no-header-lines-border behavior.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.65.1, the release fixes incorrect $FZF_CLICK_HEADER_WORD and $FZF_CLICK_FOOTER_WORD when header or footer contains ANSI escape sequences and tab characters, fixes a bug where you cannot unset the default --nth using change-nth action, and fixes a highlighting bug when using --color fg:dim,nth:regular pattern over ANSI-colored items.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.65.2, the release includes bug fixes and improvements: incorrect truncation of --info-command with --info=inline-right, support for old uname in macOS installer, bash 3 CTRL-T and ALT-C preserving last yank, not unsetting FZF_DEFAULT_* variables when using winpty, and fixing rendering of items with tabs when using non-default ellipsis. It also announces that this is the final release to support Windows 7.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.66.0, the release introduces raw mode with --raw option, toggle-raw action, and related features: non-matching items stay in original positions but appear dimmed. It adds --gutter and --gutter-raw options, --listen support for Unix domain sockets, up-match/down-match/best actions, nomatch color, strip color attribute, FZF_RAW and FZF_DIRECTION environment variables, and changes default bindings for CTRL-N/CTRL-P to down-match/up-match. Shell CTRL-R binding toggles raw mode with ALT-R.
In the junegunn/fzf release 0.66.1, the release fixes a bug preventing 'ctrl-h' from being bound to an action, and fixes --no-color / NO_COLOR theme.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.67.0, the release adds --freeze-left=N and --freeze-right=N options to keep leftmost or rightmost N columns always visible. It updates --info=inline to print the spinner (load indicator), and includes bug fixes.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.68.0, the release implements word wrapping in the list section with --wrap=word option and toggle-wrap-word action, and word wrapping in the preview window with wrap-word flag and toggle-preview-wrap-word action. It adds support for underline style variants in --color, underline styles and colors, --preview-wrap-sign, alt-gutter color, $FZF_WRAP environment variable, fish command history improvements, fish completion support, zsh multi-line history selection, and numerous bug fixes.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.70.0, the release adds change-with-nth action for dynamically changing --with-nth option, and change-header-lines action for dynamically changing --header-lines option. It delivers performance improvements (1.3x to 1.9x faster filtering), fixes nth attribute merge order, and replaces printf with builtin printf in bash to bypass local indirections.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.71.0, the release adds --popup as a new name for --tmux with Zellij support, cross-reload item identity with --id-nth, performance improvements with linear scaling across CPU cores and reduced memory footprint, shell integration improvements (bash CTRL-R multi-select and delete, fish command history and completion rewrite), GET / endpoint includes positions field, adaptive height with negative value, and various bug fixes.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.72.0, the release introduces a new inline style for --header-border, --header-lines-border, and --footer-border that embeds the section inside the list frame with T-junctions. It adds a new dashed border style, vim popup window move/resize on VimResized event, and bug fixes for gutter display in minimal style, arrow keys under kitty keyboard protocol, and bash history deletion persistence.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.73.0, the release adds Nushell integration via --nushell and installer, a new --preview-window=next position, timer-driven every(N) event for --bind, $FZF_IDLE_TIME and $FZF_IDLE_TIME_MS variables, $FZF_CURRENT_ITEM for easier quoting, and bug fixes for scoring, change-preview-window resetting wrap state, C1 control character stripping, integer overflow panic, bg-transform payload dropping, and rendering glitch with preview on left and footer.

In the junegunn/fzf release 0.73.1, the release fixes bugs: skipping $FZF_CURRENT_ITEM export when item contains NUL byte to prevent breaking child commands, and fixing O(n^2) HTTP body accumulation in --listen that could block the server.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent keycloak/keycloak release stream from 26.2.0 through 26.6.2, covering feature introductions like Standard Token Exchange, Fine-Grained Admin Permissions V2, Passkeys, JWT Authorization Grant, and numerous bug fixes and security patches.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.2.0, the project adds support for Standard Token Exchange limited to internal-to-internal token exchange, introduces Fine-Grained Admin Permissions V2 with centralized management and explicit operation scoping, and provides new guides for metrics and Grafana dashboards.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.2.1, the release includes enhancements such as clarifying upgrade instructions and documenting operator Auto update strategy, and fixes bugs including permission search issues, StatefulSet reconciliation loops, and Liquibase checksum mismatches.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.2.2, the release makes distribution startup timeout configurable and addresses security vulnerabilities CVE-2025-3910 (two-factor authentication bypass) and CVE-2025-3501 (hostname verification).

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.2.3, the release adds a new feature to log details and representation to the jboss-logging listener, standardizes introductory text in guides, and fixes numerous bugs including SAML client certificate persistence, LDAP connection leaks, and UI issues.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.2.4, the release clarifies when to use podman in documentation and fixes bugs such as double-click on social provider links causing page expired errors, token refresh issues with inherited offline sessions, and UI performance degradation.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.2.5, the release includes enhancements like fixing documentation links, speeding up Infinispan session listing, and addressing bugs such as authorization code flow scope validation failures, UI attribute display issues, and token exchange persistence problems.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.3.0, the release delivers account recovery with 2FA recovery codes, simplified WebAuthn/Passkey registration, brokering with any OAuth 2.0 compliant authorization server, asynchronous logging, experimental rolling updates for patch releases, and performance improvements to import/export/migration.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.3.1, the release upgrades to Infinispan 15.0.16.Final, updates limitations of the preview feature rolling updates for patch releases, and fixes bugs including slow realm imports, NPE during user group loading, and TLS reloading configuration issues.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.3.2, the release adds a new feature option 'Requires short state parameter' to OIDC IDP, upgrades to Infinispan 15.0.18.Final, and fixes bugs including MariaDB connector updates, CVE-2025-49146, and various clustering test failures.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.3.3, the release ensures cache configuration has correct number of owners, upgrades to Infinispan 15.0.19.Final and Quarkus 3.20.2.1, and fixes bugs including breaking template changes, backchannel logout token signature algorithm issues, and LDAP sync performance problems.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.3.4, the release upgrades to Quarkus 3.20.2.2 and fixes bugs such as per-client session idle time capping, duplicate key violations, unbounded login_hint parameter corruption, and missing client session offline settings in the admin UI.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.3.5, the release upgrades to Quarkus 3.20.3 LTS, removes explicit MariaDB connector dependency, and fixes bugs including restricted admin access failures, old hmac-generated key recreation, and CVE-2025-58057 and CVE-2025-58056.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.4.0, the release features Passkeys integration, Federated Client Authentication, simplified multi-AZ deployments, FAPI 2 Final support, DPoP support, and new client profiles for FAPI 2 with DPoP.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.4.1, the release adds a new feature to disable Client-Initiated Renegotiation by default, hides read-only email attribute in update profile context, and fixes bugs including group permission denies, standard token exchange chain failures, and operator missing clusterrole permissions.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.4.2, the release finalizes UPDATE_EMAIL documentation, makes pending email verification attribute removable by admin, supports SPIFFE OIDC JWK endpoint, and fixes bugs including brute force detection vulnerability, UI crash on add-user, and server shutdown issues.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.4.4, the release allows hiding client scopes from scopes_supported, adds rate limiter for sending verification emails, and fixes bugs including cannot save new attribute group, DPoP proof replay check, and FGAP permission issues.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.4.5, the release fixes bugs including flaky broker tests, missing artifact dependency documentation, invalid liquibase checksum, email not persisted during registration, and import not running db migration.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.4.6, the release adds filtering of LDAP referrals by default for enhanced security, addresses CVE-2025-13467, and fixes bugs including sessions not removed when user is deleted, double-encoding of query parameters, and admin console non-JSON payload issues.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.4.7, the release upgrades to Quarkus 3.27.1, warns users about printing headers in HTTP access logs, and fixes bugs including ConcurrentModificationException during SAML initialization and wrong persistent group permissions.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.5.0, the release introduces Workflows, JWT Authorization Grant (preview), guide for using Keycloak as an authorization server for MCP servers, authenticating clients with Kubernetes service account tokens, OpenTelemetry support, CORS enhancements, and a logout confirmation page.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.5.1, the release adds x-robots HTTP header, improves performance with missing indexes on BROKER_LINK table, allows full managing of realms from master realm without global admin role, and fixes bugs including 403 Forbidden when assigning realm-management client roles and SAML decryption failures.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.5.2, the release addresses CVE-2025-67735, warns when ISPN or JGROUPS is running in debug level logging, ignores OpenAPI artifacts when disabled, and fixes bugs including deadlock in Infinispan virtual threads, duplicate address claims in IDToken, and database migration failures on MS SQL.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.5.3, the release addresses multiple CVEs including CVE-2026-1609, CVE-2026-1529, CVE-2026-1486, and CVE-2025-14778, upgrades minikube for CI tests, and fixes bugs including Node.js admin client token refresh, increased startup memory consumption, and broken YAML indentation in operator docs.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.5.4, the release addresses multiple CVEs including CVE-2026-1190, CVE-2026-0707, CVE-2025-5416, CVE-2026-2575, and CVE-2026-2733, adds new key affinity for session ids, and fixes bugs including client deletion timeout, SAML authentication failures, and information disclosure of client secret.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.5.5, the release addresses multiple CVEs including CVE-2026-3047, CVE-2026-3009, CVE-2026-2603, and CVE-2026-2092 related to SAML broker authentication bypass and disabled identity provider enforcement.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.5.6, the release addresses multiple CVEs including CVE-2026-1180, CVE-2026-1035, CVE-2025-14777, CVE-2025-14082, CVE-2026-3121, CVE-2026-3190, CVE-2026-3911, and CVE-2026-2366, and fixes bugs including federated user disabled, AUTH_SESSION_ID cookie reuse, and LDAP sync duration issues.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.5.7, the release addresses multiple CVEs including CVE-2025-14083, CVE-2026-1002, CVE-2026-3429, CVE-2026-4634, CVE-2026-4636, CVE-2026-3872, and CVE-2026-4282, upgrades to Quarkus 3.27.3, and fixes a bug where calls without Host header throw uncaught error.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.6.0, the release promotes JWT Authorization Grant, Federated Client Authentication, Workflows, Zero-downtime patch releases, and the Keycloak Test Framework to fully supported, introduces Identity Brokering APIs V2 (preview), and adds a new guide about DPoP.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.6.1, the release addresses CVE-2026-4366 and CVE-2026-4633, updates CloudNativePG to 1.29, adds database data at rest encryption, and fixes bugs including false session type of access token, operator log flooding, and infinite redirect loop with IdP errors.

In the keycloak/keycloak release 26.6.2, the release addresses multiple CVEs including CVE-2026-33871, CVE-2026-33870, CVE-2026-4628, CVE-2026-37980, CVE-2026-5588, CVE-2026-6856, and others, adds monitoring backups for CNPG, and fixes bugs including JDBC_PING schema changes and various security vulnerabilities.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent ktorio/ktor release stream from 2.3.8 through 3.5.0, covering bugfixes, improvements, and new features across multiple minor and major versions.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ktorio/ktor release 2.3.8, the project addresses multiple bugfixes including a KeyStoreException on Android when configuring secure connections, a URLBuilder crash on React Native, WebSocket upgrade issues when Content-Type is present, ContentNegotiation charset problems, high native server memory usage, logging blocking response body streaming, confusing WebSocket error messages, tailcard URL matching, HttpCache NumberFormatException, CORS allowHost issues, a ReferenceError in custom JS engines, MDC diagnostic value changes, WebSocket termination with runBlocking, CIO SAN errors on Android, and missing toString on RequestConnectionPoint.

In the ktorio/ktor release 2.3.9, the project introduces an improvement to allow setting secure cookies even with the http scheme, and fixes a bug where the ContentNegotiation plugin appended a duplicated MIME type to the Accept header.

In the ktorio/ktor release 2.3.10, the project fixes bugs including double response logging with CallLogging and StatusPages, NodeJS WebSocket frame drops, IPv6 address support in Netty and CIO connection points, a JS browser call stack error on es2015, CIO file upload failures for files larger than INT_MAX bytes, CallLogging overriding MDC, duplicated SSE Content-Type headers, and CIO SAN errors with IP verification. Improvements address inconsistent query parameter behavior between Netty and rest engines, and missing Android logs with Logger.ANDROID.
In the ktorio/ktor release 2.3.11, the project fixes a bug where the test client ignored socket timeout.

In the ktorio/ktor release 2.3.12, the project fixes bugs including a NoSuchMethodError with coroutines 1.9.0-RC, missing charset on Content-Type for static resources, and inability to use ktor-network on embedded Linux devices without iso-8859-1 and UTF-16. Improvements update Netty to 4.1.111.Final, address CVE-2024-29025, and update the Swagger dependency.

chunks.title: 3.0.0-beta-2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ktorio/ktor release 3.0.0-beta-2, the project fixes bugs such as TextKt.chomp not working on multi-character strings, DefaultRequest overwriting http protocol, native target compilation issues, SSE exceptions instead of JobCancellationException, SSE dropping request body, UnsupportedContentTypeException with OKHttp, NoTransformationFoundException with Logging, SSE breaking GET/POST, cookie Max-Age expiration, untracked dependency versions, CSRF false positive origin validation, and double Transfer-Encoding on Tomcat. Improvements correct misspelled class names, ambiguous coroutineContext warnings, allow runtime log level changes for tracing, make TLSException internal, make refreshToken nullable, fix test library references, improve CSRF error messages and validation, allow Secure flag on localhost, improve SSE response header access and testing, propagate OAuth redirection errors, and address flaky HttpTimeout tests. Features include migration to kotlinx.io, changing the default session serializer to kotlinx-serialization, and replacing custom withTimeout implementations.

chunks.title: 3.0.0-rc-1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ktorio/ktor release 3.0.0-rc-1, the project fixes bugs including bytecode incompatibility in AttributeKey, request hangs with ContentEncoding, reverting Routing API changes, IOException during concurrent requests, ByteReadChannel.copyTo throwing IllegalArgumentException, dependency redirections from ktor-server-test-base, CIO EmbeddedServer.stop blocking, SSE not following spec for multiline data, and infinite CancellableContinuationImpl creation on ByteChannel.flush. Improvements include relocation notes for old Ktor modules, deprecation of old jetty/tomcat/servlet engines, backwards compatibility for monitor, and clarifying ApplicationProperties naming. A new feature adds support for watching and reloading zip files in staticZip.

chunks.title: 3.0.0-rc-2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ktorio/ktor release 3.0.0-rc-2, the project fixes bugs including custom SessionSerializer no longer supported, multipart request timeouts, MultiPartData.readPart not returning null, form limits applied to binary/file items, autoreload not working on Windows, HttpCache collision with Authorization header, Gradle sync issues with kotlin-serialization 1.7.2, ApplicationStopping event not raised on SIGINT, respondOutputStream reading entire contents into memory, UninitializedPropertyAccessException for request property, preconfigured NSURLSession causing hangs, test server failures after upgrade, InputStream.toByteReadChannel creating unattached job, and Maven builds not working. Improvements include deprecating withTestApplication APIs, replacing java.time options in WebSockets, not publishing empty io.ktor:ktor artifact, reading system properties, redirecting dependencies, relocation notes, restoring ByteReadChannel.readFully, ByteChannel.readUtf8Line backwards compatibility, and kotlinx-io response extension. Features add multiplatform XML support and watchosDeviceArm64 target.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.0.0, the project fixes bugs including Darwin maxFrameSize having no effect, KotlinReflectionInternalError on Android release APK, Netty UnsupportedOperationException with CORS, MicrometerMetrics Prometheus warning, WebSocket/Auth ProtocolException, data truncation in receiveParameters and receiveMultipart, pathSegments returning empty strings for trailing slashes, HttpRequestRetry exponential delay not working for short delays, JS browser error on es2015, incomplete writes with FileChannelsKt, response.content.copyAndClose losing bytes, ByteWriteChannel.flush not waiting, CORS check failing on Origin without trailing slash, socket and selector descriptor leaks on native, ConnectionUtilsNative descriptor leaks, withTimeout not canceling socket connection on native, and MockEngine dispatcher setting removed. Improvements address misleading readBytes name, removing reflection utils from common, weak MD5 in FileCacheStorage, missing AcceptEncoding constants, adding respondFile overload with Path, MalformedInputException not being an Exception, CSRF allowOrigin enabling Origin validation, dropping marker interface requirements in Auth, supporting request body access in RouteSelector, making Cookie Serializable, making Route.swaggerUI public, and using Dispatchers.IO.limitedParallelism. Features include support for androidNative targets.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.0.1, the project fixes bugs including removing a space from the default client user agent, Url.segments throwing on root path URLs, Digest Auth not implementing nc parameter correctly per RFC 7616, about:blank URL parsing, ByteReadChannel read methods leading to CPU-bound loops, CIO connection timeouts on Android main dispatcher, and receiveMultipart failing with capitalized content-type. Improvements address unnecessary toString calls in WebSockets logging, an INFO log message with all server interceptors on startup, Digest auth parameter quoting, ContentType.fromFilePath for newer file formats, and missing native targets in ktor-serialization-kotlinx-xml.

In the ktorio/ktor release 2.3.13, the project fixes bugs including CIO connection timeouts on Android main dispatcher, TextKt.chomp not working on multi-character strings, an IllegalArgumentException in SelectorManagerSupport, and backports a fix for CVE-2024-49580. Improvements replace the custom withTimeout implementation with coroutines.withTimeout and add watchosDeviceArm64 target.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.0.2, the project fixes bugs including ServletResponseBody corruption due to wrong offset, file not committed after closing writeChannel, CIO response body truncation, HttpCache IndexOutOfBoundsException on malformed Cache-Control, call.respondSource returning empty response, ByteReadChannel read methods leading to infinite loops, Routing ContentType.match not matching wildcards, connections not released properly, deprecated FileItem.streamProvider without implementation, MergedApplicationConfig.toMap replacing nested configs, Digest Auth using wrong nc value, JS ReferenceError when compiling to ES Module, chunked transfer encoding failure not caught with retry, HttpCookies IllegalArgumentException on raw cookies, and DefaultRequest Content-Type not overridable. Improvements add support for binary Smile encoding in JacksonConverter and optimize ServiceLoader.load on Android.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.0.3, the project fixes bugs including "Module not found" errors in browserProductionWebpack, Darwin and JS/WASM Content-Length mismatch on gzipped content, FormFieldLimit overwritten by default arg, performance issues with ByteReadChannel.readUTF8LineTo, HttpCache preventing Content-Encoding decoding, TestApplication.stop() not stopping the application, and file not committed after closing writeChannel.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.1.0, the project introduces features including reconnection in ClientSSESession, heartbeat for SSE, serialization for SSE, WebSockets support in Curl engine, conversion between byte channel interfaces and kotlinx-io primitives, CIO server support on WasmJS and JS, OkHttp-style log formatting, static linking for curl on all platforms, ARM target support in Ktor client with Kotlin/Native and Curl, Unix Domain Socket support for native targets, receiving multipart data with Ktor client, client CIO engine support for wasm-js and js, and NodeJs target support for ktor-network. Improvements address BasicAuthProvider caching credentials, unhelpful CallLogging output, adding operator contains to ContentType, ambiguous DarwinHttpRequestException for SSL pinning, introducing ServerSocket.port, missing Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header, failing to parse file URLs, making re-auth/refresh status codes configurable, adding media type for Yaml, logging HTTP method with class name, uncaught channel write errors from ws-pinger, upgrading Apache5 HttpClient to 5.4, adding deepLinking configuration to Swagger, accessing HttpClient plugin configuration options, not publishing internal test artifacts, adding UptimeMetrics to Micrometer, not writing unknown HTTP method names to metrics, updating to Kotlin 2.1.0, missing writeFloat/readFloat on ByteWriteChannel, confusing engine exclusion from clientTests, and UrlBuilder improvements.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.1.1, the project improves logging to print messages per line with OkHttp logger format and notes that WebSocket and SSE don't respect connection timeout set in HttpTimeout. Bugfixes address formData Source copying, race condition NPE in CIOReaderKt, TLS client IOException on closed socket, client waiting indefinitely on exception in onCallRespond, HttpCache not updating on Vary header mismatch, OOM on SourceByteReadChannel for large input, ArrayIndexOutOfBounds in kotlinx-io, NPE in readBuffer, JS/WASM Content-Length mismatch on gzipped content, Resources / route not resolved with sibling staticResources, and server accepting \r without \n in chunked transfer encoding.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.1.2, the project updates Kotlin to 2.1.20 and removes empty artifacts from publication. Bugfixes include URL-safe base64 decoding problem, AuthTokenHolder.clearToken not clearing during token update, Android "Array has more than one element" error on server start, WebSockets extensions header comma separation, and OkHttp SSESession.incoming flow not canceling connection.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.1.3, the project implements toString for staticContentRoute, avoids sending Authorization header for refresh token requests, improves ByteChannel single-byte operation speed, speeds up receiving multipart without Content-Length, addresses MicrometerMetrics OOM abuse via different path 404s, adds Vary header when serving compressed static content, and fixes a reference to nonexistent INFINITE_TIMEOUT_MS in HttpTimeout exception message. Bugfixes include WebSockets frame sending with ktor-serialization-kotlinx-json-jvm in Maven, OkHttp SSE request job cancellation not canceling connection, OkHttp exceptions not propagated to flow collectors, OOM in CountedByteReadChannel during multipart copy, Apache5 ProtocolException on OPTIONS without Content-Type, Netty WebSockets server processes hanging in CLOSE_WAIT, and updating JTE to support Kotlin 2.1.0.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.2.0, the project introduces features including a dependency injection Ktor extension, Version Catalog support, Unix domain socket support at the engine level, suspend Ktor modules, browser cookie storage, configuration file deserialization, HttpCache eviction/clearing, and file configuration for dependencies. Improvements address excessive ApplicationConfig allocation, Linux curl engine not working for simultaneous WebSocket and HTTP requests, ktor-network ProGuard warning, more overloads for StringValuesBuilder.appendAll, deprecating HttpClientCall.wrapWithContent and wrap, adding a way to create ApplicationCall for testing, configuration access API improvements, Application instance access in testApplication, making TestApplication client configurable, supporting resolved IP address on InetSocketAddress, deprecating SaveBodyPlugin, obscure log message on server startup, Routing accept returning 406, MicrometerMetrics route label length limit, making route label configurable, and adding more common ContentType values. Bugfixes include Logging/Darwin IOException on binary body detection, Netty NoSuchElementException on 204 responses, YAML configuration NoSuchElementException, ApplicationConfig content missing after merge, Android ProtocolException on TRACE, Content-Length: 0 added for GET requests, HttpRequestRetry not retrying some IOExceptions, and HttpCookies encoding issues.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.2.1, the project replaces kotlinx.datetime APIs with kotlin.time, handles null values in Thymeleaf template model, publishes Javadoc as a Maven artifact, and improves Netty handling of malformed query strings. Bugfixes include "Space characters in SimpleName" error with R8, ForwardedHeaders not handling parameters case-insensitively, potential race condition in socket.awaitClosed, Module parameter type Application.() -> Unit not supported, OkHttp ProtocolException with MultiPartFormDataContent and onUpload, OAuth2 breaking form-urlencoded POST requests, 404 for KDoc link, Ktor failing to boot with default jvminline argument, Flow invariant violation, and ResponseSent hook not executed on exception from route.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.2.2, the project changes the order of SSE field serialization to put event before data. Bugfixes include CORS replying with 405 on preflight when installed in a route, Darwin Content-Encoding header removed since 3.0.3, JS/WASM response missing Content-Length header, StatusPages response headers not available in status handlers, testApplication client.sse() acting like REST call, config deserialization default properties problem, kotlinx.datetime not available transitively, and request builder block overriding HTTP method in specific request builders.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.2.3, the project improves server configuration file suffix to only accept yaml, handles JS/WASM error when process global is undefined, and addresses DI async duplicate resolution. Bugfixes include CIO missing final \r\n in 100-continue response, intermittent ParserException on multipart request, infinite loop in ByteReadChannel.readFully, and ShutDownUrl server cannot shut down since 3.2.0.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.3.0, the project introduces features including server-side HTTP/2 without TLS (h2c), OpenAPI generation build extension preview, serving static resources with caching headers and ETag based on sha256, upgrading Jetty dependencies to version 12, custom respond logic for static content when file not found, upgrading OkHttp to version 5.0.0, and WebRTC Client for Android and WASM. Improvements address SSE inability to read response body from SSEClientException, SSE Content-Length mismatch on saving response body, deprecating Route.staticRootFolder, adding image/bmp ContentType, adding missing image content types, upgrading to Kotlin 2.2, bumping Kotlin API level to 2.2, and CIO ignoring system proxy settings. Bugfixes include performance regression with ContentEncoding and HttpRequestRetry since 3.2.0, coroutine deadlock with many simultaneous outbound WebSocket connections, DI JobCancellationException during cleanup, autoreloading JobCancellationException in debugger, HttpRedirect redirecting without Location header, SerializationException with propertyOrNull and Map type, "Failed resolution of: Ljava/lang/management/ManagementFactory" on Android, HttpCache ignoring all but first Vary header values, HttpCache selecting wrong cache entry with different case Vary headers, and CountedByteWriteChannel autoFlush not making channel auto flushing.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.3.1, the project adds a note about SSE session lifetime in KDoc and updates Kotlin to 2.2.20. Bugfixes include NumberFormatException when Content-Length contains null bytes, SerializationException for ClientSSESession when server responds with JSON, Netty loadConfiguration missing enableHttp2 and enableH2c properties, Netty EmbeddedServer.stop blocking for twice shutdownGracePeriod, shutdownGracePeriod used instead of shutdownTimeout in EmbeddedServer.stop(), and support for serving static resources within bootJar.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.3.2, the project removes redundant targets from WebRTC Client, adds Socks proxy support to Darwin engine, and improves Java error message when SOCKS proxy is used. Bugfixes include HttpRequestRetry SendCountExceedException, Darwin maxFrameSize having no effect, OpenAPI StackOverflowError with @Contextual serializer, OpenAPI gen missing KDoc fields, server call.request.path() returning routing selectors, StaticContent not allowing siblings, HttpCache FileStorage not using given dispatcher, Curl SOCKS proxy not working, Netty VerifyError on Android since 3.3.0, response body channel canceled while saving with HttpRequestRetry and onDownload, and HttpCache InvalidCacheStateException when varyKeys contain uppercase letters since 3.3.0.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.3.3, the project improves URL host parsing discrepancies between CIO/Darwin and other engines, makes SimpleLogger an object, supports HTTP/2 over cleartext (h2c) in Jetty Client, adds missing operationId for KDoc fields in OpenAPI gen, and improves logging for CORS plugin. Bugfixes include Netty RejectedExecutionException during shutdown on MacOS in dev mode, Darwin new SSE handlers stop responding after canceling sessions, double ResponseSent invocation when exception thrown after respond, OpenAPI StackOverflowError with @Contextual serializer, Java ContentEncoding IllegalHeaderNameException for :status pseudo header with HTTP/2, NettyHttp2Handler IllegalArgumentException, Curl client sending both Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length for DELETE requests with body, and exception handling issue in client cache.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.4.0, the project introduces features including OpenAPI specification support for Ktor Client and Server, reading OpenAPI security details from authentication plugin, using runtime-generated spec for OpenAPI/Swagger, reading OpenAPI default content type from ContentNegotiation, a routing documentation compiler plugin, routing documentation runtime API, generating JSON schema for type references with Jackson and Gson, Zstd support, Jackson 3 support, BearerAuthProvider detecting disguised Bearer scheme, respondResource support, Auth API key plugin, HTTP QUERY method support, partial HTML response, EngineMain reading trust store settings from configuration, duplex streaming for OkHttpClient, providing control over tokens to user code in Auth, iOS native interop for WebRTC client, file configuration for DI, and SIGINT support on web and SIGTERM on Native. Improvements rename target jsAndWasmShared to web, upgrade to Kotlin 2.3, update libcurl to 8.18.0, deprecate DarwinLegacy engine, test iOS target of WebRTC Client, make HttpHeaders strings const, expose plusIsSpace in parseUrlEncodedParameters, fix Ktor Oauth2 sending 401 on invalid client secret, use HTTP/2 by default in Java, add missing HTMX DSL attributes, redesign ByteReadChannel.readUTF8Line API, make readUTF8LineTo return number of read symbols, simplify Apache5 ConnectionManager configuration, make formData block inline, and add missing ByteReadChannel.readTo function.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.4.1, the project improves HttpProtocolVersion.parse with fast path for common versions, reduces allocations in GMTDate, supports operationId in KDoc for OpenAPI spec gen, addresses infinite spin and potential OOM in WebSockets Inflater.inflateFully, removes default Accept-Charset header, handles atypical route functions in OpenAPI, adds defaults for OpenAPI describe, preserves order of path parameters in OpenAPI spec, and adds toString to TailcardSelector. Bugfixes include OpenApi code inference missing lambda argument bodies, OpenAPI static content path appearing in model, no respective formats detected for serializable types like UUID or Instant, "No mapping for symbol: VAR FOR_LOOP_VARIABLE" error with codeInferenceEnabled, UnsupportedOperationException for reified type parameter with codeInferenceEnabled, resource routes missing inferred and comment-based documentation, cannot override kotlinx.serialization module, jsonSchema<T>() not unwrapping Kotlin value classes, Authentication JWT verifier failure for JWK with kty=EC and alg=null, Flow invariant error after update to Ktor 3.4.0, testApplication race condition in timeout coroutine when response is streaming, Curl undefined symbol errors on Linux since 3.4.0, NodeJS CIO "Module 'os' could not be imported" error with es2015 target, String.decodeBase64String failing when input has no padding since 3.4.0, CIO engine rejecting valid certificates with unsupported signature algorithms, Curl segfaults with WebSockets, coroutines in route handlers dispatched with Dispatchers.Unconfined since 3.2.0, and StreamResetException not propagated to caller of StreamRequestBody.writeTo since 3.4.0.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.4.2, the project improves Curl WebSockets maxFrameSize option, reduces allocations in CaseInsensitiveString, performs Netty allocation micro-optimizations, removes unnecessary ByteArray copy in Darwin for each response chunk, and corrects KDoc for formFieldLimit default value. Bugfixes include OpenAPI incorrect schema for nested classes with lists, WebSockets JsWebSocketSession._closeReason completed twice, GraalVM compatibility fix, Logging OkHttp format should log full requested URL, Logging IllegalStateException when response is cached and deserialization fails, OpenAPI NoSuchMethodError with Kotlin 2.3.20-*, Netty active SSE connection blocking HTTP/2 response flushing for other requests, JS browser digest auth error, Compression encoders buffering streaming response, certificate pinning matching against all pins instead of hostname-scoped pins, DI AmbiguousDependencyException when named dependency overridden in testApplication, Bearer Auth request body not sent again after refreshToken request, Darwin memory leak in KtorNSURLSessionDelegate, LinkageError when running Ktor app with development mode inside Spring Boot/Amper fat-JAR, NoSuchMethodError on RawWebSocket after 3.4.0, Frame.Text.readText() causing infinite loop and 100% CPU on Kotlin/Native with malformed WebSocket frame data, and ZstdEncoder decode failure when source data is split into multiple Zstd frames.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.4.3, the project fixes bugs including OpenAPI schema inference not working for custom nested generics, self-referential schema $ref using FQN while registered with simple name, schema inference StackOverflow, WebSockets handler not inheriting server coroutine context, shared engine closed when client created with config method is closed, Apache5 FutureCallback never called, Darwin SIGABRT crash when close() races with in-flight execute() since 3.4.2, SuspendFunctionGun ThreadContextElement leaking across requests, CannotTransformContentToTypeException leaking internal class names, incorrect link to OWASP cheatsheet in CSRF KDoc, unable to update/remove session data if no response content, and HttpRequestLifecycle plugin with cancelCallOnClose canceling subsequent requests when CallLogging with callIdMdc is installed.

In the ktorio/ktor release 3.5.0, the project introduces features including Route.contentType supporting multiple ContentType, adding known TDM headers to HttpHeaders, supporting getAs from root ApplicationConfig, DNS configuration for Apache5 and OkHttp client engines, custom SSE heartbeat function, dependency injection reading annotations in function references, creating user sessions shared across devices or looking up sessions of the same user, upgrading to Kotlin 2.3.21, making DynamicProviderConfig.authenticateFunction suspend, providing parameter validation convenience functions, OpenAPI supporting prefixItems in JsonSchema for tuple types, an option to not resend session cookie if data unchanged, deprecating HttpHeaders.AcceptCharset, making ktor-network compatible with ES modules for nodejs, making ES2015 the default target for JS tests, and updating Digest authentication implementation per RFC 7616. prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent kubeshark/kubeshark release stream from v52.3.88 through v53.3.0, covering new protocol support, eBPF enhancements, scripting improvements, and major architectural shifts toward V2.00.

chunks.title: v52.3.88
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.3.88, the project adds the ability to override image names in values.yaml for private repositories, extends script execution to the Hub, fixes script-related bugs, switches from text-based JSON to Golang binary objects (GOB) for worker-hub communication, resolves a frontend blinking issue, fixes an empty screen in the service map when traffic is not streaming, corrects TCP packet size display, and introduces a completely redesigned UI for scripting.

chunks.title: v52.3.89
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.3.89, the project addresses user-reported bugs by allowing CPU and memory limits as integers or strings, enabling kubeshark scripts to detect restarts and auto-sync to config-map, removing deprecated PF-RING remnants, enhancing network error detection and reporting, improving non-ASCII character display, adding DNS over TCP support, adding Prometheus custom metric vector reporting, fixing a browser issue with gRPC/HTTP2 entries, and fixing a blinking entry name for long paths.

chunks.title: v52.3.90
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.3.90, the project introduces BoringSSL support to inspect Envoy-encrypted traffic in plaintext for Istio mTLS STRICT mode, adds eBPF traffic capture with cgroup v1 support for older operating systems, fixes multiple bugs including issue #1643, and adds the ability to deactivate scripts from the scripting console.

chunks.title: v52.3.91
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.3.91, the project focuses on bug fixes and resilience by adding the ability to view Kubeshark logs in the dashboard, fixing disappearing arrows in the service map, enhancing DNS entry presentation with record type, displaying source/destination process names and IDs when using eBPF, adding CSV export of dashboard data, introducing OpenSSL WGET support, and improving scripting logging.

chunks.title: v52.3.92
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.3.92, the project adds LDAPv3 protocol support, refreshes the dashboard color scheme, enhances scripting capabilities, introduces remediation by blocking pod ingress/egress on suspicious behavior, fixes a script list disruption bug, renames the tls dissector to tlsx, improves source/destination resolution for pre-existing pods with eBPF, and adds a helper function to block pod egress and ingress.

chunks.title: v52.3.93
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.3.93, the release failed and no new features or bug fixes are described.

chunks.title: v52.3.94
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.3.94, the project introduces TCPdump-style PCAP recording of all L4 traffic including decrypted TLS/mTLS, enhances Linux OS context with detailed process info, improves eBPF capture with explicit cgroup V1/V2 selection, adds Prometheus reporting to the Hub, changes the default Sniffer port to 48999, improves Sniffer-Tracer communication, enables custom KFL macros, supports air-gapped environments, adds product support links, introduces granular log levels with a logLevel config value, enhances Istio/Envoy traffic identification, and adds an easy way to redact sensitive information from the dashboard.

chunks.title: v52.3.95
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.3.95, the project fixes a critical bug causing Worker failures in busy clusters due to short readiness probe timeout, introduces templated readiness probe values for Hub and Worker, adds RADIUS protocol support for 5G core infrastructure, fixes a UDP source/destination port mismatch, and enhances console.log to print JavaScript JSON objects without JSON.stringify.

chunks.title: v52.3.96
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.3.96, the project introduces Diameter protocol support, fixes multiple pcapdump bugs, resolves an LDAP-related sniffer crash, fixes a broken tap.tls=false option, corrects reversed DNS source/destination order, fixes incorrect aggregate bandwidth for TCP in the service map, extends nodeSelector to hub and front deployments, and adds support for specific DNS configurations in Helm templates.

chunks.title: v52.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.4.0, the project implements automatic patch updates where the major.minor tag always includes the latest patch, automatic per-node packet capture technology selection (eBPF on Cgroup V2 → V1 → AF_PACKET → libpcap), default protocol port mapping for faster detection, fixes pcapdump bugs, fixes missing pull secret alignment, refactors worker security context for AppArmor/SELinux, adds dashboard log viewing via a script, adds resource monitoring via a script, improves Hub memory/CPU, fixes a DNS panic, fixes incorrect Kafka aggregation numbers in the service map, and includes several patches for WebSocket panic, worker CPU optimization, KFL selectors in legend, sensitive data redaction in bodies, map node/edge show/hide, air-gapped script editor, and more.

chunks.title: v52.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.5.0, the project adds support for taints and tolerations for all images (front, hub, worker), and lists patches including dashboard performance improvements for large clusters, spot instance support, a fix for workers randomly stopping traffic processing, service map state caching, SCTP reassembler improvements, LDAP dissection fix, critical bug fixes, and real-time streaming API flows without full payload capture.

chunks.title: v52.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.6.0, the project optimizes service map performance for large clusters, improves SCTP reassembler, fixes LDAP dissection, adds OIDC with DEX integration for SSO, introduces a worker watchdog mechanism, adds support for hosting behind a reverse proxy with a custom path, and lists patches including critical bug fixes, real-time streaming API flows, PCAP snapshot download from dashboard, and automation template auto-start.

chunks.title: v52.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.7.0, the project adds AF_PACKET traffic capture with BPF expression override, a Helm value for default streaming mode, a Helm value to bypass Dex SSL CA check, azure-csi-premium RWX PVC support, disables online chat by default, adds GitOps-friendly mode to preserve dynamic configmap/secret values during Helm upgrades, enables CLI to use a proprietary config file, fixes a protocol matcher bug from packet loss, fixes a Kafka dissector panic, fixes a watchdog crash when no traffic, and fixes kubeshark scripts not exiting on ^C.

chunks.title: v72.3.83
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v72.3.83, the release notes are coming soon and no specific features or fixes are described.

chunks.title: v52.7.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.7.7, the project fixes a bug where eBPF capture did not work with persistent volume storage, fixes a bug where traffic processing stopped on Worker restart, adds an option to read secrets from environment variables for external secret managers, updates Chart.yaml for full semantic version compliance, and improves throughput/bandwidth/latency calculations in the service map.

chunks.title: v52.7.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.7.8, the project resolves a Make issue causing CLI to use explicit tag instead of latest, reintroduces online support via Intercom, fixes a WebSocket protocol panic, adds the ability to download Agent logic scripts for local development and version control, and lists patches for a significant Worker memory leak and a rare Hub pod targeting bug.

chunks.title: v52.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.8.0, the project primarily addresses bug fixes and security vulnerabilities, resolves a Helm chart issue, implements a minor bug fix, patches multiple vulnerabilities, and introduces PriorityClass to the Helm chart.

chunks.title: v52.8.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.8.1, the project fixes Cgroup V2 support when additional privileges are required, implements a traffic processing timeout for inactivity that transitions Kubeshark into a Dormant state to minimize resource consumption, and lists a patch for improved service map rendering performance.

chunks.title: v52.9.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.9.0, the project adds a Helm property to control the duration before automatically entering Dormant mode to conserve resources when idle, creates the hostroot volume only when the tracer is deployed, introduces support for defining a custom ingress path via Helm, and lists a patch for a bug fix.

chunks.title: v52.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.10.0, the project changes the docs URL from docs.kubeshark.co to docs.kubehq.com, fixes issue #1766, and lists a patch that updates the front URL from kubehq.com to www.kubehq.com.

chunks.title: v52.10.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.10.3, the project adds a complimentary, almost unlimited license valid through the end of 2025, pre-included in the installation as a Helm value, and instructs users to remove any previous Helm repository before installing.

chunks.title: v52.11.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.11.0, the project prepares for V2.00 with a completely refactored backend that is more performant, adds an easy way to export cluster-wide L4 traffic (PCAP), adds L7-to-L4 mapping with an online PCAP viewer and aggregated PCAP download, fixes a backend filter rule for namespace exclusion, and includes a complementary license for clusters up to 100 nodes.

chunks.title: v52.11.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.11.7, the project extends the complementary license enabling Kubeshark to run in clusters of up to 100 nodes for free.

chunks.title: v52.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v52.12.0, the project improves performance of the cluster-wide L4 connectivity map, fixes a missing footer bug in the frontend, adds individual PCAP files to snapshot archive downloads, transitions domains from kubehq.com to kubeshark.com, and lists a patch for optimized raw-capture performance.

chunks.title: v53.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v53.1.0, the project introduces comprehensive L4 network flow visibility with real-time connectivity tracking and handshake latency percentiles, a built-in MCP server for AI-powered network analysis, enhanced snapshot workflows with cloud storage support and delayed dissection, patches several critical CVEs, hardens build security, and improves memory stability.

chunks.title: v53.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v53.2.0, the project introduces open-source AI skills for network root cause analysis and traffic filtering, expands snapshot capabilities with GCS cloud storage, local .tar upload, snapshot renaming, PCAP export filters, and disk usage visibility, includes TLS-decrypted traffic in snapshots, rearchitects gRPC streaming for reliability, and adds eBPF tracer support for stripped Go binaries via offset table lookups.

chunks.title: v53.2.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v53.2.2, the project introduces MongoDB protocol dissection, moves Kubernetes metadata enrichment from hub to worker nodes to reduce hub load, adds Envoy BoringSSL TLS decryption via offset-based hooking in the eBPF tracer, introduces a ring buffer-based packet poller for improved capture performance, and adds dashboard-level namespace, worker, and dissector filters.

chunks.title: v53.2.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v53.2.3, the project expands eBPF Go TLS decryption for proxies like Traefik, threads elapsed_time through every dissected API entry, surfaces a dedicated tls KFL keyword, and ships reliability fixes for worker reconnection, reused-IP resolution, and snapshot time boundaries.

chunks.title: v53.2.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v53.2.5, the project adds native MySQL and PostgreSQL protocol dissection, fixes server-side TLS decryption for pre-fork servers like PostgreSQL, introduces a configurable dashboard entries limit, adds stream-history playback, achieves a 4× heap memory reduction in the dashboard, and includes several reliability fixes across the stack.

chunks.title: v53.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the kubeshark/kubeshark release v53.3.0, the project promotes the TLSX dissector to on-by-default with full TLS handshake visibility, ships a complete authorization refactoring across CLI, Helm chart, hub, and front, adds L7 data boundaries with a LIVE filter button, supports snapshot namespace and pod-regex filters, introduces a new internal bearer-token auth layer for in-cluster gRPC, and adds three new AI skills: security audit, install guidance, and PostgreSQL KFL support.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent labstack/echo release stream from v4.7.1 through v5.1.1, covering security fixes, middleware deprecations, major breaking changes in v5, and new features like generic parameter binding and CSRF enhancements.

chunks.title: v4.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.7.1, fixes are made to e.Static, .File(), and c.Attachment() to handle paths starting with './', '../', and '/' correctly after the introduction of echo.Filesystem support in v4.7.0. Some unused code is also removed.

chunks.title: v4.7.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.7.2, a nil pointer exception when calling Start again after an address binding error is fixed. The CSRF middleware is fixed to extract tokens from multipart/form-data forms. A write race in the Timeout middleware is fixed. The Recover middleware no longer logs panics for aborted handlers.

chunks.title: v4.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.8.0, support is added for arbitrary HTTP method types as routes and for custom 404 handlers on specific paths. New value binding methods (UnixTimeMilli, TextUnmarshaler, JSONUnmarshaler) are added to Valuebinder. The BasicAuth middleware now returns 400 instead of 500 for invalid base64 strings. Different param names are allowed in different methods with the same path scheme. Middlewares are updated to use errors.As() instead of type assertion on HTTPError.

chunks.title: v4.9.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.9.0, an open redirect vulnerability in handlers serving static directories (e.Static, e.StaticFs, echo.StaticDirectoryHandler) is fixed. The CSRF middleware now allows configuring an ErrorHandler. HTTP method constants in tests are replaced with stdlib constants.

chunks.title: v4.9.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.9.1, a logger panic when the template is set to empty is fixed by bumping a dependency version. CORS documentation is improved, the readme is updated about supported Go versions, and several test improvements are made.

chunks.title: v4.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.10.0, the JWT middleware is deprecated and moved to a separate repository. The minimum Go version is bumped to 1.17. Dependencies are updated, including x/text to 0.3.8. A helper interface for ProxyBalancer is added, and middleware.CreateExtractors is exposed. func(Context) error is refactored to HandlerFunc. HTTPError.WithInternal is added. io/ioutil usage is replaced. Staticcheck is added to CI. Relative path determination is replaced with stdlib. Square brackets are removed from IPv6 addresses in XFF. Additional configuration options for RequestLogger and Logger middleware are added. Route is added to request log. GitHub Workflows security is hardened. govulncheck is added to CI. e.Routes() is refactored and e.OnAddRouteHandler callback is introduced.

chunks.title: v4.10.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.10.1, dependencies are upgraded due to a golang.org/x/net vulnerability. The new JWT repository is added to the README. ctx.path returns an empty string if there is no registered path. A context timeout middleware is added. The link to jaegertracing is updated.

chunks.title: v4.10.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.10.2, filepath.Clean behavior is adapted for Go 1.20. middleware.CORSConfig.UnsafeWildcardOriginWithAllowCredentials is added to make unsafe wildcard origin with allow credentials less likely. More HTTP error values are added.

chunks.title: v4.11.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.11.0, a concurrency issue in the proxy middleware's Round Robin Balancer is fixed. group.RouteNotFound is fixed when the group has attached middlewares. The global error handler now returns the error message when the message is an error. Global timeNow variables are removed. An optional config variable to disable the centralized error handler in recovery middleware is added. strings.ReplaceAll is used directly. Support for Go1.20 http.rwUnwrapper is added to the Response struct. A nil check is added before invoking centralized error handling. Proper colon support is added in echo.Reverse. Documentation comments are fixed. A link to a slog.Handler library for Echo logging is added to README.md. The proxy middleware supports retries of failed proxy requests. gofmt fixes are applied to comments. Gzip response only if it exceeds a minimal length. Packages are upgraded.

chunks.title: v4.11.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.11.1, the Gzip middleware is fixed to send response codes for no content responses (404, 301/302 redirects etc).

chunks.title: v4.11.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.11.2, golang.org/x/net is bumped to prevent CVE-2023-39325 / CVE-2023-44487 HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack. A randomString bias is fixed, and CSRF/RequestID middleware switch from math/random to crypto/random. Unused context in body_limit.go is deleted. Go 1.21 is used in CI. Some typos are fixed. CORS middleware is allowed to send Access-Control-Max-Age: 0. Dependencies are bumped.

chunks.title: v4.11.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.11.3, c.Attachment and c.Inline escape the filename in the Content-Disposition header to avoid a Reflect File Download vulnerability. Context tests are refactored into separate functions. The proxy middleware reuses the echo request context. Unmarshallable yaml struct tags are marked as ignored.

chunks.title: v4.11.4 upgrade dependencies
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.11.4, golang.org/x/crypto is upgraded to v0.17.0 to fix a vulnerability. Dependencies are updated and the Go version is marked to 1.18. An example for Slog is added to the request logger.

chunks.title: v4.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.12.0, golang.org/x/net is updated due to GO-2024-2687. The binder is improved for binding to Map with string destinations. Encore is added as a sponsor in README.md. The default charset is removed from the 'application/json' Content-Type header. Go 1.22 is used in CI. Binding to a nil map is allowed. A Skipper unit test is added in BasicAuthConfig. Some typos are fixed. ResponseWriters are allowed to unwrap writers when flushing/hijacking. SPDX licence comments are added. Dependencies are upgraded. Type definition blocks are changed to single declarations. Real IP logic is fixed. The default binder can use UnmarshalParams and bind pointer to slice as struct field. maxparam dependence is removed from Context. Routes registered with empty path are normalized to '/'. The proxy middleware uses httputil.ReverseProxy for SSE requests.

chunks.title: JWT Middleware Removed
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.13.0, the JWT middleware is removed from core due to CVE-2024-51744. Users are directed to labstack/echo-jwt. The release includes struct alignment optimization, maintaining backwards compatibility for map[string]interface{} binding, adding Go 1.23 to CI, improving MultipartForm test, adding support for multipart multi files binding, adding a TemplateRenderer struct, refactoring TestBasicAuth, removing a broken header, fixing bind body when content-length is -1, and making CORS middleware compile allowOrigin regexp at creation.

chunks.title: v4.13.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.13.1, BindBody is fixed to handle Transfer-Encoding: chunked requests, which was introduced in a previous change.

chunks.title: v4.13.2 - update dependencies
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.13.2, dependencies are updated due to a security report (GO-2024-3321).

chunks.title: v4.13.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.13.3, the golang.org/x/net dependency is updated for GO-2024-3333.

chunks.title: v4.13.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.13.4, some typos in comments are fixed. CI tests with Go 1.24. Support for TLS WebSocket proxy is added. Dependencies are updated for GO-2025-3487, GO-2025-3503, and GO-2025-3595.

chunks.title: v4.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.14.0, middleware.Logger() is deprecated in favor of middleware.RequestLogger() or middleware.RequestLoggerWithConfig(), which use the standard library's slog logger. The default output format changes from JSON to the standard slog logger settings. Dependencies are updated. reflect.TypeFor is used. Go 1.25 is used in CI. context.go is modernized by replacing interface{} with any. Typos in SetParamValues and ContextTimeout middleware comments are fixed. BasicAuth middleware is improved with strings.Cut and RFC compliance. A duplicate plus operator in router backtracking logic is fixed. Custom private IP range check is replaced with net.IP.IsPrivate. Proxy connection is ensured to be closed in proxyRaw function. Logger middleware json string escaping and deprecation are handled. golang.org/x/* deps are updated.

chunks.title: v4.15.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.15.0, the CSRF middleware now supports the Sec-Fetch-Site header as a modern defense-in-depth approach, with new configuration options TrustedOrigins and AllowSecFetchSiteFunc. Type-safe generic parameter binding functions are added (PathParam, QueryParam, FormParam, ContextGet with variants). The Timeout middleware is deprecated in favor of ContextTimeout due to data race issues.

chunks.title: V5 is out
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v5.0.0, a major breaking change is introduced: Context is now a struct instead of an interface, a new Router interface is added, the old logging interface is dropped in favor of log/slog, and many method/function signatures are rearranged for consistency. v4 is supported with security updates and bug fixes until 2026-12-31. Upgrade notes and migration instructions are provided.

chunks.title: v5.0.1 small fixes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v5.0.1, the Panic middleware returns a custom PanicStackError with stack trace. A missing err parameter is added to the DenyHandler example. Context.IsWebSocket() is improved per RFC 6455. Context.Json() is fixed to not send status code before serialization is complete.

chunks.title: v5.0.2 security (static middleware folder browsing)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v5.0.2, a security fix is made for the Static middleware: when folder browsing is enabled, it now lists files/subfolders starting from config.Root and the requested folder, not from the config.Filesystem root folder.

chunks.title: v5.0.3 security (static middleware directory traversal under Windows)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v5.0.3, a directory traversal vulnerability under Windows in the Static middleware is fixed when the default Echo filesystem is used.

chunks.title: v5.0.4 small fixes and improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v5.0.4, an unused import is removed from a README example. Graceful shutdown is fixed to wait for the goroutine to finish after http.Server.Serve returns. The location of oapi-codegen in README is updated. Go 1.26 is added to CI. A new function echo.StatusCode is added. CSRF supports older token-based CSRF protection handlers that want to render token into template. echo.ResolveResponseStatus is added to help determine HTTP status code and echo.Response.

chunks.title: v4.15.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.15.1, CSRF now supports older token-based CSRF protection handlers that want to render token into template.

chunks.title: v5.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v5.1.0, c.RealIP() now returns request.RemoteAddr unless e.IPExtractor is configured, removing legacy IP extraction logic. echo-opentelemetry is added to README.md. Spelling mistakes in comments and a field name are corrected. echo-prometheus is added to the middleware list. StartConfig.Listener is added for easier custom listener creation. Rate limiter documentation for default burst value is fixed. Doc comments clarify File related methods and leading slash handling. NewDefaultFS function helps create a filesystem that allows absolute paths. http.Server.WriteTimeout is no longer set in StartConfig.

chunks.title: v4.15.2 - Context.Scheme() header validation
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v4.15.2, Context.Scheme() now validates values taken from the header to fix a security issue.

chunks.title: v5.1.1 - Context.Scheme() should validate header values
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the labstack/echo release v5.1.1, Context.Scheme() validates values taken from the header. A golangci linter configuration is added. StartConfig listener creation is made context-aware. Staticcheck issues are resolved. Typos in httperror.go are fixed. Context.Json does not unwrap response.
