prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent langgenius/dify release stream from v1.5.0 through v1.14.2, covering major features like enhanced workflow debugging, MCP support, Knowledge Pipeline, event-driven triggers, multimodal knowledge base, Summary Index, Human-in-the-Loop, and collaboration.

chunks.title: v1.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.5.0, the project introduces enhanced workflow debugging with rebuilt tools, persistent debugging variables, and dashboard integration. It also adds drag-and-drop DSL for app creation, enhanced default templates, hidden form attributes, MatrixOne integration, Firecrawl deep search, Notion pagination, and SendGrid integration. Refinements include smart login redirects, environment sync on import, API UX improvements, responsive charts, stable markdown handling, app icon picker, and instant dataset insights.

chunks.title: v1.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.5.1, the project adds Knowledge Basis Indexing for optimized data retrieval, model provider validation in the API, dynamic select parameters, a structured output plugin endpoint, adaptive panel width management, and plugin setting autofill. Enhancements include front-end UX tooltips, UI style tweaks, and improved Langfuse trace readability. Bug fixes address UI and API issues, incorrect doc links, false token numbers, node validation, error handling in code interpreters, and integration improvements for Notion and LaTeX.

chunks.title: v1.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.6.0, the project introduces support for Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) as a new industry standard for structuring model inputs and outputs. Enhancements include drag-and-drop topic reordering, SSL verify toggle in HTTP Node, batch embedding optimization, question classifier enhancements, and a Redis fallback mechanism. Fixes resolve JSON output issues, variable name uniqueness, overflow hidden in drawer, and plugin daemon failures.

chunks.title: v1.7.0 - Tool OAuth & Plugin Auto-Upgrade Enhanced
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.7.0, the project adds OAuth 2.0 support in tool plugins with refresh token handling, and a plugin auto-upgrade strategy with configurable policies and rollback mechanisms. Enhancements include citations and attributions in Agent Nodes, plugin deprecation notices, API key authentication via query parameter, audio configuration UI, variable suggestions, drag-and-drop for workflow variables, custom max active requests per app, optional OpenTelemetry endpoint configuration, RFC 5322 email validation, dynamic imports for performance, and external trace ID propagation. Bug fixes address optional parameter omission, Docker networking, plugin installation, model and app selectors, session management, and metadata/file processing.

chunks.title: v1.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.7.1, the project adds default values for select inputs, variable selection in conditional filters, OpenAPI schema enhancement for allOf, and a Kubernetes pure migration option. Bug fixes correct Langfuse integration path, CELERY_BROKER handling for RabbitMQ, metadata batch edit cross-page issues, and Windows PEM key path errors. Improvements refine ToolTip components, PostgreSQL healthcheck, and time formatting internationalization. Miscellaneous changes include a revamped tool list page and removal of duplicate TYPE_CHECKING imports.

chunks.title: v1.7.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.7.2, the project introduces workflow visualization with a relations panel and node search in the workflow editor. Enhancements include Notion database row extraction with original order and row page URL, workflow API version specification, tool JSON response support for datetime and UUID, revamped API documentation, workflow node alignment, a service API file preview endpoint, and Testcontainers tests. Bug fixes address full-text search with Tencent Cloud VectorDB, workflow knowledge retrieval cache, HTTP request component multipart/form-data boundary, conversation variable sync, and internationalization issues. A security fix addresses an XSS vulnerability in authentication check-code pages.

chunks.title: v1.8.0 - Async workflows meet multi-model management with OAuth-powered integrations.
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.8.0, the project adds a multi-model credentials system, MCP support with OAuth, default values for workflow start node variables, and agent node token usage exposure. UI/UX enhancements include document sorting in knowledge base, delete avatar functionality, extensible goto-anything commands, document name tooltips, and auto-login after setup. API and backend changes include Redis SSL/TLS authentication, migration from Flask-RESTful to Flask-RESTX, and Swagger authorization configuration. Bug fixes address database performance, authentication error handling, OAuth Redis compatibility, HTTP request node file access, loop exit conditions, agent node token counting, number input in tool configure, conversation deletion via API, and dark mode improvements.

chunks.title: v1.8.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.8.1, the project adds export DSL from history, downvote with reason, multi-modal/file filename support, and advanced chat file handling. Enhancements include DB query optimization, migration from MyPy to Basedpyright, Indonesian language support, and Jinja2 template variable expansion. Fixes address XSS vulnerabilities, persistence session management issues, workflow publishing problems, UUID v7 conflicts, and various UI component issues.

chunks.title: 1.9.0 – Orchestrating Knowledge, Powering Workflows
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.9.0, the project introduces the Knowledge Pipeline, a visual node-based orchestration system for document ingestion, and a Queue-based Graph Engine for robust workflow execution. The Knowledge Pipeline includes templates and DSL, customizable data sources and tools, new chunking strategies including Q&A processor, and image extraction and retrieval. The release also adds a new orchestration interface for knowledge pipelines, enabling modular and flexible document processing.

chunks.title: v1.9.1 – 1,000 Contributors, Infinite Gratitude
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.9.1, the project upgrades Next.js to 15.5 with Turbopack, provides X-Dify-Version headers in marketplace API access, and adds a security report workflow. Pipeline templates now support language configuration, and the graph engine blocks response nodes during streaming. Fixes and improvements address NodeRunRetryEvent debug logging, LLM node Flask context loss, agent-strategy prompt generator errors, full_text_search name reliability, IME composition value extraction, OceanBase parser selection, workflow variable splitting logic, tool node attribute judgment, iteration conversation variable sync, Knowledge Base node crash, workflow node mutation, remote filename handling, FileUploader context sync, variable not found errors, db connection errors, model list refresh, retrieval configuration handling, ChatClient audio_to_text bug, missing IO import, FILES_URL removal, httpx client pooling, plugin auto-upgrade concurrency, plugin detail panel display, and UI/UX fixes.

chunks.title: v1.9.2 - Sharper, Faster, and More Reliable
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.9.2, the project focuses on stability, async performance, and developer experience. Highlights include pause and resume workflow graph executions, structured output support during LLM node streaming, agent variables drag-and-drop, workflow run filtering and re-execution, OpenTelemetry + HTTPX tracing, CORS config for custom headers, faster web load times, improved DataSources with marketplace plugin integration, tax tooltips, and account creation language sync. Core improvements include Pyright enablement, HTTP timeout refinements, and Weaviate client upgrade from v3 to v4 requiring server version 1.24.0+.

chunks.title: v1.10.0-rc1 - Event-Driven Workflows
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.10.0-rc1, the project introduces trigger functionality for event-driven workflows, including schedule, SaaS integration events, and webhook triggers. The start node is redesigned as a component bound to WebApp or Service API, with trigger types defining their own input formats. This release is a prerelease and only supports Workflow app type.

chunks.title: v1.10.0 - Event-Driven Workflows
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.10.0, the project introduces trigger functionality for event-driven workflows, supporting schedule, SaaS integration events via plugins, and webhook triggers. Triggers are only available for Workflows. The release also includes a marketplace for trigger plugins and various other changes such as flatten_output configuration for iteration nodes, MCP specification update, RAG tool recommendations, tencent trace integration, webapp ID usage, pipeline template marketplace toggle, workflow pause state management, Hindi localization, audio content support for MCP tools, broadcast channel, and workflow resumption capabilities.

chunks.title: v1.10.1 – Multi-Database Era Begins: MySQL Joins the Family
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.10.1, the project adds MySQL support, making PostgreSQL, MySQL, and OceanBase fully supported. It includes a major performance upgrade for the Workflow Editor, eliminating costly per-node validation scans and improving responsiveness. Workflow-editor improvements include UI refinement, stability fixes, and quality-of-life enhancements. Fixes address advanced-chat workflow stop issues, 500 error in draft mode, token overcounting, workflow-as-tool file field, FileService session-scope error, weightedScore retrieval 500 error, Node.js SDK route and multipart upload, OpenAPI/Swagger loading, dark-mode rendering, marketplace search behavior, chatflow log navigation, README display panel, useNodes re-renders, plugin verification logic, nullable tags in TriggerProviderIdentity, and various other improvements.

chunks.title: v1.10.1-fix.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.10.1-fix.1, the project applies security dependency bumps: backend updates pyarrow to 17.0.0, werkzeug to 3.1.4, urllib3 to 2.5.0; frontend bumps React to 19.2.1 (addressing CVE-2025-55182) and Next.js to 15.5.7. Users who upgraded before 2025-12-09 03:00:00 UTC must verify docker compose configuration for correct web image version.

chunks.title: v1.11.0 - Your knowledge base just went from mono to full HD
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.11.0, the project introduces a Multimodal Knowledge Base that understands both text and images, with auto-image extraction, smart attachment handling, and multimodal embedding support. Other new features include Zen Mode, an 'Open Workflow' shortcut for WorkflowTool, Start Node JSON Schema, Admin API Keys skip CSRF, and dark-mode icons. Performance and infrastructure improvements include GraphEngine pause/resume handling, automatic storage permission repair, and various other enhancements.

chunks.title: v1.11.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.11.1, the project applies React and Next.js security upgrades, fixes empty available_credentials, truncates autogenerated descriptions, adds charset to response content types, fixes Flask-Restx AttributeError, optimizes save_document_with_dataset_id, fixes external image extraction in DOCX, handles empty access_token gracefully, resolves hit-test failure with missing attachment ID, integrates Amplitude API key, adds container integration tests for triggers, and optimizes Excel extractor performance.

chunks.title: v1.11.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.11.2, the project adds InterSystems IRIS Vector Database support, Aliyun SLS integration for workflow execution logging, and Tunisian Arabic language support. Enhancements include comprehensive Jest test coverage, Amplitude tracking, pipeline setting tests, and responsive chat wrapper. Bug fixes address unified translation, security vulnerabilities (XSS in Mermaid Graph, SSRF, CSV injection), upload disabling consistency, API key validation, and miscellaneous tweaks. Code quality improvements include API and web controller refactoring, Jest and Webpack optimizations, and Swagger UI disabled by default in production.

chunks.title: v1.11.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.11.3, the project adds MCP tool enhancements (embeddedResource support and direct display), batch re-index operation, AgentMaxIterationError, OAuth integration for frontend login, PDF image extraction, archive storage client, and initial RSC support for translations. Bug fixes include Redis pipeline optimization for cache deletions, UI/UX fixes, dataset access error fixes, runtime state reference release to prevent memory leaks, CORS and SSL rectifications, and Korean translation updates. Under the hood, CI/CD and build enhancements, and code/query optimizations are included.

chunks.title: v1.11.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.11.4, the project requires Node.js 24.13.0 to address an AsyncLocalStorage/async_hooks DoS CVE. Bug fixes include login redirect correction, missing id and message_id patching, and fixing destructuring of undefined properties.

chunks.title: v1.12.0 - Introducing Summary Index: Smarter Retrieval with AI Summarization
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.12.0, the project introduces Summary Index, an AI-powered summarization for document chunks to enhance retrieval accuracy. It supports multimodal summarization with vision-capable LLMs, flexible configuration, asynchronous processing, manual summary editing, and compatibility with general and parent-child chunking modes. Other improvements include Agent App multimodal support, Qdrant full-text search, workflow context registration, OpenTelemetry for single runs, plugin API key management option, and template preview before creation. Bug fixes and security updates address logstore security, SSRF in WordExtractor, tanstack devtools RCE, dependency upgrades, workflow and graph engine fixes, API and backend fixes, and frontend fixes.

chunks.title: v1.12.1 - Fix base URL in client and other bugs
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.12.1, the project fixes base URL in client, auto summary environment variable, delete_draft_variables_batch infinite loop, and IRIS data persistence across container recreation.

chunks.title: 1.13.0 - Human-in-the-Loop and Workflow Execution Upgrades
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.13.0, the project introduces Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) with a Human Input node that allows pausing workflows for human review, editing variables, and action-based routing via Webapp or Email. Architecture updates move workflow-based streaming and Advanced Chat executions to Celery workers, with a new workflow_based_app_execution queue. Configuration changes include new environment variables for PubSub Redis. The release also includes various other features and fixes.

chunks.title: 1.14.0-rc1: New Agent x Skills for Production Workflows
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.14.0-rc1, the project introduces a new Agent runtime with sandboxed execution and Agent Mode, a Skill Editor for building reusable SOP blocks with inline tool calling, command and file upload to sandbox, 'Pull a Variable' for dynamic context assembly, and Collaboration beta with shared editing, comments, and mentions. This is a prerelease.

chunks.title: v1.13.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.13.1, the project adds Hologres as a supported backend for vector retrieval and full-text search, Service API endpoints for dataset document downloads, and various workflow and chat experience improvements including HITL email markdown rendering, user-scoped draft variables, edge context menu, connection preservation on node type change, configurable send-key behavior, file payloads in message-end stream, removal of GPT-4 hardcoded behavior, and an export-app-messages CLI command. Security updates prevent SQL injection, harden HITL email delivery, enforce ownership checks, clear stale credentials, and improve enterprise API error handling. Configuration changes include a dedicated dataset_summary Celery queue, telemetry metrics, REDIS_MAX_CONNECTIONS, and deprecation of PUBSUB_* settings in favor of EVENT_BUS_*.

chunks.title: v1.13.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.13.2, the project fixes critical regressions from v1.13.1, including a severe regression in prompt message transformation causing LLM-plugin invocation failures, Knowledge Retrieval node execution failures due to incompatible enum values, and improper Weaviate client cleanup.

chunks.title: v1.13.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.13.3, the project adds variable-reference support for model parameters in LLM, Question Classifier, and Variable Extractor nodes. Bug fixes address streaming reliability with StreamsBroadcastChannel replay and concurrency, workflow editor behavior for pasted nodes, runtime execution for prompt message transformation and max_retries handling, and knowledge retrieval for citation metadata, dataset icon crashes, hit-count query filtering, and indexed document chunk previews.

chunks.title: v1.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.14.0, the project introduces Collaboration allowing workspace members to co-edit workflows with synced graph updates and online presence. It also adds Service API for HITL, MCP and plugin improvements, marketplace and OAuth fixes, a shared UI kit (@langgenius/dify-ui), accessibility enhancements, Goto Anything improvements, prompt editor variable filtering, follow-up question settings, modal refactoring, Langfuse TTFT reporting, explore analytics, Quota v3 integration, billing UI updates, summary index and Weaviate compatibility fixes, vector projection updates, tenant checks on knowledge APIs, Docker healthchecks, Celery concurrency increase, PostgreSQL max connections increase, Redis key prefix and retry logic, TiDB endpoint support, optional ALLOW_INLINE_STYLES, and security fixes including change-email flow hardening.

chunks.title: v1.14.1 - Security hardening, workflow stability, and cleaner self-hosted deployments
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.14.1, the project hardens self-hosted SECRET_KEY handling, protects internal metrics endpoints, fixes IDOR in account avatar and scopes builtin-tool credential cleanup, upgrades dependencies for security. Workflow stability fixes include version loading, online-user polling, preview resize loops, and schema collisions. Workflow authoring polish addresses variable reference picker, node title overflow, condition operator popovers, and KB metadata filter. Execution correctness fixes preserve input variable types, fix structured_output_enabled validation, file-preview URL, and plugin model selector. Human input exposes selected action values. Knowledge-base fixes include hit-testing rendering, empty knowledge creation, recommended app ordering, and null handling. RAG and document processing allow LLM nodes to access retrieved knowledge files, regenerate summaries, fix pipeline template rendering, and handle credential fetch failures. Web UI and product experience improvements include app creation source tracking, user timezone/language initialization, WebApp icon/description display, annotation reply score thresholds, unauthorized editor redirects, and tag rename fix.

chunks.title: v1.14.2 - Security fixes, agent groundwork, workflow reliability, and deployment updates
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the langgenius/dify release v1.14.2, the project strengthens tenant isolation for app trace-config and FilePreview endpoints, restricts default builtin tool credential updates to admins/owners, and cleans stale tenant tool credentials. Workflow execution reliability improvements include tracing after HITL resume, workflow run callback tracking, reduced message-update database roundtrips, memory fetch context fixes, and base64 file lookup session closure. Workflow and model selection polish fixes loading behavior, filters model presets, and improves API extension dialog controls. Knowledge-base stability fixes hit-testing rendering, empty knowledge creation, recommended app category ordering, and null handling. RAG and document processing allows LLM nodes to access retrieved knowledge files, regenerates document summaries, fixes pipeline template rendering, and handles credential fetch failures. Web UI and product experience improvements include app creation source tracking, user timezone/language initialization, WebApp icon/description display, annotation reply score thresholds, unauthorized editor redirects, and tag rename fix.

questions.query_text: In the langgenius/dify releases, which release introduces the Knowledge Pipeline, a visual node-based orchestration system for document ingestion?

answer_support.answer_text: introduces the Knowledge Pipeline, a visual node-based orchestration system for document ingestion

questions.query_text: Across the langgenius/dify releases, how does the trigger functionality introduced in v1.10.0 differ from the Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) feature introduced in v1.13.0?

options.text: v1.10.0 triggers are for event-driven workflow start (schedule, SaaS events, webhooks), while v1.13.0 HITL allows pausing workflows for human review and action-based routing.
v1.10.0 triggers require human input, while v1.13.0 HITL is fully automated.
Both features are identical in functionality.
v1.10.0 triggers are only for Chatflow, while v1.13.0 HITL is only for Workflow.

questions.expected_answer: v1.10.0 triggers are for event-driven workflow start (schedule, SaaS events, webhooks), while v1.13.0 HITL allows pausing workflows for human review and action-based routing.

questions.query_text: In the langgenius/dify release window, order the following release-content states from earliest to latest: (1) a release that introduces MCP support, (2) a release that introduces the Multimodal Knowledge Base, (3) a release that introduces the Summary Index, (4) a release that introduces Collaboration.

introduces a Multimodal Knowledge Base that understands both text and images

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent laravel/framework release stream across multiple major and minor versions, including v11, v12, and v13 releases, highlighting new features, bug fixes, and improvements.

chunks.title: v12.54.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v12.54.0, the release includes fixes such as preventing division by zero in repeatEvery(), allowing app.editor.base_path to be an empty string, fixing URL validation for punycode subdomains, preventing queue deadlock when reserving a job throws an exception, fixing throttle with redis ignoring after callback, fixing TwoColumnDetail stripping trailing punctuation, adding support for assertions on BinaryFileResponse, fixing array offset deprecation warning, adding tsvector column type for PostgreSQL, fixing memory limit passed as string from supervisor, fixing facade cache file permissions, displaying oldest pending job in queue:monitor output, fixing type() method return type in Filesystem, wrapping flags in int-mask-of annotation, fixing after-commit observers breaking -ing event cancellation, fixing migrate:fresh failing when database does not exist, adding interval() method to InteractsWithData, hashing displayName() in cache lock keys, improving html test helpers, adding Model::withoutRelation() for selective relation unloading, including request context in HTTP client Response::dump(), fixing enum handling in ModelNotFoundException error message, updating composer.json to enforce commonmark version without DisallowedRawHtmlRenderer exploit, suppressing chmod errors in Filesystem::replace() for non-POSIX filesystems, and adding composite index to jobs table migration for improved queue polling.

chunks.title: v12.54.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v12.54.1, the release makes imports consistent.

chunks.title: v11.49.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v11.49.0, the release fixes PHPUnit compatibility, fixes MySQL inRandomOrder default seed regression, deduplicates paths in view:cache, and includes test improvements.

chunks.title: v12.55.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v12.55.0, the release adds depth parameter to Arr::dot(), adds strict integer validation to Numeric validation rule, adds *OrFail transaction methods to BelongsToMany, adds inOrderOf() method to query builder, adds tcp_keepalive option to PhpRedis connector, un-taps PendingRequest, fixes float to int deprecation in trans_choice() for certain locales, allows touch() to accept multiple columns, reverts adding composite index to jobs table migration, adds fluent string validation rule builder, updates Command::withProgressBar phpdoc, lazily evaluates value for constraints in HasOneOrManyThrough, adds string helper to get initials from a string, fixes stripping gzip-compressed output from concurrent process response, fixes failing tests introduced by fluent string validation rule builder, avoids redundant Util::getParameterClassName() call in container resolution, adds missing conditional validation rule builders, skips placeholder replacements when message does not contain them, uses array_push with spread operator in MessageBag::all(), caches Route instances in CompiledRouteCollection::getByName(), accepts CarbonInterval for retry sleep duration, fixes failing phpstan, updates comments for PlanetScale MySQL and PostgreSQL, uses big integers for database cache expiration column, displays file path and line number for closure routes in route:list, and adds wantsMarkdown() and acceptsMarkdown() request methods.

chunks.title: v13.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v13.0.0, the release reverts query builder PDO fetch modes, prepares branch alias for Laravel 13, fixes query builder PDO fetch modes plus columns fix, fixes Tests/CI environments, requires PHP 8.3 as minimum version, adds missing parameters to Response methods throw() and throwIf(), fixes scope removal in nested where conditions, removes function existence checks, removes unneeded default argument, fixes unresolved merge conflict in Concurrency composer.json, fixes merge conflict, sets error exit code for clear command, adds #[Override] to BatchFake class methods, implements PDO Fetch modes, allows Listeners to dynamically specify deleteWhenMissingModels, does not allow new model instances to be created during boot, fixes typo in Blueprint: datetime to dateTime, adds support for straight join in mysql, registers subdomain routes before routes not linked to a domain, supports Symfony 7.4 & 8.0, changes to hyphenate prefixes, uses exception object in JobAttempted event, removes superfluous element, adds eventStream signature to ResponseFactory contract, aligns ResponseFactory::eventStream signature with interface, adds Cache::touch() & Store::touch() for TTL Extension, makes QueueBusy event consistent with other queue events, uses clearer pagination view names, updates countBy docblock in Enumerable interface to allow for enum callback, generates plural morph pivot table name, resolves Symfony Console add() method deprecation, adds command method to contract, and refactors to replace strpos check with str_contains.

chunks.title: v12.55.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v12.55.1, the release corrects truncate exceptions at, fixes float pluralization in trans_choice(), and fixes tests on PHP 8.5.

chunks.title: v13.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v13.1.0, the release corrects truncate exceptions at, removes useless Mockery::close(), fixes Batch::add() wiping queue assignment on first job in array chains, improves assertions for asserting HTML in text, uses Carbon::now() instead of now() helper, fixes null broadcaster deprecation warning in PHP 8.5, fixes float pluralization in trans_choice(), fixes tests on PHP 8.5, and adds toString to Uri.

chunks.title: v13.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v13.1.1, the release breaks queue dependency.

chunks.title: v13.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v13.2.0, the release supports enums in #[Queue] and #[Connection], improves raw SQL binding substitution performance, fixes missing negate for SeeInHtml assertion, allows passing enums to attributes, adds releaseOnSignal param to withoutOverlapping, adds symmetrical expressive attributes, fixes LazyPromise::wait() signature compatibility with Guzzle's PromiseInterface, makes schedule:list display expression in the correct timezone, handles exceptions in eventStream to prevent fatal error, ensures connectUsing works with UnitEnum / FileManager drive docblock, includes columns and index in UniqueConstraintViolationException, adds TimedOut worker stop reason, fixes Table attribute incrementing not working for Pivot models, ensures ScopedBy Attribute works with inheritance, modifies sum callback to include item key, bounds error page query listener to prevent memory bloat in Octane, allows opting out of worker Job exception reporting, adds mobile safe-area-inset support to exception renderer, allows passing multiple arrays to has factory method, and allows Backoff Attribute to be variadic.

chunks.title: v12.56.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v12.56.0, the release makes schedule:list display expression in the correct timezone, fixes validation wildcard array message type error, and preserves class type of mocked classes.

chunks.title: v11.51.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v11.51.0, the release makes schedule:list display expression in the correct timezone.

chunks.title: v13.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v13.3.0, the release forwards releaseOnTerminationSignals through schedule groups, fixes sub-minute scheduling skips at minute boundaries, displays memory usage in verbose queue worker output, updates WithoutOverlapping@shared() for clarity, fixes dependency injection of faked queueing dispatcher, fixes incrementEach/decrementEach to scope to model instance, adds array value types to Support module docblocks, adds lost connection to WorkerStopReason, makes MariaDbSchemaState use mysql --version for client detection instead of mariadb --version, adds enum support to QueueManager connection methods, sets up rector, improves Arr::whereNotNull() docs, passes request to afterResponse callback, adds isNotEmpty() method to Uri class, adds missing capitalize parameter to Stringable::initials(), fixes trait initializer collision with Attribute parsing, adds session to supported drivers comment, adds ->file() method to $request->safe(), adds enum support to LogManager channel and driver methods, fixes MorphTo eager load matching when ownerKey is null and result key is a non-primitive, removes unnecessary clone in SessionManager to prevent duplicate Redis connections, uses FQCN for Str in exception renderer blade templates, allows variadic args for model attributes, makes CollectedBy Attribute follow inheritance, fixes deprecation notice in JSON:API resources, adds withoutFragment() method to Uri class, fixes macros with static closures, fixes sum() docblock to include key parameter in callback signature, adds assertHasNoAttachments() method to Mailable, adds a driver method to the MailFake class, and caches getLockForPopping() result.

chunks.title: v13.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v13.4.0, the release fixes missing Illuminate\Queue\Attributes\Delay attribute, fixes $request->interval() failing with very small float values, adds pint.json to export-ignore, adds --ignore-scripts to yarn in BroadcastingInstallCommand, fixes static closure binding in remaining manager classes, fixes CollectedBy attribute not resolving through abstract parent classes, allows runtime property overrides (onQueue) to take precedence over class attributes, uses #[Delay] attribute in Bus Dispatcher, uses #[Delay] attribute in NotificationSender, adds overflow option to Carbon plus and minus, fixes respect null redirect in unauthenticated exception handler, fixes TypeError in starts_with/ends_with validation rules on non-string values, allows null to be passed directly to redirectGuestsTo(), reverts removal of unnecessary clone in SessionManager, fixes deprecation warning in Contains and DoesntContain rules when values contain null, fixes Str::markdown() and Str::inlineMarkdown() crash on null input, adds queue methods to inspect jobs, adds form request strict mode, bumps vite from 7.3.1 to 7.3.2, fixes deprecation warning in In and NotIn rules when values contain null, adds flushState to FormRequest to reset global strict mode between tests, and fixes #[WithoutRelations] queue attribute not being inherited by child classes.

chunks.title: v13.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v13.5.0, the release supports #[Delay] attribute on queued mailables, adds inheritance support for Controller Middleware attributes, normalizes phpredis SSL context for single and cluster connections, memoizes the result of TestCase@withoutBootingFramework(), adds missing @throws and docblocks for concurrency and model, fixes that retries of ShouldBeUniqueUntilProcessing jobs are force-releasing locks they don't own, adds first-class Redis Cluster support for Queue and ConcurrencyLimiter, updates PHP version from 8.2 to 8.3 in bin/test.sh script, fixes RedisQueueTest, adds enum support to CacheManager store and driver methods, fixes redirectUsersTo() overwriting redirectGuestsTo() callback, adds ability to detect unserializable values returned from cache, fixes loose comparison false positive in NotPwnedVerifier with magic hash passwords, refactors Skip middleware, resolves stan errors on MySqlSchemaState, allows closure values in updateOrCreate and firstOrNew, adds enum support to MailManager mailer and driver methods, adds enum support to AuthManager guard and shouldUse methods, adds spatie/fork to composer suggestions, adds enum support to Manager driver method, fixes custom driver binding bug, improves PHPDoc for "safe" method with conditional return type, bumps Retry action in CI, moves Scope interface @template from method-level to class-level to fix LSP violation, combines consecutive isset and unset, and changes strlen comparison to 0 to direct empty string compare.

chunks.title: v13.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v13.6.0, the release uses version_compare function, flips misordered assertions arguments, removes unused variable in catch(), fixes number abbreviation rollover between unit tiers, uses Null and Isset coalescing when possible, changes count array comparison to empty array comparison to improve performance, adds testsuite, enforces static calls, allows Table Attribute on child to override parent, returns null from Cursor::fromEncoded for malformed payloads, ports forward rate limiter fix, adds debounceable queued jobs, supports JSON responses for the built-in health route, ensures Queue::route string defaults to queue only, fixes failOnUnknownFields query parameter handling, fixes flaky QueueWorkerTest by freezing time before computing retryUntil, allows array of pivot arrays to be passed to hasAttached, fixes TypeError in digits_between validation rule on non-string values, adds enum support to PasswordBrokerManager, adds enum support to BroadcastManager, changes attempts column type from tiny to small integer, gets rid of useless Mockery::close, fixes Vite CSS not loaded from nested chunk imports, supports named credential providers for SQS queue connections, enforces stricter assertions, casts to string before preg_match in decimal, max_digits, and min_digits rules, ignores PHPUnit security advisory GHSA-qrr6-mg7r-m243, allows assertDatabase has & missing to accept arrays, normalizes Carbon, implements CanFlushLocks on FailoverStore, validates MAC across all decryption keys, and uses generic TModel in additional places in Factory class.

chunks.title: v12.57.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v12.57.0, the release preserves types on partialMock() and spy(), fixes missing UnitEnum support in ModelNotFoundException, fixes macros with static closures, corrects Storage::fake() return type, fixes callable type for freezeTime, freezeSecond, and travelTo, supports string abstract in mock/partialMock/spy PHPDoc, documents thrown exceptions in FilesystemAdapter, hints \Redis @mixin on Connection, uses PDO subclass polyfill, fixes infinite rate limiter TTL on custom increments, supports named credential providers for SQS queue connections, and prevents array to string conversion in signature validation.

chunks.title: v12.58.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v12.58.0, the release memoizes credentials in SqsConnector.

chunks.title: v13.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v13.7.0, the release applies rector fixes, supports enum in LazyCollection -> keyBy(), adds enum support to ConcurrencyManager driver method, allows arrays for assertSoftDeleted & assertNotSoftDeleted, extracts exception context in JsonFormatter when ExceptionHandler is not bound, adds isLocked to the Lock class, fixes route registration for domain-scoped routes, marks Scope@apply builder parameter as having covariant template, allows DebounceFor attribute to be inherited, fixes PendingDispatch resolving Cache for every dispatched job, adds bulk JSON path assertions to TestResponse, fixes false positives in LazyCollection::has() for duplicate keys, adds UnitEnum type support for $limiterName on RateLimitedWithRedis, allows jobs to react to worker signals, honors empty JSON:API sparse fieldsets, fixes flaky DynamoBatchTest timing assertions, memoizes credentials in SqsConnector, disables pausing on managed queue workers, fixes getMigrationBatches return type annotation, fixes PHPDoc typo in MigrationRepositoryInterface, adds UnitEnum support to Cache Repository touch method, prevents array query params from bypassing signed URL validation, adds enum support to setDefaultDriver in QueueManager, LogManager, and SessionManager, adds enum support to RedisManager purge method, fixes factory hasAttached method pivot JSON attribute handling, implements CanFlushLocks on NullStore and MemoizedStore, introduces WorkerInterrupted event, fixes MigrationRepositoryInterface return type docblocks, adds int argument for Collection::sortBy(), adds detailed @return shape to Schema\Builder::getForeignKeys, and fixes Eloquent model event dispatching.

chunks.title: v13.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the laravel/framework release v13.8.0, the release includes backports from 12.x: schedule:list display expression in correct timezone, fix validation wildcard array message type error, preserve class type of mocked classes, preserve types on partialMock() and spy(), fix missing UnitEnum support in ModelNotFoundException, fix macros with static closures, correct Storage::fake() return type, fix callable type for freezeTime, freezeSecond, and travelTo, support string abstract in mock/partialMock/spy PHPDoc, document thrown exceptions in FilesystemAdapter, hint \Redis @mixin on Connection, use PDO subclass polyfill, fix infinite rate limiter TTL on custom increments, support named credential providers for SQS queue connections, prevent array to string conversion in signature validation, memoize credentials in SqsConnector, disable pausing on managed queue workers. chunks.title: ChatGPT v0.10.1

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the lencx/ChatGPT release v0.11.1, the release note fixes the export button blinking (issue #541) and adds Enter key support for sending in the system tray, with Shift+Enter for line breaks (issue #533). It also provides a macOS quarantine workaround command.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release evolution of louislam/uptime-kuma, covering a series of 1.23.x patch releases, the major 2.0.0 release with its beta cycle, and subsequent 2.x feature and patch releases up to 2.4.0.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 1.23.10, the project addresses a security patch from 1.23.9 that required reverse proxy reconfiguration, which is no longer necessary. Users who added UPTIME_KUMA_WS_ORIGIN_CHECK=bypass in the previous version are advised to remove it to enhance protection, unless using third-party plugins/apps. A security fix fully patches GHSA-88j4-pcx8-q4q3.

In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 1.23.11, dependencies are updated. A bug fix resolves an 'origin' undefined error in error handling, and a non-Docker fix addresses a Tailscale monitor issue that was broken since 1.23.8.

In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 1.23.12, the i18n detection mechanism introduced in #4244 is noted as too basic, potentially affecting some setups. Proxy users are advised to use 1.23.11 instead due to unreliable events from #4630. Improvements include enhanced mail subsystem help text and using keylog events for TLS certificate reliability. Bug fixes cover encodeBase64 for empty credentials, i18n language detection, Dingding notification error handling, browser connection checks, JSON-Query parsing, and a missing FK for monitor-tls-info. Security fixes address GHSA-23q2-5gf8-gjpp, nodemailer, axios, and other dependency updates.

In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 1.23.13, bug fixes resolve language setting issues with the localisation-matching algorithm missing edge cases, and TLS issues when getting certificates through a proxy and updating Prometheus.

In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 1.23.14, improvements include showing an API Keys disabled message when auth is disabled and fixing status page icon display after upload. Security fixes update dependencies.
In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 1.23.15, a quick fix addresses a crash issue from 1.23.14 for users on Alpine image or Node.js <= 16 by pinning cheerio to avoid a breaking change in undici.

chunks.title: 2.0.0-beta.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.0.0-beta.0, a major version update introduces breaking changes and requires reading the migration guide. New features include MariaDB support, rootless Docker image, toast notification timeout settings, x-www-form-urlencoded support, SMTP templating via liquidjs, Grafana Oncall notification provider, MS Edge for real-browser monitor, retries persistence, remote browser support, json-query for MQTT monitor, CLI admin password reset, and numerous new notification providers (Heii On-Call, gtxmessaging, Cellsynt, CallMeBot, Whapi, SevenIO, keephq, Bitrix24, SMS Partner, Threema Gateway, SNMP Monitor, OneSender, cache bust param, WPush, SIGNL4, DNS Monitor conditions, RSS feed, serverchan3, Slack message format, 46elks, SendGrid, RabbitMQ monitor). Breaking changes drop backup/restore, install.sh, cacheable-lookup, Node.js 14/16 support, and Alpine-based Docker image. Improvements include uptime calculation, UI/UX enhancements, push examples, Bark API v2, and more.
In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 1.23.16, security fixes update dependencies and address CVE-2024-56331, a Local File Inclusion vulnerability via improper URL handling in the Real-Browser monitor.

chunks.title: 2.0.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.0.0-beta.1, new features include Docker images on ghcr.io. Bug fixes address embedded MariaDB startup, tag deletion, JSON monitor default operations, Slack button URL validation, email address friendly name error, toast error in EditMonitor, status page group deletion, timeout value, slug input, maintenance save bar, MariaDB heartbeat cleanup, and empty default condition creation. Security fixes update dependencies and patch CVE-2024-56331. Translation contributions are updated.

chunks.title: 2.0.0-beta.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.0.0-beta.2, new features add YZJ, WhatsApp (WAHA), and PushPlus notification providers. Improvements update nostr notification, proxy agents, TLS expiration warning, notification templating with Telegram support, Telegram custom bot API server, and PWA icon transparency. Bug fixes address monitor tags deletion, push examples loading, Google Chat notification fallback, ReDoS vulnerability in notification URL backslash stripping, and proxy port column type. Security fixes update dependencies and fix ReDoS in pushdeer and whapi. Translation contributions and other small changes are included.

chunks.title: 2.0.0-beta.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.0.0-beta.3, new features include country flag emojis, SMSPlanet, Pumble, OneChat notification providers, HTML for custom email bodies, SpugPush, Notifery, and SMTP monitor. Improvements enhance ping monitor options, status bar length, Pushover sounds, SMSEagle APIv2, SpugPush payload, Discord disable URL option, default friendly name, public URL field for monitors, and Flashduty integration. Bug fixes cover Matrix login URL, flat TXT records, modal navigation, Mattermost service name, null label values, tag overlapping, password strength check, notification name, Slack preview, SQL UTC_TIMESTAMP, push notification logic, and maintenance period notifications. Security fixes update dependencies and address GHSA-5px6-fx2w-459r. Translation contributions are updated.

chunks.title: 2.0.0-beta.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.0.0-beta.4, a major version update with breaking changes requires reading the migration guide. New features include deletion button on status list, clear events button, Google Workspace notification templating, optional audience for OAuth2, proxy clone, manual monitor, force IPv4/IPv6 for HTTP, bulk tag addition, markdown in descriptions, and interval conversion. Improvements update dependencies, make chart period global, add WebSocket path to MQTT, improve PR testing, i18n language matching, heartbeat tooltip, status page edit buttons, Prometheus monitor ID label, eliminate blocking I/O, Discord default avatar, and ntfy down priority. Bug fixes address cache clearing, cloudflared installation, HeartbeatBar color, monitor name cropping, Slack attachments, MySQL database name check, Matrix token hint, refresh interval, Day.js, database column type, recurring maintenance, invalid maintenance date, NTLM header handling, and other fixes. No security fixes are listed. Translation contributions are updated.

In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.0.0, a major version update with breaking changes requires reading the migration guide and all beta changelogs. New features add Nextcloud Talk, Brevo, Evolution API notification providers, 2FA autofocus, and Slovak language. Improvements add an environment variable for proxy support in notifications, fix mobile button visibility, and generate a better changelog. Bug fixes handle optional startDateTime in maintenance, default ping column value, and monitor ip_family data type. Security fixes replace proxy-agent due to vm2 vulnerability, update dependencies, and address GHSA-vffh-c9pq-4crh. Translation contributions are updated.

In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 1.23.17, a bug fix addresses the browser monitor issue due to the end of life of Debian Buster. Security fixes update dependencies and address GHSA-vffh-c9pq-4crh, a Server-side Template Injection vulnerability in notification templates.
In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.0.1, a bug fix prevents the healthcheck from shutting down Uptime Kuma during migration.
In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.0.2, a bug fix resolves a false positive for Google Chrome during migration. Other changes revise supported versions and Docker tags in SECURITY.md.

chunks.title: 2.1.0-beta.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.1.0-beta.0, new features include Webpush notifications, SSL/STARTTLS and certificate monitoring for TCP Port monitor, Twilio Messaging Service SID, multi-number SMSIR, disabled Telegram link previews, SMSIR notification provider, clone maintenance, enhanced monitor deletion, drag & drop for groups, webhook GET method, tags in Prometheus metrics, status page sorting, WebSocket upgrade test, MQTT wildcard topics, hide uptime percentage on status page, and reducing monitor minimum interval to 1 second. Improvements optimize HeartbeatBar with Canvas, make MariaDB pool size configurable, add PWA manifest descriptions, SMSC i18n, SMSIR text shortening, status page help text, Google Chat retries, relative time formatter, Node.js 22 bump, cert hostname mismatch warning, and eliminate blocking in Real Browser Monitor and Apprise. Bug fixes cover package-lock, e2e test, tag saving, JSON query error messages, Pushover sound swap, Prometheus update, HeartbeatBar redraw, UP status enforcement, beat border radius, SevenIO field name, SMSIR long SMS, statistics reset, Bark path, child monitor disappearance, group monitor retries, i18n refactor, eqeqeq disable, username trim, Pagerduty API call, gear settings visibility, and more.

chunks.title: 2.1.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.1.0-beta.1, new features include labeling min/avg/max on ping chart, extracting SQL Server monitor with conditions, resend email notification, select all monitors on maintenance page, XMPP STARTTLS dialog, system service monitor, domain name expiry, analytics support (umami, matomo, plausible) on status page, and gamedig v5 update. Improvements add Open Graph meta tags, hide empty Discord fields, make WebSocket check more resilient, add Vazirmatn font, reset status page icon button, show WebSocket URL, evaluate full DNS response for CAA, and migrate gamedig to GameDigMonitorType. Bug fixes escape Telegram MarkdownV2, validate DNS hostname and URLs, change dns_last_result column type, fix RSS content type, update CI OS versions, fix domain expiry test, improve v2 migration progress, fix MariaDB datetime format, optimize heartbeat indexes, and handle unhealthy Docker state as DOWN. Security fixes run zizmor, harden CI, and bump nodemailer. Translation contributions are updated.

chunks.title: 2.1.0-beta.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.1.0-beta.2, new features include exposing path vars and improving Slack rich message, retry only on status code failure for JSON Query, configurable response data storage, switch to gift-wrapped events for nostr, rework pause/resume/bulk-delete actions, SSL authentication for database setup, nightly Docker image releases, ntfy phone call support, Docker secrets for DB credentials, group notification services in dropdown, group messaging for serwersms, maintenance without affected monitors, MySQL/MariaDB monitor with conditions, MQTT conditions, RSS title field, monitored URL link in Google Chat, expected TLS error for TCP monitor, Halo PSA webhook, DNS multi IP/hostname support, prometheus metrics, and SIP Options Reply Ping monitor. Improvements enhance mobile monitor list readability, hide retry interval without retries, expand AggregateError logging, consistent monitor logging, i18n improvements, add prettier, proper date field processing, reduce domain expiry noise, add retryInterval validation, standardize password fields, robust expiry handling, improve domain expiry logs, add password strength translation key, and sanitize Aliyun SMS messages. Bug fixes handle release branch in workflow, ping data type, IDN ping errors, and more.

chunks.title: 2.1.0-beta.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.1.0-beta.3, new features add Google Sheets notification provider, ntfy tag values and metadata, WeCom mentioned mobile list, screenshot delay for Browser Engine, expand/collapse all groups button, Postgres query result monitoring, maintenance quick duration buttons, Discord suppress notifications, external MariaDB socket path, SNMPv3 noAuthNoPriv support, and incident history. Improvements simplify filters, clarify markdown help text, bump vue-i18n, improve punctuation, and reduce domain expiry logs. Bug fixes address MongoDB JSON parse error, disable STARTTLS option, static RDAP DNS data, JSON parse crashes, cancel multiple tests, multi-level public suffixes, UI refresh/search/scroll issues, private domain support, and beta workflow. No security fixes are listed. Translation contributions and other small changes are included.

In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.1.0, all beta changes are included. New features add Jira Service Management and Google Sheets notification providers. Improvements add custom message and format presets for Discord, and custom title/message templates for ntfy. Bug fixes address certificate expiry, Weblate conflict, Slack group name option, monitor list selection, RSS pubDate timezone, monitor names hidden by tags, expand/collapse nested groups, bot filtering in changelog, monitor ID validation, RADIUS error handling, and MongoDB JSON parse. No security fixes are listed. Translation contributions add Bavarian German and update translations.

In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.1.1, improvements add customizable Matrix notifications and a Group Name column on the dashboard. Bug fixes resolve Gamedig SRV record resolution, remove vite-plugin-pwa to avoid unexpected caching, fix Discord notification timestamp and message, add scroll bar to tags dropdown, and enable domain expiry notification only when TLD has RDAP support. Translation contributions are updated.

In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.1.2, new features add Teltonika RUTxxx SMS gateway notification, tags to Teams notifications, and DNS support via Globalping. Improvements refactor dynamic RDAP DNS data. Bug fixes clear 2.1.0 frontend PWA cache, add help text to expiry checkboxes, handle undefined monitor name in PagerDuty, fix DNS error message typo, and fix clearing heartbeats on paused monitors. Translation contributions are updated.
In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.1.3, a bug fix ensures RDAP data is actually cached.

In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.2.0, new features allow socks proxy for notifications, add WhatsApp (360messenger) notification provider, and enable templating in Signal notifications. Improvements refactor SQLite multiple connections. Bug fixes address Node.js 20 compatibility, monitor name display, tag list update, Globalping retry and error messages, domain validation for PTR records, forced DOWN status in group monitor, status page analytics type, edit page issues, URL validation, bind address logging, domain expiry notification setting preservation, certificate expiry on status page for TCP monitors, and more. Security fixes address GHSA-c7hf-c5p5-5g6h. Translation contributions are updated.

In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.2.1, new features add fluxer notification provider and set process.title to uptime-kuma. Bug fixes correct isParentActive return type, fix fluxer input styling, restore uptime ratio and avg response time in Prometheus metrics, and revert removal of @aws-sdk and @azure packages. Security fixes address GHSA-v832-4r73-wx5j, an SSTI vulnerability in LiquidJS. Translation contributions are updated.

In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.3.0, breaking changes revert sorting on status pages due to performance and add UPTIME_KUMA_SQLITE_SINGLE_CONNECTION for Raspberry Pi users. New features improve WebSocket with authentication, add custom message template for Evolution provider, Telnyx messaging, VK notification, MAX messenger, OracleDB monitor, and collapsible groups on status page. Improvements add RTT help text, change warning message, and update Home Assistant help text. Bug fixes address Stackfield provider, SSL in setup database, uptime calculation, applyExisting saving, domain expiry update, create error propagation, monitor graph gaps, and Prometheus metric duplication. Translation contributions add English (United Kingdom) and update translations.
In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.3.1, a bug fix adds busy_timeout to SQLite to avoid SQLITE_BUSY errors. Other changes update dependencies and fix the push image Dockerfile for multi-arch.
In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.3.2, a bug fix reverts SQLite back from multiple connections to a single connection by default.

In the louislam/uptime-kuma release 2.4.0, new features add EgoSMS provider, incidents to RSS, and VKTeams bot notification. Improvements add optional token for gamedig, bearer token support, and update API key documentation link. Bug fixes handle npm 11.16.0 and fix NTLM monitor over plain HTTP. Security fixes address an authenticated Remote Code Execution vulnerability from an upstream dependency. Translation contributions are updated.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent mastodon/mastodon release stream across multiple minor versions (4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5) with their patch releases, including security fixes, bug fixes, and feature additions.

chunks.title: v4.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mastodon/mastodon release v4.5.1, this patch release for 4.5 includes fixes such as Cmd/Ctrl+Enter not submitting Alt text modal on some browsers, posts from public/hashtag streaming being marked as unquotable, old previously-undiscovered posts being treated as new when receiving an Update, blank screen in browsers that don't support Intl.DisplayNames, filters not being applied to quotes in detailed view, scroll shift caused by fetch-all-replies alerts, dropdown menu not focusing first item when opened via keyboard, assets build issue on arch64, /api/v1/statuses/:id/context sometimes returning Mastodon-Async-Refresh without result_count, and prepared quote not being discarded with contents when replying.

chunks.title: v4.3.15
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mastodon/mastodon release v4.3.15, this patch release for 4.3 includes fixes for tootctl upgrade storage-schema failing with ArgumentError and old previously-undiscovered posts being treated as new when receiving an Update. The release note encourages administrators to update to the latest 4.5 version.

chunks.title: v4.4.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mastodon/mastodon release v4.4.9, this patch release for 4.4 includes fixes for tootctl upgrade storage-schema failing with ArgumentError, old previously-undiscovered posts being treated as new when receiving an Update, and filters not being applied to quotes in detailed view. The release note encourages administrators to update to the latest 4.5 version.

chunks.title: v4.5.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mastodon/mastodon release v4.5.2, this patch release for 4.5 includes a change to the private quote education modal to not show up on self-quotes, and fixes for missing fallback link in CW-only quote posts, statuses without text being hidden while loading, g+h keyboard shortcut not working when a post is focused, quoting overwriting current content warning, scroll-to-status in threaded view being unreliable, path resolution for emoji worker, tootctl upgrade storage-schema failing with ArgumentError, cross-origin handling of CSS modules, error with remote tags including percent signs, bogus quote approval policy not always being replaced correctly, hashtag completion not being inserted correctly, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter in the composer triggering confirmation dialog action.

chunks.title: v4.5.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mastodon/mastodon release v4.5.3, this patch release for 4.5 includes a security fix for inconsistent error handling leaking information on existence of private posts (GHSA-gwhw-gcjx-72v8), and fixes for 'Delete and Redraft' on a non-quote being treated as a quote post in some cases, YouTube embeds by sending referer, streamed quoted polls not being hydrated correctly, creation of duplicate conversations, extraneous noreferrer in external links, edge case error handling in some database migrations, error handling when re-fetching already-known statuses, post navigation in single-column mode when Advanced UI is enabled, tootctl status remove removing quoted posts and remote quotes of local posts, known expensive S3 batch delete operation failing because of short timeouts, and compose autosuggest always lowercasing input token.

chunks.title: v4.4.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mastodon/mastodon release v4.4.10, this patch release for 4.4 includes a security fix for inconsistent error handling leaking information on existence of private posts (GHSA-gwhw-gcjx-72v8), and fixes for YouTube embeds by sending referer, YouTube iframe not being able to start at a defined time, streamed quoted polls not being hydrated correctly, error handling when re-fetching already-known statuses, and known expensive S3 batch delete operation failing because of short timeouts. The release note encourages administrators to update to the latest 4.5 version.

chunks.title: v4.3.16
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mastodon/mastodon release v4.3.16, this patch release for 4.3 includes a security fix for inconsistent error handling leaking information on existence of private posts (GHSA-gwhw-gcjx-72v8), and fixes for YouTube embeds by sending referer, YouTube iframe not being able to start at a defined time, and known expensive S3 batch delete operation failing because of short timeouts. The release note encourages administrators to update to the latest 4.5 version.

chunks.title: v4.2.28

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent meilisearch/meilisearch release stream from v1.29.0 through v1.45.1, covering new features like network scaling, vector store improvements, ranking rule enhancements, and security fixes.

chunks.title: v1.29.0 🐑
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.29.0, the new settings indexer is extended to support searchableAttributes, exactAttributes, and proximityPrecision in addition to embedders. The new vector store backend becomes the default for newly created indexes. Support for XLM Roberta architecture models is added for the huggingFace embedder. A build compatibility note requires the git binary at build time to populate the commitSha1 field. Bug fixes include a rare internal error in the experimental vector store. Maintenance work improves CI speed and reliability.

chunks.title: v1.30.0 🐸
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.30.0, the Enterprise Edition adds the ability to modify the number of participants in sharding without starting over, introducing breaking changes for users of the experimental network feature with automatic sharding. The release details how to set up the initial network, upgrade from earlier versions, add a new remote, and remove a remote. The Network object is restructured, and a leader machine must receive all tasks.

chunks.title: v1.30.1 🐸
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.30.1, a bug fix corrects task attribution during index swap to prevent cross-index task loss. A hotfix logs a warning when FieldidsWeightsMap is missing an entry, avoiding an internal error during search requests.

chunks.title: v1.31.0 🦃
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.31.0, S3-streaming snapshots become an Enterprise Edition feature, requiring a license for self-hosted use. Support for AWS IRSA authentication for S3 snapshots is added under Enterprise Edition. A new skipCreation query parameter allows strict document updates without creating missing documents. Bug fixes address actix payload error handling and bump hannoy to v0.1.2. Maintenance includes running Windows in PR CI and making CI test titles more human-friendly.

chunks.title: v1.32.0 🐟
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.32.0, comprehensive progress tracking and logging for search operations is introduced. Document indexing is accelerated by extracting document operations from payloads in parallel, achieving a 7x speedup on four-million-document insertion using four CPUs. Bug fixes include vector sort bucketing for identical similarity scores, proper deletion of documents from FID-based databases, and rebuilding graph links during dumpless upgrade. Maintenance updates JS SDK tests to use pnpm and bumps lru from 0.16.2 to 0.16.3.

chunks.title: v1.32.1 🐟
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.32.1, an environment variable MEILI_EXPERIMENTAL_DISABLE_FID_BASED_DATABASES_CLEANUP is introduced to opt out of the field ID-based database cleanup when upgrading from versions inferior to 1.32.0.

chunks.title: v1.32.2 🐟
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.32.2, a bug fix prevents a panic when doing a dumpless upgrade on empty indexes with configured embeddings.

chunks.title: v1.33.0 🐞
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.33.0, a new POST /indexes/{indexUid}/fields endpoint returns detailed metadata about all fields in an index. Parallel cleanup of old field IDs reduces dumpless upgrade time from 2 hours 50 minutes to under 7 minutes. The internal vector store is updated to hannoy 0.1.4-nested-rtxns for faster upgrades and improved search relevance. A bug fix allows Meilisearch to rescale when the index reaches 2 TB. Security updates upgrade the mini-dashboard. Miscellaneous changes include verbose OpenAPI schema descriptions and code samples in the generated OpenAPI file.

chunks.title: v1.33.1 🐞
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.33.1, a security fix addresses a path traversal vulnerability in dump import. Enhancements update the vector store to trigger linear scanning on bigger databases for better result quality when the search cutoff is reached. A bug fix ensures non-final ranking rules consider all non-blocking buckets, improving search result quality when the search cutoff triggers, especially with vector search and sort.

chunks.title: v1.34.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.34.0, a new useNetwork field in POST /indexes/{:indexUid}/search allows easy search over a network of machines by executing a remote federated search over all remotes. The release provides detailed examples of search requests and responses, showing how the feature works with a network of three instances.

chunks.title: v1.34.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.34.1, a security fix prevents authenticated users with write permissions from bypassing the firewall by forbidding requests to non-global IPs. A new --experimental-allowed-ip-networks CLI flag and environment variable allow specifying allowed private IP networks. This is a breaking change for security reasons.

chunks.title: v1.34.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.34.2, a patch fixes an accidental breaking change in v1.34.1 where Meilisearch would not start with a configuration file if experimental_allowed_ip_networks was not defined.

chunks.title: v1.34.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.34.3, a bug fix increases the auth store database size to 2 GiB to allow indexing more keys.

chunks.title: v1.35.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.35.0, search routes accept a new showPerformanceDetails field that returns a performance trace in the response, detailing timing for each step of the search process. This applies to search, multi-search, federated search, and similar routes. A breaking change modifies the POST /indexes/<index_uid>/fields route.

chunks.title: v1.35.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.35.1, a bug fix addresses a possible task database corruption issue when using the S3 streaming snapshot method, which could occur if a task was sent while snapshotting the task database.

chunks.title: v1.36.0 🐙
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.36.0, two new ranking rules are introduced: attributeRank and wordPosition, improving relevance. A dumpless upgrade step migrates indexes from the old annoy vector store to the new Hannoy one. Bug fixes include search failing when using attributesToSearchOn on an empty index. Security bumps include bytes, jsonwebtoken, time, and rsa. A breaking change removes the meilisearch-openapi-mintlify.json file from release assets.

chunks.title: v1.37.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.37.0, replicated sharding is introduced for Enterprise Edition, with breaking changes requiring network objects to contain at least one shard object. The vectorStoreSetting experimental feature is removed, and the new vector store is stabilized. A security fix is included. The release details the new network.shards field and convenience fields for adding/removing remotes.

chunks.title: v1.38.0 🐍
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.38.0, embedding indexing performance is drastically improved by eliminating full database scans. Task deletion is optimized and fixed. A bug fix addresses intermittent connection reset by peer errors with remote embedders. Miscellaneous changes enforce that routes appear in the reference documentation and remove a verbose debug log on list documents.

chunks.title: v1.38.1 🐍
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.38.1, a bug fix reverts, optimizes, and fixes task deletion to address a regression that caused the engine to stop processing tasks.

chunks.title: v1.38.2 🐍
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.38.2, a bug fix addresses a regression introduced in v1.38.0 where Meilisearch could sometimes stop processing tasks after an automatic task queue cleanup while more tasks were being added. The dumpless upgrade process may take up to one minute before the HTTP server becomes available when migrating from a previous v1.38 version.

chunks.title: v1.39.0 🐳​
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.39.0, a new ForeignKeys setting allows cross-index document hydration, enabling documents to be enriched with data from other indexes. The feature is behind the foreignKeys experimental feature flag. Disable proxy response buffering on Server-Sent Events is added. Bug fixes address a memory leak in the indexation pipeline and avoid losing tasks by applying deltas on the wtxn view.

chunks.title: v1.40.0 🦈
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.40.0, support for the distinct attribute in federated search is added, enabling cross-index distinct attributes with facet distribution support. Performance improvements include faster federated search (about 100ms faster), optimized JSON document generation, and better memory usage for large workloads.

chunks.title: v1.41.0 🏈
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.41.0, dynamic search rules with pinning are introduced as an experimental feature, allowing condition-based pinning of documents. Search requests now default to useNetwork: true when sharding is enabled, a breaking change for network feature users.

chunks.title: v1.42.0 🦑​
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.42.0, a fallback system for sharding and replication is introduced, allowing the engine to avoid unavailable machines and resume querying them when back online. Experimental document join filtering extends cross-index document hydration by allowing filtering on foreign indexes using the _foreign filter.

chunks.title: v1.42.1 🦑​
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.42.1, bug fixes address issues when using the legacy settings indexer, including internal errors with multimodal fragments, ignored regenerate:false, and nested field indexing. A new CI run tests the stable settings indexer.

chunks.title: v1.43.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.43.0, the new settings indexer now supports filterable, sortable, facet search, and custom attributes. Facet search indexing performance is improved. The GET /health route returns HTTP 500 after task queue compaction to signal a restart is needed. Bug fixes include lexicographic filters on strings and a typo tolerance regression from v1.41.

chunks.title: v1.43.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.43.1, a security fix addresses an authenticated SSRF vulnerability.

chunks.title: v1.44.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.44.0, remote federated facet search is added, defaulting to network-wide facet search when sharding is enabled. Indexing memory usage is reduced, GeoJSON indexing performance is improved, and human-formatted sizes and detailed DB sizes are added to stats. Breaking changes include the facet search default and embedder timeout tied to searchCutOffMs.

chunks.title: v1.45.0 🦒
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the meilisearch/meilisearch release v1.45.0, autobatch deletions by filter with additions is introduced to improve indexing speed. The new settings indexer is extended to support non-extracting parameters and global facet search. Bug fixes include non-blocking document fetching and an internal error when changing binary quantization.
