prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent microsoft/WSL release stream from version 2.3.17 through 2.7.7, covering kernel updates, networking changes, modern distro support, and the first open source release.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the microsoft/WSL release 2.3.17, the Linux kernel is reverted to 5.15.153.1-2 while issues are debugged. A race condition when a WSL2 distribution is stopped is fixed. A format attribute is used to catch printf format errors at compile time. A segfault in init when boot.initPath does not exist is fixed (solves #11725). Default Hyper-V firewall rules are added to allow inbound mDNS traffic (solves #11852). The Windows SDK is updated to version 26100, and Microsoft.Windows.ImplementationLibrary is updated to version 1.0.240803.1.

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.3.21, the binfmt_late entry is no longer registered when interop is disabled (solves #11920). An invalid iterator access causing a service crash in DnsResolver::Stop is fixed. Elevated relaunch is simplified to use AttachConsole instead of pseudoconsole. wsl.exe --mount is updated to allow ARM64 passthrough disks on supported Windows versions (solves #9611). MSRDC is updated to 1.2.5620, WinUIEx to version 2.4.0, Microsoft.Windows.SDK.NET.Ref to version 10.0.26100.45, Microsoft.Windows.ImplementationLibrary to version 1.0.240822.1, CommunityToolkit.Common and CommunityToolkit.Mvvm to version 8.3.1, and various Microsoft runtime NuGet packages from 8.0.7 to 8.0.8.
In the microsoft/WSL release 2.3.22, the experimental useWindowsDnsCache config is removed.

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.3.24, VM creation is changed to fall back to no networking instead of failing. IPlan9FileSystem::Teardown() is manually called to work around a destructor hang in ni_release. The Windows App SDK is updated to 1.6.
In the microsoft/WSL release 2.3.25, the system automatically falls back to virtioProxy networking mode if NAT networking mode fails.

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.3.26, the kernel is updated to 5.15.167.4, which updates to upstream stable kernel version v5.15.167 and includes an out-of-tree patch fixing a bug in the XSAVES subsystem.

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.4.4, logic is added to wait for a block device to be available before calling mkfs/mkswap. PathTranslationStyle is set to 'wsl' in generated terminal profiles. Support for terminal profile generation during distribution installation is added. An explorer extension to handle .wsl files is added. Support for gzip compression when calling wsl --export is added. A double handle close in wslhost.exe is fixed. Modern-distro features include install on double click, wsl --manage <distro> --set-default-user, flavor and version parsing. File size based progress is added to wsl --export. The default UID is not set if not in wsl-distribution.conf. wsl.exe --distribution-id <id> is implemented. Fallback to virtio proxy networking mode if NAT fails is added. The hardcoded 30 seconds timeout is removed and KernelBootTimeout config setting is respected. Socket receive timeouts are added when starting a new distro. Logic to offer to re-install WSL if WslInstaller fails to install the MSI is added. The process no longer waits on termination event when HcsStartComputeSystem fails. The CRT is configured to crash the process when abort() is called.

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.4.5, distributions are allowed to opt out of shortcut and terminal profile generation. GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx is used to determine the maximum number of processors (solves #1115). A user warning is added that bridged networking will be deprecated. Windows-specific string conversion functions are added back (solves #12294). A regression causing the default distribution to not be listed in wsl --list's output is fixed (solves #12302). wslpath is updated to preserve trailing slashes (solves #8827).

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.4.8, terminal profiles and start menu shortcuts are no longer deleted when a distribution is converted. The stderr handle is plumbed through to WSL1 processes for import/export/setversion. Modern distros are updated to support WSL1 (solves #12298). wsl --install is made case insensitive with modern distros. A logic error causing wsl2.processors to always default to the maximum is fixed (solves #12346). Microsoft.RemoteDesktop.Client.MSRDC.SessionHost is updated to version 1.2.5716.
In the microsoft/WSL release 2.4.9, modern distro shortcuts and terminal profiles are updated to start in the user's home directory.
In the microsoft/WSL release 2.4.10, WSL1 OOBE support for modern distros is backported (solves #12398).
In the microsoft/WSL release 2.4.11, a failure to launch is handled if c:\windows\system32\lxss\lib is not present.
In the microsoft/WSL release 2.4.12, situations where the user's defaultDistribution registry value is missing are gracefully handled (solves #12595).

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.5.1, broken /etc/hosts generation is fixed and empty domain names are correctly handled (solves #12275). Hardening of the WSL binfmt interpreter is improved (solves #8843). Situations where the user's defaultDistribution registry value points to a missing registration are gracefully handled (solves #12595). WSLg is updated to 1.0.66. Support for exporting distributions via wsl --export as .tar.xz is added. The wslpluginapi.h Windows.h header include is changed to lowercase (solves #12580). User token duplication logic is moved to LxssUserSession so valid user tokens are passed to plugins (solves #12554). The kernel is updated to 6.6.75 and modules are switched to a vhd. cgroupv1 support is removed. The distribution is automatically started when a .wsl file is double clicked. A potential deadlock in the IO relay when stdin is a pipe is fixed (solves #12523). A DefaultNetworkingMode WSL policy value is introduced. Support for CRLF in /etc/wsl.conf is added (solves #12502). The automount setting is checked before mounting admin drives (solves #12443). TrustedInstaller registry protections are removed before writing the registry during installation (solves #11376). WSLg creates /run/user/<uid> as a tmpfs mount that systemd expects (solves #11261). Support for distros compressed with xz or bzip for WSL1 is added. OOBE for WSL1 distros is implemented (solves #12398). Microsoft.Identity.MSAL.WSL.Proxy is updated to version 0.1.1. Config file warnings on Linux are implemented. Localization on Linux is implemented. wsl.exe --import-in-place is updated to call plugin API and do modern distro operations (solves #12370). Support for resizing a distribution via wsl --manage <distro> --resize is added.
In the microsoft/WSL release 2.4.13, Microsoft.Identity.MSAL.WSL.Proxy is updated to version 0.1.1.

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.5.4, the wsl --update --pre-release logic is fixed to correctly handle backports and always pick the actual latest. LX_WSL2_INSTALL_PATH is set even when gui apps are disabled. A general.instanceIdleTimeout is introduced to control distribution termination timeouts (solves #10138, #9401). Config file parsing is modified to allow empty strings. Microsoft.RemoteDesktop.Client.MSRDC.SessionHost is updated to version 1.2.6074. The behavior of a custom kernel with no modules is changed to not log a warning. --vhd-size and --fixed-vhd arguments are implemented for wsl.exe --install. Detection of VM crashes and capturing dmesg is added. A kernel warning about ip_local_port_range having start/end with same parity is resolved. WSLENV logic is updated to allow passing /l and /p together to translate paths and path lists. An exception is no longer thrown when processing an empty argument (solves #12649). DNS tunneling is disabled if the global secure access client is present. Bridged networking support is removed. wsl.exe --install --enable-wsl1 is fixed to work when run as non-elevated. A partial read causing failure to import a WSL1 distribution is fixed. wslsettings launches the MSI version of wsl.exe instead of the one in system32.

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.5.6, Docker is fixed by adding back modules loaded at boot (solves #12748). Command line parsing preventing importing or exporting from stdout/stdin is fixed. Bridged networking mode is brought back. The WSL kernel is updated to 6.6.84.1. wslinfo prints a newline after usage. An initgroups helper is added to work around a musl limitation (solves #12755). An invalid kmesg error when gui apps are disabled is removed. Fallback to GrantVmAccess when attaching a VHD fails with ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED is added. UtilConnectToInteropServer is updated to respect g_InitPid and minor wslinfo updates are made (solves #12714). Sparse vhd support is put behind an --allow-unsafe flag. wslsettings fixes the networking mode selection logic (solves #12745).

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.5.7, the Linux kernel is updated to 6.6.87.1-1. WindowsAppSDK is updated to version 1.7.250401001. The soft file descriptor limit is increased to 1024 * 1024 (solves #12837). Logic to detect when an imported distribution is invalid is added. Linux side warnings are moved to a new warning infrastructure. A potential deadlock when converting a distribution to WSL1 or WSL2 is fixed. Download logic is fixed to download to a file instead of in memory (solves #12805). A systemd-generator is used to create the wslg and binfmt units.

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.5.8, the file descriptor soft limit is reduced to 10240 (solves #12985). A systemd override binfmt-support.service is added to protect WSL's interop entry (solves #13000).
In the microsoft/WSL release 2.5.9, the WSL kernel is updated to 6.6.87.2 (solves #12987, #12983, #13031). Post import distribution checks are made less strict (solves #13036).

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.6.0, this is the first open source release of WSL. Various stability improvements are included. Localized strings are updated. An exception is no longer thrown when unregistering a distro that has a BasePath that doesn't exist (solves #13004). Distribution download failure if the URL contains parameters is fixed. Various issues with systemd user sessions are fixed (solves #13053). A wslsettings crash when invoked from wslservice is fixed. MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH is set when moving distribution VHDs (solves #13055). The BOM header is discarded when parsing the Windows 'hosts' file (solves #9642). Corrupted disks are correctly reported when mount() fails with EUCLEAN (solves #13074). A ? prefix is no longer used when resolving the distribution location (solves #13064). Potential failure while downloading a distribution if LastError is non-zero is solved.
In the microsoft/WSL release 2.5.10, CVE-2025-53788 is fixed (details to be published on Aug 12th).

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.6.1, a JSON invalid utf-8 from IconPath is fixed. wslinfo --vm-id is switched to not rely on the presence of a VM ID environment variable. CVE-2025-53788 is fixed. Installation does not attempt to install distros if a reboot is required. wslsettings appropriately sets the heading level for PageHeaderTextBlockStyle. The VM ID is exposed inside user distros. A warning is no longer displayed when the binfmt process doesn't have a controlling terminal. A C1010070 compilation error in wslsettings is fixed. systemctl is looked up from $PATH for user session checks. Microsoft.RemoteDesktop.Client.MSRDC.SessionHost is updated to version 1.2.6353.

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.6.2, comprehensive GitHub Copilot instructions for WSL development are added. WSLg is updated to use wslinfo --vm-id instead of an environment variable. The hardcoded --cd ~ is removed from WSL terminal fragment profiles to support Terminal's startingDirectory. The HTTP cache is disabled when reading the distribution manifest over HTTP. The debug shell is relaunched if the user exits it. Microsoft .NET and AppSDK NuGet packages are updated. More settings are added to VM create begin/end events. The binfmt name is always set to 'WSLInterop'. TargetLatestRuntimePatch is set to false to prevent automatic framework version increases. WININET_E_TIMEOUT is added to g_commonErrors. An UnboundLocalError in create-release.py is fixed. Logic to force terminate the VM if the session lock can't be acquired for 30 seconds when the service stops is added. An incorrect timeout causing WSL1 OOBE to fail if the OOBE process takes longer than 30 seconds is fixed. A persistent install log file is created to help root cause package upgrade issues. A sparse VHD command is corrected to include 'true'. A new wsl.conf config value is introduced to allow distributions to opt-in to cgroupv1 mounts. More verbose output is added to bsdtar to help root cause 'ImportExportStdout' test failures. The distribution manifest ordering is respected when listing distributions. The initramfs generation logic is updated to set 755 permissions on /init. WSLg is updated to 1.0.71. Clean instance terminate when using systemd is implemented. A potential service deadlock when a plugin returns an error from OnVmStarted is fixed. Logging when socket operations fail is improved.

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.7.0, unused LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_WSLCORE_MODE is removed. Logic to handle partial hvsocket writes and additional logging is added. Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime packages are updated with a fix for CVE-2025-55248. Microsoft.WSL.DeviceHost package is updated to version 1.0.0-20251015.1. Edge cases around .vhd support are fixed. WslDistributionConfig is fixed to not default-initialize optional fields. The sample WSL_POST_BUILD_COMMAND is made more resilient. wslsettings allows the OOBE window to close with the escape key and fixes OOBE text truncation at 200% text scaling. Underlines are added to links on the about page. .clang-format adds InsertBraces: true and a minor fix to FormatSource.ps1. wslsettings ensures the selected setting is auto-expanded and selected. Minor compiler errors when building with VS2026 are fixed. systemd-networkd-wait-online.service is masked during boot. A number of NuGet packages are updated to the latest available versions. *.slnx is added to .gitignore. A service crash when collecting a Linux crash dump when maxCrashDumpCount is set to 0 is fixed. VirtioNetworking is refactored. Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr is switched to wil::com_ptr. VirtioNetworking is further refactored to be more portable. Invalid m_deviceHostSupport checks are removed. Common functionality is moved out of the service exe. Test logging infra is improved. Two minor issues in virtio networking are fixed. Microsoft.WSL.Kernel is updated to 6.6.114.1. Minor updates are made to improve virtiofs pass rate. Microsoft.WSL.DeviceHost is updated to remove lxutil.dll dependency. Handling for product-specific virtio networking class IDs is added. wslsettings ensures text in the OOBE window properly wraps. The WSL2_VM_ID environment variable is added back to the system distro. CI switches away from -dev versions of MS-RDX-MRO.windows-store-publish tasks. A typo in Dutch translations is fixed.
In the microsoft/WSL release 2.6.3, an issue causing wslg shortcut generation to fail is fixed (solves: #1388).

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.7.1, CVE-2026-26127 is fixed by bumping the .NET runtime from 10.0.0 to 10.0.4. Elevated virtiofs access when the VM is launched by an elevated user is fixed. An issue with config file writing sections outside of their expected header is resolved. Buttons on notifications not working correctly is resolved. A trailing slash is removed from $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR. An issue with svccommio incorrectly resetting console state in the move operator is fixed. Excessive screen updates in progress indicators are fixed. Four code bugs are fixed: substr off-by-one, HANDLE* cast, TOCTOU GetLastError, sun_path overflow. WSL stuck when a misconfigured cifs mount is present is fixed. After selecting from the navigation list, keyboard focus is now transferred to page content. Support for the statx syscall is added to virtiofs. Support for mounting directories (not just full volumes) is added to virtiofs. IPv6 support is added to virtio networking. DNS tunneling is enabled for VirtioProxy networking mode. DNS switches to using 'search' instead of obsolete 'domain'. The bind syscall is tracked when port is 0. WindowsTerminal.enabled is added to the list of config keys for wsl-distribution.conf. The process creation cursor animation is disabled by default. VirtioProxy networking and VirtioFS posix compatibility are improved. The enable virtualization error message is updated. NetworkManager-wait-online.service is masked during boot. iptables is added to the list of apps to install in WSL. VS 2026 solution generation is enabled and the ARM64 developer experience is improved. TryParse is used in view models for safer numeric input parsing.

In the microsoft/WSL release 2.7.3, the Microsoft.WSL.DeviceHost package is updated to 1.2.14-0. Shared compilation is disabled when building wslsettings. MSI verbose install logs are collected in the diagnostic bundle. NuGet package path validation in the nuget-stage pipeline is fixed. ARM64 test distro support is added. Duplicated DNS test coverage is removed. A failure and warning is given when --uninstall is given parameters. Virtio net reverts to previous DNS behavior while debugging an issue with DNS over TCP. cgmanifest is updated to match CMakeLists.txt. A maximum message size is added to socketshared to avoid very large allocations. A bind interrupted by seccomp signal race is fixed. Distro Env HOSTTYPE is set to aarch64 for ARM64 build. Devicehost stops re-signing and fixes the MSI installer failing to replace wsldevicehost.dll. MSI-initiated reboots during Store updates are suppressed. Source Link is added to embed GitHub source mappings in PDBs. console-getty.service is masked to prevent multi-distro failures. A random "ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND" when unmounting with an absolute path is fixed. Route mirroring is fixed. Wrong variable checking is fixed. Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime is bumped to 10.0.6 (CVE-2026-32178). VHD ownership after cross-volume move is fixed to prevent E_ACCESSDENIED. A {} format specifier is used instead of %s in the Linux LOG_ERROR path. The MoveVhdOwnership test is updated to WSL2 only. ssize_t is used for readlinkat return value in p9file.cpp. A SkipSignal helper is extracted to deduplicate signal skip lists. The correct GetAddrInfoTestEntry handler is used for the get_addr_info test. IDisposable is implemented on WslConfigService to dispose FileSystemWatcher. A waitpid safety net is added after signalfd setup to prevent a SIGCHLD race. Pending changes tracking and an apply confirmation dialog are added to Settings. A boot check for ipv6 disabled via registry in mirrored mode is added. A broken WSLCorePort channel after receive timeout is fixed.
In the microsoft/WSL release 2.7.5, Microsoft.WSL.Kernel is updated to 6.18.26.1. A best-effort grant of VMWP access to user-supplied VHDs is added.
In the microsoft/WSL release 2.7.7, Microsoft.WSL is updated to version 1.0.73.2.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent milvus-io/milvus release stream across core releases and related official release artifacts, highlighting new features, improvements, and bug fixes from v2.4.24 through v3.0-beta.

chunks.title: milvus-2.6.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.6.3, the project introduces primary key with AutoID enabled, manual compaction for L0 segments, cluster ID encoding in AutoID, and gRPC tokenizer support. Improvements include a refined balance checker with priority queue, preloaded BM25 stats, nullable fields for BM25, Azure Blob Storage support in Woodpecker, random score for boosting queries, int8 autoindex config, hybrid search requery policy, control of function output field insertion, configurable score merging for decay function, binary search string performance, sparse filters in queries, tiered index updates, storage resource usage tracking, granular flush targets, non-singleton file system for datanodes, batch processing config for metadata, database name in error messages, and tracer test relocation.

chunks.title: client/v2.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus Go SDK release client/v2.6.1, the SDK adds geospatial data type support with GIS functions and R-Tree index, CDC support for cross-cluster replication, manual L0 compaction, granular FlushAll operations, and AutoID with primary key insertion. Enhancements include receiver parse result cache and dynamic column handling fix. Dependencies are bumped to pkg v2.6.3 and proto v2.6.3, and Go version to 1.24.6.

chunks.title: milvus-2.5.19
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.5.19, the project bumps Go to 1.24.6 and Arrow/Go to v17, ensures accesslog consistency level reflects actual value, refactors balance checker with priority queue, adds granular flush targets in flushall, adds hybrid search requery policy configuration, and optimizes binary_search_string performance. Bug fixes address duplicate L0 segment load task generation, empty loop in growing segments, bulk import auto ID issue, collection metrics cleanup after drop, and incorrect local path in IDF Oracle.

chunks.title: milvus-2.6.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.6.4, the project introduces Struct in ARRAY data type, Qwen GTE-rerank-v2 model support in DashScope, upgrades Go to 1.24.6, enables default JSON shredding, adds disk quota for loaded binlog size, enables mmap for struct array in MemVectorIndex, adds caching layer for TextMatchIndex, optimizes bitmap reverse lookup, updates Knowhere, removes logical usage checks during segment loading, adds access log field for template value length, allows overwriting current index type, adds load parameters for vector index, unifies compaction executor task state, adds refined logs for task scheduler, ensures accesslog consistency level, and removes redundant channel manager. Bug fixes include GCC removal for CVE, deterministic search result ordering, rerank before requery, promise fulfillment on exception, and missing disk encryption config.

chunks.title: milvus-2.5.21
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.5.21, the project addresses critical security vulnerability CVE-2025-64513, supports nullable fields as BM25 function input, optimizes bitmap reverse lookup, implements rewatch mechanism for etcd failures, introduces sparse filter in query, and adds accesslog field for template value length info. Bug fixes avoid race conditions in executor update, skip tmp dir for growing r-tree index, fix sort stats task failure during compaction, support skip load json stats when disabled, prevent data race in querycoord collection notifier, handle empty fieldsdata in reduce/rerank, fix gis function geometry filter, fix geometry return point(0 0) with growing mmap, remove deduplicate limit when autoindex disabled, ensure deterministic search result ordering, fix deactivate balance checker stopping balance, fix dropped segment excluded ts, and avoid concurrent reset/add on datacoord metrics.

chunks.title: milvus-2.4.24
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.4.24, the project addresses critical security vulnerability CVE-2025-64513, supports deny DDL according to database property, adds DDL rate type and quota configurations, skips check source id, improves sparse query nnz metric, makes segment prune config refreshable, removes unnecessary collection and partition labels from metrics, and improves import error messages. Bug fixes include getting all children deltalogs for segment load, L0 bringing its own start pos when syncing, fixing compare move_cursor bug, fixing exception on arith expr with index, not deleting centroids file on sampling failure, RBAC star privilege returning empty, fixing parsing import endts, and improving error handling for initmetacache.

chunks.title: milvus-2.6.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.6.5, the project addresses critical security vulnerability CVE-2025-64513, upgrades to Go 1.24.9, skips check source id, and fixes bugs including group value nil, timestamp range initialization in composite binlog writer, empty fieldsdata in reduce/rerank, null check for packed_writer in jsonstatsparquetwrite, skipping text index for newly added columns, accidentally ignored sealed segments in l0 compaction, moving finishload before text index creation, supporting json default value in compaction, and updating milvus-storage to fix duplicate aws sdk initialization.

chunks.title: milvus-2.5.22
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.5.22, the project addresses a potential data loss issue and fixes target segment marked dropped for save stats result twice and filter geometry for growing with mmap.

chunks.title: milvus-2.5.23
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.5.23, the project optimizes term expr performance and fixes bugs including preventing close from hanging on etcd reconnection, preventing deadlock in runcomponent when prepare fails, and fixing infinite loop in resourcemanager recovery process.

chunks.title: milvus-2.6.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.6.6, the project introduces Geospatial data type with spatial operators and RTREE index, Timestamptz data type with timezone awareness, Boost ranker for rescoring, STL_SORT index support for VARCHAR and TIMESTAMPTZ, and enabling dynamic field on existing collections. Improvements include new config and dynamic update configs, fixing CVE-2025-63811, removing large segment id arrays from logs, optimizing expr copying, optimizing term expr, prefetching vector chunks for sealed non-indexed segments, prefetching chunks once, adding nullable support for geometry and timestamptz, increasing session ttl, adding DDL framework metrics, updating maxconnections config, and skipping check source id.

chunks.title: milvus-2.6.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.6.7, the project adds /livez endpoint for Kubernetes liveness probes, GroupBy support on TIMESTAMPZ fields, mmap for JSON shredding shared key indices, DML request forwarding in Proxy, upgrades etcd to v3.5.23, adds robust error handling for etcd crashes, reduces etcd load by removing expensive watchers, enhances WAL retention strategy, supports asynchronous write syncing for logs, enforces Buffered I/O for high-priority load tasks, optimizes mmap strategy, improves memory estimation for JSON shredding, refines segment load estimation, adds granular cancellation checks in query operators, and removes redundant resource type checks. chunks.title: milvus-2.6.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.6.8, the project introduces search with highlighter, moves query optimization logic to Proxy, optimizes LIKE operator with STL sort, enables concurrent text index tasks, supports pausing GC at collection level, implements penalty policy for QueryNodes, optimizes data caching, reduces CPU usage in QuotaCenter, improves TIMESTAMPTZ comparison, supports nullable dynamic fields with empty JSON default, prevents unnecessary segment sealing on property alter, supports DML/DQL forwarding in Proxy for RESTful v2, adds retry for object storage reads on rate limit errors, enhances logging, adds validation for embedding models and schema field types, introduces tolerance duration for collection drop, improves index task scheduling, adds fallback for write paths without condition write support, optimizes IDF oracle synchronization, changes RootCoord default port, adds metrics for Jemalloc cached memory, improves disk quota metric accuracy, and improves trace observability for scalar expressions.

chunks.title: milvus-2.5.25

chunks.title: milvus-2.6.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.6.9, the project supports searching by primary keys, adds storage version label metric, supports segment reopen on manifest path change and data/schema changes, improves slow log performance, adds storage version upgrade compaction policy, eliminates extra memory copy for C++ logging, adds security controls for /expr endpoint, keeps streaming service enabled until required node count, removes redundant etcd put operations, improves row count validation, cleans up build index logs, limits concurrent vector index builds, optimizes jieba and lindera analyzer cloning, adds glog sink for unified logging, enforces storage V2 format, implements batch ngram operations, adds automatic retry for binlog writes, filters empty timetick messages, improves search by primary key with duplicate checking, and adds dimension parameter support for siliconflow and cohere embedding providers.

chunks.title: milvus-2.5.26
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.5.26, the project adds security controls for /expr endpoint, upgrades pulsar-client-go to v0.17.0, adds gRPC metadata header for client request time tracking, and fixes L0 growing segment data forwarding, Azure blob storage precheck configuration, and geometry data conversion inconsistencies.

chunks.title: milvus-2.6.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.6.10, the project addresses CVE-2026-26190, adds support to stop WAL consumption on KMS key revocation, updates default auto-index config, disables storage-version upgrade compaction by default, adds automatic FP32-to-FP16/BF16 conversion in search, limits segment load concurrency, adds map_populate flag for mmap, persists BM25 stats to disk, adds loading timeout and cancellation, allows alter_collection_field to update field description, adds target manager to ReplicaObserver, updates Knowhere, adds BM25 search_by_pk, extracts assign policy from balancer, prevents import job state rollback, and improves slow logs. Bug fixes include incorrect group results during pagination, boundary validation for threadpool resize, improved error message handling, preventing coredumps, reverting compaction change, preventing crashes on division/modulo by zero, aligning timestamptz field type, and additional fixes.

chunks.title: milvus-2.5.27
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.5.27, the project fixes CVE-2026-26190, upgrades Go to 1.24.12 and dependencies, fixes imported segment positions to use actual data timestamps, and adds authentication to metrics endpoint when authorization is enabled.

chunks.title: milvus-2.6.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.6.11, the project adds a truncate API, uses PreparedGeometry for geo index refinement, switches OpenSSL to shared linking, differentiates load priorities, upgrades Go to 1.24.12 and gpgv, reduces memory usage with multi-cell DefaultValueChunk, applies load-diff based segment loading patches, removes redundant bitset count operations, adds semantic highlighting for dynamic fields, reduces unnecessary PinWrapper copies, normalizes constant-folded boolean expressions, adds RESTful search_by_pk, optimizes latest delete snapshot handling, adds user-specified warmup settings, adds LoadWithStrategyAsync for I/O pipelining, optimizes MixCoord CPU/memory, adds sparse filtering in search, and reduces memory allocations during data loading. chunks.title: milvus-2.6.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.6.12, the project adds GetReplicateConfiguration API, configurable TLS minimum version for object storage, independent replica numbers on secondary CDC cluster, pchannel count increase in CDC, automatic warmup for large tenant collections, and user-specified warmup for RESTful API. Improvements include caching layer resource management for streaming node, optimized query node segment load speed, optimized MixCoord CPU usage, phase-level timing logs for sort compaction, refactored cluster-level broadcast, configurable skip list for replicate message types, text index memory cost in segment loading estimation, per-cluster TLS for CDC, bypassed broadcaster for resource group DDL on non-primary clusters, and bumped OpenTelemetry to v1.40.0. Bug fixes address collection-level rate limits, memory accumulation during segment loading, streaming node crash-loop, memory accumulation in compaction, and additional issues.

chunks.title: milvus-2.6.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the milvus-io/milvus release v2.6.13, the project adds Gemini embedding model support, unifies KV path/key conventions, adds query metrics for JSON filter expressions, reduces transient memory allocations in BM25Stats deserialization, and adds TruncateCollection method to Go SDK. chunks.title: milvus-2.6.14

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent moby/moby release stream across core Docker Engine releases and related API/client artifacts, covering security fixes, networking improvements, new features like NRI support and rootless gvisor-tap-vsock driver, and packaging updates.

chunks.title: v29.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.1.0 (tag: docker-v29.1.0), the release includes packaging updates to BuildKit v0.26.1 and containerd v2.2.0, networking fixes such as preserving user-modified /etc/resolv.conf across container restarts, fixing --publish-all for Windows containers, fixing container restart or network reconnection when gateway configuration fails, and correcting IPv6-mapped IPv4 address display in port mappings for Windows containers.

chunks.title: v29.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.1.1 (tag: docker-v29.1.1), the release reverts a PR that broke external DNS resolution on all custom bridge networks.

chunks.title: v29.1.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.1.2 (tag: docker-v29.1.2), the release updates Go runtime to 1.25.5, fixes potential DoS via excessive resource usage when formatting hostname validation errors (CVE-2025-61729), fixes incorrect enforcement of excluded subdomain constraints for wildcard SANs (CVE-2025-61727), fixes containerd image store image inspect when not all blobs are available locally, fixes dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh nsenter error, fixes docker system df showing N/A for shared/unique size with graph-drivers, updates runc to v1.3.4, fixes port mappings in rootless mode with slirp4netns, and prevents crash when making API request with PublishAllPorts and no port bindings.

chunks.title: v29.1.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.1.3 (tag: docker-v29.1.3), the release adds shell completion for docker stack deploy --compose-file, fixes containerd image store ignoring unpack image exporter option, fixes docker image ls dangling image handling, fixes engine leaving autoremove containers in dead state on shutdown, fixes build on i386, fixes explicit graphdriver configuration being treated as containerd snapshotter, fixes potential creation of orphaned overlay2 layers, allows container creation with specific IP when networks lack specific subnet, prevents crash when starting container with PublishAll and nil PortBindings, fixes DNS resolution of containers on non-swarm networks after joining swarm, fixes daemon crash with remote network driver plugin, fixes endpoint not found error with multiple network connections, fixes rootless Docker start with IPv6 disabled, and returns error for port-mapping to container port 0.

chunks.title: v29.2.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.2.0-rc.1 (tag: docker-v29.2.0-rc.1), the release adds NRI section to docker info, adds experimental NRI support, updates BuildKit to v0.26.3, considers XDG_CONFIG_HOME/cdi and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/cdi for CDI devices in rootless mode, and natively supports gRPC on the listening socket.

chunks.title: v29.1.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.1.4 (tag: docker-v29.1.4), the release fixes docker run --network none panic on Windows, fixes image mounts failing with file name too long, fixes potential creation of orphaned overlay2 layers, and updates BuildKit to v0.26.3.

chunks.title: v29.1.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.1.5 (tag: docker-v29.1.5), the release updates Go runtime to 1.25.6 and fixes a regression where established network connections could be disrupted during a container's shutdown grace period.

chunks.title: v29.2.0-rc.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.2.0-rc.2 (tag: docker-v29.2.0-rc.2), the release adds NRI field to GET /info, adds Identity field to inspect endpoint for trusted origin information, improves validation of --detach-keys, prevents potential panic on daemon shutdown after incomplete initialization, removes restriction on anonymous read-only volumes, updates BuildKit to v0.27.0-rc2, updates containerd to v2.2.1, updates RootlessKit to v2.3.6, adds WithAPIClientOptions option to cli/command, and removes %PROGRAMDATA%\Docker\cli-plugins from CLI plugin paths on Windows.

chunks.title: api/v1.53.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release api/v1.53.0 (tag: api/v1.53.0), the release adds NRI field to GET /info, adds Identity field to inspect endpoint, supports application/jsonl for GET /events, explicitly rejects multiple AuthConfig values, fixes empty fields not being omitted in API responses, updates MaxAPIVersion to 1.53, and deprecates POST /grpc and POST /sessions.

chunks.title: client/v0.2.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release client/v0.2.2 (tag: client/v0.2.2), the release supports application/jsonl for GET /events, copies http.Client instead of mutating in-place, updates MaxAPIVersion to 1.53, and deprecates Since, Before, and Latest fields in ContainerListOptions.

chunks.title: v29.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.2.0 (tag: docker-v29.2.0), the release adds NRI section to docker info, adds experimental NRI support, adds Identity field to inspect endpoint, improves validation of --detach-keys, prevents potential panic on daemon shutdown after incomplete initialization, removes restriction on anonymous read-only volumes, adds --validate flag to dockerd for system requirements check, handles --gpus requests for NVIDIA devices using CDI, updates BuildKit to v0.27.0, updates containerd to v2.2.1, considers XDG_CONFIG_HOME/cdi and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/cdi for CDI devices in rootless mode, updates RootlessKit to v2.3.6, natively supports gRPC on the listening socket, adds WithAPIClientOptions option to cli/command, and removes %PROGRAMDATA%\Docker\cli-plugins from CLI plugin paths on Windows.

chunks.title: v29.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.2.1 (tag: docker-v29.2.1), the release updates BuildKit to v0.27.1, fixes docker system df failing when run concurrently with docker system prune, fixes daemon handling of duplicate container exit events, fixes panic after failed daemon initialization, fixes encrypted overlay networks not passing traffic to containers on older engines, and fixes potential panic on docker network prune.

chunks.title: v29.3.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.3.0-rc.1 (tag: docker-v29.3.0-rc.1), the release updates BuildKit to v0.28.0-rc2, adds sd_notify RELOADING notifications and support for systemd Type=notify-reload, stops logging warnings for stopped containers during startup, fixes docker system prune failing with rw layer snapshot not found, fixes panic on docker top for non-running Windows container, fixes regression preventing dockerd service registration on Windows without system requirements, fixes spurious ShouldRestart failed warning on shutdown, prevents logging not found warnings for volume sizes, sends sd_notify READY and STOPPING synchronously, updates Go runtime to 1.25.7, and fixes DNS config corruption on daemon reload.

chunks.title: api/v1.54.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release api/v1.54.0 (tag: api/v1.54.0), the release adds identity query parameter to GET /images/json, adds Compare method to PortConfig, documents platform param for GET /image/{name}/json, fixes swagger return value for /system/df, adds MediaType pseudo-type, and adds sanity-check and nil-Error prevention to jsonstream.

chunks.title: client/v0.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release client/v0.3.0 (tag: client/v0.3.0), the release adds Identity field to ImageListOptions, lowers minimum API version to v1.40, and changes DisplayJSONMessages to accept iter.Seq2.

chunks.title: v29.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.3.0 (tag: docker-v29.3.0), the release adds bind-create-src option to --mount, fires CLI plugin hooks on command failure, lowers minimum API version to v1.40, updates BuildKit to v0.28.0, fixes DNS config corruption on daemon reload, applies MacAddress field in POST /networks/{id}/connect, adds identity query parameter to GET /images/json, uses CDI-based injection for AMD GPUs with --gpus, adds sd_notify RELOADING and support for systemd Type=notify-reload, sends sd_notify READY and STOPPING synchronously, stops logging warnings for stopped containers during startup, fixes docker system prune rw layer snapshot not found, fixes panic on docker top for non-running Windows container, fixes regression preventing dockerd service registration on Windows, fixes shared mount detection for paths mounted multiple times, fixes spurious ShouldRestart failed warning, preserves leading/trailing whitespace in registry passwords, prevents logging not found warnings for volume sizes, and updates Go runtime to 1.25.7.

chunks.title: v29.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.3.1 (tag: docker-v29.3.1), the release fixes authorization bypass in AuthZ plugins (CVE-2026-34040), fixes privilege validation bypass in docker plugin install (CVE-2026-33997), fixes insufficient validation of Git URL fragments in BuildKit (CVE-2026-33748), fixes vulnerability in BuildKit allowing files to be written outside state directory (CVE-2026-33747), fixes daemon crash during docker build with invalid .dockerignore pattern, fixes panic when containerd client uses closed stream, updates containerd to v2.2.2, updates Go runtime to 1.25.8, and adds missing build-tag for cli/command package.

chunks.title: api/v1.54.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release api/v1.54.1 (tag: api/v1.54.1), the release adds Port.Port() method, adds go:fix inline directives to deprecated functions, removes patch version from go.mod, and fixes handling of unmapped ports.

chunks.title: client/v0.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release client/v0.4.0 (tag: client/v0.4.0), the release adds go:fix inline directives, adds DisplayStream and DisplayMessages utils, uses functional options for display funcs, prevents panic when passing nil Opts to client.New, sets default User-Agent, fixes /system/df reporting in-use images as reclaimable, and detects duplicate headers in WithHTTPHeaders.

chunks.title: v29.4.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.4.0-rc.1 (tag: docker-v29.4.0-rc.1), the release reports both content size and transferred size in docker cp, fixes docker stats --all showing removed containers, fixes rare bug causing containers to become unremovable, fixes privileged containers losing explicit AppArmor profile after restart, improves duplicate container-exit handling using live containerd task state, improves image pull/push performance with HTTP keep-alive, adds shell completion for docker rm --link and excludes legacy links, prevents providing already used completions, updates runc to v1.3.5, fixes DOCKER_TMPDIR not being respected on Windows, updates BuildKit to v0.29.0, and prevents daemon crash during startup with malformed IP-address in container config.

chunks.title: v29.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.4.0 (tag: docker-v29.4.0), the release reports both content size and transferred size in docker cp, fixes docker stats --all showing removed containers, fixes rare bug causing containers to become unremovable, fixes privileged containers losing explicit AppArmor profile after restart, improves duplicate container-exit handling using live containerd task state, improves image pull/push performance with HTTP keep-alive, adds shell completion for docker rm --link and excludes legacy links, prevents providing already used completions, updates runc to v1.3.5, fixes DOCKER_TMPDIR not being respected on Windows, updates BuildKit to v0.29.0, prevents daemon crash during startup with malformed IP-address, preserves original os.File in cli/streams, updates minimum go version to go1.25, and deprecates HookMessage, HookType, and HookPluginData in Go SDK.

chunks.title: api/v1.54.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release api/v1.54.2 (tag: api/v1.54.2), the release cleans up changelog, lowers deprecation heading to h4, restores API docs and changelogs for v1.0-v1.23, and aligns Topology swagger with Segments JSON shape.

chunks.title: client/v0.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release client/v0.4.1 (tag: client/v0.4.1), the release fixes ImagePullResponse.Wait and ImagePushResponse.Wait not returning errors, explicitly excludes -1 for containers in diskUsage, adds back replace rules in go.mod, vendors docker/go-connections v0.7.0, and vendors moby/moby/api v1.54.2.

chunks.title: v29.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.4.1 (tag: docker-v29.4.1), the release fixes docker image prune --filter label!=key=value incorrectly skipping images, fixes --log-opt tag={{.ImageID}} not stripping digest algorithm, fixes intermittent container start failures on busy Swarm nodes by retrying read-only remount, updates containerd to v2.2.3, updates Go runtime to 1.26.2, and uses single stack endpoint as default gateway for its address family when it has higher priority than a dual stack endpoint.

chunks.title: v29.4.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.4.2 (tag: docker-v29.4.2), the release hardens against CVE-2026-31431 by blocking AF_ALG sockets and socketcall(2) multiplexer in the default seccomp profile, with known issues breaking 32-bit programs and i386 images, and provides a workaround using seccomp/v0.2.1 profile from moby/profiles.

chunks.title: v29.4.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.4.3 (tag: docker-v29.4.3), the release fixes the 29.4.2 regression that broke 32-bit programs and i386 images by replacing the broad socketcall(2) seccomp deny with targeted AppArmor and SELinux rules blocking AF_ALG, and fixes the default AppArmor profile not being updated on daemon restart.

chunks.title: v29.5.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.5.0-rc.1 (tag: docker-v29.5.0-rc.1), the release enables private time namespace for containers by default, adds custom attributes support to local logging driver, supports Unix socket listening on Windows, fixes denial of service from maliciously crafted sparse tar archives (CVE-2026-32288), adds time-namespaces feature flag, signifies daemon reload completion in events, exposes userland proxy diagnostic data in docker info, fixes docker image ls --filter reference to match fully qualified names, fixes orphaned state after leaving autolock-enabled swarm, fixes logging errors showing empty strings, fixes incorrect SHARED SIZE and UNIQUE SIZE in docker system df -v, fixes volume subpath file mounts over existing file, sorts labels in volume/network/config/secret formatters, prevents corruption of Raft snapshots in large swarm state, updates BuildKit to v0.30.0-rc1, updates Go runtime to 1.26.3, fixes conntrack entries incorrectly deleted for UDP containers, fixes userland proxy silently dropping UDP datagrams, and properly supports --net=host and localhost registries in rootless mode.

chunks.title: v29.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.5.0 (tag: docker-v29.5.0), the release adds new default gvisor-tap-vsock rootless network driver, enables private time namespace for containers by default, adds custom attributes support to local logging driver, supports Unix socket listening on Windows, fixes denial of service from maliciously crafted sparse tar archives (CVE-2026-32288), adds .HealthStatus placeholder to docker ps --format, adds time-namespaces feature flag, fixes containerd auth token requests ignoring per-host TLS settings, signifies daemon reload completion in events, exposes userland proxy diagnostic data in docker info, fixes docker image ls --filter reference to match fully qualified names, fixes orphaned state after leaving autolock-enabled swarm, fixes logging errors showing empty strings, fixes incorrect SHARED SIZE and UNIQUE SIZE in docker system df -v, fixes support for CDI specifications requesting additional group IDs, fixes volume subpath file mounts over existing file, sorts labels in volume/network/config/secret formatters, prevents corruption of Raft snapshots in large swarm state, updates BuildKit to v0.30.0, and updates Go runtime to 1.26.3.

chunks.title: v29.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.5.1 (tag: docker-v29.5.1), the release fixes a vulnerability in docker cp where archive decompression binaries were resolved via PATH inside the container filesystem (CVE-2026-41567), fixes a TOCTOU vulnerability in docker cp allowing creation of files/directories at arbitrary host locations (CVE-2026-41568), fixes a TOCTOU vulnerability in docker cp allowing redirect of bind mount to arbitrary host location (CVE-2026-42306), and fixes UDP conntrack entries not being deleted when not bound to a specific IP address.

chunks.title: v29.5.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the moby/moby release v29.5.2 (tag: docker-v29.5.2), the release fixes docker cp failing with mkdirat: file exists when a container has a bind mount whose target traverses an in-container symlink.

The highlighted new features include improved JPEG 2000 decoding support (the OpenJPEG decoder was moved into a separate .wasm file, requiring a new wasmUrl API option; a slower JavaScript OpenJPEG fallback decoder was added for environments without WebAssembly support), support for ICC profiles (requiring WebAssembly support and the wasmUrl API option; an ICC profile to improve CMYK to RGB color conversion, requiring a new iccUrl API option; currently Lab profiles are not supported), improved rendering of large pages in the viewer (render the currently visible portion of pages at full resolution once size limits are reached and falling back to CSS-zooming; limit the maximum canvas dimensions to avoid rendering breaking and empty canvases), and enable creation of hyperlinks in the viewer from text that look like URLs (disabled by default due to remaining issues, can be enabled with the enableAutoLinking option/preference). Significant changes that may require updates in third-party implementations include addition of new CSS variables that the text and annotation layers depend upon, and removal of a couple of old exceptions.

chunks.title: v0.20.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mpv-player/mpv release v0.20.0, the project adds --video-unscaled=downscale-big, --image-display-duration, and a dcomposition flag for DirectComposition. chunks.title: v0.21.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mpv-player/mpv release v0.21.0, the project adds CUDA/NvDecode hwdec, teletext support, load-script and apply-profile commands, and a pseudo-gui mode. It deprecates ao/vo auto-profiles and vo_rpi, renames subtitle options, and changes osc defaults to bottombar with bar seekbarstyle.

chunks.title: v0.22.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mpv-player/mpv release v0.22.0, the project adds AudioUnit output for iOS, Matroska colorimetry parsing, tukey window, seekbarstyle=knob, tct terminal output, and --hwdec=vdpau-copy. It deprecates vf_vdpaurb and includes fixes for osc crashes, autofit, and hardware decoding.

chunks.title: v0.23.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mpv-player/mpv release v0.23.0, the project requires FFmpeg 3.2.2, partially undeprecates vo_rpi, adds P016 output surface support, and removes enca/libguess in favor of uchardet. It removes vf_vdpaurb and deprecated sub-option handling for --vo/--ao, with fixes for Windows styles, audio, and macOS fullscreen.

chunks.title: v0.24.0

chunks.title: v0.25.0

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent mui/material-ui release stream from v5.18.0 through v9.0.1, including major, minor, and patch releases, as well as alpha and beta pre-releases. It covers new features like Tailwind CSS v4 support, nativeColor, modular CSS layers, and the stable v9.0 release with accessibility improvements and deprecated API cleanup.

chunks.title: v7.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.0.2, the Autocomplete component gains the ability to render a custom single value and prevents shrink animation in controlled mode when an initial value is provided. The AvatarGroup fixes the spacing prop to accept value 0. The Dialog component deprecates composed classes. The material-nextjs package fixes nonce issues and adds warnings to the Next.js router integration. The styled-engine adds caching to StyledEngineProvider to improve Jest test performance. Various core, docs, and infrastructure improvements are included.

chunks.title: v6.4.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v6.4.11, the AvatarGroup fixes the spacing prop to accept value 0. The Dialog component deprecates composed classes. The styled-engine adds caching to improve Jest test performance. Docs add a v7 banner and fix lab version install instructions.

chunks.title: v7.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.1.0, Material UI now works with Tailwind CSS v4. The InputBase fixes a text cursor jump when inserting text fragments with new lines. The OutlinedInput adds a missing notchedOutline slot. The Snackbar skips default onClickAway when defaultMuiPrevented is provided. The Avatar fixes img slot types and adds missing slots. The Badge, BottomNavigationAction, and CardActionArea components add slots and slotProps. The useMediaQuery hook adds a warning for print usage. The material-nextjs package adds an option to enable CSS layers for pages router and fixes @layer order rules in App Router. The system package fixes types organization. The styled-engine infers ownerState from props in styled and fixes style overrides variants type. Docs include various updates and a Tailwind CSS v4 integration guide.

chunks.title: v6.4.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v6.4.12, the Badge, BottomNavigationAction, and CardActionArea components replace useSlotProps with useSlot hook and add slots and slotProps. The OutlinedInput adds a missing notchedOutline slot. The useMediaQuery hook adds a warning for print usage. A theme object changes between renders fix is applied. The material-nextjs package fixes @layer order rules in App Router. The system package skips styled component transformation. Docs include various updates and migration guide improvements.

chunks.title: v7.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.1.1, the Autocomplete fixes label shrink when renderValue is used with an empty array in multiple mode, prevents renderValue from being skipped when value is 0, and adds a JSDoc note for non-TextField components. The Chip adds slots and slotProps. The Menu removes deprecated MenuListProps from demos. The TablePaginationActions is exported as a new component. The SnackbarContent fixes the square prop and an error when theme value is a CSS variable. The codemod package adds a package name option. The system package skips styled component transformation and updates the borderRadius type. The styled-engine fixes variant props callback type to spread ownerState. The stylis-plugin-rtl fixes RTL with CSS layer via a new package. Docs include various updates and migration guide improvements.

chunks.title: v7.1.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.1.2, the Chip fixes handling of event handlers. Docs fix the fade modal demo.

chunks.title: v7.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.2.0, a modularCssLayers theme option is added for splitting styles into multiple CSS layers. An example for using Material UI with React Router v7 is provided. The Backdrop fixes handling of the component prop. The Chip explicitly defines line-height and fixes event handler handling. The OutlinedInput and Input deprecate composed classes. The Select passes MenuProps.slotProps.list alongside MenuListProps. Romanian locale translation is enabled for labelDisplayedRows. The system package adds the modularCssLayers theme flag. The styled-engine avoids reusing the emotion cache across SSR requests. The codemod adds a Dialog codemod for deprecated props. Docs include various updates and a new example.

chunks.title: v5.18.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v5.18.0, CSS layers are backported from v7 to the system and material-nextjs packages, making it easier to override styles by splitting a single style sheet into multiple layers. Docs ease migration to v5 and add AccordionSummary to the breaking change migration.

chunks.title: v6.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v6.5.0, CSS layers are backported from v7 to the system and material-nextjs packages. The Dialog adds a codemod for deprecated props. Docs add ListItemButton to clarify deprecation.

chunks.title: v7.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.3.0, the nativeColor feature is shipped, eliminating JS color manipulation and unlocking support for all modern color spaces. The Accordion adds a region slot. The SpeedDial fixes arrow key navigation when slotProps.fab is defined. The Select improves MenuProps.slotProps implementation and implements pointer cancellation. The Switch adds role="switch". The Autocomplete fixes auto highlight when options change but not length. The codemod fixes the v5.0.0/top-level-imports codemod changing color imports. Docs include various updates and a new dashboard with CRUD template.

chunks.title: v7.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.3.1, the PaginationItem fixes inheritance of the component prop. The Select reverts the pointer cancellation implementation.

chunks.title: v7.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.3.2, the Chip removes unnecessary optional chaining from key event handlers. The Drawer adds dialog role and aria-modal for the temporary variant. The PaginationItem adds slot descriptions and default components in API documentation. The utils remove a duplicate isHostComponent function. The codemod adds a codemod to convert top-level to path imports. Docs include various updates and typo fixes.

chunks.title: v7.3.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.3.3, the Autocomplete syncs highlighted index when the popup opens. The CircularProgress adds a track slot via enableTrackSlot. The locale splits locales into separate files. The Tabs fixes not scrolling to the correct tab after refresh when auto scrollable. Docs add a guide for building extensible themes and a v7 community course resource.

chunks.title: v7.3.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.3.4, the Tabs reverts a fix that broke the component. The lab package is brought back to an unstable version. Docs sort package manager automatically. Core fixes a cyclic dependency between ThemeOptions and createTheme.

chunks.title: v7.3.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.3.5, the Collapse adds slots and slotProps. The Catalan locale is added. A regression on theme.vars.shape module augmentation is fixed. The material-nextjs package supports Next.js 16. Docs include various updates and demo fixes.

chunks.title: v7.3.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.3.6, the Accordion moves properties to AccordionOwnProps. The Autocomplete removes an unnecessary dependency, fixes input caret not showing after chip navigation, and fixes an ArrowLeft crash. The Button fixes running formAction when passed. The Chip removes a leftover closing parenthesis in CSS class key. The ListItem adds a secondaryAction slot. The NumberField fixes scroll behavior. The Select fixes keyboard navigation in shadow DOM and passing certain event handlers. The Slider accepts readonly array for marks. The Snackbar avoids unnecessary ownerState spread. The TextField allows custom props in slot props via TS module augmentation. The Tabs fixes Arrow key navigation in shadow DOM. Theme typings for applyStyles with custom color schemes are fixed. The system package fixes an unwanted attribute on DOM from InitColorSchemeScript. The lab package fixes Masonry layout flicker and single column issue. Docs include various updates and a new Number Field component page.

chunks.title: v7.3.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.3.7, the Accordion removes unnecessary handling of the square prop. The Alert removes unnecessary default icon mapping fallback. The AppBar fixes inherit color CSS variable not getting applied. The Autocomplete fixes ArrowLeft, Backspace, and Delete behavior for multiple and single-value rendering with proper caret handling. The Backdrop removes unnecessary passing of classes from root slot. The ButtonGroup fixes styles when variant is contained. The CardActionArea removes incorrect root ref forwarding. The Checkbox fixes readonly checkboxes. The ClickAwayListener tightens the parameter type of createHandleSynthetic. The Dialog fixes backdrop theme style overrides. The FocusTrap computes activeElement inside loopFocus on every keydown. The Modal takes non-integer padding-right into consideration when scroll locking. The Select fixes dropdown width not matching trigger width on window resize. The Tabs fixes passing incorrect slot name props. Docs include various updates and enable MUI chat on demos.

chunks.title: v7.3.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.3.8, the Alert reverts removing default icon mapping fallback. The AppBar fixes optional chaining in joinVars function. The Autocomplete fixes scroll position resetting on reopen with disableCloseOnSelect and passes fullWidth prop to input with default true. The Badge refactors variant styles generation. The Chip removes unnecessary onDelete check. The Switch, Checkbox, and Radio remove aria-disabled from root span. The Collapse removes unnecessary string concatenation. The Drawer persistent and permanent variants should not override styles via theme using modal class. The Tabs adds ability to extend Tabs variant. The useAutocomplete adds aria-multiselectable to listbox props when multiple is true and uses React.Key instead of any for key prop. Docs include various updates and a company update blog post.

chunks.title: v9.0.0-alpha.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui pre-release v9.0.0-alpha.0, the theme generates color-mix value on top of default generated Material UI CSS variables. Docs make tooltips describe their visible text triggers and fix nativeColor docs. Core prepares libraries for the first v9 alpha release.

chunks.title: v9.0.0-alpha.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui pre-release v9.0.0-alpha.1, breaking changes include preventing Autocomplete menu from opening on right click, removing aria-hidden by default from Backdrop, ensuring onClick propagates for non-native ButtonBase, removing disableEscapeKeyDown from Dialog and Modal, removing system props support from Grid, removing MuiTouchRipple from theme component types, and improving isOptionEqualToValue value argument type in useAutocomplete. Changes include applying alpha before color mixing to border bottom color in TableCell when nativeColor and cssVariables are used, and fixing a Tooltip error when wrapping a disabled focused input. Docs include various updates and a blog post for upcoming MUI X price changes.

chunks.title: v9.0.0-alpha.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui pre-release v9.0.0-alpha.2, duplicated CSS rules are cleaned up. The system package refactors sortContainerQueries to define regex outside the sort function. Docs move shared components to the @mui/docs package and fix a typo in the NumberField page.

chunks.title: v7.3.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.3.9, duplicated CSS rules are cleaned up. The theme generates color-mix value on top of default generated Material UI CSS variables. The Tooltip fixes an error when wrapping a disabled focused input. The TableCell applies alpha before color mixing to border bottom color when nativeColor and cssVariables are used. Docs include various updates and fixes.

chunks.title: v9.0.0-alpha.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui pre-release v9.0.0-alpha.3, a new Menubar component page is added. Accessibility is improved for Stepper, Tabs, and MenuList with Roving TabIndex keyboard navigation. Breaking changes include accessibility improvements for Stepper, MenuList, and Tabs. The Autocomplete adds a root slot, fixes popup reopening on window focus regain with openOnFocus, and supports full slots for clearIndicator and popupIndicator. A partial revert of duplicated CSS rules cleanup is done. Docs add v7 migration docs for deprecated Autocomplete APIs and a Menubar component page.

chunks.title: v9.0.0-alpha.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui pre-release v9.0.0-alpha.4, numerous deprecated props and CSS classes are removed across many components including Accordion, Alert, Autocomplete, Avatar, AvatarGroup, Backdrop, Badge, Button, CircularProgress, Divider, FormControlLabel, Menu, MobileStepper, Popover, Popper, Select, Slider, SpeedDial, SpeedDialAction, Tabs, TextField, Tooltip, and Typography. The ButtonBase key handlers should not run on a disabled non-native button. The TablePagination formats pagination numbers according to locale. The TextField uses a non-native label for select. Changes include optimizing selected option lookup in Autocomplete and fixing native button detection in ButtonBase.

chunks.title: v9.0.0-beta.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui pre-release v9.0.0-beta.0, more deprecated props and CSS classes are removed from LinearProgress, ListItem, ListItemText, ButtonGroup, Card, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Chip, Dialog, Modal, Drawer, SwipeableDrawer, Divider, ImageListItemBar, Inputs, PaginationItem, Rating, Select, Slider, StepConnector, StepContent, StepLabel, Tabs, Tab, TablePagination, TableSortLabel, and ToggleButtonGroup. Unnecessary overridesResolvers are removed from styled components. Deprecated system props are removed from Box, Stack, and Typography. The system package improves performance when using the sx prop. The codemod adds missing codemod links in the upgrade guide.

chunks.title: v9.0.0-beta.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui pre-release v9.0.0-beta.1, breaking changes include removing 'column' and 'column-reverse' options from Grid direction prop, removing legacy Outline icons, and using theme spacing instead of hardcoded minWidth for ListItemIcon. Changes include fixing slotProps.transition types across all components, accessibility improvements for Alert and Dialog, fixing Autocomplete helper text focusing input, adding a nativeButton prop to ButtonBase, fixing high contrast cutoff on first character in Input, fixing empty roving focus container in Menu, and explicitly registering roving tab items with parent in utils. Docs fix HTML validation errors and update the upgrade guide.

chunks.title: v7.3.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.3.10, the Menubar component page is added to docs. Accessibility improvements are made to Alert and Dialog. The Autocomplete adds a root slot, fixes helper text focusing input, fixes popup reopening on window focus regain with openOnFocus, optimizes selected option lookup, and supports full slots for clearIndicator and popupIndicator. The ButtonBase fixes native button detection. The Input fixes high contrast cutoff on first character. The ListItemText and CardHeader revert cleanup of duplicated CSS rules. The Popper adds missing classes export. The Select fixes focus visible always set on menu item. The Slider accepts readonly array for the value prop. The Switch adds border for high contrast mode. The theme avoids creating channel tokens for custom colors when nativeColor is used. Transitions get performance improvements and misc fixes. Docs add v7 migration docs for deprecated Autocomplete APIs and a Menubar component page.

chunks.title: v9.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui stable release v9.0.0, the focus is on accessibility improvements, sx prop performance, and cleanup of deprecated APIs. The Slider uses pointer events instead of mouse events. The Switch adds border for high contrast mode. Transitions get performance improvements and misc fixes. Unnecessary overridesResolvers are removed from styled components. Core sets up workflow to publish internal packages and prepares libraries for v9 stable release.

chunks.title: v7.3.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v7.3.11, the Autocomplete fixes highlight sync and scroll preservation, popper rendering issues, and improves highlight tracking and selection state. The Button fixes startIcon alignment and removes duplicated className entries. The Checkbox sets aria-checked=mixed when indeterminate. The Dialog, Drawer, and FocusTrap fix initial focus target. The Drawer fixes transition jump. The Input fixes layout shift with display: flex. The Inputs fix autofocus in SSR environment. The Popper persists positioning styles when popperOptions changes reference. The Switch fixes incorrect role with slotProps.input. The utils add shadow dom utils. Docs update banner to announce v9 and add v9 in the versions select.

chunks.title: v9.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the mui/material-ui release v9.0.1, high contrast mode is improved on Avatar, Badge, Slider, and Switch. The Autocomplete fixes highlight sync and scroll preservation, input value and clear, iOS group scrollbar overflow, popper rendering issues, and improves highlight tracking and selection state. The Button fixes startIcon alignment and documents the type attribute. Duplicated className entries are removed from Button, Fab, MenuItem, and ListItemButton. The Checkbox sets aria-checked=mixed when indeterminate. CircularProgress and LinearProgress improve accessibility. Dialog, Drawer, and FocusTrap fix initial focus target. The Drawer fixes swipe close flicker and transition jump. The FocusTrap removes an IE 11-specific focus safety check. Form controls add an internal useFormControlState hook. The IconButton removes unused color palette mapping. Icons revert to using wildcard export paths. The Input fixes layout shift with display: flex and prevents the notched prop from leaking into the DOM. The InputBase places aria-label on the input element. Inputs fix autofocus in SSR environment. The List fixes sticky subheader overlapping iOS scrollbar. The Popper persists positioning styles when popperOptions changes reference. The Select stops using combobox element for labeling and supports single-pointer-cycle selection and pointer cancellation. The Switch fixes incorrect role with slotProps.input. The Tabs fix scrollable tabs blocking pointer events. The TextField fixes autofill styles always in dark mode when CSS variables are used. The Tooltip simplifies RTL styles using CSS logical properties and closes when its child becomes disabled. The Typography fixes the h4 variant when using responsiveFontSizes(). The useMediaQuery fixes a crash in Firefox extension. The system package fixes theme mutation when using responsive typography shorthand in sx. The codemod adds a --jsx option and packageName support. The utils add shadow dom utils, fix resolveProps receiving empty string className, and remove unnecessary excludeKeys from extractEventHandlers. Docs include various updates and a new demo with Tanstack Query.

chunks.title: NVIM v0.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the neovim/neovim release v0.6.1, the project provides a bug-fix update over v0.6.0. It includes fixes for the API (allowing nvim_buf_set_extmark to accept end_row key), diagnostics (asserting line number and column, clamping negative line numbers, escaping special chars in file names, respecting 'if_many' source option for virtual text, and setting effective buffer number for DiagnosticChanged autocmd), Lua (avoiding cast to char_u in str_utf_start), and LSP (avoiding attaching to unloaded buffers, calling config on_exit handler before context is cleared, and fixing nil-index behavior for UTF-8 in _str_*index_enc methods).

chunks.title: NVIM v0.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the neovim/neovim release v0.7.0, the project introduces breaking changes including dropping Python 2 support (minimum Python 3.6), changing nvim_buf_set_text behavior with negative line numbers, altering vim.highlight.range signature, and distinguishing input keys like <cr>, <tab>, <esc> from their control counterparts. New features include core API additions: support for Lua function and description in keymap, API and Lua autocmds, nvim_clear_autocmd, passing args table to autocommand callbacks, removing Lua autocommand callbacks when they return true, implementing nvim_{add,del}_user_command, nvim_buf_get_text, and nvim_get_option_value, and highlight namespace support.

chunks.title: Nvim v0.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the neovim/neovim release v0.8.0, the project introduces breaking changes: removing 'insertmode', 'remap', and 'terse' options; renaming highlight attributes to match Vim; erroring on invalid highlight names and allowing '.' and '@'; dropping winpty and requiring Windows 10 version 1809 or later; using @foo.bar style highlight groups for treesitter; and not merging treesitter queries by default. New features include enabling filetype.lua by default, adding undo!, prerelease to version dict, click support for statusline and winbar, preview functionality for user commands, allowing Cmdheight=0 (experimental), stdpath('run') to /tmp/nvim.user/, 'mousescroll' option, :wincmd accepting a count, multibuffer preview for inccommand, porting Man to Lua, API additions (ui options for remote TUI, nvim_parse_cmd and nvim_cmd, stdin stream handling, group_name in nvim_get_autocmds, enabling nvim_exec_autocmds to pass arbitrary data, pattern array support, unsilent in command APIs, replace_keycodes in nvim_set_keymap, :horizontal modifier, move in nvim_input_mouse, ui_watched option for extmarks), build system improvements, checkhealth for slow shell, session data in $XDG_STATE_HOME, search selection by * and # in visual mode, nnoremap & :&&<CR>, enabling mouse by default, passing diagnostics as data to DiagnosticChanged, gen_help_html.lua, inserting unsimplified key with CTRL-SHIFT-V, full treesitter spelling support, and filetype pattern conversions.

Bug fixes address UI issues with 'cmdheight' and global statusline, highlights not updating with 'winhl', make_filter_cmd for :! powershell, pwsh redirection, finding multibyte file names, unsigned overflow in home_replace(), docs-html parser update, fold marker multibyte comparison, tmux rgb verification in health, setting modifiable before writing page in man.lua, mouse scrolling with 'mousescroll', paste in cmdline mode, qflist uninitialized memory read, wrong cast in spell, stdpath defaulting to /tmp, and TUI main thread resuming.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the neovim/neovim release v0.9.2, the project provides a maintenance release focused on bug fixes and performance improvements, with some TUI and :terminal features.
