chunks.title: Nvim v0.9.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the neovim/neovim release v0.9.4, the project provides a maintenance release focusing on bug fixes. Bug fixes include build (fixing exporting symbols on macOS Sonoma), api (handling NUL in nvim_err_write() and nvim_out_write()), autocmd (api functions accepting garbage after event name), clang (null pointer dereference in parse_msgpack), clipboard (not passing --foreground to wl-copy), exception (remembering whether message is multiline), float (updating position of anchored windows first, fixing some other crashes with :unhide or :all), lua (not using global value in vim.opt_global, showing error message when failing to set variable), mouse (click on 'statuscolumn' with 'rightleft'), path (accepting special characters on Windows), provider (fixing python3 provider cannot detect python3.12, importing the correct module in provider/pythonx), rpc (fixing race condition), runtime (adding commentstring for D ftplugin), statuscolumn (updating number hl for each screen line), terminal (checking terminal size at end of screen update), treesitter (removing more double recursion), ui ('resize -1' with cmdheight=0), unhide (closing floating windows first), unittests (ignoring __s128 and __u128 types in ffi), and tutor (clarifying the meaning of ✗ and ✓). Build system bumps libmpack-lua to 1.0.11 and fixes mac release for Sonoma.

chunks.title: Nvim 0.9.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the neovim/neovim release v0.9.5, the project provides a maintenance release focusing on bugfixes, notably for issues on less common platforms like big endian platforms. The release notes refer to the online news-0.9 page for details.

chunks.title: Nvim v0.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the neovim/neovim release v0.10.0, the project provides a major release with changes detailed in the online news-0.10 page. The release notes include installation instructions and SHA256 checksums, but no specific feature or bug-fix list in the body.

chunks.title: NVIM 0.10.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the neovim/neovim release v0.10.1, the project provides a maintenance update over v0.10.0. Features include updating LSP healthcheck format. Build system bumps tree-sitter-query to v0.4.0, tree-sitter-c to v0.21.3, tree-sitter-vimdoc to v3.0.0, drops unused bundled bash and python parsers and queries, disables deduplication in link step on macOS, fixes 'popcount' name conflict on NetBSD, removes -O2 from gen_cflags, and reuses code for deps.txt. Bug fixes address swapfile warning, assert failure in VimL expression parser, API (alloc and draw cursor window in nvim__redraw), colorscheme (underline StatusLineNC with 'notermguicolors'), column (crash with 'signcolumn' set to 'number', clamping line number for legacy signs, modifying a sign should update placed signs), comment (falling back to using trimmed comment markers), defaults (default @/Q broken when 'ignorecase' is set), drawline (not drawing beyond end of window, not drawing beyond end of window with 'rnu'), extmarks (issues with revalidating marks), filetype (fixing typos in detection), float (handling error in win_float_create()), fs (making vim.fs.root work for relative paths and unnamed buffers), health (broken ruby detect, fixing fetching url with python in provider health), input (handling vim.on_key() properly with ALT and K_SPECIAL), LSP (adding textDocument/documentLink to capability map, hiding layout in codelenses in virtual text, detaching all clients on_reload to force buf_state reload, triggering LspDetach on buffer delete, checking if buffer was detached in on_init callback, handling nil root_dir in health check, not detaching from buffer if there are uninitialized clients, clearing lsp client diagnostics, removing superfluous on_detach callback from semantic tokens module, not resetting buf version when detaching client, avoiding vim.keymap.del error when stopping a client, not showing codelens for buffers that don't support it, rendering inlay hints in correct order), lua (changing some vim.fn.expand() to vim.fs.normalize()), marks (revalidating marks whose position did not change), mouse (early return when clicking in padded 'statuscolumn'), move (half-page scrolling with resized grid at eob), path (avoiding chdir() when resolving path), quickfix (making shortmess+=O work with cmdheight=0), runtime (sourcing c ftplugin properly for cpp on Windows, adding commentstring for glsl ftplugin), snippet (not overriding unnamed register on tabstop select, canceling snippet session when leaving the buffer, modifying base indentation when there's actually whitespace), tohtml (replacing ipairs with pairs, ignoring lsp inlay hints, showing how many warnings are hidden, properly handling multiple hl groups, extmark text may be out of bounds, supporting ranges again), treesitter (not modifying highlight state for _on_spell_nav, ensuring syntaxset augroup exists, displaying fields for anonymous nodes in :InspectTree, recognizing aliased parsers in omnifunc and query linter), and TUI (removing duplicate disabling of s).

chunks.title: Nvim 0.10.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the neovim/neovim release v0.10.2, the project provides a maintenance release. Features include allowing opting out of removing unloaded buffers in jumplist. Bug fixes cover API (error properly with invalid field in nvim_open_win, nvim_buf_get_text() crashes with large negative column, fix crash/leak with float title/footer on error), channel (handling writing to file instead of pipe), column (setting signcolumn width after splitting window), completion (not including \<Lua function> in -complete=), decor (not using separate DecorSignHighlight for url, excluding invalid marks from meta total), diagnostics (not applying extmarks to invalid lines), diff (using mmfile_t in linematch), filetype (handling .in files with no filename), float (properly finding last window of tabpage), health (fixing pyenv root and python exepath detect issue, returning correct name from 'path2name()'), LSP (not sending foreign diagnostics to servers in buf.code_action, avoiding reusing diagnostics from different servers in actions, returning call hierarchy item not the index, handling out-of-bounds character positions, handling encoding bounds in str_utfindex_enc, handling nil bytes in strings), lua (ignoring stdout and stderr for xdg-open), man (avoiding setting v:errmsg, checking if buffer is valid before restoring 'tagfunc'), regexp (fixing typo in E888 error message), runtime (syncing bundled treesitter queries twice, adding remaining missing commentstrings), terminal (interrupt/got_int hangs terminal), treesitter (escaping things like " in omnifunc results, linting top-level anonymous nodes, EditQuery shows swapfile ATTENTION, indent size for inspect_tree), TUI (setting id parameter in OSC 8 sequences, resetting active attr ID when OSC 8 sequence is terminated), version (returning nil with empty string), vim.ui.open (preferring xdg-open on WSL), win-msi (setting installer scope to machine), window (respecting hide flag of float windows when switching, making float with title/footer non-float leaks memory).

chunks.title: Nvim 0.10.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the neovim/neovim release v0.10.3, the project provides a maintenance release. Features include expanding file ~\ or ~/ prefix on Windows in main. Bug fixes cover API (making nvim_set_hl() respect all cterm attributes), completion (avoiding deleting text when completion leader changes), coverity (linematch out of bounds access), defaults (not replacing keycodes in Visual search mappings), events (not expanding args.file for Lua callback), extmark (builtin completion can still affect nearby extmarks), filetype (making filetype detection work with :doautocmd), inccommand (ensuring cursor is where it belongs), inspect (showing priority for treesitter highlights, always showing priority), LSP (str_byteindex_enc bounds checking, retriggering diagnostics request on server cancellation, canceling pending requests before refreshing), marks (skipping right_gravity marks when deleting text), startup (reporting --startuptime error to stderr), treesitter (showing proper node name error messages), TUI (avoiding flushing buffer halfway an OSC 2 sequence), uri (uri_encode encodes brackets incorrectly for RFC2732), and vim.system (invalid MAX_TIMEOUT for 32-bit systems). Documentation includes misc updates, clarifying 'vim.bo' is always equivalent to :setlocal, and clarifying when on_key 'typed' will be empty. Refactoring fixes incorrect use of enum and sorts various Lua tables in src/ alphabetically.

chunks.title: Nvim v0.10.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the neovim/neovim release v0.10.4, the project provides a maintenance release focusing on bug fixes and changes to binary releases. A Linux AArch64 binary has been added, and the previous 'linux64' binary has been renamed to 'linux-x86_64', which is a BREAKING change for scripts consuming binary releases. Bug fixes include checkhealth (failed if 'lua' in plugin name), decor (setting invalid flag for end of invalidated paired marks), inspect (using correct default highlight), jobs (not blocking UI when jobwait() doesn't block), LSP (minimum height for floating popup), lua (preventing SIGSEGV when lua error is NULL in libuv_worker), marks (revising metadata for start mark of revalidated pair), mpack (removing invalid bool definition), runtime (letting matchit and matchparen skips fallback on treesitter captures), search (avoiding quadratic time complexity when computing fuzzy score), treesitter (uv_dlclose after uv_dlerror, not opening fold when o/O adds a line below, robustness against ctrl-c in treesitter.foldexpr, refreshing in buffers affected by OptionSet, only refreshing valid buffers), and UI (ensuring screen update before waiting for input).

chunks.title: Nvim 0.11.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the neovim/neovim release v0.11.2, the project provides a maintenance release focusing on bug fixes, with some enhancements related to vim.lsp.enable. Features include vim.lsp.is_enabled(), root_markers can control priority, start/stop LSPs as necessary during vim.lsp.enable(), detach LSP clients when 'filetype' changes, checkhealth triggering FileType event after showing report, and health summary in section heading. Bug fixes cover LSP (detecting if Client:request resolved synchronously, using bufnr when getting clients in symbols_to_items, improper diagnostic end_col computation, only auto-detach lsp.config clients, improving error completion message, checking if client is stopping before reuse, fixing error with InsertReplaceEdit events), :print (not using schar_from_ascii() for illegal byte), cmdline (not moving UI cursor when entering cmdline), decor (extmark highlight not applied), display (adjusting setting winline info for concealed lines), folds (avoiding unnecessary loop with horizontal scrolling, adjusting filler text drawing for transparent folds), health (checkhealth float opens extra empty buffer), lua (vim.validate message param), move (consuming skipcol before revealing filler lines), runtime (cpoptions is reset in Lua file, concealing paths in help and man ToC loclist, 'includeexpr' with non-Nvim-style Lua modules), system (not treating NUL at start as no input), terminal (checking size when switching buffers), termkey (out-of-bounds write in array), treesitter (closing :InspectTree with q, invalidating conceal_lines marks, eliminating flicker for single windows, proper tree contains() logic with combined injections, parser metadata annotations), trust (support for trusting directories), TUI (not processing UI events when suspending or stopping, forwarding C0 control codes literally, not trying to add unsupported modifiers, clearing primary device callback before invoking it), tutor (L:lang is undefined), vim.lsp.enable (not eagerly enabling LSP configs during startup), vim.system (improving error message when cwd does not exist), and window (skipping unfocusable and hidden floats with {count}<C-W>w).

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent nestjs/nest release stream across v10 and v11 minor/patch versions, highlighting microservices enhancements, core bug fixes, and dependency updates.

chunks.title: v11.0.21
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.0.21, the common package adds fallbackToMimetype support in FileTypeValidator, and the platform-fastify dependency fastify is updated to v5.3.2 for a security fix.

chunks.title: v11.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.0, the microservices package adds support for topic exchange in RabbitMQ.

chunks.title: v11.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.1, multiple bug fixes are applied: core HTTP adapter error mapping, proper closing of Redis and AMQP connections in microservices, restoration of getHeader and appendHeader methods in AbstractHttpAdapter, and removal of pipeline usage in platform-express. Enhancements include adding specific transport id to microservices, allowing custom exchangeType as string for plugin compatibility, and adding exchange arguments to RabbitMQ. Dependencies are bumped for fastify, ws, and file-type.

chunks.title: v11.1.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.2, microservices fixes include support for custom strategy in async useFactory config and prevention of error logs during Redis client shutdown. Dependencies are updated: file-type to 21.0.0 and multer to 2.0.0.

chunks.title: v10.4.18
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v10.4.18, the platform-express dependency multer is bumped from 1.4.5-lts.2 to 2.0.0.

chunks.title: v11.1.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.3, core fixes include graceful shutdown when REPL exits. Enhancements add string array type to disposition in common, and defer initialization of connected microservice in core and common. Multer is bumped to 2.0.1.

chunks.title: v10.4.19
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v10.4.19, the platform-express dependency multer is bumped from 2.0.0 to 2.0.1.

chunks.title: v11.1.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.4, bug fixes address fastify adapter auto-init for middleware registration, race condition in class dependency resolution, flattenRoutePath returning a valid module, RMQ pattern matching with wildcards, and updating RMQ_DEFAULT_QUEUE to an empty string. Enhancements include a decorator for custom schema in fastify, enhanced introspection capabilities across multiple packages, and fine async storage control in core. Dependencies bump ws to 8.18.3 and fastify to 5.4.0.

chunks.title: v11.1.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.5, the platform-express dependency multer is bumped from 2.0.1 to 2.0.2.

chunks.title: v11.1.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.6, core fixes address race condition in class dependency resolution from imported modules and attaching root inquirer for nested transient providers. Microservices fixes include reporting correct buffer length in exception and fixing Kafka serialization of class instances. The @fastify/cors dependency is bumped to 11.1.0.

chunks.title: v11.1.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.7, microservices fixes include RMQ fanout bind and correct parameter type in RouteConstraints decorator for fastify. Core fixes skip lifecycle hooks for non-instantiated transient services, and common adds color allowance check to console logger options. Enhancements allow manual acknowledgement handling with @Ack() decorator in websockets, resolve extras in configurable module builder async methods, add force-console option to console logger, improve dependency resolution error messages, and add InvalidTcpDataReceptionException for TCP receive errors. Dependencies bump fastify to 5.6.1, path-to-regexp to 8.3.0, and load-esm to 1.0.3.

chunks.title: v11.1.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.8, core fixes ensure nested transient provider isolation, and fastify migrates top-level options to routerOptions.

chunks.title: v11.1.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.9, core fixes make get() throw for implicitly request-scoped trees. Enhancements add method options to @sse decorator in common. Fastify dependency is bumped to 5.6.2.

chunks.title: v11.1.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.10, core fixes instantiate nested transient providers in static context, resolve all providers when using resolve() with each option, and fix grpc stream method return type in microservices. Common fixes resolve file-type path explicitly and support fallbackToMimetype without buffer. Enhancements improve error handling in FileTypeValidator, add message property to file type validator, enhance ValidationPipe, add Promise<Observable> support for SSE handlers in core, add keepalive support for server side in microservices, and add option for async logger compatibility in common and core. Dependencies update @fastify/cors to 11.2.0, express to 5.2.1, and file-type to 21.1.1.

chunks.title: v11.1.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.11, platform-fastify fixes middie bypassing through decoded chars, and core adds missing catch handler for forward-ref provider resolution. Dependencies update socket.io to 4.8.3, @fastify/static to v9, and file-type to 21.2.0.

chunks.title: v10.4.21
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v10.4.21, express is updated to 4.22.1 to address CVE-2025-15284.

chunks.title: v10.4.22
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v10.4.22, body-parser is updated to 1.20.4 for CVE-2025-15284.

chunks.title: v11.1.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.12, common fixes a regression in loading file-type under Windows OS. Dependencies bump ws to 8.19.0, file-type to 21.3.0, and find-my-way to 9.4.0.

chunks.title: v11.1.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.13, common fixes skipping maxArrayLength and maxStringLength options. Enhancements add per-handler QoS in MQTT microservices, configurable max buffer size in microservices, and exclude built-in primitives from strip proto keys in common. Dependencies update fastify to 5.7.4 and cors to 2.8.6.

chunks.title: v11.1.14
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.14, fastify fixes a middleware bypass CVE, and common fixes logger printing invalid context when no stack trace is provided. Enhancements change requestOrigin type in common.

chunks.title: v11.1.15
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.15, microservices fixes include handling falsy indexOf return and introducing max pattern depth and object complexity. Core allows override for initializeWildcardHandlersIfEmpty. Dependencies update @fastify/middie to 9.2.0 for security and multer to 2.1.0 for security.

chunks.title: v11.1.16
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.16, microservices fix double callback when isDisposed or err is truthy. Multer dependency is updated to 2.1.1.

chunks.title: v11.1.17
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.17, microservices add Redis driver identification. Fastify auto-runs middleware for HEAD requests. Dependencies update file-type to 21.3.2 and fastify to 5.8.2.

chunks.title: v11.1.18
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.18, microservices preserve packet headers in NATS serializer. Core fixes prevent injector hang when design:paramtypes is missing, fix dependency injection edge case with ModuleRef.create, and sanitize SSE message. Dependencies update path-to-regexp to 8.4.2, fastify to 5.8.4, ws to 8.20.0, and file-type to 21.3.4.

chunks.title: v11.1.19
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.19, microservices fix consumer CRASH event listener to use backing field and prevent stack overflow in JsonSocket.handleData().

chunks.title: v11.1.20
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.20, core fixes deeply nested transient providers resolution, @Sse losing events on complete, defer SSE writeHead until after lifecycle completes, and use strict null check for SSE message id. Microservices fix ServerRMQ crash with undefined MessagePattern and wildcards. Common accepts zero timestamp in parse date pipe. Socket.io deduplicates disconnect listener. Enhancements add return buffers option for binary data in microservices, handle RMQ blocked/unblocked connection events, improve filetype validator buffer message, and add defParamCharset to MulterOptions in platform-express. Ws dependency is bumped to 8.20.1.

chunks.title: v11.1.21
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.21, core fixes settle skipped provider initialization.

chunks.title: v11.1.22
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.22, core fixes an inflight request injection bug and identifies decorator type in invalid-class-module error.

chunks.title: v11.1.23
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.23, core fixes an issue where snapshot:true eagerly instantiates Terminus transient indicators since v11.1.20.

chunks.title: v11.1.24
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nestjs/nest release v11.1.24, core fixes reset dependency-tree cache on metadata changes and adds a warning on late websocket adapter registration. Ws dependency is bumped to 8.21.0.

chunks.title: v2.2.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.2.5, the patch addresses issues from v2.2.4 with fixes including MariaDB collector handling of CPU time in microseconds since version 11.4.5, improved clickhouse_replicated_readonly_tables info, indirect cloud access using Parent's claim ID when Agent is offline, data interpolation for median and percentile in stats.d, proper database closure on startup errors, memory corruption fix by dequeuing contexts, journal watcher fixes, NVMe device discovery for nvme-cli v2.11, MySQL collector respecting global variables refresh interval, and various CI/build system fixes including Amazon Linux aarch64 package builds migration to GitHub ARM runners.

chunks.title: v2.2.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.2.6, the patch addresses issues from v2.2.5 with fixes and updates including log2journal handling of empty JSON arrays/objects, MariaDB collector CPU time in microseconds since version 10.11.11, user action logging in dyncfg with sensitive info hidden in anonymous mode, disabling legacy Go sensors collector, user action logging in go.d.plugin dyncfg, periodic event loop processing to prevent database engine starvation, deployment metrics collection in KubeState collector, agent timezone info in host labels, fallback to standard memory allocation when onewayalloc fails, Windows log collection appending new fields, improved error handling in Windows perflib collector, prevention of Sentry report flooding during database init failures, a new alert for system reboots, SSL certificate handling in statically linked libcurl, additional context info in Sentry crash reports, and automatic detection of system DNS servers from /etc/resolv.conf in DNS query collector.

chunks.title: v2.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.3.0, the major release delivers crash handling and reporting with zero-sampling, extreme cardinality protection, nodes ephemerality and streaming alerts to distinguish permanent and ephemeral nodes, and SNMP service discovery for automatic detection and monitoring of SNMP-enabled devices.

chunks.title: v2.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.3.1, the patch addresses issues from v2.3.0 with fixes including debug info handling in default builds, static build configuration avoiding unnecessary libunwind compilation, improved low memory condition detection, updater script crontab installation path fix, database page size limit validation for 32-bit compression, compilation fixes without dbengine or with address sanitizer, additional system resource metrics in status file, security fix preventing exposure of absolute file paths in web server responses, security fix for daemon status file handling using file descriptor-based permissions, removal of insecure SVG generation endpoint, unaligned memory access fix in socket message buffer, ACLK synchronization thread initialization fix, fix for commands queued before ACLK init, potential crash fix when dbengine encounters null data files, Agent status reporting for first-run scenarios, initial libbacktrace implementation for crash diagnostics, reliability calculation fix for normal Agent exits, and enhanced shutdown diagnostics with timeouts and cloud provider details in crash reports.

chunks.title: v2.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.3.2, the patch addresses issues from v2.3.1 with fixes including journal file creation reliability, leakage of build environment identifiers, potential memory access violations by validating journal file headers and page boundaries, rare crash condition by reinitializing data collection for obsolete/archived dimensions, MegaCLI collector handling of missing battery backup units, UUID generation using version 4 format, detection for additional CI environment variables to disable telemetry, Agent status system handling null UUIDs and improved tracking of shutdown time, crash counts, and connection states, detailed worker thread status info and enhanced crash diagnostics, potential crash in Windows perflib collector when handling null pointers, error reporting preserving errno during out-of-memory conditions, potential crashes when handling empty data arrays, Agent shutdown by properly joining ACLK and metadata threads before closing database connections, random crashes during shutdown by avoiding precompiled database statements for host metadata, limiting maximum database file size to 1GB, crash in variable lookup function when processing search results with scores, ACLK synchronization thread shutdown with better termination sequence and timeout handling, improved Parent node startup performance by preloading UUIDs into metrics registry, and Windows installer fix to properly manage configuration.

chunks.title: v2.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.4.0, the stability-focused release addresses issues identified via the new agent reporting system from v2.3.0, with memory optimization resolving significant memory leaks in container monitoring (especially Kubernetes), database engine components, health alarm entries, and alert pattern matching, improved SQLite memory management with max heap limits and dynamic memory release under pressure, stability improvements fixing numerous crashes in Windows performance counters and container monitoring, improved error handling when dbengine files reside on disks with errors, enhanced journal file handling with better error logging, optimized shutdown sequences to prevent resource leaks and crashes, fixed ACLK synchronization issues for dynamic host configuration changes, and new features including Windows Service Monitoring to track running states of Windows services via windows.plugin/PerflibServices (disabled by default, requires manual activation).

chunks.title: v2.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.5.0, the release continues stability commitment with comprehensive deadlock detection, improved resource cleanup, and protection against corrupted data files, along with collector improvements such as default filtering for systemd-nspawn container payload in cgroups monitoring, per-database lock metrics in Windows MSSQL collector, reorganization of Windows plugin IIS module, initial work-in-progress Netdata exporter for OpenTelemetry, removal of legacy WMI to Windows collector renaming code, cleanup of SNMP collector vendored Datadog profile components, detailed UPS response logging in debug mode for APC UPS collector, improved test coverage for OpenTelemetry journald exporter, metric descriptions and proper unit definitions in SNMP collector profiles, packaging updates including unified license agreement page in Windows installer, and added support for Alpine 3.21, CentOS Stream 10, Ubuntu 25.04, and Fedora 42 in CI and package builds.

chunks.title: v2.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.5.1, the patch addresses issues from v2.5.0 with fixes including obsolete chart cleanup for virtual nodes, SNMP collector using 32-bit counters when 64-bit unavailable, SNMP collector fallback to ifDescr when ifName empty, SNMP discovery correction for SNMPv3 credential parameter names, compilation fix on older distributions by removing uv_sleep, claiming fix in Docker by improving localhost detection, user configuration option to override default thread stack size, and CouchDB collector using correct units (bytes instead of KiB) for database size charts.

chunks.title: v2.5.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.5.2, the patch addresses issues from v2.5.1 with fixes including crash prevention by disabling dynamic configuration init for virtual nodes, eBPF library dependency update to 1.5.1, dynamic configuration issue incorrectly assigning plugin configs to virtual nodes, user transition log messages changed from debug to info, memory issue preventing use-after-free when accessing parent info, use-after-free memory issue in plugins.d inflight function handling, metadata synchronization shutdown proceeding even when event loop command submission fails, SNMP collector proper formatting of system info, database maintenance scheduling to properly sequence journal indexing after file rotation, various minor fixes including improved shutdown logging, division by zero protection, and updated dimension status messages, and improved MSSQL collector performance by moving database queries to a separate thread.

chunks.title: v2.5.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.5.3, the patch addresses issues from v2.5.2 with fixes including context update handling by adjusting hub queue management conditions, ability to debug individual jobs in go.d.plugin, debug logging for HTTP response validation in go.d HTTP check collector, duplicate name handling in go.d dynamic configuration userconfig action, Oracle database collector correct calculation of tablespace usage percentages and prevention of negative values, and database engine performance optimization by better job scheduling and concurrency handling for file rotation and indexing operations.

chunks.title: v2.5.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.5.4, the patch addresses issues from v2.5.3 with fixes and updates including improved label sanitization in Go plugins by removing null bytes, improved Go plugin startup performance by loading SNMP profiles only when used, addition of -NoProfile parameter to Windows installer PowerShell execution, optimized memory usage by switching label structures to ARAL allocator, fixed CPU architecture matching for Go plugin builds in 32-bit static builds, Redis collector maintaining TLS configuration for rediss connections, Go weblog collector excluding HTTP 429 status codes from 4xx error category, registry save operation fix for integer overflow and exponential backoff for failed saves, improved agent shutdown responsiveness by reducing streaming connection timeout from 1000ms to 250ms, database statement handling with improved thread cleanup and validation before finalization, memory corruption fix in query progress updates by preventing access to freed web client structures, and added vendored Protobuf and Abseil libraries to static builds with cross-platform compatibility patches.

chunks.title: v2.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.6.0, the release brings AI-powered monitoring intelligence with MCP server support enabling AI assistants to query infrastructure, natural language questions in AI Insights, full SCIM group provisioning for Okta, automatic space/room access based on Okta groups, SNMP profile-based collection with 100+ device profiles (alpha) and auto-detection for Cisco, Palo Alto, F5, and more, native packages for RHEL 10, AlmaLinux 10, Rocky Linux 10, and systemd journal support for static builds via Rust implementation.

chunks.title: v2.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.6.1, the patch addresses issues from v2.6.0 with fixes including double-release protection by resetting chart variables to null after release, initialization of thread synchronization primitives using dynamic allocation, worker thread completion signaling moved from callback to worker thread, SNMP profile device metadata added to virtual node labels, build reproducibility by excluding timestamps from gzip metadata, ACLK MQTT packet handling with timeout detection for missing acknowledgments and increased buffer size for parent agents, SNMP device profiles converting non-UCUM units to proper UCUM format, NVMe collector querying controller-level SMART metrics instead of namespace-level, eBPF CO-RE library update to 1.6.0, and SSL certificate detection fix on Rocky Linux and for static builds.

chunks.title: v2.6.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.6.2, the patch addresses issues from v2.6.1 with fixes and updates including packet ID clearing when processing PUBACK messages, detailed pulse metrics for ACLK telemetry, virtual nodes inheriting version from parent agent, improved ACLK with periodic cleanup of pending PUBACKs, fixed lock ordering to prevent deadlocks, added pending PUBACK statistics, publish latency metrics to netdatacli aclk-state and /api/v1/aclk endpoint, packet timeout handling corruption fix on 32-bit systems, default network interface IP detection in system-info, removal of patternProperties from go.d config_schema.json files, security validation for custom binary paths in go.d.plugin, improved disk usage measurement accuracy in Windows plugin, proxy information added to ACLK connection logs and netdatacli aclk-state output, various improvements to SNMP profiles and go.d/snmp collector, updated OpenSSL to 3.4.2 and curl to 8.15.0 in static builds, database checks to prevent statement finalization after databases closed, and added Oracle Linux 10 and Debian 13 support to CI and package builds.

chunks.title: v2.6.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.6.3, the patch addresses issues from v2.6.2 with fixes including build-time check to reject known bad compiler flags, saving of virtual host labels and removal of incorrect live flag on agent restart, and various improvements to SNMP profiles and go.d/snmp collector.

chunks.title: v2.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.7.0, the release introduces Netdata AI for automated troubleshooting, on-demand analysis, and scheduled infrastructure reports, chart annotations for shared event marking, quick data export to CSV/PNG/PDF, OpenTelemetry plugin (alpha) ingesting metrics via OTLP gRPC, SNMP profiles becoming stable and default with improved metadata and coverage, default IP detection displaying nodes as NodeName (IP), and stability improvements eliminating potential crashes and memory issues.

chunks.title: v2.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.7.1, the patch addresses issues from v2.7.0 with fixes including support for old RabbitMQ whoami tags format and a fix for Windows Agent not allowing go.d plugin to start.

chunks.title: v2.7.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.7.2, the patch addresses issues from v2.7.1 with fixes and updates including skipping status file write on Windows during crashes to prevent deadlocks, improved agent startup on Windows by enhancing log-forwarding initialization and thread handling, improved disk space calculation in dbengine for Windows, FreeIPMI crash fix by unlocking mutex before scheduled plugin restarts, improved SNMP APC device support with detailed sysObjectID mappings, improved logging and handling of unknown packet IDs, fixed Windows app memory usage reporting to align with Task Manager, registered Netdata in MCP registry, improved Windows installer to properly stop Netdata service and report failures, fixed memory leak in ACLK HTTPS client, fixed disk size calculation in Windows plugin, fixed cgroup-network spawn server cleanup to prevent orphaned processes and zombies, declared flatten-serde-json at workspace level to fix duplicate package source issues, added fallback to /host/ for machine ID in OpenTelemetry plugin, and added remote MCP support with direct HTTP and SSE transport.

chunks.title: v2.7.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.7.3, the patch addresses issues from v2.7.2 with fixes including ensuring metrics are properly retained during Journal v2 migration, removal of unnecessary cap_net_bind_service from otel-plugin, MSSQL chart unit label fix from “recompiles/” to “recompiles/s”, alerts API summary option no longer enabled by default, CLI initialized earlier during agent startup, race condition fix in ML dimension training and optimized structures for lower memory usage, missing "repeat" field in health dynamic configuration userconfig response, periodic data sync on Windows for current data and journal files, /api/v3/data correctly reporting update_every after filtering, feature size calculation fix and validation in KMeans training, prevention of shutdown-time crashes by skipping Sentry breadcrumbs on timeout, NaN check fix in anomaly score calculation, extra safety checks during cgroup discovery, and reworked maintenance handling by removing dedicated thread and using metadata event loop to reduce contention and crashes.

chunks.title: v2.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.8.0, the release introduces expanded chart analysis for comparing timeframes and correlating metrics, Netdata AI improvements including log visualization in Insights/Investigations, expanded scheduled reports for full Insights and Investigations via email, ServiceNow integration for enterprise incident management, generic SQL collector (alpha) for monitoring any SQL database with custom queries, PSS-based memory estimation for more accurate shared memory tracking, and announces SOC 2 Type 2 compliance.

chunks.title: v2.8.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.8.1, the patch addresses issues from v2.8.0 with fixes including vnodes created through dynamic configuration disappearing after agent restart, PSS memory sampling disabled by default in apps.plugin to reduce CPU overhead, source unit field added to alert values, removal of noisy INFO log from Windows datafile sync, compilation fix when dbengine is disabled, and improved Podman container name resolution in cgroups plugin.

chunks.title: v2.8.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.8.2, the patch addresses issues from v2.8.1 with fixes including adjusted Windows sensors initialization for better stability, replacement of dots with slashes in OTEL metric families for hierarchical grouping, user group updates for proper Proxmox group assignment in Docker entrypoint, ensuring Netdata has access to NVIDIA device files for GPU monitoring on non-Debian systems, prevention of replication stalling by detecting empty-response loops, stopping replication when parent is already caught up, prioritization of environment-provided config directories in go.d for runtime overrides, and silencing Redis client library logs in go.d Redis collector.

chunks.title: v2.8.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.8.3, the patch addresses issues from v2.8.2 with fixes including go.d AP collector handling unknown station statistics gracefully, incorrect plugin and binary paths on Windows for go.d plugin, improved go.d job management avoiding blocking during job shutdown, fixed and standardized Windows AD, ADCS, and ADFS charts and improved stability and accuracy of Windows hardware metrics collection, SNMP service discovery accepting version “2” and using default polling interval, logging data collection duration when go.d collections are skipped, fixed MSSQL errors chart in Windows plugin, removal of strict rabbitmq_version check for RabbitMQ collector compatibility, added collection statistics to SNMP go.d collector as per-profile charts, updated ndexec runner to return captured stdout on command failures, disabled MongoDB exporter on affected Ubuntu versions due to insecure libbson dependencies, updated bundled components in static builds, fixed off-by-one validation in Journal v2, fixed timed waits in completion to handle spurious wakeups and honor shutdown timeouts, prevented datafiles from exceeding max size by making size checks atomic, and updated DEB package builds to use XZ or zstd compression instead of gzip.

chunks.title: v2.8.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.8.4, the patch addresses issues from v2.8.3 with updates including Go version in build info and update of Go toolchain to v1.25.5.

chunks.title: v2.8.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.8.5, the patch addresses issues from v2.8.4 with fixes and updates including updating the Netdata Docker image to Debian 13.3 with latest upstream updates and security fixes, standardizing alert configuration to use consistent type for time group values, fixing CSV parser configuration serialization so empty settings are correctly omitted, fixing ProxySQL backend status metrics in go.d collector, fixing proc file parsing to support non-seekable files restoring network stats collection, fixing edit-config to ignore inherited container environment values, and fixing vnode label configuration by allowing arbitrary label keys in go.d schema.

chunks.title: v2.9.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.9.0, the release brings powerful database observability with interactive query analysis for 14+ databases including ClickHouse, CockroachDB, Couchbase, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, and more, a rebuilt SQL Server collector rewritten in Go with comprehensive metrics and Query Store integration, OpenTelemetry log ingestion via otel plugin stored in systemd-compatible journal files with configurable retention policies, and stability improvements for production reliability.

chunks.title: v2.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.10.0, the release introduces secrets management with 4 resolver types and 4 backends (AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager, HashiCorp Vault), enhanced AI conversations with reports and alerts integration, advanced alerting with silencing, evaluation, and acknowledge, a Nagios plugins collector, Azure Monitor support, and broad stability improvements.

chunks.title: v2.10.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.10.1, the patch addresses issues from v2.10.0 with fixes including adding ping_only option to SNMP collector for ICMP round-trip time metrics while using SNMP for device identification, fixing SNMP collector retries serialization and disabling bulk walk detection when MaxRepetitions is 0, and reducing transient 503 errors on dynamic configuration enable/disable by buffering command channel and extending handoff timeout in go.d plugin.

chunks.title: v2.10.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.10.2, the patch addresses issues from v2.10.1 with fixes including ZFS-related crashes in diskspace.plugin by guarding NULL filesystem field and replacing blocking pool-capacity collector with lightweight cache, reducing default SNMP MaxOIDs from 60 to 20 and removing 32-bit counter fallbacks from IF-MIB profile, and eliminating false-positive "timed out waiting for enable/disable decision" warnings by removing wait-decision timeout and making dyncfg command path non-droppable.

chunks.title: v2.10.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the netdata/netdata release v2.10.3, the patch addresses issues from v2.10.2 with fixes including a per-PID shared-memory pool leak in ebpf.plugin that caused CPU pegging, switching SNMP collector's primary uptime source to SNMP-FRAMEWORK-MIB::snmpEngineTime to avoid TimeTicks wrap, splitting dynamic configuration job-name validation per domain to allow dots in service discovery, vnode, and secret-store names, and removing unused extra_details field from go.d/powerstore Hardware struct to fix decoding errors.

chunks.title: Glances 3.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v3.3.0, the project migrates the WebUI from AngularJS to Angular/React/Vue, adds public IP information and a configurable clock/time module, improves Docker plugin sorting, and fixes several bugs including FS hide not applying and WebUI CPU time truncation.

chunks.title: Glances 3.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v3.3.1, the project replaces json with ujson, fixes Docker information display and CSV export ordering, corrects console formatting issues, and applies cyber security updates including a ujson version bump.

chunks.title: Glances 3.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v3.4.0, the project enhances process extended stats with pinning, improves start time by disabling Docker/Podman version getter, adds customizable InfluxDB2 export interval, refactors the Cloud plugin to be disabled by default, fixes InfluxDB2 folder processing and macOS index error, and restructures Docker images to provide both Alpine and Ubuntu variants.

chunks.title: Glances 3.4.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v3.4.0.1, a hotfix addresses a crash on startup with minimal dependencies that occurred in version 3.4.0.

chunks.title: Glances 3.4.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v3.4.0.2, hotfixes resolve a Windows 10 startup crash due to undefined SIGHUP and fix InfluxDB2 export not working.

chunks.title: v3.4.0.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v3.4.0.5, the project corrects a GPU plugin issue in Docker images, applies a cyber security patch for WebUI and Docker image dependencies, and includes earlier hotfixes for binary path, threshold display, Windows SIGHUP, and InfluxDB2 export.

chunks.title: Glances 4.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.0.2, the project introduces export of individual process stats via configuration or command-line filters, adds AMD GPU support through /sys/class/drm, brings back the Wifi plugin without external libraries, refactors alias configuration to a simpler format, and makes field descriptions and units available through the API.

chunks.title: v4.0.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.0.3, bug fixes are applied for the sensors plugin.

chunks.title: Glances 4.0.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.0.4, the project includes the same new features as v4.0.2 (individual process stats export, AMD GPU support, Wifi plugin, alias refactoring, API field descriptions) and adds a hotfix for sensors plugin support on Python 3.8.

chunks.title: Glances 4.0.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.0.6, the project includes the same new features as v4.0.2 and v4.0.4, and fixes missing GPU info on the Web View.

chunks.title: Glances 4.0.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.0.7, the project fixes cpu_hz_current not available on NetBSD and a SensorType change in the REST API that broke compatibility in v4.0.4, and includes earlier fixes for GPU info, pydantic dependency, Grafana dashboard, and battery class initialization.

chunks.title: Glances 4.0.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.0.8, the project makes CORS option configurable for security, fixes default configuration file path when installed via venv, addresses a 404 for a static file, screen flickering on local display, and retires ujson in favor of maintenance.

chunks.title: Glances 4.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.1.1, the project fixes sensors data not exported using InfluxDB2 exporter, and includes v4.1.0 enhancements such as process_iter.clear_cache() support, automatic hiding of down network interfaces, and various API and UI bug fixes.

chunks.title: Glances 4.1.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.1.2.1, the project fixes an AttributeError on CpuPercent object, and includes the v4.1.1 fix for InfluxDB2 sensor export and v4.1.0 enhancements.

chunks.title: Glances 4.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.2.0, the project includes the same enhancements and bug fixes as v4.1.0, such as process_iter.clear_cache() support, automatic hiding of down network interfaces, and various API and UI bug fixes.

chunks.title: Glances 4.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.2.1, the project reverts to the default Black Theme in WebUI with reduced font size, improves hide_zero option, fixes a possible memory leak, Docker/Podman log flooding, and migrates from setup.py to pyproject.toml.

chunks.title: Glances 4.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.3.0, the project introduces the Browser feature for accessing all Glances servers in a single web page, adds ability to specify hide/show for smart plugin, allows processlist and containers column selection in config, raises alert events for sensor groups, and fixes threshold display in WebUI for DiskIO and other bugs.

chunks.title: Glances 4.3.0.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.3.0.6, the project deprecates netifaces in favor of netifaces2.

chunks.title: Glances 4.3.0.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.3.0.7, the project provides a changelog-only update from v4.3.0.6.

chunks.title: Glances 4.3.0.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.3.0.8, the project provides a changelog-only update from v4.3.0.7.

chunks.title: Glances 4.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.3.1, the project adds top processes extended stats and processes filter in Web server mode, allows foreground color customization, adds an API entry point for extended process stats, replaces netifaces with netifaces-plus, and fixes config path and sensor temperature settings.

chunks.title: Glances 4.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.3.2, the project adds stats about running VMs via virsh, support for InfluxDB 3 Core, (postgre)SQL/TimeScaleDB export, makes all AMPs plugin results exportable, adds a zombie process identifier, implements a basic memory cache with TTL for API calls, and fixes AMD GPU plugin permission and container memory display issues.

chunks.title: Glances 4.3.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.3.3, the project includes various code refactoring, dependency updates, and fixes such as matching problem when fs config has show value, container sorting, and security upgrades.

chunks.title: Glances 4.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.4.0, the project introduces a new Python API for using Glances as a library, a --fetch option for system snapshot, shows used ports in container section, truncates long command lines by default, adds experimental DuckDB export, disk I/O latency stats, and fixes macOS process display and Prometheus export format.

chunks.title: Glances 4.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.4.1, the project provides a changelog-only update from v4.4.0.

chunks.title: Glances 4.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.5.0, the project adds ZFS monitoring, NPU monitoring, NVMe support, DuckDB export, CPU core assignment in process list, API token authentication, and fixes CPU speed display in WebUI, TIME+ large values, and InfluxDB export type mismatches.

chunks.title: Glances 4.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.5.1, the project fixes DiskIO crash on OpenBSD, filesystem KeyError, sensor alias filtering, SMART InfluxDB2 export TypeError, WebUI Fahrenheit display, Snap GPU plugin permissions, and MCP server DNS rebinding protection.

chunks.title: Glances 4.5.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.5.2, the project fixes system display error on small terminals and addresses 8 security vulnerabilities including CORS credential theft, secrets redaction, host validation, SQL injection in DuckDB, and command injection in action templates.

chunks.title: Glances 4.5.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.5.3, the project fixes internal server error in web server mode, container plugin crash on Podman pod infra containers, adds support for LXC/LXD containers, export to ClickHouse, and mitigates command injection and XML-RPC CORS vulnerabilities.

chunks.title: Glances 4.5.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nicolargo/glances release v4.5.4, the project fixes sensor temperature warning/critical setting, negative memory display, incorrect Docker container count, adds Rockchip MPP plugin for hardware encoder/decoder monitoring, and patches SSRF in IP plugin and CQL injection in Cassandra export.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent nlohmann/json release stream from v2.1.1 through v3.12.0, covering major feature additions like SAX interface, binary format support, extended diagnostics, and C++20 compatibility.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ Version 2.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v2.1.1, the library fixes a locale-related bug in the parser, overhauls number handling for correct round-tripping of floating-point numbers, fixes a buffer overflow when parsing numbers with leading zeros, and adds cryptographic signing of commits and released files. It also introduces an optional start index parameter for MessagePack and CBOR parsers, reduces compiler warnings, and speeds up unit test compilation.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.0.0, the library introduces user-defined exceptions with identifiers and parse error positions, enforces UTF-8 encoding during serialization, allows storage of NaN and infinity values, changes iterator tag to BidirectionalIterator, and removes deprecated stream constructors. It also deprecates certain stream operators and adds new features such as improved diagnostics and a SAX interface.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.0.1, the library fixes the JSON Patch copy operation to detect invalid target paths, fixes JSON Pointer array index validation to reject non-integer indices, adds JSON Patch tests, and updates documentation and CMake files.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.1.0, the library adds support for UBJSON format and JSON Merge Patch, adopts the Grisu2 algorithm for floating-point printing, splits the header into multiple files, introduces a forward declaration header, and adds Google Benchmark for micro benchmarks.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.1.1, the library fixes parsing of CBOR strings with indefinite length, fixes user-defined conversion to vector types, documents parser behavior for duplicate keys, and adds overflow detection for UBJSON containers.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.1.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.1.2, the library fixes a memory leak in the parser callback, allows assignments between different specializations of basic_json, fixes an iterator range check, and adds support for user-defined string types in parsing and serialization.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.2.0, the library introduces a SAX interface for parsing, supports parsing from wide string types, adds std::string_view support for C++17, allows roundtripping std::map and std::unordered_map, and makes the JSON parser non-recursive.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.3.0, the library adds support for GCC 4.8, introduces the get_to function to write JSON values to a reference, fixes CMake integration issues, and improves error messages for operator[] misuse.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.4.0, the library adds BSON support, adjustable Unicode error handlers, a macro for enum/JSON mapping, and improves parse error messages with line/column positions and context.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.5.0, the library adds support for structured bindings and reading from FILE*, fixes eofbit setting for input streams, and fixes a SAX parser bug for BSON arrays.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.6.0, the library overhauls the JSON Pointer interface with operator/ and operator/=, adds a contains function to check object keys, improves integer serialization performance, and reduces the required CMake version to 3.1.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.6.1, the library fixes a regression causing compilation errors with GCC 7 and 8, and fixes a compilation error when Windows.h is included.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.7.0, the library adds a contains overload for JSON Pointers, a to_string function, a return value for emplace_back, and switches unit tests from Catch to doctest.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.7.1, the library fixes a segmentation fault when serializing std::int64_t minimum value, fixes the contains function for JSON Pointers, and fixes SFINAE guards for std::pair and std::tuple conversions.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.7.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.7.2, the library fixes a stack overflow bug for deeply nested JSON values by changing the destructor implementation from recursive to iterative.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.7.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.7.3, the library fixes a quadratic complexity bug in destructor calls introduced in v3.7.2 by removing reserve() calls from the destructor.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.8.0, the library adds support for binary values in CBOR, BSON, and MessagePack, generalizes input adapters to any container via LegacyInputIterator, and improves CBOR floating-point encoding.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.9.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.9.0, the library adds optional comment support in JSON parsing, introduces nlohmann::ordered_json to preserve insertion order, allows switching off implicit conversions, adds convenience macros for type serialization, and adds high-precision number support for UBJSON.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.9.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.9.1, the library fixes the lexer to accept consecutive comments and adds missing functions to ordered_json.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.10.0, the library adds extended diagnostics with JSON Pointer in exception messages, a GDB pretty printer, a new CBOR tag handler, and support for containers with non-default-constructible types.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.10.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.10.1, the library fixes an assertion triggered in extended diagnostics when using ordered_json and makes the GDB pretty-printer robust against unset variable names.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.10.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.10.2, the library fixes the release scripts to correctly tag releases and fixes -Wunused warnings on JSON_DIAGNOSTICS when built without CMake.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.10.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.10.3, the library fixes extended diagnostics assertions in the update() function and when inserting into arrays, and adds custom allocator support for binary format writing.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.10.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.10.4, the library fixes compilation regressions for types with explicit default constructors and for std::find/remove return values, and fixes conversion of std::filesystem::path to JSON.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.10.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.10.5, the library adds preprocessor checks for C++17 filesystem support, fixes a compilation error with NVCC, adds a recursive merge option to the update function, and extends std::hash and std::swap to all basic_json specializations.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.11.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.11.0, the library adds std::string_view support for object keys, BJData format support, better C++20 support including operator<=>, and fixes various comparison and iterator issues.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.11.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.11.1, the library fixes the default value of JSON_USE_GLOBAL_UDLS to import user-defined string literals into the global namespace by default.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.11.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.11.2, the library fixes the value function for strings and size types, makes json_fwd.hpp self-contained, fixes json_pointer as key in associative containers, and restructures the inline namespace.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.11.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.11.3, the library adds a custom base class template parameter, more specific parse error messages for empty input, serialization-only macros, Bazel build support, and Swift Package Manager support.

chunks.title: JSON for Modern C++ version 3.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nlohmann/json release v3.12.0, the library adds diagnostic byte positions via JSON_DIAGNOSTIC_POSITIONS, enhances conversion macros with template support and derived class macros, adds std::optional support, improves binary format support with BJData draft 3 and BSON unsigned 64-bit integers, and adds multidimensional array conversion.
