prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent nomic-ai/gpt4all release stream from v2.7.0 through v3.10.0, covering new model architecture support, UI overhauls, LocalDocs improvements, and new features like web search and code interpreter.

chunks.title: v2.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v2.7.0, the project adds 12 new model architectures for CPU and Metal inference: Baichuan, BLOOM, CodeShell, GPT-2, Orion, Persimmon, Phi and Phi-2, Plamo, Qwen, Qwen2, Refact, and StableLM. It restores a minimum window size of 720x480, uses ChatML for Mistral OpenOrca to improve output formatting reliability, and includes bug fixes for VRAM freeing on CPU fallback, Mixtral GPU offloading, LocalDocs extension scanning limited to txt, pdf, md, rst, missing scrollbar for chat history, and accessibility improvements.

chunks.title: v2.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v2.7.1, the model loading is completely revamped to support explicit unload/reload, and models are no longer loaded by default on application start or chat context switch. Window geometry is saved and restored across application starts. The llama.cpp backend is updated as of 2/21/2024, adding CPU/GPU support for Gemma and enabling Vulkan GPU support for Phi, Phi-2, Qwen2, and StableLM. Fixes include a visual artifact in the update reminder dialog, blacklisting Intel GPUs, improving chat save/load speed, and significantly improving handling of chat-style prompt templates with a reupload of Mistral OpenOrca.

chunks.title: v2.7.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v2.7.2, a Model Discovery feature is introduced to discover new LLMs from HuggingFace directly within GPT4All. GPU offload of Gemma's output tensor is supported, Kompute support is enabled for 10 more model architectures (Baichuan, Bert and Nomic Bert, CodeShell, GPT-2, InternLM, MiniCPM, Orion, Qwen, StarCoder), the min_p sampling parameter from llama.cpp is exposed, a blank line is defaulted between reply and next prompt for templates without %2, and Nous-Hermes-2-Mistral-7B-DPO is added to the official models list. Fixes address compilation warnings on macOS, crashes with ChatGPT API key and clone add/remove, layer norm epsilon in BERT, and wrong number of GPU layers for clones.

chunks.title: v2.7.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v2.7.3, groundwork is laid for a 'removedIn' field in models3.json based on an unused 'deprecated' field. A warning dialog is implemented for old Mistral OpenOrca, chat deletion is made significantly faster, a new smaller MPT model without duplicated tensor is introduced, the API server port is made configurable, settings for the currently selected model are shown by default, and installed models are kept in the list when searching. Fixes include the 'Download models' button not appearing on some Linux systems, undefined behavior in ChatLLM::resetContext, ChatGPT restore from text and context issues after v2.7.1, TypeError warnings on exit, startup speed regression from v2.7.2, hiding SBert and non-GUI models from default model choices, not listing cloned models on downloads page, not showing old deleted models in downloads list, and inability to cancel model download.

chunks.title: v2.7.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v2.7.4, a right-click menu is added to the chat, the left sidebar is changed to stay open, text width in chat is limited, the SBert implementation is moved to llama.cpp's, support for models provided by the Mistral AI API is added, Ghost 7B v0.9.1, Llama 3 Instruct, and Phi-3 Mini Instruct are added to the models list, documentation and FAQ links are added to the New Chat page, the Mistral OpenOrca system prompt is simplified, and accuracy of anonymous usage statistics is improved. Fixes include detecting unsupported CPUs on Windows, fixing server chat colors, startup issues with non-Latin characters in paths, LocalDocs context links not working, incorrect code block syntax display, and unnecessary indexing of document collections on startup.

chunks.title: v2.7.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v2.7.5, the accuracy of anonymous usage statistics is improved, and fixes are applied to some issues with anonymous usage statistics. The default GPU selection on Windows and Linux is changed to the one with the most VRAM instead of the least, and an initial failure to generate embeddings with Nomic Embed is fixed.

chunks.title: v2.8.0-pre1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all pre-release v2.8.0-pre1, the context menu replaces 'Select All' on a message with 'Copy Message' and hides Copy/Cut when nothing is selected. The speed of context switch after quickly switching between several chats is improved. New Chat behavior is changed to always switch to the new chat and scroll to the top of the list when the button is clicked. The llama.cpp backend is updated as of May 9, 2024, adding support for the llama.cpp CUDA backend (with Nomic Vulkan still default, CUDA devices selectable in Settings, greatly improved prompt processing and generation speed on some devices, and GPU support for Q5_0, Q5_1, Q8_0, K-quants, I-quants, and Mixtral) and support for InternLM models. Fixes include preventing sending a message while the LLM is responding, fixing poor quality of generated chat titles with many models, setting the window icon correctly on Windows, fixing memory leaks, not crashing if a model file has no architecture key, fixing model loading progress display, fixing new chat scrolling above the top of the list on startup, showing a 'Metal' device option on macOS and actually using CPU when 'CPU' is selected, and removing unsupported Mamba, Persimmon, and PLaMo models from the whitelist.

chunks.title: v2.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v2.8.0, the context menu replaces 'Select All' on a message with 'Copy Message' and hides Copy/Cut when nothing is selected. The speed of context switch after quickly switching between several chats is improved. New Chat behavior is changed to always switch to the new chat and scroll to the top of the list when the button is clicked. The llama.cpp backend is updated as of May 9, 2024, adding support for the llama.cpp CUDA backend (with Nomic Vulkan still default, CUDA devices selectable in Settings, greatly improved prompt processing and generation speed on some devices, and GPU support for Q5_0, Q5_1, Q8_0, K-quants, I-quants, and Mixtral) and support for InternLM models. Fixes include preventing sending a message while the LLM is responding, fixing poor quality of generated chat titles with many models, setting the window icon correctly on Windows, fixing memory leaks, not crashing if a model file has no architecture key, fixing model loading progress display, fixing new chat scrolling above the top of the list on startup, showing a 'Metal' device option on macOS and actually using CPU when 'CPU' is selected, removing unsupported Mamba, Persimmon, and PLaMo models from the whitelist, and fixing GPT4All.desktop being created by offline installers on macOS.

chunks.title: v3.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.0.0, a complete UI overhaul is performed. LocalDocs is improved by using nomic-embed-text-v1.5 as the local model instead of SBert, shipping the local model with the application instead of downloading afterwards, storing embeddings flat in SQLite DB instead of in hnswlib index, and doing exact KNN search with usearch instead of approximate KNN search with hnswlib. Markdown support is added, and CUDA/Metal device option for embeddings is supported. Fixes include embedding tokenization after #2310, a crash when loading certain models with 'code' in their name, an embedding crash with large chunk sizes after #2310, inability to load models with non-ASCII path on Windows, non-fatal DLL errors on Windows with CUDA, LocalDocs fixes (always using requested number of snippets even if better matches in unselected collections, checking for deleted files on startup), CUDA PTX errors with some builds, blank device in UI after model switch and improved usage stats, using CPU instead of CUDA backend when GPU loading fails the first time, and a crash when sending a message greater than n_ctx tokens after #1970.

chunks.title: v3.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.1.0, suggested follow-up questions are generated. Scaffolding for translations is added, with Spanish (MX), Chinese (Simplified), Romanian, Chinese (Traditional), and Italian translations. Dynamic changes of language and locale at runtime are supported. Combo boxes and context menus are customized to fit the new style, view bar scaling and Model Settings layout are improved, the logo spins while the model is generating, the server replies to wrong GET/POST method with HTTP 405 instead of 404, the theme for menus is updated, the 'stop' button is moved to the message box, the build uses CUDA 11.8 for better compatibility, links in the latest news section are made clickable, translation of settings choices is supported, the LocalDocs view's error message is improved, case of LocalDocs file extensions is ignored, llama.cpp is updated to commit 87e397d00 from July 19th adding support for GPT-NeoX, Gemma 2, OpenELM, ChatGLM, and Jais architectures (all with Vulkan support) and enabling Vulkan support for StarCoder2, XVERSE, Command R, and OLMo, a scrollbar is shown in chat collections list as needed, and support for GPT-J models is removed. Fixes address placement of thumbs-down and datalake opt-in dialogs, selecting the correct folder with the Linux fallback folder dialog, clone button sometimes producing blank model info, jerky chat view scrolling, 'reload' showing for chats with missing models, property binding loop warning, UI hang with certain chat view content, crash when Kompute falls back to CPU, and several Vulkan resource management issues.

chunks.title: v3.1.0-web_search_beta
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.1.0-web_search_beta, a new web search feature powered by Llama 3.1 is introduced as a beta version. Users are directed to a guide on the GitHub wiki for usage instructions and to a Discord channel for questions and feedback.

chunks.title: v3.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.1.1, the ability to add OpenAI compatible remote models is added. A fix updates llama.cpp to cherry-pick a Llama 3.1 RoPE fix.

chunks.title: v3.1.1-web_search_beta_2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.1.1-web_search_beta_2, version 2 of the web search beta includes important fixes: updating to latest llama.cpp with RoPE fix, fixing display of only one source for tool call excerpts, adding extra snippets to source excerpts, fixing the way context is injected back into the model for web search, and changing the suggestion mode to turn on for tool calls by default. A warning notes a synchronization problem requiring manual renaming of the model file and copying prompt template and system prompt.

chunks.title: v3.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.2.0, Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct is added to models3.json, and the translation feature is enabled for seven languages: English, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, Romanian. Missing entries are added to the Italian translation. llama_kv_cache ops are used to shift context faster, and generation no longer stops at end of context. Fixes include case-insensitive LocalDocs source icon detection, comparison of pre- and post-release versions for update check and models3.json, several backend issues, restoring leading space removal logic, a CUDA crash with long conversations since #2694, making reverse prompt detection work more reliably and preventing it from breaking output, disallowing context shift for chat name and follow-up generation to prevent bugs, and explicitly targeting macOS 12.6 in CI to fix Metal compatibility on older macOS.

chunks.title: v3.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.2.1, a potential Vulkan crash on application exit on some Linux systems is fixed, and a bad CUDA build option that led to gibberish on newer NVIDIA GPUs is fixed.

chunks.title: v3.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.3.0, UI improvements include the minimum window size adapting to font size, fixing labels and links, the Embeddings Device selection of 'Auto'/'Application default' working again, setting the window icon on Linux, and displaying an antenna icon when the API server is listening. Only one instance of GPT4All can be opened at a time. Greedy sampling is enabled by setting temperature to zero. The built-in API server now responds correctly to both legacy completions and chats with message history, and uses the system prompt configured in the UI. The Italian, Romanian, and Traditional Chinese translations are updated.

chunks.title: v3.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.3.1, a crash when attempting to continue a chat loaded from disk is fixed, and the local server rejecting min_p/top_p less than 1 is fixed.

chunks.title: v3.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.4.0, attached files support is added for Microsoft Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx). The LocalDocs algorithm is enhanced for more accurate references, and Microsoft Word (.docx) documents are supported natively (with a note to ensure 'docx' is in allowed file extensions). Issues with the 'Redo last chat response' button and continuing chats from previous sessions are fixed. On exit, GPT4All no longer saves chats that are not new or modified, enabling future downgrading without losing access to all chats. The model list no longer scrolls to the top when starting a download. Llama 3.2 Instruct 3B and 1B models are added to the model list.

chunks.title: v3.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.4.1, several issues with LocalDocs in v3.4.0 are fixed, including missing words and very slow indexing. Go code syntax highlighting is corrected. The model list cache is stored with a version number and in a more appropriate directory. The Italian translation is improved.

chunks.title: v3.4.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.4.2, several LocalDocs issues, some introduced in v3.4.0, are fixed: possible use of references from unselected collections, unnecessary reindexing of files with uppercase extensions, hybrid search failure due to inconsistent database state, blank Embeddings Device selection in LocalDocs settings, and indexing of large PDFs making very slow progress or stalling.

chunks.title: v3.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.5.0, message editing is introduced, allowing editing of any sent message by clicking a pencil icon and redoing earlier responses. Chat templates are completely overhauled to use Jinja-style syntax. File attachments now support Markdown and plain text files. An option in Application Settings allows GPT4All to minimize to the system tray instead of closing. The local API server now supports system messages from the client and no longer uses the system message in settings, and messages can be sent in any order supported by the model instead of just user/assistant pairs. The Italian and Romanian translations are improved.

chunks.title: v3.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.5.1, chat template fixes are applied for Llama 3.2 models, Nous Hermes 2 Mistral, Mistral OpenOrca, Qwen 2, and remote models. A bugfix restores the default model button functionality after v3.5.0.

chunks.title: v3.5.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.5.2, model search now has separate tabs for official and third-party models. Several mistakes in v3.5's changes to the API server are corrected. The chat template and system message of cloned models now manage their defaults correctly. The Romanian and Italian translations are updated.

chunks.title: v3.5.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.5.3, a serious issue causing LocalDocs to not work properly in v3.5.2 is fixed.

chunks.title: v3.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.6.0, Reasoner v1 is introduced with a built-in JavaScript code interpreter tool and a custom curated model that uses the code interpreter to break down, analyze, perform, and verify complex reasoning tasks. Chat templates automatically substitute incompatible ones in GGUFs. Fixes include allowing XML in messages for remote model templates, a Jinja2Cpp bug that broke system message detection in chat templates, and LocalDocs sources displaying in unconsolidated form after v3.5.0.

chunks.title: v3.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.6.1, fixes address the stop generation button and the copy entire conversation button no longer working in v3.6.0.

chunks.title: v3.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.7.0, Windows ARM support is added for devices with Qualcomm Snapdragon and Microsoft SQ-series processors, though only CPU is used for LLMs and a separate Windows ARM installer is required. Updating on macOS is fixed so the maintenance tool no longer crashes on Sequoia, and chat saving on macOS is fixed when quitting with Command-Q. Code interpreter improvements include better timeout behavior and console.log accepting multiple arguments. Chat templating improvements fix two crashes and one compatibility issue in the parser, fix the default chat template for EM German Mistral, and add automatic replacements for five new models.

chunks.title: v3.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.8.0, native DeepSeek-R1-Distill support is added with several model variants available on the downloads page, reasoning displayed similarly to the Reasoner model, the DeepSeek-R1 Qwen pretokenizer supported, and a GPT4All-compatible prompt template configured by default. The chat templating parser is completely replaced with one having much better compatibility with common models. Code interpreter fixes address an issue preventing logging a single string in v3.7.0 and the UI freezing while the code interpreter runs. Local server fixes address an issue preventing the server from using LocalDocs after the first request since v3.5.0 and system messages being correctly hidden from message history.

chunks.title: v3.9.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.9.0, LocalDocs no longer shows an error on later messages with reasoning models. DeepSeek-R1 reasoning in 'think' tags no longer appears in chat names and follow-up questions. Windows ARM improvements fix graphical artifacts on some SoCs and a crash when adding a collection of PDFs to LocalDocs. Template parser fixes prevent GPT4All from freezing on chat templates containing an unclosed comment. New models OLMoE and Granite MoE are supported.

chunks.title: v3.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nomic-ai/gpt4all release v3.10.0, the Add Model page has a dedicated tab for remote model providers, making Groq, OpenAI, and Mistral remote models easier to configure. CUDA compatibility is extended to GPUs with compute capability 5.0 such as the GTX 750. The non-MoE Granite model is supported. The Italian translation is updated and the Simplified Chinese translation is significantly improved. Default chat templates for OLMoE 7B 0924/0125 and Granite 3.1 3B/8B are improved. DeepSeek-R1-based models have better whitespace behavior in output. Several potential crash issues are fixed.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent nuxt/nuxt release stream across v3 and v4 minor and patch releases, highlighting features like lazy hydration macros, enhanced chunk stability, abort control for data fetching, route rule layouts, and ISR/SWR payload extraction.

chunks.title: v4.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nuxt/nuxt release v4.0.1, the first regularly scheduled patch release of v4, fixes include adding nuxt.schema files to node tsconfig context, unpinning nitropack, and exposing shared aliases within the shared/ directory. Refactors pass file language directly to parser options. Documentation updates remove rc tag references, add the new Shared folder to v4 folder structure examples, update nuxt.new links to v4, and reference the noUncheckedIndexedAccess rule change. Build specifies nitropack types as external.

chunks.title: v3.18.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nuxt/nuxt release v3.18.0, a minor release backporting features from Nuxt v4, highlights include lazy hydration macros (defineLazyHydrationComponent) for ergonomic hydration control, accessibility improvements with built-in NuxtRouteAnnouncer in app.vue, Chrome DevTools workspace integration, typed slots for ClientOnly and DevOnly, exported NuxtTime prop types, auto-import of onWatcherCleanup, page routes exposed to Nitro for observability, simplified addServerImports for modules, ability for modules to add to typescript.hoist, and performance optimizations in vite-node communication.

chunks.title: v4.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the nuxt/nuxt release v4.0.2, a patch release, fixes include providing typed slots for ClientOnly and DevOnly, adding trailing slash to some dir aliases, constraining global defineAppConfig type, including module types in app context, including source base url for remote islands, using vite node server to transform requests, using mlly to parse module paths, and executing all plugins after error rendering error.vue. Documentation updates include new installation command, AI-assisted contribution guidelines, hydration best practice, module .with() example, and replacing dead Vue Router docs links.

chunks.title: v3.18.1

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent obsproject/obs-studio release stream from the 31.0.0 beta cycle through the 32.1.x stable releases, covering major feature introductions, hotfixes, and UI overhauls.

chunks.title: OBS Studio 31.0.0 Beta 3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the obsproject/obs-studio release 31.0.0-beta3, the release note details Beta 3 changes including fixes for a Linux AUTHORS file loading regression, encoder loading issues, a shutdown crash with browser panels, Frontend API event dispatch, and the 'Show Profile Folder' menu behavior. It also fixes a PipeWire memory leak, a crash when importing Windows scene collections on Linux, a Vulkan capture crash on Windows, and FreeBSD SSL certificate handling. Theme fixes address pressed button color in Rachni and missing icons in System theme. Legacy YouTube chat is removed, and TikTok Virtual Camera is blocked. Beta 2 changes include fixes for profile/scene collection deletion selection, backup file deletion, launch parameter crashes, FreeBSD launch crash, Linux browser panel freeze, Yami Light and mute button theme bugs, group coordinate issues, and NVENC b-frame settings. New features for 31.0 include NVIDIA Blur Filter and Background Blur, preview scrollbars and zoom/scale indicator, v210 format support for AJA device capture, Amazon IVS service integration, QSV AV1 Screen Content Coding, and first-party YouTube Chat features. Changes include CEF update to version 127, relative coordinates for scene items, splitting NVIDIA Audio Effects from Noise Suppression, and Image Slideshow Playback Mode dropdown change.

chunks.title: OBS Studio 31.0.0 Release Candidate 1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the obsproject/obs-studio release 31.0.0-rc1, the release note describes Release Candidate 1 changes that fix a YouTube dock profile switching issue, a possible deadlock with NVIDIA Audio Filters, a crash when multitrack output fails to start, a macOS audio device disconnect crash, a Windows D3D12 game capture crash, spurious connection errors with Amazon IVS auto URLs, Decklink Input/Output breakage, and an Auto Configuration Wizard stream key alteration when Multitrack Video is enabled. Scripts now correctly pass settings to modified callbacks on reload. Legacy QSV code for Haswell or older devices and for Windows 7 is removed. The note also includes the Beta 3 and Beta 2 changes from earlier pre-releases.

chunks.title: OBS Studio 31.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the obsproject/obs-studio release 31.0.0, the release note announces the stable release with new features including NVIDIA Blur Filter and Background Blur, preview scrollbars and zoom/scale indicator, v210 format support for AJA device capture, Amazon IVS service integration, QSV AV1 Screen Content Coding, and first-party YouTube Chat features. Changes include updating CEF to version 127, switching scene items to relative coordinates, splitting NVIDIA Audio Effects from Noise Suppression, changing Image Slideshow Playback Mode to a dropdown, disabling the Automatic Scene Switcher on Wayland, improving macOS Virtual Camera error messages, changing default capture behavior on Windows and Linux, adding a warning for WinUI 3 BitBlt capture, refactoring NVENC with SDK 12.2 features like split encoding and CQVBR, improving Linux screensaver inhibit in Flatpak, and removing legacy QSV code, NVIDIA Kepler NVENC support, FTL support, legacy migrations from OBS 28.1 and earlier, Ubuntu 22.04 support, legacy YouTube chat, and TikTok Virtual Camera. Application settings are split into app and user configuration. Bug fixes address QSV encoder crashes on Linux, multitrack video reconnect race conditions, Linux Window Capture crashes, macOS audio device disconnect crash, Windows D3D12 and Vulkan capture crashes, and Linux scene collection import crash.

chunks.title: OBS Studio 31.0.1

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent ocornut/imgui release stream from v1.90.1 through v1.92.8, covering new features, breaking changes, backend updates, and debug tool improvements across multiple minor and patch versions.

chunks.title: v1.90.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.90.1, the project introduces new 'Debug Break' buttons that appear when io.ConfigDebugIsDebuggerPresent is enabled, allows manual input of nan/inf values in scalar widgets, and improves the native OSX backend to handle multi-monitors and viewports decently. This release also includes over 30 other improvements and fixes.

chunks.title: v1.90.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.90.2, the project delivers many navigation improvements and fixes, debug tools improvements, backend fixes, and better input routing features for docked and multi-viewport based applications.

chunks.title: v1.90.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.90.3, the project fixes menu and popup sizing so that child menus with lots of contents are properly clamped to parent viewport boundaries and show a scrollbar. It also includes breaking changes in backends: SDL2 removes an obsolete NewFrame signature, Vulkan moves RenderPass parameter into InitInfo structure, and dynamic rendering now requires PipelineRenderingCreateInfo. Other changes include SDL2/SDL3 gamepad handling improvements, DirectX9 using RGBA format to avoid CPU conversion, and a fix for ImFileOpen before context creation.

chunks.title: v1.90.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.90.4, the project fixes a menu closing issue, restores focus/tabbing API on windows with ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs, improves Table Angled Headers mode with fixes for multi-line labels, CellPadding changes, auto-resizing, and background fill, promotes DebugStartItemPicker() to public API, and adds an optional alpha multiplier parameter to GetColorU32.

chunks.title: v1.90.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.90.5, the project adds concave polygon rendering, fixes a menus/popup erroneous closing regression when moving the mouse fast, and includes dozens of various fixes. Breaking changes include formally obsoleting GetKeyIndex() and merging radius parameters in AddEllipse/AddEllipseFilled/PathEllipticalArcTo into a single ImVec2. Other changes cover scrollbar visibility, double-click to collapse, child window resizing, table auto-width fixes, and more.

chunks.title: v1.90.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.90.6, the project changes the default ClipRect to extend to windows' left and right borders, fixes subsequent Begin() append calls from setting last item information for title bar, fixes font ascent and descent calculation, adds ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_SpanTextWidth, and includes various table and other fixes.

chunks.title: v1.90.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.90.7, the project introduces automatic swapping of Cmd and Ctrl keys on macOS X via io.AddKeyEvent(), removes ImGuiMod_Shortcut, and comments out obsolete symbols from 1.88. It also includes breaking changes in SDL_Renderer2/3 backends requiring an SDL_Renderer* parameter, and various other fixes and improvements.

chunks.title: v1.90.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.90.8, the project fixes IsMouseClicked with repeat, fixes altering FramePadding mid-frame, makes scrollbar scrolling more standard with page scrolling and repeat, fixes vertical scrollbar visibility miscalculation, and adds options to hide or omit zero values in various widgets.

chunks.title: v1.90.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.90.9, the project removes old nested structure by renaming ImGuiStoragePair, adds ImGuiChildFlags_NavFlattened as replacement for ImGuiWindowFlags_NavFlattened, renames tab colors for clarity, adds io.ClearInputMouse(), and renames ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceNoPreviewTooltip.

chunks.title: v1.91.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.91.0, the project introduces multi-select, box-select, item flags, and links. It also renames platform IME hook and adds explicit context, and includes many other changes and fixes.

chunks.title: v1.91.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.91.1, the project moves platform-related handlers from ImGuiIO to ImGuiPlatformIO, renames ImGuiChildFlags_Border to ImGuiChildFlags_Borders, and includes many fixes and improvements.

chunks.title: v1.91.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.91.2, the project adds io.ConfigDebugHighlightIdConflicts debug feature to detect duplicate identifiers, adds ImGuiItemFlags_AllowDuplicateId, and includes table fixes and faster input text.

chunks.title: v1.91.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.91.3, the project enables opt-in error recovery features, changes drag behavior for v_min==v_max clamping, and includes miscellaneous drags, tooltips, scrollbar, and backends work.

chunks.title: v1.91.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.91.4, the project renames ImGuiCol_NavHighlight to ImGuiCol_NavCursor, changes ImTextureID typedef to ImU64, moves NavEnableSetMousePos and NavNoCaptureKeyboard to standalone io options, and adds keyboard/gamepad nav options, draw callback data, and backend render state.

chunks.title: v1.91.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.91.5, the project comments out pre-1.87 IO system, removes io.KeyMap[] and io.KeysDown[], obsoletes ImGuiKey_COUNT, and includes many tweaks and fixes.

chunks.title: v1.91.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.91.6, the project changes DX12 Init() signature to take an InitInfo struct, changes CRC32 table to CRC32c polynomial, and includes general maintenance fixes.

chunks.title: v1.91.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.91.7, the project highlights new third-party extensions ImOGuizmo and ImPlot3d, and includes various fixes and improvements.

chunks.title: v1.91.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.91.8, the project includes various fixes and improvements, and highlights third-party extensions ImOGuizmo and ImPlot3d.

chunks.title: v1.91.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.91.9, the project removes tint_col and border_col parameters from Image(), introduces ImageWithBg(), and includes other changes and fixes.

chunks.title: v1.91.9b
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.91.9b, the project provides a hotfix for an assert/crashing bug related to loading table settings in certain instances, fixing issues with reordered columns and DefaultHide/DefaultSort flags.

chunks.title: v1.92.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.92.0, the project adds a protocol for backends to create, update, and destroy textures, allows fonts to be rendered at any size with dynamic glyph loading, supports retina screen rendering by default, updates 13 standard backends for ImGuiBackendFlags_RendererHasTextures, and includes tree hierarchy outlines, better child window resizing, input text fixes, table fixes, and keyboard/gamepad nav fixes.

chunks.title: v1.92.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ocornut/imgui release v1.92.1, the project adds ImFontAtlas::SetFontLoader() to dynamically change font loader, fixes a bug where changing font loader would lose Fallback and Ellipsis glyphs, optimizes large font size layout calculation, sets a maximum font size of 512.0f, and includes other maintenance fixes.

chunks.title: v1.92.2

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent ollama/ollama release stream from v0.17.6 through v0.24.0, covering new model support, integration launches, performance improvements, and bug fixes.

chunks.title: v0.17.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.17.6, the project fixes an issue where GLM-OCR would not work due to incorrect prompt rendering, and fixes tool calling parsing and rendering for Qwen 3.5 models. A new contributor @Victor-Quqi made their first contribution.

chunks.title: v0.17.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.17.7, the project allows thinking levels such as "medium" to be correctly interpreted in Ollama's API for all thinking models, and adds context length to support compaction when using `ollama launch`.

chunks.title: v0.17.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.17.8, the project includes parser repairs for unclosed arg_value tags in GLM tool calls, reapplies a change to not require pulling stubs for cloud models, formats compatibility docs, fixes localhost handling in create, improves Docker parallelism, adds int4 groupsize 64 for MLX, handles stream disconnects gracefully in cloud_proxy, replaces the sampler interface chain with a single stateful Sampler in x/mlxrunner, updates ROCm on Linux to v7.2, fixes reset to defaults disabling auto-update in the app, gets parameters from modelfile during model creation in MLX, adds header vendoring and removes go build tag for MLX, and fixes the Windows build.

chunks.title: v0.18.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.18.0, Ollama 0.18 includes improved performance for OpenClaw and cloud models, including the new Nemotron-3-Super model by NVIDIA for high-performance agentic reasoning tasks. It improves OpenClaw performance with Kimi-K2.5 (up to 2x faster speeds and improved tool calling accuracy), makes Ollama a provider in OpenClaw, introduces non-interactive task support with `ollama launch --yes`, lowers latency on MiniMax-M2.5 and Qwen3.5 on Ollama's cloud, and requires driver updates for ROCm 7. Cloud models no longer require downloading via `ollama pull`; setting `:cloud` as a tag automatically connects to cloud models. The `--yes` flag for `ollama launch` skips all prompts. It fixes an issue where "Reset to Defaults" would disable automatic updates, and ensures context compaction occurs at the correct context length for each model when using `ollama launch claude`.

chunks.title: v0.18.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.18.1, Ollama ships with web search and web fetch plugin for OpenClaw, allowing local or cloud models to search the web and fetch readable content. Non-interactive (headless) mode for `ollama launch` is introduced, suitable for Docker/containers, CI/CD, and scripts/automation; `--model` must be specified and `--yes` auto-pulls the model. `ollama launch openclaw` now uses the official Ollama auth and model provider for OpenClaw. Improvements to Ollama's benchmarking tool in `./cmd/bench` are included, and `ollama launch openclaw` skips `--install-daemon` when systemd is unavailable.

chunks.title: v0.18.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.18.2, the project adds an extra check to ensure `npm` and `git` are installed before installing OpenClaw, makes Claude Code faster when run locally by preventing cache breakages, fixes support for `ollama launch openclaw --model <model>`, and registers Ollama's websearch package correctly for OpenClaw.

chunks.title: v0.18.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.18.3, Microsoft Visual Studio Code now directly integrates with Ollama via GitHub Copilot; any local or cloud model from Ollama can be selected for use within VS Code. The release also includes GLM parser improvements for tool calls and OpenClaw integration improvements for gateway checks.

chunks.title: v0.18.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.18.4, the project forces flash attention off for grok in ggml, fixes a KV cache snapshot memory leak in MLX, schedules periodic snapshots during prefill in mlxrunner, and updates the VS Code documentation.

chunks.title: v0.19.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.19.0, Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview, built on Apple's machine learning framework to take advantage of unified memory architecture. The app no longer incorrectly shows "model is out of date". `ollama launch pi` now includes a web search plugin using Ollama's web search. The release improves KV cache hit rate when using the Anthropic-compatible API, fixes a tool call parsing issue with Qwen3.5 where tool calls would be output in thinking, makes the MLX runner create periodic snapshots during prompt processing, fixes a KV cache snapshot memory leak in the MLX runner, fixes an issue where flash attention would be incorrectly enabled for grok models, and fixes `qwen3-next:80b` not loading in Ollama.

chunks.title: v0.20.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.20.0, the project introduces Gemma 4 models: Effective 2B (E2B), Effective 4B (E4B), 26B (Mixture of Experts with 4B active parameters), and 31B (Dense). It updates pi docs, makes MLX respect tokenizer add_bos_token setting in pipeline, and adds SentencePiece-style BPE support to the tokenizer.

chunks.title: v0.20.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.20.1, the project adds prompt calibration, context size flag, and NumCtx reporting to the bench tool, fixes gemma4 arg parsing when quoted strings contain a double quote, skips cublasGemmBatchedEx during graph reservation in ggml, enables flash attention for gemma4, fixes the ROCm build for the cublasGemmBatchedEx reserve wrapper, and reworks gemma4 tool call handling.

chunks.title: v0.20.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.20.2, the app defaults the home view to new chat instead of launch.

chunks.title: v0.20.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.20.3, the project includes Gemma 4 Tool Calling improvements, adds latest models to the Ollama App, and fixes OpenClaw for launching TUI.

chunks.title: v0.20.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.20.4, the project improves M5 performance with NAX in MLX and enables flash attention for gemma4.

chunks.title: v0.20.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.20.5, the project introduces OpenClaw channel setup with `ollama launch`, enabling connection of WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, and other messaging channels. It enables flash attention for Gemma 4 on compatible GPUs, makes `ollama launch opencode` detect curl-based OpenCode installs at `~/.opencode/bin`, and fixes the `/save` command for models imported from safetensors.

chunks.title: v0.20.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.20.6, Gemma 4 tool calling ability is improved and updated to use Google's latest post-launch fixes, parallel tool calling is improved for streaming responses, a Hermes agent Ollama integration guide is now available, and the Ollama app is updated to fix image attachment errors.

chunks.title: v0.20.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.20.7, the project fixes the quality of gemma:e2b and gemma:e4b when thinking is disabled, and updates ROCm to 7.2.1 on Linux.

chunks.title: v0.21.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.21.0, the project introduces Hermes Agent, which learns with the user and automatically creates skills. It adds support for running Gemma 4 via MLX on Apple Silicon, including a text-only MLX runtime, mixed-precision quantization, better capability detection, and new op wrappers. It adds Hermes and GitHub Copilot CLI in `ollama launch`, moves OpenCode to inline config, prevents `ollama launch` from rewriting config when nothing changed, fixes `ollama launch openclaw --yes` to skip channels configuration, restores the Gemma 4 nothink renderer, fixes a Gemma 4 compiler error breaking Metal builds, fixes macOS cross-compiles, and quiets cgo builds.

chunks.title: v0.21.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.21.1, the project adds the Kimi CLI, installable via `ollama launch kimi --model kimi-k2.6:cloud`. The MLX runner adds logprobs support, faster sampling with fused top-P and top-K, improved prompt tokenization, and better thread safety. GLM4 MoE Lite performance is improved with a fused sigmoid router head. It fixes the model picker showing a stale model after switching chats in the macOS app, and fixes structured outputs for Gemma 4 when `think=false`.

chunks.title: v0.21.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.21.2, the project improves the reliability of the OpenClaw onboarding flow in `ollama launch`, makes recommended models appear in a fixed canonical order, and bundles Ollama's web search plugin in OpenClaw.

chunks.title: v0.21.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.21.3, the API accepts "max" as a think value, and the OpenAI compatibility layer maps responses reasoning effort to think.

chunks.title: v0.22.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.22.0, the project adds new models: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Omni and Poolside's first open-weight coding model Laguna XS.2.

chunks.title: v0.22.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.22.1, the project updates the Gemma 4 renderer for thinking and tool calling improvements, makes model recommendations updatable without updating Ollama, aligns the desktop app's launch page with `ollama launch` integrations, and fixes the Poolside integration title in `ollama launch`.

chunks.title: v0.23.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.23.0, Claude Desktop is now supported with `ollama launch claude-desktop`, including Claude Cowork and Claude Code within the Claude Desktop App. The Ollama app now surfaces featured models from server-driven recommendations. It fixes OpenClaw gateway timeout on Windows by enforcing IPv4 loopback, and hardens Metal initialization to gracefully handle ggml kernel compilation failures.

chunks.title: v0.23.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.23.1, Gemma 4 MTP (Multi-token Processing) speculative decoding is supported on Macs via the MLX runner, providing over 2x speed increase for Gemma 4 31B on coding tasks. It updates MLX and MLX-C with threading fixes, bumps Go to 1.26, and adds Gemma 4 MTP speculative decoding.

chunks.title: v0.23.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.23.2, `ollama launch` no longer includes Claude Desktop due to the third-party integration being limited to Anthropic models; use `ollama launch claude-desktop --restore` to restore. `/api/show` responses are now cached, improving median latency by ~6.7x. It improves backup workflow when managing launch integrations and cleans up image generation layout in the MLX runner.

chunks.title: v0.23.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.23.3, the project refines MLX model push behavior, hardens integration tests, hardens update flows in the app, updates the imagegen runner for MLX thread affinity, avoids status timeout during inference in MLX, and fixes macOS 26 target leakage in v3 metallib.

chunks.title: v0.30.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.30.0, Ollama 0.30 is now available with improved compatibility and performance using llama.cpp, augmenting the MLX engine on Apple Silicon and bringing support to a wider range of hardware, including GGUF-based models from Hugging Face and fine-tuned models, with faster performance on NVIDIA hardware. Known issues: laguna-xs.2 not yet supported on Windows/Linux, llama3.2-vision not yet supported, and nomic-embed-text now converts inputs to lowercase per the model card.

chunks.title: v0.23.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.23.4, `ollama launch opencode` now supports vision models with image inputs, and fixes formatting of Claude tool results when using local image paths.

chunks.title: v0.24.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ollama/ollama release v0.24.0, Ollama 0.24 includes support for the Codex App, OpenAI's desktop experience for working on Codex threads in parallel with built-in worktree support and git functionality. It features a built-in browser for annotating pages, review mode for leaving comments, and model recommendations for coding tasks. The MLX sampler is reworked for improved generation quality on Apple Silicon.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent open-webui/open-webui release stream from v0.6.37 through v0.9.6, covering major feature additions like granular sharing permissions, group channels, native function calling, analytics dashboard, desktop app, and knowledge base sync tool, along with numerous performance improvements and security fixes.

chunks.title: v0.6.37
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.6.37, granular sharing permissions are introduced with two-tiered control separating group sharing from public sharing, allowing administrators to independently configure whether users can share workspace items with groups or make them publicly accessible, with separate permission toggles for models, knowledge bases, prompts, tools, and notes. Password policy enforcement is added with configurable validation rules via ENABLE_PASSWORD_VALIDATION and PASSWORD_VALIDATION_REGEX_PATTERN environment variables. Granular import and export permissions are introduced for workspace items with six separate permission toggles disabled by default. Default group assignment for new users is added. Password-based authentication can be fully disabled via ENABLE_PASSWORD_AUTH. Large stream chunk handling is implemented to support models that generate images directly in output responses. Streaming response middleware now handles images in delta updates with automatic base64 conversion. Model list API performance is optimized by pre-fetching user group memberships and removing profile image URLs from response payloads. Batch file processing performance is improved by reducing database queries by 67%. Chat import performance is dramatically improved.

chunks.title: v0.6.38
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.6.38, hybrid search is fixed to work reliably after recent changes. Tool server saving now handles errors gracefully, preventing failed saves from impacting the UI. SSO/OIDC code is fixed to improve login reliability and better handle edge cases.

chunks.title: v0.6.39
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.6.39, a user list modal is added to channels, displaying all users with access and featuring search, sorting, and pagination. Channel navigation now displays the total number of users with access. Tool servers and MCP connections now support function name filtering with allow/block lists. A toggle to disable parallel embedding processing is added via ENABLE_ASYNC_EMBEDDING. Various frontend and backend improvements are implemented. Localization improvements are made for German and Portuguese (Brazil). Inline citations are fixed to render correctly within markdown lists. Group member selection is fixed. Admin panel user list now displays correct total user count and paginates 30 items per page. Knowledge base reindexing is fixed. OpenAI image generation is fixed. Docling configuration is consolidated into a single DOCLING_PARAMS JSON configuration and now supports API key authentication via DOCLING_API_KEY, requiring migration. The environment variable REPLACE_IMAGE_URLS_IN_CHAT_RESPONSE is renamed to ENABLE_CHAT_RESPONSE_BASE64_IMAGE_URL_CONVERSION.

chunks.title: v0.6.40
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.6.40, a critical PostgreSQL user listing performance issue is resolved by removing a redundant count operation that caused severe database slowdowns and potential timeouts when viewing user lists in admin panels.

chunks.title: v0.6.41
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.6.41, sign-in rate limiting is implemented to protect against brute force attacks, limiting login attempts to 15 per 3-minute window per email address using Redis with automatic fallback to in-memory storage. Administrators can now globally disable the folders feature and control user-level folder permissions. Group channels are introduced as a new channel type enabling membership-based collaboration spaces with public or private visibility, automatic member inclusion from specified user groups, member role tracking, and post-creation member management. Direct Message channels are introduced with a dedicated channel type selector and multi-user member selection interface. Direct Message channels now support a complete user-to-user messaging system with member-based access control, automatic deduplication for one-on-one conversations, optional channel naming, and distinct visual presentation using participant avatars. Users can now hide Direct Message channels from their sidebar while preserving message history, with automatic reactivation when new messages arrive. A comprehensive user selection component is added to the channel creation modal. Channel unread message count tracking is implemented with visual badge indicators. Message pinning functionality is added to channels.

chunks.title: v0.6.42
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.6.42, knowledge base file management is overhauled with server-side pagination loading 30 files at a time, dramatically improving performance for large knowledge bases, with server-side search and filtering, view options for files added by the user versus shared files, customizable sorting, and file authorship tracking. Knowledge base file management is enhanced with automatic list refresh after file operations, improved permission validation, and automatic channel-file association. Knowledge command in chat input now uses server-side search for massive performance increases. Knowledge workspace listing now uses server-side pagination loading 30 collections at a time with new search endpoints. Knowledge workspace now displays all collections with read access including shared read-only collections. Bulk website and YouTube video attachment now supports adding multiple URLs at once with automatic YouTube detection and transcript retrieval. Sidebar width is now resizable on desktop devices with persistent storage. Notes feature now supports server-side search and filtering with view options for notes created by the user versus notes shared with them, customizable sorting, and a redesigned interface.

chunks.title: v0.6.43
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.6.43, Python dependency installation issues are resolved by correcting pip dependency handling. Speech-to-Text default content type handling is fixed and refactored to ensure correct MIME type usage. Temporary chat image handling is fixed and refactored. Image action button is fixed, restoring the ability to trigger image generation, editing, and related image actions from the chat UI.

chunks.title: v0.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.7.0, native function calling with built-in tools is added, allowing models to perform multi-step tasks combining web research, knowledge base queries, note-taking, and image generation. Users can ask the model to find relevant context from their notes, past chats, and channel messages. Users can ask the model to search their knowledge bases and retrieve documents without manually attaching files. Models with interleaved thinking support get more refined results from multi-step workflows. When models invoke web search, search results appear as clickable citations in real-time. Users can selectively disable specific built-in tools per model via the model editor's capabilities settings. Pending tool calls are displayed during response generation. Administrators can limit the number of files uploaded to folders using FOLDER_MAX_FILE_COUNT. Users experience transformative speed improvements across the entire application through completely reengineered database connection handling. Users experience significantly faster initial page load times through dynamic loading of document processing libraries.

chunks.title: v0.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.7.1, reliability for low-spec and SQLite deployments is improved by disabling database session sharing by default, fixing page timeouts. Users can re-enable via DATABASE_ENABLE_SESSION_SHARING=true if needed.

chunks.title: v0.7.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.7.2, users no longer experience database connection timeouts under high concurrency due to connections being held during LLM calls, telemetry collection, and file status streaming. Users can now create and save prompts in the workspace prompts editor without encountering errors. Users can now use local Whisper for speech-to-text when STT_ENGINE is left empty. The Evaluations page now loads faster by eliminating duplicate API calls. Missing Settings tab i18n label keys are fixed.

chunks.title: v0.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.8.0, an analytics dashboard is added showing model usage statistics, token consumption by model and user, user activity rankings, and time-series charts with hourly or daily granularity. Experimental support for Skills is added, allowing users to create and manage reusable AI skills with detailed instructions, reference them in chats using the '$' command, or attach them to specific models. Experimental support for Open Responses protocol is added. The access control UI is redesigned with a more intuitive interface. Per-user resource sharing is added for knowledge bases, prompts, models, tools, channels, and base models. Message queuing is added, allowing messages to be queued while a response is generating.

chunks.title: v0.8.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.8.1, channel user active status checking is faster thanks to optimized database queries. The OpenAI API proxy now supports a /responses endpoint that routes requests to the correct backend based on the model field. Model and prompt list loading performance is improved by pre-fetching user group IDs once. Batch access control queries improve performance when loading models, prompts, and knowledge bases. User lists load faster by deferring profile image loading. The built-in search_web tool now respects the admin-configured Search Result Count setting. SCIM externalId support is added. Portuguese (Brazil) translations are updated. A public sharing security fix prevents users with write access from seeing the Public sharing option regardless of their actual permission. Model access control changes now persist correctly for direct Ollama and OpenAI models. Reasoning trace rendering is fixed.

chunks.title: v0.8.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.8.2, skill content handling is added: user-selected skills have their full content injected into the chat, while model-attached skills only display name and description. Chat toggles now control built-in tools, allowing users to disable web search, image generation, and code execution on a per-conversation basis. Image preview in file modal is added. Batch tag operations use batch database queries. Group list loading is faster with a single database query that joins member counts. Skills sharing permissions are added for administrators. Long content truncation in preview modals is added. Spanish and German translations are enhanced. OAuth session error handling is fixed. Task model selector validation is fixed. Tool call message preservation is fixed. Tool server startup initialization is fixed.

chunks.title: v0.8.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.8.3, a model edit shortcut is added from the model selector dropdown menu. The image edit API now supports the background parameter for OpenAI's gpt-image-1 model. Model access control filtering is faster by removing a redundant database query. Tool call results display arguments in a cleaner key-value format. Various improvements are implemented. Translations for Portuguese (Brazil), Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese are enhanced. The USER_EMAIL template variable is fixed to correctly return the user's email address. Image and file attachment handling is fixed. Missing function error handling is fixed. Startup model pre-fetch error handling is fixed. Function module loading error handling is fixed. A PostgreSQL group query fix is applied.

chunks.title: v0.8.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.8.4, provider URL suggestions are added to the connection form. Anthropic model fetching is added. A no models prompt guides users when no models are available. Connection enable/disable toggles are added. Prompt enable/disable toggle is added. Memory deletion and listing are added for agents. Auto pip install toggle is added via ENABLE_PIP_INSTALL_FRONTMATTER_REQUIREMENTS. An Anthropic Messages API proxy is added. Multi-device OAuth sessions are supported. OAuth group default share setting is added. Various other additions and fixes are included.

chunks.title: v0.8.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the open-webui/open-webui release v0.8.5, a voice dictation shortcut is added using Cmd+Shift+L (or Ctrl+Shift+L on Windows/Linux). A model access KeyError fix prevents the /api/models endpoint from crashing with a 500 error. Frontend initialization resilience is improved to handle individual API failures gracefully. chunks.memory_unit_text: In the openobserve/openobserve release v0.70.0, the release note describes a major release introducing LLM Observability with DAG graph visualization, session views, and user-level analytics for LLM traces; a major Service Graph overhaul with tree view custom tooltips, edge latency trend charts, and baseline-driven coloring; a new Incident Event Timeline with Activity tab; Dashboard Enhancements including panel-level time ranges, stream/field variable support, and table chart pagination; a Query Builder for Logs; 1-Click Data Onboarding; and O2 Assistant navigation, tool search, and image support. New features include DAG Graph for LLM Traces, LLM Session View Backend API, LLM User View, LLM Field in UDS for Traces, O2 Assistant Navigation, O2 Assistant Improvements, Table Chart Pagination, Panel-Level Time Range, Stream and Field Support from Variables, iFrame Support for HTML Chart, Query Builder for Logs Page, Order by Duration for Traces, Traces UI Improvements, Enrich Alert Dimensions from Query Conditions, Incident Event Timeline with Activity Tab, Edge Latency Trend & Interaction Overhaul, Tree View Improvements & Telemetry Correlation, Custom Tooltips, Inside Labels, and Dynamic Node Sizing, Baseline Latency for Edge Coloring, 1-Click Data Onboarding, Vortex File Format Support, and File List Partitioning.
