prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent phpstan/phpstan release stream from 2.1.30 through 2.2.1, including major features like optimized performance with Fibers, PHP 8.5 support, unsealed array shapes, and numerous bug fixes and improvements.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.30, improvements include an alternative solution to disable cloning with --prefer-source, TableErrorFormatter linking paths in JetBrain IDEs, improved ConstantArrayType inference, and inheriting PHPDoc return types in child methods with narrower native return types. Bugfixes address false positives for non-empty-array list checks, duplicate method error messages, offset existence after array_keys, and offset might not exist false-positives. Function signature fixes add bcround for PHP 8.4, remove stream_get_meta_data from delta, and add stream_socket_client/server stubs for param-out.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.31, bleeding edge features include AssignToByRefExprFromForeachRule, curl_setopt_array parameter validation, restricting accepted args of php_uname, requiring non-empty-array for array_rand in PHP 8, and reporting implicit too-wide @throws types. Improvements add config parameters exceptions.check.throwTypeCovariance and checkTooWideThrowTypesInProtectedAndPublicMethods, relax strict printf parameter check, support union types in curl_setopt validation, and report float and null offsets based on PHP version. Bugfixes fix list type loss in for loops, improve FILTER_REQUIRE_ARRAY support, add VersionCompareFunctionDynamicThrowTypeExtension, fix OversizedArrayType::isSubTypeOf, and avoid crashing on enum without value.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.32, improvements add PHP 8.5 support including pipe operator, deprecated casts, deprecated backtick operator, PHP_BUILD_DATE type, global constants attributes, FILTER_THROW_ON_FAILURE for filter_var, array_first and array_last return type extensions, deprecated traits, #[Override] on properties, clone with support, Closure::getCurrent, casts in constant expressions, first class callables in constant expressions, static Closures in constant expressions, and asymmetric visibility in static properties. It introduces NodeCallbackInvoker interface for synthetic AST node rules, CompositeRule for testing, and updates InvalidIncDecOperationRule for deprecations. It also understands always-overwritten arrays in foreach.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.33, improvements include caching files in OptimizedDirectorySourceLocatorFactory, more numeric-string inferences after string concat, improved EnumSanityRule, and not reporting too wide bool return type in trivial methods. Bugfixes de-duplicate phpstan.php errors, fix default level message, handle ini_get('max_memory_limit') as string on PHP 8.5, revert ArrayMapArgVisitor changes, fix 'Array does not have offset' in curl_setopt_array, treat OversizedArray as not truthy, avoid instantiating Accessory without string type, and narrow CURLOPT_SHARE accepting type. Function signature fixes correct DOMNode::C14N return type and definition, and fix time not being considered impure.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.34, major new features include optimized performance with caching of reflection objects and resolved PHPDocs, yielding 25-40% faster analysis, and utilization of Fibers for more precise analysis, solving 10 reported issues. Improvements add ArrayCountValuesDynamicReturnTypeExtension. Bugfixes fix UnionType::getObjectClassReflections, count with COUNT_RECURSIVE, bitwise operators on mixed, immediate unwrap of AlwaysRememberedExpr, range() return type, ArgumentsNormalizer, curl_setopt crash, sealed concrete classes handling, and Accessory types accepts methods. Performance improvements prevent unnecessary scope merging, cache composer.json and neon file reads, optimize keepVoidType, and remember resolved types.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.35, bugfixes fix ArrayCountValuesDynamicReturnTypeExtension and make processStmtNodesInternal synchronous despite Fibers, deep-cloning synthetic nodes before processing. Internals sort actual and expected errors in RuleTestCase, revert error ordering, remove narrowMethodScopeFromConstructor parameter, and prevent unnecessary work around parametersAcceptor->getParameters() call-sites.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.36, bugfixes fix FNSR false positive about expr.resultUnused, fix named argument parameter matching in getFunctionCallStackWithParameters, do not deep-clone nodes, add getScopeType and getScopeNativeType again, and skip polyfills in vendor when on a higher PHP version. Function signature fixes fix uopz_add_function return type. Internals test that expr inside isset can be changed with fixable rule and add regression test.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.37, improvements show LoC/s performance metric with -vvv --debug and add configurable memory cache thresholds for eviction. Bugfixes fix closure type inference, allow infinite loop in never returning function, and fix nested trait @use. Performance improvements include gc_disable in bin/phpstan, preventing repetitive calls to getArgs, ExpressionTypeHolder optimizations, PhpDocBlock inheritance optimizations, NodeDependencies normalization caching, FileCacheStorage sprintf avoidance, ConstantStringType work prevention, and CallPrivateMethodThroughStaticRule cheap checks first. Internals add TrinaryLogic logic error detection.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.38, bringing another 5-10% faster performance, improvements remove PHP version constraint from #[Override] attribute rules, take checkMissingOverrideMethodAttribute as default only on PHP 8.5+, support StaticMethodParameterClosureTypeExtension for New_ expressions, improve inference on FuncCall === FuncCall, and don't lose known offset-types in array_merge. Bugfixes fix escaped hash in regex extended mode and closure type inference bug related to FNSR. Performance improvements rework phpDoc inheritance, prevent unnecessary work in TemplateTypeHelper, ConstantArrayType, ImpossibleCheckTypeHelper, and duplicate logic execution, find all constant/method types per class at once, speed up CombinationHelper, and optimize MutatingScope, ExpressionTypeHolder, IntersectionType, and lowercase-string handling.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.39, bleeding edge requires generics for Iterator, IteratorAggregate, Generator. Improvements add new rule for filter_var (PHP 8.5+), introduce reportNonIntStringArrayKey parameter, @phpstan-all-methods-(im)pure, __stringnotstringable, FileFinder sorting, respect sys_get_temp_dir from parent process, add ArrayCombineFunctionThrowTypeExtension, and do not degrade closures or array-shapes in PHPDocs. Bugfixes resolve bitwise-not on constant integer, support int range in bitwise operations, add exceptional case for DateInterval::format, comparison with strtolower leads lower/upper-case-string, resolve template with value of BackedEnum, SplObjectStorage iterates over objects, remove extra dba_fetch variant, constant isDeprecated depends on Scope::getPhpVersion, add default value for getAttribute call, infer non-empty-array after array_key_first/last, fix strtr inferences, fix ignore comment handling for multiple traits, and do not report...

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.40, fixing 71 issues, improvements introduce rawMessages key in ignoreErrors, infer non-empty-ness after count equality, report class.nameCase error for wrong case in return type, allow ternary type narrowing in assert and truthy contexts, and add ClassConstantReflection::isFinalByKeyword method. Bugfixes fix GMP::toNumber, respect original variable type with extract on optional keys, switch statement type narrowing, possible type loss with use in anonymous function, ReflectionClass::isSubclassOf multiple calls narrowing, false positive for match operator, variadic arrow function argument errors, existing function used in Closure::bind, loadable classes not recognized since 2.1.34, invokable objects labeled as Closure, match.unhandled on multiple booleans, preserve HasOffsetValueType for constant array spreads, don't invalidate private property expressions of different classes, match exhaustiveness for class-string with union of final classes, allow passing return values of by-reference functions as by-ref args, downgrade $this to static, fix @phpstan-assert with union types, unnecessary nullsafe operator on nullable array index, and revert sys_get_temp_dir change.
In the phpstan/phpstan release 1.12.33, the release suggests to coding agents that PHPStan 2.x is available to upgrade to from 1.12.x.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.41, fixing 87 issues, major new features include a main documentation dashboard on phpstan.org, comprehensive error identifier documentation, and documentation about custom extensions. Improvements add option reportIgnoresWithoutComments, tune CPU core usage, solve HTTP proxy and custom root CA errors, report invalid printf placeholder, respect rule level in ParameterCastableToNumberRule, report non existent offset on non empty array, always show identifier in TableErrorFormatter, show instructions to coding agents, tip about @phpstan-impure, and report error when trying to instantiate a trait with new. Bugfixes fix createConditionalExpressions, differentiate signaturePrototype and inheritancePrototype, avoid false error on is_subclass_of, fix execution branch confusion, and fix spurious error in specific combination of namespace blocks and function declaration.
In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.42, the release fixes an internal error crash report.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.43, fixing 37 issues, improvements call operator type specifying extensions for bitwise and arithmetic operators, introduce UnaryOperatorTypeSpecifyingExtension interface, report trait.duplicateMethod, cannot re-assign superglobal variable in parameters, prevent PHP error 'Cannot re-assign $this' with a new rule, implement more missing errors around use of $this, infer non-empty-list/array after isset($arr[$i]), and support call_user_func_array. Bugfixes fix offset 0 optional on non empty list, narrow DOMDocument::createElement return type, parameter #2 of array_key_exists expects array, failed determine type in match operator, throw point recognition, anonymous class variable might not be defined, false positive variable might not be defined, 'Cannot use [] for reading' false positives, weird variable might not be defined behavior, foreach on constant array with closures crash, fatal error when path has array value in ignoreErrors, unreachable statement information loss, variable passed by reference not updated, incorrect narrowing of nested array after assignment, incorrect type-narrowing to *NEVER* inside array row, and array_column should not extract...

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.44, bugfixes restore Docker images builds, build Docker images for PHP 8.5, display correct number of processes with --debug, fix intersection loses __invoke return type, fix null coalescing assignment operator combined with throwing, and fix method call on unioned class type analysis.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.45, fixing 29 issues, improvements make more rules about PHPDoc tags declarations validate stub files. Bugfixes fix errors for argument array template types no longer reported, result of function_exists can't be cached, optional templated args not provided cause unbound template errors, resolve generic parameter defaults that reference other template parameters, array_filter with assert-if-true callable marks all keys optional, assign.readOnlyProperty, bogus write-only error when appending to array-like object in private class property, cannot use 'T is never' in conditional return, [NAN] === mixed always false, parameter #2 $callback of uasort expects callable, does not warn about non-nullable class-property, incorrect inference of instance variable modified from callback, TypeSpecifier resolve purity/impurity for CallableParametersAcceptor, filter_var fix throw on failure with require/force array, FILTER_FLAG_GLOBAL_RANGE constant not known on PHP 8.3/8.4, and narrowed template on an interface ignored when generics not specified.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.46, improvements properly union HasOffsetValueType in huge intersections describing the same offsets. Bugfixes fix sealed class-string match exhaustiveness for ::class comparisons and generic sealed hierarchies, fix incorrect type narrowing with dependent types, fix false positive contravariant parameter with nested trait, and properly preserve TemplateConstantArrayType. Performance optimizes TypeCombinator::union.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.47, major new features add bisect command for finding regression-introducing commits. Improvements detect more AI agents, add hint in VarTagTypeRuleHelper, implement GMP operator type specifying extension, respect sys_temp_dir from parent process, and update Symfony polyfills. Bugfixes fix !in_array with enum values incorrectly narrows to *NEVER*, PHPStan assumes string conversions cannot throw exceptions, fix ObjectType::equals, two unbounded generics in conditional return assumed always same, settype not handled properly, is_callable with array always true, allow throwing exceptions from __toString not detected since level 4, adding elements to empty array in while loop not recognized as potentially non-empty for in_array, ordering of Intersections matters for method calls, nullsafe operator chaining, exit function not internal, infinite recursion in ConstantArrayType::isCallable, infinite loop, preload polyfills in PHAR, update BetterReflection, readonly property modification through clone not reported, support covariant templates in interface properties in 8.4, and fix inco...

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.48, improvements report promoted properties with readonly or hooks as always uninitialized. Bugfixes preserve list type in ConstantArrayType::spliceArray when all keys are integers, generalize dynamicConstantNames constants to PHPDoc type if present, and use position-specific getOffsetValueType instead of getIterableValueType when intersecting two ConstantArrayTypes. Performance fixes a performance issue. Internals add regression test for @var annotation before foreach.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.49, bugfixes use declared property type instead of scope-narrowed type when inferring generic new expression types. Performance improvements use pairwise TypeCombinator::intersect folding, avoid 2^N getAllArrays expansion in implode return type extension and ConstantArrayType::getFiniteTypes, bail early in TypeUtils::flattenTypes, batch unionWith in specifyTypesForFlattenedBooleanOr falsey path, add flattening optimization for deep BooleanAnd chains, use hash map for O(1) key lookup in ConstantArrayType, and fix infinite hang when analysing wordpress-develop. Function signature fixes update session_set_save_handler $gc parameter. Internals fix PHPUnit warning.
In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.50, bugfixes fix broken type narrowing with larger union types. Function signature fixes declare multiple mysqli_ functions as impure.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.51, improvements include argument index in dumpType message to preserve argument order. Bugfixes fix ReflectionGetAttributesMethodReturnTypeExtension for UnionTypes, fix ErrorType leaking from array_key_exists with union key types in loops, fix infinite loop on recursive trait, do not re-wrap NeverType as TemplateMixedType in TemplateUnionType::filterTypes, and read class-constant @var type without triggering @extends resolution. Internals improve UnionType::accepts.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.52, fixing 45 issues, improvements emit virtual Assign node for List_ destructuring in foreach value position, narrow array key type after type-checking key variable inside foreach, support static::SOME_CONST in PHPDoc, and allow GMP in increment/decrement operations. Bugfixes include various array fixes preserving constant array when assigning union of scalars, preserving tracked nested ArrayDimFetch types, more precise foreach analysis, resolving ConditionalTypeForParameter children, merging scope after ?-> method call, tracking PHPDoc and modifier flags on ExportedParameterNode, autoloading not invoked for any string, more precise tracking $value in foreach, correctly marking unpacked constant array items as optional in array_merge/array_replace, fixing false positive conditional return type, allowing readonly property init in child classes on PHP 8.4+, projecting narrowings through stored booleans, tracking array_walk by-ref closure parameter modifications, merging conditional-expression holders, projecting stored-boolean narrowings through || truthy, fixing template of imported type, tracking $arr[$key] existence across array_key_first/last + !== null, preserving TemplateArrayType across offset writes, two-stage collapse for oversized constant arrays, and fixing callable array intersection type offset narrowing. Performance caches class constant fetch type.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.53, bugfixes treat Expr\UnaryMinus with scalar operand as scalar literal in isExprSafeToProjectThroughVariable and comparison type specifying, and unroll foreach over union of constant arrays in tryProcessUnrolledConstantArrayForeach.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.54, improvements improve DateInterval inference and handle next autoindexes as empty. Bugfixes process unrolled foreach iteration body in original context, preserve conditional expressions in invalidateExpression when requireMoreCharacters is true, recognize [$obj, $method] as callable when is_callable is known true, replace instead of union when writing to optional keys via union offset in ConstantArrayTypeBuilder, check isFirstClassCallable before calling getArgs on nested FuncCall nodes, and preserve non-empty array guarantee in ConstantArrayType::setOffsetValueType when union key expansion produces all-optional keys. Performance caches methods in IntersectionType.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.55, fixing 55 issues, bleeding edge features report invalid DateInterval constructor arguments at analysis time, report impure method overriding pure parent method in MethodSignatureRule, and validate define() and const values against explicit types in dynamicConstantNames. Improvements don't report 'no value type specified in iterable type array&callable', resolve method reflection for dynamic static calls, track more expressions, detect private promoted properties whose only reads are self-writes via new self(), report wrong types passed to array&callable type, and infer numeric-string for DateInterval::format('%a') when interval comes from diff(). Bugfixes recurse into parent expression in IssetCheck, fix oversized-array self-rejection, update jetbrains/phpstorm-stubs, track $arr[$key] existence across array_search/array_find_key, do not narrow array to empty when array_find_key returns null, fix implode losing non-empty-string, narrow DateInterval->days after DateTimeInterface->diff, treat * as assignment suppression in sscanf/fscanf, do not prefix anything in resources/ when building phpstan.phar, and walk ancestors for stub method PHPDoc on built-in classes.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.1.56, the final send-off for PHPStan 2.1.x series fixing 31 issues, bleeding edge adds unused-label rule on level 4. Improvements simulate loop analysis for goto-label pairs, add non-ignorable goto-to-undefined-label rule on level 0, improve configuration defined type validation error message, and report abstract method overriding non-abstract method in OverridingMethodRule and OverridingPropertyRule. Bugfixes preserve TemplateType in ArrayType and IntersectionType array-mutating methods, do not treat method_exists as always true for @method-annotated methods, add implicit throw point for dynamic instantiation of non-final classes without constructors, do not let conditional expression undo explicit type narrowing, narrow types after strlen, do not use callable parameter types as native types for closure and arrow function parameters, handle goto and Label in top-level file statements, suppress undefined static property error when property_exists guard is present, do not create conditional expression when holder and guard have same type, retain class_exists expression types in closure, do not report function_exists as always-true conditions, code around enum_exists does not complain about nonexistent classes, check all interfaces for constructor enforcement in NewStaticRule, and process reordered named arguments in call-site order.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.2.0, major new features include unsealed array shapes, new types decimal-int-string and non-decimal-int-string, new config parameter reportUnsafeArrayStringKeyCasting, checking constants in parameters with new error identifiers argument.exclusiveConstants, argument.invalidConstant, argument.bitmaskNotAllowed, and detecting named arguments whose parameters are renamed in subtypes with error identifier argument.parameterRenamedInSubtype. Bleeding edge makes sealed array shapes truly sealed. Improvements allow custom rules to emit collector data for CollectedDataNode with CollectedDataEmitter and reduce false positives about constant conditions in traits. Bugfixes narrow division to int when modulo is known to be zero, do not normalize union types in tryRemove to preserve finite type combinations, and prevent infinite recursion in AttributeReflectionFactory. Internals refactor TypeSpecifier, simplify InitializerExprTypeResolver api-surface, and cleanup ArrayType::tryRemove.

In the phpstan/phpstan release 2.2.1, improvements do not require specifying unsealed extra value type after ... on level 6+. Bugfixes do not unpack unsealed array when expanding arguments in FunctionCallParametersCheck and fix constants allowed in parameters for multi-variant functions. Function signature fixes allow FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOL as valid constant for filter_var and filter_input, add RoundingMode enum cases as valid constants of round(), and fix Collator::setAttribute allowed constants.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent pocketbase/pocketbase release stream from v0.22.38 through v0.39.0, including backported fixes and major feature releases such as the new UI in v0.37.0 and the SQL console in v0.39.0.

chunks.title: v0.36.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.36.0-rc.1, this prerelease contains two minor list query optimizations related to discussion #7444 that have not been fully tested and verified yet.

chunks.title: v0.22.38 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.22.38, the minimum Go GitHub action version is bumped to 1.25.6, backported from v0.36.0, because it includes minor security fixes.

chunks.title: v0.36.0 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.36.0, list query and API rules optimizations are introduced: unnecessary correlated subquery expressions when using back-relations via a single relation field are removed, and DISTINCT is replaced with GROUP BY id for row deduplication when safe. A new strftime date formatting filter and API rules function is added. The search.ResolverResult struct is modified: NoCoalesce is replaced with NullFallback, and the MultiMatchSubQuery field expression interface is replaced with a concrete struct type. Dependencies are updated: modernc.org/sqlite to v1.44.1 (SQLite 3.51.1), and the minimum Go GitHub action version is bumped to 1.25.6 for minor security fixes.

chunks.title: v0.36.1 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.36.1, the DISTINCT with GROUP BY replacement optimization from v0.36.0 is reverted because it negatively impacted index utilization for some queries. modernc.org/sqlite is updated to v1.44.2 (SQLite 3.51.2), and code comment typos are fixed.

chunks.title: v0.36.2 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.36.2, dependencies are updated: modernc.org/sqlite to v1.44.3 (race check fix), goja (circular references fix), and other Go dependencies. Minor fixes include updated tests to silence race detector errors and a clearer error message in FindFirstRecordByData when a missing or invalid key is used.

chunks.title: v0.36.3 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.36.3, Accept-Encoding: identity is added to S3 requests to fix 0-byte file responses when S3 API compression is enabled. The minimum Go GitHub action version is bumped to 1.26.0 for minor GC performance improvements. Other minor fixes include updating modernc.org/sqlite to v1.45.0, adding Buffer.concat to goja_nodejs, and clarifying the danger of app.DeleteTable, app.DeleteView, and similar methods.

chunks.title: v0.36.4 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.36.4, the optional Bearer token prefix is made case-insensitive, and $filesystem.s3(...) and $filesystem.local(...) JSVM bindings are enabled.

chunks.title: v0.36.5 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.36.5, collection and field name normalization is disabled while in IME mode, and modernc.org/sqlite is updated to v1.46.1, which resets connection state on Tx.Commit failure.

chunks.title: v0.22.39 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.22.39, the minimum Go GitHub action version is bumped to 1.26.1, backported from v0.36.6, because it includes minor bug and security fixes.

chunks.title: v0.36.6 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.36.6, NumberField.OnlyInt is set to true for generated View collection schema fields when a view column expression is known to return int-only values. The unmarshal JSVM helper is documented. An extra read check is added after Store.GetOrSet write lock to prevent races. An empty records check is added for the additional client-side filter's ListRule constraint introduced in v0.32.0. A fixed routine.FireAndForget debug stack trace limit of 2KB is set. The minimum Go GitHub action version is bumped to 1.26.1 for minor bug and security fixes. Typos and minor doc fixes are applied.

chunks.title: v0.36.7-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.36.7-rc.1, this prerelease is intended to validate a fix for high memory usage when uploading large files, as reported in discussion #7572.

chunks.title: v0.22.40 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.22.40, modernc.org/sqlite is updated to v1.46.2 and SQLite 3.51.3, backported from v0.36.7, fixing a database corruption bug. Other minor Go and npm dependencies are updated, and the minimum Go version in go.mod is bumped to 1.25.0.

chunks.title: v0.36.7 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.36.7, high memory usage with large file uploads is fixed. The rate limiter reset rules are updated to a more traditional fixed window strategy. modernc.org/sqlite is updated to v1.46.2 and SQLite 3.51.3, fixing a database corruption bug. Other minor Go and npm dependencies are updated, and the minimum Go version in go.mod is bumped to 1.25.0.

chunks.title: v0.36.8 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.36.8, an OAuth2 client secret reset issue when serializing a cached collection model is fixed. All Go and npm dependencies are bumped, silencing reports regarding CVE-2026-33809, which is not an issue in PocketBase because TIFF thumbs are not supported.

chunks.title: v0.22.41 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.22.41, the Discord AuthUser.Name field is updated to use global_name, modernc.org/sqlite is updated to v1.48.2 for vfs and error path fixes, and the minimum Go GitHub action version is bumped to 1.26.2 for minor security fixes, all backported from v0.36.9.

chunks.title: v0.36.9 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.36.9, the Discord AuthUser.Name field is updated to use global_name. Settings SMTP password clear persistence is fixed. Extra OAuth2 checks are added when downloading avatar URLs to prevent internal network probing. modernc.org/sqlite is updated to v1.48.2 for vfs and error path fixes. The minimum Go GitHub action version is bumped to 1.26.2 for minor security fixes. Other small improvements include updated JSVM documentation, fixed comment typos, and a missing file close on seek error.

chunks.title: v0.37.0 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.37.0, a new UI is rewritten from scratch with external customization support, featuring a smaller bundle size, dark mode, basic responsive/mobile support, help text for collection fields, lifted max nested level restriction for presentable relations, lighter rules autocomplete, live view query preview, audio/video embed in richtext editor, bulk export of records as JSON, local search history, API rules overview, ERD-like visualization, stepped logs chart with panning, and OAuth2 provider logos as inline SVGs in listAuthMethods. An optional no_ui build tag is added to exclude the UI from the executable. Internal JSVM bind functions are exported. modernc.org/sqlite is updated to v1.49.1 (SQLite 3.53.0).

chunks.title: v0.37.1 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.37.1, minor UI bugfixes are applied: number field input values normalization is fixed, collections can be opened in a new tab with middle click, and the collection name is shown in the page title on initial load.

chunks.title: v0.37.2 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.37.2, an autoexpandable input issue in Firefox is fixed, dark theme colors are adjusted for better readability, unnecessary tags stripping from displayed log attributes is removed, and a Safari freeze caused by a buggy CSS popover property is worked around.

chunks.title: v0.37.3 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.37.3, total count load on page back/forward navigation is fixed, editor floating dialogs position when scrolling is fixed, text wrapping for API rule fields is enabled, a view query sample loading indicator is added, and other minor light UI contrast and style improvements are made.

chunks.title: v0.37.4 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.37.4, a security fix related to discussion #7662 is included. A backups list scroll container is added. Record upsert and preview modals data loading is optimized to minimize layout jumps. SMTP IPv6 network address format is fixed. Autocomplete selection not updating the underlying input value is fixed. A ghupdate.BaseURL config option is added. A dummy bcrypt password check is added for the failure auth path to minimize enumeration timing attacks when registrations are disabled. Bitbucket, GitHub, GitLab, and Gitea/Forgejo OAuth2 providers are adjusted to reflect recent API updates and doc references, with some providers sending a separate list emails request to minimize linking security issues. A pre-hijacking OAuth2 linking vulnerability is fixed. Go and npm dependencies are bumped.

chunks.title: v0.22.42 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.22.42, Bitbucket, GitHub, GitLab, and Gitea/Forgejo OAuth2 providers are adjusted to reflect recent API updates and doc references, and a pre-hijacking OAuth2 linking vulnerability is fixed, both backported from v0.37.4.

chunks.title: v0.37.5 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.37.5, password fields not being detected as changed is fixed. The local time zone name is added next to the date field label. Trusted proxy info UI is reloaded after settings save. Other minor improvements include skipping duplicated record ids from the IN expand list and reordering confirm-email-change error checks to minimize enumeration attacks.

chunks.title: v0.22.43 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.22.43, the minimum Go GitHub action version is bumped to 1.26.3, backported from v0.38.0, because it includes minor bug and security fixes.

chunks.title: v0.38.0 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.38.0, UI logs pagination when no custom range is specified is fixed. Default CSP is fixed to allow audio/video previews. Fixed Content-Type is served for .xlsx, .docx, and .pptx files to allow previews on iOS. Settings app URL input is changed to type="text" for compatibility. An internal watcher is added to sync runtime states between multiple PocketBase processes using the same pb_data. A new Superuser IPs/CIDR subnets whitelist setting is added, configurable via UI or console command. A rate limit option to exclude IPs/CIDR subnets is added. The minimum Go GitHub action version is bumped to 1.26.3 for minor bug and security fixes.

chunks.title: v0.22.44 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.22.44, the auth state of existing realtime connections is forced to unset on user tokenKey change, backported from v0.38.1.

chunks.title: v0.38.1 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.38.1, the superuser IPs confirmation is silenced if there is no change. The experimental UI extensions APIs are updated to allow top-level await in the initialization script. The auth state of existing realtime connections is forced to unset on user password, collection secret, etc. changes. An error marker is added for each collection tab, and raw errors tooltip styles are fixed. An indexes collection update error is fixed, with a system migration that resaves all collections with indexes to ensure normalization. modernc.org/sqlite is updated to v1.50.1 (SQLite 3.53.1). Other minor fixes include updated API preview examples and fixed code comment typos.

chunks.title: v0.22.45 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.22.45, all golang.org/x/ packages are updated to cover recent security fixes, backported from v0.38.2.

chunks.title: v0.38.2 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.38.2, a RealtimeConnectRequestEvent.MaxTimeout field is added to specify the absolute max duration a realtime connection can remain open, defaulting to 30 minutes. Extra checks for the connected user IP are added in the realtime APIs to prevent bruteforce guest subscription update attempts and to protect the all-in-one OAuth2 realtime handler. The records list pagination is no longer reset on record update. All golang.org/x/ packages are updated to cover recent security fixes.

chunks.title: v0.39.0 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pocketbase/pocketbase release v0.39.0, a new SQL console section is added under Settings > Debug, allowing execution of raw SQL queries from the UI. System email alerts are sent to superusers in case of an error with automated backups. Various minor improvements and fixes include fixing logs bulk selection export error, optimizing logs and records list rendering, allowing word breaking in labels, text contrast improvements, registering missing oidc2 and oidc3 option fields, updating default email template texts for consistency, and updating modernc.org/sqlite to v1.51.0.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent podman-container-tools/podman release stream from v5.2.5 through v5.8.2, covering security fixes, new features like OCI artifact support and Quadlet enhancements, and multiple release candidates leading to stable minor versions.

chunks.title: v5.2.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the podman-container-tools/podman release v5.2.5, the project addresses CVE-2024-9675, which allows arbitrary access to the host filesystem from RUN --mount type=cache arguments in a Dockerfile, and CVE-2024-9676, which allows malicious images with a symlink /etc/passwd or /etc/group to potentially cause a denial of service through reading a FIFO on the host. Additionally, Buildah is updated to v1.37.5 and the containers/storage library to v1.55.1.

chunks.title: v5.3.0-RC2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the podman-container-tools/podman release v5.3.0-RC2, the second release candidate for v5.3.0, new features include: podman kube generate and podman kube play can now create and run Kubernetes Job YAML; podman kube generate includes user namespace information in generated YAML; podman kube play supports Kubernetes volumes of type image; Quadlet gains ServiceName key, DefaultDependencies key, AddHost key, variable support in PublishPort, CgroupsMode key, network sharing via .container file, six new keys for .pod files (DNS, DNSOption, DNSSearch, IP, IP6, UserNS), multiple ImageTag support in .image files, placement in /run/containers/systemd, and symlink handling; podman manifest inspect includes annotations; podman inspect adds HostConfig.AutoRemoveImage, Config.ExposedPorts, and Config.StartupHealthCheck; podman machine list supports --all-providers; Windows VMs expose a Unix socket for API access; podman buildx prune and podman image prune support --build-cache; and the Windows installer adds a radio button for virtualization provider selection.

chunks.title: v5.3.0-RC3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the podman-container-tools/podman release v5.3.0-RC3, the third release candidate for v5.3.0, features include: podman kube generate and podman kube play support for Kubernetes Job YAML; podman kube generate includes user namespace info; podman kube play supports image volumes; Quadlet enhancements: ServiceName, DefaultDependencies, AddHost, variable PublishPort, CgroupsMode and StartWithPod keys in .container files, network sharing via .container, mounting images from .image files, six new .pod keys (DNS, DNSOption, DNSSearch, IP, IP6, UserNS), multiple ImageTag in .image, /run/containers/systemd placement, symlink handling; podman manifest inspect shows annotations; podman inspect adds AutoRemoveImage, ExposedPorts, StartupHealthCheck; podman machine list --all-providers; Windows VM Unix socket; buildx/image prune --build-cache; Windows installer virtualization provider radio button.

chunks.title: v5.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the podman-container-tools/podman release v5.3.0, the stable release, features include: podman kube generate and podman kube play support for Kubernetes Job YAML; podman kube generate includes user namespace info; podman kube play supports image volumes; Quadlet enhancements: ServiceName, DefaultDependencies, AddHost, variable PublishPort, CgroupsMode and StartWithPod keys in .container files, network sharing via .container, mounting images from .image files, six new .pod keys (DNS, DNSOption, DNSSearch, IP, IP6, UserNS), multiple ImageTag in .image, /run/containers/systemd placement, symlink handling; podman manifest inspect shows annotations; podman inspect adds AutoRemoveImage, ExposedPorts, StartupHealthCheck, and SubPath in Mounts; podman machine list --all-providers; Windows VM Unix socket; buildx/image prune --build-cache; Windows installer virtualization provider radio button.

chunks.title: v5.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the podman-container-tools/podman release v5.3.1, bug fixes include: --ignition-path option to podman machine init no longer prevents VM file creation; rootless containers using bridge networking mode no longer panic due to nil pointer dereference; containers no longer try to set increased rlimits when started in a user namespace; certain SSH configurations no longer prevent remote Podman client connection; Windows installer no longer incorrectly installs WSLv2 when upgrading an existing Hyper-V installation.

chunks.title: v5.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the podman-container-tools/podman release v5.3.2, security fixes include Buildah v1.38.1 addressing CVE-2024-11218. Misc updates: Buildah to v1.38.1, containers/common to v0.61.1, containers/storage to v1.56.1, containers/image to v5.33.1.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent portainer/portainer release stream across STS and LTS releases, covering new features, security fixes, deprecations, and known issues from version 2.27.7 through 2.42.0.

chunks.title: Release 2.31.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.31.0, the project introduces improvements to the Helm feature including a registry URL display, chart version selection, registry dropdown filtering, and displaying more than 10 workloads under Helm expand. It also adds an allow list of headers for proxying requests outside Portainer, and routes Kubernetes config map and secret operations through the Portainer server. Deprecations include transitioning to OCI image index format and deprecating Windows Server builds for Portainer Server CE and BE.

chunks.title: Release 2.27.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.27.7, the release resolves CVEs CVE-2025-22871, CVE-2025-22874, and CVE-2025-49593. Known issues include 'Origin invalid' errors behind reverse proxies (recommend updating to 2.27.9) and limited Podman support.

chunks.title: Release 2.31.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.31.1, the release contains no changes compared to the previous release and is shipped to retain parity with the Business Edition release cadence. Known issues include 'Origin invalid' errors behind reverse proxies (recommend updating to 2.31.3) and limited Podman support.

chunks.title: Release 2.27.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.27.8, the release fixes an issue where the Kubernetes client cache was not cleared and created correctly per user, and an issue where Kubernetes namespace access changes were not reflected for API users after sign-in. Known issues include 'Origin invalid' errors behind reverse proxies (recommend updating to 2.27.9) and limited Podman support.

chunks.title: Release 2.31.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.31.2, the release contains no changes compared to the previous release and is shipped to retain parity with the Business Edition release cadence. Known issues include 'Origin invalid' errors behind reverse proxies (recommend updating to 2.31.3) and limited Podman support.

chunks.title: Release 2.27.9 LTS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.27.9 LTS, the release adds the `--trusted-origins` CLI option and `TRUSTED_ORIGINS` environment variable to specify domains used to access Portainer behind a reverse proxy, addressing 'Origin invalid' errors. Known issues include limited Podman support.

chunks.title: Release 2.31.3 STS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.31.3 STS, the release adds the `--trusted-origins` CLI option and `TRUSTED_ORIGINS` environment variable to specify domains used to access Portainer behind a reverse proxy, addressing 'Origin invalid' errors. Known issues include limited Podman support.

chunks.title: Release 2.32.0 STS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.32.0 STS, the release includes application rebranding with updated colors, logos, and dark/light mode buttons. It adds a `--trusted-origins` flag, fixes Kubernetes client cache and namespace access issues, updates Docker binary to v28.1.0, enables CSP by default, and resolves several CVEs. The Docker manifest list format is removed in favor of OCI image index format.

chunks.title: Release 2.33.0 LTS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.33.0 LTS, the release improves dropdown behavior for over 1000 items, enhances the YAML web editor, adds bearer token authentication for Bitbucket Repositories, moves kubectl shell to a pop-up window, adds Permissions-Policy header, and fixes various issues including log viewer crashes, kubeconfig exec failures, and Helm preview errors. It removes Docker manifest list format and the OpenAI integration experimental feature.

chunks.title: Release 2.33.1 LTS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.33.1 LTS, the release fixes issues with environment status updates for Standard Edge Agent, TLS CLI options, Edge Stacks with GitOps, and container engine defaulting to Docker. It resolves multiple CVEs including CVE-2025-22871 and CVE-2025-22868.

chunks.title: Release 2.34.0 STS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.34.0 STS, the release increases Content-Security-Policy restrictions, enforces minimum polling interval for GitOps, fixes environment type detection, access control in Custom Templates, and various other bugs. It adds shared credentials for Git operations, windows-2025 builds, and removes `mingit` binary from Windows images.

chunks.title: Release 2.33.2 LTS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.33.2 LTS, the release fixes issues with Standard Users joining containers to networks, database encryption secret, Kubernetes Access Control, GitOps webhook URLs, and environment status filter. It deprecates `--sslcert` and `--sslkey` CLI options in favor of `--tlscert` and `--tlskey`.

chunks.title: Release 2.35.0 STS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.35.0 STS, the release adds support for IPv6 network configuration for IPvlan Docker networks, a `--compact-db` flag for database compaction on startup, and Helm GitOps for automatic upgrades. It fixes issues with Edit Ingress, GitOps webhook URLs, Kubernetes client data race, and memory leak during Kubernetes stack redeployment.

chunks.title: Release 2.33.3 LTS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.33.3 LTS, the release improves stability by attempting to compact using a read-only database, fixes WebSocket upgrade failure with Portainer generated kubeconfig, memory leak during Kubernetes stack auto redeployment, and missing dependency versions display. It resolves CVE-2025-62725.

chunks.title: Release 2.33.4 LTS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.33.4 LTS, the release fixes broken manual stack force deployment and calendar widget rendering. It resolves multiple CVEs including CVE-2024-25621 and CVE-2025-47913.

chunks.title: Release 2.36.0 STS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.36.0 STS, the release adds support for Docker v29, auto-onboarding script for Podman, ability to rename Stacks, and a `--data-path` flag to the password reset helper. It fixes local development build scripts for Apple M series chips, ECR session management, and various UI issues. OpenAMT support is deprecated.

chunks.title: Release 2.33.5 LTS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.33.5 LTS, the release adds support for Docker v29 and removes the optional raw snapshot response from some endpoint requests as a breaking change.

chunks.title: Release 2.37.0 STS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.37.0 STS, the release fixes issues with standard stacks pulling private images during GitOps updates, disabled Update Stack button, Service view display for Docker Swarm, and various other bugs. It removes environment names from error responses and the option to access host volumes for unauthorized users.

chunks.title: Release 2.33.6 LTS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.33.6 LTS, the release fixes issues with standard stacks pulling private images during GitOps updates, starting stacks with removed private images, empty Docker snapshots, and duplicate/edit container persistent MAC addresses. It resolves CVEs CVE-2025-47914, CVE-2025-61727, and CVE-2025-61729.

chunks.title: Release 2.38.0 STS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.38.0 STS, the release updates the Portainer logo and favicon, improves Azure Container Instance experience, upgrades to Compose v2.40.3, and fixes numerous issues including stack deployment memory leaks, UI issues, and nil pointer dereferences. It removes all Matomo code and confusing Podman log messages.

chunks.title: Release 2.33.7 LTS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.33.7 LTS, the release fixes issues with the Update stack button, Containers page loading, Edge Stacks update errors, panic in Edge Group creation, and deadlock in auto onboarding. It upgrades compose to v2.40.3 and resolves CVEs CVE-2025-61726 and CVE-2025-68121.

chunks.title: Release 2.38.1 STS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.38.1 STS, the release fixes issues around changing environment group for Kubernetes standard agent, local environments using Docker having their protocol removed, and improves namespace dropdown sorting. It resolves CVEs CVE-2025-61726, CVE-2025-61728, and CVE-2025-61730.

chunks.title: Release 2.39.0 LTS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.39.0 LTS, the release addresses security vulnerability disclosure, updates form behavior to show errors after input interaction, improves HTTP response code handling, adds default alphabetical sorting to namespace dropdown, and fixes issues with environment group changes, memory leak in kubectl delete, and private registry pulling. It resolves CVEs including CVE-2025-61726 and CVE-2025-68121.

chunks.title: Release 2.39.1 LTS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.39.1 LTS, the release fixes issues with Git-based Docker stacks from GitLab validation, re-enables image registries for FIPS, fixes missing groups after upgrade, and updates kubectl shell image to 1.35.2 and Kubernetes to 1.35. It resolves CVEs including GO-2026-4550 and CVE-2026-24051.

chunks.title: Release 2.40.0 STS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.40.0 STS, the release adds an information panel for GitOps deployment details, allows editing Git URL and config path for Docker Compose GitOps stacks, adds a prune option for Docker Compose stacks, and upgrades Helm Go SDK to v4 and Kubernetes dependencies to v1.35. It includes security upgrades and numerous bug fixes.

chunks.title: Release 2.41.0 STS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.41.0 STS, the release introduces breaking changes to CSRF protection requiring full URLs in trusted origins, adds support for Helm chart edge stacks from Helm and Git repositories, reworks Docker stack creation to async flow, and adds a GitOps Workflows page. It includes TUI application support, a Redeploy button for Git-backed stacks, and security upgrades.

chunks.title: Release 2.33.8 LTS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.33.8 LTS, the release fixes a Docker API proxy authorization bypass, path traversal vulnerability in custom template handling, and unauthorized access to custom template file contents. It removes the option to pass JWT token as query string parameter and the possibility to clone Git repositories with symlinks. It resolves numerous CVEs including CVE-2026-25679 and CVE-2026-32280.

chunks.title: Release 2.39.2 LTS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.39.2 LTS, the release fixes issues with kubectl-shell-image flag, deleting kube edge stacks, Edge stack deployment retries, and saving Git credentials. It addresses Docker API proxy authorization bypass, bind mount restriction bypasses, and removes JWT token query string parameter. It resolves multiple CVEs including CVE-2026-35469 and CVE-2026-32280.

chunks.title: Release 2.41.1 STS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.41.1 STS, the release adds Age as a sort option on the Home environments list with Oldest and Newest toggles, and fixes the Talos Cluster Details page rendering blank by reverting Omni cluster phase fields to int32.

chunks.title: Release 2.42.0 STS
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the portainer/portainer release 2.42.0 STS, the release removes the legacy-csrf feature flag, adds a theme selector to the user menu, GitOps sources list view, connectivity test before adding edge environments, and Docker host disk usage display. It replaces Kubernetes Volume view with new tables, adds pod restart/delete support, and ports Swarm stack deployments to use libstack. Security improvements include enforcing container resource controls on Docker exec endpoint and upgrading various dependencies.

questions.query_text: In the portainer/portainer releases, which release adds the `--trusted-origins` CLI option and `TRUSTED_ORIGINS` environment variable to address 'Origin invalid' errors behind reverse proxies?

Use this option if Portainer is behind a reverse proxy and you are getting "Origin invalid" errors.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent pppscn/SmsForwarder release stream from early versions like 1.7.0 through the Kotlin-refactored v3.x series up to v3.5.0, highlighting new forwarding channels, automation features, and stability improvements.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pppscn/SmsForwarder release 1.7.0, the project drops support for Android 5.x, requiring a minimum of Android 6.0. It adds forwarding to Server酱 Turbo and Telegram bots, supports GET method for webhook forwarding (requiring reconfiguration of existing setups), fixes a DingTalk bot URL concatenation bug when signing is not enabled, attempts to launch the main interface after reboot on Android 8.1 and below to dynamically obtain permissions (fixing the issue where SMS forwarding would not work after auto-start until the app is opened), adds forwarding to other phone SMS, prevents force close on hot SIM swap, optimizes rule display, improves multi-SIM information retrieval and slot remark display, and adds a restore initialization configuration option.

In the pppscn/SmsForwarder release 1.7.4, the release bundles commits since 1.7.3 for users who cannot build themselves. It fixes a truncation issue when forwarding to WeCom group robot messages, ignores SSL certificate verification for webhook forwarding to improve self-hosted server compatibility, replaces '#' with '井' in Telegram forwarding to avoid tag interpretation, masks sensitive information (passwords/tokens/secrets) in sender settings with asterisks, updates the Umeng component library, and resolves an issue where SIM slot information still appeared in sent messages when the slot info setting was disabled and the default template was used.

chunks.title: SmsForwarder v2.0.0 国庆版
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pppscn/SmsForwarder release v2.0.0 (National Day edition), the release adds custom POST data support and JSON submission for webhook forwarding, adds battery optimization whitelist settings and permissions, refactors code with Lombok and upgrades Gradle, adds group support for Bark (using sender name as group name), improves regex matching, changes content matching mode from 'is not' to 'does not contain', adds low battery alert (with a dedicated forwarding rule using number 88888888 and specific content), adds Feishu webhook support, adds a custom URL scheme (forwarder://main) to launch the app, adds delayed retry up to 5 times on interface request failure (configurable interval), adds missed call reminder forwarding (same rules as SMS), proactively initializes settings after phone reboot to fix forwarding failures without opening the app, and adds multi-language support (Chinese and English).

chunks.title: SmsForwarder v2.1.0 程序猿节版
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pppscn/SmsForwarder release v2.1.0 (Programmer's Day edition), the release adds configuration export/import functionality (one-click clone), removes delayed retry for forwarding to other phone SMS, adds the ability to specify a push message icon for Bark, simplifies settings by removing the 'attach SIM slot info' and 'attach device name' toggles (users should modify the forwarding message template directly if needed), and fixes an issue where the missed call forwarding switch was ineffective.

chunks.title: SmsForwarder v2.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pppscn/SmsForwarder release v2.2.0, the release adds the ability to listen for notifications from other apps and forward them based on rules, fixes a Telegram phone number loss issue, optimizes call forwarding to include SIM slot information, optimizes Telegram forwarding to support custom bot addresses (reusing the ApiToken field, starting with http), allows custom templates when adding forwarding rules (leaving it empty uses the global setting), fixes a null pointer bug in Bark push message icon specification, adds default off switches for SMS, call, and app forwarding in general settings, optimizes the ActionBar popup menu position, adds a feature to get a list of all apps (for easy copying of app package names), adds forwarding to PushPlus, adds a help document (linking to Gitee wiki), optimizes to not show in recent tasks list (to aid keep-alive), restores compatibility with Android 5.x, and starts using GitHub Actions for online compilation and release.

chunks.title: SmsForwarder v2.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pppscn/SmsForwarder release v2.2.1, the release adds support for custom templates in email subjects, adds a {{current app version}} template variable to get the SmsForwarder version name, optimizes the restore initial settings action with a secondary confirmation dialog (including resetting settings, deleting sending channels, rules, and logs), allows custom expiration time for PushPlus channels (timestamp node), trims leading and trailing spaces when saving text input, modifies notification bar text, and optimizes the mechanism for obtaining SIM slot information for missed call forwarding (delayed by 1 second after hangup).

chunks.title: SmsForwarder v2.3.0 双12狂欢版
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pppscn/SmsForwarder release v2.3.0 (Double 12 Carnival edition), the release adds Telegram forwarding via SOCKS5/HTTP proxy, optimizes the about page to attempt jumping to the system auto-start settings when enabling auto-start, restricts installation to internal storage only to prevent auto-start failure (to be verified), fixes a bug where multiple phone numbers separated by semicolons were invalid for forwarding to other phones, optimizes logging with an intermediate state and records interface request retry logs, optimizes battery status monitoring (low battery warning thresholds, battery status changes), adds support for configuring regex replacement content on forwarding rules, upgrades the XUpdate component version, prevents duplicate processing of missed call broadcasts for the same SIM slot within the same second (some models receive two broadcasts), and fixes an issue with multiple WeCom app access tokens coexisting.

chunks.title: SmsForwarder v2.4.1

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent prisma/prisma release stream from 6.10.1 through 7.8.0, covering the transition to Rust-free ORM, new generators, Prisma Postgres improvements, and major version 7 changes.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the prisma/prisma release 6.10.1, a patch release, the project fixes an incomplete PostgreSQL connection termination fix for Windows and addresses a performance regression in the queryCompiler preview feature related to in-memory joins in TypeScript-based query execution, achieving up to 500x improvement in benchmarks.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.11.0, the project introduces preview support for Rust-free Prisma ORM for MySQL/MariaDB, Neon, and CockroachDB via driver adapters, adds CLI commands to stop and remove local Prisma Postgres instances, provides ready-to-run examples for the new prisma-client generator, and fixes bugs in VS Code embedded Prisma Studio.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.11.1, a patch release, the project fixes a PrismaClientInitializationError when using @prisma/client with @prisma/extension-accelerate on a prisma+postgres:// connection string, and resolves an issue with arrays as aggregation fields in the query compiler.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.12.0, the project moves the ESM-compatible prisma-client generator into Preview, adds the ability to specify views and migrations folder locations in prisma.config.ts (Early Access), and provides new ready-to-run examples for the prisma-client generator.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.13.0, the project moves the Prisma Config file (prisma.config.ts) and multi-schema feature into General Availability, and updates SQL views support to further stabilize its API.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.14.0, the project reintroduces the @unique attribute for SQL views (Preview) to enable relationships, findUnique queries, and cursor-based pagination on views, removes deprecated middleware (prisma.$use), deprecates the metrics preview feature, and addresses type performance issues.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.15.0, the project adds AI safety guardrails for destructive commands, simplifies runtime options for the prisma-client generator, supports schemas with no models in prisma-client, and introduces support for using Prisma ORM with Vercel Fluid compute.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.16.0, the project makes the Rust-free ORM and driver adapters Generally Available, and the new ESM-first prisma-client generator Generally Available, with benefits including reduced bundle size, faster queries, and no more magic generation into node_modules.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.16.1, a patch release, the project fixes an issue where the prisma-client-ts generator required driverAdapters and queryCompiler preview features in edge runtimes after they were stabilized in 6.16.0.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.16.2, a patch release, the project fixes validation rules for Prisma Postgres URLs with driver adapters and makes the unref() call on NodeJS timers conditional to prevent runtime errors in non-NodeJS runtimes like workerd.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.16.3, a patch release, the project fixes missing JSON null type definitions in the prisma-client generator browser entrypoint, restores pre-6.13.0 migration behavior for default schemas, re-enables negative take with findFirst, and addresses other bug fixes.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.17.0, the project adds support for Entra ID authentication in the MS SQL Server driver adapter, relaxes OpenTelemetry instrumentation version range, adds Codex CLI detection for AI safety, fixes JSON column handling for MariaDB, restores original group-by aggregation behavior, introduces new usage workspace metrics in Prisma Console, and makes connecting to Prisma Postgres with any tool Generally Available.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.17.1, a patch release, the project addresses a regression in v6.17.0 that affected diffing of unsupported types, leading to unnecessary or incorrect changes when creating new migrations or running db pull.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.18.0, the project makes prisma init automatically create a prisma.config.ts, adds support for defining datasource in prisma.config.ts, and introduces database metrics in Prisma Postgres Console.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.19.0, the project adds connection pooling support for Prisma Postgres direct connections, allows using local Prisma Postgres in VS Code without login, and includes various bug fixes and improvements.

In the prisma/prisma release 7.0.0, the project makes ESM Prisma Client the default, requires an adapter or accelerateUrl when creating PrismaClient, moves generated client and types out of node_modules, removes implicit Prisma commands, and introduces other breaking changes.

In the prisma/prisma release 7.0.1, a patch release, the project adds Deno and Bun support in Prisma Studio, fixes various Studio and CLI issues, restores cockroachdb support in prisma-client-js, and bumps better-sqlite3 version.

In the prisma/prisma release 7.1.0, the project adds SQL commenter plugin support for Prisma Client, resolves pnpm monorepo issues with prisma-client-runtime-utils, and updates the read-replicas extension for Prisma 7 compatibility.
In the prisma/prisma release 6.19.1, a patch release for Prisma 6, the project fixes a diffing bug introduced in Prisma 6.13.1 that led to incorrectly reported empty diffs.

In the prisma/prisma release 7.2.0, the project adds a sqlcommenter-query-insights plugin, a -url flag for migrate commands, allows undefined URLs in prisma generate, customizes prisma init based on JS runtime, and includes various bug fixes.

In the prisma/prisma release 6.19.2, a patch release in the Prisma 6 line, the project fixes an issue with Prisma Accelerate support in some edge runtime configurations when the @prisma/client/edge entrypoint is not used.

In the prisma/prisma release 7.3.0, the project introduces a compilerBuild option for fast or small query compilers, bypasses the query compiler for raw queries, updates MSSQL adapter, pins better-sqlite3 version, reverts @map enum behavior, and casts BigInt to text in JSON aggregation.
In the prisma/prisma release 7.4.0, the project introduces a caching layer in Prisma Client to reuse compiled query plans, adds partial indexes support (Preview), and includes various bug fixes.

In the prisma/prisma release 7.4.1, a patch release, the project fixes cursor-based pagination regression, preserves Prisma.skip through query extension cloning, enables batching of multiple queries inside interactive transactions, and adds other fixes.

In the prisma/prisma release 7.4.2, a patch release, the project fixes a case-insensitive IN/NOT IN filter regression, a query plan mutation issue, array parameter wrapping, Uint8Array serialization, MySQL join issues, and other driver adapter and schema engine fixes.

In the prisma/prisma release 7.5.0, the project adds support for nested transaction rollbacks via savepoints, introduces multi-cell selection, full table search, more intuitive filtering, cmd+k command palette, and raw SQL queries in Prisma Studio, and includes various bug fixes.

In the prisma/prisma release 7.6.0, the project adds a prisma postgres link command, a statementNameGenerator option for adapter-pg, dark mode, copy as markdown, multi-cell editing, back relations, and generative SQL with AI in Prisma Studio, and includes various bug fixes.
In the prisma/prisma release 6.19.3, a patch release in the Prisma 6 line, the project updates the effect dependency to resolve a security vulnerability.

In the prisma/prisma release 7.7.0, the project introduces a prisma bootstrap command that sequences Prisma Postgres setup into a single interactive flow, including init, link, install, migrate, generate, and seed steps.

In the prisma/prisma release 7.8.0, the project adds a queryPlanCacheMaxSize option for fine-grained control over the query plan cache, and includes bug fixes for JSON list filtering, case-insensitive JSON filtering, enum parameterization, and other issues.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent probelabs/goreplay release stream from v0.9.8 through v2.0.0-rc2, covering middleware support, license changes, capture engine improvements, and major version milestones.

chunks.title: v0.9.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.9.8, the project improves raw-input performance especially for large payloads, uses all cores by default, improves code styling with golint, adds --http-disallow-header option, does not override host if explicitly specified by --http-host, adds option to keep original Host headers, makes http timeout configurable via --output-http-timeout, fixes http response buffer overflow, and fixes trailing null byte in communication between input-tcp and output-tcp.

chunks.title: v0.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.10.0, the project introduces middleware support, makes raw input track responses and records them to file input, changes file format to human readable, changes internal TCP communication format to match file format, adds protection for malformed messages, significantly improves test speed, and fixes not adding port 80 to HOST header.

chunks.title: v0.10.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.10.1, the project fixes memory leaks, improves speed by dramatically reducing number of goroutines, and fixes input-file.

chunks.title: v0.11.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.11.0, the project announces a new site and Pro version at gortool.com, switches license to LGPL with a commercial friendly option, changes default traffic interception engine to libpcap for increased capture quality and speed, includes multiple fixes for stability, speed, and quality, and updates to Go 1.6.1.

chunks.title: v0.11.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.11.1, the project fixes a critical bug preventing use of --input-raw.

chunks.title: v0.11.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.11.2, the project statically links libpcap so it does not require the host system to have it, and fixes a panic when encountering malformed TCP packets.

chunks.title: v0.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.12.0, the project adds support for IPv6, fixes traffic interception without specifying a port, fixes memory leaks, and improves handling of fragmented messages, aiming to be faster, consume less memory, and catch more traffic.

chunks.title: v0.12.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.12.1, the project adds full Mac OS support including pre-compiled binaries, updates to use latest libpcap 1.7.4, ensures cleanup of sockets after exit, fixes crashing on systems with complex networking, and fixes a few data-races.

chunks.title: v0.13.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.13.0, the project makes --input-raw not track responses by default with an option to enable via --input-raw-track-response, renames --output-dummy to --output-stdout without arguments, makes HTTP client response buffer configurable via --output-http-response-buffer, fixes recovery when --output-tcp endpoint goes down, improves HTTP capture and replaying for multi-packet headers and POST requests, fixes libpcap crashing on multiple interfaces, fixes --input-tcp crashing for payloads over 64kb, and fixes raw socket engine IPv6 support.

chunks.title: v0.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.14.0, the project adds Windows support, allows date variables in --output-file names, supports gzip compressed files for input and output, supports replaying from multiple files with file name patterns, supports looping files for replaying indefinitely, changes default --output-file behavior to write files in multiple chunks, adds faster buffered file output, supports lower-case HTTP headers, adds a built-in file server for the tutorial, fixes a bug where gor catches its own --output-http traffic, and adds --input-raw-realip-header option to inject header with user real IP.

chunks.title: v0.14.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.14.1, the project fixes critical issues with crashing when using --output-file.

chunks.title: v0.15.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.15.0, the project adds PRO support for binary protocols and recording/replaying keep-alive TCP sessions, replays requests in proper order when using multiple files, validates bodies when Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding found, returns ElasticSearch support, adds --exit-after option, updates response output file format with timestamp and latency, properly reads body when no Content-Length but Connection: close, removes --input-http option, forces Go DNS resolver, fixes interception on loopback interface with non-local IP, fixes intercepting traffic from virtual interfaces, fixes 100-continue header placement, fixes relative file names with --output-file, properly cleans up resources on exit, and fixes connection timeout with --output-http-timeout.

chunks.title: v0.15.1-beta1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.15.1-beta1, the project vendors the gopacket package same as other third-party dependencies.

chunks.title: v0.15.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.15.1, the project adds support for basic HTTP auth for --output-http, fixes handling of Connection: close for POST requests, and fixes inconsistency in replayed response meta when used in middleware.

chunks.title: v0.16.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.16.0, the project adds PRO S3 input and output, adds a new NodeJS middleware framework, adds Kafka input and output, improves replay accuracy by using network interface timestamp, adds --prettify-http option to decode gzip and de-chunk bodies, enables HTTP response tracking via --output-http-track-response, adds --input-raw-expire option, filters response if its request was filtered, allows space inside filter syntax, adds file name pattern support for request id and payload type, adds basic SNI support, fixes --output-file-size-limit, does not add port to Host header, improves malformed TCP packet handling, fixes HTTP timeout for 204 responses, fixes handling of HTTP error codes, and fixes replay of HTTP PATCH requests.

chunks.title: v0.16.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v0.16.1, the project adds support for TLS connections between --input-tcp and --output-tcp, adds basic support for old servers like HTTP 0.9, makes GoReplay exit once finished replaying with --input-file, and fixes a prettifier issue with gzip encoding payload.

chunks.title: GoReplay 1.0 RC2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release GoReplay 1.0 RC2, the project adds support for HTTP proxies by setting the HTTP_PROXY environment variable.

In the probelabs/goreplay release 1.0.0, the project adds custom BPF filter support, support for reading directly from pcap files, an official Docker image, RPM and DEB packages, HTTP proxy support, HTTP basic auth filter, option to limit output file size, configurable output HTTP request queue, configurable output HTTP stats frequency, configurable minimum HTTP workers, dynamic profiling via pprof, --input-raw-buffer-size option, pcap immediate mode, standard Golang HTTP client compatibility mode, dynamic snaplen based on interface MTU, ElasticSearch basic HTTP auth, and numerous fixes for HTTP packet parsing.

chunks.title: v1.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v1.1.0, the project fixes usage of multiple --input-raw plugins, allows human-friendly byte size limits, fixes calculation of output file size with gzip compression, adds --output-tcp-sticky option, improves handling of malformed middleware output, fixes race conditions with files, improves error verbosity, updates dependencies including libpcap, moves to Go modules, and moves PRO code to the main repository under a separate license.

chunks.title: v1.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v1.2.0, the project reduces engine CPU consumption by 60%, implements memory-mapped AF_PACKET for Linux, adds Kafka TLS configuration flag, fixes wrong param value update with --http-set-param, improves capture of requests with large payload, creates a TCP package, and fixes minor bugs in HTTP proto parser.

chunks.title: v1.3.0_RC4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v1.3.0_RC4, the project makes big changes in the capture engine for more performance and stability, fixes a bug where GoReplay included outgoing HTTP requests with the same port, adds Windows support again, and fixes an output HTTP connection leak.

chunks.title: v1.3.0_RC5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v1.3.0_RC5, the project adds a way to capture multiple ports with a single input, fixes usage of localhost hostname for packet capture scope, fixes detection of Windows network interfaces, fixes Makefile job for Windows binaries, and fixes a big memory allocation issue during HTTP message end check.

chunks.title: v1.3.0_RC6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v1.3.0_RC6, the project significantly improves CPU and memory usage, adds af_packet packet capture engine for Linux, and skips incomplete or malformed messages from output with an option to allow them.

chunks.title: v1.3.0_RC11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v1.3.0_RC11, the project fixes loopback interface issue on Windows, fixes buffer index number for sticky TCP output connection, fixes output file size limits, fixes usage of --input-raw-bpf-filter, fixes BPF filter when listening on all interfaces, optimizes packet capture thread to reduce context switching, adds a new debugging endpoint /debug/vars, adds --input-file-dry-run option, adds --input-raw-max-wait option, adds --input-file-read-depth option, and adds --input-raw-timestamp-type go option.

chunks.title: v1.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v1.3.1, the project fixes duplicated requests on Linux and improves packet capture to make packet processing multithreaded.

chunks.title: v1.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v1.3.2, the project fixes promiscuous mode to not filter on host when enabled, fixes --input-raw-realip-header, and fixes false positive network interface lookups.

chunks.title: v1.3.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v1.3.3, the project makes various improvements for packet capture especially for POST requests, fixes replay of pcap files, and fixes replay of files with malformed records.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the probelabs/goreplay release v2.0.0-rc1, the release notes are to be determined.
