prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent prometheus/prometheus release stream from v3.5.0-rc.0 through v3.12.0, covering LTS stabilization, native histogram graduation, OTLP enhancements, and new PromQL features.

chunks.title: 3.5.0-rc.0 / 2025-06-25
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.5.0-rc.0, the project announces a Long Term Support (LTS) release with no known breaking changes. New features include experimental type and unit metadata labels in PromQL behind the 'type-and-unit-labels' flag, new PromQL functions ts_of_(min|max|last)_over_time behind 'experimental-promql-functions', a global scraping option always_scrape_classic_histograms, OTLP support for promoting scope metadata as metric labels via otlp.promote_scope_metadata, new OTLP config options promote_all_resource_attributes and ignore_resource_attributes, and a new service discovery for STACKIT Cloud. Enhancements cover Hetzner SD label_selector, non-constant parameters in PromQL aggregations, UI improvements for target count, rules filtering, query stats tooltip, and search clearing, plus earlier rule parsing checks and fuzzy float64 comparison in promtool. Performance improvements include PromQL iterator reuse, native histogram storage reuse, UI memoization and debouncing, Kubernetes SD cache usage, optional Direct IO for TSDB chunks, early label value fetch termination, simpler stringlabels encoding, and concurrent scrape pool reloading. Bug fixes address GOGC handling, config GOGC respect, native histogram last_over_time, parser position ranges, histogram_fraction/histogram_quantile with mixed histograms, duration rounding, inconsistent histogram_count/sum, NaN handling in native histograms, unary operator precedence, avg consistency, UI query warnings, HTTP Vary header, discovery deadlocks, Azure AD remote-write client_id, and a rare scraping memory corruption bug.

chunks.title: 3.5.0-rc.1 / 2025-07-08
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.5.0-rc.1, the project continues the LTS release with no known breaking changes. The OTLP feature for promoting scope metadata as metric labels (otlp.promote_scope_metadata) has been removed since problems were discovered. The remaining features from rc.0 are retained: experimental type and unit metadata labels in PromQL, ts_of_(min|max|last)_over_time functions, always_scrape_classic_histograms, OTLP promote_all_resource_attributes and ignore_resource_attributes, and STACKIT Cloud service discovery. Enhancements and performance improvements are identical to rc.0, including Hetzner SD label_selector, non-constant PromQL aggregation parameters, UI improvements, earlier rule parsing, promtool fuzzy comparison, PromQL iterator reuse, native histogram storage reuse, UI optimizations, Kubernetes SD cache, TSDB Direct IO, early label value fetch termination, simpler stringlabels encoding, and concurrent scrape pool reloading. Bug fixes also match rc.0, covering GOGC, config, PromQL native histogram last_over_time, parser positions, mixed histogram handling, duration rounding, histogram_count/sum, NaN handling, unary operator precedence, avg consistency, UI query warnings, HTTP Vary header, discovery deadlocks, Azure AD remote-write client_id, and scraping memory corruption.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.5.0, the project delivers the LTS release with no known breaking changes. Features include experimental type and unit metadata labels in PromQL, ts_of_(min|max|last)_over_time functions, always_scrape_classic_histograms, OTLP promote_all_resource_attributes and ignore_resource_attributes, and STACKIT Cloud service discovery. Enhancements cover Hetzner SD label_selector, non-constant PromQL aggregation parameters, UI improvements for target count, rules filtering, query stats tooltip, and search clearing, earlier rule parsing, and promtool fuzzy float64 comparison. Performance improvements include PromQL iterator reuse, native histogram storage reuse, UI memoization and debouncing, Kubernetes SD cache, TSDB Direct IO, early label value fetch termination, simpler stringlabels encoding, and concurrent scrape pool reloading. Bug fixes address GOGC handling, config GOGC respect, PromQL native histogram last_over_time, parser position ranges, mixed histogram handling, duration rounding, inconsistent histogram_count/sum, NaN handling, unary operator precedence, avg consistency, UI query warnings, HTTP Vary header, discovery deadlocks, Azure AD remote-write client_id, scraping memory corruption, custom-bucket histogram continuation after exponential histogram, and OTLP default config respect when otlp block is unset.

chunks.title: 3.6.0-rc.0 / 2025-08-12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.6.0-rc.0, new features include PromQL step() and min()/max() on durations behind the 'promql-duration-expr' flag, a new API endpoint /v1/status/tsdb/blocks for block metadata, and template functions toDuration() and now(). Enhancements add namespace metadata attachment in discovery, OTLP UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes translation strategy, OTLP scope metadata promotion as labels, OTLP __type__ and __unit__ labels when type-and-unit-labels is enabled, traceparent HTTP header during scrapes, UI option to disable info/warning query messages, and improved UI metadata handling for _count/_sum/_bucket suffixes. Performance improvements come from internal PromQL optimizations. Bug fixes address config escaping method error messages, discovery shutdown race condition, OTLP target_info sample generation, PromQL NaN handling in topk/bottomk/limitk/limit_ratio, native counter histogram extrapolation, numerical error reduction by disabling optimizations, native histogram subquery inconsistencies, inconsistent rate/increase annotations with type-and-unit-labels, scraping memory corruption in slicelabels builds, TSDB panic with created-timestamp-zero-ingestion, and TSDB panic on native histograms with empty buckets.

chunks.title: 3.6.0-rc.1 / 2025-09-09
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.6.0-rc.1, the only change is an enhancement in TSDB to track stale series in the Head block via the new prometheus_tsdb_head_stale_series metric.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.6.0, features include PromQL step() and min()/max() on durations, the /v1/status/tsdb/blocks API endpoint, and template functions toDuration() and now(). Enhancements cover discovery namespace metadata, OTLP UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes strategy, OTLP scope metadata promotion, OTLP __type__/__unit__ labels, traceparent header in scrapes, UI option to disable query messages, improved UI metadata handling, and TSDB stale series tracking via prometheus_tsdb_head_stale_series. Performance improvements from internal PromQL optimizations. Bug fixes address config escaping errors, discovery shutdown race, OTLP target_info generation, PromQL NaN in topk/bottomk/limitk/limit_ratio, native counter histogram extrapolation, numerical error reduction, native histogram subquery inconsistencies, inconsistent rate/increase annotations, scraping memory corruption, TSDB panic with created-timestamp-zero-ingestion, and TSDB panic on empty-bucket native histograms.

chunks.title: 3.7.0-rc.0 / 2025-10-02
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.7.0-rc.0, changes include deprecation of several remote-write metrics (prometheus_remote_storage_{samples,exemplars,histograms}_in_total and prometheus_remote_storage_highest_timestamp_in_seconds) with alternatives provided. New features add experimental anchored and smoothed rate in PromQL behind 'promql-extended-range-selectors', federation support for native histograms with custom buckets (NHCB), PromQL first_over_time and ts_of_first_over_time behind 'experimental-promql-functions', Azure Workload Identity authentication for remote-write receiver, type and unit labels in remote-write 2.0 when type-and-unit-labels is enabled, and OTLP writing start time as created time zero samples when created-timestamp-zero-ingestion is enabled. Enhancements include PromQL warn-level annotations for counter reset conflicts, UI scrape interval/timeout on targets page, TSDB resolution reduction for exponential schema native histograms, remote write logging for unexpected metadata, new remote-write queue highest timestamp metric, mixin updates for the new metric, concurrent rule evaluation for ALERTS/ALERTS_FOR_STATE, and TSDB internal operation logs. Performance improvements from OTLP direct TSDB writing, reduced OTLP logs, PromQL preprocessing, reduced PromQL allocations, optimized TSDB appender creation, and improved reverse index lookup. Bug fixes cover alerting relabeling scoping, config escaping scheme inference, TSDB mixed-type sample handling, remote-write NHCB prevention over 1.0, TSDB metadata handling for NHCB in protobuf scraping, TSDB invalid schema histogram ignoring, PromQL empty metric names in histogram_quantile annotations, PromQL error character positions, and PromQL info() function fixes.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.7.0, a warning notes a breaking change in the OTLP endpoint: OpenTelemetry attribute names starting with underscore are no longer automatically translated to key_attrib; users are advised to use 3.7.1 instead. Changes include deprecation of remote-write metrics with detailed alternatives. Features add experimental anchored and smoothed rate, federation NHCB support, PromQL first_over_time/ts_of_first_over_time, Azure Workload Identity for remote-write receiver, type/unit labels in remote-write 2.0, and OTLP start time as created time zero samples. Enhancements cover PromQL counter reset conflict annotations, UI scrape interval/timeout, TSDB resolution reduction, remote write metadata logging, new queue highest timestamp metric, mixin updates, concurrent rule evaluation, and TSDB logs. Performance improvements from OTLP direct TSDB writing, reduced OTLP logs, PromQL preprocessing, reduced allocations, optimized appender creation, and improved reverse index lookup. Bug fixes address alerting relabeling scoping, config escaping inference, TSDB mixed-type samples, remote-write NHCB prevention, TSDB metadata handling, TSDB invalid schema histograms, PromQL empty metric names, error positions, and info() function fixes.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.7.1, a bug fix reverts the breaking OTLP changes from 3.7.0: OTel attribute names starting with a single underscore are now prefixed with key_, and multiple consecutive underscores are kept in the label name during translation.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.7.2, bug fixes address AWS SDK v2 credentials handling for EC2 and Lightsail discovery, AWS region loading from IMDS when not set, relabeling labelmap action validation with legacy metric name validation scheme, PromQL parsing failure when 'anchored' and 'smoothed' are used as metric/label names, and PromQL formatting of range vector selectors with smoothed/anchored modifiers.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.7.3, bug fixes revert a changed redirect behavior for -web.external-url when -web.route-prefix is configured, fix federation of some native histograms, fix promtool check config failure with --lint=none, and fix a remote-write deadlock in queue resharding logic.

chunks.title: 3.8.0-rc.0 / 2025-11-07
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.8.0-rc.0, native histograms become a stable but optional feature, activated via the new scrape_native_histogram config setting; the --enable-feature=native-histograms flag now only changes the default to true and will be a no-op in v3.9. Changes include rejection of NHCB with NaN threshold. New features add OpenContainers spec labels to Dockerfile, unified AWS service discovery for EC2/Lightsail/ECS, native histogram stability, UI support for anchored/smoothed in PromQL editor, detailed relabeling steps display, urlQueryEscape template function, and Remote-Write 2.0 support in promtool push metrics. Enhancements clarify negative native histogram docs, add static UID to remote-write dashboard, reconcile mismatched NHCB bounds in PromQL Add/Sub, add 'unknown' state for unevaluated alerting rules, allow simultaneous classic histogram conversion and zero-timestamp ingestion, add smoothed/anchored in explain, de-duplicate OTLP target_info samples, document use_fips_sts_endpoint and Prometheus Agent. Performance improvements speed up variadic function parsing, UI rendering of collapsed content, label name/value retrieval in PromQL editor, and /alerts page via virtual scrolling. Bug fixes address PromQL info() slice indexing, API lock contention on /api/v1/targets, consistent gauge/counter histogram handling in aggregations, NHCB with -Inf first custom value, duplicate API data loading, old UI createExpressionLink, and PromQL parsing panics.

chunks.title: 3.8.0-rc.1 / 2025-11-21
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.8.0-rc.1, changes update Remote-Write 2 receiving to spec 2.0-rc.4, renaming 'created timestamp' to 'start timestamp'. A new feature adds OAuth2 jwt-bearer grant-type support.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.8.0, native histograms are stable but optional via scrape_native_histograms config; the feature flag changes default to true and will be no-op in v3.9. Changes include Remote-Write 2 spec update to 2.0-rc.4 (CT to ST) and rejection of NHCB with NaN threshold. Features add OAuth2 jwt-bearer grant-type, OpenContainers labels, unified AWS SD, native histogram stability, UI anchored/smoothed editor support, detailed relabeling steps, urlQueryEscape, and promtool Remote-Write 2.0 support. Enhancements clarify negative histogram docs, add static UID to dashboard, reconcile NHCB bounds, add 'unknown' alert state, allow simultaneous classic conversion and zero-timestamp ingestion, add smoothed/anchored in explain, de-duplicate OTLP target_info, document use_fips_sts_endpoint and Agent. Performance improvements in variadic parsing, UI rendering, label retrieval, and /alerts virtual scrolling. Bug fixes for PromQL info() slice, API lock contention, histogram aggregation consistency, NHCB -Inf, duplicate loading, old UI links, and parsing panics.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.8.1, a bug fix corrects the Remote Write receiver to not send wrong response headers for v1 flow, preventing false partial error logs and metrics from Prometheus senders.

chunks.title: 3.9.0-rc.0 / 2025-12-18
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.9.0-rc.0, native histograms are no longer experimental; the feature flag is a no-op and scrape_native_histograms config must be used. Changes add a maximum limit of 10,000 statistics sets to the TSDB status endpoint. New features include /api/v1/features endpoint, promtool start_timestamp field for unit tests, promtool tsdb dump --format seriesjson, --storage.tsdb.delay-compact-file.path flag for Thanos interoperability, and UI option to duplicate query panels. Enhancements add --storage.tsdb.block-reload-interval flag, UI Y axis zero start option, classic protobuf scraping without unit in metric name, native histograms to complement summaries in various components, notifications latency histogram, AzureAD custom scope for remote-write, config label on SD refresh metrics, TSDB out-of-order sample delta histogram, and remote-read histogram validation. Performance improvements in TSDB postings index, scraping relabelling speed, and PromQL binary operator optimizations. Bug fixes address UI autocomplete for _total counters, codemirror-promql label completion, query editor duration suggestion, PromQL delayed name removal errors, query text corruption, anchored selector resets/changes, many-to-one matching checks, unary negation collision, label_join/label_replace collision, OR expression inconsistency, rate/increase/delta histogram gauge result, invalid histogram iteration panic, TSDB chunk file overflow rejection, and TSDB resolution reduction panic.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.9.0, native histograms are no longer experimental; the feature flag is a no-op and scrape_native_histograms config is required. Changes limit TSDB status endpoint statistics to 10,000 sets. Features include /api/v1/features, promtool start_timestamp, promtool tsdb dump seriesjson, --storage.tsdb.delay-compact-file.path, and UI duplicate query panel. Enhancements add block-reload-interval flag, UI Y axis zero start, classic protobuf without unit, native histograms in summaries, notifications latency histogram, AzureAD custom scope, SD refresh config label, OOO sample delta histogram, and remote-read histogram validation. Performance improvements in TSDB postings, scraping relabelling, and PromQL binary operators. Bug fixes for UI autocomplete, codemirror completion, duration suggestion, delayed name removal, query text corruption, anchored resets/changes, many-to-one matching, unary negation collision, label_join/label_replace collision, OR inconsistency, histogram gauge result, invalid histogram panic, chunk overflow, and resolution reduction panic.
In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.9.1, bug fixes address an Agent crash shortly after startup from invalid object type and a scraping relabel keep/drop not working issue.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.5.1, this is the current Long Term Support release with no code changes since 3.5.0, only dependency updates: Docker library updated from 28.2.2 to 28.5.2 and built with Go 1.24.11.

chunks.title: 3.10.0-rc.1 / 2026-02-19
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.10.0-rc.1, a distroless Docker image variant is introduced alongside the default busybox image, using UID/GID 65532 and no VOLUME declaration. Changes add an alertmanager dimension to several notification metrics and hide expanded alert annotations by default in the UI. New features include AWS SD MSK Role, PromQL fill/fill_left/fill_right binop modifiers, OpenAPI 3.2 specification at /api/v1/openapi.yaml, distroless image, and on-demand wall time profiling under /debug/pprof/fgprof. Enhancements add more detail to histogram quantile monotonicity annotations, independent alertmanager sendloops, experimental TSDB early compaction of stale series, removable service discoveries via build tags, and promtool support for promql-duration-expr and promql-extended-range-selectors. Performance improvements avoid unnecessary label extraction, improve regex matcher performance, add OTLP label caching, compute /api/v1/targets/relabel_steps in a single pass, and optimize LabelValues intersection. Bug fixes prevent crashes from UTF-8 continuation bytes, fix missing X-Prometheus-Stopping header, fix info() filtering, fix exemplar buffer grow/shrink discarding, fix broken graph display after reload, and fix TSDB memoization issues.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.10.0, a distroless Docker image variant is available alongside busybox, with UID/GID 65532 and no VOLUME. Changes add alertmanager dimension to notification metrics and hide expanded alert annotations by default. Features include AWS MSK Role, PromQL fill/fill_left/fill_right, OpenAPI 3.2 spec, distroless image, and fgprof profiling. Enhancements improve histogram quantile annotations, independent sendloops, experimental TSDB stale series compaction, removable SDs via build tags, and promtool syntax support. Performance improvements in label extraction, regex matchers, OTLP label caching, single-pass relabel_steps, and LabelValues intersection. Bug fixes for UTF-8 crash, missing stopping header, info() filtering, exemplar buffer, graph reload, and TSDB memoization.

chunks.title: 3.11.0-rc.0 / 2026-03-30
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.11.0-rc.0, changes deprecate Hetzner SD datacenter labels and redirect promtool debug output to stderr. New features add AWS Elasticache and RDS roles, Azure SD Workload Identity, a service discovery last update timestamp metric, Kubernetes SD node role selectors and pod-based controller name labels, PromQL </ and >/ operators for trimming native histogram observations, experimental histogram_quantiles variadic function, TSDB retention.percentage configuration, experimental st-storage feature flag for start timestamps, and experimental xor2-encoding feature flag. Enhancements add AWS external_id for sigv4, Kubernetes SD deprecation log deduplication, TSDB old checkpoint removal, UI autocomplete for first_over_time/ts_of_first_over_time, and Vultr SD library upgrade. Performance improvements in PromQL joins, native histogram aggregation KahanAdd regression, remote write WAL watching buffer reuse, TSDB LabelValues intersection, and UI hover restacking skip. Bug fixes address AWS EC2 SD endpoint and panic, Agent memory leak, alerting FOR period reset, Azure SD managed identity, Consul SD filter, and other issues.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.11.0, changes deprecate Hetzner SD datacenter labels and redirect promtool debug to stderr. Features include AWS Elasticache/RDS roles, Azure Workload Identity, SD last update metric, Kubernetes node role selectors and pod controller labels, PromQL </ and >/ operators, histogram_quantiles, TSDB retention.percentage, st-storage and xor2-encoding feature flags. Enhancements add AWS external_id, Kubernetes log deduplication, TSDB checkpoint cleanup, UI autocomplete, and Vultr library upgrade. Performance improvements in PromQL joins, histogram aggregation, remote write WAL, TSDB LabelValues, and UI hover. Bug fixes for AWS EC2 endpoint/panic, Agent memory leak, alerting FOR reset, Azure managed identity, Consul filter, etc.
In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.11.1, a bug fix resolves a startup failure for OTLP HTTP tracing with insecure: true.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.5.2, a security fix addresses a stored XSS vulnerability via unescaped metric names and labels in the web UI (CVE-2026-40179). A performance improvement stops calling Simplify on regex.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.11.2, a security fix addresses stored XSS via unescaped metric names and labels (CVE-2026-40179). An enhancement introduces a health_filter field for Consul SD Health API filtering, and a bug fix corrects the Consul SD filter parameter being incorrectly applied to the Health API.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.5.3, security fixes address AzureAD remote write OAuth client_secret exposure in /-/config (CVE-2026-42151), remote-write and remote-read snappy decompression limits (CVE-2026-42154), and stored XSS via unescaped le label values in old UI heatmap charts.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.11.3, security fixes address AzureAD remote write OAuth client_secret exposure (CVE-2026-42151), remote-read snappy decompression limit (CVE-2026-42154), and stored XSS via unescaped le label values in old UI heatmap charts.

chunks.title: 3.12.0-rc.0 / 2026-05-19
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.12.0-rc.0, security fixes address remote-write snappy decompression limit and STACKIT SD secret exposure. Changes add Start Timestamp field to WAL Histogram samples when st-storage is enabled. New features include /api/v1/status/self_metrics endpoint, DigitalOcean Managed Databases SD, aix/ppc64 compilation target, Outscale VM SD, PromQL warning for sort functions in range queries, experimental start/end/range/step functions, resets() update for start timestamps, auto-reload-config promotion to stable, TSDB/Agent CheckpointFromInMemorySeries, UI for deleting time series and cleaning tombstones, PromQL use-start-timestamps for rate/irate/increase, scrape st-synthesis feature flag, and promqltest @st annotation. Enhancements add API concurrent fgprof rejection, AWS external_id for ECS/MSK/RDS/Elasticache, dynamic SD backoff, promtool --header flag, and other improvements. Performance and bug fixes included.

In the prometheus/prometheus release v3.12.0, security fixes for remote-write snappy limit and STACKIT SD secret exposure. Changes add Start Timestamp to WAL Histogram samples. Features include /api/v1/status/self_metrics, DigitalOcean Managed Databases SD, aix/ppc64 support, Outscale VM SD, PromQL sort warning, start/end/range/step functions, resets() start timestamp update, stable auto-reload-config, CheckpointFromInMemorySeries, UI series deletion/tombstone cleaning, use-start-timestamps for rate/irate/increase, st-synthesis flag, and promqltest @st. Enhancements in API, AWS external_id, dynamic SD backoff, promtool --header, etc. Performance and bug fixes.

questions.query_text: Across the prometheus/prometheus releases, how does the handling of OTLP attribute name translation differ between v3.7.0 and v3.7.1?

options.text: v3.7.0 automatically translates underscore-prefixed names to key_attrib, while v3.7.1 reverts this and prefixes key_ only for single underscores, keeping multiple consecutive underscores.
v3.7.0 removes all OTLP translation, while v3.7.1 adds UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes.
Both versions handle OTLP attribute translation identically.
v3.7.0 introduces OTLP scope metadata promotion, while v3.7.1 removes it.

questions.expected_answer: v3.7.0 automatically translates underscore-prefixed names to key_attrib, while v3.7.1 reverts this and prefixes key_ only for single underscores, keeping multiple consecutive underscores.

answer_support.answer_text: a breaking change in the OTLP endpoint: OpenTelemetry attribute names starting with underscore, for example _attrib, are no longer automatically translated to key_attrib

Prefix key_ to label name when translating an OTel attribute name starting with a single underscore, and keep multiple consecutive underscores in label name when translating an OTel attribute name. This reverts the breaking changes introduced in 3.7.0.

answer_support.answer_text: PromQL first_over_time(...) and ts_of_first_over_time(...) behind feature flag experimental-promql-functions

New features include ... experimental start/end/range/step functions

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent protocolbuffers/protobuf release stream across multiple versions, including v25.x, v29.x, v31.x, v32.x, v33.x, v34.x, and v35.x, highlighting compiler, C++, Java, Python, PHP, Ruby, and Bazel changes.

chunks.title: Protocol Buffers v31.0-rc1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the protocolbuffers/protobuf release v31.0-rc1, the project introduces the Protobuf Java Immutable API `nest_in_file_class` feature for Edition 2024, adds a weak attribute to GetClassData to speed up clang builds, implements a nontemporal software prefetcher for repeated ptr field destructor, warns on unused RepeatedPtrField, fixes a python codegen crash when C++ features are used, adds notices.h with dependency license information and a --notices flag to protoc, moves the upb minitable code generator into protoc, upgrades abseil-cpp to 20250127 with canonical BCR names, controls bounds checks via BUILD flags, creates hardened versions of `Get` and `Mutable` for repeated_field, and loosens the py_proto_library check to be on the import path instead of full directory.

chunks.title: Protocol Buffers v25.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the protocolbuffers/protobuf release v25.7, the project makes rules_ruby a dev-only dependency, fixes a PHP deprecated warning on field getters for default values, and backports bumps to aarch64 runners.

chunks.title: Protocol Buffers v31.0-rc2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the protocolbuffers/protobuf release v31.0-rc2, the project adds support for an import option for protoc, performs an automated rollback of a PHP C-Extension commit, and patches `rules_ruby` to apply `neverlink = True` to the `jars` rule.

chunks.title: Protocol Buffers v31.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the protocolbuffers/protobuf release v31.0, the project removes a fast-path check for non-clang compilers in MessageCreator, adds a missing include, adds a weak attribute to GetClassData to speed up clang builds, adds a nontemporal software prefetcher to repeated ptr field dtor, warns on unused RepeatedPtrField, adds notices.h with dependency license information and a --notices flag to protoc, fixes a bug in handling of implicit-presence string_view fields, controls bounds checks via BUILD flags, upgrades abseil-cpp to 20250127 with canonical BCR names, creates hardened versions of `Get` and `Mutable` for repeated_field, uses ProtobufToStringOutput to control the output format of AbstractMessage.Builder.toString, implements the Protobuf Java Immutable API `nest_in_file_class` feature for Edition 2024, introduces a `Generated` annotation to eventually replace `javax.annotation.Generated`, adds volatile to featuresResolved, fixes a Java concurrency issue in feature resolution for old <=3.25.x gencode using lazy feature resolution, loosens the py_proto_library check to be on the import path instead of full directory, adds support for an import option for protoc, and moves the upb minitable code generator into protoc.

chunks.title: Protocol Buffers v25.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the protocolbuffers/protobuf release v25.8, the project changes the pre-22 poison pill to only log once per affected message type, weakens vulnerable gencode poison pill to a warning by default, and backports recursion limit enforcement to the 25.x branch.

chunks.title: Protocol Buffers v31.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the protocolbuffers/protobuf release v31.1, the project supports allowing late injection of language feature set defaults from FeatureSet extensions while getting feature set extension values, adds missing `copts` attribute in Java, makes Python pyi print "import datetime" for Duration/Timestamp fields, adds recursion depth limits to pure python, and fixes a cmake staleness test.

chunks.title: Protocol Buffers v29.5

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent puppeteer/puppeteer release stream across core, puppeteer, browsers, and ng-schematics packages, covering features, fixes, and breaking changes from v24.40.0 through v25.1.0.

chunks.title: puppeteer-core: v24.40.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the puppeteer/puppeteer release puppeteer-core v24.40.0, the project adds support for the PUPPETEER_DANGEROUS_NO_SANDBOX environment variable and rolls to Chrome 146.0.7680.153 and 146.0.7680.80.

Fixes include adding missing onRelease to Mutex, making Target.asPage return the same Page instance, removing RenderDocument from disabled Chrome features, and rolling to Chrome 147.0.7727.50, 147.0.7727.56, and Firefox 149.0.2.

chunks.title: puppeteer: v24.41.0

Fixes include blocking standard network emulation reset if allowlist or blocklist are enabled, handling missing sessionId when looking up callbacks, normalizing headers, removing Cookie attribute sameParty, and not storing request on BrowsingContext in webdriver. Performance improvements remove intermediate object wrappers in webdriver. Refactors remove debug lib direct usage, deprecated Browser.isConnected(), MouseOptions.clickCount, and Puppeteer.product.

Features include adding experimental bisect CLI command and moving packages to ESM only. Fixes remove public makeProgressCallback helper and replace extract-zip. Performance updates logger signature. Refactors make proxy agent optional peer dependency.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent pytorch/pytorch release stream from v1.10.1 through v2.12.0, covering major feature releases, bug-fix patches, and the introduction of torch.compile, TorchData, functorch, and various performance and distributed improvements.

chunks.title: PyTorch 1.10.1 Release, small bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v1.10.1, a small bug fix release, the following regressions and silent correctness issues are addressed: torch.nn.cross_entropy silently incorrect on CUDA for non-contiguous inputs, channels_last significantly degrades accuracy, a potential strict aliasing rule violation in bitwise_binary_op on ARM/NEON, torch.get_autocast_cpu_dtype() returns a new dtype, and Conv2d grad bias gets wrong value for bfloat16 case.

chunks.title: PyTorch 1.10.2 Release, small bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v1.10.2, a small bug fix release, additional fixes not included in v1.10.1 are deployed: a pybind issue for get_autocast_cpu_dtype and get_autocast_gpu_dtype is fixed, fgrad_input is removed from slow_conv2d, and formatting of CIRCLE_TAG when building docs is fixed.

chunks.title: PyTorch 1.11, TorchData, and functorch are now available
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v1.11.0, PyTorch 1.11, TorchData, and functorch are now available. Highlights include the beta release of TorchData for modular data loading primitives, the beta release of functorch for composable function transforms, and stable Distributed Data Parallel (DDP) static graph optimizations. Backwards incompatible changes include fixing python deepcopy to correctly copy all attributes on Tensor objects, making the steps argument no longer optional in torch.linspace and torch.logspace, and removing the mistakenly public torch.hub.import_module function.

chunks.title: PyTorch 1.12: TorchArrow, Functional API for Modules and nvFuser, are now available
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v1.12.0, PyTorch 1.12 introduces TorchArrow, a Functional API for Modules, and nvFuser. Highlights include a Functional Module API, Complex32 and Complex Convolutions, DataPipes from TorchData fully backward compatible with DataLoader, improved functorch coverage, nvFuser as a deep learning compiler, changes to float32 matrix multiplication precision on Ampere and later CUDA hardware, and TorchArrow as a new beta library for machine learning preprocessing over batch data. Backwards incompatible changes include updated type promotion for torch.clamp, fixing complex type promotion, disabling TF32 for matmul by default, and making scatter_reduce an in-place function.

chunks.title: PyTorch 1.12.1 Release, small bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v1.12.1, a small bug fix release, issues fixed include removing an overly restrictive assert in adam, fixing a convolution forward over reverse internal assert, addressing a 25% performance regression when calculating hessian, fixing distributed store to use add for the counter of DL shared seed, raising proper timeout when sharing the distributed shared seed, allowing register float16 weight_norm on cpu, fixing weight norm backward bug on CPU when OMP_NUM_THREADS <= 2, disabling src mask for transformer and multiheadattention fastpath, making nn.stateless correctly reset parameters if the forward pass fails, fixing CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES having no effect, fixing share_memory() on CUDA tensors crashing, unbreaking CUDA lazy init, fixing cu113 wheels cudnn discoverability, removing overly restrictive checks for cudagraph, and various ONNX and MPS cherry picks.

chunks.title: PyTorch 1.13: beta versions of functorch and improved support for Apple’s new M1 chips are now available
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v1.13.0, beta versions of functorch and improved support for Apple's new M1 chips are now available. Highlights include stable BetterTransformer, deprecation of CUDA 10.2 and 11.3 and migration to CUDA 11.6 and 11.7, beta support for Apple M1 chips, and functorch included in-tree. Backwards incompatible changes include uint8 and all integer dtype masks no longer allowed in Transformer, updated torch.floor_divide to perform floor division, and various other API changes.

chunks.title: PyTorch 1.13.1 Release, small bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v1.13.1, a small bug fix release, issues fixed include a RuntimeError by torch.nn.modules.activation.MultiheadAttention with bias=False and batch_first=True, installation regression on Amazon Linux 2, installation failure using poetry on Mac M1, missing masked tensor documentation, command injection in torch.jit.annotations.parse_type_line, safe usage of Python frame in _pythonCallstack, double-backward with full_backward_hook causing RuntimeError, logical error in get_default_qat_qconfig, cuda/cpu check on NoneType, ONNX ATen Fallback for BUILD_CAFFE2=0, ONNX operator_export_type on the new registry, and torchrun AttributeError caused by file_based_local_timer on Windows.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.0: Our next generation release that is faster, more Pythonic and Dynamic as ever
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.0.0, PyTorch 2.0 is the next generation release that is faster, more Pythonic and Dynamic as ever. Highlights include torch.compile as the main API, TorchInductor relying on OpenAI Triton, Accelerated Transformers with custom kernel architecture for scaled dot product attention, Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend providing GPU accelerated training on Mac platforms, and Amazon AWS optimizing CPU inference on AWS Graviton3 based C7g instances. New prototype features include TensorParallel, DTensor, 2D parallel, TorchDynamo, AOTAutograd, PrimTorch and TorchInductor.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.0.1 Release, bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.0.1, a bug fix release, issues fixed include _canonical_mask throwing warning when bool masks passed as input to TransformerEncoder/TransformerDecoder, Embedding bag max_norm=-1 causing leaf Variable that requires grad is being used in an in-place operation, type hint for torch.Tensor.grad_fn, can't convert float to int when the input is a scalar np.ndarray, revisiting torch._six.string_classes removal, module backward pre-hooks to actually update gradient, load_sharded_optimizer_state_dict error on multi node, warning once for TypedStorage deprecation, cuDNN V8 API incorrect use of emplace in the benchmark cache, and various torch.compile, distributed, NN_frontend, DataLoader, MPS, Functorch, Releng, and torch.optim fixes.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.1: automatic dynamic shape compilation, distributed checkpointing
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.1.0, automatic dynamic shape compilation and distributed checkpointing are introduced. Highlights include automatic dynamic shape support in torch.compile, torch.distributed.checkpoint for saving/loading distributed training jobs on multiple ranks in parallel, torch.compile support for the NumPy API, improved Python 3.11 support, CPU inductor improvements, AVX512 kernel support, scaled-dot-product-attention kernels, torch.export as a prototype full-graph capture mechanism, and prototype support for semi-structured (2:4) sparsity on NVIDIA GPUs. Backwards incompatible changes include requiring C++17 to build from source and disabling torch.autograd.gradcheck for complex inputs.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.1.1 Release, bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.1.1, a bug fix release, issues fixed include removing spurious warning in comparison ops, fixing segfault in foreach_* operations when input list length does not match, fixing cuda driver API to load the appropriate .so file, fixing missing CUDA initialization when calling FFT operations, ignoring beartype==0.16.0 within the onnx package, fixing the behavior of torch.new_zeros in onnx, removing unnecessary slow code in torch.distributed.checkpoint.optimizer.load_sharded_optimizer_state_dict, adding planner argument to load_sharded_optimizer_state_dict, continuing if param not exist in sharded load in FSDP, fixing handling of non-contiguous bias_mask in scaled_dot_product_attention, fixing meta device implementation for scaled_dot_product_attention, fixing copy from mps to cpu device when storage_offset is non-zero, fixing segfault in torch.sparse.mm for non-contiguous inputs, fixing circular import between Dynamo and einops, and verifying flatbuffer module fields are initialized for mobile deserialization.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.1.2 Release, bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.1.2, a bug fix release, issues fixed include crashes for float16 empty tensors, MPS memory corruption when working with tensor slices, crashes during Conv backward pass on MPS devices, partially fixing nn.Linear behavior on AArch64 platform, fixing cosine_similarity for tensors of different sizes, packaging missing headers needed for extension development, improving error handling of torch.set_num_threads, and fixing profiling traces generation.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.2: FlashAttention-v2, AOTInductor
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.2.0, FlashAttention-v2 and AOTInductor are introduced. Highlights include ~2x performance improvements to scaled_dot_product_attention via FlashAttention-v2 integration, AOTInductor for ahead-of-time compilation and deployment for non-python server-side, improved torch.compile support for Optimizers, new inductor optimizations, a new logging mechanism TORCH_LOGS, and deprecation of macOS x86 support. Backwards incompatible changes include requiring GCC 9.4 or newer to build from source.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.2.1 Release, bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.2.1, a bug fix release, issues fixed include missing OpenMP support on Apple Silicon binaries, crash when mixing lazy and non-lazy tensors in one operation, PyTorch performance regression on Linux aarch64, silent correctness in DTensor _to_copy operation, properly assigning param.grad_fn for next forward, ensuring gradient clear out pending AsyncCollectiveTensor in FSDP Extension, processing unflatten tensor on compute stream in FSDP Extension, FSDP AssertionError on tensor subclass when setting sync_module_states=True, DCP state_dict cannot correctly find FQN when the leaf module is wrapped by FSDP, OOM when returning a AsyncCollectiveTensor, Windows runtime torch.distributed.DistNetworkError, updating supported python versions in package description, SIGILL crash during import torch on CPUs that do not support SSE4.1, DCP RuntimeError in get_state_dict and set_state_dict, fixes for HSDP + TP integration with device_mesh, numerical error with mixedmm on NVIDIA V100, RuntimeError when using SymInt input invariant when splitting graphs, compile DTensor.from_local in trace_rule_look up, and improving torch.compile integration with CUDA-11.8 binaries.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.2.2 Release, bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.2.2, a bug fix release, issues fixed include properly raising an error when trying to use inductor backend on non-supported platforms such as Windows, fixing mkldnn performance issue on Windows platform, fixing RuntimeError: cannot create std::vector larger than max_size() in torch.nn.functional.conv1d on non-contiguous cpu inputs by patching OneDNN, adding support for torch.distributed.fsdp.StateDictType.FULL_STATE_DICT for when using FullyShardedDataParallel with the device_mesh argument, fixing make triton command on release branch for users building the release branch from source, ensuring gcc>=9.0 for build from source and cpp_extensions, fixing cxx11-abi build in release branch, and fixing building from source on Windows source MSVC 14.38 - VS 2022.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.3: User-Defined Triton Kernels in torch.compile, Tensor Parallelism in Distributed
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.3.0, user-defined Triton kernels in torch.compile and Tensor Parallelism in Distributed are introduced. Highlights include support for user-defined Triton kernels in torch.compile, Tensor Parallelism for training Large Language Models, and various prototype features. Backwards incompatible changes include changing default torch_function behavior to be disabled when torch_dispatch is defined and ProcessGroupNCCL removing multi-device-per-thread support from C++ level.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.3.1 Release, bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.3.1, a bug fix release, issues fixed include removing runtime dependency on JAX/XLA when importing torch.__dynamo, hiding Plan failed with a cudnnException warning, fixing CUDA memory leak, fixing format_utils executable, fixing regression with device_mesh in 2.3.0 during initialization causing memory spikes, fixing crash of FSDP + DTensor with ShardingStrategy.SHARD_GRAD_OP, fixing failure with distributed checkpointing + FSDP if at least 1 forward/backward pass has not been run, fixing error with distributed checkpointing + FSDP and with use_orig_params = False and activation checkpointing, fixing set_model_state_dict errors on compiled module with non-persistent buffer with distributed checkpointing, fixing data corruption when coping large (>4GiB) tensors on MPS, fixing Tensor.abs() for complex on MPS, fixing UTF-8 encoding on Windows .pyi files, fixing import torch failure when wheel is installed for a single user on Windows, fixing compatibility with torchdata 0.7.1, fixing aarch64 docker publishing, fixing performance regression on aarch64 linux, fixing DeepSpeed transformer extension build on ROCm, and fixing kernel crash on tensor.dtype.to_complex() after ~100 calls in ipython kernel.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.4: Python 3.12, AOTInductor freezing, libuv backend for TCPStore
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.4.0, Python 3.12, AOTInductor freezing, and libuv backend for TCPStore are introduced. Highlights include support for Python 3.12 for torch.compile, AOTInductor freezing for CPU, a new default TCPStore server backend utilizing libuv, and a new Python Custom Operator API. Backwards incompatible changes include default ThreadPool size to number of physical cores and fixing torch.quasirandom.SobolEngine.draw default dtype handling.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.4.1 Release, bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.4.1, a bug fix release, issues fixed include the pytorch/pytorch docker image now installing the PyTorch package through pip and switching its conda installation from miniconda to miniforge, fixing performance regression on Windows related to MKL static linking, fixing error during loading on Windows: [WinError 126] The specified module could not be found, fixing tensor.clamp produces wrong values on MPS, fixing incorrect result from batch norm with sliced inputs on MPS, fixing launching kernel invalid config error when calling embedding with large index on ROCm, adding a check and a warning when attempting to use hipBLASLt on an unsupported architecture on ROCm, fixing image corruption with Memory Efficient Attention when running HuggingFace Diffusers Stable Diffusion 3 pipeline on ROCm, fixing FutureWarning when using torch.load internally in distributed, fixing FutureWarning when using torch.cuda.amp.autocast internally in distributed, fixing exception with torch compile when onnxruntime-training and deepspeed packages are installed, fixing silent incorrectness with torch.library.custom_op with mutable inputs and torch.compile, fixing SIMD detection on Linux ARM, not using C++20 features in cpu_inductor code, fixing for exposing statically linked libstdc++ CXX11 ABI symbols, fixing error while building pytorch from source due to not missing QNNPACK module, making PyTorch buildable from source on PowerPC, fixing XPU extension building, fixing warning when using pickle on a nn.Module that contains tensor attributes, fixing NaNs return in MultiheadAttention when need_weights=False, fixing nested tensor MHA produces incorrect results, and fixing error when using torch.utils.flop_counter.FlopCounterMode.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.5.0 Release, SDPA CuDNN backend, Flex Attention
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.5.0, SDPA CuDNN backend and Flex Attention are introduced. Highlights include a new CuDNN backend for SDPA enabling speedups on H100s or newer GPUs, regional compilation of torch.compile to reduce cold start up time, and TorchInductor CPP backend enhancements. Beta features include CuDNN backend for SDPA, torch.compile regional compilation without recompilations, and TorchInductor CPU backend optimization.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.5.1: bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.5.1, a bug fix release, regressions fixed include wheels from PyPI being unusable out of the box on PRM-based Linux distributions, PyPI arm64 distribution logging cpuinfo error on import, crash when using torch.compile with Math scaled_dot_product_attention in AMP Mode, MPS internal crash due to invalid buffer size computation if sliced API is used, and several issues related to CuDNN Attention.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.6.0 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.6.0, multiple improvements for PT2 are featured: torch.compile can now be used with Python 3.13, a new performance-related knob torch.compiler.set_stance, several AOTInductor enhancements, and FP16 support on X86 CPUs. Note that starting with this release, PyTorch is not going to publish on Conda. Backwards incompatible changes include changing the default value for weights_only parameter of torch.load.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.7.0 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.7.0, highlights include Torch.Compile support for Torch Function Modes, Mega Cache, and various prototype features such as NVIDIA Blackwell Architecture Support, PyTorch Native Context Parallel, and FlexAttention LLM optimizations on X86 CPUs. Backwards incompatible changes include dropped support for Triton < 2.2.0, removed support for CUDA 12.4 and Anaconda in CI/CD, C++ Extensions py_limited_api=True now built with -DPy_LIMITED_API, change torch.Tensor.new_tensor() to be on the given Tensor's device by default, and using Manylinux 2.28 and CXX11_ABI=1 for future released Linux wheel builds.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.7.1 Release, bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.7.1, a bug fix release, issues fixed include excessive cudagraph re-recording for HF LLM models, torch.compile on some HuggingFace models, crash due to Exception raised inside torch.autocast, improving error logging in torch.compile, marking mutable custom operators as cacheable in torch.compile, implementing workaround for a graph break with older version einops, fixing an issue with tensor.view(dtype).copy_(...), fixing assertion error due to inductor permuting inputs to flex attention, fixing performance regression on nanogpt speedrun, fixing extra CUDA context created by barrier in distributed, fixing an issue related to Distributed Fused Adam in Rocm/APEX when using nccl_ub feature, adding a workaround random hang in non-blocking API mode in NCCL 2.26, fixing MacOS compilation error with Clang 17, fixing binary kernels produce incorrect results when one of the tensor arguments is from a wrapped scalar on MPS devices, improving PyTorch Wheel size, fixing fmsub function definition, fixing Floating point exception in torch.mkldnn_max_pool2d, fixing abnormal inference output with XPU:1 device, fixing Illegal Instruction Caused by grid_sample on Windows, fixing ONNX decomposition does not preserve custom CompositeImplicitAutograd ops, fixing error with dynamic linking of libgomp library, and fixing segfault in profiler with Python 3.13.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.8.0 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.8.0, highlights include torch::stable::Tensor, high-performance quantized LLM inference on Intel CPUs with native PyTorch, experimental wheel variant support, Inductor CUTLASS backend support, Inductor Graph Partition for CUDAGraph, Control Flow Operator Library, HuggingFace SafeTensors support in PyTorch Distributed Checkpointing, SYCL support in PyTorch CPP Extension API, A16W4 on XPU Device, hierarchical compilation with torch.compile, and Intel GPU distributed backend (XCCL) support. Backwards incompatible changes include removed support for Maxwell and Pascal architectures with CUDA 12.8 and 12.9 builds, calling an op with an input dtype that is unsupported now raises NotImplementedError instead of RuntimeError, added missing in-place on view check to custom autograd.Function, and an error is now properly thrown for the out variant of tensordot when called with a requires_grad=True tensor.

chunks.title: 2.9 Release Notes
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.9.0, highlights include updates to the stable libtorch ABI for third-party C++/CUDA extensions, symmetric memory that enables easy programming of multi-GPU kernels, the ability to arbitrarily toggle error or resume on graph breaks in torch.compile, expanded wheel variant support to include ROCm, XPU and CUDA 13, FlexAttention enablement on Intel GPUs, flash decoding optimization based on FlexAttention on X86 CPU, ARM Platform improvements and optimizations, and enablement of Linux aarch64 binary wheel builds across all supported CUDA versions. Backwards incompatible changes include min supported Python version is now 3.10 and undefined behavior when an output of a custom operator shares storage with an input.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.9.1 Release, bug fix release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.9.1, a bug fix release, issues fixed include a significant memory regression in F.conv3d with bfloat16 inputs in PyTorch 2.9.0, fixing Inductor bug when compiling Gemma, fixing InternalTorchDynamoError in bytecode_transformation, fixing silent correctness error_on_graph_break bug where non-empty checkpoint results in unwanted graph break resumption, improving performance by avoiding recompilation with mark_static_address with cudagraphs, improving performance by caching get_free_symbol_uses in torch inductor, fixing registration design for inductor graph partition for vLLM, fixing warning spamming in torch.compile, fixing exception related to uninitialized tracer_output variable, fixing crash in torch.bmm and torch.compile with PyTorch release 2.9.0, fixing warning spamming on new APIs to control TF32 behavior, fixing distributed crash with non-contiguous gather inputs, fixing indexing on large tensor causes invalid configuration argument, fixing numeric issue in CUDNN_ATTENTION, fixing symmetric memory issue with fused_scaled_matmul_reduce_scatter, improving libtorch stable ABI documentation, and fixing image display on pypi project description section.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.10.0 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.10.0, highlights include Python 3.14 support for torch.compile(), reduced kernel launch overhead with combo-kernels horizontal fusion in torchinductor, a new varlen_attn() op providing support for ragged and packed sequences, efficient eigenvalue decompositions with DnXgeev, torch.compile() now respects use_deterministic_mode, DebugMode for tracking dispatched calls and debugging numerical divergence, and Intel GPUs support expanding to the latest Panther Lake on Windows and Linux. Backwards incompatible changes include removed unused data_source argument from Sampler, removed deprecated imports for torch.utils.data.datapipes.iter.grouping, removed Nested Jagged Tensor support from nn.attention.flex_attention, fallback=False is now the default in torch.onnx.export, and renaming pytorch-triton package to triton.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.11.0 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.11.0, highlights include added support for Differentiable Collectives for Distributed Training, FlexAttention now has a FlashAttention-4 backend on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, MPS (Apple Silicon) Comprehensive Operator Expansion, added RNN/LSTM GPU Export Support, and added XPU Graph Support. Backwards incompatible changes include Volta (SM 7.0) GPU support removed from CUDA 12.8 and 12.9 binary builds, PyPI wheels now ship with CUDA 13.0 instead of CUDA 12.x, and torch.hub.list(), torch.hub.load(), and torch.hub.help() now default the trust_repo parameter to "check" instead of None.

chunks.title: PyTorch 2.12.0 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release v2.12.0, highlights include batched linalg.eigh on CUDA up to 100x faster due to updated cuSolver backend selection, new torch.accelerator.Graph API unifying graph capture and replay across CUDA, XPU, and out-of-tree backends, torch.export.save now supports Microscaling (MX) quantization formats, Adagrad now supports fused=True, torch.cond control flow can now be captured and replayed inside CUDA Graphs, and ROCm users gain expandable memory segments, rocSHMEM symmetric memory collectives, and FlexAttention pipelining. Backwards incompatible changes include strengthened SVE compile checks in FindARM.cmake, updated the minimum CUDA version required to build PyTorch from source to CUDA 12.6, enforced a C++20 minimum in CMake build files, torch.distributed.nn.functional ops now raise RuntimeError under torch.compile, and torchrun now defaults to an OS-assigned free port for single-node training instead of port 29500.

questions.query_text: In the pytorch/pytorch releases, which release introduces a new CuDNN backend for SDPA, enabling speedups by default for users of SDPA on H100s or newer GPUs?

answer_support.answer_text: a new CuDNN backend for SDPA, enabling speedups by default for users of SDPA on H100s or newer GPUs

questions.query_text: Across the pytorch/pytorch releases, how does the backwards incompatible change in v2.7.0 regarding torch.Tensor.new_tensor() differ from the backwards incompatible change in v2.8.0 regarding custom autograd.Function?

options.text: v2.7.0 changes new_tensor() to use the given Tensor's device by default, while v2.8.0 adds a missing in-place on view check to custom autograd.Function.
v2.7.0 removes support for Triton < 2.2.0, while v2.8.0 removes support for Maxwell and Pascal architectures.
v2.7.0 changes the default value for weights_only parameter of torch.load, while v2.8.0 changes the default ThreadPool size.
v2.7.0 drops support for CUDA 12.4, while v2.8.0 drops support for Volta GPUs.

questions.expected_answer: v2.7.0 changes new_tensor() to use the given Tensor's device by default, while v2.8.0 adds a missing in-place on view check to custom autograd.Function.

answer_support.answer_text: change torch.Tensor.new_tensor() to be on the given Tensor's device by default
added missing in-place on view check to custom autograd.Function

questions.query_text: In the pytorch/pytorch release window, order the following release-content states from earliest to latest: (1) a release that introduces torch.compile as the main API and Accelerated Transformers, (2) a release that introduces automatic dynamic shape support in torch.compile and torch.distributed.checkpoint, (3) a release that introduces FlashAttention-v2 integration and AOTInductor, (4) a release that introduces user-defined Triton kernels in torch.compile and Tensor Parallelism in Distributed.

answer_support.answer_text: torch.compile as the main API ... Accelerated Transformers
automatic dynamic shape support in torch.compile ... torch.distributed.checkpoint
FlashAttention-v2 integration ... AOTInductor
user-defined Triton kernels in torch.compile ... Tensor Parallelism in Distributed

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent radareorg/radare2 release stream from version 5.5.4 through 6.1.4, covering stability fixes, architecture migrations, new analysis features, and major version transitions.

chunks.title: 5.5.4 - stability release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.5.4, the project delivers a stability release with 30 commits from 8 contributors. Highlights include using cs_disasm_iter in anal.x86.cs for faster analysis, handling jbc [reg] in the 8051 assembler, improving pD to avoid reading too many bytes, supporting Mach-O DYLD_CHAINED_PTR_64_OFFSET format, adding JSON output to zb commands, and fixing a heap overflow in aao and a null deref in the symbols file.

chunks.title: 5.6.0 - codename Miteigi
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.6.0 codenamed Miteigi, the project introduces a native C reimplementation of r2pm, initial thread support with one RCore per thread, removal of sdb_fmt in favor of thread-safe r_strf, improved panels usability, support for latest capstone, project loading in sandbox mode, new commands such as pdu, r-/r+, fc, aafs, pcc, /aF, isqq, binary PLIST printing with pFB, orders of magnitude faster analysis with aafs and sixref, honor flag colors in hexdump, fix for 3 CVEs, arm32 debugging on native arm64 hosts, scripting support for quickjs and wren, a time measurement directive for rarun2, the Rabin Karp search algorithm /e, and new arch plugins for loongarch, evm.cs, v850.np and chip8.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.6.2, the project fixes 12 critical vulnerabilities, adds support for the XALZ file format used by Xamarin to pack .NET libraries, restores ihex:// support, introduces lz4 deflating at API and commandline levels, adds FreeBSD to the CI, implements the new w+ (wx+) commands that write and seek to the end of the written chunk, and fixes panel glitches with improved decompiler usability.

chunks.title: 5.6.4 - codename "do bisa vijnu"
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.6.4 codenamed "do bisa vijnu", the project adds agfm and agfma commands to print CFG graphs using mermaid syntax, fixes string detection issues with izz, improves macho and ELF loading times, adds initial katakana charset support, fixes multiple DoS vulnerabilities in PE, QNX, DYLDCACHE, PSX, kernelcache, minidump, and macho parsers, adds FreeBSD debug support for powerpc, powerpc64, powerpc64le and riscv64, and introduces the aot command to show instruction types.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.6.6, the project removes the hexagon from anal, adds afiq for quiet function info, unifies asm.z80 into anal.z80, restricts local vars and args to an 8KB range, adds mermaid output to all ag commands, implements the jrcxz assembler, adds the CL command help, caches file_exists for source files, completes DWARF4 register mappings, fixes multiple UAF and OOB read crashes, adds dd+ to open files in child process as read-write, adds ddf command, implements ESIL for x86 SSE float instructions, adds aeb using APIs, adds aaepa to set unknown imports as ret0, implements ESIL for Stlxr arm64 instructions, and imports the initial code tokenizer.

chunks.title: 5.6.8 - codename: remora
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.6.8 codenamed remora, the project implements the abf command to list incoming basic blocks, runs aap before aae on arm64 binaries in aaa, hides dyldcache parsing errors, handles ^C when loading dyldcache, fixes multiple oobread bugs in dyldcache and NE parsers, adds support for parsing swift metadata from macho binaries, adds Visual Studio 2022 build support, fixes UAF in aaef, adds Apple Silicon hardware stepping, implements the ESIL backend for ragg2, fixes aeb emulation, adds esil.maxsteps to avoid infinite emulation loops, and fixes aeabj JSON output.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.7.0, the project adds initial support for op.family on v850.np, implements native r0 relative references in v850, optimizes thumb code analysis to be 4x faster, honors anal.timeout and improves ^C handling in aaaa, moves VAX disassembler to anal, fixes invalid basic blocks on switch/jmptbl on arm64, uses RArchConfig in RReg, introduces RAnalPlugin.jmpmid, fixes infinite loops in aav, adds missing Motorola cpu models for m68k, moves asm.xtensa into anal, fixes aoml for non-x86 targets, adds direction information in xrefs, and adds =SN and =R0 to 8051.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.7.2, the project adds op->cycles for M68K move, sets data alignment of m68k CPUs, uses r10 as SP on arm64, adds z vector registers for ARM64, adds R_REG_TYPE_VEC, adds ESIL support for VMOVDQU in x86, fixes ARM ujmp op type, moves i4004 asm to anal, adds initial anal.bpf.cs plugin, supports tbz, tbnz, rev16, rev32 in arm64 assembler, supports cset and sxt instructions, supports mnemonic list for all Capstone-based plugins, refactors wasm parsing with RPVector, adds macos-m1 GHCI builds, and updates v35arm64 to fix riscv builds.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.7.4, the project honors syntax cfg in cs anal plugins, adds big endian support for arm prelude search, re-enables the bpf.mr assembler, removes all instances of "ptr " in x86 cs assembly output, moves the lm32 plugin into anal, fixes o-- issue on macho-arm64, stops hashing files when loading for a speed improvement from 1.2s to 0.8s, splits wasm imports by types, adds omu command to create a unique map, fixes multiple issues in projects, merges asm.java, asm.sh, asm_rsp, asm_propeller, asm_m680x_cs, asm gb, asm.mcs96, asm.cris, asm.8051, asm.sparc, and asm.alpha into anal, and adds the open file command to the ms shell.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.7.6, the project adds a mnemonic API to the pickle arch, adds a python pickle machine disassembler, handles arm64 BTI instruction as a nop, updates syscalls for aarch64 to linux 5.19.0-rc1, updates syscall table for linux-x64 from kernel 5.19-rc1, fixes riscv left shift bugs, adds pickle assembler, fixes use-after-free in the macho swizzler, adds RABIN2_MACHO_NOFUNCSTARTS option, exposes dbgInfo.LineNum on macho files, adds cmd.undo for w and CC commands, fixes multiple crashes including double free, oobread in iOS arm64 kernel parsing, FPE in p2 visual mode, and buffer overrun in pd, and adds fs.cwd to define default path in ms.

chunks.title: 5.7.8 - codename "boredom"
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.7.8 codenamed "boredom", the project defines =SN for the sparc register profile, includes bb instruction addresses in abj, implements aflx and aflx* commands to re-analyze function callers, implements aflm. and aflm? for makefile-style function call summary, implements r_anal_esil_dfg_reg_is_const, improves aab results by using section size, renames asm.arm_cs to asm.arm, merges asm.sparc_gnu into anal.sparc_gnu, upgrades to latest capstone-next for ppc, fixes boundary check in mach0 fixups reconstruction, fixes two oobreads in coresymbolication and dyldcache, adds support for REL file format plugin, supports powerpc coffs, adds wasm globals to symbols, and fixes stack exhaustion bug in the c++ gnu demangler.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.8.0, the project makes RAnalOp.srcs,dsts non-pointers, renames axj to axlj, introduces anal.tailcall.delta, improves tailcall detection logic, adds esil.dfg.mapinfo and esil.dfg.maps config vars, introduces R_ANAL_ESIL_DFG_TAG_{REG,MEM}, adds /au to search for unknown destination jmp/call, adds anal.noret, fixes aae argument parsing, increases default anal.depth from 64 to 128, implements aflxv and aflx? commands, runs /azq in aaaa, fixes bx after add lr,pc,0 in arm32, implements aflxj, adds noreturn column in afll, uses RPVector in RAnalOp src/dst to support ldm/stm/simd, and adds anal.vars.newstack.

chunks.title: 5.8.2 - codename "Jonesy"
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.8.2 codenamed "Jonesy", the project honors micromips codealign, sets indirect code refs from load instructions, reworks function merging, adds Plan 9 calling conventions, implements RCore.cmdCallAt(), adds ESIL support for v850 ei, di, reti, stsr, ldsr, and setf instructions, moves mcore into the arch, supports micromips on both gnu and capstone plugins, moves anal.propeller, adds micromips cpu for mips.gnu, moves nios2 away from anal, registers RArch plugins to be loaded dynamically, implements .extern directive in rasm2, fixes ARM assembler for blt, ble, cmn, tst, and teq, supports elf-micromips auto detection, adds DWARF5 line header parsing, adds Plan 9 line number information, and fixes load address of arm64 kernel.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.8.4, the project supports function arguments without a name, optimizes RCore.analOp() lowering aa from 1m23 to 1m19, makes aab faster from 39s to 32s, adds new aarr command to reanalize all function refs, adds support for DUP in esil_dfg, implements esil-dfg support for POP, implements aob/aobj commands, migrates cr16, cris, riscv.cs, pic, anal.tricore, anal.alpha, Vax, bpf, anal.lm32, z80, lanai, mcs96, kvx, wasm, xtensa, ws, or1k, and anal.evm.cs into arch plugins, adds Inferno Dis VM, adds esil support for v850 satadd, satsub, ldb, ldh, ldw, stb, sth, stw, and mulh instructions, and adds more conditional branch instructions for various architectures.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.8.6, the project handles 'int 0x20' as eob on x86-16, fixes null deref in arm32 calling conventions, handles more noreturn functions, allows RAnal.cur to be set to NULL, fixes aae logic for mem read xrefs, fixes function stack frame size in case of FP register in Thumb's PUSH, supports big endian value search analysis, migrates tms320, mips gnu, chip8, xcore, m68k_cs, 6502_cs, loongarch, s390.cs, ppc.gnu, m68k_gnu, S390 GNU, hppa.gnu, sparc.gnu, brainfuck, h8300, pyc, msp430, ebc, lh5801, pdp11, arc, and arm.v35 plugins, implements wao nop for riscv, and improves riscv analysis with ESIL emulation fixes for jr/li/mv.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.8.8, the project improves tail call detection, checks for noret destinations in afbr listings, considers zero pages as invalid code, implements ahb-* missing command, makes macos/ios targets inherit types from darwin, improves tricore.cs handling of jumps/rets/movs, fixes ESIL MIPS64 NOR instruction, migrates java and i8080 plugins, fixes max asm len in pickle, honors endianness in ppc.cs, migrates ppc_cs, sparc_cs plugins, removes global state from v850, loongarch, riscv, lua5.3, 6502_cs, xtensa, m68k_cs, and z80 plugins, adds support for 4bit registers, adds initial support for Sharp SM5xx MCUs, improves adrp instruction assembler, parses more CodeSignature fields for mach0, implements faster Css, adds support for more ELF reloc types, and implements basic pdp11 binary parser.

chunks.title: 5.9.0 - Codename "Hyperborean"
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.9.0 codenamed "Hyperborean", the project begins deprecation of the current RAnalPlugin, refactors show flags into a single showMode bitset, changes return types across the codebase, and introduces numerous ABI changes including using RPluginMeta in RCryptoPlugin and RFS. This major release contains 1316 commits from 65 contributors and sets the foundation for the new plugin architecture.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.9.2, the project implements RBuffer.cache, adds a --with-new-abi and use_new_abi meson option, fixes afbij to return an array, fixes ub shifts on sixref, sets VAX maxinstrsize to 56, avoids aav via aaa on dalvik/java/python, fixes invalid instructions on mips, honors optype to fill opjump field, considers software interrupt branches, speeds up ao by blocksize orders of magnitude, fixes jmptable analysis on ARM, implements R_ARCH_INFO_ISVM, implements archinfo callback for Dalvik, adds initial support for stm8, adds nor in RAnalOp.toString(), provides archinfo details for xtensa, adds missing =BP in ppc regprofile, defines aop.type for more s390 instructions, adds ARM assembler tests, supports writeback on indexed ldst for ARM, handles more Swift demangler tail attributes, improves osabi detection for android, implements conformsToProtocol mangling for Swift, supports the 'O' element in swift demangler, separates arm vs arm64 reloc import logic, autodetects thumb main on arm16 elf binaries, implements relocs for ppc64, uses RBuffer.cache for mach0 swizzling, and loads imports on ELF/s390 from the GOT section.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.9.4, the project ignores NEVER bit in branch instructions on SPARC, fixes SPARC call instruction branches, exposes mem delta on store variables, improves default function names, adds anal.flagends to stop functions when flags are found, fixes aac on rebased files, fixes aae behavior on invalid instructions, optimizes RAnalOp.setBytes for NEWABI, honors codealign in nopskip, reuses R_PERM in RAnalVarAccess.type, makes anal.vinfun false by default, shows jmptbl bb cases in ab output, adds initial support for MIPS jump tables, fixes missing arm reference regression in aaaa, implements r_base32 APIs, adds initial support for the UXN machine, fixes instruction type issues for mips.gnu, exposes missing cpus list in ARM plugin, adds sfence.vma instruction support for riscv, makes dynsym and hash sections wordable, implements RBin.attr(str2bits), implements RBinPlugin Commands in new abi via i:, implements iclc command, fixes parsing dmp binaries on big endian, fixes incorrect parsing of MZ headers in big-endian, tweaks custom swift demangler, fixes Objective-C classes Swift demangling, improves swift demangler to handle more constructions, creates sections for dyldcache stub islands, sets dyldcache entry point to first map, implements initial support for RBin->RIO redirections, fixes iej/ilj on ob*, fixes symbol parsing in Plan9, adds dir.sourcebase newabi, and fixes dyldcache issues.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.9.6, the project fixes an infinite loop with anal.slow=false workaround, supports fixed x27 as global pointer reference on Dart binaries, fixes arm64 instruction types and LOADs not LEAs, fixes memory direction and permissions detection in xref, supports jump table constructions for arm64 Swift binaries, fixes invalid ESIL for add+shift on arm64, adds ESIL translation for MIPS movn instruction, fixes ESIL for TST and AND v850 instructions, exposes imm value on ADD/SUB arm64 instructions, implements ESIL and reg details for BRAA instructions on arm64, fills op.val for stm8 ref analysis, adds assembler support for m68k, fixes more x86 assembler instructions, adds new Dalvik disassembler, adds Capstone6 support for PowerPC, MIPS, ARM64, improves TriCore support with CFG, calling conventions, asm.cpu, opex, pseudodisasm, basic ESIL, and fixed register profile, handles asm.syntax=regnum for arm.cs, exposes asm.cpu options for bpf, adds generic pseudo disasm for non-supported archs, fixes stm8 pseudo return, improves tricore, arm, stm8 and x86 pseudo, fixes resizing ELF sections, detects Dart ELFs, fixes duplicated and large swift symbol demangling issues, clarifies bin.demangle.libs to bin.demangle.pfxlib, speeds up macho parser, moves lua bin parser, detects VisionOS binaries, replaces ia with iA, adds help for various commands, and enforces valid value for asm.offset.relto.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 5.9.8, the project adds array of values for arguments in aobj, fixes aobj representing undefined behavior bits, fixes string ref direction and improves false positive xref types, adds better indirect code reference detection via flags, skips string/format/data metatypes from ref analysis, fixes false positive string ref spotted as write, fixes aa warning when no sections in binobj, makes afvt work with 1 parameter to display type, adds recursive information in afi, implements aflmr command to list all recursive functions, fixes stm8 calling convention, adds aflmu command to list function calls once, handles direction and supports pointer RAM references for stm8, disables indirect pointer references for stm8, implements afln command to list all function names, adds parse.pickle plugin, adds gb.pseudo plugin, fixes more issues for stm8.pseudo, adds pseudo for rvf stm8 instruction, clarifies STM8 memory access in disasm, fixes iS sha1/sha1/sort/inc table queries plus entropy, caches sections in dwarf parser, handles table queries for imports and segments, uses raw symbol name in flatItem.realname, adds math category imports, improves iic subcommands for listing uniq xrefs, improves iic command for classifying imports, fixes crash in iic, fixes RVA to offset conversion on PE binaries, fixes broken test exposing reentrant RNum.math glitch, fixes make purge, fixes duplicated sha symbols from rvc cyclic dep, corrects OpenSSL imports, fixes qjs when using asan, defines cstd for meson-w32, uses XDG cachedir and exposes it via dir.cache, fixes empty lines when sorting, implements e+ command to set config vars in r2rc, increases float and double precision, fixes command injection vulnerability via rbin->r2, fixes infinite loops in dwarf parser, stops parsing compressed DWARF sections, disables fortunes in sandbox mode, and fixes infinite loop in pdc pseudo decompilation.

In the radareorg/radare2 release 6.0.0, the project introduces RCorePlugins with a session, finishes RKons refactoring so all r_cons calls take instance instead of global, renames RCrypto to RMuta, uses RCons instance from RLine, renames RIOPlugin.widget to RIOPlugin.data, refactors the RRegAlias api, camelcases all RCoreBind methods, wires up function and variable events, implements LA for listing analysis plugins, implements afv*/afvd* and fixes afv help messages, implements p8fm for function mask plus tests, adds JSON output to abm command, implements abm command to show bytes and mask for basic block, renames function fields for clarity, documents afi fields in afi??, fixes jmp/call refs for riscv code, implements aflmc to work like uniq but counting, implements pds* command to add comments for emulated strings, improves scr.analbar percentages in aaaa, makes anal.back a tristate, and adds anal.back to sort symbols backward.

chunks.title: 6.0.2 - codename "Relephant"
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the radareorg/radare2 release 6.0.2 codenamed "Relephant", the project fixes r_event.h install location on meson builds, fixes Android flock regression, fixes build when using libuv, implements RXML DOM API, supports R_X86_64_RELATIVE ELF relocs, avoids loading files twice on some URI handlers for bin parsing, fixes loading rc scripts from XDG paths, adds hexfile:// URI handler, supports F key shortcuts in the shell, honors underlying IO sizes in psz, and adds temporary block modifiers @xc: and @xf:.
