prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent sharkdp/bat release stream from v0.8.0 through v0.26.1, covering new features, syntax additions, bugfixes, and library API changes across multiple versions.

chunks.title: v0.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.8.0, the project introduces support for a configuration file with a simple format, the BAT_OPTS environment variable, custom syntax mappings via the -m/--map-syntax option, pager command-line arguments in PAGER and BAT_PAGER, wildcard support in Windows CMD, first-line syntax detection for all input types, encoding support for UTF-16LE and UTF-16BE, and a new syntax for Robot framework. Binary files are now detected and not displayed when output goes to an interactive terminal. Bugfixes address JavaDoc comments breaking syntax highlighting in .java files and a panic on Haskell source code. Other improvements include better help texts, updated documentation, shell completion generation during build, and new distribution channels via Termux, nix, and Docker.

chunks.title: v0.9.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.9.0, a new -A/--show-all option is added to show and highlight non-printable characters. The --pager option allows configuring the pager from the configuration file. The BAT_CONFIG_PATH environment variable sets a non-default path for the configuration file. Multiple occurrences of --style and --line-range are now allowed. The --terminal-width option can accept offsets. Changes include disabling italics by default, setting the default tab-width to 4, adding a new Sublime Snazzy theme, and no longer shipping shell completions. Bugfixes prevent endless recursion when PAGER is set to bat. Other updates include availability on openSUSE, a Chinese translation of the README, and re-written tests.

chunks.title: v0.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.10.0, a new --highlight-line <N> option is added. Changes include moving the default configuration directory on macOS to ~/.config/bat, completely disabling shell completion file generation, properly setting arguments to less when PAGER contains options, reporting missing file names, not starting the pager if a file doesn't exist, renaming bat cache --init to bat cache --build, and moving --config-dir and --cache-dir options. Bugfixes address a blank line at the end of output with --style=plain and requiring EOF twice on stdin. New syntaxes are added for Twig, .desktop files, AsciiDoc, Assembly, Log files, Protobuf, Terraform, Jsonnet, and Varlink. Other improvements include a Japanese README and code improvements.

chunks.title: v0.11.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.11.0, three new special color themes are available: ansi-light, ansi-dark, and base16. A hand-written auto completion script for Fish shell is added. The -p/--plain option can now be used twice (-pp) to also disable the pager. Bugfixes include not replacing arguments to less when using --pager, indicating binary files with a warning in interactive mode, printing empty files with a single header line, disallowing --terminal-width=0, and preventing accidental printing of files named cache. Other updates include new integration tests, a new Integration with other tools section in the README, migration to Rust 2018, updated F# syntax, and Fish shell syntax. Packaging: bat is now available on Chocolatey.

chunks.title: v0.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.12.0, binary file content can now be viewed with bat -A. bat can be used as a man pager. A new style component separates multiple --line-range arguments. -L is added as an alias for --list-languages. Bugfixes address unbalanced output with --style=grid,numbers without header, issues with filenames starting with cache, inability to build cache with a new theme without creating the cache dir, and incorrect parsing of --terminal-width -10. Other improvements include adding fish completions to the DEB package. New syntaxes are added for Emacs Org mode, requirements.txt, DotENV, SSH config, /etc/hosts, GraphQL, Verilog, SCSS and Sass, and strace. Packaging: bat is now in the official Gentoo, Alpine Linux, and Fedora repositories.

chunks.title: v0.12.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.12.1, a bug is fixed for older Windows versions where the procedure entry point CreateFile2 could not be located.

chunks.title: v0.13.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.13.0, bat can now be used as a library. A breaking change introduces glob-based syntax mapping, requiring users to update their config files. --highlight-line now accepts line ranges. Proper wrapping support for output with wide Unicode characters is added. Many existing syntaxes are updated. BAT_CACHE_PATH can be used to place cached assets in a non-standard path. Support for combining multiple styles at the same time is added. Bugfixes include not passing --no-init on newer less versions, bat cache taking precedence over existing files, treating .sc files as Scala, allowing underscores and dashes in page names, keeping empty lines empty, fixing wrapping when piping, allowing non-unicode filenames, fixing empty file without header producing incomplete grid, and respecting shebang lines for files named build. Other improvements include parametrizable names for man page and shell completion files, enabling LTO for about 10% faster performance, suggestions for macOS dark mode, extended integration section, updated man pager instructions, file encodings section, updated sort order of options, man page syntax updates, Japanese documentation updates, accepting default as a theme, and updated Windows installation instructions. New syntaxes: Jinja2, SaltStack SLS, /etc/fstab, /etc/group and /etc/passwd, /proc/cpuinfo and /proc/meminfo, Nim, Vue, CoffeeScript. New themes: Dracula, Nord, Solarized light and dark. Packaging: bat is now in the official...

chunks.title: v0.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.14.0, a new --file-name <name>… option overwrites displayed filenames in the header, useful when piping input. A --generate-config-file option creates an initial configuration file at the right place. Bugfixes address performance problems with C# and Makefiles, a highlighting bug in Ruby files with unindented heredocs, a highlighting problem in Rust source code, Windows short files not requiring paging being lost, and --highlight-line not working correctly with --tabs=0 and --wrap=never. Other changes include maintaining a metadata.yaml file for cached syntaxes/themes with version info and printing an error for incompatible versions, and updating the liquid dependency. As a library, a new high-level API is added, binary-only dependencies are stripped out with a features = ["application"] default, and optional functionality is put behind features. New syntaxes: Rego, Stylo.

chunks.title: v0.15.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.15.0, a new --diff/-d option shows only lines surrounding Git changes, with --diff-context=N to control context. Bugfixes include an error message printed in the middle of output for another file and performance improvements when using custom caches, making startup twice as fast. The Solarized dark/light themes are updated. As a library, there are changes in the low-level API (Config struct and error handler), while the high-level API is unaffected.

chunks.title: v0.15.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.15.1, bugfixes address highlighting of Markdown files and fix the base16 theme (broken since v0.14). Users suffering from no color for bat in ssh from a Windows client can use the ansi-dark and ansi-light themes. New syntaxes: Fortran, Email, QML.

chunks.title: v0.15.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.15.2, a warning notes that this release suffers from a panic when called with a relative file path. Bugfixes address --map-syntax not working with names provided through --file-name, syntax detection for files called 'rails', and potential errors with syntax detection for symlinked files. Other changes include adding padding above headers when not using a grid, printing an error if an invalid syntax is specified via -l or --map-syntax. As a library, PrettyPrinter::vcs_modification_markers is deprecated when building without the git feature. Packaging: compilation problems with onig_sys are resolved by upgrading to syntect 4.2, removing the need for libclang(-dev).

chunks.title: v0.15.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.15.3, bugfixes address the inability to run bat with relative paths and mishighlighting of Users that start with digits in SSH config. A new syntax for SML is added. Some syntaxes and themes are updated to the latest version.

chunks.title: v0.15.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.15.4, bugfixes add missing Solarized themes and fix a highlighting bug in Haskell source files.

chunks.title: v0.16.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.16.0, support for the NO_COLOR environment variable is added. -P short flag disables paging. --force-colorization/-f flag provides an alias for forced color and decoration output. Bugfixes address non-printable characters display for redirected output, file extension conflicts in --list-languages. Other changes include switching to Middle Dot for non-printing spaces, adding zsh shell completion script, improved --help text, and adding custom languages/themes sections to manpage. Syntaxes: update AsciiDoc, add GLSL, Nginx and Apache config file syntax, use fstab syntax for crypttab files, support syntax highlighting for files in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/. New themes: Gruvbox, base16-256. As a library, APIs to provide Input descriptions and directly provide Inputs to PrettyPrinter are added; Input::theme_preview_file is removed. Packaging: zsh shell completion files are included, build dependency on liquid is removed.

chunks.title: v0.17.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.17.0, a new --style value rule adds a simple horizontal ruled line between files. Pass -S (chop long lines) to less if --wrap=never is set. Bugfixes detect infinite loop when input and output are the same, throw an error when bat is used as pager, fix Bash syntax highlighting not selected for *.ebuild and *.eclass files, and fix zsh completion when using -p. Other changes include adding a note to refer to detailed help, adding a Contributors section to README. Syntaxes: improved Manpage syntax highlighting, add Svelte file syntax. New theme: Coldark.

chunks.title: v0.17.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.17.1, a bugfix addresses running bat without arguments failing with "output file is also an input".

chunks.title: v0.18.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.18.0, a pager is used when bat --list-languages is called. Bugfixes include not adding a newline if the last line doesn't end with one when using --style=plain, only printing themes hint in interactive mode, making regression tests work on recent macOS, fixing VimL syntax highlighting, printing an error message if a custom theme is broken, truncating long lines in plain mode if wrap is not explicitly opted in, silently using less instead of more or most to ensure color support, silently using less if PAGER is bat to prevent recursion, fixing Manpage highlighting, and fixing BAT_CONFIG_PATH ignored if non-existent. Other improvements include performance improvements, a new --diagnostic option, modified default theme colors, and upping min required Rust version to 1.42. Syntaxes: added Zig, Lean, .resource extension for Robot Framework, gnuplot, highlight *.pac as JavaScript. New themes: ansi replaces ansi-dark and ansi-light (breaking change); Gruvbox theme updated (breaking change). As a library, several deprecated PrettyPrinter methods are removed.

chunks.title: v0.18.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.18.1, a bugfix addresses mouse support and screen clearing broken for less versions with minor version number (581.2). Other changes include Input::ordinary_file and Input::with_name now accepting Path, the LESS environment variable included in bat --diagnostic, and increased min. required Rust version to 1.45. Syntaxes: improved Syslog highlighting, replaced Advanced CSV with a custom CSV syntax, added SystemVerilog, Solidity and Vyper. New theme: Dark+ VS Code theme.

chunks.title: v0.18.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.18.2, a feature ignores known backup/template filename suffixes when selecting syntax. A security vulnerability fix (CVE-2021-36753) prevents bat from executing programs called less/less.exe from the current working directory on Windows. Other changes include adding bash completion, fixing Clippy lints, and adding syntax highlighting test files. Syntaxes: upgraded Julia syntax, added dash and XAML syntax, apply DotENV syntax also for .env.default and .env.defaults files.

chunks.title: v0.18.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.18.3, a bugfix bumps the git2 dependency to fix build with Rust 1.54.

chunks.title: v0.19.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.19.0, performance improvements reduce startup time in loop-through mode by 90%, load themes lazily for 25% faster start, fix abysmal Python syntax highlighting performance, fix poor performance when ANSI escape sequences are piped, fix incorrect handling of ANSI escape sequences with --wrap=never, and load custom assets as fast as integrated assets. Features include support for x:-delta and x:+delta syntax in line ranges, --ignored-suffix argument, $BAT_CONFIG_DIR environment variable, --acknowledgements option, and including git hash in bat -V output. Bugfixes address first line not shown in diff context and not ignoring syntaxes that handle file names with *.conf extension. Other changes include adding PowerShell completion and bumping MSRV to 1.51. Syntaxes: Groff, HTTP Requests and Responses, LLVM, highlight for vimrc and gvimrc files, Syslog improvements, slim, Racket, LiveScript, MediaWiki; requirements.txt syntax removed; Dart new highlighter; SCSS, Sass, PowerShell, TypeScript syntaxes updated. As a library, deprecate some HighlightingAssets methods, remove from_files and save_to_cache, replace error struct with enum, add MappingTarget::MapExtensionToUnknown.

chunks.title: v0.20.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.20.0, new style component header-filesize shows file size in the header. Underline is used for line highlighting on ANSI. Bugfixes address bash completion on bash 3.x and bash-completion 1.x. Syntaxes: GraphQL support for interfaces and ampersand operator, associate _vimrc and _gvimrc with VimL, poetry.lock with TOML, various extensions with GLSL, add JQ syntax, properly associate global git config files. As a library, expose get_syntax_set and get_theme methods on HighlightingAssets, add HeaderFilename and HeaderFilesize to StyleComponent enum.

chunks.title: v0.21.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.21.0, features include correctly rendering tab stops in --show-all, adding --style=default as the new default (less verbose than full), enabling BusyBox less as pager, and case-insensitive file extension matching. Bugfixes bump regex dependency to fix CVE-2022-24713 and prevent crashes when encountering files referencing missing syntaxes. Performance improvements skip syntax highlighting on long lines (> 16384 chars) and vastly improve startup time by lazy-loading syntaxes via syntect 5.0.0, making bat display small files ~75% faster. Other changes include info about custom assets in --diagnostics. Syntaxes: map clang-format config to YAML, improve log syntax, associate /var/spool/mail/* and /var/mail/* with Email, add cmd-help syntax, adjust Zig syntax, associate .inf files with INI. As a library, allow configuration of show_nonprintable with PrettyPrinter, change binary format of syntaxes.bin, mark Error enum as non_exhaustive, change Error::SyntectError variant, add Error::SyntectLoadingError.

chunks.title: v0.22.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.22.0, features make the default macOS theme depend on Dark Mode and support separate system and user config files. Bugfixes prevent fork nightmare with PAGER=batcat, make --no-paging/-P override --paging=... if passed later, make --map-syntax and --ignored-suffix work together, and strip byte order mark from output in non-loop-through mode. Other changes include relaxed glibc requirements on amd64, improved fish completions, and stopping pre-processing of ANSI escape characters. Syntaxes: NSE mapped to Lua, correctly color fstab dump and pass fields, update Command Help syntax, fix Julia syntax highlighting for function name starting with struct, minor update to LiveScript, associate .mts and .cts with TypeScript, map Fish history to YAML. As a library, make PrettyPrinter::syntaxes() iterate over new Syntax struct, clear highlights after printing.

chunks.title: v0.22.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.22.1, a bugfix brings back pre-processing of ANSI escape characters so that some common bat use cases start working again.

chunks.title: v0.23.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.23.0, features implement -S and --chop-long-lines as aliases for --wrap=never, make environment variables override config file settings (breaking change), and implement --nonprintable-notation=caret for showing non-printable characters using caret notation. Bugfixes address bat cache --clear not clearing the --target dir if specified. Other changes include various bash completion improvements, disabling completion of cache subcommand, significantly improving startup performance on macOS, and bumping MSRV to 1.62. Syntaxes: added Ada, todo.txt, improve Manpage.sublime-syntax, add new requirements.txt syntax, add VimHelp syntax, associate pdm.lock with TOML, fix Todo.txt highlighting, overhaul cmd-help scope names, add Crontab support.

chunks.title: v0.24.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.24.0, features add environment variable BAT_PAGING and opt-in support for LESSOPEN and LESSCLOSE. Bugfixes fix more not being found on Windows when provided via BAT_PAGER, switch default behavior of --map-syntax to case insensitive, update serde_yaml to 0.9, fix arithmetic overflow in LineRange, fix paging not happening when stdout is interactive but stdin is not, and make -pp override --paging and vice versa when passed later. Other changes include customizable output directory for generated assets, using is-terminal crate instead of atty, adding Winget Releaser workflow, and bumping MSRV to 1.70. Syntaxes: associate os-release with bash, Containerfile with Dockerfile, replace quotes in fzf integration example, associate ksh with bash, sarif with JSON, ron with rust, add WebGPU Shader Language support, add .dpkg-new and .dpkg-tmp to ignored suffixes, add syntax mapping *.jsonl => json, update Julia syntax, add NSIS support, update ssh-config. As a library, add optional output_buffer arg to Controller::run().

chunks.title: v0.25.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.25.0, features set terminal title to file names when paging is not Never, add --squeeze-blank/-s to squeeze consecutive empty lines, --squeeze-limit to set maximum empty lines, PrettyPrinter::squeeze_empty_lines for library use, syntax highlighting for JavaScript files with #!/usr/bin/env bun, --strip-ansi={never,always,auto} to remove ANSI escape sequences, ability to add or remove individual style components without replacing all styles, automatically choose theme based on terminal's color scheme, --binary=as-text for printing binary content, make shell completions available via --completion <shell>, and syntax highlighting for puppet code blocks within Markdown files. Bugfixes address long file name wrapping in header, NO_COLOR support, handling of inputs with OSC ANSI escape sequences, combined ANSI color and attribute sequences, panel width when line 10000 wraps, compile issue of time dependency, override behavior of --plain and --paging, and bugs in $LESSOPEN support. Other changes include upgrading to Rust 2021 edition, various CI and build improvements, updating dependencies, improving performance when color output disabled, relaxing syntax mapping rule restrictions, faster startup by offloading glob matcher building, displaying default theme info, adding aarch64-apple-darwin binary tarballs, updating Lisp syntax, using bat's ANSI iterator during tab expansion, supporting statically linked binary for aarch64, updating options in shell completions and man page, bumping MSRV to 1.74, and updating clircle dependency. Syntaxes: cmd-help scope subcommands followed by other...

chunks.title: v0.26.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.26.0, features add build for windows/ARM64 platform, paging to --list-themes, support negative relative line ranges, support context in line ranges, and a built-in 'minus' pager. Bugfixes fix UTF-8 BOM not being stripped for syntax detection, BAT_THEME_DARK and BAT_THEME_LIGHT being ignored, prevent --list-themes from outputting default theme info to stdout when piped, rename submodules to fix Dependabot updates, make highlight tests fail when new syntaxes don't have fixtures, fix crash for multibyte characters in file path, add missing mappings for various bash/zsh files, send all bat errors to stderr by default, make --map-syntax target case insensitive, correctly determine end of line in UTF16LE/BE input, fix --style=changes printing two-space indent when file is unmodified, add missing shell completions, execute help/version/diagnostic commands even with invalid config/arguments, and fix line numbers and style components not printing when piping output. Other changes include updating base16 README links, working around build failures from vendored sources, stopping building for x86_64-pc-windows-gnu, replacing windows-2019 runners with windows-2025, replacing string-based codegen with quote-based codegen, improving code coverage of --list-languages, only starting offload worker thread when more than 1 core, updating terminal-colorsaurus to 1.0, updating console dependency to 0.16, fixing typos, updating onig_sys dependency, adding vendored-libgit2 feature, and updating syntect to v5.3.0. Syntaxes: add mapping for paru config files, Idris 2, nix flake.lock, improvements to CSV/TSV highlighting, improve (Sys)log error highlighting, map ndjson to JSON, map csproj/vbproj/props/targets to XML, add debsources syntax, add GDScript highlighting, add Odin highlighting test file, update quadlet syntax mapping rules, add Typst...

chunks.title: v0.26.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/bat release v0.26.1, features add paging to -h and --help. Bugfixes fix hang when using --list-themes with an explicit pager, fix negative values of N not being parsed in <N:M> line ranges without = flag value separator, fix broken Docker syntax preventing use of custom assets, fix decorations being applied unexpectedly when piping, fix diagnostics attempting to find version of executable named builtin when builtin pager is used, and fix --help not correctly reading config file for theme information. Other changes include improving README documentation on pager options passed to less, making PowerShell completions compatible with PowerShell v5.1, and using more robust escaping in Bash completions. Syntaxes: update quadlet syntax mapping to include *.{build,pod} files, fix inconsistencies in Ada syntax, add syntax mapping for podman's artifact quadlet files, and highlight Korn Shell scripts using Bash syntax.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent sharkdp/fd release stream from v7.0.0 through v10.4.2, covering new features like --exec-batch, --glob, --list-details, --owner, --format, and performance improvements across major versions.

chunks.title: v7.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v7.0.0, the project introduces --type executable to search for executable files, support for .fdignore files, the --ignore-file option to add custom ignore files, and suggestions for --fixed-strings on invalid regex. It also stops parsing .ignore and .rgignore files, updates regex-syntax to 0.5, and fixes absolute path normalization and invalid UTF-8 display with -e.

chunks.title: v7.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v7.1.0, the project adds --size filter option, --type empty to search for empty files/directories, and changes .gitignore to only be respected inside Git repositories. It also includes performance improvements for --type searches and starts offering pre-built ARM binaries.

chunks.title: v7.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v7.2.0, the project adds --changed-before and --changed-within for filtering by file modification time, --show-errors to display filesystem errors, --maxdepth alias, and --search-path option. It loosens handling of missing --ignore-file, re-enables .ignore files, and fixes a hang caused by zombie processes.

chunks.title: v7.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v7.3.0, the project introduces --exec-batch / -X for batch command execution, support for 24-bit color codes and font styles in LS_COLORS, and performance improvements for colorized output. LS_COLORS handling is outsourced to a separate crate.

chunks.title: v7.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v7.4.0, the project reduces stat syscalls for metadata searches, uses jemalloc by default, adds --glob for glob-based searches, --path-separator, support for hidden files on Windows, exposes exit status of --exec-batch commands, and exits on double Ctrl-C. It also fixes --changed-within/--changed-before for directories.

chunks.title: v7.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v7.5.0, the project adds --one-file-system to not cross filesystem boundaries, --base-directory to change working directory, NO_COLOR support, and --exec returns exit code 1 on command failure. It fixes zsh completion, -L including broken symlinks, and displays directories even without permission to enter. Flags can be passed multiple times, and search results are sorted with -X.

chunks.title: v8.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.0.0, the project adds --list-details / -l to show metadata, --max-results to limit results, -1 alias for --max-results=1, --type socket and --type pipe, --min-depth and --exact-depth, and additional ANSI font styles. It preserves non-UTF-8 filenames in child processes, enables colored output by default on older Windows, changes --glob with --full-path to not match path separators with *, removes legacy -exec support, and improves error handling.

chunks.title: v8.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.1.0, the project adds --owner filter to filter by user/group, support for a global ignore file (~/.config/fd/ignore on Unix), and does not exit immediately if a search path is missing. It reverts the Windows color change from v8.0.0, fixes a jemalloc segfault on macOS Catalina, --glob with empty pattern, and --list-details on BSDs.

chunks.title: v8.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.1.1, the project supports colored output on older Windows versions if --color=always is set or the TERM environment variable is set.

chunks.title: v8.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.2.0, the project adds --prune flag, improves time-based options usability, adds support for exact file sizes in --size filter, prints an error if pattern requires leading dot without --hidden, avoids panic on restricted directories, disables jemalloc on Android, makes --help colorless with NO_COLOR, and provides a more comprehensive default LS_COLORS when not set.

chunks.title: v8.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.2.1, there are no functional changes compared to v8.2.0; it is a bugfix in the release process.

chunks.title: v8.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.3.0, the project significantly speeds up colorized output, buffers stdout when not a TTY, caches file metadata between filters, doesn't buffer --exec output with single thread, adds --quiet, --no-ignore-parent, --batch-size, opposing command-line options, and more LS_COLORS indicators. It always shows ./ prefix unless TTY or --strip-cwd-prefix, sets default path separator to / in MSYS, fixes RAM disk search, substituted drive on Windows, write errors to full devices, uses local time zone for time functions, supports --list-details on more platforms, applies filters to symlinks themselves, and makes time comparisons exclusive.

chunks.title: v8.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.3.1, the project stops implying --no-ignore-parent with --no-vcs-ignore, no longer waits for full traversal if matches arrive within max_buffer_time, makes --max-results=1 quit immediately, fixes -h panic when stdout closed, disables jemalloc on FreeBSD, and updates man page and zsh completions.

chunks.title: v8.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.3.2, the project fixes an invalid absolute path on Windows when searching from the drive root.

chunks.title: v8.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.4.0, the project supports multiple --exec instances, prevents 'Argument list too long' errors with --exec-batch by auto-batching, prints directories with trailing path separator, and changes -u flag to be equivalent to -HI.

chunks.title: v8.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.5.0, the project makes --type executable work on Windows, fixes piped vs non-piped output differences (no leading ./ prefix unless --exec, --exec-batch, or --print0), fixes a panic from a race condition, prevents unbounded memory growth on huge trees, returns error when CWD doesn't exist with search path, improves 'command not found' error, preserves exit codes with --exec-batch, colorizes paths in parallel, avoids stat syscalls when color scheme doesn't need metadata, and uses jmalloc in static musl builds.

chunks.title: v8.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.5.1, the project fixes --threads/-j option value parsing.

chunks.title: v8.5.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.5.2, the project fixes --owner option value parsing.

chunks.title: v8.5.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.5.3, the project fixes completion generation to not include full path of fd command and fixes a build error when completions feature is disabled.

chunks.title: v8.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.6.0, the project adds --and option for additional required patterns, --changed-after alias for --changed-within, changes --type executable on Unix to check if file is executable by current user, and fixes Powershell completions to use fd instead of fd.exe.

chunks.title: v8.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v8.7.0, the project adds --no-require-git flag to always respect gitignore files and fixes logic for when to use the global ignore file.

In the sharkdp/fd release v8.7.1, the project fixes -1 conflicting with exec options, --max-results overriding -1, --quiet conflicting with exec options, and --changed-within accepting space as date-time separator.

chunks.title: v9.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v9.0.0, the project significantly improves performance (6-8x for smaller directories, up to 13x for larger), constrains default threads to at most 64, adds new flushing behavior for stdout, supports character and block device file types, ignores .git/ by default with --hidden, and fixes NO_COLOR support.

chunks.title: v10.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v10.0.0, the project adds 'dir' as alias for 'directory' in --type, supports @%s date format in time filters, reverts the v9.0.0 change to no longer automatically ignore .git with --hidden when VCS ignore is enabled, respects NO_COLOR with --list-details, fixes hidden files included despite gitignore when search path is '.', uses 64k page sizes for aarch64 jemalloc, addresses CVE-2024-24576, and raises minimum Rust version to 1.77.2.

chunks.title: v10.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v10.1.0, the project allows optional argument to --strip-cwd-prefix (always/never/auto), adds --format option for template output, fixes aarch64 page size again, and adds aarch64-apple-darwin target to release builds.

chunks.title: v10.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v10.2.0, the project adds --hyperlink option for OSC 8 hyperlinks, builds Windows releases with Rust 1.77 for Windows 7 support, and includes a symlink for fdfind in deb packages.

chunks.title: v10.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v10.3.0, the project adds a hidden --mindepth alias, replaces humantime and chrono crates with jiff, changing date parsing (e.g., 'M' no longer means month), adds aarch64 Windows to CI, updates dependencies, and improves Illumos support. This is the last release tested on x86_64 Mac OS and possibly the last with tier-1 support for Intel Macs and Windows 7.

chunks.title: v10.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v10.4.0, the project adds --ignore-contain option to ignore directories containing a named entry, fixes Windows hyperlink generation for paths with spaces, makes --print0 with --exec print \0 between entry outputs, fixes several ignore rule bugs via updated ignore library, raises minimum Rust version to 1.90.0 (dropping Intel Mac and Windows 7 support), and statically links CRT for MSVC builds.

chunks.title: v10.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v10.4.1, this is a re-release of v10.4.0 due to an issue with the original release.

chunks.title: v10.4.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sharkdp/fd release v10.4.2, the project fixes a performance regression caused by --ignore-contain.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release evolution of sickn33/antigravity-awesome-skills, an installable skill library for AI coding assistants. It covers a dense sequence of releases from v9.8.0 through v11.11.0, each adding community-contributed skills, improvements, and maintainer hygiene across governance, UI/UX, observability, security, and more.

chunks.title: v9.8.0 "Governance, Tracking, and Discovery Skills"
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sickn33/antigravity-awesome-skills release v9.8.0 "Governance, Tracking, and Discovery Skills", the library adds five new community-contributed skills: protect-mcp-governance for MCP governance with Cedar policies and receipt verification, technical-change-tracker for structured JSON change tracking and session handoff, multi-agent-task-orchestrator for production-tested multi-agent delegation and verification gates, global-chat-agent-discovery for cross-protocol MCP server and agent discovery, and python-pptx-generator for generating runnable slide-deck scripts from a topic brief. Improvements include README source-credit coverage and maintainer merge hygiene.

Improvements include canonical artifact refresh, post-merge maintainer sync, and PR supersession cleanup.

questions.query_text: Across the sickn33/antigravity-awesome-skills releases, how does the security hardening approach in v11.6.0 differ from the security hardening in v11.5.0?

options.text: v11.5.0 hardens plugin-safe distribution boundaries and ingest-youtube input, while v11.6.0 replaces executable pipe-to-shell examples and hardens web-app refresh archive fallback.
v11.5.0 adds new skills, while v11.6.0 only fixes documentation.
Both releases focus solely on fixing Dependabot alerts.
v11.5.0 introduces the skill-audit skill, while v11.6.0 removes it.

questions.expected_answer: v11.5.0 hardens plugin-safe distribution boundaries and ingest-youtube input, while v11.6.0 replaces executable pipe-to-shell examples and hardens web-app refresh archive fallback.

answer_support.answer_text: plugin-safe boundary hardening - blocks critical-risk or third-party setup-sensitive community skills from the generated Codex and Claude plugin-safe distributions. ingest-youtube input hardening - validates single-video YouTube URLs, terminates yt-dlp options with --, ignores user config, adds subprocess timeouts, and neutralizes untrusted metadata in generated markdown.

Replaced executable pipe-to-shell install examples across canonical skills with package-manager or download-inspect-execute flows... Hardened the web-app refresh archive fallback by pre-validating tar/zip paths, rejecting archive symlink entries, and verifying extracted real paths before moving downloaded skills into place.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent spring-projects/spring-framework release stream across 6.1.x, 6.2.x, and 7.0.x lines, including milestone and release candidate artifacts, showing a progression from maintenance fixes to major new features like API versioning, retry support, and Jakarta Servlet 6.1 alignment.

chunks.title: v6.1.20
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v6.1.20, the release note adds an option for case-insensitive match to PatternMatchUtils, fixes a bug where HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory setConnectionRequestTimeout did not work with httpclient 5.3.1, fixes an accidental ClassLoader defineClass enforcement, clarifies CompositePropertySource behavior for EnumerablePropertySource contract in documentation, and upgrades to Reactor 2023.0.18.

chunks.title: v6.2.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v6.2.7, the release note introduces a Spring property for the default property placeholder escape character, closes ApplicationContext once AOT processing has completed, adds an option for case-insensitive match to PatternMatchUtils, fixes a bug where Beans created by FactoryBean are not considered as autowiring candidates if another thread holds a singletonLock, fixes PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer placeholder resolution failures in several scenarios, fixes HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory setConnectionRequestTimeout not working with httpclient 5.3.1, fixes duplicate BeanOverrideHandler discovered in @Nested test cases, fixes accidental ClassLoader defineClass enforcement, fixes AbstractFileResolvingResource.exists incorrectly reporting results for resources inside spring-boot executable jar, fixes R2DBC NamedParameterUtils only expanding reused collection parameter once, clarifies CompositePropertySource behavior for EnumerablePropertySource contract in documentation, and upgrades to Micrometer 1.14.7.

chunks.title: v7.0.0-M5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v7.0.0-M5, the release note deprecates PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer and PreferencesPlaceholderConfigurer for removal, adds Consumer based variant methods to HttpRequestValues builder, adds defaultApiVersion to RestClient and WebClient builders, evaluates system properties in default HttpClient in ReactorClientHttpRequestFactory, uses beanClassLoader in the HTTP Service Registrar, deprecates JUnit 4 support in the Spring TestContext Framework, adds ability to validate supported API versions only against explicitly configured ones, revisits Jackson support, fixes ClassFileAnnotationMetadata.fromTypeDescriptor(…) failing on Java 24, aligns ClassFileClassMetadata with other implementations, fixes incorrect filtering of groups with HttpServiceGroupConfigurer, fixes aggregated Javadoc no longer published since 7.0.0-M4, adds Reference Documentation for API Versioning, and upgrades to Kotlin 2.1.21, Micrometer 1.15.0, and Reactor 2025.0.0-M3.

chunks.title: v6.1.21
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v6.1.21, the release note fixes encoding of non-printable characters in Content-Disposition parameter, allows update of existing WebSession after max sessions limit is reached, fixes enhanced configuration class failing to call package-visible superclass constructor on WebSphere, and upgrades to Reactor 2023.0.19.

chunks.title: v6.2.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v6.2.8, the release note makes max size for pattern cache in PathPatternMatchableHandlerMapping configurable, adds optimized DataBufferInputStream overrides, fixes encoding of non-printable characters in Content-Disposition parameter, allows update of existing WebSession after max sessions limit is reached, fixes support for collections in AbstractKotlinSerializationHttpMessageConverter, fixes PathPattern#combine throwing StringIndexOutOfBoundsException, fixes AOT code generation for autowired inner class constructor, fixes AbstractFileResolvingResource.exists closing JAR resource input streams with v6.2.7, fixes enhanced configuration class failing to call package-visible superclass constructor on WebSphere, fixes MockEnvironment not accepting Object property values, fixes PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer no longer using ConversionService from Environment, fixes inconsistent behavior injecting null @Bean factory parameter, fixes MockHttpServletRequest.addHeader duplicating Content-Type header, fixes BeanUtils.getParameterNames failing for Kotlin data classes, fixes JAXB message converters ignoring Content-Type charset, fixes aspect not triggered after restart in Spring Boot 3.4.x, and adds caching headers to unmodified static resources.

chunks.title: v7.0.0-M6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v7.0.0-M6, the release note allows FixedBackOff to be constructed with only a custom interval, revises @Nullable declarations for contains*() methods in CollectionUtils, introduces JacksonJsonMessageConverter.getObjectMapper(), removes (String, String) variants of setProperty() and withProperty() from MockEnvironment, allows access to env from SupplierContextDsl, consistently declares nullability @Contract for core utilities, updates HttpServiceGroupConfigurer API, makes ProblemDetailJacksonXmlMixin compatible with Jackson 3, introduces hints in RestClient API, adds Kotlin body advices, adds support for callable references to BeanRegistrarDsl, adds additional updates for API versioning in test and client support, defines nullability @Contract for quote and getFilename in StringUtils, supports @Import on interfaces, uses HexFormat in CharacterEditor and ContentDisposition, introduces minimal retry functionality as a core framework feature, adds support for application/*+x-protobuf media type, supports OutputStream and InputStream in HTTP Interface clients, fixes @Contract for SupplierUtils.resolve(Supplier) incorrectly declaring !null -> !null, and fixes consistent null check on injection points for pre-existing singleton beans.

chunks.title: v6.2.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v6.2.9, the release note introduces Date-to-Instant and Instant-to-Date converters, registers runtime hints for Instant-to-Timestamp conversion, improves handling of ResponseEntity<?> in Spring MVC, supports @CacheConfig("myCacheName") declarations for simplified configuration, declares messageSelector parameters in JmsOperations as @Nullable, adds getter for OverflowStrategy in ConcurrentWebSocketSessionDecorator, uses preset Content-Type for streaming and reactive responses in Spring MVC, leniently tolerates null @Aspect bean, fixes DataAccessResourceFailureException thrown when transaction times out on PostgreSQL, fixes MethodInvokingFactoryBean failing to invoke publicly exported methods overridden by internal classes when using JPMS, restores preference for interface method in getPubliclyAccessibleMethodIfPossible, makes targetBeanName field in AbstractBeanFactoryBasedTargetSource protected, fixes inconsistencies in StaticListableBeanFactory, supports StreamingHttpOutputMessage in RestClient, fixes DELETE request body not used in JdkClientHttpRequest.buildRequest, fixes AOT-generated bean registration file containing too many constants, prevents cache pollution by storing only the factories, fixes WebFlux decoding wildcard content-types as form-data/multipart, fixes AOT-generated CGLib proxies not containing method overrides, and fixes 500 response for ResourceHttpRequestHandler when requested range is not satisfied.

chunks.title: v7.0.0-M7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v7.0.0-M7, the release note introduces ContextRestartedEvent as a subtype of ContextStartedEvent, aligns HttpMessageConverters builder with WebFlux codecs variants, adds transaction-scoped resource binding in TransactionSynchronizationManager, introduces ConfigurableApplicationContext.restart() method, pauses unused application contexts in the TestContext framework, skips initialization of a NullBean, short-circuits matching algorithm in InstanceFilter, supports direct matching against exceptions in ExceptionTypeFilter, sets matchIfEmpty to true by default in InstanceFilter and ExceptionTypeFilter, requires explicit constraints in @Contract, specifies fetchSize/maxRows/queryTimeout per statement in JdbcClient, includes MethodParameter[] parameters in HttpRequestValues.Processor, deprecates DaoSupport classes, removes maxDuration/maxElapsedTime support from RetryPolicy, introduces @ConcurrencyLimit annotation based on ConcurrencyThrottleInterceptor, consistently implements toString() in BackOff strategies, supports API versioning for functional endpoints, migrates orm.hibernate5 to orm.jpa.hibernate package for Hibernate ORM 7.0, redesigns RetryPolicy to directly incorporate BackOff, adds ability to limit list of supported API versions to explicitly configured ones for Spring MVC, and refines nullability of PropertyResolver.getProperty(key: String) extension.

chunks.title: v6.2.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v6.2.10, the release note optimizes NIO path resolution in PathEditor, makes type in ProblemDetail nullable, refines UriUtils#decode and StringUtils#uriDecode implementation and documentation, provides configurable useCaches option for URLConnection usage in UrlResource to avoid jar file leak, fixes @Scheduled tasks running in SimpleAsyncTaskScheduler being interrupted immediately on context close, fixes ScriptUtils.executeSqlScript() not supporting multiple results per statement, fixes successful autowiring dependent on configuration ordering and Primary Bean flag, makes Locale parameter in MessageSource#getMessage methods nullable, allows any @Transactional propagation for @TransactionalEventListener with BEFORE_COMMIT phase, fixes catalog name not handled with the provided case, adds accept support for generated keys column name array on HSQLDB and Derby, handles direct CancellationException on timeout in JdkClientHttpRequest, adds documentation of RequestMapping about SpEL, documents SqlBinaryValue behaviour with PostgreSQL, and upgrades to Micrometer 1.14.10 and Reactor 2024.0.9.

chunks.title: v7.0.0-M8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v7.0.0-M8, the release note introduces @Proxyable annotation for bean-specific proxy type, introduces bean definition attribute for enforcing an interface-based proxy, lets Spring Boot consistently switch to CGLIB proxies for any proxy processor, adds HTTP method support in MappedInterceptor, adds post processing of outgoing messages in JmsClient, introduces ConfigurableApplicationContext.pause() and SmartLifecycle.isPauseable(), provides support to configure request interceptors in RestTestClient, provides more control over validation in DefaultApiVersionStrategy, replaces useRequestParam with useQueryParam in ApiVersionConfigurer to align with client, adds support for MediaType in ApiVersionInserter, supports HttpServiceClient annotation, prefers mapping without version for requests without a version, provides @WebSocketScope annotation and public SCOPE_WEBSOCKET constant, allows getting receipt from StompSession.Subscription.unsubscribe(), supports wildcard path elements at the start of path patterns, improves handling of request parameter without values in MockMvc, displays original request URI in NoResourceFoundException message, adds RestTestClient, supports Hibernate StatelessSession, fixes JacksonJsonSockJsMessageCodec imports, fixes IllegalStateException: No API version attribute, documents constraints for HTTP range requests, and upgrades to Hibernate ORM 7.1 and Jackson 3.0.0-rc6 and 2.19.2.

chunks.title: v6.2.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v6.2.11, the release note adds graceful fallback for non-default NIO.2 FileSystems, avoids thread pinning in SseEmitter and ResponseBodyEmitter, detects Informix error codes as DuplicateKeyException, revisits taskTerminationTimeout semantics on SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor/Scheduler, allows @Nullable BeanResolver in StandardEvaluationContext.setBeanResolver, fixes mainThreadPrefix = null causing multiple background bean locks to be blocked, fixes annotation not found on parameter in overridden method unless method is public, fixes annotations on overridden methods not found in type hierarchy with unresolved generics, fixes performance degradation when using singleton beans with Provider<T>, fixes JettyClientHttpConnector buffer leak in Spring Framework 6.2, fixes Spring application hanging on shutdown with @Scheduled(cron=…) when custom ScheduledExecutorService bean is defined on Java 19+, documents potential need to use Mockito.doXxx() to stub a @MockitoSpyBean, fixes links to Reactive Libraries and RestTemplate, documents Web DataBinder support for RouterFunction, improves documentation for ApplicationEvents to clarify recommended usage, documents terms and units in DataSize.parse(), refines @Contract Javadoc, corrects the default value of nestedTransactionAllowed in JpaTransactionManager javadoc, and upgrades to Micrometer 1.14.11 and Reactor 2024.0.10.

chunks.title: v7.0.0-M9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v7.0.0-M9, the release note aligns JpaTransactionManager default for nestedTransactionAllowed flag, introduces onRetryPolicyInterruption() callback in RetryListener, adds DataFieldMaxValueIncrementer for SQLite, adds consistent support for non-default NIO.2 FileSystems, includes exceptions for previous attempts in RetryException thrown for an InterruptedException, includes current exception in log message for failed retry attempt, removes HttpServiceClient Annotation Support, deprecates put(MergedContextConfiguration, ApplicationContext) in ContextCache, makes ServerSentEventHttpMessageReader process empty data lines, makes it possible to stream application/grpc in Spring MVC via Flux<T>, adds createException method to ConvertibleClientHttpResponse in RestClient, considers throwing an error if setVersionRequired and setDefaultVersion are called on ApiVersionConfigurer, accepts maxAttempts(0) in RetryPolicy builder, generates consistent validation error messages in RetryPolicy, drops support for Undertow as it is not Servlet 6.1 compatible, exposes retry attempts in RetryException, makes RetryException#getCause not nullable, refines CORS logging for non-processed requests due to no CORS configuration, refines Jackson 3 constructors to accept only JsonMapper instances for JSON, revises StartupStep to implement AutoCloseable, adds compression support in JdkClientHttpRequestFactory, adds support for Micrometer context propagation in Kotlin coroutines, adds support for Forwarded By HTTP header, updates HttpStatus to align with RFC9110 where relevant, and makes ContextCache close evicted context before loading new context.

chunks.title: v6.2.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v6.2.12, the release note adds forEachByte variant to DataBuffer for efficient traversing, improves exception handling in ConfigurationClassBeanDefinitionReader, adds MySQL/MariaDB to TableMetaDataProviderFactory for correct generated-keys support, optimizes state management in StompSubProtocolHandler, makes ServletServerHttpRequest.getRemoteAddress() avoid DNS lookup, emits log message when multiple primary beans are detected, fixes duplicate key error mapped to TransientDataAccessException by SQLStateSQLExceptionTranslator for BatchUpdateException, removes redundant object allocation in cglib proxy method calls, removes deprecation on CandidateComponentsIndex and CandidateComponentsIndexLoader, fixes processing response with no Content-Length header and no body raising EOFException, fixes DefaultListableBeanFactory::getBeanNamesForType not always returning all bean names, considers defaultCandidate for scoped proxies, releases data buffer in AbstractCharSequenceDecoder even when String creation fails, fixes PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver not able to resolve file in SpringBoot Packaged JAR, prevents NoClassDefFoundError when Jetty Reactive HttpClient is not available, fixes performance regression with Property Placeholder Resolution, retains order of produces media types in @ExceptionHandler, fixes nested transaction support via savepoints broken in HSQLDB database, fixes SpEL expression parser using more CPU after upgrade to 6.2.9, fixes thread race during FactoryBean instantiations starting with 6.2 due to lenient locks, updates parsed path handling in UrlHandlerFilter, fixes ResourceHttpMessageWriter.write unexpected error handling for invalid range requests, fixes AbstractTestNGSpringContextTests not thread-safe regarding tracked exceptions, and fixes UrlHandlerFilter breaking RequestDispatcher.forward() on Tomcat.

chunks.title: v7.0.0-RC1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v7.0.0-RC1, the release note aligns default order between @EnableAsync and @EnableResilientMethods, adds first class ParameterizedTypeReference support to BeanRegistrar, adds support for JTA 2.1 read-only attribute, makes UriComponentsBuilder#query not clear queryParams if null passed in, revises PersistenceUnitInfo management for compatibility with JPA 3.2 as well as JPA 4.0, deprecates TransactionCallbackWithoutResult, introduces queryParamPredicate in AbstractRequestLoggingFilter, adds builder-based constructors to Jackson 3 infrastructure, refines StringUtils#splitArrayElementsIntoProperties nullability, supports matching against exception causes in ExceptionTypeFilter, matches against exception causes in @Retryable and RetryPolicy, improves configuration of HttpMessageConverters in RestClient and RestTestClient, supports Bean Overrides for non-singletons, introduces findAnnotatedBeans(ListableBeanFactory) in ControllerAdviceBean, supports explicitly specifying no version on a request, simplifies overriding of default codec for Jackson 3 vs 2, revises nullability of TransactionCallback, TransactionOperations, and TransactionalOperator, refines SingletonSupplier<T> supplier-based static methods nullability, adds Kotlin extensions for RestTestClient, fixes deprecation warning with GraalVM 25 due to --install-exit-handlers, introduces MapAccessor in SpEL and deprecates existing implementation in spring-context, adds serialVersionUID in LinkedCaseInsensitiveMap, uses uppercase for classpath-related static final field names, prevents empty declaration of @ConcurrencyLimit, adds nullability fixes for AtomicReference, enhances toString method in SockJsFrame, and invokes ConfigurationBeanNameGenerator even if a @Bean(name = ..) is provided.

chunks.title: v7.0.0-RC2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v7.0.0-RC2, the release note adds early support for Jakarta Servlet 6.2 and Jakarta Activation 2.2, prevents compilation error with WebTestClient without Hamcrest, derives StatelessSession from transactional Session on Hibernate 7.2, adds consistent support for JPA 3.2 transaction timeouts, adds support for EntityManagerFactory bootstrapping from JPA 3.2 PersistenceConfiguration, fixes JdkClientHttpRequestFactory not cleaning response headers when decompressing, makes HttpStatus.resolve return non-deprecated one, fixes reflection hints missing for SpringPersistenceUnitInfo.setPersistenceProviderPackageName, fixes @Import with multiple bean registrars, declares Servlet mock classes with Servlet 6.1 baseline, fixes code snippets in Javadoc for exchangeSuccessfully(), improves RestTemplate to RestClient migration guide, downgrades JSONassert to 1.5.x, fixes Jetty multipart client support with Java 25, and upgrades to Jackson 3.0.1.

chunks.title: v7.0.0-RC3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v7.0.0-RC3, the release note deprecates the BeanShell scripting support, deprecates the lang XML namespace, deprecates Hamcrest methods in WebTestClient, removes Hamcrest dependency from RestTestClient, adds AssertJ support for RestTestClient, uses test-method scoped ExtensionContext in the SpringExtension, removes support for callable references in BeanRegistrarDsl, makes Protobuf support extensible for gRPC, fixes CRaC potential hangup after restoring, adds support for Spring AOT with BeanRegistrar for attribute AutoProxyUtils.originalTargetClass, fixes SingletonSupplier not singleton if null is returned on first supplier call, removes outdated Portlet mentions, moves the Groovy Bean Definition DSL section to the Groovy page, removes outdated Spring version mentions, documents automatic context propagation, refines documentation of BeanRegistrarDsl with RouterFunctionDsl, and upgrades to Kotlin 2.2.21.

chunks.title: v6.2.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v6.2.13, the release note supports response encoding in select and options JSP form tags, preserves Connection readOnly state for DataSource with defaultReadOnly configuration, optimizes resource URL resolution in SortedResourcesFactoryBean, relaxes multiple segment matching constraints in PathPattern, supports wildcard path elements at the start of path patterns, fixes validating byte[]s may produce OutOfMemoryError, updates in FragmentsRendering to names of static methods, fixes ConcurrentReferenceHashMap missing dedicated computeIfAbsent, computeIfPresent, compute, merge implementations, avoids unnecessary bridge method resolution around getMostSpecificMethod, fixes multi-release JAR issue with VirtualThreadDelegate, fixes ContentNegotiationManager not finding media type when request includes quality parameter, fixes race condition in BufferingClientHttpResponseWrapper.getBody(), deprecates setConnectTimeout on HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory, fixes PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver to handle absolute paths in JAR manifests, fixes BeanDefinitionBuilder.addAutowiredProperty causing error during AOT processing, improves HttpServiceMethod support for Kotlin suspending functions returning Flow, fixes exception translation not exposing original BatchUpdateException anymore, adds hints for entities package-private methods, fixes concurrency permit leak causing deadlock in SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor, removes jibx-marshaller element from spring-oxm.xsd, fixes NullPointerException when handling 407 with JdkClientHttpConnector in WebClient, fixes method-based Map injection failing against target Map with incomplete generics despite bean name or qualifier match, fixes JUnit Jupiter TEST_METHOD ExtensionContextScope not fully supported, introduces isAutowirableConstructor(Executable, PropertyProvider) in TestConstructorUtils and deprecates existing variants, and fixes reflection on java.sql.Types without runtime hints.

chunks.title: v7.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v7.0.0, the release note makes SessionHolder publicly accessible for external resource management, fixes RouterFunctions Builders not supporting ServerResponse subtypes, configures Jackson CBOR codecs by default if present, renames maxAttempts to maxRetries in @Retryable and RetryPolicy, prevents Kotlin Serialization side effects, adds default API version to the list of supported versions, improves user check in TransportHandlingSockJsService, updates ApiVersionDeprecationHandler to provide access to handler, uses dedicated classes for ApiVersionResolver implementations, provides AOT support for @Nested classes in a @ParameterizedClass, adds AssertJ support for WebTestClient, rejects attempt to use @MockitoSpyBean with a scoped proxy, provides a way to supply the client builder for an HttpServiceGroup, reviews HttpMessageConverters.Builder to improve readability of code using the API, configures custom Kotlin Serialization converter on HttpMessageConverters, fixes missing support for UnprocessableContent in WebClientResponseException.create(HttpStatusCode, ..) methods, relaxes media type checks in HttpMessageConverters, fixes HttpHeaders and WebSocketHttpHeaders interop issues, fixes @ConcurrencyLimit weird behavior when combined with @Async and @Transactional, fixes buildSrc:test failing on JDKs before JDK 25, adds jar validation and fixes multi-release jar, upgrades to JUnit 6.0.1 and prevents AOT test scanning failure for JUnit 4 tests, fixes port handling in HtmlUnitRequestBuilder, fixes RestTestClient.mutate() should not have side effects, and documents workaround for @PersistenceContext and @PersistenceUnit in test classes in AOT.

chunks.title: v6.2.14
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v6.2.14, the release note adds resetCaches() method to Caffeine/ConcurrentMapCacheManager, fixes single-check idiom in UnmodifiableMultiValueMap, fixes Spliterator characteristics in ConcurrentReferenceHashMap, fixes MissingPathVariableException producing wrong status code in ProblemDetail, fixes getCacheNames() concurrent access in NoOpCacheManager, fixes annotation discovery regression for interfaces extending BeanNameAware and co., fixes HtmlUtils unescape for supplementary chars, fixes cross-reference links in HtmlUnit sections, and removes @see Javadoc references to deprecated PropertiesBeanDefinitionReader.

chunks.title: v7.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v7.0.1, the release note aligns RestOperations Kotlin extensions nullability with Java one, adds resetCaches() method to Caffeine/ConcurrentMapCacheManager, fixes single-check idiom in UnmodifiableMultiValueMap, fixes Spliterator characteristics in ConcurrentReferenceHashMap, fixes RestTestClient not configuring JsonPathAssertions in the same way as WebTestClient, fixes JdbcOperations Kotlin extensions, fixes getCacheNames() concurrent access in NoOpCacheManager, fixes annotation discovery regression for interfaces extending BeanNameAware and co., fixes MissingPathVariableException producing wrong status code in ProblemDetail, refines ParameterizedPreparedStatementSetter nullability, fixes HtmlUtils unescape for supplementary chars, fixes cross-reference links in HtmlUnit sections, removes @see Javadoc references to deprecated PropertiesBeanDefinitionReader, replaces kotlin-issues attribute reference, and documents semantics and behavior of SpringExtension.getApplicationContext().

chunks.title: v6.2.15
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v6.2.15, the release note avoids package cycle caused by use of UriComponentsBuilder in ServletServerHttpRequest, makes DefaultHandshakeHandler not log client faults on error level, uses concurrent set behind reactive TransactionSynchronizationManager#registerSynchronization, exposes Collection<ModelAndView> on FragmentsRendering to facilitate Unit Tests, fixes different ReactorNettyWebSocketSession call getId() may return the same value, enhances handleTypeMismatch error message in ResponseEntityExceptionHandler, fixes NullPointerException thrown from JdkClientHttpRequestFactory for null request header value, fixes state inconsistency in LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy when connection settings fail, fixes SubscriberInputStream#resume misusing parked thread reference, fixes PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver failing with URI in JAR manifest Class-Path entries, fixes strong locking in ConcurrentReferenceHashMap#computeIfAbsent may cause context initialisation deadlock, fixes BridgeMethodResolver change in 6.2.13 breaking Spring Data entity introspection, fixes DefaultMessageListenerContainer not clearing Session and MessageConsumer for paused invokers, tightens cacheable decision behind @Lazy injection point, uses provided ReactiveAdapterRegistry in BindingContext constructor, fixes accidental fallback match for Collection-type beans due to @Bean-level qualifier annotation, fixes SortedResourcesFactoryBean not accepting non-existent resources anymore, documents that annotations are ignored if attributes reference types not present in the classpath, fixes broken Javadoc links to methods, refers to Spring Tools instead of Spring Tools for Eclipse in reference manual, clarifies JMS sessionTransacted flag for local versus global transaction, makes reference docs not use obsolete junit5 links, fixes testing chapter referencing nonexistent Dependency Management documentation, and upgrades to json-path 2.10.0.

chunks.title: v7.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v7.0.2, the release note avoids unnecessary list creation and processing in AbstractTestContextBootstrapper, makes AbstractTestContextBootstrapper resolve ContextLoader only once, logs RetryException for @Retryable methods, consistently stops already started Lifecycle beans on cancelled refresh, supports timeouts in @Retryable and RetryPolicy, uses == instead of instanceof for primitive array type checks, introduces MultiValueMapCollector for use with streams, avoids package cycle caused by use of UriComponentsBuilder in ServletServerHttpRequest, makes target type in Converter interface @Nullable, provides access to attempt count in RetryListener as well as callbacks for the initial attempt, makes DefaultHandshakeHandler not log client faults on error level, logs warning when meta-annotation is ignored due to types not present in classpath, revises ApplicationContext#getId() nullability to non-null, uses concurrent set behind reactive TransactionSynchronizationManager#registerSynchronization, refines AbstractKotlinSerializationHttpMessageConverter#canWrite, registers bean dependency for Optional injection point as well, changes canRead/canWrite overrides to Class ones in AbstractSmartHttpMessageConverter, does not make HttpHeaders read-only in HttpEntity, adds WebFlux SSE support with GSON, fixes different ReactorNettyWebSocketSession call getId() may return the same value, refines nullability of Assert#noNullElements, allows configuring default maxIdleTime on InMemoryWebSessionStore, refines BindingReflectionHintsRegistrar with ObjectToObjectConverter hints, adds resetCaches() method to general CacheManager interface, enhances handleTypeMismatch error message in ResponseEntityExceptionHandler, and adds support for package-private BeanRegistrar in Spring AOT generated code.

chunks.title: v7.0.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v7.0.3, the release note introduces a Spring property to disable context pausing for tests, avoids unnecessary pausing of application contexts in the TestContext framework, makes DisconnectedClientHelper detect presence of RestClientException and WebClientException separately, deprecates PagedListHolder and PropertyComparator for removal, adds DataAccessException and MessagingException to the excluded outermost exceptions in DisconnectedClientHelper, supports property placeholders in HTTP service registry, retains original requested bean class for SpringContainedBean, adds task rejection support to SyncTaskExecutor's concurrency throttle, precomputes PropertyDescriptor array in SimpleBeanInfoFactory, adds option for @ConcurrencyLimit to throw rejection exception, supports HttpComponents 5.6, fixes double encoding in DefaultApiVersionInserter, optimizes single-char wildcard path matching performance, allows WebFlux ApiVersionResolver to return a Mono, configures HttpMessageConverters as a list, makes HTTP Interface with an @RequestBody Object method parameter use class of actual value, consistently declares @Nullable on parameter in equals() implementations, supports listener registration for @Transactional triggered method rollbacks, introduces generalized MethodFailureEvent for use in EventPublicationInterceptor, avoids duplicate flushes in StringHttpMessageConverter, fixes when no API version is provided static resources fail to load, fixes when no API version is provided /error requests also fail, declares TaskCallback return value as potentially nullable, fixes case-insensitive semantics for LinkedCaseInsensitiveMap entrySet, updates to NullAway 0.12.15 and fixes new warnings, and provides alternative to execute(Retryable) which avoids RetryException in favor of rethrowing the last original RuntimeException.

chunks.title: v6.2.16
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v6.2.16, the release note improves performance of hashcode calculations for request mappings, improves performance of HandlerMethod bean lookup, improves performance of validation groups determination, improves performance of single pattern request mappings, optimizes NamedParameterUtils#buildValueArray by lazily fetching SqlParameter, consistently closes streams through try-with-resources in FileCopyUtils, makes SqlBinaryValue and SqlCharacterValue support InputStream content with undetermined length, fixes DataBufferUtils.write() with NettyDataBuffer on JDK 25 hanging indefinitely, fixes WebClient (Reactor) attributes on Netty channel not clearing after connection release, reintroduces WebLogicJtaTransactionManager in Spring Framework 6.2.x, makes DisconnectedClientHelper detect presence of RestClientException and WebClientException separately, adds DataAccessException and MessagingException to the excluded outermost exceptions in DisconnectedClientHelper, improves user check in TransportHandlingSockJsService, avoids lock congestion in ConcurrentReferenceHashMap, fixes resolved HttpEntity Controller argument not reflecting mutated HTTP headers, fixes AbstractMessageConverter not supporting wildcards in supported MIME types, makes LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean#setDataSource work on Hibernate as well as EclipseLink, fixes deadlock might occur when calling System.exit on startup, fixes Netty4HeadersAdapter.remove returning empty list instead of null for non-existing key, fixes EclipseLinkConnectionHandle can fail against transaction isolation race condition, fixes WiretapConnector leaking data buffers when response body not consumed, fixes UriComponentsBuilder losing the fragment when it consists of only a single character, fixes SimpleBeanInfoFactory failing to reliably resolve read/write methods in type hierarchies with unresolved generics, fixes links to JUnit User Guide, and fixes LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean documentation.

chunks.title: v7.0.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the spring-projects/spring-framework release v7.0.4, the release note caches method annotations in MethodParameter and AnnotatedMethod, consistently supports @Lazy as a meta-annotation at arbitrary depths, consistently supports @Validated as a meta-annotation at arbitrary depths, lets developers disable default registrations in HttpMessageConverters, logs which HandlerInterceptor threw the exception, improves performance of hashcode calculations for request mappings, improves performance of HandlerMethod bean lookup, improves performance of version mapping, improves performance of single pattern request mappings, improves performance of validation groups determination, adds setPackagesToScan configuration method to LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean, removes outdated GraalVM substitution, introduces beforeRetry callback with RetryState argument, optimizes NamedParameterUtils#buildValueArray by lazily fetching SqlParameter, allows customization of the ProxyFactory in HttpServiceProxyFactory used to create HTTP service proxies, consistently closes streams through try-with-resources in FileCopyUtils, uses Java Files utilities in FileCopyUtils, makes SqlBinaryValue and SqlCharacterValue support InputStream content with undetermined length, supports JtaTransactionManager and SpringBeanContainer configuration on HibernateJpaVendorAdapter, adds TaskCallback/Callable/Runnable wrapper for retryable tasks, refines YamlProcessor to allow different empty values, anticipates fixing Kotlin 2.3 compilation warning, allows YAML processors to create a flattened map with nulls included, uses Reader.transferTo in FileCopyUtils, fixes DataBufferUtils.write() with NettyDataBuffer on JDK 25 hanging indefinitely, makes SendToMethodReturnValueHandler and SubscriptionMethodReturnValueHandler customizable to allow for pass-through of message headers, and introduces RestClient.ResponseSpec#requiredBody.

chunks.title: v7.0.5

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent starship/starship release stream from v1.10.1 through v1.25.1, covering feature additions, bug fixes, and performance improvements across multiple minor and patch versions.

chunks.title: v1.10.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the starship/starship release v1.10.1, the project disables multithreading in jwalk (via gitoxide) as a workaround for issue #4251.

chunks.title: v1.10.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the starship/starship release v1.10.2, the git dependency gitoxide is upgraded to version 0.21.

chunks.title: v1.10.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the starship/starship release v1.10.3, the git_commit module is improved to use exact match for tags by default, enhancing performance.

chunks.title: v1.11.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the starship/starship release v1.11.0, new features include a user-defined color palette, left and right transience support for fish, a meson devenv indicator, schema validation that denies unknown keys, and pipestatus separator formatting. Bug fixes address buf spacing, duplicate directory name stripping, and a potential deadlock in pwsh init. Performance is improved by skipping repo resolution in the directory module when unused.

chunks.title: v1.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the starship/starship release v1.12.0, many features are added: Haxe support, an operating system module, an AWS expiration fallback, Azure username config, a bug-report confirmation prompt, a before_repo_root_style for directories, lightweight tag support in git_commit, a guix_shell module, which-rs for init path resolution, reserved remote address for localip, right prompt for nu, an Open Policy Agent module, gradle version from gradle.properties, No Empty Icons and no-nerd-font presets, and chocolatey publishing. Bug fixes include AWS credentials file detection, a broken buf icon on Windows 10, and other corrections.

chunks.title: v1.13.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the starship/starship release v1.13.0, new modules are introduced: pijul_channel, fennel, fossil_branch, gradle, and improved hg_branch with mercurial topics. Other features include --profile support for custom config profiles, env_var.VAR in format strings, .sdkmanrc for Java, log cleanup, and nix shell command support. Bug fixes cover container confusion reduction, fish vi mode transient prompt, git_commit test stability, gradle version regex improvements, nushell let-env warning, nodejs style application, and removal of vulnerabilities.

chunks.title: v1.13.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the starship/starship release v1.13.1, a release pipeline trigger fix is applied.

chunks.title: v1.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the starship/starship release v1.14.0, AWS support is extended with source_profile and AWS_CREDENTIAL_EXPIRATION environment variable. A custom module option checks if pwd is in a repo. Fossil check-out detection in subdirectories is added. Chocolatey publishing is handled for portable and install packages. Bug fixes include fossil_branch database file name on Windows, unstable Gradle version support, cygpath avoidance in init, Android Studio JDK version correction, preset output encoding, and pulumi module formatting.

chunks.title: v1.14.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the starship/starship release v1.14.1, the release pipeline is re-triggered to fix a publishing issue.

chunks.title: v1.14.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the starship/starship release v1.14.2, a panic on 32-bit targets in the git_commit module is resolved.

chunks.title: v1.15.0

Bug fixes include libz-ng-sys bump, config print-config panic prevention, nested style variable processing, presets sudo module format correction, snap personal-files interface, and Nerd Fonts 3.0 updates.

chunks.title: v1.17.0

chunks.title: v1.21.1
