prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent sveltejs/svelte release stream from version 5.52.0 through 5.56.1, covering new features like TrustedHTML support, server-side error boundaries, template declarations, and numerous bug fixes and performance improvements.

chunks.title: svelte@5.52.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.52.0, the minor change adds support for TrustedHTML in {@html} expressions. Patch changes repair dynamic component truthy/falsy hydration mismatches and re-run non-render-bound deriveds on the server.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.0, minor changes allow comments in tags and allow error boundaries to work on the server. Patch changes use TrustedHTML to test for customizable <select> support where necessary, ensure head effects are kept in the effect tree, and deactivate current_batch by default in unset_context.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.1, the patch change handles shadowed function names correctly.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.2, patch changes update expressions on server deriveds and further obfuscate the node:crypto import from overzealous static analysis.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.3, patch changes render the :catch of #await block with correct key, pin aria-query@5.3.1, and make string coercion consistent to toString.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.4, patch changes set server context after async transformError, hydrate if blocks correctly, handle default parameters scope leaks, and prevent flushed effects from running again.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.5, patch changes escape innerText and textContent bindings of contenteditable, and sanitize transformError values prior to embedding in HTML comments.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.6, patch changes optimize parser hot paths for faster compilation, fix SvelteMap incorrectly handling keys with undefined values, fix SvelteURL search setter to return the normalized value matching native URL behavior, visit synthetic value node during ssr, always case insensitive event handlers during ssr, more efficient effect scheduling, optimize compiler analysis phase, skip redundant batch.apply, and null out current_batch before committing branches.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.7, patch changes correctly add __svelte_meta after else-if chains, cache element interactivity and source line splitting in compiler, avoid rescheduling effects during branch commit, optimize CSS selector pruning, preserve original boundary errors when keyed each rows are removed during async updates, avoid O(n²) name scanning in scope generate and unique, and preserve each items that are needed by pending batches.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.8, patch changes fix {@html} no longer duplicating content inside contenteditable elements, don't access inert block effects, handle async updates within pending boundary, avoid re-traversing the effect tree after $: assignments, and simplify scheduling logic.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.9, the patch change improves bind:this cleanup timing.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.10, the patch change re-processes batch if new root effects were scheduled.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.11, patch changes remove untrack circular dependency, recover from errors that leave a corrupted effect tree, properly lazily evaluate RHS when checking for assignment_value_stale, resolve boundary in correct batch when hydrating, and rebase batches after process, not during.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.12, patch changes update select.__value on change, add invariant helper for debugging, ensure deriveds values are correct across batches, handle async RHS in assignment_value_stale, and avoid traversing clean roots.

chunks.title: svelte@5.53.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.53.13, patch changes ensure $inspect after top level await doesn't break builds, resume inert effects when they come from offscreen, don't eagerly access not-yet-initialized functions in template, discard batches made obsolete by commit, ensure 'is standalone child' is correctly reset, and remove nodes in boundary when work is pending and HMR is active.

chunks.title: svelte@5.54.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.54.0, the minor change allows css, runes, customElement compiler options to be functions. The patch change reinstates reactivity loss tracking.

chunks.title: svelte@5.54.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.54.1, patch changes fix hydration comments during hmr, null out effect.b in destroy_effect, group sync statements, defer batch resolution until earlier intersecting batches have committed, properly invoke iterator.return() during reactivity loss check, and remove trailing semicolon from {@const} tag printer.

chunks.title: svelte@5.55.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.55.0, the minor change exports TweenOptions, SpringOptions, SpringUpdateOptions and Updater from svelte/motion. The patch change ensures HMR wrapper forwards correct start/end nodes to active effect.

chunks.title: svelte@5.55.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.55.1, patch changes correctly handle bindings on the server, prevent hydration error on async {@html ...}, cleanup superTypeParameters in ClassDeclarations/ClassExpression, improve duplicate module import error message, and reschedule new effects in prior batches.

chunks.title: svelte@5.55.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.55.2, patch changes invalidate @const tags based on visible references in legacy mode, handle parens in template expressions more robustly, disallow -- in idPrefix, correct types for ontoggle on <details> elements, don't override $destroy/set/on instance methods in dev mode, unskip branches of earlier batches after commit, never set derived.v inside fork, skip rebase logic in non-async mode, and don't reset status of uninitialized deriveds.

chunks.title: svelte@5.55.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.55.3, patch changes ensure proper HMR updates for dynamic components, correctly calculate @const blockers, freeze deriveds once their containing effects are destroyed, defer error boundary rendering in forks, and avoid false positives for reactivity loss warning.

chunks.title: svelte@5.55.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.55.4, patch changes never mark a child effect root as inert, reset context after waiting on blockers of @const expressions, and keep flushing new eager effects.

chunks.title: svelte@5.55.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.55.5, patch changes don't mark deriveds while an effect is updating and do not dispatch introstart event with animation of animate directive.

chunks.title: svelte@5.55.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.55.6, patch changes leave stale promises to wait for a later resolution instead of rejecting, keep dependencies of $state.eager/pending, reapply context after transforming error during SSR, don't rebase just-created batches, allow null for pending in typings, flush eager effects in production, rethrow error of failed iterable after calling return(), account for proxified instance when updating bind:this, ensure scheduled batch is flushed if not obsolete, resolve stale deriveds with latest value, remove unnecessary increment_pending calls, correctly compile component member expressions for SSR, reset source.updated stack traces after flush, replace async 'blocking' strategy with 'merging', allow @debug tags to reference awaited variables, re-run fallback props if dependencies update, abort running obsolete async branches, ignore comments when reading CSS values, wrap Promise.all in save during SSR, and ignore false-positive errors of $inspect dependencies.

chunks.title: svelte@5.55.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.55.7, patch changes prevent XSS on hydratable from user contents, bump devalue, disallow empty attribute names during SSR, harden regex, and move Svelte runtime properties to symbols.

chunks.title: svelte@5.55.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.55.8, patch changes handle svelte:body and fix keyframe percentage double-printing, execute uninitialized derived even if it's destroyed, use named symbols everywhere, don't run teardown effects when deriveds are unfreezed, and unset context synchronously in run.

chunks.title: svelte@5.55.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.55.9, patch changes don't unset batch when calling {#await ...} promise, promise-ify {#await await ...} expressions on the server and correctly hydrate them on the client, deduplicate dependencies that are added outside the init/update cycle, avoid false-positive batch invariant error, and inline primitive constants in attribute values during SSR.

chunks.title: svelte@5.55.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.55.10, patch changes unlink errored and otherwise finished batch, walk composedPath() directly in delegated event propagation, transfer effects when merging batches, allow $derived(await ...) in disconnected effect roots, remove temporary raw-text hydration markers, propagate async @const blockers through closure references, properly unlink batches, settle discarded batch, declare let: directives before {@const} declarations on slotted elements, resume outro-ed branches if they were kept around, avoid waterfall-warning when async resolves to same value, correctly coordinate component-level effects inside async blocks, make unnecessary commit work less likely, add tag name to a11y_click_events_have_key_events warning, and catch rejected promises while merging/committing.

chunks.title: svelte@5.56.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.56.0, the minor change allows declarations in the template. Patch changes use createElement instead of createElementNS for HTML elements, store current_sources as a Set for O(1) membership checks, deduplicate identical hoisted templates within a component, and hoist rest_props exclude list as a module-scope Set.

chunks.title: svelte@5.56.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sveltejs/svelte release svelte@5.56.1, patch changes error at compile time on duplicate snippet/declaration tag definitions, parse declaration tag contents more robustly, correctly transform references to earlier declarators in a declaration tag, avoid spurious state_referenced_locally warnings for $derived declarations in declaration tags, tolerate whitespace before let/const in declaration tags, prevent infinite loop when a tag's expression ends with a trailing / at the end of the input, more robust parsing of declaration tags with regards to type, preserve newlines in spread input values when the type attribute is applied after value, update SvelteURLSearchParams when setting duplicate keys to the same joined value, and check references for blockers on server, too.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent sxyazi/yazi release stream from early v0.1.x through v26.x, highlighting major feature additions such as plugin system enhancements, image preview improvements, package management, and UI/UX refinements.

chunks.title: v0.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.1.1, the project updates the installation guide and adds support for the 'open' command to enter directories.

chunks.title: v0.1.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.1.2, the project introduces which-key and multi-key support, enables bracketed paste, adds the ability to close input using Esc and a new Cut operation, implements sorting by key with precalculated directory sizes, makes folders openable, auto-hovers newly created files, avoids duplicate precaching tasks, and adds support for Überzug++ for image previews in X11/Wayland environments.

chunks.title: v0.1.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.1.3, the project delivers 22 new features, 9 bug fixes, and 5 performance improvements, including transparent image support with Sixel, real-time task output display, PDF preview via pdftoppm, cancelable highlighting tasks, more language support in highlighting, improved JSON highlighting performance, shell execution, input highlighting, enhanced unset mode, customizable status section separators, opener display names, automatic CWD change on exit, interactive cd, current directory name in tabs, enhanced execution format, sort_dir_first option, command template support for shell, bulk rename, and new task-related config options.

chunks.title: v0.1.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.1.4, the project adds Windows support, copy file path with multi-selection, customizable UI layout, better file change detection with real-time mime-type and preview updates, natural sorting mode, scrollable preview supporting videos, PDFs, archives, and directories, a simplified file system for better performance, help for all components with key binding quick view, customization of Yazi config paths and cache persistence, and Black Box image preview adaptation.

chunks.title: v0.1.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.1.5, the project introduces 36 new features, 24 bug fixes, and 3 performance improvements, including Mintty (Git Bash) image preview support, chunked loading of large folders, process suspension via Ctrl-Z, file size sorting under the simplified file system, streamable Input component, find functionality, tab-specific sorting, new V/D/C keybindings for Input, image preview within tmux, search mode keyword display, fallback built-in highlighting if jq is not installed, case-insensitive glob expressions by default, FreeBSD permission type support, multiple openers for a single rule, optional trash, a force option for the remove command, and a flake.nix.

chunks.title: v0.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.2.0, the project adds support for custom previewers and preloaders, completes most of the concurrent plugin system work, rewrites the entire file system, refactors the UI rendering architecture, enhances the task scheduling system, implements partial rendering for frequently updated components, introduces path auto-completion, real-time file filtering, and Kitty Unicode placeholders protocol support. This is a breaking change release.

chunks.title: v0.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.2.1, the project provides an urgent fix for a crash when renaming files with Unicode characters, and adds support for trash v3.2.1 to address a trash bin location bug.

chunks.title: v0.2.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.2.2, the project fixes many bugs, adds support for Windows ARM64 and Ubuntu via Snap, introduces prepend_keymap and append_keymap for keymap customization, rewrites the event system for more efficient rendering, adds desktop entry and logo files, and supports image preview in Tabby terminal.

chunks.title: v0.2.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.2.3, the project optimizes loading speed for large directories (approximately 2.5 times faster), adds previewing images over SSH, supports passing arguments to plugins, plugin-specific state persistence, listening to key events in plugins, customizable which-key columns, image_quality and sixel_fraction options, image filter configuration, unyank support, optional trash on Android, and plugin interface for key events via ya.which().

chunks.title: v0.2.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.2.4, the project adds cross-directory selection, improves accessibility with colored icons, a file selection counter, better hover visibility, enhanced keyword recognition in finds, long path truncation, and a new color system. It rewrites Lua bindings using Unsafe Rust for cheap plugin initialization, caches loaded plugins, and adds new APIs: ya.input(), ya.notify(), ya.hide(), and ui.Clear(). A Vim-like notification component is introduced. The exec property is deprecated in favor of run.

chunks.title: v0.2.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.2.5, the project introduces a Data Distribution Service (DDS) for communication and state synchronization between multiple Yazi instances, built on a client/server architecture with a Lua-based publish-subscribe model. It adds new CLI options (ya pub, ya pub-static, yazi --local-events, yazi --remote-events) for cross-process yank-paste, CWD synchronization, and integration with yazi.nvim. Performance optimizations include reduced CPU overhead in icon matching, caching of matched icons, and an async file watcher. Feature enhancements include re-implemented fzf and zoxide as plugins, maintaining original modification time on copy, smart case for cd path completion, placeholder messages for empty directories, preserving file selection order, and preventing directory self-copy.

chunks.title: v0.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.3.0, the project adds mouse support with new click, scroll, touch, move, and drag APIs for components, a built-in extract plugin for archive decompression with interactive password input and smart output directory selection, enhanced file preview for fonts, SVGs, HEIC, and JPEG XL (requires ImageMagick), a package manager via ya pack subcommand, redesigned icons with improved matching performance and built-in nvim-web-devicons, significant archive preview performance improvements by streaming with 7zip, and many other features. This is a breaking change release.

chunks.title: Nightly Build
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi nightly build, the release is a pre-release generated from commit 8e807989 on 2026-06-01, providing the latest source code changes. The changelog is available in the unreleased section of the CHANGELOG.md.

chunks.title: v0.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.3.1, the project addresses several issues from v0.3.0 and adds a loading state indicator for slow directories, support for opening multiple tabs at startup, shorthand keybindings (e.g., <C-X>), a --cursor option for the shell command, a previewer for virtual files in /proc, support for F13-F19 keys, and a nightly build with a corresponding AUR package.

chunks.title: v0.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.3.2, the project introduces a brand-new confirm component for safer and more efficient confirmations (showing affected file lists and requiring only Enter), word wrapping support via a wrap option under [preview], an image_delay configuration to reduce terminal lag during fast scrolling, and a --dir option for the create command to explicitly create directories.

chunks.title: v0.3.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.3.3, the project fixes a keybinding regression and a WSL file list refresh issue, and introduces Git integration (showing Git file change status as a linemode), updates the size linemode to display the number of files in a directory, and adds Windows Terminal image preview support via Sixel.

chunks.title: v0.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.4.0, the project introduces the spotter concept for file metadata popups, support for transparent image previews across all backends, auto-switching between dark and light icons/flavors based on terminal background, new ya emit and ya emit-to subcommands for sending commands to specific instances, support for passing arguments to previewers/preloaders/spotters/fetchers, suggest keywords in the header when a finder is active, and many other features. This is a breaking change release.

chunks.title: v0.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.4.1, the project provides a quick patch with fixes for Yazi freezing in old tmux versions or nested terminal setups, a bug in Überzug++ image dimension parsing, a build failure for Android 32-bit architectures, and incorrect CRLF handling in preset archive and json plugins on Windows.

chunks.title: v0.4.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v0.4.2, the project fixes issues with CWD not updating on directory switch, UI not refreshing after returning from an external blocking process in an empty directory, and preview not updating after sorting directories with folder-specific rules. It adds support for many new archive formats, a temporary option to suppress deprecation warnings, and new Lua APIs fs.cwd() and fs.create().

chunks.title: v25.2.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v25.2.7, the project deprecates ya.md5() in favor of ya.hash(), init.lua in favor of main.lua, and arrow -99999999/99999999 in favor of arrow top/bot. It introduces the mount.yazi plugin for disk mount/unmount/eject, simplifies shell and plugin commands with a -- raw text marker, adds replace mode and Vim motions (W, E, B, ^, _) for inputs, enhances the package manager with ya pack -d and multi-package add/remove, supports local tmux image preview over SSH, adds a @since plugin annotation for minimum Yazi version, and other features.

chunks.title: v25.2.11
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v25.2.11, the project provides a quick fix for issues introduced in v25.2.7 and adds a new overall option under [status] in theme.toml to style the empty area of the status bar.

chunks.title: v25.2.26
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v25.2.26, the project introduces breaking changes: separator_open/separator_close replaced with sep_left/sep_right, and [completion] renamed to [cmp]. It deprecates MANAGER, PREVIEW, PLUGIN, THEME in favor of rt and th, and ya.manager_emit() in favor of ya.mgr_emit(). Built-in previewer improvements include JSON previewer respecting wrap setting, PDF previewer respecting max_width, and ImageMagick previewer respecting image_alloc. A new rga search engine is added, keymap commands can specify layers, status bar customization is more flexible with sep_left/sep_right, and spotter table styles can be configured.

chunks.title: v25.3.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v25.3.2, the project provides a quick fix for terminal response sequences leaking to the screen under SSH, and exposes all theme fields and almost the entirety of user configuration in Lua.

chunks.title: v25.4.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v25.4.8, the project introduces breaking changes: wraparound navigation enabled by default, tasks_show/close_input replaced with tasks:show/input:close, several Url/Tab/File properties changed, default key bindings for z and Z swapped, and @sync peek annotation replaces previewer sync=true. It deprecates ui.Padding and ui.Rect:padding(). Packaging changes include SVG preview backend switched from ImageMagick to resvg. A custom search engine Lua API is added, platform-specific key bindings are supported, performance improvements include doubled startup speed and faster AVIF/HEIF/JPEG XL previews, fzf integration is enhanced, Yazi can be used directly in Helix without Zellij or tmux, new prev/next arguments for arrow enable wraparound navigation, a follow command for symlinks is added, and input initialization with commands like rename, create, find, filter is allowed.

chunks.title: v25.5.28
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v25.5.28, the project introduces breaking changes: [manager] deprecated in favor of [mgr], tab_width removed, tab_active/tab_inactive moved under [tabs], and sixel_fraction removed. It deprecates ya.mgr_emit(), ya.app_emit(), ya.input_emit(), ya.preview_widgets(), Command:args(), ya pack subcommand, and several ui constants. Tabs are redesigned into an independent tab bar component. Real-time directory size calculation is added to the spotter. Sixel image preview is made 9x faster by replacing the quantization algorithm. A piper.yazi plugin is introduced. Other features include enhancements to fzf integration and Helix support.

chunks.title: v25.5.31
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the sxyazi/yazi release v25.5.31, the project provides a maintenance release focusing on bug fixes, including exposing ui.Wrap, fixing forward --end-of-word for input mode delta, and carrying hidden states for dummy files.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent syncthing/syncthing release stream from v2.0.2 through v2.1.1-rc.1, covering the 2.0 major changes and the introduction of 2.1 features like GUI grouping, proxy support, configurable block indexing, and session duration settings.

chunks.title: v2.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.0.2, the major changes in the 2.0 series are introduced: the database backend switches from LevelDB to SQLite with a migration on first launch; logging changes to structured log entries with per-package log level control and a new WARNING level; deleted items are forgotten after fifteen months by default; command line options parsing is modernised, dropping old single-dash long options; rolling hash detection of shifted data is removed; a default folder is no longer created on first startup; multiple connections are used by default between v2 devices (three connections: one for index metadata, two for data exchange); several platforms lose prebuilt binaries due to SQLite cross-compilation complexities; and conflict resolution handling for deleted files changes so a delete can win and move the deleted file to a conflict copy.

chunks.title: v2.0.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.0.3, the same major 2.0 changes are present, and this release includes fixes: restoring the --version flag for compatibility, making database migration more robust to write errors, providing a temporary GUI/API server during database migration, and cleaning files for dropped folders at startup. Other changes include re-enabling LOGGER_DISCARD and downgrading gopsutil.

chunks.title: v2.0.4-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.0.4-rc.1, the major 2.0 changes are included, and this prerelease adds fixes: only starting the temporary API server during migration if it's enabled, considering MaxFolderConcurrency when calculating number of hashers, considering number of CPU cores when calculating hashers on interactive OS, and applying all migrations and schema in one transaction. Other changes include adjusting db bench name, cleaning up DB in tests, using Go 1.24 tools pattern, and avoiding rowid for blocks and blocklists.

chunks.title: v2.0.4-rc.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.0.4-rc.2, the major 2.0 changes are included, and this prerelease adds fixes: only starting the temporary API server during migration if it's enabled, considering MaxFolderConcurrency when calculating number of hashers, considering number of CPU cores when calculating hashers on interactive OS, applying all migrations and schema in one transaction, correctly handling block-aligned empty sparse files, and applying folder migrations with temporary API/GUI server. Other changes include adjusting db bench name, cleaning up DB in tests, and more.

chunks.title: v2.0.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.0.4, the major 2.0 changes are included, and this stable release contains the same fixes as v2.0.4-rc.2: only starting the temporary API server during migration if it's enabled, considering MaxFolderConcurrency when calculating number of hashers, considering number of CPU cores when calculating hashers on interactive OS, applying all migrations and schema in one transaction, correctly handling block-aligned empty sparse files, and applying folder migrations with temporary API/GUI server. Other changes include adjusting db bench name, cleaning up DB in tests, and more.

chunks.title: v2.0.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.0.5, the major 2.0 changes are included, and this release adds a fix to only vacuum the database on startup when a migration script was actually run. Other changes include adding a DCO requirement to contribution guidelines and updating contribution guidelines from the docs site.

chunks.title: v2.0.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.0.6, the major 2.0 changes are included, and this release adds a fix to remove temp_store = MEMORY pragmas.

chunks.title: v2.0.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.0.7, the major 2.0 changes are included, and this release adds fixes: earlier free-space check, redacting device encryption passwords in support bundle config, reverting to default page cache size for SQLite, supporting HTTP/2 on GUI/API connections, and avoiding rowid on kv table. Other changes include adjusting folder state logging, packaging for illumos, and adding configurable logging format. The list of platforms without prebuilt binaries is updated to remove illumos/amd64 and solaris/amd64, now listing only solaris/amd64.

chunks.title: v2.0.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.0.8, the major 2.0 changes are included, and this release adds fixes: less impactful periodic garbage collection for SQLite and explicitly setting the temporary directory location. Other changes include triggering nightly build only on the syncthing repo, always returning values to the pools when hashing blocks, and skipping database GC entirely when it's provably unnecessary.

chunks.title: v2.0.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.0.9, the major 2.0 changes are included, and this release adds fixes: adding _txlock=immediate to modernc SQLite implementation and limiting the size of allowed authentication requests. Other changes include updating regex patterns for Syncthing-Fork entries, cleaning up migrated database, using normalised tables for file names and versions, and slightly deflaking TestRecvOnlyRevertOwnID.

chunks.title: v2.0.10-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.0.10-rc.1, the major 2.0 changes are included, and this prerelease adds fixes: improving conflict detection by tracking previous file hash, properly skipping zero/empty fields in usage report, not fetching usage report preview unnecessarily on GUI load, only performing foreign key checking when a migration was applied, not performing CPU benchmark on startup unless logging enabled, not announcing untrusted devices to other devices, and actually always inserting blocks for local files. Other changes include updating GitHub actions.

chunks.title: v2.0.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.0.10, the major 2.0 changes are included, and this stable release contains the same fixes as v2.0.10-rc.1: improving conflict detection by tracking previous file hash, properly skipping zero/empty fields in usage report, not fetching usage report preview unnecessarily on GUI load, only performing foreign key checking when a migration was applied, not performing CPU benchmark on startup unless logging enabled, not announcing untrusted devices to other devices, and actually always inserting blocks for local files. Other changes include making host network mode the default in Docker docs, removing incorrect embedding of nat.Service, minor lint fixes, and adding Azerbaijani and Kurdish l10n templates.

chunks.title: v2.0.13-rc.1

chunks.title: v2.0.14-rc.1

chunks.title: v2.0.16-rc.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.0.16-rc.2, the major 2.0 changes are included, and this prerelease adds fixes: verifying compressed message length before decompression, supporting overrides for syncOwnership in systemd, and adding back chown allowed syscalls in systemd. chunks.title: v2.1.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.1.0-rc.1, the major changes in the 2.1 series are introduced: devices and folders can be grouped in the GUI by setting a group attribute; HTTP and HTTPS proxies with CONNECT support can be used in addition to SOCKS proxies; block indexing can be turned off for folders to optimize for reduced database size and overhead; and GUI login session duration and cookie path can be configured. chunks.title: v2.1.1-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the syncthing/syncthing release v2.1.1-rc.1, the major 2.1 changes are included, and this prerelease adds fixes: properly upgrading via REST when Syncthing is running, ensuring user read/write/execute on archived dirs for versioner, only announcing wildcard for TCP punching when listening on wildcard address, closing source loader responses on errors in stcrashreceiver, and handling zero-size requests in protocol. Other changes include being explicit about workflow permissions, including runtime context in GC crashes, updating x/net for govulncheck, and using path/filepath for local file system paths.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent tailwindlabs/tailwindcss release stream across v4.0.x, v4.1.x, v4.2.x, v4.3.0, and v3.4.x patches. It covers bug fixes, new utilities, variant additions, and upgrade tool improvements.

chunks.title: v4.0.15
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tailwindlabs/tailwindcss release v4.0.15, the release note describes fixes for incorrect angle in -bg-conic-* utilities, border-[12px_4px] being interpreted as border-color instead of border-width, a Safari 16.4/16.5 crash with default Preflight styles, pre-processing of <template lang="…"> in Vue files, prefixing of all CSS variables used by Preflight, a segfault when loaded in a worker thread on Linux, multiple --value(…) or --modifier(…) calls deleting subsequent declarations, class extraction followed by '(' in Slim, exporting PluginUtils from tailwindcss/plugin for v3 compatibility, removing redundant line-height: initial from Preflight, increasing Standalone hardware compatibility on macOS x64 builds, and ensuring CSS file rebuilds when a new CSS variable is used from templates. It also changes the --theme(…) function to return CSS variables from theme variables unless used where CSS variables are invalid.

chunks.title: v4.0.16
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tailwindlabs/tailwindcss release v4.0.16, the release note adds support for literal values in --value('…') and --modifier('…'). It fixes class extraction followed by '(' in Pug, ensures @keyframes for theme animations are emitted when referenced after a comma, ensures Vite updates to imported CSS files propagate after source file changes, pre-processes Slim templates embedded in Ruby files, errors when input and output files resolve to the same file in the CLI, adds missing suggestions for --spacing(--value(integer, number)), and adds ::-webkit-details-marker pseudo to the marker variant.

chunks.title: v4.0.17
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tailwindlabs/tailwindcss release v4.0.17, the release note fixes an issue causing the CLI to hang when processing Ruby files.

chunks.title: v4.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tailwindlabs/tailwindcss release v4.1.0, the release note adds details-content, inverted-colors, noscript, pointer-none/coarse/fine, any-pointer-none/coarse/fine, user-valid/user-invalid variants, items-baseline-last and self-baseline-last utilities, safe alignment utilities, wrap-anywhere/break-word/normal utilities, @source inline(…) and @source not inline(…), @source not "…", text-shadow-* utilities, mask-* utilities, bg-{position,size}-* for arbitrary values, shadow-*/<alpha>, inset-shadow-*/<alpha>, drop-shadow-*/<alpha>, text-shadow-*/<alpha> utilities, drop-shadow-<color> utilities, and improves compatibility with older Safari and Firefox. It fixes symlink following in @source, not scanning ignored files on rebuild, supporting negated content rules in legacy JS config, interpreting @("@")md:… as @md:… in Razor, disallowing top-level braces/semicolons/unbalanced parentheses in arbitrary values, ensuring --theme(…) resolves to CSS variables with legacy JS plugins, and detecting used theme variables in CSS module files. It changes to ignore node_modules by default, @source rules with file extensions or inside node_modules no longer consider .gitignore, and deprecates bg-{left,right}-{top,bottom} in favor of bg-{top,bottom}-{left,right}.

chunks.title: v4.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tailwindlabs/tailwindcss release v4.1.1, the release note fixes disabling padding in @source inline(…) brace expansion, injecting polyfills after @import and body-less @layer, and ensuring @tailwindcss/cli does not contain an import for jiti.

chunks.title: v4.1.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tailwindlabs/tailwindcss release v4.1.2, the release note fixes not relying on @layer base to polyfill @property, supporting multiple inset shadows as arbitrary values, fixing drop-shadow-* with multiple shadows, a PostCSS race condition with concurrent changes, ensuring files with @tailwind utilities are processed, ensuring color-mix(…) polyfill creates fallbacks for unanalyzable colors, fixing slow incremental builds with @tailwindcss/vite and @tailwindcss/postcss on Windows, and a missing CSS file in Qwik setups with Vite.

chunks.title: v4.1.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tailwindlabs/tailwindcss release v4.1.3, the release note fixes showing a warning for unsupported bare value data types in --value(…), ensuring PostCSS changes to input CSS don't generate stale output with Turbopack, and ensuring classes are detected in Ruby's %w syntax in Slim templates.

chunks.title: v4.1.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tailwindlabs/tailwindcss release v4.1.4, the release note adds an experimental @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi target for browser environments. It fixes ensuring color-mix(…) polyfills don't remove used CSS variables, creating fallbacks for theme variables referencing other theme variables, brace expansion in declining ranges, a Chrome rendering bug with skew-* utilities, container query variant names with hyphens, shadow-inherit/inset-shadow-inherit/drop-shadow-inherit/text-shadow-inherit inheriting shadow color, compatibility with array tuples in fontSize JS theme keys, scanning folders with binary file extensions, and converting fontSize array tuple syntax to CSS theme variables during upgrade.

chunks.title: v4.1.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tailwindlabs/tailwindcss release v4.1.5, the release note adds support for using @tailwindcss/upgrade between v4.* versions, h-lh/min-h-lh/max-h-lh utilities, and transitioning display/visibility/content-visibility/overlay/pointer-events with transition. It fixes not scanning .geojson or .db files by default, hiding default shadow suggestions when missing theme keys, replacing _ with . in theme suggestions for @utility if surrounded by digits, skipping color-mix(…) when opacity is 100%, ensuring PostCSS errors in imported stylesheets are recoverable, bumping all Tailwind CSS dependencies during upgrade, not adding - to variants starting with @ during upgrade, and not formatting unchanged stylesheets during upgrade.

chunks.title: v4.1.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tailwindlabs/tailwindcss release v4.1.6, the release note adds automatic conversion of arbitrary values to named values during upgrade, parallel dependency updates for performance, detailed DEBUG=* logging about @source directives and scanned files, and support for generating source maps in development. prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent taosdata/TDengine release stream from version 3.1.1.4 through 3.4.1.6, covering new features such as stream processing enhancements, multi-level storage, data integration, and enterprise security capabilities.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.1.1.4, the release note focuses on bug fixes including a core dump when selecting ins_tables, replica data size issues during split vgroup, and incorrect removal of components in install.sh and rmtaos.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.2.0.0, new features include IP White List, configurable floating point lossy compression, and balance vgroup leader for a specific vgroup. Improvements cover performance optimization for partition by column, block level cache for S3 data retrieval, and split vgroup with data subscription.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.2.1.0, new features include View, optimized query for BI tool integration, and optimized data recovery when one disk is disrupted using multi-level storage. Improvements include performance optimization when querying last()/last_row() with primary key or other functions together.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.2.2.0, new features include queryable and killable data compacting operations (Enterprise), S3 as the last tier of multi-tier storage (Enterprise), stream processing Event Window, TDengine server on Windows/x64 (Enterprise), and ODBC driver. Improvements cover query performance, adaptive API for BI tools, snapshot transfer performance, and floating point numbers writable into integer columns.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.2.3.0, new features include Count Window for stream processing, refactored TDengine monitoring with Grafana dashboards for taosd and taosX, a new license mechanism, Wonderware Historian data ingestion, data compression between taosX-Agent and taosX, and Explorer HTTPS support. Improvements cover last/last_row cache performance, query optimization, system operations like redistribute vgroup with RAFT learner, and data-in optimizations.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.0.0, new features and improvements include full functional Join (LEFT, RIGHT, FULL, SEMI, ANTI-SEMI, ASOF, WINDOW), Composite Primary Key, double replicas (Enterprise), S3 storage (Enterprise), TSMA for aggregate query acceleration, configurable compression per column, Count Window for stream and batch, Active-Active (Enterprise), database encryption (Enterprise), multi-level storage with up to 64 mount points (Enterprise), data in from PostgreSQL and MySQL (Enterprise), and a simplified public Data Explorer.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.1.0, the release note highlights improved performance of transferring metadata and fixed bugs including create/drop stable not logged in operation logs, abnormal stream-task-status after redistribute and dnode restart, and other known issues.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.2.0, new features and improvements include alter table add column with encode and compress parameters, dynamic supportVnodes configuration, minimized compact impact on read/write, CentOS Stream support, and enterprise features such as balance vgroup leader on a database, speed control for cross-level data transfer, dynamic IP white list, data transfer from Oracle and SQL Server, and OPC UA dynamic data point discovery.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.3.0, new features and improvements include new functions (pi, truncate, exp, ln, mod, rand, sign, degrees, radians, char, ascii, position, trim, replace, repeat, substring, substring_index, week, weekday, weekofyear, dayofweek, stddev_pop, var_pop), Microsoft Azure Blob for multi-level storage (Enterprise), data transfer from MongoDB (Enterprise), TDengine macOS client (Enterprise), and slow query logging to monitoring database.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.4.3, behavior changes include snode requirement for stream computing in multi-replica databases and a compatibility guarantee mechanism for stream. New features include twa and interp functions in stream computing with time-driven result push mode, optimized error messages for compact and split vgroup, and Azure Blob support. Optimizations include AVX2/AVX512 decoding, improved data scanning speed, and unique query task IDs.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.4.8, new features include interp function support for fill(near) mode and returning original data timestamps. Optimizations include TSBS query performance, altering multiple tag values of a single child table simultaneously, and reduced resource consumption in force window close mode of stream computing.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.5.0, features include refactored MQTT for stability and performance, refactored taosX incremental backup-restore, stmt2 APIs in JDBC and Rust connector, configurable Grafana dashboards in Explorer, and taosX-agent in-memory cache queue capacity option. Enhancements include SQL-based disk space statistics, server-side SQL memory management, INTERVAL AUTO keyword, and strong password enforcement.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.5.2, features include taosX support for multiple stables with template for MQTT. Enhancements include improved taosX error messages, backup restore improvements, and adjusted systemctl strategy for taosd process restarts.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.5.8, features include TMQ subscription with ONLY META in JDBC, multiple-line SQL editor in Grafana, VARBINARY/GEOMETRY in ODBC, TDengine with ODBC driver in Excel, and taosX agent specific port range. Enhancements include JDBC unsigned integer support, TDgpt integration in community version, and BinaryRowData type in Flink.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.6.0, features include Decimal data type, improved taosc compatibility, cols keyword for single-row selection functions, virtual tables, stream computing continue_window_close trigger mode, greatest and least functions, and integration with FineBI and Tableau. Enhancements include asynchronous stream creation, improved Kafka performance in taosX, and index creation for nchar and varchar tag fields.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.6.3, features include taosBenchmark decimal datatype support, dnode information and components status, auto commit in websocket subscription, and suggestions for large-throughput queries. Enhancements include taosBenchmark ctrl-c fast exit, reduced taosX db size, and stream computing cols function support.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.6.6, features include taosAdapter process/connection-pools metrics, initialization scripts in Docker image, subscribe database/stable in JDBC, TDgpt covariate forecasting, and MQTT received bytes metric. Enhancements include special chars in password support for connectors, backup interval less than 60s, and DBeaver JDBC connection upgrade.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.6.9, features include persistent cache in agent of OPC, Spark retrieving data from TDengine, and SSRS support. Enhancements include data subscription offset update logic optimization, driver version number generation method update, and Explorer JSON payload newline support.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.6.13, features include IPv6 support across taoskeeper, database engine, taosX/explorer, taosAdapter, and connectors, taosX runtime log level change, Node-RED plugin for query/write/subscribe, and taosX telemetry report. Enhancements include Go WebSocket connector poll data integrity, TDengine Build CI speedup, and node recovery performance improvement.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.7.0, features include a new version of stream computing, BLOB data type, multi-level storage shared storage adoption, data subscription MQTT protocol, data mounting, auto reconnect in Rust websocket and libtaosws, MQTT Sparkplug B datain, OpenMetrics collection endpoints, and a new go connector benchmark tool. Enhancements include grant items for storage capacity and vnodes, STMT2 fixed values for specified columns, and SM4 algorithm for user password encryption.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.7.5, features include taosX ORC format import, C WebSocket connection-level timezone, ADO interface in ODBC, and taosAdapter SQL recording to CSV. Enhancements include EXPLORER_SKIP_REGISTER to skip registration, reduced taosX binary size, and shared storage NAS support.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.8.0, features include taosX performance report, TLS certificate-based authentication and transmission, stream delete_output_table option, state_window operations on state column, re-implemented TSMA using refactored stream, PROPHET algorithm in TDgpt, Pearson correlation coefficient function, and functions like IF, ISNULL, COALESCE, NULLIF, IFNULL, std, variance, group_concat, and Rollup SMA. Enhancements include state window start and end point configuration, C WebSocket STMT2 performance, and shared storage migration progress command.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.8.1, enhancements include support for alter RSMA. Fixes address incorrect results when executing first and last functions on timestamp column simultaneously, precision loss when taosX synchronizes decimal data, and incorrect first window calculation results after taosd restart.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.8.4, features include taosX OPC failover endpoint. Enhancements include taosX sync from higher to lower precision, Adapter connection management and request limit, improved last_row composite query performance, and REST API returning null for nan/inf. Fixes address tmq_get_json_meta behavior with empty strings, decode overflow interior page, and slow leader election in dual-replica setups.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.3.8.8, features include taosX KingHistorian data-in and new datasources pulsar and tuya. Enhancements include active-active WAL marker, C WebSocket connector performance optimization, improved stream startup speed with historical data, and TDgpt imputation function arbitrary sampling intervals. Fixes address event window output table creation, taosX data synchronization extra tables, and stream compatibility issues when upgrading from 3.3.7 to 3.3.8.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.4.0.0, features include adapter connector info attribute, C websocket SSL/TLS connection params, taosAdapter instances register and query, parse and write any JSON data, taosX high-availability and Kafka task load balancing, TDgpt row correlation analysis functions (dtw, dtw_path, tlcc), enterprise data transmission SASL mechanism, full transparent encryption, MFA and RBAC, and functions like SM4_ENCRYPT, AES_ENCRYPT, MD5, SHA, MASK_FULL, FROM_BASE64, TO_BASE64. Enhancements include virtual table max columns to 32767, state window zeroth_state, and stream interp and percentile function support.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.4.0.2, features include automatic xnode creation during TSDB initialization, Explorer License page machine code, taosX-agent xnode HA, taosX parquet files import, SQL recording for STMT in adapter, Rust native connector STMT2, and dual conditions of duration and row count for true_for in event and state windows. Enhancements include STMT query interval parameter binding, clearer SQL error messages, and login verification logic optimization.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.4.0.9, features include taosAdapter token support for subscription and taosdump import/export virtual tables. Enhancements include massive UI enhancement for Explorer, optimized impact of frequent child table tag modifications on data writing, and table name template expression support.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.4.1.0, features include MCP server for TDengine TSDB, external window query with explicit time range, uncorrelated scalar subquery, ANY/SOME/ALL/EXISTS/NOT EXISTS operators, batch modification of child table tag values, stream scheduled calculation by natural week/month/quarter/year, timeout notification for stream, subscription metadata changes for virtual tables, token-based login for data subscription, lag/lead/fill_forward functions, scalar subqueries without FROM clause, data repair mode, TDgpt multivariate anomaly detection, and taosX task owner privileges.

In the taosdata/TDengine release 3.4.1.6, enhancements include automatic redirection to XNODE creation page in Explorer, cross-origin security improvements, XNODE management page, SQLAlchemy compatibility in taos-ws-py, taosX configuration file import/export, AVEVA Historian automatic reconnection, Rust connector batch tag update subscription, DECIMAL and BLOB parameter binding, taos shell -H option for hexadecimal display, TO_ISO8601 daylight saving time support, and virtual table DECIMAL column support.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent tensorflow/tensorflow release stream from v2.12.1 through v2.21.0, covering major feature introductions, breaking changes, and bug fixes across multiple minor and patch versions.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.12.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.12.1, the release notes describe bug fixes and other changes, specifically noting that the use of the ambe config to build and test aarch64 is not needed and will be removed in the future, and that cpu_arm64_pip.sh and cpu_arm64_nonpip.sh are made more similar for easier future maintenance.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.14.0-rc0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.14.0-rc0, the release notes include breaking changes such as the class hierarchy change for tf.Tensor introducing explicit EagerTensor and SymbolicTensor classes, and the deprecation of tf.compat.v1.Session.partial_run and partial_run_setup in the next release. Major features include enabling JIT-compiled i64-indexed kernels on GPU for large tensors, and adding experimental support for converting models larger than 2GB in tf.lite. Bug fixes and other changes include allowing tf.py_function and tf.numpy_function as decorators, Strided_Slice supporting UINT32, disabling TensorFloat-32 causing TPUs to use float32 precision, new dtensor APIs like relayout_like and get_default_mesh, the new strict_mode API, removal of tfdbg v1 CLI, and C++ RTTI support on mobile and Android.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.14.0-rc1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.14.0-rc1, the release notes add a breaking change that support for Python 3.8 has been removed starting with TF 2.14, and that tf.estimator API will be removed in the next release. A new major feature is the optional pip installation method for Linux that installs necessary Nvidia CUDA libraries through pip using 'pip install tensorflow[and-cuda]'. Other content is similar to v2.14.0-rc0, including the tf.Tensor class hierarchy change, GPU kernel improvements, tf.lite large model support, and various bug fixes.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.13.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.13.1, the release notes describe a single bug fix: refactoring CpuExecutable to propagate LLVM errors.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.14.0, the release notes include breaking changes: removal of Python 3.8 support, tf.Tensor class hierarchy change, and deprecation of tf.compat.v1.Session.partial_run and partial_run_setup. Major features include the new pip installation method for Nvidia CUDA libraries, JIT-compiled i64-indexed GPU kernels, and experimental support for converting models larger than 2GB in tf.lite. Bug fixes and other changes include decorator support for tf.py_function and tf.numpy_function, Strided_Slice UINT32 support, TensorFloat-32 disabling effect on TPUs, new dtensor APIs, strict_mode API, removal of tfdbg v1 CLI, and C++ RTTI support on mobile and Android.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.15.0-rc0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.15.0-rc0, the release notes include a breaking change renaming tf.types.experimental.GenericFunction to PolymorphicFunction. Major features include oneDNN CPU performance optimizations enabled by default on Windows x64 & x86, making the tf.function type system fully available with TraceType, FunctionType, and AtomicFunction, moving warm_start option in tf.data, tf.lite sub_op and mul_op broadcasting up to 6 dimensions, and making SignatureRunner and related C API functions non-experimental. Bug fixes include adding TensorFlow Quantizer to pip package, sparse_gradient option for sparse segment ops, and Android NDK r25 support.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.15.0-rc1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.15.0-rc1, the release notes are similar to v2.15.0-rc0, including the renaming of GenericFunction to PolymorphicFunction, oneDNN optimizations, tf.function type system enhancements, tf.data warm_start move, tf.lite broadcasting and SignatureRunner promotion, and bug fixes like TensorFlow Quantizer and sparse_gradient option.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.14.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.14.1, the release notes focus on security, updating curl to 8.4.0 to handle CVE-2023-38545 and CVE-2023-38546.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.15.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.15.0, the release notes include the breaking change renaming GenericFunction to PolymorphicFunction. Major features include oneDNN CPU performance optimizations on Windows, full tf.function type system availability, tf.data warm_start move, tf.lite broadcasting and SignatureRunner promotion. Bug fixes include TensorFlow Quantizer, sparse_gradient option, and Android NDK r25 support.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.16.0-rc0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.16.0-rc0, the release notes include breaking changes: tf.summary.trace_on now requires profiler_outdir, tf.estimator API is removed, Keras 3 becomes the default, and Apple Silicon users should use pip install tensorflow instead of tensorflow-macos. Major features include Python 3.12 support, tensorflow-tpu package availability, and CUDA 12.3/cuDNN 8.9.7 builds. Bug fixes include tf.lite support for stablehlo ops, new checkpoint sharding callbacks, and experimental_debug_stripper in SaveOptions.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.16.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.16.1, the release notes note that Clang is the default compiler for Windows CPU wheels, and that this release is 2.16.1 instead of 2.16.0. Breaking changes include tf.summary.trace_on profiler_outdir requirement, tf.estimator removal, Keras 3 as default, and deprecation of Mac x86 builds from TF 2.17. Major features include Python 3.12 support, tensorflow-tpu package, CUDA 12.3/cuDNN 8.9.7, and experimental float16 auto-mixed precision with AMX-FP16. Bug fixes include tf.lite stablehlo support, new C API functions, and checkpoint sharding callbacks.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.15.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.15.1, the release notes describe a bug fix updating the ml_dtypes runtime dependency to 0.3.1 to fix package conflict issues.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.17.0-rc0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.17.0-rc0, the release notes include a breaking change removing support for NVIDIA GPUs with compute capability 5.x (Maxwell). Major features include is_cpu_target_available and tf.data experimental distributed_save. Bug fixes include adding GPU compute capability 8.9 support, migrating to StableHLO Quantizer DebuggerConfig, adding TensorFlow to StableHLO converter, noting last TensorRT support, NumPy 2.0 support in next release, tf.lite per-channel quantization for FullyConnected, C API renaming TfLiteRegistrationExternal to TfLiteOperator, and tf.data Dataset.load wait option.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.16.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tensorflow/tensorflow release v2.16.2, the release notes describe a bug fix for incorrect dependency metadata in TensorFlow Python packages causing installation failures with certain package managers such as Poetry.

chunks.title: TensorFlow 2.17.0-rc1

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent termux/termux-app release stream from v0.95 through v0.119.0-beta.3, covering terminal emulation fixes, new configuration properties, bootstrap updates, and support for modern Android features.

chunks.title: v0.95
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.95, the project fixes an incorrect message shown when bootstrap installation fails, updates bootstrap archives, resolves a crash caused by malformed \uXXXX tokens in termux.properties, introduces auto-detection of system dark theme, properly sets the orientation of the text selection handle, updates the notification icon to match the launcher icon, extends extra keys configuration, supports opening log files with a view intent, provides a way for third-party applications to execute commands within the Termux environment, and switches to vector drawables for text selection handles.

chunks.title: v0.96
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.96, the project exports environment variables specific to Android 11 if available, exports COLORTERM=truecolor for True Color support, fixes selection rendering when alternate cursor styles are used, fixes an invisible text issue on some color schemes by inverting colors, fixes the notification icon, and fixes argument handling for the com.termux.RUN_COMMAND intent action while allowing background command execution.

chunks.title: v0.97
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.97, the project fixes the width of some unicode characters by synchronizing the Java WcWidth.java with the C code in libandroid-support. This release is marked as not a release due to a version mismatch between the tag and the value in app/build.gradle.

chunks.title: v0.98
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.98, the project fixes the width of some unicode characters by synchronizing WcWidth.java with libandroid-support and updates bootstrap archives.

chunks.title: v0.99
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.99, the project provides a workaround for input issues with some keyboards, fixes linter errors, always flushes terminal output before closing a session, fixes the permission description for the RUN_COMMAND intent, and updates bootstrap archives.

chunks.title: v0.100
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.100, the project fixes handling of the DECRQM sequence in terminal emulation, fixes a crash when using RunCommandService and an issue with foreground sessions, and updates bootstrap archives. This release notes that the bootstrap archives contain a broken dpkg that crashes on ARM devices, and a fixed app will be resubmitted as v0.101.

chunks.title: v0.101
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.101, the project fixes handling of the DECRQM sequence in terminal emulation, fixes a crash when using RunCommandService and an issue with foreground sessions, and updates bootstrap archives. This is a resubmission of v0.100 with fixed bootstrap archives.

chunks.title: v0.102 (F-Droid only)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.102 (F-Droid only), the project adds a context menu action "Autofill password" and updates bootstrap archives.

chunks.title: v0.103 (F-Droid only)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.103 (F-Droid only), the project adds READ_LOGS and WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permissions for advanced users, which can be enabled with ADB, and updates bootstrap archives.

chunks.title: v0.104 (F-Droid only)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.104 (F-Droid only), the project exposes dotfiles through SAF and updates bootstrap archives.

This release is marked as broken and users are advised to use v0.104 instead.

chunks.title: v0.106 (F-Droid only)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.106 (F-Droid only), the project provides the same changes as the broken v0.105 release: removes restrictions from file types viewable by ~/bin/termux-file-editor, suggests installing Termux:Styling from F-Droid instead of Play Store when changing terminal font/colors, adds a ctrl-space-workaround property to enable ctrl+space on hardware keyboards for some devices, and updates bootstrap archives.

chunks.title: v0.107 (F-Droid only)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.107 (F-Droid only), the project implements numpad arrows/home/end/pgup/pgdn/ins/del when num lock is off, handles multiple defined special buttons in extra keys and in popup, adds a fullscreen option in ~/.termux/termux.properties (with a use-fullscreen-workaround for some devices), adds a default-working-directory option to open Termux in a specified directory, adds back PNG icons in addition to the adaptive/vector icon, exports the current application version as the TERMUX_VERSION environment variable, and updates bootstrap archives.

chunks.title: v0.108 (F-Droid only)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.108 (F-Droid only), the project is a special release to fix an F-Droid build issue by reverting the split APK configuration back to an all-in-one architecture APK. The changelog is the same as the unreleased v0.107.

chunks.title: v0.109 (F-Droid only)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.109 (F-Droid only), the project updates bootstrap archives and includes lots of fixes and improvements such as adding a SettingsActivity for GUI-based settings management, a ReportActivity for showing reports, a centralized logging framework, logging for bootstrap installation and storage symlink setup, requesting android.permission.DUMP, android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES, and adding support for warning users about missing Draw over other apps permission, a hide-soft-keyboard-on-startup property, support for disabling soft keyboard completely, adjusting toolbar height, executable and working directory validation for RUN_COMMAND intent, and support for session actions for foreground session commands.

chunks.title: v0.112 (F-Droid only)

chunks.title: v0.114 (F-Droid only)

chunks.title: v0.115 (F-Droid only)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.115 (F-Droid only), the project adds support to send back or store RUN_COMMAND intent command results in files, adds a termux settings button to the left drawer, allows users to disable terminal margin adjustment, shows crash notifications when bootstrap installation or setup storage fails, updates bootstrap to 2021.06.30-r1, moves from github packages to jitpack for hosting termux library packages, changes license for non-termux utils from GPLv3 to MIT, and includes various fixes.

chunks.title: v0.116 (F-Droid only)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the termux/termux-app release v0.116 (F-Droid only), the project fixes jitpack library publishing that failed for the initial v0.115 release by re-releasing so that jitpack picks up the new version, and provides updated dependency import examples.

chunks.title: v0.117 (F-Droid only)

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent tesseract-ocr/tesseract release stream from version 4.0.0 through 5.5.2, covering major feature additions, API modernizations, and incremental fixes across stable and pre-release versions.

chunks.title: 4.0.0 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract release 4.0.0, the project announces the 4.0.0 release with detailed release notes, changelog, and documentation available on the project wiki. A Windows installer is provided via the UB-Mannheim repository.

chunks.title: 4.1.0 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract release 4.1.0, new renderers Alto, LSTMBox, and WordStrBox are added. Character boxes are included in hOCR output. Experimental Python training scripts are introduced as an alternative to shell scripts. Support for AVX, AVX2, and SSE is improved. OpenMP support is disabled by default. A bounding box problem is fixed. Whitelist/blacklist support is implemented in the LSTM engine. CMake configuration is improved, and code modernization and bug fixes are applied.

chunks.title: 4.1.1 Release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract release 4.1.1, the software build is implemented as cppan is deprecated. The CMake build is improved. Code cleanup and optimization are performed, along with many bug fixes.

chunks.title: 5.0.0-alpha-20201224
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract pre-release 5.0.0-alpha-20201224, performance is improved, including on ARM and ARM64. Unit tests are enhanced. Many fixes are applied. A faster flat build with automake is introduced. Support for the latest macOS, including the new M1 processor, is added.

chunks.title: 5.0.0-alpha-20201231
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract pre-release 5.0.0-alpha-20201231, massive changes are made to the public API, which no longer uses proprietary data types GenericVector and STRING. The pdf.ttf file is no longer needed as it is integrated into the code.

chunks.title: 5.0.0-alpha-20210401
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract pre-release 5.0.0-alpha-20210401, all remaining STRING types are replaced by std::string. Many GenericVector instances are replaced by std::vector. All malloc/free calls are replaced by C++ code. The code is modernized and formatted.

chunks.title: 5.0.0-beta-20210815
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract pre-release 5.0.0-beta-20210815, bug fixes are applied. More code is modernized. Additional options for binarization are provided. Support for ARM NEON is improved. The dependency on Abseil for unit tests is removed. Float support is added for model training and text recognition, offering faster performance and reduced RAM usage.

chunks.title: 5.0.0-beta-20210916
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract pre-release 5.0.0-beta-20210916, bug fixes are included. URI support for Tesseract is extended with libcurl. Processed TIFF output files are renamed and a page number is added if needed.

chunks.title: 5.0.0-rc1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract release candidate 5.0.0-rc1, fast float32 LSTM is enabled by default. NFC normalization is switched everywhere. The banner message is removed. Music staff detection and removal are disabled. A new command line option --loglevel is added. Bug fixes are included.

chunks.title: 5.0.0-rc2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract release candidate 5.0.0-rc2, a regression for OCR with more than one model file is fixed. Bug fixes and optimizations are applied.

In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract release 4.1.2, line images with larger width are allowed for training. Bug fixes and build updates and fixes are included. Note: the autoconf build is broken, so users are advised to use 4.1.3.
In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract release 4.1.3, the broken autoconf build from issue #3642 is fixed.

chunks.title: 5.0.0-rc3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract release candidate 5.0.0-rc3, training messages are improved. A RowAttributes getter is added to PageIterator.
In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract final stable release 5.0.0, BCER is limited to the interval [0,1]. The build process is improved. Code is cleaned.

In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract bug fix release 5.0.1, SPDX-License-Identifier is added to public include files. Redirections are supported when running OCR on a URL. Many fixes and improvements are made for cmake builds, though distributions should use autoconf. The msys2 build with gcc 11 is fixed. The parameter certainty_scale is fixed (was duplicated). Compiler warnings are fixed and code is cleaned. amd64 and i386 are correctly detected on FreeBSD. libarchive and libcurl are added in CI actions. The googletest submodule is updated to v1.11.0.

In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract minor version 5.1.0, image and line regions are handled in output formats ALTO, hOCR, and text. A new parameter curl_timeout is added for curl_easy_setopt. Build fixes and improvements are made. A nullptr catch is added in PageIterator::Orientation to improve robustness. Unused code is removed.

In the tesseract-ocr/tesseract minor version 5.2.0, improvements and fixes are made for CI, autoconf, and cmake builds. /Os is set for some 32-bit MS compilers. Comments and documentation are improved. Initial support for Intel AVX512F is added. A fix is applied for very large PDF files on 32-bit hosts. NEON detection on FreeBSD is fixed. chunks.title: v0.33.0-rc.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thanos-io/thanos release v0.33.0-rc.0, the project introduces several additions and breaking changes. The Store Gateway adds a histogram for tracking index cache fetch latency and fixes a label values shadowing bug. The Query component adds command line arguments for configuring tenants and forwards tenant information to the Store Gateway, with breaking metric changes that add a tenant label to relevant exported metrics. The Query Frontend supports vertical sharding of binary expressions with metric names when no matching labels are specified, and adds TLS support in downstream tripper configuration. The Ruler supports a configuration flag for customizing alert message templates. The Index Cache adds enabled_items to selectively cache Postings, Series, or ExpandedPostings, and a ttl for remote caches like memcached and redis. The Objstore bumps to add Azure Workload Identity support. The Receive component changes write log level from warn to info, and exported HTTP metrics now use the specified default tenant for requests without tenants. The mixin rules are fixed for duplicate names and promtool is updated. Prometheus is bumped to v0.47.2-0.20231006112807-a5a4eab679cc. The deprecated --log.request.decision flag is removed in favor of --request.logging-config.

chunks.title: v0.35.0-rc.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thanos-io/thanos release v0.35.0-rc.0, the project introduces distributed query execution, receive tenant-label based request splitting, better query analysis, and numerous bugfixes and optimizations. The Query component adds --query.mode=distributed to enable the new distributed mode of the Thanos query engine. The Receive component adds tenant globbing support to hashring config. The Query UI adds a tenant input box, only shown when query tenant enforcement is enabled. The Rule component adds flag --query.enable-x-functions to allow usage of extended promql functions in loaded rules. The Reloader adds support for watching and decompressing Prometheus configuration directories. The Downsample component retries objstore related errors. Tracing adds missing sampler types. The Store Gateway fixes lazy expanded postings with 0 length failed to be cached, fixes lazy expanded postings estimate base cardinality using posting group with remove keys, and fixes caching partial expanded postings and bug of estimating remove postings with non existent value. The Store and Compact revert the recursive block listing mechanism and introduce a --block-discovery-strategy flag. The Receive component fixes a race condition in handler Close() when stopped early, fixes RemoteWriteAsync sequentially executed causing high latency, and fixes MultiTSDB not deleting non-uploaded blocks. The Query component fixes merging of query analysis, fixes Internal Server Error unknown targetHealth, fixes dedup iterator when working on mixed sample types, and fixes coroutine leak. The Query Frontend adds Redis username to client configuration, shows warnings from downstream queries, and fixes slow query logging for non-query endpoints. The Compact component doesn't halt due to overlapping sources when vertical compaction is enabled. The Store batches TSDB Infos for blocks.

The Compactor does not vertically compact downsampled blocks and marks such cases with no-compact-mark.json. All components use native histograms for grpc middleware metrics (breaking change).

chunks.title: v0.37.0-rc.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thanos-io/thanos release v0.37.0-rc.0, the project introduces several improvements across components, a new replication protocol for Receivers, and fixes for Prometheus v3. The Query Frontend fixes doubled gzip compression for response body, fixes slow query logging for non-query endpoints, passes "stats" parameter forward to queriers and fixes Prometheus stats merging, and fixes cache keys for dynamic split intervals. The Ruler only increments thanos_rule_evaluation_with_warnings_total metric for non PromQL warnings, and uses native histograms for client latency metrics. All components fix debug log formatting. The Compactor updates filtered blocks list before second downsample pass. The Store fixes panic because too small buffer in pool, fixes label_values to fetch less postings when matchers contain name=="something", returns chunks to the pool after completing a Series call, and closes block series client at the end to not reuse chunk buffer. The Receive component fixes thanos_receive_write_{timeseries,samples} stats, and adds support for replication using Cap'n Proto. The UI adds null check to find overlapping blocks logic. The Query component respects store.limit.* flags when evaluating queries, fixes coroutine leak, and fixes panic on regex store matchers. The Sidecar fixes retrieval of external labels for Prometheus v3.0.0. The API adds limit param to metadata APIs (series, label names, label values). The Reloader introduces TolerateEnvVarExpansionErrors to allow suppressing errors when expanding environment variables. The Query component adds the possibility of filtering rules by rule_name, rule_group or file to HTTP api. The Store implements metadata API limit in stores.

chunks.title: v0.38.0-rc.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thanos-io/thanos release v0.38.0-rc.0, the project introduces several additions and breaking changes. All components add POST into allowed CORS methods header. The Query-Frontend fixes query statistic reporting for range queries when caching is enabled, and fixes @ modifier not being applied correctly on sub queries.
