prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent thedotmack/claude-mem release stream from v12.3.7 through v13.4.0, covering worker reliability fixes, observation pipeline overhauls, server-beta introduction, and skill expansions.

chunks.title: v12.3.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.3.7, the project refactors the worker API by removing bearer-token auth and the unused platform_source query-time filter. A simple in-memory rate limiter (300 req/min) is added as a compensating control. Cleanup includes deleting src/shared/auth-token.ts and its dependents, and stopping tracking of .docker-blowout-data/claude-mem.db.

chunks.title: v12.3.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.3.8, a fix detects PID reuse in the worker start-guard so containers can restart cleanly. The liveness check now captures a process-start identity token alongside the PID, using /proc/<pid>/stat on Linux and ps on macOS, with a fallback to liveness-only for backwards compatibility. 14 new tests cover the change.

chunks.title: v12.3.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.3.9, new security observation types (security_alert and security_note) and a fire-and-forget Telegram notifier are introduced. A stop hook fire-and-forget summarize eliminates a ~110s terminal block. Hooks now resolve worker-port precedence correctly, and several bug fixes address session finalization and double-broadcast issues.

chunks.title: v12.4.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.4.1, a performance improvement caches Chroma backfill watermarks to skip per-restart Chroma scans. A new chroma-sync-state.json file stores per-project highest synced sqlite_id, reducing Chroma CPU on worker restart from 422% to 0% and making backfill startup near-instant.

chunks.title: v12.4.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.4.2, two ship-blockers are fixed: context overflow no longer loops forever by resetting the session, and <task-notification> payloads are blocked from polluting user_prompts. Five triage fixes address CJS build safety, hook timeout, Windows shell, path correction, and MCP server inheritance suppression.

chunks.title: v12.4.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.4.3, a one-shot DB cleanup migration runs once per data directory at worker startup, cleaning observer-sessions rows, stuck pending_messages chains, and Chroma data. It includes the v12.4.2 ship-blocker fixes for context-overflow loop and <task-notification> storage leak, plus v12.4.1 trivial fixes.

chunks.title: v12.4.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.4.4, a bug fix stops draining the observation queue on /clear. The SessionEnd hook is removed entirely, so pending observations finish processing naturally instead of being abandoned. Explicit user-initiated session deletion via the viewer UI still drains the queue.

chunks.title: v12.4.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.4.5, a bug fix addresses observation persistence on fresh installs. SessionStore was missing migration 28's column additions, causing silent failures on queue claims and observation inserts. The fix adds the missing columns and self-heals already-broken DBs.

chunks.title: v12.4.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.4.7, a cynical deletion sweep closes 27 issues by removing defenders and tolerators. Highlights include multi-account isolation via CLAUDE_MEM_DATA_DIR, a new CLAUDE_MEM_INTERNAL trust boundary, shared SSE/SQL filter predicate, pinned chroma-mcp, and migration 30 adding observations.metadata column.

chunks.title: v12.4.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.4.8, a bug fix coerces stringified numeric anchors in the timeline tool so they no longer fall through to ISO-timestamp parsing. A 7-case regression suite is added, and a parseNumericAnchor helper is extracted in SearchManager.

chunks.title: v12.4.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.4.9, seven critical fixes are patched in, including build/bundle drift removal, privacy tag stripping before summarization, preservation of relevance order in semantic search, Windows spawn restoration, Codex transcript ingestion fix, SDK boundary isolation, and standalone batch fixes.

chunks.title: v12.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.5.0, the observation pipeline is cleaned up by killing the per-message retry counter. The parser is collapsed to binary valid/invalid, ResponseProcessor has two branches, and PendingMessageStore is simplified. Schema migrations v31 and v32 drop dead columns from pending_messages.

chunks.title: v12.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.5.1, an install failure on Node 25+ is fixed by adding trustedDependencies to the plugin manifest so bun skips the failing native compile of tree-sitter. The OpenClaw plugin manifest version is synced to 12.5.1.

chunks.title: v12.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.6.0, 17 issues are fixed and 4 new foundations introduced. New capabilities include an OAuth keychain reader, quota-aware wall-clock guard, and network retry helper. Foundations include spawnHidden, paths, getUptimeSeconds, and ClassifiedProviderError.

chunks.title: v12.6.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.6.1, a patch fixes marketplace npm install failure on tree-sitter peer-dep ERESOLVE by moving grammar packages to dependencies and using --omit=dev --legacy-peer-deps. Chroma-mcp ONNX/OpenBLAS thread cap is removed to restore performance.

chunks.title: v12.6.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.6.2, a fix addresses npx claude-mem@latest install hanging on tree-sitter-swift. The 21 grammar packages are moved back to devDependencies, and the marketplace plugin install path keeps them as runtime deps with trustedDependencies.

chunks.title: v12.6.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.6.4, a fix drains invalid/non-XML observer responses so pending agent observations are cleared instead of retrying forever. All plugin manifest versions are corrected to agree on 12.6.4.

chunks.title: v12.6.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.6.5, the installer keeps the Claude Agent SDK as the single memory-agent path while supporting subscription auth, direct API keys, and custom gateway setup. The fixed agent-pool slot timeout is removed, and generator failures are reset to pending messages.

chunks.title: v12.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.7.0, native Codex hooks integration is added through the Codex plugin marketplace, along with hook payload normalization, file-context extraction, and Stop hook observation support. Worker-side initialization wait is replaced with hook-side readiness polling.

chunks.title: v12.7.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.7.1, the new babysit skill is packaged for monitoring PR checks, review comments, and unresolved review threads until a PR is merge-ready.

chunks.title: v12.7.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.7.2, Claude Code built-in auto-memory is disabled during claude-code installs by setting CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1. JSON config writes are made crash-safe, durable, symlink-safe, and safe for dangling symlink destinations.

chunks.title: v12.7.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.7.3, reliability fixes stop context-overflow and quota hard-stop failures from restarting observer generators, make Stop hook transcript lookup failures non-blocking, harden MCP/plugin startup path resolution, and fix export-memories to honor isolated data dirs.

chunks.title: v12.7.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.7.4, a patch restores Codex access to the claude-mem MCP/search plugin by pointing the Codex marketplace at the bundled plugin root. Resilient MCP launcher fallbacks are added for various install scenarios, and Codex plugin marketplaces are registered during install.

chunks.title: v12.7.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v12.7.5, a patch fixes npx installs that hit an existing Codex marketplace registration by removing stale registration and re-adding the local npx marketplace. Release workflow instructions are updated to use npm run build-and-sync.

chunks.title: v13.0.0 — Server Beta + Apache 2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v13.0.0, the Server Beta runtime is introduced as an opt-in service with its own lifecycle, Postgres-backed storage, BullMQ+Redis queue engine, new /v1 REST API, API-key auth, and outbox pattern. The repository is relicensed from AGPL-3.0 to Apache-2.0.

chunks.title: v13.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v13.0.1, bug fixes include dropping a parameter-expansion trim in .mcp.json, blocking ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL leak, classifying Claude SDK HTTP 400 as unrecoverable, hardening stop hook crash, enforcing a single chroma-mcp subprocess, and pinning onnxruntime/protobuf versions.

chunks.title: v13.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v13.1.0, the server-beta event pipeline is landed with phases 4–13, including a Postgres+BullMQ event-to-observation pipeline, API-key auth, team/project scope, audit log, three AI providers, legacy compat adapters, and Docker/Compose stack.

chunks.title: v13.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v13.2.0, the wowerpoint skill is added for generating kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDFs from a single source document. The plugin now has 12 skills.

chunks.title: v13.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v13.3.0, new skills design-is, weekly-digests, and oh-my-issues are added. Fixes include dropping a duplicate root .mcp.json and stopping Codex transcript replay after hooks migration.

chunks.title: v13.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the thedotmack/claude-mem release v13.4.0, a large defect backlog is cleared with fixes for spawn contract, worker lifecycle, output fidelity, SQLite self-healing, and more. A configurable OpenAI-compatible base URL for OpenRouter provider is added. Test suite moved from 46 to 0 failing.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent topjohnwu/Magisk release stream from v25.2 through v30.7, covering major feature introductions like Zygisk API v4, magic mount rewrites, Rust migration, and support for newer Android versions.

chunks.title: Magisk v25.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v25.2, this maintenance release fixes various issues including a potential issue when stub cpio is used, reboot to recovery when stub cpio is used, sepolicy.rules symlink for rootfs devices, better data encryption detection, and moves the whole logging infrastructure into Rust.

chunks.title: Magisk v26.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v26.0, the minimum Android version is bumped to 6.0, a new magic mount implementation is introduced to handle overlayfs, a new sepolicy.rule implementation with pre-init partition detection is added (requiring re-installation via the app after custom recovery), and Zygisk API v4 is introduced with new features and a refined PLT function hook API.

chunks.title: Magisk v26.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v26.1, changes from v26.0 include fixing app crashing when revoking root permissions, always preferring ext4 partitions over f2fs for pre-init partition selection, and restoring module files' context/owner/group from mirror, which was a regression in v26.0.

chunks.title: Magisk v26.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v26.2, MagiskBoot gains support for extracting boot image from payload.bin, handling cpio files with character files, listing cpio content, and directly handling AVB 1.0 signing/verification. The daemon socket becomes a fixed path in MAGISKTMP, resetprop supports printing property context and persistent properties, MagiskSU adds -g, -G, and -t options, MagiskPolicy fixes extended permissions patching and supports printing loaded sepolicy rules, and the app supports patching boot image from ROM zips and preserving boot.img for Samsung firmware with init_boot.img.

chunks.title: Magisk v26.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v26.3, the device information detection script is fixed, BusyBox is updated to 1.36.1, the toolchain that produced broken arm32 executables is updated, and a fix is applied for root service unable to bind on OnePlus devices.

chunks.title: Magisk v26.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v26.4, MagiskBoot avoids padding zeros if signed boot image is larger, MagiskPolicy fixes genfscon, filename_trans, and a libsepol bug, Zygisk fixes and simplifies file descriptor sanitization logic, the app prevents OOM when patching AP tarfiles and fixes a bug in device configuration detection, the daemon fixes certificate parsing of APKs, and logging errors from C++ code are no longer ignored.

chunks.title: Magisk v27.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v27.0, Zygisk introduces a new code injection mechanism and supports a new signature introduced in U QPR2, SEPolicy updates libsepol to properly set policy config bits, MagiskBoot supports compressing init for devices with small boot partitions, and ResetProp adds a new wait for property feature with resetprop -w.

chunks.title: Magisk (7b81e2d2) (27005)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk canary release 27005 (7b81e2d2), Zygisk updates internal JNI hooking implementation and MagiskInit updates preinit partition detection. Diffs to v27.0 include support for 16k page size, RISC-V, minimal libc for static executables, removal of unnecessary mirror for magic mount, rewrite of 2SI logic, MagiskPolicy preserving sepolicy config flag and optimizing patching rules, DenyList supporting enforcement when Zygisk is disabled, Resetprop improvements for property modification detections and property overlays, major app internal refactoring, support for patching Samsung firmware >8GiB, user-initiated job on Android 14, Android 13+ per-app language preferences, and MagiskBoot splitting kernel images without decompression.

chunks.title: Magisk (0495468d) (27006)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk canary release 27006 (0495468d), MagiskInit fixes a regression with sepolicy.rule loading. Diffs to v27.0 include support for 16k page size, RISC-V, minimal libc, removal of unnecessary mirror, rewrite of 2SI logic, updated preinit partition detection, updated Zygisk JNI hooking, MagiskPolicy changes, DenyList enforcement, Resetprop improvements, app refactoring, Samsung firmware patching, Android 14 job, per-app language preferences, and MagiskBoot splitting kernel images.

chunks.title: Magisk (8e82113b) (27007)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk canary release 27007 (8e82113b), MagiskBoot properly supports vendor boot images and core updates boot image detection logic for more devices. Diffs to v27.0 include 16k page size, basic RISC-V support, minimal libc, removal of unnecessary mirror, updated boot image detection, rewrite of 2SI logic, updated preinit partition detection, Zygisk JNI hooking update, MagiskPolicy changes, DenyList enforcement, Resetprop improvements, app refactoring, Samsung firmware patching, Android 14 job, per-app language preferences, and MagiskBoot splitting kernel images and vendor boot image support.

chunks.title: Magisk (4f18a66d) (27008)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk canary release 27008 (4f18a66d), MagiskBoot disables Samsung PROCA from kernel image and the app adds action.sh support for modules to define UI-triggered actions. Diffs to v27.0 include 16k page size, basic RISC-V, minimal libc, removal of unnecessary mirror, updated boot image detection, rewrite of 2SI logic, updated preinit partition detection, Zygisk JNI hooking update, MagiskPolicy changes, DenyList enforcement, Resetprop improvements, app refactoring, Samsung firmware patching, Android 14 job, per-app language preferences, MagiskBoot splitting kernel images, vendor boot image support, and Samsung PROCA disabling.

chunks.title: Magisk v28.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v28.0, support for 16k page size, basic RISC-V, minimal libc for static executables, removal of unnecessary mirror for magic mount, updated boot image detection, rewrite of 2SI logic, updated preinit partition detection, Zygisk JNI hooking update, MagiskPolicy preserving sepolicy config flag and optimizing patching rules, DenyList enforcement when Zygisk is disabled, Resetprop improvements for property modification detections and property overlays, major app internal refactoring, support for patching Samsung firmware >8GiB, user-initiated job on Android 14, Android 13+ per-app language preferences, action.sh support, MagiskBoot splitting kernel images, vendor boot image support, and Samsung PROCA disabling are included.

chunks.title: Magisk (070719db) (28001)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk canary release 28001 (070719db), this release syncs to the public v28.0 release with no additional changes.

chunks.title: Magisk (a34c04f9) (28002)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk canary release 28002 (a34c04f9), fixes include stub APK download link, support for Android lower than 8.0, MTK Samsung devices, a regression for 2SI devices in MagiskInit, and a regression causing overlay.d replaced files to be not accessible in MagiskPolicy.

chunks.title: Magisk (895b5f6c) (28003)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk canary release 28003 (895b5f6c), Samsung firmware AP tar patching is fixed. Diffs to v28.0 include fixes for stub APK download link, Android lower than 8.0, MTK Samsung devices, 2SI regression, and overlay.d regression.

chunks.title: Magisk v28.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v28.1, fixes include stub APK download link, support for Android lower than 8.0, MTK Samsung devices, a regression for 2SI devices in MagiskInit, and a regression causing overlay.d replaced files to be not accessible in MagiskPolicy.

chunks.title: Magisk (47cc532d) (28101)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk canary release 28101 (47cc532d), this release syncs to the public v28.1 release with no additional changes.

chunks.title: Magisk (b62835cb) (28102)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk canary release 28102 (b62835cb), the app supports downloading module zip files with XZ compression and MagiskMount supports systemlessly deleting files with modules using blank file nodes. Diffs to v28.1 include these two features.

chunks.title: Magisk (1e3edb88) (28103)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk canary release 28103 (1e3edb88), massive internal refactoring and code migration occurs, the app fixes patching Samsung's AP tar firmware files, and MagiskInit redesigns sepolicy patching and injection logic. Diffs to v28.1 include these changes plus XZ compression support and blank file node deletion.

chunks.title: Magisk (427a1ca4) (28104)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk canary release 28104 (427a1ca4), MagiskInit fixes 2SI on legacy SAR devices, the app disables animations when system animations are disabled, and MagiskSU gets better TTY/PTY support. Diffs to v28.1 include massive refactoring, XZ compression, animation disabling, blank file node deletion, sepolicy redesign, and TTY/PTY support.

chunks.title: Magisk v29.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v29.0, the entire codebase has undergone significant refactoring and migration, with over 40% of native code rewritten in Rust. Changelog includes massive internal refactoring, support for downloading module zip files with XZ compression, disabling app animations when system animations are disabled, systemlessly deleting files with modules using blank file nodes, redesign of sepolicy patching and injection logic, and better TTY/PTY support in MagiskSU.

chunks.title: Magisk (b1dc47a0) (29001)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk canary release 29001 (b1dc47a0), this release syncs with the public v29.0 release with no additional changes.

chunks.title: Magisk v30.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v30.0, various minor bug fixes are applied, the core module implementation is migrated to Rust, Magisk specific files injection logic is improved, and MagiskBoot compression code is migrated to Rust.

chunks.title: Magisk v30.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v30.1, a bug in module mounting implementation is fixed and MagiskSU adds the ability to restrict Linux capabilities even when running as root (uid=0). Diffs to v29.0 include minor bug fixes, Rust migration for modules and compression, improved injection logic, and capability restriction.

chunks.title: Magisk v30.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v30.2, an edge case breaking modules when overlayfs is involved is fixed, module .replace functionality is fixed in certain situations, and resetprop reduces property modification traces. Diffs to v29.0 include minor bug fixes, Rust migration, improved injection logic, capability restriction, and trace reduction.

chunks.title: Magisk v30.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v30.3, support for installing Magisk into vendor_boot partition is added, MagiskPolicy supports the new sepolicy binary format in Android 16 QPR2, more code is migrated to Rust, and MagiskSU falls back to older implementation when the kernel lacks zero userspace copy APIs. Diffs to v29.0 include minor bug fixes, vendor_boot support, significant Rust migration, improved injection logic, capability restriction, fallback, sepolicy format support, and trace reduction.

chunks.title: Magisk v30.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v30.4, several implementation bugs in MagiskSU are fixed. Diffs to v29.0 include minor bug fixes, vendor_boot support, Rust migration, improved injection logic, capability restriction, fallback, sepolicy format support, and trace reduction.

chunks.title: Magisk v30.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v30.5, a significant portion of the codebase is migrated to Rust, various minor bug fixes are applied, support for installing into vendor_boot partition is added, Magisk specific files injection logic is improved, MagiskSU adds capability restriction and fallback for older kernels, MagiskPolicy supports Android 16 QPR2 sepolicy format, resetprop reduces property modification traces and properly supports Android versions with property overrides.

chunks.title: Magisk v30.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v30.6, a hotfix reverts a change in MagiskInit that could result in bootloops. The v30.5 changelog includes Rust migration, minor bug fixes, vendor_boot support, improved injection logic, capability restriction, fallback, sepolicy format support, trace reduction, and property override support.

chunks.title: Magisk v30.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the topjohnwu/Magisk release v30.7, MagiskInit supports Android 16 QPR2 sepolicy format and using klogdump partition as pre-init storage, Zygisk supports Android 16 QPR2 and higher as well as Android XR and some Nubia devices, MagiskSU no longer drops capabilities by default when switching to non-root UIDs (use --drop-cap explicitly), and MagiskBoot improves lzma format detection and fixes commandline argument parsing bugs.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent release evolution of tw93/Pake, a tool that turns webpages into desktop apps. It covers major milestones from early CLI improvements and framework migration to Tauri, through enhanced packaging, multi-platform support, and advanced features like multi-window and native integrations.

chunks.title: V1.0.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V1.0.3, the project replaces the original ZLibrary address so that it can be accessed without special network requirements, and users are advised to re-download. Additionally, Pake CLI adds support for command-line shorthand, fixes an error with Windows packaging across different disks, and supports custom package types on Mac.

chunks.title: release build (V1.0.4-beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V1.0.4-beta, the project adds support for the aarch64 (arm64) architecture on Linux, but only for the deb package format. Other minor fixes are also included.

chunks.title: Continuous build
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release continuous, this is a continuous build triggered by GitHub Actions, with a link to the build log provided.

chunks.title: Daily updates
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V1.0.5, the project adds packaging support for Xiaohongshu, ProgramMusic, and CodeRunner. It optimizes the ChatGPT experience to be more concise and comfortable, improves semantic prompts for the Pake CLI command-line interface, and optimizes the packaging speed for GitHub Actions.

chunks.title: Daily updates
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V1.0.6, this is a daily update that fixes incorrect addresses in the previous V1.0.5 package by re-triggering the packaging process.

chunks.title: Release build (V1.0.7)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V1.0.7, this is a release build with a link to the GitHub Actions build log provided.

In the tw93/Pake release V2.0.0, the project undergoes a major upgrade from version 1.0 to 2.0. User experience improvements include window position and size memory, file downloads, external jump handling for Google and Apple without login, hyperlink navigation optimization, and the ability to open any address from the menu bar. Command-line packaging now supports local static file packaging, custom UserAgent, system tray configuration, menu bar icons, and domestic mirror acceleration. The system architecture is completely refactored, switching the underlying framework from Wry to Tauri, which facilitates future iOS/Android support. New applications Poe and YouTubeMusic are added, and existing applications like ChatGPT, Lizhi, Xiaohongshu, Twitter, and Reference receive user experience optimizations.

chunks.title: V2.0.6 更兼容
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V2.0.6, the project adds support for importing files by dragging and dropping into Pake pages, and improves link jump compatibility for more exceptional situations. It enhances download compatibility for various file scenarios, and allows Command-click to force download attempts for non-compliant downloads. The release optimizes the user experience for the latest ChatGPT, Twitter, YouTube Music, and Li Zhi packaged clients. It removes the Command + left/right arrow key logic for page navigation, keeping only Command+[ and Command+] for previous and next pages. A bug is fixed where system tray icons could not recognize .ico files on Linux and Windows.

chunks.title: V2.2.0 More Awesome
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V2.2.0, Pake now supports message notifications and audio/camera permission requests for a more native experience. The Pake CLI command-line packaging tool is rewritten to be more beautiful, lightweight, and practical. A conflict between Chinese/English input switching and the Enter key in ChatGPT is resolved. The internal download function, page navigation, and command-line update detection are improved, and the installation package size is reduced by 0.5 MB. Security is enhanced by upgrading to the latest Tauri version, requiring IpcAccess configuration for permissions.

chunks.title: V2.3.0 More Comprehensive
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V2.3.0, the command-line tool now supports injecting JS and CSS files, and configuring additional secure domains. Download capabilities are further optimized to support Blob type downloads and file exports. ChatGPT in GPT-4 mode's Code Interpreter now supports file import and export. The local development experience is upgraded so that Dev uses the same debugging environment as the command line.

chunks.title: V2.3.2 更 OK
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V2.3.2, GitHub Actions packaging is majorly refactored using Node to implement multi-system packaging with simultaneous builds, improving speed. Command-line packaging supports JS/CSS code injection and more essential configurations, and local development supports CLI debugging. The download function is further enhanced to support Blob, file export, and interface download scenarios, and a conflict between download and navigation is fixed. The problem of opening new windows is fixed, and the user experience of ChatGPT and Twitter applications is optimized.

chunks.title: V2.3.5 More Rigorous
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V2.3.5, the hide title bar feature is customized specifically for the Mac version without affecting other platforms. The release adapts to recent updates of ChatGPT, YouTube Music, Xiaohongshu, Poe, and others, especially the major revamp of ChatGPT. Support for packaging pages with the HTTP protocol is finally added, including internal loading of HTTP. A compatibility issue with packaging local HTML files is fixed, and unnecessary configurations and files are streamlined.

chunks.title: V2.3.6 More simplified
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V2.3.6, the option to display the menu bar is removed to keep the default behavior simpler, and the URL direct access feature is removed. All menu bar icons are now settable and displayed without blur for easier recognition. On Mac, the issue where clicking close would minimize the display is fixed to match the system's default behavior. For command-line packaging, a faster source is used for domestic users, and all dependencies are updated to the latest versions.

chunks.title: V2.5.1 Better understand
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V2.5.1, new features include support for setting activation shortcuts, always-on-top windows, and disabling web shortcuts. Local file packaging changes iterCopyFile to useLocalFile, and the immersive header changes from transparent to hideTitleBar. Packaging speed for domestic users is improved, unused packaging configurations are hidden, the underlying layer is upgraded, and code is simplified. Menu bar icon configuration is supported with non-blurred display, and the interaction of clicking close on Mac is fixed to be consistent with native behavior.

chunks.title: V2.6.1 Always there
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V2.6.0 (tagged V2.6.0, titled V2.6.1 Always there), support is added for setting the language in Windows packaging, running Pake using Docker on Linux, and adding titles to apps on Linux and Windows. The handling of hyperlink jumps within packaged web pages is optimized, and a system bug with closing windows in full-screen mode on Mac is resolved. Support for enforcing dark mode on Mac is added. Documentation image URLs are updated to ensure correct loading.

chunks.title: V3.0.3 Major update
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.0.3, the underlying Tauri dependency is updated to version 2.0, along with command-line and Actions modes, making it more powerful and facilitating future mobile version support. Command-line parameters are simplified, removing the need for safeDomain and adding proxyUrl proxy capability. Single-instance mode is supported by default, especially preventing multiple windows on Windows, and window closing issues are fixed. Popular applications like ChatGPT, Xiaohongshu, and YouTube Music are adapted to their original site updates, with container support for drag-and-drop and file uploads.

chunks.title: V3.1.1 Happy New Year
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.1.1, the official Pake package now supports Excalidraw, Gemini, and DeepSeek. Pake CLI supports configuring package versions and packaging in deb, AppImage, and RPM formats on Linux, with the 'all' option removed. Message notification capability is re-enabled, allowing web notifications to be transformed into native app notifications. Fullscreen settings are supported in Action packaging, and the usage logic of other parameters and CLI is simplified.

chunks.title: V3.2.16 Cheeky 🐝
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.2.16, smart icon retrieval automatically fetches high-quality website icons when none is provided. CLI functionality is greatly enhanced with new parameters: --proxy, --incognito, --title, --hide-on-close, --inject for multi-file injection. Icon display issues on Linux and Windows are fixed. Desktop application enhancements include window position memory, fixed external link navigation, Windows system theme auto-adaptation, and single instance mode updates. A brand new GitHub Actions workflow system is introduced with refactored quality and test workflows, a Contributors update workflow, and complete Release workflow support. The injection system is refactored with enhanced CSS injection, rewritten event handling, and optimized built-in component injection. CLI core improvements include support for app names with spaces and pure numbers, improved hyphenated naming, removal of is-url dependency, and replacement of shelljs with execa. The development toolchain is upgraded with Node.js minimum version >=16.0.0, latest stable Rust, full pnpm support, and Prettier integration. Build system optimization includes Docker Rust base image upgrade to 1.82-slim, cross-platform build fixes, and multi-stage build optimization. User experience improvements include optimized ChatGPT and AI tool interactions, improved icon display, and standardized file naming. A complete test suite is added with core functionality tests, GitHub Actions integration tests, and release process tests. Important bug fixes address Linux packaging file issues, Windows ICO icon copying, multi-file injection CLI issues, and window position memory.

chunks.title: V3.3.5 Smooth😊
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.3.5, the right-click menu is enhanced to support downloading images and opening links for a more native desktop experience. Multi-platform experience is optimized with fixes for icon display on Linux and Windows, improved 'hide on close' behavior, and singleton mode window recovery stability. Drag-and-drop file functionality is added via --enable-drag-drop. GitHub Actions integration is added with Action files for other repositories to directly use Pake for app packaging. Development experience is greatly improved by migrating from npm to pnpm, upgrading Tauri CLI and Commander dependencies, and raising the minimum Node.js version to 18.0.0. Advanced features include --keep-binary to preserve binary files and enhanced WebAssembly scenario support.

chunks.title: V3.4.0 Panda Magic 🐼
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.4.0, new options --maximize and --start-to-tray are added to start the window maximized or hidden in the menu bar by default. Chinese application name display issues are fixed so they appear correctly in title bars and system menus across all platforms. Multiple instances of the same application can now run simultaneously using --multi-instance. The --hide-on-close parameter allows applications to hide to the system tray when closed instead of quitting. Blob scene downloading is supported, properly handling blob-type file downloads. The issue of using local icon files is fixed, allowing direct use of local images as icons.

chunks.title: V3.4.3 Panda Magic 🐼
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.4.3, packaging issues under Linux systems are further optimized, improving compatibility and the AppImage format packaging process. The proxy setting issue on Windows is fixed. This release also includes the changelog from V3.4.0, which added --maximize and --start-to-tray options, fixed Chinese name display, supported multiple instances, hide-on-close, blob downloading, and local icon files.

chunks.title: V3.5.1 More inclusive 🙆🏻
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.5.1, a new --force-internal-navigation flag is added to keep all page navigations inside Pake. The internal file download experience is improved by preventing duplicate downloads and fixing PNG conversion issues on Linux. Build scripts and dependency configurations are updated to improve output and resource stability, ensuring logs remain visible in all scenarios.

chunks.title: V3.6.0 Handsome 🥷🏻
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.6.0, a brand-new native menu system is introduced with Navigation, View, Edit, Window, and Help menus, along with richer shortcuts for back/forward/home, refresh, zoom, copy URL, and always-on-top toggle. Multi-party login support is systematically fixed for Google, GitHub, and more by improving window.open and auth popup interception. Auto theme adaptation is added so the macOS titlebar intelligently switches between light and dark based on webpage theme changes. Stronger CLI controls include --zoom, --min-width, --min-height, and improved --force-internal-navigation. Windows install optimization fixes potential dependency install timeouts with smart retries and automatic CN mirror fallback. A CSS injection fix resolves failures caused by special characters. Dependencies are updated to the latest Tauri v2.x, and the minimum Rust version is now 1.85.0.

chunks.title: V3.7.2 Easier 🎄
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.7.2, performance optimizations are introduced with Rust release profile optimizations including LTO and size reduction, resulting in smaller binaries and faster performance. Intelligent media handling fixes an issue where CDN images and videos were incorrectly treated as downloads, adding smart detection for 25+ media formats to preview in-app. Local icon support checks for existing local icons before downloading, reducing build times, and migrates from axios to native fetch API. Error handling is enhanced by replacing unsafe Rust code with proper error propagation, and the menu system is refactored with better error messages and macOS optimizations. Linux packaging is improved with consistent binary naming across DEB, RPM, and AppImage formats, and improved desktop file generation with full RPM support. Testing infrastructure is added with 600+ lines of unit and integration tests. Dependencies are updated, including Tauri to v2.9.5, and axios is completely removed in favor of native APIs.

chunks.title: V3.8.1 Magical 🦧
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.8.1, a --new-window parameter is added to support login flows that open a new window (OAuth, SSO), fully wired through CLI to Tauri window creation. Fullscreen video support is added with an HTML5 Fullscreen compatibility layer in the inject script for sites like YouTube. Linux packaging is expanded with RPM bundling support and multi-target builds, with defaults now including deb and AppImage. Linux stability and focus fixes include disabling WebKit DMABUF renderer by default, improving fullscreen input focus handling, and correctly restoring fullscreen from tray/start-to-tray flows. macOS window behavior is changed so closing a window hides it directly instead of minimizing, with added window control permissions and Dock re-open restoring hidden windows. Theme and UX polish makes the default theme follow system settings, with explicit light/dark overrides only when specified.

chunks.title: V3.9.1 Regular 🌝
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.9.1, Windows DPI and zoom fixes improve high DPI window sizing via primary monitor scale factor and refine page zoom behavior. Linux window stability improvements fix window control focus issues on Ubuntu 24.04 GNOME and improve close behavior for correct window state saving. Editing experience is enhanced with Paste and Match Style, including a menu entry and shortcut-driven plain text paste flow. macOS packaging is upgraded with signing and notarization, a DMG background and layout, and a fix for DMG background display in CI builds.

chunks.title: V3.10.0 Eleven 🎃
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.10.0, multi-window support is added with a --multi-window flag, allowing multiple windows within a single app instance, with a 'New Window' entry in the macOS File menu and system tray menu. Internal URL regex control is added with --internal-url-regex for fine-grained control over internal links. Windows ICO icon entries are reordered to prioritize 256px images for better display quality. The DMG background image is fixed by restoring retina metadata and adjusting dimensions for correct CI display.

chunks.title: V3.11.0 Evolve 👻
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.11.0, macOS auto-install is added with --install to move the built app to /Applications. Managed new windows are supported with --new-window to open popup and OAuth windows inside the app. macOS media permissions are added with --camera and --microphone flags. Distinct app identifiers are supported with --identifier for custom bundle IDs. Icon fallback source integrates dashboard-icons CDN. A Linux AppImage crash fix ensures auto-generated identifiers start with a letter. A Gemini download fix handles blob URL downloads via fetch() when not in cache. A zoom rendering fix dispatches a resize event after CSS zoom on macOS. A Windows icon copy fix resolves a build error for pre-registered apps. A macOS new-window crash fix addresses a WebKit-incompatible window feature call.

chunks.title: Pake V3.11.5 Ironclad
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.11.5, a Linux Wayland blank screen fix disables WebKit compositing mode by default. A macOS new-window crash fix resolves duplicate WKUserContentController script handler registration and adds Rust panic safety hardening. A CSP style injection fix switches from innerHTML to textContent for style injection. macOS dock badge support is added via the Web Badging API. Incognito mode is added with --incognito for private browsing. Window size options --width and --height are added. CN mirror is made strictly opt-in via PAKE_USE_CN_MIRROR=1. x.com selector updates fix a broken search bar and update CSS selectors. Windows ICO transparency is fixed by building PNG-in-ICO format. Notification onclick callbacks are fixed. User-agent strings are updated. File extension handling fixes a crash when downloading files without an extension. macOS native menu surfaces Move and Resize options. A macOS ARM64 build fix pins sharp-libvips to a single version.

chunks.title: Pake V3.11.7 Steady
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the tw93/Pake release V3.11.7, optional in-page find is added with --enable-find, enabling Cmd/Ctrl+F, Cmd/Ctrl+G, and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+G. Native find menu integration adds Find, Find Next, and Find Previous to the Edit menu when enabled. pnpm 11 compatibility fix falls back to npm if the installed pnpm major version differs from the pinned version. Trusted npm publishing is added via GitHub Actions OIDC for pake-cli. A release version guard is added with scripts/check-release-version.mjs and pnpm run release:check. Maintainer release guidance is hardened around public artifact verification and post-release issue follow-through.

questions.query_text: In the tw93/Pake releases, which release introduces a brand-new native menu system with Navigation, View, Edit, Window, and Help menus, along with richer shortcuts?

answer_support.answer_text: a brand-new native menu system is introduced with Navigation, View, Edit, Window, and Help menus, along with richer shortcuts

questions.query_text: Across the tw93/Pake releases, how does the multi-window support introduced in V3.10.0 differ from the managed new windows feature added in V3.11.0?

options.text: V3.10.0 adds a --multi-window flag for multiple windows within a single instance, while V3.11.0 adds --new-window to open popup and OAuth windows as managed webview windows inside the app.
V3.10.0 adds --new-window for OAuth flows, while V3.11.0 adds --multi-window for multiple instances.
Both releases add the same multi-window feature but with different parameter names.
V3.10.0 removes multi-window support, and V3.11.0 reintroduces it with OAuth handling.

questions.expected_answer: V3.10.0 adds a --multi-window flag for multiple windows within a single instance, while V3.11.0 adds --new-window to open popup and OAuth windows as managed webview windows inside the app.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent typeorm/typeorm release stream from 0.3.2 through 1.0.0, covering bug fixes, new features, driver enhancements, and breaking changes across the 0.3.x series and the 1.0.0 milestone.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.2, the project fixes a broken CLI in ESM projects since version 0.3.0, adds typeorm CLI variations that include ts-node, allows users to specify which mysql package should be used, and reverts a json/jsonb change introduced in 0.3.1.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.3, the project improves initialization of custom repositories, resolves entities correctly in datasource when globs are specified, fixes missing console output in CLI migration:run since 0.3.1, and adds support for Common Table Expressions.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.4, the project fixes a BaseEntity.reload method regression and makes findOne throw an error on missing conditions, improves DeepPartial recursion, fixes missing timestamp in created migration filenames, fixes a PoolConnection leak in MysqlDriver, removes console.log calls from SelectQueryBuilder, stops crashing when redis is offline with ignoreErrors set, adds support for insert with alias, and adds an applicationName parameter for CockroachDB.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.5, the project fixes the .save repository method not returning generated uuids for aurora-postgres, allows hstore type to use transformers in postgres driver, fixes broken shebang parameters of cli-ts-node-commonjs and cli-ts-node-esm on some linux distros, supports false values in find select object api, resolves missing ConnectionOptions export in index.ts, saves correct discriminator with STI, updates DeepPartial for usage of generics with Repository class, and fixes an issue with the typeorm init command.
In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.6, the project adds a for_key_share (FOR KEY SHARE) lock mode for the postgres driver and introduces a new driver for Cloud Spanner.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.7, the project adds missing enumName support for EntitySchema, adds missing connect call on RedisQueryResultCache, adds SET TRANSACTION AUTOCOMMIT DDL statements for SAP HANA, calls dataSource.destroy() only on initialized dataSource in CLI commands, fixes an expo infinite loop on SAVEPOINT, fixes recursive document to entity attributes mapping, logs command error prior to calling destroy, makes soft-remove and recover events importable from index, displays the name of the migration file on successful migration, releases newly created runner when no runner provided in DbQueryResultCache, resolves cli init peer dependency issues, resolves ESM module declaration file correctly, adds support for TypeScript 4.8, updates mssql peerDependency, fixes wrong entity transform of relation id when referenced column is a primary key, and adds for_key_share lock mode for postgres driver.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.8, the project allows space and no-space syntaxes for SQLite constraints, allows where IsNull for ManyToOne relations, changes postgres driver version checking query, avoids using temporary table name to create foreign key/unique/check constraint with SQLite, makes dropIndex work when providing a tableIndex without name, fixes entity manager remove using entity schemas, fixes find query mongodb properly with @DeleteDateColumn(), handles inherited relations insert order, passes error to pgpool release, fixes QueryBuilder update handling Date objects wrong on a ManyToOne relationship, resolves FindOptionsOrder.nulls to allow FIRST/LAST in uppercase, resolves issues with new synonymous for GeometryCollection type in MySQL 8, makes sqlite temporary tables honor withoutRowid, and supports async import for DataSource in CLI.
In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.9, the project fixes a regression introduced in 0.3.8 that broke the CLI.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.10, the project fixes a "Cannot commit, no transaction is active" error in sql.js, adds missing support for primaryKeyConstraintName property in EntitySchema, fixes malformed query when selecting deeply nested embedded entities, addresses a prototype pollution issue, fixes TypeScript 4.8 type issues, updates RelationIdLoader to use DriverUtils.getAlias, adds orphanedRowAction=disabled, adds deferrable options for foreign keys in sqlite, unifies Pool max connection size in supported Drivers, and updates db image versions in docker compose.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.11, the project fixes boolean parameter escape in SQLiteDriver, fixes cacheId not used when loading relations with take, correctly returns insertId for react-native, disables transactionSupport option for CordovaDriver, explicitly defines property for entity relation as enumerable, fixes ormUtils prototype check crashing on null prototype, fixes outdated init command, uses left instead of inner join for where or + optional relations, marks array arguments to find operators as read-only, passes fake flag to undoLastMigration, resolves issue with migrations and unsigned int columns in aurora-data-api, resolves nameless TableForeign on drop foreign key, synchronizes with typeorm_metadata table only if needed, fixes the mpath when the parent of the tree entity is null, fixes typings for Repository.extend function, and adds an "And" operator in FindOptions.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.12, the project allows passing ObjectLiteral in mongo find where condition, fixes DataSource.setOptions not properly updating the database in drivers, fixes a grammar error in no migrations found log, improves FindOptionsWhere behavior with union types, fixes incorrect enum default value when table name contains dash character, fixes incorrect sorting of entities with multi-inheritances, ensures require is defined in the environment, adds materialized hints support for CTE, fixes multiple select queries during db sync in sqlite, fixes overriding caching settings when alwaysEnabled is true, removes redundant Unique constraint on primary join column in Postgres, removes unnecessary .js extension in imports, resolves issue with simple-enum synchronization in SQLite, fixes sql expression when where parameter is empty array, fixes synchronizing View with schema broken for oracle, adds find operator json contains, allows mysql2 v3 as peerDependency, and adds naming strategy for legacy Oracle.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.13, the project fixes firstCapital=true not working in camelCase() function, handles query relation loading strategy for TreeRepositories, improves EntityNotFound error message in QueryBuilder.findOneOrFail, fixes loading tables with fk in sqlite query runner, prevents foreign key support during migration batch under sqlite, fixes proper default value on generating migration when default value is a function calling in Postgres, fixes react-native not properly working in ESM projects due to circular dependency, resolves issues for mssql migration when simple-enum was changed, resolves issue with mssql column recreation, transforms values for FindOperators, uses forward slashes when normalizing path, uses object create if entity skip constructor is set, adds support for json datatype for sqlite, adds support for STI on EntitySchema, and allows type FindOptionsOrderValue for order by object property.
In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.14, the project drops xml and yml connection option support to address security issues in an underlying dependency, and adds QueryBuilder performance optimizations.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.15, the project makes cache optional fields optional, prevents unique index identical to primary key in all sql dialects, fixes SelectQueryBuilder building incorrectly escaped alias in Oracle when used on entity with composite key, and adds support for the latest mongodb v5.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.16, the project adds trustServerCertificate option to SqlServerConnectionOptions, adds directConnection options to MongoDB connection, adds onDelete option validation for oracle, adds instanceName to options, adds transaction retry logic in cockroachdb, allows json as alias for longtext mariadb, converts the join table ID to the referenceColumn ID type, corrects encode mongodb auth credentials, creates correct children during cascade saving entities with STI, fixes express option bug in init command, uses exit code from child process for running cli-ts-node-esm, fixes mongodb typings breaking the browser version, fixes RelationIdLoader access to queryPlanner when wrapped in transaction, resolves duplicate subscriber updated columns, and fixes select + addOrderBy broken in 0.3.14.
In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.17, the project fixes TypeORM synchronizing database even if it is up to date and adds a missing await.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.18, the project adds BaseEntity to model-shim, adds error handling for missing join columns, adds missing export for View class, adds fail callback while opening the database in Cordova, fixes aggregate function throwing error when column alias name is set, backports postgres connection error handling to crdb, bumps better-sqlite3 version range, fixes caching always enabled not caching queries, fixes circular dependency breaking node.js 20.6, correctly keeps query.data from ormOption for commit/rollback subscribers, fixes default value in child table/entity column decorator for multiple table inheritance being ignored for inherited columns, fixes deletedAt column leaking as side effect of object update while creating a row, fixes empty objects being hydrated when eager loading relations that have a @VirtualColumn, extends GiST index with range types for Postgres driver, ignores changes for columns with update: false in persistence, and improves helper for cli for commands missing positionals.
In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.19, the project fixes a "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'sync')" error caused after a glob package upgrade.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.20, the project adds missing parentheses in where conditions, avoids escaping indexPredicate, falls back runMigrations transaction to DataSourceOptions, fixes hangup when loading relations with relationLoadStrategy: query, includes asExpression columns in returning clause, fixes multiple insert in SAP Hana, resolves issue with CREATE/DROP Index concurrently, fixes type inferencing of EntityManager#create, adds json type support for Oracle, adds postgres multirange column types, adds table comment for postgres, reverts a fix preventing absolute table path in migrations unless required, and reverts nullable embedded entities feature.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.21, the project moves reflect-metadata to peerDependencies with version ^0.1.14 || ^0.2.0, updates documentation, replaces Slack links with Discord, adds GitHub Actions for tests CI/CD, splits SQLite tests and fixes better-sqlite3, applies formatting, updates packages, removes CircleCI, expands node version matrix to node16, node18, and node20, redoes cockroachdb to service-container GHA and updates its version to latest (24), removes github issues as a suggested place for questions, removes links to defunct Vesper project, adds lint on GitHub actions, refines markdown language, updates QueryResultCache method descriptions, migrates to ESLint flat config, updates select-query-builder.md, refactors to use node:fs/promises, updates copyright year to 2025, fixes typos, and updates various documentation pages.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.22, the project fixes transaction not ending correctly, adds a FAQ entry for using Vite for the backend, stops using version in docker-compose files, passes the configured schema to the db client for SAP, fixes incorrect handling of simple array/json data type in SAP, adds VirtualColumn to model shim, removes unnecessary import from JS migration, renames tests, sets timezone to UTC in tests, adds CodeQL workflow, fixes empty objects being hydrated when eager loading relations with @VirtualColumn, fixes and runs tests on Windows, supports macaddr8 column type in postgres, runs format in CI, lints repository, ensures correct MSSQL parameter conversion in where conditions, updates dependencies, fixes FindOptionsSelect to use correct type when property is an object, refactors database server version fetching and comparison, improves test workflow, sets up SAP HANA tests, exports QueryEvent before/after types, fixes mongodb connection options, incorporates wrapping metadata for MongoDB client instances, fixes bulk insert NULL values in Oracle, removes unnecessary spaces in message when running non-fake migrations, fixes sql escape issues identified by CodeQL, normalizes deprecated/removed data types in SAP HANA Cloud, fixes version detection for Postgres derived variants, supports Expo SQLite Next, adds comment explaining select version(), fixes incorrect table alias in insert orUpdate with Postgres driver, and adds package publishing workflow.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.23, the project introduces a breaking change where delete and update methods of EntityManager and Repository APIs throw an error when an empty object is supplied as criteria, instead of deleting or updating all rows. It also fixes the publish command, bumps tar-fs, adds new foreign key decorator and entity schemas options, fixes changelog generation, builds ESM migrations for JS, documents primary key availability in UpdateEvent, removes unused type parameter from decorators, adds query timeout support for MySql, adds logging to Entity Listener Metadata, propagates aggregate method's generic parameter to its returned cursor, defines Position type for GeoJSON objects, uses Date.now() instead of +new Date() in query-runner, adds FormattedConsoleLogger, updates repository additional chunk option usage example, corrects its to it's in docs, prevents error when replication is undefined, changes how array columns are compared on column changed detection, sets up testing matrix for postgres 14 and 17, fixes beforeQuery promises not awaited before query execution, cleans up after streaming in SAP, releases PR releases using pkg.pr.new, clarifies where to add new tests, and fixes update/delete/softDelete by criteria of condition objects.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.24, the project adds tagged template for executing raw SQL queries, adds husky and lint-staged, resolves pkg.pr.new issue, improves save performance during entities update, removes unused NamingStrategyNotFoundError, adds note about breaking change in 0.3.23, includes db version in coveralls flag-name, includes warning about update({}) in changelog, adds updateAll and deleteAll methods to EntityManager and Repository APIs, fixes MSSQL find operator, supports insert returning in spanner, clarifies commit practices, avoids mutating input parameter array values in MSSQL, fixes capacitor driver PRAGMA bug, and bumps version to 0.3.24.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.25, the project uses correct SQL statements in softDelete/restore comments, resolves alias or table name in upsert and orUpdate for PostgreSQL driver conditionally, uses credentials from connection options in spanner, adds upsert support for Oracle, SQLServer and SAP HANA, handles limit(0) and offset(0) correctly in SelectQueryBuilder, adds collation update detection in PostgresDriver, adds typesense/docsearch-scraper, improves linting, commits new website initial, fixes doc search workflow, updates workflows to ignore changes in docs directory, adds Plausible analytics script to Docusaurus config, adds note about using YugabyteDB, improves website generation config, fixes closure junction table primary key definition in tree-entity, adds heading to Getting Started page, fixes multiple relations with same columns causing invalid SQL, fixes null pointer exception on date array column comparison, simplifies CI workflows, and improves async calls on disconnect.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.26, the project notes that when using MySQL, TypeORM now connects using stringifyObjects: true to avoid a potential security vulnerability, and when using SAP HANA, TypeORM now uses the built-in pool from the @sap/hana-client library. It removes manual trigger on publish workflow, forces mocha to exit on stuck process, passes duplicated parameters correctly to the client in Oracle, adds support for REAL_VECTOR and HALF_VECTOR data types in SAP HANA Cloud, adds stricter type-checking and improves event loop handling, avoids unnecessary count on getManyAndCount, uses the native driver for connection pooling in SAP, supports better-sqlite3 v12, preserves useIndex when cloning a QueryExpressionMap or QueryBuilder, changes test badge, does not create junction table metadata when it already exists, supports AnalyticDB returning version() column name in getVersion() for MySQL, resolves array modification bug in QueryRunner drop methods, sets stringifyObjects implicitly for MySQL, separates driver-specific documentation, fixes redirect to mongodb page, adds Redis 5.x support with backward compatibility, fixes regtype not supported in aurora serverless v2, improves globalThis variable retrieval for web worker platform, adds @piying/orm extension to readme, fixes reload option typo, and adds entity mode virtual-property.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.27, the project reverts a fix from 0.3.26 that prevented creating junction table metadata when it already exists due to a regression. It caches package.json location between getNearestPackageJson invocations, allows VirtualColumns to be initially non-selectable, bumps sha.js, adds @signalwire/docusaurus-plugin-llms-txt to documentation, adds package.json exports for react-native, avoids using lazy count when offset exceeds total in getManyAndCount, bumps sha.js again for security, fixes docs for UpdateDateColumn, bumps axios, improves JSDoc types in generated migration templates, updates tests to reflect migration template changes, adds support for MySQL 9 / MariaDB 12, adds close stale issues GH action, adds new undefined and null behavior flags, supports vector/halfvec data types in postgres, fixes JSON parsing for mysql2 client library, and reverts the junction table metadata fix.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.28, the project bumps brace-expansion, updates dependencies, fixes package preview, adds multiSubnetFailover to mssql driver option types, introduces jsdoc eslint plugin, adds support for jsonpath column type in PostgreSQL, adds entity schema support for trees, removes close stale issues GH action, removes unused docs example file, updates jsdoc link to PostgreSQL documentation, bumps actions/setup-node to v5, picks dependencies versions from own package.json in cli/init, enables jsdoc/valid-types rule, enhances llms.txt, bumps actions/checkout version, harmonizes MongoDB version used in CI and bumps to v8, removes contradictory statement in Active Record/Data Mapper guide, fixes typos in documentation, adds SOCKS5 proxy settings to MongoDB connector, fixes link to email for vulnerabilities, removes commented out code in FindOptionsUtils, collects all migrations documentation in one place, fixes lint offenses, fixes circular import in SapDriver.ts, bumps eslint, fixes broken migration links, tests if docs build, controls development and CI version of Node.js via .nvmrc, adds single step to validate if all tests passed, and prevents running docs index on forks.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.29, the project fixes aggregate methods ambiguous column, prevents eager-loaded entities from overwriting manual relations, releases query runner when there is no migration to revert, adds async to method using setFindOptions(), disables eslint errors for chai assertions, removes limitation of branches to run on in CI tests, upgrades actions to v6, adds version dropdown (stable/dev) to docs, fixes QueryBuilder parameter of type JS Date not escaped correctly in SAP, adds pool timeout in SAP, enables new review experience in v0.3, adds returning option to update/upsert operations, enables repository-returning test, disables in progress notification in v0.3, adds deploy Github Action to v0.3 branch, disables persistent comments and inline code suggestions in v0.3, updates all dependencies to latest minor version, fixes redis cache version detection, removes summary comments location policy, removes /improve from pr and push commands, migrates from npm to pnpm, syncs qodo pr agent config from master, removes docs indexing, validates limit() in Update/SoftDelete query builders for security, updates all minor dependencies, and releases 0.3.29.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 0.3.30, the project scopes invalidWhereValuesBehavior to high-level abstractions only, scopes computed-columns join to correct table in MSSQL schema query, preserves user-defined shared join columns in change set, reverts a fix for limit with joins, allows array values in JsonContains in find-options, adjusts join in loadTables to load correct table columns for cockroachdb, uses the v0.3 branch as base for detect-changes in CI, and releases 0.3.30.

In the typeorm/typeorm release 1.0.0, the project announces TypeORM v1.0 with breaking changes and an upgrade guide. It includes joined entity primary keys in pagination subquery, adds support for PostgreSQL indices, removes legacy expo driver, preserves structured query results during txn retry replay in cockroachdb, adds version dropdown to docs, links to queryrunner api docs, adds error handling and log warning for ormconfig loading failures, removes shajs, sets up pnpm, moves docs to PNPM, adds better typing for conditions in increment and decrement of EntityManager, fixes getPendingMigrations unnecessarily creating migrations table, copies cordova query rows affected into query result, resolves nameless TableForeignKey on drop foreign key, adds Kapa.ai widget for AI-powered documentation assistance, fixes virtual property handling in schema builder, correctly processes embedded arrays of nested documents in mongo, uses ADD VALUE when changing enum values if possible in postgres, adds mutation testing and mutation score badge, changes import for process dependency, adapts Stryker mutator to pnpm, sends only mutation score to Stryker dashboard, fixes working with tables with quotes in names for postgres and cockroachdb, replaces uuid with native Crypto API, fixes getVersion returning undefined for PolarDB-X 2.0 in mysql, aligns test file names, ensures pull requests follow conventional commits spec, enables new review experience, and modifies tests to confirm ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT on PostgreSQL/CockroachDB.
