prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent ultralytics/ultralytics release stream from v8.4.31 to v8.4.60, covering INT8 calibration fixes, Axelera export expansion, training resume improvements, multi-dataset tuning, NaN recovery, checkpoint regression fixes, NDJSON-based tuning, export unification, per-image metrics, SAM3 tracking fixes, OOM recovery, NDJSON validation, pretrained argument consistency, multiscale training fixes, CLI colormap parsing, platform training edge cases, fail-fast training, DeepX integration, Git metadata, YOLO semantic segmentation, CUDA memory retry, QNN export, ONNX INT8 export, and CI isolation.

chunks.title: v8.4.31 - `ultralytics 8.4.31` INT8 calibration with non-square `imgsz` (#24028)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.31, the main update fixes INT8 export calibration for non-square image sizes, ensuring correct calibration for commands like imgsz=640,480 with int8 across OpenVINO, TFLite, TensorRT engine, and IMX targets. The release also refactors the export system into per-format utility modules, improves Apple Silicon stability with more aggressive memory clearing on MPS devices, enhances auto-batch estimation for multi-scale training, adds a COCO-to-YOLO conversion guide and a YOLO26 training recipe guide, clarifies video inference support on dedicated endpoints in platform docs, tightens dataset conversion validation for NDJSON-to-YOLO, and updates CI with ubuntu-latest runners, Codecov v6, and PyTorch 2.11.0 coverage.

chunks.title: v8.4.32 - `ultralytics 8.4.32` Expand Axelera exportable models and tasks (#23844)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.32, the primary focus is expanding Axelera AI export support. The Axelera export logic is moved into a dedicated utility module, and the export flow now uses a reusable torch2axelera helper. Support is broadened to cover more YOLO tasks across YOLOv8, YOLO11, and YOLO26, with task-aware calibration defaults via TASK2CALIBRATIONDATA. The release also updates Axelera runtime dependencies to axelera-rt/axelera-devkit 1.6.0rc3, adds Python examples for YOLO26 pose+tracking and YOLO11 segmentation, heavily updates Axelera integration docs with supported tasks, Python versions, install steps, and benchmarks, and clarifies Ultralytics Platform docs on multi-task annotation persistence, dataset upload formats, and plan-based upload limits.

chunks.title: v8.4.33 - `ultralytics 8.4.33` Progressive loss train resume fix (#24074)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.33, the key fix restores correct loss state when resuming training for end-to-end models, ensuring one-to-one and one-to-many training behavior continues properly after checkpoint loading. The release also upgrades Ray Tune support by adding search_alg to model.tune() with options like optuna, hyperopt, bohb, ax, nevergrad, zoopt, and random, improves BOHB scheduler handling, and fixes CoreML export for detection models with nms=True by passing explicit output shape.

chunks.title: v8.4.34 - `ultralytics 8.4.34` Multi-dataset support for hyperparameter tuning (#24067)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.34, the major new feature is multi-dataset hyperparameter tuning, where model.tune() now accepts a list of datasets, trains on each, and averages fitness across them. The release also fixes training resume stability by keeping AdamW's exp_avg_sq in FP32, adds thread-safe ONNX export with locking, handles DDP cleanup failures, fixes AAttn for non-divisible dim/num_heads, clamps negative coordinates in crop_mask(), makes draw_specific_kpts() respect user keypoint order, and refreshes documentation with YOLO26 benchmarks across Jetson and SAM docs, including cuDSS dependency instructions for JetPack 6.

chunks.title: v8.4.35 - `ultralytics 8.4.35` NaN training recovery and dataset cache improvements (#24154)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.35, training NaN recovery is improved by recovering from last_good.pt instead of last.pt and skipping checkpoint saves when EMA weights contain NaN/Inf. Detection dataset cache reliability is upgraded: empty caches are not written, corrupt labels give clearer errors, dataset checks accept a directory directly, and NDJSON-to-YOLO cached conversions are rebuilt when split folders are missing. The release also throttles repeated Platform: Model not found warnings, improves OpenVINO device fallback and forces FP32 on Linux ARM64 CPU, prevents duplicate pretrained weight loading for YAML configs, fixes W&B resume to continue the original run, adds backward compatibility for older YOLO12 Area Attention checkpoints, and fixes SAM3 decoder cache-miss dtype.

chunks.title: v8.4.36 - `ultralytics 8.4.36` Fix platform training checkpoint regression (#24167)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.36, a critical training fix restores checkpoint-backed model seeding so that if a .pt model is already loaded, training reuses that loaded model directly, preventing the trainer from incorrectly relying on trainer.args.model in Platform/HUB flows. The release also adds a regression test for this checkpoint path, updates Platform docs to require ultralytics>=8.4.35, clarifies Platform deployment defaults and account routes, corrects Explorer docs to note removal in >=8.3.12, and updates Jetson DeepStream links for older JetPack versions.

chunks.title: v8.4.37 - `ultralytics 8.4.37` NDJSON-based multidataset hyperparameter tuning (#24192)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.37, hyperparameter tuning logs are moved from CSV to NDJSON with per-dataset fitness tracking for multi-dataset runs, and plot/output naming is updated. The release adds a cls_pw hyperparameter to weight underrepresented classes during detection training, saves first-epoch checkpoints even if EMA has invalid values, fixes local zip dataset regression in HUB/Platform training, improves compute_ap precision, reduces duplicate model info prints in DDP training, updates OpenVINO links for YOLO26 optimization notebooks, and updates Platform docs for the new Settings > API Keys flow.

chunks.title: v8.4.38 - `ultralytics 8.4.38` Unify args naming for standalone export functions (#24120)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.38, standalone export behavior is unified across CoreML, ONNX, OpenVINO, TensorFlow, TorchScript, ExecuTorch, Axelera, RKNN, IMX, NCNN, MNN, and Paddle, with CoreML now using the model's real input name and export helper functions standardized. The release also fixes YOLOE export edge case by skipping incompatible fusion, improves dependency auto-install fallback, updates RKNN toolkit requirement to >=2.3.2, fixes resume for non-end2end models, adjusts DDP setup order, skips checkpoint saves when EMA weights contain invalid values, corrects track_buffer to behave as a true frame count in ByteTrack/BoT-SORT, and fixes SAM3 presence-logit clamp and text-only prompting.

chunks.title: v8.4.39 - `ultralytics 8.4.39` Use dashed incremented run paths (#24193)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.39, dashed incremented run paths become the default, so increment_path() now creates names like exp-2 and results-2.txt. The release adds CLI parity for Solutions with direct commands for yolo solutions region, security, and parking, fixes in-place modification of gt_bboxes in RotatedTaskAlignedAssigner, hardens security alarm email sending by checking mail server configuration, improves CI workflow resilience with retry wrappers, and updates documentation to reduce Explorer references in favor of the Ultralytics Platform, clarify Sony IMX500 supported variants, correct Neptune/MLflow integration docs, and fix Platform AP region label.

chunks.title: v8.4.40 - `ultralytics 8.4.40` Per-image Precision and Recall (#24089)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.40, per-image precision, recall, and F1 tracking are introduced during validation, exposed via metrics.box.image_metrics for detection, segmentation, and pose tasks. The detection validation pipeline is updated to store image names and compute image-level stats, and distributed validation support gathers and merges image_metrics across ranks. Metrics classes are extended with image_metrics storage, update helpers, and clear/reset helpers, and documentation is updated with examples for accessing per-image metrics.

chunks.title: v8.4.41 - `ultralytics 8.4.41` Fix SAM3 FP ghost IDs in video tracking (#24249)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.41, SAM3 video tracking is improved by enabling masklet confirmation filtering by default to reduce false positive ghost IDs, and tracker keep-alive settings are tightened from 30 to 10. The release also makes NDJSON dataset conversion safer by using hash-qualified output folders to avoid cache collisions, adds new guides for fine-tuning YOLO26 on custom data, NVIDIA DALI GPU preprocessing, and Modal serverless quickstart, clarifies architecture-only YAMLs vs released pretrained weights, documents the cfg argument, refreshes Ultralytics Platform docs, and migrates benchmark CI runners from ubuntu-latest to cpu-latest.

chunks.title: v8.4.42 - `ultralytics 8.4.42` Free tensors before OOM batch retry (#24360)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.42, training OOM recovery is improved by explicitly clearing temporary tensors and trainer loss state before retrying when CUDA runs out of memory in early training. The release also hardens security in downloads and path handling by blocking unsafe zip/tar paths, refactors export dependency setup into per-format modules, fixes CoreML export to skip unnecessary proxy model loading, adds a guide for exporting non-YOLO PyTorch models, makes backends callable like model(x), fixes dataset loading with square brackets in folder names, fixes hyperparameter tuning checkpoint copying for multi-dataset runs, fixes plot_results() crash path, adds safety check for YOLOE head fusion, documents Platform segmentation label payloads using segments, adds Jetson memory optimization tips, and updates Axelera integration to stable SDK 1.6.0.

chunks.title: v8.4.43 - `ultralytics 8.4.43` Fix NDJSON dataset validation (#24365)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.43, a major fix unifies NDJSON and Ultralytics Platform dataset handling by adding a shared resolver convert_ndjson_to_yolo_if_needed() and applying it in both training and validation, so standalone validation now correctly resolves NDJSON and ul:// datasets. The release also adds distributed-safe handling in validation flow and replaces redundant for ... in dict.keys() loops with direct dict iteration for code quality.

chunks.title: v8.4.44 - `ultralytics 8.4.44` Apply `pretrained` arg across model trainers (#24374)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.44, the pretrained argument is fixed to work consistently across trainers: pretrained=False is now properly respected even when training from a loaded .pt checkpoint, and a custom pretrained weights path can override checkpoint weights while reusing the checkpoint's model config. The release also adds data as a valid export argument for more backends, upgrades TensorRT from 10.3 to 10.7 on JetPack 6 Docker to fix YOLO26 INT8 build issues, scopes end2end auto-disable to the specific problematic combo, blocks TensorRT 10.2.0, updates hyperparameter tuning guide to match actual tuner behavior, and adds Ultralytics Platform dataset Clustering docs.

chunks.title: v8.4.45 - `ultralytics 8.4.45` Fix pretrained checkpoint training regression (#24378)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.45, a critical hotfix restores correct pretrained training behavior so that YOLO('*.pt').train() and CLI training correctly start from pretrained checkpoint weights, with pretrained=False only disabling weight loading when explicitly set. The release also blocks TensorRT 10.2.0, unifies TensorRT dependency checks, upgrades TensorRT from 10.3 to 10.7 on JetPack 6 Docker, scopes automatic end2end disable to JetPack 6 + TensorRT 10.3.0 + INT8, adds data as a valid export argument for more formats, updates hyperparameter tuning guide, and adds Ultralytics Platform dataset Clustering docs.

chunks.title: v8.4.46 - `ultralytics 8.4.46` Fix `multiscale` minimum train size (#24394)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.46, a priority fix enforces a safe lower bound of at least one model stride for multi-scale random resizing during training, with a regression test added. The release also fixes resume training to correctly stop when already finished, improves export completion logs to show the exact artifact path, aligns export argument support for data and fraction across formats, clarifies RKNN export to block INT8-only Rockchip targets with a helpful error, and refreshes tutorial videos and docs.

chunks.title: v8.4.47 - `ultralytics 8.4.47` Fix CLI parsing for solution colormap values (#24219)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.47, a key fix resolves CLI parsing for Solutions Heatmap colormap values so commands like colormap=cv2.COLORMAP_INFERNO work correctly. The release also upgrades RT-DETR post-processing by moving top-k selection into the decoder head and standardizing inference output format, makes Edge TPU export more robust by warning and auto-enabling int8=True early, improves remote checkpoint URI support including pretrained=ul://..., fixes multiple bugs across loaders, hub session, and solutions, makes imread() return None on missing files, adds a YOLOE validation guardrail for class name mismatches, and improves results serialization for mask/keypoint summaries.

chunks.title: v8.4.48 - `ultralytics 8.4.48` Fix Platform training edge cases (#24431)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.48, platform training edge cases are fixed by adding guards for empty semantic-mask batches and empty RLE keypoint masks, making training fail with a clear error if no checkpoint is saved, and throwing a clearer error for missing ultralytics.* modules. The release also fixes benchmark/export robustness by only passing data to formats that support it, corrects Platform bestEpoch reporting to use the real best epoch from early stopping, adds a custom trainer guide section on SyncBatchNorm for multi-GPU setups, and switches Dependabot pip updates from daily to monthly.

chunks.title: v8.4.49 - `ultralytics 8.4.49` Fail fast on three common training failure modes (#24478)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.49, fail-fast training improvements are introduced: corrupt cached model files are automatically deleted and re-downloaded, training stops immediately with a clear error if freeze leaves no trainable parameters or if class filtering leaves an empty split. The release also improves DDP setup for torch.compile, fixes per-image F1 metric for images with no ground-truth and no predictions, fixes hyperparameter tuning randomness to avoid repeating mutations, fixes dataset relative path handling, prevents data argument from being incorrectly forwarded in benchmarking, removes unused frame_rate argument from trackers, updates CI runner images, and adds a Python API reference landing page.

chunks.title: v8.4.50 - ultralytics `8.4.50` New Export Integration: Deepx  (#23553)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.50, a new DeepX export and inference integration is added, allowing export with format='deepx' that converts models to .dxnn format with INT8 quantization, generates a deployment folder with config.json and metadata.yaml, and supports detection, segmentation, pose, OBB, and classification. The release also adds a DeepX inference backend, full DeepX documentation, makes hyperparameter tuning report failures honestly without writing misleading best_hyperparameters.yaml, fixes dtype issues during Conv/BN and Deconv/BN fusion in float16/bfloat16, and improves RT-DETR docs with eval_idx guidance for reducing decoder layers at inference time.

chunks.title: v8.4.51 - Add Git commit message to training metadata (#24505)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.51, training metadata now includes the Git commit message in saved checkpoints as git.message and in Platform training environment metadata as gitCommitMessage. The release also refactors the augmentation pipeline with a unified BaseTransform system, updates OpenVINO docs with YOLO26 benchmarks, expands DeepX export documentation, adds RT-DETR inference tuning guidance on reducing query count, clarifies that exported YOLOE models are static, refreshes Ultralytics Platform GPU docs with new B300 availability and pricing, and limits Axelera export tests to supported PyTorch versions.

chunks.title: v8.4.52 - `ultralytics 8.4.52` YOLO Semantic Segmentation models (#24518)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.52, full YOLO26 semantic segmentation support is added as a first-class task with new -sem pretrained model variants (yolo26n-sem.pt through yolo26x-sem.pt), dedicated SemanticSegmentationModel, Trainer, Validator, and Predictor components, a SemanticMask result type, built-in datasets like Cityscapes and ADE20K, and augmentation pipeline upgrades for semantic masks. The release also extends export and deployment support for semantic models, fixes FP16/BF16 FLOPs calculation, fixes final evaluation logging so best metrics don't overwrite the last epoch, makes validation visualizations respect show_labels and show_conf, and improves dependency handling for TensorFlow, Ray Tune, and IMX export.

chunks.title: v8.4.53 - `ultralytics 8.4.53` Retry CUDA backend memory errors during training (#24569)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.53, GPU memory recovery during training is expanded to retry on CUDNN_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR and 'unable to find an engine to execute this computation' errors during the first epoch on a single GPU, automatically reducing batch size. The release also makes semantic segmentation validation more reliable by preserving metrics correctly, improves Dice loss stability by forcing intermediate calculations to float32, adds major documentation for prediction outputs including semantic_mask, updates package metadata to reflect YOLO26 and semantic segmentation, and stabilizes CI by skipping IMX export tests in broader CI and training tests on Raspberry Pi.

chunks.title: v8.4.54 - `ultralytics 8.4.54` Qualcomm QNN export (#24591)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.54, a new qnn export format is added for Qualcomm Snapdragon devices, allowing local compilation into a QNN-ready package using ONNX Runtime's QNN Execution Provider without a Qualcomm account or SDK download, supporting CPU, GPU, and Hexagon NPU. The release also adds QNN backend support, reorganizes export documentation into Export/Predict/Validate structure, adds imgsz to all Ultralytics Solutions, fixes semantic segmentation mask loading for (H, W, 1) arrays, fixes stale .npy image cache issues, reduces SciPy dependency in tracking, improves Ray Tune compatibility for Ray 2.7+, and adds show_labels and show_conf to validation docs.

chunks.title: v8.4.55 - `ultralytics 8.4.55` Accept onnxruntime variants in ONNX export requirements check (#24611)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.55, a major export fix makes ONNX export dependency checking accept alternative onnxruntime variants like onnxruntime-qnn, onnxruntime-directml, onnxruntime-openvino, and onnxruntime-training, preventing accidental overwrites. The release also adds a new Hailo deployment guide explaining the ONNX-to-HEF workflow, updates docs to better distinguish instance and semantic segmentation, enables parallel CI tests with pytest-xdist, improves Comet documentation with environment variables, and updates GitHub Actions cache to v5.

chunks.title: v8.4.56 - Fix QNN export with built-in provider wheels (#24618)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.56, QNN export reliability is improved by detecting whether onnxruntime-qnn already includes QNNExecutionProvider internally, avoiding export failures on Linux x86-64 wheels where plugin registration could crash. The export flow now supports both plugin-based and built-in QNN wheels, and session creation is smarter based on provider type.

chunks.title: v8.4.57 - `ultralytics 8.4.57` Python 3.13 CI (#24640)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.57, Python 3.13 CI is the main focus, with testing moved to Python 3.13 across platforms and official package support metadata added. The release adds Python 3.13 compatibility guards blocking TensorFlow export on macOS+3.13, TensorFlow.js export on 3.13, and skipping Axelera export on 3.13, improves RT-DETR CoreML export by adjusting decoder parts for FP16 precision, fixes semantic segmentation mask alignment by correcting sub-pixel LetterBox padding, adds Ultralytics Platform integrations docs for importing from HUB and Roboflow, and refreshes DEEPX documentation.

chunks.title: v8.4.58 - `ultralytics 8.4.58` Isolated CI export environments (#24649)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.58, export testing is redesigned around isolated environments, with each export format declaring its own environment in the export_formats() registry and a new IsolatedExports CI workflow building dedicated virtual environments. The release splits export dependencies into targeted extras like export-base, export-tensorflow, export-coreml, export-executorch, export-deepx, and export-legacy-torch, adds checks to prevent export registry mistakes, adds an RKNN export test, and improves Docker cleanup in export images.

chunks.title: v8.4.59 - Validate RKNN INT8 calibration dataset path (#24659)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.59, RKNN INT8 calibration file validation is added so the internally generated calibration image list is checked before loading the RKNN Toolkit. The release introduces RKNN INT8 export support with int8=True, data=..., and fraction=..., expands support for INT8-only Rockchip chips like RV1103 and RV1106, updates RKNN docs to explain floating-point and INT8 export behavior, and improves RKNN API error handling by checking return values more carefully.

chunks.title: v8.4.60 - `ultralytics 8.4.60` ONNX INT8 export (#24666)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ultralytics/ultralytics release v8.4.60, ONNX INT8 export is added using ONNX Runtime static quantization, with exported files saved as *_int8.onnx and a shared calibration pipeline between ONNX and QNN. The release also adds half=True support for RKNN export, fixes segmentation training for polygons on image borders by not dropping points on edges, updates auto-annotate docs to include SAM 3 and correct default output_dir, and cleans up docs metadata.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent usememos/memos release stream from v0.22.0 through v0.29.0, covering major feature additions like inline editing, shortcuts, themes, MCP server, and SSO identity linkage, along with numerous bug fixes and performance improvements.

chunks.title: v0.22.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.22.0, the project introduces breaking changes including API v1 incompatibility, moving Telegram integration to a standalone project, refactoring S3 storage to use pre-signed URLs with synchronized deletion, and refactoring tags to display related memo counts and improve search. Enhancements include support for modifying display time when editing a memo, adding Linux/Darwin binary files to the release note, and displaying daily memos in chronological order on the timeline.

chunks.title: v0.22.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.22.1, the project adds support for quickly filtering specified content types such as links, to-dos, and codes, with a requirement to regenerate memo properties via a refresh button. Additional memo-related settings are introduced: enabling auto-collapse, enabling double-click content editing, and support for reopening the last visited page (home or timeline).

chunks.title: v0.22.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.22.2, the project adds support for displaying unfinished todo records in statistics, fixes HTML rendering to prevent XSS attacks, and adds support for the Thai language.

chunks.title: v0.22.3
chunks.memory_unit_text:
In the usememos/memos release v0.22.3, the project introduces support for editing memos directly in an inline editor instead of a dialog, and displaying tags in a tree structure. Enhancements include table syntax rendering, HTML element rendering including
, a setting to enable link previews (disabled by default), correct deletion of access tokens upon logout, and moving the disable user registration option to startup options/environment variables --public.

chunks.title: v0.22.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.22.4, the project adds a password-auth flag to control username/password login, support for changing the date when editing memos, updates the default value of public to false (disabling user registration by default), adds a calendar view on the Home page for reviewing recent activities, and removes the Timeline page.

chunks.title: v0.22.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.22.5, the project adds an enable memo comment setting, an instance URL to profile, a memo display setting menu, security-related settings, allows admin users to update other memos, implements a week start day setting, reintroduces thumbnails, supports ordering by time ascending, and includes various fixes and refactors such as retiring export memos and preview markdown dialog.

chunks.title: v0.23.0-rc.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.23.0-rc.0, the project requires database migrations and introduces features including a location selector, month toggle on hover, tag count in tree view, allowing mobile user zooming in image preview, allowing single letter user IDs, allowing disabling markdown shortcuts, implementing a graph of relations, implementing nesting lists, moving reaction type to settings, supporting Georgian language, supporting disabling change username and nickname, supporting setting global default memo visibility, using a date-picker instead of raw datetime input, and using hash router for sub-setting pages, along with various fixes.

chunks.title: v0.23.0-rc.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.23.0-rc.1, the project removes HTML renderer sanitizes, updates the activity calendar, updates i18n for Ukrainian and Vietnamese, adds Bahasa Indonesia translation, adds keyboard navigation for image view, and fixes a missing quote and missing reaction handling.

chunks.title: v0.23.0-rc.2

chunks.title: v0.23.0-rc.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.23.0-rc.3, the project fixes search conditions affected by pull-to-refresh.

chunks.title: v0.23.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.23.0, the project includes fixes for migration file naming, iframe rendering, case-insensitive memo search for Postgres, future relative dates, system theme application, UTC date for calendar filter, automatic indentation in lists, and missing reaction handling. Features include disabling change username/nickname, Slovenian translation, mobile zoom in image preview, tag count in tree view, single letter user ID, global default memo visibility, Georgian language, disabling markdown shortcuts, quick unpin, Portuguese (pt-PT) translations, Bahasa Indonesia translation, Ukrainian and Vietnamese i18n updates, keyboard navigation for image view, removing done items, UI/UX enhancements on user statistics, pull to refresh for PagedMemoList, removing RSS titles, showing less when memo expanded, and fixing webhook URL truncation.

chunks.title: v0.23.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.23.1, the project fixes a panic on ARM v5-v6-v7 builds, limits the size of the resource list viewer, fixes CSS location compatibility on Safari, optimizes memoMap generation logic, moves tags from property to payload, adds a sh entrypoint for MEMOS_DSN_FILE, enhances hyperlink handling in markdown shortcuts, persists memo filters with URL query, adds missing French and German translations, optimizes filters sync, adds scroll to top, fixes checkbox toggle remembering compact mode, adds date picker navigation, fixes mermaid diagrams in dark mode, supports setting S3 store URL style, adds Czech locale, and links to SSO documentation.

It also includes fixes for migration file separator, internal error on pin/unpin, canceling no-changes save, SQL migration error, loader icon while refreshing, and calendar coloring, and adds search for multiple words and Farsi (Persian) localization.

chunks.title: v0.24.1

chunks.title: v0.25.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.25.2, the project adds automatic thumbnail generation for S3-stored images, masonry layout with responsive columns, system theme detection and automatic dark/light mode switching, manual latitude/longitude input for location tagging, copy memo content from action menu, enhanced reaction selector with hover and mobile-friendly scrolling, improved geolocation handling in LocationSelector, theme-aware syntax highlighting in code blocks, and fixes for user authentication security checks, theme colors in calendar cells, dialog state leakage between sessions, and markdown parser compatibility. It also includes accessible confirmation dialogs with markdown support, enhanced store architecture and state management, simplified concurrent operations, improved Traditional Chinese translations, and refactored memo filtering logic.

chunks.title: v0.25.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.25.3, the project updates the markdown parser/renderer to follow CommonMark and GFM specifications, adds Focus Mode for distraction-free writing, adds ability to delete unused attachments, standardizes the theme system with auto sync option, adds load more button and pagination to attachments page, resolves tag sidebar filtering and reactivity issues, prevents memory exhaustion in thumbnail generation, and fixes markdown list auto-completion to create new lines correctly.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.26.0, the project introduces major features including refresh token rotation with sliding window sessions, streaming for video/audio files, EXIF metadata stripping for image uploads, role refactor from HOST to ADMIN, React Query migration, memo map in user profile with Google Maps integration, HDR image and video support, and a midnight theme. Other improvements include Galician locale, iframe support for embedded videos, enhanced attachment handling with MIME type validation, glassmorphism map controls, slash commands tooltip, migration to connect-rpc, user auth improvements, consolidation of MemoEditor components, removal of legacy session cookie authentication and deprecated Sessions and AccessTokens settings, code block styling improvements, and performance optimizations for memory usage and backend tests. Bug fixes address access control checks, math rendering, calendar header month parsing, editor auto-scroll and Safari IME handling, browser cache serving stale memo data, returning Unauthenticated instead of PermissionDenied on token expiration, theme and locale changes on login screen, public memo API access without authentication, KaTeX math rendering with underscores, attachment linking when creating memos, text contrast in default dark mode, setext header syntax, todo command, memo_relation and attachment cleanup on memo deletion, and guest viewing of public memo comments.

chunks.title: v0.26.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the usememos/memos release v0.26.2, the project fixes spurious logout on page reload with expired access token, explore page showing private tags, calendar navigation to use current page path, default memo visibility not being correctly applied, delete memo errors, infinite view transition loop, task list item index scoping, cross-tab session loss by persisting auth token in localStorage, spurious GetCurrentUser call on init, SSRF vulnerability in webhook dispatcher, MemoEditor layout and timestamp popover styling, attachment/memo deletion when local file is missing, MonthNavigator month label not reacting to language changes, truncation of memo batch attachments, comment reactions and deletion not invalidating comments query, calendar year picker to allow navigation back to 1970, redirect to auth page instead of explore on session expiry, PAT handling in PostgreSQL, ampersand support in tags, eliminates redundant fetch when opening inline memo editor, and replaces EditableTimestamp with inline editor timestamp popover.

chunks.title: v0.27.0-rc.1

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent utmapp/UTM release stream from v4.3.3 through v5.0.3, covering QEMU backend updates, new features like TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot, macOS Sonoma support, UTM Remote server/client, and improved graphics acceleration with Vulkan and OpenGL 4.1.

chunks.title: v4.3.3 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v4.3.3 (Beta), the QEMU backend is updated to v8.0.2, and QEMU support internals are rewritten into a new project called QEMUKit. TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot are introduced, required for Windows 11 22H2 updates. A new free tool called CrystalFetch is released to download Windows installers. HPET is disabled by default on i386 and x86_64 machines. Fixes include a crash when selecting a VM, a crash when starting a VM with display/serial device errors, boot issues with OpenIndiana, and various other UI and backend fixes.

chunks.title: v4.3.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v4.3.4 is noted as broken due to a bug preventing VMs from starting. It includes the same highlights as v4.3.3: QEMU backend v8.0.2, QEMUKit rewrite, TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot, and CrystalFetch. Changes include Japanese localization update, WebDAV shared directory fix, improved debug logging for SPICE, a fix for VM freeze under memory pressure, and various macOS-specific fixes.

chunks.title: v4.3.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v4.3.5, the QEMU version is rolled back to 7.2.0 and EDK2 firmware to edk2-stable202102 due to a critical boot issue. Highlights include the QEMUKit rewrite, TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot, and CrystalFetch. Notes mention HPET disabled by default and a warning about suspended Apple Virtualization VMs when downgrading. Changes include reduced logging and a fix for boot ISO not saving in the wizard.

chunks.title: v4.4.0 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v4.4.0 (Beta) introduces macOS Sonoma support with save/restore VM state and dynamic resolution for Sonoma guests, visionOS support, and automatic VM state saving on close. Changes include fixes for shared directories and removable drives persistence, ANGLE replacement, BIOS loading race condition, and various localization updates. macOS-specific fixes include utmctl CLI path issue, window resize dynamic resolution, and auto-capture mouse in full screen.

chunks.title: v4.4.1 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v4.4.1 (Beta), highlights include macOS Sonoma support, visionOS support, automatic VM state saving, and new USB commands in utmctl. Notes mention a TPM device change causing guest freeze on Intel Macs and auto-capture preferences. Changes include hiding keystroke data from debug logs, scripting additions, utmctl USB command, and various fixes for bookmarks, boot failures, TPM support, and localization updates.

chunks.title: v4.4.2 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v4.4.2 (Beta) continues with macOS Sonoma support, visionOS support, automatic VM state saving, and USB commands in utmctl. Notes include TPM device change workaround and auto-capture preferences. Changes add default devices for PPC64, fix boot issues, fix a memory leak in QEMUKit, and add Russian and Chinese (Hong Kong) localizations. macOS fixes include terminal crash, duplicate windows, and AVF improvements.

chunks.title: v4.4.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v4.4.3, highlights remain macOS Sonoma support, visionOS support, automatic VM state saving, and USB commands in utmctl. Notes add a Linux guest Mesa 23.2.1 bug warning. Changes include guest tools caching, a fix for suspended QEMU VM with locked CD drive, Russian localization update, and various visionOS and macOS fixes.

chunks.title: v4.4.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v4.4.4 includes highlights: macOS Sonoma support, automatic VM state saving, and USB commands in utmctl. Notes mention TPM device workaround, auto-capture preferences, Mesa bug, and updated Windows guest tools. The only change is a macOS AVF fix for keyboard device on older macOS guests.

chunks.title: v4.4.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v4.4.5, macOS users are told there is no difference from v4.4.4. Highlights include macOS Sonoma support, automatic VM state saving, USB commands in utmctl, and TrollStore support for newer iOS with JIT and virtualization on specific devices. Changes fix a 'device not found' error, JIT for TrollStore builds, and add virtualization support on iOS 16.3.1 and lower for M1/M2/A16.

chunks.title: v4.5.0 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v4.5.0 (Beta) introduces UTM Remote server for macOS and UTM Remote client for iOS and visionOS. Changes include ANGLE update, crash and memory leak fixes, Italian localization, and various iOS and visionOS improvements.

chunks.title: v4.5.1 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v4.5.1 (Beta), highlights are UTM Remote server and client. Notes mention removal of automation URI scheme due to security issues. Changes include file locking fix, VM size calculation fix, confirmation popup for downloads, and various macOS and iOS fixes including USB icon, crash on device removal, and AVF display option.

chunks.title: v4.5.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v4.5.2 highlights UTM Remote server and client (now on App Store), and iOS SE wizard floppy boot. Notes mention automation URI scheme removal. Changes include improved icon selector, wizard options for floppy boot and legacy hardware, localization updates, and various macOS fixes like input capture settings, drag & drop, and progress indicator.

chunks.title: v4.5.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v4.5.3, highlights are UTM Remote server and client, and iOS SE floppy boot wizard. Notes mention automation URI scheme removal. Changes include localization updates, icon picker tweaks, mouse/keyboard release fix, and AVF options for NVMe mount and full synchronization mode to address file system corruption.

chunks.title: v4.5.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v4.5.4 highlights UTM Remote server and client, iOS SE floppy boot wizard, and iOS SE donations. Notes mention automation URI scheme removal. Changes fix a file opening error after VM creation, timestamp update, ISO locking error, and add Arabic localization. Various iOS and macOS fixes include remote server autostart and crash fixes.

chunks.title: v4.6.0 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v4.6.0 (Beta), the QEMU backend is updated to v9.1.0. New features include nested virtualization for Linux on macOS 15 with M3 or newer, and Total Store Ordering (TSO) for QEMU on macOS 15. Changes include RPC timeout fix, SPICE race condition fix, and localization updates. A known issue with macOS 15 file permission errors is noted.

chunks.title: v4.6.1 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v4.6.1 (Beta) updates QEMU to v9.1.0 and adds nested virtualization, TSO, and improved macOS guest support on macOS 15. Changes include SPICE GTK update, empty .utm package fix, localization updates, and various macOS fixes for fullscreen button, M4 series Mac issue, EFI vars permission, memory leak, and scripting additions.

chunks.title: v4.6.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v4.6.2, an important notice warns that QEMU VMs are broken in this version. QEMU is updated to v9.1.2. Highlights include nested virtualization, TSO, and improved macOS guest support. Notes mention known issues with macOS 15.0/15.0.1, M4 Macs, Windows 11 24H2, and default CPU changes. Changes include QEMU update, race condition fix, and various iOS and macOS fixes.

chunks.title: v4.6.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v4.6.3 updates QEMU to v9.1.2 and includes nested virtualization, TSO, and improved macOS guest support. Changes fix iOS Hypervisor bug, macOS resolution restore scaling, and a workaround for QEMU VM boot failure due to BIOS file reading.

chunks.title: v4.6.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v4.6.4, QEMU is v9.1.2 with nested virtualization, TSO, and improved macOS guest support. Notes mention macOS 15.0/15.0.1 permission issue resolved in 15.1, M4 Mac issue resolved in 15.2, and default CPU changes. Changes fix virtio-ramfb device issues, serial port crashes, ARM64 QEMU VM crash on older macOS, deadlock with GL acceleration, and auto-resolution restore.

chunks.title: v4.6.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v4.6.5 reverts virtio-ramfb changes from v4.6.4 due to crashes and kernel panics. QEMU remains v9.1.2 with nested virtualization, TSO, and improved macOS guest support. Changes include localization updates, iOS Remote fixes, macOS scripting additions, cursor capture fix, and utmctl path detection fix.

chunks.title: v4.7.0 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v4.7.0 (Beta), QEMU is updated to v10.0.2 and Liquid Glass design is adopted on *OS 26. Notes warn that iOS 26 breaks AltJIT. Changes include RAM slider max increase, localization updates, wizard crash fix, host-only networks support, utmctl recovery mode option, QEMU support for vmapple, and ASIF drive image support.

chunks.title: v4.7.1 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v4.7.1 (Beta) features QEMU v10.0.2, Liquid Glass, App Intents, Keyboard Shortcuts, and an Improved Wizard. Changes include new icon, UEFI boot for RISC-V64 and LoongArch64, floppy boot order fix, classicvirtio drivers, keyboard shortcuts, wizard templates for classic Mac OS, and various macOS fixes.

chunks.title: v4.7.2 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v4.7.2 (Beta), highlights are QEMU v10.0.2, Liquid Glass, App Intents, Keyboard Shortcuts, and Improved Wizard with Windows 95/98 support. Changes include AVF crash fix, network details display, security warning on import, UEFI reset option, PS/2 device handling, Windows 98 BSoD fix, scripting input automation, and various macOS USB and menu additions.

chunks.title: v4.7.3 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v4.7.3 (Beta) continues with QEMU v10.0.2, Liquid Glass, App Intents, Keyboard Shortcuts, and Improved Wizard. Changes fix a crash on block device error, add force kill on second stop button press, fix libusb and CocoaSpice race conditions, and include localization updates and macOS scripting and full screen crash fixes.

chunks.title: v4.7.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v4.7.4, highlights are QEMU v10.0.2, Liquid Glass, App Intents, Keyboard Shortcuts, and Improved Wizard. Changes fix a macOS crash on VM start with toolbar menu, home layout, USB crash, and add StikDebug support on iOS 26.

chunks.title: v4.7.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v4.7.5 features QEMU v10.0.2, Liquid Glass, App Intents, Keyboard Shortcuts, and Improved Wizard. Changes fix rare VM start failures and crashes, file path parsing with commas, ANGLE memory leaks, and various macOS fixes including App Intents, file locking, and AVF shared directory. A hotfix addresses a VM start issue in an earlier build.

chunks.title: v5.0.0 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v5.0.0 (Beta), improved graphics acceleration for Linux is introduced with Vulkan 1.3 support via VirtIO Venus drivers and OpenGL 4.1 via Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only). Known issues include no Vulkan on Apple CoreGL, DXVK not working, and a macOS 26 VM start error. Changes add Venus and Apple Core OpenGL support.

chunks.title: v5.0.1 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v5.0.1 (Beta) continues improved graphics acceleration with Vulkan 1.3 and OpenGL 4.1. Changes include a reworked Metal renderer, fix for BIOS file with comma, default FPS to max refresh rate, macOS HV_UNSUPPORTED fix, and various iOS external display and zoom fixes.

chunks.title: v5.0.2 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the utmapp/UTM release v5.0.2 (Beta), graphics acceleration improvements continue. Known issues include Apple CoreGL no Vulkan, KosmicKrisp incomplete, and Linux desktop Vulkan rendering issue. Changes add geometry shaders to MoltenVK for DXVK, fix GL acceleration regression, and various iOS and macOS graphics fixes.

chunks.title: v5.0.3 (Beta)
chunks.memory_unit_text: The utmapp/UTM release v5.0.3 (Beta) maintains improved graphics acceleration with Vulkan 1.3 and OpenGL 4.1. Changes fix GRUB rendering regression, Vulkan issues on Wayland, add localization updates, home screen delete confirmation and duplicate prevention, AVF audio fix, and scripting improvements.

chunks.title: v4.22.1

chunks.title: V4.23.0

chunks.title: V4.23.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the v2ray/v2ray-core release v4.23.1, the release note fixes TLS default to ECDSA256, config priority, FreeBSD 11 Tproxy, compatible old inbound, CentOS install script, systemd improvement, and test fix.

chunks.title: v4.23.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the v2ray/v2ray-core release v4.23.2, the release note fixes TLS to use crypto standard cipher suites, adds Illumos support, and changes to use Golang 1.14.1.

chunks.title: v4.23.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the v2ray/v2ray-core release v4.23.3, the release note issues an emergency fix for a VMess weakness described in v2ray#2523, significantly hindering attacks based on that weakness. Only servers need to be updated.

chunks.title: v4.23.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the v2ray/v2ray-core release v4.23.4, the release note issues further fixes for VMess weakness and a fix for Fake HTTP Header weakness. It introduces breaking changes: VMess connections drain unrecognized connections based on UUID, servers should not change UUID frequently, Fake HTTP Header requires synchronized settings and sufficient entropy, and server handshake wait time increases to 60 seconds. A security advisory details procedural connection drain and close patterns for VMess and improved HTTP imitation for Fake HTTP Header.

chunks.title: v4.24.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the v2ray/v2ray-core release v4.24.2, the release note begins VMessAEAD header format experiment, adds mKCP encryption, introduces taint mechanic for VMess MD5 authentication data, updates Golang tool-chain, fixes LocalAddr() in UDP workers, and notes AV false positives.

chunks.title: v4.25.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the v2ray/v2ray-core release v4.25.0, the release note further removes identity leakage with TLS ClientHello, fixes UDP stability in Socks5, Shadowsocks, and Dokodemo inbounds, adds ARM v5 binary, and changes ARM release file structure.

chunks.title: v4.25.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the v2ray/v2ray-core release v4.25.1, the release note improves ARM platform stability.

chunks.title: v4.26.0

Breaking change: VMessAEAD requires same client/server version.

chunks.title: v4.27.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the v2ray/v2ray-core release v4.27.0, the release note adds VLESS PREVIEW 1.3, Linux riscv64 release, Shadowsocks None cipher, access log for Dokodemo, typo fixes, Dockerfile curl fix, GitHub Actions push to Docker Hub, SO_REUSEPORT optimization, DOH HTTP/2 support, and Sockopt for Dokodemo Tproxy. Breaking changes: VMessAEAD update, release file structure changes, and VMess AEAD will be used when alterId is 0 in v4.28.0+.

chunks.title: v4.27.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the v2ray/v2ray-core release v4.27.5, the release note adds parsing of X-Forwarded-For in HTTP transport, fixes according to staticcheck, fixes bound check in DNS server's ipIndexMap, and refines code. It also notes that VMess AEAD will be used when alterId is 0 in v4.28.0+.

chunks.title: v4.28.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the v2ray/v2ray-core release v4.28.2, the release note fixes Routing Context GetUser() and uses string for Attributes Value, fixes coarse-grained mutex in HTTP outbound, supports disabling VMessAead by OS environment, and refines workflows.

chunks.title: v4.31.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the v2ray/v2ray-core release v4.31.0, the release note removes Shadowsocks OTA, requires Go 1.15+, fixes Trojan inbound access log, adds VLESS PREVIEW 2.4, XTLS Direct Mode, XTLS support to mKCP, full VLESS fallbacks support to Trojan, padding to abstract UNIX domain socket in fallbacks, allows startup with zero VLESS inbound clients, updates to IETF QUIC draft-29, refactors VLESS fallbacks and XTLS, implements blocking/non-blocking messaging of Channel in Stats, refines Azure Pipelines and Bazel, refines code, uses gccgo compiler, makes builds reproducible, and gets rid of GOPATH mode.

chunks.title: v5.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v5.2.1, the project fixes detection of the Shift key so that it is correctly recognized only for uppercase letters.

chunks.title: v6.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v6.0.0, the project introduces breaking changes by requiring Node.js 20 and React 19, adds React 19 support, and fixes stale output when `outputHeight` changes from above to below `stdout.rows`.

chunks.title: v6.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v6.0.1, the project fixes a bug that prevented static content from being updated in time.

chunks.title: v6.1.0

chunks.title: v6.2.0

chunks.title: v6.2.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v6.2.1, the project fixes an issue with screen reader mode re-rendering and corrects inconsistent width handling for certain characters.

chunks.title: v6.2.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v6.2.2, the project fixes screen reader static rendering.

chunks.title: v6.2.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v6.2.3, the project fixes nested newlines in screen reader mode.

chunks.title: v6.3.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v6.3.0, the project adds a `maxFps` option.

chunks.title: v6.3.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v6.3.1, the project fixes an extra newline in fullscreen mode and resolves react-devtools compatibility.

chunks.title: v6.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v6.4.0, the project adds an `onRender` hook and fixes the `.dim.bold` color.

chunks.title: v6.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v6.5.0, the project adds an `incrementalRendering` option.

chunks.title: v6.5.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v6.5.1, the project fixes handling of terminal resize.

chunks.title: v6.6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v6.6.0, the project adds `home` and `end` key support in `useInput` and fixes some flicker in incremental rendering.

chunks.title: v6.7.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v6.7.0, the project adds support for React concurrent rendering (opt-in), synchronized update, kitty keyboard protocol (opt-in), IME cursor positioning API, and improves terminal size detection for piped processes. It also fixes fullscreen trailing newline on initial render, `MaxListenersExceededWarning` when using many `useInput` hooks, unmount flush of pending renders, and handling of Option+Return on macOS.

chunks.title: v6.8.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v6.8.0, the project adds `renderToString()` for synchronous string output, support for react-devtools v7, allows `exit()` to pass a result value to `waitUntilExit()`, and improves performance by caching expensive calls. It also fixes wrapping with nested `Text`, support for hyperlinks, handling of ended stdout during unmount, duplicated `<Static>` output on exit, dropped keypresses when multiple inputs arrive in one readable tick, and handling of colored output from child processes.

chunks.title: v7.0.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v7.0.0, the project introduces breaking changes: requires Node.js 22 and React 19.2+, uses `useEffectEvent` internally, corrects Backspace key reporting to `key.backspace` instead of `key.delete`, and stops setting `key.meta` on plain Escape. New features include `usePaste`, `useWindowSize`, `useBoxMetrics`, `useAnimation` hooks, `alternateScreen` and `interactive` options for `render()`, `activeId` in `useFocusManager()`, `borderBackgroundColor` on `<Box>`, `wrap="hard"` on `<Text>`, `maxWidth`/`maxHeight` and `aspectRatio`/`alignContent`/`position` layout props on `<Box>`, and improved kitty keyboard protocol auto-detection.

chunks.title: v7.0.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v7.0.1, the project restores `useApp` exit typing and respects `disableFocus()` when handling Escape.

chunks.title: v7.0.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v7.0.2, the project defers raw mode disable to prevent a process hang on component swap.

chunks.title: v7.0.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v7.0.3, the project fixes stale `<Static>` output on identity change, `<Static>` remount via key change dropping new items, and `useBoxMetrics` not accepting ref objects with an initial null value.

chunks.title: v7.0.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v7.0.4, the project shares resize listener via `emitLayoutListeners` instead of per-hook listeners and removes `useEffectEvent` functions from `useEffect` dependency arrays.

chunks.title: v7.0.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vadimdemedes/ink release v7.0.5, the project fixes handling of incomplete stack frames in error overview.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent valkey-io/valkey release stream across major versions 7.2, 8.0, 8.1, 9.0, and 9.1, including patch releases and release candidates. It covers security fixes, performance improvements, new features like atomic slot migration and hash field expiration, and bug fixes across the evolution of the Valkey in-memory data store.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.1.0, the project announces the general availability of Valkey 8.1, a minor version update designed to further enhance performance, reliability, observability and usability over Valkey 8.0. This release is fully compatible with all previous Valkey releases as well as Redis OSS 7.2.4. Behavior changes include hiding input buffer data from being logged on protocol error when hide-user-data-from-log is enabled. Bug fixes address a crash in VM_GetCurrentUserName when no valid username is provided. The release also includes performance improvements such as optimizing bitcount command by using x86 SIMD instructions and embedding hash value in hash data type entries to reduce memory footprint. Cluster modifications add cluster-manual-failover-timeout configuration, improve error message reporting for invalid port in cluster meet command, and broadcast epoch ASAP when configEpoch changes. Module improvements add a new module API flag to bypass command validation to reduce processing overhead. Additional behavior changes enable TCP_NODELAY for engine initiated cluster and replication connections. Further bug fixes resolve ACL LOAD crash on a connected replica node, missing tracking-redir-broken when redirect client is closing, replica disconnection with TLS, file descriptor leak during dual channel replication abort, rax crash with keys larger than 512MB, RANDOMKEY infinite loop during CLIENT PAUSE, OOM in Lua cjson library, large-reply update in COMMANDLOG, setting TCP/TLS options for UNIX Domain Socket connections, and incorrect command rendering in valkey-cli with text output in multi/exec. Build and packaging changes check both arm64 and aarch64 for ARM architecture, cleanup lua object files on make distclean, and fix build error with CMake when using clang v19.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 7.2.9, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY due to a fix for CVE-2025-21605 which limits output buffer for unauthenticated clients. Bug fixes include fixing defrag crash when using FLUSHDB ASYNC in cluster mode, memory leak in forgotten node ping ext code path, module LatencyAddSample still working when latency-monitor-threshold is 0, potential crash in radix tree recompression of huge keys, error "SSL routines::bad length" when connTLSWrite is called second time with smaller buffer, RANDOMKEY infinite loop during CLIENT PAUSE, adding samples to stream object consumer trees, panic in primary when blocking shutdown after previous block with timeout, and incorrect lag reported in XINFO GROUPS.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.0.3, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY due to a fix for CVE-2025-21605 which limits output buffer for unauthenticated clients. Bug fixes include optimizing RDB load performance and fixing cluster mode resizing on replica side, memory leak in forgotten node ping ext code path, cluster info sent stats for message with light header, module LatencyAddSample still working when latency-monitor-threshold is 0, potential crash in radix tree recompression of huge keys, error "SSL routines::bad length" when connTLSWrite is called second time with smaller buffer, temp file leak during replication error handling, ACL LOAD crash on replica since the primary client doesn't have a user, RANDOMKEY infinite loop during CLIENT PAUSE, adding samples to stream object consumer trees, cluster slot stats assertion during promotion of replica, panic in primary when blocking shutdown after previous block with timeout, ignoring stale gossip packets that arrive out of order, incorrect lag reported in XINFO GROUPS, and avoiding shard id update of replica if not matching with primary shard id.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.1.1, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY due to a fix for CVE-2025-21605 which limits output buffer for unauthenticated clients. Bug fixes include fixing the build on less common platforms in zmalloc.c, adding samples to stream object consumer trees, crash during TLS handshake with I/O threads, cluster slot stats assertion during promotion of replica, panic in primary when blocking shutdown after previous block with timeout, ignoring stale gossip packets that arrive out of order, incorrect lag reported in XINFO GROUPS, engine crash on module client blocking during keyspace events, avoiding shard id update of replica if not matching with primary shard id, only enabling defrag for vendored jemalloc, and allowing scripts to support null characters again.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.1.2, the upgrade urgency is HIGH due to a CVE fix for valkey-check-aof tool (CVE-2025-27151) which checks length of AOF file name. Bug fixes include properly escaping double quotes and backslash in MONITOR command, fixing high CPU usage when fetching a random element in skewed sparse hash table, a bug that allowed clients to process commands when the server has paused command processing, a crash where the wrong slot is used when processing sharded pubsub unsubscribe events, a crash when a module attempts to write auxiliary data with AOF enabled, a bug where the engine may crash when establishing new outbound TLS connections, a bug where a cluster bus packet may be incorrectly marked as invalid, a bug where CLUSTER SLOTS/NODES information can be stale after updating node port/tls-port, a bug where replica in cluster mode can't finish failover when config epoch is outdated, and a bug to avoid CLIENT UNBLOCK command to unblock paused clients.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.1.3, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY due to fixes for CVE-2025-32023 preventing out-of-bounds write during hyperloglog operations and CVE-2025-48367 retrying accept on transient errors. Bug fixes include fixing missing response when AUTH is errored inside a transaction.
