chunks.memory_unit_text: In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.0.4, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY due to fixes for CVE-2025-32023 preventing out-of-bounds write during hyperloglog operations and CVE-2025-48367 retrying accept on transient errors.

chunks.title: Valkey patch release 7.2.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the valkey-io/valkey release 7.2.10, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY. Bug fixes include fixing a bug that allowed clients to process commands when the server has paused command processing, a crash when a module attempts to write auxiliary data with AOF enabled, a bug where the engine may crash when establishing new outbound TLS connections, a bug where a cluster bus packet may be incorrectly marked as invalid, a bug where CLUSTER SLOTS/NODES information can be stale after updating node port/tls-port, a bug where replica in cluster mode can't finish failover when config epoch is outdated, and a bug to avoid CLIENT UNBLOCK command to unblock paused clients. Security fixes include CVE-2025-27151 (check length of AOF file name in valkey-check-aof), CVE-2025-32023 (prevent out-of-bounds write during hyperloglog operations), and CVE-2025-48367 (retry accept on transient errors).

chunks.title: Valkey 9.0.0-rc1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the valkey-io/valkey release 9.0.0-rc1, the upgrade urgency is LOW. This is the first release candidate of Valkey 9.0.0, with performance improvements, atomic slot migrations, hash field expiration, and numbered databases in cluster mode. New features include client commands extended filtering, multi-database support in cluster mode, BYPOLYGON option for GEOSEARCH, MPTCP introduction, sentinel_total_tilt in sentinel INFO, automatic client authentication via TLS certificate fields, --hotkeys-count option for valkey-cli, atomic slot migration, MPTCP for replica, DELIFEQ command, dynamic modification of io-threads num, HASH items expiration, SAFE option to SHUTDOWN, and negative filtering for client command filters. New configs include auto-failover on shutdown unified config. Logging and tooling improvements add node pfail and fail count to cluster info metrics and support for lttng based tracing. Performance/efficiency improvements include optimizing bitcount command by SIMD, saving RDB file to disk using a background thread on replica(s), improving replication stability by prioritizing replication traffic, optimizing hyperloglog commands with ARM NEON SIMD, optimizing BITCOUNT using ARM NEON SIMD, optimizing string-to-integer performance using AVX512, improving system responsiveness by limiting new cluster link connections per cycle, optimizing hash table performance using SIMD, improving performance of network operations by directly writing responses to clients, allowing shrinking hashtables in low memory situations, optimizing string2ll with load-time CPU feature check using IFUNC resolver, optimizing WATCH by equalStringObjects early length check, optimizing GEORADIUS command performance with pre-allocated buffer, improving zcount performance, and optimizing scan/sscan/hscan/zscan commands by replacing list with vector. Cluster changes include triggering manual failover on SIGTERM/shutdown to cluster primary, CLUSTER FLUSHSLOT command, allowing replicas to become primaries without data using CLUSTER REPLICATE NO ONE, and adding cluster bus port out of range error message.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.0.5, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY. Bug fixes include fixing clients remaining blocked when reprocessing commands after certain blocking operations, a memory corruption issue in the sharded pub/sub unsubscribe logic, potential memory leak by ensuring module context is freed when aux_save2 callback writes no data, CLIENT UNBLOCK triggering unexpected errors when used on paused clients, missing NULL check on SSL_new() when creating outgoing TLS connections, incorrect casting of ping extension lengths to prevent silent packet drops, replica failover stall due to outdated config epoch, incorrect port/tls-port info in CLUSTER SLOTS/CLUSTER NODES after dynamic config change, ensuring empty error tables in Lua scripts don't crash Valkey, client tracking memory overhead calculation, handling divergent shard-id from nodes.conf and reconciling to the primary node's shard-id, and pre-size hashtables per slot when reading RDB files. Behavior changes include triggering election immediately during a forced manual failover (CLUSTER FAILOVER FORCE) to avoid delay and resetting ongoing election state when initiating a new manual failover. Logging and tooling improvements add support to drop all cluster packets and improve log clarity in failover auth denial message. Security fixes include CVE-2025-27151 checking length of AOF file name in valkey-check-aof and rejecting paths longer than PATH_MAX.

chunks.title: 9.0.0-rc2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the valkey-io/valkey release 9.0.0-rc2, the upgrade urgency is LOW. This is the second release candidate of Valkey 9.0.0, focused on stability, bug fixes, and incremental improvements. Attention to Valkey Module maintainers: there is a new module option to indicate support for the Atomic Slot Migration (ASM) feature; modules must explicitly opt in to ASM, otherwise this feature will be disabled in clusters that load modules without ASM support. Bug fixes include fixing module context object re-use in scripting engines, pre-size hashtables per slot when reading RDB files, not migrating script functions in atomic slot migration, and not using AVX2 instructions if the CPU doesn't support it. Performance/efficiency improvements include optimized pipelining by parsing and prefetching multiple commands. Cluster and replication changes include making cluster failover delay relative to node timeout and separating RDB snapshotting from atomic slot migration. Module API additions include a new module API event for tracking authentication attempts, READONLY flag to ClientInfo.flags output structure, and making modules opt-in to atomic slot migration with server events. Configuration changes include new cluster-announce-client-(port|tls-port) configs, CONFIG RESETSTATS now also resets cluster related stats, and CONFIG GET command returns sorted output. Command updates include updating reply schema for LMOVE and BLMOVE and un-deprecating most deprecated commands. Upgrade changes include relaxing RDB check for foreign RDB formats. CLI changes include adding word-jump navigation (Alt/Option/Ctrl + ←/→) to valkey-cli.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 7.2.11, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY. Security fixes include CVE-2025-49844 (a Lua script may lead to remote code execution), CVE-2025-46817 (a Lua script may lead to integer overflow and potential RCE), CVE-2025-46818 (a Lua script can be executed in the context of another user), and CVE-2025-46819 (LUA out-of-bound read). Bug fixes include ensuring empty error tables in Lua scripts don't crash Valkey and fixing client tracking memory overhead calculation.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.1.4, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY. Security fixes include CVE-2025-49844 (a Lua script may lead to remote code execution), CVE-2025-46817 (a Lua script may lead to integer overflow and potential RCE), CVE-2025-46818 (a Lua script can be executed in the context of another user), and CVE-2025-46819 (LUA out-of-bound read). Bug fixes include fixing accounting for dual channel RDB bytes in replication stats, EVAL to report unknown error when empty error table is provided, use-after-free when active expiration triggers hashtable to shrink, MEMORY USAGE to account for embedded keys, memory leak when shrinking a hashtable without entries, preventing potential assertion in active defrag handling large allocations, preventing bad memory access when NOTOUCH client gets unblocked, converging divergent shard-id persisted in nodes.conf to primary's shard id, client tracking memory overhead calculation, RDB load per slot memory pre-allocation when loading from RDB snapshot, not using AVX2 instructions if the CPU doesn't support it, and a bug where active defrag may be unable to defrag sparsely filled pages.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.0.6, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY. Security fixes include CVE-2025-49844 (a Lua script may lead to remote code execution), CVE-2025-46817 (a Lua script may lead to integer overflow and potential RCE), CVE-2025-46818 (a Lua script can be executed in the context of another user), and CVE-2025-46819 (LUA out-of-bound read). Bug fixes include fixing accounting for dual channel RDB bytes in replication stats, minor fix for dual rdb channel connection conn error log, and fixing unsigned difference expression compared to zero.

chunks.title: 9.0.0-rc3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the valkey-io/valkey release 9.0.0-rc3, the upgrade urgency is LOW. This is the third release candidate of Valkey 9.0.0, focused on stability, bug fixes, and incremental improvements. Security fixes include CVE-2025-49844 (a Lua script may lead to remote code execution), CVE-2025-46817 (a Lua script may lead to integer overflow and potential RCE), CVE-2025-46818 (a Lua script can be executed in the context of another user), and CVE-2025-46819 (LUA out-of-bound read). Performance/efficiency improvements include optimizing skiplist random level generation logic. Cluster and replication changes include redirecting blocked clients after failover, preventing exposure of importing keys on replicas during atomic slot migration, adding slot migration client flags and module context flags, and introducing SYNCSLOTS CAPA for forwards compatibility. Bug fixes include fixing atomic slot migration snapshot never proceeding with hz 1, defrag if slab 1/8 full to fix defrag didn't stop issue, module key memory usage accounting, and dual rdb channel connection error log. Command changes include implementing a lolwut for version 9.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 9.0.0, the upgrade urgency is LOW. This is the first release of Valkey 9.0 which includes stability, bug fixes, and incremental improvements over the third release candidate. Bug fixes include HSETEX with FXX should not create an object if it does not exist, crash when aborting a slot migration while child snapshot is active, double MOVED reply on unblock at failover, memory leak with CLIENT LIST/KILL duplicate filters, incorrect accounting after completed atomic slot migration, Lua VM crash after FUNCTION FLUSH ASYNC + FUNCTION LOAD, and invalid memory address caused by hashtable shrinking during safe iteration.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.1.5, the upgrade urgency is MODERATE. Bug fixes include fixing Lua VM crash after FUNCTION FLUSH ASYNC + FUNCTION LOAD, invalid memory address caused by hashtable shrinking during safe iteration, cluster: avoiding usage of light weight messages to nodes with not ready bidirectional links, sending duplicate multi meet packet only for node which supports it, and fixing loading AOF files from future Valkey versions.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 9.0.1, the upgrade urgency is MODERATE. Bug fixes include authenticating slot migration client on source node to internal user, resetting io_last_written on c->buf resize to prevent stale pointers, sentinel: fix regression requiring "+failover" ACL in failover path, cluster: avoiding usage of light weight messages to nodes with not ready bidirectional links, sending duplicate multi meet packet only for node which supports it in mixed clusters, LTRIM should not call signalModifiedKey when no elements are removed, fixing build on some 32-bit ARM by only using NEON on AArch64, deadlock in IO-thread shutdown during panic, COMMANDLOG large-reply when using reply copy avoidance, and CLUSTER SLOTS crash when called from module timer callback.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 9.0.2, the upgrade urgency is HIGH due to critical bugs that may affect a subset of users. Bug fixes include avoiding memory leak of new argv when HEXPIRE commands target only non-existing fields, fixing HINCRBY and HINCRBYFLOAT to update volatile key tracking, avoiding empty hash object when HSETEX added no fields, fixing case-sensitive check for the FNX and FXX arguments in HSETEX, preventing assertion in active expiration job after a hash with volatile fields is overwritten, fixing HRANDFIELD to return null response when no field could be found, fixing HEXPIRE to not delete items when validation rules fail and expiration is in the past, fixing how hash is handling overriding of expired fields overwrite, HSETEX always issuing keyspace notifications after validation, making zero a valid TTL for hash fields during import mode and data loading, triggering prepareCommand on argc change in module command filters, restricting TTL from being negative and avoiding crash in import-mode, fixing chained replica crash when doing dual channel replication, skipping slot cache optimization for AOF client to prevent key duplication and data corruption, fixing used_memory_dataset underflow due to miscalculated used_memory_overhead, avoiding duplicate calculations of network-bytes-out in slot stats with copy-avoidance, and fixing XREAD returning error on empty stream with + ID. Performance/efficiency improvements include tracking reply bytes in I/O threads if commandlog-reply-larger-than is -1, which makes it possible to mitigate a performance regression in 9.0.1 caused by a previous bug fix.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 7.2.12, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY. Security fixes include CVE-2026-21863 (Remote DoS with malformed Valkey Cluster bus message) and CVE-2025-67733 (RESP Protocol Injection via Lua error_reply). Bug fixes include fixing ltrim should not call signalModifiedKey when no elements are removed, potential infinite loop in clusterNodeGetMaster, and avoiding crash during MODULE UNLOAD when ACL rules reference a module command and subcommand.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.0.7, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY. Security fixes include CVE-2026-21863 (Remote DoS with malformed Valkey Cluster bus message) and CVE-2025-67733 (RESP Protocol Injection via Lua error_reply). Bug fixes include fixing ltrim should not call signalModifiedKey when no elements are removed, chained replica crash when doing dual channel replication, used_memory_dataset underflow due to miscalculated used_memory_overhead, avoiding crash during MODULE UNLOAD when ACL rules reference a module command and subcommand, server assert on ACL LOAD and resetchannels, and bug causing no response flush sometimes when IO threads are busy.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.1.6, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY. Security fixes include CVE-2026-21863 (Remote DoS with malformed Valkey Cluster bus message) and CVE-2025-67733 (RESP Protocol Injection via Lua error_reply). Bug fixes include restricting ttl from being negative and avoiding crash in import-mode, chained replica crash when doing dual channel replication, used_memory_dataset underflow due to miscalculated used_memory_overhead, crashing while MODULE UNLOAD when ACL rules reference a module command or subcommand, server assert on ACL LOAD and resetchannels, and bug causing no response flush sometimes when IO threads are busy.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 9.0.3, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY. Security fixes include CVE-2025-67733 (RESP Protocol Injection via Lua error_reply), CVE-2026-21863 (Remote DoS with malformed Valkey Cluster bus message), and CVE-2026-27623 (Reset request type after handling empty requests). Bug fixes include avoiding crash during MODULE UNLOAD when ACL rules reference a module command and subcommand, server assert on ACL LOAD when current user loses permission to channels, and bug causing no response flush sometimes when IO threads are busy.

chunks.title: 9.1.0-rc1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the valkey-io/valkey release 9.1.0-rc1, the upgrade urgency is LOW. This is the first release candidate of Valkey 9.1.0, with new features, performance improvements, and bug fixes. New features and enhanced behavior include database-level access control, moving Lua scripting engine into a Valkey module, supporting cross node consistency for SCAN commands through configurable DB hash seed, supporting automatic TLS reload, supporting TLS authentication using SAN URI, preventing invalid TLS certificates from being loaded, and failing to save the cluster config file will no longer exit the process. Command and API updates include making CLUSTER KEYSLOT available in standalone mode, updating HSETEX to always issue keyspace notifications after validation, adding HGETDEL command, supporting NX/XX flag in HSETEX command, new CLUSTERSCAN command for cluster-wide key scanning across nodes, new MSETEX command to set multiple keys with a shared expiration, and CLUSTER SHARDS/CLUSTER SLOTS now include an availability-zone field. Performance and efficiency improvements include optimizing zset memory usage by embedding element in skiplist, removing internal server object pointer overhead in small strings, optimizing skiplist query efficiency by embedding the skiplist header, improving performance during rehashing, optimizing SREM/ZREM/HDEL to pause auto shrink when deleting multiple items, aborting and swapping the tables if ht1 is very full during the hashtable shrink rehashing, improving performance of copy avoidance when command reply tracking is disabled, enabling hardware clock by default, improving COMMAND performance by caching responses, adding support for asynchronous freeing of keys on writable replicas, faster XRANGE/XREVRANGE via stream range hot-path optimization, and replicas can reuse the RDB file as AOF preamble after disk-based full sync. Module API changes include adding ValkeyModule_ClusterKeySlotC, more client info flags to module API, prefix-aware ACL permission checks and new module API, and supporting unsigned 64-bit numeric config values in module API. Observability and logging improvements include cumulative metrics for active I/O threads usage, cumulative metric for active main thread usage, supporting whole cluster info for INFO command in cluster_info section, adding remaining_repl_size field in CLUSTER GETSLOTMIGRATIONS output, adding logging helper function to print node's ip:port when nodename not explicitly set, dual-channel-replication announces itself at replica-announce-ip if configured, showing replica dual-channel replication buffer memory in INFO MEMORY and MEMORY STATS, adding rdb_transmitted state to replica state in INFO, new INFO section for scripting engines, adding json support for log-format config, adding server side TLS certificate expiry tracking and INFO telemetry, and adding option to use libbacktrace for backtraces in crash reports.

chunks.title: 9.1.0-rc2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the valkey-io/valkey release 9.1.0-rc2, the upgrade urgency is LOW. This is the second release candidate of Valkey 9.1.0. Behavior changes include reverting strict TLS certificate validation at config load as it is a breaking change, deferred to next major version. New features and enhanced behavior include doing the failover immediately if the replica is the best ranked replica, adding cluster-config-save-behavior option to control nodes.conf save behavior, Lua scripting engine is now statically linked by default instead of dynamically linked, and module command result callback addition. Performance and efficiency improvements include redesigning IO threading communication model with lock-free queues (8-17% throughput gain), increasing embedded string threshold from 64 to 128 bytes (30% GET throughput gain), ARM NEON SIMD optimization for pvFind() in vset.c (2-3x speedup), optimizing WATCH duplicate key check from O(N) to O(1) using per-db hashtable, optimizing CLUSTERSCAN MATCH so that it uses a specific slot if given, and improving COB memory tracking with copy avoidance. Bug fixes include fixing valkey-cli --cluster del-node for unreachable nodes, enhancing cluster stale packet detection to prevent sub-replica and empty primary, big endian bitmap byte order mismatch fix, fixing slot-migration-max-failover-repl-bytes unable to accept -1, fixing config rewrite producing negative values for unsigned memory configs, fixing HPERSIST RESP protocol violation on wrong-type key, and fixing lua-enable-insecure-api default value cannot be changed to yes.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 9.0.4, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY. Security fixes include CVE-2026-23479 (Use-After-Free in unblock client flow), CVE-2026-25243 (Invalid Memory Access in RESTORE command), and CVE-2026-23631 (Use-after-free when full sync occurs during a yielding Lua/function execution).

In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.1.7, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY. Security fixes include CVE-2026-23479 (Use-After-Free in unblock client flow), CVE-2026-25243 (Invalid Memory Access in RESTORE command), and CVE-2026-23631 (Use-after-free when full sync occurs during a yielding Lua/function execution).

chunks.title: 8.0.8 (revoked)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the valkey-io/valkey release 8.0.8 (revoked), the release has been revoked. The 8.0.8 tag was placed on a commit that is not part of the 8.0 release branch. Users should upgrade to 8.0.9 instead.

In the valkey-io/valkey release 7.2.13, the upgrade urgency is SECURITY. Security fixes include CVE-2026-23479 (Use-After-Free in unblock client flow), CVE-2026-25243 (Invalid Memory Access in RESTORE command), and CVE-2026-23631 (Use-after-free when full sync occurs during a yielding Lua/function execution).

In the valkey-io/valkey release 9.1.0, the upgrade urgency is LOW. This is the first stable release of Valkey 9.1. Security fixes include CVE-2026-23479 (Use-After-Free in unblock client flow), CVE-2026-25243 (Invalid Memory Access in RESTORE command), and CVE-2026-23631 (Use-after-free when full sync occurs during a yielding Lua/function execution). New features and enhanced behavior include adding cluster bus network traffic usage metric in bytes and reducing latency spikes during rehashing via incremental page release. Bug fixes include fixing syncio: set errno on EOF in syncRead and propagate to conn->last, GEOSEARCH BYPOLYGON leak on invalid COUNT, handling NULL pointer in streamTrim listpack delta calculation, server crash when RDMA benchmark clients disconnect, and memory leak in valkey-benchmark.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent vapor/vapor release stream from 4.109.0 through 4.121.4, covering additions like swift-distributed-tracing, Swift Testing compatibility, validation API improvements, Android support, and various bug fixes and enhancements.

chunks.title: 4.109.0 - Adds swift-distributed-tracing and TracingMiddleware
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.109.0, the project adds support for swift-distributed-tracing and introduces a TracingMiddleware type. This middleware creates a span for each wrapped request and applies a standard set of span attributes according to OTEL standards.

chunks.title: 4.110.0 - Better compatibility with Swift Testing
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.110.0, the project introduces a new VaporTesting module for better compatibility with Swift Testing, removing usages of XCTest. A new testing() extension on Application is provided to write tests.

chunks.title: 4.110.1 - Minor swift-testing related improvements
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.110.1, the project includes minor swift-testing related improvements.

chunks.title: 4.110.2 - In withApp(), always shut down app even if error is thrown
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.110.2, the project modifies the withApp() method to always shut down the application even if an error is thrown, ensuring proper lifecycle handling.

chunks.title: 4.111.0 - Validation API | `Custom` Validator
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.111.0, the project adds a Custom validator to the Validation API, allowing users to add custom validation logic more simply without extending the API.

chunks.title: 4.111.1 - do not truncate response when streaming on error
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.111.1, the project fixes a bug where Vapor silently truncated a streamed response body for error responses, preventing data loss.

chunks.title: 4.112.0 - Adds Support for Tracing Header Extraction
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.112.0, the project adds support for tracing header extraction, enabling correlation of trace data across HTTP boundaries. It also adds a closure to TracingMiddleware for custom span metadata and fixes warnings from the MiddlewareTest function.

chunks.title: 4.112.1 - Use singleton NIOThreadPool by default
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.112.1, the project configures the global singleton NIOThreadPool as the default, eliminating an additional thread pool and reducing excess threads. It also ignores UnsupportedOperation errors during thread pool shutdown.

chunks.title: 4.112.2 - Android support
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.112.2, the project adds experimental support for building and testing on Android by adding conditional imports.

chunks.title: 4.113.0 - Fix warnings from NIO 2.79.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.113.0, the project fixes Sendable warnings introduced by NIO 2.79.0 and deprecates the main blocking Application.init() API, advising migration to async APIs.

chunks.title: 4.113.1 - Prevent stack overflow by using `NIOLock` instead of `NIOLockedValueBox` during service initialization
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.113.1, the project prevents a stack overflow during service initialization by replacing NIOLockedValueBox with NIOLock for makeService.

chunks.title: 4.113.2 - Fix warning in service fix
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.113.2, the project fixes a warning in the service fix from the previous release.

chunks.title: 4.114.0 - Added a cache policy for file middleware
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.114.0, the project adds a configurable cache policy interface for FileMiddleware, allowing control over browser caching of static resources.

chunks.title: 4.114.1 - Correct SessionData's Codable conformance
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.114.1, the project corrects the Codable conformance of SessionData and cleans up code formatting and initialization.

chunks.title: 4.115.0 - Improve `VaporTesting`'s `withApp` method
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.115.0, the project improves the VaporTesting withApp method to work as advertised, allowing an optional configuration method for the Application, and marks it with @discardableResult.

chunks.title: 4.115.1 - Add Sendable annotations to the OTP types
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.115.1, the project adds missing Sendable annotations to the OTP types so that @preconcurrency import is not required when using them across isolation boundaries.

chunks.title: 4.116.0 - Allow initializing Vapor.Application with a Logger
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.116.0, the project allows initializing Vapor.Application with a Logger, adding a new variant of the make method that takes a Logger explicitly.

chunks.title: 4.117.0 - Fix warnings in 6.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.117.0, the project fixes warnings from the Swift 6.2 RC.

chunks.title: 4.117.1 - Add HEIC (HEVC in HEIF) HTTPMediaType Support
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.117.1, the project adds HTTP media type support for HEIC/HEIF images to HTTPMediaType.

chunks.title: 4.117.2 - Fixing error in documentation of HTTPHeaders accept variable
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.117.2, the project fixes an error in the documentation of the HTTPHeaders accept variable.

chunks.title: 4.118.0 - Update minimum Swift version to 6.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.118.0, the project updates the minimum Swift version to 6.0, cleans up #if conditionals, adds theme settings to API documentation, and ensures tests build and pass on iOS, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS.

chunks.title: 4.119.0 - Expose peer certificates in request handlers
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.119.0, the project exposes peer certificates in request handlers, providing the validated certificate chain for mTLS deployments and adding a dependency on swift-certificates.

chunks.title: 4.119.1 - Fix a couple of import issues
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.119.1, the project fixes import issues related to Sendable errors with TOTP types on old macOS SDKs and missing CNIOLinux imports on some UBI9 based images.

chunks.title: 4.119.2 - Fix parallel build failures on platforms with Glibc
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.119.2, the project fixes parallel build failures on platforms with Glibc caused by MemberImportVisibility.

chunks.title: 4.120.0 - Fix compatibility with swift-log 1.8.0 and later
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.120.0, the project fixes compatibility with swift-log 1.8.0 and later by removing conflicting CustomStringConvertible and LosslessStringConvertible conformances on Logger.Level.

chunks.title: 4.121.0 - The RouteNotFound that is used when the router finds nothing is now public
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.121.0, the project makes the RouteNotFound error public, allowing middleware to handle cases where no routes match the current request.

chunks.title: 4.121.1 - Do not create a session if no cookie was provided
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.121.1, the project prevents the creation of a session if no cookie was provided, fixing an issue where set-cookie headers were sent unnecessarily when using SessionsMiddleware and AsyncSessionAuthenticator.

chunks.title: 4.121.2 - Add Sendable conformance to application testing Method type
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.121.2, the project adds Sendable conformance to the Method type in the VaporTestUtils target.

chunks.title: 4.121.3 - Parse directives from all Cookie headers, not just the first
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.121.3, the project fixes cookie parsing to parse directives from all Cookie headers, not just the first.

chunks.title: 4.121.4 - Fix Response Compression Bug when Content Type header is empty
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vapor/vapor release 4.121.4, the project fixes a bug in the response compression pipeline where responses were compressed even if compression was disabled when no content-type header was set.

chunks.title: v0.49.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vectordotdev/vector release v0.49.0, Datadog's Community Open Source team announces version 0.49.0. Highlights include a new websocket source, templating support for the http sink's uri and request.headers config fields, --watch-config flag now watches enrichment table files, a TTL-based cache for metrics sets with an expire_metrics_secs config option for the prometheus_remote_write sink, and a fix for a race condition causing negative values in vector_buffer_byte_size and vector_buffer_events gauges. Several VRL functions have breaking changes; refer to the upgrade guide.

chunks.title: v0.50.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vectordotdev/vector release v0.50.0, Datadog's Community Open Source team announces version 0.50.0. Highlights include the opentelemetry source now decoding data according to the standard OpenTelemetry protocol for all telemetry data types, a new varint_length_delimited framing option, a new incremental_to_absolute transform, a new okta source for consuming Okta system logs, and exec secrets option supporting protocol version v1.1. Breaking change: the azure_blob sink now requires a connection_string.

chunks.title: v0.51.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vectordotdev/vector release v0.51.0, the COSE team announces version 0.51.0 with a caution to upgrade to v0.51.1 instead. Highlights include enhanced OpenTelemetry Protocol support with the otlp codec enabling bidirectional conversion between Vector events and OTLP format, improved internal telemetry fixing negative utilization metrics and buffer counter underflows, and enhanced memory enrichment tables with an expired output and accessibility via vector tap.

chunks.title: v0.51.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vectordotdev/vector release v0.51.1, the COSE team announces patch version 0.51.1. This release addresses internal logs rate limiting bugs and properly exposes the recently released VRL functions split_path, basename, and dirname. Users of v0.51.0 are recommended to upgrade.

chunks.title: v0.52.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vectordotdev/vector release v0.52.0, the COSE team announces version 0.52.0. Highlights include new buffer utilization metrics for sources and transforms, a trace_to_log transform, the blackhole sink implementing end-to-end acknowledgements, a GELF decoder validation option with strict and relaxed modes, and the docker_logs source retrying Docker daemon communication failures with exponential backoff.

chunks.title: v0.53.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vectordotdev/vector release v0.53.0, the COSE team announces version 0.53.0. Highlights include VRL functions to access internal Vector metrics (get_vector_metric, find_vector_metrics, aggregate_vector_metrics), the clickhouse sink supporting the arrow_stream format option, a new doris sink for Apache Doris, a syslog codec for encoding Vector events to Syslog format, and moving-mean gauges for source and transform buffers.

chunks.title: v0.54.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vectordotdev/vector release v0.54.0, the COSE team announces version 0.54.0. Highlights include enhanced vector top with new keybinds, the datadog_logs sink defaulting to zstd compression, new component_latency_seconds histogram and component_latency_mean_seconds gauge internal metrics, major upgrades to Syslog encoding transform, and a new azure_logs_ingestion sink with deprecation of azure_monitor_logs sink. Breaking change: datadog_logs sink now defaults to zstd compression.

chunks.title: v0.55.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vectordotdev/vector release v0.55.0, the COSE team announces version 0.55.0. Highlights include a new windows_event_log source, the aws_s3 sink supporting Apache Parquet batch encoding, the azure_blob sink regaining first-class Azure authentication, the datadog_metrics sink defaulting to Series v2 endpoint with zstd compression, vector top improvements, new source-send latency distributions, task-transform utilization no longer counting downstream wait time, and fixes for buffer utilization metric tracking and performance regressions in file and kubernetes_logs sources. Breaking changes include the observability API moving from GraphQL to gRPC, removal of top-level headers option on http and opentelemetry sinks, and explicit azure_credential_kind requirement for azure_logs_ingestion sink with Client Secret credentials.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent ventoy/Ventoy release stream from v1.0.83 through v1.1.12, covering multi-language boot menu support, new OS compatibility, bug fixes, and the transition to the 1.1.x series with improved remount handling and btrfs experimental support.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.83 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.83, the release was deprecated because of a BUG and users were asked to wait for a new release.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.84 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.84, multi-language support was added for the Ventoy boot menu, along with hotkey changes (L for language, F1 for help, Ctrl+d for memdisk mode), a VTOY_MENU_LANGUAGE option in Global Control Plugin, removal of VTOY_HELP_TXT_LANGUAGE, and Ventoy2Disk.exe gained Cluster Size option, FAT32 support for 32GB+ disks, UDF file system support, and fixes for format failures in WinPE/Lite Windows.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.85 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.85, a format failure during Ventoy installation was fixed, auto memdisk plugin gained support for some IMA/IMG files, booting memtest86-usb.img was optimized, Grub2 mode added KNOPPIX support, a boot issue with Peux distro iso files was fixed, and new menu languages were added.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.86 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.86, a 'F5 Tools ---> Temporary Control Settings' menu was added, Ventoy2Disk.exe gained command line mode support, VTOY_WIN11_BYPASS_NRO option was added to bypass online account requirement during Windows 11 install, VTOY_WIN11_BYPASS_CHECK and VTOY_WIN11_BYPASS_NRO were enabled by default, a resolution_fit option was added in theme plugin, MBR partition type was changed to 0xC for FAT32 installs, and VentoyPlugson added duplicate file path check.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.87 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.87, a 'return to previous menu' was added in secondary boot menu, a 'max' value for screen resolution option was added in theme plugin, a bug when browsing and booting VHD/VHDX files in an extend logic partition was fixed, BSD style checksum files were supported, VENTOY_CHECKSUM file support was added, Fn hotkeys were disabled in autoinstall/persistence/wim select menu, a blank item in the language select menu was fixed, and support was added for Lenovo Product Recovery iso and Dell PER ISO.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.88 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.88, a VHD(x) boot issue introduced in 1.0.87 was fixed, more options were added for Windows command line mode, VentoyPlugson fixed VTOY_WIN11_BYPASS_CHECK display issue, workaround #2 for Legacy BIOS access limit was fixed, a syntax error in F4 localboot was fixed, file checksum menu title now shows according to checksum existence, text mode automatically switches to en_US, and an unsupported tip message for 4k native disk was added.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.89 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.89, the issue that VTOY_LINUX_REMOUNT could not work in new linux kernel was fixed, Ventoy2Disk_X64.exe not running under altexe directory was fixed, VentoyPlugson_X64.exe silent exit was fixed, missing /FS option for Ventoy2Disk.exe in command line mode was added, Ventoy2Disk.exe automatically changes current directory when started from other directory, a tip message was added when theme file contains non-enclosed literal values, reserved space is ignored during non-destructive installation via GUI, and a menu missing issue with invalid vlnk files was fixed.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.90 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.90, the issue that VTOY_LINUX_REMOUNT option could not work for Kernel 5.18+ with Intel Gen11+ CPU was fixed, LibreELEC 11.0+ support was added, Fedora Rawhide install media detection was fixed, chimera linux support was added, Fedora boot process was optimized, and new iso support brought the total to 1100+.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.91 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.91, support for FreeBSD 14-CURRENT was added, a boot issue for Bliss OS 15.x was fixed, a bug causing Fedora boot error when Ventoy partition is NTFS was fixed, recognition for NTFS with large cluster size (>64KB) was added, and grub2 mode process for legacy BIOS mode was improved.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.92 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.92, the release was deprecated due to a critical bug, and users were advised to use 1.0.93.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.93 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.93, a boot issue for Fedora/CentOS when file name contains special character was fixed, unattended auto install support for Deepin/UOS was added, a bug where unplugging the USB drive during installation could probabilistically install Ventoy to another disk was fixed, and EFI chainloader image device path was corrected.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.94 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.94, a Synchronous Exception on some ARM cpus was fixed.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.95 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.95, Ventoy2Disk.exe dialog width can now be dragged to resize, a bug when booting veket_24 was fixed, a bug when booting the latest UOS server ISO was fixed, and new distro support was added for vanilladpup and FydeOS 17.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.96 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.96, a bug where bootpwd was not working for VentoyPlugson was fixed, escaping for path in VentoyPlugson.sh was added, a warning prompt for Ventoy2Disk.sh was fixed, the issue that VTOY_LINUX_REMOUNT=1 does not work on some distros was fixed, and vtoyboot-1.0.30 was released.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.97 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.97, support for FreeBSD 14.0 was added, a Proxmox 8.1 boot issue was fixed, the VTOY_LINUX_REMOUNT option not working with latest linux kernel version was fixed, a VentoyPlugson issue where default_file value was wrong for more than 10 theme files was fixed, and vtoyboot-1.0.31 was released.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.98 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.98, EFI boot files were updated, the issue that Ext4 filesystem created with latest gparted could not be recognized was fixed, VTOY_LINUX_REMOUNT=1 not taking effect in RHEL9/CentOS9 was fixed, boot issues for latest archlinux and KAOS were fixed, and vtoyboot-1.0.35 was released.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.0.99 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.0.99, EFI boot files were updated to fix the 'Linpus Lite' error on some computers, the issue that VTOY_LINUX_REMOUNT could not take effect in latest openSUSE was fixed, and an issue when installing on /dev/mdX device was fixed.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.1.00 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.1.00, the Shim was updated to latest to fix verifying shim SBAT data failed, eweOS ISO support was added, the boot issue of SystemRescue 11.02+ was fixed, and some other bugfixes were included. chunks.title: Ventoy 1.1.01 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.1.01, the VTOY_LINUX_REMOUNT implementation was optimized to support all Linux distros, linux remount is now supported by default, and the VTOY_LINUX_REMOUNT option is deprecated.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.1.02 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.1.02, the 'Unsupported vtoy type unknown' error when booting a VDI file created by VBox7 was fixed, and vtoyboot-1.0.36 was released.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.1.03 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.1.03, the release was deprecated because it introduced a problem in the LinuxGUI version, while Windows and Linux CLI versions were OK.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.1.04 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.1.04, the 0x80070001 error when booting and installing Windows 11 was fixed, the issue that SLES/OpenSUSE could not boot after install in Ventoy grub2 mode was fixed, boot issues for pfSense 2.7.x and latest TinyCore Linux were fixed, and Ventoy2Disk.exe was updated.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.1.05 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.1.05, some resolution issues when booting some Windows/WinPE ISO in UEFI mode were fixed.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.1.06 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.1.06, TrueNAS Scale (Linux) distro support was added, xfs was updated to latest, boot issues for Parted Magic, Libreelec 12.2.0, and Tails 6.13+ were fixed, and an order issue in TreeView mode was fixed.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.1.07 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.1.07, an issue introduced in v1.1.06 where the Ventoy ISO partition could not be mounted after booting a linux distro was fixed.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.1.08 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.1.08, support for FreeBSD 15.0 was added, and the total tested ISO count reached 1300+.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.1.09 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.1.09, a boot issue for openSUSE 16.0 was fixed, experimental support for btrfs file system (NO RAID mode, ISO file cannot be compressed) was added, the persistence plugin not working for latest Arch Linux was fixed, and VentoyPlugson WebUI display bugs were fixed.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.1.10 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.1.10, Ventoy2Disk.sh gained musl libc environment support, a LinuxGUI program crash issue in wayland environment was fixed, boot issues with Kylin Server V11 and a Windows boot issue in F2 mode were fixed, vhd.vtoy file boot issue in ext4 file system was fixed, and support for AerynOS was added.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.1.11 release  (6th Anniversary Ver.)
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.1.11 (6th Anniversary Ver.), a display issue when UEFI booting Windows/WinPE ISO was fixed, VT_WINDOWS_DISK_NONVTOY_CLOSEST_XXX and VT_LINUX_DISK_NONVTOY_CLOSEST_XXX options were added in AutoInstall plugin, improvements were made to Ventoy2Disk.sh and porteus-hook.sh, booting T2SDE was improved, and support for KylinSecOS was added.

chunks.title: Ventoy 1.1.12 release
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the ventoy/Ventoy release v1.1.12, a bug causing ubuntu24.04.4 install failure was fixed, a VirtualBox UEFI display issue when booting Windows was fixed, UEFI boot Windows/WinPE resolution issue fix was improved, and an Oracle Linux 6.9 install issue was fixed.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent vercel/next.js release stream across canary prereleases and stable security/bugfix releases, covering core changes, Turbopack improvements, and misc updates.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.12
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.12, core changes include refactoring request store creation, detecting 'use cache' module-scope deadlocks early in dev, bundling the deadlock probe worker, supporting a default instant validation level, and upgrading React to dd453071-20260506. Misc changes involve Turbopack optimizations, documentation fixes, and CI clarifications.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.13
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.13, core changes disable instant validations in draft mode. Misc changes drop ReferencedAsset::from_resolve_result as a turbotask and improve Turbopack caching with a lazily created Notify instance.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.14
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.14, misc changes include shrinking JsValue from 64 to 32 bytes, ordering loader tree imports by tree depth, and making Turbopack vergen setup more strict.

chunks.title: v16.2.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.2.6, security fixes address multiple high, moderate, and low severity advisories including denial of service, middleware bypass, cross-site scripting, and cache poisoning. Core changes fix HTTP access fallbacks during prerender recovery, fallback route params, invalid HTML responses, setHeader patching, deployment id in cacheHandlers keys, and double-encoding of URL pathname parts.

chunks.title: v15.5.18
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v15.5.18, security fixes address high, moderate, and low severity advisories including denial of service, middleware bypass, cross-site scripting, and cache poisoning.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.15
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.15, core changes force ANSI colors on overlay code frames, match proxy matchers with webpack implementation, track searchParams access via Proxy, and cherry-pick GHSA commits. Misc changes include documentation fixes, test pinning, turbo-rcstr proc macro, Turbopack middleware matcher suffix fix, DynEffect value_hash change, and CI resilience.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.16
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.16, core changes hold cacheSignal across unstable_cache foreground revalidation and encode non-ASCII characters in cache tags at construction.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.17
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.17, core changes stabilize unstable_io, use Next.js version as Turbopack persistent cache versioning key, add chunkLoadingGlobal config option, fix devtools nested error rendering, improve rewrite detection during optimistic routing, fix type:module in project dir, and favor reported errors over missing slots in Instant Insights. Misc changes include trace-server improvements, task rescheduling, CI pinning, and removal of ineffective turbo-tasks.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.18
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.18, core changes remove redundant instant navigation prefetch header and favor reporting errors from all potential navigations over failed validation attempts when a slot is missing. Misc changes include CI speed improvements.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.19
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.19, misc changes introduce a proof of concept for task eviction after snapshot for turbo-tasks-backend.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.20
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.20, core changes fix feature usage telemetry, add an info panel for cache disabled indicator, convert test/integration to isolated tests, extend instant error overlay to metadata/viewport/sync IO errors, expose source file hashes to adapters, opt out of state preservation for bfcacheId, honor Suspense-above-body opt-in for dynamic generateViewport, add next internal static-routes-info CLI command, ensure ISR LRU is written if requests collapsed, fix catch-all router.query corruption, surface invalid dynamic usage errors via Flight, upgrade React to d5736f09-20260507, show inner use cache as cause of nested-dynamic cache error, fix server action forwarding loop, and provide filename for unvalidated boundary in Instant Insights. Example changes migrate cloudinary to vercel-blob. Misc changes include Turbopack NFT adjustments, repo skills, React 18 test fixes, documentation updates, test conversions, lock-order inversion fix, strongly consistent reads enforcement, worker_threads URL resolution fix, and various other fixes and improvements.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.21
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.21, core changes redesign the dev overlay with a cleaner shell and instant fix-card guidance. Misc changes trace middleware/proxy source files in webpack NFT pipeline.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.22
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.22, misc changes prioritize recomputed tasks with Recomputation priority in turbo-tasks.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.23
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.23, core changes add a graph-based CSS chunking algorithm behind experimental.cssChunking: graph. Misc changes convert more tests to nextTestSetup, emit assets before duplicate check, split og-api test suite, pass projectDir to adapter modifyConfig, distinguish in-navigation errors in instant error overlay, eval next.config export functions in try catch, and rename TaskExecutionReason::Initial to Root.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.25
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.25, misc changes enable mimalloc in benchmarks, fix subpath imports pointing to external packages, fix error reporting with crashing webpack loaders, add documentation for instrumentationClientInject, fix Yarn berry tests, polish instant fix cards and validation messages, add deployable tarballs to pack-next, fix devtools launch-editor for VS Code renamed macOS binary, implement task-storage memory wins, add backport PR skill, respect module-sync export condition, use action cache for passing tests, add devlow-bench percentile-based comparison and run retries, update @vercel/devlow-bench to 0.4.0, add test for prerendering HTTP access fallback pages with Cache Components, implement prerender HTTP access fallbacks with Cache Components semantics, and add experimental.appShells feature flag.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.27
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.27, misc changes add next-dev-loop and next-ppr-optimizer skills, migrate webdriver callers to next.browser, revert including PPR routes in dynamicRoutes regardless of revalidate time, fix pr-status job pagination, prerender static metadata under dynamic segments to canonical pathname, revamp instant navs devtools, and add Chromium-only Playwright image publisher.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.28
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.28, misc changes mark backport-pr and create-pr skills as internal.

chunks.title: v16.3.0-canary.29

Misc changes make available_modules an OperationVc, release @next/rspack-core 1.0.3, improve notFound recovery in error pathway, fix unsound IntoIterator for ReadRef<T>, skip installing native binaries when fetching test timings, reserve comments for stats and tests, add vocabulary-bridge rule for api-ref and guide skills, rework dynamic segments intro section, fix playwright-chromium Dockerfile, fix Firefox refresh loop on initial load of streaming pages in dev mode, upgrade React to 75b0945b-20260526, prefetch App Shells on the client, add AGENTS.md for GitHub Actions, add next/root-params API reference, document ISR with Cache Components and experimental.partialFallbacks, and resize tiny jobs in integration_tests_reusable.yml.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.32, misc changes fix short circuit evaluation of AND/OR in Turbopack analyzer for string & nullish-related methods, fix instrumentationClientInject with type:module, add test for static metadata files and generateStaticParams, and align issue triage guidance with automated behavior.

chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vercel/next.js release v16.3.0-canary.33, misc changes fix code examples in getting-started guides, implement streaming prerender for Cache Components, skip flaky instant-nav-panel tests, avoid unnecessary conversions to a stream, fix next-after-app-static test, propagate adapter preferred regions, update all actions/* dependencies, consolidate Resume Data Caches and partially revert #88556, fix 'use cache' bail-out under unstable_instant = false, use module graph for NFT, and always treat promises as truth-y and non-nullish in Turbopack analyzer.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent vikejs/vike release stream from v0.4.229 through v0.4.259, covering bug fixes, new features like +onData and +headersResponse, and minor breaking changes such as Vite 6+ and Node.js 20+ requirements.

chunks.title: v0.4.229
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.229, the release note includes bug fixes such as escaping a star in the pluginModuleBanner path, adding safe operations to decodeURI, fixing side exports errors, improving error messages for wrong getVikeConfig() usage, and addressing infinite rendering loops. It also updates @brillout/vite-plugin-server-entry to ^0.7.8 and adds warnings for unexpected Vitest setup.

chunks.title: v0.4.230
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.230, the release note introduces the +onData feature and tree-shaking of pageContext.isClientSide. Bug fixes include making local configs override global configs in Server Routing, preventing premature web stream closure, fixing configEntries and exportsAll for cumulative values, improving redirection support, and adding a new debug flag DEBUG=vike:resolve.

chunks.title: v0.4.231
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.231, the release note adds features +meta.isDefinedByPeerDependency and +require.optional, and includes bug fixes for applying +require earlier and simplifying the useConfig() serialization error message.

chunks.title: v0.4.232
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.232, the release note adds pre-rendering of static +redirects and includes numerous bug fixes such as allowing Vike extension configs at the root directory, avoiding build error swallowing, fixing HMR recovery upon config errors, and implementing HMR for +onCreateGlobalContext. A minor breaking change notes that pages/ directories are now ignored by config inheritance.

chunks.title: v0.4.233
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.233, the release note fixes the execution order of +onCreatePageContext to occur after routing, fixes pageContext.globalContext for +onBeforeRender and +data, and improves pre-rendered +redirects. A minor breaking change states that +onCreatePageContext is now called after routing.

chunks.title: v0.4.234
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.234, the release note contains a single bug fix to avoid an HMR preamble race condition.

chunks.title: v0.4.235
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.235, the release note fixes a bug to reload Vike config upon the addition of a new + file.

chunks.title: v0.4.236
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.236, the release note introduces features +headersResponse and pageContext.headersResponse, allows getGlobalContextSync() in production, and implements passToClient once. Bug fixes include eagerly setting globalContext, improving error messages for runtime code in config files, and preventing Google from crawling URLs in JSON.

chunks.title: v0.4.237
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.237, the release note includes bug fixes for modifyUrl() handling undefined search, executing onBeforeRoute() upon hydration, deprecating hook types and passToClient once setting, fixing globalContext re-initialization race condition, and supporting @cloudflare/vite-plugin. It also improves warnings about NODE_ENV and setup.

chunks.title: v0.4.238
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.238, the release note adds support for .clear.js and .default.js files. Bug fixes include avoiding empty any interfaces, enabling assertSetup again, ensuring globalContext is available early, and fixing build.outDir handling. Minor breaking changes require updating to Vite 6 or above, Node.js 20 or above, and updating Vike extensions.

chunks.title: v0.4.239
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.239, the release note introduces CSP support and +headersResponse(pageContext). Bug fixes include setting Cache-Control header for 5xx responses, ensuring proper replacement of __VIKE__IS_NON_RUNNABLE_DEV, and requiring correct Node.js version. A minor breaking change notes that very old vike-react/vike-vue/vike-solid versions are no longer supported.

chunks.title: v0.4.240
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.240, the release note adds globalContext.prerenderContext and starts using hook filters for performance. Bug fixes include HMR re-rendering the whole page if an error page is shown, fixing HMR in worker env, and removing the CJS build. A minor breaking change requires updating to Vite 6.3.0 or above.

chunks.title: v0.4.241
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.241, the release note introduces the +onError hook and +force (alias for Vite's --force). Bug fixes include adding info log upon rendering error page, enabling Vike extensions to override error logging, fixing serialization of non-JSON types, and supporting +data.server.js. Performance improvements remove debugging code in client-side production.

chunks.title: v0.4.242
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vikejs/vike release v0.4.242, the release note provides full-fledged support for third-party CLIs (Vite, Vite Plus, Vitest, Storybook) and fixes Vite's CLI args support. Bug fixes include allowing omission of vite.config.js for Vike-based frameworks and automatically loading globalThis.__VIKE__IS_* types. chunks.title: v0.4.243

chunks.title: v0.4.246

chunks.title: v0.4.247

chunks.title: v0.4.249

chunks.title: v0.4.254

chunks.title: v0.4.255

chunks.title: v0.4.256

chunks.title: v0.4.259

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent vllm-project/vllm release stream from v0.9.2rc2 through v0.22.0, covering engine migrations, hardware enablement, model additions, and performance optimizations.

chunks.title: v0.9.2rc2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.9.2rc2, the release note includes enabling fp8 support for pplx and BatchedTritonExperts, enabling V1 for Hybrid SSM/Attention Models, adding CUTLASS block scaled group gemm for SM100, re-adding fp32 support to v1 engine through FlexAttention, and various bug fixes and documentation updates.

chunks.title: v0.9.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.9.2, the release note highlights that this is the last version where V0 engine code and features stay intact, and recommends migrating to V1 engine. It introduces Priority Scheduling in V1, embedding models in V1, Mamba2 in V1, full CUDA-Graph execution for FlashAttention v3 and FlashMLA paths, FlexAttention updates, new model families including Ernie 4.5 and MiniMax-M1, Expert-Parallel Load Balancer (EPLB), disaggregated serving enhancements, NVIDIA Blackwell SM120 and SM100 optimizations, Intel GPU V1 backend with Flash-Attention support, AMD ROCm full-graph capture, Split-KV support in unified Triton Attention kernel, calibration-free RTN INT4/INT8 quantization pipeline, Compressed-Tensor NVFP4 support, new OpenAI-compatible audio endpoints, and various API, CLI, and deployment improvements.

chunks.title: v0.10.0rc1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.10.0rc1, the release note includes enabling fp8 support for pplx and BatchedTritonExperts, enabling V1 for Hybrid SSM/Attention Models, adding CUTLASS block scaled group gemm for SM100, re-adding fp32 support to v1 engine through FlexAttention, and various bug fixes and documentation updates.

chunks.title: v0.10.0rc2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.10.0rc2, the release note includes using AutoWeightsLoader for bart, supporting VLMs with transformers backend, enabling shared-memory based pipeline parallel for CPU backend, cleaning up iRoPE in V1, adding Nvidia ModelOpt config adaptation, and various bug fixes and performance improvements.

chunks.title: v0.10.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.10.0, the release note announces the beginning of V0 engine codebase cleanup, removing V0 CPU/XPU/TPU/HPU backends, long context LoRA, Prompt Adapters, Phi3-Small & BlockSparse Attention, and Spec Decode workers. It adds new model families including Llama 4 with EAGLE support and EXAONE 4.0, introduces experimental async scheduling, V1 engine improvements, multi-task support, RLHF support, enhanced caching, NVIDIA Blackwell/SM100 optimizations, new quantization support including MXFP4 for MoE models, OpenAI Responses API implementation, and various hardware and performance expansions.

chunks.title: v0.10.1rc1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.10.1rc1, the release note includes deduplicating Transformers backend code, supporting model loader plugins, officially supporting Emu3 with Transformers backend, updating flashinfer to v0.2.8, adding Expert Parallelism documentation, and various bug fixes and improvements.

chunks.title: v0.10.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.10.1, the release note deprecates V0 FA3 support and notes that FP8 kv-cache in V0 may have issues. It adds new model families including GPT-OSS and Command-A-Vision, official Eagle multimodal support, enhanced existing models, CUDA graph performance improvements, attention system advances, speculative decoding optimizations, NVIDIA Blackwell and RTX 5090 optimizations, AMD ROCm platform enhancements, and various engine core and hardware improvements.

chunks.title: v0.10.1.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.10.1.1, the release note is a critical bugfix and security release that fixes CUTLASS MLA Full CUDAGraph, limits HTTP header count and size, and removes use of eval() to convert unknown types.

chunks.title: v0.10.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.10.2, the release note includes a PyTorch 2.8.0 upgrade, V0 deprecations, and API changes. It features native aarch64 support for GB200 platform, new model families such as Apertus and LFM2, pipeline parallelism expansion, data parallelism for vision models, LoRA ecosystem expansion, V1 engine maturation, hybrid and Mamba model improvements, performance core improvements, multimodal enhancements, and various hardware and performance optimizations.

chunks.title: v0.11.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.11.0, the release note completes the removal of V0 engine, making V1 the only engine in the codebase. It turns on FULL_AND_PIECEWISE as the CUDA graph mode default, adds new architectures including DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp and Qwen3-VL series, introduces KV cache offloading with LRU management, Dual-Batch Overlap (DBO), and various hardware and performance improvements including DeepGEMM enabled by default and ROCm 7.0 support.

chunks.title: v0.11.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.11.1, the release note updates the default CUDA build to PyTorch 2.9.0+cu129, generalizes batch-invariant torch.compile support, fixes async scheduling correctness and stability issues, adds Anthropic API support with the /v1/messages endpoint, and includes various bug fixes and improvements.

chunks.title: v0.11.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.11.2, the release note includes 4 bug fixes on top of v0.11.1: a Ray multi-node fix, a false assertion fix with spec-decode and TP>2, an async-scheduling + FlashAttn MLA fix, and an SM100 CUTLASS MoE macro guard fix.

chunks.title: v0.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.12.0, the release note includes a PyTorch 2.9.0 upgrade, V0 deprecations including xformers backend, EAGLE speculative decoding improvements, significant performance optimizations including 18.1% throughput improvement from batch invariant BMM, AMD ROCm expansion with DeepSeek v3.2 and SparseMLA support, new model families, GPU Model Runner V2 (Experimental), Prefill Context Parallel (PCP) preparatory work, RLHF support, and various hardware and performance enhancements.

chunks.title: v0.13.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.13.0, the release note includes deprecation removals, PassConfig flag renames, and attention configuration changes. It adds new models including BAGEL and AudioFlamingo3, conditional compilation via compile_ranges, xxHash high-performance hash option, PrefixLM support for FlexAttention, batch invariance improvements, Model Runner V2 enhancements, NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra SM103 support, DeepSeek optimizations, and various large scale serving and disaggregated prefill/decode improvements.

chunks.title: v0.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.14.0, the release note enables async scheduling by default, requires PyTorch 2.9.1, removes deprecated quantization schemes, adds a gRPC server entrypoint, introduces --max-model-len auto, adds a model inspection view, and includes new model architectures such as Grok-2 and LFM2-VL, LoRA support expansion, CUTLASS MoE optimizations, and various engine core and hardware improvements.

chunks.title: v0.14.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.14.1, the release note is a patch release on top of v0.14.0 to address a few security and memory leak fixes.

chunks.title: v0.15.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.15.0, the release note adds new architectures including Kimi-K2.5 and Molmo2, enables async scheduling with pipeline parallelism, introduces Mamba prefix caching with block-aligned mode, adds session-based streaming input, expands LoRA support, sets FlashInfer MLA as the default MLA backend on Blackwell, and includes various hardware and performance improvements such as FP4 kernel optimization and AMD ROCm MoRI EP.

chunks.title: v0.15.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.15.1, the release note is a patch release with security fixes for CVE-2025-69223 and CVE-2026-0994, RTX Blackwell GPU fixes, new Step-3.5-Flash model support, torch.compile cold-start fix, and various bug fixes.

chunks.title: v0.16.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.16.0, the release note delivers 30.8% E2E throughput improvement from async scheduling + pipeline parallelism, introduces a WebSocket-based Realtime API, adds RLHF workflow improvements, Unified Parallel Drafting for speculative decoding, major XPU platform overhaul, new model architectures including GLM-OCR and Qwen3-ASR, and various engine core and hardware improvements.

chunks.title: v0.17.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.17.0, the release note upgrades to PyTorch 2.10.0, integrates FlashAttention 4 backend, matures Model Runner V2 with Pipeline Parallel and Decode Context Parallel, adds full Qwen3.5 model family support, introduces a new --performance-mode flag, adds Anthropic API compatibility, implements Weight Offloading V2 with Prefetching, and includes various model support and hardware improvements.

chunks.title: v0.17.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.17.1, the release note is a patch release on top of v0.17.0 that adds Nemotron 3 Super model support and includes fixes for TRTLLM fused MoE, nongated fused moe triton, EP for TRTLLM MoE FP8 backend, Mamba/Qwen3.5 SSM cache blocks, TRTLLM Block FP8 MoE Monolithic, and DSV3.2 MTP Indexer handling.

chunks.title: v0.18.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.18.0, the release note adds gRPC serving support, GPU-less render serving, NGram GPU speculative decoding, KV cache offloading improvements, Elastic Expert Parallelism Milestone 2, FlashInfer 0.6.6 update, Responses API streaming tool calls, online beam search for ASR, removes Ray as a default dependency, and includes new model architectures and various engine core and hardware improvements.

chunks.title: v0.18.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.18.1, the release note is a patch release on top of v0.18.0 that changes the default SM100 MLA prefill backend back to TRT-LLM, fixes mock.patch resolution failure on Python <= 3.10, disables monolithic TRTLLM MoE for Renormalize routing, pre-downloads missing FlashInfer headers in Docker build, and fixes DeepGemm E8M0 accuracy degradation for Qwen3.5 FP8 on Blackwell.

chunks.title: v0.19.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.19.0, the release note adds full Google Gemma 4 architecture support, zero-bubble async scheduling + speculative decoding, Model Runner V2 maturation with piecewise CUDA graphs for pipeline parallelism, ViT Full CUDA Graphs, general CPU KV cache offloading, DBO generalization, NVIDIA B300/GB300 support, Transformers v5 compatibility, and various model support and engine core improvements.

chunks.title: v0.19.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.19.1, the release note is a patch release on top of v0.19.0 with Transformers v5.5.3 upgrade and bug fixes for Gemma4 including streaming tool call fixes, quantized MoE support, Eagle3 support, LoRA adapter loading fix, tool parser fix, and token repetition fix.

chunks.title: v0.20.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.20.0, the release note adds initial DeepSeek V4 support, switches default CUDA to 13.0, upgrades to PyTorch 2.11, adds Python 3.14 support, runs on Transformers v5, adds new large models including Hunyuan v3 preview and Granite 4.1 Vision, sets FlashAttention 4 as default MLA prefill, introduces TurboQuant 2-bit KV cache, adds online quantization frontend, introduces vLLM IR, advances Model Runner V2, and includes a major MoE refactor series and various performance improvements.

chunks.title: v0.20.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.20.1, the release note is a patch release focused on DeepSeek V4 stabilization and performance improvements, including base model support, multi-stream pre-attention GEMM, BF16 and MXFP8 all-to-all support, PTX cvt instruction for FP32->FP4 conversion, integrated tile kernels, and various bug fixes.

chunks.title: v0.20.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.20.2, the release note is a small patch release with bug fixes for DeepSeek V4 sparse attention, DeepSeek V4 KV cache allocation, gpt-oss MXFP4 + torch.compile, and Qwen3-VL deepstack boundary check.

chunks.title: v0.21.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.21.0, the release note formally deprecates transformers v4 support, requires C++20-compatible compiler, integrates KV Offload with Hybrid Memory Allocator, adds speculative decoding with thinking budget, introduces TOKENSPEED_MLA backend on Blackwell, adds new model architectures including MiMo-V2.5 and Laguna XS.2, and includes various engine core and hardware improvements.

chunks.title: v0.22.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the vllm-project/vllm release v0.22.0, the release note delivers a major DeepSeek V4 hardening pass with dedicated model package and NVFP4 fused MoE support, advances Model Runner V2 toward default with Qwen3-dense oracle, adds experimental Rust frontend, improves batch invariance with Cutlass FP8 support for 28.9% end-to-end latency improvement, introduces multi-tier KV cache offloading framework, and includes new model architectures and various engine core and hardware improvements.
