prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent webpack/webpack release stream from v5.99.3 through v5.107.2, covering a series of bug fixes, performance improvements, and new features such as ES module output enhancements, CSS modules improvements, and experimental TypeScript support.

chunks.title: v5.99.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.99.3, the fix addresses dead control flow with deep nested if/else statements.

chunks.title: v5.99.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.99.4, the fix addresses the terminated state for if/else statements.

chunks.title: v5.99.5
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.99.5, the fix addresses control dead flow for labeled and blockless statements.

chunks.title: v5.99.6
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.99.6, fixes include respecting public path for ES modules, fixing generation of module for 'module' library when mixing commonjs and esm modules, always applying FlagDependencyExportsPlugin for libraries where required, faster logic for dead control flow, and TypeScript types.

chunks.title: v5.99.7
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.99.7, fixes include not skipping export generation for 'default' reexport, fixing module library export generation for reexport, avoiding module concatenation in child compilation for module library, ensuring HMR recovers gracefully when CSS module with error, respecting 'cause' of any errors and 'errors' of AggregateError in stats output, and adding missing '@types/json-schema' in types.

chunks.title: v5.99.8
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.99.8, fixes include a type error with latest '@types/node' and TypeScript types.

chunks.title: v5.99.9
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.99.9, fixes include HMR might fail if there are new initial chunks, destructuring namespace import with default, destructuring namespace import with computed-property, generating valid code for es export generation for multiple module entries, fixing public path issue for ES modules, asset modules work when lazy compilation used, eliminating unused statements in certain scenarios, fixing regression with location and order of dependencies, and TypeScript types.

chunks.title: v5.100.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.100.0, fixes include the case where an ES modules entry chunk depends on the runtime chunk hash, handling function exports in webpack module wrapper, ensuring dependent chunks are imported before startup and fixing duplicate export of 'default', generating lose closing brace when exports are unprovided, CleanPlugin doesn't unlink same file twice, fixing unexpected error codes from fs.unlink on Windows, and TypeScript types. Features include HMR support for ES modules output, ES module output mode fully supporting splitChunks when external variables and runtimeChunk are not set, support for 'using' keyword, implementation of tc39 Defer Module Evaluation (experimental), support for dynamic template literals expressions for 'new URL(...)', enabling ES modules worker chunk loading for Node.js targets, improved support for destructuring in DefinePlugin, and addition of VirtualUrlPlugin to support 'virtual:' scheme. Performance improvements include removing useless startup entrypoint runtime for ES modules output and caching 'new URL(...)' evaluate expression.

chunks.title: v5.100.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.100.1, fixes include tree-shaking unused ignored modules and compatibility with old Node.js versions for types.

chunks.title: v5.100.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.100.2, fixes include keeping consistent CSS order, dependency without the source order attribute must keep their original index, and keeping module traversal consistent across reexport scenarios. Performance improvements include extending importPhasesPlugin only when enable deferImport.

chunks.title: v5.101.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.101.0, fixes include concatenate optimization for ESM that caused undefined export, respecting the output.environment.nodePrefixForCoreModules option everywhere, respecting the output.importMetaName option everywhere, fixing await async dependencies when accepting them during HMR, and better TypeScript types. Features include colors helpers for CLI, enabling tree-shaking for ESM external modules with named imports, and adding the deferImport option to parser options. Performance improvements include fixing a regression in module concatenation after implementing deferred import support, fixing a potential performance issue in CleanPlugin, and avoiding extra require in some places.

chunks.title: v5.101.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.101.1, fixes include filtering deleted assets in processAdditionalAssets hook, HMR failure in defer module, emitting assets even if invalidation occurs again, exporting types for serialization and deserialization in plugins and exporting the ModuleFactory class, fixing the failure export of internal function for ES module chunk format, fixing GetChunkFilename failure caused by dependOn entry, fixing the import of missing dependency chunks, fixing when entry chunk depends on the runtime chunk hash, fixing module.exports bundle to ESM library, adjusting the time of adding a group depending on the fragment of execution time, fixing circle dependencies when require RawModule and condition of isDeferred, and tree-shakable module library should align preconditions of allowInlineStartup.

chunks.title: v5.101.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.101.2, fixes include syntax error when comment is on the last line, handling var declaration for createRequire, and distinguishing free variable and tagged variable.

chunks.title: v5.101.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.101.3, fixes include resolve execution order issue from extra await in async modules, avoiding empty block for unused statement, and collecting only specific expressions for destructuring assignment.

chunks.title: v5.102.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.102.0, features include static analyze for dynamic imports, support for 'import file from "./file.ext" with { type: "bytes" }' to get content as Uint8Array, support for 'import file from "./file.ext" with { type: "text" }' to get content as text, snapshot.contextModule to configure snapshots options for context modules, extractSourceMap option to implement loading source maps by comment, topLevelAwait experiment now stable, layers experiment now stable, and function matcher support in rule options. Fixes include conflicts caused by multiple concatenate modules, ignoring import failure during HMR update with ES modules output, keeping render module order consistent, preventing inlining modules that have 'this' exports, removing unused 'timeout' attribute of script tag, supporting UMD chunk format to work in web workers, improving CommonJs bundle to ES module library, using es-lexer for mjs files for build dependencies, fixing support __non_webpack_require__ for ES modules, properly handling external modules for CSS, AssetsByChunkName including assets from chunk.auxiliaryFiles, using createRequire only when output is ES module and target is node, and TypeScript types. Performance improvements include avoiding extra calls for snapshot, avoiding extra jobs for build dependencies, and moving import attributes to own dependencies.

chunks.title: v5.102.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.102.1, fixes include supporting extends with env for browserslist, supporting JSONP fragment format for web workers, fixing dynamic import support in workers using browserslist, fixing default defer import mangling, fixing default import of commonjs externals for SystemJS format, fixing context modules to the same file with different import attributes, fixing TypeScript types, improving import.meta warning messages to be more clear when used directly, and fixing CC_UPPER_U parsing (E -> U) in tokenizer for CSS.

chunks.title: v5.103.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.103.0, features include DotenvPlugin and top level dotenv option, WebpackManifestPlugin, support for ignoreList option in devtool plugins, allowing custom javascript parse function, import.meta.env support for environment variables, support for import.meta.dirname and import.meta.filename, support for import.defer() for statistical path, handling import.meta.main, support to setup named exports for JSON modules and disable usage named export for 'import file from "./file.json" with { type: "json" }', support for __dirname/__filename/import.meta.dirname/import.meta.filename for universal target, CSS exportType option with link, text, and css-style-sheet values, and CSS support for composes properties. Fixes include the dependOn chunk must be loaded before the common chunk, returning to namespace import when the external request includes a specific export, no runtime extra runtime code for module libraries, delaying HMR accept dependencies to preserve import attributes, properly handling external presets for universal target, fixing incorrect identifier of import binding for module externals, fixing when defer import and dynamic default export mixed, reducing generated output when globalThis supported, fixing loading async modules in defer import, reexport module for default import when no used exports for systemjs library, renaming HarmonyExportDependencyParserPlugin exported id to CompatibilityPlugin tagged id, handling __dirname and __filename for ES modules, renaming single nested __webpack_export__ and __webpack_require__ in already bundled code, webpack function type, NormalModule type, multi compiler configuration type, fixing regression in custom hashDigest type, no extra runtime for initial chunk for CSS, and fixing a lot of CSS modules bugs.

chunks.title: v5.104.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.104.0, minor changes include using method shorthand to render module content in __webpack_modules__ object, enhancing import.meta.env to support object access, optimizing dependency sorting in updateParent, handling more at-rules for CSS modules, adding options to control renaming of at-rules and identifiers in CSS modules, adding base64url, base62, base58, base52, base49, base36, base32 and base25 digests, providing a stable runtime function variable __webpack_global__, and improving localIdentName hashing for CSS. Patch changes include adding module existence check for informative error message in development mode, using fully qualified class name for [fullhash] placeholder in CSS modules, supporting universal lazy compilation, fixing module library export definitions when multiple runtimes, fixing CSS nesting and CSS custom properties parsing, not writing fragment from URL to filename and applying fragment to module URL, fixing bugs for css/global type, compatibility of import.meta.filename and import.meta.dirname with eval devtools, handling nested __webpack_require__, improving speed of identifier parsing, improving types, not corrupting debugId injection when hidden-source-map is used, re-validating HttpUriPlugin redirects against allowedUris, serializing HookWebpackError, adding ability to use built-in properties in dotenv and define plugin, optimizing regular expression character class by specifying ranges for runtime code, reducing collision for local indent name in CSS, and removing CSS link tags when CSS imports are removed.

chunks.title: v5.104.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.104.1, patch changes include fixing reexports runtime calculation not accessing __WEBPACK_IMPORT_KEY__ decl with var, and fixing a user information bypass vulnerability in the HttpUriPlugin plugin.

chunks.title: v5.105.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.105.0, minor changes include allowing resolving worker module by export condition name when using new Worker(), detecting conditional imports to avoid compile-time linking errors for non-existent exports, adding tsconfig option for resolver options, supporting import.defer() for context modules, adding support for array values to devtool option, improving rendering node built-in modules for ECMA module output, and unknown import.meta properties now determined at runtime instead of statically analyzed. Patch changes include fixing ESM default export handling for .mjs files in Module Federation, optimizing import.meta.env handling in destructuring assignments, respecting stats.errorStack option in stats output, fixing a bug where declaring a module variable in module scope would conflict with default moduleArgument, fixing VirtualUrlPlugin to set resourceData.context for proper module resolution, fixing Worker self-import handling to support various URL patterns, reusing the same async entrypoint for the same Worker URL within a module, fixing a bug where a self-referencing dependency would have an unused export name when imported inside a web worker, and fixing missing export generation when concatenated modules in different chunks share the same runtime in module library bundles.

chunks.title: v5.105.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.105.1, patch changes include fixing VirtualUrlPlugin Windows compatibility by sanitizing cache keys and filenames, reverting part of the createRequire generation behavior for require("node:...") to keep compatibility, and skipping guard collection when exports-presence mode is disabled to improve parsing performance.

chunks.title: v5.105.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.105.2, patch changes include fixing WebpackPluginInstance type regression.

chunks.title: v5.105.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.105.3, patch changes include context modules now handle rejections correctly, only marking asset modules as side-effect-free when experimental.futureDefaults is set to true, adding missing __webpack_exports__ declaration in certain cases when bundling a JS entry together with non-JS entries, fixing HMR failure for CSS modules with @import when exportType !== "link", fixing an issue where empty JavaScript files were generated for CSS-only entry points, not crashing when a referenced chunk is not a runtime chunk, fixing some types, ensuring that missing module error are thrown after the interception handler, adding createRequire support for ECMA modules, adding category for CJS reexport dependency to fix issues with ECMA modules, implementing immutable bytes for bytes import attribute to match tc39 spec, and fixing deterministic search for graph roots regardless of edge order.

chunks.title: v5.105.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.105.4, patch changes include adding Module.getSourceBasicTypes to distinguish basic source types, handling createRequire in expressions, fixing types for multi stats, removing empty needless js output for normal css module, updating enhanced-resolve to support new features for tsconfig.json, and narrowing export presence guard detection to explicit existence checks on namespace imports only.

chunks.title: v5.106.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.106.0, minor changes include adding exportType: "style" for CSS modules to inject styles into DOM via HTMLStyleElement, adding context option support for VirtualUrlPlugin, generating different CssModule instances for different exportType values, adding localIdentHashFunction option to configure hash function for hashing, adding support for destructuring assignment require in cjs for tree shaking, adding validate option to enable/disable validation in webpack/plugins/loaders, and adding source support for async WASM modules. Patch changes include adding a static getSourceBasicTypes method to Module class, including fragment groups in conflicting order warning for CSS, avoiding rendering unused top-level __webpack_exports__ declaration when output ECMA module library, fixing resolving in CSS modules, allowing external modules place in async chunks when output ECMA module, implementing deprecate flag in schema for better TypeScript support, setting .name to "default" for anonymous default export functions and classes per ES spec, hashing entry chunks after runtime chunks to prevent stale content hash references in watch mode, and fixing multiple bugs and optimizations in CSS modules.

chunks.title: v5.106.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.106.1, patch changes include fixing two ES5-environment regressions in the anonymous default export .name fix-up, preventing !important from being renamed as a local identifier in CSS modules, and using compiler context instead of module context for CSS modules local ident hashing to avoid hash collisions.

chunks.title: v5.106.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.106.2, patch changes include CSS @import now inherits the parent module's exportType, making asset modules available in JS context when referenced from both CSS and a lazily compiled JS chunk, including missing generator options in hash to ensure persistent cache invalidation, fixing || default value handling in ProgressPlugin and ManifestPlugin, migrating from mime-types to mime-db, handling @charset at-rules in CSS modules, and marking all experimental options in types.

chunks.title: v5.107.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.107.0, minor changes include adding module.generator.javascript.anonymousDefaultExportName option to control .name setting for anonymous default exports, supporting module concatenation for CSS modules with text, css-style-sheet, style, and link export types, generator.exportsConvention function form for CSS modules now accepts string[] in addition to string, adding linkInsert hook to CssLoadingRuntimeModule, adding CssModulesPlugin.getCompilationHooks(compilation).orderModules hook, adding a pure parser option for css/module and css/auto types, supporting CSS Modules @value identifiers as @import URLs and inside url() functions, adding experimental TypeScript support via experiments.typescript: true, adding an experiments.html flag that reserves the html module type, preserving defer / source import phase keywords on external dependencies in ESM output, supporting the #__NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__ annotation to mark functions as pure for better tree-shaking, and adding module.generator.html.extract option to extract HTML into separate files.

chunks.title: v5.107.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.107.1, patch changes include aligning the experimental HTML tokenizer with the WHATWG spec, tree-shaking CommonJS modules imported through a const NAME = require(LITERAL) binding when only static members are read, fixing RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded on long linear chains of side-effect-free imports, fixing NormalModuleFactory parser/generator types, linking import bindings used inside define(...) callbacks in ES modules, and fixing runtime ReferenceError on the first activation of a lazy-compiled module when output.library.type produces a closure-wrapped bundle.

chunks.title: v5.107.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the webpack/webpack release v5.107.2, patch changes include reducing per-file overhead in ContextModuleFactory.resolveDependencies by batching alternativeRequests hook calls, including each external info's runtimeCondition in ConcatenatedModule#updateHash, fixing HTML [contenthash] for referenced asset and inline-style URL changes, resolving chunk-hash placeholders in chunk URLs embedded into extracted HTML, removing unnecessary __webpack_require__ runtime helpers in ESM library output with multi-module chunks, rewriting NormalModule#getSideEffectsConnectionState walk as an allocation-light iterative loop, fixing runtime ReferenceError on the first activation of a lazy-compiled module when output.library.type produces a closure-wrapped bundle, filling in missing entryOptions when an async block joins an existing entrypoint, and releasing per-child codeGenerationResults in MultiCompiler and at Compiler.close to reduce memory retention.

v0.5.0 removes Docker Swarm content, while v1.1.0 adds Docker Swarm content.
Both releases only fix typos and formatting.
v0.5.0 introduces Docker CE v17.MM revision, while v1.1.0 introduces Docker CE v19.x revision.

prototypes.window_summary: This window tracks the recent yewstack/yew release stream from v0.10.0 through v0.23.0, including associated yew-agent and yew-router releases. It captures major feature additions, breaking changes, and fixes across the evolution of the Yew framework.

chunks.title: v0.10
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.10.0, the project introduces Future support allowing a Component to update after a Future completes, adds agent and services features that can be disabled, adds a ref keyword for direct element references, makes Agent-related types public, updates wasm-bindgen to 0.2.54, fixes mount order of components, ensures all public items implement Debug, bumps minimum rustc to 1.39.0, requires a view method on Component and renames Renderable::view to render, removes the Transferable trait, and changes WebSocketService::connect to return a Result.

chunks.title: v0.11.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.11.0, the project lays groundwork for component libraries and cleans up the API toward 1.0. It introduces a new callback syntax requiring explicit creation via ComponentLink, renames send_self to send_message, send_back to callback, response to respond, and AgentUpdate to AgentLifecycleEvent, drops the generic type parameter from Html<Self> to Html, requires properties to implement Clone, adds html_nested! macro, adds bincode format support, and adds a noop() convenience method to Callback.

chunks.title: v0.12.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.12.0, the project improves ergonomics for html! for loops, adds #[props(default = "fn_path")] for default property values, exposes macros for creating format types, adds binary-only and text-only format support in WebSocketService, implements PartialEq for ChildrenRenderer, reduces restrictions on ComponentLink methods for Future support, adds referrer, referrer_policy and integrity to FetchOptions, fixes touch event listeners, fixes ref behavior on Components, fixes ResizeTask cancellation, switches from failure to anyhow/thiserror, removes cancel from Task trait in favor of Drop, and renames NodeRef.try_into to NodeRef.cast.

chunks.title: v0.13.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.13.0, the project adds web-sys support while maintaining stdweb support via feature flags, introduces Properties 2.0 where properties are required unless annotated with a default, fixes a Component children re-rendering bug, fixes panics when interacting with agents and when a component with a root VRef node is detached, fixes a warning when a component with a root VTag node is detached, changes Properties macro behavior, cleans up exported APIs and doc visibility, and makes ReaderService, FetchService, and StorageService methods return Result instead of panicking.

chunks.title: v0.13.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.13.1, the project provides a fix for web-sys version 0.3.36.

chunks.title: v0.13.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.13.2, the project fixes a clippy warning when building with the web_sys feature.

chunks.title: v0.14.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.14.0, the project implements Clone for WebSocketStatus, improves ergonomics for message APIs by accepting Into<Msg>, improves html! compiler messages and flexible syntax for with props, fixes a panic in stdweb ResizeService event handling, removes build check for OS compatibility, fixes interval and timer usage in web-sys workers, sends Connected message for Public agents, fixes web-sys Public/Private agent initialization, fixes websocket text message handling for web-sys agents, changes FetchError::FetchFailed to wrap a String, and makes message APIs accept Into<Msg> causing potential compile errors with msg.into().

chunks.title: v0.14.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.14.1, the project fixes an issue where the Connected message was only called for the first bridge creation.

chunks.title: v0.14.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.14.2, the project fixes an issue where components were rendered out of order and resets the Select component correctly in Firefox and Edge.

chunks.title: v0.14.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.14.3, the project removes html! component validation to allow generic components, improves Debug formatting for VTag and VText, and implements Default for Callback.

chunks.title: v0.15.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.15.0, the project switches to web-sys by default and provides a yew-stdweb alias crate for stdweb users, adds support for single use callbacks, updates the scheduler to eagerly destroy components, adds key attribute support for rendering performance, splits class names on whitespace when passed within tuple or Vec, moves the components module out to yew-components, replaces the mounted lifecycle method with rendered, requires components to implement the change method, and builds with web-sys by default.

chunks.title: v0.16.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.16.0, the project adds optional id, class, and placeholder properties to the Select component, re-exports web-sys from Yew, adds support for Option wrapped class names, adds get_parent and get_component methods to ComponentLink, fixes a bug that caused html class attributes to be set to an empty string, fixes Private worker lifecycle event sending, and bumps the minimum supported Rust version to 1.40.0.

chunks.title: v0.16.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.16.1, the project fixes worker script loading to use an absolute path and improves html! macro error messages.

chunks.title: v0.16.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.16.2, the project fixes a regression where messages sent from Component::create were skipped.

chunks.title: v0.17.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.17.0, the project allows agents to send input messages to themselves, improves rendering performance by ~20%, allows dynamic tag names in html! via @{..}, allows specifying HTML button type, makes all global event listeners usable, implements PartialEq for VChild, improves agent callback ergonomics, loosens bincode dependency version, fixes keyed list ordering, fixes key and ref handling for components with no properties, makes list rendering behavior consistent, allows preventing default behavior on KeyboardService events, checks current DOM input value before comparing, disallows children on void elements, removes Serializable requirement for local agents, makes renders lazy, makes ConsoleService and other service methods static, removes Renderable implementation from Children, stops event propagation by default, changes onsubmit listener to use FocusEvent, and removes onmousewheel and ontouchenter listeners.

chunks.title: v0.17.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.17.1, the project fixes a regression where the component rendered lifecycle method was called before children components finish rendering.

chunks.title: v0.17.2
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.17.2, the project implements Deref<Target = str> for Key, fixes uncontrolled input values being cleared on render, and reverts the lazy rendering behavior introduced in 0.17.0 so that Yew renders the component between each update.

chunks.title: v0.17.4
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.17.4, the project fixes a "call stack exceeded" panic that occurred if a Component was updated many times.

chunks.title: v0.17.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.17.3, the project adds a prompt function to DialogService, implements From<&[T]> for Classes, adds batch_callback_once to ComponentLink, fixes Properties derive with default type params, improves html! compile error messages for invalid list fragments, and processes batch component updates more efficiently.

chunks.title: v0.18.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release 0.18.0, the project fixes missing redirects, removes the Drop bound from the Task trait, enables the std feature for indexmap, adds implicit optional attributes, adds callback_future_once in yewtil, adds relevant examples section to docs, adds missing KeyboardService re-export, renames internal Agent structs to match Component, adds discussion link to issue selector, updates link to Material Design Components, extracts Classes to a separate macro, improves the keyed_list example, adds documentation for component children, and adds a macro for building properties outside of html!.

chunks.title: yew-agent-v0.1.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release yew-agent-v0.1.0, the project fixes an unmaintained anymap dependency, fixes clippy lints from 1.54.0, fixes a crash in link to destroyed agents, allows web worker resource to be relative, adds a use_bridge hook for agents, uses functions from gloo_utils, adds missing web-sys features, updates dependencies, and drops the Private worker handler when the bridge is dropped.

chunks.title: yew-router-v0.16.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release yew-router-v0.16.0, the project fixes some router behavior, fixes multiple field enum tokens, fixes clippy lints from 1.54.0, fixes router issues, updates nom to 6.1.2, adds missing router docs, uses base url for href of links, uses functions from gloo_utils, updates Yew Router, updates dependencies, adds a replace route call, adds shorthand syntax for props, adds requirement for braces around most props, cleans up and optimizes router, applies Clippy lints, rewrites router, adds missing licenses, updates Rust version for macro tests, and adds support for unit struct in Properties derive.

chunks.title: yew-v0.19.3
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release yew-v0.19.3, the project attempts to fix recursion on display, fixes default passive option, fixes trybuild, fixes event handler during capture phase, fixes VTag reuse to reset ancestor NodeRef, fixes IntoEventCallback over IntoPropValue, removes underscore prefix on fn parameters, fixes rust-analyzer warnings, fixes clippy lints from 1.54.0, fixes scheduler main queue delay, fixes case warning on derived properties, fixes inability to set the autoplay attribute, fixes duplicate with props error messages, removes extra braces in html_nested macro, removes unused punct field from props, checks event bubbling cancellation at each step, adds possibility to cancel bubbling, adds ability to add child nodes conditionally in html!, adds basic lints to the HTML macro, refactors use ref hooks, implements portals, allows Classes properties from string literals, uses functions from gloo_utils, provides reliable use_reducer dispatch and use_state setter, adds custom type for attribute values, removes trailing semicolon in macro used in expression position, and adds set_if_neq for UseStateHandle.

chunks.title: yew v0.21.0, yew-router v0.18, yew-agent 0.2.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release yew-v0.21.0, the project includes various documentation updates, dependency bumps, fixes dead links, points docs links to stable versions, fixes clippy::let_unit_value lint, mentions certain components must be children of Router, makes Classes cheap to clone, fixes top-level reconciliation in portals, asserts no circular references, consolidates publish workflows, updates migration docs, updates benchmark crates and workflow, and other maintenance tasks.

chunks.title: yew-agent-v0.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release yew-agent-v0.4.0, the release notes refer to the main yew v0.22.0 release notes.

chunks.title: yew v0.22.0, yew-router v0.19.0, yew-agent v0.4.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release yew-v0.22.0, the project raises MSRV to 1.84.0, allows setting JsValue as properties, removes deprecated class=(...) syntax, removes ToHtml trait, makes <textarea> a void element, adds for-loops to html! macro, renames #[function_component] to #[component], adds serde feature, adds use_ref hook, improves ImplicitClone ergonomics, preserves camelCase for known SVG elements, adds inert to boolean attributes, adds namespace support for VRaw, adds to_callback methods, allows converting ChildrenRenderer<VNode> and VChild to VList, adds CallbackRef, allows import of layout_test, adds WASI support for SSR, makes UseFutureHandle Clone, allows Self in prop fields, allows boolean in html!, fixes panic when hydrating components with unstable render order, fixes hydration panic on camelCased elements, fixes autocompletion in html macro for rust-analyzer, fixes empty lists hydration failure, silences non-normalised element name warnings for SVG elements, fixes inconsistent clone() requirement for Classes, fixes svg animation always starting immediately, provides better diagnostics for byte literals in html!, concise diagnostics for missing props, uses namespace when xmlns attributes are specified, fixes generic type missing errors in hooks, better duplicate key diagnostics, fixes autocompletion in html macro, fixes clippy::multiple_bound_locations lint in #[hook], avoids unnecessary scheduling, removes dependency on boolinator, avoids string copy for Key, switches to tokise from tokio, simplifies use_future_with, and includes documentation improvements.

chunks.title: yew-v0.22.1
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release yew-v0.22.1, the project fixes Domslot hydration panic caused by suspension, allows some Option<T> and &T types as children again, makes custom hooks compile in edition 2024, fixes stale states in callbacks when multiple events fire rapidly, fixes invisible svg issue on Chrome when included with from_html_unchecked, fixes a documentation typo, improves SSR example with meta rendering, replaces once_cell with std equivalents, updates rust dependencies, and notes a known bug where calling UseStateHandle::set on a handle passed from a parent does not re-render the child.

chunks.title: yew-router v0.20.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release yew-router-v0.20.0, the project pins Yew to 0.23, fixes '/' encoding in wildcard route segments, and fixes a url corruption issue causing redirection to /basename//basename.

chunks.title: yew-agent v0.5.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release yew-agent-v0.5.0, there are no changes and Yew is pinned to 0.23.

chunks.title: yew v0.23.0
chunks.memory_unit_text: In the yewstack/yew release yew-v0.23.0, the project makes use_reducer skip re-rendering for the same Rc, allows &str and String for Option<Html> props, adds a scheduler::flush function for testing, fixes broken child re-renders while setting parents' states, allows bare Nones for Option<T> props in html! macro, and improves the scheduler to yield to the main thread for better responsiveness.

questions.query_text: Across the yewstack/yew releases, how does the rendering behavior change from release 0.17.0 to release 0.17.2?

options.text: 0.17.0 introduces lazy rendering where renders are not executed until all updates are processed, while 0.17.2 reverts this behavior so that Yew renders the component between each update.
0.17.0 makes renders eager, while 0.17.2 introduces lazy rendering.
Both releases use the same rendering strategy.
0.17.0 removes rendering entirely, and 0.17.2 adds it back.

questions.expected_answer: 0.17.0 introduces lazy rendering where renders are not executed until all updates are processed, while 0.17.2 reverts this behavior so that Yew renders the component between each update.

answer_support.answer_text: Renders are now done lazily and will not be executed until all updates have been processed.
Revert lazy rendering behavior introduced in 0.17.0. Yew will render the component between each update.
